You simply remove them from the package, connect via Bluetooth, insert in the ears, and start listening to your favorite tunes. There are no wires so you can move around as you please and because they are so small, you don’t have the bulkiness. Many people, unless they take a close look at you, will not even know that you are using earphones.

Of course, what matters most with something like this is the sound quality and these earphones score above average marks for sound. The bass is especially good and I like that I can pause, skip music, take calls, etc with a simple push of the touchpads. And to charge, you just place them back into the case. They claim to last up to 20 hours on a charge, but I haven’t come even close to using them for that much time, so I cannot verify the claim.

Soundcore Amker Liberty True Wireless Earphones do not provide any way to control the volume using touch controls, so this is one issue I have with them. But other than that, these are very good earphones and certainly worth a try

title: One of the Best Headsets Around
review:
Corsair 1100 Gaming Headset is a very nice headset with many good reasons to consider it for purchase. It is manufactured by a company known for its quality headsets and this latest model is every bit as good as many from Corsair's past.

Taking a close look at this headset, the first positive aspect is the appearance. It is very modern, slick, and cool- the type that most anyone would not mind wearing, just because it looks so good. The comfort level is very good too, with just the right amount of cushioning and lightweight design.

Most important to many is the sound quality and what you get with this Corsair headset is excellent. The sound is crisp, clear, and among the best I have ever used. No matter what type of sound is flowing through the wires, it enters your ears sounding the way it should, without any fuzziness or interference. Even when you try different sounds, music, etc., it still sounds excellent.

Most products have at least one potential flaw but with this Corsair headset, I am hard- pressed to find any thing wrong or anything I would change. Okay, it would be nice if it was priced a little lower, but with quality like this- both in comfort and in the sound- a few extra dollars is certainly money well invested.

title: For the money they stay on while exersicing and sound decent.
review: I have purchased 6 different kinds of headsets trying to find that correct fit for when I exercise. I run 8 - 10 miles at a time so earbuds fall out when I sweat.  I threw out my Sony (ear wrap) headphones before my last run out of frustration. They won't stay in so it sounds like a walkie talkie at best.  Yesterday I stopped at Walgreen's and picked up the IHIP head phones.  FINALLY!!!  A headphone that stays.  They are a solid fit and for $16 the sound is just fine.  Surprised to see the other ratings so low.  If you want something that will stay in at an affordable cost then this is a 5 star product. I also saw a complaint about bass.  I was listening to BassNectar on my run and honestly it sounded just fine. I'm a fan for the price.

title: They ended my earphone drama! Pretty GOOD
review:
I have a collection of earphones and none were quite right for running on my treadmill. I just broke a pair of Bose, which worked well for the treadmill, with a high power fan I needed something to block all that noise and not keep re-adjusting them while running and possibly killing myself.
I didn't want to shell out another $100 because I don't treat them well, they are always either hanging off the treadmill or somewhere at the bottom of my bag.
Anyway, these are pretty GOOD! they stayed put and blocked out the noise! really for the price I think these are awesome.
I would like to mention what others have mentioned the cord is too long for running at least on the treadmill, but over all
I highly recommend these.

title: Just the thing!
review: So nice to be able to pop this on and do laundry or cook without hanging up or disrupting the conversation with back ground noise. The microphone works great - people on the other end hear me clearly and cannot tell that I'm on a headset.

title: Great, but one major flaw
review: The sound quality is fantastic.  I like that they aren't hurting the inside of my ears like the buds do and i like that they are usb-c charging so i only have to have the one cord with me for trips. But the fact that you can't adjust the wire in the back is a major flaw.  I have a small head I guess.  When I put these on and lean back on the couch or in the car, the wire pushes the headphones almost up to my eyeballs. I'm considering not even keeping them if they can't be used sitting or laying down.

title: Still overly snug, but very worth it
review: I'm hard to please when it comes to wireless earbuds.  I've got a dozen or so mostly samsung and a couple of random purchases.  But anker's battery life blows them all away.  My phone's microphone is not functioning well, so I use ear buds pretty constantly.  I would have to charge the other ones daily, sometimes more than once.  With these I'm charging the case about once a week and the buds about once a day.  And they are usb-c, so that helps immensely with travel and only having to bring one type of charger with me. I was a little nervous about getting a renewed pair, but these have been perfect.

title: Sort of worth it
review:
*Update* after trying to use these for a few days, I'm disappointed. They are great except that they won't stay in my ears. There's nothing to hold them in place. They are okay for emergency use, but only if I'm using just the right one and I'm laying on my left side so it stays in.

I've got several versions of Samsung wireless earbuds. I get a new set about every other year. The case on these is about the size of two samsung charging cases put together. It's just massive. But it charged quickly and the wireless charging works just fine. I called my mother to test the call quality since she is the most discerning about my earbud call quality and she was impressed at the quality for the cost. My galaxy buds were a refurbished buy from Best Buy and she could never understand me when I used them (no one else really had a problem hearing me with them). The galaxy buds live has good sound and call quality, but very poor battery life and comfort in use. They always popped out of my ears if I smiled or laughed and they pushed against that little flap and caused pain.
So far, these little things are doing pretty good. I have weird shaped ear canals so the left one didn't hold in very well (but it almost never does with any of these) but, the right one is holding in good. I'm not thrilled with the shape because it's hard to know where to line it up, but for the money, I'm sold.

title: Worthwhile purchase for certain.
review:
Great bluetooth headphones. My family and friends say they can hear me on these better than any other bluetooth i have had.
Bought this because I'm having software issues on my s7 that are causing a microphone glitch and could only have a conversation when the speaker was on, and these have solved my problem of not being able to have a private conversation anymore so i am okay waiting for a software update to fix the glitch.
Come on Samsung, i know you know about this glitch, shake a leg getting it fixed please.

title: Best Earbuds Ever!
review: These earbuds are the best ever! I've tried a few brands, lots of Apple, and none compete with these earbuds. Most of all because they are so ergonomic / comfortable. The wires go over the top of your ears and the wire molds to your ear however you adjust it. So the earbuds never fall out and all the weight is taken off your ear canal area. They are also low profile and I can even comfortably lay with my head/ear on a pillow. The microphone works great for phone calls. And the buttons are marked and with 3 individual buttons so it's easy to know which one you're pushing without looking. I also love the shirt clip, minor as that may seem. Makes using the buttons much easier. I've only had these earbuds about a week. They seem sturdy. I'll update my review if they stop working. This will be my go-to earbud from now on!! Love them!!

title: Beautiful Sound & Comfy!
review: Super comfy and awesome sound!! Such an upgrade from my Apple earbuds!! 100% love.

title: Excellent bluetooth, crappy lifespam!
review: I love this headset, but it has lasted about 18 months! Today it is dead. It sounds like it is shorting out, I get sound off and on out of both sides. Before this, crisp clear, best bluetooth I have ever used. HOWEVER, seriously, that's the best we can hope for in electronics?? 18 months of use? To address the obvious, no, I didn't drop it in water, wear it in the shower, stomp on it, or use it as a boomerang. I am a careful user.

title: Good product
review: Good product. I got this so I could listen to music on my PC at work. When I first tried using it, the sound was a bit odd. Like tin. The ear buds that I was using sounded fine on their own. But I changed out the ear buds and the sound was better. So there was just something strange about that particular cord and earbud combo.

title: Great!
review: Works great at the office. When I have my headphones on, I can see if someone is behind me.

title: Great
review:
I like this a lot and have had it for about 6 weeks now. Very easy to set up. I just made it searchable and it took my phone about 5 seconds to find it and set it up automatically. The quality of the unit seems to be good so I expect it will last a while. It does come with only one ear hook so be careful as I have heard that replacements are expensive.

The quality of the sound is very good. Each charge has lasted about 4 days so far. My online usage is not very heavy so much of that time the unit is on standby.

I would recommend the Samsung WEB470 headset.

title: Not easy to wash
review:
I bought these because I was coming up on a surgery and needed headphones that would help me sleep since hospitals are so noisy overnight. These are perfect, especially for the price!
My boyfriend tried them and asked me to buy him a pair immediately!!!!

UPDATE: Needed to wash the band and it was very difficult to take apart. The earbuds don’t just slide out. And it was impossible to put them back together :(
Had to toss them. Otherwise I would give it 5 stars

title: Two Stars
review: They are headphones that perform very poorly with regards to other headphones I have purchased from Amazon.

title: Great Wireless Earbuds
review: Great sound quality. They fit perfectly and are very comfortable. It includes four different sizes of ear caps. It’s so nice to be able to wear earbuds that don’t hurt my ears while keep other voices or noises out. The price is great for such amazing quality.

title: Love the inside
review: There is netting on the inside on one side. I love that for my headphones however on the other side you could put cash or a car key. This is the perfect small case for its hard outer shell and it's nicely designed interior. I find that the outside scratches easily but the inside stays safe. Worth the price. Case not waterproof!

title: Ears very comfortable
review: I needed a new pair of headphones because my last pair melted. I got these mainly for the white purple color scheme. But my fiance said to buy turtle beach ones for the quality. So I paid a little more than my last ones and I love these they have such comfortable ear cushions the best I've ever had. I love the design of the mic as well for its simplicity. Plus the wire is very well made, it feels durable.

title: Wife needed another pair
review: Ok no other earphones are like the apple buds.  they just work and no stress.  Happy wife happy life.

title: great headphones for the price
review: These headphones cancel a fair amount of noise and are still comfortable enough to wear for a long period of time (three or four hours at a time).  They do not cancel as much noise as my Bose headphones, but I expected that considering the price difference.  These are great for covering up nearby office noise at work. I am on the smaller side, and these headphones did not slide off my head.

title: Horrible.  Don't waste the money.
review: I really do not like these headphones.  I usually have to find smaller size headphones to fit over my head, and these are only a little too big.  But they have a very awkward shape, so the bottom of the ear part sticks out away from my ears.  I have worn them for an hour today and constantly had to put them back in place.  They kept falling off my head.  Sound quality is also not very good.  I had to turn the volume up very loudly just to hear what is being played, and the audio still sounded like it was coming through a tin can.

title: Really impressed after 2 years!
review:
I have been using these headphones on and off for about 2 years. Received them from Otium as a replacement for something I don't recall, but at that time, I was really impressed with the sound quality and the NC feature. Changed jobs a few times and didn't really get to use these until covid and I started working from home. I rediscovered these headphone and was again surprised and impressed how well they sounded.

I think the best part I like about it is that the sound is really well-balanced. It's not a studio quality headphone, but to listen to streaming music while working, with just enough bass and a good mix of mid and high is really a boost to the mind while working on complex computer codes. I like the ear pads because it covers my whole ear and the passive NC is very effective. I tried to turn the ANC on a few times, it lowers the volume and I think produces the counter frequency. I find that a bit uncomfortable.

Overall material and construction is first class. I like the case and it's sitting in a shelf somewhere. I bought a little standing headphone holder from Amazon for cheap and the headphone cradles it quite nicely.

Now if it could only give a neck massage too! ahahahaah!

title: Fantastic buds!
review: I used to think name brand products are a big hype! But these Sony buds have changed my mind. The sound quality is just absolutely FANTASTIC! I like a bigger bass on my music while I ride my road-bike and usually had to give up the mid and high freq for that. But these buds takes care of all of that without any equalizer on my phone! I am so blown away. I have Sony everything else: TV, Amps, Game console...not sure why I held up getting headphones. Oh wait, yeah, it was the price! But got a great deal thanks to Prime Day 2021! I am a proud dad of these gorgeous Sony buds!

title: Awesome!
review: I am very pleased and super happy with this purchse. I have both wired and bluetooth earbuds and these tips works on both quite well. The memory foams are particualrly useful. I have weird shaped ear-canals and I needed two different diameters for each of the ears. So having a few to chose from really helps!

title: I'll be buying more of these!
review: This camera is a decent camera. What makes it great for me is it's ability to add-on. It has a powered microphone jack (3.5mm), an external av jack (3.5mm) which I use for headphones. It has a usb port, hdmi, and ilink. What I love even more is the way the camera handles colors and lighting. In low light, it needs a-tweekin'. Keep the scene lit properly, give'r a small adjustment, and you're good to go. The grain is acceptable and even adds a classic style to it. If you're making crisp high octane cinematic productions, you'll be very frustrated. But, this camera is great for field work and less formal production. I'll be getting more of these because I see artistic potential in its short comings.

title: Great Headphones
review: I had been looking for earbuds that wouldn't continually fall out of my ears and started researching here on Amazon and was immediately drawn to these "earhook" headphones.  I was a little worried that they might be uncomfortable because I have very sensitive ears but I was pleasantly surprised by how comfortable these are.  I would have thought that after wearing them for a while, they would start to feel heavy wrapped around my ears but they don't!  I just love the fact that I can wear them on my walks and while running around town and not have to worry about my earbuds falling out every few minutes.  The sound quality is very good and it blocks out other noises because they fit (and stay) in your ears so well.  There are three different size rubber ear tips to help you find the perfect fit and I've found myself listening to more music than ever because they are so easy to put on and take off that I've even started using them while working in the yard and cleaning around the house too. I would definitely recommend these earhook headphones for anyone who is tired of having their earbuds fall out of their ears all the time.

title: Any genre sounds good with the equalizer!
review: I purchased a pair last week and got a defective pair. However, I got a new pair in Copper Red and these are highly recommended for the gym or if you enjoy a quality Bluetooth earbud. The Equalizer settings work very well and so does the application Jabra offers in the App Store. I listen to a wide variety of music from modern rap, old hip hop, 80s-90s death metal, classical, and EDM. The equalizer really does make a difference and you can make any genre sound well. Other headphones don’t offer an equalizer and it makes listening to certain genres rather dull and flat. For the price of about $100 (give or take) these are worth the price. I’d imagine the newer products Jabra has to offer is even one step ahead of the 65T Actives. I’m definitely going to purchase one more pair for every day use. I’ve tried many brands at the gym and so far the “65T Elite Active” really are elite compared to others.

title: Bought these at Best Buy- Do not purchase these!
review: This won’t be a “verified” review because I purchased them at Best Buy and not here. With that being said I don’t recommend these for the gym and in general. The headphones were 7/10 over all for about 2 weeks. I had issues with the headphones not pairing with each-other and they would want to pair to my phone on their own with out being paired to each other. The instructions included in the box were not the greatest in regards to resetting the buds. I figured out how to reset the buds but I found myself resetting the buds at least 4 times a week which is awful for a $60+ product in a competitive industry. There’s gym buds out there that are $40 that outdo these by a landslide not only in sound (debatable), durability, battery life, user friendliness, and bang for buck. As a gym rat I recommend Jabra Elites. This product from SkullCandy is a waste of your time and money. I could not return my buds to Best Buy for an exchange or refund because it had already surpassed 15 days. Thankfully the SkullCandy allowed me to use their warranty to receive a new pair but I will most likely sell them. This would be a good product if they did not have so many pairing bugs. The sound is above average. Until SkullCandy updates their software I will keep away from this brand. I was in love with these for a measly two weeks.

title: I Gave this brand a third try.
review: I tried Jaybird products three times and ultimately they are not as good as they were. The Jaybird X3 was the last pair of headphones that were made correctly. The X4 came out and quality control was terrible. I’ve bought two pairs of the X4s and they both had the same issue. My x3s lasted two years with daily use 5 days a week two hours a day. Don’t buy any Jaybird products as this brand has fallen off.

title: Love them, quality sound with all media...comfy too!
review: My wife bought this for me, from amazon, Christmas 2015. I have to say I love them. Other reviewers have said they lack bass, this might be true if you have hearing issues. The bass boost is right on. No it does not thump like car ghetto bass, nor is it suppose too. Buy some cheap Dr's if that is what your looking for. The clarity is beautiful when listening to music, TV shows and movies. Crisp, Clear, and Detailed. I can now watch movies, TV etc. without bothering my sleeping beauty (big bonus)! I opted for the RS165s because my TVs have different sound modes and they come through the headphones. Will be purchasing the Digital ones whenever our forever home is done being built to use in the living room area and keep these for the bedroom.

title: Great sound, fantastic comfort!
review:
I adore these headphones. So light, but with great quality sound for the size and price. And no head aches, neck strain or ear fungus like I get from most headphones. I bought one pair and loved it so much I bought two more for other rooms and uses. I think I may need still more...

Also, unlike most headphones, they don't break when your husband accidentally sits on them. They just quietly fold up under him. I just wish there was a wireless version of these, with inbuilt volume control. (Hint..hint..)

title: Fits My Galaxy  A8
review:
Not too heavy, feels decently sturdy and fits my Samsung Galaxy TAB A8 nicely while leaving room for access to the power & volume controls, all four speakers, microphones, charging port and the earphone jack to be easily accessible.
I bought the wine color which is beautiful, deep and rich. I haven't had this long but I'm quite pleased with this cover. Highly recommended.

title: Sadly Disappointed
review:
For more than a month I've been bounced between rehabilitation facilities and the hospital and quite often there's some patient who's unwell and acting out, yelling, screaming, throwing things. If you've ever spent a while in either type of facility you know the experience. When I saw these headphones available for review I jumped on the idea. I had a friend deliver them and where do I begin?
* They barely fit in the mesh like bag that offers NO protection to your headphones.
* I think I have a fairly normal sized head but they fit tight on my ears not painful for short term but extended wear could be an issue.
* Sound is muddy, bass is overwhelming, even after adjusting my equalizer over and over. I finally got them to sound ok, just ok.

Fit isn't great. Sound isn't great. Carry bag isn't great. I'll use these until I get home and can find a better pair. Not impressed.

title: One Size Fits. . . Or Not
review: The ear pieces are not replaceable there are no different size tips for these so they fit or they don't. If they do they sound pretty good. Fit, for me, wasn't uncomfortable though I have worn earbuds that were much more comfortable. There's some good bass and the high ends are reasonably sharp. The mid-range isn't muddy though it's a little. . . in the back. I've used these for hours at a time even fallen asleep while wearing them. They're okay walking around the house, no idea how well they hold while running or exercising.

title: Middle of the Road Headphones
review: They're okay. Do you have a kid who's going through two pair of headphones a month? Do you want a pair you can take camping, hiking, skating, and where you knock around and might be rough on your stuff? Then these are good for you. They're not super sturdy. The plastic is thin and feels fragile. These are the very definition of Basics in AmazonBasics. They're a little small so if you have a big head they might be a bit uncomfortable. The padding on the ear cups is okay the stuff on the frame less so. Sound quality is. . . Basic, highs are flat, bass is muddy. These headphones aren't premium equipment and they don't pretend to be. They work and you won't cry if you break or lose them.

title: Comfortable, Works Well (Update 12-19-2017)
review:
Bought this for the rare phone call to thr county or government where I'd need to keep my elbow painfully bdnt while being on hold or transferred from person to person endlessly. I figured on these rare occasions a headset would be just the thing to ease my elbow pain (arthritis). A bit cheap but works okay. Sill have to see about longevity.

Update - 12-19-2017: The pair I bought this spring got stepped on and the plug was bent beyond repair. I ordered another set and they arrived promptly. In less than a year it feels like they changed the design for the worse and sadly raised the price. I wish I'd saved the old set to compare because these feel far more fragile and fit my head poorly. They still work for those rare times when I need to be on the phone for a long period of time and I want to spare my elbow the arthritis pain. I'm less impressed with this pair than the last but I guess they'll do for the little I need them I really didn't want to spend big bucks on a better set for the infrequent use they get. Hope these last.

title: Good On Ear Headphones
review: These are a well fitting good sounding and affordable set of on ear headphones. It's taken a while to get a comfortable fit but I've worn these comfortably for well over an hour. The sound is good. Nice bass response without being muddy and good treble reproduction without being tinny. One of my favorite features is the single wire design which makes for less tangle and easier wear. The cord is wrapped in either cloth or nylon (I'm not sure which) fabric. This set also comes with an inline microphone which I haven't really had any use for as of yet.

title: Great Sounding Headphones
review:
These are a solid, well made and great sounding ear buds. The fit is good made easy by the inclusion of a number of different sized covers. I tried these with everything music from metal (Anthrax and Exodus) to jazz (Buddy Rich) and classical (Bach, Beethoven). I also watched some streaming TV from Amazon in HD and some regular video from YouTube. These headphones sounded great with everything I threw at them. They're so much nicer than my laptop speakers. It's great to be able to sit here and have music and movies sound right. The only time I had a problem with these was walking around. They didn't stay in place once I started sweating. For sitting around, commuting or travel these would be great. Highly recommended.
I received this item in exchange for my review.

title: Horrible Quality Sound
review: Thankfully I 'won' these in a contest from Marlboro, I would regret having spent ANY money on these earbuds. The fit is acceptable but nothing special. The sound quality is deplorable. The is no high-end whatsoever, it's all muddled and flat. The bass is barely there and the midrange sounds like it's playing through a pool of mud. I've gotten free earbuds with $10 junk MP3 players that had better sound quality. Avoid these no matter how much of a bargain they seem. They're worthless.

title: 2nd pair, better than earbuds, like ear tampons + Bluetooth dependent. wires could be sturdier
review: I lose earbuds and I think they look like ear tampons so I prefer wired and these are really good except the wire from the earpiece to the phone seems cheap. I would prefer if they were coated with some type of plastic or something to give them a little bit more protection because they get really obnoxiously Tangled and seems flimsy however thus far they are superior to others and sound quality with microphone and volume buttons.Overall I'm happy with the sound quality there's an assortment of earbuds with them , beware of some difficulty to get the different earbuds on and this is my second set so the positives outweigh the negatives

title: mics don't work with USB2 ... the 30fps is disconcerting.
review:
howdy y'all,

the webcam only does 30fps no matter what resolution you use. that is a tad freaky to watch the very obvious delay in movements.

my problem is that i only have USB2 ports ... and the mic on the two items [webcam & headset] simply don't work. when i hook up on a system with USB3, the mic for each item works fine. [*sigh ...*]

take care,
lee

title: if at first you don't succeed ---- updated review
review: I own a Sennheiser RS 170 wireless headphone and transmitter set and love it. I thought that adding an additional HDR 170 headphone to my system would be a breeze, especially since the system is suppose to support up to 4 pair of headphones at a time. Well, things didn't quite work out that way, at least not at first. The problem: pairing the new headphone to the transmitter. Pairing instructions aren't in the manual that comes with the extra HDR 170 headphone. Solution: Go to the Sennheiser website, locate the RS 170 product page and click on the download link to get to the pdf instructions for pairing headphones to the transmitter. Once there, it's all good. Pairing is quick and easy when you know what to do, and the headphones are great. I will be buying another pair soon.

title: You won't regret getting these!
review: Incredible sound. After my first Panasonic earphones went dead in the right earpiece, I tried several others and most wound up in the landfill. Sony, JVC, etc. One of biggest problems I had was even if a set of plugs sounded okay, I would get a splitting headache and I don't play my music loud. I should have stuck with what I knew. Got these and it was like the world opened up again. From bass to highs, Bach to Skynyrd, all encompassing and beautiful. Also, no headaches!

title: Refurb unit gives muffled audio
review: Purchased as a backup, which became my primary BT phone headset after my other unit flew out a car window at 70 MPH. Refurb unit functions well except the audio is muffled compared to  the identical unit this replaced. Good for price paid

title: 3 yrs late review, and used daily ( still working perfect )
review:
Guess i missed reviewing these.. Well its now 3yrs later since date of purchase (april 7,2013) .

There still being used to this day, I had a pair of beats solos which honestly i didnt see the hype as there sub par compared to the sol quality.. As well many dont even know what SOL headphones look like so your not just following that hip trend.. The quality on these head phones is amazing, Still using the same wires, and ear pieces / band that came with them.. IF your gonna get high end headphones id recommend checking SOL tracks out.

title: Undervalued!!!
review: It takes a sec to figure out how to get the twist lock part of the headphone to get them into your ears.(See JBL website for headphones for instructions). Now that I got that sorted out.. find the tip and combo that work for you. Once that happens.. get ready for a very pleasant surprise for the twenty bucks you spent... great sound.. plenty of bass.. good mids.. good highs.. and in balance. Very happy camper!!

title: Great sound quality and comfort for the price
review: Really Like these. It's appearantly the hot set of headphone to have right now andthey are affordable

title: Nice Headphones!
review: These sound great! They exceeded my expectations! I wear them when I’m at work while I’m up moving around they stay on my head and don’t fall off like my earbuds do.

title: nice product at a great price.
review: love these headphones.  in a busy office space, the noise cancelation is great, and the sound quality is simply the BEST!  love them.  I have ears that were sensitive to overheating or the feeling of overheating.  I don't have an issue or concern with these.  I do love them.  NOTE....you can listen to music and/or have the noise cancelation turned on.  for some odd reason, the auto off function does NOT shut off the noise cancelation, and the battery discharges.  I don't know if there's a solution for that, so just be aware of that.  I do really like this product.  I recommend it to everyone!

title: Longest battery life ever
review: Battery life is still awesome but suddenly the sound cuts out on the left.  I can't believe the wire or connection has weakened since I haven't coiled or manhandled these at all.  Not only that but the first time a call came through, there was an ear splitting sound before the call announced.  The headset would also disconnect itself after calls interrupted the audio and the buttons simply wouldn't respond. Tried turning it off and had to plug to charge to have it reset. The buttons often glitched and I had to use phone controls.  I am so disappointed that these are no longer functioning, they didn't last long.

title: Easily Fit
review:
These fit great and prevented us from buying a new headphone set. The old ear protectors were coming off in tiny bits on my wife's ears.
Also went on easily. Just held flap to earpiece with one finger and wrapped the band around the headset a little at a time. On in 10 seconds.
We have two sets one for living room and one for bedroom, so will be buying these replacements for BR when they wear out next. As far as I can tell they are original pieces. Work great.

title: These headphones have good sound when the buds are seated well in the ...
review:
These headphones have good sound when the buds are seated well in the ear, but they fall out a lot, and the gels fall off easily (I've lost one of each set that came with the packaging, so I'm looking for replacements. They are also not good for running or other vigorous exercise, but fine on the elliptical. They do not work well with a coat that has a collar. The battery life is great, as far as I can tell.

I use them with my iPhone, so the functionality is limited, but what I can do is useful.

title: Impossible to install
review:
The information for these states that the pads can be used with Sennheiser HD4.50BT headphones. They in fact cannot be because the flap on the back that is supposed to go into the groove does not fit. Additional problems include lack of instructions and collapse of the headphones while trying to put the pads on. And I am assuming that the orange "pick" was to help push the material into the way too small groove, but I have no proof of this as I never got that far.

I should have been suspicious when they had to take the headphones off camera during the "instructional" video.

Totally turned off on the brand now because the pars failed much sooner than they should (a year), the cost of replacements was high (>10% of my purchase price) and the basic inability to use them. I now have some great sounding paper wights.

title: Great for small heads
review: I have a small head and it’s difficult to find headphones or earphones that fit, and these do fit.  I don’t think they’re great for noise cancellation and the sound quality is fine. I operate the volume from my computer.

title: Great for small ears!
review: GREAT FOR SMALL EARS! I’m so excited to have found a pair of earphones that will fit my small ears! The ear clip is not adjustable but it actually fits securely over my ear. The earpiece comes with 4 different sized covers and the smallest size stays put in my ear, even if I shake my head or move around.

title: This is my 5th pair of beats and I love the quality sound
review: This is my 5th pair of beats and I love the quality sound. The only thing on these that I would say. Is that I can't seem to advance to the next song I'm told that you can. My previous beats wireless headphones you can do so.

title: If you want a great clear sound these headphones are in my opinion some ...
review: If you  want  a  great  clear  sound  these headphones  are in my opinion  some of the  best  on the  market .

title: My go to for cases!
review: Love it. It’s minimal clean and grippy enough to make sure I don’t accidentally drop my headphones. Definitely worth a pickup if you ask me.

title: Love the cleaning kit!
review: Soft but doesn’t feel like it’s gonna rip. Give your headphones a nice grippy feel so it’s secure in that regard. The best feature is the added cleaning kit. If you never had one or owned a pair of headphones from Apple you know it’s a pain to clean if it’s dirty. This case included that for you which makes well worth the price.

title: Perfect for a heavier gaming headset
review: Simple and slick the perfect setup for my gaming headset which is slight heavier than a traditional pair. Definitely worth picking up if you need to get creative with your available space.

title: It was..ok
review: These caught my attention because of the cool led inside the charging case. Practical use though they kind of fell short. The sound wasn’t at all what I had hoped. I just needed enough volume to drown out the gyms sound system. But even outside without music blaring it was still oddly hard to hear. The ear hooks were a little too weak for my liking. I prefer something a bit more ridged since I’m using these as gym headphones. Over these weren’t terrible they were just ok. For my use (gym sessions) it didn’t quite fit the bill. But I think if you need a pair to have laying around as a backup these are priced right and a decent choice.

title: Not premium but gets the job done!
review: [[VIDEOID:5b749e3895c1e29fa20105d93c11ebab]] I picked these up to have an alternative to my over-ear headphones while going to the gym. The over-ear HP’s would get sweaty and a bit uncomfortable while working out so I decided to check out something lighter. I got these in the mail and immediately I could tell the plastic housing wasn’t all that great if you want a set with that “premium” feel then this isn’t for you. My my needs (lightweight, comfortable HP’s) these fit the bill. Sound quality is decent but certainly not the best. Loud enough to not get distracted by the gyms own music. All in all it gets the job done. Certainly worth a buy if you need a spare set of HP’s to leave in your gym bag and certainly at a price you wouldn’t feel devastated if you lost them at any point. Batter life is decenti go to the gym about 45min per visit. I’ve gone about 4 times without charging except for the initial out of box charge up.

title: Don't toss your headphones
review:
I purchased these for my father after he said he was going to throw away his favorite headphones.
He mentioned these were not as comfortable as the originals, but was glad to have them.

title: Looks and feels like new
review: Just what I needed. I had a cushion that was beginning to rip on my Plantronics wired headset. Replaced it and the new cushion  looks and feels like new.

title: It's good if your buying new ones every 4 months
review: I bought a blur set from this company because it was Amazon's choice and had good reviews.  However after about 4 months having it it died and will no longer turn on. Also the battery life I'd about 8 hours at best. I have had different earbuds that lasted for a whole 24 hours before needing charing

title: Don't let these pass you by without trying them!
review: What can I say? It's been a long time since headphones sounded this clear! Noise cancellation, stellar! And up to 15 hours of power out of the buds when they are fully charged! Bluetooth 5.2, plus $5 off coupon at checkout and I used a $10 gift card from Amazon that I earned , ended up paying $34 for these over $50 headphones!!!

title: Great buy!
review: I love them because I'm tired of buying dongles that short out in two days because OnePlus doesn't make one for their , or too many TWS "true wireless earbuds"  to keep track of!

title: Very impressed so far
review: Love these! Have yet to test out battery life but, sound is great bass is great. With coupons and discount these 49.99 headphones ended up costing me only $36.00!!!

title: Wish they were louder, otherwise 5 star
review: I just wish it would tell you "volume is maximum" or something like that, because I wish they would go louder. I tried raising the volume and all I did was make the L headphone mono and I had to reset to make them stereo again. Otherwise the sound is wonderfully rich and clear. And noise cancelling is pretty good. Again, would be better if I could raise the volume. more.

title: Worth every penny & more!
review:
AWESOME EARBUDS! Would definitely buy again! Sound quality is superb, mids, highs, lows, bass...
It checks all the boxes. Buy these and you wont be sorry. Cant report on battery life yet but will update when I know for sure!

title: These are definitely worth the cost!!! Have purchased them twice!
review:
For the $$$ it's definitely worth it. My only gripe is that the
wire is too short but for headphones as cheap as these the sound is surprisingly good. UPDATE. Just updating because I purchased these AGAIN! For the $$$ you cant go wrong (trust me I go through headphones like toilet paper, lol) I got way more usage time out of these headphones than most of the cheap ones I had before. And all 5 pair worked, I noticed some people saying that not every pair worked. I gave 1 pair to a friend he's had them for almost 6 months! Would definitely recommend. Bought them again! This is the 3rd time in 2 years!

title: Logitech Has Done It Again
review: These headphones are really awesome. Looks great, feels great, and folds up really nicely for easy transportation. The only issue I have with it is when you mute the headset; there is no visual indicator that the headset is muted (only a chime that can easily be missed).

title: Returned after a week. Piece of junk. Constantly ...
review: Returned after a week. Piece of junk. Constantly pairing and telling[[ASIN:B00V81E5O2 Ecandy Bluetooth Headphones Over-ear Stereo Wireless + Wired Headsets with Microphone for Music Streaming,Hands-free Calling For iPhone,Nokia,HTC,Samsung,LG,Moto,iPad,PSP and enabled Bluetooth-black]] me it needs to be charged after a full charge. You get what you pay for.

title: Great Product . . . Poor Performance
review: Without researching the product I did an impulse buy of the Samsung Gear IconX.  I liked the idea that I could load music and use them while I was fishing.  During their use, the left earbud was on the side facing the sun.  After about a half hour, the earbud started announcing something like "need to cool down".  It would repeat it  . . . and repeat it . . . and repeat it until I took the earbuds off and put them back in their case and in my vehicle.  The touch controls are crazy and unpredictable and I am never sure what will happen when I try to do a tap or double tap . . .  I will be attempting to return the earbuds for a refund.

title: Love these--great sound and value, but what's with the flimsy cord?
review: I got these on sale for under $30. Love them. but I admit I hesitate to expect a long, healthy life for them. They sound genuinely excellent (unbelievably good for the price!) and are actually very comfortable (love the fabric for the ear pieces), but the cord is super-thin and flimsy-feeling. Unless it is a lot stronger then it looks & feels, I fully expect to accidentally get up one day with it plugged into my PC and accidentally rip it out of the headphones (at this price point you do not get removeable cords). This cord is only about 1.5mm in diameter and does not inspire confidence. Cord length is fine for most uses, despite other reviews stating the contrary--it's shortish, but at about 5' it's fine for me--I use it either sitting stationary, or connected to a device I am holding or carrying in my pocket. If these headphones had a tougher/removable cord, I would be perfectly happy. Note: Sennheiser really does conquer all--these were $26 (I think) and sound better than anything else I have tried lately (including Beats--terrible), including many sets costing much, much more.

title: If it sounds to good to be true...
review:
...it probably is. I would be well served to remember that before buying stuff next time. This thing was just so tiny I had to have it. And for the first 2 weeks it worked ok. Not great, just OK. Then the talk time began slipping... then the static began... then people started telling me they couldn't understand me. Then it stopped working completely. Less than 3 weeks old and already headed to the trash. What a waste.

I've made up my mind: with bluetooth headphones, you get what you pay for. I'm going for a Jawbone 2, spending the extra cash on it, and I have no doubt in my mind it will be everything the reviews say it is. Enough Samsung garbage. Should have known. There are no other Samsung products in my home, and nor will there ever be.

Matt

title: Excellent Sound Quality
review: Love my new Sony Earbuds! They hooked up to my bluetooth so easy! Easy to charge! You can go into the App and change the touch sensors to your specifications. Sound quality is great and I love the noise canceling feature! The only downside for me is I must have a little ear canal because I can't find an ear cover that's small enough so they don't fall out!!

title: Easy plug and play.  Excellent audio quality
review:
I have had the Topping D10s DAC for about 3 weeks. It has proven to be a high quality DAC .
This is my current configuration:
PC -> DAC via usb
DAC -> headphone amp or AV receiver via RCA cable, or to second DAC via Digital COAX or Optical Toslink

The resulting audio is far superior using this DAC, compared with plugging my PC audio out directly into either my headphone amplifier or AV amplifier.
When using a DAC, the audio is much cleaner and there seems to be better channel separation. The DAC does not enhance the audio signal at all. There is no high, mid, or low end over amplification. The audio out is the same as the audio in, and that's the way it should be.

I have used other DACs and the Topping D10s is a good as the others

I highly recommend this product.

title: Excellent product for my Win 7 PC that does not have Bluetooth
review:
Needed Bluetooth for my Dell Windows 7 PC. Installed the drivers from the enclosed CD. Paired immediately with my Bluetooth headset.
No problems. Easy install and setup. Works every time.

title: Kid's wired on ear headphones.
review: These headphones were perfect for school use. Durable, beautiful colors, excellent volume control, and perfect for any school aged child.

title: Beware!
review: These will not fit an iPad or iPhone. The ends are huge even though the description says they are the same size as my original cord that came with headphones. Lost money.

title: Not durable! Only lasted 6 months.
review: I thought I had really found some great headphones for a great price. They only lasted six months and a few weeks before the wire stopped making a connection. No way to contact the seller. Just out of luck!

title: Great for the price, but...
review: These earbuds are great for their price, however I don't know that they deserve so many accolades that they're receiving through reviews here or on other sites.  There is nothing spectacular about them.  Sound quality is average.  Nothing like you'd find in much higher end (and higher priced) IEMs.  Comfort can be subjective.  What is comfortable to one person may not be comfortable to the next.  I personally prefer foam inserts but with that being said, these are relatively comfortable.  If you're looking for a cheap pair of earbuds, these will fit the bill.  If you're looking for something with higher end sound quality, you may want to move on.

title: It is awesome!!!
review: This product was awesome and I would've kept it but it did not fit my Galaxy Buds2; Even though it implys that it will fit my type of case. It was too big for my earbuds case, unfortunately. I really liked it because it glows in the dark and was pink. Would've preferred a lavender or some sort of shade of purple that glowed in the dark though!

title: Fit great
review:
These really cancel out the noise quite well. I had a set of similar earbuds but one found it’s demise in the toilet (not a good day).
I tried to find the old pair since I liked them but no luck. These popped up as an item that was similar. I liked that the charging dock shows the battery power as my wife has a set from a different seller that doesn’t show this and it’s quite frustrating to gauge battery life.

The standard ear plugs that came with the device worked for me but there are a couple more size options.

The sound is great and since they snug right in your ear it’s easy to keep them in and not falling out. I don’t notice any static and have actually found they are louder than my other pair (I’ve had to adjust the volume down on my walks from my previous pair).

Great set. They are a little hard to get out of the case but that’s the same issue all of these earbuds have since there’s not a tiny handle piece to grab hold of (just a rounded top of the earbud).
Great and highly recommend!

title: These are great
review:
I wanted a dual set because we have two backseat drivers that need distraction. Well, maybe they just need a better driver but in any case I needed a DVD player set. I decided on these based on the reviews and am thoroughly impressed.

There is a built in battery which has served us well given I didn’t realize that at first and while driving the DVD player stopped. I thought it was broke and then realized it had just not been plugged in properly. After reading through I was pleasantly surprised by this feature.

My kids like the ease of access and to be able to use the remote. I really like the lack of skipping that occurs while driving as a previously set we had would skip and then restart the disc. No issues in that regard here.

The audio is great though we have the kids wear headphones as usually we have a few different sounds happening (radio, wifes phone, older sons phone, and DVD player would just add to that). I did listen to it at first as I didn’t want to have the headphones given it’ll only be a few years before he wears them all the time (teen years are fun).

If there were a downside to these, it is something that happens to all DVD players in that when cold, the laser reader has to warm before it can read the disc. That happens with all players though so it’s more of a tip than anything.

Highly recommend

title: Better than I thought
review:
I am really enjoying the sound quality from these as I needed to switch from a corded headset to something wireless. This is Bluetooth but the Bluetooth chip works well and doesn’t seem to have issue where it disconnects from my laptop and connects to my phone (I’ve had this with a few speakers).

The mic works great as I do user testing and the sound quality is important for good feedback as a tester.

I was pleasantly surprised to find out that the chip isn’t needed unless Bluetooth isn’t available on the device. There was no issue with connectivity either as my laptop recognizes the USB Bluetooth chip and automatically paired with the headset. A plus for me since my laptop tends to lag.

The headset has a good/decent look to it. The earpieces are squishy and comfortable. The headset adjusts easily. The plastic seems to be of decent quality so putting them on and taking off repeatedly should not be an issue. Very pleased overall.

title: Great headset
review:
This is actually my second headset of this type because I let my son use the last one and he decided to stretch it until it broke.
I really like that it has a clean sound quality as I do usertesting and that requires clear sound quality. They are also very comfortable and I enjoy they go on the ear versus in the ear which tends to irritate my ears.
The cable is also of solid quality which seems like it plays a role in producing clear audio.
Great buy!

title: Get these!
review:
You NEED braided if you want these types of cords to last. I bought two standard style white cords and they were flimsy and ended up melting. These have worked exceptionally well and the long cord has been really nice as 3' is just slightly too short and pulls my headphones down. 6' is the way to go.
The sound quality is as expected. The audio plug that goes into your headphones is a little large but still ended up fitting in my headphones but I had to push a little bit. No loss of sound and I am incredibly pleased!

title: Hand's free on a budget
review:
Note: there is a [[ASIN:B00QEY99DU Newer version] of this earpiece that I have also reviewed. Like that one I received this as a review sample. This one is still impressive for the following reasons: foremost is price. Even at full list this is an ideal way to use your phone legally in locales that enforce hands free laws (and the number is growing.)

It's also comfortable, which is surprising to me because I hate in-ear buds. In this case, the array f provided ear pieces in various sides ensures a good fit regardless of your age or size. Ironically the medium fit me perfectly.

Sound quality for music is not spectacular, but more than adequate for casual listening. I made and received calls and the clarity of those on both ends were also adequate. Not spectacular, but not terrible. When you consider that this is less than twenty bucks at the time of this review then in that context you are getting more than you are paying for in that department.

This may not be the best single ear headset on the market, but it's by far among the best in its price range - and since it is so inexpensive and does what it should do I am rating it five stars.

title: Convenient if you use your phones a lot
review:
Shortly after I received this as a review sample it quickly became a permanent part of my home studio. Right now my [[ASIN:B00ENZRS76 Brainwavz HM9 Hi-Fi Noise Isolating Headphones]] are mounted for immediate use, and I tested this with some smaller phones I also use like the [[ASIN:B0002F74E8 Sony MDR7502 Professional Stereo Headphone]] and they fit perfectly as well.

This is a tall, thin stand that measures ten inches tall with a relatively short five inch base. Despite the proportions this sits stably and is not apt to tip if you accidentally bump into it. I love the contoured top over which the phones rest. That holds the phones in a natural shape. For expensive phones that is not especially a problem because the over the head mechanisms on those devices are usually very well made.

The material (I am guessing plexi-glass) is 8mm thick (about a third of an inch), and is flexible. Complaints about the large logo are valid if you want a cleaner look, but since I am currently using Brainwavz headphones - and this is in my music studio - the aesthetics are a non-issue for me. I care more about function and convenient storage and this stand provides both of those.

For me the convenience of having my phones readily available is important because I use them often. This stand is an inexpensive way of accomplishing that.

title: Not just for Brainwavz products
review:
This case came bundled with my [[ASIN:B009UNZ5WQ Brainwavz R1 In Ear Noise Isolating Earphones]] and I was struck by how nicely made and perfect it is. I will not parrot the other excellent reviews on this page with regard to physical characteristics, but will confirm that they are spot on.

Although these are bundled with a Brainwavz product do not let that deter you if you have invested in another brand because these will work with most of them. I tested the fit with the following phones and they are a perfect match:

[[ASIN:B001EZYMF4 Sennheiser CX 300 II Precision Enhanced Bass Earbuds]]
[[ASIN:B004PO10E2 Shure SE215-CL Sound Isolating Earphones]]
[[ASIN:B000XPG2QI Etymotic Research HF5 Portable In-Ear Earphones]]

Of course I also tested them with the [[ASIN:B00G4UQ6U8 Brainwavz S1 In Ear Headphones]] which I expected to fit and they did. Although many of the phones with which I tested these come with their own case, none of them are are as sturdy or as protective as this one. For low-end phones this will probably outlast the phones themselves, and will be ready their their replacement. For the higher end phones this is an investment - and an inexpensive one at they - for protecting the instrument from damage.

title: The Best Blue Tooth Headset
review: So, I spend my days on the phone. This is a great headset. Comfortable and good quality sound.

title: Great Speakers
review:
I have a gaming laptop with terrible speakers... I am guessing they expected a gamer to use external or a headset anyway.

These are pretty good for it.

title: battery life is horrible, does not hold a charge
review: It was working great for the first few months...then I started noticing the battery would be dead the next day after a full recharge. Definitely not worth the $$$$, my cheap $20 earbuds were much more reliable.

title: For the price I expect more
review:
For the price, I'd expect a little bit of magic... They're great headphones, comfortable on the head, and the noise cancelling is great, but having to hold the power button for 3 seconds to turn on doesn't feel like a $300 pair of headphones from 2019. I wish they 1. Turned on automatically when you put them on, and 2. turned off or paused automatically when you take them off.

The volume control/touch control isn't intuitive at all, either. I like to think I'm a pretty smart guy, and I couldnt figure it out without reading the instructions. A product that requires reading the manual for full operation is a badly designed product. Just look at apple. They don't make a product that a 5 year old couldn't pick up and use. As much as I disagree with them as a company, they've set the bar for product usability, and at this price point I expect nothing less.

A $350 pair of headphones in 2019 that has little more in the way of user comforts than a $50 pair is kind of sad.

title: Fantastic!!
review: Fantastic!!! We bought cheaper noise cancelling headphones before, but I guess you get what you pay for. Those are so much better and the listening quality during our last flight was great. I will buy a second one when they are back on sale.

title: I personally like them a lot
review: I personally like them a lot, I got one of the previous models a while ago and wanted to get a second one for my wife. I do not have experience with or ever used a Bose/Sony, so I don't know how those compare to really expensive top end brands. I can only say, that the sound is good for my taste and the noise cancelling function works quite well. I only own cheaper headphones and this is a upgrade for us and a big difference. I would recommend them if you are on a budget, they look good, the sound is good, why not?

title: Just what I was looking for.
review:
I give it 5 stars with 2 caveats. First, it's not stated in the description that it recognizes fewer formats when in BT mode and the instructions seem to be lacking in detail, so it took a while to figure out how to access all of the functions. Hint: You can only access playback functions while in BT because BT, itself, is a sub-folder, so you have to back out of BT to do other things.

Ultimately, I gave it 5 stars because a) i had just a few songs in the missing formats and b) once I got past the navigation issues, it works quite well and the company was very helpful when I needed them.

Update: Turns out as I loaded more music I found a lot more music that wasn't found while in BT, including some albums where some of the songs appeared and some didn't. Al in all, it's kind of clumsy to navigate in BT and BT was the feature I wanted most.

However, it sounds good with the earbuds that they provide and it's size makes it convenient. The 8gb are plenty if you don't have a lot of music. I do, so I added a 32gb sd mini-card which is as large as it will take.

title: Use trifold as hand grip and speakers covered
review:
It fits snugly and has a nice grip. The trifold works well as a grip when folded and you're sitting upright. Particularly helpful if you have average or small hands.
However, there seem to be two kinds of covers: ones that have slots for the speakers and ones that don't. This one is the latter. Not a problem if you use headphones but if you plan on relying on these speakers ( which i don't) then you'll have to turn up the volume and itll still be a muffled.

title: Easy install. Feels and sounds great.
review: Old Sony headset not listed anywhere, finally thought that this one would work.  IT DID. Feels great Easy install.  Quick delivery.  Thank you 💐

title: Love it!!! So much better than the older versions.
review:
I had the old models of this and used them daily, I've been using this model now since April and its better in EVERY WAY than the previous versions!

1) The retractable earbuds are FANTASTIC! No more dangling wires. I retract them constantly - when I walk into a store and don't want to seem weird, press the button. Boom, I'm a normal guy without a weird wire hanging on my shoulder.

2) The bluetooth is infinitely better. With the old ones, I would lose signal with my phone NEXT TO THEM! This one, I legitimately have 30 feet of range or more. It's so much better.

3) The buttons are better, smarter, and easy to use.

4) The little rubber piece at the middle of the hoop is perfect. Just enough to let you bend it around your neck.

In short, I'm in love again. These are awesome.

title: Great sound for a great price
review: My daughter broke her old ear buds.  She says the smaller ones fall out her ear, and she is small herself.  These earbuds fit great.  She says the bass is good and loves the sound.  This was a good purchase.

title: One Star
review: This is our 2nd pair.  The first broke (after the 30 day return period) at the jack.  For this pair,  after 2 months, sound only comes out of one side of headphones.

title: Eureka! The perfect portable radio
review: I have not had a radio in my home for decades. I want to have something small but with large radio sound quality. I will use it for NPR talk radio and music. The earphones give wonderful sound. I’m going to really enjoy it

title: Vast improvement over previous model
review:
I am impressed with the improvements in this newer model.
The headband is softer, more bendable and comfortable.
They now include a sizing band that holds it against your head (like a ring sizer).
Slightly better battery life too.
And they have added a little padding where the vibrators hit near your ears.
The controls are still really user-friendly even while wearing it.
As always, it is easy to load/change music.

What hasn't improved?
Well it still digs in a little at the sides.
And the battery life is still not as great as the competition.
I miss the bright yellow color of my old one. Hard to see/find in my bag.
The carrying case is not useful for watersport equipment. It shouldn't get wet. Which is dumb for a swimming headset.
It is just as heavy as before.

title: Very Nice Headphones
review: I bought these Sony MDR-V150 Monitor Series Headphones as I gift for a friend, and she has been very happy with them.  She loved them and said the sound quality is excellent.

title: Nice! Some needy kids will love these!!
review:
Nice and sturdy headphones, better quality than I was expecting. I ordered 1 pair of each color, to donate to kids in need for Christmas. I buy off Amazon and other sites, good deals for quality toys and other items for my Christmas stash box to give to various organizations to give to ppl of all ages, in need of a little help, at Christmas. Hope this inspires others to do the same or more!!
I did buy 1 for my dd too!

title: Work great, comfy and for kids!
review: I got these for my 6 year old, who loves them. His old headphones hurt his ears after a while, but these are nicely padded and comfy. Sturdy for kids too. Love the cloth-like cord also, seems more durable than a standard cord.

title: Big sound for little cash
review: I own the more expensive TI-87s and like them A LOT. So when a friend needed inexpensive earphones for her child to use at school, I went looking at Basstyle. These TI-29s are inexpensive but don't sound cheap. The flat noodle design seems perfect for avoiding the tangles that will come with in & out of a backpack. Only reason it's not 5 star is they don't come with a case like my TI-87s. Quality for price still makes it a bargain.

title: Jabra-cadabra? Sure didn't work magic for me
review:
Pros:

1. I liked it for its looks at first sight. One of the sleekest looking Bluetooth ear devices that I've ever seen.
2. Almost unnoticeable when nestled in tight, snuggling up to your ear
3. Nice convenient pod for charging and carrying around, looking like a cute little black egg

Cons:

1. Once you can get it to fit comfortably in your ear, it sounds wonderful. Unfortunately, it doesn't fit my ear and due to the placement of the invisible control buttons, every time I try to adjust it, I either disconnect the call or re-dial the last call.
2. It makes me do a LOT of redialling as it keeps slipping out of place.
3. Maybe I was doing something wrong but I couldn't get it to pair with my Blackberry or my iPod.
4. Does not keep the charge for the 8 hours as promised. It discharges very quickly (in a couple of hours, or so it felt) especially when compared to the length of time it takes to re-charge.
5. I couldn't use it on my left ear, which for me, wasn't quite right
6. The art of raising or lowering the volume by sliding a finger along the headset has thus far eluded me.

This device is one you'd buy for looks, but not for life.

Amanda Richards
October 25, 2010

title: Good Bass = snug but comfortable ear tips.  Larger ones worked for me.
review:
When I first tried the earphones with the default ear tips, the sound was very "tinny". Highs, vocals, no discernible bass. Then when I was testing out the controls, I lightly pushed the earphones in my ear and wow - bass. I then replaced the ear tips with the larger ones in the set. Now they fit snug but comfortable. The sound is great. Bass is clear.

I use "Enter Sandman" by Metallica as one of my test songs. Cymbals = highs, vocals for mid, and great percussion for bass. The sound was fantastic, similar to my Sennheiser HD 280 pro.... Sennheiser is clearly better, but for small form factor earphones, Anker Soundcore Spirit X2 are a pleasure to use.

title: Great for the money!
review: These sound better than Bluetooth headphones that cost more than $100.  The battery life is longer than any I've used.  I highly recommend .

title: Great replacement headphones!!
review: This was my first time replacing the pads on my bose headphones. I was super nervous I would mess something up but these are SUPER easy to apply. They work great. I notice no difference in comfort or sound between these and the Bose pads & would recommend them to anyone looking to replace theirs!!

title: Excellent sound and a great value
review: Wow sounds great and bass is heavy, midrange and treble is present and does not drown out at high volumes. Wireless charging works flawlessly. Use these at the gym and when doing lawn work. Love these headphones

title: Does the job nicely
review: Works great.  The two USB ports on the front are very convenient for thumb drives.  Even has convenient headphone/speaker and microphone plugs on the front.  Works fine with Windows 10.

title: I had it...!
review: I wasn't going to write a review(a bad one, especially!), just cause Amazon has been so good to me - but by sending me the inquiry about, why I've so many returns on this product: Now you've asked for it! I've ordered a total of 6 Kinivo BTH360S Bluetooth Stereo Headphones so far, one after other - the first one turned out to be the best, which I gave it to my sister as a gift. Then I wanted to order one for myself, so I did - I got the packaging, opened it up. Charged the headset fully, as required by the product specs - then started using it, just to find out: Either 1. The power switch is too hard, or 2. It loses the sync, or 3. Sound is gone, or 4. The range is not enough, or 5. It doesn't pair anymore, or 6. Have to reboot my laptop, in order to pair 7. Sound is distorted, or last but not least 8. My last order was an open box, used one - even though I bought a new one AGAIN. I've followed the Amazon policy for returns, and have got my money back every time - but come on, five in a row! You gotta be kidding me, if I could - I would give (-1) star, so there it is. I've ordered one more, and hoping - I won't be in the same situation, talk about being a LOYAL customer!

title: Insane  picture quality , motion  and  all around detail
review:
We got this TV 3 days ago. First:,unpacking and setting the TV in place takes 2 people. Be sure to read the directions on the TV box. We laid the "face" of the TV on the dining room table covered with a bedspread to make sure the display would not break-- the directions say to lay the face of the TV down to attach the stand legs. Voila ! In less than 30 minutes the TV was ready to hook up. We are amazed at the quality of the picture. As my husband said, you can see every wrinkle, freckle and pimple on people . Today we were watching a bicycle race, and we both felt like we were dizzy watching the motion ! That never happened watching any TV before. The commands are very simple and displayed on the screen. As others have said, the most obvious setting to change was the picture . For some reason the default is dark... but easily changed thru settings. I am so glad I spend a the extra money to get the RU8000 , instead of the RU7100. Reviews convinced me to spend the extra money. Our old tv was 6 yrs old - light years in electronic time.
BTW. Firestick TV , Roku , Cable TV and new wireless headphones are attached. You won't be sorry if you buy this TV

title: Highly Recommended- worth every penny
review: These are fabulous!  A friend told me about them. You can hear everything in these headphones while watching TV- birds, footsteps and all things you don't normally hear on a TV show.  Especially good for understanding English speaking PBS shows.  Great thing about these is that one person can have them on while watching TV , the sound on the TV can be muted so the other person sleeping doesn't hear the TV.  I would highly recommend them.  Just plug in and they work. Easy!

title: Fits properly
review: This is the right cable for my headphones, but the set is dead and will not charge, but I can still use them plugged in. The cable is fine

title: Problem Solved
review:
I had a real problem with my headphones I thought. It wasn't the headphones at all but the cable. At first I thought it was the jack in my headphones. Then I decided to try a new cable (after I bought a new set) and it worked perfectly. The shape is the difference I think. Different than other cables. No tangle cord.
Now I have a back up pair if my others go out which are Bluetooth. Some headphones cannot be used while charging so my problem there is also solved. I highly recommend this product.

title: I Really Like These Headphones!
review: I got these headphones for free so I was a little shocked that they were as good as they are. I read other comments that says it keeps sound in but does not keep sound out but that was not the case for me. My husband had them on and he had the volume turned all the way up and I couldn't hear anything and I put them on with the volume turned all the way up and my husband said he couldn't hear anything. They feel really good on my ears and to me the sound was very good but the only thing I hate about these headphones is the cord which seems very thin and I know I will have to be very careful when using them so I don't break the cord but other than that they are pretty good headphone.

title: Good deal
review: Love these little earbuds. Work great, and cheap enough to get a few more for backups.
