title: Well done Belkin!
review:
WHY I BOUGHT IT: I have several computer carrying bags but Belkin make really good quality ware, so I decided to try
this backpack type carrier. Here is what I wanted to know:

COMFORT Great padding both in the shoulder straps and the back of the pack itself. Easy to wear for long excursions.

DESIGN: This is a 5 star design: well thought out, with numerous pockets in just the right places, comfortable, easy to
wear. This design makes sense. If you have a good sense of design, you will know what I'm talking about.

QUALITY: Top grade materials and well put together.

DETAILS: Many individual pockets so you can work out your own organization. We all aren't left handed and right brained!
Laptop compartment: well padded
Large "organization" storage pocket with pockets within pockets.
Cell phone compartment: on the right shoulder strap so easy to reach as needed
Place for your earbuds: magnetic so just "stick 'em on", right above your cell phone
Next to your back compartment: fairly large to be used as a security area: wallet, passport, money etc. It
would be very difficult to remove items from here when wearing the backpack; of course, won't help if someone
steals the thing!

SYNOPSIS:Easy and comfortable to wear; places for everything; well thought out; high quality of design and construction.
An easy 5 Star Rating.

title: Great little earbuds
review: These earbuds have been great!  The rubber part that fits into the ear is very soft and comfortable and works quite well at blocking out extraneous noise.  They are very light and after a short while I'm not even aware of them.  I use them now exclusively during my workouts to listen to music on my i-Pod as they block out all the cacophony of sounds in the gym.  And at their price, this purchase was a no-brainer!

title: The price!
review: I just love these earphones well made good sound and great price very happy with them!

title: Good sound
review:
Good sound I'm impressed, however the headphone body or build quality is not very good.
It's a shame because the sound drivers are fantastic
but the actual headphones are made of cheap materials. It feels very flimsy. An anology it's like premium tires and rims put on a cheap car. The rims and tires are great but the car don't match the quality of the tires. I'm not satisfied with these headphones, I'm convinced they will break quickly. They are awesome studio monitor speakers but put on cheap head strap very odd decision.

title: Great Headsets
review: I have to agree with all the positive reviews concerning these Bluedio T2s. They sound great compared to a pair of Skullcandy Crusher's headphones  retail price $99 that I formally owned. These cost me one quarter of the price and sound just as good. The driver on these headsets do not need a bass boost battery like the Crusher's optimally provided,  the bass sounds awesome just on their own because the size of the driver is sufficient. These are comfortable enough on your ears to to ware them for about 2 to 3 hours at that time you may consider a break. This is is when you start to feel fatigue. I've used many headsets before, gaming headsets or general music headsets and I was surprised by the sound. You will need an inline microphone if you want to use them in a wired fashion. These are compatible with inline mics I tried them. For $10 you can get an inline mic, at that point they also become gaming headsets and will work with video game consoles. Although they have a mic built in when using them wireless they  will require an inline mic if you want to use them while taking a call when plugged in.

title: Cute headphones- but they don't last long.
review: These headphones were good for a while- they held their charge like they were supposed to in the beginning and they worked really well. Great sound and mic quality- especially for being on the cheaper end of Bluetooth headphones. Though, after a couple of weeks of use, the left headphone specifically would altogether stop charging. I would be able to have it on for maybe 2-8 minutes, then it would notify me that it was at low battery. I'm not exactly sure what happened here, but the left headphone because practically useless. I was able to return them though and got a full refund. I'm sad they didn't work out- they were really cute headphones!

title: Fits more than just airpods
review: This case is nice because I have a pair of Bluetooth headphones that aren't AirPods- and it holds it perfectly fine! It seems hard to find a kind of carrying case for headphones that aren't designed for AirPods, so this was perfect- and cheap!

title: Perfect fit!
review: Only good things to say about this set of earbud holders. My case fits perfectly snug inside. I can open and close easily. I can access the charging port with no problem. And the material seems rugged but it’s soft to the touch.

title: Cheap all over, but they work
review: Don’t expect these to last very long. They have a all around in expensive cheap quality to them. The sound is also kind of tinny. But for the price and generally what you use them for, they work great. If you need book earbuds that you only need to use temporarily, this is a great choice. you can easily differentiate the colors. And they each come individually wrapped.

title: Totally decent!!
review: For the price, these are fantastic. I got them for my 3rd grader to use at school. She can toss them in her backpack and thrash them up pretty bad and they still haven’t broken. They fit comfortably over her ears, they can be worn for quite awhile without aching, and she said the sound quality is decent. I am so done with spending too much $ on headphones. Kids are so rough on them. So, I’m happy to have found these at such a good price.

title: Awful
review: I absolutely hated this product. The sound was always off by a few seconds and it kept disconnecting every few minutes. I could hear the things around me and the noise cancellation was awful. the sound quality was grainy and glitched out sometimes. But the earphones were comfortable to wear and fit my ears nicely.

title: Surprisingly good!
review: For the price, these are a great option for replacement earbuds. Which I am always losing or breaking. They are comfortable and I can wear for a long time without irritation. They fit perfectly in my iPhone. The sound is remarkable decent! Obvs, not perfect, but for price, I’m not disappointed.

title: Cool invention!
review: These are super handy. They hold my headphones perfectly without fear of falling down.  HOWEVER, I advise using a 3M wall strip and not the sticky pad it ships with. That way, if you change your mind where you want it placed you can easily move it without ripping the paint and drywall off. Ask me how I know...

title: Just a disc man. Won’t work w/o earbuds.
review: Even after re reading this “protable”(yes I know that’s misspelled) CD player description I still couldn’t really figure out that you MUST USE HEADPHONES OR EARBUDS to use. No sound comes out of unit itself. Essentially like a disc-man of the 90’s. Bummmmmmmerrr.

title: Simple and sturdy.
review: These are very simple and straightforward headphones. They are comfy and have clear sound. They adjust to head size and use a jack, not a usb port. We've had no technical problems with these at all.

title: THESE ARE CRAZY GOOD
review: I've been using these almost everyday since they arrived and AM LOVING THEM!! These are the 2nd pair of Santana bluetooth I've ordered (the 1st being from the "oye" line) These are head and shoulders better than those. They are super easy to connect to bluetooth tooth. I've used both my phone and my computer as devices with ZERO problems or drops. The sound is freaking AMAZING! I started off with Soundgarden's 'Slaves and Bulldozers' and from the 1st second of that baseline it felt like I was enveloped in sound. I then listened to Lana Del Ray to hear a airy, female voice and the sound was pure and ethereal. You can hear each distinct part of the music. The bass is balanced and not overblown. I use these on my morning walks everyday so now they just play all random stuff. They are comfortable and even if I sweat in them, they wipe clean to a like-new product. The charge lasts for a solid 24 hours. The controls are ergonomically in the correct place. These headphones prove that music is indeed the best invention in the world!

title: Works pretty good
review: These earbuds are pretty good. They tilt at an angle. Much different than previous earbuds,which stick straight out. These,  are pretty comfortable, they have a rubber ear piece and gently angle out. They sound fine. Honestly,  earbuds have to be replaced so often,  it's hard to get stoked about them.

title: I am very happy with these.
review: These are in my opinion the best wireless headphones I've worn. They are so light, flexible and comfortable. I've worn them dozens of times now for hours at a time. I've had no issues with connectivity and the sound had been clear and vibrant.

title: These things are RAD!!
review: This is the 1st set of wireless headphones I've ever owned and they sound like FREEDOM! They arrived in a pretty classy box with 2 extra silicone earbud inserts and a charging cable. The earphones came in a small and suprisingly solid, snap-close carrying case that IS THE CHARGER! Meaning, you place the earbuds into the case and then plug your charging cable into the case. Very cool. I had to download the jaybird app to set up the earbuds. I had no problems and followed the prompts successfully. The sound from these little guys is freakin' amazing! You can very clearly hear distinct instruments during songs. There is no fuzziness, just very crystal clear sound. They are pretty comfortable to wear. The charge is supposed to last 6 or so hours. After wearing them a few times exercising,  I just out them back on charger. I hope they last. Very very happy with this order.

title: Priced right, works fine.
review: For the price, these are great. I am totally over spending a small fortune in headphones for my kids. They get excited or absentminded and chew or pull on cord which renders headphones useless. The sound quality on these is totally fine. They are very very light. Easy fit on their heads too.

title: At this price point, pretty good!
review: For an inexpensive and lightweight pair of headphones, these are suprisingly well made. My kids break these as the school year goes on and it's nice to have a reasonably priced set to replace them with.

title: Only has 1 ear!
review: Didnt realize these only had 1 ear bud. Bummer. I need two. Seems like a basic, light headphone though.

title: Good sound, very good microphone, very good noise cancellation, always connect to each other
review:
These look different but they are comfortable & stay put, I guess earbud design is not a settled issue yet. I have been using these primarily for voice calls & listening to music on my computer in a very noisy warehouse where noise cancellation is paramount.
I have pretty much made these my 'computer' earbuds because the microphone is so good & the volume can be loud. The music sounds good but isn't especially dynamic. There is no volume control at the earbud but they will start/pause & answer calls with touch. They will also answer a call by double-touching the button.
I like the voice confirmation when turning on & off the noise cancellation. Instead of just different tones a voice says "active noise cancellation on/off" or "talk through mode" (it gets loud in the warehouse & I couldn't always be sure if the cancellation was on with my other earbuds). These default to no noise cancellation when they are turned off by putting them in the charge case which I do not like.
Pairing was easy & the two earbuds have never failed to connect to each other which is something I can't say about any other Bluetooth set I have used.

title: Sound great & comfortable but they quit pairing with each other
review:
These sound excellent though they aren't as dynamic as other earbuds I have tried & are a little light on bass. They are very comfortable, stay in the ear very well & I like that they grip the inner ear instead of going around the ear. Only having the inner ear clamps also makes the charger smaller. The earbuds charge in a small box that has a battery of it's own so they can recharge in a pocket.

When we first got these they set up easily & quickly. After about 2 weeks they quit pairing each other. Now, each earbud will connect individually with a phone but not with each other. I would drop a star but my daughter still uses them, one at a time & still likes them.

title: Compact & full of nice features
review:
This station is set up for all of the latest tech. It comes with two USB-C outputs which I hope become the standard connection soon. I used them to link my phone & also as headphone connections. The only video outputs are 4K which had me looking around for the for the weird cables that came with my monitors. It has two USB Gen 1 & one USB Gen 2. I appreciate that it has more connections than the Dell stations we get at work.

Everything was plug & play, my Dell Latitude 5300 immediately took to the new station. The computer & phone stayed at 100% all day while plugged in. I am surprised at the price premium of the dock is compared to the Dell docks even if it does have more features.

title: Good sound, excellent microphone & volume control.
review:
These earbuds sound good & don't have an exaggerated bass. The USB-C connection is flawless but it does stick out unlike a 3.5mm headphone with a right angle. The earbuds fit well but are bulky & the wires are heavy.

I love the volume and pause/play button section. It is large & easy to tell the controls by feel. The earbuds are also easy to tell the left from the right by feel because the left is convex & the right is concave. The microphone is better than any other set of earbuds I have had to date & I go through a lot.

When these earbuds are plugged into my LG phone calls & texts sound through the speaker when the earbuds are not being used.

title: Very good sound quality
review: I purchased this DAC/amp a few months ago for myself and liked it so much I bought another as a Christmas present for my son. It provides excellent audio quality with my Focal and Sennheiser headphones.

title: Easy to use and good sound quality
review: It is so nice to be able to use wired headphones with my iPhone XR. A wired connection with my Sennheiser HD598 headphones provides better sound quality that using bluethooth headphones. For me sound quality is far more important than bluethooth convenience. This seems more sturdy than the Apple version and enables a high resolution audio signal when using Amazon Music HD or Spotify. I liked it so much, I also purchased the updated version.

title: Nice upgrade for Martin Logan Mikros 90 headphones
review: I was very pleasantly surprised what a difference these ear pads made to my Mikros 90 headphones. These are more comfortable and improve the sound quality of the headphones versus the original ear pads. They are a bit tedious to put on but are well worth the effort. If you own a set of Martin Logan Mikros 90 headphones, I would encourage you replace the ear pads with these Geekria pads even if the originals are not worn out. You will appreciate the improvement. Highly recommended.

title: Very nice headphones
review: I already own a pair of Sennheiser HD 598 open back headphones, which are excellent!! I ordered the HD 598 Cs to use for travel and times when a closed back headphone would be needed. The 598 Cs was a very good choice.  They are easy to drive with portable audio devices, so no need for a separate headphone amp.  You also get an iPhone compatible mic that works well for phone calls.The sound quality is very nice, although a bit different from the open back 598. Closed back headphones are not as open and spacious in their sound presentation as open back headphones. The 598 Cs has a bit more bass emphasis, but not excessive like other brands of headphones. Vocals, acoustic guitar, strings and percussion are well presented on the 598 Cs. Comfort is excellent also. I can wear these for extended periods without fatigue. If you are looking for a comfortable set of headphones with very good audio quality, you will really enjoy the HD 598 Cs.

title: Nice case but too small to accommodate my Sennheiser HD598 headphones
review: I purchased this case for my Sennheiser HD598 headphones, but unfortunately, it is too small to accommodate them comfortably. In order to zip the case closed, it is necessary to rotate the ear piece 30-45 degrees, which I'm not comfortable with since the HD598 ear piece is fixed and not intended to rotate. For a smaller mid-sized set of headphones, the db case would work great since the case is well built. If you own a set of full size audiophile headphones, you should consider other options for a case.

title: Excellent replacement cable for Sennheiser headphones
review: Very good quality replacement cable for my Sennheiser HD558 headphones. It was a very easy plug into the the headphones. Audio quality is as good as the original cable and the 1.5m length is perfect for use with portable devices. Highly recommended.

title: The AKG K450 (& K451) are very nice headphones. They are the same in sound quality
review: The AKG K450 (& K451) are very nice headphones. They are the same in sound quality, but the K451 has an iphone compatible, in line mic with volume controls. These are very light wight and comfortable to wear. I could wear them comfortably for hours. The tone is clear and smooth. The bass response is nice, with warm mids and smooth highs. If you are looking for a heavy bass however, such as rap or hip hop, you should look elsewhere. For a very comfortable, nice sounding set of headphones, you can't go wrong with either the K450 or K451.

title: well controlled bass and excellent high end response
review: For $95, I could not pass up this deal. The sound on the Mikros 90 headphones is well worth the price. They deliver a very precise sound with tight, well controlled bass and excellent high end response. The are very well suited for jazz and vocals, and they can rock. Van Morrison's "Moondance" and Tony Bennett's duets CD "Playing With My Friends" sounds great. Tony's duet with Cheryl Crow sounds awesome. For some rock, I listened to Thin Lizzy's "Dedication" and guitar solos were clear and strong. These headphones deliver a very clear and accurate sound, so if you listen to a poorly recorded record, you will notice the marginal audio quality of the recording. As others have stated, they are quite snug on your head. The major issue I had with them initially was that they rotated too far forward, allowing the forward edge of the headphone under the ear pads to press into the side of my face just in front of the ears. This got to be uncomfortable after 15-20 minutes. I noticed that they did not rotate in the opposite direction, so I decided to listen with the ear pads on the opposite ear (left channel over the right ear and right channel on the left ear). In this position, the ear pads stay perfectly flat on my ears for a much more comfortable fit. I really enjoy the refined sound that these headphones produce.

title: So easy to use.
review: My radio in my car bit the dust so I ordered this to keep me awake on my trips to see my grandkids. Love the FM radio. The sound depends on your earbuds--good earbuds great sound, cheap earbuds good sound. It's not stereo, though.

title: Incredible, but kinda pricey
review:
I'm a HUGE Sony fan, I own Sony TVs, headphones, cameras, even my car stereo is a Sony aftermarket install. I was very, very excited to try this monitor.
And I have to say... it's an excellent upgrade from my old one (but to be fair, my old gaming monitor was 1440p). The 4K resolution at this size feels like a retina display- seems like you need a magnifying glass to see any pixels. I love the style of it as well- the design is very reminiscent of the modern Playstation and would fit right in as a monitor for someone with a PS5. I really like the way the monitor even has some clever cable hiding features in the base, it's not just aesthetic, it's got a function.
The only downsides are that:
1) The angle of the base means it can't sit flush against a wall. If you've got a small room with a gaming desk along a wall, the monitor is going to sit a few inches away from the wall because of the stand.
2) It's almost obscenely expensive for a 4k monitor. I mean, my Sony 4k TV was half the price and larger than this is. Granted, this has some pretty sweet features like higher FPS and GSync, but it still seems like a pretty high price tag.

If you can justify the price, it's a solid product.

title: Excellent for the asking price!
review:
OnePlus already has standard buds which are more expensive than these. I've tried those and was fairly impressed with them for the price compared to other leading brands (*cough* airpods). I'll be honest, I wasn't sure what to expect here with these "Nord" brand ones. Nord is supposed to be OnePlus' value brand, and the price reflects that. I've tried out headphones that cost more than this which I didn't care for, so I was a little anxious.
However, I have to admit I'm fairly impressed. They sound better to me than other wireless earbuds at this price range. While they aren't as well made as the standard Oneplus buds, they aren't bad at all, especially for the money. Much like the Nord phones themselves, Oneplus seems to know how to make a value product that punches way above its price tag.
I know the brand has taken a hit lately with their Android 12 offerings (still holding out for OOS13 to fix this colorOS mess they are in), but I can say with confidence that their earbuds are pretty great and worth considering whether or not you are a fan of the brand.

title: Works, but could be better.
review:
It does what it claims- it's bone conduction so the sound doesn't need to cover your ears to be audible. That's great if you want/need open ears so that you can hear those around you. However there are brand name versions of this that are much clearer. This is good, and it works, but the sound quality is going to be lacking some fidelity if you're looking for rich musical notes compared to earbuds in this price range. Everything has a sort of heavy treble tone to it.
The microphone is pretty good, as long as you don't mind it always sticking out. Even if you twist it away, it's always there, just pointing behind you. You can't really remove it. Callers can hear me, and much better than other headsets that have a mic up by your ears. I wish it could be removed to look a little less in-your-face when you don't need it. Also, I wish the unit had USB-C like all other new devices. This has the older micro-USB plug. I still have plenty of those in my wire bin, but most of my newer tech uses C and I prefer to have one set of cables for most things (my laptop, phone, over-hear phones, etc, all use USBC now). Just feels like they could have made this a little bit better. But it works.

title: Sounds great and super comfortable
review:
These are excellent for listening to audio in a noisy environment such as an airplane or bus. I wasn't expecting much out of the noise reduction system at this price point but it was pretty decent. Even more useful, however, is the ambient noise mode which will allow you to hear some of the background noise in case you need to be aware (someone talking to you or if you need to hear traffic on a bike, etc). I've used modes like that on modern Sony headphones, and was surprised to find it on something in this price range.

But above all else, I'm most impressed with the comfort of these. The cushion feels premium, I don't know how else to describe it, but it reminds me much more of headphones from brand names that cost several times what this does. The build quality looks much better than my cheap wireless headphones too. The only thing I wasn't impressed with is the call quality with the microphone. But that's sort of par for the course, as only the truly name brand higher end ones seem to get that right- putting a mic by your ears and still somehow picking up your voice over the background noise is a neat trick that isn't copied well by other brands.
Otherwise, for just music and audiobooks with some decent NR and comfort, this is a great value!

title: Move over, Sony!
review:
Technics is a brand well known in audio gear, originally a sort of higher-end branch of Panasonic. They are known for pro equipment like DJ turntables, however I haven't seen them in a while and surely never seen them trying to compete in the consumer wireless headphones space before!
I own various wireless headphones, from cheap brands to industry standard Sonys, and I have to say- I usually understand why Sony is considered the industry standard for prosumer headphones. Others come close, but I've never actually felt like a product in the same price range could surpass it, until now. This set of earphones actually has pretty remarkable ANR, and they are actually more comfortable than my Sony sets ever were (to my ears at least, I can't speak for others). The sound quality is no slouch either, which is, let's face it, the reason you'd be interested in this at all.
I can't say for certain that it is BETTER than the Sony in sound quality, but it is at least as good, yet more comfortable to wear and actually sports a longer running time. I have to admit, I was ready to come here and say that these are overpriced when I first saw it, but I'm pleasantly surprised at how good these are. I shouldn't have been, Technics are quality and always have been.

title: Sound is ok, controls are difficult
review:
This is a decent sounding pair of budget friendly wireless earbuds. They aren't the best for the price, but they aren't the worst either. They're about normal. But one of the big features of this set is supposed to be the touch controls, however my daughter found them completely unreliable. Sometimes she had to touch them 5x before they registered to pause the music, which made her more likely to pull out the player and pause it there instead.
I'd say these are 4 star headphones except for that selling point failure, if you are buying these because of the touch controls, I'd have to reduce the score to 3.

title: Cool for kids, but could be improved
review: My daughter loves these for the their fit and the concept overall. She has small ears and said this is one of the first comfortable earbuds she managed out of the box. The sound quality is ok, but she really likes the mirror functionality of the case. The problem with that feature, however, is that the display stays on for too long sometimes. It will show her the battery level when she closes it, but then you can't turn it off right away- you have to wait for the display to time out so that you can use the mirror again. Kind of silly for a case that advertises using it as a makeup mirror. But otherwise it's a pretty cool set of affordable earbuds.

title: Good for what they are, but there are better ones
review:
I love the concept of bone conducting headphones, and if you haven't tried a set before you really should! The sensation is a little unsettling at first but when you get used to it, you are rewarded with the ability to hear deep bass in your sounds without covering your ears completely the way ear buds and over-the-ear headphones require. They're not for everyone admittedly, but I love that I can feel/hear the sound and still be aware of my surroundings and able to respond if someone calls my name.
Good bone conducting headphones are easily 2x-3x the price of these, so keep that in mind. This is not going to be an alternative to a big name brand set. However, they aren't terrible either, and I kind of like them for the novelty of it at the price point.
If audio quality is your primary goal, understand that for the same money you can get a very decent pair of traditional headphones that will outshine this. But where's the fun in that?
4 stars for the novelty of it, but I give the sound quality and cost value only 3 stars.

title: Wireless, good looks, and TRUE stereo!
review:
I was skeptical because I've used multi-point bluetooth speaker arrays before that just sort of doubled-up a mono signal to different speakers. But this appears to be using the same Bluetooth 5 protocol that wireless earbuds utilize to send a proper dual-stream (left and right) channel for true stereo sound!
I did some sound tests that play only on each channel at a time, and it performed EXACTLY as intended! They look really cool and the lights add a lot of character to an evening garden party as well. The only issue however is that they don't get as loud as other speakers I've used. They are plenty loud for any sort of indoor space, but you can't really place these at either side of a backyard and expect to hear each other at maximum volume. You need bigger DJ-style speakers for that. But if you just want some background tunes to set the mood at a get-together on an average sized porch or deck, these are very nice and don't require any electrical outlet nearby.
I like them and intend to to use them more as the warm weather sets in.

title: Excellent value for headsets
review: Ok, first things first: Don't expect these to be great audiophile-sounding headphones. They are not. Can you listen to music with them? Sure. But at less than 7 bucks per set, set your expectations realistically. Then be pleasantly surprised when they are surprisingly decent for private listening on a budget. No, you won't get full symphony dynamic range response- Where they shine is in quantity and availability. If you've got a room of people having zoom meetings with clients or kids at home in online classrooms, these are invaluable. They have integrated microphones for 2-way communication, and GREAT for listening to movies / shows on a trip. We have a large family and on a recent plane ride, we were able to take these along for in-flight entertainment. Plenty for everyone plus some extras if anything breaks or gets lost. They are kind of large but at least the ear parts pivot 90 degrees flat so that they fit in a backpack with other things. The cords are also flat which is great for wrapping and avoiding tangles if they get thrown into a box together. The colors are fun, each of my kids could pick a different color to their liking. I highly recommend these for classrooms or large families on a budget.

title: Great for music AND calls!
review:
I have been on the search for wireless earbuds that sound ok and can handle calls, yet don't cost as much as Apple's... and I think this is IT! I had tried cheap brands, and wasn't surprised that the sound wasn't good. I tried expensive brands (even those costing almost the same as airpods) and while they had some excellent sound quality and noise cancellation, the callers couldn't hear me! I sounded under water and very compressed.
I kept having to resort to an old-school wired headset for calls, or bigger over-the-ear headphones with a good mic. But this set is that perfect blend! Decent sound quality, pretty intuitive to use, and the mic actually works for calls! And on top of all that, they are pretty affordable and from a name brand I recognize!
My daughter isn't into the look of the hoop-over-ear design, but honestly they are comfortable to wear and work exactly as expected so I can't help recommending these and singing their praises. Well done Skullcandy!

title: Excellent normal earphones! No frills, as there shouldn't be!
review: This is a great value for 2 "classic" wired earphones. They come with multiple tips so you can install ones that will fit your ears (we have small ear canals in my family), and they do a decent job blocking outside noise when properly fitted. They get plenty loud (like, loud enough that the warning on my phone makes sense to give), and the sound quality is fine. It's not audiophile quality, but I'm not expecting them to be. I'm expecting them to be functional at this price, and they definitely are that! I'm giving one to my daughter to use with her music player on the bus ride, and the other I'm using as a backup in my camera case for video gigs (I had my over-the-ear studio monitors die on a job once, so having a no-frills backup pair is welcome) and maybe to throw in a backpack when I don't want to charge my wireless earphones for my phone. Thank goodness some phones still have a standard 3.5mm jack! So glad they are still selling classic earbuds, and these are a great value at a great price!

title: Excellent mid-quality without breaking the bank
review:
These are very good mid-range headphones. They look cool, are comfortable to wear, and have much better sound quality than the cheapo headphones you find on Amazon. Sure, they're not Bang and Olufson, but you're not paying that insane premium price tag either.
For what these are, they are excellent quality. Has support for different types of cable connections, and when used with a proper Quad DAC audio player, the sound quality is impressive for the money!

title: Cute and funcitonal
review:
I've used other wearable cooling fans before, but they never looked great- always more function over form. I really like that these look like headphones that you can wear around your neck. It almost makes me wonder if they should make a version that doubles as actual headphones too!
Only caveat I have is that they are actually kind of long and not really as adjustable as I'd like. Great for adults, but my daughter who wanted to use it found it sticks out a bit too far to wear comfortably without looking funny. Otherwise, exactly what I expected it to be.

title: Essentially a TRS splitter, but so much nicer
review:
For the type of run-and-gun projects I do, if I can get away with plugging a mic directly into the camera ( often a single stereo 3.5mm jack these days) I will always prefer to do that than a dual-sound setup that needs to by synced in post. However, sometimes you need more than one mic, so what's a one-man-crew to do? Well, traditionally I would use a TRS break out cable, which essentially looks like a headphone splitter Y-cable, but splits the Left and Right channel into separate plugs instead of doubling them. That's great because I can connect one mic to Left and the other to Right, then split them up and remix in post as needed.
But this is much more elegant solution- It is essentially the same idea, splitting the L + R into two sides, but not only is it less messy since you don't have Y cables dangling, it also serves as a point in which to mount 2 coldshoe receivers directly to single shoe mount, essentially making this an all-in-one solution to turn a single mic input setup into a dual one. No additional hardware necessary behind the second mic. I love this solution, it looks more professional, it is more reliable, and I would definitely recommend checking it out if you're in the same boat as me!

title: Affordable, good features
review:
[[VIDEOID:5a1bce8644783f1974b4478fd2851303]] The good: This device works! See the video attached using a Sony mirrorless camera going into the HDMI input as a webcam, recorded in the Windows 10 Camera app of my desktop. It has its own audio inputs as well as a headphone monitoring jack if your camera doesn't have its own, making this a really complete system. It also has an HDMI out if you want to pass through and send the signal on to a display or projector. I also really like that the box is large enough to dissipate its own heat, unlike other "industry standard" equipment in this category (I'm looking at you, overpriced Magewell!).
The bad: The build quality is a little bit suspect. Before I first set it all up, I actually found that the board inside was loose. Shaking the box, you can visually see the hdmi ports rattle around and not line up with the holes in box unless you tilt it the right way. It seems, however, that once everything is plugged in, it works properly. But that shouldn't happen.

Bottom line: This box is a fraction of the cost of some of the big players in this market (Magewell), yet seems to offer excellent features. And honestly, it just works. If you're looking for a setup like this on a budget, I say its worth checking this model out.

title: A good mid-ranger
review: This is head-and-shoulders better than the cheapo webcams out there. Many webcams claim to be 1080p but actually either don't have the sensor or lens to actually resolve that much resolution, rather you get an up-sampled low resolution image in a 1080p frame. But not this one! This seems to have a properly sampled image which explains why it costs a little more than your average cheapo. The microphones are OK, they aren't great, but I always prefer using a headset or external mic anyway. I sit too far away from my screen to reply on camera mics. It won't compete with 4K brand name webcams, but in my opinion this can hold its own very well and does an admirable job for the money. It is definitely better than the built in cam on my old laptop, and adds a lot of value to my desktop for meetings. I recommend it for the price.

title: Not really loving the concept
review:
I listen to lectures on headphones when doing chores around the house and often can't hear people trying to get my attention. I've seen neck speakers before, and I thought it would be a very cool option for me as my family gets kind of annoyed that I can't hear them and they can't tell if I'm currently listening to something.
But I'll be honest, after trying these, I'm not really loving them. I had a pair of sunglasses speakers that aimed sound towards my ears, but this sort of blasts sound out and around me. Like, not even towards my ears. Basically, it seems just as loud to someone else in the room with me as it does to me, which then begs the question of why not just use an external speaker at that point? The call quality was just OK as well. The one thing I can say is that the build quality seems quite good. It feels really durable and made with premium feeling materials. But I just can't shake the feeling that for the asking price, I'm missing the point of these. Shouldn't the speakers be facing upwards towards my ears instead of blasting at each other in front of my Adam's Apple? Seems like a weird design that might be missing the mark.

title: Great replacement for the orignal
review:
We got this to replace some broken Apple earbuds for someone in my family. You can tell they aren't Apple, but they also don't cost what Apple charges. The sound is actually super respectably good! And be careful, they're pretty good at isolating noise around you too! I lent them to a friend and had to chase them down the street before they could hear me calling their name!
They are pretty comfortable too, I'm comfortable recommending this product.

title: Wonky UI, but very cool!
review:
My younger kids wanted a music player but they are too young for a phone so I looked into these dedicated touch-screen players. These are a big step up from the old mp3 players of my days. First of all, they have bluetooth so you can actually use modern wireless headphones which is awesome, in addition to regular 3.5mm headphones. The sound quality is excellent, and it even has a built in speaker for use without any headphones at all!
Granted, the speaker isn't very loud, but the fact that it HAS one is huge in my opinion! And my daughter thinks so too.
The user interface is a little bit difficult to figure out, things aren't very intuitive to find and sometimes it seems to respond with a bit of a lag, but kids seem to adapt to it pretty quickly. One thing I was not able to get working however, is the video function. The product details claim it can play video and indeed, there is a video function on the menu, however I could not get anything to play on it. It does not recognize any file extension other than avi, and none of the standard AVI codecs that I tried did anything. I have no idea what this thing can actually play so if you're getting it hoping to put little videos on it, you may be sorely disappointed!

title: Love a good wired pair.
review: Wireless headphones are all the rage right now, but sometimes I just want a good wired pair. When I'm using laptop especially, using Bluetooth headphones introduces lag and another thing that needs to be charged. These are excellent premium feeling wired 'phones that include an inline mic and controls if your device supports it. When used with my desktop that offers only a TRS plug (only two lines), it works as just a pair of headphones, with decent sound quality and bass response. On my LG phone or laptop which accept a TRRS plug (3 lines), the mic works as an input as well. My laptop didn't respond to the volume control buttons, but I think most phones will. Regardless, I'm impressed with the quality and presentation for the money this costs.

title: Better than other cheapos
review:
There are fortunately many wireless headphones in this price range these days. Usually they are pretty similar, but this is one of the better ones. The first thing I noticed is how SOFT the ear cups are. It feels like something that belongs on a more expensive set, almost luxurious. That makes these much more comfortable to wear for long periods versus many of the other inexpensive headphones. The build quality feels good, and the sound quality is pretty decent too. Speakers of this size are usually pretty good at their bass response, and these are no exception. They naturally have a bit of noise isolation due to the cup design, and you have the option to connect a 3.5mm cable to use them as traditional wired headphones as well.
The one thing I DON'T like, is the microphone. Don't buy these for phone calls. The mic is too far from your mouth to separate you from background noises. Yes, I know airpods also have their mic far from your math but Apple has some sort of magic voodoo to make that work somehow. I've never liked the mic on any of these headphones, so I'm used to that by now. But I feel like these are marketed more for people who want to listen to music, and for that they are great and comfortable! I honestly wish they would disable the handsfree profile so that my phone wouldn't keep trying to use it for phone calls. Otherwise, a solid buy for this price!

title: Does exactly what it is supposed to!
review:
I go through these quite often, sometimes attaching a laptop to a sound system for presentation, or when plugging in modern 3.5mm monitoring headphones to older mixer equipment. The ones I have tend to fall apart eventually after a lot of repeated use, but this seems to be holding up so far!
Sound transmission seems solid, and they have been holding up well so far, so I'd say this gets 5 stars for being exactly what it is supposed to be.

title: Cute concept for kids!
review:
My daughter enjoys listening to music in bed and on car trips. The problem with traditional headphones are that they either fall our of her ears (earbuds) or are uncomfortable if she falls asleep (over the ear). This solves those issues. Although these are advertised as more of a eye mask with music, which I imagine would be a sensory experience to promote sleep, my daughter uses them more like a headband/sweatband to wear around the house. She just cleaned her room wearing them over her forehead and it reminded me of an 80's workout video. If it's cold outside, I think they'd make a pretty interesting alternative to keep your child's ears warm as well.
She says they are comfortable, and sound good, although I can't verify these claims since it doesn't really fit me. She likes them, so that's a win as far as I'm concerned!

title: Bought as a gift for my mom
review:
I actually own a set of Ailihen headphones for my laptop, and my daughter uses one for her phone, so we were already familiar with the brand. My mom saw ours and mentioned how she liked over-the-ear style more than earbuds, so I picked this up in black and gold for her.
She loves it, and it looks great! So, another satisfied Ailihen customer.

title: A good cost effective over-the-head option
review: These seem to be a pretty great option for over-the-head style headphones that fold for storage and are still affordable. My son's back to school list required a pair of headphones for some computer lab work, and he hates the earbud style ones. This is comfortable for both kids and adults, has a decent amount of noise isolation, and even has the inline mic for TRRS plugs like a phone if used in that type of setup. Extra points because they actually look more expensive than they are. My son loves them!

title: Impressed with Roku, wasn't expecting to be.
review:
Bought this to replace an old laptop being used as a netflix player on a family member's TV. It was on sale for a few dollars less than an Amazon Fire Stick, so I figured it was worth a shot.
Pleasantly surprised by how great it is- the way you can search multiple sources for content, use your phone as a remote or as an audio channel (so you can plug headphones into your phone and mute the TV- how cool!), and even its selection of free content, was more than I expected. I didn't buy it for myself, but now that I've helped set it up, I've got half a mind to replace my android-based TV box with one of these!

title: They are as cute as they look in the pictures, and the noise isolation is impressive.
review: My daughter loves this. Very cute, stylish looking headphones, and surprisingly comfortable to wear. My kids especially don't like earbuds, so the over-the-ear style like these are a welcome alternative. I was actually impressed at how much noise isolation they provide... it really blocks out the outside sound, you end up yelling when trying to talk without realizing, and that's not even when there is any music playing! Sound quality is OK- not as amazing as my brand name speakers, but good enough for what it is. A little echo-ey, but a worthwhile compromise for the over-the-head style and this level of noise isolation.

title: Good earbuds
review: These are nice earbuds usually my mom can have just one on all day without it going dead

title: Great
review: I contacted them in regards to my earbuds I insured broke and they immediately reimbursed me as soon as I sent them the product.  They are a great insurance to have.

title: Nice headphones that cancelled the sounds for you and you only lol
review: It does a really good job for cancelling the sounds from outside of the headphones. But it doesn't prevent other people from hearing your music lol. It's worth the price. Decent quality.

title: Good sound quality
review: It's my first pair of earbuds ever. The sound quality is amazing. I used it for work, for me, I think the battery life could be better. I wish they have the battery percentage somewhere shown on the case so that I know how much battery left.

title: Good Quality
review: JBL is my favorite brand of headphones. They usually last a long time and when they go bad I just buy another pair. I was a little worried because of the reviews but I've had these headphones for a while and they've worked excellently.

title: Not For The Everyday User!
review: These headphones lasted approx. 3 months. The wires were super thin and just using them when I walked, the tiny wires inside disconnected & broke and no longer any sound.

title: Great sound quality and work perfectly!
review: These Bluetooth headphones fit perfect on my 6 year old daughter and they are comfortable. They are easy to charge and fold up easily. The sound quality is great too! Perfect for traveling and any location at any time!

title: The perfect headphones for a 5 year old.
review:
These Bluetooth headphones are even better than what I was expecting. I got these for my 5 year old for school this year and they are perfect.

They are comfortable to wear and the noise level is controlled for safety. They also have the option to use as wireless (connect through Bluetooth), or wired to plug directly into a device.

They charged up fairly quick as well. When charging, the light is red and once complete, the light turns blue.

Finally, they fold up easily and are portable - Which I love! Highly recommend these for a young child!

title: All treble, no bass.
review:
I wanted to love these wireless earbuds, but I unfortunately can’t for several reasons.

The sound quality is not good. The description says “extreme bass”, but there is no bass at all.. it’s all treble.
Second of all the bottom metal piece on the one earbuds fell off after one use (in pictures). They still work without that piece, however these are brand new, and broke after 1 use. 😭

The things I do like: The small, convenient charging case. It’s nice and compact. The other thing I do like is the comfort. The design is similar to Apple earbuds and they are comfortable on the ears, even after a long period.

Unfortunately with these, the cons exceed the pros, and I just can’t recommend.

title: Average sound at best.
review: I like that these Bluedio wireless Bluetooth earbuds are easy to pair with your Bluetooth devices and they charge pretty quickly.  I like the earbud case is a charging box.  They come with small, medium, and large earbud nubs to properly fit into your ear.  The main thing I don't like about these earbuds is the sound quality isn't the greatest.  There isn't any base sound to these earbuds, so if you like a lot  of bass, you won't be happy with these earbuds.  The sound is clear, it's just treble or flat sounding.  Also, the volume isn't very loud, even at full volume they aren't very loud.  If you just want to hear music, these work fine, but if you like a lot of bass/depth I would pass on these earbuds.

title: Comfortable to wear for long periods!
review: This headset is nice and surprisingly comfortable. For the price, you can’t beat it! Works wonderfully for phone calls. Works for music too, however the sound is very trebly. It’s nice that the ear hook is detachable and you can use on either ear!

title: Top quality headphones at an amazing price!
review: Love everything about these headphones! They are well cushioned on the ear pieces which makes them comfortable to wear! The piece on the top of the head is also cushioned for comfort and to prevent hair pulling. It’s great that these are wireless. It’s so easy to pair with your Bluetooth device! They also sound amazing! Noise canceling works well too! They come with a USB plug for charging and a cord if you wish to listen to plugged in instead of wireless. The case is so nice too! Even came with a scented packet inside which smells lovely!! Outstanding quality at an amazing price!

title: Comfortable, however start to hurt after long period of time
review: These earbuds are nice and easy to use! They come with a charging case, charging cord, and extra pieces. My wife wore these for a long period at work and was fine for about 2 hours, however they start to hurt a bit after leaving in for a long period. If you plan to wear for short periods, these are perfect! They lock right in your ear and don’t fall out. The sound quality is amazing and you actually don’t hear any background noise at all with these on. My wife noticed when walking she hears her feet (thump thump). But that is really all that you hear, other than the music in your ears!

title: Wow!! So comfortable at a terrific price!
review: My wife is very pleased with these wireless headphones! They come with a convenient storage case, extra pieces, and a charger. I can’t believe how comfortable these are! So easy to use too! Just connect to Bluetooth, turn on, and you’re ready to go! They also have volume control. The only downfall is there is not a lot of bass, but they still sound great. For the price you can’t go wrong!

title: Noise canceling and comfortable!
review: My wife tried these today for the first time and loves them! She listens to music while she works and always just used the Apple earbuds, however always complained about background noise. These sound great, are comfortable, and she hears no background noise at all! Amazing quality at a great price! Love that they come with replacement  pieces and a travel case too!

title: VERY good price for such quality sound
review:
I have had Etymotic earbuds for 15 years - my 10 year old expensive ones finally lost the left channel and currently I can't replace them at their $140 price so I tried these as a cheap interim solution. The earbuds are not marked L or R but both work very nicely - also for my small ear canals the narrower size fits well. HIGHLY Satisfactory for listening while on the train or bus, shut out most ambient sound nicely. RECOMMENDED
By the way, unless you need the microphone don't bother...go for the version without.

title: System failing after a year
review: Ok after using this pair for over a year now, I can write a proper review for it. First few months worked great, no issue. After about a year, I got 3 highlighted problems that keep happening. 1/ the system/bluetooth connection started to fail, it won’t connect to my phone, or is able to connect but has really loud random static. 2/ Random loud static, freaked me out many times. 3/ Won’t charge when i put them back in the pod, the pod is full of battery, but the pair just won’t take power from it. Today i was using the headphone while doin yard work, worked for 15 mins then they has decided to stop working completely, the app won’t recognize them, they don't take power from a fully charged pod. I’m done with these. Their sound worked great, i don’t have a problem with sound quality, it seems like its the connection system fails, between phone and headphones and pod… Spent $200 on these originally, i’ll probably buy a different brand because I want them to last at least 3 years.

title: Great headphones but terrible phone headset
review:
The sound quality of these headphones is amazing for what they cost. I love the inline volume control and single control button that works with my Samsung Galaxy Note 3 to answer calls, play/pause audio, etc.

However, as far as taking calls on these goes, they produce a very obnoxious echo for the other party if the volume is turned up above a minimal level. My guess is that the mic pics up the output from the headphones and feeds it back to the other party. This is a bummer - they have a mic, but it's essentially useless. Ah well, I just got them to use as headphones anyway.

title: Great bluetooth headphones, poor fit
review:
These headphones are great in every aspect except for comfort. They're the behind-the-head style that's oh-so-popular these days, but the fit is far worse than the comfortable (but breakage-prone) Logitech Wireless Headphones for iPod that I had before. These pair easily with my bluetooth-enabled Thinkpad, which is nice, and also with my phone (at the same time) so I can take calls and it will switch from the music, then switch back when my call is over. The built-in mic works surprisingly well, for a really hassle-free bluetooth experience.

Now for the bad: I feel like these headphones were designed for kids. They're so small (I was really shocked when I opened the packaging at how small they are) that they pinch my ears hard. The headband just simply isn't big enough for a normal-sized head. Another minor thing is that they have a mind of their own when you put them down. If you sit them down with the earpieces facing up (which you invariably will when you have to take your hourly break from the pain they cause), they "walk" themselves off of the desk if you put them down the wrong way.

title: Amazing sound quality, comfort and no breakage! (edit: Ok, they did finally break)
review:
I got these for a good deal after rebate, and was worried about the breakage problems I read about, but for the price I couldn't pass them up. I've had them for about 3 months now and I must say, I love them. I haven't seen any evidence of cracking, I believe that the problem has been fixed, or perhaps I got lucky. Either way, the quality seems great to me, both build and sound. I use them at work with my computer and it's great not to have to deal with tangled cords. The batteries easily last for a full 8-9 hour day and I definitely get a lot of questions about them from people around the office. Overall I'd have to say if you can get them for under $50 after rebate you really can't pass these up.

Edit: The headphones finally did break after about 8 months of daily use. Logitech sent me a replacement pair (which was really easy, no hassle, great customer service), which worked well for about 4 more months, and then the headband broke on those as well. When I called for another replacement pair, they told me that they were discontinued and instead they would just refund me what I paid for them. All in all, I'd say they were a great deal, but minus 1 star because they are pretty flimsy (I'd actually change the star rating if Amazon would let me, but I can't).

title: Doesn't charge properly
review: Doesn't charge the earbuds consistently, the case only lasts one charge. Earbuds randomly shut off. Also, uncomfortable on smaller ears.

title: Great Headphones!
review: The battery life and clarity on the other end, made me sure I chose the right headphones.

title: These work great!
review:
I am really enjoying using these headphones. The sound quality is fantastic... it really is! It is clean and clear, no matter what I am listening to. The battery lasts quite a while as well.
Plus these headphones are very easy to use and the buttons pretty standard. They're comfortable to wear for long periods of time too. I honestly couldn't think of one negative thing to say about them. These headphones are an excellent find! I'm very happy with them and use them all of the time.

title: Better alternative to headphones for gaming!
review:
I can't be the only one, but I do not like wearing headphones for an extended period of time. Ear buds are uncomfortable, and regular headphones are just too much after awhile. I VERY much enjoyed this speaker. You are able to have immersive, omni-directional surround-sound quality audio that is FAR more comfortable than any headphones.
It didn't take long at all for me to forget that I had this super light (12oz) speaker sitting around my neck. I was also very glad that the wired USB cable is almost 10ft long, because I have stood up to leave my desk, forgetting that I had the speaker on.
The best part is that you are able to hear your audio, but ALSO hear what is going on around you in your room. One of the things I hate the most about headphones is that you have no spatial awareness because your ears are covered.
The sound quality is great! The microphone was also crisp with actual noise cancelling. Easy to switch between audio modes for chat as well.
~~~I hope this REAL review was helpful!~~~

title: Great midrange buds!
review:
I was looking for an upgrade from my standard bluetooth buds
- Sound quality is great! Full and rich, with deep bass. The noise cancelling works well, although not as effective as some higher end earbuds (AirPods, etc), but noticeable and effective.
- Earpieces are comfortable, and I like that the post that hangs out of your ear is shorter, not super long.
- Touch controls are nice. Not hard to get used to and they provide an intuitive way to control without having to use your phone
- Battery life has been good in my experience. I rarely will use these for more than 3 hours in a row, and I charge it overnight when it runs low.

title: Not bad, pretty cheap feeling
review:
These are very similar to many of the other cheaper kids headphones.
They are comfortable on the ears, the sound quality is decent, and they look nice.
However, the build quality isn't the best. They feel cheap, and the inside foam from the ears came out after only 3 days. I don't think these will make it through the rest of the year.

title: Better quality than most kids headphones
review:
I have had to get several pairs of kids headphones for school recently, and I feel like these have been the best of the bunch. The materials they are made out of don't feel cheap, they are comfortable and have held up to my kids and their less-than-careful attitude with electronics. I think they will hold up for the rest of the school year and beyond.
Sound quality is pretty good

title: Great headphones for people that dont like the pods/buds
review:
I personally do not like the trend of airpods/earbuds, I find them to be uncomfortable. So I am glad that some companies are still making quality standard headphones, with wireless.
EASY TO CONNECT - my phone and computer found the device, labelled "B12" in bluetooth and had no issues connecting it up.
SOUND QUALITY - sound is great, with rich full bass. The noise cancelling works almost too well, as my daughter was using them and could not hear a thing I was saying
COMFORT - solid design, comfortable, does not pinch

Great headphones, would buy again!

title: Works great in the gym, except for the cable wire being too long.
review:
Except for the long connecting wire, these headphones work well in the gym. You need to wrap the long wire, and tape it, then keep in your gym shorts while exercising. After that, they work well. They do not get smelly or loose quality if worn frequently in the gym. And, the light weight design works well with any exercise. As for use as a studio headphone, maybe not so great. They keep out noise, but due to their design, do not have enough padding to keep out high level noise. Again, at the gym, that is good, so your buddy can get your attention.

My rating would be a two star if used by somebody serious in the music industry. For my use, it has worked just fine in the gym (except for the cable wire being too long.)

title: Cord just a bit too long for me.  Why not include extenion cord instead?
review:
The reviews about this headphone as to quality sound, and comfort inspired me to get this headphone. And, they were true. Yet, there is some room for improvement. My use is at the gym, so the really long cord does me no good. I would suggest having a short cord, and including an extension cord, or create two models (short cord, and long cord.) I would also suggest a carry case and a method to protect the headphone from mechanical damage. When this item goes into my gym bag, it can get bounced around and squeezed against running shoes, towels, etc. So, addressing the issue of storage in a gym bag can be helpful.

Yes, the sound is nice. Do not need noise canceling system. The pads work fine to keep noise out. The adjustable headband works fine. There does not seem to be much interference noise or feedback from the headphones. Nice!!

title: Worked Great for One Year
review:
My SE115 sure headphones were purchased after a recommendation from a friend. They worked great for one year. The headphones cut out noise from outside, and introduced nice quality sound from my MP3 player. And, I used these headphones everyday for the last year. Wow, the difference was excellent. It took only a few days to get used to it. And, I took very good care of them. Kept them in the bag, which was supplied. OK. These headphones have outlasted all my other headphones. I used to have the SONY noise cancelling headphones, and some other earbud phones. SE115 was much better. But now, I need to replace them. After 1 year of heavy use, I hope the SHURE company will honor some replacement. Ok, I did a lot of sweating and moving ... with these phones plugged into my ears. But ... These headphones now cost $100.

So, I am waiting for good news.

I have rated this product a 3-star, and will change to 5-star ... if they return the headphones, with the item working again. Some reviewers said the repair office was terrible, so I am cautiously optomistic.

Dear SHURE, please make this happen ...........

title: Not recommended for daily use, as durability is lacking...
review:
Not recommended for daily use, as durability is lacking...

Vinyl ear covers on these headphones allow human sweat to build up around this area and find its way into the ear. Previous model was better in this respect. Balancing of R and L headphones seem better, but N/C feature looses effectiveness as wear and tear brings a looseness to any grip around human ears. Nothing from this system is expected to last more than 20 days of use. Expect failure soon after store warranty or sony warranty expires. Not durable. Not a sports headphone. Also, expect wires to loosen their ability to transmit sound in about 20 days or so, due to wear and tear. Again, not good for sports usage, like at the gym and on an eliptical machine. Sorry.

title: Well made and comfortable, the best cheap earbud on the market
review:
I normally work with earbuds in all day and my ears would start to hurt from the added discomfort. Not since I bought these! They come with three different silicone ear tips to fit to your exact ear canal size. The tiny size fits easily into your ear and stays there or hours without notice. Works seamlessly with my iPhone for making calls or listening to podcasts, the pause button to start and stop whatever you're listening to is really nice. The microphone operates clearly.

For the price you can't do better, these aren't cheaply made and hold up to daily use. Considering the abuse my earbuds go through these hold up remarkably well and when once pair wears out after a year or so I simply buy a new one. I made my girlfriend into a convert, she loves and swears by her pair now too!

title: Five Stars
review: It works flawlessly. Increases the capacity of my Bose noise canceling earphones: plug-in and wireless.

title: Sound quality not worth the price tag
review:
Pros: these are comfortable headphones with great noise isolation and noise canceling.

Cons: I was shocked by how poor the sound quality was considering the price tag. The sound was nothing special. They sounded less crisp than the 10 year old non brand name $15 earbuds I was using up to this point.

I feel like these are worth buying only if you value the noise cancelling feature and don’t care much about how the actual music sounds.

I returned these, bought the Sennheiser 598s, and was very happy with those.

title: Mediocre speakers
review:
Sound is ok unless you want it louder (about 60-70% of the volume control range) , then you can clearly hear a distortion on the middle and high frequency. It holds the lower range pretty good. The volume control knob is small, tight and slippery. It's hard to turn or rotate it without holding the speaker. Price/quality ratio is good, that's why 3 stars.
There's no output for headphones.

title: Great headset keepers
review: I keep coming back to these as the best for keeping my earbuds tangle free. People fall in love with mine, so I gift them and then buy more.

title: Works with my Macs
review: Needed to convert a gaming headset with two plugs to one for my iMac / Macbook / iPhone  - works great!

title: Who knows if the earphones are any good
review:
I was really excited to get these earphones. Even had them shipped to my work so I could use them quicker. Well, I got no documentation and I have no idea how to put the battery in and turn on the noise canceling ability. There is no documentation on the internet for these earphones, or at least none that I can find.

I called customer support and no one there could answer my questions. I tried what told me to do and I am cracking the earphone. There has to be a better way. A company is only as good as their customer support. These people suck at it. I wish I had bought a Sony, it at least comes with documentation. Feel like I wasted my money. Really suggest no one buys these.

title: Bad microphone - Voice sounds "muffled" to the other end of the phone line, intermittently
review:
I used to have an LG HBS-730 that worked great: wide headset-phone range, great volume range, good microphone, great bettery life, ok sound. I used it for 2 years daily for work and podcast listening. Unfortunately, the Power On/Off switch broke and I had to buy a new one.

I was incredibly disappointed with my new HBS-910. The microphone doesn't work well. I'm often told that I sound "muffled". I need this headset for phone meetings and phone calls. Even if the sound is much better than the HBS-730 and the retractable bud feature is super convenient, the intermittently working microphone results into a VERY frustrating experience. This is totally unacceptable for this price.

-----------------
Broken 6 months after purchase... what a waste of money

title: Microphone doesn't work
review: Sound is great, microphone isn't. Not a single person has been able to easily understand what I'm saying if using these headphones for a call. Each time i receive a call and i have the headphones on, I have to leave the bluetooth mode and use my cellphone in the standard way.

title: Came defective, could not trade for another model
review: First set came defective (left earbud didn't work). The earbuds are not very comfortable, even if three different sizes are included. Sound is good, but not great.

title: They don’t last
review: I bought these a while back for my teenager.  They had all the features she wanted — wired, on-ear — and they worked well for a while.  But now there is something funky going on with the sound.  My daughter is pretty sure that the cord is to blame.  The cord isn’t detachable.  We’re adding “detachable cord” to the list of features we’re seeking in the next set of headphones, certainly not from this seller.

title: It connects fine to my phone but not my Bose Quiet Comfort ...
review: It connects fine to my phone but not my Bose Quiet Comfort 35 BT Headset.  truly disappointing.  Hoping to use while I travel on an airplane by being wireless to the on-air entertainment system :(

title: Too Large-NO Independent usage
review:
The Bose SoundSports have a nice, clear sound, but they are VERY large! I purchased the Samsung Earbuds after these, and all I ever use are the Samsung's. The Bose SS HAVE to be used with at LEAST the Right bud everytime. Cannot be used independently. The Samsung's can. And I LOVE THAT.

Samsung earbuds are tiny and fit so well in my ears. I wanted these Bose SS's for over 3 years, and FINALLY got them on sale, but was disappointed. Sound quality is good, but still overall chose the Samsung's for size and independent usage. Battery life is better in Samsung's too.

title: My Absolute Faves for Wired Buds!!!
review:
Really LOVE these as a wired earbuds. They are my faves! I have about 8 pairs stashed all over!! Love for in the ear and VERY noise cancelling. Fit is very nice!

If you need to be aware of your surroundings, you better turn your source volume down, because you well not hear any ambient noise otherwise.

title: The included adhesive anchored immediately with very little force applied and so far has proven sturdy and reliable
review: I happened across this when looking for a completely unrelated product and decided to give it a shot, and already my work area feels that much cleaner. The included adhesive anchored immediately with very little force applied and so far has proven sturdy and reliable. As somebody who uses a wireless headset extensively for both work and gaming, it is something I didn't know I needed until I had it.

title: Great sound that's wireless - Downgrade to 1 star
review:
Nothing about the original review is incorrect: they were great earbuds - while they lasted. But, they have stopped working completely, will not turn on, will not charge. They have not been subjected to heavy use and there is no good reason for them to fail in that manner. For the money, they should last longer than 15 uses. Very disappointed with the quality.

I love these new earbuds. The BT is very easy to connect and has a been rock solid connection. Battery life seems very good, although I haven't needed to use it over an hour. Within the ear the buds are very comfortable and stay secure while moving around during a light workout (Weights and biking). The phone connection sounds the same as a conversation through the cell phone. The only complaint is that the earpieces feel as if they are sticking out especially wide. They aren't really, but it just feels that way. Overall, very happy for the price.

title: valuable item to have
review: needed it to join new iPhone to my Bose headphones.  the iPhone has a different plug size, now, and this solved my issues.

title: GREAT headphones for reasonable price
review: I got these Baseman headphones just as my favorite trusty pair of headphones died. I had inherited another set of headphones and used them in a pinch but hated the inherited headphones from the get go. So I was very glad for the arrival of the Baseman's. These Baseman's are the best! Very comfortable on the ears is number one. I prefer the single cord. Works better for me than cords from each ear piece. Great sound quality. I use these headphones with my cell phone to great benefit, listening on my iPad while watching movies and listening to music, and as general headphones on my desktop computer. Works well with all my devices. Highly recommended. Especially nice is the price. Great value.

title: Sound is fine, but uncomfortable to wear
review: These headphones feel fine at first, but left me with a big headache after wearing them for the day at work.  I returned them and went back to wearing my earbuds, but it may very well be more that I'm not a headphones person than that these are particularly uncomfortable.

title: Great for headphone use!
review: I got these to connect to my computer at work, so I could plug headphones in to listen to music (my headphones couldn't reach my tower).  I've used them pretty much every business day for 2 years, and I've never had a problem!  I'm ordering a second set to have at home to plug my iPhone in to listen to Pandora.

title: Help! I'm under water!
review: Wow. Ten bucks isn't a bad deal for headphones that come with extra ear tips, right? Wrong. The Jwin earphones sound like the music is underwater no matter how I adjusted the EQ on my iPhone, Nano, and computer. Go for the Coby CVE92 Isolation Stereo Earphones instead. $5 and a billion times better sound quality! Now, I know you might be thinking that sound quality is too subjective. True. But, as a performing/recording musician for over 15 years and a music listener since birth, you can trust me when I say that the sound is at least better (I think WAY better) with the Coby's then with these. Plus, the Coby's fit better even though they only come with one tip! The Jwin never felt secure with all three tips. Last thing, I do have small ears and the Coby fit perfectly for me...who know how they'd hold up in Shaq sized ears.

title: Great earbuds. Easy to use. Comfortable fit
review: I like the charging case. The earbuds fits better than other type of earbuds on the market. These don’t have the annoying blinking lights ad the ones I got years ago.

title: So comfortable!
review: These are the most comfortable headphones!  They fit around my ears perfectly without too much pressure.  A great product.

title: Does what it needs to do
review: Love these headphones! Got them to use at my office to help block out distractions. Look great, work great, no complaints. The parts are plastic though so it doesn't feel as luxe as it looks.

title: Excellent sound for the money
review: For the money, this is a great deal!  I have a Sony and a AGPTEK Mp3 player, and this device is equal to (an in some ways, better) them.  The best feature of the quality of the sound--it produces a very rich sound and offers many custom settings.  The Bluetooth feature is fast and it easily connected to my wireless speakers and headphones on the first attempt to pair.  The ONLY reason I gave this unit four stars instead of five is because I can't seem to play one of the pre-set playlists after selecting the Bluetooth.  Once the device is paired with a Bluetooth device, the only option for playing music is the "all songs" selection.  However, for the money, the raised buttons for on/off and volume make this device a favorite of mine.

title: I like it and it pairs really well with my Kindle ...
review: This is my second OontZ Angle.  I like it and it pairs really well with my Kindle Fire, laptop, Bluetooth headphones, etc., however, the volume buttons are really difficult to operate.  If you hold them down with steady pressure, they freeze.  So you have to repeatedly press the buttons to increase or decrease the volume in increments.  My first OontZ (not a 3 plus) does not have that limitation on the volume--in general, it is just easier to use when you want to quickly adjust the volume.

title: great value for money
review: I was going on an overnight transatlantic flight and i wanted headphones to help me sleep and overall i have no complaints. i have only ever used these headphones for air travel. i dont used them for exercise/ gym etc so i have no other point of reference other than how well they performed on a airplane. Maybe if i had bought a $200 one i would have gotten perfect results, but i didn't want to spend that amount. Also i've never used $200 headphones on a plane so im not able to compare how well this stacks up to that. but i can say that it did reduce the noise significantly and i was able to play soft music from the plane's selection, and get some sleep (as much as you can on economy class).

title: Solves connection problem
review: Does the job of providing microphone connection for headphones at a great price.  Sound is ok, what you’d expect for inexpensive option.

title: Great earphones!
review: This is my second pair of these earphones and I love them!!!  I use one for travel and leave one at home.  They fit into the ear canal perfectly!! For those of us with smaller ears who can't wear the earbud type of earphones, these are pefect and the sound quality is excellent.  I would highly recommend these earphones.

title: Cheap and easy
review: I work from home and can walk around and stand up while listening in to a meeting so I can get some circulation . This is a lifesaver . Before this i felt like I was ties to my wired headphone

title: Great ear fit
review: Ergonomic shape makes for fitting in ear better compared to other headphones. Good sound quality and durability when used for listening to music while working out.

title: Didn't last long
review: Worked for a few weeks... now you can hear static noise when listening to music or anything else through the headphones using this cable.

title: Not what I bought it for, but surprisingly good audio quality
review: Noise cancellation is very poor and sometimes hurts my ears. However, for regular headphone use they are surprisingly good for the money. The battery life is exceptionally stellar.

title: Great headset, great price
review: I'm not a gamer and I did not want to spend $150 on a headset, but I did want something functional for zoom meetings, etc. This pair is exactly that. They work great, are lightweight and are very reasonably priced. A bought a second pair for at home and would happily buy another if needed and recommend them to others.

title: Best Headphones I have Ever Owned
review:
I love these headphones, they are easily my favorite. I always worry about these wireless headphones because I tend to be terrible at keeping them in one place, and these are quite pricey so losing one would really be unfortunate.
