They come with a really nice carrying case, it's a super durable case, thankfully, and I really like that it's easy to put the headphones in it (just drop it in and like a magnet kind of pulls them down). It's super easy to charge, and I really like that when I start using them a little voice comes on and tells me how much battery life is left. The battery life is also pretty impressive, I used them for hours upon hours without the battery running out, so I was pretty impressed by that.
The sound quality on these is amazing. I love how noise cancelling they are, I had my doubts with these being earbuds, that they wouldn't be that good at cancelling out noise, but these are great. I love how loud I can make it without affecting the sound quality.
I would highly recommend these to anyone, as I said these are hands down my favorite earbuds of all time.

title: Pretty solid headphones
review:
This is my first pair of wireless ear buds, I have had wireless headphone before but never like this. I was a little concerned, and part of the reason I have not gotten a pair earlier, that it would be super easy for me to lose them. I like that these have a nice and easy carrying case, and that there is some sort of magnet thing that makes them kind of snap into position in the case, and that the charger is super easy to use.
As for function, its super easy to pair them with mobile phones and laptops, like a matter of seconds. The sound that comes out of them is pretty good, it's not like high end quality sound, but it is still pretty good. My ears are a little more sensitive than most, so it's not something I could use long term without my ears getting sore, but for an hour or two its perfectly fine. Overall, I'm really happy with these.

title: Good item for the price Especially for kids
review: My niece really loves it very useful for her and connect well with any device and very kid friendly. Ordered another one for my nephew. Color variety choices aren't great though. And hopefully she'll be able to actually keep it up.  She has lost so many earbuds this suits her better because she wil be able to actually find it.

title: good functionality, sound is pretty good
review:
First of all, these work great for me. The design of the silicone flange is a little different from anything I've had before - they sit down into the ear canal, connect at a slightly deeper point. This seems to make a positive difference for me.

The sound is good enough. Not like OMG audiophile - I have the big Sony earmuffs that sound better than these, and some old corded AT's that sound better than the Sonys. And I've used some in a recording studio that had more detail and dimension than anything I've heard before or since. These are a long way off from that. But they are plenty good enough. There is nothing that catches my attention or causes fatigue or makes you want to apply corrective EQ to the source.

These are comfortable. The most comfortable earbuds I've ever had. I sleep in them.

Noise cancelling is like any ANC - good against some noise, less so with other things.

I've never run the batteries all the way down - IDK how long they last.

My one actual annoyance with these is the interface - I always touch the left bud by accident and switch into a mode I don't want. I would prefer it if there was a config utility or something to disable that touch gesture and leave it in ANC full time.

title: MEE makes some great phones, but these  aren't one of them.
review:
I have some really great MEE headphones - my favorite for long stretches of music listening. Those are A151 and I recommend those for that application.

I got these to carry on my bicycle to janky clubs where I didn't want to use my Shure SE215. Now I can't quite remember what I thought I was saving the Shure's for - they are not expensive at all for music gear.

Anyway I thought these M6 IEM's would be a good substitute, but I don't like them at all. The drivers seem inefficient and not clear-sounding compared with the other two products I mentioned. The fit is not great. One of the gels was folded over on itself - like it came out of the mold too hot and stuck to itself or something.

IDK I just didn't like them at all. I now use the IEMs I already had. Oh damn I just remembered why I wanted to use these - I changed my rig and I use a little rhyme to gather my cables; this rhyme depends are certain color scheme. I had eliminated a PSU that was white but I needed to add IEMs - so I thought it would be slick to just buy a white pair. It would have been less trouble to just learn a new rhyme.

I recommend skipping these in favor of the more expensive Shure SE215. You get a lot more value per dollar with the Shure's IMHO.

title: It’s a no for me!
review: Left earbud hardly has sound coming from it. The sound quality is just not matching the price and can be staticky and flat at times. Not worth the price.

title: These are Bose headphones???
review: Horrible. Horrible for phone calls and horrible for sound. I was excited when my headphones came and used them right away. Almost immediately I notice the sound quality was not great. It sounds like crap when you’re on the phone and the quality of the sound just wasn’t there at all for the price of the headphones. I tried turning off, switching Bluetooth on/off again but nothing at all worked. I’m surprised these are Bose headphones and I’m surprised at all the good reviews. Definitely returning.

title: What’s not to love?
review: Love these external speakers. I got them because I do gaming, and sometimes I just don’t want to wear my headphones. They do everything I expected them to do and more

title: Amazing Quality
review: For the price these little things are the best. Just as good as the high priced earbuds for a fraction of the cost. The battery life is long and the clarity is really good as well. I like that they have smaller ear pieces the change out because I have small inner ears. Don't get those $100 earbuds, this is the way to go!

title: Always Check
review: I bought this item as an Like New item in its original box. The 3.5mm talk cable was stated not be included in the box. Upon arrival the headphones were in an aftermarket box and the headphones and charging cable were the only items inside. So I didn’t test the headphones but they looked okay but I boxed them back up for return five minutes after opening them.

title: Exactly what I wanted
review: My son wanted a pair of headphones and these performed very well. The noise canceling was very good especially considering the price.

title: Good and Bad
review: The sound is pretty good with these headphones - gets very loud.  They are not so good for activities because they easily fall out of my ears and are not very comfortable.  These are probably fine if you are sitting at a desk and not moving around.

title: Noise cancellation A+
review: I’m sure it won’t be everyone’s experience, but it was a good test for these earbuds.  My grandson listens to music while plowing the field, and he assures me that he hears good, pure music  and that tractor noise is non-existent!  They are comfortable to wear, and the noise cancellation is amazing.  Good choice!

title: Comfortable to wear
review: Great sound quality - and, when working on the noisy tractor, my grandson tells me his classical music comes through without any tractor noise - which is something because that’s a noisy tractor!  They also eliminate our ability to call him for meals, so have had to resort to flags.  These are fabulous earbuds.  He says they’re the best he’s ever used.  Great choice!

title: Comfortable!
review: My grandson wears these as he plows the fields on our tractor - he loves the wireless feature, the comfort, and mostly the sound quality.  These put him in another world while he is doing really hard work - and he is much happier doing it with these new headphones.  He’s still marveling over their ability to deliver 100 hours of battery time.  Great choice - and a great gift for the music lover.

title: Noise-canceling particularly good
review: These earphones came with several tips so that you can be assured of finding a comfortable experience.  The sound quality is very good.  They come in a plastic case which doesn’t stay closed very well, but after you’ve selected what works for you and eliminated the rest, the case should close!  The cord is braided - very sturdy.  No company information or instructions.  When tested, they worked well.

title: Any job goes faster with music...
review: Wireless earbuds are perfect.  My grandson listens to his music while he works and he is so pleased with these earbuds.  The sound quality is great - they’re comfortable - and no cords!  Of course,  when I call him, he doesn’t answer, but I like to see him happy in the tough jobs he  does here at the farm!  Great  earbuds!

title: Kudos for comfort!
review: These were given five stars by all the guests over the Labor Day weekend - I guess it’s inevitable these days that guests are all going to pull out their phones and drift away from the conversation - so I was glad that we had these headphones to offer.  Many compliments on the clarity and comfort.

title: Crisp, clear sound, longer battery life!
review: These earphones are a whole level above what I’ve had.  The noise elimination is a huge plus when a lot is going on around you - that feature never worked this well for me.  Also, the sound quality is crisp and clear and for someone whom is a bit hard of hearing that is a huge benefit.  Very pleased with these earphones - longer battery life and the charging case are really a good features traveling.

title: Much better than the old earbuds!
review: Took a bit to get used to these earbuds - but now, with consistent use, the noise-canceling feature is truly appreciated.  Took some help from a grandson to get set up with the Bluetooth connection, and getting used to being wireless, but now, I’ve thrown my old earbuds away!  I like books on tape, so I am really enjoying them now.  This grandma is a believer - great product!

title: Excellent sound quality - and we love the color!
review: One more thing to stop all conversation!  Our granddaughter loves these - first of all, the color - and then the sound quality.  It was difficult to separate her from them when it was study time, but the good thing is that she likes them enough to take care of them.  We’ve bought so many earbuds - it looks like this set may actually be around for a while.  The sound quality is excellent - we had to give them a try!

title: Nothing better than Bose!
review: These headphones are already getting a workout!  My granddaughter had her heart rate in just minutes out of the box, and, after taking them on a run, she had nothing but good things to say about them.  First, she enjoys the fact that there is nothing on her head - just a wire connection lightly on her neck.  Second, the sound of her favorite music left her almost speechless to describe - clear, sharp - the best sound quality she had ever heard - and to be able to take this with her on a walk or run, was wonderful!  Third, these headphones have turned out to be a motivator - she now looks forward to the exercise, is choosing music suitable for her yoga exercises, etc.  Wow, it's great to see the smile on her face and the difference these headphones have made in her physical activity.  She reminds me that they are also great for  just "chilling out"!  I had hoped to try these out for myself, but it looks like possession is nine tenth of the law!

title: Sound quality is excellent.
review: This review will make techies squirm, I'm sure.  I chose the wireless headphones, not to connect them to eight devices - just to connect them wirelessly to my IPad so that I can watch movies and things like House of Cards on Netflix without driving the rest of the family crazy.  I need the sound up higher than the family, so I can happily see my favorites at my own sound level, noiselessly!  The sound quality is excellent.  As time goes on. I'm sure my family will show me many more ways I can enjoy these headphones,  For now, I am totally satisfied with them using them as I am!

title: Wow - a life changer!
review: I don't know if I've found the primary use for these headphones, but they are making life great for me!  Always causing too much noise when I watch movies on my IPad, I now plug in my super comfortable headphones, and get all the sound that only I can hear, at a level that allows me to get every word of the dialogue.  When there is music, it is full and rich!  One of the best parts, too, is how generously padded these headphones are - they are really comfortable for hours of movies and music!

title: Awesome!
review: My granddaughter loves these headphones. The design and sound quality are AMAZING!

title: Great what for you pay for
review: Let's put this in perspective here. You pay $10 for a little earbud here that is for what you pay for, fantastic really. It is a tiny little earbud that fits great, stays where it is supposed to unlike some others I have tried in the past that I have to constantly adjust, has a pretty good battery life at over 10 hours, good sound quality and is super discrete. You can barely tell it is there which I like since for some purposes I just don't want it to be seen at times. I was actually looking for one just like it and this one is perfect. The one thing I would like is a case or something to keep it protected and not loose it since it is so darn small and easy to loose. Other than that there really is nothing wrong with it. Simple to use, easy and I really don't use these for phone calls so I don't need fancy functions and for that price, really don't ask for crazy extras.

title: Perfect for your iPhone
review:
These are some pretty good in-ear headphones. They work only with iPhone so make sure that is what you are buying them for. On the cable they have a multi controller that allows you to control your phone, answer calls, end calls, repeat calls, has a microphone built in, play, pause and advance in the track. It also allows you to adjust the volume when you play your music. I wouldn't even bother with headphones anymore that don't provide these extras.

The sound quality of these is pretty good. They also came with some extra rubber covers so you can find the one that makes them fit best in your ears. The price is right for these too, so all in all a pretty good deal.

title: Good headsets for the price
review:
I like these headsets which are a must have for the Moto Z2 Force since this phone does not have a headset jack anymore. I like that they have a volume up/down button so you don't have to get your phone out every time. I wish you could advance the song by using those buttons but if you can I haven't been able to figure out how to as of yet, and it does claim you can and so have others (I tried longer and shorter pressing of the buttons but no luck so far). They fit quite nicely in my ears so no complaints there plus they come with other inserts so you can find the ones that will fit you best.

The sound quality is not bad, not the greatest but I didn't expect that from these at all. For that I use my super noise cancelling ones. These also do not have noise cancellation but that is ok. For the price these sell for these hit the mark I would say.

title: Battery Issues?
review:
I absolutely loved these headphones. They were great working out and extremely functional When jogging. unfortunately something happened to the battery within the last month or so and it will not respond to any charging. I fired off a message to a n k e r hoping that they respond as it's still within warranty.

I typically love anchor products and hope that this is just a fluke.

title: Amazing headphones
review: These headphones are amazing, sound is good quality and the bass is good. My son has the Samsung galaxy buds and my daughter has these. He actually likes these better. Would highly recommend

title: this computer is garbage
review: the part that is garbage about it is this. i bought it to make music with using it as a recording and mixing device via software made for that purpose just like i have been doing for many many years on several different computers. heres the deal this computer requires a stero microphone. no other computer i have ever seen does that. when you plug a mic into this thing sound will only record and or playback though one speaker. if you plug in a stereo mic then it will work. the problem with that is most all stereo mics are crappy computer headset mics and thats not something you are going to record your guitar/ vocals/ drum/ or any other thing with as they are really intended for talking and do not have the quality a regular microphone has. so i just wasted 2 days setting up and formatting and driving to the store and spending a lot of money for nothing now i will have to go through it all again. so if you intend to do anything other than office work and internet DONT BUY THIS PIECE OF CRAP. they should really indicate that this thing requires a specific stereo mic unlike any other computer i have ever seen. and by the way the tech support guy who barely spoke english could not even grasp what i was talking about for about a whole hour of me trying to explain the difference between a stereo mic and a mono mic. he was clearly reading a script with no mind or thought process of his own. BY BY GATEWAY

title: Poor design with loose parts
review: This product would be great but the plastic part at the end of the screw is not connected and will fall off!  This is very poor design.  I will be using this in a way where I will be adding it to my video camera tripod to hold my headphones---that means breaking it down and setting it up all the time.  This end piece will be lost in no time.  See the pictures for details.

title: Great sound for the money.
review: I bought these after looking at several 'best of' lists, and they appeared on several as the budget choice. Sound is great, especially after setting up the custom sound profile on my Galaxy S9. I can't hear any external noise while in use and I have to take one earbud out to have a conversation. I haven't used it for phone conversations yet.

title: My favorites!
review: Of all the headphones I have owned, these are my favorite. They are super light, the pads are really comfortable, I can wear them for hours without any discomfort. The features check all the boxes. Bluetooth or wired, sound is very good. Specs say battery life is 40 hours. I charged it two weeks ago and have used the headphones 1 to 3 hours every day, and they're still going strong.

title: My favorite earbuds
review: I’ve tried a lot of earbuds. AirPods Pro’s, Sony linkbud, Sony wxm-0004 or whatever lol, galaxy buds, Bose quiet comfort i‘s… and these are my favorite. Sound quality, amazing noise cancelling, so light weight. A big fan :) the others were too bulky, fell out, not good noise canceling, battery was ass. They all had their problems. Love these

title: Great buy for the price, good for small ears too.
review: These headphones are pretty great for the price. The sound quality is great, and the pickup range is good too. They aren't super noise cancelling, but do well enough that other noises aren't distracting. I love that they come with 4 sizes of buds because I have very small ears, and a lot of headphones are too large to fit. These are comfortable and stay in, although I haven't tried them at the gym yet. Call audio is also very clear.

title: Won't Hold A Charge
review: A few weeks in, I can leave an informed review. These earbuds are pretty good when they work. The sound is nothing compared to my Bose over the ear headphones (I'm on my third pair and they are on the list of things I'd grab in an emergency) but it's decent enough. But most of the time they don't work at all. I keep them in my purse for when I need them, and honestly hardly ever do, but I can probably only get about 45 mins of use out of them before the battery drains. I'm surprised that Bose put their name on such a flimsy product. And the mandatory app is useless and annoying, like a lot of apps.

title: Bad Call Quality Call quality is not good at all ...
review:
Bad Call Quality
Call quality is not good at all on these Samsung headphones. Other party barely can hear you. I wouldn't recommend it if you are trying to use it for making phone calls. My regular headphones which came with my S7 phone work much better for phone calls. The reason I bought these so I could use it's noise cancellation along with calling feature. Because I am a frequent flyer and fly every other week. But Its active noise cancellation feature is just OK but not really worth the price.

title: Nope. Not even.
review: Avoid. Within the first hour of use the left earbud (the slave) had been cutting out. The audio even froze up making this grinding noise as it repeated the last few milliseconds of playback over and over and over. I thought it was my phone/app so I turned off Bluetooth so the buds would disconnect. The weird noise kept going until I put them in the case and took them out again. Oh yeah, and the case looks bulky and awkward in my pocket. Very little noise isolation—they provide two sizes of ear tips but neither provided a good seal. I had my hopes up, but connectivity glitches like I mentioned are inexcusable for the price point.

title: So sad :(
review: Was really hopeful for these, but they didn't measure up. Too many dropouts in the left earbud interrupted my mid-day power naps and meditations. Eventually had playback issues where my phone said it was playing but there was no audio coming through the buds. I tried all I could to make it work—manually installing different firmware versions, contacting support repeatedly, but the product created more problems than I was hoping it would solve. Really really disappointed. I'm returning these promptly.

title: Hated these. Returned them
review: Hated these. Returned them. Made the earbuds more uncomfortable in my ear. The tackiness of the rubber material collects ear junk too.

title: Bought these to clip earbud cable to my collar on ...
review: Bought these to clip earbud cable to my collar on the back of my shirt. Eliminates a lot of the pulling and snagging on my wired buds. For my wireless earbuds, I have the kind that wrap around the neck. The problem with those is when you take one out to rest it on your shoulder, it eventually slips down as far as it can and pulls on the other ear. Or when jogging the cable would get lopsided and if I turned my head to check for traffic, it would pull on the ear. Hooking this up eliminates all those hassles. Wish I'd thought of buying these sooner.

title: Died after 2 months.
review:
Love this earphone but one side stop working after using for 2 months.
I bought 3 of them and this is the only one that broke that fast. I guess this is just the unlucky one then.

title: Easy to attach
review: I attached to a side table for the purpose of holding headphones and charging cords.  This was a perfect choice for me!

title: Was happy when I found a product that would replace the ear cups va entire replacement
review: Unfortunately even though I followed the installation instructions to a "T", the right ear cup leather production over the foam has come loose and is about to fall off. I was expecting a higher quality. Adhesion to the headphone is good but the covering over the foam is in my opinion a quality defect and I do not recommend buying these as you will likely experience the same issue. Glue should be better adhered to the plastic rim that mounts to the headphone.

title: Great sound, very comfortable
review: Great sound, very comfortable, durable cord.  Unlike most headphones I've dealt with recently, this cord actually holds up really well! The one downside is that the size adjustment portion on the band is pretty weak. Mine broke, so I'm buying a new pair. Honestly, great deal for the price. I still use them with the size adjuster bit broken.

title: Great, but found the orginal Headphones are better!
review: I like these earbuds, the sound great, but found that the OG headphones are more comfortable and have overall better sound quality.  Also, much easier to switch between users with the original ones.  Still, the buds are great, but not worth the $50 price tag in my opinion.

title: Can't beat my price of $73
review: You are not going to get high quality color picture but for $73 I paid it is awesome. I attached picture of the screen, taken at 9.5 feet which is where i had to place projector from provide screen. . I used painter / drywall poles. Audio is not loud. I need to attach separate audio output to headphone outlet. . Fan takes getting used to but I can block it sound  without blocking air. You must place projector at distance to fill screen provided. 9.5 feet is what I have. Less than 3.55m or 11ft 7 inch as stated in instructions from screen that is 100 inch diagonal. Maybe color is better with better screen but still ok. Apparently u can project from back but have not tried. Less fan noise that way but definitely need sound hookup. Have not experimented with that yet. Not sure if can complain for price.

title: Great sound, and PRICE
review: OK I don’t write reviews! I just had to for these. I really like the look and sound. I’ve had all kinds of brand name headphones. The sound is GREAT, I’m a bass person and these have that! The only draw back is no case, but for the price that won’t stop me from buying again!! Price reflects no case. I didn’t want to let the word out about these, but l just had to write this on the quality!!! All this is my own opinion!

title: Not great quality.
review: Speaker already stopped working on one side. Sound was not as good as my original Samsung headphones. Will return if possible.

title: both cases are excellent; I chose the color because it stands out ...
review: both cases are excellent; I chose the color because it stands out when I put the Ipod down and forget where I placed it; offers good protection; no interference with either the headphone cord or the charging cord; shipping was fast and items well protected for shipping

title: Perfect for travel or as a gift for a frequent traveler
review:
Best travel purchase. I thought it’d be too big so I bought the 2pk that comes with a smaller bag as well, but I won’t be needing it because it’s the perfect size. Holds all my charging cables and bricks for the Apple Watch, phone, earbuds, and kindle. And has a nice little slot for the kindle or small iPad to fit in there too. Doesn’t look too bulky when closed up and is softly padded. Would fit nicely in a purse or backpack. Now I won’t have to dig for my chargers in multiple different makeup bags like before. My husband loved it and wants one now too!
FYI I bought the BagSmart packing cubes in pink as well thinking it would be a matching color but they are not. I wish the pink shade would be consistent among the brand’s other items. But not a huge deal.

title: A DUD!
review:
Did not work. I was able to hear my friend... she could not hear me. My husband and I tried everything we could to see why on earth it would not
work.. but to no avail. I am confused... it is not advertised for use as only headset to listen to music or whatever... rather it says clearly it is for a phone... not sure why my set did not work but I returned it.!

title: The sound impressed me. Sharp and clear, with deep bass.
review:
These earbuds have a really great sound. That’s what struck me first when I used them. The sound is sharp and clear and loud, with deep bass.
They fit very comfortably and stay put. Best of all, the battery lasts for a long time between charges. For the price, I would definitely recommend them.

title: Easy to use and Comfortable
review:
I love the fact that I can take them out of the case, put them on and I’m good to go! They pair and connect to my laptop immediately and make my online studying so much easier and fun. The sound is clear, the charge lasts for a long time and they’re so comfortable I forget I even have them on!
I'm giving it overall 4 stars only because when they arrived the protective plastic covering on one of the earbuds was crumpled. Otherwise the product itself is great!

title: Nice sounding headphones
review: I like the sound from this headphone.  The cushioning around the earpiece is nice and soft but it suffocates my ears and  keeps them hot, so I cannot keep it on long.  Sony needs to rethink the design of the earpiece.

title: jbuds
review: it would be better if it came with a microphone but good earbuds regardless. I bought it for a gift and no complains.

title: CHEWBACCA Hears the FORCE
review: You see, Chewy getting old needed glasses, other headphones pushes on my glasses. This one I FEEL THE FORCE!. I HEAR THE FORCE, CHEWY IS SATISFIED>

title: great
review: I love these headphones, slim and sleek and work really well. They were exactly what I was expecting and were definitely worth the low price I paid.

title: Great Protection
review: I'll admit that I'm worried about losing these slippery little earpods!  They're too expensive to lose, so I like that I can clip this on in the inside of my bag.  I have wireless charger, so I can still pull these out of this case and recharge them, as needed.  If you're nervous about losing your earbuds, I highly recommend a product like this.

title: Perfect
review: I have tried (and returned) several earbuds because they stick out so far. These fit perfectly in my ear with no big mass sticking out! The sound quality is excellent! Super happy!

title: Great Audio sound.
review: I like the wireless earbuds they allow the amount of freedom I need. The sound is great . On occasion I need long time use so I can use one ear bud and replace it with the other bud while it charges  Very pleased with my purchase and would reccomend.

title: Work great for Logitch H390 (see photo)
review: The ear pads on my Logitech headset started to fall apart, and none of the advertised replacements fit.  These cover the original ear pads and keep them from flaking off when I use them.  Very happy so far!

title: Good headset.  Lousy ear pads.
review: This headset works well for the price, and is able to work on my corporate laptop which is locked down. However the ear pads are very fragile and will begin to peel and flake, leaving black dust and pieces all over the desk and the side of your head.

title: It does not 'cancel' noise. It adds more.
review: These headphones do not cancel the noise in the traditional sense.  It's more like a white noise generator that adds a layer of static to block out quiet noises. It makes them louder in my opinion.  Nice quality headset if you can get it priced in the single digits. But as for noise canceling, it does not do that.

title: Amazing!
review: I should have done this so much sooner. I wish I had known and done the research and ordered these sooner. What an improvement for my call quality for me and my customers. These are the best headset I have had.

title: Great product does what it's suppose to!
review: I like that this product does not take up much space, it works perfectly with my headset.  Exactly what I was looking for.  Item as described and would definite recommend to anyone looking for a headset stand.

title: Remote feature does not work!
review:
I like the light and the fact you can listen to the tv on the remote without disturbing others when you plug in your own headset. However, I purchased this mainly for the remote finder feature and that feature doesn’t exist, or doesn’t work, is nonexistent and falsely advertised.
Because it makes the remote bigger, it has been easier to locate... that is a plus, but this is not worth the money and I purchased three.

Oh well, I tried.

title: needed to replace,
review: I loved these headphones. unfortunately, the wire broke off one phone after install. I have mixed feelings

title: Worked great…For awhile
review: For the first several weeks they worked great then the sound in the right earbud began to decrease more and more. Now only the left earbud works.

title: Five Stars
review: Great headphones for the money.  This is my second pair.  The last pair lasted about two years and then I bought this newer version.  I use them daily to workout and the batteries last 4-5 hours before needing to be recharged.  These cannot be beat for the price!  A++++

title: Not the most comfortable
review: Not my my favorite headphone. They don’t hold the charge that wel. I also sometime have a hard time getting them to stay connected. The comfort is ok but they can kind of fall out when I’m running

title: Great combo option!
review: I spend a lot of time at the computer for work so I wear blue light glasses often. These for that were comfortable to wear. I get tired of wearing ear buds so having this as another option to listen to music while I work is really nice. The sound quality is pretty good, in fact better than I excepted it to be and better than many headphones I have. They are a bit bulky to wear but not too bad. Overall I feel like these are worth the money and if you spend a lot of time at the computer like myself they are a good investment.

title: Uncomfortable
review: I have been disappointed with these headphones. They are uncomfortable and the noise canceling doesn't work very well.  I've got a set that is less than 1/3 of the cost that are more comfortable and seem to work better. Buy the cheap ones or save your money for the top Dog in my opinion.

title: Strong cord, great sound
review: Very nice sound quality in these headphones. Have been using to listen to podcasts and it cancels the noise around me very well. The braided cord feels stronger than the regular wire cord and is still going strong!

title: I would highly recommend these to anyone who is getting tired of the wireless world.
review:
Long gone are the days of corded head phones, or so I thought... It seems as though everything is bluetooth in today's age, which has its benefits, but dead batteries and poor connections make me miss the old school plug and play.
That's partly why I loved these Belkin headphones that plugged right into my android device. The bass was deep and rich, the overall sound was crisp and clear.
They Fit snug in my ears, and were comfortable for over an hour of play time.
Like most wired headphones the cord is a bit short to my liking but it was sufficient.
I would highly recommend these to anyone who is getting tired of the wireless world.

title: Solid headphones. Needs more Bass.
review:
These are awesome headphones. Some of the most comfortable headphones I've owned. The headphones are covered in a clothlike material that helps absorb and whick sweat during a workout.
The noise canceling is good but not great. The battery life has yet to leave me stranded and I've gone for a week without charging with fairly regular use.
The sound is clear and sounds crisp but I feel like it is lacking bass.

title: Clear comfortable sound
review: These seem like a solid pair of headphones that let out beautiful clear music. So far the battery life on them seems great. They really seem like they are well built. They connected with my phone easily. They stayed in well during workouts while I was moving around.

title: Huge and slightly heavy
review:
Very large...I'm a woman with a small to average size head. I feel like a goofy looking pilot or NASCAR person wearing them on class Zooms! BUT the noise cancelation and good sound are worth the weird looks when I'm having to teach while my own two kids are in their virtual classes at the same time...my students no longer hear my kids talking in the background when I'm unmuted.

The headset is heavier than I'd like and makes my ears feel a little sweaty if I have to wear them for more than 30 minutes at a time. Sound is very clear and I've had no complaints from the mic. I wish it wasn't only for USB connection but it serves its purpose for me at the moment and I knew that when I purchased it wasn't interchangeable.

title: I don't like the included ear buds but that was an easy replacement.
review: So far, so good.  This is my first experience with a bluetooth headset and the sound and connectivity are both great.  I did replace the ear buds with the style from the S7 phones, but with added wingtips, because the round silicone "ball" style ones that come with this don't stay in my ears no matter what size I try.  I've been able to do plenty of activities and not have any issues with slippage or loss of signal.  I didn't even realize you could use this for phone calls until after I received it, so that was a bonus for me as I got this solely for music at the gym.  Compared to my wired buds that I was using prior, these are fantastic and I'm very happy to have chosen this headset over others I considered.

title: good but big
review: I'm starting to lose hope that I'll ever find wired earphones that fit snug and don't wiggle out of my ears during runs.  For the price these are nice and the music clarity is perfectly acceptable for my needs.  But they still fit big.  While they don't "fall off," I do have to adjust every couple minutes by pushing them back into my ear.  Obviously a better choice than every earbud I've ever tried - and I think I've tried them all - but not perfect.

title: Jury's still out
review:
I believe that you get what you pay for. I can honestly say that you do NOT get the same sound from a $20.00 pair vs. $100.00. That is unless you overpaid for them. I've had so many other headphones, but I got lazy and didn't want to spend $200 again for headphones.

These do sound really good, and base is reasonable. I like the cord design as well. It looks/feels strong and sturdy.

I like the sound so much that I forgave the slight lack of response from the remote. It essentially works the same way they all do so I was a bit annoyed. on the 5th day of using this, I pushed the left bud further in my ear and notice a weird sound. The lost sound but when I touched them the sound would come back.
I'm assuming that the large size is for the base, but I will be investigating and it it's just a gimmick....
I exchanged them immediately and will be giving them another go. If in 30 days they give me ANY problems, they are going back.. I will try to remember to update this.

title: Tangles if not careful
review: This is a lightweight set,  and they are about as good for their price.  There is a slight tintiness when using them, but for a quick earbud in my laptop or Kindle Fire,  it serves the purpose.  I like the sound for my Youtube music or IPOD.  However,  the lengthy wire will get tangled if not careful.  Nice packaging.

title: They are light.  They are noise canceling.  At least to me.
review:
I love these headphones. One, I like headphones that cover the ears, rather than going inside. I play a lot of music through YouTube and Ipod. And, these actually sound great. They are not heavy on the ear and they seem to be heavy on "noise canceling". I have to turn the music lower if I want to hear outside the earphone.

I love these! I use them daily, relaxing with the IPod, Kindle Fires, or the Laptops! Excellent. This is all I need.

title: Especially for my music!  Love the great sound,  feel is comfortable over the ears!
review:
I much prefer to use these headphones for the music. And, I prefer to hear my music out of earphones....good earphones, because I hear more, everything about good music comes through headphones.

So, after a simple pairing, I got these to work. At first they felt heavy on the ear, but I got used to it. Anytime you have pressure on the ears with phones, it takes a while to become accustomed.

Noise canceling? YES! I believe that that noise canceling feature works great. Generally, with ear phones, you can hear people talk....but not with these. If I wanted to hear anything outside of my ears, I would need to raise up one ear pad. And, more important to me, is that I prefer these over the ear phones, because I get tired of those little in-the-ear phones slipping off, while I am always juggling them to stay on.

Sound is wonderful! And, better, I paired this up with the Kindle Fire, and next I will try other devices. But, I wandered throughout the house, doing my chores, headphones on, and listening to good stuff. I rarely got interference of breaks....unless I got near the Desktop, then I heard breaks.

So, all around I love this set. Great sound, comfortable, long play, etc. etc.

title: Nice, strong sound on my Laptop for my YouTube Music!!
review:
Well, I cannot give you the specificities on the technology of these Speakers, but I LOVE them! I am techno challenged at some stuff. I wanted to have these for my new Asus Laptop I received from Amazon.

If anybody knows music out of Laptops, it always leaves me to plug in the earphones for better sound. I play a lot of YouTube music! I plugged these into the new Asus and wow..... I love the clear, crisp, sharp sound.

The manual supplied is simple. There isn't much to it. And, I struggled once I made the connection of usb from speakers to laptop, and couldn't figure why I had no sound. Then, like a genius, I figured it MUST be PAIRED. So, on the remote is the Pairing button.

Bingo! It worked! The music sound was perfect. I raised the sound up from the back of the speaker, and still had greater sound. I like the size of the set.... not large, not real heavy, but mobile enough to use on different devices. The look is sleek, the feel is quality!

So.... for my Laptop, YouTube, and my music, this works beautiful!

title: Comfortable on the ears after lengthy wear.
review:
The most critical element of over-the ears headphone is..... how do they feel after an hour? These feel very light, no irritation after lengthy wear. And, of course, the next thing is.... how do they sound? I play these on my Kindle Fire, listening to music and videos, and I like the sound, clean and crisp. I don't have to have super power great sound. I just want to hear my music good!

Third thing to contend with is the cord. This is a tangle-free cord, plastic coated, more flat, like a landline cord. It stays in place, doesn't tangle when placed down...

Excellent

title: Nice and loud, neat little zippered case to store them
review:
These are very sufficient for moderate listening. I use these for the Kindle Fire and Ipods. I prefer earphones that are just that...earphones with earbuds.

I like the flat wire which is supposed to prevent it from becoming tangled. But, the sound is what matters most. I get loud sound and at times it might be a little tingy, but I have to experiment more with various music and devices.

What I like is the smart zippered case. This prevents me from getting a wire entangled in other objects when I travel with it in my bag. Plus, the ear buds are nice and tight and you get extra ear buds that store right in the zippered case.

I like these earphones.... simple and with quality for the price!

title: I Love this..... Now I can store my kids childhood fun on it!
review:
What I don't like is that any touching of the device to pause or stop.....gets recorded. It can be annoying ot hear clicks.

I do have several hours of my kids' childhood recorded on cassette tape. Plus, I have a lot of music that I recorded that is ONLY on my cassette tapes. SO. I have transferred so much to this recorder! And now I have it! Stored.

I will present my two with their childhood fun in their own WAV file. These WAV files will play in my Itunes and Media Library. You can simply send it to those programs. However, you cannot play a WAV from a burned CD.

This little gadget is smart looking, silver metal, fine quality. It is slim, easy to work with, carry it anywhere. The screen is large enough to read, and the marked knobs are easy to read.

As I mentioned, the clicks being recorded every time you touch it......Make sure that you have some comfortability before you record anything important, because when you start messing around and hunting for the buttons, you are recording a "click" sound. So, familiarize yourself first.

You also get earphones. When you record in the MP3 format, the sound is very good! This is wonderful, easy to use, convenient for school or music, etc. Received product for review. Rizzo

title: About as good as one can expect for these types of devices.
review:
Wireless headphones can be great, however sometimes they have their little annoyances. These are a little tricky to secure over the ears and once you get it, it will make it easier to slip on and off. You will receive extra earbuds, but often those are a challenge to stay on. It's always a challenge to work with the buttons on these contraptions.

Otherwise, they are mini and lightweight, and as far as for music. Yeah, so far, the sound is quite clear and crisp. You have the necessary items to charge, and that takes a couple of hours.

So, for the quality of the set, they should last a good amount of time. Work with the buttons to ensure which is for what..Rizzo Review for Product.

title: They HOLD IN PLACE AND SOUND GOOD TOO!
review:
Works great for me! Finding headphones that fit comfortable in the ear, is difficult. And, unfortunately, that is the crux of headphones.... how well they fit in the ear!

The ear buds are slightly turned in, and that is what holds them in place! There is a marking for right and left, which is helpful. The cord is lengthy! I use these in my Kindle Fire and Ipods.

PLUS, you get a nice little round case to keep your earphones neat, and there are extra ear pieces.

And, most important, I get good sound with the earphones. You also have volume control button for taking a phone call too.

Yep. I like these! They are comfy, stay in the ear, have a long cord, and sound good enough....Product for Review. Rizzo

title: SOUND IS GOOD,  CONCEPT IS NOVELTY
review:
Nice trendy concept. This blue set is equipped with LED Flashing lights. Once you plug the earphones to the device, and start playing the music, the lights blink off and on to the music. These are nice for the dusk to dark walking or jogging. There is a short cord USB for recharging the earphone LED.

The sound is great! Yes, I plug into the Ipod and Kindle Fire. It is good enough for those two. Good enough for me.

Earpiece? I doubt I will ever see a comfortable in-ear plug. These are the hard shape, simple, hard, and as you know it takes some getting used to. But, I still have not found a comfortable ear plug. So, with proper adjusting, finding the right spot, you will be okay.

I have not tried the microphone. Received Product for Review.

title: Hook over the ears are more trouble than they are worth.
review:
These earphones provide average sound, nothing spectacular. But they are good enough for my IPODS and Kindle Fire.

The problem arises when you need to put these hooks around the ear. It sounds easier than it is to put them on. You need to struggle a little, then if you have reading glasses or regular glasses, it makes it more challenging to put them on.

And, when you hook them on, they do not stay secure. So, if you try them on without the hook over the ear part, you have a slick earphone, meaning it slides and does not hold.

Why do people insist on making hook-over-the-ear?? They are generally more trouble than they are worth. ...

Earphone for review. Rizzo

title: I love it!  Excellent for the Ipod too!
review:
If anybody knows the range of sound from Kindle Fires....it's quite sad. The Kindle Fires are great for earphones, but to listen to music out loud, the sound is clearly lacking. You can only go so far.

With this wireless soundbar, it's like playing the music from my computer....and I use Bose! I love the portability, slip into your bag, pocket....it is that portable. It is lightweight, comes with a usb cord for charging.

Then, I tried it on the IPOD. Beautiful sound, nice, loud and clear! If you are a music lover like me, take your music around and play it loud. You can hear this from another room.

Generally, I plug this into the Kindle Fire 8.9 and watch my music videos, and play other music on the Device and from Amazon Cloud.

title: Yep.... roam in style!  Sound is awesome!
review:
I have dock speakers, airplay, ipods, etc., all over this large home. But frequently, I like to have carry an ipod while I roam the house doing this and that. I love the sound these earphones produce!

These are specially made for the Kindle Fire, and I use it for the Fire 8.9., the computer for ITUNES, MEDIA PLAYER, 3 IPODS and Stereo components.

The criteria for headphones is that they must feel light, and these feel very light over the head. They are not tight and are equipped with adjustable head pads. A new feature for me was the lengthy cord with a different feel. I like the length of the cord, but in my roaming, there is a need to be cautious with the cord getting caught on something.

The genuine wood look is beautiful, and with a nice feel. The set comes with an attachment plug for various other components you may want to plug in the earphones.

Excellent sound! The bass comes through perfect. Excellent feel, lightweight, attractive!..... Rizzo

title: Great for an extra pair of headphones!
review:
I always like to have several pair of headphones around. I plug these into the computer and get a nice sound, even for the Itunes music! But, mostly, I will watch movies or Netflix movies and shows. This way, I can do so in private.

Great for my IPOD! Although I need to turn the headphones up higher for the IPOD, I still get a nice clear sound. I like the feel on my head, not heavy and they stay in place with plenty of head movement.

Another thing I use this for is the Webcam, Logitech VideoCam. I like the way the sound is, and I can raise the sound, and mute the mic also. The mic can be used on the left or right side. I also appreciate that the mic is not too close to the mouth.

As far as the noise canceling, it is moderate. If I turn the sound too high, then of course I down out any sound outside.

I like these!......Rizzo

title: Light, comfortable, attractive!
review:
Generally, our family Ipad ends up bouncing all over, placed her and there, everywhere. But with this handy laplounge is wonderful. I don't use the Ipad as much, but I will watch some movies late at night. At nighttime, in bed, I place this on top of my abdomen, for viewing. It holds excellent, doesn't slide. I also have a portable DVD player and this things holds it perfectly. Now when I laugh, I don't shake the Ipad or my DVD player.

This is attractive, light colored, and with a small carrying handle. A little pocket comes for storing my glasses, earphones, piece of candy, cloth, etc. You can carry this out of the home. It's not huge, and it is lightweight, beanbag type fill. When I'm sitting, I like to adjust the tray upwards, as at times, my neck from a previous surgery hurts if I bend down uncomfortably. The Ipad fits snug into the tray. And, I prefer the landscape format, but it unsnaps to easily change to portrait if you need.

I have taken this on a trip, it's easy to find if you misplace it, and sturdy enough to throw it around. I like it! .....Rizzo

title: The key is to know how to put them on
review:
Normally, I don't like this kind of earphone, I could never get them on immediately. But since I have worked with them, I like them! You need to know how to slip them on over the ears.

The key is to take the open edge of the earhook, place it at the front of the ear and slide it to the back in place. You cannot simply just put if over/or on top of the ear; it won't work. Slide it to the back. Then, there is a small piece under the hook that allows for adjustment! This gives a nice tight and comfortable fit with the cushioned buds. This is important, to have buds that do not irritate the ear.

I worked out in the yard with these earphones, the fit was comfortable. They stayed in place; the round bud that fits in the ear is soft and hardly noticeable. On top of that, the sound is very good. Now, the box cover says 5-way adjustable earhook - This I haven't discovered yet.

For good solid, easy comfortable fit, try these......Rizzo

title: Fantastic Buy
review: They bought these for us at work. They work so well, thar I bought a pair for home when I telework. They dramatically improve the ability to hear in meetings when using zoom or another software.  I would definitely recommend these headphones for both professional and private use.

title: When Your Second Pair is as Important as the First
review: I try to take a mile to mile-and-a-half walk each morning with our dog, to keep both our weights down, and since I walk the same route every day, after a while it gets a bit monotonous. Sure I can watch the weeds at the side of the road as they progress through the seasons--presently the privet and the honeysuckle are in sweet bloom, later on I want to see if the thistle plant blooms this year, in the fall the leaves make a carpet of color--but most of the time, dull, dull, dull. So I've taken to listening to a podcast while I walk, and was using the nice set of Jabra earphones I have, but they are too heavy to walk with; they work fine if I'm sitting still but if I move they fall out of my ear (I do mean my ear, because the traffic is so bad and I have to cross a busy street, I only keep one in). So I wanted a light pair to walk the dog in. These are great! The sound is nice and clear and very full even if I only have one in, and I love the fact that three sizes of earpads are included. I am using the largest ones and they are a nice tight fit. No having to push them back into my ear every three minutes. Very happy with these.

title: I experienced connectivity and spacial issues.
review:
The Wireless Earbuds arrived as described nicely packaged. Once opened I inspected all items and found no physical defects. The ear buds came charged so I went right into testing.

Connecting to my iPhone was easy and took seconds. During the week of testing i worn around the house, yard, out driving and on runs. I experienced issues with connectivity were sound would drop out but come back immediately and spacial issues were the sound was not synced between the the left and right earbuds. Both issues were intermittent but frequent enough to be a problem and happen at random. One earbud use I only experienced the sound drop outs.

Sound quality is good, they are no AirPod pros or Bose but for the price I had no issues with sound quality.

The tap features I could not get to work but on occasion no matter what I tried. This was irritating.

The earbuds and case appear well made. I would say quality of both are average. Charging was simple and quick. The LED is a nice addition.

They were comfortable to wear and stayed in my ears well while running and doing other activities. There are three different sized ear cups to choose from.

Overall, I give the item 2 stars. This is due to the core features having issues and not functioning as designed.

title: Perfect for morning walks
review: I’ve been struggling with the morning walk. Headphones don’t fit under a hat and it’s too chilly to go without the hat! This is a great compromise! Hold a charge forever! Looks adorable! Very pleased!

title: Battery leaks power when not in use
review: Decent sound quality. Battery life sucks. It tells you not to charge overnight, but I go swimming in the mornings. So I charge it the day before and unplug it overnight. By morning it has lost 50% of its charge just sitting there powered off. Very frustrating. I liked the variety of ear bud covers that came with it. I did take it in the pool and it worked and continues to work afterwards! I just kind of wish I had opted for Bluetooth headphones instead of this.

title: A Horrible Experience - Never again, Arama. You will never get money from me again.
review:
Update: Although the headset was not up to par for me, customer service was amazing. They offered to replace my headsets with two more expensive headsets from their line. I declined, but they followed through in a friendly and knowledgeable manner. They rectified the situation immediately. Customer service with this company is outstanding!
-------
I was able to hear my clients wonderfully. So, I assumed that all was well with the headphones. However, my clients began to complain about the fact that they couldn't hear me well; that they couldn't make out what I was saying; that it sounded like I was talking far away in a tunnel or like I was talking underwater.

This is completely unacceptable.

title: I have been buying Logitech for over 10 years and I am shocked that they would pull something like this. Usually with this brand
review: For a $125 this is a complete ripoff.  I bought two pairs of Logitech headphones.  This one and the Logitech ClearChat Comfort/USB Headset H390 ($25).  The microphone and the headphone quality are the same and they look almost identical.  The only difference is that the $25 pair has a mute button on the cord.  I have been buying Logitech for over 10 years and I am shocked that they would pull something like this.  Usually with this brand an investment of $125 would have a more noticeable boost in quality.  This item is a complete ripoff.  Buy the $25 pair and you'll come out on top.

title: I usually love Logitech. This particular set of headphones developed a ...
review: I usually love Logitech.  This particular set of headphones developed a short a few months after I bought them, and had to be discarded.

title: Good product
review: Works great, was worried about potential delays since I use it to listen to TV on my Bluetooth headphones.  There is a slight delay, but only noticeable when I was watching for it.  Overall, a good choice.

title: Good quality W/decent comfort
review: I own a Treo 650 and tried a Plantronics bluetooth headset which was a awful experience - bad comfort and bad sound quality.  I bought the Logitech and have found it to have GREAT sound for both incoming and outgoing.  It has ~20ft range and the wind resistance works well.  If it was a little more comfortable after wearing for the long periods of time, I would have given it a rating of 5.

title: Noise canceling exceptional!!!🎧🎧
review: [[VIDEOID:a3de4f76fe2d6346c7e418b5fe1771ca]] They are base heavy headphones. But with the equalizer you can really take a lot of the bass out, in the app. The outside of the headphones you just tap on them. You can go into the app and change settings. Awesome! Probably the most comfortable headphones I have ever had. Nice case. Battery life 50 Plus hours I think I might have been closer to 60.

title: Best head phones under a $160
review: Sound quality is pretty good. you never gonna find a better pair unless you get a pair of high end headphones. Only thing there's not heavy bass but the bass is decent.  If you like heavy bass earphones like Beats game you're probably wanna get a different type of headphone. But if you like balance headphones  with good clarity without the high end price like bose' they well worth. If you single and you want super loud headphones this probably aren't for you also.  1 or 2 volume clicks from the top level  these headphones are still loud To be comfortable.

title: Saved me money
review: The Bose headsets are notorious for flaking ear pieces. These fit perfectly. Easy to install. My headphones look new again! I will def buy again when these wear out.

title: Earbuds
review: It would be better if you would just label the earpieces. Then just trying to figure out if you have the right one in the correct ear holder. Removing the earbuds from their holder was extra work. Ultimately, does not work for me and is time-consuming. RETURN TO SENDER...

title: Not worth purchasing.
review: These headphones are poor quality. The sound quality is terrible. They even started falling apart after first use.

title: Not what I expected.
review: I tried it with my phone, my work laptop and my t.v. The sound quality is nothing like the wired $9.99 earphones. When using it for conversation on laptop or phone the sound quality isn't the best for the receiving party.

title: Junk
review: I bought this for a friend cause he was unable to order it online so he gave me the cash and I ordered it for him. I never like this headset even when it first came out. I thought it was junk then and its still junk now.

title: Great Earbuds
review:
I’m no audiophile. Usually I wouldn’t give over 25 bucks for a pair of earbuds, but I got these as a gift. That said, however, these are pretty dang impressive. First of all, they sound great. They have a really good tone once you adjust the equalizer in the software and I was surprised at how good the bass sounded. Second, the noise reduction really works. It doesn’t block out 100%, but I’d say it knocks out about 85% of room noise. It’s really appreciated in a houseful of rowdy kids and several multimedia devices running at the same time. Pass through sound works with a quick double tap. Thirdly, they fit well. They don’t fall out and are comfortable to my ears for the duration of the battery life. They include three sizes of inserts, so fitting was easy.

There is one thing I really dislike. Micro usb. It’s the reason I deducted a star from my rating. Why, oh why, does this device use micro usb for charging? Why force me to clutter up the floor with another cable? Stupid decision to forgo usb c for micro usb.

I can’t really speak for phone use or the Alexa functionality because I don’t use it. I disabled the microphones in the software. Don’t want amazon or anyone else intruding into my private life.

Over all, these are great buds; I use them everyday.

title: Impressive set of earphones.
review: A little tight for big heads, but great sound from such an inexpensive headphone. Volume is very loud. I'm no audiophile, but consider me impressed just the same.

title: Great value & amazing sound quality
review: I received these & haven’t went back to my wired headphones. The sound quality & the battery life were better than I expected.

title: Solid Buy
review: Though these earbuds are a bit pricier than many others on the market, they are of better quality than most. They're well-designed, are comfortable to wear for extended periods, and sound great - full range sound quality from lows to highs.

title: Excellent Quality and Price
review: I am very impressed with the quality of these earbuds, especially for the price (currently $24.99). They're well-made and solid, the sound quality is very good (full range, with clear highs and deep lows), and they hold a charge for several hours. No drawbacks or shortcomings for me.

title: Love My Husky Earbuds
review: These are especially fun earbuds. The design, lights, and the quality are very good. The sound is also very good for the price. I've fallen asleep with them in my ears many times and experienced no discomfort. They are easy to connect via bluetooth.

title: Pricey, but Outstanding Sound
review:
These are definitely among the best-sounding earbuds I have ever used. The full-spectrum quality is incredible - like you will hear nuances in your music you may not have noticed before.
The noise canceling is also incredible. If you set it to 100%, you will hear NOTHING going on around you.
The buds are extremely well-made, and the charger/carrying case is also well-made, although the case is not quite on the same level - the lid is a bit wobbly, not incredibly solid when the case is closed.
Overall, these earbuds are worth the price. The battery lasts for over 6 hours and the case can charge the buds a few times over before needing to be charged itself. The buds are also holding up very well to daily use and some drops.

title: Pretty Decent!
review: These earbuds work as advertised. The sound is solid (good response from low lows to high highs), they're well-made, and they hold up well to daily use.

title: Decent sound. Battery life stinks.
review: What attracted me to these earbuds is the simplistic design. The sound quality is very good and I take advantage of the noise cancelation feature often! What's great is that it actually works where other brands I've tried who advertised noise cancelation just wasn't there. The one down fall is the battery life in both the earbuds and the case are very short. Advertised for 15 hours  but lasts barely 1 charge. The ear buds don't even last 2 hours sadly. But overall I'm just happy that the sound quality and features work wonderfully!

title: Decent Stand-By Pair
review: These earbuds work fairly well and sound fairly good. They're a little flimsy, but are decent for the price. I wouldn't make this my main set, though. The battery lasts a couple of hours.

title: Comfortable and Convenient
review: I really like the convenience of wearing a sleep mask that also provides audio. This gives me a good experience and allows me to fall off to sleep more quickly. It's far more comfortable than using either over-the-head headphones or earbuds, especially for sleeping.

title: A Good Buy
review: Decent quality for the price. The sound is full and has good bass response (something missing from a lot of headphones). They're well-made and are holding up well to my daily use, and they are comfortable to wear for long periods.

title: Nicely Made. Subpar Sound.
review:
These headphones look pretty good coming out of the box. The cord is a bit kinked and doesn’t seem very flexible.
In use, they are just decent. The sound is a bit too thin. Not a great response to bass frequencies and the sound seems a bit weak and “spaced out,” as though the buds aren’t all the way in your ears.

title: High Quality Sound and Comfort
review: I use these earbuds for long periods of time, listening to music, podcasts, and audiobooks. I am very happy with the sound quality, which is clear and full. They're comfortable to wear (even for extended use) and I've found them to be quite durable.

title: Pretty decent.
review: These are fairly sleek earbuds, as is the rubber storage case they come with. The drawbacks are 1) that they don’t stay in your ears extremely well if you’re moving around, and 2) they do not have good bass. The sound is almost all treble.

title: Decent headphones.
review: These earbuds are a little on the bulky side (at least for me), but the sound quality is decent and I like the wire that attaches the buds. I've lost the separate bluetooth earbuds multiple times but the ear phones with the wire that connects to the device gets caught on EVERYTHING so these are a Godsend! Lasts for hours and charges up quickly. They eventually do hurt my ears after wearing them for an hour or so but then you should be wearing them for that long and my ear holes are on the smaller side even with the small silicone ear attachment. Really decent and worth it to have!

title: Amazing!
review: This item turns your iPhone or iPad into an FM receiver. Simply download the free app, plug in the phones using the Lightning port on your device, set up your favorite FM stations and your favorite EQ settings and you can listen to FM over-the-air broadcasts of your favorite FM radio stations near you. This is not a streaming device, it's an FM chip tuner in the earbud line. If you don't have a radio nearby but have your IOS device and these phones, now you do!

title: Absolutely wonderful earbuds!
review: The idea behind these earbuds are great! To use a metal casing around the wires. It keeps them from getting tangles and protects the internal wires from just breaking - which has happened to every pair of earbuds I own. I would love to get the pair that has the capability to make calls with. A great value and the sound quality is really good. Warning: be careful on rugs during the winter! Causes electric shocks and it does shock your ears!

title: It's ok.
review: Decent headphones. Sound quality is decent but not as durable as it appears. The actual ear piece falls off the whole earphone. Disappointed but they were good while they lasted.

title: Excellent!!
review: Bose has outdone themselves again! The sound quality is amazing and the comfort while sporting these headphones is outstanding. I can't believe that for the selling price is so affordable yet the quality is comparable to some of the more expensive headphones out there. Starting my Christmas shopping soon and these are definitely going to make a few people happy!

title: Great, true sound for a great price
review:
Having recorded, mixed and mastered music for several years, true sound is crucial. These headphones are very inexpensive and you get more than your money's worth. The sound is uncolored by any kind of equalization and the clarity is impressive.
Highly recommended for project studio engineers or simply for everyday audio monitoring.

title: Very Nice...
review: I’ve had a pair of Sony Studio/Professional  headphones in my life since the early 90’s. They’ve been great all these years. Love em.

title: Adequate for the price
review:
[[VIDEOID:146c0552488f3c640f0cc3edd6c70d1b]] See video for details.

Update: I took away a star and returned these headphones. They were just too bulky and the sound quality was too muffled.

title: Great protection from full blast airline announcements
review: These work great on airplanes and you can’t even hear the blaring announcements. And you just put your palm against the right headphone to be able to hear ambient noise. You can control the volume and skip tracks just by swiping the right headphone. Easy blue tooth connection.

title: Worth the money
review:
This is an absolutely crucial purchase if you work in a shared space (crowded coffee shop), fly for longer than 30 minutes, or if you just appreciate hearing the nuances of a song. I was hesitant to buy them after reading about the condensation issue but I’ve worn them now for several weeks and have only seen condensation once, which came during a marathon writing session. The carrying case is a joke but if you’re spending this much for headphones, I suppose you know how to take care of nice things.

Buy the headphones, you won’t regret them.

title: YOU WILL LOVE 💕 IT!
review: Allows lamp, clock & nightlight as well as phone & earbuds to charge/run at the same time. So flat it fits behind nightstand without having to move furniture out where stuff can fall behind. I will be purchasing several more to outfit all my rooms. I’ve purchased several but this is by far the best & most convenient I’ve found.

title: Microphone
review: The overall sound is great - no complaints on sound. The biggest of all is that they dont translate well over to PC. Microphone is REALLY bad. People either cant hear me or they say i sound like im far away and in a can. Also cant get them to pair up with newer(2020/8 months old) Sony tv and has bluetooth capability. If these issues could be solved with software updates, they would simply be the best headphones I personally ever had. However my Logitech Pro X wireless(not bluetooth) headphones exceed the Bose 700 in all departments and cost over 50% less

title: Great value, great battery life!
review: The earbuds are very comfortable and the instructions were clear.  The black case is sturdy and the battery life is amazing!  The quality is better than average -- I've bought other Bluetooth wireless earbuds and these are the best quality and well worth the price!

title: Mom, An Avid Audiobook Listener, Did Not Like These Earbuds
review: Mom loves to listen to audiobooks while working. These days, a smartphone paired with good earbuds make that very easy to do. Unfortunately, she does not think these ones are good. They are uncomfortable to wear for extended periods. They are so touch sensitive that even her hair can turn them off. The sound is tinny on some of the audiobooks. To top it all off, she feels the charging cord is ridiculously short. All in all, she gives these earbuds two stars and is being generous in giving them that many.

title: Mom Loves Them But Now Has To Share
review:
When these became available I asked our 15 year old nerd if he wanted them and his response a shrug and a "whatever". Mom wanted to try them though. She uses earbuds when she's walking the dog and wanted to see if these had better sound. Well her response was a big yes, their sound is really good. So is the Bluetooth range. She can leave her phone in the front room and hear just fine all around the house, even in the upstairs bedroom. They paired easily with her iPhone 7 Plus and are lightweight enough to be good for extended use.

When our nerd saw the headphones, his "whatever" immediately switched to "I have to try those!" He loved them too, saying the sound was great. With his iPhone 6 though, he has to connect them to his phone with a cord. The more recent Bluetooth of the headphones won't pair up with his older phone. Nice as she is, mom agreed to share the headphones with him so our family happily gives the product a 5 star rating. :)

P.S. I'm thinking of buying our nerd his own set of these headphones for Christmas. Don't tell him I said that though. :)

title: Logitech USB Desktop Microphone
review: I just wanted a basic microphone to use with Ventrillo to be able to talk to my in-game buddies.  This is the first mic I have ever bought.  I didn't want to get anything too expensive since its primary use is for chatting.  Very easy to install.  Just plug it into the USB port and you are ready to go.  My friends say my voice is crystal clear.  I also like that I don't have to be  really near the mic to be heard.  My only complaint is that sometimes I echo to my friends.  I'm sure that is because I'm not using headphones and it is picking up my speaker sounds.  It is not bothersome enough for me to switch to a headset which I didn't want to do.  I spend long hours on the game and cringe at the thought of wearing headphones for that long.  Great little starter mic to use with chat especially for the price.  I even bought a second one for my husband's desktop.  I've had it for a little over a year now and it is still going strong.  I've never had a problem with it.  Great buy.

title: Good Earbuds, surprised
review: When I tried these on I was pleasantly surprised by the noise cancellation and sound quality of the earbuds. They sound much better than others. The charge and pair easily, and are comfortable to wear.

title: good ear buds for the price
review:
I recently purchased the Bluetooth Headphones True Wireless Earbuds and I have been really impressed with their performance. These earbuds come with a sleek and stylish charging case that is easy to carry around, making it very convenient for me to use them on-the-go.

The sound quality of these earbuds is excellent, with Bluetooth 5.3 technology and Hi-Fi stereo, I can clearly hear every note and beat of my favorite music. Additionally, the Active Noise Cancelling feature helps me to block out all unwanted noise around me, allowing me to focus on my work or relax without any distractions.

One of the features that I really love about these earbuds is the LED power display on the charging case, which shows me the battery level of both the earbuds and the charging case. This helps me to keep track of the battery life and avoid any surprises.

The earbuds themselves are comfortable to wear and fit securely in my ears. I can wear them for extended periods of time without any discomfort. Plus, they are compatible with iPhone, Android, and Windows devices, so I can use them with all my devices without any issues.

Overall, I am very satisfied with my purchase of the Bluetooth Headphones True Wireless Earbuds. They are a great value for the price and have exceeded my expectations in terms of sound quality and features. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and high-quality pair of wireless earbuds.

title: works great for what I need
review:
I really never have used earbuds much at all before. I do take my iPhone or iPad with me when I am going to be sitting and waiting for Dr's offices or mechanic visits. I like to watch videos but don't want to use the speaker function, so these earbuds work great for me to listen in private.

I am sorry that I don't have much experience with other earbuds. I can't compare this set to others but I like these and am happy with them. They work great for what I need.

I have no complaints with these and they are great for my own needs. Thanks.

title: My first pair of earbuds, very easy to use
review:
Hi, I am 54 and new technology makes me nervous. This is my first set of wireless earbuds. When I first opened the package and saw the enclosed instructions I got even more nervous. The print is for much younger eyes than mine. It is very small. Once I got into the instructions they were very simple. The book is only big due to the fact that it covers more languages than I could imagine.

It is very simple to charge up and get ready. Pairing them to my iPhone was also very easy. Switching from music to a phone call just requires a simple tap.

I can't compare these to any others since these are my first pair. I can tell you that these are very easy to use. They fit me right out of the box. I did not need to change any of the included pieces for them to fit me.

The charging/carrying case is nice. Everything with this feels and looks like top quality.

If you are looking for earbuds, check these out. I like them.

title: Great for runners
review: Got these because I was tired of my regular headphones slipping off when I would go run.  Haven't had any issues with these.

title: No tutorial video for Mmx 300s II
review:
I can't lie, even though I returned my Beyer's because they were to heavy, these are alot more comfortable than the stock pads. 8/10 recommendation simply because they're too pricey on an already pricey product and no video.
Also they kept on falling off my mmx300s II for some odd reason which was really annoying and contributed to me ultimately returning them. Also there's no video and reassurance that these were even compatible with my headphones. Despite that I'd say it's OK for "true audiophiles" .

title: Boom goes the bass! Clear sound! Lightweight! 4.5 stars
review: I have had several versions of earphones/headphones (i.e., wired, outside/inside, earbuds, etc.) over the years, but after seeing the design for the Mairdi Bone Conduction Headphones, I decided to give them a try. These headphones are unique in that they sit on the front of the ear (open ear) against the face. One size fits all. My husband uses them and finds them to be comfortable. The sound quality is decent and very clear. You can even feel the bass pulsate against your face if you are listening to bass heavy music. These are noise canceling, but I did notice you can hear some outside noise/sound if the volume is low. You can take phone calls, change the volume and control your play list, from the headset. This set is not bulky at all, very lightweight. The battery life is decent, several hours. Another great feature is that this headset is rated IP67 waterproof so sweat will not damage the unit, which means it is great for using while playing sports or working out. This set comes everything you need - a charging cable, silicone ear plugs, a velvet storage bag, and a user manual. Overall, these headphones are perfect for workouts and other activities. I give them 4.5 stars.

title: Great for podcasts or YouTubers!
review:
