Lately my son has become interested in producing YouTube videos and podcasts. So, when offered this microphone by AVudio, I grabbed it. Here is what we both found:
-This microphone is sturdy.
-It is adjustable.  -You can adjust the volume settings.
-The quality is great.
-It is easy to set up.
-It has a nice sleek design.
-It is easy to connect a headset.
-There is a convenient mute button on the front of the mic.
-You can use with a Mac computer or a PS4/5.
-Connects via USB-C.

Definitely a must have for budding YouTubers/Host.

title: Could be better!
review: My husband works out and I recently (accidentally) washed his workout shorts with his earbuds in the pockets. Of course it was his fault for leaving them in there, but I felt some guilt, so when offered, I ordered these as a replacement. This review is based on his experiences: The Bone Conduction Sports Bluetooth headset was very comfortable (in the ear). Connecting it to a phone was very easy. It comes with everything you need: a manual, charging cable, and an extra set of earbud covers/caps for different ear sizes. You can control/adjust the volume and skip songs via a control (push button) on the earpiece. Even while running, they felt secure. And finally, his only hesitation in giving this product 5 stars is the ability to hear outside noise. He feels that this is a result of how the earbuds are designed. Unlike other headsets he has owned in the past, these sit “outside” of the ear canal/not directly in the ear, which means you do lose some sound quality. Perhaps, if these buds fit inside the ear a little deeper, or you use a headband to press the earbuds closer, the sound quality would improve. In conclusion, he believes these earbuds are not “bad,” especially at this price point ($50 on Amazon), but it could be improved. 4 stars

title: Decent earbuds for an affordable price. 4.5 stars.
review:
The Belkin wireless earbuds can be used by android and iPhone users. This review is based on my using an android (1 plus) and my sons using their iPhone 12 and Samsung Galaxy S20 FE. Below is a summary of what we found.

PROS
- These earbuds are sleek and elegant. Super fashionable.
- They come in black versus the traditional white. Because they are black, most won’t notice them in your ear as much as they do other colors.
- Easy to pair (hold earbud button for 6 seconds). Pair under the Bluetooth setting on your phone.
- The amount of charge (i.e., percentage) shows on the phone display. Your device will signal when paired.
- The charger case is ergonomically friendly.
- Easy to change and come with USB charging cable.
- Comes with extra earbud tips.
- They are noise cancelling, so you do not hear any background noise.
- You don’t have to hold the button you just “tap” quickly (with your finger) to access controls.
- Buds fit comfortably in your ear.
-The sound quality is very good. These buds can handle bass heavy songs just as well as they handle jazz and classical music.
- Battery life is decent.

UNDECIDED/NEGATIVES
- There is a learning curve for figuring out the controls. It is a little confusing on how to control or how many “taps” are needed to pause and play music. This will take a little practice or getting used to.

title: Just what I needed.
review:
Ironically, it took a pandemic (Covid-19) for me to finally bite the bullet and invest in a better laptop. My laptop was getting slow and having difficulties maintaining a charge. So, I ordered the Dell Inspiron laptop computer to dedicate solely to my teleworking (i.e., job). Understand that this review is strictly from this perspective. I wanted something reliable and easy to use. I wanted something that allows me to connect remotely to my work computer and where I can surf. This does the trick. It is:

Easy to setup.
Comes preloaded with various programs.
Charges quickly.
A convenient size. Not too big or too small.
Touch screen. The screen is super clear and bright.
It has face recognition which offers extra security.
Has a long (charging) cord.
Can install additional programs easily. *I was able to add the programs needed to connect virtually to my work computer.
It is lightweight and fits easily in a large purse or laptop bag.
It has additional ports (i.e., C-port, USB, headphone, etc.).
It comes with a microphone and speakers.
I know some have complained but my fan is quiet/silent.

In conclusion, for the price and what I needed it for (I’m NOT a tech person), this laptop is perfect. I’d recommend it. 4 stars

title: Protection and Style.
review: This Fintie Folio case is very pretty. It is a soft blue leather case with trees and blossoms covering. It fits the Fire HD 10 well. Your device is secure. You slip the Fire into the secured latch that velcros. There is an opening for the speakers, headphones, volume control, and power button. The cover doesn't muffle sound or block the built-in camera. You can still hear clearly. You can either hold the cover or prop it on the stand on the back. There is a place on the side for a stylus, if you want to.  So for protection and style, you can't go wrong with this cover. I'd highly recommend it.

title: Love, Love, Love the color.
review: The WXY Bluetooth headphones are pretty. They are rose gold (a metallic pink) and white inside the earmuffs and along the inside of the headband. They are lightweight and comfortable. They are wireless but can be wired as well. You can use these with most electronics, meaning anything that is Bluetooth enabled or via USB/audio cord. You can charge the headphones with the USB. They are fashionable and stylish. Very feminine. They have a decent battery life. The WXY’s fold up nicely and fit into a carrying case. These are affordable and will be great as a stocking stuffer or gift.

title: Handsfree Baby!
review:
The Jabra Talk 35 Bluetooth Headset is great.
The instructions are simple and easy to follow.
This headset is comparable with an android or iPhone.
It fits comfortably in your ear. There are extra ear attachments that allow you to wear over the back of the ear or just inside.
The quality is clear.
The battery life is decent.
If you live in a handsfree state like I do (Georgia), this is the perfect little investment, especially if you drive an older model car that is not Bluetooth enabled. And I especially like this option better than some of those other cellphone accessories (that you mount on the dash or on the window).

title: VModa doesn't disappoint.
review:
Reviewed by a very satisfied college student.
These headphones are to be used in with the iPhone, iPad or iPod.
VModa always encloses their products in very insulated packaging, which prevents damage.
They come with a convenient carrying case. There are a variety of extra ear cushions (sports fins, earhooks, etc) included.
Volume and play controls are located on the re-enforced cable/cord. They are easy to reach and adjust.
These headphones are a nice color (orange)....which makes them easy to see and keep up with. I especially like the fact that they aren't the traditional white or black.
These headphones are extremely lightweight and don't weigh down the ear.
These headphones are comfortable in the ear and can be used while exercising or just walking back and forth to class.
These earbuds are sweat and water resistant, which are perfect for runners or cross country lovers.
These headphones are affordable (i.e., comparably priced).
They are noise canceling and the sound quality is out of this world. From bass heavy music to classical, the sound is out of sight.
Outstanding quality, not to mention a decent manufacturer's warranty.
I would highly recommend these headphones. 5 stars

title: Reviewed by the Hubby....
review:
These are a great set of headphones. Sennheiser is a brand that you know and trust. I have purchased this brand before.

Aesthetically: The look and feel of the Sennheiser HD 4.30G is very streamline. They are black and sleek. The cushions that comprise the ear cups are comfortable and fit over the entire ear. They do not leak sound, like some other headsets I have used, when the volume is loud. This feature allows the user to play music and not disturb others while listening in public.

Packaging: While some may feel that these earphones should be stored in a hard case, they are not, so keep that in mind if you are worried about protection. These Sennheisers fold up which makes them convenient for travel and storage. They fit into a small draw string storage bag with a detachable cable. The detachable cable allows the user to control the volume, pause, forward and play songs. The cable also allows the user to stop and answer phone calls. The clarity is very clear. I have an android phone, but I am sure that they are compatable with the Iphone as well.

Sound Quality: These headsets have a frequency response of 18000- 22000 hz which allows the listener to hear those deep bass lows and high notes that are popular today in a large genre of music. Again, the sound quality is very good and great clarity.
Overall, these headphones are 5 out of 5.

title: All you'd want and more. Not to mention you can't beat the price.
review:
This product is inexpensive. Under $6.
My nano fits snugly and securely in the case.
I can adjust the sound and skip songs easily.
There is an adjustable armband (adjust for any size).
It is made from a comfortable material. It doesn't stay damp long and dries quickly so that sweat doesn't cause an odor (but I don't really sweat, I get sticky or as my mom likes to say, I glisten).
There is an optional clip for waistband or belt.
When your device is in this case, the controls are each to reach and make adjustments.
The Headphones/Ear bud jack is accessible. The cords fit securely without having to adjust them.
For a small, really small investment, you have a great product.
Would highly recommend it.

title: Great
review: Fits my earbuds case well, I have room for the charger and additional buds. Protects and I like the clip. Would recommend

title: The sound and size are good, but they're not practical.
review: There is no jack on the speakers to connect earphones. There is no way to talk with the speakers in.

title: Overall a good pair of headphones, however one "ear" stopped working quickly.
review:
I liked these headphones.

They had a consistent sound quality which may not be to everyone's taste, but I liked. They were simple, but did the job and I was enjoying them.

Unfortunately one of them began to malfunction fairly quickly after getting them and would charge in the case, but not turn on when removed. Hence 3 stars.

title: In or Out
review: I love earbuds but they always fall out and this overhead spring load solves the problem at a good price.

title: Anyone Who experienced "CONNECTED AS USB 2" or "unstable connection" problem LOOK HERE!!!!!!!
review:
Firstly, if you want to use a cable link, please remember to turn off the air link in the headset's setting.
I had tried many times and found that the cable was first recognized as a USB 3 cable when you connect it.
Then it will turn to USB 2 （if) after you click "allow device access file" on your headset.
That option actually means that you choose to use the line as a "file transfer" cable instead of a pure link cable.
To solve this problem, you need to close the "allow device access file option" in your headset's setting or choose "not to allow device access file"(I did not try this one).
So that your cable will be recognized as a normal USB 3 cable with (mine was 2.8 - 2.9 GBMS).'

title: A Cheap Bluetooth Amplifier!!
review:
This product came on time and was packaged with other items.

Pros: Setup was easy! Extended range on my Bluetooth headphones.

Cons: Only gained 20 feet. Was hoping to be able to extend to a toss my house (50 ft.)

Overall this is a functional Bluetooth extender, but doesn’t extend to the range that was advertised. Go for a higher quality item and skip this one.

title: A Comfortable decent headphone
review:
These headphones came in a well secured box. The box was well taped.

Pros: Has a great sound. Noise cancelling works really well, for use when I mow the lawn. Great battery life! Doesn’t squish your ears or your head when you wear them. (Defiantly been a struggle to find a pair of headphones that doesn’t hurt to wear them for long periods.) They charge super fast. They can connect to any Bluetooth enabled device. Great bass boosting abilities.

Cons: They cover that is around the headphone will start to degrade if you do not clean them after you sweat. They fold way to easily. It would have been great if the swivel was made out of steel not a cheap plastic.

My experience with these headphones has been great! It actually helped me decide to get a pair of in ear headphones for work. These are a little pricey, but are worth the cost of you take good care of them and charge them well.

title: Good product while it lasted
review: Good product while it lasted. Used with my iPhone for long conference calls and training webinars. Liked the double earphone design and it proved to be very comfortable during extended wear. Unfortunately the microphone stopped working and others said I sounded distant or broken up. If it used more substantial wiring and connections, this would likely get four or five stars.

title: Great EarPods
review: So far these earbuds sound SO much clearer than my older pair. Crystal clear and good sounds depth.

title: Not holding up!
review: Purchased for my wireless Bose head set.  This clip will not hold the thick headset wire.  I tried it for about 5 minutes and moved and the clip broke!  I had to reorder the correct more solid clip to hold my Bose set.  Shipping was fast.  Price looked great.  Ended up giving them to my Grandaughter for her inexpensive thin wire headset.

title: Best yet!
review: I have purchased quite a few wireless head sets.  I have a regular full cushion headset that works great as far as distance, but must say, this is by far the best sounding, comfortable head set I own to date.  Plus the fact I paid more for my next best wireless head phone.  I bought my son-in-law one, and he loves it for working out at the gym, and for running!  GREAT PRODUCT!

title: Fits amazing
review: I love this for my cassette player. Fits amazing and has a little pocket for headphones. Great quality!

title: Good for classroom
review: Good price and fairly nice quality - I got them for my classroom and the kids like using them more than earbuds.

title: Me like!
review:
These are awesome.

They came in very nice packaging that seemed above the price of the headphones. They came with extra ear pieces and a carrying case.

I love the volume changing feature - always helpful.

The only weird thing about these headphones is how big they seem compared to my previous pair; this is mainly due to the thickness of the cord since it's tangle-reducing.

I really like these!

title: Makes for a better fit!
review: Absolutely love them! I’ve always had an issue with getting any earphones to stay in my ears. I thought the Apple AirPods would be different but they wouldn’t stay either. Very annoying, to say the least. So I decided to try the Earbuddyz and as soon as I put them on I could tell the difference. Would recommend!

title: Sounds is good.
review: I am very happy with the sound and overall fit.  However,  the headphones start to hurt on long calls when wearing glasses.  Overall it is s great product.

title: Not good for staying in
review: I like the sound quality the battery life is not good and the earbuds keep falling out of my ears. I did put the small earpiece on the earbuds but even with that and not moving they fall out.

title: First off great sound, no doubt about that
review:
Without going into the technical details, which have already been very well covered, i'll instead get into how it performs in the real world and in the longer run. First off great sound, no doubt about that, which gets 5 stars.
The small problems are all on the outside. The cable gets tied in knots easily and the tearing of the outer casing which encases the cable just made it worse. This can of course be replaced, but i hope they've come out with better cables since i bought it about 3 years ago. Make no mistake, they do carry excellent signal however. Lastly the padding on the ears tend to wither slowly a few months like flakes of dry skin falling off. Some even got caught around my ear. It would be great if it were easy to wipe down and clean. If you use it as often, cleaning the pads around the ear is something to consider. With headphone sizes, it really depends on the shape/ size of your head. This great indoors and holds on well enough. Movement may be limited as with most headphones of this style. So, over all, very good headphones. I'd recommend it for the actual purpose it was meant to serve. The sound is fantastic.

title: Stops working after a year
review:
I bought these headphones because I thought they would last me a long time and the reviews were great.
The first pair I got at Walmart and those lasted me 2 years and then they stopped working and the latest one I bought on Amazon and thet just lasted me 1 year. I am so disappointed with these. I won't be buying them again.

title: Sound is great but mic didnt work at all.
review:
I was so happy to get these headphones and today I used it on my first conference but my mic didnt work correctly at all. I should have gotten the regular ones without the mic. But I cant return it now because I threw the box out.

$22 down the drain. I can't believe that. Just get the ones without the mic.

title: Great quality for the price
review:
If you're looking for a cheap pair of headphones that you don't have to be super upset if you lose, or a spare pare to keep somewhere just in case...these are it! For the price, they sound quite good and they seem to be very durable. Sure, you're not going to get the same audio quality as a $60 pair of earbuds, but these sound very good, not overly tinn-y and with a good bass. If I lose this pair, I will buy another just like it. I'm quite pleased with it.
Also love that it comes with multiple sizes of earbud attachments, as I have small ears.

title: Finally a dual that works with Apple
review:
it took me a while to find these. I did searches and it wasn't until my husband came across this. I do have bluetooth B&O headphones but they only last for 4 hours. So I use my Westones to listen to my meditation music or my Apple playlist alone. I love that Apple allowed a company to make this because I spent a lot of money on westones for best quality listening. AND I love the ability to charge my phone at the same time. so this little thing is worth the money!

Now I know many other companies make a similar thing but I ran into the problem of not compatability and I spend money on 3 different ones. so yes, these Belkins ARE the bomb!

title: B&O worst earbuds.
review: My husband bought these for Christmas for me. Initailly it worked great a few times after charging; sound quality is fantastic. But for some reason  it just stopped staying on and would not connect to my iphone. I Even tried 3x to get the earbuds to stay on to do the latest software update thinking it would make a difference. As much as i hate to say it, and i love B&O, but these earbuds are horrible!!

title: A&K Rocks!!!
review: LOVE this player!!!! I was using the Ibasso DX90. That sounded great too!! But A&K has a touchscreen that is far better.  You have the ablity to delete songs manually where as the Ibasso DX90 did not allow that. Plus it offers more finger room to press the buttons. Sound quality is just as great as Ibasso. A&K is less bulky. Highly Recommend this player with a great pair of headphones. I use the Westone W50 and love the sound quality!

title: Happy day!! Lol
review: Love the way it fits. Been driving me crazy using wireless headphones, because unless you spend big money or remember to keep them charged I end up waiting for charging every time I need them.

title: When it comes to conference calls while working from home, these headphones are terrible
review:
These headphones are terrible for conference calls. They do not cancel out background noise -- a delivery truck beeping several houses away is perfectly audible through them.

They also have issues with picking up random static sounds, delivering choppy audio or speaking, and a myriad of minor annoyances that I should not have to deal with on $400 headphones.

Otherwise, they look good are a okay for personal use. But when it comes to work or anything professional, I think their downsides are enough that I would definitely not buy them again.

title: These headphones stopped working properly about four months after purchase ...
review: These headphones stopped working properly about four months after purchase. This extremely short lifespan is unacceptable for a product in this price range.

title: does exactly as intended
review: the fact that it comes with two is awesome. I can leave a set of wired headphones plugged into one device and have another on standby for a different device if needed. they work great.

title: Plastic construction, could probably find something better for the price
review: Upon opening these headphones I was immediately disappointed with the weight of them. They're completely plastic constructed and feel very light and flimsy. The mic makes a clicky noise when you move it. I got this to make phone calls since I work from home but found that the person on the line would occasionally have difficulties hearing me, which doesn't normally happen with my normal headphones. For the price I think I'd try something else.

title: A little underwhelmed for the price
review:
These headphones look great and the sound quality is nice but I don't think they actually feel very nice. The headphones themselves are a little hard and stiff, not to mention they're rigid when it comes to adjusting the size. They don't move nearly as smoothly as headphones I've tried at much lower price points.

The bottom line is even though they look nice and sound decent, I'm going to reach for these less because they're just not as comfortable as other pairs I own (some of which cost less than this pair)

title: Decent pair of inexpensive headphones
review:
For the price I think these are pretty decent quality bluetooth headphones.

Upon opening I was a little disappointed by how cheap the plastic bits on this headset feel and look. My boyfriend didnt think they looked too bad but I definitely feel like these look like lower cost headphones. The carry bagit comes with also looks pretty inexpensive. They stick out on the sides a little more than I'd like as well.

If you like your music LOUD, these will be for you. In comparison to some beats headphones I have, these are about 2x as loud. Quality is decent but can definitely become distorted at the higher volumes.

I found these comfortable at the top of my head but the ear pieces did begin to make my ears sore after a while.

They come with a wire to make them regular headsets which I think is awesome for places or times you can't charge these.

Overall for the price, I think these headphones are pretty good, just don't expect a luxury item. Would probably work great as travel pair.

title: Hurts my noggin
review:
I've used headphones for long periods of time before and have never had any issues. These headphones apply some pressure on your ears, but for me it seems to apply a lot of pressure on the top, where the headphones rest. After a half hour or so of wear, it makes the top of my head sore.

The sound quality is decent, but nothing better than products I've tried before. you can push up or down on the actual headphones to increase/decrease volume, as well as pausing songs. The headphones fold up into a decent size that makes it a little easier to carry around in your purse or backpack. However these do come with a soft case so you'll still need to be relatively careful with how you handle them. To be honest I think beats headphones are more about brand name than actual quality.

The color and design is cool but for the price and the comfort (discomfort) level, personally I don't think it's worth it.

title: Great sound and noise cancelling
review:
Great sound quality, and the noise cancellation on these is awesome. Even when I don't have any music playing it knocks out any exterior noise. I also haven't experienced any nausea that I get from over the ear noise cancelling head phones which is pretty great.

Comfort level is okay, and I also do notice the tiniest bit of delay when I go to pause or play songs, but I think for the price these are still an awesome set of earbuds. Just make sure these are set in their charging positions correctly to ensure a good charge.

title: The silver looks a bit cheap...
review: The silver on these headphones is plastic and looks quite cheap in person. For the price and sound quality, I think there are a lot of other options for a lower price.

title: Problems holding charge.
review:
These earbuds seem like a good idea, as an inexpensive alternative to airpods. They look nice, fit well and also come in a little case.

The sound quality is decent in them, and they're able to stay in pretty well during workouts.

However, these came with no instructions, so it did take a while to figure out how to use them. And I'm still not sure if I'm using them to their best abilities.

The other problem is that about 2-3weeks of use they're struggling to hold charge. I'm not sure if I received a faulty pair but they frequently show to only be at half charge/low charge even after charging overnight.

These were awesome while they worked for me, wish they were still fully functional.

title: Great value for working from home
review:
Bought these as a backup headset for work from home and they’re a great value for the money. The sound is acceptable, controls what you would expect for headsets in this price range, and Logitech makes durable products in my experience.
I would recommend these for anyone looking for a quality headset for videoconferencing or work from home.

title: I LOVE these headphones
review: I LOVE these headphones!! My wife HAS to have the TV on at night to go to sleep and I dislike TV playing when it's bedtime. Suffice it to say this product has reduced a lot of tension and I've used them as well to hear clear crisp audio.

title: Great audio quality AND price
review:
Very pleased with the audio quality from a relatively inexpensive pair of earbud headphones, even more so given their price.

UPDATE: I've purchased additional pairs of these earbuds for myself and my family. They really have quality audio, come with a very nice zipper case, and are one of the best values I've found in headphones/earbuds. Very pleased and will likely buy again when they're on a deal of the day.

title: On conference calls all day
review: I am on conference calls for at least 6 hours a day as a telecommuting IT manager so comfort and sound quality are of equal importance to me. This product is so comfortable that having it on my head all day does not give me a second thought and the audio quality of those on the call and of my voice is excellent. I am seriously considering buying a couple spares of this product for whenever the product is no longer available - that is how pleased I am with the headset.

title: Nice basic headphones. Good volume.
review: No one is going to confuse these with Bose, but at this price point I think they are nice headphones. I do agree with other reviewers that it would be nice if the earcups swiveled but I didn’t find them uncomfortable. One pet peeve I’ve had with some other headphones is that I can’t turn them up loud enough. Yeah, I know everyone is worried about ear damage, but if I can’t hear what I’m trying to listen to in a noisy environment like on the train the headphones are no good to me. They paired easily, sound good and the buttons work as expected so what’s not to like.

title: Not universal charging cable, and the left speaker broke. Even when using a hard case.
review: The sound quality was surprisingly loud for bone conduction headphones. Although it was a bit too much when you turn them on and the blaring, rattling "Power On" was not ideal. I would turn these on in my hands instead because it would hurt my ears if placed on my head to turn on. Needless to say the downside was the charging cable was specific to these headphone only. I purchase a separate hard case to transports these headphone to and from the gym and still the headphones broke. Not certain how, but the left ear piece no longer plays any sound. :L

title: I love these
review: Seems almost identical to the LG HSB-700.  Only difference I notice is voice functions and range.  Voice notifications are superb, no more obscure beeps telling you if your battery is low, with the LG HSB-730 it's specific (battery low, connected, trying to connect, etc).  The range on this headset is a bit limited and this can be a little annoying at first, but the point is that your not supposed to be 1000 feet from your phone when you use it, otherwise you could lose your phone and never realize it.  Like the changes, time will be the test with durability, hopefully this one lasts a while.  A steal at $49.  Definitely recommended.

title: Best headphones I ever didn't buy myself...
review: I actually bought these as a gift for my husband who is currently deployed after seeing that he put them on his wish list.  After I bought them he mentioned that he found a pair over in the Middle East... Grrr 😂 So, I could have returned them OR I could have kept them for myself to drown out the screams of our parrot who is highly pissed off that he is gone for a year.  Glad I went with option B - these headphones are amazeballs!  The sound quality is phenomenal, they hold a charge forever (seemingly), and they drown out the miserable green bird and allow me to get work done without contemplating putting him in the oven for dinner. (Joking... I don't eat meat)  But seriously, if you are even thinking about these take the leap - they are worth every penny and beyond.  I'm glad my big jerk of a hubby ruined my surprise gift, because I love my new headphones 😁

title: Long lasting
review: I love these headphones but if your ears r small and if u r doing certain workouts they fall off the ear which can b annoying, they're comfortable and sound great, very loud. I would repurchase for sure, love they are waterproof when I sweat

title: This seller is not helpful do not buy
review: I loved everything about these headphones. After 5 months they stopped charging in one headphone. They r cheaper now but where about $40 when i got them. It was outside the return window i contacted them 3 times and were 0 help i contacted amazon to get this resolved because under warranty these shoulda lasted atleast 1 year.  I rather pay more for something if i get good service. Never buying from this seller again

title: Amazing!!!! Love it! Recommend it!
review: My first impression as soon as I put them into my ears” O my GOD!” . The clarity and sound are an AMAZING! I bought 3 other different brands of earbuds and returned them. None of them had this almost “Boss” quality, doesn’t matter how much it cost. In addition they came fully charged, multiple ear rubber pieces and charger. What else I could wish for?! Maybe “ One Buy, One Free”!!!!😅 I know I’m dreaming but girl could dream !

title: Pending
review: I like that these earbuds came with a charger and different size of ear rubber cover. What I don’t like it is earbuds stays inside the ear  only 60 % of the time. It’s stressing me out that I need to be always on look out and not to loose them. I changed ear rubber to medium size thinking that maybe solution and will give a couple more days to try. I don’t know why apple EarPods stays without falling out even if I walk fast or run and others brand are not. Something wrong with design! Will keep you updated it I keep them or return them.

title: No Bueno!
review: I have the Bose Sound Ultra for Android and they sound amazing to me.  BUT, the cord keeps fraying at the junction of the plug that goes into my phone.  I just had to order my 9th pair through Best Buy (who is no longer going to carry them for Android...only IOS).  wanted was an economical pair to have in my backpack for "emergency".  I ordered three different ones to see what sounded good to use until I find a permanent WIRED earphone with a tough cord made to survive the life of New York City with delicious sound.  These things ... THESE THINGS.... they will be sent back tomorrow.  They are HORRIBLE.  I wasn't expecting to be wowed for the price.  But the reviews made me think I might get somewhat of a "wow".  Seriously, I cannot even believe I allowed myself to have hope.  I can only hope Robert Smith of The Cure will forgive me for using his music to test these made for a six year old. There you have it.  I wouldn't accept these things to listen to a voice read a book to me.

title: Headphones
review: These headphones can get really loud. If you turn the music on and place them over you neck, you can hear the music from at least 4 feet away. They do charge quickly... it has taken no more than 20 minutes to fully charge them. They have a bass button which is nice to get a better quality of music, as artists intent for their music to be heard. The volume button can be used to change the music. They were easy to connect to an iphone XR. You can also talk on the phone with them and hear well on both ends. They fit well, but did make the ears a little hot, which may be from the cushioning. These also have great range. I placed my phone (that was connected to them) in my room and went out of my apartment and down to the first floor, outside and the connection did not mess up at all.

title: Noise cancelling
review: These headphones adjust about an inch up on both sides. They are comfortable, they are padded on the ears and at the top. They have good sound control for kids. On the highest level, you cannot hear anyone else speaking so they are noise cancelling, and the volume is not deafening. They are durable also and have nice graphics. The cord is about 3.5 feet long. This item has a year warranty that covers any defects in material or workmanship.

title: Volume control
review: I gave these headphones a 2 because something about the shape of them is off. It is as though there are leaning forward. You can feel and see it when you put them on. Which makes them slightly uncomfortable. The kids safe volume is working, I could fully hear another person that I was talking to or talking to me, even on the highest volume. Therefore, it is not noise cancelling. the cord is about 4 feet long. The graphics on it are nice. It seems to be easily scratched or scuffed becaused when I received mine, it has scuffs and scratches in it already. The ears and top of them are padded and it has a limited warranty covering defects in material or workmanship.

title: Couldn't work all the features
review: I tried to connect the headphones with my tcl roku smart tv, but could not get it to work. I then plugged it into my galaxy S9 with the audio to audio cord and it did work. It was very loud, which I liked. The directions seemed complicated to me, I did give it a few tries trying to connect it to different things, but it hasn't worked out for me. I really don't see the difference between these and any wired/ bluetooth headphones. Although, the portable charger that comes along with it is very nice and convenient.

title: Very loud
review: These headphones were used on an iphone XR. The volume goes up really loud, which is good. They are really comfortable too. When you place them in your ears, you don't have to adjust them to fit, they seem to just sit in place perfectly. Overall, I would recommend these headphones solely off of comfort.

title: Get the Megivez E20 instead of these.
review: The Megivez E20 is better than this T08 by far for about the same cost. I started out with these Megivez T08 model but the microphone did not perform well at all for phone calls. I contacted Megivez and told them I wanted to upgrade to the Megivez E20 based on reviews and that the volume can be controlled from the earbuds unlike the T08 and I must say they are a huge improvement in all areas. I am happy to report that Megivez is way on top when it comes to customer service and support. They quickly sent out the E20 model and it is much superior, in my opinion, as the microphone works and volume can be controlled from the earbuds themselves. The sound is quite good provided some adjustments are made. There is plenty of bass. In fact, too much as it can make the rest of the frequency spectrum sound muddy. However, using the built in EQ on my iPad and iPhone and selecting Bass Reducer mode brightens up the midrange and highs with still plenty of tight bass, as it should be, with a balanced sound. I feel that, like headphones or speakers, a short period of “break in” time is needed as the sound improves after a few days of use. The buds are very comfortable and unobtrusive. I often fall sleep with them in. The charging case is solidly constructed, more slim and compact than these T08, and fit comfortably in pocket or bag. I have seen the E20 buds offered with a $10, $15, even a $20 dollar coupon by Amazon making these TWS earbuds an amazing bargain. Highly recommended.

title: Quality for a little buck.
review: I not going to go on and on about it, because I have to say that I was super pleasantly surprised by this headset.  At first it was seriously not what I was expecting I thought it was going to be bigger and bulkier. But I totally love the fact that it’s not. So what I love about it is that it’s not bulky, so it’s easy to not take too much space on my already crowded computer table.  I wish the battery life was a little better, but I’m not going to complain much. The sound is super good for a 32 bucks headset. And the leather on the ear is soft and not irritating at all.  So for the I’m satisfied with this product for the price that I paid.

title: I was so happy to find these on Amazon
review: I was so happy to find these on Amazon. Its always disappointing when companies discontinue your favorite products and such is the case for these headphones. These are honestly some of the best headphones on the market in my opinion. I do not care for the earbuds that you stick in your ears as I do not find them comfortable. These clip over your ear and are so comfortable to wear, even over a long term basis. The sound quality is excellent. You get clear stereo sound. I love these!

title: I loved these earbuds when I initially got them
review:
I can't stand the trend toward those little cylindrical in-ear headphones that constantly fall out of your ear unless you push them directly into your brain stem.

That said, I loved these earbuds when I initially got them. The head hit nicely in my ears. It was flexible; it had some give. They were comfortable and worked well. Note: I use my headphones about 7 hours per day between phone calls and music/podcasts while I work.

The punchline: about 4 days after it was too late to return them, the right speaker blew out. I don't listen to anything very loud. I'm not an extreme athlete who wears these while running through mud or fire. I would classify my usage as "typical". And they broke.

I moved on to a different brand, however I may try these again when those break. I'm not sure why I cannot find < $100 earbuds that don't break after a month. Had these not broken they would've been 4-5 stars.

title: Great Wireless Headphones, Especially for the Price
review: Great pair of wireless headphones. Great sound quality and really good battery life. Probably the best I'd used up to that point, even over more recognizable brand names.

title: Best earphones I have
review: Great earphones. I use them like every day. As long as you take care of them and clean them out and stuff, they'll last you a good while. The sound quality is good and I love all the functions it has. Plus, the app that goes with it that you automatically have in a Samsung phone makes it even better. You can change the functions and equalizer among other things. I recommend getting a case for these though, as the case is smooth, so it can slip out of your grip or whatever and they can fall. Getting a case for these is a good investment. Aside from that, I don't really have any cons. Great headphones. Convenient, and have a good battery life.

title: A great option for the price!
review: better than expected based on the price for the number of headphones The colors are fun and the quality is great for the price. If you go through a lot of headphones this is an affordable and decent option.

title: Good price for Good quality!
review: These earbuds have good sound, good phone call quality and an amazing battery life. I tested them out yesterday continuously and they lasted around 9 hours. The charging case, is small, compact, and magnetic. I found that it was easy to connect these to my iphone and they were quick to charge, just pop them in the case and plug it in.

title: Wireless, noise cancelling and comfortable
review: These are good headphones. I prefer to use headphones to earbuds when I’m at home—just more comfortable but not all headphones are comfortable. These are. Sound is good, hookup is easy and battery life is good. Overall a great investment for me.

title: All around great
review: These headphone are comfortable, have great sound, effectively cancel noise and have decent battery life. They're my favorite headphones. I actually prefer headphones to earbuds when I'm at home or spending a long time watching TV or on my computer. These are great.

title: Good sound
review: Good sound, good noise cancellation, decent battery life and NO wires. These do a good job and are fairly comfortable. I think headphone do a more comfortable job of noise cancellation than ear buds especially around the house and these are doing a good job.

title: Nice durable cable
review: All my earbuds require a micro USB and all the cables that come with them are short. This is long enough to be useful and does the job. Pretty durable - I’ll be getting a few more because everything is coming with micro usb now and those annoying short little cables that aren’t easy to work with.

title: Good sound, comfortable to wear.
review: Decent sound and fairly comfortable but I found them to be just a bit heavy and it didn’t feel like the earbuds would stay in with a lot of activity. That said, they are very comfortable, don’t wiggle around and don’t just fall out.  I thought the case was a bit oversized and the whole package was bigger than I like for wireless but as long as I’m not moving around a lot, they stay in, are very wearable and the sound is decent. I’ve got another pair that I wear frequently and compared to those these feel a bit “top heavy” so it may not be a problem for someone else.  I do want to comment that they come encased in a foam holder and it was VERY difficult to get the earbuds out of the foam.

title: Standard earbuds — wired
review: You’ll need to plug these into your phone with the audio jack. This is NOT a lightning connector  and it is NOT wireless but if you can still use earbuds that plug in these fit fine and the sound is decent. I don’t think they are stable enough for a lot of moving around but if you are more or less stable, these will do the trick. Earbuds have enough options and I found them to be very comfortable.

title: Actually, it worked! Legacy Sony radio-amp no Bluetooth, but superb...
review: with a Sony 5 CD carousel - so I can listen to my huge CD collection. (Yes, later, will burn to disk but for now...), Just plugged it into the headphone out, with an extension to get to where the USB power hub was  (needs power, thought I) and this little gem paired to Bluetooth Headphones and now I have wireless headphones that the then SONY did not have. Next step is to buy shelf speakers because if the cans sound, so will the boxes. We are very pleased. Simple, cheap, effective - what more is there to say, I ask you?

title: Bought in August 2022, failed in November, 2022.
review: Mid November, 2022 - loud crackling noise for a moment then gone. But video-to-audio sync failed thereafter. Meaning the actors' lips move and the sound of what they are saying is heard a second or 2 later. Swapped out to another (MPOW) headset and synced perfectly. Hence these BERIBES Bluetooth Headphones are most unsatisfactory.

title: Set up today 2022-06-26. Caution! Factory installed speaker wires set too far in: no sound.
review: So last thing to check if no sound but VU meters moving and headphones sound OK. Yes, the factory installed speaker wires were pushed too far into the connectors so the insulation prevented metal-to-metal contact. Solution: back out the speaker wires an reinstall. Just trying to be helpful. 2 days later: noted clipping and crackle in the FM radio at peak signal. As pointed out elsewhere, this is a bad FM radio. Occasional click/pop on the CD.

title: Great Case. Great look. Great features. Love it!
review: really nice case. great protection for my bluetooth headset. love the color and feel.  Love the caribiner  clip cuz I can clip it to my bag strap and not have to waste space inside the bag. love it.

title: iPad
review:
I needed this for an iPadPro and about a dozen headsets around the house. I had earbuds!
Just glad I did not have to find a headset to fit it.

title: It works!
review:
I had such a problem trying to charge, wait, and then use headphones....
This splitter I got for my Samsung Note 10 works !!!
Thank you!!

title: GREAT Way to Watch DVDs In Bed When I Want to Have Fun- Sound Weak
review:
Recently, I have wished that I had the ability to watch DVDs in bed without having to watch on the big TV. I also would like to take it to my shed with no electricity so that I can play art classes without having to rely on internet at all.

HOW THIS CHARGES
This charges using the type C cord in a few hours.

PICTURE
The picture is decent. It is not like watching an expensive bluray or TV screen, but it is fine for close up watching.

OPERATION
I have had no issues operating this. It is pretty easy and the set up is not difficult to adjust.

SOUND
That is where we lose a star. Even at the highest setting of 20 this is so quiet that if I run fans in the summer, it is hard to hear with the player right in front of me. Headphones would solve that, but I don't always want to wear them.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I like this set. It is fun to play with and allows me to watch my English tribute of nightly Hyacinth Bucket episodes where no one else has to listen to it and complain because I play it too much.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. If the sound was a little bit louder and better, I would like this more. As it is it is still okay.

title: Great Sound- My Family Loves These
review:
I have a family of Opinionated head phone and ear phone critics. When I got this headset, my son grabbed it to test out on his phone and MP3 player, but it did not work on his phone- it is not a smart phone. It also did not work on my phone which is a Rugby 2 which is not a smart phone either.

As a head phone set, it works well with the MP3 player. My son seems to feel that it does not have a good separation and balance so he is not as big of a fan. However, my daughter loves these. She feels that they are better than the best of the sets that we have and have fantastic definition and excellent sound.

I tend to like these ear buds too. They are comfortable and the sound is very good. Nice definition as well as good balance, I thought these were good ear buds. If you have a smart phone, these would be fantastic for listening to music as well as using your phone capabilities. As I get more chances to test these out, I will update as necessary.

title: I like these, but my twelve year old not so much
review:
These headphones had a mixed reaction in my household. My daughter at twelve likes to spend some time with headphones on connected to her MP3 player. She has literal headphones. I showed her these headphones- or ear buds with loops on them- and asked if she would try them.

Her reaction was that she did not really like them because they had a suction and made it feel uncomfortable on her ears. They did stay in place very well and allowed her to do a lot of activities she could not do with her headphones on. She just couldn't see to get past the suction feeling.

I, on the other hand, like the tight fitting ear rubberized buds because they lock into the ears and close out interfering noise which I appreciate when working outside and trying to block out annoying noise like our next door drummer on days when I just don't want to hear it.

The earphones are comfortable and do stay in place well for activities like gardening and running. They are nice.

Some people might not be able to get past the suction feeling, but if you can, these are nice and will stay in place during active times.

title: Very full-featured
review:
I'll update this review as I get more experience with the radio, but my first impressions are very positive. It's an excellent value because of its huge number of useful features. However, some notable features are missing, especially SSB if that's important. Likewise, there's no connector for an external antenna. Other features, such as squelch, are shared with the numbered buttons, so they're hard to remember without referring to the (comprehensive) manual.

* AM, FM, and complete shortwave bands.
* Digital tuning, with fine tuning that's easy to use.
* Bandwidth selector that's amazingly effective. Strong AM stations sound amazingly good on the wide setting.
* It can charge rechargeable batteries. Or turn the charge switch off to use non-rechargeable batteries.
* AC power adaptor is included.
* Pretty nice leatherette padded case is included.
* Telescoping antenna is about 2 feet long.
* FM and AM work well. Not sure about SW yet. I need a directory, and I need to compare with better radios.
* Sound quality from the mono speaker is good at low volumes. At higher volumes, the 1 watt amplifier will start clipping. FM stereo is available when using earbuds.

More to come ...

title: Very excellent
review:
I bought the ATH-A990Z as an upgrade from a previous pair of AT 700x headphones. These ATH-A990Z headphones are superb in many ways, and I often use them to listen to high resolution streaming audio from Qobuz (24 bits, 96 kHz). It's kind of like going from mono to stereo -- once you hear the difference that high resolution can provide, it's hard to go back to ordinary CDs or MP3s, even though those can sound very pleasant.

The fit of the earpads and headband is very good, and I often wear them for hours without any fatigue. In fact, the overall experience is so good that I look forward to my listening time. The substantial ear pads are very effective in blocking out noise from my surroundings, and create a zone where I can enjoy even quiet passages in my classical music favorites.

The sound is a little bass heavy, so those who like the Bose sound will probably be very happy. I prefer a flatter response, and it's actually pretty easy to accomplish that with the Windows equalizer for my Realtek hardware in the Sound control panel. The highs are very light and airy, beautiful. The net result is entirely excellent, with sound that is very smooth and open. Just fantastic. At the price, the ATH-A990Z headphones compare very well to much more expensive alternatives.

title: Almost ok
review: These were much less expensive than the OEM earpads, and you get what  you pay for. They almost work; hard to keep them connected to the headphones. (Maybe I'm not installing them correctly.) They include a plastic pry tool to remove the original worn earpads. These are considerably less comfortable than the original pads, and make the headphones somewhat uncomfortable to wear. Not horrible, just not as good. Someday I might splurge for the OEM pads.

title: Good noise cancelling, sound pleasing but just ok
review:
You get two types of noise cancelling with this. First, there's some noise blocking just from having these stuck in your ears. Then the active noise cancelling works quite well. But you have to have them stuck in your ears really firmly, which isn't too easy for me. I suppose it all depends on the shape of your ears. You get several sets of tips, but none of them seem to fit me quite right.

The active noise cancelling works better than I expected. It does a better job with low rumbles, like aircraft noise. It's not so good with voices, but it does give you a little bit of reduction there too. I use them in my office, in a somewhat busy environment.

The sound quality is very pleasing, but it doesn't have the sparkling highs or very deep lows that you get with more expensive earphones or earbuds. Nevertheless, the sound is smooth and well balanced, so it's comfortable to listen to.

For the price, I'm pretty happy.

title: Really nice earbuds, and fantastic for the price
review: The sound is well-balanced and very smooth. In fact, I couldn't really improve the sound using the iTunes equalizer -- it's just fine with the equalizer set to "flat". At a very low volume level, I did use a slight bass boost which is normal procedure for most any headphones or speakers. These earbuds come with a handy case, and are remarkably good and very easy to listen with. They've got a permanent home in my travel kit.

title: Nice earphones!
review: At first I thought these earphones were faulty...I didn't push then in all the way. They are nice to have for my cellphone.

title: Comfortable earphones!
review: These are the cutest and most comfortable little earphones. There's a faint R/L marking near the sound holes on each ear bud. I'm no runner but, my swift limping skills never made them fall out of my ears. The sound is clear with a volume control button on the cord.

title: Sound great and well designed.
review:
I ordered '1MORE Wireless Earbuds Active Noise Cancelling, Bluetooth Headphones Dual Driver, WNR, 20H Playtime, IPX5 Waterproof, 4 Mics for Phone Call Work, Home Office' for review and would like to share my thoughts.

I have been really impressed with these wireless earbuds and would compare the sound and quality to the 1MORE "truly" wireless earbuds that I also own. Although the Active Noise Cancelling is not the greatest, I would still consider these to be one of the best bang-for-your-buck options if you prefer this type of wireless earbud.

Sound quality to me is great with the Bass being well balanced, the Mids are smooth and the Highs are clean. The volume could go a bit higher but I have found that with most earbuds and headphones these days, they seem to be limited and could use a bit of a boost but overall these do the job. The neck piece is light yet looks and feels of high quality and not flimsy like others I have tried. Call quality is decent and gets the job done. Overall I think that 1MORE has done a great job on design, quality, comfort, value and sound with these.

title: Quality leather and snaps.
review: I ordered the 'Gydandir Leather Cable Straps Cable Ties Cable Organizers Cord Management for Organizing USB Cable Headphone Wires, 2 Sizes 5 Colors' for review. So far I am pretty impressed with the quality of materials used. The leather and snaps are a nice quality and the stitching is flawless. They do take a little time trying to get the cables wrapped just right so that straps fit correctly. Some have mentioned that the smaller strap is useless as it wouldn't fit anything, but if you wrap the smaller cords right, they fit just fine (see attached images). The nice thing is that if you can't get the smaller straps to fit, then just use two smaller straps (snapped together) to wrap your cord. Overall these are a nice way to clean up my cord drawer and they look really classy. I would say these are a great value if you want something nicer than a bunch of rubber bands holding your cords together haha.

title: Sound quality is better than most over-ear headphones!
review: I ordered these Razer Ifrit: Low Profile Design wired earbuds to use mostly for gaming on my Xbox One console and I am absolutely blown away by the amazing sound quality. Even the mic performance is better than expected. I've always loved Razer products as they tend to be well made and of higher quality, and I have to say that these are no exception. If I were to complain about anything it would be that the band that wraps around the back of your head (they fit a little big for me) tends to brush against my gaming chair, which gets picked up by the mic on the other end. This gets a bit annoying but after a bit you learn how to avoid this by keeping your head from bumping and brushing against the chair. No stars deducted for this however, only because of how incredible the sound and build quality is. I may be retiring my over ear headphones in favor of these ;)

title: Easy to pair but fit for me is not optimal.
review: These Jabra Elite Active 45e Wireless Sports Earbuds are comfortable enough to wear and definitely stay put however I can't get them to make a seal in my ears and there are no other tips included. Pairing was super easy which I would expect from a Jabra product. Sound quality is decent for this type of earbud but without being able to seat them snugly in the ear canal, they really do lack in bass. In a quiet room the call quality works great as I had no issues hearing the caller and the caller could hear me clearly. I do like the physical volume control and it is easy to adjust. I did notice some issues with the music dropping out on occasion while walking throughout the house but it was not much different than other wireless buds that I own. Overall these make for a great outdoor wireless earbud, as they seem to be made of high quality and water resistant materials which should hold up to sweat and a bit of rain.

title: Loud and Clear
review: These earbuds were a gift to my sister, and she just can’t stop talking about how good they are in canceling out background noise, and how clear the sound is when they are in use. They are worth the cost.

title: Cords too flimsy
review:
Update: After 16 months the right ear went out. Bummer. Took off a star.

Gorgeous sound coming from these but I don't like the clips. They're clunky in that they don't allow the speaker to sit firmly against my ear so I'm not getting the full sound I could be getting. Come on, Koss, offer these with a headband please.

Edit: after wearing for a few days the clips hurt my ears. I did the headband mod after buying the separate earphones on here and now they're very comfortable.

title: Really wanted to like them...
review: I really wanted to like these earbuds. There are so many great things about them. The sounds quality is good, the battery life is good, but they just hurt to wear. I love the voice commands and how easy they are to use. The head gesture controls I didn't like... I couldn't always figure out what I did that caused issues. So, I could do without those. I think the biggest problem for me is that I can only have them in my ear for about an hour before my ears just start hurting. If they fit your ear, then I am sure they would be a great buy.

title: So painful to wear
review: I don't have complaints about the sound. I thought the sound quality was pretty good. But, because I work in an open-space environment at work, I need earphones that I can wear for long periods of time—these are not comfortable. After about a half hour, my ears were in so much pain that I gave up and went back to my old pair that didn't have quite as good of sound to them. The bluetooth connection is a bit wonky and sometimes disconnects for no reason. My other headphones never had this problem. I do not recommend these at all.

title: Is headphones sound great build quality subpar
review: I had these headphones for a month or two I guess and the padding on the bow going over the top of your head came unglued or whatever and the stuffing was showing and could have come out and it was very poor quality stuffing to begin with the headphones sound phenomenal but for me build quality factors in a lot too so I returned them for poor craftsmanship manufacturer defect.

title: If you're looking  for Bluetooth earbuds look no further because these are the best there are.
review: I have to say as a person who, not only is an audio engineer in the professional touring world for over 20 years but also as a person who has a literal collection of wireless earbuds in the Bluetooth category, the Decibullzs are ahead of all of the rest even at a lower price point than some that I have. The custom moldable ear fitting is almost revolutionary in my opinion is easy to do very comfortable and just very awesome, so not only does this company make a fantastic product, but their service and support after & before the sale are in the benchmark catagory,  bar setting, absolutely phenomenal. I wouldn't hesitate to buy this product over again and again and again even if it cost more thank you Decibullz. Outstanding all the way around performance service and value for the money keep up the good work!

title: Works perfectly
review: This gadget made my old tv bluetooth to my earbuds. I plugged it in and it is perfect. There is no difference in sound quality if it is charging or not like the other reviews said.

title: Wow!
review:
I put these headphones on, connected them to mt Walkman playing hi-resolution lossless flac files, and was Blown Away!
All I can say is WOW! Job well done Sony. I have 15 pairs of headphones up to $2000 a piece and this pair bows to none of them. You won't regret buying this pair! Cannot recommend highly enough. My favorite pair of bluetooth headphones. Call quality and battery life are excellent. Build quality and supplied case are top notch. I got the Silver version.

title: Beyond Excellent
review: I just bough this Gold version. I already own a pair of black ones. I don't want to not have a pair when I want to listen. If these are not the Best noise cancelling headphones, then you need to get the right tips on. I use these at the beach and out in the yard. Sweat is not a problem, a charge is good for the week. I'm really fussy about the sound. My regular inside phones are Beyerdynamics, Sennheiser, and a pair of Sony IER-Z1R. I only listen to lossless music.

title: Unreal Sound!
review: The first time I listened with these headphones was Magical!  My usual music was transformed. I heard sounds like I had not heard them before. Sound was entering from all parts of the Soundscape, It was Fantastic. It was like rediscovering my music collection.  Unfortunately, the bad recordings sound even worse. They are quite comfortable for hours of listening.

title: Unbelievable
review: These are without a doubt my favorite Headphones. They are much smaller and more compact than I was expecting. These are the Most comfortable headphones I have ever worn. The noise isolation also very good. Nobody in the room could hear my music playing other than me.  Well worth the price. I drive them with my Sony PHA-1A DAC/Amplifier. The sound is phenomenal. I am so glad I waited to buy a new pair of headphones until I experienced this pair. Well done  Beyerdynamic!

title: Love it! My Sony WX-1000 headphones fit in great
review: Love it! My Sony WX-1000 headphones fit in great. I also put my Sony Walkman NW-ZX100 in as well. Very well made and durable

title: Works great
review: I had initial issues connecting this to my bluetooth headphone, but after it did, the connection was solid and I haven't had the issue since. Controls are great and the battery last a long time.

title: Nice little speaker
review: I have a couple of meetings a seek and have been putting on a headset to attend them remotely. This is so much easier and allows me the ability to have multiple people listen when I'm in the office. The sound quality is good for a conference speaker. Music is ok, nothing to write home about, but that's not what this was made for. Controls are straight forward and easy to use. A very decent conference speaker.

title: Nice headphones
review: There are nice headphone. They paired easily and stayed in the ear, even while doing rigorous exercise.  Other sets I had would turn themselves on and run down the battery which was a huge pain. So far these have not. It takes a little while to get used to the button functions. The there is no separate volume controls so it's a bit of a pain turning it up or down. Actually the hardest thing I find with these is getting them out of the case. :-) I did experience a connection loss when I went into the room next door that I didn't have with other headphones. The sound quality is excellent.

title: Great set of headphones
review: All I can say is WOW! The sound on these headphones are excellent and has plenty of bass. The noise canceling also works very well. When it's on, I can't hear my wife. ;-) It allows you to fully enjoy what you're listening to. As for comfort, I can't say you forget you're wearing the, but you won't mind having these on for an extended period of time. I didn't suffer  the discomfort I felt with other brands after a while. I was able to use them all day, which also says something about the battery life. I highly recommend these headphones.

title: Works Great
review: Great item. This is my second set because my first set worked so well that I wanted another set for my other earbuds.

title: Adds Bluetooth audio to any TV with audio output
review: Simple setup that allows connection of Bluetooth headphones to a TV - even older tvs. Easy to install and great sound quality (depending, of course, on the sound quality of your headphones). Works with any TV with audio outputs.

title: Excellent sound - excellent build- snug fit - bluetooth
review:
These are really nice headphones. The built quality is first rate and the sound is excellent. I would put them on par with my favorite (similarly priced) Sennheisers. Clean, clear highs - smooth solid lows, nicely balanced overall sound. The active noise reduction system is phenomenal. I had an air cleaner (with fan) sitting right beside me and it disappeared! The amazing thing is that the sound quality didnt change - it was excellent whether on or off
They paired easily with both my phone and my laptop... no issues there whatsoever. Powers up when unfolded, powers back down when folded.

They come with a USB charging cable, and a soft sided case. The controls are cleverly built in, with a pause/play in the center of the eight ear, volume up on upper portion, volume down on lower portion. Theres one button on the left ear... that turns the active noise reduction on and off.

The two things that I thought were negatives... one is that the overall size is suited for average sized heads. I have a rather large head (my hat size is xxl). These headphones fit, but they're snug. They do have really nice soft cushions which make them usable, but they could be just a smidge larger (my Sennheisers are bigger). The other thing that I consider a negative, there's no provision for "plugging in" to some of my older gear... its bluetooth or nothing.

title: Perfect fit replacement pads.
review: These are exact replacements for tge original Sennheiser headphone pads.  I really like my Sennhwisers and have been using them for years.  The pads had become stretched and sloppy, frequently falling off, etc.  When i decided to replace the pads, I almost went with an alternate dye to the hefty price on these genuine pads (They are, after all, just foam).  But in the end, I decided to go ahead and get the originals... now I'm glad I did.  They fit perfectly and seem to have turned my old used Senns into a new-like set!  I can find no fault with these pads.  I'll take away one star for the price... leaving a four star rating.

title: Nice headphones... uncolored sound!
review: As a musician with a home studio, I needed some new headphones to track with. These came with good reviews, so I decided to give them a try. Good move on my part... they have a good uncolored sound, cover the ears completely and even come with 2 cables (1 coiled, 1 straight).  I do have a big head (size xxl hat) and proportional ears. I wouldn't say these are "roomy", but they do just cover my ears and seal around them nicely to minimize any sound leaking.

title: Love them
review: Love them. They are easy to connect to my device. Nice for when you are moving around, walking, listening to a book.  But the sound is not as good as the Bose quiet comfort headphones. I have those too.

title: Not too shabby
review: These headphones are very good and well priced. I wear mine to the gym and I have no issues with cords anymore and it’s amazing. Sound isn’t bad, and they are sleek.

title: Headphones make it stop working
review: So there IS a jack for headphones in the back, but as soon as you put that in, it won't work.  Confusing.

title: Doesn't work with inline mics
review: I wanted to use a pair of headphones (buds don't stick in my ears) in my iphone and hoped these would allow me to use a 3.5 plug with my iphone for calls.  The sound quality was fine for audio, but the person on  the other end of the phone couldn't hear me.  Back it went...

title: Love these headphones!
review: I have small ears, so earbuds simply do not stay in.  Even the ones with the ear loops fall out.  So I've always used over-the-ear headphones.  The big ones are too clunky.  These are just right!  The head band can be bent so as to achieve the right pressure, and the bluetooth aspect makes it so easy to wear when I am out and about and not having to worry about a cord getting in my way.  Others have mentioned that finding and using the charging port is a bit wonky, and it's true.  Sound quality is not concert-hall, by any means, but respectable enough.  I actually like that it's not noise-canceling, as I walk in the city and like to know what's coming up on me.  I do wish there was a volume control on the headphones, instead of having to control it on my device, but it's a small bother.  I would absolutely buy again if these ever die on me.

title: Idiots spending $100+ on headphones these work great. Excellent at the gym or during a run
review: Idiots spending $100+ on headphones these work great. Excellent at the gym or during a run, Under heavy use yet they last for a good while.

title: Earbud design kills it for me
review: Even with earbuds placed in their sockets, which is a pain, the wires are still all over the place. Plus has outdated usb-b connector. Not using. Got a better LG set.

title: Like quite a lot
review: These seem fine. OK sound, good battery life, simple controls. Just wish the earbud retracted with button push. Minor complaint

title: These were the worst earbuds I’ve ever had
review: I got these to replace another pair of earbuds that lasted awhile but eventually gave out. I didn’t expect much from the price. These were more expensive than those so I thought it was going to be nice. No, these crapped out after three months of use. The battery life is awful. The sound quality went horrible. Do not buy these if they become available again. All the money I’m wasting on these cheap earbuds I might as well get Apple ones!

title: They fit in my ear
review: So far I like they came with different options for the earbud cushion. I’ll need to use them for longer to see if I like them but they fit okay in my ear.

title: Didn’t work right out of the box
review: It said “this accessory is not supported by this device” definitely wanting to return these but considering I’m ordering a real pair of headphones, I’d rather tell everyone to NOT BUY THESE. sometimes with the headphones in it’ll not support it and play whatever I wa a listening to out loud. This is not cool

title: some good things
review: the screen protector worked poorly. Too many bubbles that couldn't be removed. I finally gave up and took it off. I like the padded case though,it really comes in handy for storing the items. the wall charger works great. Don't know exactly how long it takes to fully charge, but doesn't seem to take more than an hour or two.the  hdmi to hdmi cable for the tv to kindle didn't work and I tried to get it replaced but Digital was of no help at all. I like the cover viewing stand but wish it had an opening for the charging cable when closed, might cut one in it myself. the styless works great and is very comfortable to use.The small bag isn't worth much and the fish bone is completely useless. The earbuds worked alright though. Except for Digitals' bad customer service , which Amazon corrected I probably still would buy though.

title: It does what it's supposed to. The hook attaches ...
review: It does what it's supposed to. The hook attaches to the top corner of the monitor with adhesive foam, and it holds headphones.

title: Love!!
review: I was skeptical about these because I haven’t had any luck with wireless headphones but these are AMAZING! I’ve used apple AirPods for as long as I can remember and these are so much better! Easy to setup, put on, stays on and sounds great! Love!

title: Excellent Product
review: Excellent quality of noice cancellation and sound.  I was also very impressed with the life of the battery, lasting longer than any other wireless  product I’ve used. And for the price, compared to other wireless headphones, this is a no brainer.

title: Painful fit
review: These are the most uncomfortable earbuds I have ever worn. The sound is great. But the piece that fits inside your ear (not the rubber piece that goes in the ear canal) pushes up against the cartilage of my ear. Maybe I just have small ears, I don't know. But this piece seems larger than normal. I've had Sony earbuds before, and they didn't hurt like this. Difficult to wear for any length of time; which negates the reason I bought them: to wear all day at work and block out noise.

title: No volume control
review: There's no volume control on these headphones.  The sound through the headphones was deafening and hurt my ears, even with the volume on my TV muted.  It's a shame, because they seem like they would be comfortable, and the cord is the perfect length to span the distance between my crosstrainer and the TV.  I need headphones because I exercise early in the morning and don't want to wake the rest of the household.

title: on 4th warranty claim
review:
The sound is good. But my wife uses them daily and they only last about 3 or 4 months before the audio on one side or both is lost. There's no sign of physical damage, but there must be a connection breaking inside somewhere. We sent them in for a warranty claim and received reconditioned headphones back in a few weeks. Then it happened again, still within warranty. Again we received reconditioned headphones after waiting a few weeks. Four months later and the audio on one side is cutting out again. Another warranty claim. Overall, I've been happy with Sennheiser, but wish these were more durable because we lose the use of them for many weeks out of the year while we're waiting on warranty claims. At this rate, we'll have six warranty claims before the warranty is out after two years. Then no doubt we will want to find something that doesn't involve this hassle.

Update, 11/2014 - we just received them for the 4th time on warranty return. They seem to last about 90 days and then they need repair - even though there is no external sign of damage. I bought my wife some AKG Q460's to use when these are in for repair. She still prefers the PX200 II's when they're not broken because they're lighter, more comfortable and don't pinch her hair.

title: Very light and convenient
review: I love these! I wanted something that wasn’t bulky and had no wires. I also did NOT want noise cancellation because I use it for walks around town and want to hear if there’s something approaching, a car horn, etc. And unlike earbuds, they don’t fall out and get lost. For the price these are great! I listen to podcasts, so I can’t speak to the music fidelity.

title: Like these so much I bought 3 pairs
review:
These are the only earbuds that actually fit in my ear comfortably and don't fall out when I move my head.
I still like the kind that have a behind the ear clip if I run but it isn't convenient if you are taking them on and off alot. These are perfect inexpensive earbuds for everyday use. Fun colors too!

title: Great headset  for the price...IF THEY DON'T BREAK
review:
NOTE - I've had these for just a month and they just broke. No sound comes out of the right side at all. Very frustrating. I only used them a few times each week, so I would say they are not well made. I returned them to Amazon for a refund.

ORIGINAL REVIEW - I needed these because the stupid white bud earphones that come with iPhone kept falling out of my ears and there was way too much ambient sound. These are exactly as described, they come with nice adjustable foam plugs so the buds will fit in your ear and now I only have to listen to my iPhone at half volume rather than cranked all the way up. The sound is good. I don't think the sound is incredible, but I don't really care about that, as I didn't feel like spending $100 on something that I will probably lose or break in a year. I wanted to spend even less, but couldn't find anything that wasn't cheap feeling. This is a nice middle ground. They also look nice, the silver/black matches the iPhone.

title: Not as advertised
review:
They claim "noise isolating," but nowhere in literature or packaging does it mention anything about noise cancelling or isolating. Trying to sell these riding on the "noise cancelling" wave of the active cancelling headphones. It probably just means because the buds go into your ear canal (like all buds).

Seem well made (of course made in China..., WTH isn't?)

For the price, they're probably worth it, but just seems kind of slimy to use words that sound like they mean something more than just, "ear plugs."

title: Great sound and like that they're collapsible.
review: We use these in our audio bag since they collapse down nicely and have very good sound for their low price. Well worth it if you need some cheap headphones that stow away easily. Feel kind of cheaply made and like they'll break easily, but so far, no problem.

title: Great
review: Received these earbuds yesterday works great  bought for my kindle fire hd now I can read my books and watch movies in peace :)

title: Great headphones and they dont feel like burden on your ears
review: These headphones are great to wear while jogging or during gym session, These doesnt sound like a music is played in a tin foil, they are not heavy in bass which is what i prefer it has good mixture of treble, mid and bass. if you are someone who likes headphones with heavy bass these are not it. but if you like to listen to some quality music you wont be disappointed. very well worth the purchase .

title: Converts 1/4 inch to 1/8  plug perfectly
review: High quality plug!  There are few 1/8 inch headphone buds - this is the solution for me!

title: A review from a random guy on a quest for nice earphones.
review: I bought these to see what all the fuss was about. While aimlessly wandering the internet, I came across talk about KZ ATE's. I paraphrase one review that kept popping up in all the sources; I read, "these $15 earphones feel and sound like $50+ ones."
