title: Very user friendly
review: I bought this for my son who loves his cartoons,  but hates car rides.  He has special needs so some things really upset him that most people wouldn't care about.  The last DVD player we tried skipped when we hit a bump and it made a mechanical noise that drove him mad.  This one works great without any skipping and it's very quiet.  The picture quality is great and the sound is surprisingly loud if needed.  Usually you need a pair of earbuds to be able to hear other players, but this one can be heard clearly anywhere in the van.

title: Very comfortable
review: I bought this for my son to use at school.  He has special needs so he works on a computer and listens to the lesson on headphones.  The cord really got in the way so this is a much better option.  It is very easy to use and connect to his laptop.  The sound quality is great and the built in microphone is very handy as well.  The ear pieces and headband are padded for extra comfort.

title: Adorable
review: [[VIDEOID:df08d15b3580b102ad4c474125ef2a7e]] I know that this is supposed to be for kids, but I actually bought it for myself.  I was a little concerned that it would be too small, but it was just too cute to pass up.  It's so adjustable that it fits fine.  I think it would easily fit a small child as well.  The sound quality is great and I love the pastel colors.  It has an attached microphone so it's appropriate for video conferences or podcasts.  The best feature is that it can be used as a traditional set of headphones with a cord or connected via Bluetooth.  It's very easy to set up and now every time I turn it on it automatically connects to the wifi.

title: Better than the original
review: I bought this replacement cable fir my son who loves online gaming.  The poor boy is constantly losing stuff so I was thrilled to find a replacement one.  Not only did it save me from buying a new set of headphones,  it also works better than the original.  The sound quality and everything is the same, but you can adjust the volume from the cord.  It has a little wheel built right on the cord so you can raise or lower the volume easily.

title: Squeaky clean
review: [[VIDEOID:91b5cc1ed0a9c6f4680af6d066a1321d]] I bought this for my husband who uses his earbuds on a daily basis.  This is going to sound weird,  but he had a really bad infection in his ear canal that wouldn't go away.  His ENT doctor suggested that his earbuds might be holding in bacteria and told us to throw them out.  I am so glad that I tried this instead of throwing out something so expensive.  It was super easy to use.  The set includes alcohol wipes for cleaning up in addition to the cleaning pen and brush.  I wanted to give them a through cleaning without damaging anything.  This was gentle on the delicate parts, but still managed to give me a deep cleaning.  I was surprised (and grossed out) by all of the gunk that I pulled out.  Afterwards,  it was easy to clean the pen and brush for next time.  It's been a few weeks and apparently it worked because his ears are doing great now.  I plan to use it on the regular just to keep everything neat and tidy.

title: Incredibly comfortable
review: [[VIDEOID:8ad56e82588ba47ea3d1c8e6bba5980a]] I bought these for my son who is on the autism spectrum.  He has sensory issues and he really hates the feeling of headphones.  Ear buds are definitely out of the question.  I wasn't sure what to expect from these because I am not tech savvy enough to understand how they work.  Thankfully, the instructions are easy to follow and it walked me through the process of connecting it to the Bluetooth.  He absolutely loves them.  They aren't tight on his head like headphones and it doesn't irritate his ears.  It gently rests on the top of his ear arch and goes around the back of his head.  He can also hear what is going on around him so it feels less claustrophobic.  It's adjustable so it easily fit my big old head and his little one.

title: Very comfortable
review: I bought this for my son to use with his online classes.  It is a lot more comfortable for him since he has sensory issues and regular headphones were too restrictive.  The sound quality is great and the microphone portion works really well too.  It was super easy to connect and the battery life is long.

title: Great for insomniacs
review: I have a rare genetic disorder that causes severe joint damage and as a result,  I have a lot of chronic pain.  I bought these so I could watch TV at night when I am in too much pain to sleep.  They were super easy to set up and I was able to do it on my own.  The sound quality is great and it doesn't disturb my husband when he's next to me in bed.  They feel comfortable and I am glad that they hang down instead of going across my head like headphones.

title: Just as good as airpods
review: [[VIDEOID:50a509ca92ee072cbb2d2a4c48213b4d]] I love my wireless ear buds, but they are too expensive for me to share with my son.  When I saw these at such a good price,  I decided to buy him a pair.  I wasn't expecting much, but the sound quality and battery life is as good as my airpods.  I really appreciate the case.  I think it will protect them, but also keep them from getting lost.  I also like that you can charge them directly from the case.  It's very convenient that I can charge the earbuds several times before I need to recharge the case.

title: Easy to use
review: I am not very tech savvy,  but my son uses a laptop for school.  He needed this so he could plug in his different devices like his Webcam and SD card.  There are also outlets for headphones and other various devices.

title: Very comfortable
review: I bought these to use while exercising.  I have a pair of earbuds, but they irritated my ears when I wore them for longer periods of time.  These are very comfortable and so easy to use.  It was simple to set it up the first time, but now it connects to my phone automatically when I turn them on.  The sound quality is great and it cancels out the noise around me.  They hold a charge for a long time,  but they also come with a cord so you can plug it into your device if you want.

title: Perfect for little ones
review: I bought these for my daughter's daycare.  It's hard to find headphones that fit very small children,  but these are the perfect size.

title: Didn’t make it a year
review: I’m in an office setting, my earbud case was on my letting which stays in my purse or backpack for work. The top came off, will not stay on and the little latch loosened up and doesn’t snap. I use my pods maybe three times a month so no actual wear and tear. Disappointed in quality.

title: Excellent protection
review:
My husband ordered this case. I love it also. He needed something to survive the work day and regular wear. The case is nice. It certainly offers excellent protection (generally we purchase otter but wanted something a bit different). This case adds to size and weight but doesn't create bulk. Creates excellent seals.

There is no built in screen protection. Purchase a Moshi matte protector. (these are washable and reusable)

The case uses hex, or allen, screws. While this is awesome, it will not make for quick removal. This case also creates an intense seal so once you take out the screws ( we had to get a different ipad) you will have to pry it off (carefully!).

Little things that are slightly annoying is that the hinge scratches very easy, the earphone jack is hard to get just right to keep in place.

title: Perfect fit, good material, right size
review: Needed replacement for my S.ny Extra Bass earpieces but i could not find original ones, so i decided to try 3rd party ones. I must say these are fantastic silicone earbuds, fits perfectly, same size as the original (grey on my photo), i even replaced the ones on my bluetooth headset with these (red) because its that good. It is a little softer, but it has a nice matte finish to it, so its not that slippery - which is great. Highly recommended.

title: Static on connecting to Bluetooth, constant background static.
review: Static out of the right ear, out of the box. I am getting sick and tired of all the low quality bluetooth headsets these days. This is ridiculous. I have a pair of similar Arctic headphones that sound great compared to these....

title: SO Comfortable
review: I've tried out several sleep masks and this one is BY FAR the most comfortable both in material and speaker size/positioning. The eye holes are covered with a very soft fabric and the piece covering the nose is breathable while keeping the light out. The headphones are small but mighty - great for a back or side sleeper! I was a little concerned with being able to feel the charging cord, but even with it on my pillow side, I haven't noticed a thing. Pairs seamlessly with my cell phone for listening to music or even taking a phone call. Highly recommended!

title: Bohm Bluetooth Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones
review: Received the headphones on time, just what I expected, great sound, good price, I am well satisfied, Great product, I recommend product and seller.

title: These headphones blow... Pass on them.
review:
Just got these and returning them the first day. They keep disappearing from my Windows 7 devices and the Logitech software doesn't see them. Upon doing additional research I see this is a common problem with this model headset, and there is no workaround that isn't overly complex. Now I see why they went from $179 to $79. Cause they suck.

Back to searching for a good wireless headset...

title: Great product, definitely recommend
review: These are great, they cover your whole ears without putting too much pressure on them I would most definitely recommend them for that feature alone. I also love that they come with a separate cord so you make them like regular headphones to connect to an older stereo or cd player

title: Amazing product
review: I love these earbuds. They are soo awesome. I have never bought bluetooth earbuds before but these are amazing, so worth the low price

title: Comfortable
review: I had to change my iPhone earphones because they are too big for my ears. This were the perfect fit!

title: Really good sound quality
review: These little earbuds come with their charging case and a USB cable to charge. They were 30% charged when I received them so I plugged them in overnight to fully charge. The red light on the case never went off or changed so I don't know if it's supposed to when fully charged.  The sound is clear, not a lot of bass as I would prefer but at least they have a good crisp sound. The buds are also very comfortable to wear for awhile.  They did not irritate my ears at l. I have to get used to the sensitivity of the touch button on the bud, though. They are very sensitive to touch and if you're trying to adjust the fit, you'll be pausing or forwarding a song in the process, but that's just my issue. Happy with these and looking forward to using them often. They paired quickly to my android devices and the directions included were simple to follow.

title: He said he felt like they were not as clear sounding as he would ...
review: These were decent headphones my son purchased for his ipod. He likes the option of having the mic on the headphones. He said he felt like they were not as clear sounding as he would have liked, but for the price, they were good enough.

title: Best fitting apple earbuds
review: Fit is so important with noise cancelling earbuds & for me, these are the best fitting of all the Apple earbuds for my ears. I only wish they had the same audio characteristics as the apple airpod pros so I could use them as a hearing device

title: First wireless headset which stay in my ear & is comfortable!
review: I’ve tried iPods, Bose SoundSport Free & many other wireless headset - these are the FIRST TO FIT PROPERLY & stay in my ears. I wanted a headset that would work with the iphones new widget  “Live Listening”, which only works with AirPods or the Powerbeat Pro

title: Doesn't fit!
review: These earphones are very nice & look comfortable BUT they do bot fit my iPhone 7. Very disappointed. Will be sending these back unfortunately.

title: These are great!
review: These earphones are great with wonderful sound. Appears that the material used are very good quality. Really don't know about the durability yet but so far so good.

title: nice earbuds!
review: The color is beautiful. They seem to be made well. I purchased these to replace my Apple iphone earbuds, which I did not like. I had to keep adjusting them all the time. These are really good and stay in place with nice sound. So far so good!

title: Comfy headphones!
review: So far so good! Just received today and they work well! So that's great! Hope i'm not jinxing myself by saying that!lol! They are very comfortable and secure. The sound is very good also. The fabric itself is very light and it is lined with mesh. These headphones are (in my opinion) WAY over priced. Let's just hope they last for a while.

title: The future is now and here's a little gadget for robot lovers
review:
First of all, the marketers of this [[ASIN:B00JVUO0RO DE Chrome Robot Dual Headphone Splitter]] have a good sense of humor as is evidenced by the instructions on the package. Very cute.

I don't carry much on my keychain because I don't want additional weight in the car's ignition weighing it down. This robot is lightweight despite its size, therefore, I put it on a separate lanyard so I don't misplace it. When hung in a special place, I know where to find it quickly. The robot separates, revealing a mini plug with splitter eyes for using two electronic devices. I've had no problems so far and find the plugs fit smoothly, but it's really a novelty item and not my number one choice as a splitter. It's a handy little device to take on long trips with kids, so the driver can enjoy a quiet time with the kids enjoying a movie while wearing headphones, and if you keep it in the car, you're always ready. The quality is not great, it's just a cute novelty for a robot loving person.

I received the product for review.

title: Watch your hairs
review: Since the [[ASIN:B009S4FMB6 Jabra SUPREME Driver's Edition Bluetooth Headset - Retail Packaging - Black/Silver]] comes with a headband, I tend to use it with the headband.  Unfortunately, my hair is thinning because I lose some each time I remove the headset.  Regardless, this bluetooth is extremely easy to synch with my Droid and it's recognized each and every time I turn on the Bluetooth in the car.  I wear this only for driving and I don't care that passersby give me funny looks, it works great.  The earpiece is larger than most contemporary bluetooth devices, but it's cushiony and comfortable for long drives.  The microphone is sensitive and responsive.  I haven't had a complaint yet with any call.  Slipping the earphone onto the headband is a simple task, and I find that I'm wearing it 90% of the time, preferring that to the ear wire and no band.  My main criticism other than the hair pulling of this design is that it takes some getting used to to operate the touch controls as well as turn the device on and off.  When off of the band, it's an easy feat, but no so when it's attached and you can't bend the microphone down completely.  Since the battery is really long lasting, it hasn't run out of power yet in the middle of a call.  Because you have options for charging this set, you're a step ahead, and with an adjustable headband, it fits most head sizes.  It's a good set.

title: Simple to pair, easy to operate, this is a good headset
review: The compact [[ASIN:B006C248BC Motorola H19txt Universal Bluetooth Headset - Retail Packaging]] arrived in an attractive hard plastic box which I'm using for storage of some little bits which made me happier than having another package to recycle.  The headset is compact and different than my other bluetooth headsets because the boom is foldable.  The most difficult part of getting this up and running was removing the little plastic from the headset, so I'd give it tom marks for accessibility and function.  Easy to charge, this headset hasn't burned the charge any faster than my other headsets, another plus.  Pairing with a Motorola Razr was simple and required nothing other than turning on both units, yay for ease!  I'll admit that I was startled because a voice spoke to me as soon as I opened the box, but I wasn't too surprised since the light was already on in the headset.  I've had no problems with the fit in my ear or the reception, but I dpn't usually travel too far from my phone, so it hasn't been tested to the max.  The design reminds me of a Volvo, boxy, if you know what I mean.  I'm very impressed with this Motorola headset, but must admit that I prefer my Plantronic bluetooth headset which is in this price range.  I am not complaining about this one, I just really prefer the other because I like it's design better.

title: Oy
review: I'm not eager to award a product with a single star, but the [[ASIN:B007YYUUA0 BlueAnt T2-BK-USEN-US Endure Bluetooth Headset - Retail Packaging - Black]] has earned one measly star.  I've been using a [[ASIN:B00177YJFM Plantronics Discovery 925 Bluetooth Earpiece (Cerise) [Retail Packaging]]] for four years without complaint and would recommend that headset hands down over this one.  I'd definitely not recommend the BlueAnt because of it's poor design, lousy fit, flimsy construction, terrible pairing and most importantly, undesirable sound quality.  There are many other bluetooth headsets available with better characteristics at a much lower cost, so I'd investigate others and try them out if you can.

title: Average ear buds at an average price
review: For variety, the Altec Lansing UHP606 Backbeat Pro Reference Earphones are a fine change from my Ultimate Ears SuperFi 3 Studio Noise Isolating Earphones when my ears need an alternate bud phone.  If the lighterweight and more flexible cables are bent and wrapped around the back of the ear as they are with the Ultimate Ears, the length is just about equal.  These are simply the cables into the ear buds.Both have a mini plug w/ a right angle, but the Altec Lansing is about 1/2" further extended when inserted.  The cables are less rigid than the Ultimate Ears and are encased in clear plastic rather than the more usual black.  They look cute.  The sound, on the other hand is only average.  I like the zippered small case which is included and most ears likely will have a satisfactory fit from the included assortment of silicone tips.  External sounds are restricted with a nice tight fit, but the range of this audio could be improved.  The price is what I expect to pay for an average pair of ear buds which are better than many, but not the best available.

title: Solid phones...
review: These headphones lasted three years--a lifetime compared to others I've used. I'm a runner, posting over a thousand miles a year, and these hung in there nicely in the cold and the heat. I'm replacing them with a new pair today. -ME

title: Great Headphones
review: Great pair of headphones for the prices. Cheap enough to replace when broken. I have 3 of them and typically keep one in my backpack, on connected to my laptop and one just for generally use. Pretty good sounding music and feels comfortable going into your ear. just brought another pair as of today for a friend.

title: could not keep connected to computer
review: May have gotten a bad one. I could not keep this connected to computer. When it did work, the connection to headphones was unusable.  Spent hours trying to find what was causing the random static like background noise. Nothing else running on bluetooth, 6 ft from dongle, etc. Borrowed a friends dongle and that one worked without issue, so not my equipment.

title: Two Stars
review: Didn't fit on Korean Air so not compatible with all airlines that have two holes for earphones/headphones

title: Great noise cancellation
review: The noise cancellation is amazing, main reason I got these earbuds. I have the bose qc 2, and this makes a great companion for summer headphones. Thanks to this, I dont have to increase the volume to max to drown out background noise or chatter. There will be some external sounds that makes it through, but it isn't a deal breaker, since these are just earbuds.

title: No Messing with Bluetooth Headphones!
review:
You can plug your favorite headphones right into the remote on these! There is no need to mess with a quirky Bluetooth set, that doesn't sound as good as your corded Sennheiser, Audio-Technica, or alike.

I think the Roku is much easier in general to use for streaming than any other device I have tried including: Chromecast, Xbox, LG Smart Apps, Onkyo Smart Apps, Yamaha Smart Apps, Wii, or a regular media PC.

title: Not an audiophile
review: I wasn't willing to pay $100 or even $50 for a "good" pair of headphones. I've never liked to hear a heavy bass in my music and I find that most "good" headphones I've tried have too much base even when you're just listening to people speaking. I use these to listen to podcasts while I'm doing many other things. I forgot my phone in another room one time and the bluetooth never disconnected. I love these especially because they were less than $25. Since I've never had bluetooth earbuds, I have to remember to turn them off or they completely lose power. But that's the worse thing about them. Having to remember to charge them. I love that the two sides connect with a magnet so I'm less likely to lose them. ETA: I've had them for 7 months and don't take good care of them but they still work just fine. This was a good use of my money.

title: Dependable and useful
review: My child has hearing problems so I was concerned about him using headphones that would further damage his eardrums.  These are great as it limits the volume but still allows him to hear. I have used them myself to check the safety and they work great. They are comfortable to wear, easy to connect and long battery life.  We both use them all day long and the battery lasts.

title: Bueno
review:
I ADORE THESE HEADPHONES!! I’m a grown-a** woman and these headphones kill me with how cute they are!! The LED lights changing color tickles my inner child to the extreme! Honestly, the sound is crazy good, too-way better than they deserve to be (in this $ range). My boyfriend owns Skullcandy Uproar Wireless headphones, and the sound on my Dualpow Angry Bear’s kick the sh*t out of his! No staticky crap messing the music up.
Noise-cancellation: with these on, I can’t hear much of what’s goin on in the background (which is fine with me). Don’t buy these if that’s what you want in a pair of headphones. You’re not gonna get that at this price point anyway.
The battery life is GREAT, i get hours/days of use out of them with one charge! Very convenient!! Ain’t nobody got time for that!
Overall, I have nothing bad to say so far.
If I find something, I will definitely update this review, because these are just too good to be true (right now)!

title: Stopped working after only 3 weeks
review: Only three weeks after purchase, L earbud started making loud static noise and intermittently not playing any sound at all, and then stopped working completely.  Disappointed.

title: Worth every penny!
review: Probably the best set of headphones I've ever purchased! They're pretty popular around the office, and all I heard were great things so I took the plunge. The ear buds feel great, my ears aren't getting sore after extended use like with other pairs. Seamless pairing with my Iphone 5S (iOS 7.1.2). The controls work very nicely. I was a little concerned that I would be getting a counterfeit product after reading other reviews, but thankfully I did not! This is the legitimate LG product, in the retail packaging. I've been shopping around for Bluetooth headphones for awhile, and I'm glad I landed on these ones!

title: Supersonic In Ear Earbuds worked for me for little bit ...
review: Supersonic In Ear Earbuds worked for me for little bit. After 4 or 3 months or so I already saw wear and tear. These Earbuds I did not use them everyday. Plus I did take care of them. I have mixed feelings about this Earbuds.

title: Great sounding Headphones
review:
Bought these to replace a set of KRK Circumaural headphones and couldn't be more satisfied at the performance of these headphones.

UPDATE - After about 100 hours of break-in, they sound even better!

title: This wireless headset really works very very well just don't lose it
review: This is the best wireless headset I've ever used only I lost it and now Amazon is out of stock.

title: Fantastic!
review: I love this bluetooth transmitter. Its fast and easy to set up. Set the switch to one of the 2 settings  (the manual will tell you which one) plug it in, turn on your headphones to syncing mode, and you're ready to go.  I use it while it's plugged into the wall, but it also holds a charge so it doesn't need to be plugged in to a power source to use.

title: Piece of crap.
review: Headphones are beautiful in appearance and light up nicely when on, but the problem occured while playing online. Multiple times the device would cut off speech. There would be many times where we had to go through a whole set up of going into the computer and resetting the settings to make sure it was connected. It should have been as easy as plugging in, but NO we had to go to settings just to fix issues. Very annoying!! It also echoed at times. I couldn't believe this was happening with a new set of headphones that I just bought as a gift for my fiance's birthday. Very disappointed.

title: May help children with who can't handle noise
review: I am using these for a child with noise sensitivity.  He seems to like them and they seem to help.  I don't have anything to compare them to, but putting them on blocks noise well (better than my over the ear expensive headphones that are not noise cancelling) then the noise cancelling does a little more to cut down on noise.  I think they are very good for children with noise sensitivity.  Adults can use them too.  They can get sweaty especially outside.  The colors and style are very cool.

title: Look good, reasonably comfortable, sound good ... but DON'T WORK!
review:
It would seem they got everything right with these headphones except the bluetooth connectivity, making them next to useless.
The signal drops in and out constantly.

I just got these and haven't used them with my phone yet, but inside connecting them to my macbook the signal drops in and out constantly and utterly frustratingly.
My computer is maybe 5 feet away from the headphones and the instructions advertise a 30' range indoors.

Completely useless if they can't maintain a connection.

I have a two year old pair of Motorola bluetooth stereo headphones that have never had this problem in exactly the same situation.

UPDATE
They are a little better with my phone but still if you turn you head the wrong way they drop out or get static.
Don't waste your money on these like I did. I find myself using my 3 year old Motorolas (that are falling apart) all the time instead of these.

title: Cool case cover,  buy your own adhesive!
review: I ordered this case cover for my wife new galaxy earbuds plus. She loved the color but unfortunately it doesn't fit 100% and the  adhesive didn't hold at all.  I think it could be a better product with better adhesiveness . I will find an alternative solution .

title: Pretty and stylish
review: These are very pretty earbuds!  The stone sparkles a lot and the gold tone gives the whole thing an air of elegance. The sound quality is fine—nothing special but that’s really not why you would buy something like this anyway.  It’s for the look, not the sound.

title: Fits snug and secure.
review:
I prefer this set of Phitric A801 earbuds to the more expensive Anker Soundcore Liberty Air. Both look very similar. Both sound good. Both pair quickly when removed from the case. The one thing that puts this one over the Soundcore ones is that it actually fits securely and will not fall off.

I'm not talking about during extreme exercise or sports because to be honest, I'm way too out of shape to do either. I'm talking about sitting at my desk at work, perfectly still, and the Soundcore ones just slip right off and onto the floor. I have not had this issue with these Phitric ones. One reason I think is because of the weight. The Phitric earbuds feel much lighter than the Soundcore and I think that is helping the Phitric earbuds stay in place.

title: So comfortable
review: I really liked it, because it’s fits to me perfect, in box you have 2 size earbuds, you can change it. And it’s so cheap 45$. Only disadvantage is when you put to charging box , sometimes you can’t fit from 1 time.

title: Honest Review
review:
Purchased these as replacements, good points - sound is great, bass sounds great, pretty good battery life. Down side - will pop out, the voice telling you “paired” or “charge” is in a different language with no way to change it, if you have an iPhone you also won’t be able to see the battery life of the headphones or pack and there is no no ice cancellation unless you have the sound up, Overall decent quality for the price.
4/17 update been using for a bit and now they lose syncing with each other, one will say something in Korean or Tai and then stop working, have to tap it to sync back up.
New update 4/25 now one ear piece is not holding a charge and they unpair often. Product is going down hill.

title: It works as it should
review: It works as it should.  Keeps my Bluetooth earbud wire from flapping around while I am doing by cardio work out, and keeps the earbuds from falling to the ground if they get dislodged.  I stopped using it only because the earbuds I had crapped out and I got truly wireless earbuds as a replacement.

title: They work
review: They work.  I really wish they made the newer phones with the 3.5 mm jack in them so we wouldn't have to buy this crap to use headphones, but I guess the company has to make more money some way.

title: Use for smartphones
review: I am not developed in the intricacies of depth and pitch and all that other stuff so I cannot comment on the quality of the sound.  The music sounds good to me through these headphones.  I like the fact that it folds up and comes with its own carrying case, this is the reason why I purchased these.  The case is a soft pull string bag, not a hard case.  Ear buds irritate the inside of my ear so I needed these type and I like them.  It doesn't squeeze my head, they are comfortable over my ears.  There is a note on the instructions that you are supposed to use this with smartphones and that there is no guarantee they will work on digital music players, and that the mic may not work on "unsupported" devices.  I took a photo of the instructions.  I didn't try the mic myself yet, but I only got this to listen to music and watch movies on long airplane flights.

title: Great Value
review: These earbuds have great sound, they fit in my ear comfortably and don't come out unless I want them to.  Great value for the price I paid.  I have paid over twice as much for similar earbuds and these sound way better.

title: It Works
review:
The instructions were a little confusing but I managed to connect my earbuds to this device while watching TV after several attempts. The downside is that once connected and listening audio through this device, I'm not able to switch back to TV audio unless I pull out there audio jack. But at least when I need to, I can now watch TV at night without bothering my wife and other family members sleeping.

**Update**...I think that I've gotten to the point where I'm completely familiar with this device. I do use it very frequently at night to watch TV and be considerate of those sleeping. So, I'm changing upping it to give stars.

title: Work great for intense situations, but obviously you can't leave them on during charging
review:
I really only use these when I ride our zero-turn mower so I won't lose them. Thanks to COMPLY TrueGrip Pro earbud tips, I have an amazing fit that never jiggles about, so I probably don't need these earbud straps, but they make a great insurance policy.

I like the magnetic clip so they fit around my neck securely when I'm not listening to my buds.

I'm not sure about the durability. I could see them snapping if used carelessly a lot. But then they come four to a pack, so that shouldn't be a problem.

title: It is what it is, and it works fine.
review: It is what it is, and it works fine. Is large enough for me to store earbuds and the charger for my fitbit, which will be great while travelling.

title: Still Best. Radio. Ever.
review: After using it a year it's still my go-to favorite radio. Reception, durability, quality. And sounds great with or without high quality headphones.

title: Spend $50 more and get an Eton Field instead.
review:
If you're looking to buy this radio probably the radio you want is the Eton Field. Yes it's 50% more in price but more than 50% in value. The build quality is superior, it's heavier, the knobs are more substantial, the sound is better, and the reception is better.

This does have great sound, and the reception is decent, with some distortion on voice, nothing to write home about. It's lighter and the plastic is thinner than the Eton, and the knobs are cheaper.

The reception and sound quality of the Eton Field is why I'm sending this back. It sounds better on easy stations, and it gets a hard to get FM station at the very edge of the dial locally that the CCrane EP Pro can't hear at all. It's a rave station I like. Plus my usual oldies stations which can be hard to get are received better on the Eton. The Eton sound with high fidelity home stereo system Sennsheiser headphones is superb, free of interference artifacts and the Eton on battery easily powers them.

Because I already had the Eton Field I had something else to compare the C Crane EP Pro to. And there is no comparison.

title: Rockin' Bass! LOUD
review: I returned $50 Edifiers because these have much better bass and more trilling guitar highs and are just more... LOUDER! Plus I need the earloops for them to stay in my left ear.  Only caveats they seem just slightly right of center and the case isn't charging. I listen to mostly stadium rock and these fit the bill like my Sony and Mpow headphones.  For $15 they're a definite keep.

title: pass
review:
These headphones have a substandard sound, bass, and spatial field. The bass is not only recessed and somewhat muddy, it sits in the middle while the treble is in outer space at the edges and the sound is neither clear, pleasant nor coordinated. Also the earcups are just a little small and they're not as comfortable or well-made as, say, Anker. For wireless headphones these don't sound good. For Sony they're worse. For the price they're horrible.

For a fraction of the price you can get Boltune, Mpow or any number of brands that are better built, more comfortable, and sound *much* better.

I like the Mpow 059/059+ myself.

title: WAY TOO MUCH BASS!!!
review:
WAY TOO MUCH BASS!!! My less expensive Mpow 7s have plenty of bass but include the middles and high frequencies equally, sound really good and loud like Sony's. These simply don't have the hightop and even lose the middles in the bass, that's with the BassUp turned off.

On the positive side they were instantly the most comfortable headphones I ever put on, seem well constructed, and I liked the blue and beige design. Really, really comfortable; moreso than my Sony's.

But it's sound that counts. And these are going back.

title: Great sound one tenth the price!
review:
I'm a Sony fan, don't enjoy bluetooth and normally use the MDR7506 which is the only headset I can stand. In the past I had a $35 Panasonic set that sounded surprisingly good. They are no longer available on Amazon. I hate 'V'- sound oriented phones. Panasonics are similar to Sony in that the response is even across the spectrum (with the bass enhanced). No middle tones recessed or dropping off the top. Good soundstage full and present upfront, no recessed or hidden instruments and wide stereo separation. Front and loud. Perfect clarity. For me this is "the Sony sound" and my comparison standard. Panasonic reproduces this standard closer than any brand I have tried including phones that cost up to $300 (I *really* hate the 'V' profile). I usually have to wait on the Sonys for Christmas.

This headphone set comes, again, amazingly close given its price range, which is about 1/10th of the cost! They're the only ones that can hold me over till Christmas and make a great backup pair. Comfortable, truly circumaural, very lightweight and can handle the wattage output and full volume of my home theater system. At this ridiculous price they're remarkably good. And better than other midrange brands I've tried.

title: My Favorite Radio
review:
Just get it. This is my new go-to radio. Blows the 910ET away at half the price. Superior sensitivity, selectivity, stereo signal reception, and sound quality which is both bassier and LOUDER; stereo FM way louder and better sound (more bass) over quality earphones with a much stronger and stable stereo signal and spatial field. AM and SW sensitivity also superior to the DSP digital tuning 310ET.

If you're older and grew up instinctively "DXing" on your clock radio in the 1970's, this is the experience you're looking for. So much more fun than letting an ATS or ETM circuit do it for you, and again it gets more stations on both FM and SW and that's without an added antenna. This one comes with a free clip-on antenna to boot. But natively with telescopic I'm getting more SW than 910ET with SW antenna plugged in. As mentioned this doesn't cut sound during tuning inbetween frequencies. Seriously, heed this tip and turn the analogue volume on the left all the way down to bottom before turning the unit on the first time; nearly broke my eardrums.
This is my favorite radio by far, and closer to being truly portable.

title: useable
review: Amazon removed the account link to write/view past reviews and replaced it with purchase recommendations, uh-huh. I have only been able to stand two headphones in my life:  Sony studio/5xxx, and Phillips earbuds for their excellent reproduction.  I'm new to Bluetooth and knew I'd be taking a quality hit. However these are loud and bassy and the treble isn't boxed in too much like many sets and i enjoy listening to them in my chair. So i recommend them.

title: Stick with Sony
review: Comparing any headphone to Sony Studio, the sound quality-- stage, stereo separation, loudness, instrument separation, instrument tone, bass response, surround channel -- fails to measure up, or even come close. By far better than Sennheiser which makes grand pianos sound tinny, this set has undesirable elements at the far reaches of either side that don't appear on Sony. Not a fan of the 'V'.

title: Would buy again
review: I don't regret this purchase at all. I bought a Class D amplifier, and even though I only use headphones, I feel much safer with this outlet. Sturdy, metal, great!

title: Disappointing audio quality
review: Solidly built, quality-crafted, and excellent 5-star functionality. The problem is, especially for a player and brand as good as this, the sound quality is disappointing enough (without being awful) to be distracting. The cheap player that comes with an ebook subscription has superior sound, for example. I wanted to get rid of the wires, but for this reason I'll go back to the cheap player. For the price, pass. I got it on sale in a box store for $35. I'll keep it, but I'm not using it. Don't pay this price for boxy, centered bass, and non wide-spectrum stereo without a high-top. $10 around-the-ear earbud set from competing brand offers superior sound. This player does not have sound presets or tone adjustments, which is sorely needed since the default fails.

title: i found the active noise cancellation to be ineffective
review: i bought this hoping it would be a good noise cancellation set of earbuds, but it isn't. otherwise it works fine, just not worth the price.

title: I did think the sound was pretty bass-y and just as good as the XX i ...
review:
Someone said "These hurt my ears a bit as they seem to have some sharp edges."... I had the same experience.
I did think the sound was pretty bass-y and just as good as the XX i bought 2 years ago.
I was wondering if these were knockoffs...
I also bought another new model fulfilled by Amazon that had the same 'X wraparound' shape as my old XX earbuds (look at the pics if you wondering what shape on the back of the earbuds I mean), and not the square-'blocky' square shape on these earbuds.
Also the wires are nice and loose on those other models ( https://www.amazon.com/JVC-HAFX101V-Headphones/dp/B007HIR3MG ), and not as rigid as these. The wire is a bit thicker on these, which maybe gives it some rigidity (which I don't like on these).
These also have a 'L' shape at the end of the cord, and not straight like the other models (i prefer the straight).

If these are legit JVC's, I'll give it 3stars.

title: * The features are kinda cool (pressing the side of the headphone to stop/play/forward/backward playlists)
review:
I got a couple of these where Spotify offered them @ 50% off $50 sale...
I'd say Its somewhere between 2-3.5 stars.

Pluses:
* The Bluetooth works well.
* The features are kinda cool (pressing the side of the headphone to stop/play/forward/backward playlists).
* Above feature even works with Spotify on my Windows computer.
* The wire where you plug-in w/o using bluetooth is kinda cool so can use without using power.
* feature to share the bluetooth w/ a wire to a friend is cool. Me and sis watched a meteor shower and I played some tunes we could share w/o disturbing our quiet suburban neighborhood.

Minuses:
* I'm 5'3" with a small to regular-sized head, and it feels too tight and hurts ears after 30m-1hr. Almost a deal breaker.
* The headphones themselves feel tight, but also don't wrap around your ear like some headphones and dont stay on tightly. Like they are the size of your ear which I don't find very comfortable.
* The power button and USB charger port are right in the area where the headphone can rotate (and be half covered by the plastic).
Its annoying to access those buttons sometimes .
* sometimes accidentally activate the touch feature. Could be set to be less sensitive.

title: for our 2 year old grandson
review: We purchased this for our grandson to use.  He really enjoys the headphones, except sometimes he messes with the controls on the side.  Too bad there is not a way to lock them, but it is really not a problem.  Very nice product.

title: Worked great!
review: Got this for pairing up my bluetooth headphones. Installed driver, plugged it in. Found headset and works great.

title: Excellent sound quality. The cord, not so much
review: These earphones have excellent sound quality. I like them much better than my beats earphones which has too much bass. However the courd design is terrible. The cord is stiff and does not hang correctly when you are wearing them.

title: Nice pair of earbuds!
review:
The audio from these earbuds are way better than my other head set.
They are not noise cancelling which I need the most and my ears are small so these dont fit that well. Overall theyre great for the price. If you're looking for great audio these are it.

title: Earbuds stay in place!
review:
Tried these earbuds tonight. I listened to my oldies for over an hour and the clarity is fabulous!
I have had issues with other brands with them falling out of my ear. These fit perfect and did not fall out once. I'm happy with my purchase.

title: Runs a bit big
review: I bought these headphones for my three year old. They run big which can be a pain asjusting it all the time. The volume is pretty low which is great but not so much when on a plane.

title: Un-natural sounding
review: Bought these based on reviews. Apparently people don’t know good quality sound when they hear it. They sound very colored and artificial. For comparison, they don’t sound as good as the cheap earbuds that came with older iPhones/iPods. They are comfortable and look nice though.

title: Looks nice but unfortunately, it is hard for other party to hear me
review: The above title says it all. It looks great, but it becomes useless when I can't use it as an earbud. When you are hearing music or you can listen to other party talk clearly but they can't hear you clearly. Returned.

review: WOW great little MP3 player.  the sound is really good ..you should purchase  GOOD EARBUDS OR HEADPHONES with any of these types of products . But the sound and volume are really good I tried to turn it all the way up and ended up turning it down halfway ..,my advice :  place your music in self created folders otherwise it will play 10 sec samples of your music.  the size fits into the palm of your hand ..all metal casing..easy to use and understand without instructions pretty much. review:
My spouse tends to fall asleep with headphones in, so they break often & has used up all my spares. Needed to get an inexpensive bunch that still sounded good to keep in, so that we have a handy supply. These fit the bill, they sound much better than I expected, and the price was good.

*updated 11/2022 - I keep ordering these as spouse loves them but destroys them constantly. I like to keep a good supply in stock for him.

title: Good value.
review: Good headphones for what I need them for, which is the gym. Reasonably priced too.

title: Works perfectly
review: I have a samsung tv, with 1 optical connection, but wanted to hook up a sound bar & some headphones at the same time that both use optical connections.  This worked perfectly & now both things work without issue. I'm glad I ordered it.

title: Nice headphones for the money
review: I read many reviews on wireless headphones as wanted to replace a really cheap pair that had fallen apart, but didn't want to spend a fortune.  The sound is very good, and the range also, so can go to the kitchen & still hear perfectly. Got this particular set up as don't have a lot of shelf space to put it, & some would be just too tall. The only reason I deducted a star is that the inside ear pieces are totally flat, so doesn't seal off the ear fully so to speak, & sometimes I can hear what is being listened to if you are next to the person wearing them, where the ones with the padding & hole in the middle didn't do that.  Hubby wears glasses, so as another reviewer wrote, I see where it could be a little uncomfortable after a while with it pushing on the rims, though he has not complained at all on that.  Hubby loves them, & I only deducted a star for 1 little reason, which is not a huge deal & overall.

title: Not that great
review: Figured for the price would be worth a try since the others I wanted were out of stock. Great shipping & delivery, but the product itself is not very good for sound quality, no base at all.  I've had cheap headphones before that sounded much better.  Choice of earbuds was a nice touch though, but moot since won't be using them.

title: For the Money It Can't be Beat
review: I've previously paid a lot more for headphones that were no better than these.  I use them on my computer and my MP3 player while in my home only because I hate when sound leaks from my headphones in public and people can hear what I'm listening to, however, for around the house these headphones are great.

title: Good Sound quality
review: These earbuds were well made.  The sound was clear and of good quality.  They had a nice magnetic charging case and charged well.  I would like a volume control on the ear piece, but they were worth the money.

I wear glasses, and some headphones don't work well over the frames. This set fits comfortably.  I use them every day, mostly to listen to the radio and they are holding up well.  And, my family doesn't have to listen to my choice in music and news...........

title: Great sound.
review: Other reviewers have noted the lack of bass, which I also noticed, but it seems the clarity and fidelity of the other wavelengths are so delightful, I have completely enjoyed these earphones.

title: Beautiful sights, empty barrel sounds
review: Good camera, but use a different mike. I've been using the one on my headphones and it works out  very well.

title: Amazing quality for price
review: .. until I dropped them once and the left earbud stopped working. But for the price you can buy two more of these and still pay less than for the AirPod pros (which I have). These are great, but AirPod pros have better nosie cancelation and fit in the ear for me. However, these have a Bluetooth range 10 times better of AirPod pros (at least on Android phones).

title: Broke after few months, replacement broke again after a few months..
review:
My first pair, one of the earbuds the sound got really low, nothing worked to fix it. Returned for replacement.
Second pair, after a couple of months the same thing happened, but now they are out of warranty and I cannot replace them. I did not pay $200 for 1.5 years of use, this is BS. never again, will buy Airpods as much as I dislike Apple.. Reading online it looks like this is very common.

Edit: Added one star back, just tried using them again after 4 months and they are working again! Also, I deleted the app and reinstalled it, including the earbuds plugin. Make sure to delete the app completely by going through all the apps installed. Wait about two weeks and reinstall the app. This is what I did, might work for you. Also make sure to drain the earbuds completely, plug them in to charge and while they charge connect them through the freshly installed galaxy app.

title: It was a joy.... TO TAKE THEM OUT
review:
I can't believe I fell for buying these expensive as hell headphones, all of the positive reviewers must not have ever made a trip to Walmart to buy headphones with rubber fittings for like $15. These headphones suck for the following reasons:

*Fit - what they do is force themselves against the upper portion of the ear which after a few minutes becomes extremely painful. The cord is longer on one side on purpose, BY A LOT so you have that wire hanging in your mouth/face the whole time due to the cord been coiled. I prefer to have cord hanging straight down and out of my face.

*Sound - no base like you would get from headphones that fit into your ear, I did not realize how much it sounds better when the headphones go inside your ear instead of been outside.

*Cost - you are paying only for the looks and packaging.

Positives:

I will keep the clipper that came with them, it is a very nice clipper and I will use it on my $10 set of headphones I been using at the gym. Too bad this clipper cost me $50.

Lessons learned: never buy anything for 2x than what it should cost.

title: Left Speaker Quits
review:
I really love these sleep-phones. But here's the problem. After about 2 months usage, the left speaker stopped working. It's still functional if you don't mind one sided listening. I've ordered the replacement wires and speakers (a few dollars less than purchasing the entire headphone). From what I can see in the pictures, the replacement set has a different plug device. I hope the company redesigned it and this one will last longer. From other reviews, I see that I am not the first one experiencing this problem. Nice product, AcousticSleep. Charging over $30.00 for it just isn't fair unless it comes with some kind of warranty. What would it take to make it so that it lasts a couple of years?

Update: The same thing happened again. The problem is located, not with the small speakers inside the headband, but at the place where the cable plugs into the machine. It happened within 6 months of purchase. I've given up on this item. I can't afford to buy the product every 6 months (I've purchased 3 thus far). Don't purchase these if you expect them to last longer than 5 or 6 months.

review: I bought one of these from another company for around $25.00.I was hesitant at first because it's a lot of money for a radio that you can only use with a headphone or ear buds but i took a gamble knowing it's a brand name and i figured that if i don't like it, i can always return it.Damn...this radio sounded great & i didn't know at first but it has a stereo sound and not like one of those radios that sounded tinny w/ a lot of echos (G.E.Radios are notorious for this!) title: A Nice pair of ear buds for a great price!
review: I ordered a pair of these from amazon when my old headphones crapped out on me.it's a great product considering it's made by Sony and no regrets here.The balance between the trebles and bass are good.It's a great deal for the price and i'll order again soon...

title: Great buy
review: These wireless headphones are great! I was afraid they were going to fall out of my ear but they haven't! I've been on mile long walks and runs and they've never fallen out or lost connection. Just for the sound quality, it's well worth the price. Thr charging case is magnetic and quickly charges the headsets. I would definitely buy these again!

title: Wow
review: These premium aftershock headphones are worth the difference. Charge port is 1000x times better than the base models, these where a gift to my wife. I will be switching to these as well.

title: They Work! Great Deal!
review: Best ten dollars I've ever spent in electronics. I always hate when I get that new pair of earbuds+mic and within a day I can tell that the connection is shoddy and the wiring won't last. These headphones are not only not those headphones, they're downright good. And at ten dollars, I ordered two more pairs within a week of receiving the first. It's been a month now, and I have no complaints yet. I use them for many hours each day and for all of my phone calls.

title: They work.
review: Light headphones that do the job without uncomfortably pressing on my ears. They do the job.

review: The description on this headset is inaccurate, it states that it comes with in-line volume control, but it does not have any volume control at all. (Attaching screenshot of description at time of purchase in the event the description is changed to accurately reflect available features). The sound quality is good, the over-ear speakers are comfortable, and the mic works well but it is little on the soft side in terms of volume.

title: I believe in the reviews!
review: A sound snob I take my headphones very seriously since I use the every day and these are beyond my expectations. Every thing the other reviewers have said these are is exactly what they are! Buy! You'll be happy you did.

review: The earbuds are very large, if you have small ears. The other issue is that the callers I spoke to reported a lot of background noise, even with the noise cancellation turned on.
