review: I loved these headphones, but it’s less than one year and the right phone has died! If a company plans to make a good product, shouldn’t they care enough to make it last? It’s a rhetorical question. Of course they should! Shame on you Panasonic.

title: Love These Headphones!
review: Just received my cozyphones and wish I had found them years ago. Light and comfortable is what I had been looking for and bought several pairs of over the ear phones, which worked ok, but the plastic cord always tangled up. These cozyphones have a nice, soft fabric covered cord. I just love that kind of attention to detail. I listen to old time radio programs to fall asleep and some ocean waves, or brown noise on my iPod and iPad. These headphones work great for both. Thank you cozyphones for a super product. I’ll be buying a few more as spares and gifts. Highly recommend this product since I live in a very warm climate and these are not hot at all. Can’t wait to sleep tonight with my new cozyphones.

title: One of the best bass headphones that i have they will be perfect ...
review: One of the best bass headphones that i have they will be perfect if they had a ditachable cable

title: Nice earbuds with QI charging
review:
These are very well packed and overall nicely designed. I like that they went with a type C cable to charge them. Other earbuds I have used have gone with micro USB and that is definitely getting annoying to keep an extra cable on me. I really like the ability to charge these with the QI charger I have. That makes it convenient to charge at not android users houses. The sound quality is nice and honestly they are extremely easy to pair.

Using them as a pair or as just one is easy. After pairing with your phone you can simply put the one you aren't using in the case. When you want to switch back to two you take is out and you will hear powering on and the sound will sync. The one downside I have found with earbuds in this price range is they don't offer the ability to sense when it's removed from your ear. This means when you want the earbud to turn off you'll need to put it in the case. The manual does a good job of explaining what tapping the side will do and you can also power them on and off holding down the side of it.

Overall:
These are great set of earbuds and are being used as my daily pair at the moment. I will update this review if I have any issues.

title: Cheap but useable
review:
So the product, like all in this price range, is made in china. The sound quality is okay for a 5 dollar set of earbuds, but definitely not a great everyday pair. It's more useful as a spare. The quick pair you can throw it in your pocket pair where you don't have to worry about it breaking. Don't expect the depth and detail you would get from a pricier set. Not much to say about them though, but if you need a really cheap set then get these.
DEFINITLY NOT AUDIOPHILE GRADE!! No one expects them to be obviously. If these break in a reasonable time, I will update my review.

title: Hitting above its weight class
review:
Better than I expected for the price.
Fits well. The fins make the difference
Comfortable. Plenty of earphones and tips
Good battery life
Easy to pair
Sound is pretty good. Not too much bass
Microphone work better than expected

Caveats
Takes a long time to connect to phone
Touch controls can be finicky
Case looks nice but is quite large
Does not access Google Assistant for me on Pixel 2. Might work for you though
No ambient sound mode

Easily comparable to the pair of Galaxy Buds that I had prior for a third of the cost. Excellent value

title: Good sound. Otherwise awkward.
review: A mediocre MP3 unit. Not that intuitive to use or to load music on to it. Sound is better than expected for a unit in this price range, particularly when paired with good headphones.

title: The best!
review: GUMY headphones are ounce for ounce the best set of headphones around.  They are comfortable, portable, and sound great. I have had sizing issues with in-the-ear headphones and do not like the bulkiness of over the ear styles. These do the job perfectly and stay in place. Just remember that each earpiece is specifically designed for the right or left ear.

title: Basic and comfortable
review:
This is a very basic headset, I am using it as my backup for my fancier (more expensive headset) and so far, I think it works well.

The sound is good enough for conference calls, a bit tinny sounding with music.

It does a pretty good job with noise cancellation and it folds up small enough to fit into my overpacked carry-on bag.

title: Wow, I just blasted myself with sound!
review:
I didn't realize how bad my old set of earbuds had gotten until I tried listening to an audiobook with this new pair and just about had a heart attack. So loud! So clear! Like a foghorn in my head!

Anyways, once I adjusted the sound down, they are perfection. I am listening to a book with a new (to me) narrator and her accent (very British) was difficult to decipher before. Probably because there was a tiny bit of background static with my old earbuds, but now I can hear and understand everything.

Some other things I like;

Sturdiness, the cords seem a little thicker and they seem less likely to tangle the way my old set was wont to do.

Magnets on the backs of the earbuds. These are super cool and I really like that they keep the earbuds from tangling and they are easier to find by touch when I am using them at night in bed with the lights out.

A pause button that is clearly delineated from the sound buttons. This is just all around a tiny bit bigger than my old set and it is super useful and easier to pause and restart.

Great set of earbuds, if I can keep my cat from chewing on the cord, I could easily end up using these for a long time.

title: Great length charging cable.
review:
This USB charging cable worked well to charge my phone, headphone and my external battery. I was thinking 3.3 feet might be too long and sort of annoying to deal with, but I tuck the excess length into the top drawer of my nightstand so that my cat wont eat it (she LOVES charging cables).

Note: there is no data connection.

The cable arrived in a special box, that is a little bit gift-y, if you were thinking of gifting this eminently practical item.

It is quality construction and is a little thicker and stiffer than other charging cables, if that matters to you.

Nice cable.

title: These are really nice
review:
I've had a lot of pairs of earbuds over the years, I prefer them to headphones.

This pair is really nice. The cord seems less inclined to tange and the size of the rubber bug thingamajigs is just right for me.

My last pair of earbuds went through the washing machine, I forgot them in the pocket of my apron. They came out working, well, one side did the other was silent and I ended up wearing them for a few more weeks. So having sound on both sides of my head was wonderful and I'm trying to be objective but Lizzo sounds much better if you can hear her from both ears!

Anyways, these earbuds work, they wind up well and don't seem to tangle as easily as my old pair.

title: Great upgrade for your life
review:
With the number of things these headphones can do, it almost seems like you could ask them to make you a sandwich and the response would be, 'do you want tomatoes, yes or no?'

They do not pinch my head nor do they slide off if I happen to be walking around while wearing them.  They aren't as hot and thus sweaty as my old wireless set.  

The noise cancellation is almost too good.  I didn't hear the bus arriving or a car honking at me when I was waiting to cross the street.  Even with the sound turned down low I could still hear it while standing next to a busy street.
It worked using the alexa voice commands and making a phone call was easy and worked just fine and the sound was good.  Even without a boom it had a good mic and people understood everything I said without distortion.
The only thing I didn't like is that they cup the ear and press on underside of my ear at the eustachean tube (not a doctor) and it was a bit irritating after a while.  

I wish they were a different color, brown is just the ugliest color and I don't know why everything this year is some vile shade of mud.

title: Nice
review:
Where have you been all my life?

I simply love these tiny headphones. I was worried that the strap going around the neck would get sweaty or just feel super weird. But I hardly noticed it after a few minutes.

title: Highly useful
review:
I am using this for the bluetooth headset with my Windows 10 Computer.

It gave me better reception than what I had with my old dongle. It works exactly as I thought it would, the driver was built into windows 10.

I was able to walk to another room in my house (same floor) and still had clear sound. I am using this for a work IP phone and so far it has been perfect.

I got out of range when I went outside to check the mail. Then I had to turn the headset off then on again to get it to re-pair.

I would buy this again and would recommend it for anyone.

title: Good quality sound without distortion
review:
These headphones are even better than I'd hoped. I tried them out for music, which is really the deciding factor when it comes to headphones, I allow a lot of leeway when it comes to sound for movies, audiobooks and tv shows.

But these were super nice. They are comfortable too. The cord is thick and is the right length to go from head to pocket with extra wiggle room and the sound adjuster is on the cord, tres convenient.

It was hard to see in the picture, but they are not totally white. there is a thin line of lime green that is on the out part, the color is bright enough that it almost seems to glow, like a LED light from the sides of the headphones, it looks pretty cool actually.

title: Good enough for VOIP phones
review:
The positives about these headphones outnumber the negatives.

In no particular order;

1. Easy set up. Like all bluetooth devices, these headphones were a quick set up by simply turning them on and my mac responded with 'Do You Want To Use This Device?' The total set up time, approximately sixty seconds!

2.Excellent for VOIP gmail phone.

3. You can charge the headset, while you are using it. So on marathon conference call days, I can plug them in, while using them for about twenty minutes and then they are charged enough to last through a long, boring, three hour conference call (more's the pity!).

4. They charge off the USB port and they come with a cable for doing this.

5. They are lightweight and comfortable to wear, so no headaches!

6. Adjustable volume which is perfect for the hard of hearing.

The negatives, in no particular order;

1. The sound quality is not so great. It is too grainy for music, there is a static sound in the background of everything you are listening to, not a big deal if you are using them for phone conversations, but a definite loser if you are trying to listen to music.

2. It gets more static background noise as the batteries wind down.

title: Best and most durable splitter I've bought
review:
This is the fifth headphone splitter I've bought. The others all suffered from the same, unusable defect, they were crapola and broke. Worse the sound quality was crackly and very 1985 (remember listening to tapes with a walkman, yeah, that's the sound quality I'm talking about).

I hook my cordless headphones in and then traipse around the house washing up, folding laundry, making beds (sometimes I do this) secure in the knowledge that the cord pluggy thing will not come undone from the techno starfish I've plugged it into. It has more ports (I think that's what they are called) than we really need, but it is still the most functional splitter.

I love this, I can listen to a book on tape while my hubby watches a movie and my kiddo listens to music, all of us lost to the world for a little while.

When this one wears out I'd order another lickity split!

title: Lightweight.  Usual Logitech quality.
review: USB connection to computer.  Very clear sound.  You can hear someone in your vicinity call you, which is what I want.  I use it at home, and it's very good for that purpose.  If you want total silence, you don't want this headset.  Long cord is a big plus.  I have been a Logitech fan ever since I had a warranty claim on a large purchase.  It was handled promptly and correctly.  The replacement was ordered while I was still on the phone.

title: Comfortable.  Works on computer and at gym.  Good enough sound quality.
review: Good sound quality.  Plugs into my Apple IMAC and immediately silences the computer, without going into systems preferences, as a USB headphone requires.  Also works at my gym.  Comfortable, and a long enough line.  5 stars to me.

title: Extends My Headphone Cord Four More Feet!
review:
My stereo boombox sits on a table heater on the other side of the room so I needed something to extend the headphone cord. Now if I put the boombox on the floor a little further out and use this extension cable I can sit in bed and enjoy music again. The cord works well and seems very durable.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Best Sound Quality!
review:
This Boombox has the best sound quality I've ever heard in any small stereo I've ever owned. Everything sounds wonderful and I was especially impressed by how beautiful Christmas music sounds. The instruction pamphlet is very detailed, however I found the buttons very intuitive to use.

To be honest, this Boombox has everything you could wish for besides a remote. That is the only thing I miss about my old CD player. But that CD player only lasted less than a year. I'm hoping this one will last a lot longer.

Some of the features this has include:

Cassette Recording and Playing
Two great speakers for stereo sound
Sleep timer (15, 30, 60 or 90 minutes)
3 Favorite Radio Station Buttons
Audio in for connecting Smartphones, Digital Music Player and other audio devices
Battery Powered (6 C batteries) or AC
Mega Bass button (Press this button and you will have rich sound)
Logical placement of on/off button and volume controls
Ability to listen quietly with headphones

I'm enjoying this Boombox and can recommend it highly for the excellent sound quality. CDs play quietly and listening to favorite music is a true comfort.

~The Rebecca Review

P.S. I just ordered a third one. They last exactly a year from purchase every time. It is the CD player that goes after a year of use. I can't find anything better than this so that is how it goes.

title: Works Great for a Speaker and Cordless Headset
review:
With this splitter I can keep my cordless headphones and mini speaker plugged in at the same time. This saves me a lot of time and hassles. I'm using this with a six foot extension cable and it works great. I'm so happy amazon makes it so easy to get what you need for musical perfection. I'm enjoying to listening to music with a mini speaker half the time and headphones the rest of the time.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Crystalline Sound
review:
I was very conflicted before buying these headphones as I read the negatives and questioned whether these were as good as the last Sennheiser headphones that just broke. I will say that these perform differently when not charged fully. It is best not to use them before you've left them overnight on the charger. Then you will have less problems with static. You may hear static when you first put them on but as soon as the music or youtube video has started the sound is crystalline. I'm currently listening to some of my favorite music and it could not sound better. So I'm glad I took the chance even when I expected there to be issues. Sennheiser is really as good as AKGs once tuned in. You can also walk around the house with these on and take your music with you. Just charge them before using for the best results.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Dreamy Bliss
review:
I'm a fan of the GR07s but these GR01s impressed me with their pristine clarity. There are also 15 eartips so I was able to get a perfect fit. Although these go a little deeper into the ear canal. If you don't get the right fit they tend to fall out of your ears so you might have to try a few eartips to get the right ones. Then they stay in place quite nicely. What I noticed about these earbuds is that vocals shimmer and the bass is smooth and silky instead of jarring. Dancy pop is bright and sparkly. I especially like listening to Owl City with these earphones. Electronica really sounds incredible. I hear more details than when wearing Sennheiser or AKG headphones and that is really saying something. So is spending a little more for the GR01s worth it? Yes definitely. Go for it and you will be happy you did.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Great lightweight headphones for iPads, iPods and Portable CD Players
review:
I have Sennheiser cordless headphones so I was aware of the high quality of Sennheiser products. I was looking for a pair of headphones that I could use while walking outside and these are perfect. They do cancel out a lot of noise giving you a more intimate listening experience. The first time I wore these my husband scared the heck out of me. He had to tap on my shoulder to get my attention because I was so involved in listening to a CD I made. So you really can get a bit lost in the bliss of music.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Perfect Solution
review:
The Sony extension cord for headphones works especially well and makes my husband happy when I'm watching movies late at night. This works with my computer, DVD player and stereo. This cord also works with the AKG headphones and the K240 version makes everything sound amazing. The cord is lightweight and the nine feet extension makes it much easier to enjoy music a little further from the source. Now I can sit on the other side of the room and watch a movie on my computer or enjoy late night movies without disturbing my husband.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Dreamy Music Bliss - K240
review:
Clear crisp notes dipped in acoustic perfection. Listening to music on the AKG Acoustics Semi-Open Headphones is like falling in love for the first time. You may start to feel breathless as notes wash across soundscapes unveiled in moments of sheer amazement.

What beauty these headphones reveal. Every note is placed perfectly in a musical clarity revealing a perfect harmony and depth as sound swells and breaks and takes off in all directions like universes of sound.

This is not an exaggeration, but rather an admission of fact. Let's just say that if a friend gave you these, you would love them forever.

If headphones can make you feel weak in the knees...THESE WILL. The AKG headphones are also surprisingly comfortable and lightweight.

My personal favorite - K240 - Studio quality sound - Advanced Varimotion transducers -superior sound detail and especially high sensitivity

K271 - Studio quality with ambient noise isolation

K301 - Powerful bass and specially tuned drivers - circumaural ear cups

~The Rebecca Review

In some sort of dreamy music land from which I don't want to return...

title: For Jogging and Walking
review:
For the price, this portable CD Player has excellent sound quality and extra features to make it perfect for outdoor sports or light jogging and walking. The Anti-shock protection feature really works and the backband headphones are comfortable to wear and seem to stay in place fairly well.

The CD player has a grip band accessory that also works for attaching this CD player to any belt loop. I like the compact design and the simplicity of the features. You can buy an AC adaptor for home use.

The real beauty of this CD player is that you can use the program play feature to play up to 32 tracks in any order you wish. This is a good feature if you want to listen to just a few tracks on any specific CD. The program deletes itself when you turn off the unit. You can also use the random play feature.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Staticky and uncomfortable
review: I’m returning these. The left earbud doesn’t work and the right one is staticky. And they’re uncomfortable.

title: Does not work for phone calls.
review:
When connected. No audio from headphones calls directed to speaker.

Returned.

title: Noise level is sucks!
review: when I got them and started to listen music, people surrounded could hear that music!!! It’s nice design, super cool betas, but when I listen my music or lectures in headphones, no one else should! I myself hate when I can hear what’s playing in once’s playlist and they have headphones on, it’s absolutely inappropriate

title: Loses Bluetooth Connection
review: These connect okay, and sound is fine, depends on your device as usual. Feels comfortable in the ear, I have small ears, but I wouldn't work out with these, they don't feel snug enough. I connect to any Bluetooth device just fine, but it has a very small amount of distance. If I walk into another room to get something it starts cracking up. No problems with other headphones, just these. Fine for sitting at your desk, but there are better ones out there for the same price.

title: Great value and comfortable
review: Extremely comfortable headphones.  Can wear for long periods.  Use them as headphones for guitar practice.

title: Great cable, better price.
review: These cables offer me great sound quality when connecting my headphones to my computer for long hours of music creation and production. I can't complain.

title: Comfortable and Worthwhile
review: So far so good, two months into daily use. It's worth mentioning they're more comfortable than my previous earbuds.

title: Too small, too tight, poor sound quality.
review: Too small, too tight, poor sound quality and all around not great.  I wanted to send them back, but the company wanted to charge me half what I paid for them for return shipping. Might as well keep them at that point.  Bummed I wasted money on these. Can’t even wear them since they give me a headache pressing too tight on my ears and head.  Two thumbs down. Do not reccomend. Only gave them 2 stars because for cheap headphones, the noise canceling is fairly decent. Suppose that’s a plus if you don’t mind the feeling that your head is in a vice when you’re wearing them.

title: Like not love
review: I like how the headphone padding feels. Coming from a pair of earbuds these do the trick. I feel that I could have saved my money and gotten some nice Bose Noise canceling headphones, but I liked the color and figured I'd stick with these. Happy with the purchase, but not overly in love with them or impressed with them.

title: Works great!
review: This one works great with my wired earphones. The sound quality is better than the one I used before.

title: Fit the Plantronics Audio 995
review: I bought these to replace the earpads of my old Plantronics Audio 995 earphones.  They are not a perfect fit but worked fine to replace my old crumbling pads.

title: Reduces certain noise, Sound quality not the best
review:
I bought this for my office space at work. There is always noise around and I thought these headphones would be a nice solution.

On noise reduction:
The headphones effectively reduced the humming of the overhead HVAC, however they did not reduce the people talking or phone ringing from offices around me. On my experience, a great part of the noise reduction came from the closed ear-cups.

On sound quality:
I compared the sound quality to my current headset (Sony MDR-V6) and I was disappointed of the Sennheiser. The Sony are way better regarding sound quality and for a fraction of the cost.

I had great expectations for these headphones but they did not work for my purposes. I am sure these would be a great for airplane travel but not for workplace noise.

title: Great
review: Great sounding headphones! I'm a professional musician so I know what I'm talking about. :) The only sad thing was after years of using these, the rubber material started to fall apart. So I'm here to buy a second set!

title: Good bang for the buck. Great investment.
review: I've used these a few weeks now so can't tell you about the longevity (yet). I'm giving them five stars as they're delivering really well for me. The volume control is awesome. The fact they magnetically snap together behind my head when I have to take them out makes them convenient and not tangled up when reinserting. The cord is very long (in case you're tall, which I'm not). They aren't noise blocking but I guess most sports wouldn't entirely want that. The ear pieces take a bit to realize how to do the insert & twist into place (directions clearly come with it). Comfortable. Nice pouche for storage. Performance great, quality great, consistency great and exceptional value (since I've spent more & gotten less. I'd say this is the whole package. Also, I'm a "heavy user".  I'm 5'2" with normal female ears. I'm a size 4. This is important to note because I was sent the wrong size (it took three times in the mail). They had customer service issues and kept send GINORMOUS earbuds instead of the smallest. This problem, I understand has been remedied now . Be careful when attaching your earbuds to be certain they are all the way on correctly . They will not fall out of your ears and once properly fitted they are a joy.

title: Not for card readers
review: It may be a fine extension for earphones, but for a credit card reader it simply does not work.  Another reviewer said it worked fine with his Square reader, but I had a different experience.  Take your chance.

title: Great for the price, waterproof
review:
They sound great, and I am moderately picky. These have a nice balanced, sharp, clear and adequately bassy sound.

The other day, I accidentally left one in my pants pocket. It went THROUGH THE WASH..... AND SURVIVED. Still sounds great. Recommend as a good, midgrade earbud.

title: Best headset for the money!!!!  Buy it you will be very happy.
review: This is the best headset for the money.  I bought it for my husband for his birthday.  He loved them so much I bought a pair for myself.  The quality of the sound is excellent.

title: Difficult to set up but has good sound
review: It's not plug in and use with Windows.  You have to go online and download a specific file to use it. It's hot to the touch and awkward for your laptop. The sound quality is very nice and clear with headphones but with this plugged in the sound on your computer will not work without them.

title: Possible fake!
review: Felt like cheap plastic. Came with no original box just a plastic bag, I don’t know if maybe just Logitech sold it in bulk to the seller this way as it was easier for shipping and all for them. However, made me somewhat suspicious it could be a fake as it felt very cheap and other reviewers mentioned the same thing. I tried using the mute button on a face time call with my computer and after I clicked it the audio was lost completely, I tried messing with the audio settings on my computer and not even that would fix it. No other headphones I have ever used have done this and I have used headsets to work on a computer for 10 years. The sides of the headphones just said logi on them. I returned this!

title: No more painful earbuds!
review: I love these!  I don’t have to wear painful earbuds anymore!  Plus you can hear outside sounds. Buy them!  You will love them. They look really nice too. They are also polarized.

title: So disappointed!!
review:
So disappointed!!!

I wanted to have a new headset without spending $150 at phone store.

When listening to another talk - they sound like a robot.

title: Best headphones
review: My husband's favorite pair of headphones ever. Comfortable. Sturdy. Loud. Long lasting. Great buy.

title: In love
review: So, these are different then normal headphones. But I have issues with my ears... I can wear headphones or earbuds for more then 5 minutes without getting a migraine. Umbyea these solved the problem! I am so happy I decided to try a new trend lol. Construction seems ok.

title: Charging issues
review:
Great sound quality and just a great set of headphones....until they started to have issues charge about 4 months in. What started as just the left headphone has now turned into both headphones never charging correctly, even if placed correctly in the case. After a year I can now see spots of corrosion on the charging prongs.

Overpriced for the short life span these will give you. Buy some Raycons instead.

title: Rubber came loose after 2 uses!!
review:
Wore it once for a short time, 1 - 2 hours, then wore it on a flight for 5 hours and the rubber on the earbud came loose! This was only the second time I used it! It is now too uncomfortable to wear.

Very disappointed because the other JBL products I own have been fabulous. One of the main reasons I purchased this product because it was JBL.

title: I would give five stars but......
review:
....... But these earbuds are hurting my ears! That's why I switched to using the large earbuds covers provided, as I was able to stretch the large ones pulling them down and over the metal part, which means these aren't fitting my ears correctly. So I'm just gonna look for different more comfy types of earbuds covers. Ouch, they're still hurting...

Pros: The bass is NOT too loud, it's fine. I recommend using an EQ app or what's already in your iPhone or Android to fine tune your musical tastes.
Long battery life, but it does NOT last for 18 hours! It does last for 12 hours, though, as I'm very hard on my earbuds.
Fairly quick charge, about an hour.
Leather neckband poses no issues of discomfort, I sleep with these all the time. I'm actually quite used to this odd design now.

Cons:
Bluetooth just goes out once in a blue moon. Not too much of a hassle though.
OUCH!! MY EARS HURT!! I'm either getting some nice comfy earbuds or getting liquid silicone, go watch a video as to how to apply over my current earbuds. If the silicone is applied right, it'll solve my issues.

title: It's a decent pair of earbuds for the price
review: Decent pair for the price, no complaints.  Six bucks, not bad!  Although these aren't as loud as my old skullcandies, I'll need to spend more money for that.  Great earbuds in a pinch, recommended to buy.

title: Great sound...when they work
review:
I have had these since October. The sound quality is GREAT! Cancels noise around me when they are in my ears. Battery is OK but not even close to what they say. Maybe 4 hours with the charge in between. Mine decided to rename themselves and then sometimes decide not to connect. Kind embarrassing when I start the music and it's blaring from my phone and everyone around can hear but I can't and realize they didn't connect again.

Update have had these over a year and seriously the best headphones ever. After upgrades and set up again on my iPhone I have not had any troubles with sound or connection. Battery lasts a long time and headphones never disconnect.

title: My Favorite
review: I love these headphones. They adjust to fit easily, great sound quality and comfortable on my ears. Very cushiony.

title: tony
review: hard to program and it only works with wired headphones and the blue tooth don't work

title: Do what you want them for
review: Overall they’re good headphones, easy to set up and just work.  There comfortable but big and after a while they do start bothering your ears.  The sound is good and controlling volume is conveniently located on one side of the earphones.  The headphones have to be placed back in the charging stand a certain way to charge.  After you figure out the best way it’s easy.  They did interfere with the Apple TV and it’s WiFi connection.  Once I figured it out just moved the devices farther apart and problem solved.

title: Good value for the quality
review: I bought these for my daughter. She is allowed to listen to music and podcasts at school, and these are stylish and unobtrusive. She has been enjoying them, and we will be ordering another pair for my other daughter. Seems like a good basic daily-use set of earphones. I cannot speak to the audio quality, as I have not tested them myself. But they are still working after being toted around by a 6th grader, so that's something.

title: Wouldn't recommend
review: Eh used these for a while, first one headphone went out and then the second headline became super staticky. Not really worth the buy because it'll only work for a short period of time, a least the pair I bought.

title: Love This Case
review: Absolutely fits the, Mpow 059  Bluetooth Headphones. .  Perfect in everyway.  Highly recommend .

title: Be cautious if you're buying this used.
review: I bought these headphones "Like New", and for 50$, these sound great, but whenever they are adjusted or moved slightly, the right ear cup creaks loudly, which made them almost unusable for me..  Buy these used at your own caution.

title: great product
review: this was a Christmas gift for my son and he loves it . It helps him keep his earbuds safe .

title: Poor Sound but Cheap
review:
I got these as a cheap replacement for the earbuds that came with my iPod and am quite disappointed. The sound quality is horrible, it's very fuzzy, not crisp and clear as it was with the iPod headphones.

The buds themselves are larger than on the iPod headphones. They have a rubber edge which makes them somewhat comfortable while wearing. Because they're so large, though, they often fall out because they don't fit right.

The cord is noticeably shorter than on the iPod headphones, I measured and it was about 6 inches shorter which makes a difference if you want to keep your device in your bag while wearing the headphones.

They're only $10 so it's not a huge loss but I wish I had spent a little more and gotten a better quality set of earbuds. Other earbuds in the $10-20 range (particularly those made by Sony) are of a much higher quality. Just because they say Philips doesn't mean that they're good!

Update 9/3/10: I've had these headphones for about a year and they still work! Granted, I don't use them daily, they are my backup headphones, but I'm really surprised that they have held up so well for a year! Not bad for 10 bucks!

title: major problems with Bluetooth connection
review: These headphones sound awesome, noise cancellation awesome ,fit was good. What is really bad about these earbuds are the cutting in and out of the Bluetooth connection and having to reset them multiple times for them still not to work had to send them back. Really wanted to love them.

title: Truly Incredible for the Price
review: This is the third pair of these I've purchased. I lost my first pair (thank god they're only $21) and my wife wanted a pair after she tried mine. I've also recommended these to many friends in search of workout headphones they don't have to worry about (unlike a $200 pair of PowerBeats or Bose SoundSport Free). These also last for literally a freaking decade and don't have crazy signal drops like some bluetooth cheapies. Anker strikes again with a lovely product at a wicked price.

title: Great Price, Outstanding Quality
review:
These completely blew away my expectations. The build quality, the sound quality, and the packaging are all awesome. For the price these are the best earbuds available on Amazon.

My main reason for purchasing them was I needed a set of desk headphones to keep at work. These are absolutely perfect.

The amount of bass and low end clarity that comes from these is phenomenal. Comparable to much more expensive in-ears I’ve tried from Bose, Klipsch, Shure, and Beats.

title: My second pair of these and I use them every day
review: These have great sound and I REALLY LIKE THEM!  I have an iPhone and even though these are for Samsung, they work just fine.  I wear my headphones at least 4 hours a day and the one complaint I have is that they need to be a bit sturdier or stronger to preserve the wire inside.  If you're using them as much as I do, after a year the cord becomes weak and you lose sound in one ear or even both. These will probably last longer for other people as mine truly get above average use.  The microphone also works pretty darn well. This earphone is superior to the Bose in ear, Sound-true Ultra which is more money.

title: Not Bose sound quaility we've grown to love and expect.  Dreadful!
review:
I'm a huge fan of Bose, but these were terrible and I returned them. There wasn't a great deal of sound output and what there was sounded hollow and tinny. I didn't like the shape of these buds as they cut you off from the outside would, but not in a way that gave you better sound or louder clearer sound. I'd describe it as suddenly hearing the inside of your head and your blood flow. If you're at all claustrophobic these will bother you. I'm not and they were unsettling. If the earphones were shutting out the outside sound to give you more sound quality it might be bearable, but that just isn't the case. I listen to a LOT of recorded books and these sounded like they were being read to me via two cans and string.
I even tried to switch over to the old style silicone ear inserts, but still the sound wasn't very loud and still sounded awful. Go for the sports earphones. I've owned two pairs of them and they sounded wonderful and make sound rich and enjoyable. These aren't worth $10, and certainly not $150.

title: Loose connection?
review: I've only tried one out of the three, but it's terrible.  It switches from mono to stereo randomly; sometimes wiggling the connection helps but it's staticky.  It does not happen with the same headphones and a different extender cord I have.  Waste of money.

title: like tampons and gum
review: It's really big.  Barely fits in my backpack.  But it fits my headphones with room to spare, so I stick other random stuff in there, like tampons and gum.  Maybe it could have a long strap and I can just replace my purse.

title: Great for the price
review: My $100 Bose earbuds finally died, so I bought these as a cheap replacement. The sound is pretty good. I certainly couldn't expect the bass and sound quality from the old ones, but these are definitely decent.

title: Like them for driving!
review: I like these. I was trying to get the hang of them! I have difficulty fitting earphones into my head sometimes. I don't know if my ear holes or small or what… these had multiple sizes.  Actually the medium size was perfect. And after a little while I figured it out and got used to them. The sound is good! The last few earphones I've tried on Amazon didn't work out. But these ones have great sound and great pick up. I got a discount from the manufacture for my review!

title: Gift for the father in-law.
review: I purchased this as an additional source for my FIL headphones for the TV. Works nicely one minor gripe is it seems very easy to bump the HDMI cold and slight wiggle is needed to seat it again. It could just be the unit I received. So for now I am not faulting the mfg.

title: Great for road trips!
review:
Not too bad a pair of headphones, They stop my little ones from grabbing my Beats. I bought these at a local retailer, in a spur of the moment for a long road trip. (5+ hours) They do charge rather quickly. In less than 20 minutes they were fully charged. So the kids could use them while on the trip.
I personally would have preferred that they could be charged while in use, they cannot, and immediately shut off when its attempted. My kids love to allow their devices to get super low on charge. I removed 1 - 1/2 stars for the charging decision. I also remove 1/2 star because they feel slightly off when wearing them. The kids however have never noticed the wearing issue. They seem to like them a lot. Though my son told me he'll be sure to keep track of my Beats. I figure it has to do with these being on ear and the others over the ear. He's just like me and prefers over the ear. Chip off the old block.

The wife and I have been able to watch TV and talk this evening in the hotel room. Where we use to always hear this or that. Its nice to actually not have to say "turn it down" before talking. They have used them for hours today. I purchased the blue/grey and the green/grey for my boys. For their price and easy of purchase they will certainly be on the upper end of my re purchase list if its needed.

title: Great headphones, I bought these for a train trip ...
review:
Great headphones, I bought these for a train trip the Mrs was going to take a year or so ago back. They worked wonderfully for her and helped quieten the trip. We now use these to watch the Apple TV, while not bothering the others. Well that was till my 9 year old figured out how to pair these to the computer and or his iPad. I for the life of me cannot figure out how he learned to pair them. But thats always the way with new tech the kids know it all.

I love the over the ear covers, they make wearing them for extended periods of time more enjoyable. Even after a few years the battery is still working well. Love the quality of the sounds, though I don't need the wide range of sounds as other professional types might.

title: I love the quicker charging 3
review:
I have owned both the 2 and the 3. I love the quicker charging 3. I keep them with me all the time. I love the ability to have them paired once and then they work across my all apple products. iPhone, iPad, Mac (multiple).

Cons:
The new control module. I would love to be able to take the control unit off the 2 and place it on the 3. I often do not get the controls to work on the first time, too spongy feeling for my preference. I would give it a 5 star if the control was better. I loved running with my 2 and how precise the controls were. I wish I had not give the 2 to my son, and I would take them running with me and keep the 3 for all other tasks.
Also I prefer the responsiveness of the power button on the v2.

All in all I am happy with the purchase as they are great and I can train myself to work around my issues above. I will anxiously wait for the next version. I must be happy as even with my noted issues I have purchased 4 sets of these for myself and family members.

Edit: The latest release 10.3 has alleviated most of my issue and the headphones seem more responsive to me. I have not changed my star rating as they still are not as responsive as my previous version.

title: This thing is great
review: This adds two working video outputs, ethernet, sound via either headphones or hdmi which is great for hooking up to home stereo, very sturdy aluminum shell. I love this thing.

title: Don't let the brand name fool you.
review: For the price these are the best earbuds I have ever used. I own the higher end buds and these are just as good if not better.

title: Work great
review: I use these on airplanes and when using my switch with wireless headphones.  They work great.

title: Bought them in a pinch and they have lasted more than 3 years
review:
I needed to pick up a pair of headphones while I was travelling when mine broke. The only place I had available to me was a place that only had these and JVC marshmallows for earbuds. I am not a fan of the JVCs (I have tried them and find their foam tips to be scratchy in my ear); so while I don't particularly care about the hype of Beats and definitely am not a fan of Lady Gaga, I went ahead and purchased these - they at least looked well made.

I have had these earbuds for nearly three years now and I am happy with how well these have held up. The design of these earbuds makes them distinctive, which is ok, I guess. The inline mic make them a great for taking calls in the car. There is no inline volume - just an answer button (that can also control music- play, pause, and next). The tips are comfortable and this set comes with a lot of options! The cable is tabgle free and shows no signs of weakness.

title: Very happy
review: I bought a pair of vmoda headphones a few years back.  When I had them, it wasn't long before the wire fell apart and the headphones were useless.  I was upset at the time because the headphones were expensive and broke quickly.  A couple years after that, I bought another pair and had the same problem.  All along, I was impressed by the comfort, sound quality, and small size of the headphones.  Finally, I bought these headphones again last year.  They seem much better built than the others that I had.  So far, I have had no issues with the quality of the manufacturing!  I don't use the mic on them, so I can't really speak for that, but they are great for running and in the gym!  They stay put in your ears while you are working out (except if you are not paying attempting and accidentally get your arm tangled in the wires without noticing- which has been a good test for the durability).  So far, I am very happy with these and would recommend them to someone who is willing to pay a little more for sound and comfort!

title: Affordable and GREAT
review: Very pleased with the headphones.  The sound great, are very comfortable, have good noise cancellation, and are a great value.  Plus, they fold up into a great protective hard shell case when not in use.  I recommend these headphones to anybody.  You won't be disappointed.

title: Awesome sound quality
review: I just received these in the mail after my apple headphones broke. I love the look of these. They look exactly as pictured and I'm absolutely in love with the wooden part of them. I think the sound quality might be a little bit better than the apple ones, maybe that's due to the noise reduction. Some of the reviews say the braided cord makes it tangle free. I can assure you that's not true. I've had them for less than 24 hours and they've gotten pretty badly tangled at least 3 times. Apart from that though, these seem to be very nice (and affordable) headphones.

title: Great purchase for working out
review: Overall, 5 stars. Sometimes the earphones require adjustment as they slip off my head during workouts...but it could be due to excessive sweat.

title: Bose will always be my first Choice.
review: I love my headphones.  The color is very nice and the sound quality is exceptional.

title: Worth it
review: Good, simple value.  Nothing flashy but a nice upgrade from the headphones they give out for free on United Airlines.

title: Battery life is good
review: This headset is really good. It sounds amazing so I would suggest you try is that if you don’t like them you can send them back but I am pretty sure you’re going to keep them. They are the best. Thank you.

title: AMAZING PURCHASE!
review: Worth every penny! Really great sound quality & and bass response. Best 35$ headphones on the market! I've now bought 3 different bluedio headphones and have been satisfied with every product.

title: Perfect for single headset with room for ipad.
review: The bag works as expected with plenty of room for a headset and room for your electronics.  Seems well constructed and should last a long time.  Perfect for flights where I am not taking other people.  Much lighter than a full flight bag.

title: Sound quality good but comfort not so much.
review:
Sound quality is excellent at least for me. I am not an audiophile but the sound is perfect for me. I did not have any of the issues some report about having to insert and remove them because the sound was not set right for the VR headset. For me they just worked out of the box.

Comfort is not so great. Usually my head hurts from the headband of the Quest long before anything else but these hurt my ears before the headband hurts my head. I am not blaming the earbud company as they can not make their earbuds fit everyone's ears but for me they don't fit well at all. I have gone through each of the 3 different sets of rubbers and picked the best out of the 3 but still they hurt after an hour of use.

So sound quality gets 5 stars from me. Comfort and fit gets a 3 1/2 but ill round up to 3 3/4 but since that brings the total to just under 4 1/2 I have to give them a 4 star rating.

title: These are fantastic. Im kind of an earphone snob
review: These are fantastic. Im kind of an earphone snob, but I dont have a lot of money. These worked better then most the super expensive ones I tried. Loud, good bass, and great at cancelling out noise. Highly recommend

title: Wonderful headset!
review: Super headset!! Noise cancelation is clear, callers can hear me, and I can hear them. Very comfortable. Cuts out when placing the phone in a pocket, especially if it is across the body from the headset, but that seems to be the trend with bluetooth 4.0 low-energy devices. The pairing and set-up process is great and accessible to vision impaired users. NFC for set-up is great! This has been reviewed with my Nexus 6P.

title: Great sound, great fit
review: I can never keep up with my earbuds thanks to having teenagers in the house and with their friends coming in and out "borrowing" stuff. These are very unique with the design and I've added a label maker "name tag" to these. I use them for workouts and they stay in better than others that I've used. Not sure why...they just do! I would definitely recommend them to friends/family.

title: Great clarity and great fit
review: I use these for conference calls for work.  I'm a consultant and I'm on calls all day long and half of the night since we have an offshore team.  I can wear these comfortably for long periods of time without issue.  I also haven't received negative feedback regarding the clarity of my voice as I have with other headphones like this.  I would definitely reorder and recommend to others.

title: Work well
review: Bought these as a gift, but tried them first. Person next to you can hear the music at a low volume when you’re listening at your preferred volume. When wearing the headphones, you don’t hear people or things around you. -that’s nice. The plastic is a bit thin but for a gift they sound and work great. A nice feature to use wireless or use with a cord if the battery dies.

title: AWESOME
review: My hubby has been dreaming of owning some nice headphones to cancel out the sound of me watching the TV.  These are luxurious in comfort, sound clarity, and other noise cancellation.  Perfect!

title: New favorite headphones!
review: New favorite headphones!  Absolutely love them.. fit in ears great. Best headphones I've bought in the last year. No more searching!

title: Allows me to use my old cords with my iPhone 7 Plus!
review: These are great at adapting my headphones, audio cords etc to my iPhone 7 Plus. New cords are extremely expensive. Saved me from having to buy all new headphones. And chargers.

title: Others can hear 30 feet away
review:
My son said these had terrible noise cancellation and he can not use them. They are basically like walking around with speakers on your head! He tried to use them at the library and people 30 feet away could hear what he was listening to! He often uses speakers to make calls on his phone too and that was not even possible.
They defeat the purpose of being headphones if they are simply speakers for all to hear.
He had to use cheap earbuds the library loaned him.
He said these grey and tan ones looked a bit girlish. I as a mom thought they were attractive. I think the tan may look a bit like light pink possibly and he said girls gave him compliments lol which may mean they are more to a girls liking. I got this color due to he is on the street a lot and can not be drawing attention to himself. He can not have red or blue gang colors which some of the others had even if it was in the cord. And the black ones had shiny chrome which is too much of an attention getter. So, I opted for the grey ones.
They are also bulky and if you are limited on space my son said they did not fit in his backpack well. One night he even gave them to me to take home since he needed room for more important items in his backpack. I told him to just put them on his neck. And he was not even interested.
So, I'd say they are a fail.

title: Died after 1 use
review:
Get what you pay for sometimes.

These headphones stopped working after just 1 use

Disappointed, can’t recommend

title: Good for the price
review: The headphones are very comfortable feeling on my ears. They're big enough for my very large head. The volume control on the cable. Is very high up and close to the headphones? I can barely turn my head to be able to see what they are because I can't pull it far away from my face to be able to read the buttons. However, that is my only real complaint. I would place the inline volume control a little bit further away from the headphones and sales.

title: Good sound quality
review: If you're familiar with the brand then they live up to their same sound standard. I do wish the case was more rugged so that I felt more comfortable with how they would survive a drop, if that day ever comes. A feature which I detest is that the earbuds do NOT work independently of each other. The right one can be used without the left but the left CAN NOT be used separately. If the right earbud is in the case charging then the left earbud will not activate. This is one of the primary reasons why I chose to upgrade from my previous wired set and since I did not know that that would be an issue I did not look for that function in the description and reviews. In fact I still do not know what they would call this feature and in reading up on other wireless earbuds have not see it described or listed. I do also wish they were a little more snug/secure in my ear. Anytime I open my mouth, to eat for example, they become dislodged.

title: I will buy this again and again in .. 100% good  , I am using this last 6 months
review: Here's the one of the most underrated earphones in the market. I have had to change a few pairs because it always feels uncomfortable after long usage especially when I'm running but these are so comfortable! I will buy this again and again in the future.

title: Very good gadget
review: Very smal to bring it with me while traveling, I charge my Dell laptop, iPhone and wireless earphones together, it does not get hot. I also use it to charge my surface, charge any device faster.

title: Amazon Basics In_ear Headphones - White ...
review: Small, comfy earphones are comfortable and do as nice a job as speakers without the bulk...The fit is comfortable and the sound quality is just great. AND the price was very right!

title: Great sound quality and amazing battery life
review:
I was not ready to invest in a set of Apple, Bose, or Sony headphones, yet I was afraid to buy the cheapest headphones available. i wanted something that wouldn't ruin my music, or break the bank, and based upon other reviews, I believe I found a happy medium with these Anker headphones The bass doesn't sound over amplified, or pushed and it has a nice balance in the mid and high ranges.

At first I used it with my phone, and was terribly disappointed, but on my computer and other bluetooth sound systems, they sounded fantastic. I later learned I would have to re download my entire Apple Music library to enjoy higher bit rate music, so I primarily use these with other devices.

The battery life it amazing. I have not had to charge them in almost a month after daily use of an hour or so. When the battery does get low it takes only a few minutes to get hours of use thanks to its quick charge technology.

They are lightweight, comfortable, and the sound quality is surprising decent for an inexpensive set of headphones. About my only complaint would be that the controls are not as intuitive as I would like, but overall I am very pleased with this purchase, and would highly recommend them.

title: Exceeded my expectations with clean balanced sound and undistorted bass.
review:
[[VIDEOID:4c60e87ead4c44abcba14a2d6daa5b1e]] When I test speakers I play the type of music that is meant for headphones because of the meticulous care taken when mixing the recordings. I don't expect headphone quality, but I do expect balanced sound and on occasion, a little extra "undistorted" bass. I do like my bass and the Doss Soundbox Pro+ did not disappoint. The bass was punchy and clean without being overwhelming.
Not only did this fill my living room with clear, undistorted sound, but I could hear it two rooms away without it sounding too bright or boomy at max volume. I am not sure if this would be loud enough to blast through a large room filled with noisy people, but it's perfect for smaller gatherings and apartments that share common walls with neighbors.
I mostly use this with my computer, so the even though the lights are fun, they're a bit distracting near my screen, and I was able to turn it off by holding the "extra bass" button for a few seconds. This speaker paired quickly with all of my devices, and the sound quality exceeded my expectations, I highly recommend it.

title: Clear sound with distortion free bass
review: I have tested many earbuds that range in price from $10 to over $100, and I must say these sound very decent in this price range and better than some that cost twice as much. They are very bass-midrange centric, but the sound clarity is superb, and they have not distorted at the loudest volume I could stand. I heard instrumental detail I would not have expected in a pair of $25 earbuds. I thought the heavier bass and midrange would seem unbalanced and bothersome, but it wasn't after listening to a range of music for a few hours. I haven't tried them on phone calls yet, but if the music sounds this clean and clear, I am sure my phone calls will as well. I will update my review if it doesn't live up to my expectations. So far I like these earbuds a lot and highly recommend them.

title: Bass centric, but doesn't distort. Great choice in this price range!
review: I've tried a nearly a dozen pair of earbuds that cost between $10 - $70 and The HaRuion A001+ in-Ear Earphones perform very well, especially in this price range. They are bass-centric,  but not to the point of completely overpowering the sound, and they do not distort at high volume. The mid-range and treble sound crisp and well balanced, and the overall fidelity was good. I have earbuds that cost almost 5 times as much and do not sound as good, which proves you don't have to spend a fortune to get decent sound quality. They come with 2 sets of ear cushions to fit every ear. I'm very pleased with these earbuds and highly recommend them.

title: Very disappointing sound quality.
review: I am usually pleased with Amazon products, so I was disappointed when I tried these. There was virtually no bass or treble, and the midrange is thin and weak. There are holes in the sound where instruments are supposed to be. The sticky rubber on the cord caught everything, and you could hear it rubbing against everything it touched. The sound of the wire rubbing against my arm was the only true fidelity I heard. There are much better earbuds in this price range so don't think you have to spend a fortune for great sounding earbuds; you don't. Sadly, these are not the best choice.

title: Five Stars
review: Wire is super small gauge, but it works great for my PC gaming headset. Clear sound and great connection.

title: Very cheaply made
review: I can see that these will last only a few wears.  Be careful when placing on earbuds. Will rip very easy.

title: Amazing set
review: I love my headset, I wear them at night when everyone else is a sleep, battery last a long time as well.

title: Good headphones for my tween son
review: Good headphones for my tween son. He likes them. Says they fit well and are comfortable to wear. Now if he can just keep up with them!

title: Great substitution for those who don't want to buy airpods!
review: Perfect for those that want wireless earbuds, but don't want to spend much either.

title: Liquid platinum Amazing
review: Upgraded from 887 to this. Boy the benefit is humongous. This thing is lit!!! Instead of thx aaa's signature space vacant sound, with this thing, every thing comes alive and glamorous. thx aaa's sound will drive you crazy especially after a long listening session. But this thing, I could not appreciate more. I admit ASR's review may have somewhat referencing value, however in this case, the actual performances are exactly opposite to the ASR's scores. I love the strength of this thing, the sound is powerful and is capable of delivering instant explosiveness with full impact. With some "unfair" comparisons with some dac amp all in one products that I used to or still own such as smsl m9, sabaj d5, teac ud505, forcal arche, ifi idsd pro, sony ta zh1es, none of the amp parts of those products reaches this level. But I guess you can always argue that those all in ones focus on the dac parts except arche. Arche definitely focuses more on the amp side, the dac part I could give it a negative score at best, the amp part of arche is not bad, 3w per channel which is capable of driving many insensitive headphones beyond any focals own headphones. Sorry I just do not own a lot of amp only products but 887. I just simply could not love it more, it is a blast! I've heard some good words about this and I had my doubt, but now, it has proven that this is the type of product that is a must own, don't even think or hesitate.

title: Perfect!
review: Great headphones.  Got these at a great price! Perfect for back to school and the sound quality is great!

title: Does NOT support A2DP
review: You get what you pay for. This headset should be louder, have better range and at least support A2DP. You can use it with phone but if you have a device that needs A2DP for music then this will not work.

title: Wrong headphones pictured
review: I ordered these headphones based on the picture.  It showed headphones that hook over the ears and go into the ear canal.  When I received the package I got just plain ordinary head phones.

title: Works as I'd hoped!
review: Works perfectly to store my headset and it's charging wire. Sticks firmly through rubber to the front of my nzxt s340 case. I like that I do t have to hide the headset, clutter the top of my PC or stretch the headset out to clamp on something it shouldn't be on anymore.

title: Don’t waste your money
review: Shows it comes with headphones & it doesn’t. Box was damaged at time of delivery. Package iwas damaged. Skips a lot of discs for being “new”. DVDs are brand new & their skipping. Junk.

title: Plastic fantastic
review: Seems to work, cheap feeling plastic - but then not spending much either. It has a built in battery that is supposed to charge headset twice. I just mainly wanted protection for my headset while not using it.

title: Works as it should, low volume though.
review: I recently joined a gym and most of the equipment is connected to the large banks of tv’s - but you need wired earbuds to take advantage. I ordered this to plug in to the equipment and use my wireless earbuds and the volume is so low you can barely hear the tv. To be fair I plugged in to an Alexa at home and it worked great with all sorts of volume, so I don’t know why so low at the gym - wired buds work great with adequate volume. Sound quality is good, pairing was easy.

title: well, it's Bluetooth.
review: pretty simple install, really nothing to do but plug it in. For this I used an LG HBS-780 Bluetooth headset which is like a horseshoe hanging around your neck with earbuds. Headset connected no problem and sounds great, however the range is pretty bad. If I hold my hand a few inches from my neck in between the headset and the Bluetooth dongle the sound starts to cut out - and i'm literally 2 ft from the computer tower at chest level seated and the dongle is plugged into the front of the tower. title: it's a headset cable... it works.. it's just fine.
review: Works just fine... it's just made to hook your Plantronics headset to your phone.

title: Great buy
review: If you are looking for cheap over the ears headphones while you workout. this is it! this is a great buy. I have been using this every week 5 days a week when I run on treadmill and they have yet to fail. Not only it stays on but also it does not get bothered by the sweat and all. I am very much Satisfied with this product.

title: A little delicate
review: Great headphones, except they snap a little too easily on sides. I was able to get replacement ones, so I am happy.

title: The sound isn't the best, so just hook it up to a better speaker
review: I bought this because despite having all the streaming services available, I have some CDs that either the artists don't allow their tracks to stream on Spotify, or I have CDs with rare bonus tracks that aren't available anywhere else that I literally can't listen to without a CD player. The sound on this little machine does leave you wanting (though, I haven't tried it with headphones, which can sometimes be better), but I plug it into my Klipsch speaker and I'm off and running. I also like that it has so many modes (Bluetooth, radio, etc.). All in, a great little CD player that you can also wall-mount for less clutter - another bonus.

title: Fabulous Headphones
review: I have yet to buy an AmazonBasics product that I don't like, which makes me very curious as to which well-known brand name is more than likely ghost-creating their products. That being said, I forgot how much I love over-the-ear headphones, as opposed to ear buds. For one thing, you can crank them up without fearing blowing your eardrums out. Instead of hearing the noticeable tinniness of the emphasized treble of ear buds, you can instead enjoy the full-throated bass of over-the-ear headphones - and man, do these deliver. The bass is *fantastic.* These are lightweight and cup nicely to the ears, and they are adjustable, of course. The pads on the ears are soft and squishy, and they are excellent at noise-canceling. You really can't beat the price at $14.99 for these. This is truly a great product.

title: Not the Greatest Headphones
review: They are good for a cheaper Bluetooth headphone. I wouldn't recommend them if you're wanting deep base and clear vibrations.

title: Doesn't cooperate with Samsung Galaxy S10+ and Liberty 2 Pro earbuds, awful tech support
review:
Was looking for best way to increase the volume and enhance the tone on my Galaxy S10+ when using with Liberty 2 Pro earbuds. I read alot of reviews on
Amazon and elsewhere saying this was the kit to get. Boy was I disappointed.
First of all, design wise the piece is simple too small and the LED screen window and print is tiny, and dark. Barely legible, and that's inside. I probably could have accepted that had I been able to get it to work. Spent hours trying to set-up, firmware update, resetting all devices codecs to"AAC" only. It did pair its bluetooth connection with my phone, however none of the controls on it had any effect on the phones audio output, so I got from the phone only what I got when Fiio was not connected. Worst part was the Fiio support. In a word, it s*ckec, in my experience. No US tech support or chat support. I sent 3 detailed emails explaining the problem and they were all misconstrued or answered without reading the previous ones. Their genius advice was to change phones and replace the Fiio. Because of the time difference between east coast and asia, replies took a day to answer. I really wanted this device to work, however in the end, and due to their awful/useless tech support I returned it to Amazon, who was great handling the return. My advice is to try another company with good reviews and good tech support. These guys are not that, in my experience, and neither was the device.

title: Keep these. They are great for $25
review: Good deal for $25. They sound reallygood when paired with a good headphone amp, phone mic also works well. Earbuds are pretty comfortable and high quality braided cable. They are keepers.

review: Great Headset and good sound NOT amazing but for this Price it was decent. The only con was I could not wear this for more than 3 hours it was too tight and started to heart my ears.

title: Nooooo Whyyyy??
review: I was under the impression Skullcandy was great when it came to the earbud. But my $6 Phillip headset provides a better listening experience than this. Super disappointed. No real bass and its just really load.

review: I was looking for wireless earbuds because I lost my last pair. This one was on sale, and the price is very good, so I decided to give it a try. I just received them yesterday. The only thing I don't like is that the left and right earbud show the same name on my iPhone -  S8. They should have used S8-L and S8-R, so I will know which one to connect/disconnect. It says the earbuds are with IPX8 waterproof, which protects earbuds from rain and sweat during sporting, running, jogging, swimming, shower, and yoga, etc., but not for diving. It is an excellent feature because most others are IPX5, but I haven't got a chance to test it yet.

title: Nice and solid
review: Just arrived today. Nice and solid. Will use them for my earbuds. Nice colors and material.

review: I just bought these wonders yesterday. I choose the earbuds so I can use them in more places like the gym and yard work instead of only on airplanes. review: The thin wires look fragile, but so far so good. I had forgotten how essential good wired headphones are. I no longer make a fool of myself with audio problems during meetings.

title: Economic price with good sound and simple operation
review: I had returned Echo ear buds and have bought at least 2 other non brand name earbuds before trying these. I am very happy with the way they sound when using the Spotify equalizer. On top of that - the ear bud wings that came with them keep them in place which is really important. I guess now it’s just a test of time. I will come back and update my review after a few weeks of use but for now I think it is a promising start.

title: Works great and saved a ton of money!
review: I was really hesitant to buy these because of the low cost. Being a new gym member my husband needed a set of wireless headphones for the treadmill so I read review after review on Amazon I decided to give these a try and if my husband lost them it would not be a huge investment to replace .Turns out these little headphones work extremely well and they even come with ear clips if you have trouble keeping the buds in your ears. I'm very happy with this purchase and believe it was worth the 20 bucks!

title: Well worth the money
review:
[[VIDEOID:e1357f8ba5ba18d5f83af1be700c2c42]] Of course you can't compare this to a high end earbuds, but you can't can't get a basic pair as good as these for $8 !

title: Nice product. Works ok with non apple earbuds
review: [[VIDEOID:baa62f01c58e825d0c7953ba708980ee]] I can now without our jog without having to worry about my airpods or earbuds from falling out of my ears and losing then. Although this was probably designed for apple airpods which are a bit slimmer than off brand ones, I did manage to get them into my regular earpods I use as well. review:

Once removed and cleaned, just peel and stick padding onto headphones would lining up the holes to match. Takes just a minute or so to replace.
The padding quality is decent enough, but not of the highest quality like the original. Good replacement if you don't want to pay much. I hope my review and pics helps.

title: Decent quality. Cheap pair.
review: Nice design but not high quality. Paid $10.99, but now it's over $18. Worth the $10 bucks I paid and great as a backup pair to my other high-quality earbuds. It's an ok pair for the money, but don't compare to upscale brands or quality. You get what you pay for. Great for kids gaming or travel. Makes a cheap stocking stuffer as well.

title: 🎧 Good basic earbuds 🎧
review:
[[VIDEOID:e5b3a799e28872295e88788baf581d14]] I will not compare these cheap earbuds to expensive one on the market. However, for $10 these are a great pair to have. title: Superb sound quality and very comfortable.
review:

title: Excellent pair, Very lightweight.

Overall, very satisfied with my purchase.

title: Great value. Easy Install. Works well.
review:

title: Good quality headphones
review: This gaming headset is well worth the price. While there are betters ones on the market, third well do the trick for your gaming needs. The sound is good, which is what I need for my zoom and other social media online meetings. Overall, I recommend.

title: Nice little Amp with good sound.
review:
The Headphone Amplifier works as intended. I am really quite surprised by the sound quality and performance of this little amp. My mother is getting older and so am I and find it a bit of hard to hear on my phone or in noisy places. It weighs less than 6ounces and easy to take with you wherever you go. Glad I bought it. Very useful product.

title: Great sound, poor microphone
review: Excellent sound. Has a very generous length cord. The mic for phone calls is a bit poor. But i bought it just for the sound. I mostly use it as a back up when my earpods are charging. Pretty standard earphones.

title: Great sound, but not very good for sports or jogging
review:
I was really excited getting these cool looking wood style headphones. Came in very presentable packaging with different size earpieces. I purchased these "wired" headphones as back up when not using my AirPods. The sound is excellent although I had two other difficulties. ( Which you may not have on yours )

1. Would not stay in my ears no matter what size earpiece was used. Had to constantly push them deeper into my ear to stay in, just to pop out a few minutes later.

2. Every time I tried to use it for phone calls on my Samsung S9+ phone, people couldn't hear me clearly or sounded like a bad connection.

I usually not this critical and usually happy with most of my purchases, but this one failed to live up to its usefulness.

title: Great sound and easy to use!
review:
I freakin' love these earbuds. They are incredibly comfortable and won't budge during my workouts or runs. These buds tuck nicely into its oval shaped charging case, which stores the pods in between my workouts and keeps them from getting lost. I find that the charging pod case is extremely hard to open. Actually, you have to squeeze and open the case at the same time to lift the lid to get it open. Love the google assistant feature as well. These buds can last 5 hours on their own and then an additional 10 hours if they are charged up in between workouts. ( Much longer than my Apple earpods. )

You can find other less expensive wireless bluetooth earphones, but the alternatives either aren't sweat resistant for workouts, or don't fit as well. So overall, they are a very good set to own.

review:

title: Great comfort & sound. Highly recommend
review:
I saw some reviews that were critical of these head phones and mentioned a Bluetooth buzzing when used with a mac book. NOT SO! THESE ARE THE BEST HEADPHONES I'VE EVER OWNED AND VERY COMFORTABLE.
Batter life is good. Pairing is easy. Sound quality is unmatched.
