title: Great set of headphones!
review: I really wanted rose gold headphones and I am pleasantly surprised by these! I love that they fold up so they can fit well into purses or totes. I love these! They're extremely comfortable, too!

title: The best
review: These headphones were purchased for my husband to use while at the gym. He absolutely loves them. They are really loud and work great.

title: The product 135H is misleading.
review:
This is what I was waiting for, the play time lasts 2 hours, it because of the built in microphone the paranoid government requires that all headphones/headsets have a built in microphone. the price was a steal. I am definitely recommending these to a lot of people.
The instructions are in the white envelope.
Overall I am very proud with this product,

title: Surprisingly good headphones
review: I didn’t have high expectations for these headphones considering the price, but I was pleasantly surprised that the audio quality was pretty good and they are comfortable in the ear. If you lose them, there are four more to choose from!

title: Not good for glasses-wearing customers, but the option to switch ears is great
review: I am, unfortunately, going to have to order a different headset. I had high hopes for this one, based on its reviews, but it is problematic for me. First, what I like: the ability to wear it on your left or right ear is brilliant, and the sound quality is fine--not optimal, I think, but fine. The controls would be convenient for many people, but they are not for me, which leads me to my major frustration with this headset: it is definitely not for glasses-wearers. I should have foreseen this, honestly, but I didn't. The piece that fits behind the ear is quite large, and even though I wear super thin, flexible glasses frames, there really isn't enough room for both the headset and my glasses behind my ear. It is next to impossible to put on this headset one-handed without my glasses on--with them, there's no chance, as far as I can tell. Trying to operate the controls makes my glasses move around on my face, which is definitely unpleasant while driving. I also find the rubber piece that fits in the ear uncomfortable. I switched to the small size option, but it still seems to be a little too large, and its shape is definitely less comfortable than that of my old Bose headset. One last comment--the packaging is terrible to get into, and you have to basically destroy it to open it, which means returning it is not really an option. I'm giving it 3 stars because I think it would be a fine headset for many people, even though it's a poor one for me.

title: Multi-function player that is affordable!!
review:
I ordered this for my granddaughter who mentioned her desire to have one for listening to music in the car and have her own tunes on. I was surprised at how small it was and convenient to place in your pocket or purse. The player came with complete instructions on each function that it is capable of. Included with the player is also the charger and a set of decent earphones. She has downloaded her favorite songs and also discovered the capabilities of the player such as recorder, games, video and radio. The sound from the earphones appears to be fine with no static and very clear.
This device is also a e-reader which I would be very interested in. I feel it is a great value for the money and keeps the children away from wanting to always want someone's phone.
I received this product free in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

title: I'm impressed
review: Comfortable, amazing battery life, sound quality is superb.  I listen to metal music primarily, so this can be hit and miss with headphones - the momentum's deliver excellent sound quality, though, with special attention being paid to the mids and highs.  Low end is fine - but won't compare to Beats or something that is targeting heavy bass delivery.  These headphones are going to be ideal for dense music with intricate instrumentation, bringing out the sounds of each instrument fairly.

title: Bad fit, terrible sound
review: Bad fit, terrible sound. I put these things in and in but a moment could tell I made a mistake. Sound was muddy and the fit was wonky. My 20 dollar anker earbuds sound and feel better. The search for a real upgrade to them continues...

title: Noise reducing maybe.
review: Just to be clear... These are not exactly "noise cancelling" headphones. They do a fantastic job at removing the white noise (the sound of blood circulation you hear when you cover yours ears) but they don't block out the surrounding noises that well. The music will drown out most of the sounds, but some loud noises will still get through. On an airplane I was still able to hear a slight rumble from the engines.

title: My first Bluetooth headset, but not impressed
review: I bught one of these, and the tiny plastic earpiece broke the first time I tried to adjust it. I sent it back and received a new one. I am not sure why so many people complain that it is uncomfortable, I barely even notice it is there. It also paired pretty quickly and easily with my LG VX 8500 (Chocolate phone). The sound quality on my end is very good, but some people I have called complain of an echo on their end and it picks up a lot of ambient noise. I have not tried pairing with multiple phones, using it in a windy environment, or using the feature to find it when it is lost. I did try the voice command dialing, and it works intermittently. I cannot say that I am very impressed with this headset, although it is convenient, I would definitely not buy another one.

title: If you like 80’s sound quality, these are for you :(
review: Such cute packaging and such professional feeling ear buds. Unfortunately the sound is AWFUL. They sound like listening to a cassette tape on a Walkman with those small foam headphones....from 3 feet away. Seriously, I couldn’t believe hoe poor the sound quality was. No bass. No clear treble. If the packaging and feel wasn’t so good I would give them 1 star. But I bumped it to 2 for appearances Only.  If they could fix the sound, they would have a winner!

title: Too Big for 12 year Old's Ears.
review: Good headphones but still too large for my 12 year old's ears.  I wish they'd make them more kid sized.

title: I can't hear you what?
review: I bought these to have as an extra pair. Good thing they were "extra" as they fell apart on day 2. First the left side quit working, then by day 5 the right side was all static unless you held the 3.5 mm plug into the device just a certain way. I expected them to be similar to the low end skull candy. Nope...I've had Dollar Tree headphones that lasted longer.

title: iPad/iPhone perfect fit
review:
I just needed a simple headset to watch netflix on my iPad and block out household / airplane noise. These are lightweight, don't crush my head, decent sound and the cord is just the right length. I've had headsets where the cord is so long I've had to cable tie it shorter !!
The output sound from an iPad/iPhone isn't stellar so why buy $200 headset? These are great. They are well built having just survived being jammed in and taken out of my backpack over 8 flights and a 12 day vacation.

title: Not worth $10
review:
First, mine didn’t smell.

Now that I have the positive attributes out of the way let’s discuss why you should avoid this case.
I reluctantly paid $33 for this and I have to wonder what I was thinking. It’s nowhere near worth that much.

It will not/cannot survive a side impact. Well that’s not true. It cannot protect your APM from a hit or drop that could damage them from the top. I’m not sure if it could from the bottom or sides. It’s either molded cardboard or thin plastic covered with fabric. No padding, just fabric.

Internally there is another layer of cardboard (or plastic, thin, very thin) covered in a felt like material. There’s absolutely no drop protection.

The magnets designed to put the APM into “sleep” mode lay flat. You will have to pinch them up while putting your headphones into it if you wish to keep them from clanging together and not using the stock case. Even then the magnets don’t work every time. See my pic.

Overall this is a $10 case marked up cause they can. I mean we have expensive headphones so why not charge us more? We have already proven we will pay.

Skip this thing. Mine is going back. If you want something to protect them in a backpack then still look elsewhere. You can get something equal to this for less.

Thanks for your time.

title: Not really for the Galaxy Buds.
review:
Not really for the Galaxy Buds. They barely fit into the buds and cause them to stick further out of your ear. About as comfortable as having an ant crawl in your ear as well.

The Buds tips fit down over the top of the Bud, these fit on the end. I've used foam tips with other earbuds and these are amount the worst. They barely expand once put it, and if they do deal at all they stay when removing the Bud from your ear. That was fun...

title: This case is perfect for Powerbeats earphones
review:
I find that this cases perfect for Powerbeat earphones. It is well made, durable, and large enough to hold the Powerbeats. I recommend purchasing these as the case that comes with the Powerbeats is not nearly as protective, and cannot be closed to keep out debris.
Well done!

title: Not as good as the original SkullCandy Crusher wireless
review:
I had high hopes for this headset especially after seeing all the reviews. The ANC isn't really that great and if nothing is playing there's an annoying hiss. Also unlike the original crusher wireless when bass hits on these headphones vibrate like crazy which honestly is quite annoying where the originals did not do that.

on the pros though, these are much more comfortable on the crown of your head where the original crusher wireless would make the crown of your head hurt.

Do I think it's worth it comparatively from it's cheaper older model? Jury is still out.

title: Strong bass but UNCOMFORTABLE
review: I bought these because I thought the heavy bass would be nice during action movies... I was right, the sound for that type of thing is great. BUT they are super uncomfortable. I know that no headphones are one size fits all but they really hurt the crown of my head. I had to buy a protective pad for it which made a world of difference. Would I recommend them? hard to say but they are great for action movies.

title: These work great, sound great and have great battery life
review: This is my 2nd pair of Logitech H800 speakers that I've purchased. Both pairs work perfectly. I purchased these because the headset provided by my work does not work well for Skype calling and I wanted a wireless option. These work great, sound great and have great battery life. Bottom line, if they break, I'll purchase them again.

title: My husband loves these
review: I got these for my husband and he is very picky about his headphones but he loves these and uses them everyday.

review: The sounds, features all great.  Easy and quick pairing, recognition of devices fast.  No on/off buttons when the paired device is turned on earbuds activate automatically.  Play, pause, rewind and fast forward commands simple to use.

title: Love 'em
review: Headphones work great.  Charged up quickly and were ready to use within one hour.  Syncing to ipod was very simple.  Bought them as a gift for my granddaughter and she loves them!

title: Safety First
review: My wife absolutely loves these.  I purchased them to replace some Bose wired headphones she was running in.  Now she feels safer because she can hear her surroundings, and finally she is away from wired headphones. These seem to be built well, and the blue is a sharp color.

review: These are adorable and ultra soft but the cord that retracts is entirely too thin for children.  My daughter got her on Wednesday and they were broken by Saturday.  They'll make great ear muffs but not great headphones, unfortunately.

review: These are not apple noise canceling AirPods. They are cheap functional earphones that do exactly what they say they will do. They play music well enough but they are not Bose quality sound. Sometimes you get what you pay for sometimes you get more than what you pay for. In my opinion you get more value for your buck out of these than more expensive ones. review: I loved these headphones. Super comfortable. Long battery life, good sound quality. But after  only 6 weeks one side stopped working and I can't return them anymore. For $30 I thought they would last longer than this. I am really disappointed.

review:

review: I wear headphones when I go to bed so I can listen to podcasts. Not all headphones will work for this. Some are very uncomfortable, some won't stay on. These look okay for my purpose.

review: But, I like to listen to music that has some base and isn't tinny. I also like to listen to podcasts. The shoulder speaker that I have been using is on its last leg. review: One thing I am pleased with, is the battery life. 40 hours on one charge is decent. And with only a 5 minute charge, you get 4 hours of use.
