title: I am hoping these will work wonderfully
review: Reading other reviews, I am starting to get little worried. But, I am charging them up now and will start my online class when it is done. These are true wireless and do a good job at eliminating noise. I've got noise around this joint. Between my husband and his loud tv volume and two dogs and canaries and finches, I am surrounded by noise. I usually wear  headphones that are noise eliminating. I find those confining. I find pods easier to use. I have Apple Airpods Pro and I like them. But they are not by me at the moment. We boxed up so much stuff to move out our old sofas and replace them with new. If the Yamahas can't cut the requirements, then I will be updating accordingly.

title: works as described
review: I got this for that "just in case" moment when an earbud decides to make a break from my ears. This should keep them a bit more secure.

title: Has some flaws but sound is good
review: I don't like that you can connect via bluetooth but have to use the dongle to get all the features you want. That is not good. I also don't like that the headset cannot be used while it is charging. Many times, I listen to music at night and because I have some issues with depression and anxiety, I sleep more hours than regular people. I don't like that the mic cannot be removed when not in use. The sound is great though. The RGB isn't a deal maker or deal breaker for me. The boy will enjoy using this when he is gaming. He is going to love the sound

title: Nice sound and feel comfortable
review: This earphone set looks a little different. It comes with two different cards of ear plugs. One card is for bass hearing and the other is for crystal clear sound. The bass hearing also provides more noise cancellation. These say they are red and black but they look more pink and blue - which is A-ok with me.

title: They work with my earphones
review: These are nice eartips. They fit well and actually work better than the ones that came with the earphone. The memory foam makes them more comfortable.

title: nice USB cables
review: I have many devices that still use a micro cable. These are nice and well made. I don't have a phone to use them on, but I do have my headphones and other devices. Some are data storage and when I use one of those, I use these cables to transfer the data.

title: I use this alot
review: When I go to sleep at night, it is while I am listening to podcasts. Or, I may do Muse Meditations first. Whichever I do, I put this on first. It pairs quickly and I like it. I have tried it with and without the earbuds and I prefer it without. But, on those nights my hubby can hear the podcasts - the sound adjustment on the speaker doesn't have much range, then I will use the buds.

title: I am not a connoisseur of audio
review: But I do like a nice sounding earphone with good bass. These fit my bill. Additonally, I enjoy the QI charging capability. These give you 7 hours of sound and another 35 hours when you recharge them in their case. The case is quality - real leather. You do get what you pay for. And if you want great sound, this will fit your bill. For my purposes, I like to listen to my music, listen to ipods, listen to my meditation and sleep guides and I don't want to hear a lot of other noises... like my husband or the puppy snoring.

title: Good value
review: Sometimes, old school wired earbuds work pretty darn good. For the price, these work great. These are the type I would give to kids, being they will break them in some manner. My grandkids went through so many pairs of earbuds. When you can get your hands on ones that are not very expensive, that work well and they will use, it is a win win

title: These are great for the price
review: What I like about these, are the sound. They are much better than other buds and headphones I have used. What I don't like, is that the charge only lasts up to 3 and 1/2 hours before needing charging via the case. You can charge with a fully charged case three more times before you need to recharge the case. If I want to use these at night, I can't. I am not going to wake up every 3.5 hours to charge them.

title: This is great
review: For my purposes, this is the ideal speaker. I listen to podcasts at night and I have used headphones, wired and bluetooth and earbuds, wired and bluetooth. I have even used the headbone type speakers. I want something I can hear that doesn't get tangled up in cords or my hair and this is working. The sound is phenomenal. I was truly expecting it to be heard by the hubby, but nope. I had him wear it and it was at a volume that to me, was somewhat high. I could just barely detect the sound. This will do.

title: When I use earbuds, I want noise cancellation
review: These give me that. I sleep with my earbuds on quite often while I listen to podcasts. The noise cancellation works to keep the hubby noises neutralized. The sound is great for what I use it for. I like these. And I can use them in my iPad or my iPhone.

title: Just the other day
review: the girl was asking if i had any earphones. And these came in to my possession. And it is two pair, not one. She will be overjoyed to have a spare set since she tends to leave her belongings lying about and their dog eats them.

title: Great sound and noise cancellation
review: You will not be disappointed with these earphones. I use mine at night to listen to podcasts (note: also keeps spiders out of your ears). The sound is great and the noise cancellation superb. I have a number of headphones and some work better than others. When I sleep at night, I always wear my headphones. All I hear is what I am listening to with these. Some of my other noise cancellation headphones don't cancel the noise as much. Others don't have as nice of sound. I like these so far the most.

title: I am okay using an app to control this unit
review: I like being able to charge my phone by just sitting it on the speaker. And I like the convenience of using an app to set the time and alarm and what I want to wake up to. It is easier to me. Otherwise, I would have to set things in the dark if my husband is sleeping. This does all I need it to do. I like that it has two additional usb ports in the back so I can charge my headphones and ipad.

title: I am suitably impressed
review: These headphones are easy to operate, do a good job cancelling noise in the room from televisions, kids, dogs and husbands. They are also comfortable. They were so simple to set up. I set them up on my laptop. I held in the square  button until  I heard that the speakers were on. Then I checked my laptop system information and ran the Bluetooth device and there they were. Put on one of my songs and I had to turn the volume  down quite a bit. They get plenty loud. I am very impressed with these headphones. I may be swapping out the ones I use nightly for these.

title: Nice earphones
review: The sound is fantastic. This has dual drivers for beautiful highs and lows and separate amplifiers. The silicone and rubber housing makes the earbuds comfortable and lightweight. You can wear them for up to 8 hours of use and then do a 15 minute recharge for another two hours. These are so nice, you will not even notice them while you wear them. I sleep with my headphone or earbuds and I often find that they will hurt my ears. These don't. Smaller is better.

title: Work for me!
review: I listen to podcasts while I try to go to sleep and let them play all night long. These earbuds work great for me. I don't have to discern between the best bass or treble. I am mainly listening to talking or music for sleeping. Eight hours is enough time for me to sleep for the night, so that works great too. And I can recharge the buds quickly in case I am having one of those sleepless nights and go over 8 hours in bed without sleeping. I am pleased with these.

title: Nice earbuds
review: These would be perfect for me if they could stay charged for over 12 hours. I want something wireless that I can wear at night while I sleep. These will last up to 9 hours, and I can work with that. The earbuds are nice and I like how they fit. The sound is superior to other buds that I have.

title: Another earbud disappointment
review: Why can't these companies get their stuff together and produce a decent earbud that will fit in your ear and stay there. They also need to test the charging timeline. Try them for more than a month. I am not pleased with these.

title: I have issues with earbuds so generally use headphones
review: When I go on vacation, I want to take earbuds like these, because they sound good and they take up less room. The wires on buds is usually what ends up going south. These wires seem to be stronger and I like that they don't tangle. I like how I can customize the sound with these too. Lots of nice features.

title: when i got this, I thought my husband still had his Bose headphones
review: We had purchased replacement pads for his Bose headphones before and these look the same. So when I told him I got these replacements, he told me "remember when the girl broke my headphones?" No, I did not. So, I have my memory and his memory to remember if they will fit the Bose headphones. We both agree that they do.

title: for a USB microphone, works great
review: I got this for my grandson, who is big in gaming. If his headset mic quits working, he will have a back up and this doesn't sound so bad. It is a great price for the quality.

title: nice addition for bluetooth headphones
review: sometimes, you want to listen to a movie or a television show or a game at a different volume that the others that are in the room. With this, you can hook up at least two headphones and set your volume where you want it and you can also go further than with what normal blue tooth devices do.

title: Now I need their headphones for the best sound experience
review: This piece of equipment is built to provide you unparalleled hearing and speaking on your apple device. You have a lighting charge for the iphones, ipads and macs that require the lightning to use the device's speakers. On the other end, you have a 3.5mm headphone amp so that you can hear spectacular sound through your headphones

title: Doesn't seem like a JVC product
review: First, the wireless earphones do not have any noise canceling abilities. I charged it up and paired it with my iPhone. I had to turn up the volume all the way and it still didn't seem like it was enough. Then, it sounded as if only one side was working, so I pulled out the right plug and I could hear the left plug. I am not sure that the left has as much sound as the right side.

title: A decent set of wireless earphones
review: I really like that they are making earphones with the magnet, so it isn't as easy to lose them. This pair, you don't want to lose. It has good sound and I love the noise cancelling. I seldom use my earphones for anything other than listening to podcasts. I have a cell phone, but I seldom send or receive calls. It is usually text or messaging. If I could improve anything on these, it would be to have longer battery life, because I like to sleep while listening to podcasts.

title: Best for up to 4 hours use
review: When you get wireless earbuds, they work great, but the battery will last up to 4 hours, generally. After that, you stick the buds back into their case (that you have pre-charged) and leave them for 2 hours. Then you can use them for another 4 hours and this can be done for up to 4 times before you need to charge the case again.

title: Good quality headphones
review: These work well. You get plenty of sound but you also get the wire, which is sometimes better than using wireless. The bass is good, the buds are comfortable and I like them. They are very similar to another pair I have in my stash that I use as my go to when I want a good set of buds. Since I listen to podcasts all night long, I am tethered to my iPad - and yes, I have forgotten in the middle of the night and have gone to the bathroom and dropped my iPad. The earbuds normally stay attached.

title: The sound is pretty darn good
review: I am suitably impressed with how well the sound is with these headphones. The bass is good and the sound gets real loud real fast. I didn't have my laptop turned up very high at all and these were more than high enough. If you get these for your kids, warn them on the loudness.

title: Whoa! Scared myself with the sound being so loud
review: I can confirm that these earbuds work. I didn't expect the volume to be so loud on my phone, unless it was raised by the volume when I was unwrapping the cords. And after I got the volume down, my husband asked me why I didn't turn the volume down before I put them on. He had to tell me again after I removed the plugs due to the noise cancellation. I would say they work pretty well.

title: Charging already
review: I tried these on and I like them. Then I charged them and connected to my iPhone. The sound is really good. Only thing missing to make these great, is noise cancellation. But, since I will use them at night, it is pretty quiet in the house. These are great headphones at a good price from a good company. .

title: Made for young children
review: The one thing I don't like on this wired headphone, is the fact that it is wired. If it is used on a young child, they could get caught up in the wiring. Using it as a headband or to cover eyes works great. It is fleece material, so it is comfortable. The headphones can be removed ant the headband can be laundered as needed. I like that the speakers can only have the volume adjusted to a volume that is never too loud, so that a child never gets them so loud that they could damage their hearing

title: You can't beat these for the price
review: All of my grandchildren are getting headsets for Christmas. These are noise cancelling and work with most devices. You just can't beat the quality for the price. You can buy several of these for what you would pay for one of the others. You will be surprised by the headphones.

title: 3 hours of battery life?
review: I use my buds and headphones for more than just walking and talking and playing games. I also listen to podcasts at night and because these cannot endure enough battery life, I am stuck with either my headphones or earbuds. Other than that little issue, these are darn nice in-ear headphones. If you read the Amazon page, it will give you a lot of information on how to use them and how to tell which is left and right and what functions they do on the right and left.

title: Lasts 8 hours between charges.
review: The JVC wireless earclip sport headphone is a perfectly good headphone. I usually have issues with the earp piece and plugs. Maybe I just have a screwed up ear or something, but I have a problem getting them to stay on properly. I played around with it until I got a fit. Then I charged it up. It attached easily to my laptop, iPad and iPhone via Bluetooth. Started playing some tunes, some soft, light songs, others with lots of bass. I wasn't disappointed by either. Right now, these are my favorites. They are water resistant and when I am not wearing them, they can be magnetically closed so you don't lose them.

title: My Xbox players like Turtle Beach products
review: The boy will be excited when he gets this headset. His dad will be jelly. They both use Turtle Beach headsets and this is a big change from what they have. They will get more bass, better audio, better mic sound, better speakers and a more comfortable fit. That is all they want. That and the amplified sound.

title: After a while becomes uncomfortable in my ear
review: I was so excited to get this new Jabra. I haven't worn one lately. I charged it up and paired it with my iPhone 7+ and downloaded the Jabra app to make adjustments and to enable your Jabra to do all kinds of things - like message readout, email readout and others things. Not all smartphones will have the compatibility to do all the extra things, so make sure you download the app and follow instructions. Anyway, I hooked up my Jabra and it informed me that after a full charge, I had 6 hours. I chose to listed to podcasts on my iPad. I woke up in the middle of the night and the Jabra had my ear hurting and I had to swap to my headphones. I don't toss around, I sleep on my back in a recliner to prevent me from moving around. One thing I really noticed that irritated me, was that I never got the full sound from the Jabra unless I held it close to my ear with my hand holding it in place. Maybe I have weird ears, I don't know. But this is not a device I got enjoyment from.

title: A wonderful piece of professional headset that beats the old ones
review: If you have ever worked in a call center or a business where you had to use a headset, you will love this Jabra Engage 65. After this little guy is charged (you can sit your headset on the stand to charge) you get around 13 hours of battery life and you can walk around up to 490 feet. You are also able to connect two devices and it has a wireless connectivity. It is easy to set up to your desk phone and you can also set it up to work with your computer so you can use the Skype app. Make sure you read all directions carefully and if you are going to use a smart phone device as the soft phone, there are apps you will need, most importantly the Jabra Connect app. I am still playing with this little gem before I put it in use because I want to know everything I can do with it. I am thinking that since you can connect it to a computer, after you change your speakers to come from the Jabra, you should also be able to listen to music. The most important thing you want to know, is that this has noise cancellation microphone and enhanced speakers so that even the noisiest of offices should not be an issue.

title: Ear phones ar great
review: I charged these up and then tried them out. They fit nicely in my ear and the ear hooks and ear loops help them stay in place. I have had issues with those types of things previously, but on this set, they do what they are supposed to do. I am thrilled about this. Now, what would make the perfect, is if the charge lasted 12 hours, I listen to podcasts at night and 8 hours isn't going to be enough. With podcasts or with sleep music, bass is not a priority for me. But, because I have depression, I sleep longer than most people, even on my medication. Sometimes, I will wake up in the middle of the night and hear an interesting podcast, and with these staying in my ears, it makes it easier. My headphones are great but one pair slips around alot and the other pair which is a much better pair, has a very sensitive on off on the ear muff. But both of those will hold a good charge, These House of Marley are going to make for a better night's sleep without constant having to adjust the other headphones.

title: Lightweight, good sound, easy to pair
review: I have to say, I was pleasantly surprised how good this little pair of headphones work. The sound was good, with base coming through well. I have another set that I wear at night that I love, because they are noise cancelling. But, they tend to slip off my head and shut off until they are back in place. These will prevent that issue. They also did cut down on the outside noise. They are not as good at dampening sound as my other pair but at night, I don't hear a lot of noise other than my podcasts. And I have the other pair for when I need all the quiet I can get.

title: Love these noise cancelling, double mike headphones
review: These are now my most favorite headphones. They are noise cancelling and you can pair them with two devices at the same time. You get about 30 hours of listening time, which is great for me, because I listen to podcasts at night and don't want to have to fumble around for ear buds when my headphone runs out - which I have had to do in the past. What is really cool about these headphones, besides being blue tooth and noise cancelling, is that you can remove them and they stop playing your music or podcasts until you put them back on again. This also comes with an app that you download for android or iPhone and with that, you can set up to play radio or spotify to wake you up and a number of other tasks. I am still looking into the app. I highly recommend that you watch the video on the Amazon page to get a better idea on how to set these up and what they can do. The transparency allows you to pause while you listen to what is going on inside the room.

title: great sound, sweatproof and stays in my ears
review: As wireless Bluetooth earbuds go, these are great. They fit better than the previous Jaybirds but I detest the charging method. As it goes with many of the wireless buds, you have to attach the charging portion to specially aligned ports. As with others of this design, I just don't like having to fiddle around with them and would love to listen to them all night long - which requires charging if I sleep for more than 8 hours. They are great for running and sports. What is nice, is that they charge for 4 hours and then you can connect the charging clip and they work for an additional 4 hours. The sound is very good and when you download the app and set up how you want your sound, it is great. You can change the settings to your liking.

title: great traveling companion
review: For a little desk fan, this one has a good amount of cooling. I hooked it up to my laptop and had plenty of air coming out. More so than other USB fans I have tried. I am one of those people that needs a fan at night while they sleep, when I go on vacation, I will have that now. Otherwise, I have a difficult time sleeping. The only thing I think needs improvement, is the sound. It is somewhat loud for a small fan but since I wear ear plugs or headphones at night while I listen to podcasts, it will not bother me as much as it will bother my husband. Poor guy has to live with me.

title: I have heard better
review: These earbuds are just okay. To me, the sound is tinny. In phone conversations, the receiver can hear me well but doesn't hear others that are in the room with me making noises and adding their two cents to the conversation. The sound with a connection to my iPhone does not sound normal, though. These will be fine for working out but I would not make them my primary buds. I have earphones and earbuds that have much better sound. I also don't like how you have to remove the stabilizer to charge them. Very easy to lose that piece.

title: Carry your Nintendo Switch with ease
review: This is a perfectly good case for carrying your Nintendo Switch, accessories and games. Most people end up with earbuds, chargers for car and home, screen cleaners and other miscellaneous items and this provides a nice way to keep them neat and organized for travel or for home. The case has foam compartments for your console and controllers and has a Velcro net bag for other the accessories. The zipper tends to hang and mom or dad may have to lend a hand, as getting around the rounded corners can be a bit difficult. The carrying handle is rubber as is the edges of the case where the zipper is located. Overall, nice case.

title: Find your electronics happiness
review: These TeckNet cables came in just in time. I noticed that one of my usb micro cables wasn't charging my headphones and decided to investigate. I took a picture so I could show you what happened. The old usb micro cable was coming apart where it plugs into the device! With this six pack of 4 different lengths of cables, I should be back in business for some time. It pays to buy multiple cords because with kids, they go through them quickly and they don't unplug them by the ends, they just yank them out. I plugged in the longest one and immediately attached it to my headphones, I like the extra long cable, because I can charge my headphones while I listen to my podcasts or music while I sleep. The smaller ones are great to use on my laptop for a quick charge nearby. I am a happy camper right now. You never know where you might find your happiness. I found mine this morning in a small box from TeckNet.

title: Phenomenal sound.
review: I got these headphones today, charged them, used the N for the NSB Blue tooth, which my iPhone accepted immediately and started playing my tunes. The sound is amazing. I am sitting next to my son who is playing xbox One Forza and I cannot hear the game at all. I was able to hear my barking dog, he just wasn't as loud. The battery life is not as long as my other pair of Bluetooth earphones, but the sound is definitely better. These do not have a bass adjustment. However; with digital sound, you should not require any changes to bass, as you will hear the digital music as it was intended. They come with beautiful packaging, a usb cord dedicated to the earphones  and a manual. English instructions are there, just not first, as we are accustomed,

title: soft siicone that won't hurt your ears while keeping your pods in place
review: I am one of those people that has a difficult time keeping earbuds in my ears. These help. Normally, my Apple EarPods will just fall out. These help keep them in place. It helps with the EarPods just falling out of my ear. So annoying. These are practical, inexpensive and work. Something like this should come with all earbuds, Apple or not, because I have issues with all earbuds slipping out of place.

title: NoiseHush Nx80 Earplugs
review: Nice, inexpensive earbuds. Has a decent sound. I go through earbuds quite often, generally the breakdown is at the end that goes into my ipod (thanks to my granddaughter). If they could come up with a pair that prevented pulling out by the cord from the unit, then I would not need nearly as many. Comes with a pouch and several sets of different sized ear buds.

title: Improved Sound
review: I'm a specs guys. Found it really difficult to spend any money on something like this but the sound upgrade in quality is worth it. While the battery life is not as long as the previous versions, I never found myself out of battery from listening to headphones 24/7 except when in the office. In that case I had only had them in for noise cancelling. Funny story a sales manager told me to turn them down once so she could continue ranting and raving while talking over everyone around her. Now that I have these noise cancelling head phones and get to work from home everyday until at least 2022 (fingers crossed) this won't ever be a problem anymore. They are great for blocking out sound from bathroom toilets flushing when hard at work tho in an office setting I don't feel I should be subjected to sitting directly near the toilets anyway. What can I say, whether blocking out rude sales managers or toilet flushing these are the best. Great for gaming too, I find myself x10 better when focused and not even noticing loud stomping, yelling, or other peoples phone conversations when I have these in.

title: this is a must-have for me
review: the earbuds are too easy to lose this around my neck makes it easier to walk around. I don't use them much for talking on the phone I use them mostly just for listening to music or shows

title: Great! So much beeter than the first ones!
review: I purchased the first buds and those went back! They were so HORRIBLE! These are hands down the best earbuds I have ever owned! I am so glad I gave them another shot!!! Worth the price!

title: Good Bones
review: These headphones are amazing and they really do improve hearing the music without blocking your peripheral hearing.

title: Great for Travel and Kids!
review: I bought these for my 10 year old (he has large head) for iPad use in the car. We've gone through two or three pairs of regular over-the-ear headphones in the past year or two. I think we've finally found a winner! Sound quality is good, quality of the materials seems good and, best of all, they can get smashed in the seat pocket, stuffed in a backpack, sat on or tossed around the car without damage! He can even fall asleep in them and not be uncomfortable. They do make his hair a little crazy but definitely not a concern for a child. :) Highly recommend.

title: great buy
review: these work as advertised.  they take crappy sounding, bassless ipod stock earbuds and make them sound at 100% better (mainly more bass).  Don't get me wrong, your not going to get audiophile quality here, just MUCH better.  I had to bump up the mid to highs via the EQ on my ipod to even things out.  For the price, it was well worth it.  The little carry case they give you is darn handy also.

title: Ok for the cost. Meh at best.
review: Over All these headphones are a good deal for the $. However don't expect anything but mediocre quality with the sound quality which because distorted and then corrects itself. Thus seems to happen if watching a movie with a lot of sound affects. The fit is good. Better than those cheap buds that are constantly falling out of the ear. But again, for the low $ it is an overall good set of headphones. Worth mentioning that the packaging was nothing more than a plastic sack. I thought that odd for a brand like Sony.

title: BEATS ALL OTHER HEARING DEVICES
review: I've purchased three different systems before this one.  This one is more expensive but it will be the last one  you purchase. You can hear with the TV sound is off.  Not having an adjustment knob on each speaker is the same as not having it on headphones...but not a problem and with the advantage that you can  speaker up or down for a difference in volume

title: These kill the Signature Sennheiser 598 sound
review:
Some of us are more discerning than others. To me, these absolutely killed the sound stage and gave the cans a muddy sound, producing more bass (could be a plus) but washes out the crisp mids and highs.

I watch movies with 598SE's. Also classical music and some rock. I sent these pads back. They killed the 598SE incredible sparkly experience.

They were denser and harder and not as comfortable, not even close, as the originals.

They are probably comfortable "enough" if you don't wear them for hours or are not sensitive like that. And, they still sound like decent headphones, but just not great like originals. And, its nearly impossible to find true oem replacements. And if you do, 50 bucks is insane. So, I can see why people buy these. But, not for me.

title: Love the ten pack of headphones I use them all ...
review: Love the ten pack of headphones I use them all the time there really great and at a good price so if your looking for some headphones get these they are  a good product

title: great headphones, better than previous H2O models
review: I've been an H2O devotee for about three years, I bought the housing for my I Pod Video model and have been swimming with it ever since. I had the original headphones that came with it, the sound quality on them was not great and hard to get the volume up high enough to hear it on a lot of the spoken word I listen to at the pool at the gym. These new ones are great, I get listen to podcasts and books that I could never have listened to before on my old headphones because these fit in the ear and are just louder. Sound quality is better too. A suggestion for fit- put them in your ears before you get your ears or the headphones wet, they do fit better and require less adjusting later.

title: Don't be scared! It's great!
review: This product makes me giddy!! I was a little aprehnsive about taking my iPod underwater but after all the research I did here and elsewhere nobody had a bad experience with it. I bought it for swimming laps (leisurly pace) and I thought it might be a little cumbersome but when you're in the water the thing is weightless and even strapped to my arm it doesn't bother me in the least. You MUST buy their headphones seperately, it doesn't come with them and you have to use them or it is not waterproof. I think this is my favorite iPod accessory, besides swimming with it I take it to the spa and in the bathtub!

title: DO NOT BUY
review: Headset broke after using for less than a month and now they can’t be sent back.  The window to return has expired!

title: Great for problem sized ears that don't play well with earbuds
review: I love these, because no earbuds fit me well. I'm forever engaged in a battle to keep them in, especially if I'm running and sweating like crazy. They're a little mysterious to figure out how to put on, but once you get that figured out, you're golden. They don't fall out and they don't hurt the back of your ears like some external headphones do. Definitely worth the purchase if you can't get earbuds to work particularly well for you.

title: great headphones for the price
review: These headphones are durable and quality of the sound is reasonably good. Good sound isolation too. My only concern is that rubber attachments sometimes suddenly come off and fly away in unknown direction, and the headphones don't come with the same attachment to replace. I specifically prefer double ring attachment. Attachments from other genetic headphones don't fit well.

title: Great headphones, glitch with Spotify.
review:
Headphones sound awesome, easily pair with your phone, and have about a 5-6 hour runtime. I use an iPhone 8+.
Cannot skip songs using the spotify app though, which I find incredibly annoying when I am unable to grab my phone to switch songs.
If you are an avid spotify user, I would suggest another brand. Otherwise, the skip track works great in pandora and music apps on apple.

title: Easy to use, inexpensive wired headphones
review: These are so inexpensive compared to expensive headphones, but they work so much better. They actually stay in my ears compared to wireless earbuds. They have an easy to use set-up with plug and play. They also have easily accessible and use buttons to change the volume, which are lower down than most headphones I have used, so it is easier to use than most. Love it!

title: Broke After 1 Week
review: These broke after one week of use. I could never even get the microphone application to work anyways. The earbuds were uncomfortable in my ears and even with using alternative size buds, they just never felt comfortable. They are cheap and not worth your time or money.

title: Good for two years now.
review: Apparently got these back in mid 2020 for my ATH M50X headphones.  Been using them essentially daily for 2 years.  Still basically good as new. Very pleased.

title: Very happy with them so far
review: Got these for work so I could leave my ATH-M50s at home.  Very happy with them so far, use them regularly, not quite as comfy and definitely not the same incredible audio quality of my M50s, but comfortable and still sounds much better than most headphones I've used.

title: Disappointed.
review: I bought these expecting a good headset for day to day use.  It kinda fulfilled this, but the cord let it down so hard.  Audio quality was good enough but degraded as volume control appeared to wear out despite never being used.  Replaced with Audio Technica headphones and dedicated mic, and gave to my girlfriend, who's notoriously rough use has badly damaged the thin cable and weak connectors beyond what can easily be repaired.

title: Good splitter.
review: Had this for quite a while now.  Use it with several headsets / headphones and mics with great success on my laptop and smartphone.  No complaints.

title: Just get some command strips
review:
I bought this stacking kit when I purchased the FiiO E12A Mont Blanc IEM Special Edition Portable Headphone Amp, Titanium so I could connect it to my FiiO X5 High Resolution Music Player (2nd Generation)(Titanium). It is easy to set up, but it sure is ugly once you get it on there. Some of you may like that - I thought it looked kind of cool, like a weird set of custom recording gear or something. But the rubber bands used to hold the headphone amp onto the back of the DAP were strange looking. They also get in the way of the E12A’s USB port, so I would have to scoot the bands out of the way when I needed to get in there. They got in the way of the X5’s volume keys too, but you won’t need to use those if you’re using a headphone amp.
I eventually broke the plastic frame on one of the cutaways for the rubber bands when I was trying to put my X5 back in. It’s thin in a few spots, and the plastic cracked. Instead of buying another one, I used some Command Strip Picture Hanging Strips (sort of like velcro, but without the fuzzy strip) to snap them together. It looks neater, and it’s easier to use.

title: BLUETOOTH YOU CAN HEAR... Loud like Beats!
review: I've needed something like this for years!  I've tried nearly every stereo Bluetooth headset that I can get my hands on from Motorola, Plantronics, Bose, Beats, etc.  While I like my small Plantronics and the volume from Beats, but both have issues.  The Plantronics doesn't get loud enough for some applications, and the Beats headphone is just too big to carry around all the time.  This amplifier will allow you to use a standard wired, replaceable headset with your Bluetooth devices (computer, phone, etc) at a decent volume.  Thank you, Japan!

title: Sound is okay, product hurts like hell
review:
These are incredibly uncomfortable. My ears don’t particularly stick out, but these headphones squash them and hurt after several minutes. An oblong ear pad would have been an improvement.

Given that they sync with my car and phone, I have to fumble to switch to phone audio if I get a call while somebody is using them in the vehicle. Would be easier if they had a built in microphone.

Also, if you have hair longer than an inch, it’ll get caught in the joints and get torn out.

Aside from that, easy to set up, good battery life, okay construction.

title: Better than expected, especially for the money
review: These headphones took some time for me to get used to how they feel in my ears. I'm coming from mainly using the Apple Earpods and was used to how those felt in my ears "at rest", and comparatively these always felt like they were going to fall out. Once I got used to the different feel, these were worth it in my eyes for the better sound quality. Not sure about durability yet, but so far it seems that these might last longer, and at $10 less than new Earpods for a better product, no complaints here.

title: Wow, simply wow.
review: Other reviewers no doubt have already vocalized my thoughts better than I could hope to, as I am merely an aspiring audiophile rather than an actual one. In any case, these are the first noise-isolating earphones that actually stay in my ears, and I would argue for the size, the sound quality is right on par with (if not superior) to that of my Bose QC15s.

title: cute
review: The headphones look cute, my granddaughter loved them.  They lasted through 6 months of school. kinda disappointed

title: OK
review: These are good headphones. I bought them for my little sister for Christmas. She really liked them but they broke with 6 months of her getting them. I'm not sure if that is a product defect though because she is generally really hard on headphones.

title: Wanted to love these, but I can’t
review:
Pros -
Mask is comfortable and blocks out light
No need to wear earbuds to listen to music
Mask is lightweight
Mask doesn’t have any odd odor

Cons -
The quality of the speakers in the mask are SO incredibly poor

Audiophiles steer clear of these

title: The Best Bluetooth Headphones Ever
review: These are by far the best blue tooth headphones I have used.  They arrived mostly charged (enough to last about 3 hours right out of the box).  They paired easily with more than one device, the sound quality is excellent and they are very comfortable to wear.  They also come with various size replacement ear buds and ear hooks.  A great product and a great deal for the price.

title: These are probably the best bluetooth headphones around
review: These are probably the best bluetooth headphones around.  Light, attractive, work extremely well, easy to pair......what more can I say...I love these.  Bought a second pair.

title: Great Sound - No Problems
review:
This is a great portable CD player. The quality of the sound is excellent with no skipping. The headset is also good quality with nice comfortable ear buds.

There are much cheaper versions available, but this Sony version is well worth the price.

title: A lot disappointed
review: A lot disappointed. The sound comming out of these headphones is very clear and precise however, they don't crank up as I'd like. When I want to listen to music I want to be able to turn the sound down, I have my Galaxy grand prime at max audio and it doesn't matter what I do to these headphones, the sound remains the same. They still sound like 50% audio. I turn the volume knob up or down, zero difference.

title: A good cable
review: A good cable. Nice and thick, not skinny and cheesy. I used this, a 2.5mm splitter, and two one foot cables to build my own short, 2 1/2 ft assembly for my headphones. It worked out great.

title: BUYER bEWARE
review:
My husband thinks he is a motorbike when he sleeps. In other words, he horrifically snores. These headphones are the perfect solution. I put on calming Zen music and I drift off into blissful sleep WITHOUT hearing him at all! TAKE MY MONEY!!!!
Edit: This product died after a month. Cannot even get them to turn on. BUYER BEWARE!!!!

title: Last long
review: These earbuds last for pretty long. I am pretty impressed. I think the price is reasonable for the quality

title: Touch controls no good
review:
Touch controls are slow to react. The delay is 1 second. I had to turn on sound for touch control to make sure the touch worked. In 30% of cases it fails. At the same time when you try to fix earphones position in your ear, controls can do something unintended, stop, skip, increase volume dramatically . 2 second touch doesn't work for me to control ANC. I have to use their app that uses phone battery, takes space, access my phone data.

They are not very comfortable. My ears hurt and skin feels irritated after three hours of wearing them. It's the hard plastic part that hurts.

There is no place for the charging cable in the case. Cable is huge and thick. Cable should be small and should fit into the case so everything could be carried around in one place.

Those earphones need design improvement in the sense of comfort and functionality.

I tried to use it during the flight, the noise cancelling does not work, soundcore was no use during the flight.

I tried to use it to call my phone. The sound is impossibly loud when I dial and there is no way to turn it down, touch function doesn't work while dialing. Microphone sound/ clarity is very poor, I tested it with my own voicemail.

It's only good to listen to music at home. I would not recommend it for use while flying or to make important calls.

title: Relly low quality earbuds.
review:
Really disappointed. Maybe it's a fake item?
I bought similar Skullcandy S2INDY-134 before from this seller http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B004P1ITVC/ref=oh_aui_detailpage_o00_s00?ie=UTF8&psc=1

and they fit and sound fine. It was an excellent item that lasted for two years of heavy use before the wire finally broke off .

This Skullcandy S2IKDY-133 is horrible. Plastic is cheap and rough, not polished, they fall out of my ears, rubber is shorter than in S2INDY-134 and doesn't fit tight, I hear all the sounds around me. The sound quality is bad. Like this pair was made in some underground sweatshop. I can't use it. Really really got unlucky with this purchase. Probably won't buy headphones on Amazon again. Too dangerous to get a cheap bad deal.

title: Impressed
review: I'd like to recommend this headset after I had a trip to Austin with it, the ANC feature was impressive. Also, it is light, comfortable and not expensive. You will get much more than you paid for!

title: Look for other options
review: This headset continuously slides off the back of my neck so if you're not paying attention you can lose it the noise cancelation I don't know that exist but when I'm chewing my mom came hear everything

title: Great buy, recommend to friends and family!
review: These are the coolest headphones I’ve ever had in my life by far. Not upset. Definitely recommend. They also fit pretty comfortably for me, but I also have an about averaged sized melon lol.

title: Great fine...
review: These headphones are a great quality and work great for my use. I Love the fact that they reach around my neck well enough so that they don't slip off. The sound quality is good. I would recommend them to friends and family.

title: USB ports broken within weeks.
review:
Ordered 3 of these.

Many issues with the USB ports for charging.

None have ever worked with charging my ps4 controllers.

One of the towers currently is not charging my iphones, iPad, Apple Watch, or a headset.

The normal ac plugs work fine.

Absolutely ridiculous for the USB ports to be broken this fast.

Will update this review as I talk to sellers.

title: Very cool, great sound, but heavy.
review: Very cool headphones, look cutting edge and green pulsating light is a nice touch. The sound on these is top-notch and the vibration button really makes the deep bass rumble! They are very noise-cancelling and well built, on the large size. Just a bit too heavy for my comfort, although my son loves them. Wish there was a switch to shut off the light because they stay lit even when the PC is shot off. For the price, these phones rock!

title: the BEST replacement for the iPhone 5S
review: This is, hands down, the BEST replacement for the iPhone 5S! And it’s compatible with my Beats by Dr. Dre Pro, which never happens. Those are the hardest headphones to find accessories for. I love this cable! And the built in remote allows me to answer my phone and command Siri. I have absolutely no problems hearing others, and they have no trouble hearing me through the mic. You can also change tracks with the remote. This is by far the best and ONLY replacement I will ever need to purchase!

title: Great, not noise canceling, lasted 35 days
review:
Update:9/2/22
The left ear bud has randomly been going on and off, thought it needed charged (I’ve only charged the once since I bought them. And use them daily). Nope. Left earbud is all static and clicking. :(.

I needed a replacement for my $200 beats. These are a great. Easy to pair, and don’t slip!

I hated the noise canceling on the beats (I like to hear cars coming).

title: Impressive for the price point
review:
Overall, for a low cost over the ear earphone, these are very impressive! I've purchased and returned several in the 30-$100 range. All with major issues w/ bluetooth, sound quality, and overall quality.

If you are used to $200+ noise cancelling earphones, these are not in the same caliber, but are one of the best pair I've found that are under $200.

Pros: Easy to connect to bluetooth,
Long range of bluetooth (able to walk about 40-60 feet away, and outside of the house). (This was comparable to my AKG $300 pair).
Looks are nice
Quality of materials (while plastic) seem durable
Size of ear piece is much lager than most, and fits well over my ear! Better than the AKG's and other's I've tried.
Fast charge, and long battery life.

Cons:
Not noise cancelling. Things are quiet, but I prefer to hear a little road noise when I'm walking. (so for me this is a plus).

Overall, I think these are a great option, and are thinking about getting a second pair.

title: No driver included.
review:
The concept is fine and I finally found an audio out jack on my LG TV. LG did not put a Bluetooth output on their top of the line TV. I had to use a Bluetooth transmitter from another product since none was included with the headphones
Volume is a problem with them. I normally use a volume setting of 8 on the TV. With these headphones I has to use a volume setting of 40 to hear speech.
I was impressesat first, but the lack of any gain sort of killed that.
I could not comment on quality of the sound because of the lack of gain. Maybe it is great, I just could not hear hear it.

title: Disappointed
review: So upset about it for NASCAR in Phoenix it is a louder track than most the unit would not turn up enough so we could hear we tried three different types of headphones none of them worked it was the unit itself

title: Just as expected, I've had many
review: Apple earbuds just as expected, good quality, and will probably buy them again when I destroy these.

title: Super Value Amp
review: Using this little amp as an headphone amplifier.  Well built small unit.  Lots of inputs, little heat generation (no fan required).  Treble and Bass controls work very well.  This is a very nice amp at a very low price.  Most happy with this purchase!

title: Great for the hard of hearing....
review: Bought these for my hard of hearing 96 year old father.  Most headphones produce so much bass that it makes it impossible for the hearing impaired to hear the dialog in movies and other TV broadcasts that have music in the background.  I had tried all types of headphones for him, but none worked until now.  These headphones do not produce an overwhelming amount of bass as all the others do.  It does have base, but not too much.  The headphones are comfortable,the in line volume control is a must have feature.  I cannot say enough good things about these.  I also purchase a small Pyle 40 watt amp to boost the output from the TV and to give him control of the bass and treble.  The combination of these headphones and the Amp (from Amazon) have made watching TV so much more enjoyable for him.

title: Disconnects. battery problems, now left side stopped working
review: Problems for the past 3 weeks now it is worse. Intermittent disconnects, reconnects, battery problems, now left side stopped working. The 2nd pair I bought for my girlfriend also has problems with sound & reconnecting.  The Base sound is mediocre compared to my old Senso BT and Sony headphones has much better sound compared to these. Cheap quality!!

title: Inexpensive but still Good Quality
review: These headphones are as described. They work great drowning out all the noise while I am working out! Would buy them again. My kids also love them.

title: Great sound, great cushion and great value
review: I bought these for my husband based on a video review that I saw on line for them. I did try them out before I gave them to  him, you know, so I could make sure they worked. These headphones block out a lot of sound even with no music playing. I love them, and he loves them!! I am really happy I bought these for  him. They expand to fit, the ear parts swivel so they can be packed flat and the ear pads themselves are very cushiony.

title: Poor quality
review: Poor quality. Did NOT work with our IPhone 8 + and headphones. Had to return item.

title: Satisfied with purchase
review: As described in description. Easy to use and comfy sleep headphones. Battery life is excellent was able to listen to my meditation music for 8 hrs. Woke up and the headphones still had a charge. I would recommend these sleep headphones.

title: Stay away from this product.
review:
First issue i have with this product is that the bass makes the crackling distortion sound. The volume is no better than the cheapest headphones you can buy from Amazon.

But the BIGGEST i have is the LIE about the playback time. I played this device for maybe 4 hours put it down and the next day i picked up my phone and the tribit and was DEAD😳🤔🤷🏽‍♂️🤯 WHAT HAPPENED TO THE 30 HOURS. I later let it charge for an entire 24 plus hours and it still did the same thing. When i turned it off and tried to use it again the next day. This product is a waste of the wait even if it were free. I can clearly distinguish a reduction in noise but there is also a clearly noticeable drop in volume. I was forced to give in a "1" Overall and in sound quality and volume control because there is no "0" on the scale.

I previously wrote a review on this product and they sent me a new pair. I'm upset because after laying that original money then getting a new pair I'm still getting the same result. This is just not a good product. There needs to be more sound , better sound quality and better power capacitance. I charged the item for close to 2 hours on 40% and I only had 80%. I went to "manscape" yeah it took close to an hour maybe even a few minutes longer but the girl told me "battery low!" Just before getting in the shower.

So now I've bought the Mpow and the Tribit over the ear headphones and they both are not worth buying. I had to use the earplugs instead.

title: Best buds I have own they are fantastic.
review: Man what a great pair of earbuds.  I have tried so many earbuds including Sony,Bose, Samsung and more and by far the nyz are the best. I'm so very happy with them. If I had one wish with the nyz I would like to see them waterproof. And the price is amazing I'm going to buy everyone in the family a par.

title: Great, but be ready to untangle the cable
review: The headphones are great. They sound amazing and the quality is terrific. I have a serious gripe though with the twisted cable. It tangles constantly. I have let it just sit and spin and it still feels like it wants to bind and tangle up. I really dislike that aspect of these headphones immensely.

title: amazing sound, but earpads get hot
review: I love these headphones. I had to buy the velour earpads to replace these stock ones though because the pleather got too hot on the ears. The unfortunate part is that it changed the sound signature a bit. Overall though I'm very happy with these.

title: Price is great and would definitely order again
review: Headphones work flawlessly. They are vibrant and work as described. Price is great and would definitely order again!

title: I like that the sound on them cannot be turned to ...
review: My son absolutely loves his Spiderman headphones.  I like that the sound on them cannot be turned to where it is dangerous for his ears.  This survived a vacation with a 4 year old who is pretty rough on things!

title: Samsungs do it better
review: I had a samsung galaxy 8+ when I purchased these and BOY-OH-BOY did these rock my socks! The features are sooooo great with the galaxy. Well, now I have an iPhone (yuck) and the features are not compatible with this stupid phone so they’re just another pair of bluetooth headphones. Don’t get me wrong, they still rock my socks as far as sound quality, durability, overall quality goes BUT zero features, zero special app, zero-ness. Sigh. Iphone sucks, not these headphones.

title: No app for iPhones
review: These are not compatible with iPhones. They will not connect to the Samsung buds app so there is no way to tweak or access the features. They do connect via Bluetooth but you might as well just get a pair of $20 headphones because there is no way to make changes to the settings or access features.

title: Disappointed returned.
review: I own multiple pairs of wireless earbuds. Apple pro, Samsung buds+ and these.  I wear a headphone nearly 24/7. I sleep with them in to cancel out my partners snoring and to listen to something while I do everything. I decided to return the Sony pair. Unlike the other two, these were the largest devices. Even though I could fit them to my ear, after an hour they would be drooping and falling out. I could never get them to stay in my ears. There is nothing to keep them inside my ear and they are not balanced weight wise. The sound was comparable to the AirPod pros. Because they droop, they would initially do great canceling out noise, but would fail as they fell out. Overall I thought they were just ok in comparison to the Samsung for fit and apple for sound quality. The case does not have wireless charging unlike the other two. The Bluetooth connection was less reliable in comparison. It frequently disconnected when worn throughout the day and dropped the connection at a shorter distance. Disappointed.

title: Seems like a perfect fit for Bose Quietcomfort 15
review: This cord fit perfectly in the headset side that goes into the Bose Quietcomfort 15. The downside is that it is as flimsy as the original Bose cord. There are better cords to use as a replacement.

title: Does not replace Bose Quietcomfort 3
review: The Bose Quietcomfort 3 headset requires the angled end of the cord to be 2.5 mm. Be very careful when choosing which cord to replace your old one. Other than that the quality of this cord seems much better than the Bose original cord.

title: These are the best Bluetooth headphones I have ever had
review:
**update** these headphones have been great until recently. Even though the battery is fully charged they will shut off without warning and will not sync when I turn them back off.
These are the best Bluetooth headphones I have ever had. The battery lasts a really long time, they don't fall out when working out, and have a good range for staying connected when walking away from your device.

title: Good but
review: Loves these headphones.  The sound was great, they didn't fall out of my ears, and they were comfortable. Now after a month they won't charge.  Very disappointed 😔

title: Save your money
review: I bought this because I have a pc headset that I wanted to use on my playstation 4 and this did not work at all. No matter how you plug it all in it doesn't work at all. Really disappointed

title: It’s a safe option, that’s for sure.
review: They did refund me for my broken headset that quit working after a very short time. Nothing necessarily bad to say about this protection plan. Although, I feel like the redeeming your warranty process could’ve been easier. Maybe that’s just me though.

title: Left bud doesn't work. Always disconnects or does play at all
review: I can only write a review on half the product. Only half of it works. one earbud works, the other constantly connects and disconnects. Very disappointed as it was a Christmas present and they are less than three weeks old. I would recommend you spend the extra money and get a decent pair.

title: Sturdier and heavier than I thought it would be
review:
I'm using this on my desk to hold my large monitor and all the accoutrements that go along with having a home office - pens, extra paper, extra headset, remote for the 32"TV I use for a monitor. I was afraid that the monitor wouldn't work with this and I was prepared to be disappointed. Absolutely am not. It is far sturdier than I thought bamboo would be, nice looking, and it is perfect. I think if I ever close down my home office, I'll find a way to keep this and use it.

I'm going to add to this review: While I've had no problem with this unit, per se, I can still see where shoddy workmanship could have affected its use. I think I was lucky, it came undamaged with all the parts in the correct order and space. However, the backs of both drawers are uneven. I guess you could say crooked. It doesn't affect the way the drawer fits into the unit until you look down at the drawer and realize it isn't really a rectangle, more like a trapezoid. I'm glad I was one of the lucky ones who received a working unit, however, I think I'll avoid this company if I buy something similar again.

title: Fairly good headset
review:
I wear a headset for the better part of a day. I like to use headsets rather than the phone handset because it keeps my hands free.

These definitely do the job with noise cancelling and the volume control works very well. I've been told once or twice that people have trouble hearing me at times, but since I don't know if that's the headset or their phones, I deducted a single star.

My only complaint is the clip that puts the volume control and mute button together is very difficult to hook onto anything other than very thin fabric. I have to struggle to get it on and off my jacket during the day. My suggestion to the manufacturer, make the clip easier to slide fabric into or make it a clip that opens.

title: Not just for gaming use
review:
I used these connected to my computer to answer calls during the day. These interfaced easily with my computer so they turned into my permanent go to's. I have tested these thoroughly with a couple of customers to make sure that what I was saying was getting out there with no interference. Noise cancellation did very well. The sound quality, as I've heard myself recorded also, if very good for a relatively inexpensive set of headphones. I also like the way the ear pads fit more over the ear than on top of it, as compared to a couple other headphones I've used.

I have no idea what these would be like for gaming, as that isn't the reason I bought them, but the clarity would certainly lend itself to gaming. If you are shopping for affordable headphones that are a bit sturdier than others out there, this would be a good choice.

title: Nice headset for listening to audio books
review:
I needed a headset that I could plug into my phone, my kindle, and my computer. These were sort of cute, so I figured what the hey? I'll give them a try.

They fit good, and while listening to audio books, as long as I keep the volume in the mid range (and who wants books screamed at them?), it does great. I wish they'd made the volume control a little bit more intuitive. Instead of dealing with the headset, I used the volume control on whatever I had plugged them into. Be advised, and I would hope this is only mine but don't know, if you turn up the volume too high, there is a lot of distortion and some noise that comes through the headset. The distortion was the most irritating to me, thus why I adjust the volume on the device, and make sure it doesn't go over mid range.

For the money, these are functioning, cute headsets

title: Far sturdier than I thought it would be.
review: When I ordered this, I'd planned to run it behind one of my monitors, assuming that the female connector wouldn't be all that sturdy and I wanted to keep it out of harm's way as I tend to be very rough with things that are on my desk. This was for the headset I wear while I'm on the phone during the day, which came with far too short a cord to be of any use. This extension cable works perfectly and it won't become disconnected easily, which is a huge plus for me!  As always, if something changes, I'll post an addendum here.

title: Color me very pleased
review:
First, after reading all the negative reviews (along with the positive), I'd decided that if they arrived in anything other than perfect condition, they would be returned. Well, surprise. They arrived in fine shape. I got them out of the packaging, hooked up my iPod and got on the treadmill. The sound was really, really good with these, considering the price. They adjust well, and their noise cancellation is spot on. I didn't expect them to be perfect with noise cancellation because of the price and quality.

The one thing I can see that would be a deterrent to these is that you HAVE to handle these carefully. You cannot be rough when adjusting, you can't toss them down on hard surfaces. In other words, you have to take care of these headphones, just like they cost 10 or 20 times more. I'm very pleased as I need lightweight phones, not bulky ones, when I work out and when I'm just listening for pleasure.

title: Replacement headset
review:
I bought this as a replacement headset for my Dragon software. The first headset, and the one that came with the software, disintegrated when I put it on last week. It seems that everything fell apart at once. This one is a bit different style so I am hopeful it will work out. A couple of things I noticed though. I tend to wear the ear piece high on my ear, but that means the microphone dips too far down. So I've made the headpiece a little larger, moved the earpiece down a bit and it puts the microphone just where it needs to be. The other thing is that the microphone bar, I guess you could call it, is very loose. It only has one position and cannot be adjusted. This doesn't bother me too much, but I realized it might bother other purchasers, so I wanted to make sure I mentioned it.

Overall, it appears to be working well.

title: Not expensive, yet very satisfactory
review: I ordered these because of the reviews they'd received regarding the sizing and the sound.  All of the good reviews are right on. These are NOT $300 headphones but they have decent noise-cancelling properties for the price.  In addition, they stay on my ears when I'm exercising which is always nice.  My only complaint is that the headphones themselves are just a hair too big for my head, so even adjusted to the smallest size/length, they could still be a bit shorter.  But because of the way they're built, they still stay stable on my head. I'm pleased with this purchase. I didn't have to spend a lot of my money to get something that works.

title: Kitty Earphones with good audio
review: Just received these at the weekend, and they are perfect for an everyday set of earphones to carry in my purse.  Besides all of that, the earphones and case are just cute.  A small cat and a fish adorn the two earphones, and of course the cat and the word "meow" on the case.  On top of all that, the audio is good.  The last two pair of earphones I purchased, the audio was terrible, so I'm very happy with these.

title: Save an extra ten bucks and buy something that will work longer than a month
review:
If the cord is at all moved around from the headphones.. say you sleep w them or drop them on accident.. The opposing side will cut out completely. I could mot get the volume to work wo an outside source.
Not a fan. A model priced 2 dllars more has lasted 3x the amount.

title: Excellent for beginning music production!  - READ description
review: people always rant and rave about how there's not a ton of bass boost // for a set of 10 headphones they are extremely comfortable I was not looking for added bass // I am a producer and dj // it is very important to have controlled levels in your headphones in production // not ADDED bass and for mixing and mastering.... these are great! for 11.00 headphones the clarity (which is most important) is exceptional... I would definately recommend these for an inexpensive production set of cans... they do the job very well on a great budget // very heavy / comfy

title: LEFT EARBUD DOESN'T WORK!
review:
I read lots of people are having this or similar issue with left earbud not charging or having any sound at all... I ordered a replacement for the left earbud not working, SAME EXACT PROBLEM AS FIRST SET!

Garbage product!

title: Pretty good but still cuts out from time to time

title: What I've always wanted
review:
I have been wanting a product like this for years to replace wires when I exercise. So far in 2 months of owning these headphones I have not been disappointed. They fit well on my head (I saw reviews where people were upset about this). I am not picky about sound as some may be so perhaps a $$$ Bose may suit others but for the price this set is not bothering me.
I have used it for music (jazz, pop, rock) and even radio app, as well as, to via phone chatting.
The only issue I have had is with using my wifi there is a beep and the sound goes in and out. Not sure if this is universal or not but with regular phone (ATT) signal I have no issues on phone or radio app (nobex).
The battery lasts they say 8 hours but for me seems MUCH longer. I should say I have not timed it out. The instructions say to let the battery die completely and to charge 3 times to help battery last longer. In two months and what feels like hours and hours of listening I have only charged it I think twice. There is a beep that occurs when the battery is low.

As far as use goes... these headphones fit fine when I am jumping on my trampoline so if you are concerned about how they would be while running, I would say they work well.
I can go about 20-30 feet before sound goes in and out because of distance. I haven't measured it out but that seems a good estimate.

title: Excellent, but don't get the app
review:
I have had these for a day. They are absolutely amazing. Life changing, worth every penny. I have seen a lot of reviews where they were compared to AirPods Pros, but there is no comparison.

I bought them because I have a noisy (but lovable) neighbor. The noise cancellation on these is superior, but not for low, bassy, external sounds, but rather sounds in the higher range.

My advise, and to save you some time: Do not get the app. It is so invasive of your information, and I know all apps are, but this one is probably the worst. You can set up bluetooth with all your devices without the app, and use all the features, no problem.

It also has Alexa built in, which is insane, I have yet to pull the trigger on giving Alexa permission, but I think I will; there is an Alexa button, I THINK that's the only time it's listening. If you're like me, and you have Amazon Prime Music the combo is insane.

A few cons: the Noise Cancellation will pound your ears if you’re not listening to content. I didn’t know it could do this, but I can see why people say they can only wear them for so long.

Do not under any circumstance get the app. It’s much more invasive than any app I’ve seen (of tkunborher to read the privacy (publicity) statement. Your earphones can operate fine without the app.

title: Vs. Panasonic: Good Quality, Outstanding Value
review:
Having worn out several Panasonic headsets like this, I decided I'd try a less expensive alternative. Glad I did. The quality is on par with, or better than, the Panasonic versions that I've had (KX-TCA430). Voice quality and volume levels (on both ends) are as good or better.

The mute is a sliding switch. At first I expected to really dislike it as I was used to the Panny's push button. However I find that if you're muting yourself for more than a couple of seconds, the sliding switch is much better. Not having to hold a button in the entire time you're coughing or having a quick side conversation during a conference call is a nice plus.

The only issue, and it's minor, is the tension is a tiny, TINY bit tight on my noggin. That said, I've had LONG conversations with this on and never once thought about it. No pain or discomfort even after extended calls.

Overall, I'm extremely happy with this headset, especially for the price. Time will tell, but based on its construction and appearance, I expect it to last through several years of moderate use. In fact, I think I'll buy at least one more as a backup!

title: Work Great! Size and Sound Quality An Issue

Once they are seated (their design makes this easy) they can sound great. However, I have a big head. Some would say in more than one way, but these physically do not fit my head. The buds do not actually press into my ear. Therefore, the sound I get is very tin-ee (that "phone" quality). Unless these seat into your ear like any ear-bud they will sound cheap. Last week, less than 2 weeks after the 90-day warranty expired, the headband snapped in half while he was putting them on. While he is only 9, he is very mature for his age and is very gentle and trustworthy with his belongings so the issue was not abuse. Being so close to the warranty period and having such a serious design flaw I decided to write the company to see if they would fix or replace them. Nope. They asked me to jump through a bunch of hoops as though they were going to do the right thing, then said, "Contact a local technician to repair them". Right. For a $30 pair of headphones. I certainly didn't expect them to last forever - they *are* cheap - but I DID expect he would get a year's worth of use out of them for the price. Do not bother with these.
