title: Only cancels about 5% of noise
review:
I thought "They're cheap, why not?" I expected that Sony would at least make a semi-descent product, but I was wrong. They only cut out about 5% of ambient noise. I tested them in a lot of different environments and it didn't perform well under any circumstance.

I compared them to a pair of low-end headphones ($20) to set a baseline, see below.

Test:
In flight - no noticeable difference between each pair
While driving - slightly better muffling of midrange noise, but slight (2% better)
Fan on high & low - slightly better canceling of low freq noise (2% better)
In crowed auditorium - slight better muffling (1% better)

They barely did any better than the cheap-o, non-noisecanceling, over the ear headphones I got for half the price.

The biggest thing I noticed is that the very little amount of noise that was actively cancelled was replaced fully by a hissing sound. This made the headset pretty much useless.

I would recommend not buying these headphones. I returned the set I bought, and got my money back. There are better headsets at this price.

title: Just the perfect product and sound is 100% perfect
review:
Works perfectly !!! I use it for an old harman kardon boombox that did not have Bluetooth.
I use it also to stream from my iPhone to the etekti and then it is connected to the base of my DECT headset. Works100%. Very happy!!!

title: Best I've ever had!
review: I listen to Binaural Beats at night which requires me to listen to it from headphones. Regular headphones hurt over time especially when sleeping. These ones are so comfy! I get the best sleep at night thanks to these amazing headphones/eyemask combo! I highly recommend it if you want the best sleep of your life!

title: Great sound and battery, occasional mic pairing problem.
review: Pairing was easy.  Holds a good charge (6-8 hours).  Sound quality is fantastic.  Volume is louder than any other earbuds ever used and fit allows for noise to be isolated (best alternative to true noise cancellation) - actually takes some getting used to when you put these in and the outside world noise goes away.  Very similar to in-ear studio monitors.  Only complaint is they don't always pair the microphone which can be troublesome when trying to take a call, though the sound always pairs.

title: Perfect for my daughter.
review: My 6yr old needed an inexpensive headset for school. These are fairly light weight, inexpensive and cute. She loves the cat ears, of course.

title: Nice!
review: Bought these for my ten year old son.  He LOVES them. He doesn't like wearing headphones much, but he's got these on for hours and hours each day. They are surprisingly light weight for their size.  My wife wants a pair now too.

title: These are great headphones, especially given the fact they can be ...
review: Don't let the price fool you. These are great headphones, especially given the fact they can be had for less than $20.00.  I got them for my daughter and she rarely takes them off.  She says the sound quality is really good.  I listened to them myself and I was pleasantly surprised. They won't give Bose a run for their money, but we're talking about apples and oranges here.  The iJoys are one of the most comfortable set of headphones I've worn.  I have a larger than normal noggin and these fit on my head, as well as my daughter's w/o slipping or pinching.  We've had them for several months now and they are used daily.  No complaints.

title: Comfortable!
review: I bought these for my husband for because the ear buds can end up hurting your ears after a while and we both use our headphones almost every day and he loves these.  Now he has a small head so he wears a hat so that they dont move but that is not the headphones that is his head!  I would for sure buy these again!

title: Great product!
review: If you like the shape of Apple headphones you will love these. I can wear them for hours and they stay in place.

title: Great for running!
review: I LOVE my new Ipod!  The Nike Fit upgrade is awesome, and I love how I can see what my current pace is during my run. I use this one primarily for running, and not much for just listening to music, so I can't really judge on battery life.  I do, however LOVE the bluetooth feature, as I can run cord-free with my bluetooth earbuds.  I also bought this for my father who is a runner as well and he loves it too.  It's super light and small so it's great for traveling.  This is very easy to use and lightweight.

title: Best out there
review:
After trying all major brands (Philips, Sony, JVC, etc.) these are the first pair of headphones that last more than just a couple of months (I am a very sweaty guy and I use these at least 5-6 times per week to work out, so they have it rough), they produce great sound, they barely ever fall out of place even when running, the adjustable clip-on feature is very confortable and does not irritate the back of your ear at all, and the gum tip never falls off, without which you can't put them in your ears.

I am not ever switching to any other brand after trying these.

title: Price versus quality
review: Very nice set of earbuds. If you like an every day set for the price. These very nice fitting and sound in nice. Not to much bass though

title: Best Purchase
review: purchase Retekess TR101 Walkman Headphone Radio FM best purchase where I donate them to where I work what we need for the individuals help.

title: Not good as claimed
review: Not good as claimed. I bought one but only one but after 2 months, one side phone didn't work any more. Per my experience, many bad quality earphone are the same as this.

title: Incredible Earbuds
review: These are by far the best earbuds I've ever encountered! The sound quality is unbelievably fantastic. And the amount of noise cancelation they provide is even better. The Bluetooth stayed connected for as far as I needed to travel away from my phone with no buffering to remain connected. If you are looking for amazing quality, and a sleek, comfortable earbud, these are the ones for you! I highly recommend this product.

title: Absolutely Disgusting
review: I received broken, used, and dirty headphones. Absolutely appalled and disgusted. It looks like there is someone's EARWAX smeared all over the headphone.

title: Super comfortable. Noise quality is excellent
review:
Let me start off by saying, I've had the QC 15 and 20's. I've used Bose over the course of a decade for my travel. I wasn't planning on getting a new headset and was fine with my qc20 for a bit. But the gel like earbuds hurt after a long day of work. I happened to check out the sony mx4 during the prime day sale, but after watching the reviews online decided for the bose 700.
I use this about 8 hours a day. All of my calls are through my computer. I need something that's comfortable and can handle the extended use. I got this because the sony had really bad reviews on the call quality.

Call quality- no issues here. Given I'm using it in a small office with the hum of the AC.
Comfort- Extremely comfortable. The weight is minimal and doesn't give off that heavy sucking feeling after a few hours
Bass- It's ok. I'm not using it for hardcore bass anyways.
Noise cancellation- My office is in my backyard. With neighbors mowing their lawn throughout the day. This has helped filter it out.
Bose app seems pretty cool. But since it's connected to my laptop, I haven't had time to tinker with the settings.
Controls- I'm used to tactile buttons, but am not opposed to this.

I have a few trips coming up and I'll test these on an airplane soon.

title: Good for the price
review: Note, Windows is not updating 7 as of 2020......everything so far is working good. the volume is not that strong though. But using headphones or speakers does the trick. The battery does not last long when it's unplugged from the charger. Product did not show any damage. I wish that it was upgraded to  windows 10 though.

title: Awesome Headphones!!!
review: Great headphones! They are easy to use, hold a lasting charge, and block out all outside noise. Wish I would have bought these sooner

title: The weird square thing on the connector had to be ...
review: The weird square thing on the connector had to be cut, but I was able to clip it away with scissors and a box cutter knife, now it fits my headphones.

title: Great sounds, but it comes with wires
review:
Pros:
-Comes with 3 different size silicon(?) inserts for your ears
-Comes with a small device to clean the phones and buds
-Arms secure the headphones in place during vigorous activities
-Great sound range

Cons:

title: Large earbuds
review: The earbuds themselves are a little large and uncomfortable in my ears. However I only paid $10 for 5 pairs so I was not surprised. I am only using these to listen to audio books so the quality doesn't really matter.

title: Ok headphones but they fall out
review: They lasted almost 1 year to the day. The sound quality was good enough, the range is exactly as described, and they fit comfortably. I was using these in my workshop and while gardening.  They don't stay in place when moving around, they have a tendency to beep for no reason, the play time is somewhere around 4 hours, and it's difficult to get the charging cable into the port. They fell apart 2 weeks ago: the charging port went inside the earbud & the power button fell off.

title: Great sound
review: Some earbuds failed noise cancelling. This earbuds have great quality of the sounds, no noise.

title: EARPHONES ON THE GO!
review:
purchased the earphone as a birthday gift.
for the on the person , easy to pack
or plug up any place.

title: You won’t be disappointed!
review: I use these headphones daily in the gym. I love that they tell me when they’ve been successfully connected to my phone and when the battery is getting low. They are also super comfortable to wear and stay put even during heavy workouts. The carrying case is an added bonus, and is high quality. I can easily fit the headphones, charger, and an outlet cube for charging in the case, and it has a carabiner so I can attach it to the outside of my gym bag so I have more room inside. Unbeatable for the price and I will be repurchasing a second set for my son.

title: Works great
review: Does exactly what they're described to do. Love them. This has made keeping my cords organized much easier, and my teenager loves the earbud cord keepers, as he no longer pulls his headphones out of his pocket in a tangled mess. Though I did have to use some superglue on one of the cord clips... My thick Samsung Galaxy phone charger cord seemed to be a bit too heavy for it and it kept separating from it's foam backing. Little bit of superglue fixed the problem right quick. :)

title: Definitely not as nice audio quality as the Wingz 4.0 - and the Wingz are 1/2 the price.
review:
I bought these from Fry's - didn't like them one bit. Muffled audio, not clear or crisp at all. For $85, I wanted something that at least offered crisp and clear audio.

I returned them and purchase the Wingz 4.0 bluetooth headphones. WAY happier, and they only cost $45. The Wingz 4.0 are almost identical design, sound much better, and offer Bluetooth 4.0 with battery level indicator on my iPhone 5.

title: Not the greatest but work okay
review: As soon as I opened the headphones I noticed that the rubber ear bud covering was already torn. It's very thin and flimsy but I was able to still use them even though the product was received less than desirable. Other than that, they stay on pretty well when running.

title: Solid
review: I really like these headphones but for for work related stuff.  I'm able to take in spoken information and not completely block out everything around me.  Plus sound quality is fine backup if I leave the 400 dollar Sony ones behind. Those put you in another world.  These are for multitasking

title: I ca't get him to take them off.
review:
Heading cross country on a trip and figured the 11 yr old needed a new pair of headphones for his iPad. Well it's been 2 weeks and he loves them. Now if I can make sure he doesn't break them before we leave. Did I just jinx myself? I bet I did.

He was impressed by the play/pause button on the cord. We can't figure out if it's also a volume control. He threw the packaging away to fast.

title: Just what we needed.
review: With the new iPad Pro and Air Pods the boy just wanted his big headphones to use. So along comes this little gadget to help.

title: They switched.
review: I grabbed these for my 13 yr old daughter and grabbed another set for my 15 yr old son. Well they decided to switch. So now these are the 15 yr olds and I will say I can't hear his music like I can when my Mr. wears his headphones. I don't think he has used the mic yet as he's just watching videos on his ipad. Though we grabbed these to work with the xbox.

title: Yay! The Wife is Happy.
review: I grabbed these b/c I was tired of listening to the crazy videos the Mr. watched while I tried to read. While I can still here sound OUTSIDE of the headphones, he LOVES them. Told me to give them all the stars.

title: Stay far away from thses! They are total JUNK ...
review: Stay far away from thses! They are total JUNK! I cant believe they would even try to pass these off as headphones.

title: I have 6 headsets in my drawer right now...and this one is by far the best
review:
I have never written a review on a product, but I feel like I must on this headset.

I work remotely and average 17 hours a week of phone time.

My company gave me a Plantronic headset first and the wiring went out, then I moved on to a Logitic I after time and time again the USB port was a pain in the behind. The biggest challenge was they were both VERY BIG and BULKY.

I found this GE headset and Best Buy and decided to give it a shot....1 because it was less than $20, 2 because I could plug it in to my cell phone, VOIP system, and landline, and finally because it was light foam not this big and bulky headset.

I LOVE IT! My first one finally tanked after 18 months but really I did not expect it to last forever. I literally use this for work, personal and it has seen a lot of hours.

I am ordering two more right now.

title: Omg so cute
review: I LOVE THEM they are so cute! I’m letting them charge rn but it’s adorable. The pink in the middle is like the EXACT color I wanted it’s not like a rose color it’s like a pale pink and I’m so happy I bought this. I was in between Sony earphones and these and not only does this have more color options but it looks just as good… literally so cheap I love it GET. IT.

title: Best earbuds I've ever had
review: I bought these to replace a pair that I bought years ago these are the best earbuds I've ever seen because you can squeeze the little thing and put it in your ear and it expands so they stayed in your ear they also sound great I would highly suggest these to anybody

title: Sound is great!!
review: This EarFun Free earbuds sound is very good and connects easily upon selecting in your settings. The charge box is small and compact and easy to carry in your purse or pocket. It also stays charged for a long time!

title: Love it.  You will NOT be disappointed
review: Love love love. Perfect size. Don’t fall off like others that are super big and thick and heavy. These are adjustable so you could make bigger. Super easy to Install. Had pneumonia a few months ago and lost hearing in my left ear/ well I wear one speaker over that ear and my hearing has slowly been coming back.  Very happy with this purchase.  The headphone has the volume adjustment.  A little pricier than the others sold but I purchased and tried those and didn’t like. Some didnt even come with the transmitters which was a drag and waste of my time.  This is it for me.  I don’t know about gaming but I just gave it a five stars on that one since I don’t know why it wouldn’t work for gaming.  Works great with my fire stick too

title: So close JBL !!
review: These JBL earbuds are wonderful. Sound quality is awesome. Lots of bass but I had to return them. The fit was not there. I tried different ear tips, but the buds would not stay in my ear. The way I think they should the little wing tip did little to nothing as far as keeping them in my ear but it is a subjective thing, so just because they didn’t work for me doesn’t mean they won’t work for you, so I am still giving these your buds, a major major major go give them a try you won’t be disappointed. I have an iPhone you can’t get Siri with these but if you have a android device you can say OK Google and get Google assistant. Sound quality is great. Lots of bass JBL app so you can fine-tune your listening experience. 👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾 One more thing I did have an issue with wireless charging, but that could just be a one off unit thing !!!

title: Skullcandy needs to step their game up!!!!
review: Sound quality was mediocre fit and finish with mediocre I'm really surprised by how mediocre the Skullcandy indy work I have the Skullcandy crushers and they're awesome headphones but these here were a real letdown Skullcandy really have to step their game up!!!!

title: Great earbuds
review: These are great wireless earbuds for the price . The Bose active noise reduction really works and the Alexa app is great sound quality is a really subjective thing but I have tried quite a few earbuds and I could say these are some of the best sounding earbuds I have ever owned for $130 you really can't go wrong battery life is great phone call quality is great the charging case is a little bit on the big side but I can overlook that took a phone call on a very windy day with no problems wish they had type c charging but at this price point I guess you can't have everything overall I would buy these again

title: Great for big ears
review: These are great if you have big ear canals like me but after a few workouts the sweat would make them pop off of the headphones

title: Best headphones for kids
review: My daughter loves these headphones. She is 5 and they fit great. Our dog chewed the cord so we have to order another set. We may try a different animal this time and just be able to switch them out.

title: Best of the budget earbuds
review: I'm on my third set of budget earbuds and these are far and away the best ones that I've had. The design allows for them to stay on my ears whether I'm running or doing lifting. The battery life is pretty good, I typically use them for between 60 and 90 minutes at a go and I only charge the case every week to 2 weeks depending. The absolute best thing about these is they don't lose connection when you walk more than 7 ft away or when they're sync to your wrist and you only have the right earbud in. That was a common problem when using my garment on my left hand and running with only the right earbud in and other brands. But this one keeps connection the whole time when I'm running no issues. The sound isn't amazing, but it's still good enough that I would only notice it if I grabbed another much more expensive set of headphones to compare it to. Highly recommend for the price

title: Good budget headphones
review: These are very good value for the money.  Purchase a five pack cuz my son tends to destroy headphones by messing with the cord constantly. So far these have held up better than most other ones in the price bracket and they do pretty good sound.

So far so good. Will update in a month or so.

review:

-Pairing / Initial use was easy.

title: BRAINWAVZ WHERE HAVE YOU BEEN ALL MY LIFE?!?!?!?
review: BRAINWAVZ WHERE HAVE YOU BEEN ALL MY LIFE?!?!?!?  So I have been using an AT BPSH1 (Breadcast headset).  I have just been dealing with the pain after long periods of wear.  I stumbled across  these and decided to give them a try.  O M F G - They are amazeballs.  They fit as described and feel like excellent quality.  Highly reccomended.

title: Outstanding Headset
review:
I am a business user that spends most of my day on conference calls. I am ALWAYS on the phone it seems. This headset is the absolute best one I have ever owned. It is comfortable, tangle free, excellent call quality, and just plain works. I have been using it daily for 6 months now. I highly recommend this headset to anyone who is looking for a top quality wired headset for long term use. The only thing about this headset that I did not like at first is the mic is on the left ear instead of in the middle - I eventually got used to it.

I use this headset with a Blackberry Bold and my Galaxy S4.

On a side note - Klipsch's customer service is outstanding. I accidentally got my headset caught on the table and popped the volume control cap off. They graciously replaced it with a brand new one. That's rite a brand new one - not refurb.

In conclusion I can only speak for this headset and the R6 series. I previously owned a S5i "Rugged" and it was not rugged at all. They seemed to have stepped up their game with the R6i.

title: Call quality reports were good but using it for hours at a time gets ...
review: I purchased this as a backup while my $$$ headset was going through RMA.  This headset is ok.  Call quality reports were good but using it for hours at a time gets uncomfortable.  I would not recommend this for users that plan to be on the phone for long periods.

title: disappointed I love Bose sound & Quality can't re-purchace @ ...
review: Returned.. defective on one side.. disappointed I love Bose sound & Quality can't re-purchace @ this time do to moving ( costly) I really wish these had worked because I never would of returned & I'd have a pair of Bose Headphones..

title: Perfect
review:
Great earbuds.
Great sound quality, the battery life is good and being able to use 1 earbud at a time makes it even better. When one dies, I switch to the other. I would recommend it.

title: Great headphones for average use, wires seem very sturdy & never get tangled
review:
These are great headphones for music and movies for the price. I have never owned a big-money pair of headphones & after buying cheap ones that I had to replace multiple times due to breakage, I decided to get these after a recommendation from a friend. After buying them for myself, I also bought them for each of my kids. They're great for average use... i've never been bothered by outside noise, they are comfortable, and the sound is of good quality. They also are much sturdier than the cheapie $10-$20 ones I've gotten before. (My kids haven't broken them, which is a minor miracle)

I do recommend getting a bag or carrying case for them (I use a Crown Royal bag:) it certainly helps protect them and they do seem vulnerable at the hinges where they collapse for storage.

The only thing my kid complains about is the wire is kind of short. I prefer it because the wire is nice and thick and never gets tangled. with my previous cheap ones, it was always the wires that were delicate & one or both ears would go out. These are so much sturdier. (I think he just finds them too short when he wants to sit in the recliner with his iPad on the table & watch his Minecraft. If you don't require your headphones to meet these specific and ridiculous needs, the length should be fine.)

title: Two Years and Still Incredible Sound and Comfort
review:
I bought the Bose QC25 headphones in February 2015 and they're still awesome. The noise canceling couldn't be better, the sound quality is impeccable, and they are the MOST comfortable headphones that I have ever had.
I use them in the house to listen to my iPod, which sets in a Yamaha dock that is connected to my Yamaha receiver. I also have my TV hooked up to my Yamaha receiver so that I can listen to the TV with the Bose headphones. They get a lot of use, but no abuse.
I have not had any problems with the headphones, just the expected maintenance of replacing the pads after two years, but that was easy to do with the Bose replacement pads.
From my experience I highly recommend the QC25 phones. Worth every penny!

title: Excellent Sound
review:
Wow, just received these earphones yesterday and they create a beautiful listening experience on my iPod. What a superb upgrade from the generic earphones I had been using. Both bass and treble are perfectly balanced for my listening enjoyment. However, if you prefer the bass to rattle your eardrums, then these phones probably won't satisfy you.
I have a pair of Grady headphones that cost $299 that I use connected to my Yamaha receiver, and these Thinksound ts02 8mm sound every bit as good on my iPod.

title: what a rush!
review:
The Grado Prestige SR325is headphones just blow me away.

I have the Audio Technica Pro Studio Monitor Headphones ($159), and I did not expect that sound quality could not get much better. Well, I was amazed to find how wrong I was.

Expensive is a relative in terms of what you can afford. If you can afford these headphones, they will be worth every penny.

They are like listening to my music with new ears.

title: Great concept. Horrible and misleading marketing
review:
Great concept. Horrible and misleading marketing.
These headphones WILL NOT give you 7.1 surround sound with the XBOX one or the PS4. That the one feature that makes them worth the $200 price tag. Will be returning....

title: First USB-C headphone/power dongle that works reliably with iPad Pro gen 2
review:
If you are looking to use your high-end analog headphones while being able to charge and have had bad luck with these kinds of adaptors, this is the one you want. After trying at least 4 different models/styles this is the only one that held a stable connection (no signal cutouts causing the dongle to stop being recognized), has a good DAC that doesn't over-gain the signal and doesn't slow down charging. The corded design is very low-profile, well made, and best of all doesn't add any bulk to the device.

Again, if you are looking at similar dongles that profess to do the same thing, I urge you to just get this because it works reliably. I have had no problems with it.

And it even comes with a little pouch so you're less likely to lose it!

title: Not the original formula
review:
At first these seemed like excellent replacements for my tripleFi leads which the dog destroyed but it became clear there are some serious design problems. Aside from the mic being mediocre, the headphone lead from the junction is the weak link and within 45 days the lead was bent at this point and felt like it was break at any moment as there seemed to be no longer structural integrity at the most vulnerable location. It was less than a mo th from this that the wire severed enough to cut the connections and only the insulation was barely holding it together. If I bought another I feel like just a little gaffers tape at this point would avoid inevitable damage even with light use, but hindsight is always 20/20.
Otherwise, aside from the slightly weak mic, audio fidelity seemed on par with the stock leads. I wish it was just designed to be more durable.

title: Not a good solution to give standard headphones "mobile" features due to basic design
review: There are not a lot of M-F line extenders out there that have controls and a mic built in. Find an in-line extender with a separate line with controls and a mic on the end is impossible to find. If you use a pair of reference headphones that have no controls or mic, you might thing this is a good solution, however the positioning of the control/mic module will be all wrong which is evident the first time you attempt to use it. I ended up fastening it to my desk so the controls are handy, but because the mic is about 18" from my head it is not attenuated to capture my voice at that distance so people can barely hear me. Therefore, this cord is a bit of an anathema. Putting the controls and mic in-line makes it unsuitable for a set of headphones that have a long cord, particularly if you are walking, and mic is designed to reproduce sounds at very close range, so it's not useful as any sort of "proximity" microphone. Again, if the controls were on the end a separate cord that's about 2' to 3' in length and offered the extender line to be as short as 6", this would be perfect for people who wish to make their standard headphones become "phone" headphones. Since this is not the design, it fails in this regard.

title: Solid design, great size, and a bonus net-pouch inside
review: This is a great case that protects well and has an handy net-pouch for accessories. There is ample room so your cans won't be crushed inside, deforming the ear-pads, but it is not to cavernous for them to flop around inside very much or be to bulky overall. The zipper is a heady gauge and built to last. The style is very plain so it's not exactly aesthetically interesting in any way, but it does their job perfectly. If you travel with a pair of nice over-the-ear headphones, this case is a must have.

title: Still the best value for high-end earbuds
review:
This was one of the last Ultimate Ears earbud lines before Logitech bought the company which resulted in an immediate drop in product quality and increase in product price. Yes, these are still wired headphones, but the sound fidelity is unmatched, and instead of complicated noise cancelling algorithms this simply employs noise isolation to block out ambient sound. These headphones have been out of production for some time, but for whatever reason you can still find them NIB from many vendors. They charge about a little more than what cut-rate vendors charged when they were new about 6 years ago, but they were way ahead of their time and frankly nothing on the market in this price range sounds even close to this good. Plus, these original UE headphones (I don't evangelize anything UE after Logitech bought them) have a lot of great design features. The earbud units are modular, so if you ever destroy the leads, you can always replace them for $10. Also, the standard leads these ship with do NOT have the mic and volume/start-stop control on the leads, but you can buy them in various levels of quality for about $20-60 aftermarket and swap them out. It's money well spent if you want to make calls on them. Also, the lead up to 6" from each bud is cased in memory metal so they can be bent to shape and hold in place to are a comfy fit on he outside of your ears- great idea.

All around the best earbud headphones for the money, if you can find them!

title: these are still great headphones for the price and ended up being much ...
review: While Ultimate Ears has seemed to have gotten of lesser quality since bought by Logitech, these are still great headphones for the price and ended up being much better than I expected. The only downside is the box is disappointing and a far cry from the great boxes UE headphones used to come in.

title: Great Headphones
review: The Panasonic RB-M500B Deep Base Head Phones are very well made with great battery life.  The battery lasted a lot longer then I expected per charge.  The sound quality is clear if not a little lower sometimes but the bass adjust button is amazing at bringing a full sounding bass while not taking away from quality and clarity.  The larger than normal ear pieces fit quite comfortably and do not push against the head too much at all.  While the buttons blend in seamlessly they are hard to navigate your fingers to operate while listening. Overall a great headset and I would recommend them to anyone looking for a good pair for a reasonable price.

title: Extremely Useful and and Incredible Value,  Awesome Sound Quality
review: These little ear buds really do it all.  They have some of the very best sound I have heard in earwigs.  Works really good with Dolby Atmos.  They are very easy to setup and worked right out of the box.  Works with single earbud really well but sounds incredible when using both earbuds.  These are absolutely amazing  and very easy to use.  Love the portability of them and the size of the charger.  It's great that you don't need a USB connection to charge every time.  The little case itself charges the earbuds multiple times before needing to be charged itself.  That gave me extreme flexibility as to not worrying about when I would be able to charge.  Love that I can use them individually because you can always have one charging.  These really have everything I have been looking for in a pair of blue tooth earphones.  I didn't believe they would actually be noise cancelling but they do a good job of it.  They even fit my ear perfectly. Now I just have to manage not to loose them or get them stolen because everyone loves them.  You really can't go wrong with these and this is a purchase I am extremely happy with.

title: Best in Class and Just as good as Expensive name brands!!
review:
These headphones are very comfortable to wear and incredibly light. They produce amazing sound for their size. These are by far the best headphones I have owned yet. I was going to spend a lot of money on an expensive set on the recommendation of a friend, but I decided I would try these out first. The battery life is extremely good and they charge quick and are good for the whole day. I have yet to run the battery all the way down. I let my friend that suggested the expensive ones and she even liked these just as much. She was actually kind of angry about it. They are truly sweat proof, that's for sure because they have been soaked and still work great! I have went on runs, hikes , played basketball and everything else you can think of in these and they have yet to fall out of my ear. They are a really good fit, at least for my ears. That is rare because I have never found a headset that set comfortably in my ear without falling out easily.

The magnets in the earbuds are an incredible idea that help it to stay in place when not in use and keeps my from losing them as I always do with smaller items like this. They are truly noise canceling because even if I just put one of them in I can't hear nearly as much noise on that side. These are an incredible product that I highly recommend everyone try before wasting money on a high dollar pair because these, in my opinion are just as good if not better. I hope this helps someone save some money!!

The sweat has no effect on them and they continue to work flawlessly.  I really love this pair of headphones.  They battery life is amazing because I have worn them all day with high use and never ran out of battery charge on them.  They also are a very comfortable fit at least for my ears.  This was a great purchase and I couldn't be happier.  I would recommend these to anyone.  I hope everyone enjoys theirs as much as I do mine!

title: The bass is amazing
review: The sound quality is good not great but if you like bass, you will love these headphones.

title: Semi-professional sound monitoring and video games
review: I use this to monitor/produce music and play Fortnite. I know it is a weird combination, but I wanted a simple solution: basically, good headphones that happen to have a microphone on them. I like this better than my Audio-Technica ATH-M20x professional studio headphones. The Audio-Technica are good and flat like I want, but the bass level is much too low for most modern realistic playback. These CM 500s have a more realistic (but less flat) bass. Much better for my mixing. As far as Fortnite, the mic swivels down and I can ask my son to come revive me. That's pretty much what happens when we play together: I get killed, and he carries me through the game. I'm what he would call a "bot". Anyway, I like that the microphone swings up and down without needing to bend it. I expect it to last longer without breaking with that design. I'm very happy with these headphones.

title: Good bluetooth headset
review:
I love this bluetooth headset by it saves my ears by not getting plugged into my ear channels. If you've had a lot of ringing in your ears, which I do, this is the way I protect my ears.

They're very comfortable and not sweaty. They have a long battery life and are very light. With them going behind your head, you don't notice they're there. Good sound quality and good price as well.

title: Must Have For Flying
review:
To protect your hearing, I highly recommend that everyone uses noise cancelling headphones while flying.

Took several long flights with this set. I estimate that this has reduced the cabin noise by about 20 decibels, or about three quarters of the volume. I can still hear some hissing noise, but it really made my ears feel comfortable. And I can still hear the captain speaking loud and clear. This is much easier to carry onboard than those bulky over-the-ear models. Though I think those models may work better.

I also wear this while mowing or using power tools.

The music quality isn't good. It sounds a bit muddy even in a quiet surrounding. It's a notch below my iPhone 6's headset (which isn't a strong performer.)

title: Pleasantly surprised!
review: Got it prime fast, powered right up, connected to my LG G3 in about 4 seconds, and sound better than my wired headphones. I'll be ordering another set as back up.

title: Awesome Bluetooth Headphones at an Amazing Price!
review: I freaking love these headphones. I own multiple products from MEElectronics and they have not disappointed me yet. These are great sounding headphones at a great price. Don't fall for the cheaply produced but highly expensive Beats headphones. The Air-Fi Matrix2 blows them away. I was looking for a quality pair of bluetooth headphones that delivered the sound quality I wanted, and these delivered above and beyond. LOUD AND EXCELLENT!

title: Perfect streaming with every TV.
review:
I have FIVE TV's in my house. Four of them are either Roku built in or have a Roku Ultra attached. The other is an older unit that has built in streaming, but not Roku brand.

The Roku Ultra is the best you can get. It has all the features you could ask for, and is customizable for you preferences. The picture quality is perfect. The audio is flawless. The voice search is super accurate and very convenient. I don't use the earbuds with the remote. But, I have tested it and found it to be great. The quality of the sound through the earbuds is good. You can use your own headset. But, the bigger the speakers in your headset, the greater the drain on the remote batteries.

Overall, I have always been extremely satisfied with Roku. I carried one set with me, when I traveled. And, I used to travel A LOT. It was comforting, being able to take my favorite programming with me, wherever I went.

All Roku streaming devices are good. I really like the Ultra. Five stars.

title: Not just toys!
review: [[VIDEOID:acdf4e3eeba5db6935b5794352d29f3b]] These walkie-talkies are PERFECT for just about any activity where you need to talk to someone while you're out on some adventure. (We even use them when we go shopping. I get half the shopping list and she gets the other half. We go opposite directions in the giant stores and keep in touch with these wonderful little guys.) Super easy to operate. Just turn them on and push to talk. Or set it to VOX (voice activated transmit) and just keep them somewhere on your front, upper body and you don't even have to push the button, the sound of your voice will be enough to activate it. There are more features to these walkie-talkies than I can list here, that make them perfect for nearly any environment, including professional work in the field, including squelch, CTCSS and 'roger tones'. You can even keep things quiet by plugging in an earphone. They have a small flashlight built in. But, I would not depend on it to light my way on a dark night, just for digging around in your tent or backpack.  In my video, I was down at a friends house, three blocks away, and talking to my wife, who was still at home. The price for this four unit set was crazy cheap, for the quality and function built into it. Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Great portable tunes, with no wifi or data plan required.
review: If you think about it, we have made ourselves slaves to the phone companies and internet providers. We have to stream or download everything. It has to be live. Well, sometimes, it's just not possible. And, after you start using a device like this MyMahdi MP3 player, you will find that your anxiety levels get a LOT lower. No more stressing over how good your signal is or how much of your plan you're burning up. This little gem can hold a ton of music or movies, even more when you expand the memory with a micro-SD card. The touch screen is great. And, at 3.5 inches, it's actually big enough that you can enjoy a movie, while your stuck at the airport waiting for your departure. The sound quality from the included hardwired earbuds is great. But, it also has bluetooth. So, you can hook up your JBL's or Beats over the ear headphones and get a theater like experience. The way this little guy was built is pretty impressive. Solid metal case, nice and hefty. Reliable physical switches. Very durable. Should last for years. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Reliable Motorola quality.
review: [[VIDEOID:571a38012f4389ea2c6a60c0d56833ce]] The best thing about Motorola is their reliability. I'm an ex-cop. And, I'm still involved with first response teams with my current occupation. I have seen Motorola products used by professionals for as long as I can remember. Motorola has been around for a looooong time. These headphones cannot be beat by any other in this price range. The sound quality is comparatively equal to any other in this range. The treble is slightly muted and the bass is slightly flat. But, the midrange is crisp and clear. The quality of the sound is unaffected by the volume. It's just as clear at full volume as it is at 10%. The earcovers are very comfortable, and do a decent job at the 'passive' noise cancelling. I opened up my Pandora and tuned into Santana radio. All I heard was music. Even though the TV was going in the same room at normal volume. Bluetooth connection couldn't be easier, turn them on, select them on your phone and select okay. If you're looking for a solid, reliable, durable and long lasting set of quality over the ear headphones, you found them. Five stars.

title: It is SOOOO good!
review: [[VIDEOID:a5128c033ceec958822c811238a72798]] First, I'm not a V-logger or blogger. I don't do Podcasts or self-centric Youtube videos. But, I DO videos about drones and quadcopters. Some of which, I narrate. I've always wanted to have a better audio experience for my viewers. Now, I have it. This Eivotor professional microphone is exactly what it says in the name, PROFESSIONAL. The quality of the sound recorded (to my ears) couldn't be better if it was done in an actual studio. Part by part... The mic itself is so well made, I couldn't think of a single criticism. It's just, simply stated, a professional quality mic. The stand is super sturdy, solid and easy. The cage is the perfect example of how to isolate 'telegraphed' noise from your desk or table, preventing unwanted noise in your recording. The mic has an open cell foam wind screen, like any pro mic would have. The 'pop' screen is great for those of us that over enunciate our consonants. I don't do that! (roll eyes) The connections are standard, the three prong mic connection can be swapped out for any length you happen to have around. The other end is a standard 3.5mm 4 c jack (designed for splitting the signal between your recording device and headphones). But, it can be used without the splitter pigtail, in case you don't need the feedback. You can tell from my brief video, the recorded sound is very good. Great purchase, five stars.

title: Great sound, no noise.
review: I really like this new set of B350 noise cancelling earbuds from Tranya. They are as close to perfect as I have found in this type of earbud. The dual mics have active background noise cancellation for clearer phone conversations. Then, the buds have passive noise cancellation from the ear cups to help eliminate other background noise for your end, also making calls clearer and improving the quality of your music listening experience. And, the quality of sound coming from the buds is also great, nice rich bass and crisp clear treble. Pairing with my phone was practically automatic. The charging / storage case is nice and compact. I'm very pleased with these buds. Five stars.

title: Perfect sound from these and NOISE CANCELLING!
review: I really like this set of NOISE CANCELLING earbuds! I was kind of leary about the noise cancelling part. But, turns out, they work really well at eliminating most background noise. I have over the ear headphones that do it. But, it's not something I've not experienced in buds before. And, the quality of sound coming from the buds is great, rich bass, crystal clear treble. Super easy to pair. Simple touches on the left or right bud to control all functions. Phone conversation is great. Music is wonderful. Recharging is simple. Just drop them back in the little box. Magnets hold them in place and they're recharged quickly. Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Great sound quality, long battery life and fast easy pairing!
review: This newest true wireless stereo set of bluetooth earbuds by Octing have about the best quality sound I have heard in this class and price range. They are great. The bass booms, the midrange is clear and the treble is crisp. Super easy to pair, and they last all day, for the way I listen to music and use my phone. Super easy to control with just a touch. They recharge quickly in the case, which is compact enough to keep in my pocket. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great corded set for your new iPhone.
review: Great quality corded headset for your iPhone iOS 10 and above. Newer iPhones no longer have the traditional 3.5mm stereo jack for your earbuds or phone set. You must use the firewire port. This set is perfect. It provides great sound to the earphones, calls are nice and clear on both ends. The inline controls work perfectly for volume up and down, pause, play, answer/hang up and even initiate calls. The buds have optional size cups, so they stay in your ears, even while doing vigorous exercises. Good Purchase. Five stars.

title: Very comfortable, great sound, easy controls.
review: This wired headset is great for those who don't like to depend on BlueTooth. Plugs right in, with full function, volume up and down, pause and play, answer and hang up. The sound quality is as good as it gets for in the ear buds, good bass and crisp treble. Very well made ear pieces, strong silicone jacketed braided cord over the wiring, with strong strain relief at the plug and the controls conveniently placed at collar level on the right side. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Nice little bud case
review: I could imagine a few other ways to utilize this little zippered case, designed for earbuds. But, it works very well for it's intended purpose. Even for some styles that have the 'wrap around' type support, as shown in my pics. It was a little snug, but they fit. The standard buds (either wired or wireless) fit much better. The case itself is nice 'pleather', good zipper and nicely appointed swivel snap to attach it to whatever you want to hang it on. My wife chose the natural leather color to go with one particular purse. She hangs it on the outside of the purse, like a 'bling' effect. Looks great. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great TWS ear buds!
review: I like these earbuds a lot. First, the sound quality is SUPERB! I added an equalizer app to my phone that really punches up the bass. These buds handle the extra bass at even the highest volume settings with absolutely crystal clear sound quality! I am super impressed by that fact alone. Now, when I connected them to my phone, it was so fast and easy I kept looking at my phone, wondering to myself, 'Is that it?' Yep! Awesome! The charging case is compact. The buds pop in and stay in place with magnets and start charging automatically. When you pull them out of the case, they sync with your phone automatically, no buttons to push. Making or cancelling a call is as simple as touching one of the buds. Pausing or playing your Pandora is just as easy. I guess you can tell, I really like these Tranya TWS earbuds. Good Purchase. Five Stars!

title: Comfortable with great sound.
review: My wife likes them so much, she took them from me. (Well, l let her have them.) The audio both directions is great. They paired to the phone very easily. The standby battery time is longer than two days. The talk time is about 5-6 hours. That's great for such a light weight headset. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: FAST charging for multiple USB devices, including the new C type!
review: The size of this charger can be deceptive. But, if you feel the heft of it in your hand, you will know that it packs a punch. I can charge both my cell phones, my blue tooth headset, my blue tooth desktop speaker and my Samsung Tab all at the same time and STILL charge faster than with the OEM chargers. The EUASOO charger also comes with some heavy duty mounting tape. So, you can attach it permanently to your desk. I just throw mine in my backpack with all of my electronic gizmos and I'm good to go. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great sound quality on both ends of the call.
review: Most earbuds will suffer some kind of sound weakness on one end of the call or the other. Either you can't hear the caller very well, or they can't hear you. These work very well, both ways! The noise cancelling dual mics on these provide crisp clear sound for your caller, cancelling nearly all background racket. The speakers give great bass and treble, so your music is very enjoyable. After you've paired these with your phone the first time, they pair automatically when you pull them out of the case. No buttons. Just touch the buds to pause, play, call, hang up, etc. The charger case is compact, and has plenty of battery power. I'm very pleased with this set. Good Purchase. Five stars.

title: Well built laptop backpack has a POWERful bonus.
review: This Gemeer laptop backpack is great, just as it is, for transporting and protecting your laptop. I carry my HP Pavilion 17 confidently, as it fits easily into the well padded backpack, leaving plenty of room for peripherals and other goodies. But, while some backpacks may sport a hole, through which you can run your earbud cord through, this backpack actually has a USB patch cord built in! This allows you to connect your cell phone power pack on the inside ( and tuck it into one of the many convenient pockets) and then recharge your phone, at your convenience, without digging around inside to make the connection! Definitely a POWERful bonus. I'm happy with this purchase and highly recommend.

title: Great protection for your headphones!
review: I ordered this hard case for my JBL E55BT Quincy Jones edition headphones. It's a perfect fit, great for travel. It has an elasticized mesh pocket in the top half of the clam shell case that holds the sound cord, USB charger cord and even the user's guide. Very nice design, very sturdy. Good purchase!

title: Awesome sound, very comfortable, easy to connect, loooong battery life.
review: I have purchased three JBL headphones now. This set was for me. I really like the quality of the workmanship and materials. JBL is known for the quality of the sound they produce. This Quincy Jones Edition cost a little more, and I really don't know if they're actually any better than the 'non' QJ headphones. But, they sure do have a nice look. I'm very happy with these JBL's.

title: Great technology, terrible product.
review:
The electronics and features of this blue-tooth headset can't be beat. The sound quality is second to none. Now, the bad news. The materials and construction of this headset couldn't be worse. It was just a matter of weeks before the plastic neckband starts to crack. The soft rubber skin on the inside of the neck band and ear pieces is glued on with some type of adhesive that starts to break down pretty quickly, turning into some kind of goo that releases the skin and leaves a slimy sticky mess.

I have actually purchased two of these. With the first one, I thought maybe I was too 'rough' with it and caused it to crack. But, when the second one did the same thing, I gave up, understanding that it was just an inferior product. My advice, don't spend your money on this one. Get one of those that remains around your neck with the 'ear buds' on flexible leads that dangle when not in your ears.

title: Very nice sound and comfort.
review: This headset with two wire choices, one with a wire mic, is a comfy fit for an average ear or smaller, and emits an excellent sound quality. I used it to record and sing on Stramaker and I could hear the music much clearer , enabling more fine tuning in my vocal recording. So far, so good! Hope they are durable and last.

title: Headphones working for voiceover work.
review: So far so good after a couple weeks. We've had no issues with this headset as we've had with others on Amazon. My son uses it on PS4+ and I use it for voiceover work with my converter box. Working great, as of yet! We will see if it makes it past the month. Inexpensive, mailed pretty quickly. Good service.

title: Adult Headphones Too Tight
review: I returned these as they hurt my ears. Nothing was as described. There was no noise cancelation. Sound quality was poor. Headphones are bulky and not easy to store. Save your money; there is nothing to like about these headphones.

title: Small Does Not Hold As Much As Photo
review: It is only about 2 1/2" wide but very bulky. It only has room enough to hold my Apple earbuds and charger. It's okay. Also, only available in black and not waterproof. You get what you pay for.

title: Perfect fit for Skullcandy Hesh 2 wireless headphones.
review: These were a perfect fit for my Skullcandy Hesh 2 headphones.  The headphones themselves were perfectly fine but after 5 1/2  years the pleather was  peeling BADLY on the ear covers.  I couldn’t  Imagine getting rid of of a great pair of headphones because of the covers so I did a quick check on amazon.  I am so glad I did.  The old ones slipped right off and these only took 3-4 minutes to put on.  They look brand new.  Sound quality and comfort are the same.

title: Good was fine - Quality is poor
review: I've been using this pair gently probably about 3 times a week and all of a sudden then sound started to muffle, I thought it was my phone first (thank goodness) and checked with other earphones I have which all worked so I'm assuming a wire got loose or something. I guess it lasted $20 worth (5 months).

title: Great Purchase
review: These are holding up nicely! The sound is great and the headphones are easy and comfortable to wear. I can recommend these without reservation. No problems at all with them.

title: Incredible Sound
review:
These headphones are perfect for me. I'm not a huge basshead, love my boom bap songs and all but I've always preferred ACCURACY over something that'll make my brain tingle. That's the h.ear on 2's. If you want an experience that shows you what the song is suppose to sound like then these are for you. Don't get me wrong, they definitely serve well on the bass end, perfectly so in my opinion. For those that prefer the bass, along with other EQ's, is adjustable via the sony app.

Noise cancelling is good. It's not the best-of-the-best but when my music is playing I can't hear anything around me which is all that matters to me.

title: Too good to be true - not a good investment for your ipad.
review: This is just really cheap quality stuff. (I bought the black version which was the only one available at the time.  It doesn't have pockets in the front).  The stylus tip was unusable after a week.  The headphones aren't good quality and the sound is poor.  Haven't tried the car charger because I'm concerned it will blow the fuse - it's really, really, cheap. Ditto the screen protector. The case is too obviously cheap looking plastic - much less quality than it seems in the picture.  It's not something you could use without embarrassment as a professional.  The rotation part is good, but mine would not stay propped up when it was horizontal.  I recommend you save your money and purchase something more respectable and better quality. You can get a decent case for this money without the gadgets.  This looks like a good deal, but it is unfortunately too good to be true.

title: Decent bone induction headset

title: Great headphones
review: GREAT headphones.  Sound quality and noise cancelling is excellent.  Comfortable to wear.

title: Amazing cost to quality ratio. Sounds one tier below super premiums, but cost 95% less.
review:
Dear lord. These are fantastic. I am zero percent surprised, given that I have owned several Cambridge Soundworks products, and they have all impressed.

They're the absolute best for a music fan on a budget. Sure, it's not a $399 set of Bose cans, but with the coupon, these were $17 and sound 90% as good. The only difference between these and super premiums are perhaps the highest of highs and lowest of lows. If you're buying these to absolutely blast opera or dubstep, you might be a bit disappointed. For the 99% of people who just want good Bluetooth headphones for a fantastic price, this is the set.

Can't speak to longevity, but from personal experience CS stands 110% behind their products, so I'm not worried.

title: Sound is awesome!
review: These were a great deal! $19 bucks for wireless earbuds! They fit great and sound great! If you don’t wanna spend an arm and leg - these are the ones!

title: Just as good as Turtle Beach
review: Ordered these for my son after his expensive Turtle Beach headphones quit working. These are great and he loves them. Just as good quality as the more expensive ones!

title: Wrong item sent
review: Wrong item sent.  Works ok but no volume controls.  Hopeful it's durable..i dont mind since i am only using it when my wireless earphone needs to charge.

title: Great for exercising!
review: Normally I don't like the over the ear earbuds, but after so many times that my other earbuds would drop out, these fit the bill perfectly! Not only does the sound come in great, but there's no worries of them dying due to sweat. I even forgot about them and walked into the shower after working out and they kept working fine.

title: The HISS is killing me
review:
I've chatted with tech support and I'm supposed to leave my buds connected to my phone, in the case and open, and it'll update the firmware to get rid of this terrible hiss, but it's been hours and nothing... no update. SMH.

ETA 01/27/19 I returned them. Even after the firmware update they continued to hiss. I have cheaper wireless earbuds that do not hiss, so it was very disappointed with these.

title: because they headphones are awesome! It was a little disconcerting at first when ...
review: I was in the TSA line and someone left these behind. Instead of leaving them there on the table, or taking them, I turned them over to the TSA agent. I really hope the person who lost these came back to get them and not have them stolen by some POS TSA agent, which usually happens, because they headphones are awesome! It was a little disconcerting at first when the noise cancelling kicked in and did exactly what it said it would, then the sound was great too. I would never usually buy something so expensive like this, but I've had a number of bluetooth headphones and they all suck. These do not, do I wish they were cheaper? Yes! But then they might not be as good.

title: Inexpensive but not cheap!
review:
Disclaimer: I am NOT a Vine Reviewer.

title: these work great
review: Have kids that don't clean their ears when you tell them too and then borrow your earbuds? Yeah, gross. I clean them, but sometimes they like to fly away and are never found again. These are a godsend!

title: Only giving it 2 instead of 1
review: because you get so many for the price and you'll need them! I got the first one on and thought, okay, this isn't so hard. The next 5 ripped. Not sure what I did that first time, but I got frustrated and quit before I ran though the entire 400 to fix one set of headphones. Not sure if other brands are better, but they probably are and probably thicker. If you like frustration at a cheap price, this is your fix.

title: This is best pair of work at home headphones I have every purchased!
review: Very clear, sound is great! Microphone lights up everytime a phone call is detected on Avaya phone system. Great if you work from home or Skype! I use for both and i'm pleased, comes with a nice carry bag which i place my headphones in after every use. Just because I definitely want to prolong this pair. Very comfortable, not heavy, not light, very good study weight. Has light up Mute button(red) and Phone function which also had light (blue). I have gone through 3 pairs of Logitech and they all have crashed // stop responding after a year a piece. I won't go back to Logitech.

title: not great for voice, buggy firmware updates
review: I seriously use to love BOSE. The buggy firmware updates have forced me to write a review to warn AGAINST this product. There's also now weird echo sounds when you use them as a headset. Which makes them almost unusable as anything but a headset. I don't know what happened to this company and it's sad when there's so much more competition now in the market at both the low price and high-end noise cancellation space. Please please please BOSE fix the firmware and return these to a good product.

title: Best 3 in 1 cable, keep one of these everywhere
review: I keep one of these cables everywhere, car, office, home. As much as I would prefer to be USB C everywhere, this cable is a lifesaver when your power dies and you just know this cable will charge any modern device. I've never had an issue with it not working on anything whether that's headphones, GPS unit, iPhones. Every cable should have a 3 in 1 attachment. Life would be so much easier.

title: Light weight
review: Simple headphones. Purchased for my 79 year old father. Fit perfect. Light weight.

title: Great headphones
review: Headphones are as stated.  They are comfortable to wear and come with several sizes of earbud covers.  The sound quality is excellent.  The noise cancellation is pretty good.  They charge quickly.  Very happy with these headphones.  Would definitely buy again!

title: Gorgeous earbuds in a stunning package
review:
Truly gorgeous earbuds, almost more like jewelry than audio hardware. These come packaged in a STUNNING plain cardboard box (please see photos!) -- sophisticated and impressive, demonstrating the use of materials in an artful manner. Inside the box you'll find the earbuds and related materials presented in a beautiful, magical way. As if you'd bought these at a museum gift shop or Japanese garden. Everything is beautifully presented. There's a small notebook and pen (!) as well as a few different sized rubber collars for you to choose from. The wood on the earbuds is gorgeous. They fit well.

Now, the bad news. The sound is a bit muddy, even listening via iTunes on my Mac with the equalizer. The high end is somewhat lacking. They're more than adequate, but the fact of the matter is that the sound is a little bit on the muddy side of things. The sound is beautifully rendered, but I'd love a little more brightness at the high end of things.

Overall these are easily the most beautiful earbuds I've ever seen. These would make a stunning gift! Truly gorgeous. Quite unique.

I received this at a discount in exchange for my honest and unbiased opinion.

title: Impressive stereo imaging in a wireless solution
review: I find myself listening to my MP3 collection all over again to hear what I've been missing by listening with my iPod earbuds or my iPod boombox from Apple (anyone remember those?) or through my dime-sized laptop speakers. NO MORE. Even thinking back to the big speakers I had when I was in college, these headphones reproduce each and every note beautifully. The over-the-ear design takes a little getting used to compared to wearing earbuds, but the fact that there's no wire to tangle is a major plus. The sound was a little on the boom-y side of things until I used the iTunes EQ. Very impressive headphones, they look great and, most importantly, they sound fantastic. I had zero setup issues, in fact the device had connected to the tiny transmitter before I could put them on. And my kids won't march up to my iPod boombox and turn the sound down on me while I'm listening through these. Keeps my music to myself. These would be great to wear while working (but don't wear them during staff meetings).

title: Very nice FRS device -- great for camping
review:
I've found over the three years we've used the T6220s that suburban range is often greater than you'd imagine, but where these little radios really shine is giving one to your kid to keep instant tabs on them "just in case," and when you're camping these are the greatest thing since tents for not losing any kids at Scout camp! They're also very useful at the swap meet or someplace like Disneyland to keep track of subsets of your group.

They're tough, we haven't killed one yet. You'll have to look at a few pages in the manual to see how to work the radios, but it's not like it's trigonometry or anything like that. You can easy learn to operate these radios.

Simple, bulletproof, decent performance... this is a good product and I'm glad that I bought a pair.

We tried a VOX headset but it was not a big success. I do like the NOAA feature on this radio, get weather/emergency information when you really need it.

Dandy little radios.

title: Love to sound quality but stay close
review: I love the volume button in the side of the headphone.  I didn’t have to have my device to raise or lower the volume.  Very easy to install and get started.  Ear pieces are very comfortable.  I was a little disappointed in the range of the headphone.  Your device has to be close.  I couldn’t not go into another room and have the stay connected.

title: Great battery life for a bluetooth earbuds.
review:
The battery life on these are great. I am typically on 4+ hours of calls a day and listen to a about 20 minutes of podcasts a day. The battery life is as advertised. I found the bluetooth connection to be pretty solid as well.

The rubber earbuds that fit into your ear do a good job of blocking out ambient noise. They sit comfortably on your ears. I have yet to work out with them though, but for daily work calls and use... they get the job done easily.

title: I love these headphones
review:
I love these headphones. I use them for my Xbox, the sound is clear and the mic picks ups very well. This is my second pair, and my first pair is still in active use (gave it to my brother in law). I think they have a great sound and as constructed very well. The wood just looks nice as well.

They include 6 different headphone buds to make sure you have the right fit. While these aren't noise cancelling, I can't hear my wife calling for me from the other room...until she gets in my eye line.

title: Annoying and un-initiative power on/power off, kills usability
review: Sound quality and fit is perfect but the power on process kills it. You need to hold down AND release the power button to turn the earbuds on, but the problem is there is no sound/light that gives you feedback on when you can release the button. And if you hold down the button too long, it won't power on at all. Not only that, the power-on sound only plays a couple seconds AFTER releasing the power button. Essentially, these ear buds are a pain to turn on especially if you put them down for a little bit and you don't know if they're already on, or already off.

title: Good sound, but non standard ear tips
review:
The bass on these are way better than the JayBird Freedoms that this replaced, but the problem is these don't use the same standard sized ear tips that nearly every other earbud manufacturer seems to use(these require a hole in the tip that's significantly bigger than others). If you lose them, then you'll end up paying $5 + shipping for a set(which is essentially 2), where as I can get a pack of 10 for $2 off any site. Switching to more comfortable gel tips are not an option too.

Another warning is that the microusb charge plug doesn't have the same feel/pop/click feeling when plugging them in to charge, the first time I kept pressing the charge cable and I almost broke the tip or wonder if I used the right plug.

The plus side is that the bass is really good, way better than my JayBirds, and it has the nice battery level indicator on my iPhone.

title: Just adequate
review: I'm not sure about the bone conduction. The size is a little small, so it hurts to keep this on my head for long. The music can be heard while it is not near my head. They do function as headphones for music. Those ear plugs are counter to the purpose of bone conduction headphones. I would not want to block noise from cars if I walk or run near a road. I have had close encounters before this year. The price is right for what these do.

title: Replace disintegrating headphone pads
review:
Pried off the headphone speaker and pad on each side (iHome headphones - no model on the headphones - had to look up that info from when I ordered them), slipped off the old pad, and reattached the headphones. Then I put a line of glue on each of the new pads, one at a time, and pressed the new pad onto the headphone over the speaker until it was in the right position. Allowed it to set up for several hours before gluing the other pad. Used Elmers clear glue.

Now the headphones can be used once again (without getting black flakes all over the place), and the pads fit comfortably over my ears.

title: Love it!
review: Fits my work desk perfectly. If you have a home desk it may be too big, pay attention to the dimensions, evidently those holes are all different sizes! I love it, I can plug in my phone and my headset for Zooming.

title: Amazing sound, Long battery
review: I typically hate earbuds and prefer over the head headphones....I like my music LOUD--I like to drown out ALL the noise. Needed something small for a long flight. These were way better than I had hoped. Super comfortable in the ears, charged one time...lasted the entire trip. Charged for the second time one week after the trip. These even worked standing in the middle of the ocean--- the color (orange) made them super fun!! Hight recommend

title: Other side could not hear me.
review: It took a little bit for the headphones to pair up and work. I could hear fine and it was fairly clear. The people on the other end could not hear me well at all. I ended up having to speaker phone and hold the phone for a two hour call.

title: Great value!!
review:

I got these at a very steep discount and didn't expect much. I was getting them as a spare pair.

Well, they far outperformed my much more expensive pair of earbuds. The sound quality is great, they're comfortable, and they stay put for workouts!

title: These are terrible headphones with poor sound quality
review: You get what you pay for!  These are terrible headphones with poor sound quality.

title: Perfect!
review: Great wireless earbuds! Good sound, good battery life, and they fit in my ears perfectly. I would absolutely purchase these again.

title: Feels cheap
review: I got these headphones for my 2.5 year old daughter that LOVES Barbie. The design is cute and the colors are bright. The padding on the ears are soft and comfortable. They are a bit for her head and fit my adult head better. They just feel cheaply made to me. The cord is very thin and if the cord comes out of the side of the headphone, they are totally broken. Other brands have the cord that can come out with a plug which makes is way easier since little kids like to tug on it. These headphones are also labeled L and R so make sure you have them on the right ears or they fit funny. They don’t come with a carrying case or little bag. Personally, I feel there are way better kids headphones out there at the same price point.

title: AMAZING
review: Great sound for such inexpensive earbuds. Will definitely be buying a few more for Christmas gifts this year.

title: They are okay
review: I feel that these headphones were okay but since I have small ears even with the hoop thing it has it still would fall off of my ear. It was annoying that the part that goes in your ear doesn't have any rubber support 😒.  It would hurt my ears ever time I has to ear these.  Other than that they are good.

title: Great for the apple enthusiast
review: My wife wanted overpriced apple earbuds..pardon me airpods, and these were a tolerable price point. Great functions and decent mic pickup though i will admit.

title: excellent choice

title: Absolutely yes
review: My husband and I use these alot as well as our grand kids. Great for Christmas presents. Love the quaitly of these earbuds. Great sound, good battery life and good value for the money. review: Very large, I was hoping for a snug fit. These extended further than the actual cushion.  So if you want to charge you will need to take off or just pull off a little. title: Great headphones
review:

These are great everyday use for music and movies.

review:

title: Nice, Economical Headset
review: Pretty nice headset for the amount of money that was paid for it.  It works perfectly.

title: Worth to buy. Outstanding performance
review: Well, it is an excellent earphone. As a Bluetooth in ear headphone, it has outstanding performance. I even feel that it is better than my IE60, maybe because I am using my iPhone instead of a flac ape wav player. It is worth the price. But when you use the mic, the sound is not as good as using other wired headphones. It is really a good headphone. Worth to buy.

review: I guess you get what you pay for.  Not much bass. Sound fluctuations switch from left to right ears throughout use.  They'll work in a  pinch until you are able to purchase a pair of  better quality  earbuds.  Sorry☹

review:

I had a cell phone headset, but it would just not stay on.

title: Had mine since 2000
review:

I still don't understand what the deal with beats headphones are.

title: Durable, nice for $20. Saved me money.
review:
This is a good pair of inexpensive headphones. They are durable. I have bought both the black and white models - just not for myself. I prefer the white ones since they are easier to find in clutter. These can not touch my SONY V6 headphones, not even close. Of course, I don't want anyone to touch my SONY V6 headphones so these fill that gap nicely. After more than two years of use I was surprised that these did not fall apart. These are not that comfortable but that's not the point, these are nice for being $20. In this same price range I paid more than this for ear bud headphones, all of which fell apart. Most of my ear-bud headphones suffered the same fate of having their cables break on the inside.

it's not fare to compare these to more expensive headphones. If you are buying these for yourself and can afford it, of course get better ones.

title: HIgh Quality Headphone Extenders
review: It's helpful to have a few of these around so your headphones can reach a little farther.

title: COVID Work From Home Lifesaver
review: Save your ears! Stop wearing headphones! The solid quality is impeccable and my co-workers say they can hear me crystal clear.  Highly recommended.

title: Great wireless headphones
review:
Great wireless headphones. Step up immediately from the wireless airpods, great looking, and wonderful fit.

Cons.: Experienced a problem with one of the headphones seeming to short out at times and stop working. Frustrating when on the go with these.

title: Five Stars
review: these are great headphones for the price! and they last so long before having to charge-would definitely recommend these!

title: comfortable, light and well designed
review: Just got it, looks nice and sounds good. I'd say you can get a good deal from this product, the quality is pretty good. They fit in the ear in a similar way to the Apple earbuds. I just received this product and I hope to share my feelings on using it after a while.

title: Enjoyed traveling with it!
review:
I hadn't seen a movie in..drum roll please..six years. ANY movie.
As I bought myself a portable DVD player for Christmas for business use and for travel, I needed the travel case (and headphones, too!)

I had a plane trip coming up and wanted to take this as my carry-on.

May I digress a moment? Good grief! Whatever happened to standards? I cannot believe the things I saw people bringing onto the airplanes! What in the world is the matter with people?! And why did the airlines allow it!? Ridiculous!
Strollers, golf-bag sized duffel bags, whole sets of luggage, HUGE pieces of luggage! Why bother having those signs and cubes that say 'if your bag won't fit in this space' you will have to check your bag if they don't abide by it??!
Ok..I've vented..

Anyway, I don't want the hassle of carrying things so I carry a purse and this time my DVD bag and I just loved it. I watched movies on my drop down tray and never even took the DVD player out of the case.

It gets 4 stars only because the headphones barely fit and because I prefer having two zippers on the track inside of just one. Know what I mean? Being able to zip one side, then the other side on the same track and have the zippers meet in the middle. I think it would have made manuevering much easier. And if the bag was expandable or larger to accomodate the headphones and accessories better it would be PER-FECT!

title: So thrilled!
review:
I just used my Sony Walkman Radio/Cassette player and am so thrilled!
What a great product! The quality is so nice; the headphones just perfect for me and the case that came with it fit snuggly on my sweats while I jogged on the treadmill.
I was so happy to dig out some old cassettes I haven't listened to in 15 years and had so much fun remembering the songs and singing at the top of my lungs! (I'm sure the neighbors appreciated it - LOL)
Thanks, Sony, for bringing back the memories of songs and times and places and for getting me back into walking again!
The only thing I might wish it had is an auto-reverse to play the other side of the tape, but maybe not since that is what broke on my last cassette player (which was an Emerson).
I love it so much I'll be ordering another one just in case this one gets discontinued or something - hopefully not ever!

title: I Love these headphones
review: I Love these headphones ... I use them with my android phone,,kindle and sing with them on signsnap...Loved them so much that we purchased a pair for my Dad..Definately a good buy...

title: This is the best blue tooth headset I have ever purchased!!
review: This has been the best blue tooth headset I had ever purchased!! However, when I ordered a new replacement - I received a defective one. So I ordered another one & I’m not impressed by the quality of the new ones I have received. I will try one last time & then - I will give up.

title: These are the best wireless headphones I have ever purchased!!
review: These are the best wireless headphones I have ever purchased!! The sound is awesome, noise cancelling unbelievable and a great price!!

title: Great sound
review: This is the best earbuds I have ever had. Comfortable to wear, great sound. Well worth the money.

title: Amazing sound quality!
