After the initial charge, I listened to music from various sources and the sound quality was better then I expected, especially given the Lightning price paid. When I attempted to charge it the "second time" at my charging place (simply a six-foot surge power strip) that has the mfg. supplied charger and/or the cable as the connector ends vary a bit. So, I go to change the puppy up and the mini- receptacle pops back into the housing which prevents charging. I would guess that the good ole QC practice has disappeared so likely I just got a random bad one. Initial and especially long-term product quality must be paid for.

title: Well worth the cost! My IPOD Classic Reborn
review:
I was expecting some clunky piece of semi-finished electronics out of China and instead I am pleased to say the construction grade I give a B+ to and operating ease and efficiency A- (only due to tiny-tiny-tiny print on instructions. (correctable via download it seems) so not a real minus.

The improvement to the volume output on my Ipod is a 10 out of 10. Quality of audio and ease of adjustments 8 out of 10. Clearly I need a better pair of traveling headphones but no more earbud style for me at any price. Older studio quality (seven years ago) Sony model is good now but the increased power output causes distortion at any level higher than 50% of available volume which is not their fault as they need to be semi-retired and not used for any more Zeppelin or strenuous bass. Phenominal in their prime. Buy the reviewed item; it is GREAT especially for group and indicidual tunes while traveling or CAMPING with your friends. Doing research on affordable but solid bluetooth outdoor possible semi-lightweight portable single speaker units. Have made four purchases but more on that at new review site!

title: Linklike Wired Earbuds
review:
THE BEST EARBUDS EVER
The quality is literally unbeatable for the price! Thank you Linklike! Truly the best earbuds I've ever owned. I've lost a few pairs of these over the years but always come back and buy the same ones– I've been using them every day! I will now never have to buy wireless ones and I will for sure find a good option from this brand! Highly recommend!

PROS:

These earbuds are so comfortable you don't even feel them in your ears. Great at blocking out noise. The controls and mic work perfectly.

CONS: NONE

title: Separate buttons for volume and skip ahead/back. YAY
review: These do exactly what I want. I can wear these working out and can still hear cars and other things. There is a separate button for skip ahead and back as well as volume up and down. No holding down longer for the two different functions. Plus very affordable! I have found that my having fingernails, not long by any means, makes it difficult to turn off the headphones because a small part of my fingernail hits one of the other buttons as I push. I love these headphones so much for my audiobooks that I made a solutions that works perfectly. See the photos. I rounded a ball of Sugru and stuck it on top of the too-small button, let it dry overnight, then sliced off the top to make it flat. I've done this for my other headphones too that I can't blindly feel the on off button without taking them off.

title: I am in LOVE. These have changed my life and my marriage
review: I'm a writer and my husband plays his tv shows and sports or music which really detracts me. I must have ADD or something because I get distracted so easily. In the room I have this ceiling fan that does not know how to move air quietly, the "special silent" motor isn't silent anyore—unless I put on these headphones! I have no idea how they work, but bluetooth connects them to my computer and my phone so I can use them like regular bluetooth speaker headphones. It's summer now and my neighbors always have bbqs with lots of beer. I like to sit by my pool with a glass of wine and write. I can't even hear any of them unless someone shouts I got the silvery ones and am glad I did. They sort of disappear on my head easier than big ol black ones. I have never had pain from these either and wear them all day. When I bought them, I also bought the Sony Noise Cancelling Headphones WH1000XM3 which are actually just as amazing but Bose was just one tiny bit better. But mostly, I didn't like the dull finish on their silvery ones. Looked cheap. sooooo happy with these I'm going to buy my son a pair who is starting college and gets way too distracted by his roommates. His grades are going to improve so much!

title: I can't believe I've lived without these!
review: I am completely addicted to my headphones. I wear them hiking and listening to my music or books on mp3. When someone calls, I just answer it and my book or music pauses and I can just talk without doing anything. The microphone in the ears picks up a clear voice. I ask what I sound like and everyone says it sounds great. I can wander around the house in these but if I get too far away from my iphone, it starts to blank out. It's best to carry your player in a pocket. The earpiece is a perfect size. Not too large or small. I am going to buy these as a gift for everyone in my family. Good price here too.

title: The sound is awesome and they are comfortable to wear!!!
review: These headphones are great because they fit on the ear comfortably and the sound is nice and clear, and even when louder is not distorted. I use these for movie watching on the computer, as well as for transcription. The price for these is very reasonable too! Highly recommend!!!

title: Great product
review: Great product. I prefer the one with the head phones after getting this one. I have had 4 rokus I keep giving them to my friends and family. I got this one for me and I should have purchased the one with headphones.  I have had bothe. They all provide great tv service.

title: What i wanted!
review: I really wanted to replace my old bose headphones but wasnt sure whether to stay with Bose or go Sony. I am happy with my purchase as it does everything i wanted in the new headphones. and they are really comfy!!

title: *** UPDATED *** Lightweight, comfortable but ridiculous Burn In process recommended
review:
I use these for walking and listening to my audible books, so don't need a great range of sound frequencies, but I went for the recommended Audio burn in process. I have no idea if this improved the sound quality as they stated since I didn't listen to them prior to the burn in, but as I did the requisite 40 hours of burn, all I could think of was, why didn't they do this at the factory instead of asking me to wait 40 hours and tie up my phone to do it? Very poor customer service.
At any rate I am now happy and this headset performs well for my purposes.

*** Update October 2021 ***
The ear cushions stay on very loosely, always was a problem, but it finally happened that I lost one somewhere. Now the whole unit is useless just for one foam earpiece. Stay away from this.

title: Great Headset, my favorite
review: The best, the only headsets I use.  So comfortable you forget you have them on.  Voice are clear on mic and headphones for clear phonecalls.  The cord can be a hassle for some people but not me.  I don't need another bluetooth headset unit to keep charged, this one is always ready and available.

title: Excellent product
review:
PROS

1. The control buttons work well, and they are easy to find by touch, without having to glance at them.
2. The sound quality is excellent, in particular, they offer unusually good bass for an earbud set.
3. They are waterproof. This is quite useful for me for exercising in the pool, such as water walking and water aerobics. I don’t feel completely safe using these earbuds for swimming, though.
4. The battery is advertised as working up to 24 hours on a single charge. I haven’t personally confirmed this claim, but the charge definitely lasts for an entire day, in which I have used them up to 10 hours.
5. They have a hook on each earbud, which allows them to stay in place while exercising.
6. Good value for the cost.

CONS

None that I can think of.

title: Excellent product for this price range
review:
PROS

1. These earbuds have sturdy construction, which is actually much more sturdy than other brands of a similar style of Bluetooth sports earbuds I have owned.

2. It has an attractive color of deep pink and purple.

3. It fits comfortably. As is typical for this type of sports earbuds, there are hooks that go over the ears to keep it in place when you exercise.

4. It comes with a convenient, zippered carrying case, extra tips, and a charge cable.

5. It connects easily to my smartphone.

6. The sound quality is good—I use it for phone calls, audiobooks, music, and videos.

CONS

For this price range, I can’t think of any complaints. I would order this brand again.

title: Works well
review:
PROS

1. It has a noise-canceling microphone.
2. It is comfortable to wear, although can be a bit hot on the ears in some environments.
3. It is relatively light-weight, given what it is.
4. It has a 3.5 mm jack, which can be connected to a PC, Mac, or smartphone.
5. It is easy to set up.

CONS

1. These headphones do not fit entirely over the ears, so in a particularly loud environment, noise could get through, causing difficulty hearing. I do not have an issue with this myself.

title: Works best for stationary use
review:
After a bit of fiddling around, I finally got this headphone amplifier to work with my cell phone. It actually does seem to help the quality of its audio. It allows me to have clearer sound on my phone for bass in particular, which is something I otherwise find to be a problem when listening to music on my phone. The sound of bass guitar is generally weak without this amplifier. The problem is, in order to use this amplifier with my phone, I have only two choices: (1) Sit still, since it is not possible to freely move around with my phone while listening to music using headphones and this amplifier as I can do when I use Bluetooth earbuds, since this device does not have Bluetooth transmitter capability. (2) Carry my phone in one pocket and this device in a separate pocket, which seems like a weird way to do things in this era of ubiquitous wireless transmission.

Due to the above limitations, this amplifier is much better suited to stationary use, such as a laptop. When I used it that way, it did make both treble and base sound better, and it reduced outside noise.

title: Terrific sound quality
review:
I have had the chance to test through Vine multiple different Bluetooth headphones with microphone, both over-the-ear type and earbuds. These are the best I’ve tried though, of course, part of that is, “You get what you pay for.” These are quite pricey.

These headphones can be used to make phone calls with both Android smartphones and iPhones, and they paired easily with my Android Pixel 3a phone. They also paired easily with the transmitter for my TV.

More Positives:

—Battery life as advertised, lasts around 19 hours.
—Headphones comfortable, and “L” and “R” clearly labeled on their inside.
—Excellent sound quality for music, phone calls, podcasts, and audiobooks.
—USB C connector.
—On/Off slide switch rather than a button.
—Volume control.
—Noise cancellation.
—Sleek, modern, attractive design.

A Few Negatives:

—Single button for play/pause, forward and back, and nothing is labeled.
—No carrying case

Overall, a good value for the money.

title: Good value for the money
review:
This product includes a Micro-USB cable for charging, two ear tip sizes and two wing tip sizes. I had never previously owned a Bluetooth headphone with in-ear wing tips. All my other ones have either ear buds or over-the-ear wing tips. I was afraid these would be uncomfortable, but fortunately, they feel fine and hold their position firmly in my ears.

I was easily able to pair up these Bluetooth headphones with both my Android smartphone and the transmitter I use for my TV. Their volume doesn't turn up quite as high as my other brands of Bluetooth headphones, some of which cost twice the retail price of these. This poses a slight problem for me when listening to TV but not for phone calls, audiobooks or music on my phone. The sound quality is otherwise clear and without distortion. This device re-charges fairly quickly.

All in all, I consider this a good value for such relatively low-priced Bluetooth headphones.

title: Similar, less expensive products work just as well or better
review:
This is a moderately high-end headset with a price to match. The manufacturer claims that it supports multiple devices at the same time, that it has a long range of 490 feet, that the battery charge lasts "all day," which most of us would interpret as 8-12 hours or more, and that it has a noise-cancelling microphone and enhanced speakers to create "crystal-clear calls" in noisy work environments.

I have tried to pair it to both my phone and TV transmitter at the same time, and the TV transmitter does pair if the phone is paired. The range isn't as far as advertised. The battery charge lasts about 4-6 hours. It has excellent sound quality for receiving calls and listening to TV, but persons on the other end of a phone call often complain that they have trouble hearing me, so the mic doesn't work very well. This headset is really uncomfortable to wear, making it difficult to use it more than an hour. Also, be aware that the rechargeable battery is not replaceable when it dies.

I actually have a headset with similar functions that cost me about 1/5th the price, so I'm not convinced this product is worth the extra money.

title: Excellent, inexpensive earbuds
review:
I use inexpensive earbuds for my MP3, smartphone and a transmitter hooked up to my TV (which allows me to watch it with no sound disturbing my husband). For these purposes, I have found the sound quality for these earbuds substantially better than for my usual, inexpensive Panasonic earbuds.

The earbuds are comfortable in my ears and do not dislodge easily when I bend over. The wires are less prone to tangling than my Panasonic earbuds, which is a nice plus. The package includes three different sizes of silicone earpieces, which makes them able to serve users of various ages and sizes.

These earbuds come in multiple, bright, attractive colors. I received the blue color, and it is a rich, deep blue.

All in all, I like this product and would have no problem purchasing it again or recommending it to friends and family.

title: Good value for the price
review:
These earbuds are an attractive red color. They are a comfortable fit in the ears, and they have good sound quality.

These are a good value for the price. I have bought them before and will buy again.

title: Very comfortable, as advertised, and good sound quality
review:
I really like these earbuds. I use the medium-sized ear cushions. They fit me fine. I can keep them in for 5-7 hours listening to audiobooks, music or hooked to the transmitter for listening to my TV, and they do not hurt my ears. The sound quality is good for all of these activities.

I used my voice-recognition app on my Android smartphone, and it worked as well as if I didn't have these earbuds in.

The cord is only a little over 3 feet long, which is a bit short. However, this cord seems to tangle up a lot less than my other brands of earbuds.

I got the blue color, and it is a clear, bright, attractive blue.

I did not like the clamshell packaging! It is a pain to open, and having to use scissors to cut open such packaging leaves dangerously sharp edges that can easily cut the skin if one does not take extreme care to prevent it. You also need to watch out that you don't accidentally throw out the extra ear cushions which come in several sizes.

title: Terrific sound quality!
review:
I have another pair of wireless, Bluetooth earphones that I like a lot, but the sound quality of this set blows the other ones away. Of course, these cost twice as much, so that might have something to do with it.

In particular, these earphones are terrific for listening to music. I use them around the house and while working out at the gym. The earbuds are comfortable and fit well. They don't fall out when I am active, and the neckband is comfortable as well.

Another major plus of this product is the long-lasting charge of the battery. My other Bluetooth earphones only hold a charge for two hours. To have a charge for 18 hours means I can go several days without having to recharge the battery. Amazing!

title: Comfortable
review:
I was very happy to find these replacement earpads for my Sennheiser headphones. I use them incessantly to watch TV without disturbing my husband, and vice versa for him.

They are quite good quality, but frankly, I could not myself load them onto the headphone. I had to get my husband to help with the task, and he struggled with them, too. It's a tight fit.

But all's well that ends well. They are on now and they work great. Very comfortable.

title: Great value for an excellent product
review: These earbuds work as well as the Panasonic ones my husband and I have purchased for years. The sound quality is excellent, and the price is about half as much. I've already ordered a second pair. It comes in a pleasing variety of colors for all tastes. I got the pink and my husband got the blue.

title: Wonderful product
review:
I have owned these headphones since August, 2014. They are easy to use, and the sound quality is excellent. Prior to owning them, I tried out some $20 wireless headphones from a local drugstore which did not work at all, and I also did a jury-rigged setup with a very long, trip-hazard cable linking some headphones I owned to my TiVo. Never again. Both were a disaster.

This system is absolutely wonderful for two reasons:

First, I have weird hearing issues in that when I am trying to sleep, every little sound bugs me and I seem to hear even a conversation in the next room far more clearly than I have any desire to do, but when listening to TV, I can't understand 75% of what the actors are saying without captions. Go figure. With these headphones, no more problem. All dialog is clear as a bell.

Second, I no longer have to drive my husband crazy blaring the TV in order to adequately hear the actors speaking. By the same token, if my husband is watching a program on TV that I'm not at all interested in, I don't have to be subjected to listening to that either.

It's win-win.

I will say that I was not myself techie enough to install these headphones. My husband is an IT guy and he had to do it for me. So that's one downside for the customer who struggles with techie installations. Other than that, all is great.

title: Works well for Dragon Naturally Speaking but not very comfortable on my head
review:
I got this headset to use with Dragon Naturally Speaking. It works very well with that software.

I had no problems with it technically. I simply had to run it through the training wizard in Dragon, which I had already done previously for a handheld recording device I had purchased previously.

The one negative is a fairly big one, though. The headset presses too tightly into my skull on the opposite side of the earphone. When I need to use this for many hours at a time, that's a very uncomfortable downside.

I rate this product 5 stars for how well it works and 2 stars for comfort. Overall, 4 stars.

title: Love these!
review:
We have several different brands of earbuds around the house, and these are the ones my husband and I like the best. They come in a large variety of colors, the cushioning at the tips is very comfortable in the ears, the sound quality is great, and the price is excellent.

The next time we have to purchase earbuds, we will be buying this brand again.

title: Decent, inexpensive headset
review: This is not an expensive headset, so I didn't expect it to be wonderful. It works fine, after a year of fairly frequent use at my desktop computer. However, recently I have switched to using earbuds not just with my iPhone and MP3 player, but with my desktop and laptop, too. Earbuds are a lot smaller, more portable, and comfortable than a regular headset.

title: Excellent product
review:
I've ordered these earbuds before and liked them enough to order again. They are comfortable in my ears, durable and produce excellent sound on my iPod and MP3. The color and style are quite attractive, and the price is good for what you get.

Highly recommended.

title: Amazing sound quality, Durability is another matter.
review: Extremely good sound quality, all of my friends found the microphone to be very good quality and everyone could hear me very clearly. However the durability, I used these in office conditions with very little movement. I literately did not take them out of my office, and after about 1 and a half weeks the right earbud no longer work, the microphone also no longer works. I am extremely disappointed  in these since I thought they would be amazing, and they were, until a week passed.

title: Great quality & value
review: My daughter LOVES these. She got sick of normal earbuds for listening to music on her iPhone, and these have been a fantastic replacement.

title: Came apart in 2 days
review: Shoddy assembly, cord came out of headphones within 2 days. Not recommended for a 5 year old.

title: A 1 Star rating is really too much....
review: I really wish I could give this less than a 1 star rating. These earbuds/earphones are such a waste of money. I know they were cheap, but you might as well throw your money in the trash if you plan on buying these. They are HORRIBLE!!!!! You can barely hear anything out of them. Even when it was at full blast and there was not any background/outside noise going on I couldn't hear very much. This is NOT an exaggeration. I know sometimes these reviews are but they are horrible. I originally bought them for my 10 year old daughter and she gave them to me complaining she couldn't hear out of them well enough. She likes to "blare" her music super loud in her headphones so I figured she was being melodramatic. WELL....she wasn't. I think my whisper is louder than what these ear phones/clips get. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!!!!

title: good sound good unit...not much on rounded edges
review: nice little unit...good price...biggest problem is its rounded edges..i cant wrap earphone wires around it...just becomes a mess in my pocket...sound is good radio works fine...will get another just wish i could wrap headphone wire around it...no biggie..good unit

title: order two with one problem
review: yes ive been using htese sansa for years now...and yes things change..and yes they have changed the charger...bummer now have to have 2 different charges at work and home for the older models and newer ones...also purchased these open boxed saved a couple of bucks and came with no earbuds..bummer..but with that out of the way....i enjoy the battery life and ease of use...

title: Cude solves problems for me.
review:
The combination of tap and cube is really all thats needed. Forget the other Echo devices. Cube solved many tv issues for me. No need to shout Alexa commands over tv background noise Alexa politely pauses your Alexa related activity for you. Switch tv inputs no problem. Volume control, on/off, and search are well developed. Apparantly improved network communication problems that I caused me to abandoned the stick.
Not all offerings as Roku: remote earphone jack, Spectrum internet tv app absent during at least search during my initial set app search in late june. Using alexa to turn the tv on automatically sets the tv input to fire cube's. Thats what Ive observed sinse June 21 preordered shipment.

title: Love these earbuds!
review: I had a previous version of these earbuds and like them so much that I ordered another set for my husband. I did have a problem with the first pair but the customer service was so quick it was almost unbelievable. I wrote an email and a replacement set was in my mailbox in two days! Great company to buy from. This pair has wireless charging which is something we both wanted. Not as much clutter on the nightstand with a 3-in-1 charging stand. These earbuds are very comfortable. I had similar ones from Apple and had to send them back because they hurt my ears. Not these! I often listen to stories as I go to sleep at night and use only the right earbud for that. I don’t even know it’s there and it stays comfortable all night. The battery life is great. I love to listen to audio books and listen for hours each day as I do my housework and cook meals and these have never failed me. I would highly recommend these to anyone.

title: Great addition to our TV room
review: These headphones are great. My husband has some hearing loss and the loud TV drives me a little crazy. Then there are times I want to watch a show and he wants to read. And there are times we both want to use them for clarity. We find that they connect easily. At first the red one didn’t connect well, but after a little use it seems to be fine now. They are comfortable and hug the head so if you tip your head down they don’t fall off. Although they don’t keep out all outside sound they do a great job. If my husband talks to me while I’m wearing them I usually have to take them off and ask him to repeat what he said. I especially like the USB charging. We have the outlets built into our side tables, so we just hang these on a hook on the side table and the charger is right there. Overall we are very pleased with this purchase and will probably buy another set for the bedroom where our old uncomfortable headphones seem to be on their last legs.

title: Great headphones
review: I use this to do my Rosetta Stone lessons and it is working well.  My biggest problem is that I sometimes forget that I'm attached and walk away from the computer while still wearing the headset.  LOL!  The only complaint I have is small.  They are a little tight, so they can get uncomfortable when wearing them for extended periods.  By the time the pressure gets to me I'm usually ready to quit studying German anyway.  Great sound in and out!

title: What a joke!
review: I purchased these at Sam's Club when I saw them beside the Bose for a much lower price.  I should know by now that you get what you pay for.  When I put the battery in and turned them on, the noise canceling quality was so poor I could still hear my dishwasher (and it's a new very quiet dishwasher).  I really didn't see any difference.  I use noise canceling earbuds while mowing the lawn and they cancel noise much more effectively than these do.  When I tried these with the mower I had to turn my iPod almost all the way up to hear the song.  I won't do that to my ears.  I think I'll go back for the Bose. When we tried the Bose in the store all background sounds faded away completely.

title: Waist of money
review: I paid 50 something dollars with the tax the headphones went out in a week I am mad and waisted my money

title: Almost perfect.
review:
Finally seem to have found a pair of bluetooth headphones with acceptable connection performance. I was begining to think that it was too much to ask to be able to put my phone in my pocket and still be connected. Or to walk more than a few feet away from my phone and still stay connected. These ace those tests. Connectivity is not perfect but I am willing to accept that as it's bluetooth. I do get the occasional drop for no apparent reason but it is not often enough to be a huge negative.
They come packaged really nicely. So nicely you almost feel obligated to go slow and enjoy the experience.
You have to chose between the silicone or foam ear bud tips. The silicone feels softer and goes in and out easier. The foam will give you a more secure fit and sound isolation. I went with the foam and they do a fairly good job of keeping the outside world out. They are by no means 100 percent effective though.
I used the medium foam tips as well as the ear wings and find the comfort pretty good and the fit very secure. Wearing them for a couple hours was not an issue and I had no discomfort.
I cannot comment on their ability to transmit music as I use them for podcasts. Sound quality was fine for speech.
These have come down in price so much lately that I think they are a no brainer compared to the competition.
I dropped them a star due to the occasional random connection failure but overall I am very pleased with them.

title: Wanted to love these but....
review: The most important thing to me about wireless headphones is range. It seems that the tech is not quite there yet. I see in some reviews that people are able to still be connected a couple rooms away in their house. I did not get this same result. Comfort and fit are top notch. I really could wear these all day. I do not run but I would imagine they would be rock solid and stay in place. I wanted to love these. I really wanted to love these. However the range is just not realistic (at least in the pair I had). If I set my phone down and walked more than a 5 feet away they cut out completely. If I put the phone in my pocket they cut out completely. My phone is a Galaxy S7 Edge. Sound when in range is good but the limitations in range are not realistic for everyday use. My search for a pair of bluetooth headphones continues. If you want to use these at your desk with your phone right in front of you I think you will be happy.

title: Good quality and sound for the price but NOT a comfy fit (this might be due to having small ears, so don't let that deter you)
review:
I have a thing for diffusers, portable batteries, essential oils, and I am somewhat of an earbud hoarder, so I didn't refuse the offer to test out the Accutrend headphones. I've had them for nearly a month to thoroughly test them out, and here is my assessment:

Pros
*I've tried several different earbuds, and these are good in terms of price and quality at the time of this review.
*I like the volume control and microphone feature, because it is an added convenience, and I am able to adjust without much difficulty
*The detachable clip and hard, protective storage case are an added bonus
*Sound quality and bass is better than expected when I first pulled the earphones out of the case
*

Cons

*The biggest issue I had was having them fit comfortably in my ears and staying in place. This isn't helpful for workouts, and there doesn't appear to be a proper workaround. (Supplemental note: My husband has larger ears, so he seemed fine with the fit when trying them out)
*They do tangle easier than some of the other models I've tried of the same caliber which makes it a little annoying

These earbuds are a good deal for the consumer pocket as of today. If the product malfunctions, I will revisit this review and update accordingly. I did receive these earbuds free for testing purposes for an unbiased review, and positive ratings are never guaranteed.

title: For the price this is an excellent performer. I enjoy my music and phone conversations ...
review: For the price this is an excellent performer.  I enjoy my music and phone conversations without a hitch.  The headphones are well built and very comfortable.  No issues with the seller or delivery date.  All went well.

title: excellent, comfortable wireless headphones
review: These are very comfortable resting around the neck.  The earbuds fit well and stay put.  The sound is great, clear, and blocks background.  I've had headphones where you can feel and hear every step vibrate/echo  but this set  is very clear.

title: This product doesn't last
review: I dont trust this product line of headphones! This is my second replacement due to poor materials and construction. First pair lasted a few months then the headphone covers came  off! The replacement broke apart at the swivel assembly while wearing around my neck! Very thin plastic parts and cheap design engineering. Sure, they sound good and Anker has an 18 month warranty, but im tiring of getting replacements that WILL break with daily use.

title: Decent clarifying headphone with a flaw
review: After getting Soundcore and similar phones and using them for a while and discovering shortcomings, i decided to try these as i have other ZVOX products. At my age i needed a hearing enhanced headphone. Best features are very clear dialogue and NO Bluetooth lag! Im pleasantly surprised as i was always seeking higher volume for speech clarity and these help greatly. Ive lost about 15% of my hearing.  HOWEVER, first pair were returned due to excessive noise when pairing. I had to turn them on and off on. And off and on to get them to pair. I returned them and got a replacement. But these had the same problem! One could blame it on my bluetooth transmitter, but its never happened with my other two headphones! Some sort of design bug.

title: Over hyped by sly marketing payoffs
review: You get what you pay for, A mediocre TV with a lame remote, along with several useful features missing. Color adjustability barely makes a difffrence in too red picture. Picture is not clear enough. No mute or volume controls with headphones plugged in. Don’t be fooled, my 4 year old Vizio beats it w/o HDR, etc.

title: Better sound with some Quirks
review:
It provided better overall sound for my anemic older Vizio TV. However, several issues make it quite different from other "soundbar" types. If you program your Comcast remote to use the Zvox functions,it hijacks other functions that control your TV! I have my headphones connected to the audio out, and now I cant use my Comcast remote to control them or any normal Vizio audio functions without turning off the Zvox manually. OL barely works as commercials are still as loud as ever. I still have to turn it up to get a decent level on shows,and theres quite a bump up in sound between 17-18!
No codes to use with other universal remotes? Seems the Zvox people decided once it was hooked up no one would ever switch back to their TV sound for any functions. If it worked seamlessly with my remote I'd give it 4 stars. Easier to stick to their weird remote.

title: Great but
review: Generally speaking the headphones are awesome but I find that the battery life is short. Don’t last 22 hours as advertised.

title: My Husband Loved His Gift!
review: I bought this as a gift for my husband.  He does not use his phone with a bluetooth and it not really tech savvy when it comes to his cell phone.  When he walked with his hand held radio he would drop it or the earbuds would not work.  This was perfect!  It blocks out sound completely and he can tune into his favorite channel.  The quality of sound is very good and he has had no complaints.  He has had no trouble finding his favorite stations.  Great radio/headset!

title: Perfect for those still listening to radio!
review: This is small, but mighty.  It is a wonderful little radio with impressive sound.  The clarity and volume are superb.  I bought it for my husband who loves to walk and listen to programming.  His earphones fit perfectly, and it even has a wrist strap for safety.  A transistor radio will never be obsolete!

title: It works!  Finally can get wireless headset connected through my laptop
review: Easy to install.  Worked well for the new headset on my laptop.  FINALLY now can use the wireless headset on this laptop.  Was always tethered before.  Thank you!!

title: Great quality for the price.
review: So far I’m very pleased. They charge and keep a charge well. Sound quality is on par with more expensive brand name headphones.

title: Won't stand behind their product.
review: These were great headphones when I first received them. I used them a few times and then stopped using them for many months, really for no particular reason. Once I decided to start using them again they would not charge. I contacted Plantronics Customer Service and they emailed me a procedure to reset them. Unfortunately that procedure did not work. I contacted them with this information and they apologized and told me to return them for replacement. When I tried to do that their website informed me that the warranty was expired, by a month. End result is a non working pair of $80 headphones....

title: High quality sound and very durable.
review:
I am really enjoying these earbuds. The sound quality is excellent. I’m using them for multiple purposes both for transcription as well as listening to music and both the voice audio and the depth of music tones are satisfactory.

I particularly like the durability of their construction. I am hard on my earbuds, particularly the connector onto the computer. This is all metal and therefore much sturdier than ones I have had in the past.

title: Not compatable with a macbook 12 that doesnt have a USB port.
review: They are good headphones. Unfortunately,​ I had to return them because I have a MacBook 12 retina which does not have a USB port, and I could not connect them.

title: mY OLD EVO HAS VOICE!
review:
1. I didn't think it would really work as plug & play which usually means plug and fiddle on older computers like my Compaq EVO W8000 Server-PC without a sound card-but I was wrong.
2. Plugged it in, attached the headphones, booted the EVO, put in a movie and got sound- NO SETUP REQUIRED.

title: Fantastic headphones for the price
review: I specifically did NOT want noise-canceling headphones. I also did not want ones with the rubber in them. Both things aggravate my tinnitus. These are perfect. They fit in my ears easily, and pair immediately with my macbook every time I use them. Sound and audio is great for zoom meetings, and music sounds fantastic, too. I could not ask for better.

title: They hurt, but the sound is okay
review: These are very tight against my ears causing discomfort. For JBLs these are not stellar. A bit thin with mids lacking. They’re inexpensive- I wasn’t expecting full rich sound, but JBL/Harmong Kardin make excellent small speakers with some of the best sound for the dollar. I got them to use/leave at work. I needed corded headphones to plug into the ridiculous pc for zoom. Having headphones on hand for lunch is useful and I am not interested in being expensive personal items to work. These will do, but boy they hurt. They’re light and not ugly.

title: They died in less than a month!
review: I honestly liked the idea of having Bluetooth headphones and initially thought the product was pretty good. However, after having the headphones for less then a month I ran into a bit of a problem when they would NO longer charge. On my initial charge I could see that the Micro USB plug in was just not normal. The included Micro USB plug would just not seat properly into the headphones, it seemed to fit on a slant. I attempted to charge the headphones a few nights ago (3rd charge) and the charging light NEVER came on. I even tried to wiggle the Micro USB but NO such luck. I figured I would try and leave the charger on over night (in hopes maybe the charging light went out) but the headphones were still showing low battery in the morning. I looked in the manual that came with the headphones and there was only an email address to contact "support@photive.com" (NO phone number) so I sent them an email at 07:29 am in the morning and received a response at 4:44 PM that day. The email asked for my order number along with the date of purchase (again NO phone number) so I just decided to send the headphone back to Amazon since this would be an easier process.

title: Headset broke after 2 days
review: I've used these headphones in the past for work and really like them. They're great if you work all day with a headset in your ears, listening to voice not music (mono/not stereo). I like the fact that the sound comes from the button at the base of headset rather than directly in your ears, so there's not electronics up against your ears all day long. The bad news is that the headset I bought stopped working a day or two after I got it.  Be careful who you buy from here, always check seller feedback.  Cheaper isn't always the best choice, especially with electronics.

title: Very good earpads at a very good price
review: The earpads I had on a set of headphones were pretty much crumbling.  This brand got very good reviews and after using them for a while I have to agree.  Very good price, very good earpads.

title: The sound is great. They are by far the most uncomfortable headphones ...
review: The sound is great.  They are by far the most uncomfortable headphones I’ve ever owned. The metal looks cool, but ouch. Definitely not for extended periods of use

title: Good quality, but ear cuffs are shallow making them press into small stud earrings.
review: Good quality, as you would expect from Sony.  But, I wear small diamond stud earrings and the shallow ear cuffs press my earrings into my head.  I don't want to take them out while using the headphones for fear of losing them.  Also, the swivel on the cuffs seems loose; almost flimsy.  But, neither of these complaints were bad enough to make me return them.  I use them daily and overall I'm very happy.  The sound and noise cancellation are excellent.

title: Best wireless buds I have ever owned
review: The sound quality, battery life and easiness of these earbuds is fantastic. Used them for the first time today at work and they canceled out all the noise from the machines and lasted my entire 8 hour shift with battery remaining.

title: Fiio E3 Headphone Amp
review: I am giving this 2 Stars due to the fact, I can't really tell any difference using my MP3 player with headphones attached or with out this as a booster to the phones.  Sorry I can't say it is any improvement of the delivery of the music over not using this product.

title: Horrible pairing.  Connects once then never again, not visible to PC, Mac, Android or iPhones
review: One bad set was a fluke.  Two bad sets means these have some inherent problem.  Won't pair.  Won't stay connected.  Once they drop from a device they're gone forever.  I don't have this issue on any of the 6 other earbuds I have ranging from $35 generics to $250 SonyXM4.  Not my first rodeo.  These are simply bad.

title: Longest living rechargeable device I've ever seen
review: Longest living rechargeable device I've ever seen.  I play these all day, every day at work.  And charge them maybe once a week.  Good sound both on headset and speaker mode.  Top notch!

title: Works for basic audio
review: It is STEREO not true 7.1, just to be clear about that.  No software shipped with it because Window will download a driver automatically and extend the Windows Sound control panel with a couple extra options: Bass Boost, Room Correction, Virtual Surround, Loudness Equalization.  Using iTunes as a music player I think Virtual Surround and Room Correction suck.  The lyrics drop in volume compared to the instruments and much of the music sounds under water/garbled.  Just leave the enhancements off.  It is good for being a completely separate audio device.  So if you want to designate one microphone for most of the PC but your headset for Skype or a game it would let you do that.  Maybe you want to be able to send audio from one room to another... You could just switch the playout device to the USB stick and have your music play on the patio instead of your desk speakers.

title: Love these headphones
review: Love these headphones. They use to come with Dell computers and they were great. They did not have a name or brand on them anywhere so I did not know who made them. The logo was there but I did not know it then, so off to the internet I went. Googled my fingers off and finally found them. It was expensive and I could not swing it at that time and went another direction. Never have been as happy as I was with these. The other day I was looking for something else and I came across these. At a discount price too! Had to have them so I bought them. They are still as amazing to me as they were then. Are there better headphones out there? Probably but at a much higher price. These just seemed to sound natural to me and I'm happy!

title: Great Battery Life - Echo-y Sound and Ok Noise Cancellation.
review: This little earbuds have great battery life. They are a little clunky in your ear, and the sound isn't that great, but they lasted forever. The range on the bluetooth was also hit and miss with sometimes being less than a foot, and sometimes over 10 feet. Overall, a great set for kids or a cheap pair of headphones.

title: Good sound but some annoying design points
review:
Pros:
- fair price
- very good sound and base
- strong signal. They stay syched with the device and each other
- comfortable
- fast charge and good battery life
- I like the wireless charging feature

CONS:
- getting them our of the case is ridiculously awkward. Like picking a pit out of orange. There's no secure grip point. Nothing to get get your fingers onto or under. It's easy to send the earbud flying across the room when you finally pop it free.

- i find the touch sensitive controls illogical and way too touchy. Good luck trying to adjust your earbud without jumping tracks or triggering some other unwanted function.

title: these are fake jvc headphones, don't buy
review: the sound quality sucks at higher volume indicating lower quality woofers used. Look for GUMY not marshmallow if you want the old style. (Walgreens sells the real GUMY headphones, go there)

title: No good for guitarists.
review: I connected it from a mini amp to two different headsets.  On both sets, there was over a 1-second delay.  This device cannot be used to play guitar so if that's why you want to buy it, don't bother.  Go old school and just use headphones with a wire.

title: Good headset
review: Great headset. Stays on my ear all day with no issues. I had to bend the earpiece a little bc it was too tight as first but after a few wears it's perfect. Works with the c1110 radios we have at work. Just make sure you push the plug in ALL the way to the radio. I can be heard clearly with no issues sending or receiving.

title: Awesome cable, great price.
review: Just received the 16ft cable, tested it in F1 22 on PC using Steam with the Oculus 2 headset, works perfectly.

title: My 2nd pair of Wicked Cushion Replacements
review: I’ve had my QC15 headphones for over 22 years. Had to replace the cushions 4 years ago and went with Wicked. I use the headphones daily to listen to music and podcasts, but also to block out the noise of a computer server near my desk. I have the headphones on 6-9 hours a day and just recently saw the cushions had split. Bought a new set of cushions and, like the last pair, they fit perfectly. You have to work at it a little to get them snapped in under the tabs, but once in they don’t come out until time for new replacements. Highly recommend these replacement cushions!

title: Noise cancelation best feature
review:
The sound quality is great, but in my opinion not what justifies the price. The feature that does justify the price is the level of sound cancellation they provide. I've used premium over the ear sound cancelling headphones (including Bose) but none of them come close to the reduction in sound these provide.

If you are looking for quiet, these are what you want. You can also use provided modes, or custom design them through the app. The app allows you to create a mode that has minimal or no noise reduction. You can even create a mode that senses the noise level around you and when it becomes too loud the noise cancelling kicks in.

I was hesitant to spend this much money on ear buds, but am now happy I took the chance.

title: Great, if you don't mind the wait...
review: These ear pads fit QC2 headphones perfectly.  You have to work to get the retainer worked into the channel on the headset, but once securely seated, they are a great replacement to the original ear pads.  The product deserves five stars, but I deducted one due to the delivery time.  These are shipped from overseas and expect to wait a month to six weeks for delivery.  Don't be impatient and in a hurry to get them installed; however, once they do arrive you will appreciate the quality.  In addition to the ear pads, there is a replacement of the cloth backing for each side.

title: Pretty good for the price
review: I've been using these daily for a week or two now. I'm not a fan of in ear headphones and wear glasses, but I find these ok. I'm not sure if the pressure I feel when I have them in is normal or not, but it's only in one ear which isn't that bad. They are comfy over my glasses and don't bother me on that aspect. Tho I do find myself trying to rotate them periodically as they can make my ear canels hurts after some period of use, not really enough to make me wanna stop using them. So far I've had an issue with the audio dropping periodically when I move my head, sometimes it will flicker from headphone to headphone, but that usually last a few seconds. Due to me putting them in their charger when I get home for my midday break then once I get home if I'm not using them after they haven't really died on me. The left one died once and didnt want to connect to the case, I'm not sure if that was a battery issue or if the case died cuz I hadn't charged it in a few days, but after I plugged the case in both headphones continued to charge like normal.

title: best headphones for price
review: These are the best headphones you can get for this price. They sound amazing for music, movies etc.

title: Protects a laptop
review: Bought this product to protect my teen's Acer 15.6". The padding works well to transport her laptop from home to school while in her backpack. The case is snug and doesn't fit anything else so I had to purchase a separate pouch for earbuds and power cord. The color is true to the picture. The zipper is smooth.

title: It is quite expensive for what it is, a ...
review: It is quite expensive for what it is, a cheap little piece of plastic.  I'm sure it will do the job but it likely cost .25 to manufacture.  There's gotta be a more cost effective solution to keep your earbuds tidy.

title: Excellent Value Headphones
review:
Theses headphones are affordable, wireless headphones that seem good for any traveler. The 20 hour battery life is very impressive, plus it can be recharged with a microUSB charger.

The ANC doesn't entirely cover up a screaming 2 year old, but it does a decent enough job. These aren't $200+ Bose headphones actually.

Sounds and music were good and crisp. Bass was lacking a bit. Bass heads won't like these cans.

They're very comfortable. My longest wearing session was 2-1/2 hours. No sweating, no ear numbness. Headphones can sound like heaven, but if they ain't comfortable all is lost. My wife fell asleep with these on for almost 5 hours. NO complaints from her either.

For the money these are some excellent headphones. My one hour flight to Miami was absolute heaven with the ANC on.

title: Excellent
review:
Heavy duty construction. Excellent fit & finish. Keeps my headphones neat, tidy, and out of the way.

My only suggestion is that the screw head (slotted) on the underside is the same as the side screw (allen). Would be much easier to adjust, especially in tight spaces.

title: Decent buds
review:
I tested these earbuds on my Nexus 6 phone and Windows 10 PC.

Pairing was virtually instant on both systems. The bluetooth range was acceptable at 22 feet.

The installed buds fit well in my ears. There is a smaller set if needed. The neck band was a bit small, but I have big neck disease :)

Quality is a bit of a concern with the little wires coming off the neck band. Not a fan of the off white/gray as it stands out like the apple junque.

Music quality was decent as was the call quality. Friends said the mic was good with just a bit of feedback from background noise.

All-in-all, not a bad set-up.

title: Good value for the money
review:
I use this headset for my cellphone and find that it excels in that area. Most cellphones include an inferior in ear headphone that falls out of the ear or the mic is constantly rubbing against your shirt.

Although a little big, this headphone works amazingly. I can hear properly and my callers can hear my voice clearly.

For the money it's hard to beat.

title: Very Clear but limited range
review:
The sound is very clear and distinct. I had no problems walking around the house or driving in the truck. Motorola includes 3 types of ear pieces for any type of wearing style. I prefer just the hook with no gel. I can't handle having something stuck into my ear.

Pairing was super simple. I turned the headset on and then turned the bluetooth on. Within seconds I was paired. No special codes, no jumping through hoops. It worked, right out of the box. BTW, I have a Sony Experia Android phone.

I don't know where they get the 300 foot distance thing. The most I got was 108 feet during my test. I used one of those rolling rulers the contractors use. I placed my phone on the ground just outside my garage door. Then walked down the street, in a clear line of sight, using the rolling ruler. I got to 108 feet when all sound died. Then on my return trip the sound didn't come back on until I was 47 feet away from the phone. I still think 108 feet is a great distance for a bluetooth device.

This headset is light and stays put with just the hook. Talk time is about 8 hours which is fine for me. I can also listen to my music streaming from my phone. App games sound okay, but they can be a bit choppy.

title: Works great - takes time set up for use
review:
This product works as advertised and I love being able to have great audio quality to my headphones whenever I want. It's great for quiet movies / dialogue heavy movies where you can miss a lot without headphones. I can also wear my wireless headphones while I do things in other rooms and still hear the TV.

My only ding is that I frequently have to re-pair my headphones to it. It's not always a smooth connection process and I spend 10-15 minutes at almost every use either getting my headphones connected or troubleshooting a lack of audio. This is worth it to watch a long movie, or binge some Netflix, but not so much for 30 minutes of TV watching.

title: Excellent Quality
review: Great headphones for kids. Works great. You can plug the cord in on either side of the headphones. Sound is of good quality.

title: I love the earbuds. First I have ever used. The sound quality is wonderful.
review: I am in my 60s. This is my first time using earbuds while walking or going to the gym. I am very happy with the product. They exceed my expectations. They are comfortable and easy to store/charge. I keep the volume at a level that I can hear traffic approaching and a person speaking to me.

title: Good sound quality and comfortable
review: This is a great headset! Good sound quality and comfortable to use. Bought this few weeks ago and has been very helpful for my telephone appointments. Bought it and arrived within 24 hours. Worth it to buy for office use. It serves it’s purpose.

title: Nice kid's headphones for at home schooling
review: These are very nice wireless kid's headphones. They feel light weight, the band is adjustable, the cuffs are plush, and you can wear them wired as well. The only down side is that this charges with a micro usb, which is very outdated for a product made in 2021. Overall, it is still a good product and I would recommend it if you are looking for higher quality headphones for your kids.

title: Great true wireless earbuds
review: The sounds quality of this is very good. Charges with a USB-C cable. Comfortable to wear for long periods of time case charges the earbuds every time you put them in. Controls are easy to use with simply pressing the sides of the buds. Noise cancelling but you can adjust how much sound passes through for you to stay aware. Overall, highly recommended.

title: Great earbuds, but outdated charging.
review: These earbuds connect very easily to bluetooth and are very comfortable with the design. Not too heavy, and weighted enough so you know they are in your ears. The controls are very easy as well. The only problem I found with these earbuds is that it uses a micro use charger instead of a usb-c charger. It is inconvenient to have to pack another extra cable with you when traveling. Overall, the sounds quality is great and they did a great job with the design. Overall, I'd recommend them if you do not mind carrying an extra cord with you when traveling.

title: Great wireless earbuds
review: I have another set of earbuds but they are a bit heavy and I have trouble with them slipping while working out. I also got a few true wireless buds but I don't trust myself not to lose one while working out. I actually really liked these buds. The wire is adjustable, as well as it being much lighter so it doesn't slip as much, especially if you choose to only have one bud in at times. The volume control is easy to use as well, and it is easy to pause and skip tracks when needed. I have smaller ears and the wings did a good job with staying in place. Charges with a USB and was a breeze to connect with bluetooth. I found myself only having to charge them once a week after using them every day. Overall, great product. Would highly recommend these for anyone needing buds for the gym or runners.

title: Great headset with a few flaws
review: First off, I think this headset is pretty good. I'm a female gamer, and I would say this set is kinda heavy compared to my older Razer set I've used for about a year. These are glasses friendly. I would say the tension of the ear cuffs is a good fit. I do wish that the set was a bit shorter. I am on the shortest length currently and it still feels a bit long. The feature I really like is that you can amplify and adjust your voice level. I am able to speak normally and still give loud clear instructions over Discord. Pairs easily, I didn't even need to go into my settings. The only flaw I see is that the mic is kinda short. I wish it was half an inch or an inch longer. You mute and unmute yourself by moving your mic up or down. I honestly wished it was a button instead, but it isn't a deal breaker. The voice is very clear and crisp according to my friends on discord. I use this for my PC and it works great. Overall, highly recommended.

title: Not the most comfortable
review: The cups on these headphones are very small. It does press down on the ears quite firmly so it does get uncomfortable after a few hours.  The size of the headphones is nice though. It folds away neatly and would be great for traveling, especially since it comes with it's own hard case. It connects easily, but the mute button will not work at times which is problematic if you often do conference calls so something to keep in mind.

title: Only work half the time
review: These headphones would be great if they worked. I don’t know why they need to connect to Bluetooth if they literally connect to my phone with a cord. They’ll work and then when I go to use them an hour later I get a connection error and I’m stuck without headphones. Very disappointed.

title: Works great - sounds great
review:
This is my kind of electronic product. It does exactly what it is supposed to do - recharge my iPod and allow me to listen without earphones - without requiring me to spend hours learning how to use it. I had it up and running in minutes. The controls are easy to understand and use. The speakers are of good quality.

In short this is an excellent product.

title: good quality
review: My teenage daughter listens to podcasts and a lot of music on these headphones. She feels that the sound quality is very good. She has petite ears and the buds fit her well and do not fall out. The pink is fun and makes it easy to tell them apart from those of other people. The noise cancellation is pretty good, as she often needs a visual cue to respond to a person's attempt to communicate.

title: everything you need
review: I once saw a guy remove his airpod type earphones on a plane, and was immediately grossed out by the amount of earwax on them! Eeeew! This kit gives you everything you need to keep your earphones squeaky clean and avoid grossing out your neighbors on a plane or your friends and family.

title: good quality headphones
review: These headphones took very little time to set up according to the directions included. The sound quality is very good. The headset is lightweight and comfortable.

title: nice earbuds
review: I like the pink color that makes these earbuds instantly recognizable. Most similar earbuds are white and can easily get mixed up with those belonging to other people. The sound quality is pretty good. One ear occasionally cuts out for some reason, but once jiggled goes right back to working fine. These are a good deal for the cost.

title: my daughter really likes these!
review: These earbuds look similar to the crazy expensive ones. They seem to work just as well too! Sound quality is very good and they actually stay in her ears comfortably, which can be an issue for a smallish user.

title: charge lasts a long time
review: These earbuds are comfortable, which is not always the case for a smaller teen/adult like my daughter. They stay in and do not fall out constantly. The plain white design does not scream "third party knockoff" either. Sound quality was a pleasant surprise. It is actually pretty good, though not the best we have ever heard. The charge seems to last a long time, which is very convenient.

title: not Pokemon related!
review:
Initially I thought these headphones were Pokemon branded. The "ears" resemble Pikachu's tail. Although they have a Pokemon sounding name, "Volibolt", they are just capitalizing on people like me being mistaken.
The headphones are ok for sound quality, but the sound becomes distorted at higher volumes. They are not really large enough to fit kids older than ten. Both the expandable band and the ear covers are made for young children.

title: good quality sound, nice color
review: I love the robin's egg blue color of these earbuds! They are distinctive and will not easily be mixed up with other people's headphones. The sound quality is very good.

title: simple to set up
review: I gave these bluetooth earbuds to my young teen and she was able to set them up in about a minute without any help. They are comfortable but tend to fall out- I think many people with smaller ears can relate to this problem. They are made for men and even in pink are bigger than desirable for a girl. The sound quality is very good.

title: I like to wear them on occasion when I am doing ...
review: Let me begin by saying I am not a heavy headphone user. I like to wear them on occasion when I am doing a task that is rather mundane and doesn't require a lot of movement. I am not an audio snob and big names do not impress me. I want good quality sound and comfort. These headphones are perfect for me. They are not too heavy and they actually seem to fit and stay on! I am a smallish adult and some sound systems - especially earbuds- just don't fit. I don't want to feel lost in an overly heavy and large set of headphones, either. I am quite happy with these plantronics.

title: These headphones/earbuds are comfortable, but do not fit me as well as ...
review: Clear, crisp sound, quick set up for bluetooth. These headphones/earbuds are comfortable, but do not fit me as well as I would like. They seem to be made for someone with fairly large ears. They stay in place pretty well while I am stationary, but tend to fall off when I am in motion.

title: comfy and very sturdy
review: These headphones are not as flexible as portrayed in the ads, but they are sturdy and well padded for comfort. There is a small sort of removable bumper to make the headphones snug on tiny users. I am quite satisfied with the construction and function of the phones, but my daughter complains that the 85 decibel limit makes it harder to enjoy her music and videos.

title: finally- a device to avoid tangles!
review: We go through a lot of earbuds at my house. Many have excellent sound but do no hold up long with heavy use- especially when the younger kids are involved. This set is great because not only do they sound good, but they are comfortable and have this wonderful little spooly bit to wind the loose wires around. My 13 year old is generally rather hard on her stuff, but when I gave her this set to try, she found it "fun" to store the cord on the cute little moonrock. I call that a good design!

title: good quality
review: The sound quality is quite good, and these buds seem to be made of slightly more durable stuff than some of the others I have used. I have given up on buying the cheapest earbuds, as they don't last at all, and one pair gave me a nasty shock. I am pleased with the Philips brand and will gladly recommend them.

title: great product!
review:
I love the Jabra WAVE bluetooth headset.It's a bit unorthodox - it starts in your ear, curls back behind your ear, then extends down to the microphone. There were multiple earpieces available, and I was able to find one that fit comfortably. There's a cover for the mike that helps with ambient noise.

I was easily able to connect it to both my HTC Thunderbolt Smartphone and my Notebook. The headset can be linked to two devices simultaneously.

Battery life is excellent, I get around 4 hours of talk time on a full charge.

The call clarity of the headset is excellent, although I did experience some unexplained interference a couple times.

title: good product
review: These earbuds come with three different sized soft cushioned bits, so users can find the size that suits them best. I am a small to medium sized woman and I prefer the smallest size, though the medium are also a decent fit.  They are quite comfortable and can be worn for a long time without discomfort.  The sound quality is pretty good, though not as good as some of the real (bulky) headphones I have used. The bright color is nice, too.

title: Priced right with great quality
review: I use my headphones everyday and these replacements are priced tight for great quality.

title: Lacking in bass so great for audiobooks
review:
Great sound nice and loud. I use them mostly for audio books and the the sound is clear and crisp. When listening to music they have a great sound although slightly lacking in bass. The covers come off and you can wash them which is cool. I where them all day at work and the aren’t quite as comfortable as the really high end headphones but they aren’t that bad. They have the lastest usb plug ie different than all my other devices which is annoying to have another plug but whatever, get with the times I guess.

What’s frustrating though is the control is easily bumped which is a pain w audio books

title: We love this for river tubing
review:
We love this for river tubing, our only complaint is that the volume isn't very loud or high quality, and the phones have to be upsidedown. But hey, it stayed afloat and kept our phone dry so we had tubing music which is all that really matters.

If you have an iphone that doesn't let you adjust the volume through the headphone cables (like an old clickwheel), then I don't think this will work with your phone in terms of adjusting volume or skipping songs. Otherwise it does the job.

We just wish it had an AM/FM radio, I don't think that would have been hard to add. Because while this runs for 20 hours, most phones and ipods don't. So once those die you have to be music-less.

title: They Fit His Ears
review: My husband has had a heck of a time getting earbuds to fit his ears properly. He says that these are providing the perfect fit. Yay!

title: Long Charge Life & Great Sound Quality
review:
My husband is, let's say, "discerning," rather than "picky," but really he's both.

He is absolutely enthusiastic about these headphones.

Complained at first because there weren't any directions. I asked him to download the app because I needed feedback for this review. He downloaded the BACKBEAT APP and found the USER GUIDE, along with all kinds of other information and applications, including "find my headset."

This paired easily with his ipad. It will also pair with a second device.

When he first turns them on, a voice says, "Power on, battery high." The battery is built in -- it takes a charge. The charge lasts a long time -- up to 22 hours. He used them on a flight from Florida to L.A., then left them unattended for five days, then used them on the return flight and they still had some charge left over. It takes about two hours to charge these. A cool feature is "fast charge;" charge for ten minutes and you'll get three hours of listening time.

They're comfortable on his head, and he likes the controls on the headphones, themselves. He's happy with every feature: sound quality, noise cancellation, battery life.

title: Very Cool Design! Great Sound Quality!
review:
These interfaced with my ipod touch easily and instantly. The sound quality is fantastic!

I have an older ipod that only goes to iOs 9.5. In order to get the Sony App for these headphones, your Apple device requires iOs 10.0 or later. Therefore, I'm only able to turn volume up or down using my ipod volume controls. I'm not able to use any other controls on the app, obviously.

These interfaced with my Kindle but the volume is too low. Since I can't use the Sony app, I'm not able to turn up the volume.

These stay in my ears just fine, no matter how active I am. Different sizes of rubber/plastic ear inserts. I think they're comfortable. My husband thinks I "look like a Klingon" when I'm wearing them!

The case is very cool. The earphones are labeled L and R and they fit into the case which is a charging station. When the case itself needs recharging, there is a cord with a USB connector. This unit can only be charged using a USB. It takes about three hours to charge the case. Earphones last up to nine hours before they need charging.

The earphones are somewhat water resistant. I suppose that means that if you have them in and you get caught in light rain, or drizzle, and they get a little bit wet, they will still work. I haven't tested this. They cannot be immersed. The charging case is not water resistant.

title: Enhanced Sound From My ipod Touch
review:
These interfaced with my ipod touch immediately -- the directions were easy and clear.

The sound coming from my ipod touch is enhanced a thousandfold when I listen to recordings through these Panasonic Bluetooth wireless headphones.

I haven't timed them, but they stay charged for a long time -- many hours.

They're light on the head, and the buttons are easy to access while wearing the headphones:on or off, volume, change tracks, pause for calls and resume play.

WONDERFUL SOUND! Bass tones, treble and vocals. No wires make it so convenient to walk around my entire house, listening to music while doing chores or exercising.

I love these not only for the great sound but also for their appealing style.

title: Crystal Clear
review:
Features I really like about these JBL Synchros S200 Premium In-Ear Stereo Headphones:

rich sound quality and clarity

attractive design of the lightweight, aluminum earpieces

foam tips that allow a very tight fit

the flat, tangle-resistant cable

the tiny plastic clip that lets me attach the cord to my shirt

spare tips

compact, round, zippered carrying case

beautifully designed packaging makes this an appealing gift.

The angled tips give more comfort, but you have to make sure to insert the tips into the correct ears. They are marked with a tiny "L" and "R."

Product comes with a warning booklet and the print is incredibly tiny, printed in a light gray color: do not wear these or keep them in the immediate vicinity (closer than 10 cm) of a pacemaker.

The instruction booklet states: remote and mic are supported only by iPod nano (4th generation or later), iPod classic (120GB, 160 GB), ipod touch (2nd generation or later), iPhone 3GS or later and iPad. The remote is supported by iPod shuffle (3rd generation or later). Audio is supported by all iPod models and iPad.

title: Very versatile
review: Finally gave in and bought these- where have they been all my life. Way more convenient than wired ones I had with my iPhone that didn’t match the jack and got tangled. These are by far the best purchase I’ve made on Amazon this year. All the hype is definitely worth it. Have also used to make calls for work and work way bette than a normal headset if calling from your cell. Easy to take on the go and so far battery has lasted me a whole day while on the phone. (9 hours, depending on use).

title: Price Is Right Sound Is Good
review:
Up front, these get a little muddy at the passage between the low and medium ranges, and again right between the medium and high ranges. Otherwise, they're mostly true - no extra bass, no super bright high end.

And it was really inexpensive to get FIVE of them. And I've been sitting on mine and leaving them around two **** disturbing cats, and they still work. I am a permanent market for cheap good enough earbuds, because my son has ASD. He needs his music all the time, and he fidgets the cables. We go through more than one set a month, every month.

When he was younger, he needed over-the-ears. I so wish these had been available. There are lots of reasons to have over the ear headphones available. You don’t need ASD to be sensitive to noise.

These are sturdier than the earbuds as well. It’s been over two months and not one cable has broken. Recommend.

title: Borderline - But Worth It - ASD ADHD Fidgeters
review:
My son has ASD with sensory issues. Earbuds are his number one coping mechanism. He's musical, and his hearing is hyper acute, so at first, I bought him the best-sounding ones we could afford.

But his number two coping mechanism is fidgeting his earbud cable. He swims by twirling it and picking at it, We tried models with replaceable cables - spent a ton of money - and finally gave up. I started buying the cheapest multipacks of basic earbuds that I could find.

And the thing is: most sound almost as good as many of the expensive ones and some sound better than a few of the popular *cough* overpriced *cough* brand names. So that's what we've been doing for a couple of years now.

This 21-pack looked like a winner (we go through them at a rate of one or two a month). And these will do in a pinch. For the price, there is no way I can be sorry I got them or not recommend them.

If your person regularly breaks these this, this pack is good to have on hand. However, if audio quality is an issue, you might want to choose a different inexpensive brand. These are about as good as the very first buds that shipped with the original iPhone. Sound is muffled and lacks discernible highs and lows.

It will block outside noise and let someone cope for a bit. Recommend with caveat.

title: Nineteen Bucks - Whaddya Want From Them???
review:
I am not going to lie to you and say these sound as good as my B&Os or even as good as AirPods. Both of those earbud sets are worth what you pay for them in sound and all around quality. That's not necessarily true of other brands in their price range. Read carefully when you start to shop, because a name doesn't mean that much anymore.

So, for sound alone? I wouldn't buy these. The top end is almost painfully bright. Midrange is accurate. Bass is on the weak side of accurate. They're serviceable. But about the same sound quality as those 10 pair for 12 dollar wired sets (which is to say - as good as many many sets that cost 2-5 times as much).

But comfort? These are lovely. My ears are small. These haven't fallen out once.

Set up was easy. They stay connected. Overall experience is positive, and I recommend them.

title: Sound Okay - But Break Quickly (ASD Alert)
review:
My ASD kid has great ears and listens to music and videos and everything but his surroundings all day every day. It's a crucial coping skill for him. For years, we have bought the cheapest earbuds we can find, because he fidgets the cords and the break.

Most of the expensive earbuds do not sound much if any better than the cheap ones, but these KZ ZEX Pro buds DO sound noticeably better.

Unfortunately, they break just as fast. Like 3 pairs in 4 months fast. So, for now, we are back to the cheap ones.

title: Comfortable - Secure
review:
My earbuds always fall out. I got the expensive AirPods because supposedly they were built to not fall out so much.

Lies.

They ae easier to wear than most. My pain threshold is super high for things like arthritis and giving birth and kidney stones, but earbuds hurt, and some days I can't wear my glasses. What I am telling you is that my ears are sensitive.

The foam tips keep the AirPods secure, and they hurt much less than the silicon tips. They fit in the charging case and make a big difference in noise cancellation mode. If I had to nitpick, it would be that they're almost to good at noise cancellation. They can kind of defeat the purpose of transparency mode.

Other than that, they're aces.

title: Much Easier
review:
It's amazing how much the right tools matter.

After years of messing around with regular sized swabs, these tiny ones were a revelation. The kit has everything you need to clean not just AirPods/bluetooth earbuds but also dirty jacks and crusty circuit boards. Works for jewelry, too.

title: ASD Essentials for Sensitive Hearing and Fidgets
review:
My 20 year old has ASD and fidgets with his earbuds.

His hearing is super acute, and music is kind of his thing, so for a bunch of years I bought him what I thought were decent earbuds, and they broke within days or weeks.

He twirls them when he takes them out to talk to people.

He pinches the wires while he has them on.

Our budget.

But here's the big secret: MOST of the really expensive ones don't sound much, if any, better than these cheaper than cheap ones - even to a musical kid with superfine ears. And they break just as fast, so who cares?

title: Price Is Everything (ASD Coping Skill)
review:
My son has ASD and goes through earbuds like candy. He wears them all day and all night AND he fidgets the cables. Sound quality is an issue, but the larger issues are price and availability.

And here's a secret: the really expensive earbuds aren't that great, and they break just as fast as these.

Highly recommend.

title: Nice Alternative
review:
For dedicated lightning cable earbuds, these are nice and inexpensive.

The expensive ones do not sound any better than these, which tend to get a little muddy in the lower mid range and a little boosty in the bass, but are perfectly fine if you just want to listen to your music or podcasts. Recommend. 4.5 stars

title: Yep. They're Earbuds.
review: My son goes through earbuds like you wouldn't believe. He has ASD. He needs them to function in the world. And he fidgets them constantly. I've tried every cheap set out there (after learning hard lessons with expensive ones - Bose earbuds are worth the dough if you're not going to rip them to pieces by picking at them and twirling them and whatnot). Panasonics sound good for the money and last - usually - up to a few months. Recommend.

title: Features Work
review: These are decent lightning wired headphones. I like wired better than bluetooth, mostly, for listening to music. At this price point, these are good. If you are looking for exquisite fidelity, you are looking at paying a lot more.

title: Really Good for Inexpensive Earbuds
review:
