The earbuds that cost over a hundred bucks are always always going to sound way better than these. Even the ones that are a blatant ripoff (not naming any names). But if you are using them in a way that crimps or pulls the cables (backpack, coat pocket, crammed in a purse), you are better off saving the fancy ones for home use.

These have good clean sound, maybe a little bass-y, maybe a little dead in the middle, but definitely serviceable for compressed music and for phone video. Recommend if you go through a lot of earbuds.

title: Spoiled Kid Likes Them
review:
My son has some fancy gaming headphones, so when I tried these and liked them, I asked for his opinion. He says they are not as comfortable as his, and the mic does not seem durable to him, but they sound decent. When he saw the price point (twenty smackeroos as of this writing), he opined that these are a fantastic bargain.

As the person who purchased the fancy headset (and two previous fancy versions that were eaten by kittens), I agree. If you have kittens, though, I suggest you go ahead and spring for a set with a braided cable.

title: In Case of Emergency
review: You really cannot beat the price on these. However, the sound is heavily compressed, and the wires are cheap. Nevertheless, I live in a house with a kitten and have a teenager who loses things. Therefore, I keep at least one of these earbud sets on hand, still in the packaging, at all times for when the kitten murders a better headset or for when the kid can't find headphones on the way out the door to school.

title: Hopeful That More Compatible Apps Will Make This Even Better
review:
These are accurate. I have a finger monitor that I check against the reading I get at the doctor, and the Biosport Earbuds match up with that beat for beat. They also sound good - not the best, but really good through the mid-range with not-too-tinny highs and better-than-adequate lows. They are noise-filtering, as opposed to noise-blocking, which I would guess is for the safety of people using them as intended (running or biking outside with cars).

The lack of compatible apps so far is kind of a killer for me

title: Not as good as they advertise
review: The sound is average, nothing special, I was expecting more. The noise cancelling is disappointing and mine came with a problem in the left earphone, the noise cancel option sometimes turn off automatically. The ambient option is good and clear. The good thing is the connection stability with iPhone.

title: The best ones so far
review: What a great product! I’ve been over JBL and Bose premium headphones and there’s anything like this ones. Design, sound quality and NC are great! Worth every dollar.

title: Good sound, Great battery life
review: Rich bass but mids and highs not as good.  I have a mid-range hearing loss so I need the mids to stand out.  Still, better sound than my best headphones.  The soft rubber thingies that wedge into your ears work wonderfully and they seem to never slip out.  I haven't gone running with them but sitting, standing and walking don't seem to jar them loose.  But they are changeable to other thingies of different sizes, and once you remove them, they slip off the earplugs easily.  Then they are difficult to slip back on in the right way.  But with a little patience they slip back into place and then you have several hours of good sound.

title: Clear, crisp sound
review: Headphones often offer muffled, bass-heavy sound.  These earbuds offer clean crisp sound.  I have a slight hearing loss in the middle range and these buds are perfect for my hearing.

title: But cups were comfortable, and I have listened to hours of music ...
review: Sounds are a little muffled, especially in the mid-range, but not enough to matter to most people.  I couldn't get Windows 7 to recognize the headset, which means I couldn't use the microphone. Unless there is a special driver for this, Windows 7 will not recognize anything that is simply plugged into the earphones hole.  Windows 7 (and most other versions) will simply power anything plugged into the external speaker plug as if they are all the same.  So that means no microphone will work without a driver.  But cups were comfortable, and I have listened to hours of music and movies with no discomfort at all.

title: Strong fit, portable, compromising in performance
review:
The ear buds stay in my ears no problem. However, a decent seal is difficult to achieve. Changing out the rubber tips, rotating, and slanting the ear buds to get a decent seal is inconvenient. The lack of a reliable seal makes for unpredictable sound quality. Sometimes, the bass is decent, sometimes you wonder where it went.

One clearly identifiable problem that brings my rating so low is that the left ear disconnects from the right ear bud every time I use them. This happens at home, at the gym, on a run— everywhere. The price is low, but if the product doesn’t perform, the rating can’t be high in my opinion.

EDIT: Product gets one star. The ear buds now started to have a slight echo after 1 week of usage.

EDIT 2: The earbuds now sit in my ears and continually reconnect and repair even though my phone is right here. I am not playing anything but the earbuds keep chiming in my ears.

title: Take your soft-tip earphones to the next level
review:
These tips make your headphones work like ear plugs. They make an aggressive seal in your ear canal and hold your earbuds in. Additionally, the seal creates some good bass sound compared to a less aggressively sealing rubber tip. Also, when traveling, you can leave the earbuds in as earplugs with no music when you want to rest (e.g. on an airplane for example).

I run with these and do dynamic workouts. They stay in my ear even when sweaty better than the rubber tips. And I sweat a lot.

title: Neat product. Outdated specs.
review: Bluetooth 5.0 is a must in the gyms today. Too many people crowd out Bluetooth 4.2 bandwidth and generate skips and other connection issues. Otherwise, the sound is ok. The battery life is longer than most Bluetooth headphones. But if I can only wear them outside away from others, it’s just not worth it.

title: Good so far
review: Just started using wireless earbuds. I ordered a similar looking pair, but they were too big for me. These fit better although I could picture losing them. I like the compact case. The touch is very sensitive and will just take some time to get used to/remember the functions. I think they're pretty good for $29.99, but again, my experience is limited.

title: Affordable, and mostly easy
review: My husband and I have been wanting to try wireless earbuds. We ordered two slightly different Wilbur ones. These seem to fit my ears better. The others don’t have the “stem” and seem too bulky for me, but my husband said those fit his bigger ears and so block out noise better. A single button controls all the functions, so it's easy...once you remember how to press the button for each function. I think it will become intuitive as we get used to it. The only negative we've noticed so far is you can only control media/song volume via the earbuds. We did finally find a way to control call volume, but you have to go into your phone sound settings. Overall, we're impressed so far though. I don't know how much earbuds should normally cost, but I thought they were going to be more than $22.99. They came safely boxed, unsealed.

title: Affordable, and mostly easy
review: My husband and I have been wanting to try wireless earbuds. We ordered two slightly different Wilbur ones. The main body on these (not the earplug part) seem too bulky for me, but my husband said they fit his bigger ears and so block out noise better. The others have a "stem" and seem to fit my ears better. A single button controls all the functions, so it's easy...once you remember how to press the button for each function. I think it will become intuitive as we get used to it. The only negative we've noticed so far is you can only control media/song volume via the earbuds. We did finally find a way to control call volume, but you have to go into your phone sound settings. Overall, we're impressed so far though. I don't know how much earbuds should normally cost, but I thought they were going to be more than $23.99. They came safely boxed, unsealed.

title: Saved me from having to retire my wonderful old Radio Shack PRO 35 headphones
review: Arrived on time.  Merchandise as advertised.  Saved me from having to retire my wonderful old Radio Shack PRO 35 headphones.

title: For the price, they beat the Beats!
review: Our son got a pair of Beats for Christmas, and I bought these.  I've listened to his Beats, and I've listened to my Skullcandy, for the price I prefer the Skullcandy.  The sound quality is terrific, and I wish that I hadn't wasted money on other brands of headphones all these years.  I should have just waited for them to come out with these.  I wouldn't say that the sound is exactly the same as Beats, but for the price I paid for these I'll do without the very few things I might be missing by not paying 200 dollars for headphones.

title: Seems pretty decent
review: These were easy to install and took less than 10 minutes from removing old pads to putting new ones on.  Very straightforward procedure.  They seem like they’re about the same quality as the oem pads, but perhaps a tad less soft.  It’s hard to really notice any difference.  I put the black and gray geometric ones on my black headphones and they look nice.  My guess is these all come from the same place in China so idk if the WC ones are any better or worse than others you can find for half the price.  I got mine for $15 elsewhere, but I’d likely not spend more than that on these pads.

title: Excellent product, excellent price!
review:
My Sony V250 pads have been degraded (black flakes, also the seams coming apart) so bad for many years, I was about to replace them but the prices(about $15.-) I found elsewhere held me from jumping on it.
It paid to wait.
I found another one even cheaper but I chose this one because it came with a cute cord organizer for about 50 cents more. Since V250 has a long cord (for the computer use) I needed something to keep it short and tidy.
The pads are better than I expected for the price. If the description is true and it's made of polyurethane, it's going to be even better and I expect it lasts quite a long time from what my experience in the past tells me. Polyurethane has very good resistance to the elements such as sweat.
Installation is just as easy as removal of the old pads, no tools required, no alignment misses, they are just round pads.
I don't use the headphones all the time. I use the speakers for the most part when the sound quality is not critical or the noise level is not disturbing to others around me, but they are always at my side being ready for use.
My headphones look new again and I'm very happy.

title: Reasonably good for the purpose
review:
I had this for about 6 months or so. I'm happy with these speakers. They are not hifi speakers but still better than the speakers came with the computer currently in use which are built in behind the monitor, so facing backward. I use headphones most of the time and they sound better than these speakers, but there are times headphone use are not desirable
I use these speakers when sounds quality is not important such as video watching which is nice I can control the volume without keep pushing the volume key, when I'm doing something else on the desk and the cord become distracting, when I get too sweaty to use headphones etc.
Build quality seems to be good, I haven't had any parts coming apart except the front grill, they come off by design.
The best part of this purchase is that unlike the speakers come with the computers, I can use these speakers on the computer I buy in the future. If I don't like the speakers come with it, I'll have another option.

title: Surprisingly good sound!
review: I have sensitive ears so comfortable headphones are hard to find. These are very comfortable - I can wear them for an hour without pain.

title: These things are amazing. They come in a nice package with a ...
review: These things are amazing. They come in a nice package with a semi rigid case and tons of tip options. They have a very even sound output that isn't too focused on bass which is nice for listening to most music. You will appreciate songs that you have heard may times with these headphones. The cord is a rubber coated braided affair that is very resistant to tangles. The buds are also color coded so you can tell left and right faster. Well worth the price.

title: Wonderful headphones that don't make my ears cry!
review: This is my second set of PureBoom headphones (the first set is still working, but I lost one of the little ear sleeves and couldn't find a replacement), and they're a terrific bargain! $10 for a set of headphones that fit perfectly in my ears, have a great zippered case, and have flat cables that are tangle-resistant. These are equal to the Shure headphones that cost 10 times as much and lasted about a year before the sound became all wonky. Highly recommend these and would buy them again.

title: I loved the sound
review: This was my first Bluetooth Headphones in Ear that I've ever purchased. I put a smaller ear piece on and it fit just grand. I loved the sound. I thought it was a rich sound. The only problem was that I had an allergic reaction to the ear bud material which of course was no fault of SoundPEATS.  It was a surprise to me and am so sorry that I have to return them. But hey, this is a great set. I would say, Go for it!

title: perfect for the price
review: hubby goes through earbuds faster than I don't know what.  good to have these on hand

title: Always great to have extras on hand
review: My hubby goes through earbuds faster than anyone I know.  this was great value getting a 2 pack.  hoping they last a few months LOL

title: Love these!
review: Have tried so many wireless earbuds but none of them would stay in my ears, I have small openings.  Well, my nephew told me about these and I'm so happy.  Took me a minute to figure out how they went into the ears, but once I figured that out it was great.  You do have to remove them from the earbud to place back in charger case, but that's not a deal breaker.  I've tilted my head side to side, open and closed my mouth, even sneezed and they still stayed in place.  I'm a huge fan and love that I can wear earbuds now.

title: Just OK
review: I had the older version on this amp, and I think it was better than this version.  I use these with Audio Technica ATH-M50x headphones and I noticed a difference, but I don't know that I would say it was better.  Louder certainly, but not as clear.  I am not an audiophile, so the only description I can give is that it seemed more muddy.  The highs didn't seem as clear and the bass was loud, but lacked any real punch in songs that normally would deliver it.

title: Fantastic wireless earbuds
review: Very impressed with these earbuds.  Sound quality is probably the best for any earbuds that I have owned, wireless or otherwise.  Noise cancellation is good, but I haven't had an opportunity to really see how well it works in various settings.  For me at least, they are also remarkably comfortable.  Battery life compared to some other options on the market isn't as good, but for me it hasn't been an option.  I usually have an opportunity throughout the day to throw them in the case and let them charge for a bit.  No reservations about  these and I have recommended them to several of my friends.

title: Disappointment
review: I rarely write reviews of headphones because I do not consider myself any sort of audiophile. In general, I just now what I like. What I can tell you is that despite having over the ear Audio Technica headphones that I love, I hate these. For the price, the sound quality is disappointing in general. Specifically, the highs make my ears want to bleed. As a middle-aged man it's bad, I can only imagine what it would be like for someone younger. I have tried different devices from an iPod, to my Fiio, to my phone and I always get the same problem with the shrieking highs.  Adjusting the EQ manually helps a little, but to get it to where it is tolerable makes the overall sound quality that much worse.  Honestly, I have a $15 pair of Panasonic earbuds that I prefer more.

title: Just OK
review: I think they are alright.  The sound quality is average for headphones in the price range.  The wires seem a little stiff to me, which I found more annoying than I probably should have.  All things considered, I would probably not buy them again.

title: Just Okay
review: In general, I would say that these are just sort of okay.  I have several other pairs of headphones that sound just as well, were cheaper, and were more comfortable.  Probably not a pair that I would repurchase.

title: I love these!
review: I'm loving these wireless earphones.  Sound is adequate for exercising.  Controls on ear pieces make controlling music. .. And answering phone easy.  Great product!

title: Help for small ear canals!
review: Directs sound into ear canal even creating a noise canceling effect. I have small ear canals which make using earbuds difficult as none usually fit.  These have cured the problem.  Three come in pack making it easy to choose the one with the right fit.

title: Love the sound
review:
Love the sound, beautiful headphone, and I'm glad I purchased the limited edition. My only problem is that the headphone is a bit tight and heavy on my head and the earpad is not as soft as I want it to be. Otherwise, everything is great.
To be honest, I don't care much about the low bass for this headphone simply because I mostly listen to soft music. This thing is not noise cancelling for sure. I did replaced my bose qc25 to get this. What I want is nice music for my tight budget, and the ATH-M50x fulfilled all of that.

title: Solid performer
review:
The thing that I like best about this Kbear Wired Earbuds is that the cord does not tangle. Given how annoyed I get waiting for wireless earphones to pair (or when the pair fails), I'm starting to prefer wired again, but the cord tangle is annoying too so this product's cord being non-tangle is a win to me.

The sound quality is okay. I'm good with it. It does come with different sizes of earbuds as per the standard. It has a friendly price point as well.

Overall, I give it a 4-star as a solid performer.

title: Good battery life
review: The one and probably only thing that I do not like about this Bluetooth Headset with Microphone, V5.1, Noise Canceling Wireless On Ear Headphones is that it is a bit tight on fit and there isn't much flex there so I can't wear for too long. I didn't realize that my head was so big. Otherwise, this headset works pretty well. The battery life lasts good amount of time. The sound is good as is the microphone. It isn't top-notch, but for the price point, it is more than adequate. The fit is the only thing that keeps me from giving it a 5-star but if one has a smaller head than mine, it may be a perfect, or near perfect, fit.

title: Working very well
review: I selected this item because I have had good experiences with Acer products. This Acer Full HD USB Streaming 2MP Webcam keeps that streak going. It was easy to install. Easy to use. When my headset with mic broke, I was 'saved' because this new camera has a mic so that saved me some grief and embarrassment. I may be rating it higher than I would have otherwise because of that 'save' but hey, a product shows it quality when under pressure so a 5-star it is.

title: Easy to put together and works as needed
review: This stand holder took less than 5 minutes to put together. It is just 3 pieces. I like that. It also works as expected in that I can put my headphones on it and the stand is stable and balanced. Simple to put together. Simple in design. Simply works. Perfect to me.

title: On/Off switch is my favorite feature
review:
My previous headphone was an IFECCO Bluetooth headphone. I loved it and I didn't want to give it up but it was getting to that time that it was time to replace. It had outlasted much more expensive headphones and out-worked them too.

Even when I selected this new IFECCO headphone to try, I was skeptical that it would be as good. As soon as I started using them, my skepticism went away. The ease of installation, the sound quality, and the comfort was all there. It even has a much-appreciated feature that my old headphones did not have - an easy on/off slide switch. Such a simple feature but oh so appreciated.

So my old IFECCO headphones were finally retired with a 'thank you for your service' ceremony and the new headphones have been put to work and they are doing great.

title: Exactly what I needed
review: As my laptop started to get a little moody, I needed a stable workstation to work from. That meant using an older (but stable) PC that didn't have bluetooth capability. Not a big deal for work stuff, but when I want to watch a movie or such, I prefer using bluetooth headphones or speakers. I have enough wires to deal with so this product was fantastic. It was a good price; it worked with my PC; and it worked with my bluetooth devices. It did take a little getting used to the application but that only took a couple of tries and I finally got the steps down, it has worked as well as if the bluetooth capability had been part of the PC. Very glad I decided to try this product. It has worked well for me.

title: Comfortable solid performer
review: Gaming Headset, EasySMX Cool 2000 Over Ear Stereo Gaming Headphone with Mic and Volume Control is a solid performer that is comfortable to wear. The audio was crisp and clear right out of the box. The mic working at optimum did take some tweaking when using with the PC but it was easy enough to figure out. All in all, a good solid headset at what looks to be a reasonable price.

title: Good for my PC
review: I like these in Ear Headphones SDFLAYER E97 Pro Earphones for my PC. It has good sound and it is comfortable to wear. Also, it is nice to have the anti-tangle cord. I'm not as keen on it for my phone though as it isn't quite working right but that may be more that I'm not using it correctly. That said, I really wanted these earphones for my work PC to listen to webinars and demos and then store away easily. With the anti-tangle cord, it is very easy to store and then take out to use and not have to spend 10 minutes trying to untangle. So in that capacity, these earphones work perfect for me.

title: It works and that's all I need
review: The description of this product is a mouthful - "Triple Driver in-Ear Earphones, Prymax Earbuds with Microphone Noise Canceling Gaming Earbuds with High Fidelity, Bass Sound, in-line Remote Compatible with iPhone X 6 7 8 Plus, Samsung, Sony Phones." I'm not even sure what some of that means (specifically 'in-line Remote Compatible"). I just plug it in to Android phone and it works. It has good sound. The ear bud covers that it initially was on the earbuds were a little big so the buds kept popping out of ears but it does come with several sizes so I went a size down and it fits as needed. It is pretty good at noise canceling. I haven't tried adjusting the bass sound but on the default, it sounds good to me. All in all, they work well.

title: Works as needed
review: The Sony RF400 Wireless Home Theater Headphones (WHRF400) was an interesting but easy set up and the sound is fine. All in all, it is comfortable, wireless and works as we had needed so we are good with it.

title: Standard and steady
review: Pioneer Hi-Res Audio in-Ear Headphones are comfortable. When it comes to earphones, comfort is important to me. They are standard in-ear headphones so there isn't much fancy about them and I like that. I wish the sound quality was a bit crisper but that may be a good thing for the health of my ears. Overall, I like them because they are steady and consistent in quality.

title: Works well and I like the look of it
review: I like the earbud design of this JAM Live Large Earphones Bluetooth Wireless Earbuds in blue. It says that it has 7 hours of playtime. I haven't timed it exactly but that seems about right. I did have to try several times for my phone to finally pair with the earphones but once it paired, it worked quite well. As noted prior, I like the earbud design. It is bigger than usual but it makes it easier to find and keep track off and it is comfortable to wear. The sound is above average. About the only thing I'm not too keen on is that the cover to the USB port doesn't quite snap close for me but that is a minor thing.

title: Good sound as well as comfortable in the ear
review: I've become more partial to wireless headphones but I have a device that just won't take the wireless headphone that I use with my phone so I figured I'd try this headphone. Cords can annoy but the sound and comfort of the Mi In-Ear Headphones Pro Silver Dual Driver Earbuds with Mic is really nice. I also used it with my phone for the mic and that was worked well too. So while I still have a preference for wireless in general, this item is something that I would consider for future purchase due to the sound and comfort quality of the product.

title: Good sound and very comfortable
review: I was a little skeptical when I selected this item, but once in use, the B&O PLAY by Bang & Olufsen Beoplay H4 Wireless Headphones won me over. I have a wireless headphone already that I like (and still do) but these headphones really are nice and comfortable. The instructions were a bit thin but we still got them up and running quickly enough. The sound is good and the fit is comfortable. One thing that I really like about these type of headphones is that they don't irritate my ears. The bonus is that my son can use them as well. He's a big guy so he often finds that headphones can a little too small and tight but these headphones have flexibility and they are as comfortable for him as they are for me.

title: Exactly what I wanted and needed
review: I had just been talking to a friend that I needed an item where I could put all my items that need USB charging (phone, fitbit, earphones, et al) so the Sabrent Quick Charge came around at a perfect time. I really like it. My earphones take about the same time to charge but I'm fine with that because what I wanted is what I got in that I have one spot where I can hook up all my stuff to charge and it works well for me. I also like the size in that it doesn't take up much space so I can easily move to side and when in use, it doesn't take up a lot of desk space so this is exactly what I wanted.

title: Nice product for me
review: When this first arrived, my son started to test them out and he's a little picky about the sound on earphones. Plus they were a little tight for him. For me, the "Francois et Mimi VT006 Active Noise Canceling Over-Ear Headphones" are perfect. They paired perfectly to my PC. The sound is just right and the cans fit comfortably around my ears. All in all, a great product for me.

title: Impressed
review: I was a little skeptical because I haven't exactly been sold on wireless ear buds. I have these inexpensive Amazon basic ear buds that have been solid for me for almost a year now and I also already have a fitbit that I like very much that fits my admittedly modest fitness needs. That said, I was curious about this item so I wanted to try it out and I was pleasantly surprised and impressed by Jabra Elite Sport True-Wireless Bluetooth Stereo Earbuds. They were well packaged. I like that it has a selection of earbuds (small, medium, and large). They are comfortable to wear and they stayed put as well. App was easy to install on my iPhone and set up and so far, it is registering good readings. Bonus is that not only did the earbuds pick up as accessible for my iPhone, it also paired with my PC so I like that flexibility. It is on the pricey side (for me, anyway) and that is probably the main drawback so far that I can see for someone with my budget. Yet, now that I have tried it, it is a really nice to have item and I think for someone who is more serious and 'elite' with his/her fitness goals, he/she would probably find more pertinent use for it.

title: Works very well for me
review:
I received this item on Friday (super fast delivery; I'm impressed!) and was anxious to try them right away because although I prefer the over-the-head headphones, the in-ear headphones are more compact and easy to take on road and I spend a lot of the time on the bus.

I do like the sound. As with the other AmazonBasics headphone that I was able to try out, I feel like I can hear again. No more having to turn the volume up to 100%. Thank goodness. It is a little tinny in sound if you don't have the buds sitting in the ear correctly, but when the bud is set correctly, the sound is nice even at 40% volume. Clear and pleasant.

I still prefer the over-the-ear headphones because buds have a tendency to irritate my ear if I use them too long but on a bus ride to and from work, this will work perfectly.

title: I can hear again!
review:
I received this item on Thursday of this past week and while it appears to be packaged as a "basic" headphones, they are so much better than my previous headphones. The sound! I can't believe how much sound I was missing. I can actually put the volume below the 50% mark now.

When my son tested them out, he liked them well enough but said something about the treble but I didn't notice anything particularly off. The point of that is that for an audiophile, there may be a difference but for those of us who just want good sound at decent volume level AND at a good price, this is a good item to take a look at. I've already got it on my wish list to buy another one.

title: Best headphones I've ever used
review:
I probably should bump Polk Audio Buckle Headphones to 4-stars but I just can't do it because the sound and comfort of the headphones is just so good.

Reason to possibly bump it down was that the microphone didn't quite work as expected but really, I didn't select it for the microphone so I don't really care.

To be honest, I haven't had a headphones this good since... well, I don't think I've ever had a headphones with sound this good. I actually had to keep the volume at half because of the quality of the headphones.

I'm not sure yet what the 3 button control is used for. I'm still learning about the headphones. I'm sure I'll figure it out once I can get it back from my son who likes the headphones even more than I do.

Price on the headphones may be eye popping but now that I've used them, I can see why some headphones cost as much as they do. There really is a difference.

I briefly mentioned comfort and yes, they are very, very comfortable.

title: Good value for the money and a great pair of workout headphones
review: Good headphones for the price. Not the beat I own or anything sound quality wise But I bought these for working out and something I can get sweaty. These are great for a combination of quality Sound and durability. I definitely think that I would purchase again if I needed another pair. Absolutely stays in place with very little slippage of the earpiece once you find the right size for you which several are included

title: catches even pretty narrow cables
review: Extremely convenient, catches even pretty narrow cables.  I like the ease of popping cords in and out, like chargers or headphones.  For more permanent stuff I have zip ties.  These are adequately sticky for small-medium cords, and I haven't tried anything large.  I got two six-packs, and I'm satisfied.  If I needed more I would buy again.

title: Love These
review:
I purchased these after reading a review (CNet, I believe) about the best earbuds. I'd been looking for wired ones because I've bought nice, top-end Bluetooth earbuds before and have never been happy with them. Usually, they don't work consistently, are subject to interference, drop the audiobook/podcast/call, and are too finicky.
These, though? They've exceeded even my highest hopes. The sound quality is excellent. They have a wonderful case that charges them until its battery dies, which then recharges quickly with its included USB-C charger cord (no plug, you need a regular USB port to plug it into).
They're super comfortable, they stay in my ears impressively well, you can wear one at a time if you'd like because they connect independently and each has the pause/play button on it. They have an impressive range, too. I've accidentally walked away from my phone and made it 4 rooms away without losing the sound (it does get a little fuzzy). I've used them frequently since I purchased them 3 months ago and I'm still super impressed. Reliable, excellent, and I'm no longer looking for wired earbuds. I highly recommend them. The one downside for me is that they're noise-canceling. I'd love it if there was an option not to, but to make up for it, I just wear one when I'm out walking or need to listen for something.

title: Great headphones
review: I purchased these for my 9-year-old daughter. She's not the most attentive person and often leaves things lying about, which means they often get dropped, stepped on, sat on, etc. These have held up well to over a month of such treatment. She's also very sensitive to things that feel uncomfortable and has no complaints about the padding on her ears; she loves them. (She has thick, curly hair which sometimes gets snagged on the metal upside down u-shape over the headphones, though.) They are very good at noise canceling, which she loves! (I don't always since she can't hear me calling her, ha ha.) Great, great headphones for the price. I recommend them and would buy again.

title: Great value
review:
I have a snazzy pair of blue tooth wireless earbuds, but they still don't hold a candle to the reliability of these wired ones.

Note they do not have any controls on the cord. (Sony does offer other options that do!)

They're reliable and I love them.

title: Great earbuds
review:
Excellent earbuds for the price. I use mine many hours a day every day, both outdoors (dog walking) and indoors (folding laundry, cooking, etc.). They put up with a fair amount of wear and tear and have held up well to it. I really appreciate the remote on the cord. There are 3 buttons: volume up, play/pause, volume down. I don't use mine to take calls, though I do believe you can, so I cannot comment on that part.

I highly recommend these if you're looking for a quality pair of earbuds for a very reasonable price. Love them!

title: Love these!
review: I love these headphones! I often snag my headphone cords and with the over-the-ear style, they're less likely to pop out on me. They're comfortable and the sound quality is good. Happy with my purchase.

title: Excellent quality
review: Quality earbuds. I bought these because of a "Best of 2016" article I read while researching earbuds. Well made of quality materials, excellent sound, and they look durable. (We'll see once I've had them for longer than a week. ;) Very happy with this purchase.

title: Not for me (crackly sound, then broke after first month)
review:
Two minor issues I had with these earbuds: because they're metal, you can get static shocks during the winter (whenever I do laundry, I listen to audiobooks)--not horrible, but not fun; second, if you wear them outside of something with a zipper, the friction causes crackling noises in the audio.

They are adorable, for sure. I don't think I've ever had cuter earbuds.

When I'd had them a month to the day, the play button stopped working. I've returned them and opted for another brand.

title: Great value - Punches Above Its Weight
review: Got the TOZO A1 primarily to use with my Nintendo Switch.  Works great with the Switch…pairs with easily and stays connected, no problem.  Didn’t intend to use for music, but turns out these value-priced buds work fantastic listening to music on my iPhone.  Sure, they’re not as good as Sony WF1000XM4 or Apple AirPods Pro, but for less-than-$20 these easily outperform original Airpods.  Other positives:  USB C charging, a small/pocketable case, and decent battery life.  These are pretty small, but not teensy-tiny…about the same size as Beats Studio Buds (sound a lot like them, too; but doesn’t have nearly as much bass presence as the Beats).  The only negative I have is the “non-standard” size of the included eartip.  It’s about half the size of other buds.  And there’s only one size included (I’d estimate the size to be medium), no smaller or larger sizes are included with the package.  In summary, the A1 is a great value, good sounding option for anyone looking for decent set of backup or low-cost primary earbuds.

title: easy to use and has a long life
review:
I got these to replace a wired headset for my phone. The mic is in the U shape so it picks up sound rather well. Has a bit of an issue when waring masks, but otherwise very clear.

Sound quality is really good, if not at times a little quiet. the noise cancelation sometimes gets confused and will amplify sounds like running water over voice, but its easy to avoid.

the battery lasts a rather good amount of time, and the headset has a decent range if you put your phone down to charge. It will sometimes have momentary disconnections if you are in a winter coat or near different electronics or machinery, but for the most part you have to walk into a different room before audio quality is truly effected.

I sometimes forget that I have it around my neck. if you have it running for hours at a time, your ears might hurt a little bit form the earbuds or wax might build up in the speakers, but its otherwise very nice to use. I should read the manual as I didn't realize I could answer and end calls, or stat/stop playing with the power button. One charge usually lasts me a few days of heavy use.

title: Works well.  Reliable thus far.
review: I've had this for about 4 months.  It works well with no popping/crackling/noise distortion.  Converts the cable so that I can use my Turtle Beach "Xbox" headset for usage on my PC.

title: Love these!
review: These headphones are amazing! I bought these a few months ago and have taken them everywhere with me. They are a bit bulky to carry around, but look very sleek and work wonderfully on planes and in the office!

title: Amazing gadgets
review: The shape of my ears are rather strange so earbuds never work for me - until I used these little hooks. The large pairs fit my ears perfectly, and now I can use AirPods comfortably without worrying about dropping them.

title: Great buy all around! Way better than expected. VERY happy!
review: I love these headphones! Very good sound quality, comfortable, nice features, great foldable design with carry pouch. Can't beat them for the price and they look, feel, and sound great too! The cord and mic are also good quality. A great buy overall. I love the purple color! VERY happy.

title: Less than five minutes to comfort and joy(ful) listening!
review: My dog chewed up my Bose soundtrue headphones.  Really.  Luckily the speakers still worked even though the foam covers were completely ruined.  The replacement covers look and feel good.  I used a YouTube video to understand how to put them on. It was as easy as can be, once I saw how.

title: Best Headphones for the Price
review: Purchased for my mom in her 80's enjoying classical and rock music; she couldn't rave enough about yhese earphones with great stereo sound and comfortable ear pads. I highly recommend them and purchased another pair as a gift!

title: More cons than pros
review: Best part of these headphones? That they’re Bluetooth and have a long battery life. Sound quality is decent but nothing to write home about. That’s where the pros end. I’ve already had to send the first pair back because after only 6-7 months, the right one stopped working. Received a replacement pair from Apple and after only a couple months of use, the left earpiece padding started coming unglued. Bought a replacement for them here on Amazon for $20. No lie, a week later, the earpiece padding on the RIGHT side has also come unglued. WTF? These were a promo freebie that came with the purchase of my laptop but I don’t recommend them and wouldn’t pay $5 for them either as the quality control sucks. In terms of usefulness, they slide around my head no matter how often I adjust them and they make my ears and head hurt. Don’t recommend them, especially not at this price.

title: Impressive
review:
I was gifted this and was skeptical at first but after having it a few months, this speaker is one of my favorite accessories. After an accidental coffee spill on my phone, the speakers no longer sounded the same so this seemed like a good solution.

Pros:
- Bluetooth connects right away, no lags (I’ve got a pair of Beats headphones that don’t always connect)

- Sound is exceptional for a device that costs less than $30

- Rubberized bottom stabilizes the device

- Rubberized ends allow you to use it vertically in a narrow space (I use it this way when my desk is full of paperwork)

Cons:
None so far.

I’ve owned it for a few months. Will update if anything changes.

title: Great headphones, iPhone compatible
review: Got these to replace the earbuds that came with my last iPhone and they work great. Included are 3 different sized rubber covers for the ear piece so you can switch them out to your preference and comfort. I also bought my husband a pair and he loves his too.

title: Great!
review: Loved this.Battery life is great and the ability to download music directly to the earbuds is awesome.

title: Good speaker for price
review:
Nice little portable speaker. I bought this as a cheap alternative to a sound bar and I am impressed with the sound. My tv has down firing speakers, so this speaker gets the job done whether its sitting in front of the tv or next to me. It also has a 3.5mm jack of you want to plug in headphones. The instructions are pretty straightforward and it connects pretty easily.

The only thing I didn't like and why I took off a star, was because of the short charging cord that comes with it as it could stand to be a little longer (it also does not have a charging brick, but my rating does not reflect that, just to inform others if they want to know). The cord is about 6 inches long and I immediately changed it out with a 3ft cord I had to reach my extension plug by the tv.

Edit* Since owning this speaker a bit longer, I've noticed a ringing sound in the speaker when it's paired with my tv. While listening to music it's not as noticeable. I also learned the hard way that the 3.5mm jack is input only and not output when others had said you could use headphones with it. So if you want that option, it's a no go for this speaker.

title: I really wanted to like these
review: I currently have a pair of Bose wired headphones which are extremely comfortable but I'm really tired of dealing with the wire.  Received these and immediately charged them and started trying out the tips and wings.  I couldn't find a combination of tips/wings to make these comfortable.  I've discovered, through this process, that I can't handle having something 'seal' the ear canal like all these tips do.  When I wore these I could hear myself swallow, I could hear myself walking, I could hear my jacket collar rub against the cord across my neck.  This type of headphone just isn't going to work for me. Thankful for Amazon allowing me to return these.

title: Keeps old tech going.
review: These are just the ticket for older headphones that still work fine, but the foam pads have fallen apart.  Without new pads, the headphones would be unusable. They are stretchy enough for typical small headphones.  I recommend them.

title: Excellent device
review: These headphones work well and sound just fine.  I have paired to a Nexus 7, iPad, and computer with no difficulty.  The are comfortable and the battery lasts a long time.  I have had no problem with range up to twenty feet or so.

title: Fine Machine
review: I purchased this player just for audio books and it works great. When you turn it on it remembers where you were in the book when you last shut if off. Really works nice. Get a good set of headphones for real pleasure.  The case is a little flaky. I used some clear book tape to reinforce the joints and it much better. Many hours of play time on one AAA rechargeable battery. I recommend it.

title: Expensive but required
review: My headset needed this since my last one was bent at the metal usb port. Pretty expensive for a small piece but it is required and it's better than buying a new headset altogether.

title: Could be great with a small tweak.
review:
Long battery life, comfortable, great range, the only real complaint (and why the loss of a star) is the sound. The base is good, but there seems to be an issue in getting the volume to go to max. I don't mind hearing ambient noise, because it keeps me from getting run over, but when you're at the gym, you can just hear your music over the garbage they play over the speaker system. Oh, and the little charger cover eventually broke off, which is a shame because I used to wear them when I was casually swimming and didn't want to annoy the neighbors with loud music.

*****UPDATE***** After the most recent firmware update, my headphones are suddenly able to to max, and there is very little distortion. It's been a year and the battery life still kicks serious butt, the range is still awesome, and the sound is nearly as good as my Bose. You can still hear the important ambient noise, such as traffic etc.,

title: Design flaw hampers a beautiful pair of in-ear headphones.
review: These headphones sound great, cancel noise completely, and are as comfortable as in-ear headphones can be, BUT, they separate at the noise cancelling rectangle no matter how gently you treat them. It's a flaw in the design that is just unavoidable. Since Bose does replace them, I would have deducted only one star, but they limit the number of times they will replace a single headset, but don't have a solution for the design flaw. One last complaint is about the coating on the wires. Bose continues to use a wire coating that has a tacky/sticky feel to them, and catches the wires on anything that they get close to. As a result, you will catch the wire on things as you walk by, and have the earbud jerked from your ear.

title: Good for Apple Fan
review:
Bought these for my wife just before the next generation was announced. #appleProducts
She didn't care that they were the prior generation when she received them. Occasionally has problems with asymmetric charging. But seems otherwise very happy with her headphones.

title: Sounds great, looks better
review:
Sounds pretty good. "Noise cancellation" is true somewhat, earbuds can only do so much in passive noise cancellation. Sounds comes through fairly nice otherwise.
The build quality is where these really shine for me. The cable looks and feels nice. The end pieces appear to be all metal. I've been very happy with these ear buds.

title: Fantastic earbuds
review: A fantastic set of earbuds.  I own two pairs and use them almost everyday.  I thought they would have broken by now, but they haven't.  This is especially surprising since they spend the entire workday around my neck and get banged by boxes fairly regularly.

title: My earbuds of choice
review: My earbuds of choice when I buy them for myself.  They're small so they're comfortable to sleep in or to put a larger set of headphones over them (like when listening to music while playing on an electric drum set).

title: Earbuds Dead on Arrival
review: Case seems to charge but earbuds totally dead. Charged 24 hours nothing. These did not look new, probably someone returned these and these are getting musical chairs until they arrive with a customer who never gets to testing them until the 30 day return window closes. But we are returning them post haste. Can live without our Bluetooth earbuds.

title: Grainy messed up display under front camera
review: As another reviewer stated these discounted phones seem to be slightly messed up in one way or another. The one I received was very grainy under the front facing camera.  I am going to try one more time with the black 1 TB model that comes with the headphones.  If the discounted model you buy goes out of stock you will have to buy what is available at the current price.  Returning these phones if defective is not an easy process. Read the Amazon return policy so you kniw what you are getting yourself into.

title: 8 years and Still going strong
review:
I have purchased a lot earphones. But these are the only ones that are still going strong in both ear buds right and left.

Only slight improvement would be to be able lower volume to lower levels. If in a super quiet environment.

title: Middling
review: The size alone is a huge limitation on this player because it takes a lot of futzing around to find the right controls.  Sound without earbuds is nearly non-existent, with earbuds, not bad.  Mostly it was a mistake on my part thinking that I was going to get more than I got.

title: Nice speaker, decent sound.
review:
This is a strange little speaker, but it does the job. The sound is good, obviously not high-end audio, but now I can listen to my audiobooks while I shower, or when I'm working around the house and don't want to be wearing headphones.

It's compact, with a compartment in the bottom that holds the charging cable (USB to, I think it's mini. I never remember the name.) It also comes with a cable that you can use to connect it to the headphone outlet on your phone rather than use the bluetooth. It's loud enough to be heard over running water, and of course waterproof. I wish the hanging strap was a bit larger, but it'll do.

title: A little pricey for an uninspired design
review: Decent headphones, decent sound for my purposes which is to listen to audiobooks.  I don't like over-the-ear designs because they usually end up hurting if I wear them too long. Kind of pricey for what you get.

title: In spite of some drawbacks, these are quite good.
review:
I was a little skeptical when I received these. I do have trouble with a lot of the earbud-style headphones which tend to shuck around in my ear, hurt, or slip out if I'm moving around at all. But these are comfortable and the choice of sizes means that I have the right fit for my ear canal. There are also over-the-ear hooks to ensure they'll stay on, and even these aren't uncomfortable.

The sound is really quite good. I was astounded by it. On the downside, the set-up was a little iffy. I never got the audio instructions and had to suss things out for myself. But that wasn't difficult. I was up and running in a matter of minutes.

The controls are a little persnickety. I'm always hitting the voice dialer when I'm trying to adjust the volume, and answering calls... I'm just not that good at it. It's going to take some practice. Since I rarely am willing to talk to anyone anyway, it's not a big deal for me.

There are some trade-offs, but all things considered these are nice hands-free headphones.

title: Good little headphones, just what I needed.
review:
I use headphones for my job, and I'd never been entirely happy with the ones that were provided to me. They were huge and heavy, and very uncomfortable to wear for hours at a stretch. I began using a set of Maxell headphones that I'd used with a Walkman -- so you know how old they were -- but the sound was never as good as I'd hoped. When the foam pads finally wore out, I knew I had to pop for a new set, so I chose these JVCs.

I'm very pleased with them They're light and easy to adjust, and the sound is a whole lot better than my old Maxells or even the enormous earmuff headphones that came with the job. The only problem I have with them is that they're kind of hot to wear in the summer. However they manage to muffle the screams of the brats next door, so it's all good.

The ones I got were a beautiful royal blue, nothing like the photo. I expect you get what you get. No biggie, they work the way I want them to, so I'm happy.

title: So far..very nice!
review:
UPDATE: Took them on vacation and they suffered a small accident. One of the earbuds cracked. I reached out to the company and they immediately sent over a replacement. Super happy with these. On the vacation they performed above and beyond until I dropped them on concrete stairs. If you don't that... then these will last you a long time.
*

I just got these...I'm taking them on vacation and will give an update later on. For right now...these are everything I hoped for. The color is spectacular. The packaging was so beautiful. I love the case! These fit wonderfully in my ear and the sound is pretty decent. Only downside is you can't control the volume from the headset, but you can answer and hang up the phone from it. Hopefully they last longer than my Samsung ones. I bought my Edge in October and those earbuds just died on me. Only a lifetime of a few months. :-( I have high hopes for these. Good buy with prime shipping.

title: They’re Exactly What I Wanted
review: They have it all: Easy to use, a few bells and whistles, pink!, cute, comfortable, great sound quality, and a decent battery life. To be fair, no other earbuds I’ve had have had longer battery life, I just always want longer. The price is really good considering how nice these are. I primarily use them to watch Netflix and listen to YouTube late at night so I don’t bother my family. I’m a night owl. If you’re on the fence, get them. They’re impressive.

title: Sounds good, looks silly
review:
While I like the idea of the little clips to hold earbuds in place, the plastic panels on these things are rather large and make me look like I'm wearing massive earrings. The sound performance is about the same as the Koss KE29E, which is a good thing for an under $20 set of earbuds, and these seem like they're more durable. I don't see myself wearing these in public much, though. More recently, I grabbed a set of MEE Electronics M6 earbuds, which don't cost much more, stay in just as well if not better while running, don't look nearly as silly, and sound considerably better.

So, these are pretty good for earbuds under $10, and they'd be OK for under $20. However, there are better options out there for only a little bit more money.

title: Hard to beat for the money
review:
Even pre break-in, these sounded great: probably the best headphones under $20 I've found. After break-in, these MEE buds were sounding like something that cost 4-5 times as much with a nice, even frequency response that favors bass only slightly. I find them comparable to $60-$80 Sennheisers, my previous favorites (which superseded Sony and Koss buds that I also liked). These MEE buds came with 3 sets (S, M, and L) of your typical soft rubber earpieces as well as 2 sets of the interesting multi-tiered earpieces shown in the photos and a pretty standard cloth case. Between the various earpiece options, it's unlikely anyone will have an issue finding a good fit.

The cord is about 1 m long, which suits my purposes. I like the over-the-ear wire bits, too, as they prevent tugs on the cord from dislodging them. They might be awkward with some kinds of glasses, but my straight-earpiece sunglasses fit over them fine. They can be bent to hang down more like normal earbuds if desired, though.

I'll be checking out more MEE products now, seeing what a great value these were. I still favor AKG and Beyerdynamic at the high end, but for my biking/hiking/running/workout listening needs, I'll probably be coming back to MEE.

title: Big Lag
review: I use this headset for working from home, and every phone call is a struggle due to lag. I am constantly talking over people or being talked over by them. It's functional, but not ideal perhaps for phone calls.

title: Love It!!!
review: The first pair of earbuds I don't regretting buying. Absolutely love it, works flawlessly and as described.

title: So far so good
review: Quick to connect (to Soundcore Bluetooth over ear headphones). No noticeable voice synchronization issues when paired to my Sony AV receiver. No signal drops, either.

title: I am giving them 4 stars for the amount of coolness they provide and the super case that they came in
review: We got these for our daughter for her birthday after she asked for them for months. I have not listened to the sound quality. I am giving them 4 stars for the amount of coolness they provide and the super case that they came in. The lights are super!! The speakers to make them shareable is great! Daughter is 10. She certainly has the coolest headphones around, according to her.

title: My favorite headphones, especially for traveling
review: Love these headphones.  They fit over your ear instead of inside, so you can wear them for many, many hours.  Both the cord between the two headphones and the one going to your electronics are completely retractable, which makes these super easy to carry around.  They are definitely the only ones I will use when traveling.  I have even had a pair stolen from me, since they are so unique.  You can no longer get these from the Sony site or in any store in the States, so I am very happy they are still carried by Amazon.  They must get them directly from Japan since all packaging and info are in Japanese only.  Don't care - just so long as they continue to carry them.

title: Good Quality for a low price
review: These are a good quality, inexpensive set of headphones.  The longer cord is especially helpful.  They are light weight but still good sound quality.  Great value for the very low price.

title: it's more comfortable than ear buds for her and the ability to ...
review: Bought for my daughter, she loves it, it's more comfortable than ear buds for her and the ability to connect them to another headphone and have two kids listening to the same audio output is a great feature.  Cord is nylon covered and round which helps keep it from tangling like the normal ear bud wires.

title: Bought and Tested So You Don't Have To
review:
Do these work? Yes
If that's all you care about, then you will most likely be happy with these headphones.
For me, the fit and seal is not good (can't complain too much because of the price).
The cables and inputs make it really awkward, I don't mind wired headphones, but there are better designs than these. The locations are on both sides depending on the cable used (there are 2 included) and they seem to always get in the way no matter what I'm doing and no matter which side I am using.
The product feel is cheap. I feel like I'm going to break them every time I use them.
The more I write this, I want to give 2 stars, but I think 3 is fair for the price. Maybe 2.5 Stars is a happy medium
Would I recommend these?
No, I would recommend looking elsewhere for a wired pair of headphones.

title: These things rock
review: For the price these are great! They fit in the war well and sound decent, don't expect it to sound like $200 headphones but they definitely sound better than any others in this range.

title: Our third pair
review: After reading some tests that found few brands of volume limiting headphones truly keep volume from harming kids’ ears, I was pleased to find these at such a good price. Kiddo loves them and the adults in the house can wear them comfortably. There’s enough noise canceling from the padding to work well but not so much I cant get kiddo’s attention from across the room when I need to. We own both Bluetooth and wired. They last a few years which isn’t bad for this price. The mic is imperfect but that’s a small price to pay for avoiding permanent hearing damage.

title: Wonderful earbuds.  Very comfortable.
review: These are the best earbuds that I've ever used.  I'm not an audiophile.  I use my earbuds for listening to audiobooks most of the time...and a little music.  I'm not really fussy about sound quality, I'm afraid.  I bought these for the price and the brand name.  I was pleasantly surprised at what a difference they made to my listening pleasure.  For one thing, they are extremely comfortable.  By far, the most comfortable earbuds I've ever worn. I haven't tried yet but I think you could even lie down wear them with comfort.  For my needs, these are fantastic.

title: Perfect case for iPod and ear bud storage.
review: I am very happy with this case.  I wanted something to store my new earbuds and bought this on closeout sale.  It holds my iPod Touch and my earbuds very well.  I use every day when I walk the dogs.  Very happy with this case.

title: Roku 2 works great
review: This little box is a fabulous little invention.  You plug it into your TV and can access Amazon Prime videos easily.  This is actually our second box.  The first, a Roku 1, is located in our living room and we use it almost nightly to watch something on Prime.  I bought this second box for my sewing room.  The Roku 2 has some improvements such as one touch buttons for Amazon, Netflix, etc.  It also has an earphone jack in the remote.  I think this might really come in handy, although I haven't tried it out yet.  I love the Roku and highly recommend it.

title: Just okay
review: I bought this case for my brand new iPod Touch.  It looks nice but it doesn't really do the job.  I cannot plug in my charger nor my earphones without removing the case.  I'm not sure why because there are holes there for the plugs, but neither one of them will seat properly for use.  I'm using the case for now, to help protect my iPod when I carry it in my handbag, but I'm on the search for something that will work better for me.

title: Great way to listen to music in bed
review: I'm just thrilled with my new sleep phones.  They are the perfect way to listen to music or an audiobook in bed.  They are so comfortable...so much better than earbuds or headphones because the tiny speakers are flat and embedded in a fleece headband.  While the sound may not be up to the highest standards, for my needs they are perfect.  I like to set my iPod to go to sleep in 15 minutes, put on some Brahms and off I go...I rarely stay awake until the iPod clicks off.  I'm very happy with this product.

title: Works with Hyper X Cloud II Gaming Headset
review: Seems sturdier and more functional than the original one that came with my Hyper X Cloud II Gaming headset. No mic clip on back with comes with two sturdy cable wraps.

title: Use it for my headset
review: My wireless headset is constantly dead.  I use this to charge it while gaming, so I don't lose so much mobility as the shorter cords.

title: Great
review: These are great headphones. The noise cancelling is handy for when you want some quite when you are outdoors. The battery time is also great, I never run out of juice when I'm outside. The bass is punchy and the mids are balanced.

title: Great
review: I have small ears and these earbuds fit great. Comes with extra tips for customizable fit and a nice pouch for storage. Sounds quality is great. Balanced highs mids and lows. Design-wise, it's very minimalist which suits me fine.  Great price, no need to spend hundreds for quality audio.

title: Afordable
review: For its price it's good enough. If you're a casual listener, not fussy with audio, this is actually pretty decent, especially for this price, others in this range aren't so good. It's sturdy and the hard plastic is durable. I have small ears and it fits okay. The bass boost feature on this pair helps the tinniness often associated with cheap earbuds.

title: Beautiful sound
review: After having to use broken headphones for so long, these were really a godsend. This headphones make my music sound so much better. There are the literally the best headphones I've ever had the pleasure of using. The sound is exceptionally clear. And the staging is really excellent, I can really hear the spacing in the room of the recording. And the bass makes the sound feel nice and big. It's also nice and powerful, not too thumpy, or distorted, just makes the sound fat and rich. I also like how they differentiate the right and left earbuds with a red ring around the right ear, it gives a fast visual for which earbud goes where. The L-shaped connector makes it to keep your music player in your pocket without the connector sticking out. The only thing I have to say is that the cord is kinda a sticky plastic/rubber feel, which could potentially be a  lint magnet, but I think that make sit more flexible to resist the cord sheath form snapping. I am really pleased with these headphones, they are a great price for really good quality.

title: You get what you pay for.
review:
Okay, For a pair of headphones that cost me less than 10 bucks, I didn't expect anything that great anyways. You get what you pay for, they're not bad, but they're not that great either. This is why: Sound quality is pretty weak, it's not just flat, but a bit tinny, on the trebles and the bass is pretty weak. The fit is unergonomic, it's just this generic round shape that runs a little big, so if you have small ears, the fit will be awkward. I've only had it for a week so, so far there are no problems with the durability. I like how the plug end is flexible, so I know int he future the wires aren't gonna fray and break. The cable is pretty flexible too, I don;t anticipate any crimping. The plastic housing on the wires and ear pieces themselves are alright for the price. I bought these cause I wanted some cheap disposable in ears for cycling. I can still hear what's going on outside while wearing these. They're a bit quieter than my regular in ear headphones. The bottom line is, if you want cheap earphones that work decently, these are fine. If you're used to better sound quality, these may jar you.
I also want to compare these to the earbuds that came with my zune player. The Zune earbuds are much better in sound quality and fit. After using it for two years, they broke so I bought these as a replacement. For around the same price, under 10 dollars, the zune ones are better.

title: Beyer Dynamic Headphones
review: Great luxury headphone. Unfortunately I was not able to have the pleasure to hear the sound or test the comfort  because I have purchased as a gift; the receiver has a pair and they truly love them.

title: Five Stars
review: Love it now I know that my "special" headphones are expectly where they should be in it's protected case.

title: So far so good
review: I have yet to actually test it with an ipod on a beach or in a pool but I've put tissues in and dipped it in my bathtub. They came out dry. I hope the screen can be touched through the case as they say. Glad it comes with the earphones too. A bit of advice: clean your ears deep before you put them on

title: Excellent value
review: These headphones are comfortable for both my spouse and myself. The sound quality is very faithful. Volume controls easy. Best of all my cats aren't interested in chewing them up like they are with other brands. :)

title: Overall Not Good Value
review: Not very sturdy. I tried it on and it feels very loose on my head. So, the headphone doesn't make good contact with my ears.  Wouldn't work while exercising for me. Also, the plastic component when you pull the headphone to size it right is very cheap plastic material.  It'd break in a minute. Returning it right away. It's just not good value. Even at 20 bucks feels too much for what it is right out of the box.

title: Smallest Earpads/Earmuffs Ever
review: I was excited to get some decent sound and long usage at the gym BUT these are fitting for kids or those with VERY SMALL ears. I have smaller than most guys but these are ridiculous. Through the years, I have bought/use many headphones.  All covered my ears. These do not at all.

title: Using my Android phone headset on my PC!
review:
My laptop is kinda old, it has one jack for headphones and another for an external mic. Like everybody else in the spring of 2020, I am suddenly working from home and I was looking for a way to use my Andriod phone wired earbuds with a built-in mic on my laptop.
Enter this splitter.
Like many other people I initially had trouble getting both the headphone part and the mic part to work, but the problem was *not* this product, it was the settings on the programs I was using. Both Zoom and Microsoft Teams have settings that need to be adjusted so it sends audio to the headphones and takes audio from the mic. Once those were correct, BANG, it worked like a charm!
I have been using this for the past 3 weeks now and I couldn't be happier. Happy I didn't have to buy some huge gamer headset with a boom mic (which were mostly out of stock anyway!) and happy the solution to my problem cost less than $5!

title: FINALLY!!
review:
I have tried 5 different kinds of headphones and earbuds to use when I run and they have all required me to fiddle with them while I ran. Those old school Sony's that many people love hurt my ears and none of the earbuds held in place on the sweat started.
Enter, SportaPro!! These sit snug and do not budge even on long runs, even when sweat runs down my bald head and onto my ears (sorry, if you thinks it is gross to read about it try living with it!)
I have worn them in the regular style on my bare head and also over and under a hat, it all works fine. They are a bit large so storing them is not as easy but I don't care, they fold up a bit and still fit in my little running kit bag (with GPS watch, mp3 player, heart rate chest strap, etc.)
As a bonus I had not thought about, the on-ear style means that I can still hear what is going on around me (approaching cars, other runners, etc) while the headphones deliver very good sound with a decent bottom end.

The search is over, I'm going to stock up on these while they still make them!

title: Great for the price!
review:
The sound is very clear and even though it feels like it's a bit loose in my ear it stays put pretty well! People I talk to say that I sound a bit muffled but they can still understand me just fine.
Super convenient, I keep it in the car so if I get a call when driving I don't have to fumble for my plug-in headset.
A very good low-buck Bluetooth earphone!

title: I wanted to love these so bad
review: It is very difficult to find good quality wired earbuds that have volume control. These ticked all the boxes: sturdy flat cable, sturdy angled plug, in line volume control, but they have a fatal flaw. The plastic housing presses into your ear when they are fully seated. After 30 minutes to an hour they make my ears very sore. The plastic housing has a much larger radius than the tips and even has a sharp edge right at the point they touch your ears. A small redesign would fix this, which is very frustrating, but the search continues for what seems like such a simple thing. Good quality earbuds that last a while, don't hurt your ears, and have in line volume control with a pause button. Klipsch had amazing ones I used for years, but they quit making them a few years ago. Since then I have been through dozens of pairs trying to find a good replacement. Once again, this isn't it.

title: Best wired earbuds for the money by far!
review: These earbuds are awesome! I bought them mostly because I love wood stuff and thought they looked super nice and I needed some wired ones. I used to use the Klipse but they seem to have stopped making them. These sound at least as good and look better at a fraction of the price. They have a microphone, and inline controls, and the cord is a bit longer than normal. Between the design and function I would swear these were made specifically for me. I wear out wired earbuds about every 6 months and I will definitely be buying these again next time.

title: One major problem
review: Overall these are nice for the price, but the one issue is a fairly big one. These earbuds will occasionally raise the volume all the way to max for no reason and won't turn down until I unplug and plug them back in. It is very annoying and kinda painful. I really miss my Klipsch but they seem to have stopped making the ones I normally buy.

title: Don't waste your money
review: I have a pair of BeatsX that I wear to work everyday, and wanted a set for home as well. I thought the Sennheiser would be an upgrade, and while they are nice and sound great, they are truly awful earbuds. The huge thing that goes around your neck is ridiculous, and most annoying of all I wanted them for use on my computer and phone as I switch between the two throughout the evening, but they can't be used on one without completely turning off bluetooth on the other device. If you don't turn off the bluetooth on the other device they shout "Disconnected" in your ears every 15 seconds. Just buy the BeatsX, I have used those everyday for about a year now and they sound great, get 8 hours of use, and charge very fast. The new version of these only get 6 hours of battery life so I won't bother with those. Wish I had returned these and gotten a second pair of Beats. I'm back to using my wired earbuds when at home because I can't stand using these things.

title: Decent sound quality and comfortable. Great plus in that they can work as ...
review: Decent sound quality and comfortable.  Great plus in that they can work as external speaker in addition to headphones.  The external speaker sound quality average, not as good as when used as headphones, but very acceptable and volume is fine indoors or out.  These are not earthshakingly loud, but they are not superquiet as other reviewers have posted.  The convenience to cart them around and use that way but use less space is a plus.  Only drawback I had was an issue with the charge port.  After a while I had trouble getting a good connection with the USB--like it developed too much "give".  This made maintaining a good charging contact difficult.  Have not yet resolved this challenge.

title: Works very well
review: This lock has worked perfectly with no wear for months. Fit is perfect and ensures my Plantronics headset stays connected to whatever dongle I require in my home office.  A must-have for flex-use of Plantronics headsets.

title: Below Meh
review:
This is a case where you get what you pay for.
After reading so many glowing reviews I went for it and got this set.
The left ear foam is already split at the seam and I used glue to stop the tearing further.
The sound quality is far below that of the much smaller but slightly more expensive Koss KTXPRO1 Titanium headphones.
The sound volume is very low and increasing it to 100% still does reach a desirable volume level.

title: Too much hassle to even return...
review: I cannot fathom why there were so many positive reviews. This thing it total junk. As someone had noted (which I should have paid more attention to) these headphones have ZERO bass. I cannot imagine any application where the quality of sound is not relevant at all. Yes I agree they are cheap, but if paying $2 more gets something that can at least reproduce sound, you should go for it.

title: Solved all the VR hardware issues.
review: So I was having terrible HTC Vive issues with the controllers not being able to pair and getting all kinds of firmware out of date warnings. In the end I was having issues where pairing one controller would unpair the seconds one. I contacted HTC numerous times and even sent back the headset for repair and it came back with them claiming that nothing was wrong with it. After contacting HTC support for the last time, they thought that it might be the USB 2 & 3 controllers on my ASUS MSA99X EVO R2.0 motherboard and they recommended I get this Inatek card. I did, and as soon as I plugged in the HTC headset to it, miraculously, all my VR issues disappeared. Now the lighthouses and controllers shut down properly and automatically and turn on and pair properly and automatically. I wish I had knows that. Evidently not all USB ports are created equal. Who knew?

title: Sounds amazing combined with my audio technica m40's
review: Worked perfectly and without any configuration on my PS4. Sounds amazing combined with my audio technica m40's, way louder and more detailed than just hooking up the headphones to the controler. I tried the almost identical $12 USB card by Bengoo before ordering this one, but the volume on PS4 was way too low, not even 30% of what this Sound Blaster puts out. I would definitely recommend this one

title: Good but uncomfortable
review: I wanted to go full wireless and after a decent amount of research decided on these for Black Friday. After a few months I can finally give a decent review. The earbuds themselves feel high quality and the sound quality is also great. However the fit out of the box is abyssmal. I am constantly on guard of either them falling out or the discomfort of having them in for extended periods of time. That being said they pair extremely easy, very rarely drop signal, sound great, have a good enough battery life to where it’s only been an issue once, and and small and compact. I bough a pair of comply foam tips to fit on the earbuds that would also fit in the case. Hopefully this solves the problem but for headphones this expensive no one should be uncomfortable in them.

title: Annoying blue flashing, but works very well
review: This probably deserves a 5 star review-ive used it daily for 2 years without having any issues with it. The thing is, even if the PC is asleep or hibernating, this thing flashes the brightest blue in the world, which is an annoyance factor for me. I used it with an Anker ext. Speaker, Sony headphones, and earbuds, but it'll work on anything.

title: better for exercise than casual listening
review: these are great headphones. I got them for casual use and while exerciseing. it turns out these are much better for exerciseing than casual listening, because they get unfomfortable after being in the same place for 20+minutes. not uncomfortable as in hurting, just work their way out of where you put them. while exerciseing, they don't some how,they stay put. If you are gonna use these for running, working out, etc., get them. If you just want casual listening, these are still good, but their are probabley better options for $25.

title: I find it amazing. I have yet to test the battery only ...
review: I find it amazing. I have yet to test the battery only using the plug, and I think the earphones that come with it are rather pathetic but I have earphones that are much better. but for the price it was worth provided it doesn't break down in a year or two.

title: or use the headphones and keep in your pocket it's perfect, but I wouldn't suggest keeping on speaker and ...
review: It's not very loud, if you're sitting in one place, or use the headphones and keep in your pocket, but I wouldn't suggest keeping on speaker and leaving it one place while you move around the house. Of course it doesn't have the best reception outside of my house. but I think for the price I got a good product. I just think I was expecting too much for ten dollars, and decided to purchase a more expensive model.

title: cute but annoying
review: It's a cute case, but can be a pain to use at times.  It can be really hard to plug stuff into it, and especially so if you have L-shaped connectors.  Unfortunately we have those both for charging cords and for my kid's headphones, which makes it really hard to use either.
