review: Really easy to use, good sound quality. Super easy to pair and set up and the earbuds work independently of each other. Nice product.

title: Nice Headset, works with older computers
review:
My AIO (HP) is ancient (Windows 8). The fancy Beats sound system stopped being properly supported by MS Windows 10 a long time ago. This headset takes over and works properly for conferencing and teaching and I don't have to use the stupid college-supplied iPad. And for a decent price.

We'll see if it's durable.

title: Nice cushions--Read the sizing instructions
review:
Fits well (make sure you read their sizing instructions), is comfortable and seems more durable than the flaky stock cushions on my JVC HA-RX300s. We'll see if they last, but it looks good.

IMPORTANT: My 90 mm headset took their 100 mm cushions. They explain this if you read their sizing instructions.

title: Perfect...
review: New phone, no earphone jack 😡. This dongle allows the continued use of my plug ins and can simultaneously charge my device when needed. Sound quality is good, fits tightly in the phone's  charger port. I'm glad this was available.

title: Great...
review:
I use for my work-at-home office.
1. The control buttons on the headset stand are pretty ☺ and easy to use.
2. The range is excellent at around 120 feet away (I haven't tested beyond that)
3. The sound quality is excellent! I can hear and be heard clearly, however, at the beginning of some calls, I can hear some distortion or slight echo but by the time the call connects, it's gone (Jabra tech support helped me resolve the problem).
4. The visual on a call alert is great so when my family comes in, they can immediately see mom/wife is unavailable.
5. My home is quiet most of the day so idk if the mic noise cancelation is effective.

I returned the 65 for the 75 when it went on sale for less than what I paid for the 65. It's super nice too! Set up was a bit more complicated but Amazon tech support is good. Jabra customer service is friendly, efficient and knowledgeable.
I used Plantronics wired headsets for years until my employer switched to Jabra wireless 5 years ago. It was such a great headset, I decided to upgrade to a newer model for the advanced features. Some reviews are not so great but of course, they're subjective so I decided to try 4 myself and take advantage of Amazon Prime free return option if it didn't work...it's working well.

title: Really awesome...
review: I've been using for 90 days. Battery life of the charging base is excellent (I've charged it maybe 3x within 3 months). I mostly use one earbud at a time for 3-5 hours per day. The earbud itself needs charging after about 7-8 hours if continuous use. The sound quality when using one bud is clear, good volume and overall great. For the 1st time, a few days ago, I used both earbuds and the sound quality was awesome. The problem with most buds is that over time, the materials wear out or they break down altogether so I can't speak on longevity beyond 90 days. Overall, these serve my purposes of listening to music/videos, etc., however, I haven't used them for phone calls.

title: Nice and roomy...
review: This is huge. I am storing 3 pairs of wired earphones without a problem. The case is soft to touch but sturdy to protect the contents. The yellow color is as advertised. Nice buy.

title: Perfect function, terrifying form
review:
[[VIDEOID:aa4e23c31b35022c3e7c9d7b2385b22e]] I'm a grown women with tiny ears and these are the first earbuds that fit well and don't hurt me. They charge quickly and have have excellent sound quality. However, charging them in the dark is horrifying.
Parents beware!

title: Won't stay in the ear at all.
review: These headphones will not standing here at all, and the shape make some terribly uncomfortable.

title: I love them
review: These are great, comfy, cheap , noise canceling when it's up loud. I see many complaints but for this price this headset is wonderful

title: They pair easily and stay put in ears.
review: I love the blue tooth headset!  It was easy to pair with iphone and ipad, and stays put in ears whether I am on treadmill with music or in bed watching movies.  I have not been able to sign up for the lifetime sweatproof warranty that is advertised but that could be my lack of technological skills. I’m going to try again today!  Great headphones!!!

title: Great little buds for a very affordable price
review: You get what you paid for. These aren’t the newest beats or Apple headphones. But for the price these little buds pack a punch. They’re perfect for work and for the gym. Great buy!

title: Love these headphones
review: We go through kids headphones one pair every 3 month later including the frozen pair of ihome headphones! None work better than this they’re Bluetooth and the relays are removable for when your girl grows up and decides it’s not the cool thing to do anymore. Live this brand would buy again

title: I am still using this phone
review: I spent time today looking for a new phone.  All I see is heartbleed issues and battery eaters.  I have used this phone since they came out with it. I never have battery problems. I have played Sudoku till my eyes hurt. It takes pretty nice pictures.  It has a voice recorder that I even forget to use. The alarm clock is great. The bluetooth never worked. I dropped it once in Walmart and the headphone and USB cable never worked after that. But it does make calls and receive calls like it should. I used the browser occasionally.  I don't think the browser works anymore.  I can still email photos to my email.  I think it is time for a new phone.  The amazing thing is I found it in my purse lining.  I traveled this week and couldn't find my phone. I thought it was lost forever.  It kept sending out a low battery signal and I could hear where it was.  I had a hole in my purse lining and the phone had slipped into the lining.  The battery life is still amazing.  Not sure what to do with a phone that really is a phone.

title: does what its supposed to
review: Does the job but was pretty expensive for a little piece of plastic. Oh well. better than paying a bunch of money for a retractable earbud set only to have it malfunction

title: Not worth the money
review: Nice soft headband, but the headphone pieces are uncomfortable because they press into my head

title: Good inexpensive headphones
review: The headphones are comfortable, though a bit large for my head. The sound is good, but not the best. They serve as a pair of headphones for work and suit the purpose well. If you just need a decent, but inexpensive headphone then this works well.

title: While I still have an iPad with a port.
review: If you're going to listen to podcasts all day long, two things will happen: Your bluetooth earbuds will need to be charged, and your device will also need to recharge, so you can't plug in your lightning cable earbuds.

title: Fantastic audio quality!
review:
I thought I was happy with my previous earbuds, but these blow them out of the water. The noise canceling is fantastic, I live in a busy household, and it's nice to be able to pop these in and get some focused work done. The case feels extremely high quality. The gestures work fine.

I was really impressed at the audio quality, I'm noticing details to songs I've listened to thousands of times, even when at low volumes. The sound is very clear and balanced and adapts naturally. I don't quite understand what the positional audio does, but it is a better listening experience than anything else I've tried. These are definitely worth the money over my previous earbuds, which were in the $50 range.

The battery life isn't quite as good as my previous ones, but these are doing more. In most cases, I'm not someone who listens all day, so it's not a big deal for me. They recharge to a usable state very quickly.

I received this item for free through Vine for an unbiased review, my opinion is my own.

title: Anti-skip feature works great!
review:
My 8-year-old loves books on CD, so we got this to replace our old player. It's perfect. Kiddo has been carrying it around and keeps swinging it by the wrist strap but the player doesn't skip a beat! The controls are easy to use. There is some processing time between functions, the computer is not very fast. It feels very durable.

The speaker is mediocre, but you can hear the words just fine; it's tinny as expected for something like this. It is what it is. Plugging in headphones works great.

The one issue we have is that the Bluetooth doesn't seem to be able to pair with objects that can't "pick" it. Because my headphones just pair with whatever picks it, the two devices just have the Bluetooth lights blink until they time out. The manual only says to pick it in the menu, but all my Bluetooth devices are old and just have a pairing function, no menus. There is not much information for troubleshooting so we gave up. I docked one star for that.

I received this item for free through Vine for an unbiased review, my opinion is my own.

title: Great value! Very happy with it.
review:
We tested this headset and the call on the other end was crystal clear despite a lot of noise in the background. The microphone is very powerful! They are comfortable and easy to wear, and the range seems as long as described. My husband works as a tech taking calls and has used it for a few shifts and has not had issues with dropped calls etc. Pairing works great with android and PC. This works as well as the name-brand ones for half the price.

The charging station is worth the upgrade. It’s very easy to pop the headset onto and make sure it’s charged for the next shift. The storage for the USB dongle is also extremely clever.

I received this item for free through Vine for an unbiased review, my opinion is my own.

title: Love this style.
review: I have like Gummy Earphones for years. I prefer this style and have foind it in creassing hard to find them. The store I would normally get them from went to the Earbuds (which I hate). Amazon to the rescue. Grabbed two pair. I have never jad them die on me due to construction. Theh always fall victim to a dog attack when I am not looking.

title: Great for side sleepers
review: Very comfortable wireless headband headphones. Pairing is easy. It takes a bit of fiddling, but the electronics are removable for washing the headband. Sound quality is a little muddy (the highs sound attenuated), but it's not bad, especially if you don't want sharp hi-frequency sounds keeping you awake. The foam padding covering the speakers seems like it will last a while.

title: Good and loud, nice high end
review: Nah the bass ain't boom, but it's acceptable, and it sort of depends on how tight you fit the ear tips into your ears. But these are nice and loud and they have a great high end. You get a lot of bang for the buck -- they're rated IPX7 waterproof, the case has a digital charge meter, and it recharges the earphones several times before it requires recharging (via USB-C). Pairing and operation are pretty simple, and the instruction sheet covers that. You get three sizes of ear tips by the way. My set arrived with the smallest ones already installed, and almost a full charge.

title: Five stars for my purposes
review: The sound quality isn't that of boutique headphones, but these pretty much hit the sweet spot for me. They are excellent for listening to narration or spoken word material or podcasts, dialog-heavy movies and series, and for phone calls. They lack boomy bass and have good high end and a pretty flat mid-range, all of which are a plus for me. They're okay for music, but if music listening is your primary use, you might shop for something else. I'd liken them to the sound of a good quality portable radio with the "bass boost" turned off. And the mic works great for phone calls.

title: Good for audiobooks or narration
review: This isn't a full-range audiophile headset. It's basically a midrange speaker. But it works very well for listening to spoken narration, audiobooks and the like. Really handy for side sleepers -- just hang it on the "upside" ear, switch it when you roll over.

title: Good sound, good mic
review: Good wireless headset at a good price with good performance. Audio is very good, and the mic works very well.

title: Does what I wanted it to do
review:
I wanted something to amplify my phone's ring volume at night so it would wake me up. Volume boosting apps only boosted volume on my phone when headphones were attached. The seem to do nothing for ring volume. So I gave this speaker a try.

It works. Volume depends on what you set on your phone, but it does amplify nicely. It's not overpoweringly loud, but it is a lot louder.

The plug seems a little undersized. It's kind of loose in my phone's jack, and the speaker crackles a bit when I move it a little when it's plugged in. But it doesn't cut in and out, and it works.

The plug is positioned toward the back of the speaker so when you lay your phone down the speaker won't prop it up. As a result, the speaker is a bit front-heavy, so when you're carrying it with the speaker plugged in, the speaker tends to rotate to whatever the lowest position is. Most anything flat can be positioned behind the phone and speaker to stop that though.

Don't expect full-spectrum audio and rich bass. It's a tiny speaker and it sounds like a tiny speaker. But it does provide a nice boost to volume, it's small and convenient, and it's rechargeable.

title: Pretty much live up to the listing description
review: These headphones have great sound, are comfortable, and they pair nicely with an iPhone. They live up to pretty much everything in the listing description including fast charging and long run time. They look and feel high quality and they come nicely boxed.

title: Great audio
review:
This in-ear headset works great with Xbox, Playstation, and Switch. All the online players were able to hear the mic great.

It also works with an iPad, but the mic was a little glitchy with an iPhone.

The audio from the ear buds is phenomenal---right up there with name brand buds.

The only negative---and it's minor---is the ear buds are a little larger than most. That might be something necessary for sound quality, or for the mic wiring or something. But as I said, that's a minor negative.

Overall this is an excellent gaming headset with great audio both in and out.

title: Good headphones
review:
Just to clarify a few details: These headphones have a built-in mic, volume control (+ and - on on the mic), and a four-barrel connector for compatibility with most phones and devices. (I think headphones with built-in microphones should be called headsets, and headphones without mics should be called headphones---just to avoid confusion.)

Like most headphones (or headsets) today, they're set up to favor bass response, which to most buyers is a good thing. The response across the rest of the frequency spectrum sounds well balanced without too much top end.

The mic response is, well, pretty much like a budget phone headset mic response.

They're comfortable (even if just a little tight-feeling on first use) with good padding, and they look and feel well made.

A good choice for people who prefer on-ear instead of in-ear headsets.

title: Good entry level GPS watch
review:
This is a good entry level gps watch. I use a Nike Run and a Garmin 220 and this one seems to be nearly as accurate. It’s light and comfortable, and the band is soft and doesn't feel cumbersome or sweaty.

The interface isn't super intuitive, but the instructions are clearly written and accurate. As far as the function goes it seems to do a lot better if you sync it with the companion iPhone app. Occasionally it would lose Bluetooth connection – the app has a much simpler and more intuitive interface than the watch face itself. Aesthetically it’s really cool though – when you’re in idle mode the face is black with white numbers, and when you start a workout it switches to white numbers – really easy to tell where you’re at regarding the different modes.

You can program a goal pace, time or distance – bear in mind that there isn't haptic feedback so if you have your headphones in you might not be able to hear the audio cue when you hit your milestones.

Syncing it with GPS was a little frustrating because it seemed to time out – again connecting it to the companion app made this much easier – it only took a couple of seconds.

All in all a decent watch, especially for someone just starting out in the GPS tracking stuff – just make sure to use the companion app.

title: Great picture, a bit lacking in WiFi reception
review:
Very nice, sharp picture, bright, and great color. Other reviewers say the built-in OS crashes a lot, but the 32-inch unit (1366 X 768 resolution, 60 Hz) we got worked fine and was stable.

The remote's one-button access to YouTube, Netflix, Vudu, Toon Goggles, Pandora, and Accuweather is a nice feature.

The onboard speakers are tinny, but loud enough. There are lots of inputs and outputs including component audio and video (RCA), USB, HDMI (3 of them), headphones, composite, 15 pin VGA, and an optical digital output.

It comes with remote (batteries included), two feet (which are attached with screws -- a magnetic screwdriver will help because the screws go in small recessed pockets), user manual, and quick start guide. It also has monitor mount screw holes in the back (200 x 100mm spacing).

My one concern -- and the reason I'm deducting a star -- is the WiFi reception. We set the TV up in a room adjacent to our wireless router -- which provides a strong signal to every device through the house -- and only got 75 percent signal strength on the TV, and we didn't get full HD video on WiFi. It seems to need a better internal antenna or something. So it might be best to consider this mainly for LAN cable connections, HDMI, or uses where the TV will be very close to the wireless router.

title: Excellent and affordable
review: Got it even though was skeptical at first. It arrived very quick, packaged beautifully and did not take even a minute to set it up. It easily connected and the sound quality was way beyond what I expected from small speakers. In addition to that the headphones are very thin and soft, so they are comfortable to sleep with ( which is what I originally got them for). I added an outer cover from natural material, as I can not use synthetics and now I enjoying them for my naps!

title: meh
review:
purchased for single sided hearing loss after extensive research for "the best" on the market (at this or near this price point).
perks:
i can hear more clearly out of that ear using this headset. (music, netflix dialogue). if you're not deaf in one ear, this is irrelevant.
Can listen while charging, so no "down time" like some other products.
cons:
headset is uncomfortable in multiple positions. i can not really find a good position, but the least uncomfortable- and interestingly enough, the best sound quality is NOT in manufacture explained position: it's over my head with the pods near my temples or behind my ears.
Sound quality is not good, it's better coming through tinny computer speakers, but using those, i can only hear it well on my good ear. It's louder/better/and more clear (can hear fine details in the music) if you wear a headband or tight hat to press the pods against your head- but again comfort is a factor.
Noise leak is a major factor. If you turn it up to "low-normal" listening volume (cell phone set at half volume, headset set to lowest selectable volume) my housemate can still hear music played at arms reach. do not anticipate that you can wear it around others in a quiet room.

would i buy again? no.
Did I return them due to problems as stated above. Yeah.

title: Nice option for listening to CDs
review: If you have a new cell phone that does not have an microSD card slot, you may not want to take up so much internal space with music you don't listen to that often. It's nice to have the option of playing a CD on a specific player. Mine arrived well packaged and was fully charged. I like the black and antique gold colors. It comes with in-ear phones but I prefer my over ear headphones. It's easy to use as a CD player. It has an equalizer but I have not yet needed to use it because the bass is more than adequate for me. I have not yet paired it with my car and I will update my review when I do. Overall, I really like this especially because it's rechargeable. No more having to carry or fussing with batteries.

title: Great for listening to music and handling calls
review: This is a versatile set with audio and call functions. I have the burnt copper which reflects a nice reddish-brown color in light. The sound is good compared to another set of headphones I own, the ones named after a DJ/rapper(?). On these, however, I can press the :Sound" button to enhance the bass or make voices clearer. I normally use the cord to connect but Blue Tooth pairing was easy. The ear cups are soft and provide deep cushioning. I have owned Panasonic headphones before. They were great but I lost them and I really miss them. Theses are bigger and bulkier, the sound quality is up-to-date.

title: Great headphones but with at least one drawback
review: I watched a few YouTube videos to get more info about these headphones. I received white but the black might have been a better choice for me. Lots of ear plugs and wings in various sizes, plus a clip and a devise to shorten the cord if it is still too long for you. I usually have an issue with the skip while wearing wireless but these did not skip so far. To be able to listen to a full song without that blank interruption is great. Some reviewers do have an issue with the extra weight the external battery adds, in addition to making the headphones feel off balance. I do not exercise wearing these, so I have not experienced that issue. I tried pairing these with two different phones, a Samsung Note 4 Edge and a Sony Xperia XA Ultra. The sound was tinny on my Samsung and there was little bass. I downloaded the Jaybird app from the Google Play Store and installed it on my Sony. The sound was better on my Sony but with the app, it was amazing. Being able to select different setups or customize my listening preferences really helped. I tried listening to both music and audio books.  Both sounded great. The biggest drawback of these headphones is that you can only recharge them through attaching the external battery. If I lose the battery, the headphones become useless. Overall, these seem great so far. We will see how they age with wear. Hopefully, the company with offer additional external batteries for purchase.

title: Good earphones
review: I was looking for in-ear phones that would fit my tiny ear canals. These still do not fit but the sound is good. I like more bass in my music and these project more bass than most earphones I've used. I like the metallic red color because it matches my smartphone.

title: Good value and great backup earphones
review: These are just basic in-ear phones so I did not expect much. I tried these headphones in several different devices: a very old music player, Samsung Galaxy Note 2 and my iPad 4. All gave the same level of quality in sound. I have a pair of Bose and these are not as good, but would be a great back-up if my Bose were to fail or get lost. They are easy to store in my purse and backpack. For the price, you can't beat it unless you insist on pricier name brands. Sometimes, simple can be better.

title: Do exactly what I want them to do!
review: I wanted some wireless headphones for use around the house. It paired easily and quickly with my Samsung Galaxy Note 2. The bass is great when I listen to music but I do not believe these are noise canceling. Still, they free me from a wire and that is great while I do houswork and hobbies. I ordered the wine color which is great. Making a phone call was easy, too, once I got used to the placement of the controls. The initial charging took a few hours, so I did that overnight. I really like these headphones and I would recommend them.

title: Traded an iPad2 for this one with 64GB without offers
review: I do plan to buy the 128GB iPad but for now I am enjoying this device. My friend got this Kindle but he didn't like not having a back camera. We traded devices. In terms of price, I think he got the better of the deal, but in terms of performance, I think I did better. I have very close bandwidth in my country, but I was able to download a full movie. I was able to download all my Kindle books. I'm debating about downloading my Audible content to this or leave it on my Samsung Galaxy Note II. The sound while watching a movie is great when listening through headphones. Other reviewers have gone into the pros and cons of this device so no need to rehash their comments. Overall I am please with my trade, but it can't totally replace my laptop. It will strictly be for entertainment.

title: Very nice, compact design
review: I bought this to use with my iTouch 4th gen and Bose bud earphones. The attachmnent works well. This is not a remote for functions in the iPod or iTouch. It controls the sound only and also can hold/resume a track. I wish there was a fast forward/rewind, but it does the job.

title: Great product!
review: I bought it at first sight.  The software was easy to understand, and downloading was a breeze.  I could fit 130 minutes of cda files on the device.  You could fit infinitely more if you load MP3 files.  64 meg goes a long way.  The sound from the supplied headphones is awesome.  I wasn't expecting them to have such great bass.  Most of all, I love how small it is.  I'm a woman and I like to put it in my pants pocket and walk around the office with it.  No one knows I'm carrying it except they see the headphones.  I now wear a set of ear buds and hide the cord under a jacket or sweater to be more discreet.  The only drawback is you need the MMC card to expand the memory.  Its slot is too thin for an SD card which is more readily available.  That's the reason I rated it a 4 instead of a 5.  Otherwise, I highly recommend it.

title: Top Sound From Wireless Headphones
review: Love the Bose SoundSport Wireless Headphones, in Citron. The comfortable ear tips come in three sizes (S M L). They are sweat and water resistant. For more information go to [...]The Bose Connect app unlocks current and future headphone features. These are engineered to stay with you and out of your way. Comes with a handy case which can be snapped to a belt, in a purse, or other clothing. The instruction reference shows how to change the ear tips and the proper way they fit into the ear, it show how to control the volume, and how to charge the battery. These are available in several languages. Online registry is available. Warranty is for one year.

title: Top of the Line Headphones Made For iPhone, iPad, iPod.
review: Caeden Linea N°2 In-Ear Headphone, connects form and function with Apple 3-button remote cable and travel pouch. Nicely crafted with hand- selected materials for durability and design profile. Included are several sizes of interchangeable silicone tips for comfort. Sound is top of the line. Perfect to connect to your iPhone, iPad, iPod.

title: Shure SRH145 Portable Collapsible Headphones— Perfect in Comfort and Sound
review: Shure SRH145 Portable Collapsible Headphones are a sleek, modern design that fold for easy carrying. They are comfortable as well as good-looking. The soft ear cushions are very effective in muting the outside noises and that allows the wearer to enjoy the quality of sound expected from Shure products.

title: Get whatcha pay for I guess
review: Got a lot of static/interference noises from day one and crapped out after 3 weeks. I wasn’t gentle with it, nor was I rough. I’d say it took everyday wear and tear. Now the lightning connection is finicky and isn’t recognized by the phone so that it’s still playing on speaker even though it’s plugged in properly. Like I said, I wasn’t gentle with it. I’d keep the headphones plugged into it when I tossed it in my bag and would sometimes wrap the cord around my phone when not in use. I also didn’t see in the description that it doesn’t work on calls or with Siri. Live and learn

title: Great Headphones!!!  I highly recommend getting a pair!
review: These headphones are fantastic.  The sound quality is good but not amazing, but for the price of the headphones the sound quality is good.  I was really impressed with the battery life, at a full charge the battery lasts forever.  I'm sure you will not be disappointed with this purchase.

title: Against my better judgement
review:
If you don't mind abysmal customer service, then skullcandy is for you!
I had skullcandy headphones before. They lasted a total of 3 months before one of them stopped working.
I tried to get them replaced and get skullcandy to honour their warranty. They ignored several of my emails for about 3 months. I called them out on twitter. Still nothing. In the end, they waited out the warranty and then told me the warranty had expired. Same thing happened to my daughter. And then to my husband.
Basically after they get your money, you are on your own. As long as you keep that in mind, you will be fine.

Against my better judgement, I let my husband talk me into trying them again, since their sound quality is pretty good. And now we know better than to expect anything beyond that from this company.
So I will see how long it takes this time for one to shorten out and them to ignore me. 👍

title: The sound is great. But the auto chime that says 'Connected' is ...
review:
The ear cups can get a little warm from extended wear. I had to shift the cups slightly off to let the ear breathe.
The sound is great. But the auto chime that says 'Connected' is kind of loud, and is not volume adjustable.
So turn the headphone on, and get it connected, before wearing it.

Update: Had it for a few months and the headphones died. Wont turn on even after charging it overnight. Sad....

title: Good product!
review: Good price for a good product. My 3 kids like them a lot. One daughter is not careful with them so I had to replace hers after 2 months, but any headphones would do that.

title: they hurt my ears
review:
im thinking the small size might be a little big for my ears because these hurt to wear for longer than a few minutes.
Biggest problem is you can't use the left earbud by itself. You can only use it by itself if the right is out of the case or in the case while the case is open. Also I wish I could disable the touch setting altogether.

title: Random, Amazing find!
review: Really impressed with this! I got this for my husband for his work outs. He has hearing loss on his right ear but bass translates well in that ear so we’ve always had to hunt for good earbuds for him. He’s tried a number of other brands, a couple of them high end and we’ve been disappointed everytime. So i thought it wouldn’t hurt if we tried this one. I tried it before he did and I was so pleased! I wanted to get one for myself. It keeps the charge well too. Great sound quality, comfortable fit and very ergonomic.

title: Great for keeping headset nice
review: I really like this product. Makes finding headset easier and keeps it from getting smashed.

title: Nothing like the earbuds that come with the beats
review: Nothing like the earbuds that come with the beats. Smaller than the small size of the beats and the holes for the sound to come out are larger than what you will find with beats. Don't waste your money getting these.

title: Stopped charging in less than 4 months
review: The earbuds bluetooth were difficult to plug in and especially hard to unplug.  Therefore within 2 months the inner connection seems to have gotten broken, thus is touchy and I have to fiddle with it for at  least a minute to find just the right way to plug it in in order for it to show the little red light indicating that it will successfully charge.  In other ways I have liked these ear phones for sleep affirmation and hemisynch music.  They have been comfortable for side sleeping though the battery box can get in the way. I am tired of the daily fiddling to make them charge and never know when it will finally not work at all, so will buy a different brand this time.

title: CLEAN SOUND AT LAST
review: This is my fourth set of headphones. I decided to spend the fairly big bucks, because the cheap Sonys didn't fit right, the Audio-Technika ATH-M50 had unacceptable distortion and was uncomfortable, and the noontec zoro HD had the same distortion and comfort problems. Re. distortion, maybe it's a bigger problem with me because I enjoy  classical piano music. When a key in the middle treble range is struck fairly hard, the beginning of the note can sound harsh (distorted). It can be so harsh that it causes me to cringe and shudder. I once took a piano CD to a music listening room to see if it was the CD or my system. The distortion was even worse there until he played it on a really high-end system. So I was stuck with harsh piano until I decided to spring for these Beyeerdynamics. Happily, the distortion is minimal at normal listening levels but increasingly present as you crank them up. The rest of the sound quality is excellent. The main thing is, the sound is really clean (free of distortion). Great frequency response, including fantastic bass. They're comfortable, too. Finally, I've lost my sense of wanting something more in headphones.

title: Pretty good sound, some issues
review:
The pics of the Cabor Small Wireless Headphones looked like a couple other pairs I've owned, and I was looking for a new set, so I ordered them.

Unlike my other wrap-around outside ear headphones, these came coiled up. When I gently pulled them open and put them on, they shot off my head as they coiled back up. There's no way to stretch them out - they coil back up if you put them down. As a result, I find they're very fiddly to put on, and while I can get them on both ears so they don't come off, I couldn't run in them or do something active that involved leaning over repeatedly.

Soundwise, these were pretty good - not great, but definitely not bad. I didn't find the sound tinny or weird but pleasant, and very good for audiobooks. Once I found the tiny light, I found these headphones super easy to pair. The buttons are easy once you get used to them, but black buttons with black letters isn't the easiest to read.

My charger cable arrived dead, but we have so many cables that fit this headset that it wasn't a problem. By the way, the light on this headset is very small, and from some angles you might not realize it's on.

Overall this is an okay headset, but next time I'll buy a set that doesn't want to coil up every time you let go of it.

title: Good headphones at a good value :)
review: My husband wanted light weight, over-ear headphones.  The ones he had were uncomfortable and didn't sound too good.  He LOVES these - the feel, fit and sound.  He listens to audiobooks and music with them.  I'm sure they're not audiophile quality, but they're very good, and a huge upgrade from the last headphones.

title: Amazing sound, and comfortable....
review:
These are awesome earbuds! They are very unusual since they have detachable ear pieces, which I'm not sure if it is a good or a bad thing, but the sound quality is so good, I really don't care!

They have a nice balance of sound to them, and I tested them with different genres of music. Everything from classical to country or rock sounded amazing, and I have found a new favorite pair of earbuds!

I have tiny ears, and I really like the comfort in these ear buds. They stay securely in my ears, and block a lot of noise out too, which of course is important in promoting sound quality. I purchased these at a discount in order to test and review, and I have to say, these really fit the bill, they are a great quality!

title: Would buy again
review: The fit isn’t great, but for the price the sound is good the battery life is maybe 4 hours, I believe. I’d buy again for the price.  I lost the right one, again fit?,  but I’m picky or have funny ears🥺. Lastly  I find my iPhone Bluetooth will not connect once disconnected until I place the earbud in the case (charging “or” charged/ not connected to power) and then remove it, then it reconnects To iPhone. I’m still using the one😉

title: 10/10 would recommend!
review: My mother bought these headphones for me and they are my favorite! They work WAY better than my old ones! 👍👌

title: Amazing sound quality
review: I love the spatial sound, and the pure quality of the sound on these headphones.  The head tracking is awesome!  My only dislike is that if I'm already in a game, and then plug these in, I lose some ambient sounds in the game..easy fix..plug them in before starting the game.

title: Sensitive hearing is finally happy with earphones!
review: I have always had sensitive hearing - loud noises, constant vibrations, competing sounds, all come together into a migraine most of the time. I cannot tell you how many different headphones, earbuds, and such I've been through. All add to the cacophony that mentally and physically drain me or create more noise chaos. I have never been happier to solve that problem than when these arrived in the mail. Podcasts, music, lectures, phone calls and FaceTime are finally a pleasure when moving about my day.

title: B+ Nice but tight
review: Within this price category these Amazon headphones are really nice. The features work well, and the sound is better than expected. One drawback- they’re really snug. I’m an adult female with an average head and these got uncomfortable after a while.

title: Disappointing
review:
I bought some really nice earbuds from another brand and sadly their small, medium, and large ear canal things are way too big for my tiny ear canals. So, I bought these so I could listen to my games and music without them falling out of my ears constantly. They smallest tips fit, but are a bit uncomfortable, and after only maybe 6 times use, I notice that sound is only coming out of one ear. Also, the cord is coming apart.

I’m sorry to say that the sound quality is not that great either. If you’re looking for good wired earbuds, trust me, these are not it. I will be sending mine back for a refund.

title: Great quality and value!
review:
Finally some affordable earbuds that sound great, and both sides actually work. For this reason I highly recommend!

I’ve bought 2 other pairs, different brands in the past couple months so finding that these actually work properly and sound great makes me very appreciative!

title: Quality, but they fall out of my small ear canals
review: Nice set of bluetooth earbuds.  However,  I have very small ear canals.  Unfortunately, none of the rubber pieces are small enough to stay in my ears.  I did have some luck with the malleable foam, but I will likely have to keep checking them and pushing them further in every couple minutes I use them.  They do sound pretty good.

title: Average, a bit uncomfortable, decent noise cancelling, and I wish the bass was more audible.
review: I was hoping for better earbuds than these.  The sound is pretty average, when you compare them to similarly priced headphones.  The noise canceling feature works fairly well, I can crank my music up to cover the sound of my son playing the xbox 360.  What I don't like is the comfort.  Smaller buds  would improve this I think.  I have them the smallest ones on them and they're still too big to fit comfortably (I have been told my ears canals are quite small though).  I need more bass.

title: Fit and comfort are not up to par.  Mediocre sound. Noise canceling feature works pretty well, but I wouldn't buy again.
review: Unfortunately I found these to be VERY uncomfortable.  They don't stay put in my ears, even though I switched to a smaller size.  The sound is just so-so.  Consequently, I gave these to my 11 year old daughter, who is using them to watch movies on her iPad.  I do have to say (and this is why I give it 3 stars) that the noise canceling works rather well.  Usually my daughter uses my awesome voice canceling Sennheiser earphones and can hear me pretty well still while we're in the car.  Yesterday she used these in the car, and I had a much harder time getting her attention.

title: Couldn't resist a 2nd pair...just because!
review: I love these so much that I just bought a second pair (first pair I bought in 2014, and they're still going strong).  I saw the $20 price tag and knew I had to have another pair to keep on hand (or share with my kids, grrrrr).  Anyway, I love the twist to fit feature, it turns it so it fits very comfortably inside your ear at the correct angle.  I use the smallest rubber buds as I have small ear canals.  I took out all my earbuds to compare tonight and these knocked the others out of the part.  The sound is crystal clear, bass is good, I am hearing impaired but I feel like I'm hearing the depth of all the tones.  Oh...about the color.  It is NOT red.  It is more of a light raspberry color, closer to pink than red I think.  No biggie, well worth the price.

title: Great buy, awesome headphones!
review: I did not have a chance to try these out as they were a gift to my 21 year old daughter.  I have my own Sennheiser headphones, the noise canceling model, and know the quality and sound is unsurpassed.  She called me to thank me and said she's never had headphones that even came close to producing such great sound quality.

title: Does what it's supposed to
review: I lost my original headphone adaptor, so I ordered this 4 pack.  Theyre just as good quality as the original.  Now I have some spares, because you have to unscrew them to take the headphones out and I don't have a very good place to put them so that I can use them when need be.  For now, it's in a pouch in my purse.

title: Best Earbuds I've tried
review: I've had 5 other earbuds in the under$100 category and these are hands down the best pair. The battery life is great! I typically use them while listening to audiobooks and I might need one charge in the whole day of listening. And the fit is very comfortable.

title: Poor fit
review: The eartips are too loose and fall off the earbuds with very little resistance. This makes them virtually unusable. I'm afraid that they'll come out still stuck in my ear and I'll have to dig them out.

title: Good waterproof headphones.
review:
They ARE waterproof, I wore them in the shower. My ears got water in them and I had trouble hearing, but that is hardly the fault of the headphones. I don't like headphones like this that seal a whole lot, I find them uncomfortable, but, the sound is good for the price, and I can fit the whole charging assembly into a little 3" zipper case on the go.
They connect well
My one plus 5t remembers them no problem.
They pair no problem in android
They are the color I expected

title: Great but…
review: These are really good ear buds, my only complaint is that as wired earbuds they require using my Bluetooth which then runs down my phone battery. Not cool, if I turn my Bluetooth off it disconnects my earbuds whether they are plugged into my phone or not. Why????

title: Perfect fit for my ears, Hassel if you use a charging case
review: They fit perfectly in my ear and I have tiny ears. My earbuds don't fall out now :). They are comfortable. However, I do have to take them on and off every time or they won't fit in the charging case.

title: bell style + no-tangle wires = epic fail.
review: Will not stay in ear. The untangle aspect of the cord makes them inflexible, and therefore they squirm their way out of the ear. Even just sitting at a desk, they won't stay in. I tried a lot of retrofits,including wrapping them over the ear, all to no avail. Finally threw them in the trash. If they would make these earphones with in-the-ear buds, they'd have a real winner.

title: Love it!
review: My new favorite thing to listen to music with. I can listen to music or watch videos while not bothering anyone around me. The quality of sound is great and the battery lasts for a really long time. I've only had to re-charge it once and I've used them quite a bit so far. I'm not familiar with the different brands of Bluetooth headphones and have never heard of this one but I would definitely recommend these headphones.

title: Not so good
review:
These are awesome. Super cheap and will bump. Worth it.

So now my left earbud isnt working. So not as good as i thought.

title: A great sound / value
review: Great sound for the money. Battery last for many hours at normal volume. Bass setting is good, but seal in your ears is very important. Helps to have earbuds that you know fit your ears to replace what comes with it.

title: Great to be completely wireless.
review: These earbuds are terrific for not having any connecting wires. Nothing to catch on clothing. They paired easily with my phone and to the tv. Bonus feature is the display of the charging dock, and that it could charge up my phone if needed while travelling.

title: ALMOST perfect
review:
These adidas RPT-01 Bluetooth Sport On-Ear Headphones are almost perfect.

First let me tell you why I had to take off a star. The fabric on the headphones is almost identical to their shoes, and after a while is actually irritating to the skin. On top of that, because these aren't a complete over the ear headphones and just sit on the ear just adds to this discomfort.

Other than that these are SO sharp. They look great but I have to tell you the sound quality really surprised me! I am definitely happy with these!

title: The Best I've Used
review:
I have tried many Wireless Bluetooth Earbuds, and so far these are THE BEST I have had the pleasure of trying!

First of all, they actually fit!! I was able to fit in the medium, but I sized down to the small insert and it was perfection. CRAZY noise cancellation. Like I tried to use them at work, but then I can't hear anybody talking to me, haha. Which is usually a good thing, but for work maybe not so much. So I had to use one and it was great.

The connection process was seamless on my Samsung S10. I had zero issues connecting these. I've had other earbuds where one would connect, but the other wouldn't. I have never had that problem with these. When I take out of the case it connects immediately.

The sound quality is excellent. I have it on the lowest sound setting and because of the noise cancellation, it's more than enough in most scenarios. (If you want to be able to hear your surroundings)

I would give these ten stars if I could!! Very very happy with these and have been telling all my friends about them who want an alternative to the over rated Apple Airpods.

title: Can't Sync Both
review: Unfortunately, I was unable to sync both headphones. It is the weirdest thing because one headphone is syncing and working and the other one is dead. They also just feel too large to my ears even with the smallest inserts. I don't think I have "small" ears by any means.

title: Great to Have
review: My husband works out all the time and goes through so many of these headphones. These are a great addition to his collection of gym headphones because they are affordable and provide enough sound and also noise cancellation at the noisy gym. I like that it has a microphone and it's actually a really important feature for us since I often call him at the gym.  Very happy with these headphones!

title: Works with the iPad
review: I picked out these cute My Little Pony headphones for my 4 year old and her iPad so I don't have to listen to Baby Shark anymore! I like that I don't have to worry about the sound being too loud because I'm sure if it was up to her she would be rocking out! She has sensitive skin around her  ears and hasn't complained once about the headphones bothering her at all. Very happy with these little headphones!

title: Awesome Sound Quality
review: First and foremost I must say that the sound quality on these little head phones are top notch! The sound gets nice and loud which is perfect during workouts and the bass hits nicely. They are also very comfortable and I guess the ear buds themselves have a very ergonomic design which fit inside like a glove. These also have a microphone attached so you can take calls in the middle of listening to music. I cannot say enough good things about these little headphones besides they work perfectly with the old school iPhone 7!

title: 300 Dollars Though?
review:
While I am impressed with these headphones, I cannot find anything to justify the price point.

They feel good on my ears. I usually don't wear over the ear headphones but haven't had any comfort issues. I like that there is an application where you can customize the equalizer (among other things). I'm more of a bass kinda gal so I appreciate being able to turn it up. I also like that I can control the volume and skip songs straight on the headphone so I don't have to fool with my phone.

I like the way they look but they aren't very "trendy" they are literally the same color throughout the product. I'm wondering if they are trying to appeal to an older customer base. The single color does look clean.

A big plus for me that it uses the same charger as the Samsung S10 so I know I will be able to charge them wherever I charge my phone such as my car or work desk.

Overall, a nice headphone but you can get something very similar at a fraction of the price.

title: I hear the bass!
review: I do hear the bass on these headphones. The only issue I had with them is they have to be positioned at just the right angle or they act like an earplug. Like it completely muffles the sound. Very strange and have never had that happen before with an earphone. The design is also unique and I've never seen anything like it.

title: Good gaming headphones
review: Turtle Beach is known for their gaming headphones. When I hear the name I know I'm getting a quality product. These headphones are no different. I love that these are the same quality at a lower price point. It's perfect for those who want the quality yet not the commitment especially if their children are using them. The color combination is also very nice ! Works great with the PS4.

title: I can only get one at a time to sync
review: he bass is really strong. Charging is very convenient but for some reason I can only sync one at a time.  Each time I touch them they cut off.  But for what its work the sound is great for cheap earbuds.  They dont fall out when working out or when I get sweaty.  But overall if I could get both to work the would be perfect.

title: Great headphones
review: Super fun color matches my phone perfectly.  Great sound and noise cancellation,  I charge it up for a few hours and it lasts at least 3-4 days of work out use.  I like that fact I can talk trough the headphones when the phone rings.  I do not want to pay hundreds of dollars for beats and this is a great replacement.

title: nice quality headphones
review: The battery life was awesome I charged once and listened all weekend.  The sound quality was phenomenal, I heard every beat and sound.  They are very comfortable around my ears and  were adjustable.  I love the fact that they are wireless so I can move around without being confined to a cord.  VERY Loud headphones.

title: Feeling like a kid with a volume limiter
review: I have had multiple pairs of bluetooth earbuds. While the sound is clear, the volume doesn't go very high. I have checked settings on different devices so this is not a device setting but rather the earbuds just don't have the sound output that I was hoping for. I used these while bike riding hoping to cancel out some of the traffic noise but I can barely hear the music with the volume all the way up. These ones hit the mark on staying put in my ears but clearly missed the mark when it comes to audio output. I'll keep looking for a good pair of wireless earbuds that offer this style and fit, but better audio.

title: Tips too big for charging case but kept earbuds in your ears
review: I had to use the largest size for a knockoff paid of AirPods and although they fit well and stay in my ears, they are not compatible with my charging case. Obviously this is unfortunate because I have to remove them every time I need to charge the earbuds.

title: Volume limit is great for kids, cord replaceable
review: I like that the cord can be removed from these headphones so that if the cord goes bad (and my daughter has a bad habit of destroying cords from pulling them out by the actual cord and not the plastic piece at the end), the entire headphone does not have to be replaced. I like that the volume isn't too loud and I don't have to worry about damaging little ears from listening too loud.

title: Great sound, stays put in ears
review: I really like the sound quality of these earbuds. The bass is decent. The foam ear plug type material caps work well at cancelling out outside noise. The only issue I had was trying to put on the sport portion of the earbuds, it doesn’t come attached so you don’t have to use them. I did find that they stay in my ear better with the sport portion attached.

title: Awesome outside noise cancellation bass sounds good
review: I wasn't hopeful when I bought these. I've had some pretty low quality earbuds. I like my music loud and always have an issue with distortion. These don't have the distortion and the bass sounds great! Packaging is nice and they fit into my ears well. They come with 2 extra pairs of different sized rubber ear pieces. I was surprised at the noise cancellation these offered as well! The cord looks like it's braided but is actually a pliable rubbery type. I bought them for my daughter to use for her iPad but I think I'll keep these ones for myself!

title: lightweight and comfy
review: This is my dream item !  I walk every day and until now, been using ear buds which i hate.  They never feel right plus I just hate the wires hanging.  I'm not a pro at this , actually this is my first pair of bluetooth anything and I got it working in about 10 minutes and hooked it up to my phone and Ipod and it's perfect.  I walked and sweated and it didn't bother the connection or the headphones.  IT's great sound, very clean and doesn't skip.  I don't use the phone feature because when i'm out exercising, that is my hour to myself and don't answer the phone.  very easy volume control and you can skip songs too.  They feel GREAT on my ears !  I have pierced ears and I do have a set of Beats with the wire and they squeeze my ear and squeeze my sunglasses to my head.  These are lightweight and very comfortable.  I would HIGHLY recommend them and like i said, I own the other pair of headphones and like these much much better

title: great product
review: i used these twice already, once for a hike in a park with my hubby and the other for a workout on a treadmill.  They are comfortable and wow, the sound that comes out of them is fantastic !  I couldn't hear my hubby talk, well, i heard him mumble but not making out what he said.  For the treadmill these were perfect. It drowned out the monotonous annoying treadmill sound.  They are not too tight on your head. I wear glasses and they don't press my ears against my glasses.  I had a few headphones that did that.  They are lightweight and they have cushions around the ears.  I would highly recommend these especially if you are working out on a treadmill or in a fitness center where you are not talking to anyone.  Great product.

title: nice
review:
I workout every day and I usually use a treadmill. The shelf on the treadmill is fine for holding my IPOD but I always hit the wire from the IPOD to the headphones and knock the IPOD off the treadmill. This arm band is great. It's snug fitting. The IPOD is snuggly in there and won't fall out no matter how much you move around. Every thing is still accessible but for me, the wire from the IPOD to headphones is out of the way and now I can swing my arms and use my hand weights.
the arm band adjusts from the smallest arm to the biggest. nice product.

title: The Best I've Used!
review:
Wow! I was impressed by these headphones. Not only do they have clear sound, but they are comfortable for longer listening times. They make listening to something easy even when the train in the valley is going by, or the trash trucks are at work.
I don't usually use the noise cancellation since the headphones cancel a lot of noise anyway, but turning on the noise cancellation was astonishing! It cut out so much noise that I didn't know when the AC kicked on and wondered why I suddenly felt my chair vibrate just a little. I can completely understand why there are cautions about using the noise cancellation at times because you really can't hear much!
I charged my headphones one week, and it is still fully charged a week later. Of course I don't listen all the time or for hours on end, but it's great that I don't have to charge them all the time.
One thing I really like about these, besides the comfort and noise blocking, is the fact that they are wireless. I like to be able to get up and move away from my computer and still keep listening.
I'm very glad I got these!

title: light, great sound
review:
These are such a great option, you don't shove them in your ear or cover them up. You can get great sound and still be able to hear your surroundings. That's great if you are out walking or running, no one can sneak up on you. Also, you are the only one that will be able to hear what you are listening to.
This pair of open ear headphones is very light, they wrap around your ear to have the speaker sit just outside of it. I am not a fan of the sensor control, in my opinion, it isn't as reliable as a button. This one is better than those I find on the ear buds.
They connect easily, they will reconnect if you go out of range and come back. The range is okay, maybe 30ft. The battery life is excellent!

title: great alternative
review:
I am really so happy that I have discovered open ear headphones. The sound is good and even though they don't fit into the ear, no one else but me can hear anything I'm playing. When I use them to listen to voicemails, they vibrate a little. They do not do this with music or audiobooks.

They are flexible and comfortable. I can wear them all day at work without bother.
You can play/pause and adjust sound right from the headphones. The battery life is 10-12 hrs. The range is about 50ft.

title: too heavy
review:
These are probably the least favorite bone conducting headphones I have tried. The fit is not very comfortable. Also they are heavier in the back so it pulls the speakers up higher and you can't hear them as well.
It does have controls on it and is waterproof. The battery life is pretty good as well.

title: Light with great sound, great for you ears
review:
I’ve had to stop using ear buds as often as I normally would. I listen to audio books and podcasts all the time do I’m constantly having buds in my ear and it starts to cause irritations. I then tried bone conduction ear phones and I love them as they don’t cover or go in my ears. I decided to try these air conducting ones to see if there is a difference. The sound is excellent in both but these are much lighter and much more comfortable! I’ll be able to wear them all day without issue. The battery life is excellent too.
You can play/ pause with the headphones as well as volume.

title: definite room for improvement
review: I use this type of headphone all the time. It is more comfortable and I can sleep in these as well. This particular model has controls that are confusing or don't work. The fit is adjustable but I would only wear these if I planned to use the controls on my devices.

title: must have!
review: This is one of my favorite headphone bands. It is very comfortable and looks fine for sleep or a headband. The earphones are flat so it is perfectly comfortable to wear even if you are a side sleeper. The sound is good and the battery life is amazing. I sleep 8-9 hours at least on  a weekend and I still have plenty of charge left. You can adjust volume, play and pause with the controls at the front of the band. I think you can skip tracks or rewind with them but I never use those features so I never remember how they work.

title: new and improved
review:
I cannot express enough how much I love these! I like to listed to audiobooks as much as possible and sometimes ear buds hurt after a while or they fall out. This is great to wear around the house or to exercise. It's best feature is the flat speakers. You can sleep with this and be very comfortable, even if you are a side sleeper. Perfect if you like to listen to music or relaxation stuff while you sleep. You an wear it as a head band or to cover your eyes during sleep or a nap.
The sound quality is not like that of most earbuds but it is pretty decent. The battery life while in use is at least 10 hours. It only takes an hour or so to recharge.
These newer ones have better adjustable bands and it is easy to find where to charge.

title: love these!
review:
I cannot express enough how much I love these! I like to listed to audiobooks as much as possible and sometimes ear buds hurt after a while or they fall out. This is great to wear around the house or to exercise. It's best feature is the flat speakers. You can sleep with this and be very comfortable, even if you are a side sleeper. Perfect if you like to listen to music or relaxation stuff while you sleep. You an wear it as a head band or to cover your eyes during sleep or a nap.
The sound quality is not like that of most earbuds but it is pretty decent. The battery life while in use is at least 10 hours. It only takes an hour or so to recharge

title: Not great quality
review: These JVC Bluetooth earbuds all have the same issues. The sound is pretty good but the controls kind of suck. The + and - button are both for volume and for skipping through tracks. But it is a guess as to whether you are going to get one or the other. Holding down the buttons should skip back or forward a song. Sometimes it does and sometimes it cranks the volume. My last JVC buds died after a few months. These seem to be the exact same so I have little expectations that these will last.

title: Just okay
review: I have a pair of Bluetooth headphones of similar design but the main button for power/play/answer calls is on the side and much bigger than on this. I didn’t realize the convenience until I tried this pair. It has three small buttons that are difficult to navigate. Plus, when I paused music, the button doesn’t work to have it play again so I can only start it again from my iPhone. The sound quality is okay, not great for phone use.  They do fit really well and don’t fall off my ears.

title: Meh
review:
Not that impressed with these. They are fine for listening to music though the buttons for sound adjustment take some getting used to. Especially as you can’t see them when you are wearing the earbuds. If you don’t squeeze hard enough it just changes songs instead of increasing or decreasing sound. I like that they have different size buds to get the right fit but I had some issues keeping them in regardless.
As for using the phone, you can’t use the remote and it doesn’t connect well, sounds terrible.

title: These actually fit pretty tight around my ears
review: Sometimes I forget that I've been wearing noise cancelling headphones all day and start yelling at my husband when I think I'm speaking at a normal volume. These are great, but the do feel a little snug around my ears (probably to help cancel out the noise). They do not cancel out everything - I can still hear birds outside my window but they definitely do the trick for use on conference calls. They seem to do a great job at cancelling out noises in my room from going over the mic into my calls.

title: Great for small ears!
review: These are great headphones! I have very small ears for an adult so it's difficult for me to find wireless headphones that truly fit and these ones absolutely do. There is also a slight little curve to them, so they have a better chance of not just popping out of my ears (at least that's what I tell myself). The sound is good quality and I like the little charging case too. It's a little difficult to get the earbuds out of the charger if you don't put them in just right, but I've figured out a good angle and can get them out every time with no issues. This is the second wireless headphones I've purchased that were Rowkin, and by far these are my favorite pair.

title: Short cords, but otherwise works well!
review: For speakers that cost less than $10 and arrived at my house within 2 days, I can't really complain too much! The cords that plug into the computer (USB for power, and regular headphone size jack) were pretty short and almost don't reach the desk table to the floor where my computer currently sits. I was able to make it work, so that's all that really matters!

title: Good for the smaller ear
review: I want two main things from my earphones.  I want them to have good sound quality and to be comfortable in my ears.  An important corollary is that they sit well in my ears even when I sweat at the gym.  As other reviewers have noted, these are on the small side, which is fantastic for those of us with small ears (I have small ears).  They may not be as good for those with a larger ear, I can only speak to how they worked for me.  Other earphones become uncomfortable in my ears, and these were not so bad.  The sound quality was also decent.  Not amazing, but certainly decent.  For the current price point (ca. $20), I'd say they're a good deal.

title: Great for music, noise cancelling not as good
review:
These headphones are generally good, but some of their features are better than others. I'll start with the good. For listening to music, these headphones are excellent. The sound quality is fantastic. I listen to classical music while I work, and for that these headphones have been fantastic. I can hear all sorts of nuance, and beautiful, clear sound. These headphones are comfortable to wear, and sit steadily on the ear without pinching or slipping.

The noise cancelling feature is another story. When in noise-cancel mode everything sounds odd in these headphones- almost like the sound is dislocated. It's hard to describe, and not particularly pleasant. I was very interested in the noise-cancel feature, and disappointed that it created such odd sound quality.

These headphones are competitors to Bose, and similar. I'd recommend trying them if you've had problems finding a comfortable fit in other higher-end headphones, but not if you want them mostly for noise-cancelling.

title: They really work
review: These are great sport headphones.  They are lightweight, and they offer good sound quality.  Most importantly, though, they stay on, even when I'm sweaty, even when running.  They fit snugly in the ear, with a customizable loop around the back of the ear, for tight fit.  These are the first headphones I've owned that don't fall out of my ears when I get sweaty.  I'm delighted with them.

title: Great quality especially for the price
review: I bought these for my son's 15th birthday....he loves them! Great quality especially for the price. He likes them better than the Dr Dre BEATS headphones. More importantly, if he happens to leave them or they get stolen on the bus or locker room (sports), I won't be too bent out of shape and would gladly replace them for the price.

title: Really nice budget bluetooth sound
review: These headphones are great for the price. I love the sound in them, though it might seem quiet to some who like louder headphones. The bluetooth quality is great, and battery life is very good. You can't beat these for the price!

title: Broke in less than a month
review:
This review is for the Jabra Elite 5 True Wireless in-Ear Bluetooth Earbuds.

I’ve used the earbuds for less than a month and the left earbud has broken. I’ve gone through every troubleshooting and support step on Jabra’s website and in the app, but no matter what I do, the left earbud will not turn on. It’s a tiny useless brick.

I’ve connected the earbuds to different devices, forgotten them, reconnected. The firmware is up to date. The case is fully charged. The contacts inside the case and on the earbuds are clean.

I’ve tried to reset the earbuds to factory settings, but the reset process won’t complete because you need to reset both at once. So I can only conclude the left earbud is bricked.

The right earbud still works, and while I can use it in single earbud mode, the earbuds should work longer than a month. I also wish the case had a reset button instead of having to rely on the earbuds.

title: Short battery life
review:
The KONNEK STEIN True Wireless Earbuds are a decent set of wireless earbuds. The sound quality is good, I’ve been using them with music and streaming shows, and I haven’t been disappointed with the sound quality.

I’m not as pleased with the short battery life, touch controls, and lack of audio cues.

I get about 2-3 hours of playback per charge. It’s rare for me to battery drain earbuds, but with this pair, I hear the low battery chime every time I use them.

The touch controls and lack of audio cues go together. The touch controls are super easy to activate on accident. More than once I’ve taken the earbuds out only to find I hit Play while doing so, and they kept playing music. I also activate random controls when adjusting the earbuds in my ears … and I don’t always know what I’ve done. Did I turn ANC on or off? The audio cues are just beeps, not an announcement like “ANC on/ANC off.”

I like the design of the case. It has a sliding top, so you can actually clean the entire area where the earbuds sit. When you put the earbuds inside the case, a light flashes to show their battery level. The case charges wirelessly or via USB-C. There’s only one LED light on the outside of the case, it’s easy to miss when you’re trying to see if the case is charging or not.

title: ANC doesn't work very well
review:
The RioBuds Wireless Earbuds are just okay.

The Active Noise Cancelling doesn’t work very well. I have music playing in the earbuds, the television is on in the next room, and I can hear every word of the show. The television isn’t blaring, it’s at a normal volume. ANC is one of the most important features for me with any headphones I use. Too much background noise bothers me, so it’s disappointing the ANC doesn’t actually work with this set.

The sound quality isn’t great, isn’t horrible. Music doesn’t sound like it’s playing through a tin can, but it doesn’t hit all the tones I hear with better pairs of headphones.

I don’t like the touch controls on the earbuds. I’m always bumping them when I try to put the earbuds in or adjust how they sit in my ears.

On the plus side, you can use one or both earbuds. The earbuds charge wirelessly in their case, and I like that the case has 4 LED indicators to show battery life. The LEDs also show if the earbuds are being charged inside the case, which is a feature I haven’t seen before.

title: Works on other earbuds, not just AirPods
review:
The Link Dream Cleaner Kit is not exclusive to AirPods. It works with other earbuds, I have several different pairs and just used the cleaning pen to clean all of them. I have earbuds from Anker, Monster, and Bloody.

I like the design of the cleaning pen. The long handle is easy to hold, and then you push out whichever end you need to use. The sliding mechanism locks at either end, so the end doesn’t recess while using the pen.

The metal nib end has a small plastic protective cap, I was able to put the cap back on after using the pen.

This cleaning pen just works!

title: Doesn't slip on wood or desk mat
review:
The Link Dream Headphone Stand is a nicely designed headphone stand. The base is heavy and solid, and the entire bottom is non-slip. The stand does not slip on wood or a desk mat.

The RGB lighting and USB charging ports are powered by the included USB-C to USB-A cable. The back of the stand has 2 USB-C ports and 1 USB-A port, they are helpfully labeled so you know which to use for powering the stand.

The stand has about 9 inches of usable height, which is enough for my Razer Kraken Kitty headset.

There are a few options for the lighting color: a few solid colors, flashing, and a flowing rainbow. The stand remembers the last selected option; if you set it to blue and turned it off, when you turn it back on, the light will be blue. However, the pictures show that when the rainbow option is picked, the rod will also light up rainbow. When I tried it, the rod did not light up rainbow. It flowed between the colors of the rainbow, but the whole rod was a solid color, like blue flowing into teal flowing into green, etc.

title: Helpful for cord organization
review:
I have the pack of 50 clips from DUOOLN, the value is good if you have a lot of cords to organize. The width of a clip can accommodate two thin or braided cables, think phone charging or headphone cable thickness. Thicker cables, like HDMI or power cables, are one cable per clip.

I also use the clips to hold LED light strips in place on the underside of my desk. The adhesive on the strips isn’t always strong enough for that, so these clips are helpful there.

The clips generally stay where you stick them, but they are best for cords that you don’t use or move all the time. I tried using one for my phone charger, and because I was taking the cord in and out of the clip every day, that one did come unstuck.

title: Better quality than expected
review:
I think the sound quality on the bopmen S40 Active Noise Cancelling Bluetooth Headphones is pretty good. I’m not an audiophile, but my ears know what they like. These headphones provide smooth playback; they don’t sound tinny or like I’m listening from far away.

The Active Noise Cancelling is about as good as noise cancelling I have on Sony headphones. I live with my mom and she watches videos that drive me crazy. So the bopmen headphones have saved my sanity for the last month. The ANC mutes enough of the loud background noise of her videos that I can get some work done.

The headphones are made from plastic and feel solid. They fold up for travel; I don’t feel like they’re going to break in my bag. The box includes a pouch for storage/travel.

The ear cups are a bit smaller than I would expect for over ear headphones. The earmuffs are some sort of leatherette material that is soft, with pretty good cushioning. If I wear the headphones for more than 2 to 3 hours at a time, I do start to get a headache from the squeeze and fit.

title: Leather Centric 15 Inch Buffalo Leather Laptop Messenger Bag
review:
This Leather Centric Buffalo Leather Laptop Messenger Bag certainly looks cool, and gives off an Indiana Jones/adventurer vibe. This is the sort of look I prefer for my accessories, so I was excited to try the bag out.

Unfortunately, functionality wise, the bag is just okay. Maybe a little below average.

It’s weighty and bulky even when empty. Add a 2.38lb MacBook Air, a Moleskine journal, and a pair of over-hear headphones, and it’s like carrying a sack of bricks.

The shoulder strap isn’t made of leather and looks cheap. I was constantly fussing with it, trying to get the small padded portion to stay on my shoulder. When using the strap, I felt like it was always shifting behind me, and it didn’t lay comfortably against my body.

The bag doesn’t provide a lot of protection for a laptop, just a barely padded compartment.

The bag is also stiff. If I had a laptop and over-ear headphones in it at the same time, I couldn’t get the flap to buckle, even after adjusting the straps. The bag doesn’t handle bulk very well.

Unfortunately, I’ll have to go back to using a regular backpack instead of this much cooler looking leather messenger bag.

title: ViewSonic Monitor
review:
I’ve been using this ViewSonic monitor for about a month, with both my laptop and Switch. It seems like a great value. It’s not for a high end gamer, but for most of us, it’s probably pretty good.

Performance/viewing is as expected in using this as a second monitor for my laptop. I’ve honestly been using it more with my Switch, since the picture looks great. I can’t always use the TV to play in docked mode, so being able to put this monitor to double use is great for me. I especially like that it has speakers, since you can’t connect Bluetooth headphones to the Switch without an extra item. Games look crisp, with quick response time. I used Paladins as a test, and honestly prefer playing it more on this monitor than my TV screen.

Navigating the menus takes some doing, as it’s all done via buttons on the backside of the monitor. It’s clunky, no lie. The built-in setting options are so-so; to my eyes, the default setting was the most vibrant.

The monitor stand also takes up a lot of desk space, with that big circle base at the bottom. I’d prefer something sleeker, with a smaller profile. The red trim is really a matter of personal preference, I’m indifferent to it.

I do like that ViewSonic included an HDMI cable, since not all monitors come with one.

title: Active Noise Cancelling Headphones
review:
I’m not a sound snob, so I can’t speak to the sound quality of these headphones. To me, they sound just fine. I use them almost every night, either paired with my laptop or phone.

The active noise cancelling feature is my favorite. I’ve tried similar features on other headphones and sometimes I get nauseated after having the noise cancelling on for too long. I don’t have that problem with these headphones. The active noise cancelling doesn’t block out all sound, but it does a decent job.

The ear cups are round and nicely padded. The headphones aren’t too tight on my head, either. If you have a larger head, this pair of headphones might not be too comfortable, as the ear cups are on the small side.

title: BoseSoundTrue around-ear headphones II
review:
When I shop for headphones, I shop primarily for comfort. I’m not a sound snob -- I just need headphones that are super comfortable.

I’ve had a few pairs of over-ear/around-ear headphones. If I wear them too long, they give me a headache, either because they are too heavy after a while or squeeze too much or both. My last was a pair of Skullcandy’s, Hesh style, and I couldn’t wear them for more than 2-3 hours. These Bose SoundTrue’s feel a little lighter, and the ear cups are oval, not round, which makes them fit me better. They also don’t feel as tight on my head as the Skullcandy’s, but I don’t feel like they’re going to fall off.

Soundwise, I think they’re fine. But as I said, I’m not a sound snob, so as long as music sounds good and not like it’s played through a tin can, I’m happy.

Convenience wise, the ear cups swivel so the headphones fit in the included flat case. They don’t fold up a lot, but the case will be handy for when I want to take the headphones out with me. The cord is detachable, and has a remote for music/phone call control. I received the Apple version to review, so only the play/pause worked on my phone, but the other functions worked on my Macbook Air.

title: Decent sound
review: Decent sound and easy to adjust to fit better. Used to watch movies but not have the sound up loud enough to annoy the neighbors. More comfortable than headphones or earbuds. No complaints other than lack of basic controls unless I use my phone.
