As for the sound quality, there are better ones out there, but they cost much more. For the price, these are good--better than others I have gotten, that's for sure! As it says on the description, it is optimized for workout music, so it does best with pop, hip hop, and house music, but it's fine with other stuff, too.

Other features: it has a very nice hard plastic carrying case and a little clip on the wire to secure it to clothing and avoid movement

Great product!

title: Awesome design, perfect size
review: Love at first sight! This carrying case fits an iPad beautifully, regardless of casings or skins, and has a neat divider inside to secure it and protect it from other contents in the bag. On the other side of the lightly padded and reinforced divider are two mesh pockets for accessories (wires, headphones, etc), as well as a pen or stylus holder, and just enough room for a few magazines or a smallish book (about the size of two more iPads in thickness and maybe an inch or so bigger in other respects, max). The exterior is a moulded synthetic that makes it a semi-hard shell, and there are two loops for holding in hand like a briefcase, or an optional strap for over-the-shoulder usage. Great product, fair price.

title: Great Headphones
review: I do not have a great point of reference because this is my first set of headphones of this type, but I am a big fan!  The set up was super easy.  The headphones themselves are really comfortable for me which is important because I have small ears.  The sound quality is great and the microphone works well.  I am not a tech person by any stretch and it was easy for me to integrate with my computer and phone.  Great product - I am a convert!

title: Good Headphones, Retro Detail Weird
review: These are very good headphones. The sound quality is good and they are comfortable. I love that they are wireless. My only gripe is the "retro" look. The metal protrudes past the bottom of the headphone. This is not such a big problem for adults, but it makes for a weird fit when we use them for my toddler daughter.

title: Super comfy headphones
review: I got these for working around the house, wearing around work and going for walks. The cups are super squishy and comfy, they sit outside my ears which is ideal to not put pressure on my piercings. I mostly control them with my phone, but the buttons are easy enough to figure out. Even without using the noise cancelling button I can barely hear people though they still try to talk to me. The headphones are a little uncomfortable if you put them around your neck, but that's not what they're meant for. There is a HUGE nonremovale L and R on the corresponding ear cups which is odd but not terrible, you will always know what side goes where. After nearly 3 months of about 5 days weekly use the fabric is pulling up from the cup part, but it should be glueable.

title: Easy to use headphones
review: I got these to use on walks, while cleaning the house, walking into and around work. The headphones fit VERY tight, I have a pretty small head and they press in rather hard which becomes uncomfortable after a while. They also sit on top of your ears and if you have earrings they will press on those too and also hurt and irritate those. The controls are easy to use and they charge quickly at least.

title: Good headphones
review: These headphones are nice for kids, especially younger ones that have a hard time keeping ear buds in. These rest nicely on their head, and have some padding around the ears increasing comfort. I even use them myself at times. They are easy to use/ adjust and have a good sound. Overall good product and no issues so far. I will update if I have anything else to add, or if I experience any issues.

title: Comfortable
review: I like that this is a 2 pair of earbuds. I have one near my bed and one in my travel bag. They come in a nice case and are comfortable to wear. You have to put them in the right ears or they dont fit right. I like that they have the little remote on the wire which is easier to access to adjust the volume. The sound quality is good. overall good product and experience. I will update if I have anything else to add or if I experience any issues.

title: Great for the price (currently only $14)
review:
This is an overall good set of earbuds for the price! The sound quality is good, music could be controlled by the little remote on the wire, comes with several different ear bud attachments for your liking, and they seem like an overall good quality set. Based on my experience so far I would recommend, and I also would order again.
* will update if I have any issues or have anything else to add!

title: Good features and overall great headphones for kids
review:
My 6 year old love these. Her favorite part about them is the design lol (they are pink and glittery). They also sound pretty good as well. She uses them on an amazon fire and they work out great!

They fit her well but they could also be adjusted to be larger, so hopefully she will have them for a while. They could be adjusted enough to fit an adult. I tested these out and listened to music on them and they sounded good!

These also have several good features like that the chord is nylon to keep it from ripping and getting tangled, it has cushioned ear pads which also fold for better portability, and the input is at an angle.

Seem pretty sturdy too, but only had them for a short time so I gave them a 4 star review for now, until I see long term how they hold up! Overall great headphones for kids!

title: Works as expected
review:
I was able to use these to enable my headphones to work with my audio interface for recording and they worked well. The sounds quality was good, and they are easy to use and plug in.

Please let me know if you have any questions about my review, or if you have found it of any help to you.

title: 5 stars
review: First let me say how much my daughter talks, and we are loud people. With these ear phones on, at a normal level, I couldn't hear her over the music that was playing. These are quiet possibly, the most comfortable earphone that i have ever worn or tried on. They have a pillow on top of the arch as well. They were easy to adjust and seem very sturdy. The look is beautiful. I would recommend these over the other top name ear phones. Now that I have both and can compare... I am a BOSE fan for sure!

title: 4 stars
review:
I like this headphones but sometimes getting them to connect isn't always the easiest. They have a great power saving option, when you remove them from your head, the music will pause, which is nice. I mostly use them when I am cutting grass outside. The sound quality is good and and they will get pretty loud.

My only real complaint is that they don't really cut out the noise all together. If you lean a certain way while wearing them (as weird as that sounds) then they don't cancel the noises at all.

title: 5 stars
review: I really like this earphones. The sound quality is nice for the price. I use these when I use the smule karaoke app. They fit comfortably in my ears.  I like that it comes with different size ear pieces so that you can find the perfect one for you. I would recommend these.

title: 5 star
review: This little device is easy to use and so neat. We are an iphone family and still have alot of earphones that do not blue tooth. Which almost renders them useless in this day and age. Not anymore though. All you have to do is plug them into this device and then connect this device to your phone. Just like that. The sounds quality is pretty good but not amazing. It will do when you are needing earphone but only have a jack.

title: 5 stars
review: My daughter was THRILLED when she got these headphones in. I was surprised at how well they were made. They are really durable and they have a pretty good sound. She really loves that they are fuzzy on the ears, it was right up her little alley (she's a big girly girl). I would absolutely recommend these to any frozen fan!

title: great sound
review:
These headphones are amazing. I would compare them to the same quality as a BOSE headphone and better than beats. When I tell you they have amazing noise cancelling features... that would even be an understatement. You can hear NOTHING around you when you are wearing these headphones. The sound quality is great too.

They were easy to pair to my computer as well as my phone. I absolutely love them!

title: great until they were not
review: I was all set to give these ear phones a 5 star review. The battery life is great and the sound quality is even better. They were very comfortable to wear too! pretty much everything you need from a basic pair of headphones... until they broke after using them twice. The padding on one of the ears broke and will not go back on and it snapped at the leg. So its safe to say that the quality of the headphones are not great. They should last much longer than a few wears.

title: I love headphones with a cord
review: I guess I am still old school because I like a headphone that has a direct hookup to the source. I just think that it sounds better. I hated that iphone got rid of the audio jack on their phones. But this is an ok alternative… its just harder to find. I love these headphones. The sound quality is good and loud but without feeling like it is damaging my ear drum. They plug into the charging port for easy access. The only problem (which is apple’s fault not the headphones) is that you can’t charge your phone while you have headphones plugged in.

title: Not happy with these
review:
First I will say that when I ordered these there was absolutely no information given about them. I thought that I was ordering bluetooth wireless headphones. These are not bluetooth. I did deduct for that considering that the information was not given at the time to let you know that.

There are only two positives in my opinion about these. 1) the charging cradle. Its nice and its better than just having to leave your headphone laying around on the floor or table to charge them. 2) the padding in the earphones are very comfortable. But that is about it.

After I finally figured out how to set them up (the instructions are lacking and leave alot to the imagination) the audio isn't good..

long story short... I would NOT ever recommend these to anyone.

title: Good option for spoken word audio.
review: Got these to replace some in-ears for the gym. They were easy to connect, comfortable to wear and battery life seems good. However the music sound quality is a down grade over in-ears. If you listen to podcasts these would be a good choice but if you want good sound quality for music, these (and probably a lot of bone conduction headphones) probably aren't the best choice. Nice product overall.

title: Great bass and staying power
review:
These have great noise response and staying power on your ears. I use them for working out and rather than worrying about them slipping off mid-lift, I can focus on what I'm doing and not get hurt.

I was rather surprised by the weight as well, they feel sturdy but not too heavy on the ears. You can also use them for swimming as they are true 'waterproof' buds - but I would not go more than a meter or two under water as pressure tends to do weird things even with the most waterproof of earbuds.

title: Perfect!
review: My daughter's school requires the children to have over-ear, non-bluetooth headphones and these have fit the bill perfectly!  She says they are very comfortable and they don't get too loud.  They are labeled as toddler headphones but my 10 year old is using them happily!  Great product!

title: Very good mic and sound
review:
I had not heard of the Yealink brand before, but I needed to demo some of these for work.

I utilize microsoft Teams most of the day and was interested in a teams certified device.

These Yealink devices are really just fantastic. I have dogs and kids in my house, and live on a busy street.

When I am using these headphones no one can hear anything going on in the background but they all say I sound like a RADIO DJ because the voice quality is so clear and in their ear. Excellent.

If you do any kind of Teams usage all day, these are your best bet. The teams button automatically launches meetings, and the USB controls let you mute and pickup/hang up callers.

title: Fantastic!
review:
This is a great BUDGET projector that works phenomenally well!

I plug our roku stick directly into the projector, which also has a 5V out port to power the stick.

I then plug the headphone cable directly into the input on my receiver, and we project it on the wall.

The only problems I have is the refresh rate is slightly sub-par, with a little bit of blurring (not noticeable after a moment).

The blurring at the edges is difficult as well, but all in all it's great for a quick "Family movie night" setup.

title: Wow! Very high end!
review:
You’d be surprised at how much difference there is between lightning cables for Apple devices.. but here we are.

At first glance I was pleasantly surprised that this cable shipped with a protective carrying case of its own. Candidly, this will not get used to carry this cable but probably some headphones and tips, but it’s a nice gesture from amazon.

I plugged the cable in next to my night stand and was immediately impressed by the full metal construction of the cable shielding. It seems like a more durable and robust cable than most I’ve encountered!

The sheathing around the length of the cable is a heavy duty fabric wrap that does not disappoint.

I think you will enjoy this cable as much as I am, as it is durable enough to meet all necessary needs I can come up with.

title: Works great!
review:
It's your typical extension cable. The bonus about this one is that it supports microphone as well as audio feeds.

I used this to extend my apple headphones to my PC and make it easier to talk on ZOOM and other types of conferences without constantly fighting with my headphone cable length.

The wrapped cable is durable and attractive, if that's important to you.

Mine came missing a black ring on the third divider, but it hasn't impacted performance.

title: Beautiful sound theatre, excellent warmth and comfort
review:
I'm a big headphone enthusiast and I was excited to review these. In the last month I've reviewed a pair of Jabra open air headphones and they blew me away. So I Was excited to do a base comparison of both sets.

First up.. comfort. Right out of the box these exude comfort. There is a THICK 1" pad that cups over my ears and sits snugly on my head. The headband is made of covered metal that ensures a nice reliable tight fit without being intrusive.

Second.. sound quality. There is a rich and well mixed sound stage for these headphones. Trebles and Bass both are well represented and the mids don't get lost in the mix.

Bass boost.. The bass boost feature is substantial and when it is on it feels like a subwoofer is on your head. Pick any 'bass heavy' track and you can actually feel your ear lobes vibrating from the bass response. excellent.

Charging time.. I have noticed that the claimed charging time is a little off. I leave these to charge overnight and after a day of listening the voice prompt tells me they are "medium" in charge. Well.. that's not 50 hours. I haven't done a full test to see just how many hours I Get out of it, so it may just be a quirk of the voice prompt detection.

Pairing is easy and it pairs well to multiple devices.. so far I have had no issues or interference under those circumstances and an 'all day wear' is easy with the comfortable pads.

All in all these are great!

title: Love
review: I still prefer corded headphones. I know with technology being what it is, wireless headphones are all the rage - usually wearing headphones 9 hrs a day though, that angry "battery low" warning always made me jump...not to mention when other issues or interferences would make the sound crankle. These headphones work great without a crackle, have a long enough cord to keep my phone settled comfortably on my desk, and have a volume control on them to easily turn down or up the sound / calls. Very pleased!

title: Great but I miss the noise cancelling
review: If you plan to use these for straight headphones, awesome. Honestly, they fit nicely without pulling or pinching, they are a fun metallic color (mine are a shiny burnt copper), and they have a nice long battery. Drawback, mine did not have the noise cancelling feature, and having been spoilt with other headphones in the past that DID, I miss it in these. Other small drawback is that these do not fold up and travel well. Nowhere in the description does it say they should, but having caught a few other reviewer's comments I thought I should point it out - and not attack Panasonic for it. They work great in an office/cubicle setting, as long as you dont work in the middle of a construction zone, and although I have not tried to connect them to anything besides a laptop or phone, I'm sure they would work well for watching TV after your familys passed out for thr night too.

title: Disappointed
review:
These jumped out at me because of the case design so I was really looking forward to trying them. Unfortunately, the case is where the excitement ended. Pairing is simple, just pull them out of the case. You can use these together or just one at a time. These are really small but they actually stayed in my ears and that’s also while I slept. They are also pretty comfortable. The battery life is awful. They had a straight playtime at 3 hours and 20 minutes. I need the battery to last at least 9 hours and that’s really not difficult to do. I have a few earbuds that last 3 times that and at half the price. Next would be the sound quality and that was also an epic fail. If the volume would have gone past the highest aloud the bass would have been a bit better. If you need to make or receive any calls, these will definitely not work. Every time I tried to use the phone features, the call would drop right after the hellos. The distance between these and my phone were was the only thing I found to be exceptional. What a shame. Clearly the manufacturer put everything they had into the case design so that consumers, like myself, would run out and buy them, only to be disappointed.

*If my review of this item has been helpful, please hit the helpful button to let Amazon know.

title: Great Everything!
review: I think I have finally found an above average headset. The sound quality is pretty great but what I love the most is how long a full charge lasts. I clocked it at 25 hours of straight music. Yep, even when I slept. I  can’t sleep without music but my husband needs silence. I usual put in my earbuds but those were constantly falling out and getting lost. I didn’t think I could sleep with big headphones on and have tried a few times with no luck. I can not believe how comfortable these are. I couldn’t even tell I had them on. This was so simple to pair and I have these paired to six separate devices and they work great. The functions are easy to use and the noise canceling is 100% effective. I love these and they are my number one choice in my Bluetooth devices.

title: 14 Hours Of Music
review: I like these flexible little headphones. They fit me and they adjust to fit my three year old. I love the hot pink color. The sound quality is pretty good and a full charge lasted 14 hours and charged in 2 1/2 hours. That’s great for me. The noise canceling is decent I can still hear some outside noise but it’s not bad. This is really comfortable to wear and it doesn’t fall off my head which is kind of a big deal for me. I can’t stand when headphones don’t stay in place. This is a good set at a decent price.

title: Charge Doesn’t Last Long
review: I’m kind of a earbud collector. I’m extremely attached to my music so I’m constantly updating my buds with some to spare of course. These are mediocre. They aren’t bad but the sound quality isn’t that great. And they do not last very long. A full charge lasted under four hours and the charging case charged them twice. That’s not very good for me at all. They are comfortable but that’s pretty much it. Why on earth these only last a little over three and a half hours is beyond me. That just isn’t enough for me to even fool with them. I guess they are okay as a backup to a backup.

title: Well-Made Perfect for the Kiddos
review: These are pretty good for kid’s headset. The sound is better than some of the adult ones I have purchased in the past. I ordered these for my l’il girl. She loves watching her Peppa Pig and other little shows that she watches. Sometimes I just need a break from listening to it all. They fit her little head nice and snug and they are so soft and comfortable. They look really adorable too. She really likes this headset. And the LED lights are a nice touch. This is a well-made mid grade headset that is perfect for the kids.

title: Just So-So
review: These are perfect as backup headphones so if my wireless ear pieces stop working for some reason then I can reach in my bag a use these. The sound quality is just so-so but it might be because I'm use to my high-quality earpieces. These are fully functional and calls were given and received with no glitches or drop-offs. The cord is too short for me. I think I just don't like to be tethered to my phone. They were not very comfortable to wear either but they did have good noise reduction qualities. The price on these is pretty comparable to others like this and I do like that they are Apple certified. I have a few wireless Bluetooths though so these probably will not get much use unless I decide to give it to one of my kids.

title: Parent and Budget Friendly!
review: This was a great way to give my  l’il one a gift while giving myself one as well. I can be completely honest and say that it is nice not to have to hear all the little kid shows, games and music all the time. The best part is that they actually stay on her head so she feels comfortable wearing them. I tried these out and even though these are not Bluetooth headphones, the sound is great and they are 100% noise canceling. These are only compatible with 3.5 mm audio devices which for some is out-dated but, very useful for stereos  and late model phones. The red is a dark shade so the space invader design is hardly visible but that really isn’t important to a small child. I’m just happy to have finally found a pair that fit my l’il girl. These are definitely parent and budget friendly!

title: Still going strong
review:
My daughter goes through headphones like you wouldn't believe! So far, these ones are holding steady. She says they're quite comfortable and sound nice. They are also very nice looking.

1 star - Awful! Want my money back!
2 stars - Bad but not horrendous.
3 stars - Decent/Good
4 stars - Really good!
5 stars - Excellent! Definitely recommend!

title: These are staying mine!
review:
I have a hard time with headphones. Most don't fit me comfortably and, if I DO manage to find some that I can tolerate, my hubby or one of my kids ask to "borrow" them. And I never get them back. I've finally found comfortable earbuds and now these over-the-ear headphones. The sound quality is great and the fit is great, which means one of them are going to ask to "borrow" them. No way! Unless these are on my head, they are going to be hidden! I'm not losing these, as I've finally found ones that work great for me!

1 star - Awful! Want my money back!
2 stars - Bad but not horrendous.
3 stars - Decent/Good
4 stars - Really good!
5 stars - Excellent! Definitely recommend!

title: Best headphones ever!
review:
These are, bar none, the best headphones I've ever had! Normally, headphones tend to hurt my ears and I've, literally, never had a pair that didn't eventually make my ears sore. These don't! No matter how long I've worn them, they've stayed comfortable! And the sound quality is great! Add in the fact that you can use them together or separately, and these are just awesome! The battery life is longer than I expected, as well. These are just all around awesome headphones and well worth the price!

1 star - Awful! Want my money back!
2 stars - Bad but not horrendous.
3 stars - Decent/Good
4 stars - Really good!
5 stars - Excellent! Definitely recommend!

title: Great headphones except for one feature
review:
These are excellent headphones. Very comfortable with really good sound quality. What brings my review down from a 5 is that there's not enough information in the booklet. When using these headphones, of you take them off of one ear, they sometimes shut down. I think it's a feature that shuts then off, when not in use, to save battery life, but it's a little too sensitive and there's nothing in the booklet on that feature. Other than that annoying problem, they are great. If that problem is addressed and solved, these headphones would be a 5 star.

1 star - awful! Want my money back!
2 stars - bad but not horrendous
3 stars - decent/good
4 stars - really good!
5 stars - awesome! Definitely recommend!

title: Wonderful headphones
review: The headphones are well made, sturdy and can be folded into small compact shape that fits into any small carrier/bag. The Bluetooth connection is sure and works great, very easy to set up. There is SD card slot for external music usage. The sound is clear, the bass is strong, and listening to music is absolute pleasure. The headphones sit tight on the head and do press on my ears after wearing them for some time, but I have that with every headphones I have ever used, so it's not an issue for me. There is a charging cord but also a possibility to use longer cord to plug them into the phone. So, any way that is comfortable for you. The are aesthetically pleasing, look cool on and have a wonderful sound. What's not to love!

title: Good headphones
review: The headphones charge fast and hold the charge for about 4-5 days of 5 hours use every day and are still working. The cushion is not as thick as in some but still is soft and comfortable and does cancel some noise. The earphones have 180 degree rotation, the top part is adjustable as well. The sound is good, rich. They have built in Bluetooth and mic, answer button accepts the calls, the sound during the call is good as well.

title: Awesome headphones
review: The headphones charge fast and hold the charge for about 4-5 days of every day use and are still working. The cushion is thicker than in most, is really soft and comfortable and does cancel most of the noise. The earphones are adjustable in size. The sound is good, rich, you can hear the bass reverberating in your ears. I love them. They have built in Bluetooth and mic, answer button accepts the calls, the sound during the call is good as well.

title: Wonderful headphones
review: The headphones charge fast and hold the charge for about 4-5 days of everyday use and are still working. The cushion is not as thick as in some but still is soft and comfortable and does cancel some noise. The top part is adjustable to desired size. The sound is good, rich. They are very comfortable, do not press on the head. The bass sound is excellent.

title: These are headphones for kids
review: The headphones are for kids to use at school as per specification on the front of the box they came in. They are foldable with a decent length cord and can be put away into a velvet pouch. The sound is good. The part that gets into contact with the ears is soft and does not press to hard on the head. My girl declared them cool. Nuff said.

title: Very good headphones
review: I really like these headphones. They are adjustable and cover my ears in a way that does not press on the tips. I hate when that happens. My entire ear is inside of the headphone. The cord is sufficient length. It has three buttons on the back of the right headphone. One is for answering and ending the call. The sound quality during the call is excellent. Everything is loud and clear. The other two are for bass regulation. One increases it, the other decreases it. The sound comes out rich and vibrant. I love using them everyday.

title: Awesome deal
review: I like the angled ear pieces and the sound is clear. It's not perfect but good enough for clear conversion. I love the storage case and the overall quality. For the price this is a great headphone.

title: Does what it's supposed to do.
review: Work as described. Doesn't charge, change volume or anything. Didn't change sound quality either. Happy with product as how it is supposed to work. Perfectly camouflaged with my headphones.

title: THX Noise Cancelling Headphones
review:
I was so excited to receive these headphones and give them a go. I’ve spent right at a week with them and this is what I’ve found.

There are little to no instructions regarding these headphones and I had to research the app that has to be downloaded and go to the Razer website to begin using. Once I had everything set up, it was easy. I would have rather had a semblance of instruction than the wild packaging. The headphones were easy to pair to my phone and the sound is crystal clear. I was impressed with the noise cancelation especially. As an audiophile, I am very, very critical of sound and what is missing with these headphones is any kind of upper volume range or bass. For the price, I would have expected better in that department.

The strongest plus to these headphones is the clarity of the music. Even with the lower volume and the lack of bass, the music is sharp and clear - something I have found gets lost with other brands. The noise cancellation is also a strength above others.

Overall, I would recommend if you’re not searching for heavily bassed or volumed headphones.

title: Works well
review: My granddaughter got so excited to see these arrive. She's 11 y/o and was able to navigate the instructions herself to set up and use. If the volume is turned up, other people can still slightly hear the noise from the headset. But the sound quality, according to her, is good. She is very happy that she is able to listen to music and keep it to herself, and still hear what's going on around her.

title: Seriously comfortable!
review: The sound clarity is stunning. Our first pair of immersion headphones, so it was quite an eye opener to be able to feel the vibrations! These headphones arrived perfectly packaged for shipping and has a very protective case. Very much compatible with our iPhones and iPads, these are my husbands new favorites for the ultimate in surround sound experience!

title: Fit is perfect!
review: I have several pairs of wireless earbuds and truly wanted to find one that would fit great and stay put and these fit the bill. For me, the sound quality is great. I have other paid that allow me to adjust the sound but for what I need these to do, this is the  go to pair when working out or jogging. The water resistance is also another nice added feature in case I get caught in the rain or it’s a heavily humid day. Totally recommend these for gifting to people that participate in heavy physical activities. The case is larger than most but it’s okay for what I need them for.

title: Sounds great!
review: These really are quite handy and allow you to interchange the earpiece for comfort. You have to use both at once in order to have volume control, and the blue toothing is different than my other sets of earbuds. The sound is amazing though and truly enjoy the full sound. The price seems suitable for the sound quality.

title: I returned the headset because on the second day of ...
review: I returned the headset  because on the second day of use, stopped charging energy.

title: Nice Headphones
review: So cute headphones. My daughter loves it. I like the volume is not too high for kids under 12. Very well design, quality, and very comfy when use them.

title: Wonderful Headphones!
review: Awesome headphones!!! Sounds like the other person is right next to me. Bluetooth works great. I couldn't be happier.

title: 32” LED HDTV by Continu.us | CT-3270 HDTV 720p 60Hz LED,
review: Works great, the sound isn't the greatest but I use it for gaming. I use headphones so that doesn't matter much. the picture is clean and crisp.

title: Great sound
review: I got these for my mother in law who recently broke into the wonderful world of a cell phone that gets online. She loves these headphones and uses them every day during her breaks and lunchtime to listen to her audiobooks. She said they are comfortable and the sound quality is excellent and really easy to use.

title: These are Really Great Headphones
review: I love these headphones geared toward kids. My five year old loves frozen and I have bought her headphones to use before, but they were the kid-safe with low volume, and we couldn't hear anything. These are soft and comfortable and you can hear whatever you need to. You can also use them to answer calls, there is a mic. My daughter was amazed she could talk with her sisters through them. I even caught my husband using them after his headphones batteries died. So they work great.

title: The Best wireless headphones
review: These wireless headphones are so good, not only are they are comfortable but the battery lasts for a long time, at least 6 hrs non-stop. I wear these all day and I don't have any discomfort after I take them out. It is very easy to connect to my phone and big for me they stay connected even if I take them out, they are ready to go the next day. The case stays charged for 100 hrs, so you don't have to worry about not having a charger around. I charge mine case at night and I have never run out of battery. They are more pricey than others but they are so worth it if you are looking for comfort, especially since I wear mine every day.

title: Excellent pair of wireless headphones
review: My family goes through a lot of headphone, wireless and wired and these are by far the best ones I have had. The sound quality is superb and the fit comfortable, I wear them all day.  They are charged in their case and mine last around 6 hours. The headphones are hooked up separately, it was not to hard to connect them to my phone. I am worried about losing them and the case but so far so good, I would absolutely recommend these headphones.

title: The best I have tried for the money.
review:
I think this is a great headset for the money. I can wear it comfortably for hours. The volume is good. I rarely get complaints from listeners, and when I do, a small movement of the microphone boom fixes it right up.

I own or use 5 headsets. The only headset of the 5 which I have found to be better is the expensive Plantronics I use at work. Of the 4 I have at home, 2 are the "wrap around the ear" kind. I do not find this style comfortable. I cannot wear them for more than about 30 minutes. The Panasonic version has scratchy foam fore the earpiece which makes it almost unusable (as compared to this Plantronics which has a soft, leathery feel).

The other wraparound I have is more of a hard plastic. It feels better, but it still hurts my ear after a while.

The last headset I have at home is an expensive Motorola blue-tooth earpiece for my cell phone. I find that the Motorola does not sound as good (sounds like I am in a garbage can) and is not as comfortable as this Plantronics. I think this headset is a great deal.

title: Good cheap headphones
review: If you need good, cheap headphones, especially for kids, these are a great option. The price is great and they are comfortable to wear. The sound quality isn't the best, but for the price point it's impressive. The colors make them extra fun for a classroom.

title: Perfect for school use
review: These headphones are pretty colors. They are perfect for elementary kids to take to school for iPad use. They are comfortable. The part that covers the ears are very soft and padded. The sound quality is fine for little kid use.

title: Decent headset
review: This is a decent headset with good enough sound and noise cancelling. They feel fine wearing them.

title: Great sound
review: The sound quality from these headphones is great. They cancel noise extremely well. They are comfortable to wear.

title: Good sound
review: This headset puts out a nice sound. It is comfortable to wear. The noise cancelling is pretty good. I can still hear what's going on but it's quite muffled compared to what is playing in my ear.

title: My daughter loves it
review: My daughter loves these headphones. They are cute and work great for her needs at school. She says they are comfortable to wear.

title: Great sound
review: This headset connects easily to bluetooth. The sound quality is very good. You can hear what is going on around you but it is not at all distracting. It's comfortable to wear.

title: Comfortable
review: These headphones are comfortable to wear. The sound quality is not the best, but it's good for the price point.

title: Great headphones
review: These headphones are small so they are easy to take along. They produce good sound, especially for the price. They are comfortable as well.

title: Weird, but cool
review: These headphones are kind of weird, but they are also cool. I can't handle the feeling of headphones over my ears or earbuds in my ears. These fit kind of near the top of the ears and it's amazing how something that doesn't cover or go in your ears can produce such clear sound and no one else can hear it unless they get very, very close.

title: Only one complaint
review: My only complaint about these headphones is the battery life is not great. The sound and comfort are excellent. They just need to be charged a lot.

title: Good for classrooms
review: Basic headphones. Perfect for a classroom or computer lab. Works well for spoken audio like lectures, audiobooks or YouTube. Not a great range for listening to music or movies. At less that $6 a headphone, you do get what you pay for.

title: Great headphones
review: These headphones are very comfortable. The sound is good as is the noise cancelling. The bluetooth is very nice. The battery life is amazing. The earbuds being magnetic makes them easy to put away.

title: Nice office headset
review: Nice office headset. Is able to have two active paired devices (two phones or a phone and computer). Stay on well when moving around the office. Sometimes falls of if bending over or running down the stairs. Mute/unmute by moving the mic is a great feature on conference calls.

title: Good headphones for the price
review: If you need headphones for kids, these are a great option. For the price they are good. The sound quality is slightly better than the speakers on an iPad. They fit comfortably and don't hurt or pinch ears.

title: Didn't last super long
review: These headphones are pretty nice. The sound quality is decent and the noise cancelling is good enough. The problem is they only last a few months before they quit working. For the price I would've expected them to last much longer.

title: Comfortable
review: These headphones are comfortable to wear. The sound quality is very good, particularly for the price. They fit over the ears well. They are great for kids on remote learning.

title: Great headphones for the price
review: These are really great headphones for the price. The sound quality is not as good as more expensive headphones, but of course you get what you pay for. The microphone works very well. They have been excellent for use in remote learning plugged into an iPad. These are especially good for children who might not be as gently on their headphones are older kids and adults.

title: Sounds great
review: Comfortable. Sounds great. good battery life. I can use one headphone at a time for listening to music or making calls. Only issue is no battery indicator either in iOS or the charging/storage case.

title: Totally worth the price!
review: If you are looking for higher end headphones, these are the ones for you.  The battery life is incredible.  I use it a lot and can go a week at a time before having to charge it.  The noise cancelling is the best I've ever used.  The ear muffs are very comfortable.  These are just really great headphones.

title: When they work, they are great
review: I had a problem with them turning on and not connecting and they wouldn't turn off so I'd have to wait until the battery died to use them again.  They are fairly comfortable.  When they work, they are good enough headphones, but definitely are not worth the price.

title: Comfortable and reasonably long battery life
review: These headphones are very comfortable. I’ve had no issues with wearing them for extended periods of time. The sound is pretty good. I wish it was a little more sturdy feeling though.

title: Great Price for Mid-Range Noise Cancellation Headphones
review: The voice assistant on these headphones is very poor quality.  The noise cancellation works relatively well, particularly combined with the fact that they go over the ears.  It's not as good as high end noise cancellation headphones, but that is to be expected at the price point.  Pairing was easy.  They are reasonably comfortable.  The buttons are a little bit awkward, but it's nice that it has physical buttons in the first place.  For the price, these are great headphones.

title: I wish I liked them more than I do
review: The sound quality and noise cancellation of these earbuds are amazing.  The hear through option works relatively well.  I just can't find a good fit of ear tip for my ear.  I was able to find a moderately comfortable fit, but I could not be fully active while wearing them.  They often fall out of my ears.  I really want to like them more, but I just don't.

title: My New Daily Use Headphones
review:
I have been looking at Noise Canceling headphones trying to figure out which one to get. These are just about perfect.

The Active Noise Canceling works very well. I have tested it on the Plane, long car ride, next to a room AC unit, settling down to sleep. I was able to get some sleep on my last flight thanks to this headset.

They work best when there is something playing even softly. My previous headphones could not be turned down low enough in a very quiet environment or up enough in a very noisy one. The Jabra 85h can handle that range. The microphone quality on phone calls is comparable to my old Plantations Voyager v5200. I was much happier once I realized that the headphone can be adjusted for head size.

title: Solution to a problem
review: I work from home and my phone always needs a charge whenever I need to use the headphones. This was perfectly priced and worked with my iPhone 11.  I thought these cables were more expensive, so I never bought one.

title: Broken/Do not work
review: I received 2 broken headphones. Neither work. I plug them into my phone and I hear the person on the earpiece of my phone still. How do I get a refund?

title: Smidge Too Large
review: It’s a great looking replacement ear pads but just a little bit too large so it would not fit my headphones.

title: Surprising
review: For the price these headphones are surprisingly nice. Great for a class or for listening to music or an audio book while waiting for appointments. Each pair comes in a plastic bag. They are simple to use, just plug in. They adjust and should fit most heads. They are comfortable and the sound is pretty good. Not sure how long they will last but overall a pleasant surprise.

title: Good Sound Quality
review: These are nice headphones. They look stylish and are comfortable. Sound quality is surprisingly good, both for music and calls. The noise cancelling is adequate. It does not block all or even most noise. Enough to make a difference but nothing to write hone about. Battery life is good. The talk through feature would be better if you did not have to manually reset after using. But all in all these are good headphones.

title: Smart Design
review: This is a well designed way to enjoy music comfortably while staying aware of your environment. Set up and use is easy. It is lightweight and comfortable. For most folks the sound quality is more than acceptable. Audiophiles will be less enthused. There are retractable earbuds. These are great. I am a super light sleeper. One of my household works shifts, comes home late and blares the tv. With the earbuds he can enjoy his programs without disrupting the household. The battery life is very good. I like that you can do your chores while using. Good product.

title: Decent Music, awful Calls
review: these earbuds have a decent sound quality and exceptional battery life. controls are simple once you get used to them. IMO there is no such thing as a comfortable earbud but these are as good as the better ones. Music is decent if you are exercising or walking the dog. It is a little light on the bass and audiophiles won't be impressed. (Audiophiles will probably not be using earbud to listen to music anyhow.) But where these fail is on phone calls. They pair easily enough and calls get connected. But the quality is poor. I can't hear the other party and they can barely hear me. for my purposes, dog walking and exercise, I am primarily interested in music so these are okay. But at the current price point of nearly forty dollars, I would expect better call quality. 3.5 stars.

title: Pretty in PInk
review: I love the look of these inexpensive earphones. They are really quite pretty. Set up was simple and the battery is good. I am not a fan or earbuds, really any earbuds. These are bearable, not wildly uncomfortable. They stayed in while I was being walked by the dogs. Comfort is about what I expect with earbuds. The sound was decent and so far there have been no problems.

title: When comforto is Crucial
review: Comfort is crucial when it comes to headphones and these more than meet the mark. The cushioning is superb and your ears are cradled. The phones are not too heavy. They feel solid but not in the least disruptive. set up and pairing was straightforward. The sound quality was good but you do have to fiddle with the EQ to get it to where you want.  the controls are easy to master and like that noise cancellation could be turned off. The noise cancellation was pretty good at least on a par with similar brands. The battery lasts as promised. These phones fold and come with a convenient sturdy carrying case. I use them primarily for music but call quality is more than adequate. Overall a satisfactory experience.

title: This bud for you?
review: What attracted me most to these buds was the fact they could be used wired or wirelessly. and that is what disappointed me most. Set up was easy despite the lack of included instructions. You do have to access the instructions online. sound quality is decent; not symphonic but adequate.  The noise cancellation works well when they are wireless but is non-existent when they are wired. They sound like any cheap bud when wired and I was expecting more. I am not a fan of controlling the noise cancellation and EQ via an app. I would prefer it be integrated easily with the button.s. Comfort is average. I admit to not being an earbud fan. these are pretty much on a par with others I've tried. They don't fall out and are no irritating.  Phone call quality is average. The mike does not provide noise cancellation and at most times this is not an issue. They do come with a little pouch. Other than the disappointing performance when wired, these are c certainly adequate buds with superb battery life.

title: good Sound
review: When it comes to headphones like these I look for sound quality, comfort and durability. these provide most of the above. The sound is surprisingly good, much better than other phones in this price range. I am not a fan of any earbuds and these are about average as far as comfort. They do give you options on size but buds just are not designed for comfort. That being said they are not too bad. However, the part that lies on your neck is heavier than expected. not a deal breaker but somewhat annoying. They are pretty durable and have survived drops. It takes about three hours to fully charge but the charge lasts. They pair easily and perform well. I use them mostly for my long treks with the hounds. The controls are okay once you are familiar with them through the buttons are kind of small. They are not easy to adjust if you are active. I generally set them and forget about it. Decent for what they are.

title: good fro the Price
review: I must admit at the outset I am not a big fan of earbuds. I find them uncomfortable and the quality is usually less than sterling. These are average in comfort. They feel a bit stiff but bearable. Where they distinguish them self is in sound quality. It is far better than the price point suggests. There is balance and a noticeable but not overwhelming bass. the cord is almost four feet long.  It comes with a functional storage/carrying bag. these are pretty good considering the price point. Inexpensive yes, but certainly more than adequate.

title: Lights & Sound
review: I find earbuds a necessary evil. These, however, are better than most. They look cool and the lights are a fun and useful touch. The controls are easy to master and use once you become accustomed to them. sound quality is decent. They aren't Bose but much better than most at this price point. I like that they stay secure and the neck cable is light.  But You pretty much have to carry your phone with you or stay in the immediate vicinity of it for them to work. This may not be a universal complaint. I live in a mountainous region and cell signals are notoriously unreliable. However, the cell was fully barred and I was inside but in moving from one end of the house to the end of the hall caused a loss of sound. They do not score super high marks for comfort. They are fine initially but become uncomfortable. I'ms using them to walk my dogs and am happy and relieved to take them off when we get home. But concededly I am not an earbud fan. So sound is good and comfort is average.

title: Decent System for the Price
review: This is a decent system for the price. set up was simple. I especially appreciated the longer cords/cables. The six-foot length provides versatility. The appearance is sleek. the sound quality is good. It is heavy on the bass which I don't mind and the sound is clear. I am using it at home for online seminars, videos and music. so far all the component s work well with one exception. The speakers tend to have a static hum, Initially, it was obnoxious but over time it has diminished. It doesn't interfere with the sound when you are playing something but it is noticeable when you are not playing anything. It is noticeable but not so objectionable that I would return the system. It does accommodate headphones. Not a bad choice for a budget system.

title: It's a Hoot
review: Thi sowl headband is as useful as it is adorable. The fabric is soft. The owl design is cute and the colors are vivid. The removable headphones actually provide fairly decent sound for the price. Tey are not  noise cancelling but do a decent job nonetheless. The band is versatile. It can be used as a sleep mask as wel  as in any number of activities. The headband is machine washable and stretcfhes sufficiently to fit most heads. 4.5 stars

title: Pretty Near Perfect
review: I admit a bias in favor of over the ear headphones. bias not withstanding these noise cancelling phones are pretty near perfect. The sound quality is good and the  mic is fine. I like the options for noise cancelling. They make sense and a difference. The battery life is superb and overall the performance exceeds expectations. I would have liked a little more cushioning on the ear cups and head band. Some ventilation would have been nice too. Depending on the environment your ears can get hot. Not a major problem and certainly not a deal breaker. overall I am very impressed with the quality and performance of this set. 4.5 stars

title: Better than Earbuds
review: These lightweight on ear headphones are way better than ear buds. wireless they produce decent though not exceptional sound. certainly better than buds. They are comfortable and I like wirefree. set up and operation is easy. They charge in less than three hours and the p[ower lasts for about eleven hours as promised. They perform well for headpohnes at this price point.They looks good, have decent sound and are reasonably comfortable. Can't ask for mucch more thann that.

title: Performs Adequately Though Not Impressively
review: Basic and inexpensive this earphone will do the job. I was impressed by the ease of pairing and the length of time the charge lasted. It worked with sound  and clarity being adequate.I appreciated the car charger because I tend to use it most often in my vehicle.  It is simple to operate but that simplicity does come at a price. First there is no sound control and that is something that is sorely needed. The earpiece is not adjustable and rankly I found it uncomfortable with or without the wire loop. Granted I hate ear buds and the like but can and do use them. But I was conscious of this device the full time it was in my ear. Bottom line it works adeuately lthough not impressively. I do use it in my car and it seems durable. But it is not comfortable and it really needs a volume control.

title: Decent Sounds & Comfort
review: These are decent earbuds. At the outset I admit I am not n earbud fan. I find them uncomfortable  with usually pltry sound quality. Still for long walks with the dogs nd exercising the conveninece can't be beten.. These buds come with ear hooks nd adjustable tips. The hooks re hrd but they do keep the buds in place nd eventually become unnoticeable. The tips are okay. I do like the design of the wire nd holder. It is light, stays in plce and out of the way. The controls are on the ear and fine once you become accustomed to them. Sound quality, while nothing to write home about, is good for ear buds. Similrly phone calls, while not exactly crystal clear, are acceptable. They re better t music though. These  are not noise blocking. The charge holds. Oerll good ear buds.

title: Comfortable With Disappointing Sound
review: These are essentially cheap earbuds with a feel good cause. I ad mdit, at the outset, I am not an earbud fan but use them when exercising and walking my dogs. These are fairly comfortable and come with three different sizes of ear cushions. the sound quality is okay but far from tolerable. there is virtually no bass. Better thn nothing but unimpressie een for ear buds. lthough it is en ogue to link products with corporte donations, this tactic leaes me cold. I prefer to donate to the charities of my choice, that I have vetted and feel passionately about rather than being assessed  a fee so a corporate entity can polish its reputation. If you are moved and wwant to py a surcharge for a subpar product, be my guest. So while these buds are more comfortable than most the sound quality is mediocre at best.

title: Good Battery LIfe
review: I must admit at the outset I am not a fan of earbud, any earbuds. I do't find them comfortable and the quality is not even close to a good pair of old school over the ear p hones. That being said, they are a necessary evil. I have large dogs I walk miles everyday and having some music to keep the pace is pretty much a necessityi. These phones  are pretty good. They gie yo a number of tips to customize fit adn Iwas able to get them to fit fairly comfortable. I like that they are wireless and come with the chargin case. Chargin and set up witht he app are fairly strraightforward. They do have good battery life. Skound quality is acceptable, better than many phones but more than adequate for my purposes. You can also have phone conversations. This feature works decently assumiong you are in an area with decent reception. I live in a mountinous region so for all intents and purposes this is not a feature that works reliably. That is not the fault of the phones as much as the geography. Plus when I am walking I do it for exercise and really don't want to have any phone conversations. So while these share many of the same shortcomings of osimilar ear budgs, they are wireless, have terrific battery life and provide fair to middling sound. Not bad at all.

title: The Beat Goes On
review: This is a terrific way to store and charge your ear buds. the case is a study clamshell with a lithium battery. remove the tray to charge non-beats earphones. Thebattery is rechargeable and there is a SUB port. . It is handy to keep the phones stored, safe and ready for the next run.

title: Satisfactory
review:
I consider earbud a necessary evil. I prefer over the ear phones for both comfort and quality but for many applications they just aren't practical. These fit adequately and perform well.

In the box are the headphones, a small package of three sets of silicone bud tips to accommodate different sizes, a usb cable and the usual paperwork, irritating pictorial directions, a reference guide and warranty. charing takes two hours and the charge lasts the promised eight hours. Audio is decent. speech, from phones and audio books is clear. While probably not sufficient to satisfy an audiophile,music quality is more than acceptable especially when you are walking the dog or performing other tasks. The controls are simple to use. They are very light light and reasonably comfortable. Overall, a satisfactory set.

title: Comfort, Style and Decent Sound
review: These headphones provide comfort, style and decent sound. the retro styling is terrific and the over the cups gently cushion the ears. It takes a bit of time to become accustomed to the controls on the ear cup but  they are simple to use. the sound quality is decent. An audiophile might differ but I have more expensive headphones that do't sound half as good. They are not, however, noise cancelling. easy to adjust they re light on the head and stay comfortable for an extended period of time. Pairing is simple and the charge actually lasts. I am pleased with the overall performance and style.

title: Boosts Office Productivity
review: Boost office productivity while liberating yourself from cable clutter and the inconvenience of constantly having to plug and unplug devices. this docking station is easy to set up. It has a sleek modern look and doesn't eat up too much real estate. It  will connect up to two displays and a number of peripherals including headphones and mics. I does not support copyrighted timewasters like Netflix or gaming.  (although I confess that at times I wish it did.) However what it does do it does well. I have had no problems or issues and haven't had to mess with cables and connections. it does not charge the host battery or anything else for that matter. but it can't be beat for handling office tasks. Well done.

title: Lightweights
review:
These lightweight headphones are good for when you ar on the go. although they come without a carrying case or bag, they fold and are small enough to tuck in a bag or backpack. They charge via the included USB cable. a full charge takes about 2.5 hours but there is a 15 minute quick charge option that will extend your use by 2 hours. The mic is built in and the button controls (on/off, volume, change tracks, pause for calls and resume ) are on the ear pieces. There are LED indicators for the functions and when charging.

Comfort is okay. The band adjusts for different head sizes and does not bind. The cups are padded but the whole time I had them on I was aware of them. While they did not make my ears sweat or hurt, I couldn't say they were soft or cushiony or especially comfortable. They do not block ambient sound at all. Music quality was adequate. The base is impressive but everything else is fairly pedestrian. It does work well for making and taking calls. They do feel flimsy and one of my ear cups had to be popped back in. At the current asking price of roughly sixty dollars I expect more. They are okay for running errands around town but not comfortable enough for me to wear for an extended period. I liked the portability and lack of weight. Performance was adequate.Quality was fair to middling. all things considered they are average at best with only a superior bass and easy portability to recommend them.

title: Up Your Game
review: Comfort and performance are paramount  in gaming headsets. This one is impressive and affordable. At first glance, they look like a headache in the making. but they are surprisingly lightweight and comfortable.  People game for hours, not a few minutes at a time. and uncomfortable headpiece is a deal breaker.Unlike some the headband does not feel like a vice.The ear cups are soft enough to cradle the ear while blocking out sound. The surround sound is impressive and contributes to an immersive experience. The controls are easy to use and function as expected.  The retractable mic is a pleasant surprise. To date I've experienced no crackling. these are wired headphones which are fine for those of us who game primarily on PCs. wireless are sexier, more expensive and have to be recharged.  They appear reasonably durable. If you are looking to up your game economically while enjoying ddddecent sound, this headset will not disappoint.

title: Well Done
review: What I liked best about this player is that is works with anything ( including DVDs, 3D Blu-rays , 4K Ultra HD discs, USB files, CD Audio, and more) on anything, 4K tv or not.My second favorite feature is that it can be used with Bluetooth headphones.  It packs some heft and I was surprised at how hefty it was. It is a bit larger than I expected but has a sleek appearance.the package includes an instructions, a remote control, batteries, warranty info and a registration card.  Set up was simple and hassle free. My home network can be skittish but I encountered no hiccups.  Load time was satisfactory. It varied depending on what was inserted but there were no lags. Currently there are four streaming apps: Netflix, Amazon, Opera TV and VUDU. I've only tried one, Netflix, and it worked well. Overall performance is satisfactory. the picture is great. I can't say that it was much improved but there is definitely some.  This player seems very well made and thus far has performed well. There are pricier models with more bells and whistles but this one has everything the average home user would need or want. A good product by a reliable company, it is not unduly complicated and provides superb performance without the need to rebuild your library.

title: Decent Multipurpose Headphones
review: These are a good value for headphones. they are lightweight and comfortable. the sound quality is decent. I actually like the extra long cord. It provides versatility and you can connect to just about everything, phones, tv, stereo and computers. On the down side these do not block sound. You can hear what's going on outside and people outside can hear what you are playing. They are not especially portable. They do not fold nor are they notably compact. I've only had them a short time so can't speak to long term durability. I am using them in an office so the wear and tear is minimal. For my purposes they are fine. I don't know that someone who uses them daily on an active commute or a serious audiophile would be equally satisfied. If you are in the market for an affordable multi purpose headphone, these are worthy of your consideration.

title: Ear Buddies
review: Although I much prefer over the ear headphones, there are times the portability and convenience of lightweight ear buds can't be beat. Unfortunately comfort and overall sound quality are usually issues. These inexpensive headphones address comfort concerns by including ear caps in three different sizes. The caps are made of silicone which is soft and does mold to the ear. I liked the white and gold. It made them bright and easy to find in a cluttered bag or backpack. Although the sound quality is far from philharmonic, it is more than adequate for headphones at this price point. It is crisp and clean with no overpowering bass. The inline mic works well  and contributes to the convenience factor. Overall I liked both the look and the performance of these affordable in ear headphones.

title: Performance and Comfort
review:
The best headphones are the perfect combination of superb sound and comfort. But finding that balance is easier said than done. I've had many headphones from the inexpensive to the pricey that have failed to meet the mark.

These Koss headphones have a sleek appearance and come in a convenient carrying case. The D shape conforms to the ear and the graduated cushioning is comfortable. It is snug without being too tight and there is no slippage. Although not noise cancelling, they block much exterior noise. The sound quality is superb. Music is rich and full bodied with no muddy undertones. There is no bluetooth connectivity and I wish the headphone wire was longer. But these are not deal breakers, at least for me. Overall, an excellent choice for comfort and performance.

title: Fun  Fashion Phones
review: Having burnt through yet another pair of earbuds, I opted to try these pretty, inexpensive headphones. The sound quality is remarkable for a low end set. No these are not two hundred dollar headphones, but for every day use,they are fine, decent sound quality and no noise. Adjustable, they should fit pretty much anyone. The round phones fit snugly and seem firm, but all in all, they are quite comfortable. The Gumball Sunrise pattern was bright and cheerful, sure to appeal to the younger set and a nice change from my usual black. BTW I purchased these at Office Max for ten dollars less than what is listed here.  Recommended.

title: Perfect For My Purposes
review:
I was looking for a pair of decent over ear headphones to use with a portable dvd/cd player. I travel quite a bit and did not want to spend a tremendous amount of money but still wanted good quality and some degree of portabililty. Thesse fit the bill. The sound is far superior to any ear buds I have tried and other headphones in the under fifty dollar range. The sound was good and crisp. The leather ear phones are very comfortable and superb at blocking ambient noise. I have used them with both music and meditation cds and have been satisfied. They come with a striaght plug and a jack adaptor.

My sole complaint was with the band itself. Although some might disagree, I do not have a fat head. My skull is a normal size. The band itself is just a tad too loose and feels like it is going to slip. It also seems heavy. However, this one shortcoming does not outweigh the many positives. Recommended.

title: The answer to two people in a room with one being hard of hearing.
review: I can watch TV anytime during the night while my wife is sleeping.  I turn on the TV, hit mute when it starts to come on, then push the on button on the headset and adjust the volume.  The sound is contained in the headset and no disturbance to my sleeping wife.

title: Bad Buy
review: Had these headphones for less than a month and they would not recharge.  Contacted Skull Candy and they shipped me an envelope to send them back.  They replaced them free of charge, I though how great.  Thanks Skull Candy.  Well last week the new pair that I have had for less then a year will not charge.  Don't buy if you use them often, not worth the money or the headaches.

title: Works as expected
review: The headset is secure and protected inside.  I keep the headset in my work bag and wanted a case to protect it.  Works great

title: Purchased for backup
review: Wanted an extra power cord, so I could have one at work in case i need to charge my headset.

title: Fits but flimsy
review: The green one glows in the dark. That was a feature I wasn't expecting but has been nice to have! This cover is exactly as stated.  Silicone.  However I have been using it around 2 months now and the silicone has become lax on the top.  When I try to open the case the top slips off without more than a nudge.  I'm always putting it back on.  I do not take my ear buds anywhere.  They sit in my beside table where I listen to audio books in bed while the hubby is sleeping.  I use them 3-5 times a week.  This is important because I don't put them in a pocket,  purse,  booking, or any of the places I expect most people would keep thier earbuds.  If they have that much movement I can't imagine this case to work at all.  Maybe if you put a rubber band around it? The carabiner is a requirement. It holds the case on best it can and is the perfect size to open the case enough to take your buds out and back in.  If you are reading this,  you already know that finding a case for these jbl's is impossible.  I wanted something cute and pink.  I had to settle for lime green but hey,  it flows in the dark which means I can easily find it on my bedside table in the dark!

title: Great for organizing for school
review: Case works well organizing all my school items.  Use it for phone and bluetooth headphone chargers, dry erase markers, pens, paper clips, etc.  Keeps me organized.

title: Sleek design
review:
I like that I can put the headset inside the case to charge and tuck it away in my purse or jacket pocket. I can also charge the headset with it standing in the slot ontop of the case, when the case is sitting on my desk.
Recommend purchase.

title: Good for their purpose
review: Simple and sturdy transmitters of sound that can extend the length of your headphone cord, if necessary. However, I discovered that these cords work best when they are NOT plugged into the headset all the way, but part-way. IDK why but that's my experience.

title: Good quality cable
review: A simple item that will provide length to any existing headphone set that needs a little more footage to reach your tv if you don't have or don't want wireless.  I don't so this solved my problem nicely.

title: Inconspicuous helper
review: I needed to add length to my coiled headphone cable and this provided a simple solution that lays flat on the floor.

title: Good sound quality
review: So these aren't $3K FAD earbuds, but so what?  Do I need to spend that kind of money to listen to music off my computer.  Heck, no.  These are just fine.

title: Great sound! Great buy!
review: What a beautiful sound!! You cannot go wrong with these Sennheiser headphones ... worth the price!

title: Handy gadget to have around
review:
If you have a MacBook, you need one of these things (darned Macs are limited to only USB-C ports). I needed a hardwired Ethernet connection for work and a regular USB port for my headphones. This little gadget took care of that quite easily.

I had a small concern, but I contacted customer service, and they quickly resolved my issue. I very highly recommend this product AND this particular company (there are many devices lookalikes here on Amazon).

Get UNI and get back to work. ;-)

title: The best roku on the market
review:
We should have bought this earlier. This replaced our ancient model. It may have been 10 years old. The reason we upgraded as the old model took for ever to load, everything was slow and we were missing channels and we had trouble adding channels. We put off upgrading as we figured it was our cable company.

For us this model wasn’t a plug and play on our old tv. We had to log onto to roku and request a free adaptor, which took a few days to arrive. Once we got that we could easily plug it into our tv and all our problems were solved.
The total per to this model is it can easily travel. You can unplug it and plug it into your hotel tv. What fun was that. At night when we got back to our hotel we were able to unwind just like we do at home. Grab a few drinks from our fridge and a couple of snack and we were in business.
I highly recommend this model over the other models. If you want you can use your phone as a remote and you can watch shows from your phone and use headphones as to no disturb others

title: Avantree HT5009 40 Hrs Wireless Headphones for TV Watching w/Bluetooth Transmitter
review: This headphone set is awesome!!! The headphones have theater sound quality . Has 40hrs. of listening. Easy set up. I recommend buying this set, you'll notice the difference right away from the cheaper headphones.

title: Comfortable In-ear Earphones
review: The earphones are very comfortable.  I use for my small tv in the bedroom so I had to add an extension for the cord.  Works fine.

title: Works
review: My new phone didn't come with a earphone plug in, so I bought this and it works great.  It's a little big but now if my wireless headphones are not charged, I can still listen to my movie through the "old style" headphones.

title: Super happy easy install
review: Absolutely user friendly install. Just make sure to install the provided interior padding first. Then you snap in the cushions one snap at a time . And take your time dont try and push the hard up against the headphones it will not attach . They feel like factory cushion and look 100 % authentic.

title: Battery Life is down in 2 months.
review: I have had this headset for less than a couple of months now, and right off the bat, the headset body and retractable ear buds are very flimsy feeling but do function. The sound is good, although I do not understand why anyone wouldn't ave noise canceling turned on! That is absolutely horrible when it is not on! It amplifies and echos every single sound. Other headsets don't do this naturally, so not sure why it is even an option. BUT, I have been noticing that the battery seems to run low very quickly, and I thought it was just my imagination at first. After them being on the charger through the night last night, I only have 90% charge? That is not normal for just a couple of months! Does this mean, in the next month it will go down again? And then again? I should have stuck with LG, these off brands really disappoint sometimes. We actually have another BCS brand headset that had to be replaced once, and the second one broke very soon after replacement, so we gave up. I should have known.

title: Look nice, but not comfortable.
review:
I am still trying to figure out all of the functions for these earbuds, since it is all about how you touch or tap them. I end up just using the phone to control them since they don't react very well except for start and stop of audio.

These buds look pretty sleek which is one reason I got them, and live up to the claims for sound and battery life. But they are not comfortable, and they take turns falling out of my ears when I am talking which is very annoying. And yes, I have them in the correct ears (L/R). Also, having to take them out and put them back in the case when I am not using them is inconvenient.

I am going to return them and purchase my usual bluetooth headset, because at least I know they won't fall off and get lost. I paid WAY too much money for these to keep taking that risk, and to also be uncomfortable.

title: Why did I purchase this?! Don't waste your money...
review: What is the point of this 2-year insurance, when you can't even use it until the manufacturer warranty expires first!? I couldnt use it because the 1 year warranty hasn't expired on a junk headset we purchased. But we cant even get that headset fixed by the company because we have to literally call China to fix it, they have no online reporting for warranties. So, now we have wait a year in order to get Asurion to fix the darn thing! Not happy with this!

title: These are so awesome - I even bought the case to store them safely
review:
When I first started listening to music through these headphones I thought it sounded muffled. Then I decided to really give them an honest workout before returning them.

I am converted! The sound is not muffled, I just needed to pay more attention. There’s nothing wrong with them, I was just use to another product.

To parrot everyone else out there they are incredibly lightweight, amazingly comfortable, and totally user friendly working with my Iphone 6. I can keep them on for 2-3 hours and I’m so relaxed that I’ve nodded off to sleep lulled by my music.

I do not require total noise cancellation and actually prefer to hear some of the world out there. I can always crank up the volume if need be.

These are without question one of the best products I’ve come across in a long time. I was able to grab them at a special value price and am so glad that I scan those daily Amazon deals from time to time.

These headphones are so great - I sprang for the seperate purchase hard case from Avantree to protect them.

Please consider these headphones. I think you’ll be really happy with them.

title: Light weight, but not light in sound.
review:
After owning several pairs of headphones, I can say that this is one of the lightest, clearest and best price options out there.

What really impressed me was the fact that they stayed on my head and didn't slide off after a little while. Not only that, but they didn't make me constantly aware that I was wearing them. They are comfortable and blend in seamlessly with my style. I can walk around, do yardwork or whatever and never have to adjust them,. They stay put.

The sound is well-balanced but if you want stronger bass, this might not be your best option. I've never owned a pair of Beats so I wouldn't want to make a comparison. Everyone has their own preference in sound quatity so it's hard to determine what will work for you.

It's amazing how far headphone have come since the 70's. But with so many choices out there, I think this is an excellent place to start, and maybe finish.

title: They Work
review:
Look, I'm no expert on earbuds and all of the technical mumbo jumbo that people like to throw out there. I just know what I like and what works for me.

These work great with my Iphone 4 and the music sounds fine. I listen to a lot of film scores that have heavy orchestration and I have no complaints about the quality. Everything is lush and full with a nice balance.

They fit comfortably in my ears and include the added option of a discreet microphone that I have used for phone calls when I am driving. That was a nice little bonus, and at a very reasonable price.

title: At Last.......
review:
After owning 4 different pairs of earbuds (and test-driving a whole bunch more) since Christmas, these are absolutely without question the best product out there. They fit perfectly the first time I put them on, but without that feeling that you have added insulation to your ears. Other manufacturers misconstrue this as "noise reduction" when in fact everthing sounds muffled like you attached cotton balls to the earbuds.

I have been using these earbuds for over 2 hours non-stop - skipping between movies, t.v. shows, audiobooks and, of course, music. The sound is clear but not tinny. Everything sounds rich and warm without being overwhelming. They are extremely comfortable and blow away the original ones that came with my unit. For a while I began to think my ears were deformed because the original earbuds kept falling out (my husband said my ears were missing a piece). Now I know better.

The price is a little steep I agree. However, if you're gonna invest $249.00 or however much in an Ipod and heaven knows how much more in downloads, than it would only stand to reason that you would want the best sound possible. Otherwise, why bother owning one in the first place?
