These are simply terrific and I hope everyone out there who has ears as apparently deformed as mine will go and buy a pair. You will be ecstatic with the results.

title: Apparently I've been hearing songs incorrectly for 20 years
review:
Sound Quality: I always thought Eddie Vedder sang "Jeremy spoken restlessly" for 20 years, despite the fact that it made no sense. Today I plugged these suckers into my ears and heard that "Jeremy spoke in class today"...

Battery Life: So far so good. Only listened for about 60 minutes at a time, so they work for my needs.I just keep the little battery charger case in my pocket and I plug them back in after each use so I don't know how long the headphones and case hold a charge.

Noise cancellation: Surprisingly good. I didn't buy them for noise cancellation but they do cancel outside noises to some degree. I was in a cafe playing horrendous tween songs, so I jammed them in my ears like a crotchety old man and it made the bad sound stop :)

Left earphone: I've seen people complaining that the left earphone cuts out. When its happened for me (and it happens on both sides), I just shift the headphone in my ear. Problem solved for me. (You can also turn on only one earphone at a time so maybe people are turning one off unintentionally.)

title: Nice headphones. Great value.
review: This is definitely the best set of headphones I own. I have a very expensive Bose headphones and these sound much better. I don’t think they play quite as loud as the Bose but the sound quality is much better. Don’t spend $400 for Bose when these are a 10th of the price.  I would buy them again.

title: Great buy!
review: This is my 4th kindle and I cannot tell you how much I enjoy the larger screen especially since my eyes need a little help with he larger font! LOL. I did purchase the largest memory and 3G so I can download my books at any time. I’ve yet to use the audio on this kindle but I’m waiting for my wireless headphones to come in.

title: Great product within it's limits
review: Works well for anapproximately 15 to 25 percent increase in volume.  Can increase further if you place two of them in series with each other.  Wont shut off unless you unplug the headphones

title: Works for few hours
review: Wife loves these but has to change over to her old set of corded headphones as these die within 3 to 4 hours even if not listening to a call or music.

title: They work very well!
review: These earbuds work perfect with my laptop even better than the ones that come with I Phones.

title: Doesn't work as I expected them to.
review: It won't let me listen to my music when the noise cancellation is on. My previous headphones did! Same company.  I use them when cutting the lawn.

title: Very Nice Headphones - I'm an Android User
review:
These buds are really nice. I particularly love the braided cord, there's never any twisting or tangles and because I'm on the go, you can just scrunch 'em up and toss in a purse or backpack, or even shove them in your pocket. I chose the blue set and they are cool (see pic with my dog trying them out :)

My only complaint is that when I use these with my laptop, the volume buttons don't work. Now I am not sure if it's a software issue, or the headphones just don't work with Windows, maybe they weren't meant to, my old Samsung buds worked on the phone and a laptop. I use an Android Galaxy S7 and these are great.

Wonderful clarity and sound and the mic is spot on, no delays or trouble hearing on the other end, so I'm told. I'd go for five stars if the vol keys worked on my computers.

title: The mute button functions totally backwards.  I they can hear EVERYTHING on my end ! !
review: The soind and comfort of the headset is fine, not exceptional, but definitely adequate for my basic needs.  The mic functions just fine also.There is one feature ... a feature that can be very important, that functions totally in reverse of its intended function ... The mute button makes it so that I can't hear the other person BUT they can hear EVERYTHING on my end !  So much for the mute ! !

title: Top notch Customer Service Support
review: I will update this review once I receive my right earbud replacement. The one I received did not work properly and would not connect with the left earbud. Meanwhile, I emailed support with my problem and they sent out a replacement the next day. Very happy with their customer service and commitment to their product. 7/15 update: Received my replacement earbud as promised and it works!  Aside from the delays due to the first right earbud not working properly, reporting this, then receiving the replacement about a week later, I am very pleased with this product. It offers the smallest earbud cover of all the earbuds I looked at, which is essential if you have tiny ear canals, and is of excellent quality overall.

title: The right size earbuds at last!
review: Regular sized earbuds don't fit my small ears. I didn't know you could get smaller ones until my son told me and recommended this brand. The smallest of these earbuds are perfect for me. Very happy.

title: AS DESCRIBED
review: IN A NICE PACKET. GOOD VALUE. SAME AS THE HEADSET THAT COMES WITH STANDARD PHONE. PERFECT FOR MY NEEDS AND i GET 2 FOR LESS THAN THE PRICE OF ONE AT BEST BUY

title: Good headphones, but lousy documentation/instructions
review: great headphones. a little tight on my head, but i'll manage. they serve the purpose for me with good sound at a very reasonable price. i'd give them 5 stars, but the written instructions were absolutely horrible. no indication about how to charge them and very poor instructions for how to use.and the print was microscopic! I'm pretty tech-savvy and could figure it all out, but what about people who aren't?

title: I love being able to keep my headphones plugged in and ...
review:
Works amazingly. I love being able to keep my headphones plugged in and just hitting the switch to make my computer automatically switch to speakers. I chose the version with an external power supply as I am also using an external hard drive. Don't need to blue screen for insufficient power.

The buttons are very tactile and the usb cord is about 8 in. Could be a bit longer, but it works for my setup.

title: ANother favorite of mine
review:
Most headphones are (bias on) made for men (bias off). They are heave and give me a headache after a short time and I'm never able to adjust them properly.

With the Coby CVH32, I pop them on and can wear them all day. I love them! Yep, I have 2 pairs at home and one in my laptop travel case.

title: Five Stars
review: Just what I needed to use a extra set of headphones in the back of my living room.

title: Really impressive sound
review: I needed outside the ear headphones while I nursed an ear infection in both ears and went with this behind the neck style. I was impressed with the sound. The only wish I have is that part that goes around the neck was a bit longer. They can pop off my ear but I’m overall satisfied.

title: finally bark free studying
review: I use the earbuds with a laptop;  studying with 2 little dogs in the house  so these earbuds help me when they start their daily barking contest.  thank you.

title: Five Stars
review: These headphones are great - good sound quality and excellent noise canceling. I am very pleased.

title: Great for kids distance-learning.
review: I’ve got this for my kids distance-learning and they are fighting over it so I have to purchase another one! They both like it because the sound is good and it is more comfortable than most affordable headphones that I have been purchasing.

title: The worst
review: I really wanted to love this headphone. In the first 10 mins, I was in LOVE. The sound was great and I even walked around the house and it didn’t cut off. Theeeeeennnnn, all of a sudden it started to go in and out and got to be super annoying. It would cut out every 2 seconds or so. I couldn’t even use it. I thought maybe it was a defective one. I ordered a replacement. The replacement was worse! The noise cancelling does not work (the first one worked but it wasn’t great but also wasn’t something I was looking for). I have the noise cancellation turned on high but I can hear every single person in the room I can hear every click and clank and I can hear my son watching YouTube on his phone which was on a very low volume. It seems like the headphones are doing the opposite. It has enhanced every sound in the house no matter what setting I put on the app. And the app… It continues to connect then disconnect then connect… It was so annoying.

title: Doesn’t fit properly
review: I love the idea of this but the speakers aren’t in the right spot. Maybe my ears or eyes are misplaced (lol) but the band tends to cover my eyes if you place the headphones exactly on my ears. It’s also a little loose on my head.

title: Hums in my videos
review: I’ve had this for some time and every time I use it, I get a hum in my videos. I’ve tested it and it’s the product and not laptop, headphones, camera or surrounding sound related. Too bad because I past the return window and initially I loved that it was long and pretty light weight. The humming is a deal breaker.

title: Syncing issues
review:
Update: it was great for a couple of days and then it started syncing and in syncing with the various laptops. I had to continually remove from the laptops not using it before it will work. It is now not syncing to any of the devices. I had to use the cord so my son can continue his class work which defeats the “wireless” purpose. It’s comfortable and cute but may have received a defected one?

Great headset. Easy to set up. Now that the kids are home and will starting Distance learning, I needed headphones for them to do school related stuff on the laptops. I wanted to test one before buying for the other 2 boys.

title: Has it’s perks
review:
There are some things I love & not love about it. Yes, I would recommended it for the price but I wouldn’t pay more for this.

PROS:
✔️It sounds great.
✔️FM is a great Feature
✔️Connecting to a device is easy
✔️Affordable
✔️Option for plugging it in instead of wireless
✔️Folds into compact size for traveling
✔️Adjustable

CONS:
🚫Yes it sounds great but sometimes I hear static. Turning it off and back on seems to fix this issue.
🚫FM feature is great but you can’t really know which station you’re on so you’re just randomly “scanning” and maybe it’s just me but the signal isn’t great in my house.
🚫Even though connecting a device is easy, you can’t just turn on your iPhone and have it connect if you were previously connected to another device. I had to google this because I couldn’t figure out why I couldn’t connect. Each time you switch devices, you have to disconnect the one you’re connected to and connect it to the new device. I have cheap wireless headphones (in ear) that just connected to whichever device I was using or was nearby.
🚫The volume seems to be extremely loud as soon as you turn it on. It’s caught me by surprise and have hurt my ears. So I have to remember to turn it down BEFORE placing it on my ears.
🚫I haven’t had it long so if the static continues, it can be very annoying.

title: It's ok
review: Not easy to use the earbud controls - you have to use the app and the settings don't stick.  Ended up turning off all controls (volume, noise cancellation, Siri etc.) and just using it as plain vanilla ear phones.

title: Work well with Avantree Audition headphones
review:
Got these for my new Avantree Audition headphones, since i don't really like leather/fake leather against my ears. These seemed a bit bigger but other comments here said they'd fit, and they do!
It was a bit fiddly putting the new ones on since I hadn't replaced ear pads before, but it was easy enough to figure out and they fit fine.
They are larger than the ones the Auditions came with but I'm fine with that, these are more sort of larger oval shaped, and the original ones were more round.
Glad I got these, way more soft cushioning than the original ones my headphones came with with a nice soft cloth feel.

title: and this headset works wonderfully for that
review: Been using this for most of a year since buying it. No issues at all. I work from home and use an Avaya VOIP phone to take inbound calls, and this headset works wonderfully for that. Battery will still last about 3 hours of constant talk time, and it's rare I go that long without being able to give it a few minutes charge.

title: Dont' waste your money
review: Nope, does not work.  The headphone part works but the mic does not.  I connected it to a frogz headphone/mic combo I use regularly with my android phone.  And you'll have to pay for return shipping if it doesn't work, so think twice before you buy.  (With 51 five-star reviews and 11 four-star reviews, I thought I'd be safe.  Shoulda considered the other 34 mediocre to  bad reviews... *sigh*)

title: Gorgeous, Rich Sound
review:
I bought a pair of these years ago and have always loved them. I needed another set of earbuds for travel, so I bought some less expensive ones...which sounded tinny...and another not-so-cheap set that sounded flat...and finally just bought another set.

I have super-large ear canals, out of which all earbuds fall, but these stay neatly in place no matter what. They also don't hurt my ears. And the sound is sublime.

The wireless version is on my gift wishlist.

title: Still doesn't fit the Clamcase. I finally gave in ...
review: Still doesn't fit the Clamcase. I finally gave in and drilled the case. Now this thing fits...but I no longer need it for my fancy Bose earbuds.

title: Muddy Sound
review: I got these as a gift, and couldn't believe how terrible these sounded compared to my cheap pair of Skull Candy earbuds. The music actually sounded like it was being played through a pillow, the sound was so muffled. Changed the earpads, fiddled the equalizer...threw them in a drawer where they will rest in peace until I can give them away. Bah.

title: Great buy for Bose headphone refurbish
review: Great product for a great price.  Works perfectly on my Bose TP1-A headphones. They also came with the inner speaker mesh (not pictured at time of purchase).  Highly recommend!

title: Volume control
review: My older headphone was easier to control volume. I must feel with a finger to adjust  minus or plus . My older one required only a movement forward or backward.

title: Must buy!
review: I always hated in ear earbuds but these are very comfortable. I wear them at hours on end and the never slip or get uncomfortable in my ear. The right one is only phone activated but the sound is amazing. Never dropped a call or worried I was too far away from my phone with Bluetooth connection it would lose signal and I live in the country. Great power case too and super fast! Love these earbuds

title: Recommend highly
review: Best headset I've bought! I have sensitive ears & these are awesome. They fit great & the sound is perfect. I like a lot of bass & noise canceling & this product delivers! Recommend highly!

title: Great for what I needed!
review:
I was looking for a new set of headphones for my television because my old ones got the wire fully chewed by my cat (hoping these will not meet the same fate). I have high hopes for these since the wire is much thicker and sturdier feeling than the ones they are replacing.
The sound quality of these is good, the earpieces are very comfy when in my ear and stay in well too! I like that the earpieces come in a variety of sizes to fit almost any ear. They are pretty tight to get onto the actual earbuds, but once on there they WILL NOT go anywhere and are super secure! I've had no issues with these and I'm very glad I got these. Plus the color is super pretty, and I love how they're flat on one side so it really helps differentiate between the left and right bud!

title: You get what you pay for
review: This set of wireless headphone and smart watch are very nice.  The packaging it came in was very sturdy.  The watch itself is great!  The band is a bit small for me.  They want you to be able to have 3 fingers under it and well that's just not going to happen with me.  I like the BPM option.  It helps me keep track of my POTS.  The one thing I was disappointed about and why I only gave it a 3 star is because the baby pink headphones had black streaks of dirt all over them.  They did eventually wipe off.  Just was a bit of a turn-off. So I guess you really do get what you pay for.

title: Awesome headset
review: My son loves this headset for gaming. It has great sound & is very comfortable to wear. He is very happy with it.

title: Perfect Fit for 2 Beats Headphones and a Blue Yeti Microphone
review: We needed a headphone splitter that would work with two pair of Beats headphones that would plug into a Blue Yeti microphone.  This one works.  The sound quality is no different than if the headphones were plugged in individually.  Great product so far and we like it.

title: Thubs Up From the Hubs...
review:
We needed a second set of headphones for him that he could use with his computer and be able hear what is going on whenever we do live a live stream together on my YouTube channel. These headphone have fit the need perfectly.

I currently use the pink Beats Solo that are the photo and this review is for the black Beats, his. I hate to admit it because the Solo pair cost more, but this pair actually has better sound. They are easy to use, easy to adjust the size on, and he loves them.

The only thing that I don't like about them is the fact that the cord is built in which means it isn't replaceable. With the Beats Solo, the cord plugs into the headphones so if it shorts out, you can replace just the cord without having to shell out the cost of the headphones again. That is the only negative thing I can think of for these headphones and the reason for 4 stars instead of 5.

If anything changes, I'll come back and update but so far so good and he really does like them.

title: I've Had Them for 10 Months...
review:
I purchased these in January, 2018 so I figured enough time has passed and I've used them enough that I can give an accurate review on my experience with them.

In a nutshell, I love them and think they are great headphones. I use them plugged directly into my computer for video editing, plugged into my Blue Yeti microphone for live streaming on YouTube and plugged into my iPhone for listening to music, movies and talking on the phone utilizing the built in microphone. They are generally used somehow almost every day.

They look and work exactly like they did the day they arrived. I don't store them in the case that came with them, usually they are just laying on my desk when not in use. Appearance wise, they have held up beautifully and look almost exactly like they did out of the box.

I really do love the sound quality. I wouldn't say it is perfect but I knew that when I purchased them but it is much better than my Apple earbuds or any other brand of headphones that I have used. I do have to note here that I've never used Bose so I can't make that comparison.

The cord has held up just fine but I'm always aware of where it is and try to make sure that it doesn't get pulled or yanked, although it has happened a few times.

All in all, for the price, I do believe that these are a quality headphone and if you take care of them, are well worth the money.

title: Meh, at Best
review: It says in the description "extra bass". Perhaps they're speaking about the fish?? RETURNED. I currently have a cheap set of Phillips earbuds that sound 100% better.

title: Works Great For It's Purpose
review: I bought this mic when my laptop died on me and after purchasing a desktop computer that does not come with a built-in mic. It's very easy to use, inexpensive, and I like that it isn't on a headset so I can also hear things that are going on in the house. It also works perfectly with no problems. I use it to Skype my brother when we are gaming in two different rooms in the house.

title: Wonderful.
review: I don't know  why I did not use headphones nefore!  They are so comfortable and helps these 82 year old ears to hear the tv better. They are so comfortable.  I can now watch tv without saying what! I can't hear the tv! Love them!

title: Nice!
review: Good little radio.  Decent sound though you do have to use headphones--no internal speaker.  Fair reception on major stations.  Comes with a pair of moderate headphones--nothing special but not the lowest line either.

title: The lights are super bright. However
review: Really neat headphones.  The lights are super bright.  However, they are much heavier than I expected.  The light on one ear is already messing up and haven't even had them for a year yet.

title: Headset
review: This is the best headset I have ever owned. The sound quality is perfect and it is very easy to use. No one else can hear what is being said.

title: Good headphones for the price
review:
My kids have ordered this particular model and so did I. We have all had problems with the cord shorting out right after we bought it.

UPDATE****
When I first bought these headphones they were glitching, however, the problem seems to have worked out. The company did reach out to me and offer a replacement but they only had black and I really like the blue so no replacement ever came. However, outside of the initial problems I had, they have been going strong for the past 2 years now.... even after being crammed in and out of my back pack as I traveled around the country AND to and from coffee shops locally!

While I upped my rating I still left one star off for the fact that my kids' headphones never did start working any better.

title: Poor quality and broken right out of the packaging
review: Very Poor Quality - I ordered 2 and in 1 package the headphone was crimped near the ear piece and almost broken off - these are not like my original S3 head phones - they are cheap - you get what you pay for - as for me I'm disappointed I thought Samsung was a solid reputable company ...

title: A GREAT BUY
review: I S SO YOU CAN ACTUALLY HEAR SOMEHATE EAR BUDS. ALL THOSE YEARS WITH HEADPHONES MAKE ME WANT HEADPHONES, AND THESE ARE GOOD BUT DONT CONFORM TO YOUR EAR.S SO YOU CAN ACTUALLY HEAR THINGS IN YOUR ENVIRONMENT TOO.  GOOD OR WHEN THE GRANDKIDS COME OVER.

title: Noise cacellation works too well
review: The noise cacellation feature on these actually works too well for someone that needs some kind of background noise to be comfortable.  The silence was absolute and actually a bit unsettling.  For someone that wants that level of noise cancellation though, these would be ideal.  They work really well and actually stay in your ears without falling out, which is another issue I tend to have with earphones.  Now that I know how to handle them without accidentally activating the noise cancellation feature I am really happy with them.

title: Getting them into my ears is a bit of a pain
review: The touch control on the earbuds is a bit of a problem when they are prone to falling out of my ears after awhile.  I do like that once they are connected there aren't a lot of flashing lights on the earbuds themselves.  Paired up with my phone easily and holds the connection perfectly.  My issue with them might just be an issue with the size and shape of my own ears, but I can't seem to keep the left one in at all and when I feel them falling out and reach to catch them the touch control on them becomes an issue.  I do still use them, but mostly just the right one because it stays in my ear better than the left.  Sound quality is decent, but the volume system on it is weird.  It would be nice if there was a way to turn off the touch control on the earbuds themselves and just use the phone's volume control directly.

title: A literal must have.
review: I bought one of the platonics 5200 sets. The ear piece that this replaces will literaly cause you pain after minutes of use. So this is a must have. This ear piece does direct sound better and fits in ear well. Makes head set sit in charging case a little funny though. Other then that works great accept for 1 small flaw. It comes with a rubber o ring that breaks as soon as you put it on head set. Quick fix. The ear pieces that came with head set have a spongy type oring that will still fit this adaptor. Problem solved. But product should come with it. Had to godown a star because without that o ring it does not stay it headset. But with thw quick fix mentioned the benefits out way that flaw.

title: Objectively pretty terrible
review:
I got these for $40 at my local Best Buy and they are objectively pretty terrible compared to my previous $32 Sennheiser CX~s earbuds. The shiny material seems so much flimsier, almost as light as plastic, and the skullcandy logo is poorly integrated and a bit cheesy. The sound quality is tinny and poor -- it doesn't really exclude sound and doesn't give you as much of a surround feeling with lush deep notes. I feel like I'm practically listening to apple earbuds (except that they're a bit more comfortable). I'm afraid to yank too hard on it in case of compromising the inexpensive materials it's made of, and when I slide on a couch or something I get a lot of feedback from the earphones. Also, when I just plug it into the computer I hear a constant low buzz.

tl;dr not very good, even for the current $25 price. I'd spend an extra $10-20 to get something that sounds really good, and might last.

title: Highly Recommend
review: Love these.  I have a hard time keeping most earphones in my ears, but these stay put with no pain.  I misplaced my first set, so bought a second pair with no hesitation.

title: This little speaker does an amazing job! What we didn't realize is that it ...
review: We purchased this speaker to go with a battery operated radio that only had headphones.  This little speaker does an amazing job!  What we didn't realize is that it would also plug right into our phone.  This has come in extremely handy!  We have purchased 2 of these speakers...one for ourselves, and one as a gift.

title: HAVE A STRONG MAGNIFYING to read the instructions
review:
Hopefully I will be able to listen to my audio books with my new hearing aids without the pressure around my ears because using of my headphones where very painful pressure AROUND my ears.
BIGGEST PROBLEM I have with this is trying to read the instruction sheet. EVEN WITH A MAGNIFYING glass I can't read the *&$! instructions on how to turn the thing on.
Next I will go to a copy machine and blow the print up so I can find out how to pair the thing to my computer to listen to my audio books

title: ONLY WORKS WITH SMART PHONES not flip phones or free from APPLE computers
review: I have a FLIP PHONE not a smart phone so the BOSE does not work with my phone.  The  Bose headset requires a SMART PHONE to use, or to be connected DIRECTLY to an Apple computer.  If you do not have a Smart Phone and do not want to spend $300.00 for a PLUG IN set of ear phones, then you don't need to buy IS BOSE head set.

title: The connection kept dropping out in the female plug.  Finally said not worth it
review: I needed a long extension cord for my ear phones when I am on my tread mill.  I ended up disconnected the earphones extension cord and the sound came through with no problem

title: Good but Cheap
review: While these headphones really do deliver very good sound with their 50mm drivers and good seal between the ears and padding, the only parts I could find that weren't plastic were the screws. Boy are these cheap feeling. But in the end they're comfortable and sound great.

title: SKW Makes Great Quality Cables
review: Bought this thick, braided, high quality 3.5 to 3.5 to replace the sad excuse of a cable that came with my Oppo PM-3 headphones. Big upgrade in quality.

title: Excellent quality here to the LDG headphones
review: Excellent quality here to the LDG headphones. Sporting a fairly thick cord that leads to two buds that feel solid, comfortable, and have a weight to them that says quality to me. Music is crystal clear with more than ample bass; comparable to the Nuforce headphones that cost twice as much as the LDG's. Highly recommended.

title: So cute, but don't fit my ears well
review: really cute earbuds, but they HURT my ears. Too big, they fall out a lot or I have to SHOVE them in (ouch!) I put the smallest covers on and they still fall out all the time. Kinda disappointing.

title: Great Al Purpose Amplifier.
review: I purchased this to use with a Polaris connection Avaya Phone. It was not only great for that purpose, but it works for monitoring of a call by someone else with a standard jack headphones, and it works quite well. I have since changed over to wireless connection but passed this on to a co-worker who is just as happy with it.

title: Feels nice a firm..perfectly snug..
review: [[VIDEOID:4575998761ded4198b65e6dec1037d8e]] The case is great! Nice snug fit I think my headphones will be safe..would totally recommend.

title: Lots of length
review: I had a very short earphone cord, probably only 3 feet.  I ordered this extension and it was very fast shipping, the product looked to be well made and durable.  Would definitely recommend this product and seller to anyone also looking for an extension to headphone wire.  I now have 20 feet!

title: Comfort and Mute Button
review: This head set was wonderful - only problem was it hurt my ears, I have big ears and the ear piece hit below the top of my ears and after a bit, they were tender. BUT, I truly loved the way it worked. I am using a headset right now that I absolutely love for work, comfortable, fits my ears, but the mute button is not good. Nothing wrong with it, just a basic up for mute down for unmute, but even with me putting a piece of colored tape on the mute par, had to keep my finger on it all the time when I wasn't working. LOVE IT

title: Great Wireless Headset for the Price!
review: I was shocked how nice this headset was. It came in a hard zipper case with a usb cord and a jack cord. I bought it for myself to watch movies on my computer. I am going to buy one for my granddaughter for children. I didn't know how to connect it to my computer (my computer is still rocking and a-rolling even though its 12 years old), the instructions were for laptop, bluetooth, Iphone or android phone. So I contacted the chat line and I was walked thru every step of the way on how to connect the wireless headset to my desktop. It worked like a charm. Love the headset - I truly am thinking of getting one for each of my grandchildren and great grandchildren for Christmas.

title: Wonderful Headset
review: I bought this for my cell phone (smartphone) and love it! It works wonderfully. I can talk on the phone without having to hold it and continued knitting, crocheting, etc. I like how light it is on my head. Love it. I am going to try to use the headset on my computer see how that works.  It really work good. I was going to order one for my daughter, but when I ordered this in January I paid 5.86 now it is 26.99, so sorry daughter of mine.

title: Works great!
review: Just know they do what was advertised, they work wonderfully, can't hear anything when on; microphone works great; perfect length;  - but be aware that after about an hour of wearing them,  they do hurt the ears even though the headset is not heavily padded, reason why I rated it as an overall 3 star. I meant to order the Cyber one that was over the head one earpiece - (I had one for about 8  years and it finally had to be retired) not the double headset I bought - that was my fault.  Great price too.

title: Fantastic sound from any device and noise cancel is great just for quiet time.
review:
These headphones are great! They have excellent sound no matter what I plug them into. Noise cancelling is nice to as I can put them on to read or study and drown out the TV or appliances running. My only complaint would be that since I wear them so much they sometimes get uncomfortable but I think it's the combination of the ear cups and my glasses. If I am just listening to music and have my glasses off it doesn't bother me so much.

It's also nice that these come with two cords, one Apple product rigged with a volume control and mute right on the cord and one not. I do seem to go through a fair amount of batteries so I keep some spares in the very nice case.

If you use headphones a lot and appreciate the quality of Bose sound these headphones are a wonderful product.

I selected these when picking between these and Dr. Dre beats...a tough decision as both have fabulous sound.

title: Finally a headset that works great
review: I have tried many headsets over the years and always had problems. Clients couldn't hear me clearly, or the microphone would slip, or I couldn't hear without pressing the earjack into  my ear. This headset is solid, the microphone stays in place and it's comfortable. Definitely a great choice.

title: works very well
review: I like how the headset let's you know that it is paired with your phone and ready to be used as well as letting you know when the battery is low.

title: Good quality good sound, great for multi conference calls
review: I have been a user of these headphones for over a year. Love the stereo sound, great fit, and easy to charge. Over time, battery life has gotten shorter however, great warranty service and main reason why I spent so much for these. Also, call sound/mic works really well and another reason why i still use these.

title: Ear Pad issues
review:
Like many posting have stated the ear pads are well.. cheap and provide little comfort with minimal use. Just received my pair and put on for first use. After tweaking the EQ the sound is good. For the money this was a good buy and I would buy again at the sale price as long as I know there is a better ear pad replacement that will fit. The ear pad on button side came apart at seam in that 1st use. Maybe this is old inventory (thus sale price!) that sat in a warehouse and the heat got to them. In any event many who posted have had this problem so, it is either that or, the pads are very very cheap for a top brand headset maker with an original premium price! Not a positive endorsement of their (Soul not Amazon) quality control.

I contacted Soul direct to see about a replacement ear pad before trying to send back to Amazon. A test of their customer service.

title: Works well
review: I liked these earbuds.  They were easy to use and pair with my phone.  They were comfortable to wear and stay in well.  Sound quality is good.  I haven't really been able to test the noise cancelling abilities because I haven't used them anywhere that needed noise cancelling yet.

title: comfortable and battery lasts well
review:
I find these to be comfortable to use. They connected easily. The sound quality is good. I found they last pretty well. I don't tend to get to use them for more than an hour or two at a time without interruptions. But rarely have to charge the case. The earbuds automatically charge every time you place them back in the case, which I do whenever I take them off. It is easier to find a case than a couple small earbuds. I like the mirror and the way the LED tells me the percentage charged the earbuds are.

They are supposed to have noise cancelling abilities. I never really have been able to check that so far because generally, where I work, it is not that noisy and I have to be able to hear the phone ring. I do have to say, wireless earbuds are so much easier than carrying wired headphones or even earbuds around.

title: Great for travel
review:
This is great if you need to carry a number of cords and cables, such as for phones or hard drives. It is also good for USB drives and plugs. You are limited to what fits in it as it isn't huge, but it is a good size otherwise.

I basically got it for my mobile music production rig. So, USB cables yes, audio cables probably not. The small 1/8" headphone cables fit but the bigger 1/4" patch cables won't fit. It will also hold some of my dongles, which is great. The hard sides seem pretty sturdy. I haven't put anything really heavy on it and I don't really plan to see how much weight it can take before cracking.

title: works okay
review: These work okay.  I've had some that worked better and some that worked worse.  I would say they are your standard inexpensive earbuds.

title: Just what it says it is
review:
Now if only I could find one of these for my iPad. I love this type of cover. It is soft and slightly sticky - but not in a bad way. It's just when I put it on a surface, it doesn't move. It's actually very soft to the touch and comfortable to hold.

The cutouts are all in the right places, except one. There is a cutout to the right of the earphone jack that has nothing there to need a cutout. and the on/off switch doesn't have a cutout, but really, it isn't needed. It doesn't seem to upset my Skinomi cover, either. So far, I'm very happy with this.

For the truth in advertising crowd. This cover will collect lint and cat hair or whatever you have in your house. They all do really. But I prefer them to the kind of cover that will slide off the top of my closed laptop. The black seems to be the best color, or really anything but clear/white. I had a clear one for my old kindle. It got really nasty looking after very quickly. I've had other colors of this same stuff for my phones without a lot of problems.

title: 2nd Pair, Just As Good As The First
review: So we liked the first pair we tried so much that we ordered another pair so the price is what I am going to discuss first, only because I was not expecting much at this price but then when testing them out and using them that is the first thing I considered was, "how good are these for that reasonable of a price". This headset does not disappoint at all. I am pleasantly pleased with how well these perform. The noise cancelling is spot on, the sound is great and the battery life is fantastic. I would recommend this set for anyone looking for a headset for any practical use, no matter if they need a good gaming headset or just a good headset for music. They are lightweight, and constructed well. We've had some really fancy, expensive gaming headsets and this one has outperformed several of them for half the price. If you have more than one person to buy a headset for, this one is affordable enough and good enough that you could grab 2 for the same price as 1 of some of the others that perform at the same level.  I hope this review is helpful!

title: Perfect For Gaming
review: The price is what I am going to discuss first, only because I was not expecting much at this price but then when testing them out and using them that is the first thing I considered was, "how good are these for that reasonable of a price".  This headset does not disappoint at all.  I am pleasantly pleased with how well these perform.  The noise cancelling is spot on, the sound is great and the battery life is fantastic.  I would recommend this set for anyone looking for a headset for any practical use, no matter if they need a good gaming headset or just a good headset for music.  They are lightweight, and constructed well.  We've had some really fancy, expensive gaming headsets and this one has outperformed several of them for half the price.  I hope this review is helpful!

title: Fantastic Head Phones!
review: I am a big fan.  I was skeptical, mainly because every pair I have gotten has been pretty darn uncomfortable, but the ear buds just don't work for me.  They truly are uncomfortable so I decided to try to go back to the full headphones and try these.  I am sure glad I did!  Sound quality is awesome, the comfort is better than I could have asked for.  Set up through bluetooth is really easy too.  If you are looking for a very comfortable headset with bose-type sound quality, these so far have proven to be just like that, and for the money- I highly recommend.  Hope this review helps!

title: Mixed bag
review: These were a mixed bag. One broke right away but the other headset works well and fits fine.

title: No more ear pain!
review: I love the fact that this does not have  earbuds. Earbuds always make my ears hurt but no more. I use this while working around the house or to fall asleep at night. Awesome product!

title: Excellent quality for the price
review:
I felt the need to review because there were wildly varing reviews out there and I almost didn't purchase these. I own 3 varieties of BOSE headphones, and I needed to get a new headset with a USB connection since my work laptop is broken in that I can hear web calls but not speak. I'll address some conflicting reviews that I found to be bunk:
Comfort - I'm usually not a fan of on-ear headsets but these are padded and comfy. They aren't too light as to slip off, nor are they heavy or bulky. One reviewer said the cord and control circle (volume and mute) was so heavy as to drag the headphones off his head ... totally untrue. The cord is very long - you can slide over to your file cabinet or printer - yay. And the cord is NOT heavy as to feel its weight on that side of the headset.
Sound - The sound is excellent and as I mentioned, I'm a BOSE girl. There are so many USB headsets in the $39 - $79 range and I'm glad I spent the extra dollars for this price point. Working from home in the COVID age means a lot more WebEx and Zoom meetings, and sound - and noise cancellation - has to be excellent. One reviewer said she could hear herself breathing. That only happens when the mouthpiece is aimed at your nostril - duh. Move it.

I can't comment on longevity as these are new, but hopefully these will have a nice long usage life.

title: Did not grip anything I tried to clip it on
review: I wanted to clip my headset wire to clothing so it wouldn’t snag on doors etc.  They did not stay on for even a second.

title: Microphone will not work
review: Pretty good quality but major flaw in advertising its compatibility with iPhone since it does not support microphone function. If you plan to extend your apple earbuds or any earbuds with an included mic. The mic function will no longer work.

title: These sound great
review: These noise cancelling earphones sound great. The only problem I encountered is that the battery compartment door popped off so I have to hold the batteries in place with tape.

title: Good Headset
review: This headset is pretty good, overall. I like the quality of a Turtle beach headset better, but the price is much more reasonable. The sound can be flaky at times but definitely not bad

title: Very nice headphones. Comes with multiple sized buds for different ...
review: Very nice headphones. Comes with multiple sized buds for different ear sizes as well as a mini USB charger cable. Overall, these are very easy to control. Syncing with my phone was super easy and turning them on as well. Simply push the middle button and you're good. The controls are on the right side as your headphones hang. Being that I am right handed, this has not been an issue. For the price these have been more than amazing. I generally use these in the gym and they never fall out. Anker is a great brand and these are a very good buy.

title: Adapts  stereo plugs to fit an Iphone 6
review: I use my Iphone connected to a transmitter for wireless headphones in the shop to listen to podcasts. The Iphone with a case will only accept a small diameter jack in the earbud connection, anything else is too large to plug in fully, so I was glad to find this adaptor. Very reasonable price and definitely does the job.

title: Exactly what I wanted
review: I bought this to run from my Iphone to a wireless headphone setup in my shop, and it does the trick.

title: Beat my expectations
review: These were mostly charged out of the box.  I plugged them in to charge for a little longer and I was ready to go. They paired very easily. You can use one or both earbuds which I sometimes like as an option. I did water aerobics with these on. The sound was good, the volume was good. I have not yet answered a call with them on, but as far as listening to music, podcasts and audiobooks they are working well.

title: Five Stars
review: Holds my son's school headphones, keeps them much safer than the zip lock bags other kids use.

title: Great, cheap
review: Great, cheap, earbuds, I keep a stock of them for the kids for when they lose, break, or leave them where the cat can eat them!

title: Love these ear buds, they stay put!
review:
Yurbuds Inspire 100 In-Ear Headphones
Love these ear buds, they stay put! Work great, way better than the plain round ones that were always falling out. Bought 2 more pair. Be aware that there are different sizes for men and women. I didn't notice this with the first pair and got the larger size. Called Yurbuds and they sent me smaller covers but I couldn't get them to go on the larger buds so hubby got those and I ordered smaller ones.Then I ordered a second pair for my Kindle. Love, love, love them. Also, yurbuds customer support is great!!

title: Best invention and product
review:
These headphones are one of best inventions EVER!!
My hearing has diminished as I have gotten older and found great difficulty understanding woman’s voices. I stopped watching a lot of tv because of that. For Xmas I received these as a gift and I have been binge watching so many programs/movies etc. The headphones are soft to the ear, lightweight, the controls are easily accessible , has a long battery life and easy access to charging. The noise cancellation is so good—has two levels so that you can have total noise cancellation or not. Best product ever!!

title: We loved these headphones and so did my son
review: We loved these headphones and so did my son. Will be ordering a new pair soon since our cat chewed through the cord.

title: Failed within two weeks.
review: The earphones are very comfortable when in the ear laying down on a pillow to sleep. The sound quality is fair to good. This is my 2nd pair within a year. The last pair also failed within two months. Both time one side stopped working. The problem is that the units are very compressed to make them comfortable to have in ear and lay on a pillow. With that said, they are fragile. I really want them to work as these are the most comfortable I have used so far, and I have tried 8 different types. Most hurt your ears if laying on for any length of time, so you can only have one side in. Of course the side that your not laying on. They are inexpensive, but I would pay more if they made them stronger.

title: Very good cable
review: Have used these many times for Walkman and if my Bluetooth headphones are charging. The problem is that one of the cables left side audio went out. ( I purchased two units to have a long cable). I will buy again as the price can't be beat, and the sound quality is very good. I recommend this and will continue to purchase.

title: Solid good earbud!
review: Keep buying these, as they have very good sound for the price. I use them for my mp3 while sleeping as the wife don't like any noise. The reason I keep purchasing them is that they are the most close fitting and comfortable units if you’re in bed to sleep. They are sturdy, but the only reason I’ve purchased six pair is that my dog loves to chew the earbud if I don’t take them off the night stand. It has nothing to do with the performance of the unit.

title: Oh So Good and Frustrating
review: Lots said, so will keep this short, these headphones are awesome when they work-- hold on the head well, good sound and controls, good battery life, and altogether cheap.  Problem is we had to go through six units to end up with the three we have now for the family.  Two of those arrived not working properly, another lost a speaker after a short time.  The other three have held up for nearly a year each.  If you are new to these and they do not seem to sound or function correctly at first, then they definitely are not... the working product will make you smile unconditionally.

title: no earbuds for me
review: I cannot wear earbuds.  I thought if they went around the ears that they would stay in while I was at least on the treadmill.  Needed to keep pushing them back in which started to hurt my ears.  I tried the different sizes and the one size I had in fit the best but once I started to sweat out they went.  I have bluetooth headsets that are not earbuds but I could not hook up to the tv's at the gym.

title: You get what you pay for
review:
Worked great for about 4 months. Sound quality was acceptable and battery life was great.

Then out of nowhere, the right earbud died.

title: really disappointed with these
review:
really disappointed with these.

received them as a Christmas gift and they broke twice within a year. the first time, the earbud casing snapped off; they were still under warrantee, so there was fortunately no cost to replace.

the second time, the cover on the volume adjuster fell off. no longer covered by the product protection plan, Apple wanted over $150 to fix them (almost the cost of a brand new paid).

as good as the sound quality is, you may be better off just buying a dozen $20 pairs of headphones at the same price.

title: shoddy construction
review:
I had no issues with sound quality or drivers or range, but I found the physical construction itself to be quite shoddy. within 6 months, both of the clips that connect the ear pieces to the headband had snapped off.

I didn't travel or do anything out of the ordinary with the headset that might put it under abnormal stress (maybe a couple hours of warcraft raiding 3-4 nights/week and the occasional business conference call from home)

title: Great sound quality
review: Got this when the world shifted to remote work for COVID and work life became an endless Zoom meeting.  Wanted to be able to sit in a comfortable chair with the laptop on a shelf and not have to worry about moving around a little while using the headset.  Works great.  If anything, I wish I'd gotten a shorter cord.  6' is a little long.  But better too long than not long enough.  It's easy enough to coil it a bit & tie it.

title: So far so good.
review:
I really like this headset.
Quality build, quality materials.
Seems to be pretty sound and solid.
Battery life seems to be really good.
It seems to be fairly durable as well.
Sound quality is good... but not great.
It truly donse the job almost perfectly for regular everyday users for general music listening and phone calls.
Has a bit of a disorienting slight eco type of thing with phone calls but for the most part works satisfactory.
Has a bit of distortion when at full volume with certain types of music...
It has ok base... but not great compared to dre beats.
Overall i do really like this product.
I am happy i bout it.
It seems to be worth the money.

title: Very Good Quality!
review: Excellent quality, extremely fast delivery. Looks great with a more than reasonable price/cost.  Saved me from having to buy another headset.

title: perfect size for the headphone
review: My headphone is running great for the past 10 years but a pair of new ear pad was looooong overdue. these are the perfect size with snug fit, slightly more dense than the original (well, mine original is soft as slime since they are 10 years old.)  hopefully I can continue use this pair for another 10 years!

title: Excellent Headphones
review: Multi-purpose headphones since you can use them with your PC, cell phone or nothing at all just for the noise canceling feature. Light weight and very comfortable.

title: These are a very cool item. Hooked up flawlessly to my Samsung S4 ...
review: These are a very cool item.  Hooked up flawlessly to my Samsung S4 phone.  Can go around the house listening to music, while the phone stays on the charging stand.  Then I can even take a call, and the voice quality is pretty good.  The music quality is excellent, and they are a nice comfortable pair of headphones.  I don't like earbuds, so I'm always looking for a lightweight alternative.  These fit the bill.  Also, they come with a very nice case that holds the user guide and charging cable along with the headphones.

title: Budget earbuds that don't suck? Say no more!
review: These are awesome earbuds for thier price. They didn't even break on me after a year of use. I ended up breaking them on accident! I'd still be using them probably if I hadn't. Can't recommend these enough.

title: Earbuds are Great
review: I hesitated at first buying these Earbuds because I did not know the company or the product. After a lot of research, I decided to give them a try. Wow, they are high quality. My grandson purchased the latest pair of Apple's earbuds and I have to say these are just as good as Apple's and better than my son's newest pair of Samsung's. I work out at the gym, and I have no problem of these earbuds staying in my ears.  The noise cancellation is okay, but you can still hear your surroundings. The company sent me an email asking me how I like them and if I have any suggestions for improvements. I was impressed with this company for sending me that email. They also said if I have any problem with them just give them a call. That is customer service. I highly recommend these Earbuds. The price is great and so is the quality.

title: Not the greatest sound in the universe but plenty good for what ...
review: I bought this one because I wanted a small speaker that I could hook up to my headphone amp. The fact that it has bluetooth is just a bonus. Not the greatest sound in the universe but plenty good for what I intended.

title: A Mixed Bag, and Overpriced UPDATE: Do NOT buy!
review:
UPDATE: My initial reaction is below, but after initial use--less than 5 hours total--i didn't have time to use them. now that i have the time, they won't power up and won't charge. the seller refuses to replace or refund because it's now past the warranty period, but under the circumstances some understanding would be nice. i have had one similar situation in past and the seller was understanding and made it right. not so in this case. so, i'm out over 250 bucks. so i paid around 50 bucks an hour to use them! you've been warned.

pros:
☛excellent noise cancelling
☛bluetooth connects almost instantly
☛no perceptible audio lag when watching videos

cons:
☛ears get hot very quickly. i won't be using these in the summer without air conditioning.
☛bluetooth range is pathetic. i have $30 headphones with twice the range.
☛bass is muddy, even after eq-ing in the app. muddiness not cleared up, there's just less of it. (if you only listen to classical music, or any genre without prominent bass, you'll be pleased with the sound quality.)

summary: i probably should have returned these, but they aren't eligible for return through amazon, so i avoided the hassle. if these were a hundred bucks, i'd consider them a good buy.

title: they can be tight on the ears
review: These on-ear sound great.  Bass is rich and deep, the mids and highs come through clear.  They have, imo, excellent battery life.  If I can warn folks about anything: Consider that they are on-ear headphones, if you wear glasses it can be a bit uncomfortable under prolong use.  I found myself adjusting the headphones to ease the pressure on my upper ear lobes after prolonged use.  That said, I believe this phenomenon is true of any on-ear headset.  And it is likely equally a challenge if you were to use cans (over-ear headphones).  Just something us glasses wearer need to keep in mind.

title: a bit flimsy
review: Purchased end of Oct2019 to Dec2019, the left audio channel has faded.  Not exactly certain where the issue is, both left and right audio was fine, but across a couple devices tested and the left audio is only 15-20% output volume compared to right.  The cable did take a few hard tugs as it did get hung on objects such as chairs or door nobs -- uncertain why the effect is faded sound vs no sound output - prior to "my issue" the sound quality was actually pretty  decent the bass was deep albeit artificially spacious-sounding.  I also struggled with the fit on my ears; admittedly, my ears are on the smaller side, thus I was constantly re-adjusting ear placement of the headphones.  NOTE: the ear pieces slides up and down to be somewhat accommodating.

title: while big and heavy the sounds is good
review: as you read up on head phones you'll find that there are better headphones than this; but will ears know?  i agree with some write ups I read, the sounds got better with the headphones the more the headsphones are used.  Just note these things are big and heavy.  if you are looking for solid sound, yes - long term use might be a bit much.  but the soundscape immersion is actually very nice.  And the big canisters do end up subduing external sounds, making it rather easy for folks to sneak up on you even at lower volume

title: It worked well to connect my headphones wirelessly
review: I bought some lovely Bluetooth headphones to use when listening to podcasts and classes.  I then discovered that my computer does not have Bluetooth capability.  I thought a dongle might work.  I bought this one and after a bit of fiddly work, I was able to make it work.  Now, it works flawlessly.  Written directions may or may not have made a difference.

title: So cute
review: Ok, these are a little girl’s so the sound quality rating is not really a “thing”. She is six, as long as noise comes out of them like it is supposed to, she is happy lol. In any case, she is really enjoying her own headphones, and I think any little girl would enjoy these!

title: Amazing sound, amazing cancellation of noise
review:
My husband is wearing them right now, as he mows our 5 acres of ground (there is 5 acres of pond), or I would have picture. He took a break and let me know that he loves these headphones!! Sound is phenomenal, and the noise canceling feature is amazing. He is on a large mower and it cancels that racket really well.

They ARE expensive, but you know sometimes you get what you pay for, and these justify every penny. I am pretty sure I will never get to use them LOL

title: Nice little set of buds
review: These sound great! And the noise cancelling feature does very well I think. The earbuds are very soft and comfortable and the magnetic buds to keep them around your neck is a great idea. I really like these! And the case it comes with is foam and generously sized to hold everything.

title: A good headset but Mine broke
review: This was a great headset! Everything was built with great quality. The sound and all were excellent! Problem was it broke after 3 months. Why? The damned wire is wayyyyyyyyy too long! It is all over the place. It kept getting tugged under the wheels of my computed chair until eventually the wires go stressed and now I cant hear a thing unless I really wiggle the wires. Would I buy it again? Yes, but now that I know the flaws I can be prepared to meet them head on! With proper care this will be the only headset you will ever need!

title: Good price
review: I was looking for headphones to wear while I was working out and I do not recommend these for that activity as the ear piece kept falling out of my ear.  Overall the sound quality is decent and you get what you pay for with this product.  It is a good product at the price being offered.  The noise isolating is just that if the ear piece sits tightly, make note that this is not noise cancelling as there is no active component to this product.

title: Good headphones
review: I had a pair of Bose headphones that unfortunately stopped working after many years of use and I purchased these new headphones.  They are very nice quality headphones, but I feel like the old ones that I had previously, had much better sound quality to them.  Overall this is a Bose product so the materials and packaging are great.

title: Disgusting.
review: Microphone and control not working. Violent pressure on the head and ears. Frequency characteristics are three times lower than stated on the box. It is clear that cheap cannot be high quality, but these headphones are worse than my first ones, which I used 55 years ago.

title: super comfortable
review:
SUPER comfortable headset. They honestly sound great but i expected a bit better.

Audio quality is good but no better than the competition in my opinion. Bass in the headset could be better.

title: Not impressed.
review:
Sounds quality is good.
When using noise canceling during phone calls it sounds equivalent to plugging your ears completely so you cannot hear yourself talking and end up talking louder (annoys everyone in the viscinity!) and picks up more noise on the mic, i.e. shuffling papers, dishes, bags (I can no longer multitask when using for phone calls).

Switchimg to ambiance isn't that much of a sound difference and sounds like ears are plugged or are under water.

I wasn't a fan of the Airpods sound of the noise canceling feature but this is worse. I can't find a good quality earplug without noise canceling technology. Miss my old Samsung wired earbuds!

title: Voice is not stereo.
review: It’s not that good, what I thought. Practically my previous earphone is better than this one.

title: Some inconsistencies in use
review: Got this product so that I could use my old headphones with my new iphone SE. It works for allowing me to hear sound through the headphones, but when I tried it with Facetime, the people I was talking to couldn't hear me. So I found it to work for one purpose but not the other.

title: Inexpensive, attractive cord organizer option
review: I was looking for something simple to organize my earbud cords--this fit the bill.  I wish they had offered a deal on buying two, as even at the low price, you still kind of feel like you are paying a lot for what you get.  Still, it has worked for what I wanted, and I would recommend it.

title: These earbuds aren’t the quality that is advertised.
review: These earbuds operated for about 5 months, then only one would play or hold a charge. We tried multiple times to charge and pair them with multiple phones. Nothing worked. We now have one operating earbud that is constantly beeping because it’s searching for the other nonfunctional earbud.

title: Faulty Wiring!
review: I am on my third pair. Razer is nice enough of sending me replacements, butt I have gotten a short in every single headset I have owned. I am never going wired again...

title: Hey, these are pretty good.
review: They work pretty we.. Have been using them when I am shoveling snow and they are very nice. Sound quality is on par with my corded skullcandy. Have plenty of bass. Battery life seems to be good as well. Also have worn them for several hours and they do not become uncomfortable after longer periods like some of the other headphones I have owned. The over the ear piece is a floppy piece of silicone, but it seems to be enough resistance to keep them in place. I will be buying them again if I need replacements.

title: Comfy economical earphones
review:
The XClear Wireless Earbuds arrived in a nice Apple-like packaging. Included are the black rectangular charging case, left and right black earbuds, a short USB-C cable, and 3 various sized earcaps. For the price I did not expect much in terms of quality; however the plastic material has a nice matte feel to it. The angular exterior of the earbud pieces makes it stand apart from the Airpod.

Charging didn't take too long. My first impression wearing these was that they were very comfortable. I generally do not like earbuds but these are small enough that they don't cause pain after wearing them for a long time. Initially I thought the sound was a little tinny, however with a little adjustment I was able to get a better rich sound once the buds were properly seated in the canal. There's a definite lack of bass if you are into that.

Overall for the price I was very pleasantly surprised by the material and construction of the Xclear earbuds. Only time will tell if these will hold up but after testing for a few hours I can heartily give these two thumbs up!

title: Sounds AMAAZZZING! Fit was terrible!
review: I've had my fair share of IE monitors & over the ear headphones & as far as sound quality, imaging, sound stage, separation these are amazing. Bass was very present but not overwhelming. The highs were not sharp or sibilant at all. But when it came to the fit I couldn't get past 1/2 hour & I tried ALL of the tips, which FIIo does a great job of giving you plenty to chose from. But unfortunately for me these just killed my listening enjoyment.

title: Looks good buuuuuut
review: It holds my pair of Monoprice M1060's but it's so light that it moves around a lot. Depending on the material of your ear cup pads like with the M1060's are a thin pleather material which "sticks" a bit to the wood, makes it a bit of a pain to remove the headphones with one hand. The footing is very this so any movement of the stand or table or if the cable of your headphones are pulled a bit the stand will literally fly off any stand. But they do what they're meant to do which is to hold your headphones in a safe upright manner

title: Kind of disappointed! I had the Momentum over ear headphones & ...
review:
Kind of disappointed! I had the Momentum over ear headphones & they were amazing. Their fit was the problem. I've seen they corrected this on the Momentum 2's.

So I decided to get the in ear Momentums but the sound signature is "weird". They're okay but not as "memorable" as the over the ear or their CX models.

title: If you get a good seal to your ear they sound great and the ...
review:
Got a pair of these for Christmas 2014 for working out purposes.

PRO's
1. Very convenient
2. Works as intended
3. No issues of getting tangled or in the way of. My workouts

CON's
1. Not as loud as it could be. If you get a good seal to your ear they sound great and the volume is sufficient
2. But that's part of the issue. Trying to get and KEEP a good bud to ear seal is frustrating to say the least & a good seal lasts maybe a minute or two.

1.12.15 - I thought the magnets that clasped the 2 buds together didn't work but, oops user error the magnets do work very well I was not connecting in the most magnetic area.

Other the. That they're okay for the price I guess. Come to find out now in 2015 almost everyone and anyone who makes headphones are coming out with Bluetooth wireless headsets!!
On a scale from 1-10 is give these a solid 6.5 or weak 7
JBL needs to rethink the ear bud design & try to perfect the seal orrrrr crank up the amps so the volume can get higher

title: Works great
review: I was really torn between this Plantronics & the more expensive Discovery. I went the cheap-y route & was glad that I did. I only bought this for the Ca law & normally use my earbuds with my iPhone to listen to music. Other then that I just leave the plantronics in my car. But it sounds great, last a decent amount of time.

title: Disappointing
review: They don't do a very good job isolating noise. My old Shure in-ear headphones worked better. The fit also isn't that good. I find that I have to wear them with the cord curled over my ear for them to fit in my ear, but the cord is not long enough for that to be a very comfortable fit. The left and right cords come together much too close to my chin when worn that way.

title: The jack on these does not fit Nexus 4 with Google's official bumper
review: The plastic around the jack is too fat for use with a Nexus 4 that has a bumper on it. I'm really disappointed about that because I loved my Shure SE110 headset, and I was looking forward to this replacement. I'm returning these because they are useless with my current phone.

title: Covered damaged item as promised.
review: I submitted a claim for waterproof headphones that became damaged as a result of regular use.  The square trade offered me a solution that met my needs that same day.

title: Comfortable, secure, and easy to use.
review:
Out of the box, these earphones look surprisingly appealing and well-constructed. There's nothing "cheap" about themThey are very easy to connect to Bluetooth.
I use these earphones for running. They are a bit tight when placed over ears, but at the same time they stay on very well. I found ear cushions quite soft and comfortable. I think they sound perfectly fine for exercising. So far I had no problems as far as Bluetooth transmission: sound is crisp without any skipping. They worked when I was good 20 yards away from my phone.
I did find it difficult to locate "backwards/softer" button by feel while earphones are worn, but eventually got used to it.
Overall I think its a very nice "bang for the buck" product. Time will tell whether or not sweat will cause problems; so far it has not.

title: Easy to use and good sound, but few things can be improved.
review:
The player appears to be well constructed. It is also quite small and light. Transferring songs is pretty easy, but, as every other non iPod MP3 player, it doesn't support Apple Purchased AAC files, so those will need to be converted to MP3 format. I didn't use the enclosed headphones, so I can't comment on those, but, listening to songs while swimming, I found the sound to be very good. I clipped the player to my goggles and it felt nice and secure. I did try to use Blue Tooth pairing with iPhone while swimming, but, as was mentioned by some reviews, once the player is as inch or so underwater this function stops working. I will try to "tinker" with this a bit to see if I can get it to work, but so far no luck.
Now for cons. For one thing, there's no way to create playlists. The choice is straight play through all songs or shuffle. I had 5 playlists on my iPod, but now I'm forced to combine all of them or sync each one separately every time I use the player. That is the main reason I give this product 4 stars instead of 5. The other irritating thing is if you press "Stop" button while in Bluetooth mode the player automatically reverts to "memory play", so you have to re-connect to Bluetooth again. Volume and skip songs are adjusted by same buttons, so if you are not careful you will skip songs instead of adjusting the volume.
I hope that this player will be improved to allow playlists to be created; then it will become significantly better.

title: So far no leaks!!
review: This is my second pair of Swimbuds. I've always struggled finding headphones that would not leak while swimming.  It must be some anatomical issue with my ear canal, because I've tried at least a dozen headphones - and all of them leaked or fell out at some point.  These swim buds are so light that they actually stay in my ear.  Short cord doesn't get tangled up.  And I guess the Christmas-tree tips are a bit different because so far these headphones are the only one that have not leaked, but I do have to insert them deep into ear canal.  I use just a touch of petroleum jelly on tips to help the insertion and to moisturise ears, because these headphones (like most other waterproof headphones) can cause irritation of the external ear canal.  There are a lot of tips to choose from.  I use them in my Endless Pool, so I don't know how they will perform in regular pool during turns and flips, but my guess is because of their lightness they will work fine.  I don't care much for clarity of music during swimming, but I found sound to be quite acceptable with these headphones.

title: Finally the waterproof headphones that don't leak or fall out!
review:
I've tried about 10 different headphones for swimming; all of them either leaked or were falling out. I guess my ear canals refused to follow the evolution theory of Darwin and remained primitive. But finally I found something that even worked for me. I've been swimming with these amor about 2 years. These headphones have a very nice snuggle and comfortable fit, they don't leak or fall out after 45 mins swim in endless pool (I haven't tried them in a lap pool). The only peculiar thing is I found that if I wear them in proper orientation (that is left channel to left ear) I couldn't hear anything out of the left bud! However, when I reverse them and wear them "upside down" with right ear channel in the left ear, the sound is perfect and the buds still don't fall out. Short cord doesn't interfere with strokes or get tangled up.
These come with a myriad of different shapes and size buds, extension cord and very nicely packaged.
Overall I'm extremely satisfied with these - I think the money is well spent.

title: A SOLID PLAYER THAT PERFORMS
review:
My object: to find a RELIABLE budget MP3 player to use with my Bose Soundsport Free bluetooth earbuds while working out on my bike trainer.
Music Quality: Very good. A rich, full sound with good left-right separation. The EQ is a plus, but I was happy with the default sound settings.
Bluetooth: Despite using an older version of Bluetooth (2.1), The unit paired easily with my earbuds, and stayed paired. No flukey disconnects like I've experienced with budget no name players.
Performance: Reliable. Set it the way you want, turn it on and use it, shut it off when you're done, no nonsense.
Some people have complained about low volume. My experience was that you are given options in the setup menu which allow you to overcome that. I have the player volume at near maximum, and use the volume control on my earbuds to do the rest. There are 8 songs loaded on the player when you get it, but you can easily delete them when you hook it up to your computer. There is a 40 page instruction manual available as a pdf on Sandisk's website. The good: solid documentation of all features. The downside: a ponderous amount of info to absorb, but like me, I think most people will set it and forget it.

title: Budget Price, Excellent Display
review: I have an AGPTEK MP3 player, and it's not bad, but I can't read the dim, microscopic display, especially outside.  I was looking for something equally affordable with a display I could see and navigate without glasses.  In this respect, the Timmkoo excels.  The display is fantastic.  The BlueTooth 4.2 does a nice job of feeding the sound to my Bose wireless earbuds, and is easily connected. I like the BlueTooth screen, which is very easy to use.  The other day, I absentmindedly walked away from the Timkoo by about 20 feet, and realized I was still getting my music loud and clear.  I can walk around with the player in my pocket and listen, where I have to hold my other player in front of me or it cuts in and out.  Some reviewers have criticized the lack of features on this player, but for me, it's not a big deal, as I generally put the player on shuffle play, and just listen to whatever comes on.  I wish there was an EQ.  Overall, I think it's a pretty good package for the price, especially considering the highest rated MP3 players easily run north of $200.

title: Great idea, but not so great results
review: I purchased this to use in the gym with my iPod shuffle to avoid using wired earbuds.  In the sense that it eliminated the wires, it was a success, but in terms of musical fidelity and blocking out extraneous sound, it was a failure.  Back to my earbuds.

title: Left Earbud Inoperable
review: Left earbud doesn't work, only crackling and static. This is the first product I've ever had to return. Unfortunately, it seems to be a common problem, so I'm not going to bother exchanging them.

title: Sennheiser's Rock!!
review: The Sennheiser HD 229's are as all Sennheiser headphones always are...top notch! The sound they deliver is simply amazing. The bass is solid, midrange is perfect, and highs are precisely where they belong. Fact is these pull out instruments I wasn't hearing previously using ear bud head phones. My first pair I owned lasted a very long time. As a matter of fact, I would still be using them if they had not gone M.I.A.

title: Overrated, veiled, narrow sound stage
review:
I paid about $340 for a refurbished unit from the manufacturer, fulfilled by Amazon. This is one seriously overrated product, based on careful listening I did comparing these against AKG K702 and Sennheiser HD600 and Denon AHD2000. I would prefer all of these against the Audeze EL-8, though the EL-8's were more expensive than all of them at even the $340 refurbished price. The EL-8's are certainly not awful, but they sounded a bit dull and veiled, and their sound stage was quite narrow, very close to head. Hard to see how these were $700 headphones when they came out. One review compared these to the Audeze LCD-X, saying you get a lot of the sound of the X for just a fraction of the price. Nope. I also compared these to a friend's LCD-X (same music, same system), and I would take it the X over any other headphone I've heard.

I wanted to like these EL-8's. I truly did. I like the idea of planar magnetics, and Audeze seems like a quality manufacturer based in SoCal. The EL-8's are just surprisingly mediocre. The various raves I read about them online before purchasing make me question the accuracy of a lot of the audiophile press.

title: Teen approved!!
review: Bought these for my son who is notoriously hard on earbuds! He made a point to tell me yesterday how much he enjoys them - coming from a teen that says a lot!

title: Sturdy and Roomy for my Oculus Quest 2 and Gear
review: After adding the Elite Strap, Snap-on Headphones (I hate earbuds) and Controllers covered with Grips, my Oculus Quest 2 (OQ2) could not fit into the OQ2 Case or my Sarlar case for OQ2.  And, by squeezing this into Sarlar case the strap broke.  However, I learned that elite strap breakage was pretty common so I ordered another elite strap and started looking for a padded case that I could arrange to accommodate my OQ2 and gear.  This one is a bit over the top in terms of what I originally wanted but it will protect my OQ2 and gear.

title: For the clumsy users, like me.
review: Literally the first day I owned my Sony's I dropped them, leaving a nice deep scratch in the case and one of the earpieces. I'm usually great with taking care of electronics, but for some reason I found myself dropping these dang Sony's every other week. I decided enough was enough, I didn't want my own inability to hold onto a case to cause me to have to replace the whole thing or lose an earpiece someday. Fortunately for me, this product exists! Between the extra bulk and the textured sides, even my apparently clumsy self hasn't managed to drop my earbuds since putting this case on my case. Case-ception is the way to go for sure, just hope you don't mind the extra pocket space. I only really use them while hiking, walking, biking, or whatever when I have a backpack or jacket to put them in anyways. Either way, great product. Added sense of security is great, hope you're all better than me at holding onto things though.

title: Good fit
review: I'm glad I bit the bullet and tried these although they are not name brand. I chose these because I wear glasses and around the ear don't stay and over the ear headphones eventually hurt my head from pressing on my glasses. I got them for watching videos while treadmilling it and they have not fallen out yet. Sound quality is good, but my usage is to work and exercise in them, not sip brandy in a leather chair and try to decipher every note. The battery life is good, I haven't run out yet. I will update if they end up being trash.

title: Get what you pay for
