On top of that, they are also great for blocking external noise so now I also wear them when my dog starts barking at the neighbor's dog! :D

title: Sound quality
review:
1. Description.
Crystal crisp treble and this is true.
But where is bass - no bass at all, and this is supposed to be in the description.
2. Reviews.
I am very surprised by such a high rating.
I'm not a big fan of bass, but it is not possible to listen when there are only high frequencies.
3. Action.
I have listened to these earbuds for 3 days, I thought I'd get used. After 3 days I understood it's impossible to get used to it.
Sent back for full refund.
4. Conclusion
The complete absence of low frequencies, as well as
excessive bass and a negative effect on a person, causing a
headache, which ultimately can lead to problems with hearing.
Come on guys, save our ears.
I am fully confident the product not usable!

title: great sound
review: Where to start! These headphones are amazing! Very well made. Comes with bag for storage and a charger cord. The sound with these headphones is amazing. I listen to everything from rap to orchestra and all sound so wonderful. Easy off and on button, and it announces to you when it is turned on and when it is shutting down. There is a volume button right on the headphones. These are wireless, or can be plugged in.  Not heavy at all. I'm very pleased I got these. I also bought a pair for the hubby. He loves his too.

title: Great
review: The sound is very good. They work as well as the iphone earbuds without the microphone.  I recommend these, I have bought numerous buds these are my fav's so I bought several!

title: Sony Quality and Design
review:
My FAVORITE headphones!
Great sound, comfortable, durable and a great selection for those who like a little more than what earbuds have to offer!

title: Original package was open and product was broken.  I returned it.
review: The headphones were very inexpensive and I should have remembered the old maxim, You Get What You Pay For.  But I did not expect the packaging to be already open and the headphones were broken. I returned them and did not want to try again with the same product.

title: All were great, but for some reason my ears became very ...
review:
I bought these headsets after trying about 4 different others. Turtlebeach PX22/X31, Skull Candy, and a nameless brand. All were great, but for some reason my ears became very very sore after about 2 or so hours of use. I was in need of a headset that didn't break the bank, but was still comfortable. I saw a youtuber recommend these and decided to give it a go. All I can say is these are an extremely comfortable headset for the money that feels very similar to more expensive options ranging in the 200 - 300 dollar amount. It comes with a nice set of goodies, thick cord, simple setup and best of all Kingston has a nice warranty for them as well. The detachable mic is also a plus for when you aren't chatting or using it.

Only negatives are that for big headed people like myself it takes an extra minute or two to adjust it so its comfortable. Not really a con to me, but might be for others.

title: Sounds good, cancels noise, hurts my ears
review:
This headset does cancel noise, and the sound is clear. That part is fine. For the not-so-fine parts: they're really tight, and they cancel noise almost too well.

The tightness:
Right away, I felt that they squeezed my ears too much. I left them to stretch across several hard-bound books for a few days which loosened them up for a while, but they eventually go back to their original tightness that I can't wear them for more than 15 minutes at a time. My ears get squashed and they hurt to leave on, and I don't even have a big melon head!

The noise-cancelling:
While they do block out outside noise, they cancel my own voice out too, and I feel like I'm talking into a blanket by myself - I can barely hear myself talk. It's very disconcerting.

All in all, if they weren't so darn tight, I think I'd like them better. I had to dock 1.5 stars because of the physical discomfort, and .5 star for the talking-into-an-echoless-void factor. The sound quality is good, though. So, if you have a smallish head, and you like having all the outside sound shut out, they may work for you.

title: Great features, excellent battery life
review:
Pros: great sound, and has amazing battery life. Little magnets click to hold the earbuds together around your neck if you aren't using them, and the audio stream automatically turns off in this position. And, the stream turns on again when separated, if the earbuds are still on. Pairs easily with other devices, unlike other earbuds that I've tried, which seem to get very confused and would only turn one ear on, or was finicky and didn't want to connect, etc. These connect quickly and surely (I don't know how else to put it!).

Cons: none really. The only (mild) complaint I have is that the light that indicates whether or not the earbuds are still on after they've been hanging around your neck without being used is in a spot that's hard to see. You kind of have to skootch the whole thing away from yourself so it's not directly under your chin where you can't see it, and even then, you have to angle the switch toward you to see whether the light is on. (Such First World Problems.) Beyond that, no other complaints!

title: Works well for sleeping
review:
I wanted some headphones that were flat and wouldn't hurt my ears or fall out and get lost while I was trying to go to sleep. These work just fine. The speakers lie flatly against my head and don't poke or feel lumpy. I only use them for sleeping, though, not for exercising, so I can't say how easy or difficult it would be to remove the speakers and controller to wash the headband part.

Sound is fine. They don't go into your ear like regular earbuds, so you have to turn the volume up a little, but it does what it should. I haven't tried to control the volume using the buttons on the headband so I can't really rate that aspect. All in all, it does what I wanted it to.

title: Was great until app no longer available
review:
The only way to customize these headphones with the colors that you want is with the app. Well the app is no longer available on the App Store. So how can I customize my headphones now? I can change the different colors but in order to do three colors at once or two colors at once I have to have the app.

Way to support your customers.

The app is available in Google play store though. Doesn’t help that I have an iPhone. :(

Otherwise these headphones are great. And I like that you can cast what you’re listening to, to another pair of wearhaus headphones.

title: Arrived in one day
review:
Arrived very fast. So far so good. Still learning the controls so they are not responding sometimes or I accidentally activate Siri! I replaced 2 of my LED wireless headphones (one ECandy another a different brand but exact same) one the battery last less than 5 hours the other one used to last 8 hrs without LEDs but now only lasting about 6 hours and sound leaks through the metal "mesh" where the LEDs show from. So I had to be careful with how loud and which song I listen to. Now with these headphone, I don't hear any noise leaks and I don't have to worry about it.
These headphones also fit nice and secure to my head/ears and I wear glasses and these are still comfortable.

I love the app because I can change the colors of the headphone. I think it would be cool to have one side one color and the other another color.

Overall, these are great headphones so far and I don't really hear outside noises too much. :) I still think the price is still a bit high and I wish they were foldable but like the headphone stand it came with in box. =P

title: These are really nice headphones
review: I ordered the white ones and they are pretty nice looking. Most of my music only gets the red lights and some will get the blue lights (2nd row). I have yet to find one that gets all 3 LED lights. I enjoy the sound, more so over my around the ear $20 bluetooth headphones. I do like when it connects to my iPhone, it not only displays the bluetooth icon but there is a small battery meter next to it as well so I can monitor the battery life of the headphones. The only thing I'm not very fond of, is the fact that others will also be able to hear what music you're listening to through the LED light feature. It's not as loud but you can still hear the music coming from the mesh over the LEDs.

title: What a great Value
review: What a great Value for these headphones and they have a great sound and they are lightweight to boot.

title: Good, short cord, fit is adequate
review: I'd like it if the cord was a bit longer.  It's actually the length they say.  I may need an extender cord because I sit with my laptop off to the side of my desk. Otherwise fine. The fit is good. Sound is good, clear and loud.  Not super hi fidelity, but at this price I was looking only for an over-the-ear headphone.

title: Good headphones for a good price.
review: Got a swarming pack of daughters?  Buy these by the dozens.  You'll need lots.  Good headphones for a home overrun with kids.  Good sound, sturdy enough and good price.

title: Silent Right (update)
review:
My right earbud just stopped working. I purchased these less than a month ago and all-of-a-sudden the right ear stopped working. Aside from that the sound quality is excellent. Softest setting is still quite loud.

(Update) replacement pair got the same problem. Right ear is going out and I'm 2 days passed the return window.

title: Mostly because I didn’t know any better. I would use whatever was the cheapest earbuds ...
review: For the longest time I wasn’t that concern about audio quality. Mostly because I didn’t know any better. I would use whatever was the cheapest earbuds I could buy at the local discount store. A few years ago I was gifted some Beyerdynamic T770 80ohm earphones. I would say they were and are life changing. I realized how much more amazing music was. There was details in the music that I had never heard before. However, they are bulky over the ear and not practical for every day around the city wear. I decided to look for a pair of IEM and came by the Final Audio E2000’s. I did try a few other but E2000’s are the best so far. They have a detailed balanced sound. The bass is good but not over powering. They are very easy to listen to for long sessions. The Final’s are also very comfortable to wear.  Some reviews have mention concerns about built quality. They don’t have reinforcement on the cable stress point. I personally don’t know if this will be an issue and only time will tell. For now, I would highly recommend them.

title: If you are looking for a good inexpensive over the ear headphone this is the way ...
review:
If you are looking for a good inexpensive over the ear headphone this is the way to go. I have never used anything else other then cheap discount store earphones or apple earbuds. The Monoprice blows them away. The only downside side is the clamping force is a bit much. I am getting used to it.

.

title: Please Do Not Waste Your Money on Buying Broken Equipment
review: I normally never bother with negative reviews.  However this product needs a warning for other ‘potential’ buyers.  These earbuds broke after 30 minutes of use.  I powered it up exactly like instructions.  After 30 minutes the battery lost its charge and I was unable to charge them again.  Please pay more money to purchase a pair of working ear buds.  The low price is tempting but not worth receiving an already broken piece of junk.

title: Easy syncing.
review: Easy to charge, easy to sync with devices/blue tooth. I like the size and the convenience of these headphones.

title: Very Good Product—Recommended
review:
Amended Jan 18, 2019:
I am upgrading my rating, as after resetting the earbuds and power cycling my iPhone, low volume issues and sound quality resolved.
———
These earbuds, the soundPEATS in-ear Bluetooth 5.0, are very well made, charge easily and quickly, and pair without difficulty. The sound is very good and they fit easily into the ear. The buds can drop out IF you don’t put them in properly (tightly into the ear canal). The earbuds are Bluetooth v5.0 and stay connected to my iPhone (no dropping signal). I am quite pleased with this item and recommend it.

title: A Very, Very Good Bluetooth Earpiec--Clear Sound On Both Ends Of Calls
review:
I have lost more Bluetooth earpieces than I can count. Many have been Plantronics, a few others have been from other manufacturers. This one is the best I've had and I hope to keep it for a very long time.

It has the clearest sound on my end ever, and callers I've asked about call quality on their end say it is exactly as good as when I use my iPhone's own microphone without a headset.

A full charge gives the 12 hours talk time advertised and that's no empty claim. It sips power. It also pairs easily and maintains its connection.

This is a very good earpiece and I recommend it highly. AND it's relative low cost means you can buy as many replacements as necessary if you, as do I, lose them with regularity.

title: Super long charging life and great sound!
review: I left the headphones on overnight and they are still going strong w/o any additional charge! Great sound for the price- i bought 3 so far just to have them at my home and office

title: Love them
review: Love these headphones, the looks of these are great, not to mention the sound quality. You get the highs and the lows. They fit comfortable in the ears and the cord is long enough. I will differently love these headphones.

title: Great pair of earphones
review: I love, love, love these. The price the quality and the sound. There is nothing to hate about these headphones. I showed a pair to my wife and she wanted a pair. The presentation was great it made you even more excited about the product, I love the base that's it offers and it does great with the Tribble.

title: No bass
review: I am a huge music lover. I listen to all kinds of it and for hours a day. The first song I listened to with these headphones was Pillowtalk by Zayn, which is a bass-heavy song. I immediately noticed there was no bass to speak of with these earbuds. That's just not acceptable for me, so I'm returning them.

title: Sound quality with these is terrible
review:
I ordered these because I rearranged my desk setup at work and needed to extend the length of my existing earbuds without spending too much money.

This cable feels like it's made really well, but the difference in sound quality when using this cable vs. just my earbuds is too much for me to ignore. It sounded very tinny, muted, and there was almost no bass. I ended up returning them.

title: Unfortunately, has some flaws...
review:
I suffer from tinnitus and listen to white noise or meditation videos on YouTube while trying to sleep--otherwise the ringing is just too distracting. I have been using earbuds for the past two years, but for various reasons no longer wish to use them. So I ordered SleepPhones, hoping they would eliminate the need for uncomfortable ear buds.

I have tried these for two nights in a row. Both nights I woke up with the cord around my neck; the band had shimmied to the top of my head (read: speakers not where they need to be); and I was sweating from the fleece (maybe I need to wait to review until the temperature has dipped below 80 degrees where I live). Plus, the speakers only offer any significant volume when my phone volume is turned on high--even then, I wish I could get it a bit higher.

I was really hoping these would be a good alternative to earbuds, but I think I will continue to be disappointed and am out $35...

title: Great sound for the price.
review: I had rated these as a five star but I am editing my review.  The headphones were great, but the quit working.  So, I bought another pair of the same headphones, and then those quit working as well.  Two strikes and you're out.

title: Comfy
review: These are great earbuds. They fit well, connect with Bluetooth easily and sound great!

title: Not just good for the price, just plain GOOD
review: Fantastic purchase!  Pairing is super easy, battery life is amazing, and the range is outstanding.  The only reason it didn't get 5 stars is because the bass is almost non-existant.  I know that's a common issue with wireless ear buds but I've had pairs with better.  Now, I only bought them to listen to podcasts so not having bass isn't an issue.  The vocal sound quality is on the same par as the $150 earbuds. Overall very satisfied with them.

title: No strings attached
review: I am enjoying my headphones. With this product it is totally hands free as the 🎤 for phone calls are built-in to the headset. This is one of my best purchases thus far.

title: Cancel sounds around
review: I bought this headphone for my daughter and she loves it. Nice cancelation is really good, as sometimes I am talking to her and she can't hear anything I am saying while using the headphones.

title: Worked up to the warranty period!
review: I bought these as started earbuds for myself. I often lose them so I didn’t want to have to replace 150 dollar earbuds. They were working just fine until the warranty date passed. Now, I’m stuck with only a right earbud because the left refuses to charge or connect.

title: The Range and Quality of each Call!
review: The product is exactly what I was looking for to assist with speaking to clients within my business. It allows me the freedom to walk around without an interference. The range is 350 feet and I use all 350 feet of it as I do a great deal away from the desk! The headset works with most phones but it also states to call to make sure. It works perfectly fine with my VoIP phone system. Sound is perfect, you might have to adjust the volume a little but not much!

title: Disappointing life expectancy
review:
I had so badly wanted a decent pair of wireless earbuds that I ignored the complaints and warnings about these earbuds having issues.

For a month or so, these worked amazingly. They hooked up to my Note 8 with no issues. The sound quality was pretty good for such a small device; not mind-blowing, but good. Everything was inline with the product reviews I'd read online.

Unfortunately, as of this morning the left earbud has become so quiet I would call it useless. One earbud quieting has been reported by many users. I hoped I'd be one of the lucky ones who didn't run into the issue, but that's turned out not to be the case.

I am surrounded by Samsung products and I love the brand, but I've chosen to return these rather than fuss with sending them in for repairs. They shouldn't need repairs after 1 month or so of use.

For the record, I used these on my daily commute and while out and about. They never got sweaty or wet. They're not clogged up. They've never been dropped or misused. I put them on to charge and the next time I went to use them, the left earbud had quit.

I gave two stars because while they worked, they were amazing. I just wish they'd lasted longer.

title: Are these actually Samsung Headphones?
review:
Pros: Cheap!

Cons: Horrible sound output!

Sorry, but I'm not 100% convinced these aren't knock-offs. I bought these to replace a different pair of stock Samsung earbuds for my Note 4 after my dog decided they looked like a good snack.

After actually using through a morning commute, I'm confident with the conclusion that these are either knock-offs or refurbished. They have horrible sound output!

I'm not am audiophile and I don't expect stock earbuds to "wow" me with their amazing range. But with these there's NO bass whatsoever. The range seems to be limited to the higher notes. Everything sounds hollow too. I have to turn the volume up way past the recommended volume to hear much of anything.

I guess another was of putting it is that these are a GREAT pair of $7.00 earbuds. They don't seem like a decent replacement for the stock Samsung earbuds that came with my Note 4.

Are these really Samsung earbuds?

title: Added Bluetooth to my aging laptop.
review: Can finally use my Bluetooth headphones with my laptop.  Working very well in linux mint.  Very happy.

title: Avantree NC Headphones are very good
review:
I DID NOT intend or want to spend 300-500 $ for this type of headphone; this model seems to suit me very well for home and travel use and I am one happy camper...also enjoy 2 day shipping when available!
Thanks Amazon...

title: Over 1,000 hours of working perfectly
review: I use my headphones extensively; about 20-30 hours/week. I’ve had these almost 11 months, and they worked great until recently. I’m rough w headphones using them in a variety of weather conditions. So although they lasted 11 months, they worked great for about 1,000 hours!!  I give them 5 stars for lasting that long.

title: Great sound for a great price!
review: Lots of colors, so at a glance everyone knows whose earbuds are whose!  Great sound for a modest price.  My kids ASK for these.  I buy them each several pair a year.

title: Great Cable
review: Well constructed. Excellent quality. No detectable noise.  It is being used in a circumstance where the absolute BEST connection is needed....it is connecting a PreSonus interface into a Magni 3 headphone amp. Extremely important that the audio quality not degrade or change.  This is the best it's going to get if you have to use this type of cable.

title: Perfect
review:
Do you want an accurate mix when you cannot use your monitors? Tired of blowing hours using headphones only to hear a terrible mix?

These are the best I've used, and I have used virtually everything from closed to semi to ear buds to full-out multi-hundred dollar performance in-ear monitors.

These are the most comfortable, do not hurt your ears on long sessions, remarkable frequency response, and the most important of all, an absolutely non-colored flat mix. I was astounded when I recorded a quick reference track to play back on crap computer speakers - just to check the accuracy. Blown away. Buy them and stop wasting time looking around. I would say depending on price flux, you can nab these or go with the Presonus'. Just buy the 8400's over the 6400, there's really no point in debating the difference per price eval.

One star off the bass because although you can hear sonically accurate bass, for some reason they will not reproduce the full (fill in the blank) spectrum of your kick drum.

title: Kinda weird but works well!!!
review:
Very strange design but actually works really well.

I don’t like corded earbuds as they pull on my ears. I love wireless but don’t want to lose them and my ears don’t hold them well, especially during exercise.

This little device works really well. Keeps me from losing them. But, also keeps them from tugging down on my ears.

Only downside is it’s hard to fit in all my layers during cold weather bike rides. Do I put it on the outside and then worm the cord under everything?? Or under everything and not be able to get to them easily?? Still haven’t solved this conundrum but I think that’s my problem and not a design flaw.

Definitely a worthwhile purchase for me.

I use this for biking and hiking and occasionally just grocery shopping.

title: Works but are uncomfortable.
review:
I’ve been contemplating getting these for a long time. I need something for hiking and biking so I can hear ambient noise for safety.

Pleased that it works. Unfortunately, the headset is quite uncomfortable. They press on my ears, kinda forcing them to fold forwards. After 10+ minutes, this becomes painful. It’s even worse when worn with a bike helmet.

A headset redesign is desperately needed but the technology definitely works.

title: Surprisingly helpful.
review:
I struggle with my AirPods falling out at the most inopportune times. I was looking for some sort of clip but found these.

When I wear wired headphones, they end up pulling down (painfully) on my ears after awhile. So far this setup hasn’t.

I’ve been wearing them for both hiking and biking. I haven’t had to frequently retrieve my AirPods from the ground since starting to use them.

I like the magnets too.

I’m still looking for the perfect solution but these are a good start.

title: Meh
review:
Meh. I got my first AirPods recently. I was thrilled with them. So much better than corded headphones.

I upgraded to these because they are supposed to be “better”. Not really. They are less comfortable. They fall out all the time. They are slimey and gross feelings when sweaty.

The noise cancellation is real. It’s amazing how much it cuts out though I rarely want to be cut off like this. I can’t hear the doorbell (I literally missed being informed about a gas leak in my neighborhood because of this) and it’s dangerous on a bike. If you leave it open for ambient noise there’s a lot of crackling sounds from wind or it shifting in your ear.

Also the mic seems poorer - or at least my family complains more they can’t understand me more often with these than the previous hard AirPods ( the ones without the silicone ear piece.)

title: Exactly what I needed.
review: Exactly what I needed. I've had a set of plantronics duel headset for years (since 2009 I think) and the foam on the ears was just disintegrating.  This was a perfect replacement.  It was quite hard to get the new ones on - to do so, I had to remove the inner foam - but then on they went and they are perfectly comfortable without the extra foam.

title: Falls out just as easy or easier than standard ipod ear buds
review: I'm pretty critical of my body but the one body part I've never felt bad about are my ears.  They are neither big or small.  They don't stick out, they don't sit oddly close to my head.  They are all around very average ears but these headphones don't work for me.  The part that is supposed to go behind my ear just slips off - it seems like maybe they are too big?  Not sure.  Sound quality is similar or better than standard ipod ear buds but since these won't stay on, there's no point.

title: Nice not to have earbud tangles
review: Nice not to have earbud tangles. Saw it on "I want that" on HGTV. Came in a timely manner and packaged well by both the manufacturer and supplier.

title: Smallest I've seen - Comfy when sleeping
review:
This is the smallest earbud I've seen. On spy shows the agents have these tiny comm devices they put in their ears... these are about that size.

I got these for listening to sounds when I sleep. I've tried several other brands and even the smallest ones I purchased had some slight discomfort. These did not. The rubber on the outside is very soft. I knew they were there but didn't wake up with any ear pain. They also didn't fall out all night. There's a couple bags of different size ear caps and ear tips but I used the ones that came on them and they were fine. Sometimes when I take out an earbud the rubber tip will pop off and stay in my ear. But I suspect if I try another size ear tip I could fix that.

Connectivity was not an issue. Just worked. And unlike the other brand I reviewed, both ears have a good solid connection, even when in my ear sandwiched between my skull and the pillow.

Noise cancellation - with the eartips fitting in tight, it does provide more noise cancellation than I expected. Not active but it dulls the outside world a bit.

The only downside is that the sound is a little thin. There's not a lot of low end. And the max volume isn't blasting loud. But it was plenty loud for me and I didn't need to listen at full volume. I suspect both of these things are due to the small size.

title: Outstanding Customer Service
review:
These seem great. However, the first pair we received only worked in one ear. The replacement pair worked just fine until two weeks after getting them when the folding piece broke! I'm not going to mess with getting a 3rd pair. I'm going to order my son a better quality pair of headphones!
**UPDATE TO REVIEW**
After posting this review I was contacted by the company. They not only refunded the purchase price, they sent a new pair of a newer version of the headphones. The new pair is great! We've had them for quite some time and they are working perfectly without issues. After dealing with this company and their outstanding customer service, I would now highly recommend these headphones!

title: Right earbud stopped working! Got a replacement & just purchased a new pair
review:
Good headphones but not for running. They can fall out of your ears. *****Update... The right one is no longer working. What a disappointment!

1st time - 1 star- got a replacement for ear bud. Just purchased again today. It's kinda early to tell if they work.

title: Did not work with note 10.
review: Purchased for my note 10. Long story short, did not work with that phone. I guess you could use it for normal headphone use, but if you're looking for a DAC for HD/Hi-Res audio, may not work for your device.

title: Excellent affordable Bluetooth earbuds
review:
These earbuds are very reasonably priced and have very good sound. I tested them against my wired Bose earbuds and although these do not sound as good, they do hold their own to the Bose.

They connect to Bluetooth very easy and have not lost the connection as others have mentioned. In addition these earbuds have on/off buttons but you never have to even worry about that as they turn on when you remove them from the charging case and turn off when you put them down to charge. Just make sure you see the lines on either side moving which assures you the earbud is being charged.

I like the usb c capability. I use usb c for my phone so that is a plus. Also a nice usb c cord comes with the unit.

I used the earbuds on a phone call and had no issues. The comfort is very good, also comes with I believe three sets of black Buds to fit your individual preference. Battery life seems long plus you always have the case to charge them if needed.

If you want an inexpensive set of earbuds that won’t disappoint, these are a good choice. If you have a teenager who wants a set, these also would make a very good choice. All in all these are impressive at this price point and I recommend them.

title: My mother picked these
review:
I wanted to get my mother some earbuds so she could listen to her music better. I showed her a couple of options and she selected these. Among the ones she looked at, she liked that these stick out of your ears since she's afraid the lower profile ones might either get stuck in your ears or somehow damage your eardrums (shrug emoji).

As far as sound goes, the tonal quality might not be as good as much higher priced earbuds. But unless you want to spend top dollar on premium brands, these sound good enough for the price. I noticed right away that the noise cancellation seems to work really well. Haven't tried the mic yet, so may update this review again in the future.

title: Great case for my Sony earbuds
review: This is a great carry case for my Sony earbuds and charger. Looks very compact, sturdy, and professional

title: Fire! Great headphones, especially for the price
review: Received my new headphones early after very quick shipping. What can I say, they're FIRE! The design is sleek, the red color pops, and the fit is comfortable. Most importantly, they sound great! Listened to a couple tracks and heard both the bass thumps and the high tones. These will definitely be my headphones of choice, especially when I travel/fly. The price is great for the quality you get. Highly recommend!

title: Great for Working Out
review:
I Love this item. I work out at a gym just about everyday, lift weights and cardio. The earbuds stay in my ear, while moving around and the reception is very clear. I like how the item tells me if my battery is high or low. It is light weight around my neck. I highly recommend
this item. I would also recommend to keep the headset in the box if you carry a gym bag or back pack, this way the headset won't brake.

title: Wonderful buds !!!
review:
I am about 80% happy with these

Update. These earbuds are totally amazing. 5 stars from me. I can hear things in music I have never heard in my songs !! I love them.

review: I gave this 3 stars because this thing is huge.  The earphones were in the back of my head and there wasn't enough velcro to close it.  But do not hesitate to buy this.  This is only my review.  I wish it did fit.  It's nice material.  Nicely made. It was just too big for me.  Make your own choice

review: My husband has to use these when he plays BF3 because otherwise i am forced to hear the machine gun and helicopters, etc. These headphones came recommended from a fellow gamer because they are surround so when he plays, he can hear what direction the sound is coming from. so if an opponent is coming up behind him, then he can hear it. Pretty great. Definately worth the money.

title: High quality for good price
review: These are actually pretty decent earbuds for the price. Actually, my wife has a pair that cost more and these give them a run for the money. They charge quickly, battery life seems to be fairly decent and pairing them to my devices was very easy. Now I can watch videos and not disturb my wife.

title: This is very nice
review: I guess I was expecting something cheaply made, but this is actually very well made. It came in and I was excited to try it out. It turned on and before I knew it it was on and a couple of minutes later the DVD was playing. Picture quality is nice. I like that you have player function on the actual unit and the screen. Volume seemed a little low but I haven’t seen if headphones would be a better way to go. For the price this is really neat and I’m sure to get lots use out of it. I would recommend it.

title: Heavy on my head. Otherwise ok.
review:
Ive had this headphones set for over a year now and it does the job, BUT it is too heavy. Any day when I have a lot of meetings and use it for extended periods of time, the top of my skull hurts. Literally hurts. I noticed it in the beginning but decided to keep it and give it a try. Well, I still use it every day.
I would invest in a cordless set if I were to buy it now, because this long cord is also a pain.
Overall will do the job.

title: Bad Headset, SquareTrade stepped up and made it right.
review: Had problem with headset a few months after purchase, Amazon not much help, Manufacturer even worse. SquareTrade stepped up and made it right.

title: I do not recommend these earbuds.  They have a serious design flaw.
review:
I would have easily given these earbuds 4 or 5 stars, if it wasn't for the "low battery" warning. JLAB clearly put no thought into this. Here are my issues:

1) The first low battery warning occurs about 5 minutes before the battery dies . So if you just started your jog, or just got on the bus, you're screwed. With 6 hours of play time, the low battery notification should give you at least 20 minutes notice. Since you are almost always "out and about" when listening to headphones, it would be nice to have enough juice to finish your activity or get where you are going.

2) The low battery message (which is verbal) repeats FREQUENTLY for the brief remainder of your battery life, constantly interrupting your music. This is so annoying you wind up taking the earbuds off.

Since the earbuds are essentially useless once you get the first low battery warning, the warning serves no purpose. Giving the low battery warnings at the 30, 20 and 10 minute marks would be far less annoying and actually give you a chance to get to a charger.

title: Awarkward & Static
review: It's very hard to find an inexpensive headset for a portable home phone that is comfortable & works.  This on works on either ear.  I'm a lefty & had no trouble adjusting so worked on my left ear, but found it very uncomfortable to wear.  The fit is awkward.  (If it helps anyone, I'm female, 5' 2" - have a small head - even a size Small motorcycle helmet is big on me & have long straight thin hair.)  I got for use on portable phone, not cell.  People I called said they had a hard time hearing me & heard static.  It had good reviews but I found it to be junk and a total waste of money.  I was very disappointed.  I also bought the GE T126593, which by comparison, was fantastic, loud, clear & comfortable.

title: So far, so good
review: I had a 4 port USB hub but I was in need of more, so I got this 7 port hub. It has a nice long cord so it allows for beter placement, lit up power on lights, and enough slots all 3.0 to allow me to charge my phone, Kindle, power charger, external hard drive, headphones etc.

title: Smaller then you think, beware.
review:
Pros. Made of metal, so its heavy duty.
Cons. Size isn't accurate when you see the picture. It is ALOT smaller then you think it is. If made for a little kids headphones, it is represented correctly, but mine hang over the side of the thing, not all inside the hook part. The 2 screws are super tine, need the number 1 screwdriver bit and its a bit difficult to secure because there is not a lot of room, you will need a long number 1 bit and a cordless to secure them, or a drill measured absolutely perfect, pre-drill and then use a number 1 hand held screwdriver to fasten the screws. The take, although very sticky works well, it was very hard to remove the plastic top to it. They should have made it easier with a little extra pull tab on it. I ended up using a razor knife and still took me over 5 minutes to pull the tab off so I could use the tape on it. Overall, I give it a 3 Bob, for the inconvenience and misrepresentation of its actual size. They can say all day long its "This" big, but its the picture that sells it to us, we want to know its the right size fit.

title: I heard these were like professional quality but i found them to be way ...
review: I heard these were like professional quality but i found them to be way less then that. I got a 20 dollar set of Behringer headphones that sound much better. These have a tinny sound to them, as well as when listening with them, i hear what sounds like an old 33 1/3 record scraping sound through them.  I do like the heavy duty cord but thats not worth a thing if the sound quality is jacked.

title: Bad headphones
review: I have had these for a couple of months now, thinking that my sound coming into the headphones was just low, like thats what you get. Then today, out of the blue, while wearing them, they started being loud, like, the way they should be working. I had actually jumped up and thought wow, this is what they are supposed to sound like, i didn't do anything to make the change though. They worked properly for about an hour, and just a little while ago, they went back to very quite sound. I tapped the headset, wiggled the wire etc, but cant get the sound as it should be. Going to toss these and get a better set for sure. I guess i got what i paid for.

title: Great buy
review: For the price these are excellent. I mostly listen to podcasts with them and the sound is clear and crisp. Music comes through well too. Far better than the budget ones I previously bought. Though the sound quality isn't as good as my expensive headphones, these are great for movies in bed or listening while doing chores.

title: As advertised, they work well and give great sound
review: These do exactly what you want them to do, especially useful with a phone that has a USB-C input but no earbud input. We have only had them a week, but have used them non-stop and they have been reliably great. I love that they come with a carrying case, even if we haven't used it yet. With family visiting, even trying to sleep has been a task with all the commotion/chaos, so these have been lifesavers for keeping all that noise away.

review: I hate earbuds, they hurt my ears, but I like to listen to podcasts while doing boring, mindless, wrote tasks at work. These are an excellent alternative to really big headband headphones, small enough to be subtle but they don't have to be jammed into my ears. The sound quality is great- I occasionally take them off while the sound is playing to make absolutely sure it isn't audible to the people around me, it's that crisp and loud. But it isn't! Very satisfied with this purchase.

title: An adaptor cable that finally works.
review:

I recently purchased wireless headphones so they don't get much use any more.

title: So far, works as advertised. Unobtrusive and allows ...
review: So far, works as advertised. Unobtrusive and allows me to plug my headphones into my iPhone with the case on.

review:
Perhaps not the fault of this particular earphone.
I bought these based on favorable reviews and low price. However, just like all previous earbuds I've tried, they sound tinny and
just wont stay in my ears. I guess it's just the shape of my ears. I'll just stick with my Grado SR80s.

review: I was highly skeptical at first but these are 10x better than ios stock. So far sound quality is like listening with high dollar headphones.  Phone calls are fine. So far no one has complained. I plan to buy a spare set

review: Can;t buy just a few, but a good value even if I only use two of them.  I have a pair of connected wireless earbuds, 1More "Pistons", and here is a wire connecting left and right so I do not have to worry about losing an earbud if one should fall out, but they came with no clip. review: My wife tears through headphones on her MP3 player with her Audio books.  These appear to standup better.

review: My wife is very hard on earbud type headphones, usually not lasting more than a few weeks per pair. So, I do not want to pay a lot for earbuds. She aso only listens to books on tape, but constantly - so I don't need a lot of high fidelity.  These appear to be a good value.  We'll se after she opens them (Christmas Stocking stuffer) and has them for a few weeks.

title: Good but could be softer
review: I think for the price point, these headphones are excellent. I will tell you, after wearing them for more than an hour laying down, they can begin to hurt your ear a bit, but again for the price, you can’t beat them. I recommend them if you don’t want to spend an arm and a leg. I do wish they were padded more inside where the speakers rest.

review:
Great headset at a great price. I really love the fit and sound quality of the headset. The only recommendation I can think of is that it would be nice if you had longer from the time you got the low battery warning to when the headset actually shut off from the battery dying.

Other than that, everything else great.

review: The headset allows me to be on the phone and  work on the computer all day without straining my neck. Very comfortable and great sound quality

review: Yes it’s expensive, choose items carefully. They have many options and I unfortunately originally chose the wrong one. Huge headset. I purchased two smart TVs and it is still difficult to find the best option two use I have Bluetooth connection as not to annoy another person. So currently I have three of these devices. title: Works great comfort plus
review: I have tried so many different Bluetooth connections to no avail. The battery life in this unit is great, the sound is clear, the headphones are comfortable and I think they are awesome

title: Great sound.  Battery could be better
review: I really like my beats earbuds. The only thing that could be better is the battery life.

title: Comfortable
review: Comfortable, great fitting, snug headset great for long, hand free drives or just walking around hands free. Battery lasts all day and the range is great. Noise cancellation on this headset is immaculate and the pillow soft ear support makes the hands fee worth while. This is a great headset I highly recommend it 🥰

title: Case does not closes
review: I don’t like that the item is JUST a silicone case that does not close securely. There is no clip, clamp, or zipper NO way to keep your headphones secure

title: Almost perfect
review:
First night: really soft fabric and material. So soft that the contours to keep the fabric off the eyes are very shallow. I could feel my lashes brushing against the fabric when I blinked. I won't be able to use this for naps/meditation when I have makeup on. It did 100% block out light, even when I shifted my sleeping positions, so the light from my skylight didn't bother me.

The sound is good, but if when listening to something binaural beats I had to have it a little louder to get the full effect. These absolutely are not noise canceling. Even when positioned properly they barely sit directly over my ear holes. Especially with the cushioning the ear pieces sit in there's just no way for them to be noise canceling. I can hear everything outside of my headphones, even just my dogs breathing as she sleeps. To not hear anything else I woul have to have the volume too high to sleep.

They charged 4 hours and I've been using then for 12 hours so far with no problem. They're comfortable when I change sleep positions too.

title: AWESOME!!
review: AWESOME ear tips!!  Shuts out the world, brings in the sound!  Great for commuters on trains/bus. Clean your ears often or they will get dirty fast!  These are foam and skin cells will stick, but worth having these buds!  I use with Phaiser Bluetooth Earbuds.  Love the combo!

title: Killer sound!
review: Excellent, once I figured out which ear tips worked best!!!  Got these headphones on a 'deal', so sort of an impulse buy but well worth it!  Easy to connect, convenient - no cords to hang about - and great sound quality provided you use the Comply Insolation memory foam tips.  I wanted something for my noisy bus commute and, with the foam tips, these block EVERYTHING and EVERYBODY out while giving me a great sound; bass kicks, treble is clear, overall very pleased with the sound quality - using the foam buds!  They come with a huge assortment of rubber earbuds and changeable tips.  What I now assume, the foam buds were a sample 'memory foam' earbuds from Comply Foam  which for me worked better than all the other rubber ear tips that were sent.  The rubber tips just didn't fit in my ears well and, because of that, the sound sucked.  I contacted Phaiser about getting more of the foam buds and they referred me to a link on Amazon to get more; not their product apparently; just a sample.  A little disappointing since the buds that come with their product don't allow a good sound.  But, if you get some good covers (the foam buds) I would recommend these headphones.

title: Great Value Gym Headphones
review: Do you really need the highest end earbuds for the gym? If not, definitely get amazon basics. Good price, and amazon makes a good product. Audio quality is good enough. I just need something to drown out the other people at the gym. I will definitely buy again.

title: tl;dr best earbuds for price
review: I have always been a big skullcandy fan (I know, I probably just lost most people reading this review, but hear me out). I am a hipster when it comes to skullcandy, I was skullcandy back in 07-08 when they were actually of quality. No different than the first set of beats that were good, and everything recent is subpar. Now, I continued purchasing skullcandy because I was never good to my earbuds. The average lifespan of my earbuds was about 2 months, so the cheap quality was fine. But when I started med school and had to study all the time, I found my earbuds finally lasted over a year, but the quality was bugging me. They wouldn't cancel out the annoying undergrads who used the library for socialization rather than studying. I decided to finally to invest in pair of higher quality earbuds. I was willing to spend beats price if I was going to get quality. Little did I know there existed a pair of earbuds roughly equal in price to my skullcandy, but outclasses them when it comes to quality. All of my friends who have tried these earbuds have had to switch. They have a great sound, noise cancel, and have a mic if you're into that. The one negative (hence the minus 1 star) is that the jack has this "nub" that when pressed in my pocket pauses my music. This is very annoying for walking to class or the bus. But when I'm sitting and studying, I would choose no other.

title: Worth every penny
review: I loved them, rubber ear tips, foam ear tips, hard and soft carrying case, great sound, sadly I lost them while going on a drive with my ex's dad, I tried to find this page again, but I never could find action pies post, these headphones are absolutely worth it

review: This is  my first pair of wireless earbuds and I highly recommend them!  I got so tired of having to buy replacement earbuds when on of the wires would inevitably short out.  The Purity earbuds are reasonably priced and very comfortable in my ears.  They paired easily with my Iphone and the second I put them in, I get an audio confirmation that they connected with my phone.  I love the fact that they magnetically click into the little pod charging case and stay charged between uses.  I generally use them for 3-4 hours at a time and have never run out of battery in that time.  The sound quality is good and I will NEVER go back to wired earbuds again!

title: Decent earbuds for the price
review: I'm actually giving these earbuds 3 1/2 stars, mostly for the sound. After reading the reviews, I thought these would be better than the original earbuds that came with my iPod. I found that I liked the original earbuds better and they fit better in my ear. I didn't experience the heavier bass that people described and I thought the sound was a little flat. That being said, these earphones seem to be pretty durable.

title: Good solid sound with bass
review: Easy to connect and the sound is fantastic. Much better than the apple ear buds I'm used to using.  I'll have to play with the different sized earbuds to see which one fits my ear better, but otherwise is a very good buy.

title: Very useful

title: Bluetooth headet
review: I bought these for work after I started working from home and grew tired of the work-issued headset (only one earpiece and anchored to my computer so I couldn't walk around during meetings). However if you like to wear earrings, they may become uncomfortable with the earring backs poking you (So I don't wear any)

review: Really like the headphones, but my husband wear eyeglasses and the headset does not sit as well on his head when he has his glasses on. Other than that he still likes them.

review: I researched for a few days which earbuds to get because I am picky about my music when I'm running.  I've had bluetooth headphones before and depending on where you are running your surroundings can interfere with the single and the bluetooth disconnects - for a week now this has not happened to me once - FANTASTIC!. The sound good and cancel out all the noise if you select that option.  I can still hear tires on the road so I know when cars are coming by. review: The sound is good, but they hurt my ears after 1-2 hours.  These helped me understand I would much rather have over ear headphones than on ear headphones. title: Good noise cancellation, not a headphone for head bangers
review: Not bad headphones, the noise cancellation is quite good. My friends found it amazing that you could drone out most of the noise on our campus. However, the one problem I had that was a deal breaker for me was that these headphones are way too quiet. I may just be used to my previous headphones (ive had BOSE, creative, and skullcandies) but these were by far the quietest headphones Ive ever had. For me, if I am listening to music I am on a walk or at the gym so I need some good loud sound, and this was nowhere near enough. I personally didn't like them enough so I  returned them, but as for noise cancelling, if that is all you want I would recommend them. The battery life is great and it covers most noises outside of direct conversation.

title: Break quickly
review: They are decent headphones especially for the price but, you get what you pay for. They quit working pretty quickly. Not awesome quality.

title: Poor Noise Cancellation, Not comfortable
review:
I used MPow Noise Cancelling BT Headphones for many years and loved them. I could turn on the noise cancellation and without music playing they would block out almost all sound. Unfortunately they stopped working and I could not find them again.
These HROEENOI Headphones don't even come close to the quality of noise cancellation. There is a difference once the NC is turned on but I can still clearly make out all sounds when my music is off. So the real noise cancelling is the music playing through the headphones.

Also they are less comfortable, I clearly feel pressure from the band on the top of my head. It is not unbearable, but certainly not as comfortable. They are noticably heavier than the MPow headphones I had as well.

title: Love this case!
review: Fits perfectly. Helps protect and makes it easy to tell my headphones apart from others in the family.

title: 10 stars plus!
review: They are easy to use, stylish, stayed charged SO LONG, fit easily in ear, great sound quality, noise canceling is excellent, etc. My husband has used these off and on for over a week now and still hasn't had to charge the box. 10/10 recommended He got the silver black combo and the charging box as well as headphone are black. review:
Let me start by saying I like these headphones. They are good for making telephone calls. However, I am a runner. With the closure of the gyms in my area during the COVID-19 pandemic, I am exclusively an outdoor runner (not my choice but have to play the cards you are dealt, I guess). These headphones have great noise cancellation and are good at the tail end of my morning runs when I have to call in to a daily conference call for work. However, there is no way to control the volume or skips songs. So I cannot conveniently change the song when I am running because I have to take my phone out of my armband.

All in all, I like the headphones. I just wish I could change songs with them!

review: This is an awesome product. I use it in an earphone jack on the TV because I have to listen to it so loudly, and I don't want to bother my neighbors. Sound quality is great! It's very well made.

title: BEST headphones for the price!!
review: These headphones are the BEST I have found in this price range. I love that they come in these cool fun colors. I'm hard of hearing so I use these all the time. The flat wire is truly tangle-free. They stay in my ears comfortably for hours while I listen to music.

title: I LOVE these headphones so much, I have 5 pairs!!
review: I love these headphones for talking on the phone. I'm hard of hearing so I use headphones quite a lot. These are great because they are comfortable, sound great, stay in the ear, and come in great colors. I like to have several pairs handy, in my purse, in my iPod,  near the phone charger, and plugged into the roku remote! These are the BEST headphones, especially for the price. They last longer than other ones in this price range.

title: Great product great price. Abusive usage = very short life
review: I bought these in January. I’ve had no issues with them. I wasn’t expecting the best earbuds in the world. I bought these for while I was working. I work outside a lot. I’m in and out of my van, climbing ladders and doing all kinds of stuff. Recently (end of June) one of the earbuds stopped working. It still lights up when removing or replacing it in the charger. I’ve tried holding the button. But for some reason it just won’t turn on. Aside from the fact that they only lasted 6 months they were great and just what I needed. I would charge one while using the other then swap. They even both fit in my right ear (which is hard to find nowadays). Most earbuds can only be used in left for left and right for right. I wish there was a way to contact the company so I could get a replacement earbud. I may reorder but they only lasted 6 months. Most others I’ve had last at least 1 year.

title: Bought for VR
review:
I originally bought a 12" cord from another seller for my Meta Quest 2 so that I could connect headphones, but the problem was the Quest 2 audio jack is on the left side and my headphones (Bluetooth that can turn into corded cans) have their jack on the right side. That meant that my only option was to put the headphones on backwards, but then the audio channels are reversed. This is a problem in VR as directional audio is a big thing. If something is sneaking up behind me on the left side but I hear it on the right side, that's no good.

Enter this product. The length is perfect for me to wear my headphones correctly AND having a second one to use with my PC is pretty awesome as I don't run into problems like leaving one plugged into my PC and not having one in my Quest 2 carrying case when I need it.

I listen to music with  while riding and the track pauses when I receive a call and resume after the call is finished. What more could you ask for in a headset. One of the best I have purchased. The neckband is pretty light and my jogging around the house caused a lot less bouncing than I had worried about. Pretty happy about it so far, will update after more use.

title: Good for the price but does not always pair the microphone
review:
A good budget range wireless headset for work. When on a call the ANC is pretty good at blocking out the background noise. I do find that the boom mic sensitivity drops off rather quickly if it is rotated up beyond nose level, it gets muddy fast. The earpieces are ok, they don't fold or rotate for easy carry in a backpack to the office for example. Music is quite good; clear and good bass response. One continuing issue of these headsets is that it turns off on the charging stand and does not auto pair (with the dongle) when I pick it up. That is inconvenient if it's charging between calls and I have to flip it back on and wait a few seconds for it to pair with the dongle. Also the microphone is not always connecting so I have to reset - this is a major issue both when paired via the dongle or bluetooth. Soothielec customer support has been responsive though.
*** UPDATE ****
Even with the suggested reset procedure I have not had any luck getting the microphone to pair reliably. This is unfortunate because I really liked the feel and sound of this headphone. But not pairing is a show stopper for work. Ended up returning for a refund.

title: A MUST HAVE FOR ALL HEARING AID WEARERS!  FINALLY, A HEADSET WE CAN USE AND ENJOY!
review: I have severe hearing loss in my right ear (I am deaf on my left).  Earbuds do not work as I cannot get the volume loud enough and I cannot use headsets because how they cup the ear causes feedback in my hearing aid.  I was hopeful when I saw this new style of headset but did not want to invest too much money until I knew if they would be compatible with hearing aids.  I am so happy with them.  In addition to the bone conduction, there is sound which aligns with the mic on my hearing aid so it provides excellent sound quality without any feedback. The only complaint I have is the band is not adjustable and is sized a bit large for my head. Then, add the fact that it is summer, sweating causes the headset to slip too much, out of the position needed for my hearing aid.  Still, I am very happy with them and plan to upgrade to a higher quality headset as soon as my budget allows.

title: Didn't live up to the hype. Does not pair well with HD800 and HD820 headphones.
review:
Power isn't everything. My intention was for the A90 to replace an old portable DAC/Amp combo that is only rated at 1.6W total at 75Ω. I figured the massive increase in output power paired with a much higher-end DAC would sound heaps better than the little DAC/Amp combo I've been using for the last 7 years. Sadly, the A90 made everything sound a bit thin and lifeless. It's like it has the negative characteristics of an overly clinical sounding amp without any of the positives like extracting detail.

It's not a horrible amp. It's just not a great amp. Maybe the A90 would sound better when paired with muffled/veiled or extremely warm sounding headphones. For Sennheiser HD800's or HD820's though, which are inherently bright, it's a horrible match. The A90 sucked the soul from the music with those particular headphones.

The chain I tested with the A90 was a Naim ND5 XS2 streamer > Nordost Silver Shadow BNC > Schiit Gungnir Multibit DAC > Cardas Clear XLR > Topping A90. There's usually a Schiit Mjolnir 2 at the end of the chain and it sounds amazing. I didn't expect the A90 to outperform the Mjolnir but I did expect it to outperform my little DAC/Amp combo, especially when being fed such a good source

All I can really take away from my experience with the A90 is DO NOT pair this amp with bright headphones. Can't comment on other headphones but avoid this amp if you've got HD800's or 820's.

For regular use this works really well. Connects to my iPhone XS Max every time. Never dropped connection once so far. The noise isolation is decent but not close to my Bose noise cancelling over the ear bluetooth headset. Wasn't expecting that either. The case is great for recharging and needs maybe once a month charging itself.

Definitely recommended.

So not sure if these are more for kids than adult size ears because they do hurt like pressure pushing on my ears in the fit.

review:
I've had the QC35 headphones for about 2 weeks now and I love them! Sound quality is awesome and you are wire free! The Bluetooth pairing is super simple, and switching between Bluetooth devices is seamless. They are lightweight and very comfortable to wear for long periods of time, no itching or sweating. The noise canceling is amazing, just as good as the QC25 (wired) headphones. Receiving phone calls while listening is a breeze and the sound is clear, not muffled and easy to have a conversation. The charge lasts more than 20 hours and the on/off switch is very conveniently located on the side of the headphone with the volume and pause just below (if your phone isn't handy to adjust the volume). I absolutely love these Bose headphones! 5 stars all the way Bose!!
https://www.bose.com/en_us/products/headphones/over_ear_headphones/quietcomfort-35-wireless.html

title: Great quality
review: I've read things on here that say not the same I've have bose for over y years and wicked pads are same as bose as far as I'm concerned great comfort and quality 5 stars my headphones

title: Impressive all around
review:
I bought these to replace the wired Sony's I've had for about 3 years - I just looked to see if they were still available, looks like they're discontinued - Sony MDRXB510AS, I wanted another active set of headphones but with more modern technology...waterproof, noise cancelling, and true wireless was my criteria.

I've mainly used these headphones for conference calls, listening to music, and overall just blocking out noise from the window. I can say that these are nothing short of impressive. Comfortable to wear for hours on end, they're lightweight and sleek. The bass is punchy and with the app you can adjust the equalizer, it also gives you battery %. I was on 4hr of calls yesterday and listened to music in between working sessions, by far the best purchase I've made in recent years.

Some might say the charging carrying case is a little bulky, but I feel like it comes with the territory. You're getting a huge amount of quality in such a small package, I'm satisfied with my investment!

review: These headphones are no where near the quality of the original Samsung S4 headphones provided with the phone. You get what you pay for.

title: As good as the originals
review: I ordered these to replace the earpads on my Bose QC-2 headphones, which had worn out. A link to an on-line video on how to replace the earpads was included.  It was quite clear and there was no problem attaching the new pads.

title: More comfortable than Apple earbuds
review: I bought some Apple earbuds and they were really uncomfortable.  These however are perfect and they hang around your neck.  Not like the Apple product that would pop out.  I feel like these are a much better product

title: Very clear voice
review: Great set of Bluetooth earbuds.  When I am talking through the earbuds, my volume is normally on low. Even with a low setting, the people I am having a conversation can hear people across the street on the basketball courts.  It does pick up your surroundings well.  No static.  Very clear voice.  It is waterproof  I did shower with them on.  Only issue was that it turns off when the water hits it.  Unsure if it’s because it’s water or because it thinks I pushed them to turn it off. That’s why I am giving it a four star.

title: It's perfect!!!
review: I had never used a headset for my phone before and was very surprised at how great this worked for me.  Very happy with my purchase.

title: Works for gaming headsets
review: Bought these for the kids gaming headset. He really seems to like them and says they have good audio quality. Great price

title: Great upgrade to the Focus UC
review:
I love this headset. It is a great upgrade to the Plantronics Focus UC. When wearing the Focus for too long, my ears would start to sweat and I had to take them off for a while, I would say after about 45 minutes or so. I can wear the 8200 headset for hours without discomfort. It works great for desk phones when paired with the MDA220, and the sound quality is great when paired with my cell phone. When switching between the cell handset and the 8200 headphones, the caller says they can hear no difference in sound quality. Excellent dual stage noise cancelling as well. If I had any complaints, it would be that the noise cancelling is too good as I cannot hear people talking to me when I have these on or am walking around the office.

Definitely recommended for office use with cell, desk phone, and Skype for Business VoIP calls.

title: Works Fine - Read Review for Details Though
review:
This extension cord does what I need it to do, reach my ears while laying in bed with the player on the shelf. I like that the cord is thicker than my headphone cord as it does help keep it from tangling (an issue I hate with headphones).

The reason I could not give it 5 stars is because the plug that connects to the MP3 makes static noise if you move or touch it, not an ideal thing for most people so I don't want to rate it higher, giving potential buyers the wrong idea (that's why these reviews are so important). But because I don't move my MP3 player much, it doesn't affect me so not worth returning/exchanging. With the nice, low price I paid ($1.39 with free shipping on 1-20-13), I really can't (and don't) complain.

Update 11/13: Purchased another 9/13 as a backup. It serves my purpose, cheaply.
