Battery life is 12 hours at least I haven't ran out of battery life yet. My only complaint is the microphone doesn't always respond when I ask Google to do something. It's connected to a pixel 2 XL. Overall I'm happy with them for twenty bucks you can't go wrong. I have pixel buds for normal use and when I'm not working. the problem with the pixel buds it's only a 5-hour battery life. Otherwise I'd probably wear these for work.

title: Inexpensive, Decent Sound, Lasts about a Year for Us
review: These earbuds are pretty decent for the price. We needed a pair with a straight jack which can be hard to find. They are comfortable to wear, sound pretty good and cancel some outside noise. However, they only seem to last about a year for us. We don't mind replacing them once a year since they are reasonably inexpensive but if you want long lasting earbuds with excellent sound quality these probably aren't for you. If you want inexpensive earbuds with a straight jack that sound decent for the price, they will do.

title: Basic quality
review: Tend to build up static electricity. The resulting small static shock is not dangerous but is uncomfortable. I'd never experienced this issue until I purchased these earbuds.

title: Adequate
review: I do not like how it powers off, otherwise it works ok.  I only use it for a Cardboard VR headset setup.  Generally I love Plugable products, but this one is pretty average

title: Perfect for work/zoom meetings
review: I got these to use, instead of my company supplied headset, at work. I cant believe how much better I can hear! It’s so much more comfortable than those headsets. I saw some reviews saying theirs wasn’t authentic. Mine definitely is an Apple product.

title: One of the better Bluetooth speakers I've used
review:
First off this speaker is a pretty good size for portability. It's a little bigger than my sony xb22 but still easily fits in my bag. Sound on this speaker is also relativity good. I'll never expect sound quality from a speaker this size to match a good set of headphones or full sized speakers. That being said they do sound good, decent clarity and a solid set of coils. Not a lot of distortion at max volume which surprised me. It's not bass heavy even if you adjust your equalizer, I believe that's what gives these speakers such clean sound quality. Definitely one of my louder speakers closely matching the volume to me pc desk speakers. Not sure if it has a 24hr life on full charge if running full volume but honestly you don't need to run this full volume unless you're outdoors. Even though I waited to buy these on sale I still think they're worth the price compared to other equal priced speakers.
Overall thoughts 10 outta 10 would recommend

title: Well worth it
review: Wow. This was just what I needed. All the little tools on the pen cleaned up my gunky earbuds. The sound quality improved loads. The putty worked well on one bud, but got little pieces stuck on the other…which I had to use the pen tools to clean out ironically. But the end result is still the same. Cleaner EarPods with better sound, for nearly half the cost for similar items online.

title: it almost look like a 3m ear plug
review: Technically I do not see any problem with this earbud. But earphone itself is just too big. it comes out too much even when I am wearing them. it almost look like a 3m ear plug. Quality is good but just too big.

title: Easy to replace, and the price is cheaper than I expected.
review: I didn't know they sell the replacement pad to be honest. I happy I found it. You suppose to replace this every year? I had mine for 5 years and never replace them until they started to crumbled. So happy to find it on Amazon. I thought it would be at a higher price. Happy to pay less than $10 for them. It was so easy to replace. I am happy with my Bose Noise cancellation headphone again. Never fly without them. They feel like new again.

title: Small ears
review: I received my earbuds 3 days ago. The siund is wonderful and the battery life seems to be good. I haven't charged it since i got it. I use the earbuds intermittently and about 1-2 hours at a time. My disappointment is the fit. I have small ears and I've tried 3 different sizes of the rubber pieces that come with the earbuds but alas none have worked. They keep falling out. Im saddened that i won't be able to use these during a workout 😤

title: Slippery when wet
review: Well, of course earbuds will get slippery and start sliding out of your ear when you're sweating and these are no different. I have sensitive ears, so for me if they are slippery and I have to keep turning up the volume, eventually I turn it up too loud and it hurts my eardrums. I bought these to have a better gaming experience with Dance Central on MetaQuest2. It does give you a better experience. But when I start sweating, I'm fiddling too much with them and trying to keep them in my ears. I guess I also don't like how you attach them to the headset. It seems like the wire gets in my way sometimes. Idk. I'm 44, not one of these whippersnappers that know how to jerryrig all of this stuff. Overall, I'd buy them again.

title: Paid for new and got terribly beaten up and used
review: I paid for a NEW headset and the one I received was horribly used. I mean, it's like they didn't even try to hide that it was used. And to top it off, the right ear didn't work. That's not good if you're doing transcription. I've used this brand before and didn't have an issue. I think I just got a bad set.

title: Not good for pool or if you have on a swim cap
review: I needed some headphones for the pool so I can do my HIIT water aerobics. I saw all the reviews and was skeptical about what I saw but decided to get them anyway.  You never know with reviews sometimes. Sometimes they are just people venting, and sometimes they are dead on. In this case, the reviews are dead on. These are not the greatest headphones for the pool. I am only using them for a aerobics and bluetoothing my YouTube workouts and they are always coming out of my ears. I wear a swim cap and I always have to re adjust them. They hurt. These are really not made that well. I've also done a couple laps in them and no, they do not work well under the water. Like even a little bit of water. I really don't recommend these because they just do not work that well. If you are only using them for aerobics and don't need to wear a swim cap, they may work. But they don't stay well suctioned in your ear. Not a good buy. You do get what you pay for.

title: Horrible for recording audio...had to return
review:
I was eager to order this because of the fairly good reviews. However, I am severely disappointed with the final outcome. I record audio narrations for online learning as a profession, and this is what this headset was going to be used for. When I used the headset to record my audio for several different modules over the past week or so, the audio would waiver, fade in and out, and there would be sporadic crackling noises. I tried using different USB ports on my laptop, to no avail. Furthermore, the noise cancellation feature is almost non-existent. It picked up airplanes flying over my house, birds singing outside (even though my doors and windows were closed)...my last headset (not this brand) was phenomenal at canceling at these types of background noises, so I know it can be done. This particular headset said it could, but I did not experience that result.

I have begun the process of returning this product and I'll be purchasing a different brand.

title: Worked great!
review: It boggles my mind that there are aftermarket parts for a 36-year-old headphone design, but I love my MDR-V6s and was a little heartbroken when they broke.  I'd never heard of Poyatu, but the parts were reasonably priced and fit perfectly.

title: Once again, right earbud nearly dead
review: This is the second pair of identical Bose headphones I bought from Amazon over the past 3 years. This pair that I bought in November of 2020 is having the same issue as the one I bought in 2018. Out of nowhere the right sound earbud goes very tinny and silent. I tried resetting the headphones by plugging in waiting 5 seconds, and then unplugging and waiting a minute. None of these issues have helped. The last time this happened and sent me a refurbished set. I will be contacting customer support again and letting them know how unhappy I am with this product.

title: Fits great!
review: very comfortable..easy to replace..they don't feel exactly like the original but i like these better. They seem more well built and are more secure on my ears. A little expensive but worth it to keep these expensive headphones looking and feeling new.

title: Not as cushioned
review: The headphones work very well. Bought these to replace a worn set that was Sony's one step up from these. These sound just as good, but the ear cushions are not as large or as soft. Even so, I am pleased with the purchase.

title: Great headphones for tv watching
review: I purchased these for my mother who has trouble hearing in one ear. She could not be happier.  She loves how she can wander around the house and still hear what’s going on in another room. Lightweight and often comments that she forgets that she’s wearing them. My part was connecting the base to the Tv and pairing the headphones. Was very easy. Excellent!

title: COMFORTABLE
review: GREAT FOR THE GYM. I bought a 4 pack for my wife. Like all other headphones they will go bad depending on how hard you use it. the PINK is great from what my wife says. It doesnt fall out of your ears to while running. The 4 pack set was a deal at $5 a pair. I would recommend this for any sporting activity.

title: COMFORTABLE
review: I bought this for my wife to talk to me and she loves it. Great clarity and the microphone isn't over bearing like others. Quality is great look no further for a inexpensive headphone/mic combination. I would recommend this to anyone.

title: Surprisingly great sound for the money!
review: I just received them today. I bought the black ones. Nice small container. Fits in pocket easy. Easy open. Simple instructions to follow for charging. Surprisingly the sound quality 👌 so far it's great. Awesome bass!! Noise canceling is great! I was getting annoyed not having earbuds when my entire family had them. Of course the men in the family had top of the line. One was Samsung matched his phone, other has iPhone buds. Both top of the line and they listened to mine and it easily sounds like theirs! Mama scored on the price/quality. Let's hope they last. With me I'm sure they will considering I never have to replace my tech products and read all reviews.  I cannot wait to finally have them for my walks, meditation sounds,  and podcasts. It's now my time to say "what?" Or I know I'll be startled bc I have them in now and I can't hear the TV. So let's see how it goes... oh, I like how it does come with 3 sizes for your ears. The smaller size fits me better. Kinda impressive.  I just can't see paying so much money for things like this, when you can find these and not be scared to have to replace them bc you lost one or broke one. When there's buds like these out there! If it messes up for any reason, I'll update. Try them out!

title: Ouch!- But They Deliver Good Sound~
review: The cushion of the earphones are not as contoured for my ear, in which, it gives my ear a discomfort if I use them for a few minutes. Otherwise, they deliver good sound volume. I may return them.

title: Sound Experience
review: Rated a bit 'mediocur'- Looks super good in the advertisememy. Does the job in general. No super..., what they call: "volume experience." You get just what your tv puts out as if you were just listening to it without a headset. When you use it,..it just keeps out the sound from others around. The volume doesn't go up that much if you turn the little knob on the headset. No stereo sound though it's on the device. Hmm... For the price you get what you pay for.

title: Nice for the price
review: The headphones are a pretty pink, and they are super easy to sync up with your phone. As to the noise cancelling aspect? It's just so so. Not a bad buy for the price.

title: Hands free!
review: These work perfectly with my work phone. Management doesn't like to purchase headphones because they are terribly expensive using our supply system. These headphones are a great workaround. They are reasonably priced, and work great!

title: Unique design with great sound quality.
review: I ordered these for my son as he prefers corded ear buds. He has had wireless, but has trouble getting them to stay in his ears. What is nice about these is they are kind of a hybrid style. They fit in your ears like wireless ones, but have the fitted cord that goes over the back of your ear to help keep them in place. The cord is textured & long. The sound quality is excellent. In fact when I was listening with them, I was impressed. So far they seem to stay in for him & he likes them. Zero issues. The only concern I have is the way the buds snap in to the cord. It is sturdy & there is no reason for the concern, other than I have never used earphones with that setup, so the concern is strictly of the unknown, so don’t know about longevity. It seems to me that earphones, including the main stream name brands, don’t always last for the long haul. I guess only time will tell, but for now, it sounds great.

title: buy these now!
review: looked everywhere and read every review, these headphones ROCK. They are at a great price and the company is on the leading edge of DJ equipment. Buy these now!

title: Earphones for my Kindle
review: I like listening to music while I am reading.  I bought a green Kindle cover and these earphones go nicely with it.  The sound is good, they are comfortable and portable.  You can't beat these for the price!

title: works just fine - looks like ok quality
review: Geez what do you want for $5?  It does the job, decent quality, no electronic glitches that I can see so far.  It works fine for my phone to headset connection and I have 3 more feet!

title: Fail!
review: The headphones were doing great then the microphone stopped working 2 weeks after I received them.

title: Earbud Covers work well
review: I like these little foamy covers for my iPhone earbuds.  They don't work for everone but they are perfect for me -- they help keep the earbuds in my ears and are very comfortable to wear.  Seems they might cost less considering how little there is to them, but I do recommend them.

title: Satisfied With Purchase
review:
I wanted this device to use while walking, because earbuds fall out of my ears, and every version of headphones or hook-over-the-ear device gets tangled in my hair.

These seem to be well-made, work as expected, have a nice long cord, and have a sound quality that's OK with me. And yes, they are very comfortable.

It's a little tight on my head, but I knew in advance that frankly, I have a big head! I imagine they will fit practically everyone else. Also, it can get sweaty when I'm walking outdoors, but what would you expect of a fleece headband in Texas, in the summer? The same feature will be an advantage in winter. Simple design, well-made, it works.

title: Have to push extremely hard for stereo effect!
review: When I first connected only mono x 2 earphones - had to push extremely hard on both to get stereo on both (did not hear or feel click to indicate all the way in). My 14 year old daughter does not use it as she can not push it in hard enough to get stereo for her and her 12 year old sister. So they do not use it. Have another different brand enroute!

title: Latex free!!! Won't eat your flesh away!
review:
Imagine if you will the burning and blistering of the inside of your ear thanks to a very expensive headphones company cheeping out and using latex!
Well, our youngest discovered that in a painful way so we went shopping and found these. They aren't the exact coral melon color of her earbuds, but they also don't eat her flesh away, so 5Stars!!!

title: Not for a teenager or younger
review:
These arrived in excellent time and packaging and worked very well for approximately 3 week before our young teenager destroyed them.
This isn't exactly a knock on the product itself seeing as she routinely kills headphone cables but we had hoped they would have made it a month before they shorted out.
Prior to their untimely destruction they had everything going for them; materials, style and audio quality.
If you're careful with your equipment and avoid kinking lines these will be fine for you and an excellent bargain. If you have a teenager or child who still hasn't grasped that wires dislike being bent in unnatural ways or yanked on from the cord instead of the actual plug you might want to skip on this...or do as we have, refused to buy said teenager a replacement cable and have told them to pay for it themselves.

title: Comfortable, Excellent Sound, Superb Battery Life
review:
These headphones are fantastic! The noise canceling is superb, it blocks out all environment sounds, even my loud window Ac unit. The sound quality is excellent, great range of tones, especially base. Great for listening to music and watching movies.

They are the most comfortable headphones I've ever owned. I can wear them all day long without getting sore or hot ears. You barely notice they are there.

The show steeler on these is the amazing battery life. They last several days, with heavy use, and you can do a quick charge of just 15 minutes and get to 50%... Wow!

They are very well made, excellent quality materials with a super soft memory phone around the ears and top of head. They fold up nicely into the included case, which is also rather nice. There is a good reason these are so popular.

Overall, it's well worth the price. I've had them for about a month and absolutely love them, I highly recommend them for people who work at home and listen to a lot of music while working and watching movies. One hint for switching devices is to disconnect it from the current device first, then reconnect onto the next. It's not ideal, but I only use them on my kindle and MBP, so it's not a big deal. It did take a minute to get them to pair with my kindle fire 10", but now it works perfectly.

title: I can use my favorite headphones again!
review: I bought the new 10" 2019 Kindle fire HD, and plugged my favorite kingston hyperx cloud  II headet in... no sound. I tried my other headphones and they both worked just fine. I searched google and Amazon forums and found no good answer, only that the new Kindle doesn't support headsets. I found that odd, as I used my hyperx's on my older fire HD kindle and they worked just fine. Anyways, after searching for a while, I saw someone randomly post that using a splitter would work - plug the splitter into the Kindle first, then the hyperx headphones into the splitter! Voila... they work perfectly now. The sounds is as it should be. It was worth spending just $6 to use them again. I'm not using them to share sound, so I can not comment on that.

title: Does not work properly on Mac
review: Be warned, the amp controls do NOT function on a mac. I purchased this to replace the original amp that came with my cloud II headset. Sadly, it did not work well. Aside from no control function (volume/mic), I also had to repeatedly unplug and plug it back in to get my Mac to recognize it. Kingston did finally replace it for the original, after weeks of inconvenience, that's why I bumped up 1 star to 2.

title: Great for headphone storage!
review: I bought these for my kids to take to school to keep their flash drive and head phones in for computer lab. They got tired of digging out tangled mess of headphones and wasting class time untangling them. These clip right on their bags and are handy. They fit headphones, 2 flash drives and a tube of chapstick easy. The zipper is smooth and they haven't had issues with it.

title: Great size, best cord wrap for headphones.
review: I bought a bunch of these to try them out and these were my favorite for wrapping headphones. The small ones are perfect. They attach and don't dangle off the chord too much and then are the perfect length for wrapping around a headphone cord. I just wish you could buy just one size, but I will probably use the larger size for other cords too.

title: Not Bone Conduction
review: I have tried a few "bone conduction" headphones. The way you can tell if they are bone conduction is because you can still hear the sound with earplugs in. These are not. These are speakers directed at your ears. There re much better actual bone conduction sets available at this price point.

title: Bone Conduction
review: I have tried a few "bone conduction" headphones. The way you can tell if they are bone conduction is because you can still hear the sound with earplugs in. These are true bone conduction, but the volume is much quieter than others at this price point.

title: Bone Conduction
review: I have tried a few "bone conduction" headphones. The way you can tell if they are bone conduction is because you can still hear the sound with earplugs in. These are true bone conduction headphones. These are a great value compared to others at this price point. We have not tested the waterproof properties, and the sound is quieter than on ear headphones at the same volume levels. But these are comfortable and easy to use.

title: Loud
review: I have tried a few "bone conduction" headphones. The way you can tell they are bone conduction is because you can still hear the sound with earplugs in. This is true bone conduction technology, unlike some other listings. However, even on the lowest setting, the sound is VERY loud. Almost painful if I am in a quiet environment. I love that they keep my ears open for environmental sounds for safety. Highly recommended, even of they are pricier than some options.

title: Amazing
review:
I have been using the same over-ear headphones since shelter in place began. After over a year, I thought I would never love a pair more. until these. I have an iPhone. And I loved my airpods. I liked being able to tap to pause or double tap to skip songs. With a busy household, those were important. But the in-ear was not my favorite. The battery life was never amazing. And there was clearly no noise cancellation.

But these. . .

I could write odes to these headphones. They check all my boxes. Even without "noise cancellation" turned on, they cancel noise better than any other on ear headphones I have had. The battery life, both with and without noise cancellation on, is better than other less expensive products I have used. I do not have enough knowledge to utilize the app for more than the ambient sound or talk through settings, but the thing that really has made them an instant favorite is being able to tap to pause or double tap to skip again. I had forgotten to charge them Thursday night and had to switch mid day to another pair. A pair, I might add, that had been my favorite for over a year. And I was happy, until I tapped to pause and then remembered I couldn't. Oh man. I survived, but now I pay more attention to when I need to charge my headphones every other day.

title: Replaced 10 year old headset from same brand
review: With distance learning we have been using lots of headsets. My 11 year old prefers this style.  He was using a very well loved abs much used headset from this brand that was 10 years old, so we decided to replace it with something from the same brand.

title: OK Sound Quality for Distance Learning
review: I have learned that perhaps the standard of headphone we have for casual listening during the school year is not the same standard we need for everyone being home 24/7. These were a good replacement for kids who had the cheapest of cheap wired headphones, but I refer the sound quality, fit,  and battery life of my own pair.

title: Super Comfy, Great Sound Quality, Long Battery Life
review: I really like these. They are super comfortable, even with all my earrings in. Especially with all of the working at home and conference calls that make up my days at this time, I pretty much wear my headphones constantly. These make it easy to weave in and out of music and conference calls. It is definitely love.

title: Sound Quality Really poor
review: We tried several headphones during distance learning and working from home and these were the worst. I gave up within 10 minutes. After a month I decided to try them again, still terrible.

title: Sound okay, did not last long
review: Like many kids, my kids are doing distance learning on the computer. With 4 kids doing lessons all at once, headphones are a must. These worked fine for a week, but then my daughter started complaining that she couldn’t hear out of one side. They have been replaced by another pair from a different brand.

title: Everything I Wanted
review: Good sound, good battery life. This is the 6th headset I’ve bought this year and it’s the only one that lets my mom do her errands in her wheelchair and the battery lasts the entire outing.

title: For when you want to keep one ear open
review: At work, on a jog, or just listening for the kids, it’s really common for folks I know to only want to use one earbud. My only problem with that using traditional earbuds is that with a lot of the music in my library, I miss half the song. This has been an excellent solution and I recommend it to all my friends.

title: Oh, these were a hit!
review: The star of the party were these light up headphones. Comfortable for my 8 year old old, these are definitely smaller than other headphones I’ve gotten from this brand. Definitely kid sized and would not fit me comfortably.

title: Works Well
review: I have a lot of devices plugged into my laptop docking station at work already. I jumped at the chance to use my usb-c port for charging my iPhone to free up another port for a headset. It took my laptop a bit to recognize the cord (I had to unplug it and re-plug it in twice), but once it recognized the cord, it has worked great.

title: Comfy for sleeping
review: Whenever I get comments on these, the first question is if they block out other noises. No, they do not but I don't want my headphones blocking out all the other noises. I need to listen for my kids and other household noises, so earbuds that block out all the other sounds are never what I'm shopping for People sitting next to me can hear my music/ audiobooks as low background noises, it isn't loud enough for them to hear distinct sounds. I can sleep in these, although the fleece was too warm for the summer. Great for my winter walks and keeping my ears warm.

title: Still a little big for my 2 year old. . .
review: I enjoyed having multiple color options to pick from, and they are definitely more volume limiting than our other kids headphone sets, but they don't fit my 2 year old's head as well as the Caliphone animal ones do. We have several JLab headphones/ earbuds at our house and we have always been happy with the quality and price point.

title: The Tiger the cutest design for this brand!
review: I was looking for inexpensive kids headphones. The kids need them for computer lab at school and my son was complaining the ones we had sent for him were too big and would slide off his head. Since they were going to be living at school, I didn't want to spend too much in case they got lost or broken. I ordered the Tiger set first and was pleased with the quality and fit. They were such a success I bought a second pair in a different design (the Panda) to tell them apart. The Pandas arrived and I'm not as much a fan of that design as I am the Tiger, but I love that they are both gender neutral. I wish these were more volume limiting, between being able to adjust the volume on the headphone and whatever device they are plugged into, the little kids can turn the volume up quite loud. But for the price I feel it was money well spent.

title: Prefer the Tiger design. . .
review: I was looking for inexpensive kids headphones. The kids need them for computer lab at school and my son was complaining the ones we had sent for him were too big and would slide off his head. Since they were going to be living at school, I didn't want to spend too much in case they got lost or broken. I ordered the Tiger set first and was pleased with the quality and fit. They were such a success I bought a second pair in a different design (the Panda) to tell them apart. The Pandas arrived and I'm not as much a fan of this design as I am the Tiger, but I love that they are both gender neutral. I wish these were more volume limiting, between being able to adjust the volume on the headphone and whatever device they are plugged into, the little kids can turn the volume up quite loud. But for the price I feel it was money well spent.

title: Love them
review: My husband is a little hard of hearing. He can wear these headphones and crank them as loud as he wants without blasting me away with the television. We both love them.

title: Great for my son's allergic reaction
review: We purchased some fairly nice headphones for all our children and he was the only one who broke out from earing them. These did the job at preventing his ears and neck from breaking out anymore. Easy to install and wash :D They do get lost easily so keep them in a little laundry bag or something!

title: Nice bulk headphones for distance learning!!!
review: I really liked these! I have 6 children and my oldest Son already had a set of headphones. These were great and lasted well for our household. The earphone part pops out so it is not broken even when it looks like it is! I do like that feature. They fit my children from age 3 up to age 13. After about 3 months the sound in one ear started going out on some of them but I think that is due to my kids being rough.

title: Excellent little ear buds. Definitely recommend.
review:
Super impressed!! I wanted ear buds to use while I draw at night while in the same room as my sleeping 1 year old daughter. Wires are not ideal with a toddler, 3 dogs, and a cat lol

These came recommended by a friend and (though the price initially had me hesitant) I am super happy with them. Loved the sound quality and so far I've used them 6 hours and have not charged them yet. Was easy to connect them to my phone (Galaxy S9). Best part about them is that even quite loud, you can't hear them. Had my roommate listen to a song on loud before I used them at night - heard nothing!

Box and carrier/charger are very nice and futuristic feeling. The magnets pulling the earbud into the right place in the carrier is super nice!!

One note - it does not come with a wall plug, but it does come with a USB to micro USB cord. not a huge deal since I have spare wall plugs but it might be annoying to someone who doesnt have several floating around.

All in all, definitely worth the money!

title: I didn't expect the sound to be as nice, but I'm loving my audio book on this
review:
First of all, I wear glasses, and these work perfectly. I didn't expect the sound to be as nice, but I'm loving my audio book on this. I walked around outside and voila, I can hear my surroundings as well as my audio book! The case was a super nice surprise. I will bring these to work on Monday for everyone to take a test drive.

Second, I looked at these relatively tiny things and wondered how they would get around enormous head and all that hair! These things do not get larger or smaller. I tipped my head upside down with my hair in toss and reached up to put on the headset in an upside down position. Oh yeah, they more than fit.

Third, WARNING...please remember to turn down that little volume controller ASAP, IT'S SET TO LOUD!!!

My final thought is simply this, I need one for my brother!

title: The music sound is HORRIBLE. Company must have paid kids to write great ...
review: The music sound is HORRIBLE. Company must have paid kids to  write great reveiws & still lost money. If you're stuck w/these headphones; listen to a book I guess...

title: CRAFTSMENSHIP HAS SOMETHING LEFT TO BE DESIRED 4 THEIR POPULARITY & PRICE
review:
I just purchased 2 pair of Sennheiser HD 202 Headphones for $20. a piece while the advertisement stated their actual price is at "$40." a pair...My logic is; Buy 1 get 1 free... Which I'm glad I went that way...
They are made of plastic and seem a bit flimsy for the 'Actual Price' someone might pay due to the Great Reviews ....IMO...But I'm from the old days of quality crafted audio devices.
I do LOVE the Sound; perhaps only a step below Bose??... And if someone knows a Better brand that doesn't cost an arm and a leg (Bose) Please let me know.
I would recommend getting them while 'On Sale'
The ten foot cord is completely worth it

title: Don't get too excited over these....
review: Tinny sound, uncomfortable headset and terrible battery life. I was excited to get these and now I wish I had my money back. Here's hoping the next pair is is better.

title: I have never found more comfortable ear buds anywhere.
review:
Awesome headphones. We use these at work with our smart phones and listen to music the entire time we work.
We did not know that the voice in them will announce any phone number that is calling you while you are using them as well. I accidentally found out that if you press the buttons in the right combination, it will call the last number that called you....oops!
They have great sound, easy to use, these have about 5 1/2 hours of battery life to them. They also come with several different pieces so that you can find the most comfortable fit for you.
I have never found more comfortable ear buds anywhere.

title: Finally, something that fits my ears and stays in!
review: I have small ear openings and the vast majority of any type of earbuds don't fit, won't stay in during movement, or hurt. Thankfully, these don't! The "wings" keep the buds in and are quite comfortable. I'm no audiophile, but the sound is excellent for my needs. I use this item for listening to music while walking or bouncing on a mini trampoline. This set might be more expensive than many, but so far, they are worth it. I hate having to replace things every four months because they were cheap to begin with and had no durability.

title: Great headphones
review: These are simple, easy to use, good quality headphones. The braided cord has been very effective in preventing breakage. They adjust easily and store smaller because of the folding. My kindergartener is able to be completely independent with them!

title: This USB converter works perfectly!
review: I was so leery about this purchase, seeing reviews on this (and, tbh, other brands of this type) which said that the product only lasted a month. This was the best purchase I could have made! I've been using it about 5 months now, and have never had any issues! I use it continuously, and not all that gently at times, and the sound quality remains crystal clear. The "fast charge" does, indeed, work - as long as I'm using the Samsung charger that came with my Galaxy S20+. If I use a generic "fast charger" it takes forever to charge. I never need to plug my earbuds in in any particular order (as many similar products said you must plug in the earbuds, before plugging in the USB into the phone) and it works no matter which "order" I plug in the USB. If I do need to plug in the charger while my music app is running, my music app will pause, and I need to push play afterwards. I will absolutely purchase this brand again, should it ever fail, and recommend it highly! (But, I'm still hoping new model phones will once again restore the headphones jack, because that was a stupid move - no matter what their reasoning was!)

title: Good quality sound and style!
review: Great earphones - I love how they sound! My cat ate the wire of the last set I had, and I didn't hesitate to purchase another one! In fact, I might order a couple more to keep on hand, in case she gets hungry again...

title: They didn't work after 2 weeks.
review: I had good luck in the previous Earpollution earbuds I bought from Wal-Mart (they lasted about a year and a half!) So I had high hopes for these.  After just two weeks, the plug is faulty (I have to wiggle the connector to get them to receive sound)  and now have reordered a different brand.  Maybe I just got a bad set - like I said, I loved my previous ones. The sound quality is awesome considering what you pay for them.

title: I've owned much better headphones for the same price
review: The sound is "ok", but the quality is very low. I've owned much better headphones for the same price.

title: Buy the protection plan/insurance offered!
review: I love these headphones but they will die eventually. My first pair lasted ~14 months but I took the advice of my husband and bought the $8 protection plan and when they broke and couldn't be repaired = check for $109! Totally worth it. I bought a replacement pair and of course a protection plan for those.

title: Wouldn't buy again
review: I realized after wearing these for about an hour why they must have been on sale on Amazon. The cord from the headphones to the media device comes right out the bottom in a non-flexible way. Therefore it bumps my shoulders and introduces a weird static type sound to the music playing. They're okay now that I know to hold my shoulder a certain way and what the noise is if I lose the position but I wouldn't buy them again.

title: Nice fit and great listen
review:
Most earphones are not as comfortable as I'd like, but I enjoy my new Kinvoca earphones.

For those that have sensitive ears, and I'm one of them, these earphones are comfortable and are easy to wear.

title: Great ears!!!
review: I have enjoyed using my new earphones. When in place, I do not hear the white noise. When I need to keep track of something, the earphones stay in place and I can still hear whatever I want.

title: It's good but the cord is a little too short
review:
Bought this to get a more streamlined look. I have a bigger bulkier one the kind that goes over your head and it covered both ears. I wanted one that had only one ear cover. I don't know if it has noise-cancellation since I have one of my ears uncovered. The head band is ok and it stretches up to a certain point which is fine for me. The mic is adjustable and you can wear the headset either side that is your left or right ear. I decided to add a "boom" (?) sponge cover thing over the mic just to reduce any harshness of the T or D sounds or harder consonants when I talk (just in case). I purchased those mic sponge covers from Amazon a year ago and it comes with 15 pieces so I had extras.

The only complain I had with this headset is that the cord is a little too short. I could use another 6"-8" longer so I can also attach more comfortably to my desktop too. it's just a little too short. So I am looking for an extension to make it longer, to plug into my mac. On a good note, I LOVE how you just plug and play with this headset.

title: Good Fit
review: I guess it was a bargain. I only used one so far on my headset and it seems I have a lifetime supply! The fit is great and it does help when I talk to not overly hear the "Ta" sounds when pronouncing certain words when I get on Skype, on Zoom and also doing professional webinars!

title: Good deal, solid product, nothing better than Ipod while you swim!
review:
Armband adjusts to fit securely. It feels a tiny bit cumbersome, it does not lay flat against you,exactly. you can't completely forget it is there, but it was comfortable and did not bother me wear. It can move around a tad, until you get the hang of putting it on your arm.
Good sound with these earphones, but a better pair would make some difference
You can't beat swimming with your Ipod!

title: Ah, I love this thing!!!
review:
First of all there is no way to describe how wonderful swimming with an Ipod is, but it is great! I go faster and farther without even realizing it.

One reviewer said they had a problem with the sound due to water getting in the way, but I'm guessing they were using the wrong size earplugs because the sound is great.

I had my first one for two years + without a problem, then the earphones stopped working and AudioFlood sent me a new pair for nothing.

I am now getting my second iPod from AudioFood because after 3 years and nearly daily usage, I started having problems charging it.

Get this iPod!

title: Nice headphones, but ON EAR HEADPHONES.
review: These are great headphones, but I hate them because they are on ear. They say they are over the ear but that’s BS. Super uncomfortable for more than 5 minutes. Sound quality doesn’t matter if I can’t bear to wear them.

title: Five Stars
review: Great headphones. Good sound quality. Good price. I break headphones like crazy but these withstand a lot.

title: Adequate only 41 days
review:
I originally gave it 4 stars because this headphone is supposed to have a built-in mic for use with phone or computer applications and that mic does not work very well at all. The headset audio was excellent, though, so I kept it for those functions. After 41days, they no longer recharge. Amazon won't take them back because it is past the return window and the support connection on the site AND FROM AMAZON are nonfunctional.
Only buy these if you want good use for a MONTH and can throw money away on worthless foreign ripoffs.

title: Great earbuds
review: I love these earbuds. I have purchased several sets. Only complaint I have is that over time the cords tend to get stiff.

title: IS it new or a prodcut that failed before being returned.?,,,
review: I ordered this for my vacation home already owning a ROKU for my primary residence.  The first roku I bought had earphones and was in a very colorful box. This one arrive in a brown generic box.  When I ordered it, I did not realize it might have been used and returned.  There is also wording " Tester___Software  4016A. I have not used it, but I  have submitted and inquiry to Roku as to the validity of the numbers. I think I need to return it....

title: Waffled but decided to keep.
review: Not sure- The item I received was sold by Chrystal trading and was fulfilled by Amazon.  It was packaged in a T-Mobile generic cardboard package.  There was no wrapper around the package, nor any seals at the flaps.  Nowhere did the package state Motorola. Words consited of " Accessories for T Mobile", "Headset",  and 'Universal accessories for T Mobile", "Mobile enhancement" and "made in China".  There was a sticker which said "H19TXT."  The ear piece itself does have a Motorola Label and some numbers on the back. The instruction book was not the usual little Motorola Instruction booklet.  IT was a poor quality, black and white, 8.5 x 11 sheet  with photocopies of only pages 2,3,14,6,8,9, and 12 laid out next to each other. The writing on the package states the box "includes  6  Designer skins to personalize your bluetooth headset".  No such skins were included in the box I received. I note there were 2 extra silicone earpieces in a tiny plastic bag which  were not listed under the contents.  It sounds clear on my end,  but I don't know yet about the other end. It announces  an 8 hour talk time, and it has proven very good, even when I use it to listen to audiobooks. It paired easily with my iPhone 5 and the command button worked so far when I made a few calls.  At the time I bought this it was 71.99 with free shipping and eleigble for prime, as compared to the other one eligible for prime, which was sold directly by Amazon and was 89.00 with free shipping.

title: Recommended!
review: These wired earbuds are comfortable and have a great value. Their sound and bass quality is good, and when I use them to talk on the phone, the mic has no problem picking up my voice, even when I speak quietly. I love their magnetic feature. Because of it, mine have yet to tangle.

title: Great product - great customer service experience
review: I used these headphones for work on a daily basis for 5 straight months. I did not have any issues with hearing or being heard on calls. After about 5 months the right one would no longer charge so I contacted the seller through Amazon. I received quick follow up with some tips for troubleshooting. After trying the troubleshooting without success the seller sent me a new set which are working great. Awesome product, exceptional customer service. Definitely will be a return buyer.

title: Good audio, maybe not the best for small ears.
review:
The headphones sound great. They were easy to pair to my phone, and the connection was solid. I did have a few times where the audio cut out when I went into another room. I was only about 3 meters away from my phone, but there was a wall between us, and it cut in and out. Not a huge deal, but it did come up.

My only complaint is that they are just not very comfortable over a long period of time. I know that I have small ears, but based on the reviews I thought these would be a good fit. I've tried all of the different sized ear pieces, and they are all painful after an hour or two.

I did sign up for the free additional ear pieces, so maybe one of those pairs will fit better.

title: Not a great product, not great customer service
review: I bought a pair for my son and for myself. My son's barely lasted a month (the earbud disconnected from the rest of it) , and I Contacted Villain about it 2 weeks ago-no response. I've bought $8 earbuds that lasted longer than these did... Very disappointed with them.

title: Great speaker
review: I love this. Great to be able to listen to music from my phone without wearing earbuds and without carrying the phone around. Sound quality is good. Speaker is easy to use and it’s small so you can easily carry it to wherever you want it.

title: Doesn't Make a Stable Connection with my Sennheiser 429s Headphones
review: Does not make a secure connection to my Sennheiser 429s headphones. An unfortunate accident ruined the audio cable with the microphone that came with the headphones, so I decided to get a replacement cable. Sadly, I couldn't find one with a microphone on it, but this one had good reviews, so I got it. If I slightly move the Ugreen cable, though, the audio cuts out on the right side of my headphones. I have to repeatedly push the Ugreen cable into my headphones' cable. The Ugreen cable looks like a quality product; too bad it doesn't make a good connection with my headphones. It looks like I'll have to try some other company's cable now.

title: Almost Perfect
review: The piece that goes over the other ear (without the earphone) is a little uncomfortable, but other than that, this headset works very well. I'm glad I got it.

title: Great Value. Works Perfectly.
review: Great value. Works perfectly. Need to remove them from one's ears carefully though. I'm used to pulling my earbuds out by the cord sometimes, but the construction of these headphones is delicate. I yanked them out of my ears one time and the head of one earbud separated from its socket. I was able to push it back in and didn't have any problems, but now I have to remind myself not to tug them out. As long as a person is careful with them, they should work well and last a good while.

title: Fooled Again
review:
Well, people were raving about these, so I got drawn in. They are fairly comfortable, but I didn't notice any great difference in the sound quality of my headphones; certainly I didn't notice any improvement. So, I disagree with the high praise these earphone tips are getting.

I admit I haven't tried many earphone tips, but for one thing these were expensive and for another, when I tried to get one pair off of one set of headphones to put them on another, one of them ripped. I was not being rough either. You have to be super careful and push them off slowly with the flat of some sort of blade against the plastic part that grips the headphones. I recommend not using your fingers or fingernails to remove them if you want these tips to survive. I'm going to try to superglue the one that ripped, but still. They should either be easier to remove or better made somehow, considering how much money I spent on them. Add to this the fact that I'd have to replace them after a while anyway because they get worn out from being constantly twisted so that I can shove them into my ear canal and it gets to be too much. I don't plan on buying these again. I'm not even using the ones I have, after I got a pretty painful shock in my ears when I came indoors from the cold. (The ear buds that came with my headphones shock me, too, sometimes, but not as bad as these did.) I wasted my money. <Sigh.>

title: 50/50 Can't Be Beat
review: I'm a typical music listener--not a professional musician or anything--but I like these headphones better than the other in-ear headphones I have tried (Sony MDR-EX38iP, Munito Billets 9MM earphones). The sound is great, the ear buds are comfortable (I use the small ones), and I love that control with which I can pause, skip, and control volume, as well as answer and end phone calls. One song: listening on the 50/50 headphones, the sound is great. Same song: listening on the Sony headphones, I had to turn the volume way up on my iPhone to hear it at the same level. Munito Billets: besides being ugly, they are uncomfortable. The sound is almost as good as the 50/50 headphones, but the control with the microphone only controls volume--no pausing, no skipping, no answering or ending phone calls. I will never try another brand again (unless it's a gift, of course). When I buy headphones, I will buy Skullcandy 50/50 Ear Buds.

title: What Are People So Excited About?
review: I don't get why people are so excited about these headphones. The sound is not better than or as good as my Skullcandy 50/50 headphones, the cord is shorter, and there is no volume control where the mic is (just the pause/end call button). The reviews for these headphones were so good, I figured I should get two at once. Well, I wish I hadn't. I'm sending the second, unopened box back as soon as I can, and I won't even get a full refund. (I should just stick with my Skullcandy 50/50 headphones. They're better than these headphones, and better than the Sony in-ear headphones I bought afterward trying to save money.)

title: Good cable, liked the 90 degree angle at one side
review: Bought this hoping my headset microphone would be recognized by my laptop, but ultimately made no difference. A good cable, just didn’t fix my issue, a USB headset did.

title: At first use, seems to do the trick
review: With significant hearing loss (and hearing aides), and a job training in web meetings, I need an amplifier to boost the audio from my Microsoft Surface Book using Sennheiser headphones sufficiently to do my job. It is so critical to me, and I travel so much, that I have used the tiny FiiO E06 and have a backup at all times, as well as backup cables, because they tend to give out as well. I decided to bite the bullet and pick up a more substantial amplifier, thus purchased this one. Out of the box, build quality looks good. Plugged it into my computer charger USB port and gave it a try. Major static but sufficient amplification. Plugged it into the computer USB port, and the static improved. Amplification was plenty good on Low Gain, but boosted further on High Gain, more than I need. If the battery is really as good as they claim, won't need to plug it in all the time, as I did the FiiO. Still will travel with the tiny one, but this is great for daily work. Can't comment on music quality, as I haven't tried that yet. Will update if anything changes, hope this amp lasts.

title: It worked for a wired headset with separate connectors
review: Needed to use my wired headset with the computer. Seems to work fine and more sturdy than another I had.

title: Fits the Surfacebook
review: Nice quality case for my Surfacebook, narrow pocket that will hold the charger and headphone but not much more. I terior is a soft fleecy material. Would have liked a shoulder strap, but otherwise serves my purpose.

title: Loved it while it lasted X 2
review:
I used this amplifier to boost the sound coming out of a Sennheiser headset while doing training through the internet. Since this is my occupation, and I have hearing loss and wear hearing aides, the use of the headset without the amp did not produce loud enough sound for comfortable conversation. This little amp boosted the sound perfectly, the size allowed me to carry it for use in different locations, and I was a happy camper. I just found, after four months, that I lost sound in one side of the headset, and by inserting and removing the amp and changing connections discovered that the problem is in the amp, not the headset or computer. Not sure if I should get another one of these or something else, loved the portability of it. Will have to look into the warranty, sure I no longer have the paperwork.
Update 5/2016: Amazon did begrudgingly refund the price of this amp (a Warehouse purchase, so they balked at warranty) and I purchased another, only to have it also die in a few months like the first. Will try to exercise the warranty on this one, but basically have a extra on hand or get another device...just not a lot this small. Looking for recommendations on something else.

title: Not as comfortable as I would like, sound is good
review: I have hearing loss and wear hearing aides, so thought an "on the ear" model might work with my open fit hearing aides for my internet based training job, to maximize what would be uncorrected hearing (since the hearing aide picks up sound at it's behind the ear location). I found this inexpensively at Amazon, so tried it. First, it has two plugs, so if you only have one input to computer or phone, need a cable to use it. The sound quality has worked well, however someone asked if I was ill, apparently my voice sounded unusually husky to him. They felt comfortable initially, on my small head, but after three hours I was shifting them around, trying to get the pressure off my ears. I found the the earbud from my new iPhone seem to work better than these, so I will keep them for occasional use, but I am somewhat disappointed in the comfort. The location of the microphone seems fine.

title: Amazing for little speakers
review: Purchased for a seasonal home to be able to play music from my computer. Amazed at how much volume these put out. Volume control must be via sending device, like your computer, but appear to work with any device with a headphone/audio out jack. No technical issues thus far. Works with computer, iPad, smartphone, etc. Adjusted with equalizer on my computer to improve the bass, as it sounded a little high as it came out of the computer.

title: Great buy, Great Sound
review: Finally....I wanted to post this review 2 minutes after I received these on my doorstep....I took them out of the box, and immediately went to the computer and put my music on.  I put on the song that for me is the test of good or bad headphones and.....wow, Wow, WOW!!!!!  I there are not enough good words in the dictionary to describe how I feel.  The clarity was awesome, I could hear every nuance of the music I was listening to, and believe me, I have waited a long time, and tried many, many, many headphones and earbuds (the earbuds hurt my ears...small canals).  I have tried expensive ones and cheap ones...I started buying really cheap ones because I had to replace them so often, and I have not enjoyed my music half as much as I used to.  I am NOT being paid for this review, and I am thinking about buying another pair, just in case, because of the reviews on how easy the plastic breaks...It would be worth buying more to have on hand for the sound alone.  Thank you for such a Great product and the price is unbeatable...Usually you get what you pay for...in this case you get Much more than expected.  Love it!

title: Protects well, 5 months in.
review: Edited at 5 months: The only downsides are the flaps that cover the headphone/ear bud jack and power cord plug in hole, and the relative difficulty in getting the case around the iPod and the two halves of the case together. Before putting it together, I used a razor blade to cut the two stiff flaps off. Otherwise, they would put pressure on, and bend, headphone cord and power cord. I've dropped my iPod many times at many angles since putting the case on, without damage. 5 months in, and many drops later, and still no damage to my ipod. Touchscreen still works exactly the same.

title: Did not last.
review: The left earbud's speaker started going out after about a month. Also, not long after, the two coated wires that lead to each earbud seperated all the way down to the jack.

title: Save earbuds, save money
review: This case has paid for itself already by keeping my earbud-nibbling cat from getting hold of my buds.  It also keeps the cords from tangling.  Fast and easy to use.  It is small and soft enough to put in a pocket but the center where the buds go is sturdy enough to keep them from being squashed.  I wish I'd bought this a long time ago.

title: Exactly right
review: Fits mp3 player, earbuds and charger cord handily.  Nice and sturdy.  Perfect size and color match to mp3 player AGPTEK G05 8GB Portable Clip Mp3 Player with FM...No one is better than I at losing small things so this case is a necessity and one of the reasons I chose the player.

title: Good headphones
review:
Good pair of headphones. A great crisp sound.
Although I feel like there are a little overpriced I would recommend them to others.

title: Good sound, comfortable, but people can't hear me. 3.5 stars ✨
review: I love to listen to music with these earbuds. They fit my small ears pretty well without making them sore. They sound great to me after I customized the sound on my Note 10+. They don't have a lot of base, but I am ok with what they do have. The biggest problem I have has to do with what I needed them for. I cannot use them to talk to people. I can hear them, but they cannot hear me well. They say I sound tinny and like I'm in a hole. If it weren't for this, they would be great.

title: Has great sound when positioned properly
review: This headset is too big for my head.  When I put them on where it’s comfortable I can hear things pretty good but when I shift the speakers back a little the sound becomes much more brilliant.  Unfortunately there is no adjustment to be able to have the speakers line up with my ears.  Pairs with Bluetooth easily.  Charges fast and seems to last a long time.  Easy to turn on and off too.  I’m scoring these as a 5 because they are very nice and comfortable with great sound and mic clarity.  Just be aware that they need a large head in order to use effectively.

title: Great earbuds!
review: Love these earbuds! Comfy fit, great sound quality and wireless great for working out!

title: okay
review: At first I was under the impression they sounded flat. But after pushing the ear gel plug a bit more in the ear canal they sounded better. I really like the design and they look nice. However I noticed the headset lacks a certain sound boost other headsets have. Not talking about bass boost but more overall sound boost. The button in the center when listening to music changes track and i'm guessing answers calls. (Haven't used this for that yet). Philips also sells another model that has volume up and down. Taking a wild guess I would say this is an older version. Positioning of the ear cap gel really makes the difference.

title: perfect
review: bought this to use with another Bluetooth headset .. it worked fine , just plug and play. lost it but purchased another.

title: Perfect headset with microphone
review: I love this headset which is better than expected. It is strong and sturdy, but gentle to touch and doesn’t hurt my ears after hours of wearing them. The padded headband of the wireless headset is adjustable and stretchable to fit me perfectly, and it is suitable for kids too. I like the feature that helps connect with laptop and my smartphone at the same time. I could connect from my kitchen to my home office which is about 40 feet. The transmission is stable and efficient. This is also great for driving. It is easy to pair with my laptop and smartphone. The product was received within the expected time, and it was packaged well. I rated this product five stars for overall satisfaction.

title: Very comfortable and easy to use
review:
I am pleased with this headset; the sound quality is good and audibility is very sharp. The music quality is also good. Assembly is very simple and needs no additional tools to set it together. It also fits well into my ears. I have been using this set for the last three weeks and it works great. It is paired with my cell phone and I use this to listen to the incoming calls and also listen to the music from micro SD card inserted into the cell phone. It is small and has a discreet design. It is very light, easy to carry and works great. The gadget also synchronizes easily with phone, but it does not pair with my Garmin Nuvi GPS machine or my Acer Chromebook both of which are Bluetooth-enabled.

Pairing with cell phone is very easy; just turn the headset on and the cell phone on, it detects the Bluetooth easily and within a minute it gives the message that it is paired. The built-in battery is excellent, and on one charge it lasts for about 5-6 hours of use time. The downside is that this piece doesn't have a separate mute button or the volume button; you have to control volume from your cell phone. Another negative feature is that the three replacement parts for earpiece that comes with the set are of same size, hence gives little option for someone with small (or large) ears. I have rated this product four stars for overall satisfaction.

title: Way too pricey
review: The quality of the audio is fine and it is comfortable to wear for 2 to 3 hours, the product is strong and well made but it is way too pricey. I have used headphones purchased at lower price and they perform well. I compared this product with other headphones ($65) by listening to classical music, classic-rock, pop and blues, the quality was a little better with Monster DNA and the clarity is one notch higher. As some reviewers have noted that the audio quality gets better with music that has nice bass. All said and done; it comes down one simple question. Is this product worth so much $$ compared to other products available in the market? I personally believe that this is too expensive.

title: The 1.5" TFT color screen is too small
review:
This devise is very small to enjoy video or viewing the family and friends pictures. It is only 6 mm (1/4") thick and has a 1.5" TFT color screen, and the resolution is poor. This may be OK for browsing through your music files, use the device as an MP3 player or listen to the FM radio. The headphones are not the best, but it works OK. You can store up to 2,000 songs, and choose your music by title, or artist. You can also create your own favorites list to play at any time. Overall, if you already have a MP3 player, I don't think this will add significantly to the value.

2. [[ASIN:B0036RA4M8 Coby 4 GB Video MP3 Player with FM Radio (Blue)]]
3. [[ASIN:B003IB51D4 Pyrus Electronics 4gb Mp3 / mp4 / mp5 Player with 2.8 Inch Touch Screen and All Stainless Steel Casing]]

title: Good, but quite sensitive to slightest touch.
review: These attractive black earbuds and charging case are nicely presented with a small pouch, charging cord and 5 sets of rubber ear tips in a variety of sizes. The instructions provided were clear, and it was easy to sync to my iPhone. I received good, clear audio immediately. However, the pods are very sensitive and respond to the slightest movement, which resulted in disconnecting a call. This does not seem to be a problem with other audio. Accordingly, it appears that I still need to get better acquainted with the product, but I am satisfied.

title: An incredible value.
review:
It really astounds me that these ear buds are under $10 as the sound is crisp and clear, whether you’re listening to music or the spoken word.
Over the years, I have bought and sampled a variety of earbuds, some of which have been incredibly expensive. I have yet to come across anything in this price range that’s made as well, is as comfortable in my ears, comes with a nice little black carrying case, and delivers great sound.
In addition, the volume control and volume range is excellent in that you do not need to put it on high-volume to get loud sound. This can be especially useful if you’re in a public space with lots of noise.
Last but not least, they’re a nice pure design and lightweight.

title: Great value
review:
I like these. The bass is excellent, there is a really wide volume range, and they are lightweight.
In addition, the headphones sit comfortably on your head.

I tried them with a wide variety of music, from classical, to kirtan, to rock, to folk---all sounded very good.
I also sampled my current audiobook (Nora Webster) and it came through beautifully.

title: Crystal clear sound
review:
I am a fan of these; however, I prefer a slightly warmer sound, hence the four star rating and not five. Their sound is truly crystal clear which, if you are using them with a phone, is desirable.
My other great earbuds from Sennheiser came with a very easy to use pouch for storage. The case included with this set is awkwardly designed and not user-friendly.

I like having the controls on the wire, as opposed to having to access your device for loudness, track shuffling, etc. These have a chic little controller in a very convenient place, at about neck level.

You may want to also check out TDK EB900 High Fidelity In Ear Headphones.

title: Excellent for the price
review:
I like these in ear headphones a lot. Their sound is crisp and clear, and they are very lightweight, since the cord is made from woven fabric as opposed to the typical rubbery cord on most ear buds.
The volume is strong, but there's no volume control on the cord--a minor quibble.
Noise cancelling abilities seem above average, compared to Sennheiser and Ultimate Ears.
The buds are mid-sized and comfortable.
All in all, a very good choice for home and airport use.

Update: December 2013
One of the earbud's plastic cases broke and one of the thin wires inside detached, making them unusable.
I had been a fan of these, but am disappointed in the quality.

title: Not working after week
review: These earphones make my music sound like it's coming out of a tin can. Furthermore they started fading in and out after a week of use. Terrible. They're headed for the trash can. Don't waste your money on this product.

title: Major upgrade
review: So glad I bought these as they are much better than the ones that come with the earbuds. Extremely comfortable and don't fall out like the originals did (regardless of the size I used). Cancels noise so much better as well! Very happy with them!

title: More Than I Expected
review:
To be honest, I didn't know what to expect from the Jabra Elite 7 Pro earbuds. Being an avid user of corded earbuds, I expected that they would fall out of my ears immediately. I was so wrong. They fit so snuggly without hurting my ears at all.

I am so amazed at the ease of use. I downloaded the Sound+ App on my smartphone, followed the instructions, and was ready to use the earbuds within minutes. The sound is very immersive. I experimented with ANC and HearThrough along with the equalizer to get the perfect sound quality.

The battery life was longer than I expected. I was able to use it for approximately expected eight + hours on a single charge.

The only teeny tiny issue I have is with the charging case. There should be a slot where you can put the edge of your nail, or some type of grip to open the lid a little easier. The exterior is very smooth, and you don't always get a good hold on it.

Overall, these are wonderful wireless earbuds that I can use every day.

I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest review.

title: Comfortable but loud (not in a good way)
review:
First off, these came adorably packaged in their own little leather case. Made me reminiscent of my old CD cases but on a super small scale. Inside was a small "thank you" paper, the ear buds and extra silicone covers. They are surprisingly comfortable. I had no issues wearing them for hours. The controls on the cord worked fine. No issues there.
Plugged them right in and they have a hiss to them. Is that the noise cancellation? I don't know. I don't think so. It only made everything seem louder.
Ok, no problem, maybe that is just the static white noise energy of not having anything else. I've had a few other headphone sets like that-hissy until the music starts. Turned on an audio book. Nope, still hissy. It wasn't as noticeable while the audio book was playing, but it was there and I am now hyper fixated on the constant "hisssssssssssssss" of static in the background.
Sound quality was ok. Not as nice as some pairs I've had in the past, but not terrible. I can live with the quality.
But can I live with the hiss? The jury is still out on that.

title: Disappointing
review:
I was hopeful I'd like these. Unfortunately I just don't.
They came partially charged so I was able to use them right away. They paired easily with my phone. They turn on and off easily with just a touch. They also charge quickly, and per the guide you can charge them about three times on one charge of the case.
But I find them incredibly uncomfortable. After just a few minutes the insides of my ears hurt. I also don't find that they are noise cancelling-maybe because they just don't fit my ears well?
The sound quality is nice. But every now and then there is a delay between the two earphones so the left earbud will be behind the right one for a couple of seconds which is super disorienting. My phone (which it was paired to) was only about 12 inches away.
Anyways, overall I found these disappointing. I'll be shopping for something else to try.

title: Great Quality and Sound
review: They are very good quality earbuds. I bought them for my wife as a Christmas gift. She really enjoys the sound quality. For the price, these earbuds are very good!

title: Good sound and feeling, until it rips.
review: I like the feeling and the improved sound because of the earplug, but I seriously question the durability. I used the medium size for a week and one of the buds ripped. I have short nails, I keep my bluetooth headset in a protective hard case, but one still managed to rip. Now, I can use the large buds, but it is uncomfortable.

title: Great headphones
review: The Panasonic RP-HTF600-S Stereo Headphones were a great buy. I bought them to convert them into gym sweat-proof headphones - and it worked! I have been using my headphones for over a week now with no problems. These guys sound great - and I have absolutely no complaints. They are very comfortable and feel like they were made well. I am extremely satisfied with this purchase.

title: Jaybird Sportsband - not for the athlete.
review:
I sweat a whole lot. Maybe too much... but with the sweat warranty I thought I would be good. I wasn't. Within 3 days I had already shorted them out.

Now you might be thinking - I don't sweat too much - still consider these factors though:
They are uncomfortable on a larger head. There is no padding between the metal in the headphones and your head - so if there is a lot of pressure, it hurts.
These are also not flexible. If your ears are not flush against your head, they might not want to stay on.

Also, the sound for the price was 'meh'.

Good bluetooth from headphones to transmitter (ipod, samsunggalaxyS2) range though!

title: After two weeks will not connect or pair with any device.
review:
I recently purchased BÖHM Wireless Bluetooth Over Ear Cushioned Headphones with Active Noise Cancelling - B76. They worked OK for 2 weeks. Now they will not reconnect to anything. I tried re-pairing by turning off and holding the button down for 3 to 5 seconds. I hear "power on, pairing" and the light flashes blue and read. But it will not pair with phone, computer or audio receiver. I have tried many times, with headphones 1/2 meter from devices. It will not pair with any device.

When i try and pair with a computer I can see the BOHM B76 headphones, but after a few minutes computer says "Device BOHM B76 Not Responding". Support does not respond to email an they have no phone number. If I don't hear from them in a few days I will be returning them.

title: occiam Bluetooth Headphones 4-Mics
review: These are excellent earphones, especially for the price. They sound good and are very comfortable. I really like that I can use only one if needed and it will switch to mono mode. Both pieces have control buttons. I also love the color. The case has a nice size and bright display for charging levels.

title: Great value
review: These headphones work very well for the price. They’re nice, basic headphones in soft pastel colors. They are a bit bigger than I hoped. They fit my head fine on the smallest setting, so I’m concerned they’ll be kind of big for my grandkids.

title: Work well for my walks.
review: These earphones sound good and feel comfortable. I got them to wear under my beanie while out walking on chilly days, and they are great for that. They don’t cause any discomfort at all. However they don’t stay in my ears very well without the hat holding them in. I do have very small ear openings, though, so they will probably stay in for most other people.

title: A real game changer!
review: The audio I transcribe usually has loads of loud background noise. These headphones made my life so much easier, by bringing the speakers voice right upfront. They don't remove background sounds, but they definitely dull them down a whole lot. The speaker sounds nice and crisp, and definitely overpowers the other sounds.

title: sound is ok, but no voice prompts and limited capibilities
review:
If you need a really cheap set of earbuds, this is it. They will not work very well with your phone, however. Most of the advertised features, like phone answering, volume control, track back and forward, simply do not work on all phones. At least it doesn't on my Android. A disclaimer in the package said it's designed mostly for iPhones.

I wouldn't buy if you need all around earbuds.

title: very ok quality for the money
review:
These headphones work really well for things like zoom meetings and phone calls, but for listening to music, they sometimes appear a wee bit cheap. The sound feels just a tad off, but I can't put my finger on how I'd describe it. Maybe a bit flat??

They are also surprisingly comfortable to wear.

title: Awesome earphones!!!
review:
I was skeptical of this product when I ordered it, but I was pleasantly surprised when it arrived. It comes in a beautiful gift box with spare silicone buds. A case is also included. The noise cancelling works very well, almost too well to use outside when you need to be aware of your surroundings.

Sound quality is superb, almost like very expensive name brands. However, after using them for an extended period (5 hours-ish) your ears start to ache.

I bought my 2nd pair of these earphones, they are that awesome.

title: Excellent headphones
review: I was somewhat skeptical at the price of these headphones for all they brag about; however, I have been thoroughly impressed with the sound and comfort.  I would highly recommend these headphones to anyone looking for great sound at a decent price.

title: Lots of padding, Many compartments
review:
CNPOP Electronics Organizer,Travel Cable Organizer Bag,Water Resistant Double Layers Pouch Carry Case for Cable,Cord,Phone,Charger,Earphone,Travel Accessories Tech Storage Bag for Men,Grey

Lots of padding is built into this electronics organizer. There is padding on the top and the bottom and also there is padding on the inside divider. That’s a great feature to protect the electronics. A phone with a thick case fit into one inside pocket. There are numerous other pockets and elastic straps to hold other items in place. This seems like a great value to me.

title: Great sound quality, well made and comfortable
review: Great earphones - the sound is fantastic. After going through multiple types of earphones to wear to the gym, some with poor quality sound, some very uncomfortable -- finally found these and they are well worth the cost. Very well made, comfortable, and I actually look forward to wearing them. I would highly recommend these!

title: Not very well made
review: I was disappointed in how these fit, and that they really aren't adjustable. Some reviewers said something about bending the metal. Well, I guess you could do that, but I had a pair of sports ear phones prior to this (for years before they broke), and the clip part was actually adjustable without having to literally bend the metal. The Koss ad says something about the pivoting ear piece, They don't pivot at all. Anyway, they do not feel at all secure. Most people are not 100% symmetrical, so I'd like to adjust the left one tighter but I can't. The clip part of the headphone pops off when I have them in the pocket of my gym bag. I can just snap it back on, but that is also another thing I find inconvenient. The sound is not great either. I had a pair of Philips sports headphones prior to this, and the sound was much better. So I'm going to purchase another pair of Philips. The cost of shipping and the hassle isn't worth it for me to return these.

title: These work pretty good for the price
review: I've been looking for another set of earbuds, so thought I'd try these.  I had to put the small silicone pieces on so they fit in my ears better, but they still fall out once in a while.  I need to work on getting the seated in my ears better, I think.  They connected easily to my iPhone.  I've found the best way to get both of them connected is to turn off Bluetooth on the phone, put both buds in my ears, then turn Bluetooth back on.  I cant get the buttons to work on them, but I don't use that function much on any of my other earbuds, so not a big deal to me.  Still happy with them.

title: Good little earbuds
review:
These are great for sleeping. The small size is very comfortable. Sound quality is good. I also use them while doing chores - mowing the lawn or doing housework.

It took me a couple of days to notice the (extremely) small pieces of plastic on the earbuds over the charging ports, so if you find you’re having problems charging them, make sure you’ve removed the plastic. Other than that, there were no problems pairing them to my phone. Very happy with this product.

title: Horrible product AND customer service
review:
After just a few months, the left earbud stopped working. Tried to contact customer service, but they wanted a video to show its not working?? How do you do that??? All I got was the run around, so now I can only use the right earbud.

A waste of money - don’t bother buying!!!!!

title: Can charge all my devices, laptop, simultaneously
review: My new power block has a quality build, and creative design, and i have been able to charge  all my devices and PC at the same time using this device, which i really like. This power block has an attached short extension cord, which I like as this avoids me having to plug a large power block directly into my wall outlet, keeping other outlets unencumbered.
