The power block has 2 usb-a and 1 usb-c plug, for my phone, smartwatch and headset, and 2 plugs for power cords I have been using for my laptop and also my lamp, which I like. I like this power block / power strip, and recommend it.

title: Very good sound, fit well, work well, comfortable
review: My new headphones 🎧 provide very good sound quality, and the controls for volume up/down and pause/start for music works well with my laptop, which I like. The headphone have a good oook and feel, with the earbuds fitting snuggly in my ears to the point that they are almost hidden in my ears when I use these, which I find appealing. The only negative is the wires for the headphone are relatively thin and so longevity and ruggedness is questionable to me, time will tell.  Overall I like these headphones and recommend them.

title: Nice Headset that works very well for music and calls
review: These alto base headset pods work well with my phone for listening to music, tested on several classic rock songs. The bass in particular was very good on this headset. These have the look and feel of the competition originals. You can turn the music that is playing on or off with a single tap on either headset pod. You can advance to the next song with a double tap on the pods. Those functions worked well and as expected. I was able to make some phone calls to family and feedback was my voice could be heard clearly via the headset microphones and was not muffled in the least. The pod charger is shaped like the competition originals and appear like they would fit in any of the typical protector carry cases on the market.  The volume level left at maximum was not as high as other Bluetooth headsets I have used, otherwise this would be a 5 review. I recommend these alto bass headset pod sets.

title: Give Apple a Hand (or just a finger)
review: Great.  Now I can use the headphones I actually like with my work phone, and get around Apple's proprietary nonsense (and avoid giving them any money).  Note that you can get some like this that allow for a charger cable pass through, but they are bigger and uglier.  This is nice, small, and simple.

title: Good.
review: This works just fine, so I sort of hate to give it less than five stars, but considering how long it is, one would expect you might want to run this under the floor or through some walls or whatever (mine is from my set of stereos to a computer in the basement), so for that scenario, this "braided" sheath really isn't the best choice.  Anyway, works as expected.  Keep in mind that it a stereo model, so it will not accommodate your stereo headset with mic (mic would require an extra conductor).

title: Not for stereo headphones with mic.
review:
Nice cable. Works as expected. I like to use lots of extenders to keep my space clutter free and add lots of versatility.

Note that this is two channel plus ground, so it won't work to extend stereo headphones with integrated mic. Also note that normally three channel cables are compatible (sort of "backward compatible") with 2-channel devices, so you might want to consider that depending on your setup.

Male connector has a bit of a "neck" on it, presumably to ensure it fits into phone/device case holes. Unfortunately, it is a bit too short to work with my Caseology case for Iphone6, but that is a very common problem for me.

title: Works as expected.
review: Nice tight fit.  Works as expected to convert old (or some type of trying to be fancy) stereo headphone inputs to a type you can actually use with most modern headphones.  They are stereo, so don't expect to get your mic to work through this as well.

title: Pairs quickly and works well.
review:
They work as expected, which is well. Surprisingly well, considering how complicated these little devices seem to be. Like other earbuds of this type, they often blink while you're trying to put them away because you can't help but push activation buttons. What I've found is that you just put them away and they'll settle themselves down and charge their own batteries.

Color is a bit reddish for pink, but it's just a color. They are quick to pair with my phone since the initial setup, and even that was easy. There's a lot of these things on the market nowadays, so check around for pricing.

title: Dual mode
review: This is a pretty nice headset.  I really like that it can be wired as well, because most of the time I wear headphones is on a plane (and their screens usually take wired only.  Plus, then you don't have to worry about power.  They sound good and work as expected, but I've seen some of higher quality and some that fold up and are more compact, so I guess being being spoiled for choice leaves me jaded to headphones.  Certainly not a bad choice if the price is right.

title: Convenient and Good Sound
review:
Great headphones. They pair easily with my Blackberry every time I turn them on, and they sound great for calls or music. I really like wireless in many headphone situations, although for almost everything else I prefer the reliability and quality associated with wired devices. I mean, audiophiles may prefer to have their music in unprocessed analog (which obviously can't be done over Bluetooth), but if I'm doing something around the house that I actually need to wear headphones for some reason, the wireless part is really convenient. But I really love that these have an audio jack as well. The battery lasts quite a while in these things.

Funny, a few years ago, everyone was giving you chargers with 5V products, but now it seems that everyone expects you to have a bunch laying around already (sort of true in my case, but some of them break, some get lost, etc.). A charger does not come with these headphones.

title: Sound and Style
review:
These may be the best sounding headphones I've been able to try so far, which is saying a lot. You definitely pick up all the little oddball sound effects happening in the background of your music, stuff that I realize is easy to miss even in higher end stereos. They also look really good: simple and classic, the way I like it. These are worlds apart in both respects from all the Beats headphones you see that succeeded solely from marketing and bad trending. It's also nice to have the digital-to-analog converter inside since lossless music is becoming more common thanks to memory being so cheap.

The bad news is that these are sort of a one-trick pony: no mic, proprietary connector (which can be justified since it supposedly draws power as well, but then why no mic and additional features), no ability to charge phone while in use (why not have an input to charge both simultaneously on the cable or the actual headphones?). So you're just getting music, and just from your phone. Of course most people want it that way.

title: Perfect
review:
We bought these for our team of travellers in the office. Absolutely fantastic. The side pockets for water bottles give me confidence that they will not stretch and warp anytime soon, the zippers are all smooth as silk, the interior is nice, the handle is not guady like on some other Swiss models, the ScanSmart feature is obviously great, although some overzealous security people will still make you remove your computer. It's also comfortable and roomy, but not so big that it looks silly. Down-to-business black and just the right number of pockets.

There is a phone/MP3 player pocket inside the main compartment with an escape path for your earphones; I would prefer if this was a full zip pocket accessible directly like on my CamelBak M.U.L.E. On the other hand, I now find myself sometimes looking for the sunglasses holder on my CamelBak, but it's not there, just on the SwissGear ScanSmart.

Really a great product.

title: Do the job
review:
I got this item to use it on my desk to hold my phone to watch movies…ect. I don't use the speaker that often because I use more the headphones due people around me.
This stands hold the phone a little bit higher than normal and is steady enough. My neck feels better but I wish this stand was taller to get it to the eye level. I use it every Day at work. its easy to carry it around or leave it at the desk. My wife wants one to use while cooking to listen to music and to watch her shows.

title: Decent quality for the price
review: These earbuds provide a lot of value for what you pay. A quality case with a digital readout, Touch Sensitive controls on the air, buds themselves, and good sound quality.

title: Great earbuds at a fraction of the price of AirPods!
review: Got these Bluetooth earbuds to replace another pair that did not last as long as I had hoped. Really appreciate the quality construction evident in this product. Even the packaging is top-notch, very reminiscent of the way Apple packages, their iPhones and other expensive products. Comes with a variety of earpieces to adjust the fit to the shape of your ears, as well as include a charging case, and a USB-C to USB a cable Fully charged right out of the box, they connected instantly to my iPhone, and provide great sound quality.

title: Reasonable price, decent quality
review:
These headphones are proof you can get decent quality at a reasonable price. These don't have the sound you'd get from a high end pair, but for the price, they deliver clear sound and block out a good bit of background noise.

The padding is thick and comfortable. They fit snuggly against my head, and didn't feel like they were squeezing too tightly. They are very lightweight. I love the silver color. They look very sleek and polished, and more expensive than they are. Pairing was extremely easy. My phone found them as soon as I turned them on, and paired with them as soon as I selected them.

If you're looking for a good pair of daily use headphones, these are a good choice.

title: Great sound for a good price
review:
This is definitely one of the better pairs of earbuds I've purchased. The pairing, which can sometimes be frustrating, was incredibly simple with these. They came already charged, and were ready for use.

I tested their range throughout my house, and they did great. I didn't notice any problems leaving my phone upstairs, and going in every room downstairs. So the range of coverage is really good.

The charging case displays the percentage of charge remaining. This is a great feature, and keeps me from having to guess if I have enough charge for use if I forget to charge them. The charging case can also be used to charge other devices, but I haven't tried this out yet.

They fit comfortably in my ear, and are more secure than my pop in earbuds. My pop ins will sometimes pop out if I'm too active. I did have to change the rubber earpieces to get a better fit, but there are several included so it was easy to get a good fit.

I think these are a very good value for the money. They perform as well as many more expensive earbuds, but won't break the bank.

title: Good for everyday use
review:
This is a good, inexpensive pair of earbuds. The sound quality is good for listening to podcasts or watching movies, but not so great for music. I have others I use for that.

They fit comfortably in my ears, and I can wear them for several hours without irritation. They come with an awesome carrying case that alone is with the purchase price. Not a bad deal for 10 bucks.

title: Amazing sound quality and comfort
review:
It's hard to believe these earbuds are priced at under 20 bucks. They deliver better sound than my much pricier big name brand pair. They're more comfortable too. I wish I had discovered these before I invested in the others.

If you're looking for an inexpensive, good quality pair of earbuds, you should grab these. You won't be disappointed.

title: Good sound
review: These are really nice earbuds for the price point. The sound quality is great. They fit comfortably in my ear, and stay put. Set up was easy. The charging case even has a digital display showing you how much power is left. They would make a great gift.

title: Nice sounding earbuds
review: My earbuds died, so I was looking for a good inexpensive replacement pair. These are perfect for my needs. They fit snuggly in my ear, and the sound quality is surprisingly good. I use them on my walks, and around the house while cleaning. They stay charged for a good while. Great budget friendly pair of earbuds.

title: Perfect radio for emergency use
review: I got this radio to keep on hand for emergency use. It's the perfect size to slip in your pocket. It has a very slim profile, and is about the size of your palm. I specifically wanted one that takes batteries, and doesn't need electricity to charge. The sound is clear, and it has good volume. I also like that it has a plugin jack for headphones. It comes with a nice little pouch with enough room to hold the 2 AAA batteries, along with the radio. Never leave the batteries in the radio when not in use. With all of today's technology this is an item that few people think about anymore, but when the time comes, you'll wish you had one.

title: Good sound for a great price
review: These are a great choice for an inexpensive pair of earbuds. The sound is clear, and the noise cancellation is excellent. They fit snuggly in my ears, and are very comfortable. They deliver quality sound at a great price. I do wish the charging cord were a little longer.

title: Nice Portable Player
review: This is a nice and easy to use portable player. It has lots of functions and it has a touch screen, so it's fun to use. It doesn't have a speaker - it is meant to be used only with earphones. I like the size, it's small enough to fit into a pocket. It's an affordable unit but it still has lots of functionality!

title: Fits Great
review: I'm using this on my Roku controller with voice recognition and volume control and it fits nicely. This is really going to help keep my remote safe since I seem to drop it on the hardwood floor on a regular basis. My roku doesn't have the feature for headphones, but the cover still fits perfectly and I really like it.

title: Nice Little Radio!
review: I'm totally impressed with this little radio! It is small but has many features. It is so much better than I expected. I think it is comparable to much higher priced models. It's easy to use, and even though it's small, the speaker is really good. The display is easy to read. The headphones are good quality also. One of the best things about this radio is that it comes with well-written, complete instructions that are easy to follow. It's nice and lightweight, so you can bring it with wherever you go. It's also great to have on hand for emergencies. love this radio!

title: Comfy Headband Headphones
review: This is a nice comfy headband headphone that has decent sound. This is my first headband headphone set so I don't have anything to compare it with, but I am very happy with this. I wanted this for sleeping and it seems like it will work great for that. The headband is comfortable and not too tight, which I like. The material is soft yet thin enough that it won't make your head hot. I was able to pair it easily and I'm not technically inclined. The sound seems fine. I like that you can remove the hardware to wash the headband. I'm going to get a lot of use out of this!

title: Can't be Beat(s)!
review: I can't provide a technical, detailed "audiophile" review of these headphones.  I can provide only my opinion, as a very particular and somewhat hard to please consumer.  The base is crisp, not muddy, not boomy, not overpowering, just flat out perfect. The midrange and highs are music to my ears  :-).  I really am picky, and can't imagine ever wanting better headphones than these, at any price.  But hearing is subjective, so best of luck finding  what you love...I did!

title: Very nice headphones. Noise cancelling works well.
review:
I'm very happy with these headphones! They are very comfortable and a good size for my ears.

I primarily use them for gaming. Plugged into my Playstation controller with the USB-C to the 3.5mm cable.

The sound quality is great for a set of headphones at this price point.

The Bluetooth is just as good when listening to music with my phone.

Be aware the noise cancelling function only works when connected to Bluetooth that I have experienced.

A wired connection doesn't require the headphones to be turned on, but noise cancelling does.
Not a big issue anyway because the ear cups fit my ears well and do a great job silencing the outside world on their own.

If you're looking for decent headphones at a budget price, you have found some right here.

title: Not recommended
review:
I really wanted to like these. They have an interesting design and the idea of being able to sleep comfortably with these in your ears intrigued me.

Unfortunately, they are just not good. The sound is very basic, tinny without any detectable bass.
Also, the voice that declares the status of the device is in what sounds like Chinese. I was unable to determine how to change the language, or if it's even possible.

You also better keep up with the charge cable that comes with these because I was only able to find one other cable in my whole house that would work to charge them.

As I said, I love the look. The digital charge indicator on the case has a really nice aesthetic.
I just can't recommend that you spend your money on them when much better earbuds can be found at this price point.

title: Unique experience
review:
Bone conduction is a unique experience. I won't waste your time explaining it here.

These headphones provide clear sound, and fit my head nicely.
I personally would recommend them more for spoken word, audiobooks, podcasts, and the like.
Not saying music is bad through these, but if you are an audiophile, these may leave you wanting more.

I really enjoy these because the bulk of my media consumption is spoken word. And these are great.

title: Different from standard earbuds, but great for the price.
review:
I ordered these for my son who says normal in ear earbuds make his ears itch. These earbuds sit just outside of your ears and allow the sounds of your surroundings to be heard. They fit around the back of your head snugly but are still quite comfortable. No sweaty ear canals here!

They have 8GB of internal storage for you to store music and listen to without an external source. I have not tested this function because I primarily stream my music and content from my phone.

I agree with several other reviewers who have stated that this type of device is much better for spoken word (podcasts and audiobooks), than actual music.

While I don’t consider the sound of the music coming through these bad, there is something that is lost with these that you would get with standard earbuds and headphones.

For the price, you could do much worse. Overall, I would recommend these to anyone who has trouble with earbuds being in their ears for extended periods, or for anyone who would want to be able to monitor their surroundings while still trying to listen to their favorite content.

title: Sleek earbuds
review:
These earbuds are comfortable and provide nice sound and bass. However I heard a static sound every time someone in the shop used compressed air, no matter which setting I used. Great for outdoors, but not in the workshop?
The tap button functions are convenient and easy to use. Overall a good sound product, minus one small problem I'm sure most people will never have.

title: Surprisingly enjoyable
review: Set up was easy though I will say the instructions don't have English instructions, just the guide to what each button does and you an use deductive reasoning from that. The sound quality is good. Not like the most amazing ever but clear and smooth with no extra noise. Comfortable to wear. Great since I have a large number of piercings on my ears beyond just the lobes. I can wear them with a Bluetooth headset piece and glasses and everything stays where is should be. Can hear the things happening around me but also my media.

title: Great for WFH
review:
I have been using a personal gaming headset for work for comfort. When an update rendered it non-compatible I had to surrender to a generic Logitec headset that was too small for my head or ears.

I do have to talk on the phone a lot for work but I also do a bunch of data entry to having podcasts or music going is really nice. It was hard to get a set up where the music was not in my headset when I was talking to people but also I could hear it with the headset on.

This little guy has been a great solution. Airpod in one ear and this little thing in the other I can listen to my media and be readily available. The sound quality I would give a 6.5/10, ease of use 8/10, and comfort 7/10 (but I have small ear canals that always is a struggle). I would get this style again if it ever came to it.

title: Not the most secure
review: As pictured. A little hard to get rightly secured but once there it's a good setup to hold a headset.

title: Long lasting charge
review: These are perfect for emergencies and everyday use. Dont let the price mislead you, these actually hold a better charge than other brands I have used before. You're not getting the same quality sound as more higher end headphones but these are still a good quality for the price Im impressed. Easy to connect to your devices too!

title: Great quality
review: With most headphones and with constant wear, the ear pads wear out over time. This set was easy to apply. The only tricky thing was for me to remove the old pads off my Beats Studio headphones. These are the same or similar fit and the quality is pretty good. These are easy to install you get everything you need in the kit. You have removal tools, stickies, and instructions.

title: Broke after a month, poor service from EKSA, have still not replaced as promised
review: I liked this headset. It was comfortable and had great range. After a month, I started cutting out so much that it was not usable. The time for return had passed so I was directed to EKSA to address it under warranty. Although I paid for the return of the headset to EKSA, they first claimed they had sent replacement. The delivery label they showed me was to the East Coast, not where I live. Finally, today, I received an H-5 model from them. It has a 32 ft range, not the 99 ft range of the model I ordered. Very disappointed with EKSA.

title: Awesome
review:
Wow! The price is right and works well for zoom meetings
You need headphones Get them !

title: Excellent earbuds
review: This is a great set of earbuds. I've had no issues with connectivity since pairing, and can hear through them very clearly. They are working perfectly for what I need.

title: Excellent sleep headphones
review: These are probably the best sleep headphones that I have, currently, as I've tried several types. I like these better because you can adjust the band, so that it is the right fit. They also have definite spaces for the speakers, which is so important, as other sets I've tried in the past have had issues with the speaker pieces moving around and not staying put. It's comfortable and easy to use, which is what you want when you're sleeping. The most frustrating thing is having to fidget with something when it's supposed to be helping you sleep, but instead it's adding to your sleep issues. Great product.

title: Good quality wireless earbuds
review: This is a nice set of earbuds, with good sound quality and a comfortable fit. When using these to answer a call, my friend reported that the sound quality was really good from her end, and the sound quality was good on my end as well. The bluetooth was super easy to set up and I have no issues with connectivity while I'm using these. My one issue is that I train capoeira, which is an Afro-Brazilian martial art with a lot of spinning kicks and inversions. When I use these while training capoeira, they do fly out of my ears. I tried a few different sets of tips, but they still fall out. I do realize that they're probably not really designed to stay in for that type of movement, but I appreciate when I have a set that do stay in while i train.

title: I had some trouble with sound
review: These earbuds actually felt quite comfortable. After the initial pairing process, I noticed that the sound was cutting in and out. However, I thought perhaps it was just an initial problem that would go away. I wore these today for about 20 minutes, and found that the cutting in/out happened regularly. It would stop and work fine for a while, and then it would cut in/out again for a little while and then work again for a while. Although the earbuds were comfortable, the cutting in/out were not comfortable for me, so I ended up returning these.

title: Surprisingly good value for passive noise isolation
review: Though slightly bulkier than I'd liked, this is surprisingly good value.  The noise block/isolation effectiveness is excellent for this pricepoint.  Though unfair to compare it with active noise canceling headphones, the sound quality for this headset is decent.  Worked great with phones and laptop;  easy to pair and battery life seems to last as claimed. For short durations (1-2 hrs or so), the headset is comfortable on the ear - haven't tried it for extended period like a coast-to-coast flight.  Overall, good value for a passive noise reduction headset.

title: a good example of cost/value/performance;  not a airpods/buds pro substitute
review:
This is a good choice for a mid range (50-70$) earbuds that comes with a few excellent features and some drawbacks that will make you love your airpods or buds even more.

The main positives - the BT connectivity is excellent and zero loss of signal while jogging/yard work etc. Never had to repair the earbuds to my phone (Note). Battery life is as advertised and very pleasing. Fit is comfortable and no heaviness or blocked feeling.

The could-be-better - getting used to the stem controls is not that easy and has been finicky at times. Volume/bass is mediocre at best. Though some noise reduction is perceivable, it is uneven. It is IPX5 rated, means it should be able to "resist a sustained, low-pressure water jet spray".

At the advertised price, you are paying really for the battery life, BT chip, above-average noise suppression and average sound. Overall, a decent pair for using in situations where you are OK sacrificing performance (travel, yard work, jogging etc - where one could lose or step on it ).

title: effective. ok comfort level
review: For a headset in the 100-150 range, this provides an excellent sound quality; the noise cancelation is defined mostly as noise suppression (not active cancelation where out of phase waves to cancel/mute the sounds are generated); that allows for increased situation/surrounding awareness - plus, it is only a mono-head set.  For working in a home office, this is an excellent option.  May not work well in crowded spaces (post covid, of course).  The headset holds charge for 15-20 hrs of active conversations.  I usually keep it fully charged every alternate evening.  The earpiece is padding is fine, but has a learning curve for the buttons.  (I alternate use with AirPods when Zooming on an iPad where screen sharing is not required - one can tell the difference in convenience very quickly - this is great if you have to stare at a larger screen while talking and feels less free to move around/gesture).  Overall, good quality sound.

title: average sound quality with below-average features
review: One of the few headsets that has no volume control.  This alone disqualifies the headset.  The mic quality is actually decent and as a spare headset for travel, this may be an OK option - but not a default option.  There is no active noise cancellation (obviously), may block some noise - but on an airplane system, this didnt give enough volume or noise blocking to be useful in airplane entertainment systems either.  Not worth taking a chance on this model.

title: surprised at the quality and versatility;  headsets are average; not all FM stations reachable
review: At this pricepoint, this music player packs a lot of good features - expandable memory, FM radio, voice recording.  The headsets are average and tend to create some static - this may be due to the design of the recess that results in creating additional movement.  Apart from that, the only other issue was that not all FM stations in this region (Boston area) was reachable (beyond 105 freq).  Stations that can be reached by the device - the sound quality is excellent.  DIdnt notice any playback issues on mp3 - from the drive nor from the extended memory.  It does seem a bit bulky, but for a low cost device with FM and mp3, this is an excellent choice.  Primarily used by the kids in the house with a different headset than the one included..

title: A good introduction to higher-end phones - at the right price.  not replacing my current fav
review: For a headphone at this pricepoint, the sound quality is decent but not great (compared to a noise-cancelling headphone set I use regularly - not a direct comparison, I know).  The packaging is very high-end and maybe a bit too much. Excellent graphics of the design elements on the packaging and the sturdy box makes this a ready-to-gift item.  For me, the main use is for travel - so, noise canceling is a must; this set is a bit bulky for travel, especially if you decide to use the included travel case.  Also remember the quality of the sound is more dependent on the source of the sound (streaming music is not a great way to enjoy this headset - any ordinary will do); for this pricepoint, I did not find it a compelling value.  Compared to other over-ear noise isolation headsets (quite a few in 100-150 range, and even sub-100 on sale) are available - and their performance is almost identical for most sound sources (CD, streaming, travel..).  A good entry-level set for a higher-end, but only at the right price - not at the list price.

title: excellent value for the price; color scheme a bit jarring
review: Good quality headphones for the price;  for the main purpose of having an easy-to-use headphones while jogging/walking, this is an excellent  option - fairly quick to charge, sufficient battery life (6-8 hours when used on an average of an hour a time or so), easily pairs with the devices, and OK sound quality for mic and headphones.  Not a major fan of the red-black color scheme for the wires - completely black or white would have been a more palatable option.  With multiple options for earbuds and good performance for the price point, this is an excellent choice.

title: Not especially impressive
review: These earbuds are not especially impressive. I would have given them 3.5 stars if I could have. The noise cancelation is pretty decent. The earbuds last the five hours they say they do. The earbuds don't get very loud, which would perhaps be good for a child or teenager to protect their hearing. For an adult, though, it can be a bit frustrating in situations where you really want to rock out. The charging case is adequate. In all, it covers all its claims, but there just isn't anything impressive about the sound quality and shorter battery life.

title: Shocked by how long the battery lasts!
review:
With the purchase of my new phone, my wired earphones no longer could connect to my phone. I shopped around, and decided to order this pair. I am so glad I did! These truly last for hours. I am truly shocked by how long they last, especially in the case that powers them even if the case isn't plugged in. Because the case has a battery that charges while plugged in, you can use these earbuds while traveling and have one charging while using the other.

The sound quality is pretty good for such small earbuds, and they come with different sized silicone tips to fit a variety of ear shapes for comfort. The case is a little heavy since it has such a great battery, but the fact you can use them for at least 24 hours if you use one at a time on a full charge makes up for the heavier weight.

title: Lightweight, breathes well, great sound quality. Comfortable and high quality.
review: These do not cancel outside noise. In fact, their open-cell design makes them perfect for conditions where you actually want to hear what is going on around you as well as whatever media you are listening to. Because they are lightweight and breathe well they are good for extended wear; your ears won't get sweaty as quickly as other over-the-ear headphones. Compared to other high performance headphones, their small, lightweight design is also comfortable for extended wear. I'm not a highly qualified audiophile, but the sound is rich and true to my ears. Being wired, they will not need recharging, which together with the other features this makes them perfect for anyone who wears headphones for extended periods

title: Uncomfortable with glasses.
review:
I really like these headphones. Sound quality is quite good, and no more issue with AirPods falling out of my ears while exercising/gardening or ear pain when lying down with buds in. Yay! Also, these are great at keeping my ears warm during morning walks in cool weather.

The bluetooth is quite efficient, even at a distance. It kept overriding a phone call when I was outside and many yards away from the headband which was left inside sitting on a counter. I finally had to turn off my bluetooth to carry on the conversation without interruption.

Unfortunately, there are two downsides:

1) The stretchy fabric is difficult to move out of the way to access the charging port.

2) When paired with glasses, the headband puts too much pressure on the "temple tips' causing sizable discomfort behind the ears.

Yet to be determined: Laundering. There are clear instructions with pics on removing the electronics before laundering. The wires are quite small however, and I'm a bit concerned I might break something in the process. Not wanting to experiment unneccessarily, I'm opting to wait until the headband really needs cleaning before I attempt this. If all goes well, I'll come back and up the rating. But for now, I don't feel comfortable giving this more than 3 stars.

Bottom line: I DO like this headband, and will use it a lot. But I would not recommend it for those who wear glasses.

title: Nice upgrade from Liberty Air
review:
I bought this set when I thought I lost my Liberty Air. I am very satisfied with my Liberty Air, but kept these because of a couple extra features which make the Liberty Air 2 my go-to earbuds.
With Liberty Air they only paired through the right earbud, so if the right earbud was dead I couldn't use either of them. With Liberty Air 2 I can use either of them while the other still charges.
Liberty Air 2 charges with the USB-C cord which is what my phone uses so I don't need to have two cords.
I have not familiarized myself with all the buttons and occasionally when I'm inserting the earbuds they will call up Google help on my phone or skip to the next track of what I'm listening to.
Both of them have great noise canceling, great sound, are comfortable, and fit well. Battery life seems better with the LA2.
Very satisfied, as always with Anker Soundcore products. I will not buy a cheaper off brand for headphones or earbuds, and I don't need a more expensive brand because Anker suits my needs perfectly.

title: Yay!
review: Hey, I really dig these headphones. Easy to connect, no weird apps to download. Just turn the Bluetooth on and it'll be a device that starts with BB-something or other. The instruction manual will get you together, but basically you put this around your neck, pull the buds out, stick em in your ear and go. There is an auto retract button to put the buds back in place when done using. Not a lot of bass but really good regardless. And they come with their own charger. There's extra buds for replacement if needed. Pretty cool

title: Almost made it...
review: Almost made it three months before totally pooping out on me yesterday. I work out a lot and sweat quite a bit so I go through earbuds constantly. However, this particular brand supposedly had a good reputation for active people so my hopes were high. But these too have failed me. Oh well. Having the app being able to control the sound was a very cool and different feature. The hear through feature was annoying & when I was at the gym I always had to put music in full blast so I couldn't hear people talking around me. Won't ever try this brand ever again but maybe these would work for a less active person.

title: Great if you need to be aware of your surroundings
review: I have a two-year-old at home so it is not in my best interest to have super sound-canceling headphones so I got these to try as it says you can still be aware but listen to audio.  It came packaged just fine with no defects that I could see.  It has a magnetic 4-pin charger, I wish it was USB c but I will live.  The initial charge took about 2 hours and then I got to work.  Pairing them was pretty easy you just use the multi-function button and I never lost connection.  The sound quality is pretty darn good for a bone-conduction headset I was listening to an audiobook and could make out everything said.  They fit my head snugly and as I was doing various tasks around the house stayed on just fine.  Are these top-of-the-line, no, but for the price they are a pretty good set and worth it if you are wanting to explore bone conduction.

title: Nice noise canceling headset
review: I got these because I've become insane with the need for ANC while working from home so I'm always looking for the best ones.  It comes packaged pretty standard but has its own hardshell case for the headphones so that is great.  It charges via USB C which I love and the first charge out of the box took 30 mins to an hour.  Putting them on they are super comfy I've been wearing them for about 5 hours and have had no problem with it so far.  It paired with my mac very quickly.  The ANC is actually pretty good for this price point not as good as my Sony's' but not by 200$ worth of ANC. This also hase multipoint connections which make these an even better deal.  If you are looking for a nice set that won't break the bank give these a shot I've been really enjoying them.

title: Good for listening not so much for talking
review:
I've wanted to try bone-conduction headphones for a while now but just never wanted to take the plunge. Charging it has a magnet connector, I wish it was USB C but it is what it is. For the sound quality, it is less than over-ear headphones but that is to be expected. The microphone was what really disappointed me as I used this on a teams call and everyone said I was muted. I would say if you want to try a bone conductor this is okay to try but just use it for listening not talking.

Update

I have decided to add a star because I have found what these excel at driving. I used to use my ear buds when I was driving but that cut down on my ability to hear the outside world when I use these while driving I don't have that same concern. While they still arent the greatest for office work I now have them chilling in my truck for when I want to drive and listen to my books.

title: Okay for what they are
review: My fiancee likes to stay up and watch tv after I go to bed so I figured I would try to get these to block the noise and light of it.  For the "block the light" part the mask effectively blocks and it has eye cups so there isn't pressure on your eyes, though I have seen better eye cups on other models of night masks.  The headphones are a bit fickle you have to have them both directly over your ears in the perfect position or you won't hear stuff right.  Also, they didn't really block out the noise of the tv more added background noise to it.  I think they would be fine in an already quiet room but if there is another noise going on you will still hear through what you are listening too.  All in all, I say these things were okay but could use some tweaks of A> better ye cups, and B more in-ear noise canceling.

title: Great tool for cleaning up laptop and computer accessories.
review:
This little guy comes with 7 tools and each is good for its own area of cleaning.

Keycap puller: To be honest I have not used this as none of my devices have raised keys but looks like it would work nicely.

Screen cleaner bottle: it is small and doesn't spray a ton at a time, which sounds like a downside but is not. It sprays the perfect amount of fluid so the screen is not soaking wet. It is also refillable so you can use your own fluid if you prefer.

Big brush: This is good for sweeping off laptop keys and general dust. It worked wonderfully and can also retract into the body when not in use.

Wipe pad: Very useful when used along with fluid together they made stubborn smudges disappear.

Microfiber cloth: Decent microfiber cloth cleaned away the smudges and left the screen pretty darn clear.

Qtip stick (not its real name just what it reminded me of): I didn't really know what this was for until I looked around my area and saw my earbuds case. This got down into where the ear tips sit and pulled up a frankly embarrassing amount of crud.

Detail tool: This gets into the really small opening, it has a silicone tip for larger openings, but it can be removed to get into smaller ones. I used this to clean my mice and it did a wonderful job.

All in all it's a great little tool to give your laptop and other electronics a deep clean.

title: Love these!
review: I really love these headphones. I don’t like to stick earbuds in my ears as I have my daiths pierced and it can be very uncomfortable to wear earbuds. Earbuds also tend to block out sound around me for the most part and I like to be aware of what’s happening around me. This is the first time I have tried bone conduction headphones, and I really like the experience. I do find that I have to turn the volume louder than if I had earphones in my ears, but I’m OK with that. I feel like the price is really reasonable considering the technology. I gifted a set of of these by a different brand name to my father for Christmas, and he absolutely loves them. They make a great gift!

title: Great headset
review: I have been wanting to try a bone conducting headset for a while now, so I was excited when this one arrived. It is ver lightweight and comfortable to wear. I feel like the sound quality is very good. It was super easy to pair with my phone and came charged. The experience is is very interesting. You can hear the music playing just holding the headset in your hand or close to your ear like you could with regular headphones. However, when you put the set on it is like a surround sound all in your head.  I love not having to put in headphones! That said, it is on the quieter side and you do need to have it up pretty loud. Also, you are not going to have any sort of noise canceling with these, so don’t expect that. They are great for when you want to be able to hear your surroundings, but also your music. I would definitely recommend.

title: Volume is way too quiet
review:
I’ll start with the pros. The headband is super soft. I love the feel of it and the headphones are very flat which is nice if your a side sleeper. I found the headband to have plenty of stretch and to be very lightweight. I also did not find it to be hot at all.
However, I bought this to watch movies in bed without disturbing my hubby and the volume simply is not loud enough. I have it turned up all the way and can barely hear what I am watching. Once you do get to maximum volume the headphones emit an EXTREMELY LOUD BEEP. It startles you and makes me wonder if the beep can be that loud why on earth are the headphones so quiet? They are obviously capable of being much louder.
I admit I have not used these for sleeping. If your purpose is to listen to quiet music, a sleep story, or sleep sounds I think the volume will work perfectly for you. If your purpose is to watch movies or listen to music while you work out, these will not do the trick. They are simply too quiet.

title: Not my favorite pair of earbuds
review:
I was looking for earbuds that I can wear for long periods as I often wear them through the work day, but these hurt my ears after an hour. They also come with a lightning style cable which is great if you're a fruit phone user, but since I don't have any of those fruity devices laying around my house I would then need to protect that one cable so I could charge the things. The battery life was short. Also, the left earbud refused to stay off when I tried to turn it off, it kept power cycling back on.

The box it came in was beautiful- I wish they had spent more time making a quality product than making a pretty box.

title: Works well, not a fit for my tiny ear canals
review: The headphones work well. I like the charge monitor on the side of the case. The case has a sensor on the door, so I can't fidget with the door as I did on my last case. The main thing is that even with the smallest silicone bud, these get uncomfortable after a couple of hours.

title: Works great for audio, does not have phone passthrough
review: I love being able to use the radio in my old car again. Audio was fine, battery life is good. This will not work with phone calls. I had to use the phone speaker or connect another bluetooth headset (which did not interfere.)

title: Not comfortable for long term wear, short range.
review:
The range on these is way less than my other bluetooth items. The sharp edges dig into the side of my head and where they rest on my ears leaves a red mark after 20 minutes of wear. I was hoping to be able to use these at work, but there is no way I could wear these for hours at a time.
Also- these are different from regular headphones in that they leave your ears open for other noises. It feels weird at first until you get used to not having them in your ear canals.

title: comfortable for sleeping
review:
When this arrived, I immediately put it to use. I have earbuds on me 24/7, even if they aren't in my ears. Sometimes I use them when I am out in public because I have sensory issues and can become easily overstimulated in crowd situations. This arrived in the evening, so I wore it around the house and decided to try wearing them while sleeping.

The band fits my head perfectly, without discomfort. I am a side-sleeper, so there were a few times throughout the night when I could feel the speaker between my ear and the pillow, but it wasn't unbearably uncomfortable (certainly not as uncomfortable as having an in-ear earbud in the ear I am lying on). It was more noticeable because it was a new sensation that I was unaccustomed to. After wearing it for the whole night, I forgot I had it on.

It came with a full charge, which lasted about a day and a half. I haven't recharged it yet, but the care and use instructions that came with it were detailed, clear, and easy to understand. I plan to plug it in tonight and I don't anticipate having any issues.

I will definitely recommend this to friends.

title: Great for my office computer
review: I have a standing desk at work, and that was the reason for this purchase. The length is great, the connection of my headphones into the extension is a secure one; I have tested this by accident when going too far outside of my little cubicle.

title: Cant beat the quality for the price
review: These earbuds are great especially for the price. I listen to them pretty much all day at work. Long battery life and easy to use. They might not bump like some of the $100 or more earbuds but they are just right for me. This is my 2nd pair. Highly recommend!

title: Comfortable & good sound quality
review: One of my sons works night shift & was happy to try these out. He usually falls asleep with earbuds & has to hunt for them when he wakes up. He said the sound was good & connected easily to his phone's Bluetooth. The mask blocked the light & allowed him to stay asleep longer. Very pleased!

title: BeTIM bone conduction headphones are the most comfortable I’ve found to date
review:
BeTIM’s headphones are have a thinner profile battery pack than others I have tried, making them more comfortable. They fit well even with glasses on!

The sound quality is really good, better than I expected. Both music and audiobook sounded clear and good.

If you crank them up (say to about 1/3 on your phone), folks within a couple of feet can hear some noise, though not quite well enough to make it out.

The headphones came with roughly an 80% charge and were ready to go out of the box, which was packaged nicely enough to give as a gift. Pairing took just moments- I am very pleased with these headphones!

title: True to size cable, Bkduice USB A to Type C Charging Cord 3 pack
review:
This 3 pack of 1' USB A to USB C cords was a good value for me, as I needed a couple of cords to share around work (someone's always forgetting their cord for phone, headphones, handheld gaming system, etc.).

These fellows work, and I like the short size because I can be pretty sure no one's texting under the desk with only a foot of cord to keep their power on.
At home, something similar- no one's staying up late watching video streams, playing their Switch or texting friends during non-screen time when the charger needs to stay within a foot of the PC or hub. Everyone needs their rest.

It's a simple product, and a good one.

title: My fave headphones now
review:
Finding Bluetooth headphones that last more than 4-6 hours per charge under $25 is tough. Finding the same that are on-ear rather than earbuds is tougher. These are both!
This is my second pair, the first I bought to wear at work and liked them so much I got a second pair to wear while mowing the lawn.
The sound quality is very good, they’re light weight and do last through the work day.
I also like the clear greeting with battery level announcement.
Easy to pair, easy to use- perhaps the only drawback is the charging port is under the right speaker and you may have to move the cover to get clear access to it. Otherwise, no complaints!

title: The best, just buy IT
review: So the best part of the Bluetooth headphones are not only the price, it tells you when it's ON and OFF as well as when it connected. The buds are comfortable, sound is perfect. Battery last longer than others .The packaging is beautiful. It will make a good gift. I recommend it 💯

title: Using a wireless headphones for the 1st time
review: I really like thos headphones, the sound is excellent, battery life is great. It's an excellent quality. It also cancels out noise.

title: Good overall
review: So this headphone was good while it lasted. Overall the sound is good the mic is also amazing. The way the buds are built are great they just fit into the ears comfortably. But unfortunately for me it didn't last as long as I thought it would. It was a good buy.

title: Nice but won't last long
review: These headphones are so comfortable I also like the packaging and magnetic feature but sorry they don't last at all. Am disappointed

title: Such a good deal
review: Great deal for teachers and their classrooms. Colors are vibrant, material is thick plastic but adjustable and comfortable for my daughters ears instead of the ear plug headphones. It’s also safer

title: Perfect fit the kiddos
review: [[VIDEOID:d73906efc7007d0d7c0a7e14b32a5e43]] It’s small like very small in your hand but the headphones size and fit is exactly as AirPods minus the cushions for your ear. They work great and fit my 9 year old just fine! Easy to Bluetooth and pair to phone. Definitely worth it and affordable!

title: Didn’t know I needed this!
review: I recently started working from home and have been using my AirPod pros to make and take calls. Using my AirPods 8-10 hours a day has really irritated my ear drums. Came across this headset and thought to give it a try. I really like the comfort feel of the headset versus sticking my AirPods in my ear. Now don’t get me wrong the AirPods are great for my runs and going to the gym, but having a headset separate for work and not irritating my ear drums is a MUST. My clients can hear me clear and there’s no static. Truly a great item to consider

title: So different
review:
A friend of mine had me try a pair of bone conduction head piece a couple of years ago. Was so strange how well I was able to hear the music without something being in my ear.
Saw these bone conduction earbuds and I had to try them out. I like that I can clip them onto my ear instead of having something shoved into my ear. Won't even try to figure out how they work but, they work.
I am able to hear my music just fine and my ears are open so I can also hear if someone is talking to me.
Not sure if I'd like them better if they were connected by some type of wire of sorts so that I can pop them out and have them hang on my neck when I don't want to use them.
Sound is nice. Nice being able to use earbuds and not have it in my ear.

title: Nice earbuds
review:
Good sound quality. Good controls. These earbuds allow me to listen to music or watch TV shows without disturbing the rest of the household.
Good value for the price.
I recommend them to anyone looking for earbuds.

title: Fits nicely in the ears
review:
My first complaint about any earbuds is that they're uncomfortable wearing. I didn't find that with these earbuds.
I wear earbuds many hours during the day and then I like to have them in on the nights I can't sleep. These are very comfortable. No irritation at all.
Love how long they do hold the charge. I can wear them most of the night and they still are almost fully charged when I get up in the morning.
After charging up the case, it only takes about 30 mins to fully recharge the earbuds back to 100%.
They seem very well made. The sounds that come out of these are excellent. Can hear all music very clearly.
Like everything about these earbuds.

title: Good wireless ear buds
review:
I use wireless earbuds often and it is important to me that they have good sound, are comfortable and have long battery life. These ear buds meet all three requirements well.
The sound has great quality that I like. Earbuds are very comfortable to wear since I wear them for many hours during the day and at night when I'm in bed.
I like the tube design. Seems sturdier than flip open cases that rely on a small hinge. I like how I just have to twist the tube to open it up. Convenient and better, in my opinion.
I like to use these to help me sleep by playing music from about 10 pm to 6 am. The battery easily lasts that long.
I put them back into the case for a charge in the mornings. I haven't had any time where the battery has drained. Can go at least 4-5 days before I need to put them back into the case for a recharge.
Highly recommend these to others who rely on wireless ear buds.

title: Great price for over average wireless headphones
review:
I needed a wireless set of headphones for when I am outside cutting the grass, working in the yard, working in the house, or for when I just want to sit with a nice hot cup of coffee and chill.
These wireless headphones are perfect for everything I needed them for.
Not sure exactly how long they took to charge up. I set them up and went about my day. Came back a few hours later and they were all set to go.
Pairing them with my phone was as easy as can be. Directions were very easy to follow. Once paired, I just turn the headphones on, and I was good to go.
Music from my phone sounds really nice. One touch of the button and I can advance to the next song or hit the next button and I can go back to the previous song. Volume is great to cancel out the loud rumble of my lawnmower.
Very comfortable on my ears for the couple hours I've worn them. They don't have a lot of cushion like the more expensive headphones (not wireless) that I've had. But, for the price, they do well enough.
These will be used ALL the time between me and my wife. 6 hours of playing time is plenty of time for me to get my work done and then pass them onto my wife so she can enjoy her music while enjoying the sunshine.
Love them!
Haven't tried them with a phone call yet. Will have to come back and update this when I do.

title: Very nice wired earbuds
review:
I still have some devices that do not have Bluetooth. For those devices these wired earbuds are very nice.
The sounds is excellent. Good through all the ranges, (base, midrange, treble).
The earbuds themselves are very comfortable to wear. Sometimes I forget I have them in my ears, which has not been my experience with other earbud designs.
It comes with a very nice carrying case to carry in a pocket without the wires getting tangled or the earbuds damaged. Once again something that can happen with other earbuds I have used.
It comes with a multitude of sleeves.
I would recommend these to anyone needing earbuds or earbud replacements.

title: Comfortable headphones for sensitive ears
review: My 13-year-old daughter has always had trouble with headphones. On-ear headphones and in-ear headphones both hurt her ears (in different ways), so she can’t stand to use them for any length of time. But enter this cool little headband. She loves it! It’s comfortable enough that she can wear it for hours without any problem. When other people are in the same room, they can’t hear what she’s listening to at all. The sound quality is actually pretty good—obviously it doesn’t sound like a pair of AirPods Max, but it’s pretty decent. There isn’t really any noise reduction, so don’t expect that. But if you hate ordinary headphones because of the discomfort, maybe give these a try.

title: Great wireless earbuds with some flaws
review:
The ear buds and charging case both look nice and high quality. Bluetooth connection was super simple and show up instantly when the case was opened. The range is very good having my PC in my bedroom I can walk out into the kitchen and still get full signal. Sound quality is OK for the price you can't really complain. Battery seems to last a good amount of time used it for an hr it the earbuds still had charge. Charging the case takes about an hr, the earbuds took about 30 mins for the red lights to stop showing.

Cons: The charging port for the case is annoying it has a dust cover that partially blocks the Usb C port. You'll have to bend the dust cover out of the way to get to the port. Controls are slow/laggy You have to push and wait for the vol to change before you can press again if not you'll end up stopping or changing the music

I recommend this for someone looking for a low price wireless earbuds that has long Bluetooth range, Great for people working out loosing one of these wouldn't hurt too bad.

title: Hard to beat in terms of value for the price, but it has its limitations
review:
While these headphones won't excite an audiophile, if you want to spend as little as possible on a set of headphones but not make too many concessions with regard to comfort and sound quality, this is the set to get. For $25 you get headphones that sound way better than you would expect for the price point, and are also pretty comfortable to wear for extended periods.

The build quality is OK. Again, these are $25 headphones, but they are pretty decently made. They will not stand up to rough handling, but as long as they are treated with care, they will provide a good service life. The earpads are comfortable and do a good job of blocking out ambient noise. It has an attached cord that has both a 1/4 inch and a 3.5mm jack. You have to screw off the 1/4 inch one to expose the 3.5mm one. While I like the convenient way it provides 2 different jacks, I would have much preferred to have a detachable cord. But again, for the price, it's not a deal killer by any means.

The sound quality for the price is excellent. No, it doesn't sound as good as a $200 set, but it's reasonably clear, decently punchy, and doesn't significantly distort at high volumes.

If you're looking for the best value in a headphone, it's hard to beat this. Five stars.

title: Very durable cable jacket; great quality jacks
review:
I use an extension so I can wear corded headphones while on the treadmill at home, since the treadmill noise makes it impossible to listen to music any other way. The problem is that the cords get jostled and stressed quite a bit, and wear pretty quickly.

This cord, however, is far better made. The jacket is braided and very sturdy, but remains pretty flexible. Both the male and female jacks are firmly attached to the cord and are also very sturdy. I didn't encounter any static or pops with this cable, which is a first for me with any other cable.

It is a bit more expensive than other cables, but the build quality is very much in line with the price point. I'm very impressed with these, and would highly recommend them, especially for applications where the cable gets stressed, stretched or jostled around.
[Sample provided for review]

title: Sound quality is far better than the price would suggest; excellent comfort
review:
I have other Brainwavz earbuds and they have never failed to provide me with great sound. These are no exception. While there is some crispness missing from the sound that you get with their more advanced (and more expensive) offerings, these hit the mark far better than the price would suggest. The bass is rich sounding without being boomy. It’s not way dialed up on the bass end like other models, but strikes a good balance.

The comfort is excellent. The Comply foam tips are delightful to use – they mold themselves to your ear rather than the other way around. Excellent sound isolation as well due to the tight, but comfortable fit.

The build quality is nice considering the price. The cords are on the thin side, but are well-anchored. The cord is not, however, something that will take a lot of abuse (such as the flat cable on the S1 model, which is far more durable). The earbuds are plasticy but again, given the price, I’ll rate the build quality as above average. However, I do wish they would have made the R/L markings more legible (which is an issue with all their earbuds). A small spot of white paint on the R solves that problem.

All in all, these are excellent earbuds. Hits the mark on sound quality, build quality and comfort, and does it at a very nice price point. Highly recommend.
[Sample provided for review]

title: All hail the Omega
review:
This is a well-made and highly functional headphone stand. It’s solidly made out of what appears to be a single piece of thick (1/4 inch) plastic. The feet are beveled so it sits perfectly flat and remains stable even if jostled. The plastic is perfectly polished to a glass-like finish.

While I can’t fault it whatsoever in terms of build quality and functionality, aesthetically it’s just a bit too over-the-top for my taste. The shape is fine (sort of a squashed Omega) but the 4.5 inch width makes it look too massive. The company name is also in letters that are so large that they add to the “massive” feeling.

It merits 5 stars due to the build quality and functionality, which are excellent. It’s just too massive and imposing looking for me, so I’ll need to drop the rating by one star.
[Sample provided for review]

title: Nice design and features; sound quality is good but not great
review:
Earbuds are my headphone of choice, and I'm rather particular about comfort since there's nothing worse than a poor fitting bud. These Onkyo earbuds fare very well with regard to comfort. They are very lightweight, but stay put even when exercising. There are an assortment of tip sizes so you can customize them to fit your ear. For me, the middle-sized one was a perfect fit.

I really like that these have detachable cables that can be replaced. I've ruined more than my share of earbuds due to breaking the cable, so that feature will probably come in handy down the road. The cable itself appears stout enough to withstand all but the most rigorous strain.

The sound is good but not outstanding. Nice separation, clear mid-range and treble, and a decent amount of bass. But when comparing the sound of the Onkyo to my other less pricy earbuds (such as the RHA MA350) I was not wow'd by the Onkyo as being significantly better. A bit clearer, but very close in terms of sound quality.

Granted, the Onkyo have, to my eye, better styling than other buds, and the replaceable cord is certainly a big plus. Those issues, plus the comfort factor, warrant a 4-star rating. But to get 5 stars at this price point, more is needed in sound quality than delivered by the Onkyo's. Good, but not 5-star superlative.

title: Comfortable to wear, decent sound, poor noise isolation
review:
Overall, these are a generally OK pair of headphones. While the sound quality won't please an audiophile, it is more than acceptable for general use. I found them to be better suited for movie watching rather than music listening since the bass and upper range are rather muted. Decent quality midrange.

It scores pretty high with regard to comfort. Lightweight, easy to adjust, and nicely cushioned.

I was not impressed with the noise cancellation feature. Yes, it does cut down on some background noise when the cancellation feature is engaged (simple switch on the earpiece turns it on and off; it runs on a AAA battery). But, the sound isolation is actually less than I get with a quality pair of properly-fitted ear buds. I could easily hear ambient sounds with the headphones on.

The track skipping feature does not work with the Fire. The manufacturer does not claim it would, so no stars are detracted for that. I mention it only in case Fire owners are thinking about using that feature. Other than that, it works perfectly with the Fire - made it much more enjoyable to watch videos than using the internal speakers.

I'll give this 3 stars. It offers OK sound quality and decent comfort, but it's billed as having noise cancellation, and that feature is not well implemented.

title: Good quality, but quite small
review:
As others have noted, this is smaller than the dimensions listed in the product description. As best as I can measure, the internal dimensions as 2.5 inches by 3.75 inches by 0.75 inches thick. I was unable to fit my fairly compact point and shoot in it, but it is fine for holding smaller items such as an MP3 player and headphones.

On the plus side, construction quality is very good. Nice padding, good zipper, and there's a hard insert to help protect screens/delicate items from the customary dings they can encounter. Has a wrist strap as well, but the hook is not all that sturdy that I'd completely trust it to hold firmly and not break.

If you can live with the very small size, this is a decent product.

title: A bit dated, but a durable performer
review:
I've had this for a little over a year, and use it while exercising outdoors. It's taken a real beating - dropped it several times, gets wet in the rain/snow, and so on. But, it just keeps on working! Got to love a product that can take a punch.

Reception is pretty good - can pick up several stations quite clearly, and a few more with some static. Sound quality is decent. You won't mistake it for CD-quality, but it's radio, after all. Battery life is very good - goes a few months on an AAA. I just switched to rechargeable batteries, but even with regular alkalines it's pretty cost effective.

The only downside I've encountered was the headphones. Found them to be very uncomfortable, and replaced them very soon after purchasing with a set of ear buds (not sure of the brand - perhaps Sony as well).

It's not as flexible as a MP3 player but I find the radio reception on this to be far better than the reception on my MP3 player that has an FM tuner. Yes, a conventional FM radio is a bit dated, but then again, so am I - sometimes it's nice to just listen to the radio. For the price, this is a great performer.

title: These are so comfortable
review: The headphones that I use at work broke so I needed to replace them. I chose these ones. The color is super cute and the initial feature that drew me in. I’m really glad that I went with these. They fit in my ears so comfortably and that’s really important to me because I have problems with my ears and having earbuds in for a while can cause those problems to flare up. I haven’t had any issues with these so far. The sound quality is great in my opinion, obviously not as good as a super expensive pair, but they get the job done for what I’m using them for.

title: Amazing Headphone
review: These headphones are amazing. The noise-blocking feature is so good to the point where someone has to jump around in front of me to get my attention. The sound quality on these is great as well. My music sounds so good and I feel like I'm immersed in every part of it. They are also comfortable to wear for an extended period of time.

title: Decent but not the best sound quality.
review: These are decent headphones for anyone who doesn't need amazing sound quality and just wants a decent pair of headphones lying around. Stylistically, they look really nice. Comfort wise, I love the padding that they have on the ear part, I just wish the ear part was a little larger. I have smallish ears and these sit right on top of them. When wearing them for long periods of time, they tend to make my ears start hurting. I would prefer over ear headphones as opposed to on ear headphones. The band adjusts nicely to accommodate a variety of size heads. Sound quality isn't the best, but for just plugging in to watch an episode of a tv show on netflix or something like that, they are fine. I wouldn't recommend them for someone who is really into music and wants to use them for that purpose.

title: Amazing
review: I love these headphones so much! I work a retail replenishment job so I'm unloading a truck, going up and down ladders, carry and lifting boxes and doing tons of walking around while at work. I had been using regular headphones, but the cord always ends up snagging on something and either pulling out of my ear or making it really dangerous for me. I don't have to worry about any of that with these headphones. I just wrap them around the back of my neck and I'm good to go. The sound quality of these is amazing as well. And I really love the buttons that are right on the cord so I don't have to keep reaching into my pocket to pull out my phone to adjust the volume or change the song. I'm so happy to have found these!

title: These are great!
review: I love wearing earbuds while working and typically have issues with some brands but these works great! Im able to hear well and I did notice that it blocked a good amount of outside noise. They also work well for calls. People can hear me clearly and I cam hear them as well. Great set with a nice case. The battery lasts a long time too.

title: Clear sound and stays in my ears
review: These are great! I've had several pairs of earbuds lately, some were okay but these have been just what I needed. The sound quality is pretty good.  It also has the wrap around the ears which helps the earbuds stay in place. Whe on the phone call I can hear clearly and have been told that I can be heard clearly as well.

title: Great sound quality but a few annoyances
review: I love this headset but it's also very annoying because of a few certain aspects. First off, the sound quality is great! When speaking on the phone I call hear very well and I've been told that my voice it clear as well. My issue are that the earbuds tend to loosen up and fall out every few minutes. The other issue is that the controls are on the ear bud itself, so while on phone calls, I've hung on so many people while trying to reinsert the earbuds or adjust so that they don't fall out. It's gotta to be so annoying and I hate that because the battery life and sound quality are great but I'm so tired of mistakenly hanging up and having to call back and apologize for my earbuds hanging up because I lightly glazed my finger on top of them.

title: The best battery life!!
review: These are the best earbuds!! I usually will use them for hours at a time and the battery barely drains. I love that the battery levels are shown on the case when you recharge them. They also charge very quickly.  Best of all, the sound quality is A1!!

title: Great mono earbuds
review: I've bought these earbuds for years and have never been disappointed until now. The most-recent pair I ordered works only on the left side. Unfortunately, I'd thrown away the packaging and couldn't return them. Lesson learned again: try before you trash the wrapping.

title: OK Headphones
review: I think these headphones are more like 3.5 stars but I rounded up.  I have kind of a small head for an adult female, and still these headphones were too tight.  Usually I can wear headphones made for kids but not these.  These are definitely for smaller heads and small ears since the ear cups get painful after a while since they aren't big enough to fully cover my ears.  The sound is o.k., nothing to write home about, but for the price (as of this review these head phones cost $19.44) I think they are worth it.  Great for kids, not so good for adults, even if you are a pinhead.

title: Good Headphones
review: I like these headphones and find them very convenient.  However, after wearing them for awhile my ears get sore from the pressure of the ear pads.  I've bent them outwards as far as I dare go without breaking them and it feels o.k. for a while until the pressure begins again.  It's not because of head size as these headphones generously extend out.  I think the earcups are just putting too much pressure on the outside rims of my ears.  There is zero noise cancellation that I can notice and I can easily hear conversations around me and what's on TV.  But, for the price (as of this review these headphones cost $16.79) I don't expect noise cancellation.  I have to control the volume from my phone or laptop, and I don't use these to answer the phone.  What I like a lot about them is the long cord.  The cord is almost twice as long as on some earbuds I had been using and frequently accidently pulling out of my ears because the cord was short.  I have not had that problem at all with these headphones.  The sound quality is dang good too, which I wasn't expecting.  Overall - very good headphones, earcups could be bigger, great sound, long cord and easy to use.

title: Great Earbuds for $21.99
review: As of this review these Bluetooth earbuds cost $21.99 and I think they are definitely worth that.  My most favorite aspect about them is the long battery life.  I have been using these earbuds since they came in yesterday morning and I didn't charge them beforehand either.  Straight out of the box they are still running strong the next evening and show minimal battery depletion.  The controls are encased in plastic so they could break so don't step on them.  The sound is good but I really only want them for listening to podcasts.  They also have a good range - if I can go inside the garage from where my PC sits, then I consider that a good range.  Probably a good 50 feet. I think the pinkish gold is very pretty too.  Sorry - I don't use these for phone calls so please read the other reviews concerning that feature.

title: Great Battery Life
review: For $12.99 (the cost of these Bluetooth earphones as of this review) you get a good set of earphones. They connected to my PC and phone very easily, The distance range is pretty good before they start to break up (I can go into another nearby room) and the battery life is really good. I had them on all night (fell asleep while listening to music) and the next morning they were still working. That was at least 8 hours. I like these and am glad I took the chance on paying the tax to get to review them. Oh yeah, they sound good too.

title: Can't Hear Myself Speaking Into the Microphone
review: I couldn't get the microphone to work (light was green) so I had to watch about 4 "how to get your microphone to work on windows 10" tutorials on Youtube until one of them actually worked.  I was finally able to test the microphone and could see the sound bar going up and down as I spoke louder and softer into it.  However, no matter  how many tutorials I watched, I could never hear myself through my headset to actually hear the sound quality of the microphone.  So, I don't know if I sound wonderful, super tinny or somewhere in between.  I'll keep working with it but at this point I have to give it a rest for a while.  The little pamphlet included with the microphone is absolutely useless and doesn't offer any troubleshooting.

title: Good Wireless EarBuds
review: As of this review these earbuds cost $24.49, and I think that's reasonable for what you get.  These connected via Bluetooth instantly to my PC but it took several attempts to get them to connect to my android phone but eventually they did.  These answer calls just fine and do all the phone stuff but I don't really use them for that.  I like to listen to various podcasts and music.  The sound is pretty good and once I get them situated in my ears I forget they're there.  The case is really easy to carry in my purse and is easy to keep the earbuds charged.  I don't know how long the battery life is because once I finish using them I put them back in their case.  But I have worn them for over 2 hours and they held a charge that long.

title: Great Earbuds for the Price
review: My teenage daughter was really happy to get these earbuds because her iPhone 7 didn't come with a phone jack. These earbuds plug into the charger port. She says they have a great sound and I can't believe they only cost $17.99 (as of this review).

title: Average Quality
review: I definitely prefer to use Bluetooth earbuds any day over wired, but sometimes it can't be helped.  Such as times when my Bluetooth earbuds weren't charged.  The sound of these is o.k. but not what you'd be getting from a high end pair.  I teach classical guitar so my acid test for any earbud is playing that and seeing how it sounds.  I'm doing it now and the trebles come through o.k. but the bass is pretty weak.  These will be good to keep a pair in my car or purse for those times when my Bluetooths won't work for whatever reasons.  The volume doesn't work so it has to be adjusted on the device they're plugged into.  They come with extra earbud covers and they feel fine in my female ears the way they are.  I don't know what these cost as of this review but I wouldn't want to pay more than $15.00 for them.

title: OK but Not Real Good Sound
review: The earbuds I received for review don't have external volume control.  I have to adjust the volume using my phone or whatever device I have these plugged into.  I had my husband call me and the call button on the earbud cord worked fine. These are fine for in the car and yakking on the phone but if you want to listen to music it would be best to get a much better set of earbuds.  These don't have any bass to speak of, and the sound is thin and tinny.  You get a couple more pairs of bud covers for a better fit.  No instructions come with these but it's not really necessary since they're easy to figure out.

title: Works Great!
review: Omigosh!  This thing is great!  I can use my expensive Bose over the ears headphones with my phone and get such good sound!  I didn't know what I was missing before.  And it's well made and a lovely red color.  I'm really glad I got it for review.

title: Really Good Wireless Earbuds
