review: These wireless ear buds have unusually good sound.  I wasn't expecting "Layla" (Derek and the Dominoes) to come through so clear and loud!  I had to turn them down.  They connected to both my PC and phone quickly and easily, and I had them in my ears and listening to music in less than a minute.  Getting used to two taps for higher volume and three taps for lower volume takes a little getting used too but it works.  The product page says play time is 24 hours but no way - lucky if they last for 4 or 5 hours before needing recharging.  The call and answer work o.k with my phone but I'll never use these for that -just listening to music and podcasts.  They fit my ears fine but additional pink ear bud covers are included along with a white charging cord (wish it had been pink too).  The pink is more of a fuchsia pink and is really pretty.  Right now there really isn't anything negative I can find to say about these adorable earbuds with great sound.  If they have problems later I'll update this review.

title: Good Wireless Earbuds
review: These wireless earbuds seemed to charge quickly enough and the sound is pretty good  but not as good as some other wireless earbuds I have  but those were really expensive.  Getting away from the source was not as far as I had hoped for.  If I get more than 20 feet the signal breaks up.  I would really like to get 50 feet as with my other set. They connected to my Windows 10 PC but  not to my Axon phone.  They feel good in my ears and around my neck.  So far the battery life is about 8 hours at low volume.  The price is around $56 as of this review and I have seen others just as good for less money.  Noise cancellation is OK.

title: Seem to be the Exact Same Pads as the Originals
review: These are exactly like the ear pads that came with my Bose headphones.  I've probably had these headphones for at least 5 years and the ear pads were looking kind of rough.  They are very easy to replace and good instructions are included.  The new pads are just as soft, pliable and comfortable as the original pads and it's nice to have some new pads on my ears.

title: These Are Great Headphones for the Price!
review:
I think these kids headphones are great! I was surprised at the sound quality - really good. They're adjustable and can fit a grown-up's head but the padded ear cups are smaller is size to fit smaller ears. I plugged it into my Chromebook last night and expected the sound level to be limited but it isn't. I was able to crank it up pretty loud. However, there doesn't seem to be a volume control on the headphones themselves so a parent can put them on first to check the sound level and then give them to their kids to wear.

They aren't as well constructed as more expensive headphones but are fairly durable. I got the purple pair and think they are super cute and the ears light up. These come with a button battery for the ears. I really like these headphones and as of this review they are only around $17.00. Keep in mind that these are not Bluetooth and have to be wired to a source.

title: Good but has Some Problems
review: The sound quality is very good - no complaints there.  Connecting to my laptop and pairing went fast and easy and the battery life seems long.  Using the volume controls on the outside are intuitive and easy to operate.  The reason for the 3 stars is because these headphones have a very limited range.  If I move more than one room away, especially if behind a door or wall, they cut out.  If I'm using my laptop (most of the time) I have to carry it with me when going room to room while using these.  Also, though I have changed the earbud covers to different sizes, I just can't keep these in my ears.  They actually pop out and I'm always trying to get them back in.  I've never had this problem with earbud before.......I don't know what's wrong here.

title: Good Earbuds
review: For cheap headphones these do a pretty good job.  As of this review they are around $27.00.  Personally, I prefer Bluetooth headphones because I hate messing around with cords and I like to be able to move about unencumbered by being tethered to a device.  That said, my husband uses these while lounging in his overstuffed chair watching videos on his phone.  He says they sound good and as long as he has some earbuds that connect to his finicky phone he's happy.

title: Very Comfortable to Wear
review: I like these Bluetooth headphones a lot.  they are very comfortable and feel good around my neck.  The small ear bud covers fit my ears perfectly.  I mainly like to listen to podcast after podcast, and I wore them for about 4 hours straight and the battery is still going strong.  Everything about them is good except the range.  I can't get very far from the device I'm connected too or else it will break up or disconnect.  I basically have to carry my phone with me, or not go further than a average bedroom's distance away from it.  I have a pair of very expensive Bluetooth headphones that have a very large range and I can go outside and leave my phone inside and still maintain a good connection.  But, for only $16.99 I can't complain about these.  The volume button on these is actually easier to use than on my pricey pair, and they're more comfortable.

title: Works Well Most of the Time
review:
The Jabra 45 Bluetooth was super easy to connect to my phone and instantly connects every time I turn the Jabra on. The sound quality is very clear and easy to hear voices, music, podcasts or whatever desired with controllable volume. I'm unsure about how long the battery lasts, but I've only charged it once and that was several days ago, however I turn it off when not using it. My only problems are:

1. I can't seem to find the right size earbud cover to fit my ear. The Jabra 45 is a loose fit for now and prone to falling out.
2. It will hear me when I request it to call nearly everyone, but for some reason it just can't understand me when I clearly say in English, my husband's name. And that's too bad because he's the one I call the most.

Other than those two problems, it works pretty well. I must add though, I have a Jabra 25 and I think it works better. I also have a cheap Plantronics and it never mishears my husband's name.

title: PANASONIC Wireless Retro Over-The -Ear Bluetooth Headphones.
review:
There are several things I look for in Bluetooth headphones: good sound, comfort, distance from source, battery life and ease of connection. These headphones have them all in spades. I love classical guitar and with this headset I can even hear the guitarist breathing! They have a very clear sound. Head comfort is fantastic. My ears don't get sore and they are light on my head. I can walk around outside in the backyard further than I can with any other of my Bluetooth headphones, even venturing down into the basement. I have yet to run the battery completely down and I frequently fall asleep with my Bluetooth headphones on. I was able to connect easily on all my devices easily - even my finicky android phone. You can use these to talk on your phone since they have a built-in microphone.

Besides giving me great sound and other perks, these headsets look so retro!! Extremely cool.

title: Decent Set of Ear Buds
review:
The one thing I absolutely can't stand about most earphones (buds) is the constant tangling of the cords. I have ear buds that I don't use simply because I can't get them de-tangled. I really like the cord on this set. It's thicker, fabric-like, strong and doesn't tend to get all tangled up on itself nearly so much. The sound is decent too. I've been listening to several different types of music ranging from "Caprice No. 9" en Do Majeur by Angèle Dubeau (violin solo), to "Evacuate" by The Boxer Rebellion. The ear buds sound good. The voice of the violin is very clear, and the raucousness of "Evacuate" is also loud and clear. They fit in my smallish ear canals fine, feel comfortable and so far haven't tended to fall out.

I like them and look forward to using them a lot.

title: Pretty decent MP3 player.
review: I realize that it is time to let go of the most famous player that is no longer being manufactured, so I wanted to acquaint myself with others and this one is a pretty good start. It does what I need it to do; I connect my headphones and go right to the songs I want to play and they are well organized. The speakers on the device aren't that loud but I never use them anyhow. Storage is good for favorite playlists and this is a very reasonable price.

title: Fantastic sound at superb price!
review: I use these as a backup to my more expensive pair of headphones and the sound quality is almost as good as the ones that cost three times more! They fit comfortably and I can wear them while on calls with clarity, and while working out they stay put. Simple pairing and operation, holds a good charge. They're a fantastic alternative to higher brands or an awesome backup when you are out and about but still want quality sound.

title: Really nice headphones, comfortable, look and sound great!
review: My son loves the design of these headphones the most - they are SO nicely designed that they look much more high end than they actually are. The sound is also very nice too for the price and they're very comfortable. A more popular brand would definitely have another $40 (at least) tacked onto the price just for the name, so you will be pleasantly surprised by these.

title: Fun gaming speaker!
review: My son likes to use this in multiplayer games and also enjoys using it as a speaker for his music, etc when he is not gaming. The sound is pretty decent and the speaker is small and portable, the design is cool and he also likes to be able to chat without his headset. It's a unique design that has multiple purposes further customized by the app. The drop in price makes it even more attractive to buy and is very much worth it now!

title: Simply put, a REVELATION.
review:
This is without a doubt the most phenomenal speaker I've ever had and it can handle any genre of music - and I play them all - and bring the most out of each track and genre, from hip hop to house to jazz to rock to Afrobeat to drum and bass to classical. Using the EQ in the app allows you to fine-tune just the listening experience that you are looking for and you and your space are flooded with PERFECTION the moment you press play. I am old-fashioned; I like to play my music straight from my iPod for the most part as there are no interruptions with streaming unlike a phone; there are several native streaming apps that you can connect with but I want nothing separating me and the music as it was recorded and meant to be played. As with high end headphones, I use a burn-in track on YouTube (easily looked up as there are several) just to get those tweeters open and ready to ROCK!!!

The unique shape of this speaker allows you to sit it in a corner so there is a serendipitous acoustic resonance no matter the space and the design and style is also flawless. This is an expensive speaker, to be sure, but it is ready to fill you with priceless moments of the best universal language there is next to love - MUSIC.

title: Wasn't sure what to expect, but WHOA!!!!!
review:
This is my first pair of in-ear monitors and what made me nervous, besides the price, was the fact that they looked like a regular pair of cheap, wired earbuds...and then I tried them out. The unboxing experience is awesome, the monitors are snugly nestled in foam, the cords wrapped around the middle of the packaging. You have several pairs of ear tips to choose from. I tried with large right out the box but when I tried the small, they worked best for me. I like to slide them into my ear and twist to get a seal.

I experiment with a lot of genres. The bass in the house music was astonishing; the mids and his were soooo sparkling clear. I love being able to listen the way a producer would and pick up every nuance. I like to experiment with music myself and know I will cherish these. I don't have enough experience to compare but this is an awesome pair of monitors that are very well design, stored and ENJOYED.

title: BLASTOFF!!!
review: This is the perfect headphone amp for someone who enjoys bass-heavy tunes like hip hop our house music, in my case both. This was very easy to set up and begin using and it delivered the head-pounding, dangerous levels of bass that I am used to and happily ignore the risks of. LOL It works well across all genres of music too!

title: Quality headphones at a great price.
review: A great pair of headphones can set you back hundreds of dollars, but these JVC headphones manage to have excellent sound with minimal cost. They are comfortable, adjustable and easy to pair with your phone or other listening device and the bass is strong but not too muddy. The noise cancelling is good and so is the ambient listening, which is important for staying aware of your surroundings. These make an awesome pair of headphones for exercise and travel!

title: Very pretty with great sound!
review: I'm not much of an earbuds person but knew I needed a smaller pair when I am out and about as to be more aware of my surroundings. These earbuds are not only beautiful, but they sound great with nice bass and wonderfully clear audio for phone calls. Pair and setting them up in the app was simple and I like being able to adjust the settings to the genre of music I am listening to. This is an awesome buy and an awesome pair of earbuds.

title: IN. LOVE.
review: This is my first pair of Technics cans, and I am SOOOOOOOO outrageously delighted with them! The unboxing experience itself is pure joy and I love it comes with a message of the importance of music. You feel like you are about to undertake a journey with a trusted guide and boy are you ever. The headphones are very comfortabel and super fly! They are fully charged right out of the box and easy to pair and set up in the Technics app. I am using this strictly for music making (amateur) and love plugging them into my laptop and exploring different genres. People have raved about the highs and mids and they truly are resonant and the BASS is also dope too! This is a gorgeous pair of headphones known for their DJ following and for the average music lover they are sure to ecstatically please. I can't recommend them enough!

title: Great headphones, stylish, affordable.
review: The sound in these headphones is awesome! My husband wanted an inexpensive pair for errands and working out/walking around in the city and these have the look of a very high end pair but none of the cost and a comparatively deep sound. They are comfortable and the sound range is great for the price. These would be a perfect backup pair for day to day activities!

title: Working from home with the luxury of corporate quality equipment.
review: This headset is definitely one of the best ones I've tried! It is very comfortable and has incredible audio and connectivity. I've had to use this on many, MANY calls and have never had any issues. My husband and I both use it and it is comfortable and stores easily with its own charging stand so you never have to worry about the battery running low and can charge it between calls. This is good to have even as some places return to the office as things still remain uncertain and it's best to be prepared!

title: Awesome, affordable entry level buds with high quality!
review: These are such a nice pair of earbuds! Nowadays they can cost several hundred dollars, so it is awesome to see a pair from an established audio brand come out with a pair that doesn't skip on quality and earns every bit of its name recognition. The buds are comfortable and have extremely clear audio with smooth hi, mid and bass levels. The bass is warm and pretty spectacular for a pair of buds. These are an extra pair that I use when I am running or working out because of the quality and ability to replace them easily if something were to happen. But this is a terrific buy for not only a backup but main pair at a wonderful price.

title: One of the best pairs on the market for quality, comfort and design.
review: I was largely impressed by these LG FP9s; I have several different pairs of earbuds/headphones and these are competitively priced and able to compare the the pairs that are in the higher price range. The fit is very comfortable, the calls clear and the battery life is great. I also love that they can pair to airline entertainment with no problems, which has made these become my traveling pair as well. The mic quality is outstanding! I am able to take calls even in noisier environments and still be heard clearly. For this price, there is extensive value because of all its features and I am very happy with these. I say spring for this particular model.

title: One of the best pair of cans to own.
review: These are incredibly soft and cushioned against the ear and provide LOTS of bass for those who like bass-heavy music. You can customize how you want your music to sound in the headphones app to give a complete listening experience and they also store nicely. At this price point, they are excellent compared to other brands that might cost a hundred or two more with the same featues. Noise cancelling works well and phone calls are clear. Amazing performance and value.

title: Decent pair of headphones at a great price.
review: I got these for my son, who wanted a pair that he can take out while doing outdoor activities and errand running for the times he doesn't want to use earburds, nor have a super expensive pair that he might lose. The sound quality is great and the battery life is wonderful too. The noise cancellation works very well and the headphones have a plush and comfortable fit. We put these up there with other well known name brands but at a great price!

title: Supreme comfort, quality, fit and style.
review: This is my second pair of Jabras and definitely the most costly. But for their high end price, they have all of the features and qualities that make such a purchase a solid one instead of a regret. The fit is perfect with a soft cushion against the ears which also fills the canals with INCREDIBLE sound. I was startled by the sheer amount of bass! The noise cancellation is extremely effective and for such a small pair of buds they double as ear plugs because of it! Phone calls for that reason are extremely clear but adjust the background settings so outside noises aren't picked up. This is a true pair of sports earbuds and richly designed with all you need to get the most out of them. A great buy.

title: Great fit, excellent sound and call quality.
review: These ear buds are awesome! I usually don't like wearing earbuds because I prefer cans but of course I need something more subtle for awareness sake and for when I am making calls or in meetings. The sound quality is excellent for both music and phone calls with a surprising amount of bass and very clear audio. The setup and pairing was super easy and the noise cancellation is perfect. These are a very reasonably priced pair with all of the quality and function of pricier brands and with the colorful options, much more attractive too.

title: Lightweight headphones with great sound and call clarity.
review:
Sennheiser has a wonderful range of headphones from studio-quality to sports, and these headphones have the same lush sound sound as a pair of their high-end cans but pared down to earbud size and for those on the go who don't want to skimp on quality.

The calls and pairing was simple, clear and crisp and nice bass as well. I like to wear these on my morning and afternoon runs and the price for these is excellent.

title: Decent headphones but depth of sound is low at this price point.
review: The headphones are designed well and comfortable, but the bass delivered was somewhat disappointing. The noise cancellation and battery life were great though. I see that these have since been discounted and at the current price point they are a much better buy.

title: Solid pair of affordable earbuds.
review: These are great for working out and they are very comfortable. The price is amazing for the quality of sound that you get and they are easy to set up and pair with excellent call clarity as well. Earbuds can cost upwards of several hundred dollars and these are an excellent entry level pair for someone who wants quality, great price and comfort.

title: Impressive sound at affordable price.
review: If I were to trust a pair of headphones released by musician, Carlos Santana would definitely be at the top of that list and here we have an affordable pair that brings through all the necessary musical range of notes and sounds. They are beautifully designed, fit well and sound absolutely amazing. I like to wear these when I am out and about and get many compliments on them.

title: High quality headphones with superb sound.
review: You really can't go wrong with Sony and their headphones; even their most budget pair has impressive sound and these are phenomenal with deep, rich bass and crystal clear mids and highs. The noise cancellation is excellent, as is the price. These pair easily and are very comfortable. No need to spend hundreds on a pair of cans, get these instead!

title: Awesome earbuds!
review: They fit snugly and have amazing sound at this price point. The audio and calls are crystal clear and works well with all of my devices that they pair easily too. Some earbuds can cost several hundred dollars but these have the same quality and function without the unnecessary cost. I love them!

title: Unique design, dazzling sound and function!
review: I hadn't heard of this brand before, but loved the way they looked so I got them for hubby to try. He is very very happy with them! He usually has a pair of headphones for home and office and these have replaced his office pair because of the clear sound with phone calls that easily transfers to immersive sound with music. The headphones are controlled by touching the side of them and he likes that he doesn't have to fiddle with his phone or device in order to switch functions. Noise cancellation is excellent. These are phenomenally priced but rank right up there with more popular models that cost at least a hundred dollars more!

title: SUPER sound, battery life, comfort!
review: Hubby has been wearing these nearly every day since quarantine began and is so impressed with them! Since we've been homebound for a few months, these have helped him enjoy running and long walks during quarantine and he can go a few days without having to recharge them. He says they are very comfortable and what he likes most is the BASS they provide for such a small earbud. As an old school hip hop and jazz fan, he loves that the size doesn't compromise the quality of the sound. These earbuds are an investment but a very much worthwhile one and the price is reasonable.

title: Impressive audio, calls, and battery life
review: These Sennheisers are an attractive pair of earbuds that are way more powerful than they look! The stark white design is a welcome change from the black that is everywhere, so they stand out in both appearance and function. I like to use these when I am working on documents and contracts but want some calm music playing. The earbuds fit comfortably and they sound clear on phone calls and lovely on any type of music, though obviously you want a pair of cans for solid bass performance. All in all, these are a wonderful pair at a great price.

title: Solid, comfortable headphones with very nice sound.
review: My husband wears these when he is in the den working on projects or lounging in the backyard and he says the ANC works wonderfully because he can't hear me calling for him. LOL Out of the box, the first thing you notice is the sleek design and they fit comfortably with lush padding. He says the sound is very rich and likes listening to jazz with them on for the range of depth they provide. I would compare these to the Sony WXH headphones in terms of quality and price and this is a solid pair for the audiophile who wants a beautiful pair of headphones that don't cost a fortune.

title: Professional quality and design, SUPERIOR performance!
review: I use these for both entertainment and studio/voiceover work and they are amazing. They deliver rich, lush sound and clarity through all genres of music. They fit very comfortably and the battery life is phenomenal too - I can take these out with me for hours and barely lose a "bar". The ANC works very well as I can use these on a city street and still be immersed in sound with no distraction. These are truly high-end studio headphones but without the staggering price of most. I highly recommend them.

title: From unboxing to use, sublime experience and sound.
review: You know you're in for something special just by looking at the beautiful packaging of this product, which lays out its professional accolades and unparalleled features. I don't think I've seen headphones so beautifully packaged before and that needed its own compliment. But the buds themselves are extraordinary. Clearly designed for musicians and serious studio work, they are built for long sessions and deep listening but very comfortable and easy to adjust for the perfect fit. I was amazed by the levels of depth and clarity I was able to experience with such a tiny pair and use them all the time when I don't want to have my big cans on. For the price they are an excellent buy.

title: Immaculate sound and way cheaper than the competition!
review: I wanted to try these because although I am a "big can" person, the smaller earbuds do have their appeal in different settings and circumstances. I really was impressed by the sound that came from these, clear with resonant bass, for them to be so small! The competitor's price for their new buds at $250 is just way too much to pay when something like these exist and work just as well. I highly recommend them.

title: Excellent sound, fit and comfort with impressive noise cancellation.
review: This headset works very well at a price that is fantastic! My nephew drives a semi and this has helped him stay connected to the family with better call quality when he is on the road so much. The headset fits comfortably and has really good battery life as well. He has encouraged his colleagues to get one and some of them have!

title: Give your fancy headphones a classy place to chill!
review: This looks so nice with my new Master & Dynamic headphones and give my home office studio a professional look with minimal space required. The construction is durable and most importantly, protects a very expensive piece of equipment by displaying them so elegantly! A must-have for audiophiles.

title: Rich and immersive sound, plush construction and heavenly experience!
review: These are definitely the most attractive and all-around handsome pair of headphones I own; they LOOK as exquisite as they sound! I have several "high end" pairs and these are a new favorite because of the design and RICH sound that rings through your ears as soon as you put them on. I've found a few burn-in tracks on YouTube just so I can get the full resonance out of them quicker because I'm of the school that it really DOES make a difference. The cups are soft and super comfortable, plush padding and double as verrrry expensive earmuffs that bring music down from the heavens! The bass is punchy and deep; the mids and highs are also crystal clear, which is what you should expect for paying for a unit such as these. Phone calls are clear and pairing was tap and go. I think these will last for years and if you were to justify the expense by calculating the days worn (EVERY! ONE!) then you could change your life for just thirty cents a day. LOL What are you waiting for?!

title: Top notch sound, quality and fit!
review: This is my first pair of Shure headphones and boy was I ever impressed! I wore them on a three-hour plane ride and they are truly noise cancelling and fit me so well. For them to be in-ear, the bass is astonishing and I love how the buds truly mold with your ear for maximum comfort. Call quality and battery life is excellent. I will be using these on my trips from now on.

title: Very decent seat of cans for the price!
review: I tried these out for the times when I am running around the city and don't want to wear my more expensive headphones. These work very well, the sound is clear and a nice deep bass for the price point.

title: Solid headphones.
review: I gave these to my son because his other pair got stolen, and he really likes them and says they provide decent sound and comfort. They won't compare to the higher end headphones but the bass which he likes is decent and the remote and mic make it easier for him to operate them while on the go. These are a good pair of commuting headphones as well.

title: Easy pairing, comfort, clear audio and cancellation.
review: My husband does a lot of traveling and by that I mean on the road in addition to air travel so he wanted something that he was able to use for conference calls on the go and this more than impressed him, it saved him tons of headache. He has an Android that he said was very easy to set up and and he was able to get the most out of the headset once he spent some time perusing the manual, which he is loath to do, but this headset is so loaded with cool features that it is worth it. Definitely a must not just for truckers but folks on the go yet need excellent communication devices.

title: Awesome wired sound!
review: I really like these headphones - excellent sound from such a small pair and I like the way they fit as well. The price is very fair for the quality received and these are a great alternative to bulky on/over ear sets when you want discreet and subtle entertainment.

title: Mighty little buds with great bass and overall sound.
review: My husband thinks these headphones are fantastic with impressive battery life, design, and sound. He wears them on a long shift and only has to recharge them during breaks. They fit well in his ears with no discomfort and he loves that they can fit right into his pants pocket and be discreetly removed during important conversations (except with me). For the price, this is a solid pair of headphones for any activity that will deliver on quality.

title: Personalized sound with personality!
review: Besides the great quality of the sound for a pair of in-ear headphones, the coolest thing about these is how easy the app is to use for customization. Because of this, you only have to slide these in your ears and go, and get yourself to optimal listening level without even breaking your stride.

title: Color me DELIGHTED!!!!!!
review: I was not expecting much from these little tiny earbuds aside from a way to listen to my music when I need to be more aware of my surroundings and just want to block out the idiots on the subway, but when I actually checked them out I was SHOCKED by how good and LOUD these lil babies are! Great bass, great depth and detail in the sound for such a low, low price. These will remain in my purse when I don't want to wear the big cans. I LOVE them.

title: Beautifully designed headphones - looks and sound-wise!
review: I love these and my only wish is that they were a bit louder, otherwise they are AMAZING at this price point. I watched a documentary I'd seen several times before and was able to hear conversations I didn't know existed; the richness of the sound and extra bass are TRULY impressive. I am just glad that I can adjust the volume on my own through music software directly but these are AWESOME. I had them on all night without even realizing it and when I picked them up today, the battery was still almost full. You probably won't find a better pair of headphones at this price.

title: Decent headphones for everyday use
review: If you are a hardcore audiophile then you will find these a little too simplistic in sound for your liking, but will appreciate the sound QUALITY in terms of bass and the comfort of your music as it tunes out everything else. I would look at the headphones in the 50-60 dollar price range in that case. Otherwise, these are pretty good for your morning commute and workouts! They are comfortably worn over the ears and the noise cancellation is okay. With these, depending on what you're looking for you should either shop around and splurge or purchase these with its restrictions in mind.

title: Speak so you may speak again.
review: I am one of those writers that usually likes to write out first drafts by hand, it is a must. But paired with Dragon, this headset actually saves me a lot of time because I can simply go back and edit the work I've freestyled while in the flow of thought. It is extremely comfortable and I didn't have any problems or complaints while using it. It also works fabulously for professional purposes such as dictation/transcription of medical and legal notes too. There are other headsets out there that can be very pricey, but this is a reliable brand native to the best software out there and you simply cannot go wrong!

title: JVC - Quality and Value
review: These are great and affordable headphones by JVC that are truly wireless and have crisp, clean sound. They are excellent for listening to music but be careful on phone calls as the person you are calling will be hearing all of the background noise. Perhaps this is a setting that can be adjusted but otherwise a great pair and buy!

title: Sony wins again!
review: Sony has pretty much always been my go-to brand for quality sound and value, and these earbuds are no exception. For such tiny devices, they fit in the ears comfortably and have excellent noise canceling capability. The extra bass sounds incredible and phone calls are clear and crisp. They stay put during strenuous activity and are easy to pair and use! This is a great buy for a lasting quality and a terrific addition to any audiophile's equipment stash.

title: Awesome sound and value
review: These are a powerful little pair of earbuds that are extremely comfortable and high quality. Because they have different sizes to choose from, you don't have to worry about the discomfort of extra pressure or too little security while enjoying your favorite music and programs! Sennheiser is an excellent brand for a durable, long-lasting purchase that you will not ever regret and these are well worth the buy. Just connect and GO!

title: Ultra-Light, Ultra Right!
review: Excellent and well-priced earphones for music and inspired listening on the go! I prefer cans over buds and was pleased with how comfortable these were and they stayed charged and connected with no problems. An excellent purchase for those who like to jog, walk or spend hours alone immersed in an activity where they only need themselves and some good beats to keep 'em moving!

title: Skullcandy and Ear candy!
review: Quality and affordable headphones with a nice sound and bass. I got these for my son and he loves them; they are a great pair without the expense of the higher brands and also fit comfortably on the ears. The Bluetooth makes them easy to run and exercise with also! Sleek design and color, overall a great buy!

title: Greatest thangs EVAH.
review: When you get a pair of these headphones, you will not EVER take them off. That is how comfortable they feel; that is how ABSOLUTELY PHENOMENAL the sound is; that is how DEEP AND POUNDING the bass is, especially if you are a househead! They are super durable and I cannot stop raving about them. If you are a music fan of any kind, these will be the best investment and purchase and gift you could ever give to yourself, or receive. They also double as earmuffs in the winter! LOL Whenever people compliment me on them, I offer to have them listen and see for themselves just how SICK they are. Oh man. I love them whether I am listen to music or spiritual lectures. I wear them on my walking meditations and am in total bliss. They are on the pricier side since they are wireless but the other model is just as good and they were the first things I bought for myself two years ago. Now is the perfect time to get them because Amazon usually does have them as the deal of the day so BE ON THE LOOKOUT and get your LIFE!!!!!!!!!!!!!

title: Awesome, super comfortable
review: The sound quality on these headphones is amazing and they are also very, very comfortable to wear. If you spend as much time listening to music as I do, then you know how important that is. I also love the design - nothing gaudy or flashy stamped onto the side of your head, since what is coming OUT of the headphones is most important. LOL  Recommended!

title: Boostaroo works well
review: We have used the Boostaroo multiple times now mainly on trips with the car. I have a laptop and the sound it put out while watching a DVD movie wasn't enough to be heard over the noise encountered in the back seat of our car while going down the highway, even with earbuds. The boostaroo not only raised the sound level high enough to be heard, but the sound quality is greatly improved and both my sons are able to listen at the same time with headphones since boostaroo also offers three outlets for headphones and since each outlet has it's own amp the sound quality remains the same for each listener (doesn't diminish with each  additional listener) very pleased.

title: Wow
review: I honestly did not have high expectations for these as usually when I purchase headphones without a big name the quality doesn't seem to be there. These totally shocked me. I actually got them for my daughter so I didn't have to hear her youtube and these were perfect. They fit her big which is expected since she's 2 but they still fit. Connecting was easy and quick and the sound is amazing. The quality and loudness are awesome! These are so worth every penny!

title: Works with my S22 Ultra
review: Acquired this for use with my Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra and it works as expected. No complaints, allows me to use my around ear studio headphones on my mobile device.

title: Not bad but not for me
review:
I don't really like in-ear buds and use around ear headphones at home. This seemed like a decent on the go solution, but they seem like more trouble than they're worth. I haven't had issues with disconnecting or not having native English voice prompts, but they just don't seem to "do it" for me.

By nature of the fact they fit on the outside of the ear, they're not the loudest even at max volume. The design is nice because it allows me to hear people talking without having to pause the music or remove the headphones, but I wouldn't consider these as possessing any noise canceling properties.

They don't fit snug either and if I manage to get them into a position where they don't move around a bit, they'll begin causing discomfort after a brief period. I feel like I'm constantly adjusting them, which leads to me triggering the very sensitive touch function. I'm not positive how the touch functionality works, as it sometimes pauses the music as expected but often randomly controls volume.

They work and everybody's different, but they're ultimately too touchy, don't fit well and aren't loud enough.

title: fit doesn't work for me and not sold on other aspects of design
review:
I really really wanted to like these. I got them to keep a spare set of earbuds in my car for when I forget to take my airpod pros with me or when I don't want to risk losing those. I wasn't expecting or needing the sound quality to be as high; I would've been perfectly happy with the sound and noise cancellation of these if I didn't have other issues.

Regardless of which tips I use, I could not get the earbuds to sit comfortably in my ears. They always felt like they were going to come out, and I found that if a laughed/crinkled my eyes, they would actually come out. I also wasn't crazy about how touching the round part turned them on/off. When I'd be fiddlng with them trying to get the fit right, I'd be constantly turning them off and on. I prefer the design of touching the stem to turn on/off where it's a mre deliberate act.

Other than that, bluetooth pairing was straightforward as was charging and seeing how much charge was left in the case. As far as I can tell, there's no way to know how much each individual bud is charged which is disappointing. I looked everywhere for a label of left vs right when out of the case and couldn't find anything until I saw in the maual that they're supposed to be labeled and I looked again. The R and L are super tiny and hard to read such that they're not usable in most lighting situations.

Overall, these were a bust for me. I'd opt for my wired earbuds as a backup pair over these.

title: Already Broke
review: The headphones with the volume adjuster has already broke after 3 uses. Would not recommend!

title: Just right
review: My 8 year old likes them better than the more expensive headphones that she broke. I like that she can still hear me calling her.

title: She loved it.
review:
It is really nice. I have purchased one to my wife. She loved it.
She was boring using wired headphone. Additionally, it is easy to control phone such as music, call answer, and hung up from the headphone.

title: Great purchase for a great price
review: Great headphones for the money everyone knows headphone don't usually last long but my experience with this brant is really good they never just stop work im the one always misplacing them 😆

title: Not the best for smaller, hard ears.
review: I really like Betron earphones, but these simply do not fit in my ear and is the ONLY reason for 3 star rating. If you have smaller ears, that don't have a lot of "soft" parts, these may not be the right ones to get. I was bummed because Betron has amazing noise canceling, but this design leaves little wiggle room to make them fit. Ended up getting an older model Betron.

title: Love these!
review:
I absolutely love these earphones. I had a pair that was a gift that lasted a year & the only reason they quit working was my own fault. My niece grabbed them & pulled them hard off my head & they caught in my hair causing the wires on one side to pull away from the earpiece. I was devastated and searched for another pair. I tried and returned 2 different types (one super expensive one mid range) then happened across these that were exactly like the pair I had! They are super comfortable, I fall asleep with them on all the time. I completely forget they are even there. I’ve bought both my parents a pair & my dad wears hearing aides & says they work very well for him. The battery life is super long & they charge very fast. I love these things and recommend them!
There is T much in the noise canceling area, but that isn’t what I got them for. I don’t want them to cancel out noise, the purpose is so I CAN h hear what is going on around me but others can’t hear what I’m listening too. They are perfect.

title: Great earbud tops
review: I have very small ear canals.  My Google pro earbuds kept falling out of ears.  So I was not happy.  Finally with a little extra effort they got on.  I probably could have used 6 mm but these will work.  Yay!

title: Small little addition to home office set up
review: Very small addition for my zoom office calls when I use a headset. It’s nice to have hands on volume control for me as I don’t have to click and search for a a tab or button on my laptop on top of giving presentations … great price and works great.

title: Great price for long battery life and sound !
review: I’ve been looking for a pair of earbuds that I could use for gym and not lose. These are great.  Long. Atteryblife and easy to Cary, fit my ears and sweat proof ! Will buy again in another color

title: Overall this is a nice headset, but with issues
review: Overall this is a nice headset, but with issues. It has very good volume, plenty more than enough sound and speaker is of good quality. headset is light and fits fine over my head and feels very comfortable.

title: Didn't work for me.
review: This didn't make my gaming headphones work. That was the only reason I brought it for.

title: These are what you want!
review: Woo!  These headphones are great! Comfortable and they stay on my head very well.  Not too big as to over crowd my face.  They adjust small enough to fit my 3 year old and large enough for any human being. They are a steal at this price.  Great sound quality, and they swivel and seem very durable.

title: Perfect fit and very well made
review: Have you ever had perfectly good headphones that you love and they started shedding that fake leather like a gecko? I got fed up with buying new headphones every time the fake leather started breaking down. Why manufacturers use that material is beyond me. Rather than replace them I made a cover for the top which started shedding first (black flakes on my face and in my blond hair!). When the ears started, I looked to see if Amazon had any remedies and I found the Geekria earpad covers. I slipped them on and they are perfect! Soft and comfortable and no problem with hearing through them - and best of all no more black flake shedding!

title: Great buy!
review:
I am in love with these headphones. I can enjoy listening to music, videos, etc. Without the cables. The sound is great!
Would recommend and again!

title: I like it when I exercise
review: I have bought a lot of earphones,some of them I use it when I am driving ,some of them I use to sleep ,some of I use to exercise especially for running.The design is so good that it will easily stick to your ears and won’t drop at all,and the quailty of the sound is awesome !

title: Overall it is ok
review: Overall it is okay, I really like the color purple. The volume quality is not that good. It is used when you workout, but the length of earbuds is a little bit long.

title: Not great for every day use.
review: They hold headphones, which is the point, but as others have noted, they do not stay in place at all. They knock over very easily and you cannot remove headsets with one hand.

title: Great Value
review: Great sound quality, it's clear and blocks out other noises. The case has a futuristic touch with the earbuds bring able to slide and snap in when the earbuds are put back in their slots. They fit perfectly for my ears and don't fall out. These were definitely worth the money, will buy again.

title: Comfortable and long battery life
review: I've started using these wireless earbuds everyday.  The battery life is long enough for an afternoon of constant use and the earbuds are comfortable to use for hours.

title: Compatible with Galaxy phone and chromebook
review: These inexpensive headphones are perfect for the gym or traveling. I use them with my chrome book and my Samsung phone. The sound is clear and they work as I need them. Price can't be beat!

title: Works as expected but newer versions are available
review: This bluetooth headset works as expected. The sound is clear. However, there are newer versions of earphones that work as well and are more comfortable, less likely to fall.

title: Great for workouts
review: My exercise headphones recently wore out and I tried these as a replacement. I like the way that they are easy to set up and pair with my Samsung phone. I just had to scan and pair and it worked immediately.  The sound quality is clear and the battery seems to go for a long time without any issues. I've only started using it and it has been several days without a need to charge again.  I like the way that the headphones stay in place and can magnetically lock so they don't fall off when I'm wearing them on my shoulders.  Very convenient and works well for my needs!

title: Simple, attractive and unobtrusive
review: We decided to use the Next Zen cable box to hide  the jumble of cables and chargers that we use for our phones, headphones, kindles, battery packs, iPad, etc.  This large white box is able to hide most of the electronics we use on a daily basis.  We'd set this up on our home office but I plan to use one to set up a charging station in each room we use often: den/tv area, bedroom/dressing room area, living room/kitchen.

title: Light and protects the sides of the Samsung Buds Live/Pro case
review:
This Sameo protective case goes around the Samsung earbuds case to cover the edges. It's lightweight but protects the sides of the case and keeps the top and bottom from being accessible. Although if the case falls or is hit in the center where there is no silicone protection it is vulnerable.

I was tempted by the blue and the yellow cases. The yellow is bright and cheery.

title: Not difficult to set up and works better than expected
review:
I ordered this mp3 player to help me stay motivated to work out. I had started running but developed an injury and am trying to get into swimming. The indoor lap pool can be a chore but having the music on my new mp3 player makes a huge difference.

The headphones and mp3 player are easy to set up. I transferred the mp3 format music. I wear the mp3 player inside my swim cap and it isn't uncomfortable. The player worked well underwater and was better than I'd expected.

title: Inexpensive, convenient and perfect for gym
review: I ordered these headphones to use at the gym.  I like the fit and they come with extra silicone covers that can adjust the fit.  The sound quality is more than enough for my needs as I use this while listening to music, watching videos and listening to podcasts while I work out.  The magnetic feature is great as it keeps the headphones in place/less likely that I will lose them. While these won't be the first headphones I grab to listen for a prolonged period, these work perfectly as my gym and short travel headphones. I like that they come in a soft protective case that has a hook - I'm able to tie this up with my small gym padlock!

title: Easy to set up and reasonable price for their quality
review:
These earbuds come with 3 sizes of plastic pads but are set up with the medium sized one out of the box. The smallest pads worked best for me and fit reasonably well. The over the ear part did stay in place even as I powerwalked with a face mask.

The earbuds were easy to set up and pair with my Samsung phone. They came charged and it is not difficult to charge them with the USB cord. The volume is quite good and I did not find the sound tinny. While I don't have many pink items, these magenta earbuds are easy to spot in my black handbag, so the bright color is a plus. The earbuds are reasonable priced for their quality.

title: Excellent product. Long battery life, stays in place and great sound quality.
review: Excellent product. The earbuds have a long battery life which are perfect for my all day hikes and bike rides.  I can wear them all day, they are very comfortable in ear and do not fall out. The sound quality is great. I would highly reccommend and purchase again. Thanks!

title: Two packs, roomy, and easy to organize
review:
My husband and I use and travel with a large number of rechargable devices. It seems that the cords, plugs, etc keep increasing. This 2 piece travel pack has enough space for us to organize and travel with everything we need.
We can pack the cords and chargers for battery packs, Samsung and Apple phones, kindles, international adaptors, memory sticks, chargers for headphones, booklights, cameras, iPads, laptops, etc.
The containers are connected with snaps and can easily be detached so one set can be kept at home or at the hotel and the items needed for the day are easily organized and brought for the day's use.

title: Easy to set up, comfortable when used for hours, great sound
review:
I've used different styles and brands of headphones and have come to rely on Sony's quality and ease of use.
These paired easily with my Samsung Galaxy phone through the Sony app. The headphones are light, easy to use, comfortable, and provide excellent sound quality. I like that I can keep them around my neck and they are weighted down as well as held together with magnets. I love that the headphones are light, bendable, easy to store in my backpack pocket.
Battery life is also a big plus.

title: Efficient use of space and offers several USB and regular plugs
review:
With just 2 people in our household, we still have so many electronic gadgets that these power strips are necessities. We have the usual long power strips but this takes up less space and is easy to bring when traveling. I love the USB sockets which I fill up with my phone, kindle, headphones.
This power strip would also work well in a library or studying situation as it can easily be put on a shared table and will expand the sockets available for a group.

title: Convenient and safe!
review: This Woods surge protector with 3 USBs and 1 USB -C outlet is so helpful!  It was so easy to use -- just plug into 2 sockets -- and we immediately had a safe way to charge more of our electronics and had 3 additional sockets.  It's now possible to charge 2 phones and a Kindle and headphones and have sockets ready for use.  This works very well at home but I also plan to bring it traveling within the US.  It offers more charging ports, so you can share limited sockets in a hotel room or while waiting for a flight.

title: Inexpensive, easy to replace and good quality
review: I was excited to see these replacement pads for my Bose Headphones.  My headphones work well but the ear pads were suffering from wear and tear after years of use.  These were the same size and type. They were easy to replace and work well.

title: Earbuds with good sound quality and last for hours on one charge
review:
I'm always looking for earphones and earbuds of good quality. These go for hours on one charge and stay in place quite well, so they're particularly good for traveling and for working out. I love that they are water resistant and that they allow some ambient sound - I am able to wear them while walking around NYC and even on the subway - this allows me to be aware of my surroundings while listening to music or an audiobook. While the earbuds are relatively expensive, they produce good sound quality and they can run for hours on one charge. The regular earbuds can be dislodged relatively easily but because these hook over the ear, they are more stable and less likely to fall out.
Setting up the earbuds was easy - they quickly paired with my Samsung phone.

title: Inexpensive and helpful cord organizer
review: I travel with so many cords and chargers that my usual small tote can't hold them all.  This new cord storage works out well for me.  I'm able to organize the cords for my Kindle Paperwhite, my bluetooth noise cancelling headphones, my book light, my phone charger, my small bluetooth headphones charger, my husband's iPhone charger, etc. and keep the cords organized.  I love that there is another equally large section that can hold laptop, etc. peripherals.  For $10, this is one of my most useful travel items.

title: Works well as intended
review: Fits and protects my new Sony Noise cancelling wireless headphones. Rather large case, but the headphones don't fold inwards.

title: Easy to set up, complex and nuanced sound
review:
I had no trouble connecting the headphones to my phone through bluetooth and the Beoplay app. It did take me a while to custom fit the earphones using the different sized buds. I find the sound quality markedly superior to my other in earphones. More nuanced, complex, deeper bass, crisper treble - it sounds more like the larger headphones but has the convenience, size and portability.

I use it for less strenuous exercising and appreciate that the cords seem thicker and more durable than the plastic cords of my other earphones.

title: Fits well and a 2 hour charge gives 12 hours of music
review:
I was happy to find that these headphones are compatible with my Samsung Galaxy 9. It took me a while to figure out how to link the headphones to my phone but after setting it up, I had no problems. I'm 5'3" and these headphones and their earhook fit me well. They will likely fit someone with larger ears but these haven't fallen off, unlike the larger Panasonic ones that I'd used in the past. These earphones come with spare and different sizes of earbuds, which allows for customization. The controls are reasonably easy to use - the buttons are all on the right earbud.

I am happy with the battery life on these earbuds. Two hours of charge gives me nearly 12 hours of audiobooks/music.

title: Wireless, easy to use, comfortable and works well
review:
These JVC Wireless Memory Foam Earbuds Marshmallow is carefully packed and arrives in a padded envelope. I charged them using the enclosed USB charger for a few hours before using. There are paper instructions enclosed in the box, but the earphones only have 3 buttons (volume, power/pairing). It was easy to turn on and pair with an iPhone. I found the smaller earbuds comfortable and a good fit for me. For the most part, the earbuds stayed secure and when they occasionally slipped off, they stayed on my shoulders.

The sound was clear for phone calls, audiobooks and music. These earbuds are convenient, easy to use and are such an improvement over the earphones that came with my phone!

title: Inexpensive headphone splitter that works well
review: These AmazonBasics headphone splitter works as expected.  No need for batteries or additional connections, the splitter makes it easy to share an audiobook or movie while traveling.

title: Customized fit and clear crisp sound
review:
Audio-Technica's headphones provide excellent quality for the price. While over ear headphones are comfortable, they're far bulkier. What the in-ear headphones lack in comfort they make up for in convenience. These latest ATH-LS50iSBK in-ear headphones bend and adjust to your particular ear shape. The sound quality is far better than my current panasonic sports headphones and worlds away from the airbuds that came with my iPhone. The voices and instruments have a crispness and clarity that reflects the quality of these headphones. The headphones come with several sizes of earths, which is just another way that these headphones allow for a customized fit.

The earphones come with a soft pouch, though a hard case would probably keep the shape of the flexible cable loops better.

title: V-Moda Forza In-Ear Headphones - good looks, quality, and comfort
review:
I hadn't previously tried V-Moda headphones, instead I'd mainly relied on my trusty AKG and Bose over the ear headsets. I hadn't realized that In-Ear Headphones could be so comfortable and deliver such clear, beautiful sound. It's made me appreciate my iPhone's sound as well.

Though $130 is expensive for headphones, the V-Moda gives you quality. The headphones are carefully packed so that the sensitive headphones are in foam and the additional fittings, sports ear hooks and sports fins are protected in the case. It comes with a small, attractive, durable portable pouch. The cord is "anti-tangle" - though unlike some of the other reviewers I haven't tried to tangle them up. Mainly, I'm impressed by the clarity of the sound and that I could wear these earphones for while traveling for hours without any discomfort. These are so much easier to bring with me while I'm walking around in NYC as well as when I'm traveling.

title: Very nice for price
review: I wasn't looking for the best headphones, just for listening to music and videos on my notebook. Sturdy, comfortable, light and nice sound for the price.

title: Good headphones
review:
I got these headphones because my Tribit Quiet Plus 72 headphones had fallen apart. Since I couldn't afford Tribit headphones anymore, I have decided to give this product a try. And, to be honest, they look identical to the aforementioned headphones with some differences.

Needless to say, these headphones work as well as the last ones I had. The sound quality is incredibly high definition and the bass function is amazing for my music-listening experience. It is even better when you use it with the ANC feature.

The noise canceling function does a great job with background noise isolation allowing me to feel less distracted by the outside noise. This function allows me to stay focused on the tasks at hand and helps me get the job accomplished.

The only sad thing about it is that it came with a leather bag as I was expecting a hard, protective case. But eventually, I found one that fits my headphones perfectly. :)

title: Worst claim ever
review:
Brought these Funsound Bluetooth earbuds with this warranty and Asurion refused to approve my claim.

I was so shocked at how they handled my claim. After sending them NUMEROUS screenshots of my Proof of Purchase, they have single-handedly denied my claim.

Flabbergasted and outraged, I went to Amazon customer service and demanded a refund for my policy.

The process was very quick and I was also able to return the headphones also before Amazon had taken the listing down due to the overwhelmingly negative reviews and complaints.

title: Good headphones but...
review: Recently, I bought these headphones because I wanted the full experience for music with a touch of Deep-bass in any song in my personal music Library. Unfortunately, these so-called HD headphones did not deliver on what I wanted in a pair of full-cup headphones. Each time I wanted to listen to songs with a deep-bass pulse, it skips in the sound quality output because of the extensive cord. That's not what I wanted in a pair of awesome headphones. But yeah, it works on some songs, but not all of them. But the best parts of this product is that it is very comfortable, very relaxed and keeps your ears warm...with the power of music, that is. :D

title: Wish I had these a long time ago
review: Awesome headphones. I can use them while I walk my dog and still hear if anybody is coming up the trail. I have also never liked turning standard headphones on blast and not being in tune to my surroundings. A coworker reccomended them. Unsure how they stack against other bone conduction headphones.

title: Horrible
review: This stupid thing came and it's backwards so I tried wearing them for 1st time and I lost my earbud cause it fell off since the thing is backwards smh

title: Best for the price
review: Great wireless headphones. Love the long last charging case. I had a different pair from a different company that crapped out after 3 months. These are way better had have lasted so far.

title: OK but wouldn't buy again or recommend
review: Having trouble finding headphones of any type that don't end up aggravating me thru out the day. These barely made the cut but will use until can find something else.

title: Not good for walking but works good around house
review: I was looking for a smaller antenna for my mp3 so that I don’t have to have earphones plug as antenna while using my Bluetooth ear buds. It’s heavy for my mp3 so I still use the earphones supplied. But it does give good reception to my mp3 when I do use it around the house. I can’t go walking because bulky.

title: Head size is small
review: The headphones work well but did not fit properly. They were to small to fit myself as a large male.  Gave them to a female family member who had a smaller body.

title: Good quality at fair price
review:
These do just as good of a job as the really expensive earbuds...
Very happy with this purchase

title: Stopped working after 3 weeks
review: Liked the headset at first. Then after about 3 weeks it stopped working with Skype calls.

title: They don't fall out!
review: My whole life I wish and tried to be able to use Iphone headphones and they just would not stay in my ears. These headphones do not fall out. Not in the gym, not at work, not cleaning, not sweating at the pool, they just don't fall out. Phone calls on them work great, super easy to set up with any device, they're just so convenient. No regrets buying these at all. The case they came in is a good size and lights up with how much battery is left on it. The 4 different sized ear buds that came with it are great too. I'm definitely going to get the flat charger for it though because using the cord is kinda of irritating but not impossible.

title: Good for call center work
review: I needed a headset with a mute button and a led light to indicate when it is on or off. The ear pieces can move in or away from the ears. The thing that was a little weird is not being able to hear your own voice in the ear pieces. Otherwise a good headset. Comfortable.

title: Great Product
review: These headphones are awesome. The sound is great. The case is much needed and is just as awesome

title: **EROkay sound quality, but died after 3 months.
review:
**EDIT** Company contacted me and offered money to take down my honest review. I did not take their money and will leave my honest review up. Make better products and you will have less negative reviews.

Purchased in Dec. 2020 because of high rating. Sound quality was okay and batter life was shorter than expected. One of the ear buds would occasionally disconnect, but a quick off/on would fix the issue. As of April 2021, the housing will no longer charge the ear buds, so they are useless. Since I pouchased in Dec. 2020 I am beyond the return window and I'm stuck with them. Will not buy again, but will look for a more quality earbud.

title: Nice earphone
review:
Earphones worked right out of the box, the 3.5mm jack is slim enough to go through my phone cover. Microphone quality was good as per feedback from friends, sound quality to listen to music is ok. Magnets on the earbuds are just right strength and do a good job of keeping wires entangled.

This is a good buy for the money!

title: I would 100% buy these again.
review: I love the feel and quality of these headphones. Cord has not gotten tangled once since I've had them and the carrying case is awesome!

title: Buy these headphones
review: Comfortable light weight headphone with excellent sound quality. Just as good as Beats or Bose at a much better price

title: Great quality and comfort
review: I purchased for my little brother as a birthday gift and he absolutely loved them. He said the sound quality is great and they are very comfortable to wear. He says these are his favorite brand of earbuds so far

title: Perfect for people with lots of ear piercings
review: I bought these headphones because they have more open space for my ears to fit comfortably due to my piercings. They are super comfortable and I love that they fit my head perfectly without a tight squeeze. If you are a bass head I highly recommend they have an amazing bass

title: Reliable
review: Connection is fast and reliable. Headphones are comfortable and doesn't cause any discomfort after wearing them for hours. I haven't noticed any lip sinking at all.

title: Weak volume
review: These earbuds are nice until you actually go to use them. The volume is extremely weak and the rubber ear wing things move out of position too easily causing me to have to readjust them constantly. I returned them. Would not recommend!

title: Okay, but not very loud.
review: These are okay and all, they're just not very loud. If you like it loud, go with another set of earphones.

title: Fixes the awful earpads on 1more triple drivers
review:
Nice and soft for all-day use, I just peeled the idiotic on-ear pads off my 1more triple drivers and wrapped these around the metal driver cup for a factory-looking fix that makes them proper over-ears. The depth and size and foam density make them perfect, not impacting the sound quality whatsoever.

If you own more 1more triple driver headphones, buy these, peel off the original trash, and slip these on for a completely fixed experience.

title: No issues so far
review:
Bought so my wife and I can watch movies using two different pairs of headphones - grados and meze 99's require different volumes. I honestly don't know why all splitters don't have volume controls.

The quality is fine. all plastic, but the adjustment wheels have the right amount of friction to not be "bumped" into another volume, and the internals are good enough that I can split a hifi signal from Tidal to a pair of grado 225's and GS3000's and not notice any loss in quality.

I can't speak to the long term durability yet, but it's got about ten hours of use between home and airplane situations and had no problems. If it dies within a couple years, I'll update this review.

title: FINALLY some hybrid tips for the bud pros
review:
I prefer the fit of memory foam to silicone. The oval shape of the buds pro has introduced a problem that I had never really run into before, where I notice that my left earhole is just slightly not oval compared to my right. I've never had another pair of IEM's that needed a different size of eartip between left and right, but the bud pro's fit is just so bad that I had to get foam tips and use a small in my left and medium right. I've never had that before.

But even then, the silicone just doesn't seal completely. So I switched to comply foams and realized that I kinda hated those, too. I wanted something in between - a silicone tip that had some "back-fill" into my ear canal.

These are just right. I can wear double mediums like normally, they don't require me to stick them in and then RE-stick them once the memory foam heats up, they don't cause any scratchy irritation that foam can cause after hours in your head, and I actually quite like that they aren't a rigid shape. Makes putting them on the earbud itself a little trickier but overall, A+

Also came with a cute card from the company inside.

Overall, these are the tips to buy if you've got problems with the fit of your buds pro's (which seems common. They really do fit like crap.)

title: Literally the best thing money can buy for portable listening.
review:
Seriously? A full AMP/DAC that can happily run two pairs of pretty hard to drive he4xx planar magnetics with a splitter, BLUETOOTH, you can run it as a WIRED DESKTOP AMP/DAC, a monster battery, a BALANCED OUTPUT, and even has details like being able to disable charging while it's plugged into a computer as a wired amp, to keep the battery healthy longer, for this money?!

I'm sold. Beyond sold. This is the best investment money can buy after the headphones, but not a long way behind headphones. If I was given the option of this and my HE4xx's or a set of Meze classic 99's? This. Every time.

Fiio are just mad geniuses. It's built so well. Feels so nice to use. I can't find a single issue to whine about. Even has a belt clip. This is the audio bargain of the last 20 years.

title: Better than stuff ten times the price
review:
This just has all the little features you didn't know you wanted.

stupid fast charging, long battery life. It doesn't have that awful sad chinese-english robot voice when trying to connect/disconnect. The case is conveniently shaped and though a bit bulky, makes up for it by being able to charge your phone in a pinch.

Pretty bass heavy, not the most abject hifi crystal clear neutral audio, but if you're buying IEM's for HIFI, you're weird. Music sounds great. Videos sound great. Not muddy at all.

The connection quality b/t the earbuds and the phone is great. The microphone quality is just fine. I have terrible cell service in my home, so when I need to make a call, I put my phone on the windowsill and I can walk all over my two story house without an issue.

Comfort is SUPERB. I can't sing the praises enough. I can wear these for hours.

title: The fit took some getting used to on AD700's
review:
They fit on my AD700's just fine, took some work, but they are nice and snug. They do transform the headphones from the over/on ear setup to a more closed soundstage since these earpads are very much in the "over ear" camp. The old ones sit on and around your ear and make everything sound light and ethereal. These narrow the soundstage quite a bit, but make things sound a bit heavier and punchier. Honestly, the sound quality is an improvement for what I use them for, but if you're a classical or jazz music snob, these ear cups might actually be a significant downgrade in audio quality.

Comfort is solid. I did kind of have problems with the old AD700's putting pressure on my ears after 4 or 5 hours in my office, but these don't do that because they don't sit on the ear.

title: fifteen years later, still going strong!
review:
I dug these things out of a box today and tried them on. They're easily fifteen years old and incredibly, they still work. And they actually sound pretty good (I'm a bit of an audiophile and normally use much more expensive headphones, I bought these things as a kid, likely at an airport.) They don't really have active noise reduction, they just bump the EQ up and the volume slightly. With the switch off, they are fairly neutral, with slightly tinny highs, moderately underpronounced bass, otherwise pretty good. with the EQ on, they get a bit muddy, but the bass becomes much, MUCH punchier. Think of the powered switch (one AAA battery) as a basshead mode.

Comfort is decent. nothing special, but certainly not uncomfortable.

Overall, for the price advertised on amazon, I wouldn't suggest them, but they've lasted through a teenager's abuse and then sat for another ten years, and when I plugged them in with a fresh AAA they worked and actually sounded pretty solid. Detachable cord is a bonus as is the adjustable volume on the left ear. If you can get a pair for under twenty bucks, I'd say jump on it.

title: They would have been ok, but...
review:
They would have been ok, but the earpiece just came apart about 2 hours into my workday. I had to super glue it back together. It's pretty unfortunate. They look nice and they seem to work ok for now, but I can't recommend them since they fell apart after less than 2 hours use while I was sitting at my desk in my office.

EDIT: Two days later, and the other side fell apart. Also, the first side that fell apart just shocked the crap out of my ear. These don't run on high voltage, and it's not like it burned my ear or anything, but your headphones shouldn't be sending sparks, of ANY voltage, that close to your brain.
STAY WELL AWAY FROM THESE HEADPHONES

title: Amazing Headphones and an AMAZING VALUE
review: These are awesome headphones. Straight up. I'm an electrician, and right now I'm wiring prefabbed prison cells on a 5 acre lot. I'm basically spending ten hours a day in a huge outdoor maze made of concrete and steel. What makes these headphones so amazing? One, I charge them all night and they lay my whole shift as long as I turn them off for my half hour lunch. That's 9-plus hours on a charge. Two, I usually have my phone in my pocket, but sometimes I leave it by my tools. I can walk 60 yards straight away from my phone and still be connected. Or I can go two rows of cells over. 20 yards and 3 feet of concrete and rebar. Finally, I work outside. Heat, cold, reason, a little snow, sweat, etc. And they keep rocking. I love these things, especially considering the price. These are awesome. Grab a pair!

title: Distorted Sound Right Out of the Box
review: I wish I had purchased something else. I purchased this cord extension at the same time that I purchased a very expensive headphone from Amazon. When I plugged everything in, the sound was very distorted and hard to hear. I assumed the headphones were defective and returned them to Amazon. I then purchased a headphone from another party. When I plugged the new headphone in, the sound was still distorted. It became clear that the cord extension was the problem.

title: Great headphones, recommend!
review:
The packaging was very impressive and I love the braided cable of these headphones. I usually wrap my headphones up and put them in a small case and the braided cable are excellent at staying straight when I take them out. Build quality is top notch, very light weight and the cap is aluminum, I wish there were more metal, but for the price, this is sufficient.

The sound quality is bass heavy, really gets the low end. Overall is pleasant to listen to. Definitely stays in my ear very snugly with the attachment came with.

title: review after having the product for over a year.
review: This headphone is very nice built, I can's say solid, and it doesn't have to. They are goos enough for everyday use and they clearity of this thing, is the best I have ever tried. Way more clear the any of the BEATS. the bass mid and high are fairly even, but they are very clear, you can definitely hear things you couldn't from other headphones.

title: good and not so good
review:
The sound is really good -- the little plastic dealies take a few days to figure out which size works best. The little dealies are not readily available, though, and when you can buy them they seem to be terribly expensive. They're about $8 for a pack of three sets, one of each size, so considering you will only use one of the three sets it is really an expensive replacement. If you can find other earbud covers cheaper, please comment.

The other thing that is really not great is the cover over the wire is very flimsy. I have had the earbuds about a month and the wear on the wire where it meets the plug is substantial.

In all, next time (and probably soon, because these are flimsy) I will purchase earbuds that address these issues better. I may pay more, but in the long run it makes sense to find better made earbuds, especially since they are made to run around and be stowed away -- that increases the probability that these two little things will be an issue.

Live and learn.

title: Decent Sound; Ear-cup Broke after a year of intense use
review: I did like the headset while it was unbroken, however the plastic frame bends every time you put the headset on. Overtime the plastic weakened, turned white, then broke.

title: Great bracket-works perfectly , secure under desk headphone storage.
review: Super quick response, the headphone bracket went on easily and the adhesive appears to be major effective. I have two sets hanging from it right now: Bose QC35s and Sennheiser HD 280 pro with the full length cord, and both are happy and out of my way while readily available. Would (and might-I have other 'phones) certainly buy again.

title: Do Not Stay in Ears
review: It's a shame about these earbuds. They work very well, but I cannot stand them because they will not stay in my ears.  I tried different tips to no avail. I would not recommend purchasing.

title: Great headphones and a line which I'll be buying more from in the future
review: These headphones are amazing. I'm new to the audiophile world but these headphones were recommended across multiple online forums as some of the best headphones even beating out a few other much more expensive options. I haven't tried many headphones but I can honestly say these are worth 100+ what I paid. The sound is neutral sounding so if you'd like to listen to music or watch tv/movies without any sound coloration these are it. The bass is tight and precise without ever sounding weak and packs a decent punch. These aren't your average beats so if you're looking for that sloppy overwhelming bass they provide, you should look at another pair. The highs might be my favorite part. They seem to dance around your head while remaining crisper then many sounds I hear in real life. The build quality is what you can expect with the majority of German engineered products which is perfection. They're sturdy and the coating looks really nice under different types of light.
