They did take some time to get comfortable for me like there is some break in period but I also didn't realize that the ear cups can but rotated to fit the angle of your ears which helped a lot.

title: Sturdy and cute. I got the sunflower.
review: Fits my earbuds and charging cord. The case fits into the palm of my hand which is big enough. I have to store the plug with my other chargers in a drawer, but when I look at this case I know my buds and cord are protected.

title: was running HDMI for the first few weeks) and it is amazing. I have not sat in front of a ...
review:
After years of gaming on a laptop I'm in nirvana.

All the reviews pointed to this monitor and they were right. It is unbelievable. I'm running it to my Geforce 970 via a display port cable (just got that today, was running HDMI for the first few weeks) and it is amazing.

I have not sat in front of a gaming desktop for years, it's been laptops forever and I'm never going back.

I have no complaints about it, I like how easy it is to adjust the height and angle, how it will "hold" whatever position you give it, wait, I have one complaint; the speakers are hot garbage. But if you're using your monitor for speakers you need to reassess where you are in life. I use headphones or actual, you know, speakers.

If you need a new monitor, get this monitor. If you don't need a new monitor, get two of these monitors.

I have a whole list of things I want to do to my existing computer build (I built it fast and dirty in places to get wife approval) and now I'm thinking about forgoing all that and getting a second monitor.... I'm in trouble.

title: Excellent for the price
review: If you like vocals, piano, and natual sound, then you want a flat response. If you want boomy bass, heavy instrumentals, and strong highs then you want a V shape respone. These offer more of a flat response. They sound slightly cleaner (female vocals) than my $200 earbuds. Construction quality is excellent, they are comfortable, and they block exterior noise without having to push the tips deep into your ear canal.

title: Add an amp, kick back, and be amazed!
review: Superior headphones that sound better than everything I have listened to in that price category. The 650's definitely need a headphone amp to bring out all the "punch" they are capable of providing. You won't be disappointed.

title: good, light, inexpensive earphones
review: I needed some inexpensive earphones for when I worked out (I don't like earplugs).  These fit the bill. Solid enough that they will last a long time, and light enough not to look out of place in a gym.  Sound is good quality and the phones fit just right so background sounds are do not intrude.

title: Excellent Replacements!
review: Worked great! I have a set of iFrogs earbuds, and when I was mowing, I lost one of the earbuds. So I got a set of these. Work perfect!

title: strange pocket configuration
review:
I bought this but returned it shortly thereafter. I ultimately ended up with a mountain hardware paladin instead (though I now have mixed opinions on that one, too).

Anyway, the HAL is a nice pack, and well-deserving of accolades. It fits well and generously accommodates a large laptop and other stuff. There's a well-designed water bottle/umbrella pocket on one side. My complaint was not enough small zippered pockets for storing chargers, headphones, and other miscellaneous electronics.There are some small compartments within the larger pockets, but I think things would just fall out of them and get jumbled around within the larger pocket (not fall out of the pack though.) The other thing that bothered me about the HAL is the strange design and shape -- it's a little too hip and urban for my tastes. Je ne sais.

title: Worst fit ever. Unusable.
review: Unusable. Bought directly from Samsung and I am sending them back. I think it would be easier to hold a golf ball in my ear.  Even chewing food causes them to fall out. These are the worst earbuds I have ever had. It is a shame too because the Galaxy Buds Live were the best fitting ever. Only earbuds that survive the push-up test and don't fall out. The Pros fell out after just 15 push ups. Pretty sure intense thinking or increased heart rate would make them fall out. They are that bad.

title: Not great but pretty good still.
review:
Pros:
-very comfortable
-light
-battery indicator light (hold down volume button red=low purple=med blue=full charge)

Cons:
-battery life not the best, I feel like I am always charging it
-sound is ok but not great at all

I would gladly pay more for this same design with better sound quality. I had hoped for something better from an in-ear headphone. The sound is not horrible but just not great at all. Not particularly crisp and clear, with no great treble or bass either. I really like the way everything sits on your neck instead of your ears. The one thing that sucks is that I can't do crunches it sit-ups. They fall off and it gets annoying.

title: Works out of the box on Linux and Windows
review:
Could use a bit better picture quality, but the adjustable brightness ring light fits my needs. The camera was recognized right away under both Linux and Windows (required for work). I've used the camera with Zoom with no issues.
I have not used the built in microphone because I use a headset with microphone. If using a similar setup, I would remind you that muting the in-line mic on the headset potentially leaves the camera mic open - be careful.

title: Soft, small, and squishy -- basic earphones with a 3.5mm phone jack and no hard parts
review:
These are pretty basic earphones that provide decent sound. The most distinctive feature is that there are no hard parts -- other than a tiny speaker surrounded by squishy rubber -- so you could easily wear these for hours or sleep in them without much discomfort. The back of the earphones appear to be made of the same squishy rubber that the earbuds are made of -- so the entire earphone is soft and comfortable. They are one-size fits all -- no extra earbuds or other bells and whistles -- so if standard size earphones don't work for you without adjustment, you may want to pass on these. These are very small and they stay put. I would not call them noise-blocking, but they do a decent job of muffling sounds even without music.

Wish these came with a lightning connector so I could use them with my iPhone right away. I sometimes listen to music or a audio book until I fall asleep at night -- and I wake up a couple hours later to take out the hard earbuds. These should be a big improvement over my hard earbuds. Once I get a dongle so I can use these with my iPhone, I will definitely be trying them out in bed, and I expect that is where they will get the most use.

title: Very comfortable and convenient, with clear sound.
review: These quickly displaced my apple earbuds and have become my go-to earphones.  They are super comfortable and do a great job of blocking out extraneous noise.  The flat cord doesn't tangle, and the two earpieces are magnetized, so they stay together when you're not using them.  It's not a big process to untangle them every time I take them out of my purse.  I like the convenience of corded headphones -- they're always ready to use and I don't have to worry about them running out of charge, nor do I have to have a charger handy or mess with syncing with bluetooth -- I may be a little bit old school -- but I think these are great!

title: These are so comfortable!!  And provide up to 20 hours on a single charge.
review: These Sony WH-CH400 Wireless Headphones are super comfortable and provide up to 20 hours of music playback.  They also have a hands free device built into the headset, for easy phone conversations.  The headphones are surprisingly comfortable and soft against the ears.  They're not noise-blocking, but they do a decent job of keeping out extraneous noise  The headphones are also compatible with Google and Siri -- although I haven't tried that function yet.  Overall, I am very pleased with these headphones, as they provide very comfortable and good sound.  They're a little bulky for use when I'm out and about and they're not tight enough to wear at the gym, but for just hanging out, they work great.

title: Microphone did not work well for phone conversations -- otherwise headphones are fine.
review: Headphones are fine.  Microphone is not good.  These were absolutely worthless for phone calls.  After using these for a couple days, I am ditching them and going back to the headphones that came with my iPhone.  I would not purchase these again.

title: Convenient and comfortable, but sound quality was sometimes inconsistent and they were not the most secure in my ears.
review: These were nice for working out as there is no cord to get in the way.  The sound quality is good, but I experienced a fair amount of skipping and inconsistent volume.  I strongly prefer the simple corded earphones that came with my iPhone, as they seemed to stay in place better and provide more consistent sound.

title: EXCELLENT headphones with brilliant bass -- really shut out background noise / compatible with Apple products
review:
So far I like everything about these headphones -- they are exceptionally comfortable, they seem to be well-made, the sound is fantastic (particularly the bass), and the ingenious closed-back design shuts out background noise. The headphones come with a two-year warranty. They fold compactly and come with a drawstring bag. Volume and other controls are located on the cord -- you can control volume and control the phone with the cord controls. Amazing.

These are great headphones for any purpose -- but they have added functionality with Apple products. These are compatible with iPhones 6plus, 6, 5s, 5c, 5, 4s, 4, and 3GS; iPad Air and Air2, iPad mini3, mini2, mini, touch, classic, nano (4th generation or later) and shuffle (3rd generation or later).

Other reviewers complain that it is hard to tell left from right. I experienced that problem as well -- but my husband had no trouble spotting the L on the left side. The cord goes on the right. Once you figure that out, the problem is solved, so it's a pretty minor complaint in my book. If you don't need bluetooth capability, give these a try. They're wonderful!

title: Wonderful blingy headphones
review: These little headphones work wonderfully, provide top-rate sound quality, come with their own handy carrying case, and have just the right amount of bling.  The range of sound is great and they fit comfortably.  I particularly like the little white leatherette carrying case -- I usually keep these in my purse & use them to listen to music on my phone.  The case keeps them from getting tangled up with all the dangerous stuff floating around in my purse.

title: very nice earphones
review: These are very nice earphones with a unique flat cord that resists tangling and is easy to deal with.  The sound was clear and the bass was a little more pronounced than in my $10 Sony earphones.  I'm not sure I'm enough of an audiophile to know whether these are worth the price, but they are a nice, substantial, comfortable earphone that produces clear sound.

title: comfortable, functional headphones
review: These are definitely a step up from the little earphones that come with iPods and such, and they deliver fine sound.  They're didn't stay in well enough to use while working out, though, and they don't do anything to block out other sounds.  Overall, these are a perfectly adequate earphones for everyday use.

title: Excellent tip for kz iem
review: I am so glad to find the extra large tips for My earbuds. Before without the large enough tip to seal my ear channel my iem always sounds animic without proper base punch. With these extra large tips my kz ast iem sounds like it should. Yes, without a good tip even the best iem will sound like a toy. Thanks for making the extra large tips available. Highly recommended.

title: Great iem with excellent quality
review:
I am a kz earphones longtime customer with several earbuds including the kz ast
20. I believe this new improved iem is the great earphones. I like especially the clear treble and midrange in this new phones. I am looking forward to future kz family of earphones. Highly recommended!

title: Excellent earbuds
review: I have to agree with the review s of many users. The earbud is excellent as the sound quality goes. The construction of the earbud is solid. Compares favorablely with the hifiman deva I have that caused more the ten times more, albeit the hifiman is the big over the ear kind. For the price,you will be well served.

title: Large enough to really function as the earbud tips should be
review: Finally there are large enough earbud tips that seal the sound of my IEM and give me full range of sound from treble down to bass. The music s are so good and loud that I have to turn the volume down. The tips are made of soft rubber and stay in my ear comfortablely.. Highly recommended.

title: An excellent buy
review:
This little gadget is very versatile and you can input through micro USB port on the dac\amp and charging is through another micro USB port. So you can listen to music and charge the battery at the same time. The front has a port you can input with a 3.5 mm male line. There is hardly anyone will furnish a 3.5 mm input anymore. So it is valuable if your player has a 3.5 mm jack. This amp really opens up the sound stage of my headphone ( a hifiman deva) I think this is the most valuable feature for me. I don't use the bass booster at all,if you like the heavy bass there is a switch for it also. The amplification is adequate. I only turn the volume at 11 o'clock or 12 o'clock that is loud enough for me. So there is plenty volume to blast your ear off if you like. The quality of the music comes off the amp is very true there is no emphasis through the whole diapason of frequency.
The gadget gets quite warm after a few minutes of using and since there is no vacuum tube in the amp so the heat will not generate any white noise . This is one of the benefits of the digital age. For 160 dollars this is an excellent buy if you don't want to spend 1000+ for an amp. I bought the amp\fav full price and receive no incentive to write the review. It is my honest opinion.

title: Nice little gadget
review: The headphone DAC is very small with a mirror on the top surface the whole dac is made of metal very minimal looking. But don't let its small size fool you.  It really makes your head phone come to life. I have a Hifiman dev phone it really sounds much better with this DAC. Some review mentioned the volume bu ttons have small increment and you have to push many times to adjust the volume. The fact is these buttons are continuous , you just need to push and hold it for adjusting the volume.

title: A must if you listen to music from a cellular phone.
review:
The Ceridian enhancer was promptly delivered in two days of ordering.The package is in a white cardboard box nicely packaged. Now, the important business, the enhancer does make a difference in the clarity of the music and at the same time increases volume too. If it is not an amplifier, it definitely increased the volume of my Hickman deva headphone. The enhancer affects the music at all levels the base the mid and high all are enhanced without bias.
Since the music becomes more clear it feels the music become closer. Now the better headphones give you an open soundstage that is different from the cheaper one which sounds like the music is playing in you brain instead in a open space. What i am saying is that using this enhancer does make my music cleaner but I seems to lose that open space that is characteristic of the planar magnetic phones. It is all comes down to what you want from the gadget. The enhancer does make volume higher and music cleaner and you can hear all the sounds and these are already built in in the more expensive phones. For my headphone it just makes it louder cleaner without much added advantages. If your phone sound muddy and thin, this enhancer will make a great difference. I am sure if you listen music from a cellular phone you do need this enhancer.

title: Good experience
review: The headphone came in two days after ordering as Amazon prime free of charge. The package was packed securely. This is my first planar magnet phone i have. Right off the box it sounds impressive and I am sure it will sound better after breaking in. It already sounds better than my m50 that is more than 5 years old. I enjoy the deva's clear sound especially the mid range. My m50 sounds ok inboth lower and higher ranges but the middle range is not as clean as the deva. The dava also sounds more open like the music has been played in a room rather inside my head. I have been initiated to the planar magnate that is a good baptizing for me. Yes, I believe the planar magnetic phone does make sense.

title: it came in in a small box very nicely made and inside was the earphone and a cloth ...
review:
The earphone came in on time in two days. it came in in a small box very nicely made and inside was the earphone and a cloth bag with 3 pair of rubber covers of different sizes.
I let the earphone burn for about 3 hours to condition it. Then i try it on and find the sound quality is a little warmer than i like and the bass has been enhanced. I personally like the sound of speaker that is not enhanced in any quarter of the range. Since the bass has been enhanced, it sound a little booming to me and that is why for the 4stars instead of 5. Several people complained that the earphone transmitting the rubbing sound to the ears whenever the wire is rubbing on some surfaces. It is because the size of the rubber covers on the earphone are too large for the ears. Change the covers to a smaller size will greatly extenuate the problem. When you use a pairs of covers too big for the ears you will even hear your own blood flowing through the ear and each time you swallow your saliva it will bloom in your ears too.That is not the way to hear music through ear-buds.

title: Works, expensive
review: At first these made my ATH-CKR10 sound awful, tinny, as if listening to an old radio with no bass; not sure if the flanges softened with a little use but they sound much better now: give them a little time. My particular need was for something to make these headphones more comfortable, as they touch my ears with the supplied tips. They now sound with a little more treble and a little less bass. They should include at least an extra pair to make them a more acceptable value.

title: Nice
review: I'm using this to carry a Blackberry Passport (way wider than most phones), its headphone set, sunglasses in a pouch, and there would be room for a pen and a small notebook; the idea is not to carry my phone in my pants pockets, and use the headset to avoid putting the phone against my face when making calls. It's nicely padded and looks good, remember to get the shoulder strap.

title: Nice!
review:
I am working on replacing an Onkyo receiver with integrated dac (which I'm giving away) with a more portable dac and later a speaker amp. The first part of the equation has worked out, the explorer sounds great and lets me listen with headphones (Meze 99), bypassing my Macbook pro's sound card. For some reason the explorer works fine from my left USB port, but randomly disconnects on the right USB port, which I'm guessing doesn't get enough juice - bad Apple, bad. At $150 the explorer is a bit of a no brainer, at least at this time; version 2 might be even nicer and isn't much more expensive but I wanted to keep the overall dac + amp costs below $300-ish.

Update: still awesome. Got a USB 3 / ethernet hub, the meridian works well with it. Now connected to an 80's NAD receiver and used Q Acoustics 2020i: great sound for little money.

title: Works for Sony Walkman NWZ-A844
review: Found a Walkman I'd always wanted for cheap, took the plunge... But since it isn't an iPod (aka the Windows PC of music) there aren't that many alternatives for cases. This worked out fine, there's a second pouch at the back for headphones. It comes with a carabiner that says "Not for climbing" LOL...

title: Great
review:
Not a technical review, all I know in audio is what sounds good to me...

I'd been listening to ripped music on a Sony NWZ-A818 with its supplied, and quite good, earphones, trying to escape the horrors of mushy iPodland, but I'd been longing for the next step. After reading many reviews I zeroed in on this... And all I can say is listening to music with these on brings a huge satisfaction grin. The clarity is great, I can listen to new instruments, or listen to them much more clearly, there's better space between instruments... It sounds like it's the way the music was intended to be heard in the first place...

My ears ache after a while but I'm just not used to headphones, and the tip someone wrote here about putting them around a Kleenex box works...

Like music? Get these!

title: Exceptional audio quality and comfort
review:
These are the most comfortable headphones I've used in a long time. I've been wearing them 5+ hours every day in the office and they are like pillows for my ears. Comfort is what I look for first in headphones and these are by far the best.

Audio quality is amazing - there are hundreds of reviews that praise the audio in layman terms as well as audiophile techno babble - point is, they are outstanding.

I bought these during the black Friday sale for ~$90. I would say anything over ~120 is too much but at 90 there is nothing that comes close (again, in my opinion).

title: too bad they're so hard to find these days
review: Hubby loves these headphones, too bad they're so hard to find these days!  We use them all over the house, they have two  different "channels" you can listen on;  at the same time, I listen to my computer stuff, he listens to his TV stuff. Each of us could listen in to the other's channel if we wanted by switching from 1 to 2 on the little switch on the side of the headphones.  Their range is 150 feet, excellent.  Audio frequency range is excellent, 20 Hz through 20,000 KHz.  No interference from neighbors as they are on two different frequencies.  Range is wide enough that hubby can sit outside on the back porch and listen to the sound from the TV in the living room.  They're battery operated with AA batteries.  Overall this is an excellent purchase.

title: ... the first pair that fits my ears snuggly and comfortably and the magnetic closure is convenient
review: These headphones are great--this is the first pair that fits my ears snuggly and comfortably and the magnetic closure is convenient. Last about 6 hours on a single charge.

title: Super easy to assemble.
review: The stand arrives in three pieces.  The base, which is a flexible rubber, the stem, which is metal (aluminium) and the resting post which is a stiffer type of rubber.  The base slips onto the metal and the resting post snaps onto the top of the metal post.  Assembled in less than 1 minute.  The entire footprint of the stand takes up less space than if you were to simply lay the headphones on their side.  Attractive, well-made, practical.

title: Don't like what you hear?  Don't blame the headphones!
review: These are Monitor headphones.  What this means is they will reproduce exactly what is fed to them.  Poorly compressed mp3s, lousy sound card.... You name it...if it's got flaws, you'll hear it through these headphones.  For those who love perfect flat response, these are the headphones for you.  As for durability and build quality, it's too soon to determine how durable they'll be but the build quality seems very good.  For my large skull, I find them very comfortable.

title: The best cheap earbuds
review:
These are probably the best cheap earbuds on the market. They sound fairly good, they don't fall out of my ears, and they are comfortable. I've used earbuds that cost a lot more but fail at those criteria.

The cords seem a bit fragile, but that's really all I can complain about.

title: Worked as expected
review: As with most earphones in this price range,  broke within a few months. However, the 4 dollar ones I bought the same day managed to last longer...

title: Broke After 2 Weeks
review:
No joke, it broke after 2 weeks of wearing it casually.
The buds themselves came apart at the seam- I tried to superglue them back together(really!), but I'm no engineer/craftsman, nor someone with good enough eye-hand coordination to super glue two tiny pieces of plastic together!
This was a shame really, I had really taken a chance buying these.
Oh, I know, they aren't the most expensive, but as someone who's mainly lived off nabbing their sibling's earbuds, I was feeling pretty brave buying them.
And y'know those generic Samsung earbuds? White and inconspicuous as they are- they've lasted me months! I just really wanted some higher quality sound...
Won't be buying again- and will forever be wary of buying earbuds.

title: Great sound and awful connection!
review: I am a simple man, one who likes simple products regardless of manufacturer. I only have one rule- they have to work. These do that only halfway. You see, in regards to audio, they sound fine, actually they sound great. This is coming from a man who used Xio Mi Redmi earbuds and crappy but serviceable Lenovo wireless earbuds. These sound comparable if not a bit better. The issue is the Bluetooth, and boy is is bad. Just the smallest movement of my phone causes all sorts of audio breakup, especially when the phone is in my pocket (being a TMobile Revvl 5G). I think I'll just use these for home from now on, because I cannot commute with these without it sounding like The Strokes are having an actual stroke.

title: Definitely a Win-Win!!
review:
I am very pleased with these earphones! The sound is lovely, rich and full, and they fit very nicely. There are three sizes pf earbuds, and the ones which were already attached fit perfectly,. and while I cannot imagine an earbud getting lost for some reason, I could use one of the other sizes if need be. The small, but sturdy hardsided clamshell case is a huge plus! The earphones stay in one side, and my iPhone cable and the other earbuds stay in the other, safely held in place by netting. Although small, the case holds the cables and earbuds quite easily, and fits into my purse.

Now when we are on a long drive, my husband can listen to his music, and while I can listen to an audiobook or music, I can also easily use the remote control to pause for conversation. It's definitely a win-win and a great value!

title: Excellent value, fits perfectly, sounds great!
review: I enjoy knitting, a lot, and I also enjoy chatting with friends and family on the 'phone.  Before I got this headset, I could do one or the other, but not both.  That has changed now, thanks to this great little headset.  The piece that fits over my ear is padded and comfortable, while the band that goes over my head is adjustable.  I keep it plugged into the telephone at all times, so that I can just put the headset on when I need to be on the telephone.  It works very well, and the price was also quite affordable.  I have no complaints whatsoever.

title: NOT GOOD!!
review: Bad quality. One headphone works better than the other. Nothing compares to the original.

title: Both seemed broken right away
review: The sound was muted from one ear amd crackly in the other, I tried 3 different headphones as well as a set right in the 1/4 port of the reciever.

title: Great sound quality
review:
These are not studio grade headphones. They have a bass-biased tuning.

That being said, they produce excellent sound quality. Bass-bias can be countered using an equalizer if your music app or hardware setup comes so equipped. The sound is full, crisp, and rich. Build quality seems decent, though time will tell how they hold up to regular use. All in all, I'd say these headphones represent a superb value, certainly better than most other headphones you can find in this price range.

title: Enduring Quality
review: I was thrilled to find that Phillips is still making these great headphones. My original pair finally died after 10+ years of great service, and these are virtually identical to my old ones, for a great price. Good sound, comfort, and affordability.

title: It does what I needed it to do  =)
review: Does exactly what I need it to do. Im happy with my purchase... I have a TOSlink in/out it passes audio through all the time so I can use my stereo like normal or power on my bluetooth headset so my partner can sleep while I watch tv. The recorded voice prompts on the device is a nice finishing touch.

title: Fantastic!
review:
These headphones sound incredible! The sound is so warm and bright and full compared to every pair of headphones I've ever used! (the tendency for most headphones seems to be to go super bass heavy and call it good sounding.)

These have solid sound through the whole range, but comparatively don't have overdriven bass (they can handle it, but it's not disproportionately loud).

title: The perfect exercise monitor
review:
I have used quite a few heart rate monitors - mostly Polar and Garmin. Hate the chest straps. And my phone is always with me. So my main goal out of the Scosche was comfort with sufficient accuracy and flexibility.

It is all that. It reports within two beats or so of what another monitor does. I'm not sure which is more accurate but it really doesn't matter; they're both close enough. It's easy to put on, although I did need the larger armband due to muscular forearms, and easy to control.

Some reviews mention it being hard to turn on and off. Mine is really easy. Press down for perhaps five seconds until the LEDs change pattern; that's it.

It doesn't come with software, which is fine. I'm using the Adidas miCoach, which recognizes the Scosche, can use the phone's GPS, plays music from my collection (including shuffling playlists), can tell you verbally over the headphones your current burn, pace, heartrate and time, and syncs to their website. That software is free (you can pay for additional workout varieties; I haven't done that yet), and together the sensor and program are a great combination.

title: So good I bought a second set!
review:
My Android phone (Droid 4) doesn't work with iPhone-button headsets. The mic and buds work, but the button doesn't. So I was looking for a lightweight over-the-ear headset with mic and button. This appeared to fit the bill.

The sound quality is much better than I expected. It's not up to a pair of dedicated $80 headphones, but much better than from buds, and lots of volume. (Usually a problem on phones.) The microphone is good... the other end hears me perfectly.

To use the button, you install the Philips app from the Google Play store and program it. It defaults to firing off your media player (and only can talk to one at a time), but you can change that. The button is programmed (including by one/two/three button presses) in the app. The app may not be necessary with all programs though.

My only nits are that the headset pushes against glass ear pieces a bit hard, and the headset program doesn't notice a difference between the Philips headset and headsets without a button. That doesn't do any harm, but it is weird.

title: Almost perfect, but unusable
review:
This is nearly a great headset. It's small, the signal and sound are good, and the boom-switch is great. But the fit is extremely finicky, and when you find which one of the ear-loops work for you, since they don't stay on the headset well, you will promptly lose it.

And then Motorola Support's voice system will not hear you, you can't reach a live person after even 10 minutes on hold, and their phones appear to shut down entirely at 5pm.

Avoid it. Other headsets hold onto the ear loop better or at least let you get replacements.

title: Good headphones for the price
review:
Good headphones for the price. You would have to spend a lot more money to get better ones.
They are a little tight but seem to loosen up with use. That's a lot better than ones that slide around on your head.
Sound quality is very good.

title: Five Stars
review: Earphones work wonderfully, they arrived early and in perfect condition (new and in a sealed box).

title: Perfect on a Kindle Fire
review:
I purchased these specifically to use on my Kindle Fire, whose built in speakers I find to be too low in volume. I don't like to use headphones, so I was looking for active speakers, something small, if possible. The price is ultimately what caught my attention.

I was pleasantly surprised. I was expecting them to be tinny and lacking bass, but found quite the opposite. Very good quality for the price, and have no regrets over this purchase.

When done using them, they store very nicely in the provided carrying case. If you use them on a Kindle Fire like me, you'll need to use the battery pack, which requires 4 AAA batteries. Make sure you turn off the power switch when finished with your session.

title: I Was Hoping for More
review: I have new neighbors upstairs and was hoping to quietly watch TV and cancel the sounds from their apartment.  It hasn’t worked that well.  The headphone is not really comfortable and the volume doesn’t seem to be consistent.  I’ve kept them and they’re adequate, just not great.  I’ve had a couple of ZVOX TV speakers and have been totally happy with them, but this doesn’t seem to be the same quality.

title: One word: waterproof
review: I know it says water resistant in the title, but I dropped one in the shower, had to get soap out of my eyes before I could find it, right at the drain where most of the water was pooled, zero negative affect on it. Still works great, sounds great, continued to work in the shower after picking it up, they are not joking about how water resistant these earbuds are.

title: Daughter loves it
review: Daughter loves this headphones due to the beautiful unicorn, the sound quality is great for a young girl

title: Will fit small toddler head
review: Finally a pair of headphones that fit my 2 1/2 year old! I love that she can’t fiddle with the volume setting. I listened to the sound quality and it’s just fine for her.

title: Perfect for my ears
review: I have such a hard time finding headphones anymore, since typical (and wildly popular) earbuds just don't fit my ears well. I still like this style the best, and I've used these for computer work to listening to music while walking or jogging. I'm careful with them, of course, but so far they've held up well. And who can resist the color?!

title: Quality earbuds
review: Quality sounding earbuds in my opinion with very good price. I think big brands are very overrated and charge enormous amount of money. I'd prefer these over them any day

title: Pretty good for the price
review: They're pretty comfortable and sound pretty decent. Really satisfied with it because of the price. Quality earbuds are way too expensive now but this one matches them pretty closely.

title: Great Headphones!!
review: Great pair of 'phones you just need a good headphone pre-amp/DAC and these things sound great.  They're not for bass-heads as is mentioned in other more detailed reviews.  I won't elaborate to much in this review other than you have to use good, high quality power--your sound card in your laptop or phone simply will not do justice.  The color, fit & finish are outstanding and the 2 cords are nice..Very high quality and couldn't be more pleased.

title: Good sound but not comfortable to use
review: Sound quality is good. But it is very annoying that rubber piece comes out every time you take the earbud out of your ear. I will probably lose it in a short while..

title: Should be worth
review:
They’re what I was looking for. Here’s a list of pros in cons so you can decide if they’re what you’re looking for.

Pros:
-sound quality is like apple EarPods
-magnet on ear buds so you can wear them around your neck when not in use
-great durability (I’ve had them for 3-4 months and so far they’re almost like new still)
-they come with a clip (for keeping stray earbud intact when you decide to only wear one)
-they come with a cute black triangle case with a keychain and a button on it. I keep them on my bag.
-comes with optional rubber and fabric covers for the earbuds to make them comfortable and/or fit better
-adjustable cord size
-micro USB charger
-the colors are just like th picture
-can control music and calls with the remote on headphones
-quick charge
-once you sync it the connection to phone after turn on is immediate
-Great packaging

Cons:
-sort of short battery life of 2hrs
-the adjustable piece on the cord broke after 2 months and is therefore no longer adjustable (headphones are still wearable tho)
-not a very far range. Phone needs to be either in the room your in or in a room very close by

All cons are very much minimal IMO and overall i think these are definitely worth your money!

title: Adorable but cuts in and out...
review:
Disconnects often. I have a brand new Audiovox 6700, so the issue could easily be with it, but I am unable to pair them for longer than an hour w/o the bluetooth connection dropping.

I can't tell you how many times I've thought it was connected, answered the phone, only to find the headset/phone connection had broken and the person on my phone couldn't hear me and I couldn't hear them.

Frustrating. I'm taking it back to see if it's the phone or the headset.

title: Works Great!
review: Our car does not have a bluetooth feature, and the phone has no audio cord hole.  When we are on the road we like to listen to some of our apps.  This little device plugs into the phone's charging outlet, then I can plug an audio cord into the device and into the car's speakers.  Also, I can plug my headphones into the device and listen to apps on my phone at night and not disturb anyone.  I am uncomfortabe with things inside my ears, so I use small headphones.

title: Very Happy Customer
review: Really, really love these.  I did have the previous model, but I gave them to my son because his earphones (another brand) died.  The problem stated about the older model was that the cord was too short.  Well, Sony has corrected that problem with this newer model, and they have a longer cord which works perfectly.  There are no English instructions that come with these, but really you don't need them.  The sound is good, especially for this kind of product.  They fit comfortably over my ears.  The springs reel back the cords quickly and well.  I had used my old ones for two years and liked them, so that's what encouraged me to repeat the process with these and I haven't been disappointed.

title: BUYING SECOND PAIR
review: I have used these headphones for two years and have never had a problem with them.  The sound is very good for this type of product, and I really like retractable wires.  They are great to use in my Roku remote control at night so that I don't disturb my husband, also good for audio books and music.  My son recently borrowed these and now I don't think I'll get them back. :(  He likes them, too!  I have just ordered another pair of these headphones -- only in white -- for myself.  My son had the Koss headphones but the wire broke which can be an issue for those even though the sound is good in them, too.  The price of the Sony headphones have gone up quite a bit in price since the last time I purchased them, but then what hasn't?

title: A Very Happy Purchase
review: I could not be happier with this little speaker box!  I travel a lot and use an MP3 play with my favorite music on it.  Because I really HATE wearing earbuds and headsets I purchased this speaker to travel with me.  It has really good sound for its size.  I also like to use it to enhance the sould coming out of my laptop -- even though my laptop was supposed to come with all this super duper sound system its really not all that great.  I just hook up this box and the sound is sooo  much better.  For its size and price I do recommend it.  Of course, I don't know how it compares with other little speakers out there, all I know is that I am very happy with this purchase and this speaker travels with me, my laptop and my mp3 player.

title: Happy Campers!
review: I bought these as a gift for my son after his similar Panasonic headphones died and we could not find any replacements locally.  He was in another room when he tried these from Koss and I heard echoing down the hall, "Wow, Mom, these are great!  Come and hear these!"  He was right.  The Panasonic headphones were good, but my son and I really think that these Koss headphones are better.  He LOVES these, and I'm a hero!  He doesn't like to stick things in his ears, and he didn't want the bigger headsets that are in the stores.  The other Panasonic headphones that are similar to what my son had before  that Amazon sells takes about six weeks to get here, but these Koss ones got here in my "Prime" shipping time of two days.  My son has had them for over a month now and tells me that he uses them for several hours a day and has had no problems with them.  As of this writing I can highly recommend these headphones.

title: Great buy for the price
review: I had a bit of trouble pairing them but decided to read the instructions and then they paired quickly and easily.  Always read the instructions!  They sound great to me - I'm no expert but the music sounds good and they work seamlessly so I'm very pleased.  I would tell anyone to take a chance on them.  They aren't $500 earbuds but they do what I want them to do!  I'd buy them again.

title: It works, but it's imperfect
review: I bought the AirFly Pro so I could use my Bang & Olufsen earbuds with the in-flight entertainment console and my Nintendo Switch. Confusing to set up, but worked well enough on the flight. There is unfortunately a slight lag that I eventually stopped paying attention to - if I'd been watching a movie it probably would have driven me crazy. Okay product, but I'm going to keep searching for something that doesn't have an audio delay.

title: Great earbuds, but some old B&O features are missed
review: I flew across the country on a flight with three screaming children. I popped these in, turned on the ANC, and had a lovely five and a half hour flight with battery to spare. My only gripe is the lack of touch controls from previous B&O earbuds. Being able to switch between tracks with a few taps was a treat - hopefully those controls are able to be added in a future update, because they're sorely missed and the reason I'm giving four stars instead of five. Otherwise, beautiful earbuds, design- and sound-wise. I also recently switched to the Comply Isolation Plus Tx-200 tips because I needed a small size anyway, and B&O earbuds always come with medium Comply Sport tips. Well worth the extra $20.

title: Cute cat ears design.
review: Got these headphones for my granddaughter. She loves anything pink. They can be used wirelessly and also come with a wire when the wireless charge is exhausted. They also light up, have good sound, filter out noise, fit comfortably & securely. Overall a good inexpensive headphone. I would recommend these cute cat ear headphones.

title: Perfect earbuds
review: I bought these earbuds for my wife and she loves then.  They fit her smaller ear canal perfectly.  We went to Staples and they had nothing too compare even the $100 plus buds.  In addition they come with various sized buds too ensure a proper fit. I would highly recommend them.

title: I want to love these but... volume controls don't work
review:
For the price I guess I can't be too surprised. Other than not being able to control the sound on the headphones, I would be totally happy. The volume control doesn't work.
Unfortunately I need these, as is due to an immediate need.
I'm able to control volume via my phone volume so... they'll do.
I'll revise if anything else is off or nonfunctional.
I'm hoping the charge lasts for as long as described, I've yet to go more than 2 - 3 hours of use. And I recharged after each time.
Will update with more info in a few weeks.
Like I said, I want to love them... I just wished they loved me back; and everything worked as should.

title: Great sound quality.
review: This is my first time using wireless earbuds. The system comes with several sizes of covers & I was happy to find a pair that worked for me. The sound quality is so clear. Great for listening to music & podcasts or to talk on my cell. They cancel out my neighbors noise. I would definitely buy them again. The price is very affordable.

title: love all but one thing about them.
review:
I personally bought a pair of these from bestbuy but i would like to put a review here as well.

When i got them I was extremely happy, I personally have a problem with dandruff so i have a lot of it accumulate in the cups of the ear, so i go to pull the foam ear pads off to clean it every now and then.

It has a EXTREMELY weak connection to the actual piece of plastic that holds it onto the headphones and i have had the ear padding break off of the plastic ring.

I recommend extreme caution when trying to remove them, Ive personally had to superglue mine back onto the plastic piece.

title: Five Stars
review: love the clarity of the headphones, and they are comfortable, block out environmental sounds.

title: Headphones color
review: This came with bright purple headphone - like a small child would use - and not the black as listed. Returned and reorder but got the same!

title: Must cut away old pads with razor kniofe, then, superglue the new pads into place
review:
Pads are the correct size, but there are no 'rims' on the headphones for the new pads to slip onto. Had to slice off the old pads with a razor knife blade. Used one spot of superglue to start the top of the new pad in place, then, the opposite end; followed by two side spots of glue, @ pad.
Works well; I had just expected an easy Off/On replacement process. Should have ckd the old pads, first. Though, I'd still have ended up in the same place. :-)

title: Great value
review: These headphones have great sound for the price.  My husband uses them with our desktop computer to watch YouTube and complete trainings for work.  He love them.

title: Earbuds
review: I love, love, love these earbuds. For the price they are amazing! The sound is great, they are comfortable to wear. So far so good!

title: Great for gaming but range can be limited
review:
I purchased this from a "brick and mortar" buy best because I needed a new headset immediately for gaming / raid.
This headset is great. The software is a bit clunky but once you're set up you can forget about it.
The only thing I struggled with at first was the range. Beyond 10 feet LOS sound and mic dropped out and connection dropped. I fixed that with a USB extender and put the transceiver to the top of my middle monitor. This increased the range from 10 feet to 30 feet through walls and with diminishing quality to mono sound before cutting out. Now I can walk around my house still chat.
Your results may vary.

title: Good range - Not durable at all
review:
Worked as expected with very good range.

However, it's not very durable at all. Dropped from head level sitting at the desk and it broke on the desktop(approx 14-18 inches) at the point where headset connects to over the head band..

title: Protects from bumps and improves grip
review:
I do recommend this product.

This protective cover is a good fit and seems to be good quality. Price point is spot on. Cover doesn't get in the way of power, USB or headset jacks. Provides a good feel and improved grip.

Awesome for propping it up on a table or couch pillow because it prevents it from sliding.

-1 Star because it hangs easily when being removed from backpack or case. It snaps back into shape but if you don't have a good grip you might let go.

Note: Do not get this with the Recommended "Gizmo Dorks Hard Shell EVA Case for the Acer Iconia Tab A500" with the impression you can easily use them together. The Acer doesn't fit well even with the Fosmon Skin removed.

title: Love these!
review: Makes my iPod and iPhone earbuds stay in my ears without being bulky or uncomfortable. They seem sturdy. Not too hard and not too rubbery. Highly recommended.

title: Very good overall
review:
I use this Walkman for listening to audiobooks during walks. This unit paired easily with Tozo Bluetooth earbuds.

The sound is excellent!

A few minor negatives: 1. The user interface is less intuitive than that of my previous four non-Bluetooth Sony Walkman players. 2. If I forget to blank the screen before putting the unit in a pocket, the touchscreen may interpret contact of other objects as intended actions. Once, the playback only paused. However on another day, the unit exited the audiobook that was playing, and started playing a different book. It took a long time to find my place and restart the first book. 3. The playback time on a full charge is less than one-fifth the stated 45 hours. Using Bluetooth must place additional demands on the battery.

title: Worked well in China.  Somewhat noisy.
review:
The BESTEK Portable Travel Voltage Converter worked well for me on a recent trip to China. At one point, I had an iPhone, a Kindle, and a set of headphones plugged into USB outlets while another cellphone and a laptop computer were charging through the 110 V outlets. The unit handled this load with no problem. I would have given this item a five-star rating if the cooling fan had been quieter; mine makes a light buzzing sound. The pitch of this buzzing sound does not change with the electrical load.

Not knowing which plug I might need, I had left the unit packed in the box in which it arrived. After unpacking and packing it back through three hotels in China and Hong Kong, I decided to keep using the box as a handy and compact way to keep all the parts (converter box, cord, and three plugs) together in my carry on bag.

After reading several of the one-star reviews, it seemed that someone needed to write that this item is NOT designed to handle the electrical demands of most small appliances that have heating elements (like hair dryers, curling irons, hair straighteners, etc.). If your appliance draws more than 200 watts of power, this product will not work for you.

title: Good case for the Product
review: Very lightweight, efficient and useful carry case for the body of the personal microphone system. Does jot fit the headset. I find it useful as I transport my mic to and from many locations.

title: Works great.
review: Plug it in Windows configures it and good to go.  No fuss.  I am now able to connect some bluetooth peripherals like headset and controller to my desktop.

title: Comfortable to sleep in.
review:
I was very pleased with the fabric on this unit. I have tried others and the headband always felt slightly too tight and the constriction would always get uncomfortable after awhile. This is tight enough to not slip off my head, but the fabric has enough gentle stretch to not get uncomfortable.
I was not expecting exceptional sound quality, just decent sound in a small enough profile that I could comfortably sleep with my head on a pillow. This does just that. The individual speakers are small pucks about 2 inches in diameter. They say they have noise cancelling in these, but I am not sure how you accomplish that with something that does not completely cover your ears like headphones or in the ears. These rest lightly against the side of the ears depending on how you have them arranged. So it was my experience that it did not do much canceling of ambient noise.
Overall good purchase and I will continue to use them.

title: Quality sound
review: This is a great headset if that is what you are looking for. I also bought a pair of KZ ZS-10 IEMs at the same time. They were 1/3 the price and sound 3x as good. Returned the AT headset and kept the KZs.

title: Works Great
review: We bought these to extend our kids headphones for use with their portable DVD players in our van. They worked great and they were very reasonably priced.

title: A Must For Hands Free!
review: Great headset for my phone.  I need hands free since I'm on the phone for hrs at a time.

title: Decent Cans!
review: Would give 4.5 but it's my first day owning them. These headphones sound great, the bass is there and the highs are there. But, they really shine with the mids, which is a decent leveling, although you can up the bass on your device, that really brought the sound quality up. I'd recommend wearing these at home, they aren't built as well as I had hoped and they feel a bit flimsy, but despite this, they fit well and sound great.

title: Finally, Easy Wireless setup & charging
review: I bought the White wireless ears buds to match my iPhone 11 Pro Max. I was stunned at how quick and easy it was to set up. I pulled the wireless buds out of the box. Now, I did read up on the TOZO T10 Bluetooth 5.0 Wireless Earbuds with Wireless Charging Case before I bought it. I wanted to make sure, as a senior citizen, using it would be simple.  Working the earbuds is a mere touch on the right earbud (instructions are included). I still have to memorize the number of taps, etc., but since I'm older, I'm allowed. My iPhone connected and off we went. I love being wireless. I also bought a Tozo charger that works with my iPhone and the Tozo earbuds.

title: Small, Snug Earbuds with Loads of Sound
review:
What I like most about the Realm Apple MFi Certified Headphones with the Lightning Connector has to be a snug fit and sound quality. I like to close off from the world when I listen to an audiobook or music. I can get so much work done that way. The Realm of Apple MFi is the perfect fit for my iPhone. I've learned the hard that it's important to have a spare set of earbuds, and this set is just what I needed.

Perfect for both young and old.

title: Blocks some outside noise; Impressive sound
review: I am really impressed with the Midola Bluetooth earphones. I noticed most sounds are blocked out, but not all. The volume can get pretty loud at times, so I do not recommend this set for kids. I use this headset for audiobooks because I can listen as I do other things. The earphones are comfortable to wear, and as I said, blocks most sounds. I can sit in the living room, listen to my audiobook, and browse through a magazine while my husband watches TV. The Midola earphones are one of my favorite go-to headsets now.

title: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
review: I use the Dragon USB headset with my Dragon NaturallySpeaking software. I use it to write my reviews. Sometimes, my hands need a break and this is the perfect solution. I was using a different headset. Its a bit larger and moves around my head; sometimes it slides flops forward and I lose my concentration. I haven't had that problem with the Dragon USB headset. The noise-canceling microphone picks up everything, so I have to turn down the music while I'm working.  I am so happy with my new headset.

title: NICE FIT; GREAT SOUND. GREATLY IMPRESSED.
review: I was going to pass the JVC HAECX20B Sports Clip Inner Ear Headphones (earbuds) to my husband. I do not like earbuds hooked onto my ears. Well, it's a good thing he turned me down or I would’ve missed this great product. I LOVE these earbuds. The ear clips are soft rubber NOT plastic. There is no pulling or tugging on my ear. I eventually forgot about them. The JVC headphones make the world go away. I’m not kidding. I chose the best earpieces for me (replacements included), turned up my audiobook and got to work. The next thing I knew my work was done.  I’ve listened to music with them as well.

title: STAYS PUT; WEARS WELL; SOUND GREAT
review: Kingyou Products never disappoint. The running headphones work just as well as the last pair of earbuds I own by this company. They fit snug and stay put. The sound is great as well.

title: Nice
review: A very nice case!  Doesnt cover any of the plug ins like the one I got before.  I can plug my earphones in as well as charge it.  I got the pink and love it.  Its got places to put in cards or whatever you like and it snaps shut.  I WOULD like there to be a coin pouch but we cant have everything right?  I would like for it to have a more sturdier snap to close it but its not bad or anything.  I recommend.

title: After about a year, not so good...
review: After about a year, first one, then the other earbud came apart.  Seems the wood part doesn't adhere to the metal part all that well.  I glued the first one back together, but when the second earbud came apart, one of the wires broke as well.  Now, they're gong in the trash, and I'll try another brand.

title: I love bass, but this not it
review: Ok headphone, not enough bass as it states "extra bass". Not that comfortable for my ears, but louder then my old/discontinued sony headphone.

title: too big and uncomfortable
review: This was an awesome headset, but way too big for my small head. I gave it to my husband because he misplaced his.

title: Great headphones.
review: This is the third time I have purchased these headphones. They are tight on my ear and stay put.

title: Just okay.
review: For the price, they are great bluetooth headphones-- however, the ear pieces themselves are bulky on my ears and I am constantly adjusting them to stay put and they fall out easily.

title: pretty good
review:
I'll give it a 4 out of 5. for the price, it's hard to find anything better.
pros: more clarity than I expected. usually headphones I buy tend to be boomy and muffled. bass is actually pretty good and not boomy. doesn't interfere too much with the mids or highs, and it hits pretty hard when needed. not shrilly either, sounds relatively flat and not V shaped.
Not very clinically detailed which makes it work well with all kinds of music and songs. The voices that go through these things are also very intimate.

cons: bass doesn't go low low, but I'm comparing it to my $2500 iems. not as dynamic as high end headphones but for the price its good. bass isn't as low where you can feel it in your chest (trust me, i've had some iems that convince me i feel the bass shaking my ribcages), but it's powerful. bass is also surprisingly tight for dynamic drivers.

overall i knew what i was getting, so no complaints. i just needed something on the fly but was pleasantly surprised.

title: Great for those who want better desktop audio
review:
I've always been disappointed with desktop speaker systems...you know, the ones that come all attached together with a non-removable subwoofer. The subs were always either super weak or the speakers were horrible quality. I decided to buy my own speakers and subwoofers separately. There aren't that many desktop recievers out there. The ones that are look ugly as SH1T. I first tried the SMSL 18 whatever, it lasted a year and then the subwoofer out quit working. This thing is so much more powerful and better sounding than that weak smsl brand. I love everything about it: the small size, the power output, sound quality, lots of input options.

There are only 2 things I will complain about:
1) Why must I use the remote if I want to manipulate the bass/eq?
2) I wish there was a headphone out. My VR headset doesn't have any headphone input so I need to put on separate headphones.

Overall, the cons aren't a deal breaker, just an annoyance. Especially since it's so affordable!

This is probably the best small form desktop reciever you will find. worth it for the price!

title: Details are good, but it has issues.
review: Coming from a pair of jh16fp's, these headphones are more detailed.  The details are just supreme.  However, it manages to sound dark and be harsh at the same time.  Also the mids are slightly recessed as the female vocals sound a little distant.  These would have been perfect if they got rid of the harsh highs and bring up the mids.  But perhaps they did this on purpose so we would need to buy the higher end headphones.

title: The pinnacle of portable digital audio players
review:
Having bought many digital/mp3 players before, they all seemed the same. Some have more treble, more bass, more clarity, so I figured what does this one really have that could warrant such a reputation?

After listening to a few mp3's and flac files, I realized it: Detail.

When they say high resolution, they mean it. Even in techno, which usually have sub-par recordings, I could hear that the robotic voices are not actually robotic which was kinda hilarious. This player will reveal instruments you never knew were in your favorite tracks. The superb detailing makes old songs worth listening to again, and makes your tracks overall more lively.

Of course you'll need a really good pair of headphones to make use of the clarity and extra detailing. Skull candy, bose, turtle beach, beats aren't going to cut it. Get something from JH audio, Sennheiser, heir audio/noble audio, shure, or westone.

title: Wow!  Exceeded my expectations!
review:
Man, after falling in love with the $20, mdr ex58v, I bought a $260 sony xba 40 and fell in love with that too. I bought this out of curiosity mostly, and to have another backup. I have to say, I am pleasantly surprised at the quality of this headphone.

PROS: This is even more clear, crisp, and brighter than the xba 40. It's almost completely flat. It has enough bass to get the job done, and it isn't overshadowing. This brings the vocals forward more than the xba 40. You can hear music the way it was meant to be heard by the artists, through these headphones.

CONS: Bass heads won't like the average bass that this one offers, although the bass seems bottomless and crisp, it's not as loud as a bass oriented headphone. Sound stage is also kinda thin, it doesn't have the wow 3D effect as the sony xba 40's. Also, slightly sibilant if you turn it up very loud.

Other thoughts, this is like the perfect headphone solution for ALL types of music.

title: Worth every penny
review:
I don't know what everyone's talking about when they complain that the highs are a bit muddy or drowned out. The highs are clearer than any headphones I've ever owned period. Although those complaints are few and far in between.

This really brings music to life, I can hear more music detail than I've ever had, and the bass is crisp, clear, and very deep. The highs are also very detailed and fine tuned. I listen to rock, hip hop, classical, well basically everything, and the SOL republic doesn't disappoint. I'm excited to go to work just so I can listen to this ALL DAY.

SOL republic has gotten itself another life-long customer.

title: Average product
review: It's average headphone, compared with my friend Sony which is cheaper and better noise cancellation.

title: Comes with unattached ear piece with no way of attaching it
review: The 1 Star is because, like a lot of the other reviews say, it arrives with 1 earpiece not attached. There is absolutely no way to attach the earpiece. After fooling with it for an hour bound & realizing there is no secret to it, it will not attach, I had to take the rubber thing out of the one ear piece and work the screws that stick out to the sides in through the “now too large” hole, now I can get the ear piece to “set” in the head set but won’t stay. I have to stick it in the ear piece, hold the headphone to my head & try not to wiggle around too much while I using it. There were no other choices through amazon to be able to return the item for a different brand. The actual job that the ear phones do is actually great, I have noticed an improvement in my singing & had several others compliment me. If you can find another company that sells a good ear phone for voice training, go for it. This company definitely sends theirs with an unattached ear piece with no way to be able to attach it correctly. I read the reviews before ordering but couldn’t find them through any other companies so thought I’d take a chance & mine would be attached.

title: Oldie but goodie for my iphone 12
review: My kids love their AirPod Pros, but I still love using the earbuds. They work great and are much cheaper!

title: Great earbuds that fit nicely
review: The kids really like them and they seem to be better quality than the JBL Earbuds that only lasted a few months.  Also, the price was right and they come in some great colors.

title: Great headphones and great price!!
review: My wife and I like watch YouTube on our separate devices. I got headphones for each of us and not disturb the other. My wife was surprised at how light and comfortable they are and at sure a great price! "A happy wife is a happy life!"

title: Best Earbuds !!! Highly recommend to Motorcyclist!!!
review:
I can’t tell you how many pairs of earbuds I have purchased!! These are by far the very best ones!! The sound quality is awesome and I have loud pipes. I can still hear my music perfectly!! They fit snuggly in my ears as well!!
Highly recommend to motorcyclists!!!

title: Very Small
review: These are great headphones but if your kid has a bigger head they will be too small. These are best for very little kids or those with smaller heads. They are easy to use and fold up nicely for storage.

title: They’re good headphones but the battery dies incredibly fast and connectivity issues.
review:
I really like these headphones but they die faster than any Bluetooth headphones I’ve had before. They also connect to my Apple Watch but will disconnect and don’t work when you play sound. I have to connect them every time.
I will say that the sound quality is fantastic and they fit perfectly into my ears with comfort. The buttons, though a bit sensitive, are nice to have. They were also cheaper than AirPods so that’s a plus I guess.

title: 2nd Beats Earbuds does this to me
review: Right side earphone does not pair. After a few times of usage. This is really frustrating

title: One earbud stopped working after two months!
review: Got these a couple months back for my bike rides and they sounded great, had a great battery, and I enjoyed them very much. When the weather turned hot I started to sweat and the right earbud to slowly slop out a lot then the sound faded out and stopped working. The description say they are "active" but they simply did not hold up to exercise. It's a shame because they really did sound nice.

title: Problems with the left earpiece connecting
review: Always have problems with the left earpiece connecting. Sent it to Apple but they couldn't replicate the issue so I'm stuck with a malfunctioning set of earphones

title: Insulation disintegrates
review: I have used these earbuds a few hours each day, they have not been physically abused.  The insulation on the wires is starting to disintegrate all over the entire lengths of the wires.

title: Yes ! Amazing quality
review:
This transmitter saved my
Life, I still like playing my ps3 and I was able to go wireless on my headphones for my ps3 , no lag and fast connection. Amazing product.

title: Wow just an amazing headset!
review: I wasn’t expecting such a great lightweight headset the sound is perfect loud and balanced the Bluetooth connection is fast I owned the stealth 600 turtle beach headset and this headset is better , I like that its not heavy like the expensive headsets. It does feel cheap but it does the job!

title: and sound quality is great. Great value
review: I need colorful Bluetooth headphones to wear at work so people get the hint that I don't want to be bothered, so I got these in blue. I've looped back around to get another pair for the gym! Battery lasts, Bluetooth pairs effortlessly, and sound quality is great. Great value!

title: Good purchase
review: Work great. My only complaint is that the bass is not great, sound is a little tinny. Didn't have the money for expensive headphones so these are great for the money I spent.

title: Priced right and sound good for running / gym. Long battery life.
review: Battery lasts forever. Easy to pair. I prefer a bit more bass, but probably better not to have since it’s millimeters from your eardrum. The different sized ear buds make it simple to choose the right size for your ear canal. I’d never risk $200+ for something to fall out of my ear while running and get smashed on the treadmill. These stay in place, even while sweating. If I were using headphones at a desk or sitting at home appreciating music or tv, I’d chose a full sized headset, but that’s my preference.

title: Awesome
review: These are awesome! They are super lightweight, and they are the most comfortable earphones I have owned. I have sensitive ears and normal earbuds hurt my ears, but not these. They stay on, and I can wear them for long periods of time. The sound quality is pretty good for watching videos/movies, but probably not the best for music. I don't mess with the in-line volume too much, but it can be nice at times. The travel bag didn't last long though. It came apart at the sides pretty quickly.

title: Best headphone, Best Price, Best Quality. Highly Recommended if you are looking for one.
review: This headphone is one of my best finds and selections, and I enjoy it. So far, great experience. Per the product specification, this headset does justice and is recommended to everyone who works remotely. I found this headset bit bulky, and I will give it five stars if it is weightless—otherwise a fantastic headphone.

title: Save $$$ - Great Buy
review: KOSS- Been around for ages.  Great quality headset for my small portable Stereo Player.  Save $$$$- BUY this!!

title: Design over usability
review: These buds do stay in my ears really well, after I fitted the large foam ear pieces, and they do isolate well.  The sound is basically good if a little muddy in the bass end.  I do have a couple of complaints however.  There is no volume control in the remote.  I suppose I didn't read the description close enough, but really?  Not every recording is mastered to the same volume.  The design necessitates taking your phone out of your pocket to adjust the volume.  Not a big deal?  Try it a few times and see how much of a pain that can be when your hands are already occupied with packages or whatever. Also, the wires from the centerpiece/remote are spaced far enough apart no little slider could be placed to pull up and place the phone speaker closer to the neck.  This necessitates holding the phone speaker next to your neck to get a clear enough voice signal.  It seems design was given priority over usability in these earbuds.  There are better earbuds out there that don't have these built in ergonomic oversights.  I wouldn't buy another pair and I wouldn't advise anyone else to.

title: Doesn't make a good connection with Apple earbuds
review: This worked fine.  At first.  Then they started to fail after just a few days.  I can restore the sound and functions by reseating or adjusting the connection but it continues to happen.  It's super-frustrating.  I wish Apple would make a fully-compatible cord extender for their earbuds.

title: AWESOME headphones
review:
I work from home and this set of headphones are definitely what I need every day.
The sound is great! Microphone is clear! It sounds great and my clients say they can hear me perfectly.
They are comfortable, lightweight, and fit my head (very comfortable to wear for long time. Very soft ear pads and head support pad)
Very good battery life – can be use around 7-8 hours without charging.
Connection is also good I’m able to walk all around the house without any interference or disruption in the signal.
I would definitely recommend! Worth the money!

title: They do the job
review: I use these when driving in older cars that don’t have Bluetooth. Work beautifully, and I don’t have my ears cover or plugged with headphones.

title: Liked the voice features, app and sound but they just didn’t fit.
review: Really liked the earbuds. Loved the features. Liked to use voice commands vs always tapping or swiping on the earbuds. My only 2 reasons for returning were that (1) the earbud wouldn’t stay in my left ear. I tried all the sizes and but none worked. (2) both inside and outside the earbuds (even in noise canceling mode) allowed outside noise (even background music) to be heard while listening to music on the earbuds. For the right person (ear wise), you could really enjoy them.

title: See notes although I would still recommend
review:
I wanted to find a set of waterproof earbuds. I would hate to fall in the water with my Airpods on and before I drop some serious coin, I want to test a less costly product.

Delivery, instructions, controls, charging and pairing is spot on. Very pleased.

My only issue so far is the fit. In the morning, the earbuds keep slipping out (fix is wash your inner ear before using to remove any excessive oils). The only other fit issue I’ve noticed is if you yawn or move your jaw a bit, the earbuds loosen up and you loose the snug fit.

I still have to play with the different sized ear plugs to see if that can resolve the problem.

Even with these challenges, I would recommend.

title: Ultimate Headphones to clearly hear no matter your age!
review: These headphones were purchased for my 82 year old Dad. He uses hearing aids and in order to watch TV (sporting events, movies and general TV) he needs closed caption. These headphones can cancel background noise such that he can hear a football game without all the irrelevant crowd noise. I purchased these headphones in 2018. Now 2020, they continue to be a homerun. These could be considered overkill for my Dad’s needs but ... He’s my Dad and deserves it!

title: Ava tree is the best
review:
I connect my Bose headphones and an hear every word on my tv programs now
Hooked up optical cable

title: Buy Something Else - RIP OFF!
review: Cheap material, poor sound quality, terrible fit, (keeps falling out), awful battery life.  Never been an "ear bud" fan.  Heard they got better.  That's a lie.  (Headphones really are better). Those cheap airplane headphones that they give you for fee are far superior to this crap.  Was actually glad this last time when ear bud fell out and rolled & down drain.  Anything is better than this.  ANYTHING!

title: Sound great
review: Very happy with these. Sound excellent with a headphone amp/dac. I really don't see a reason to spend more $. I've had various sets of wired over ear and in ear up to as much as 400 dollars. And I'm more than happy with tg sound from these. Plus they are well built and styled.

title: Poor sound quality
review: Sound quality for music had a muffled feeling to it. There are better options out there. A 300 dollar pair of headphones shouldn't sound worse than my 70 dollar wired Phillips.

title: Why use a nonstandard cable?
review: These are very comfortable and the sound is pretty decent but why use a non standard cable? I want to use other length cords. For instance, I want to use a very short cord, a few inches to attach to my FIIO BTR5. I can then just clip the BTR5 to the headphone itself or my collar. Anyway.. other 3.5 jacks do not fit in to the headphone securely. What is the deal with using a proprietary cord? I'm probably going to send these back...smh.

title: Not good quality
review: Did not last. Was very hard to plug the jack all the way in from the start. Over time, only played on one side of headphones. Had to buy a new one, different brand.

title: Good for gaming, not so much for music.
review: Mainly got these for playing CS GO which they turn out to be very good for. The semi open back design is working well for telling where footstep and other telling sounds are coming from. Definitely an improvement in that regard. However, I was also hoping that they would be nice for music. And I can't really say that I'm impressed at all there. They sound like about what you would expect for $30 headphones. I don't see an issue on the bass end like many people complained about, but the tinny high end is real. Overall just kind of weak and uninspiring. Now that said, my computer doesn't really seem to push them enough. Have to crank the volume all the way up, over twice as far as my old headphones. And more than twice as high as my speakers. So I ordered a DAC/AMP for them. Kind of defeats the purpose of saving money on cheaper headphones. :) But I really want them to be dual purpose. May revisit review if the DAC makes a big difference for music.

title: Ok for the price
review:
If you've never owned quality earbuds, these will seem like they are pretty darn good. However, I've already been spoiled by a good pair of Ultimate Ears buds. Unfortunately those were accidentally damaged, so being without any kind of phones for my MP3 player, I picked up these Vmodas.

Let me just say that I REALLY miss my Ultimate Ears buds. These VMODAS do have pretty good bass, but everything else is muddy in my opinion. They actually sound pretty good for Rap and electronic stuff like Crystal Method. But for any kind of rock and roll, Classical, Blues etc. they don't cut it at all. I would have to rate them mediocre overall. I would have given them a 2 if it weren't for the price. At 29.99, I didn't want to be overly critical.

If you really care about sound quality, and have the money, get yourself a good quality pair of buds. Otherwise, these should do I guess.

title: excellence
review:
Ultimate Ears has managed to blend sound and style into a tiny comfortable package with these phones.
I honestly cannot find a single thing to complain about with these earphones.
Also, they seem to get better with age. I swear they sound better now than they did when I bought them 3 weeks ago. Just great stuff. Absolutely worth every penny.
I wanted some westone 3s, but after having these for a few weeks, I am not all that hyped about the westones anymore.

title: Like shoving hot pokers in your ears
review:
I bought these after looking at several reviews. Most reviews are positive toward the sound quality. And I do agree with that, the sound quality is pretty decent.
However, the comfort of these things is horrible. I kept thinking it was the tips that were bothering me and kept trying the different sizes. Also ordered comply tips. After much experimenting I was looking in the mirror at them (while in my ears) and realized it had nothing to do with the tips. It is the circular metal housing just behind the tip. Much too large. It presses against some of the other protruding parts of your ears. Within 5 minutes these things are becoming uncomfortable. Within a few songs I was ready to get these parasites out of my ears.
Look elsewhere. Earbuds with driver housings that are narrow near where you insert them into your ears are a better choice.

title: Lose connection often
review: I like how comfortable this Headphones  are fit in my ears, unfortunately the randomly disconnect a lot. Also, a touch control is not very functional.

title: Fantastic replacement buds!
review: I continually lose buds on my headphones and these are perfect. They're the right size and good quality. Affordable too!

title: Good sound quality and microphone. Color-coding is great!
review:
These headphones are color-coded, which is great for knowing which ear is "left" and "right."

The inline microphone works well too - am told by people that they hear me loud and clear.

Then only aspect I'm not crazy about is the cord, which is short and quite stiff, apparently because it's water-resistant.

title: Great...while it works.  :-(
review:
REVISED REVIEW
