This headset works great...but for a short time.

With ULTRA LIGHT use, the first headset worked for about two months. The company had great customer service and replaced the headset.

The second headset lasted about one month before people began telling me they could barely hear me. The microphone stops working very quickly.

One defective headset could be a fluke. However, two? That seems unlikely.

I love the concept of this headset but unfortunately the execution leaves a lot to be desired.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:

These headphones work really well!

The microphone is very powerful and offers noise reduction due to foam cover; volume dial is easy to access and use, and headband is comfortable to wear. One can position the microphone for use on left or right, depending on preference.

I feel like a telemarketer when wearing this headset but who cares. I'll take function over form any day! :-)

title: Great product
review: I just wish the slot went a little deeper to be able to accommodate the entire wire length.  Other than that, I love it because it makes it easy to carry my earbuds in my pocket and not have them get entangled with my keys or the wires getting entangled with each other.

title: Great Volume
review: Very satisfied, for the price. I use them indoors & out, they pair quickly & have decent range. I’m hard of hearing, that is the main reason I wanted wireless earphones. My phone’s volume isn’t loud enough & these solved my problem. I like the carrying case too.

title: Perfect for the shower - Great for spoken word
review:
I throw my cell in a dry box & either audiobook or watch TV while showering at the gym. These little earbuds work great and I have had no issues exposing them to water.

From time to time, a drop of water will land on the earbud just right and pause whatever I'm watching/listening to but aside from that, I love being able to adjust the volume without having to open my dry box.

Also the battery seems to last an extremely long time - I only use them for 15 - 30 minutes a day but I've gone weeks without recharging the base unit (thanks to the charge indicator).

Only con, is that they are slightly too large for my ears and can fall out easily. It's a big con but not enough to send me looking for a new set of shower earbuds.

I would not recommend these for music but they are great for spoken word.

title: Nice earbuds for Oculus Quest
review: These are nice low profile earbuds. Generally good sound. I usually only use one of the earbuds so cannot speak to how well these cancel noise. Ordered a second pair for my Q2.

title: Great sounds with EQ app
review:
Tried a friend's PBPs before purchasing and was verrrry hesitant. I am not a fan of unbalanced music and it seemed like these produced far too much bass for my liking. An EQ app to reduce the low range, boost the mid ranges and generally balance the sound out was just the solution. These are now my very favorite headphones.

9/24/2020
Changing rating from 5 to 3 stars. These sporadically disconnect from my phone at least once/day. I have to turn off blue tooth, then re-pair. Sound is still good.

title: Cheap and works!
review: We use MS Teams in an environment that doesn't allow us to use a microphone on our laptops so we were stuck tethered to the computer via headset cables.  With this device I'm no longer tethered AND for those miscreants that can't figure out how to use Teams (ours has no dial in function) I can put my phone on speaker and connect all participants whether via Teams or conference line.  It's fantastic!

Fantastic sound quality. I should’ve made the move to wireless years ago. Not a fan of the button locations as I tend to bump them removing the headset but I’ll adapt to it I’m sure. Definitely recommend if you’re still struggling with a wired pair.

title: Great tool
review: I love to listen to books and my new MP3 players does not have an exterior microphone.  This little gadget is perfect.  It charges on your computer, holds a long charge and has quite a good volume for listening.  It makes it so easy to listen while doing other things and not have annoying earphones in.  I love it.

title: Five Stars
review: Easy to use, cheap but high quality headphone! Competitive quality with $100 headphones!

title: Disappointing
review: I've been using these headphones for ONE WEEK and I'm already experiencing distortion in the sound. I primarily use them for work phone calls and can't believe how quickly they have failed. Was I sent a used pair that someone else sent back for the same reason? Unacceptible.

title: Headphones
review: Ok so they’re cool, it’s just only one side is working for me what a bummer, the sound quality is great in the side I can hear out of I just bet if both side was working these would be my favorite earphones.

title: Mini bag
review: [[VIDEOID:1cf95fcb80dbf0db7fafe2163e8e246a]] Perfect for my daughter’s headphones she really love this thing she can’t get enough. She wears it as a person and then sometimes she looks like her keys as it has a key holder read on the back this thing is really nice and stylish.

title: Five Stars
review: Excellent headphones, just wish they lasted longer but for the price, they are awesome!

title: Let me start by saying I love the round disk that you can easily adjust the ...
review: Let me start by saying I love the round disk that you can easily adjust the sound with and plug in your headphones without having to plug them into the computer itself. Having said that, I was using these for about a month when it got a buzzing sound that gets worse the longer you have them on so I will have to purchase something else:(

title: Saved me from having to replace headset.
review: I thought I was going to have to purchase a very expensive cordless headset but changing the battery was all I needed to do to get my old headset working again. I am very grateful and very satisfied with this replacement battery. Worked like a charm and we are back to using it daily.

title: poor sound/do not fit
review: I bought these based on the peace sign only.  Mistake!! Horrible, horrible sound. No base whatsoever.  Neither size of the rubber tips fit me.  They both fall out of my ears.  Worse pair of earbuds I've ever spent money on.

title: Love these headphones
review: Love these headphones, they don't slip out of your ear. I am a runner so that's really important for me.

title: Happy
review: I use my earbuds on a SanDisk mp3 player I listen to books I check out at my local library and music . I am very happy with the sound and quality of the earbuds ,

title: Little odd things
review:
I had the previous versions of these earbuds until I found out they only had a mic in one ear piece. I don't always use them both at the same time so this was a bit annoying and I didn't know that until someone told me why I always sounded so far way! This new version have mics in both pieces so no matter which one I leave in, it still has the mic, this is way better. One annoying thing about these are that it seems as if they are always updating!!!
The battery and case are odd for these ear buds. Sometimes the battery lasts all day other times, I use it for a little while and they are already dead. The case has difficulty charging properly on the Samsung fast charger. It takes a long time and is intermittent as in I have to pick the case up and move it around the charger until it chargers. The range is not that great, if I leave my phone in one room and sneak off to another room, it either looses connection or is full of static. I've had previous earbuds that I could leave my phone almost anywhere in the house and still be connected. The sound is great and I really like how it is integrated with phone. The earbud touch pads are very sensitive and can mess up a audio book/podcast real quick which is kind of annoying too. Overall for the sound and the integration with phone, I'd probably buy again.

title: Worthy Investment
review:
Purchased these headphones on a whim while in Hawaii just before my flight home. After many years of using my own in-ear headphones when on the airplane, I decided it was time to upgrade. I've always been hesitant to spend sooooo much money on headphones, but the aching from my ears after this last trip was enough to convince me that it was time to do myself a favor. Well, that and the 4.5% tax in Hawaii vs. the 10% back home in California. The Apple store has these in Navy, which was another selling point for me.

The moment of truth came on the flight home. Just shy of 6-hours with these headphones on and not an ache or sore spot anywhere. Ear pieces are very comfortable, sound quality is great. Keep in mind that since these are wireless, you have to use the included cable to connect to an in-flight system. Make certain that you plug the cable into the headset all the way or you may have some sound quality issues. I was worried I had wasted $350, but once I double-checked the cable I realized I hadn't pushed it in all the way. Problem solved.

I paired the headphones with my phone to test that connection, and the sound quality of my music was fantastic! Pairing process was fast and simple. The only thing I don't love so far is the Bose App. I'm trying to figure out what the purpose is, as it doesn't seem that critical and it doesn't seem to offer a whole lot. Other than that, I love these!

title: It works as advertised. But only one flaw.
review: Okay  product.  Record  sounds during gaming perfectly.  Sound quality is excellent during gaming and  playback. The only complaint I have is that the left earbud stop playing sound. I have purchased two pair in a year and it happened twice. I think is the wire quality. I have not damaged them so I think that is the problem.  I hope they get them fixed because other than that they work as advertised.

title: Craftmanship subpar
review: The quality is not what I was expecting. The trim around the top of headphones is separating. Other than that OK.

title: Day 1 so far so good.
review:
I havent detected any noise cancelation at all. I hear everything, thats okay I bought the headset so I could workout and not have them fall out of my ears, they stay on very well. Base is lacking big time but I dont think I have the fit right yet.

For the price I'm very happy.

title: Well made, lite on the ears. Sound is ...
review:
Well made, lite on the ears.
Sound is a little flat and lite on base but not shocking for a wireless headset.

EDIT: After a while I've had many complaints about background noise. At least for my headset not only does noise canceling not work, background noises are often amplified to be louder than my voice. I was going to exchange them but I waited to long. I'm not disatified with the headset, but I talk all day on the phone get at least a complaint a day.

While listening to music and making calls nearly continously the battery will last 7-8 hours. You can charge the headset while in use.

title: I love this headset until I broke the charging port
review: I love this headset until I broke the charging port. It was more a bad charging cable than a product defect.

title: I was able to get the headphones working once on the computer and it was great, I rebooted and I've not been able to ...
review: I'm not sure if its the product or my bluetooth head phones. I was able to get the headphones working once on the computer and it was great, I rebooted and I've not been able to get them working since.

title: Well made
review:
Very sturdy construction, speaker plug on the bottom for a headset earpeice if you want it. Screws in to the unit very solid making it impossible to accidentally disconnect.

Connected to my VX7R I got a compliment on how good the audio was (not just for a handheld).

title: Not to bad, not to great
review: Volume levels are very hard to get right. The sound quality is low. It also installs software on your PC. Its a little phone icon running in your system tray. If that program is running you will not be able to change your audio settings to any other device for skype (like a headset on your PC). There also isnt a easy button to turn off that program or prevent it from starting with windows every time.

title: Almost perfect, if only the volume controller worked
review: I really wanted to love these earbuds--they're perfect for sleeping, and they really do block outside noise well. Here's my problem: Within days of using both pairs, the volume controller on the cord went bananas and would automatically turn the volume all the way down. Even when I tried to override this bug by using the volume controller on the device, the earbud volume control would again turn the volume all the way down. Pretty useless for the purpose of listening to sound! I finally took the entire volume control mechanism off and put tape around the remaining wire. This worked fine to solve the problem, but now I have tape around the cord protecting me and the wire from each other. So if you don't mind taping it up, these are fine I guess!

title: Well these are just terrible
review: I thought this would be a good solution to my "ugh I go through earbuds so fast" problem, but it's not. The sound quality is just awful, like being inside a tin can, and every single pair so far (I'm on the sixth pair in two months) has completely lost sound in one ear after just a couple of uses. Totally not worth it unless maybe it's for a little kid who doesn't care about hearing something awful one ear at a time.

title: Easy to use.
review: Took a risk on these as I wanted a second pair of bluetooth earbuds. They came with a USB cord for case to charge earbuds, a carrying cord that can attach to case, extra earbud rubbers in different sizes, instructions (usual tiny type). It was easy to pair and everything worked just fine. I haven't used them much yet, but played a few songs with it and sound was good. The earbuds seem to magnetically snap into the case when you put them in to charge so simple and easy there. The charging port on case is USB C so I used my phone charging cord. Not needing another cord for charging will be a plus when traveling Being able to charge up the case and keep the earbuds charged on when not in use also a plus. I paid around $24 when I ordered for the black, but I notice the black is on sale now for around $19 so if you can grab a pair on sale for a lower price even better. I have not used them extensively yet so don't know how long they will last, etc. but will adjust rating as warranted the more I use them. I am happy with the quality of these earbuds.

title: Audio is good
review: I just got these and tried them out on my Samsung S21 Ultra. I lost my other set of USB C earbuds and sometimes forget to charge my Bluetooth wireless ones. Sound seemed quite good. Only thing is the fit in my small ears isn't the best, but it's okay. The thin foam covers probably won't last long, and were a bit hard to get on, but without the foam ear piece covers the fit seemed fine too. The foam covers add a bit of grip that helps keep the ear pieces in my ears. I haven't used them on a call yet, but tested the mic on the voice recorder and it sounded good. Overall happy with these earbuds.

title: Good value. Moving to USB C as 3.5 jacks disappearing.
review: I just received these earbuds so I haven't used them yet to answer a call but have tested it out on my laptop and my watched a video with it on my Samsung 9+ phone and it works just fine. I wanted something with volume control buttons as they make things so much more convenient. You can hardly find 3.5 jacks on anything new these days so I'm moving on with the times with USB C. The ends of the earphones have magnets so they hold together to prevent tangling when not in use. There are extra earphone rubbers in different sizes if you need to change the size or need to replace the ones on the earphones. Material looks to be good quality and wires have that silicone feel and they're not too soft which I feel helps prevent tangling. I put a colored dot with paint over the L on the earphone so I can easily distinguish the sides in dim light. You can do the same with nail polish, dimensional paint, etc. if it's important to you. These earphones are simple and work so I have to give it 5 stars for value and features. I can't speak to durability yet but will update this review if it's warranted.

title: Just needed an "extension cord" for my headphones
review: I purchased the 4 foot version as I just needed an "extension cord" for my earphones. My plug holds firm and sound is okay. Price was good. Only thing that I would say is a con is the black and white "fabric" type wrapping. I wish now I had purchased solid rubber or plastic as I feel it's more cleanable if anything gets on it like dust. But it's a relatively small quibble as otherwise I am satisfied at this price level. I have no comment about durability as I have just received the cord but I will update this cord if I have any problems.

title: Happy with cable splitter
review: I just got this cable splitter. I tested out both ends with a headset and it works just fine. Sound was clear. Jacks fit nice and snug. If I have any problems with use I will update this review but so far I am happy with the quality of this product at this price point.

title: These are astonishing, but how do they compare to airpods?
review:
If you are looking for earbuds with ambient mode, you will no doubt conclude that you should get these or AirPods pro. (Especially if you have an Apple phone.) Which is better? It depends.
I have both. I have the beats at home and AirPods pro at my office. Both sound excellent in every way. I'd say that sound quality, noise canceling, and ambient mode are identical.
But there are tradeoffs. The Beats are designed to stay in your ear better. The AirPods feel like they can fall out easily. And they indeed do fall out fairly easily. So if that is a factor for you, the beats are vastly superior. The AirPods are slightly more comfortable (probably due to the same factor that causes them to fall out more easily). The charging box for the beats is slightly larger. That could be good or bad. AirPods also charge wirelessly, while the beats don't.
So if you exercise or mow or are active when you are listening, then the Beats are a clear choice. But if you are sitting at work listening, I'd go with the AirPods.

title: Worthless
review: No sound isolation.  Sound quality is about like a 1 dollar set of earphones from dollar tree.  Package was almost impossible to get into.  Nothing was good about these.

title: Easy to use, putting the earphones in and taking them out.
review: I’m a dedicated wired-earphone person. My ears are too small for Bluetooth ear buds. I’ve tried other earphone keepers, and these are the best!

title: Fits over glasses frames, stays put when running
review:
I wear glasses, and these fit comfortably over my ears and frames. I don’t know how they seat and block out sound for non-glasses people, but I still have awareness of surrounding noises, which I consider a good thing. A lot of earbuds get uncomfortable fast, but the buds on these do not press heavily on my ear canals and my ears do not fatigue wearing them.

They don’t come loose when running for a few hours, and allow enough noise in that I am able to hear traffic and be environmentally aware.

Battery life seems good. I used them constantly on a 4 hour 30 minute run, and they did not die (audiobook, not music, not sure if that makes a difference for battery drain).

The on-ear controls are fantastic. I don’t like touch controls, but these are actual buttons, and are simple to operate: button on the ear pauses/unpauses, rocker button on the top of each earpiece controls volume. I haven’t used them for any calls, so I can’t say how they work on that front.

I’m really happy with these headphones. They were an impulse buy when they were on sale, but they have quickly become my go-to earbuds for running and at work.

title: Case is not a charging case
review:
This one’s on me for not realizing, but the case for these headphones is just a case, and does not hold any charge for on-the-go recharging. The charging case is an extra $50.

Moving on to the review, I wear glasses and these mostly sit well on my ears alongside the glasses. I use these at my desk at work where I need environmental awareness, so they are not turned up very loud, so I can’t really judge the sound quality at higher volumes.

I’m satisfied with these, and they fit my criteria perfectly: over ear hook, no bit going into the ear, and no headband behind my head. The lack of a charging case is a disappointment considering how expensive they are.

title: No VoltBolts
review: The main reason I purchased these were for the Pokemon ear VoltBolts. My package was delivered damaged and without the Pokemon ears. I am very disappointed, and my daughter will be when she opens the box on her birthday. I could have purchased plain headphones from anywhere that DIDN'T come damaged.

title: Unable to connect
review:
Trying to use device to connect Bluetooth headphones to Windows 7 PC. To date no success, must be me, Prompted by writing the review I tried again and after 45 minutes was able to connect and use as expected.
Humbled

title: Great for both hard of hearing and those with normal hearing
review: I had trouble figuring out where to put the speaker, since the 55-inch TV stand is round and fills the whole surface of the entertainment center on which it is standing. I finally put it on the floor in front of the entertainment center and ran the  wires under the entertainment center so that they do not show. It work fine from that position. The wonderful part about the sound bar is that my husband, who is severely hard of hearing can now hear the TV sound well without blasting me out of the room from turning up the volume so high. He no longer needs to wear a headset in order to hear without raising the volume, so we can now talk while watching TV. I highly recommend this sound bar for people both with and without hearing problems, because the sound is so rich. I would also like to comment on how helpful ZVOX was when I called them. they answered immediately and gave me very helpful advice, which saved me a lot of time trying to figure things out by myself.

title: Didn’t work for me.
review: Purchased to use with my electronic drum kit.  Plugged my Corsair headset in and it did not work.

title: Good size for my ears.
review: Love these earbuds.  They fit in my ears and don't fall out.  They aren't noise cancelling, but I haven't found any earbuds that can do that job. The sound quality is good and I hear stereo in each ear. They charge quickly and really I don't need to charge very often.  I would say that I use them about an hour each day and charge once every 12 days or so. The case is small and fits in my purse nicely.

title: Very Loud! Great Sound Quality, Very Deep Bass. Many Connection Options, Light. Compact
review: These headphones sound great. They are very light and very loud because of neodymium magnets. Fold up design is very compact. The Bass is very deep and accurate. Great for regular listening and recording studio.

title: Bluetooth Transceiver Has Much Greater Range than 5.0 Bluetooth
review:
My old 5.0 Bluetooth USB transceiver was great for using headphones in the same room as my computer. But, if I went into the next room the sound would break up and be useless.
The USB connector plugged into my rather filled-up backplate with other USB encryption devices and cords.
This new Bluetooth transceiver with extended range lets me walk all over my 2 bedroom apt. Even the restroom.
I couldn't be happier.

title: Very nice headphones - sound fantastic
review:
These headphones sound very good. I have spent all kinds of money on headphones over the years and this is one of the best pairs I have had, yet. Especially for the price. They are easy to operate. The Bluetooth pairs easily, the manual is very easy to understand, EQ works very well. Overall the features on these are very nice and sound quality is excellent.
They fold up very small. They charge quickly, too.

title: Great cable!
review: Great cable! This worked to replace the headphone cable for my Focal Spirit One S that my kitty chewed up.

title: Needed the ear hook
review: I’ve not been incredibly active to use these airbuds for sports, but I guess I have a small interior ear structure. I can’t keep earbuds inside my ear without the help of the “ear hooks.” These do the trick. Comfortable, sound is good and I got a pretty color of navy. Also they came with different sized plugs, and included was the charger cord.

title: These are great!
review:
These are not noise canceling headphones, in fact the are just the opposite and that’s what we wanted. My husband jogs and I bike and we want to hear sounds around us for safety.
Our only suggestion is that they make the power on/off button a bit more substantial as it is hard to feel it easily with your thumb while wearing the headphones. Better to use when they are off your head.

title: Beyond Disappointed
review: I have bought 4 Symphonized Earbuds before. First got my iPhone 6 & then for my upgrade iPhone max. Also wrote a previous review here that I would never buy from another company since I enjoyed the quality of the Earbuds very much...Unfortunately, I tried a pair of the “Bling” Earbuds (thought the pink & the bling” looked cute but realized that they are “total junk”!!! How can a company offer such awesome product and also such lousy product? This pair help up barely for 9 weeks before The right side broke and I was only able to listen to the left side. Now the left side works intermittently and I finally can’t use them at all anymore!!!! This particular pair was $16+ instead of the previous $26-34 per pair but should the quality of the product suffer this much? I would have been better off buying a $1,- Dollar Tree earbuds. Very Very unfortunate. Now I have to start my research again to find a company that prides itself of selling quality and constant/lasting earphones/buds.

title: Must Have
review:
Have bought 3 pairs in the past (ALL still work well) and bought this pair for my new iPhone. Same great quality and worth every penny. The sound is the best compared to many other very expensive Earbuds I bought in the past!
Also so happy that Earbuds are made out of wood, created in NY, and they are very stylish!!! Will NEVER go back to cheaper or even more expensive Earbuds!!
Top this all off; company went the extra mile (which is very rare!!!) and added a beautiful round case for my Earbuds. No one can ask for more!!
~~ I do not work for this company and don’t get paid by this company. I am just a very happy & impressed customer that felt let to share that there are still high quality but affordable products on the market and businesses that care what they sell. Thank you for taking the time to read my review.

title: Buy & Buy Again...Great Product
review:
Best earbuds I bought in awhile.
Product was packed professionally, earbuds even came with a bag.
The Wood truly makes the sound so much clearer and enjoyable to listen to my music, podcasts, etc..
Also the buds look stylish and sophisticated.
As importantly to me is that the company of this product (per product info; instructions) were created in New York and company/creators “invest & support” our children and future generation!!
To me it’s a “Win : Win” situation. I can be part of investing into our children; while enjoying a product that holds up to all of its promises!!
I do not mind at all paying more (possibly) for a product that is superb AND helps others, children.
Hope more Amazon customers like me will “invest & support” others while purchasing the products they need or want.
“Thank You” Symphonized!!
PS: Bought another Symphonized and enjoying the product as much!!! Kept product on “My List” for upcoming gifts.

title: Great Quality & Free Extra Gifts
review: Best earbuds I bought in awhile. Indeed, they are more pricey than other non-wireless earbuds but they also last much longer, are durable, and sound is great. Company even gifted the purchaser with a Velcro fastener to keep earbuds tidy after use and a small but quality black satin pouch. “Thank You”. PS: Enjoy them do much that I bought a “back-up” pair. Now I have all colors: White and Gray. Kept product on my “Buy Again” list!

title: Best Product; Best Company
review:
Have ordered many items from Anker and I absolutely enjoy all products from Anker. Actually bought a 2nd pair of these very comfortable, great sound, and sturdy Earbuds.
Anker Company does not only provide quality products but they go beyond to assure that their customers are satisfied by providing a quality bag/pouch for the Earbuds and even extra buds, but also have a Velcro type closure around the Earbuds/cable to keep it neatly together!! Services and high Quality that I have not witnessed in a long time from Companies.
Side note: I am not an employee of Anker but rather a very satisfied customer that is taking her time to share sincere feedback and appreciation that Companies like Anker still exists.
Thank You, Anker.

title: Works well
review: I love these earphones they connected to my phone as for pros they work really well and the battery power also lashes really well I’m very pleased with these headphones .

title: Cable extension
review: I wanted a headphone cable that I could use with my computer while using my treadmill.  This is perfect and exactly what I wanted.

title: Great for the price.
review: I had been searching for a cheap set of these to use at night while I watch my iPad. Because I tend to fall sleep with my AirPods in.  These work great for what I needed. Battery life seems to be great. I am 100% an airpod user. So, I would not recommend these earbuds if you were looking for something with that kind of quality. Sound quality with these is better in the right ear than the left ear. I will say they are actually comfortable to wear. They paired up with my iPhone and IPad very easily. They do transfer from one ear to the next, so if you want to just use one until it dies and then use the other these work great.

title: Perfect
review: I live these earbuds. I have surround sound in such a tiny earbud. The quality is great. I love the different sizes of the rubber part that goes into the ear canal. I have very small ear canals and there is a small enough one to fit my ears. The price was great. I even like the different colors to choose from. I’m gonna buy a pair for my hubby for Xmas.

title: Easy to use, great speaker quality.
review: The one thing that beats the Nook all hollow is the speaker quality.  You don't need earphones to hear your Kindle.  The one thing I don't like is the email format.  Splitting the screen is a waste.  Still having to learn how to get to full screen.

title: Inexpensive headset ON-Ear not "Over-Ear Headphones" as stated
review: Bought set for listening to instructional videos at school for grandson.  He dislikes earbuds and wanted something more comfortable.  The are advertised as Over-the-ear but the opening between ear hole pads not large enough for the pads to be over the ear. He tried on earphones and they are uncomfortable as they are On-The-Ear.  Returned.

title: Not preem, choom.
review: Biggest issue was how uncomfortable these are. I'm a petite female and the head band is so large it doesn't actually rest on my head so the headphones hang on the top of my ears. Painful! I've used plenty of headphones with noise canceling, these ones literally cause pressure in the ears when it's turned on so it cannot be used. The volume level is very sad, I constantly want to turn it up, but they're already maxed out. If you happen to have noise canceling on the headphone sound is even quieter. These things also squeeze my head and cause a headache in a short amoint of time. The bass is decent, although I can get a better thump out of my almost 10 year old Beats that are falling apart. I'm typically a fan of Anker products, but this is absolutely a get what you paid for item. If you're a music enthusiast do not buy these.

title: Works Perfectly!
review: With all of the online meetings going on we needed more USB ports for cameras, speakers, headphones, thumb drives, etc.  This fits the bill perfectly.  Windows 10 recognized it immediately.

title: Not Good
review: these didn't fit my Philips Sony headphones. I am sorely disappointed but for the cheap price it's not worth the bother to return them. I put them on a giveaway table at the local senior center.

title: Worth it.
review: It’s been a while since I bought any new earbuds, and I’m glad I picked these.  The sound is really great, but is overall quiet.  Pretty balanced tuning, though I would honestly want a bit more bass.  Very comfortable, too, but do best with the foam tips.  Battery life is phenomenal.  Can last me several days of moderate use before I have to charge the case back up.  I highly recommend these, but definitely wait for a sale.  Also, the app does a fine job on iOS, but doesn’t have quite the same usefulness on Android.  If you don’t want to spend the dough on AirPods, these are a nice budget alternative.

title: Exceptional sound.
review:
These sound absolutely fantastic. Nothing is boosted. This sound is flat and even…exactly what I want. Perfect for watching movies or listening to music. A definite improvement over the original EarFun Free.

Battery life without ANC is decent, but the ANC cuts playtime by almost half…..and the ANC isn’t really that great. I am digging the seven hours at a time I can get from a single charge, though. Pretty much lasts throughout the day.

Again…ANC is weaker than I expected. I like the ambient setting, though. Can actually hear those around me talking. Normal vs ANC, though…doesn’t block a lot other than steady sounds like the fans or motors. Would probably do a LOT better with some foam tips, but I don’t have any that fit.

I am glad I picked these up on sale. Just an overall fantastic earbud…and the weak ANC isn’t even worth knocking a star off when taken with the sound quality. Best earbuds I’ve owned.

title: Great for the classroom.
review:
This is the first set of classroom headphones I've purchased online. Usually I get bulk dollar items and they end up breaking after a few days/weeks. Decided to splurge a little and get some real headphones that will last. Have tested all ten out myself, and they're all working just fine. My son has been using one pair daily for the past week and they're still going strong. A+ on sturdiness, for sure.

The audio quality is decent for what it is. These aren't going to be used for listening to music or editing audio...These are going to be used by students at a computer working on Lexia/SeeSaw/Reflex Math, etc. For that purpose, the audio is just perfect. Voices sound crisp and clear, and that is the most important thing in a classroom.

Carrying bags are a nice touch. I've already labeled them with student's names and hung them up on the wall in my class. Everyone will have their own, and I will easily be able to see who might have walked away with a pair.

They're compact, sturdy, and sound great for classroom use. At this price, I'm very pleased with what I got. Definitely recommend for any teacher out there who needs to upgrade or replace their old sets. All ten work perfectly, and all ten are identical. Great buy!

title: Great viewing angles
review:
This makes for an excellent replacement to the screen my son broke on our laptop. Viewing angles are fantastic, and the colors are rich and vibrant. Seems to be pretty sturdy, and the screen cover is very professional looking. I really like that you can connect headphones or use the built in speakers. It can not only be powered by the included wall charger, but from power banks or from the device itself.

It's sort of a built-in docking station, too. Adds data transfer through the USB ports, so it is perfect for our needs. I've tried it with my LG V60 and Samsung S10+ and it worked as expected. Could play mobile games on the big screen. Also worked with the USB-C port on my main laptop as a very nice second screen.

Loving it.

title: Very good for the price
review: I buy a lot of headphones and earbuds trying to find just the right sound.  These are the least expensive buds I have bought, but have better sound than many buds ten to twenty bucks higher.  I found myself draining the battery in one sitting the other day (a bit over five and a half hours at low volume) listening to a variety of different genre.  I am genuinely impressed with the soundstage of these.  It is overall very neutral.  You’ll need the EQ to pump things up a bit.  Bass is not heavy, nor are the highs.  At high volume they do have some distortion, but overall a very pleasant experience.  As they are, they have decent noise isolation, and with some foam tips these would be amazing.  Keeping these at work, for sure.

title: Excellent Podcast Mic
review:
For the first time, I was able to use audio straight from a microphone to record a video. I didn't have to do ANYTHING in post. I've used lavalier mics, shotgun mics, and two "studio" mics in the past. All of those needed at least something done in post, if only just noise reduction. This one beats my studio mics hands down. Didn't need any filters or noise reduction.

Really easy to use with either a PC or an iPad. I do my audio using GarageBand for iPad, and this connected right up with the USB-C connection. There was zero lag from my headphones, either. Gain and Volume knobs worked as expected. Mute cuts audio from the mic and to the headphones as well. Overall a great experience.

The mic did pick up some desk noise, so I will be mounting it on either a boom or to a swing-arm instead of the little tripod that comes with it. The included tripod is 100% plastic. Pop filter is a metal screen inside a plastic frame. Will be using a real pop filter instead for future videos. This one seems more for decoration.

Easily worth the price, and I definitely recommend this for anyone just starting out. It's superior to any other microphone in this price range that I've used.

title: Decent replacement speaker
review:
Needed something small to replace my big speaker setup. Now that I'm working from home I value desk space over a gaming setup. Haha

This one is pretty stylish. Has some neat LED lights that pulse in and out, and the whole thing just looks cool.

Sound is pretty good for the price, too. For everyday office tasks and some streaming music, it's perfect. Also sounds great for Google Meet and Zoom. For gaming, I've got a headset, so no loss. In line controls are a plus. Actually similar to the control on my Creative setup.

Very cool little speaker. I'll be taking this to work with me when I go back, for sure. Definitely better than the ones I've got up there!

title: Best with computer.
review:
I got another pair of headphones from this same company for my youngest last week. I liked them so much I decided to get myself the USB-C version to use when I'm on the computer. Really decent quality for the money.

Windows detects them as TX 384kb HiFi Type_C_Audio. The audio from the computer is substantially better than the audio from my phone. I'm predominantly going to use these while editing my videos. I don't do anything important, so just gotta make sure the voice sounds okay. These are great for that purpose.

In-line mic / volume control works well on the phone. The mic is decent quality for the price. Sounds a bit better when run through the computer, too. I was trying to take a selfie on my phone while wearing these to test them out and the buttons can also control the camera app. Kinda neat.

Much like the 3.5mm version, the sound is better than the default buds that usually come with devices. Can get decently loud. Bass is a bit muddy, but the mids sound okay.

Wish it came with a braided cord, but a quick sound check on my videos, these will be just fine.

title: My wife loves them!
review:
One of the problems with ordering Christmas gifts online is that your wife gets her gifts and opens them before Christmas! Haha

Since I like writing reviews, she let me get the pictures before she went jogging with them. I'll write my impressions and she'll write hers:

Me:
LOUD! I was not expecting these to be so THUMPING! Serious drivers going on in these earbuds. I was really surprised, especially for the small size. Also, a HUGE improvement to the sound when you toss on the foam tips. Makes a substantial difference. Absolutely superior sound to comparably priced sports buds from JLabs. These absolutely rock.

Her:
"I liked the foam tips. They stayed in really well when I was jogging. The sound was fantastic, too. With those tips in, I couldn't hear anything except the music. Our son was jogging with me and talking...Couldn't hear a word he said. I liked that I didn't have to hear him! Noise isolating is amazing..like the kids don't exist. Merry Christmas to me, right?"

title: Lots of space for cables.
review:
Exactly what I needed. I've got a little pencil box next to my desk full of all the different charging/data cables and some headphones that I use when working on my videos. Needed something I could sit in a drawer out of the way or take with me in my camera bag and still be organized. I've really happy with this case!

There are seven pouches for cables, a big mesh pocket to toss my USB sticks and SD Cards, and a large pocket on the back for the chargers and a couple extra batteries. This is going to be great to keep everything organized when I take my camera on the road. I especially like that it came with velcro cable ties. They're a fantastic bonus.

The cloth is pretty sturdy and it has decent padding. Zippers seem solid enough. The elastic bands are stretchy enough to accommodate some of the longer cables I've got. This will definitely keep things protected in my bag.

title: Loud, Clear, Comfortable
review:
Fall is here and I'm going to fight winter weight by walking. The fabric material is very sturdy but soft. I'm really digging the pattern, too. Plus, it fits my gigantic head. Seriously difficult to find something big enough for my noggin. This stretches nicely and isn't weirdly tight. Also, lots of material up top. I'm loving the size.

I wore it for my morning walk today. Kept my bald head nice and toasty. Connected right up to the phone so I could stream some Pandora. The sound was pretty great for a hat. I'm not saying it'll blow you away, BUT music is loud and crisp. It definitely favors treble over bass, but it still sounds good. Certainly better than the earbuds you get bundled with your phone. I haven't had a chance to really listen to it with my fancy MP3 player, but the sound quality from streaming music was just fine.

title: The sound quality is really great for such an inexpensive set of earbuds
review: The sound quality is really great for such an inexpensive set of earbuds.  I will absolutely buy these again.  Do not use these if you are also using an equalizer...Seems to cause a bit of buzzing on the mids.  ONE ISSUE:  The left earbud pops like a Snapple lid when I put it in my ear.  Other than that, I really do like them.  Not as high quality of materials as my old SoundMagic e80, but the audio quality is just as good.

title: Not as good as name brand.
review: These worked for a short while. Not as great as name brand but did the job until replacement headset arrived.

title: Likely the best wireless headphones out there.
review:
Bought this as a birthday gift for my brother and he absolutely loves it. He called me as soon as he received and had it set it up. The sound was really clear. I thought he'd really like this headset for the gym since he he didn't own a wireless one. He told me he's using it everywhere- regular calls, gym, etc. He said he gets great coverage and was surprised how well it worked when he had left his phone in another room of the house. These headphones can really hold a charge so you get plenty of talk/listening time. Highly recommend.
I gave two other pair as gifts and receivers had the same reaction.

title: So glad that I have these!
review: My older headphone pads were flaking, and it was gross. These replacement pads fit my Cowin E7 headphones perfectly. Getting the old ones off was quite difficult, but installing the new ones was easy.

title: Comfortable and good sound
review: I like these earbuds very much. Easy to connect, very comfortable. I think the sound is excellent, though I don't listen to music with a lot of bass so for some folks it might be lacking on the bass.

title: international  version is same as US version  just 20 cheaper
review: Love these ear budd. Have a S10+ and as soon as I opened the case and took out the ear buds they started connecting.  I ride a motorcycle  and can hear my music clearly in a half helmet  on the freeway. Havent taken a phone call on the motorcycle  since getting these so not sure if wind will affect the call or not but they are great earbuds. The only issue I have had is pairing them to my laptop. First time they paired without much problem  but the sound quality  was poor. Found supposed  solution online and it did make them sound a lot better, however after that I could not get them to pair as headphones  after that, only as heasset.

title: Really good sound from light weight headphones
review:
I was really surprised at the sound quality from these headphones. I use these headphones for streaming tv and movies on my notebook, and was expecting barely "ok" sound from these light inexpensive headphones.

I was impressed by the full and rich sound with these headphones and none of the poor "tin can" like sound quality you can often run into with these kinds of light headphones. Well worth the money in my opinion.

title: Skip it
review:
The charging cable won’t fit into the groove completely and gets disturbingly hot very quickly. I won’t use the charger with it, which kinda defeats the point of even having it

UPDATE: the connection for the old style headphones does not work at all.

title: Philips earhook ear buds - wonderful
review: I was just amazed by the sound quality with these earhook earbuds.  I am ordering more of them.  I would recommend them to anyone.

title: Pretty but not effective
review:
I got the ear phones because I have 3 kids doing virtual learning, and I though earphones would help. . . We all could still hear each other as if there were no headphones on at all.
They are pretty though.

title: Decent quality, no volume controls
review: Decent quality at the right price point. Earphones are basically disposable items for me since they are lost so frequently, I actually bought a couple of these. If the cords were a bit thicker and they has volume controls would be perfect. The ear fit is good.

title: Love these, great fit for my small ears
review: This is my third pair.  I purchased two black pair. One was tossed when I began to get shocked when using them with my laptop. I discovered later it was my Dell laptop that was the problem. I purchased a second black pair, but waited over a year for the white with a mic to come back into stock.  The white stands out when I leave them laying around or in the bottom of my backpack.  The best corded earbuds!!

title: good value for the money
review: Works well with both my Kindle and my cell phone.  I have teeny earholes so those portable earphones drive me crazy.  This is a good alternative.  Decent sound.  I am giving it a five altho there a couple things I wish were different.  It comes with a connector cord that is really short so you need to buy a longer one.  There is no way to tell how much battery charge is left on this little r2d2 look a like.  The paper work says two hours but I get much more out of it.  Also,  not sure why black and silver versions cost five bucks more.  One of those mysteries that we all experience on Amo.

title: Battery life failing
review: I used these headphones frequently, but in the past week the charge only lasts about 20 minutes. I have changed several times yet only last fewer minutes! Note I only use one earpiece! I do alternate earpiece but regardless charge isn’t lasting!

title: bad sound quality, erratic bluetooth issues, bulky design
review: I had two of these (different color) and both have issues. It is rather large compared to other TWS earbuds. I guess it's ok to use it at home but if I wear it outside it would look silly. The sound quality is tinny and low. One major issue is one pair has inconsistent Bluetooth disconnection - sound would cut in and out about 4 or 5 times during a song's span. I would not touch this brand again.

title: right earbud dead on arrival, could not pair or work
review: I can't even evaluate features, sound quality, etc. because I was not able to get right earbud to work. It's as if it does not have any battery or can't hold charge. The left earbud paired immediately but preliminary listening indicates sound is tinny and low.

title: Great size and usability, volume could be louder
review:
I have two H700's and tried it on both a Motorola Razr V3 and a V600 for several weeks. This is a great device and its size and flip on-off feature is so convenient and unmatched by other Bluetooth headsets that I have used. The build and look are rated 5 for this product in my book. The only thing I wish it could be a bit better is its volume during driving condition. At home or in office, the volume is more than adequate. I have one Logitech headset that can turn up volume better than H700 but like many other BT headsets I have to press 4 seconds to turn it on.

Combine with Razr (or V600) voice dial capability, I don't get to see my Razr phone as often. Phone just stays inside my pocket. For outgoing calls, I flip open H700, say a name, and get connected. When people call me, I take H700 out of my pocket, flip it open, put on my ear and it's connected (which gives a perfect timing to allow phone to connect with headset.) This process takes 5 seconds total typically. It's so convenient.

I find this summary manual on Motorola web site which is very handy. [...]

title: Easy to setup and plays great
review: The only gripe that I have about these headphones are the lights.  When the music isn't playing, the lights work great.  But the instant the music starts, they fade in and out, and depending on the style of lights you have chosen, they may not work at all.  But the sound is great, so aside from the light problem, I give it 4/5.

title: Buy these headphones!
review: These are great quality headphones at the fraction of cost you would spend on other headphones with equal or less quality! Very comfortable and practical.  They are so soft and lightweight and fit securely. A must have! Buy these now!!!!

title: Some of the best headphones I have ever owned!!
review: I have been wanting to get a pair of truly wireless headphones for a long while now and had a good friend from work recommend these. It took a while before I decided to drop the cash and that was a good thing as they dropped in price from the recommendation and the purchase. They are very comfortable, quite loud, pretty great bass for what they are. All in all, I love em, and I have suggested them to a few friends as well.

title: I love these earbuds!!
review:
I want to mention right away that I have small ears, and these are fitting just fine for me...that was my biggest fear when ordering initially because I didn't think these types of earbuds would stay in.

These are the best earbuds I've ever had! I'm one to listen to things like Critical Role or Distractible while I'm cleaning and such. They have great sound, and so far they have not died on me, although I don't think I've used them for more than 3 hours at a time. It's easy to tell when you're reaching your max bluetooth range, which happens to be almost at the end of the house for me. If you're reaching your limit (and plan to stay there for a while), simply move your phone to a closer spot.

Phone usage: I did not buy these for the phone usage, but I did try them out once, and they worked really well... although they apparently didn't work for my brother very well, but I think our cell service might be stronger where I am. There were a few times here and there it would get robotic, but it seemed to fix itself pretty quickly.

They are also VERY noise-cancelling! I was listening to some music while our Roomba was running...was literally watching it run 5 feet in front of me...did not hear it! If I let the dog outside, I tend to just have one earbud in.

title: Awesome product!
review: When you are hard of hearing, or want to watch tv and not disturb others, these are great!! Doesn’t affect volume on tv, so other people can hear at a lower volume, the earphones come already paired with transmitter, so ease of use!

title: Minnow
review: I used to have a couple of these fish shaped cable holders, that I loved using for my earphones. I can't find them but was excited to find these. I received them today and went to use one and IT's Too Small. It holds about Half of the cable. My old ones held the entire cable. These are nicely made, just too small.

title: Listen To This!
review: These are decent headphones for the price. The cable that came with it, I don't like. Lightweight and comfortable.

title: Not noise canceling
review:
My point of comparison is the very expensive earbuds from a very popular phone company, but even with that in mind, these aren't noise canceling. My noise isolating headphones block out more sound than these and, ironically, the most quiet I had when using these was when the recorded "noise canceling on/off" message would go off.

They are very comfortable and okay headphones, but unfortunately not what I needed.

title: Amazing sound.  Open, airy, detailed and smooth.
review: Bought this on the Black Friday discounted price and boy am I glad.  This sounds amazing paired with my Willsenton R8 tube amp.  Very premium looking, feeling and sounding product.  The popular Sony, Bose and other mainstream headphones can't compare.  I understand these only get better after a few hours of burn in.  The packaging, cables and materials all communicate a level of quality that is premium and worthy of the MSRP price.  The fact I got this at a deep BF discounted price only makes it all the more better.

title: Love these!
review: The perfect sounding, fitting and most comfortable active BT headphones.  The sound is surprisingly great with clear highs, natural midrange and solid bass. These are quite durable and my last pear lasted two years before Iran them through the washer. I tried a few others but came back to this one as nothing comes close in this price range.

title: Disappointed
review:
When I first tired these on, they felt so soft on my ears. They felt much heavier than my previous headset but felt really comfortable at first. I used them all week for work. I spend 8+ hours per day taking calls. I didn’t have high expectations. I wasn’t looking for an expensive wireless headset. The first day went well. Took just a couple minutes to connect to my laptop and Avaya. These lasted ALL day. Very nice when you don’t have much time to charge during the day. The mute mic worked perfectly. I love how the mic turns red when muted. So my daughter would know when I was muted so that callers didn’t hear her.

Day 2: connected as usual to laptop. I assumed that it would auto connect with Avaya once I logged in. WRONG. I’m sitting there reading emails and wondering why several minutes pass with no calls. I was horrified to find out that someone was on my line. I heard no sound! The person could not hear me. After a couple minutes of “hello?” The person hung up. I had to reboot my computer to get the headset working but it worked fine th test of the day.

Day 3-5: every morning connection issues. This headset would just lose connection and there was no notification that the connection was lost! This happened the rest of the week. I’m not using this headset anymore. I can’t risk not hearing people.

I didn’t have any issues connecting to my laptop. All of my issues were with connecting to Avaya.

title: Perfect little case
review: Perfect case for my headphones. I do not have AirPods I have just the regular Apple headphones with the cord and this case hold them well when I wrap them up. exactly what I was looking for, I had to buy this case because my cats would keep eating my earphones, so I needed a place to store them. Attaches to my gym bag and good to go!

title: Great for small ears
review: I always have an issue with my headphones or earbuds causing me soreness since they are so petit. This set is perfect, I have not had an issue once. They’re comfortable and they don’t fall off and the sounds quality is acceptable for sure for the price. Not to mention it’s a headset as well. Awesome buy, definitely recommend.

title: Don't like
review: I'm updating my review on these earbuds. I do not like them for 2 reasons. They are bulky and do not fit in my ears. Any time I'm exercising and start to sweat, they fall out. I do have small ears though. If you have small ear openings, these are not for you. The other thing I dislike is the volume. When I'm mowing my yard, I cannot get the sound loud enough to hear over my mower. If I could return these, I would. I'm outside of my return window though. The one thing I do like is the color.

title: Exceeded Expectations
review: I was pleasantly surprised about the quality of these ear buds.  I purchased them for about $20 and though, 'eh', I will give them a try.  I have used them for a few weeks for audio and phone calls.  The audio quality is very good and haven't had any problems using them for phone calls.  The battery life so far seems to be good, but always put them into their charging case after I use them, so can't say how long they last on one charge.  The LED battery indicator on the charging case is nice so I know when to re-charge the charging case.  I have not tested them for bike riding to see how wind resistant they are, but I have worn them while working out inside and they have plenty of volume to drown out any other external noises.  The only con for me was the little, i mean little touch button is hard to feel, but for basic pausing a single touch works fine.  The only other thing was the size of the earbud.  It is one size, but that is normal for all buds and it fits comfortably in my ear.  There was no issues pairing this with a Samsung Galaxy 10, Samsung Galaxy S22 or a Sansa Clip MPS.  I would definitely recommend this product.

title: not very good sound quality
review: unfortunately, I was disappointed.  I have tried many of the bluetooth around head/neck earbuds and this one just doesn't cut it.  The speakers sound tinny and there is no noise cancellation, so when using these for bike riding it sounds like you are in wind tunnel.  Price was reasonable, but doesn't compare to Jaybirds X3,X4 or Helm Audio earbuds.  Save your money for something with better sound quality.

title: great looking watch and great for running and biking
review:
I really like this watch. I replaced and old forerunner. (many generation old) It feels great and looks good since you can download and tailor the watch faces. I have downloaded music to it using MediaMonkey and it worked fine. So far, synching with earbuds Jaybird Tarah Pro and Vistas, has been good. The availability of watch faces and activity widgets is nice.
But
Be warned, it takes a little bit to set it up and understand how to understand how to download and update activity widgets. Updating of watch faces isn't too bad. Be patient and read the user guide, there is a lot of functionality you should be aware of whether you use them or not.

title: Love This Little Radio!
review:
It's compact yet pulls in same stations as larger radios, has good sound, can be used with AC outlet, batteries, or rechargeable batteries which recharge in the radio when you plug it in! Batteries sold separately. Also, has weather alert with NOAA weather station. You can also set 19 favorite stations, AM & FM, & I love that it has a clock display. It also has clock alarm & earphone jack. This would make a nice travel radio/clock.

It's small & light enough to carry with you from room to room but no handle to do so. You just pick up the whole radio - its that small & light - but then you have 1 less hand to carry something else. I'm going to make a slinged pouch out of netting I can put it in for walking around. In the house, its loud & clear enough to turn the volume up & hear in more than 1 room.

title: Impeadance matching transformer
review: Used to replace output transformer in old vacuum tube radio sets. Also a good 2000 ohm winding to replace headset in old receivers during speaker conversions. About the only ones available anymore. Work as well as the old USA made ones from decades ago. Arrived with the mounting ears bent a little, but simple to straighten them with ordinary plyers. Have bought several over the years. 1/8 watt tap is very high impeadance and is usable with tubes needing a specific load.

title: Great sound, cord links and fit
review: I’ve only had my headphones for two days but I really like them so far. I cannot use wireless on my TV so I’m really happy that I found headphones with such a long cord. Because now at least I can move around a little bit. They have a great volume, great sound and they fit good.The first night I use them I actually fell asleep with them on my head. LOL no problems here

title: Not worth it.
review: So disappointed i got these brand new and the left earbud was not making any sound. This apparently is a common issue i checked the forums and tried all the possible workarounds. They all seem to be lucky inconsistent attempts to kick it back into gear. Mine after working on it all day still doesn’t work. I hate dealing with returning purchases for a refund. But paying $40 to deal with this is an issue for me. If it is for you reading this. I wouldn’t give it a try. Don’t buy these. I hear their other dash headphones have a ton of common issues too. Not worth.

title: Great headphones
review: I replaced my MPOW similar priced headphones with these and I love them.  The bass is much better, especially when I use bass button on the headphones along with the EQ on my iPhone.  Anker products have always been great quality and reliable for me.

title: Can't recharge the headphones
review: The headphones were great -- I really liked them.  But about three months after I got them, something went wrong with the micro-SD cable slot on the headphones, and the cable cannot connect to it and I cannot recharge them.  So I have a beautiful pair of headphones that are absolutely useless.  In addition, contacting and getting information from the seller has been impossible.

title: Good for kids
review: It is not bad. Small with simple controls. OK as a source for a surround sound, but for headphones, pretty flat sound. Probably fine for voice, not music.

title: Good for Sony 2  5/8 inch
review: Great fit and comfort. The original pads went bad pretty fast. Easy to put on and a velcro strap and clip for the cord was included. My headphones were just as good as when I bought them.

title: Audio output for my laptop
review: My laptop has an audio jack but it worked with some devices and not with others. The sound was not loud enough either. Now I can use headphones or input the audio to a surround sound. Worked plug and play.

title: Decent Headphones
review: I don't care for earbuds and these were white to match my uniform. I added foam pads as they were a bit uncomfortable, the sound was good...a little lacking in bass compared to my Sony Sport headphones, but overall I was quite pleased.

title: The headset the sound is very good in it But what I don't like about it ...
review: The headset the sound is very good in it  But what I don't like about it is you can't control the sound of the people you're talking to  You raise the volume on the headset  so you can hear the people you're playing with and then everything else is too loud you cannot control the volume

title: Quality
review: Sounds great, seems very well built.  Works as a mini antenna if your phone has an FM tuner chip.  As an antenna, it sn't as good as headphones, but it works ok.

title: Microphone Stopped Working Quickly
review: Buds are too small and the microphone feature and the button stopped working after less than two weeks after purchase. Worst headphones I ever brought, I do not recommend.

title: Fantastic Headphones at a steal!
review: Terrific headphones, the sound quality is something like Apple itself would have, deep base it's almost surround sound. Plus it comes with all the great volume buttons attached to the right ear bud so you can adjust the sound with a push of the button AND it has a mic so you can talk hands free. I'm so glad I ordered these, I'll be buying more!

title: God quality product if it fits your ears.
review: Good quality and everything but the right side kept falling off, I have a rather small head & ears. I had to return the headset, it was not an issue, amazon returned the money right away. I liked the headset, it is a good product if it fits you.

title: I now have one in my TV in my bedroom and one for my computer.
review: I wear my earphones all around my apt.  Switch the cord when I could have the extensions wherever I need them

title: Amazon had everything you need and want!
review: I get my reality headset set up with that device I really can't thank you enough!

title: Heavy
review: The earphones won’t stay in my ears no matter which ear bud size I use - they are too heavy and fall out if I move my head.  Every time I touch them at all I seem to accidentally skip or pause my music as well.  The sound quality seems good when they’re in & the battery life seems to be very good.  I rarely use them though because they fall out too much.

title: Good product
review: I gave it five stars for adhesion and thickness even though neither actually apply. It’s not thick, which it shouldn’t be. And it has no adhesion. It has a clamp. It works as intended and the holder for the headphones flip up if you need it out of the way.

title: Broke after 4 months
review: I bought these on 4/29/2022. Today is 9/9/2022 and these headphones have stopped working. We were gentle with them too. I expect headphones to last longer than this. Will not buy again.

title: Five Stars
review: It works! I use it with the Sony ICF38 Portable AM/FM Radio and some cheap headphones at work.

title: Better than anticipated for the price
review:
I do loose connection and have to fight it a bit to properly switch between my iPad and iPhone. It likes to connect to last used device. Occasionally, the sound gets garbled, and I do not know why, but it's rare.

I have trouble with all earbuds staying in my ear. I think they are different sizes. So, since it came with multiple ear piece covers, I switched them to different ones, and that seems to help. They are pretty comfortable. The sound quality is good. The charger case is very nice. I always worry about loosing earbuds.

I would purchase again.

title: Fits my small ears/head
review: I had the previous generation of this headset so I knew what I was getting. When I get glasses/hats I have to buy adolescent sizes (preteen-teen), so this headset fits me well at the smallest adjustment. I can still hear people if I have no sound or low sound while wearing which is what I prefer. The sound quality is satisfactory.  There are volume controls on the side that easily can be pressed against my chair... so I have to be aware of it and maybe use the clip that is on the back of it (it slips over clothing doesn't actually 'clip'). the cord is longer I believe than the other generation. Aside from the logo and the sound perhaps being a bit better it is essentially like the previous version I had purchased.

title: Good sound quality, Not Durable
review: Had to drop my review from 5 to 3 stars. I still think the sound quality, volume, and charge on both case and earbuds are fantastic but I'm on my second pair, after one of the buds died after ~6 months, and now one of the buds has again gone almost completely silent after less than 2 months. Pretty disappointed

title: Sounds amazing
review: I bought it straight off the carwires website (it was cheaper + free shipping). I was surprised with how good it sounds. It's as clear as my earphones! Love it

title: Does not work with headset with boom Mic.
review: I bought this to use my headset on my Iridium sat. Phone.  I could hear alright, but could not talk through Mic.

title: Long battery life
review: I’ve had these headphones for a year now since I bought them. I am an avid runner and use them at the gym. They have been great and are only just now giving issues with retaining battery life. Before, I could use them for an average of 2-3 workouts (averaging an hour each time) before needing to charge them. Sometimes I would forget and walk away from my phone and they had about a 15-20 foot range before losing signal. They don’t take long to charge to full power again and sit on my ears wonderfully, even for the most intensive workouts.  I would highly recommend them for the price and anyone looking for a great set of starting Bluetooth headphones.

title: An absolutely terrible headset
review: My boss bought this for me to use instead of my phone sometimes and they are the worst. While I can hear and talk through them perfectly fine. It constantly picks up the smallest amount of sound. My phone dings and 5 seconds later I hear that same ding in the headset. We have a set of train tracks outside the building and the train rolls by and I can hear it in my headset. It's the worst! Why is there so much playback?? I tried reading the instruction booklet, maybe there is a feature to adjust but there is nothing. These headphones are the absolute worse. I'm about to buy some of my own to use at work cause these are TRASH.

title: Five Stars
review: Sounds great, easily replaced my last set, and I love having the easily accessible headphone and mic jacks.

title: Battery goes for days
review: This light-weight, comfortable headset is amazing.  The battery lasts for days.  I use it at work, 8 - 10 hours a day and charge it on weekends.  It lasts all week long.  I use it pretty regularly through the day and have not had any problems understanding anyone or anyone understanding me.  It will pick up some surrounding noise if you are in a loud environment or outside.  My wife always says she can hear the birds.  The earbuds come with some size options and once you get used to having it there, you barely notice it.  The magnets work like a charm to hold the earbuds and will help placing them properly.  The wires are tied back with adjustable rings to keep them from getting in the way.

title: Worth the money
review: I have owned other earbuds and nothing compares.  Good price on Amazon and I will never buy another brand after having these.  Noise cancellation is great and so comfortable to wear!  Very happy!!

title: Great Headphones
review: I have multiple wireless headphones and while they are all good, these are my favorite.  I love that they recharge in the little case and fit my ear perfectly!  They come with a few different sizes so you can find what fits you best.  The case seems to hold a charge for a fairly decent amount of time.  Very pleased with this item!!

title: Easy to Install
review: I bought this for my iPad Pro and it is easy to install and works immediately when I put my earphons on into it. It made the volume loud and made a better headphone experience.

title: Gaoye G1000 3.5mm Jack HD Stereo Wired Earphones Gold-plated Noise Isolating Sweatproof Headphones Sports Earbuds 1.2M with buil
review:
I am the kind of person who keeps having to buy new headphones every month due to damage or dissatisfaction. When it comes to earphones, there is quite a variety in design and style, but not much variation in the functionality of the product. So i was quite impressed to see the features the Gaoye G1000 Earphones provided and it made me curious enough to want to give them a try.
Although i was not sure what to expect, I was quite pleasantly surprised with what i received. All the while looking quite fancy and sleek, this pair of earphones has one of the best audio qualities that i have ever experienced from everyday headphones. The audio that flows through the cords and out the earpieces is as crisp and clear as a breeze on a cold winter day. I did not even have to put the volume of my device on maximum in order to enjoy my tunes, the beat and bass levels of the headset being impressive.
Another thing that goes its way is that it isolates sound- despite being loud and clear, the music does not spill or scatter, and for the user, it seems as if any external sound has been cancelled.
All in all, i really enjoyed using the Gaoye G1000 Earphones- I still am- and recommend it to anyone who is sceptical about the unfamiliar brand.

title: Paww Over Ear Headphones
review:
I have always found it to be quite annoying when you are trying to relax and listen to some tunes, and other people disregard that fact and talk over you. The constant mumbling that rests at the back of your eardrums is truly annoying. Which is why when i came across WaveSound 2 Over Ear Headphones, i decided to take my chances and give it a try. And i am pleased to say that i was not disappointed.
The headphones do what they claim to- they block of extra noise quite well to ensure you enjoy whatever you are listening to without any interruptions. Add to that the fact that it is cordless and works seamlessly over bluetooth, and you have yourself a winner. So far, i have been enjoying using these WaveSound 2 Over Ear Headphones wherever and whenever, as the custom built holding case makes it the perfect companion for travelling. It became my best friend over a hiking trip and is my companion to all places I visit!

title: Good quality until they broke
review: I really loved these headphones, and they worked well for talking with headphones for 6 months. Then, one day, I pulled out the earbud (as I always did) and a wire was exposed from the ear bud. The sound stopped working in that ear. I tried seeking a refund from Hexteria Solutions, who only offered a $1 refund even though the headphones were within their one year warranty. As such, I would not recommend these headphones or this company.

title: Stopped working - Don't Buy
review: These headphones started having static 35 days after purchase. I was no longer able to return them. Now they do not work at all after less than 2 months. I took good care of them and rarely used them. They are obviously poorly made. I would not recommend this product.

title: It's a headset
review: It's a headset. It's comfy to wear over long durations. The sound is good enough for me

title: Nice earbuds
review:
Actual Apple earbuds. Come packages from Apple. So far so good.
Good sound and pretty comfortable in my ears

title: Great Item for a little girl.
review: My daughter loves her headphones because they are very comfortable and the quality is good.

title: Great headphone and customer service
review: I love these headphones, although the 1st set suddenly stopped working, they are still great.  Contacted Customer Service and and they responded right away and had another pair shipped to me.  I received them in 2 days.  They are comfortable, pretty good sound quality.  I like them better than the ones my husband bought for about 4 times the price and his don't even fold or retract.  Battery life is awesome.!!!

title: everybody needs a 35 foot Toslink Cable
review:
I have my 35 foot Optical audio cable running from my LCD TV to my Tritton Headset. I hate having cable running all over the floor so I got this one so I could move the Tritton base next to my couch moving the bulk of the cabling to where it could be coiled and managed without laying in tangles or knots on the floor.
Thanks to the Superior quality of the Blue rigger cable I can do this with confidence and not feel like I did with my last digital optic cable which looks more like a really thin straw than a cable.

title: Accurate reproduction? No.
review:
If you like all bass and all treble, and no mid-range, then these are the earbuds for you. If you care about audio quality, steer clear. These drastically change the audio quality of whatever you are listening to. I thought I'd get these to have a nice rich sound, but in order to sound rich, you need the whole spectrum. Instead I got a hole in the spectrum, right where most audio lies.

It's too bad, I generally like A/T products. This one really misses the mark.

title: Better that expected
review: this is an awesome earbud. only issue i have had is when i am outside it breaks up. it's possible that the aluminum around me is causing it. other than that. it's great

title: Great product. So glad I bought it. Fantastic price.
review: Comfort, sound, battery life, noise cancelling and price are the best things about these headphones. What more can you ask for. I am so glad I bought these. One of my Best Buy’s of the year.

title: Excellent replacement for my computer's sound!
review: I'd bought a 3 piece system not too long ago that died quickly. The subwoofer was still good but the speakers went out quickly. Needed something for the pc as its what I use for home projection system, and I wanted connections for mic and headphone. Gave this a try and was totally surprised at the clarity. I was happy that I could place it near my mixing board and use it for voice over work too. This frikkin' rocks.
I LOVE my new earbuds.  The are sleep, soft, and comfortable.  I have very sensitive ears and small canals, so the smallest pair of covers are perfect.

title: Better range than $136 Samsung earbuds!
review: The range on these earbuds is amazing! I left my phone in my bathroom, walked to the kitchen, and even out to my backyard! I didn't hear any static until I walked into the detached garage. Way better range with less static than my $136 Samsung buds live. I haven't tried taking a call yet, so I don't know about mic quality.

title: Don't get frustrated.
review:
When you first get this watch, you need to make sure you leave it on the dock, after pairing to make sure the system updates, otherwise the watch will not work properly.
You have to have Google hangouts for messageing.
My battery lasts a couple of days. I can leave my phone in the kitchen, wear a bluetooth headset and receive messages she phone calls throughout my house without having my phone in my pocket. As soon as I figured it or I loved it!

title: Fantastic headset
review:
I saw a complaint or two about the buzzing sound that people were hearing: Just want to say that's the noise cancellation...it's white noise. It can be turned off if you don't like it.

Otherwise, this headset is great. Battery life lasts about 2 full days (as in a full 48 hours without being turned off). Found this out the hard way lol. Bluetooth works, the mic works great and the sound quality is wonderful.

title: Good for the price
review:
It’s cute, works well, and has jacks on the side for headphones to plug in. Only thing I don’t like is that you can’t choose a static color. Really can’t complain for the price though.

I’ve had it a couple weeks now and it’s still working fine

title: VERY comfortable
