review: These earphones amaze me.  I just wanted something for casual use (I'm no audiophile) and didn't expect too much at this price point.  WRONGO!!!  Sound is great, but what sticks out to me is 1:  Comfort - I actually forget that I am wearing them.  They are light on the head and NOT sweaty.  2:  Pairing is the easiest I've ever had.  They seem to snap at whatever is near.  Very nice!  An extra feature is the fact the Tribit can be used wired or wireless.  It comes with the cable.  AND, there is a clamshell hard case thrown in, too!  Got my lead on this set from a pro review online (not Amazon) where the guy stressed the great value.  He is 100% correct.  IMHO this is one of the best buys on the market.

title: Excellent earpads
review:
I got these for my dt770's so that my ears wouldn't touch the speaker inside. They do their job well. They technically fit loose on the headphones because the stretchy pat can go way over the part on the dt's. But they still are centered and work well. Seeing that they weren't made specifically for my headphones I cant complain about that.

Would buy these again for another pair of headphones if I ever needed to.

title: Fit perfectly
review: Fit a pair of Sony headphones that I’ve had for years perfectly. Saved me from having to buy a new pair.

title: These things run small
review: I don't have a huge head, but these headphones don't quite cover my ears (also not huge). The headband is too short, and yes I unfolded them. I gave them to my teenager and they fit her fine.

title: GREAT price - Superior Quality!
review: Our entire family are musicians and we all have our own in ear headphones - with different preferences for singing and hearing balance of voice and instruments while recording.  My husband purchased my Shure 300 series as a gift for me - his are the Shure 400 series.  Mine were ok for two years but then he purchased me Bose in ear headphones.  I was unhappy with the quality of the ones we could afford in the $150 price range... then we found the Sennheiser IE6 Dynamic In-Ear Headphones - they are AWESOME!!  Nice range of depth - highs and especially the lows.  I would recommend if you can't afford to have in ear headphones made specifically for your ears - you may consider these.

title: Fantastic Earbuds
review:
At first I was skeptical, so bought a pair of EarPods instead. I was disappointed with the fit, sound, and noise cancellation so returned them. I then ordered these and was blown away by how comfortable they are, the effectiveness of the noise cancellation, and best of all the sound. To my ears these are the best earbuds I have ever owned. The sound is deep, rich, and present, and is great for all kinds of music. They only connect to one device at a time, but that's not a big deal to me. They sound great on the phone too. I have already used them for over 20 hours and am very pleased.

The only criticism I had was that there was no volume control, which is a real issue if you plan to use these with devices like Apple TV where there is no Bluetooth volume control on the device. I got a very pleasant surprise when Bose released an upgrade that added volume control by sliding your finger up and down on the right earbud. Perfect!

Though pricy, I would highly recommend these.

title: Great Customer Service and Got an Upgrade!
review: Tozo customer service reached out to me after seeing my review. They sent me a new pair of the headphones and they’re actually better than the ones I had ordered. So far I’ve had no issues. I appreciate their customer service and how they want to ensure their customers are happy and satisfied with their products!

title: Great Buds For Chromebooks
review: These are fantastic for Google Chromebooks! I’m an educator, and many of my students are not able to afford expensive earbuds. These are perfect. Another teacher gave me a pair to use with a student with focus issues, and I immediately bought a couple of sets and assigned them to specific students that needed help focusing. These earbuds are not perfect, but they do block out some surrounding noise, and the sound is a good quality that stays instead of coming and going.

title: stay in my ears and is comfortable. perfect for the runner who has trouble finding ...
review: stay in my ears and is comfortable.  perfect for the runner who has trouble finding earphones that don't fall out

title: Very nice hard case !!
review: I love this case!! The protection is outstanding and fits perfectly with my Apple AirPod Pro earbuds. I’m daughter loved it so much she purchased one. It’s beautiful too!! And I love the wrist strap vs the key ring. I purchased the pink marble. So pretty!!

title: Impressed!!!!
review: I am really impressed by these headphones!! Cute little storage and they work pretty darn good for what I use them for. ( watching movies in bed :). ) For the sale price I veiled them for .... I’m very happy. The rose color is very pretty too!

title: Great headphones.
review: Great headphones...love that the cord is only on one side! Pretty tight fit, I can only wear them for a little bit but they are perfect for my 9 year old

title: cute little MP3 Player
review: This is a great little item for my 4 year old. We have a bunch of music for her but won't allow her to wear headphones at this young age so, this cute little box is perfect. She has figured out how to work it herself so it's not difficult to work.

title: Not great
review:
Updated review after using for a week:

They fade out every couple minutes randomly. They don't lose the connection per se, there's just a sound-drop. They're getting better about it -- at first they were unlistenable. Now it's once every 15 minutes or so.

Note that these are not true "low latency" earbuds. They do NOT use the AptX-LL technology. They are merely BT 5.0 which offers lower latency than 4.2. If you are watching videos of people talking, as I often do, you will notice a slight lip sync issue. 60ms latency is generous, I'd say closer to 100-150ms.

There doesn't seem to be any difference between "music mode" and "game mode." Since this doesn't switch between, say, AptX and AptX-LL, it can't do much to reduce latency over and above standard BT 5.0.

The looks are ok. They're more dark silver and not as white as is pictured. These came completely discharged which was worrying.

title: Excellent Sound
review: Loved these earbuds, noise cancellation worked great, great sound, and I love the case that charges the buds when docked by magnet.  Great Product.

title: It's good enough for me
review: Unit takes a long time to recharge. I had it plugged into the usb port on my computer and after about 3 hours it still hadn't recharged.  I finally just plugged into a wall plug.  Took about 6 hours to charge.  I am not sure how the sound cancelling works, but I had construction going on in my house and I put the headphones on to reduce noise, but it didn't seem to work that well.  My cheapy sound suppressors that I use when working with my chain saw seem to work just as well.  I've listened to some videos on youtube and facebook and in that capacity the headphone works fine for me.

review: In LOVE with these!! Legit I am the pickiest workout gal on Amazon and these are my absolute must have. Cannot say enough good about these headphones. Sound quality is unmatched. Great battery life, they stay in place and are (so far) completely sweat resistant.

review: I read most of the reviews before I bought this head set need it for online lessons for my embroidery machine software, never dreamed they would sound so good, I'm listening to music right now and it sounds amazing.  Very happy with this head set, been wearing them for over an hour and they are not too tight for me, some people say they fit too tight.  They do have a slide adjustment on both sides to help make them fit better, which I find really help. I'm very pleased with this headset. I was surprised with the good reviews that I decided to give it a shot and they work wonders still! I bought them in August and these are still bringing joy to my ears. The sound is great! Such a low price for great earbuds!

title: I like these headphones that really work and I don't have ...
review: I like these headphones that really work and I don't have to keep putting them back in my ears. The others always fall out!!!

title: Better and less expensive than an Audioflood!
review:
I've been using it for about 2 months now and so far so good! I swim 2-3 times per week in a pool and open water. Decent sound quality and battery life. I can go about a month between charges (a low battery light or indicator of some sort would be nice, but it's not a big deal!) I recommend following the directions for how to loop through your google strap as the earphones will stay in the ears better. Loss of 1 star as it's a bit too bulky to clip to my goggle straps so I have to strap it to my swim suit strap. Not hard for a woman but might not be so great for a guy!

I previously owned an Audioflood (waterproofed ipod shuffle). It was expensive and quit accepting a charge after less than a year. I love this as a less expensive replacement! Works and sounds better!

I recommend!

NOTE: RINSE AND ALLOW TO DRY after each swim!!!!

title: It don’t do much
review: It holds up your headset which I guess is better but then the pad for your head gets pushed in. Take it or leave it

title: Best sound quality for the price!
review: I really like these Bluetooth the sound quality is very good, the price you can't beat I do have an issue with the earbuds they don't seem to fit as well as others. They lose their flexibility after a while. However these are the best Bluetooth quality sound I have purchased.

title: Better than most
review:
These are better than the other two Bluetooth I've gotten, the sound quality is good, battery life is normal.
You get a good product for a small price. The earbuds themselves I have a problem with keeping them in my ear I have tried both pairs. However that all being said they are still the best ones I purchased so far

title: Works great
review: I received this and set it up on the same day very easy to do I'm now able to get my spectrum app for cable TV much faster than the Roku 2.. as I ordered this refurbished I did buy the 4-year warranty and figured that I couldn't go wrong.  The new rokus for my bedroom TV we're just overkill and did not want to pay the high price.  I use this in a bedroom in an apartment building and use the headphone feature while watching TV at night so I do not disturb my neighbor. This is a great Roku would buy this again.

title: simple design, excellent function and comfort!
review: The sound quality for all types of TV watching with these headphones is amazing. Simple design, excellent function and comfort! My last MDR-DS6500 was falling apart after 5 1/2 yrs of constant happy use and I couldn’t find replacement headphones for the still-functioning base unit. Thrilled to find another set from an outside seller, but seems I got the last new set existing. Tried a cheaper Sony model but didn’t like the sound. A newer model of comparable price has complicated settings I don’t need or want. Sony, please keep making this model of digital optical rechargeable headphones!

title: Better than much more expensive in-ear headphones
review: These in-ear headphones have a super sound, fit well in the ear, and have 3 sizes of ear pieces. I got them for my husband for Christmas and he loves them. I'm ordering another pair for me!

title: Comfortable, seamless Skype integration, and impressive range
review: Truly amazing!  Using with Skype 4 Biz and the integration was seamless.  The range on this thing is unbelievable - I've gone out of my house and walked around the yard about 75 feet from the docking station and had perfect clarity the entire time.  Charges quickly and i have yet to run it out of battery in a single day, or even a couple days.  Amazing little piece of technology.  Also the most comfortable headset I've ever worn.

title: Is this a JOKE?
review:
You have no idea how SMALL this rack is. Seriously!!
What is this? A mini-headset holder for squirrels?
NO, I do NOT recommend.

title: Unable to "Pair"
review:
Bluetooth was supposed to give me a prompt to pair "W7", but did not.
I couldn't pair with my laptop, nor could I pair with my phone.
Too bad. I liked the design of the headset.

title: Blocks out Background Noise Well ...
review:
Sound is excellent.
The buds fit well and block out background noise, which is why I got them.
However, just be aware, IN THE QUESTION AND ANSWER SECTION:
"The earbuds can only be paired with one Bluetooth device at a time. There are 2 ways to connect them with the 2nd device: removing the old pairing data on the 1st device; OR reset the earbuds then pair them, thanks for your question."

EDIT:
(3 weeks later)
I took OFF 2 stars because of not being able to go from laptop to phone.
Why do I have to UNpair to switch?
The manual was difficult for me to understand.
When I TRIED unpairing from my laptop to switch to my phone, I couldn't pair with the phone because I got a prompt saying, "incorrect PIN or passkey".
What????
WHERE is the PIN or passkey?
The booklet had NO pin or passkey, and I have NO clue how the earbuds ever paired with my laptop in the first place.
I decided to keep the buds anyway and use only on my laptop.
Guess what? The earbuds will no longer pair to my laptop.
Frustrating!

title: Great earbuds.
review: Good headphones the noise cancellation works and there is amazing sound quality and the headphones last for like 10 hours.

title: The backup that wasn't there when I needed it
review:
I use my computer alone with headphones on 90% of the time, but sometimes you need speakers. I bought these for those times. They sounded just fine, but they spent most of their life in the original box, unused. Last year I was entertaining a guest and went to plug them in, but found them dead as a doornail. Maybe a few hundred hours of use total and given the lightest treatment a device could ask for.

My dad has speakers from 30 years ago that have been through multiple moves, water damage, smoke, pets, heavy usage, and still work like new. Speakers haven't changed radically since then, and dying this quickly is just pathetic.

title: Falling apart :(
review: Headphones sound great, and work really well.  Bought them for hubby as a Christmas gift in 2015.  Too bad the covers are disintegrating, and soon, will be completely missing.  For the price, this item is not worth the expense.

title: Wonderful!
review: FINALLY...........Finally a in-ear headphone at actually works for me! The shape of these ear buds makes it so much more comfortable than others I have tried. You can't see it from the picture, but the ear bud part of this "off set" allowing part of this headphone to sit nicely in the open part of your ear. It's kind of hard to explain, and maybe the description of this headphone on the website might explain it better. Regardless, I am so tickled that I have finally found an inexpensive headphone that doesn't hurt my ear and stays in place.

title: I normally don't write reviews until after 30 days of using the product but this is a good case
review:
First, I bought a pair of Sony Noise Cancelling Headphones WH-CH700N: Wireless Bluetooth Over the Ear Headphones with Mic and One Touch Control AINC Digital Noise Cancellation – Blue and they fit like a glove! It's as if the case was specifically designed for these headphones.
Secondly, the build quality is very sturdy and hard, your headphones would be safe if dropped from a reasonable distance of about 5 feet, however, the zipper is a little flimsy but again not a deal breaker...inside the case, there is plenty of room, the top part of the case has a net to store wires and other small components like an MP3 or maybe a headphone amp but definitely not a phone.
Thirdly, there is a chemical smell but it's not overwhelming enough to be a deal breaker and it doesn't transfer to your hands, clothing or backpack but I do wash my hands after handling the product. The manufacturer suggests spraying perfume on it but I suggest using Febreze or room spray.
Conclusion: It's a very good case for the price and I would recommend it and buy it again...Look for my other reviews they are coming soon.

title: Great for non wireless headphones
review: We use it with our older, less expensive wired headphones and headsets.  Works great for what we want

title: quality product and sound
review: These headphones are extremely comfortable over ear and fit snug. They are versatile, and the sound quality and workmanship I would rate excellent. They far exceed the SONY phones I had on every level, and paid basically the same price for these as I did the SONY. Very satisfied.

title: Very light headed
review: This is the 2nd pair I've purchased over the years. I accidentally sat on the pair, but I wear them while in bed, and my wife doesn't want to listen to whatever I have on. They were/are gotten for my wife, because she loves the light weight & covers her ear perfectly. She is not a sound officionado  like myself, so the sound quality is plenty good enough for her. The comfort & light weight is why I use the broke, but useable pair in bed. I have a pair of very good full ear phones on my "MAIN" stereo, which my wife doesn't appreciate. She is a totally no-tech female that thinks the speakers on her laptop are fine. SO these headphones have their usefullnes, they don't sound horrible, but if you want hi-tech sound quality, these aren't it, but doesn't mess up your hair either. Great if you don't like stuff (buds) stuck in your ear.

title: as in MUCH better.
review: Exactly what I wanted & accurate description. Just wanted to extend my wired earphone reach a little more than with the cable I already have. Make SURE you choose gold plated cable for anything, be it HDMI, this, whatever, because there IS a difference, as in MUCH better.

title: Comfortable wear, fantastic sound
review: I ordered these at the beginning of the pandemic (March 2020) and have been using them for hours during the workday ever since.  They are comfortable, even for extended wear, and the sound quality is spectacular. I have not had issues with the drivers at all, just plug them into a computer and they work.  I am happy to say my original pair is still going strong, after 15 months of heavy use.  I did notice that the wire that runs through the plastic headpiece is not stuck on well, and one section came nearly all the way out of the groove it was housed in.  I fixed it though, by filling the groove with black sugru. Not only did it hold very well, the color match was so perfect the headset looks like it was manufactured that way.  Yes they could have done a little better sealing the wire in, but even so, I still bought a second pair of these for my house as I really enjoy using them.

title: Poor headphones, great case
review: I used to have cases like these ages ago and misplaced them over the years. Happy to see they are still available.  They keep the headphones protected and take up such a small space.  At such a cheap price, I purchased these so I would have a nice case to go with my Sennheiser earbuds, which fit perfectly even with the foam covers.  I did try the JVC earbuds and they sounded pretty tinny compared to the Sennheiser ones.  Go with the Sennheisers for sound and these for organization.

title: Works very well
review:
I"ve owned 2 other Moto Bluetooth Headsets & have found them to be comfortable & clear when talking. I decided to try the H17 after having a Plantronics Discovery 925 that didn't work well for me. I have issues with ear fit, so I prefer a headset that has an ear loop.

I bought the Moto H17 new. The price on Amazon was very reasonable compared to prices at my local retailers. My headset arrived in a timely fashion & packaged as advertised.

I've been using the H17 for a few months now. I like the comfort & compact design. When you open the flip switch, a voice tells you the battery level. I experience good call clarity & battery life. I'm not a heavy user, I mainly use it when out & about on errands & sometimes when driving when family members might need to reach me.

title: Excellent product
review: I typically don't care for in-ear headphones but got these so I can talk on my cell while doing chores around the house.  They not only came the same day, but they fit my S21+ perfectly and the sound is great!  I'm so glad I took the plunge and purchased them.  Also love the little case they came with.  Great price for everything.

title: Deeply discounted for a reason...
review: Like a few others had mentioned in their reviews, the bluetooth on these is barely functional.  I've connected to a few devices and it is definitely the headphones that intermittently cut out rendering these pretty useless.  I've connected with the provided cable and the sound is ok, as is the noise cancellation.  For me, they are fairly comfortable up to about an hour, after that their is just a little too much pressure on my ears causing soreness.  Overall, bluetooth headphones that don't have functioning bluetooth are just overpriced wired headphones.  Be prepared to be underwhelmed.

title: Great case
review: Fits my headphones perfectly.  Has enough extra storage for charger and cables and was a great price.

title: Decent, inexpensive headphones
review: Are these as good as a Bose or Sony?  Nope.  But they also are much under the $300 price-tag of those high end headphones.  I get a little static every once in a while connecting to my tv an the and sound sync to the picture is occasionally off by a half second or so.  These are very functional headphones at a great price-point, well worth the purchase.

title: Amazing sound quality
review: Just got these headphones yesterday and so far I love them!  I'm not very knowledgable about the ins and outs of audio quality, but I've been comparing them to the Jabra bluetooth headphones that I've had for about 14 months (and which recently began to malfunction).  The sound quality is amazing on these headphones, I'm hearing details in the music I've never even noticed before.  It's like the difference between seeing a scene in 2D on a photo or television vs. 3D in real life.  The headphones are also lighter in weight than the Jabra.  The controls are also easy to use while the headphones are still on your head.  Jabra's touch-sensitive controls (work sort of like a laptop trackpad) never worked well, even brand new.  The only downside I've found so far is that my ears hurt if I have the headphones on for more than a couple of hours.  I do have a big head.  The Jabra headphones are also on-ear, but the padding was quite a bit softer and had more give.  The foam on the Bose headphones is definitely stiffer.  I'm going to give it time to see if either the foam becomes less stiff or my ears decide they can handle it, because the sound quality is so good that I am unwilling to return them.

title: little on the short side but...
review: works good if you just want to charge the headset did not really work well while wearing it due to 3ft if it was 5-6 ft would be awesome but does the job I needed it for so would recommend it!

title: No plug in for headphones!
review: I love how light this Kindle is but I can not get my wireless headphones to connect and I've tried and tried.  It easily connects to everything else I own.  NO BUILT IN PLUG FOR HEADPHONES is ridiculous!! One of the reasons I bought this was for Audible!  Now I can't use it for that.  Other then that I like it.

title: They don't recharge
review:
I ordered these, and they seemed to work great. But when the charge ran out, I discovered that the charger doesn't work right: one earbud seemed to recharge, but the other didn't. I sent it back and got a new set. This new set doesn't recharge at all. These things are useless. I can't understand why they have so many stars. Maybe everyone just rates them before trying to recharge them (the factory seems to charge them up fine, the charge just doesn't work). Or maybe this defect just started happening recently, in which case, you probably shouldn't trust the earlier reviews.

Very disappointed. Plus, I'm traveling now, so I don't know how I'll return them. And there's no way to contact the seller.

title: Best ones I have tried out of many different brands
review: These are the best I have tried,  after trying many different brands to find some that we're good,  the sound is amazing,  the fit is amazing and you can tell it is a quality made product.  They are very comfortable.  Just to add I have never left a review before on my Amazon purchases and this one I had to because these headphones are impressive!

review:

Cons

USB cable is very short (maybe 8 "?) , and fits very tight on to the headset. So tight , that you need to be very careful when disconnedting so as to not damage
No charger

Paired with an iPhone 7plus.. range was not quite as expected.. starts cutting out at about 20-25 feet..hoped for better ,but I can live with that.

title: Battery Performance
review: The battery performance is not as advertised.  Nor is the noise cancellation feature.  However, it is a good headset and value.

title: Nice headphones
review: Nice headphones for the money. Good sound, decent range. Helped my wife and I to enjoy different forms of entertainment without bothering each other

title: Money well spent
review: I'm very pleased that I spent the extra dollars for this device. Incredibly simple to set up. I've been told that others can hear me loud and clear on conference calls. No more headset for me!

title: 0 dongle and that was a little better, but it would drop incoming audio so people ...
review: I could never get it to work properly. The problem was with the bluetooth connection. I have a Dell Latitude laptop running Windows 7 Enterprise and I use a Cisco softphone for work. I would be in the middle of a call and it would disconnect while I was sitting at my desk. I bought a Kinovo 3.0 dongle and that was a little better, but it would drop incoming audio so people could hear me but I couldn't hear them. I contacted the support site but they couldn't recommend a specific BT dongle to use with it to resolve the problem so I eventually returned this headset and got a different one.

title: sounds like I'm in a tunnel
review: i guess you get what you pay for...the people who I talk to using it respond that they have problems hearing me, sounds like I'm in a tunnel, etc...I will only be using it as an emergency backup in case my headset has a problem.

title: Good buy!
review: Very quick to put on.  I have used this for the last five days at the gym - including doing alot of plyometric jumps - and my earbuds stay in!  Good product and would recommend

title: Do Not Buy.  Units shuts all the way down without hitting button
review:
The sound is amazing for such a value priced item. The units pairs quickly with my iPhone 6.
I have an issue with the stability of the bluetooth connection. With the phone within a few feet of the earbuds, I will occasionally receive a click with no sound and reconnection in maybe less than a second. Since this headphone has only been used with the iPhone 6, it is my impression the bluetooth electronics are not a stable as the product claims to have.
UPDATE
With a full battery charge, the bluetooth headphones will now shut-off without any provocation to doing so. I cannot use them anymore. Do Not Buy These

title: I love this
review: I take my chihuahua for long walks and I just love listening to the music.  I’m not comfortable wearing earphones and being unable to hear approaching cars and things going on around me.  I’m happy with the volume, the battery and the sound quality.  Great product for little money

title: Nice looking & very sturdy
review:
I purchased this for my adult son for Christmas. He absolutely loves it. He has had it for several years now and it is still working great. He was tired of his headphones just laying on his desk and broke 2 different pairs because they did not really have any place to be. This has helped him keep them safe and have his desk look nice when they are not in use.

The package arrived exactly as described and very quickly. I would purchase again from this seller, since the transaction went so well.

title: Better in person
review: I am one of probably a very few who still prefer a wired headset. A like Samsung headsets because of the sound quality. The red color is pretty and they don't get as easily tangled as my Apple wired set.

title: Very nice earbuds at a reasonable price
review:
I like to wear earbuds on planes instead of headphones. Easier to fall asleep with them on. A couple months ago I bought the TaoTronics earbuds with active noise cancelling. I needed another set for my wife so I decided to try the Sony MDRXB50AP which doesn't have noise cancelling. With TaoTronics, there is a huge background noise difference when noise cancelling is activated, at least when flying. Even though the Sony doesn't have noise cancelling, it does a good job blocking out the engine noise - about the same as TaoTronics with active noise cancelling.

It really does have extra bass. Wouldn't want any more. Overall sound quality is quite good.

The earbuds are reasonably comfortable, slightly better than TaoTronics. They don't easily fall out of my ears.

Unfortunately, I bought the headphones for $45, which is more than they cost now. However, I am still happy with the value. At today's price you can't go wrong. If I had to buy another set I would buy these and not the TaoTronics.

I have never listened to an expensive set of earbuds so maybe I don't know what I'm missing. However, I prefer using these over my Bose QC-15 headphones when I travel.

title: Disappointed. Ok for my usage but cheaply made
review: UPDATE!!  I DID NOT RECEIVE WHAT IS PICTURED AS BEING SOLD!!  I have checked every millimeter on these headphones and see NO company listed, other than the "The ONE" printed on the right side.  These cannot be Conambo, as advertised, and in fact, when I search the internet, they cannot be found!  They must be a cheap replacement, as the box is also generic, with no photo! No wonder there is NO noise-cancelling and they are disappointing!  Adding pictures of what I ordered, and what I received.  Unbelievable. Taking my review down to one star. Definitely not worth $40! I would hope the 'good reviews' received the actual correct product!  (original review ...earlier tonight>>> Noise cancelling?  I still hear everything going on around me. Disappointed.  Ok for my usage but cheaply made. The headphones could also use a touch of treble.

title: Great sound!
review: Sounds fantastic and super clear! The way the design sort of nestles in your ear is great for when you're running, they haven't popped out on me yet. Great quality all around, however the mic feature in them barely picks up my voice on calls but. Still this is designed to be sport ear buds, not a Bluetooth headset for phone calls. Battery life is great and overall I am very happy with them.

title: The audio isn't the greatest but the headphones are lightweight and work for playing ...
review:
The audio isn't the greatest but the headphones are lightweight and work for playing xboxlive which is a plus. You honestly get a better product than when you pay for.
My first pair lasted me about a year. Definitely willing to buy again.

title: The strap system is just the best for all-day wearability in all circumstances
review:
The strap system is just the best for all-day wearability in all circumstances,
esp. if coupled with a small clip-style music source (such as a Sansa clip),
as you can clip the music player to the strap and have not dangling cords
anywhere. As good for skiing or running as it is for hiking through tangled
undergrowth or gardening. The earpieces themselves are not the best, but
good enough for non-critical listening; I do wish there were replaceable -- that
the strap system was such that one could interchange earphones, as I have
not found anything that good for all outdoor activities and as the strap easily
outlasts the earphones themselves.

title: stinks but fabric freshener made if usable
review: cheapest yet great quality. i have to say the one star missing is because of the smell. we had to put a dryer sheet in it for several days and soak it in fabric freshener then air dry for 2 days before we could put in the headphones in this. do as i did and you will have a wonderful product! im buying 3 more for my kids headphones👍

title: Missing hole for headphones
review: Great case except I had to create my own hole for the headphones jack. Wonderful case. The NEXUS fits well and protected.

title: Easy to assemble
review: Arrives in a flat pack. Easy to put together. Not much taller than my headphones. Need to place it up higher to keep the charging cord from being bent sideways. Good purchase.

title: Protect the original case and easy to find
review: The soft gel cover protect the earbud case and the dark red color is easy to spot.

title: Poor quality
review: Bought these twice in a year and they failed both times. The right earbud failed in both occasions, the most recent time after a month. Steer clear

title: Get ready to lift your hand set every time you want to make a call.
review: Product works ok, but not as good quality sound and mic as my wired set, also I despise how it connects to the phone.  Instead of having the normal single plug connector to go into the hole that most phones have for headsets, instead it connects via RJ-11 jack into the hand set.  What a nuisance!  Now I have to lift the handset every single time I want to make a call instead of just pushing the "Headset" button on my phone.  Apparently this is a head set for people who don't use their phone 100 times a day like I do.  Ugh.

title: works well
review: Very easy to set up, works well. Picture quality is fine, audio also OK as far as I can tell. I have only used it twice and nobody has complained about what they are hearing. I use it for zoom and also used it for gaming a couple of times when my headset was not working.

title: work
review: They work as advertised. I'm not sure if it's the splitter or my speakers which were interfering with the headset to begin with but using the splitter people can hear me but say my voice is very muted. Without the splitter and without my speakers plugged in that is not an issue.

title: Good sound
review:
These speakers sound nice but aren't without problems. They interfered with my gaming headset, I was not able to use both at the same time. After some emailing with the manufacturer they finally sent me a diagram of how to hook it up using two splitter cables which I had to buy. I could only use the 3.5 mm plug in and everyone I talked to said I sounded very muted. The speakers do sound better using the USB connection, though you give up access to any control such as equalizers which you might have.

Since I had tried another set of speakers before getting these, Klipsch, which sounded better BTW but developed a vibration after two weeks of use and had to be returned, I ultimately decided to keep these. I just don't see any others online that would be as good. I now have had to abandon my headset and use the webcam for my gaming. If I need the headset, I have to unplug the speakers and plug in the headset. Since the plugs I have available are in the back of the computer this is awkward.

There shouldn't be any reason for this problem. Neither the Klipsch nor the ancient Dell speakers which both these newer speakers are replacing caused any conflict with the headset. Why the Kanto does I don't know.

title: Excellent sound isolation and very good audio quality
review:
Excellent sound isolation and very good audio quality. Almost as effective on airplanes as my much bulkier and heavier active noise cancelling headphones. Does start to hurt my ears after a couple of hours. Much easier to travel with than the headphones.

Update: I accidentally put these through the laundry, and THEY STILL WORK!!!!
Truly amazing.

title: very nice
review: Work well, very comfortable, keeps out much of the ambient noise and then the noise cancellation works on top of that.  Good sound quality.  Only drawback is the size; case is twice the volume of the old Sony NC headset I replaced.

title: Great deal for the price
review: Love my new earbuds! They work great and from a long distance away from my phone. Cheap, yet great quality. Would highly recommend.

title: I love these earbuds!
review: I love to listen to music and podcasts on the go, wired earbuds are OK but I find most of them uncomfortable after a short period. They not only cause discomfort, they fall out of my ears or are easily dislodged if they get pulled a little bit. The sound is crisp and clear and very comfortable to wear. I am very happy with the design and the clarity!

title: So far, very satisfied!!
review: I have a pair of middle of the road Sony earbuds. So far, these are just as good for half the price. We will see about longevity

title: Excellent quality, but...
review: Material and workmanship excellent; fit iPad mini 5 fine, but I needed a slot on top for headphone cable plug.

title: Design flaw
review: The volume up and volume down buttons are too close to the scan button. My 94 year old father frequently hits the scan button by mistake which, to him, turns off the headset.

title: Comfortable and useless
review: These were a pain to install and they are letting more sound in, than my original pair. The entire reason I have these headphones is so I don't have to listen to my idiot neighbor walking around all day and night.  So sound reduction is ESSENTIAL. I'll be buying the more expensive pair.

title: dependable player for car or home
review: The square shape is nice, and all the controls are well marked. It does not have great volume, but works well with earphones.

title: You get what you pay for
review: The previous reviews were good so I took a chance. They work for audio such as an audiobook and are okay-ish for something like a TV show. They are horrible for music. No bass and absolutely no noise canceling ability. The earbud tips are your typical cheap ones that slowly slide out of your ears. Would not recommend.

title: Very good buy
review: Just like the picture, very good quality, fast shipping. I have airpods, but I still like earphones too :)

title: Love them!
review: I tired a bunch of earbuds and these are awesome. Next in line we’re the Jabra earbuds but they didn’t feel secure.

title: Good but not for me
review: Earbuds like these apparently don’t work well for my anatomy, they felt bulky and like I would lose them easily. However, the jabra app is pretty cool and you get to tailor your sound, the noise cancellation and hear through works really well. The sensor that detects when the earbud is out is on point, playing when in and pausing when out. I didn’t like that the max volume wasn’t loud enough to block out airplane noise though, so that was another deal breaker. I feel overwhelmed with the amount of research I’ve done but CNET and the sound guys have good reviews.

title: Not just for women
review:
I bought 2 of these, the 2nd by mistake & it turned out to be a good mistake.
Love these headphone. Use all the time on treadmill & elliptical. The 2nd set - stays on my bicycle which I ride 4 times a week 10 mile circuit.
Read where these were recommended for women, I'm a 5'10" 220lbs definite man retired international oil driller & karate instructor.

title: Comfortable and Cute
review: Head phones work very well for my 7 year old granddaughter. She loves the color and the cute cat ears. Headphones are comfortable and easy to travel with using the little bag that came with it.

title: Comfortable. Noise cancellation
review: The price was great. I don't have a good expensive ANC headphones to compare, but this ANC works. For example it made the dishwasher go away. Music playing in kitchen on a smart speaker was cancelled out. I could hear peoples voices, so doesn't take out everything. But it took away the machine noises. Music sounded good. They are very comfortable

title: Good price. Work as expected
review: This is 2nd set purchased for teen who lost one earbud. Price was good enough where I just bought another set. They seem to work well. Have not heard any complaints...from teen.

title: Good for listening but not for phone conversations
review:
I like these earbuds for listening to podcasts or music but tried having phone conversations with them and the other person always has trouble hearing me.

What’s cool about this purchase is that the charger works also as a case to store them and can also be used as a phone stand.

title: Awesome!
review: So happy with these earbuds! Wore them on my cross-country for 5.5 hours…quite, comfortable, great battery life!!!

title: Long life.  May be a little uncomfortable to some
review:
This is my first use, but I can say that the battery life is reeeeeally long, as in 3/4 talking of my 13 hour day. And that is perfect because I'm working myself into an early grave, which is strongly encouraged by my employer. I killed my phone battery three times over and still haven't recharged the headset today.

They won't fall off, to be sure, but they start to hurt my ears after several hours. (ok 13 hours) Just be aware if you have sensitive ears and plan on wearing them way too long. My ears are very sensitive and would probably be ok if I took them off for a while. My wife says I'm a fat-head, so maybe that's why they're tight...I dunno.

The sound is quite good actually. I was pleasantly surprised by this. Don't expect audiophile quality and you won't be disappointed. Bluetooth sound has improved lots since version 1. The buttons are great for controlling phone operation or music. They are not small and they are easily discernible, so no hunting for the buttons.

For the long life, sound and the way they stay put I give a 5. For comfort I give a 4. The price is awesome, so overall I give 5.

This is just day 1, so I'll update this if they change for some reason. Well, unless they suddenly explode...or my employer and I reach the goal we've set for me. Not then.

title: Connectivity
review:
This*headset keeps cutting out & losing connect even when right next to my device, I had purchased one before this one & it worked perfectly! I loved it & since was a gift to my grandson, I decided to get one for myself. I was sorry I had to return because the connections wouldn't hold.
Maybe I can try again at a time.

title: It won't charge
review: I bought a new H270 headset. I plugged for more than 8 hours but the light still flashed red and didn't turn blue. After unplugging I can't turn it on. I tried charging it again but it doesn't work. I googled this up and found that a few more people have the same issue and no solution.

title: Such a great idea!
review:
My question is, why hasn’t this been around for years? Super convenient!

Just charge it and its case once you open the box, then turn it on, pair it with your device, and you’re off and running! I used it for the first time last night at the gym… I was obsessing over earthquake reels from Turkey, and it was amazing because I could lean back on the bicycle or walking the treadmill and never break stride, never fuss, and simply click your fingers. Game changer!

Only bummer is you have to go into phone settings to switch between music or video..it can only do one or the other. BUT, if you have a headset or AirPods you can use them to handle all music while this gadget will handle video.

Progress in tech we use daily, I like it. Especially with such a heavy phones today, far too heavy for our fingers to hold for any length of time (but who’s talking about that?…just one more detriment to our health that’s quietly accepted in society but shouldn’t be..I suggest). This at least helps with a few apps. Can’t wait for far better audio control on phones. Look around, people in the 20s and 30s already have bulky knuckles from super early arthritis. It’s messed up. Bravo for this little convenient ring!

title: sounds great
review: i have "normal" ears.  i am not an audiophile.  got an ipod.  got sennheiser earbuds.  sounded nice.  way better that apple phones that came with ipod.  they broke.  was looking for replacement buds.  too many listings!  hard to pick.  cross referenced with customer reviews on mid-priced units and consumer reports.  narrowed it to a few final candidates.  picked this one.  nice price on Amazon.  love them.  sound friggin' great.  perfect for airplane use.  cloth cord a nice feature.  pouch holds buds for storage and travel (though not big enough to also hold ipod).  comes with several additional earbud covers (silicone, i think).  so i was able to make a nice fit.  highly recommend.

title: Sound starts out good but then fades to where you can barely hear it.
review: At first these earbuds were great. The sound was nice and they could pair with both my phone and computer at the same time so I didn't have to switch back and forth. But then the sound started fading when I was on a call or listening to music. The sound would start normal and then slowly fade over about 2 minutes to where it is barely audible. I've read their guide and have scoured the internet for a solution but nothing has worked so at this time these earbuds are worthless and I would not recommend them.

title: Totally Disappointed
review: This pair of earbuds were more like $10 pairs you get in stores..really disappointed...no bass...I'm sorry I ripped up packing but truth is it's not worth standing in line to return these...

title: Highly Recommended...
review: First off I liked sound..Bass wasn't overwhelming but just enough for me...one thing I was surprised by was there was more weight to them then I expected considering most headphones I have are very light...The controls work perfectly and they sync up with my One Plus 6t phone really fast...Battery life seems good in the 10hrs I used them for first time...All in All I'm definitely liking these headphones...

title: Lightweight and sound great!
review: The sound was just right for me...bass was good and highs and lows we're just right..only had these few days now but their very comfortable from moment I put them on..the look of the wood is really nice...the only concern I have is the wires are kind of thin but we'll see how they hold up..right now overall I'm happy with my choice of SYMPHONIZED Headphones..

title: ... of headphones but by far this one is my favorite..
review: I have few pair of headphones but by far this one is my favorite...the bass tone is exactly what I was looking for..these Sony white headphones look great and we're worth the price!

title: DISAPPOINTED!
review: Not often that buy a product that disappoints me but this headset did...the headset itself is uncomfortable and the sound quality is not even as good as my $20.00 Sony head phones. .really sucks...

title: Super easy to install & super neat and organized looking
review: Super easy to put up and looks neat and organized. I love it for my kids headphones

title: Easy to install and looks nice to use!
review: Perfect and easy to install. I put this up to keep my headphones up for my kids by the computer. Its super easy to install and looks good while storing the headphones safely.

title: Great sound and value! No Brainer!
review:
Wow! Totally impressed with these. Considering the cost these are truly a great value. The sound is excellent. Even the bass is very good. Here are the highlights so far.
1. They are super easy to use.
2. They paired right away with my iPhone
3. Sound is very good overall.
4. Great value compared to other wireless earbuds.
5. Case is super easy to charge.

title: GET THIS!!
review:
I got these earbuds as a cheaper substitute to airpods. Its actually BETTER than air pods!! They connect automatically to your phone when you remove them from the case after initial bluetooth setup. Battery life is great.

You can tap the sides of the earbud to skip songs or raise/lower volume. Also waterproof!! I use them in the shower and its so enjoyable! I REALLY recommend.

title: not recommended, buy the real sennheiser replacements
review:
UPDATE:
stiff and constantly pop off when taking off the headset
poor quality, makes my sennheiser way less comfortable than the original earpads...

still, price for these is at least reasonable compared to sennheisers
even the massdrop earpads are a ripp off and way overpriced
i mean, these too are overpriced, but... ALL earpads seem way overpriced, relatively speaking these are the best value i could find so far

title: get headphones with built in mp3 player instead
review:
worst MP3 player ive ever used

horrible bundled earphones, keep falling out, bad sound quality, earphone wires scraping against anything are highly amplified into the earphones
confusing menu and button layout
buttons arent very tactile and its hard to just find them by feeling them with your fingers
shape of the player isnt ergonomic, its slippery especially when working out
shape of buttons is slippery
the clip to secure it to clothing is super weak and useless
volume buttons are small and not easy to reach especially when working out

title: very sturdy, can hold two heavy headsets the entire thing ...
review:
very sturdy, can hold two heavy headsets
the entire thing is made of hard rubber so it bends and flexes, making it easy to put a headset on the hooks

title: Okay
review:
The setup and sound is dead simple, but the first pair I had the batteries got so hot while in the cradle that it melted the cover. The second pair has been alright so far. My only gripe is that the soft rubber band that rests on your head develops a crease at the peak and turns brittle and hard within a couple of months - on both pairs.

UPDATE: The crease finally cracked the band in two and the headphones are not wearable any more.

title: Pocket Too Far
review:
Based on the good sound quality reviews, I purchased this Cardo S-800. I figured that the people complaining about the fit probably didn't know how to wear it properly. I once had a wired headset that baffled everyone who tried to wear it, but it was very comfortable for me. I figured it might be the same thing. Nope! This thing's ear bud is *HUGE*. I couldn't fit it in my nose ... seriously, it's that big. Who has ear holes bigger than their nostrils? Anyway, so this mean I had to use the coat hanger. I didn't think it looked that bad at all, and besides who cares what it looks like, right? So all the thing would do is flop out of my ear. Even with the ear loop, the design relies on the bud clinging to your ear. If that bud doesn't fit in your ear, it's going to just hang loose on your ear and flop around when you turn your head.

So, after getting over all of that, I still figured if it sounded awesome I would keep it. After charging it up and pairing it with my Q9C, I put the phone in my pocket and answered a call. WTF!?!?! Static. The call is all scratchy with static because the phone is in my pants pocket. If I take the phone out and hold it next to the headset, it's great. Back in the pocket = static. It's supposed to be good for over 30 feet and it can't travel the 24 inches to my pocket? I don't get it.

title: Tries too hard to mimic Apple, but misses the mark
review: I wanted to like these earbuds, but sometimes it is better to pay full price and get full value. Given the shape and utility, it is very promising, but misses the mark on comfort, fit, sound quality and design. Up close, it is just a cheap pair of earbuds that don’t actually live up to its description - esp it is not noise isolating.

title: Good versatility and sound quality
review: I own 3 pairs of these and love how versatile they are. I keep 2 in my gym bag and 1 for everyday use. The new updated ones have a smaller profile, so it fits a little better inside my ears. For the price point, you get a great set of earbuds that are hard to beat. The new ones cost a tad more than the original set, but I’d gladly pay that for the reliability of these earbuds.

title: Plush, comfortable and secure fitting
review: This is the 2nd headphones we purchased. They are nicely constructed, very plush and comfortable to wear. Our kids love them and we found the need to purchase a blue AND pink one. The sound quality is good and the fit is secure, even on our little toddler's head. At a reasonable price point, I am very happy with my purchase.

title: Thin and Bright
review:
I bought these to use while playing my guitar, using a headphone amplifier. They sounded very thin and bright, not pleasing to the ear at all. I had to crank up the lows and mids to get anything halfway decent. I didn't keep them. I've used the amp with other headphones and they sound fine. It's these.

They felt comfortable enough, but their build quality felt cheap and plasticy. Since I didn't keep them, I can't speak to the longevity of them.

I don't recommend.

title: It does not fit
review: I would enjoy it a lot more if it actually squeezed my head with any force at all. Right now, it just gently rests against my head, and only plays what sounds like very low quality, cheap headphones. However, they sound great, full range of audio with powerful bass, when I put them in my ears. Which is frustrating, because I got these thinking I wouldn't have to put them in my ears. The earplug mode isn't even worth mentioning. It's terrible. Definitely not worth $80, maybe $20.

title: Works well.  I use it often.
review:
I use these headphones + microphone often, many times a week for extended times. It works well. People can hear me, I can hear them. I plug them into my computer to use them.

They are not super comfortable; however, they are not uncomfortable either. Average comfort. Important thing is that they work.

title: I love my Echo 8..
review: I have Amazon Prime,  and have watched movies on this..listened to podcasts, my choice of music, I love all the information it gives you, games you can play, educational programs. I love the recipe display and Alexa helps you step by step..going at your pace.. as she tells you each step..as you instruct her.."next"... The picture is so clear.. and the sound is super good too . I have watched a movie with my headphones plugged in..while my fiance is watching his sports games on TV. I know there is so much more to learn ..I know I can set it up to display my photos too. I hit the Echo 8..I love this screen size.. I'm so happy with my purchase.

title: Being able to hear tv without bothering my husband
review: I really like these headphones.  The only problem is they could be made to be more adjustable...and the charging port in the middle of them get caught in my hair. But I like how they connect right away ...volumn buttons are sturdy..I like almost everything about them.

title: Very comfortable
review: I use this headset to enjoy my shows without disturbing my wife. Happy wife happy life!!

title: Great Inexpensive Headphones!
review: These are great inexpensive headphones they have a very smooth deep sound and good stage presence across all bands of music.

title: I am pleased with these replacement earphone covers.
review: While there are no installation instructions, once I looked closely at the covers and the earphones, installation was pretty straight forward. They are superior to the OEM covers, in fit, comfort and esthetic.

title: Good fit
review: I was excited to use this since it’s not flimsy and fit perfectly. Unfortunately, it was not compatible with the NEC phone system we use in office so after various attempts of trying to setup the headset and only getting high pitch feedback I’ll have to store it until I find use for it or give it to someone who can use it.

title: Amazing splitter! I can have sound bar and headphones connected at same time
review:
This is much nicer than the regular single wire connection I had. This is much thinner than my current wire and with the splitter was able to connect my soundbar and wireless headphone at the same time. Prior to this, I had to choose between one or the other having to connect and reconnect each one depending if I wanted to watch TV without bothering any one in the house.

This is exactly what I was looking for last year but didn't find an easy option like this one.

Totally worth getting this! Would be nice if there was a splitter with THREE ends so I could have Two wireless digital headsets on at the same time.

title: Great battery life and great for listing to music! Did I mention super comfortable?
review:
This is my fourth set! WHY??? The others were politely requested to be on loan for a very long time!

These are the new IT techie device. Wears easy, allows some outside noise so one could talk to you if they needed to. You can then answer them or just ignore them and say... Can't hear you thru my headphones... sorry. BUT you really can hear them.

Listening to music you get that little bass bump that regular headphones can't deliver at a safe volume. These are not really loud, you just feel the bump because these will vibrate a bit on deep music notes.

In the picture you can see my over the ear headphones. This really gives you an idea of the size of these devices. The elongated Bone Induction gives a different feel to the fit. They are very light and once you get used to them, can hardly feel them.

Bone induction is the new thing, especially with this design. For those of you uncomfortable with things in your ears, these will not trigger that concern.

My G/F has a bit of a hearing issue and sometimes can't discern what some people are saying, especially over a phone call. These actually have helped her hear better over the phone and with recorded messages. I think the slight vibration from the sound triggers her to listen sooner and allows conversation to register quicker.
Either reason, she actually likes using bluetooth hands free devices now.

These are definitely worth it!

title: Good value and quality
review: I am very pleased with the sound quality of these headphones. They have helped immensely with my working from home and with meetings

title: Great Earbuds!
review: I’ve had other earbuds in the past. Battery life and bass tones were always lacking. These earbuds are very good in both of those areas. Noise cancellation is good. Don’t get me wrong, if you spend a lot more money, you will get an excellent product. These are some of your “Best Bang for your Buck” Earbuds! I highly recommend and would buy again!

title: Nice Case!
review: I bought this case for my Bluedio Turbine headphones. They fit great and provide good protection. I use this case for storage more than transporting. The only thing that would make it better is if the case was included with the headphones!

title: Great Headphones!
review: Now, I'm not a headphone expert, but these headphones work great for what I use them for. I connect them to my iPhone 6s Plus. Like everyone else has said, it has great bass. Great bang for the buck!

title: Gets the job done
review: I've gone through tons of headphones searching for superior sound and, while these headphones don't provide the quality of some more popular and much more expensive brands they are just as good as my 100$ buds. Plus when the cat chews through these I'll only be slightly angry.

title: Not worth the extra $$$
review: This is a good looking set of earbud and the quality is fine, but definately not worth the extra $$$ compare to the Sony MDR-EX51LP or other comparable $30 range earbud.  Sound quality was not any better than the Sony MDR-EX51LP and in my opinion, not as comfortable either.  For comparable price of this set, I would suggest getting V-MODA Vibe or Shure E2c, both offer much better sound quality.

title: It revolutionized my life!
review:
I LOVE THIS THING! It's USB-powered, which is a huge plus!

I have it powering my 7.1 Dolby Surround Logitech Z-5500 system, and let me tell you, this is NOT cheapo pseudo surround like I find on a whole range of similar products (::cough:: Asus Xonar ::cough::).

This is actually a 7.1 external surround card! It does a full 48,000 Hz, too. Compare this to your typical cheapo laptop soundcard, that can barely do 44,000 Hz and *fakes* 7.1 surround via software emulation (HP, Sony, and Gateway: I'm looking at YOU).

Even if you're just using this on high range headphones, if you want MUCH better sound than what your laptop or standard desktop motherboard soundcard gives you, then buy this. The music is very crisp and the SPDIF/Out has more power behind it than my Desktop's Creative soundcard lol.

title: Don’t believe the hype DMS is right.
review: Got these as a gift for my girlfriend and my disappointment is immeasurable, it’s worth noting that she however seems to enjoy them! With that in mind she is alsonot an audiophile. When compared to other audiophile headphones they fall short on every mark except maybe bass. They sound muddy and even somewhat distorted when weighted against my dt 880s which are my least expensive pair of headphones for comparison. These may have a niche but high quality audio isn’t it.

title: I love these
review: I love these they sound great and are extremely comfortable for a pair of headphones under 500 bucks they are a great addition to my ever growing collection.

title: Hilariously good
review: Full disclosure this is only my second pair of hi-fidelity or audiophile headphones so take that for what you will. However I am absolutely blown away at the audio quality of these things. I read the reviews before buying and bought a new cord with them so I can't speak to how they sound with stock. I have absolutely no complaints.

title: Disappointing.....
review: I've had 4 or 5 pairs of Scosche headphones over the years and I've loved all of them except this pair.  I hate the controller as it is too sensitive and constantly turns on my audio (thereby running down my battery or changing what I'm listening to). These will be going in the bin immediately.  Look for the tapline controllers - much better.

title: Headphones are great but the customer service makes this item incredible
review: I've enjoyed the Headphones , and the customer service of the company which has made me feel confident with my five star rating

title: Difficult to install
review: They are comfortable, and I would have given them a higher rating, but they were impossible to install on the earphones. I had to put them on with double-sided tape. For some reason, I find that Bose always seems to have a little quirk in their products for no reason.

title: Nice but sound goes up to full volume each time song or video changes
review: The headphones seem nice but we returned both sets because the the sound kept going back to full volume whenever we changed the song or video. Tried disconnecting and reconnecting but that didn't fix the issue.

title: Sony headphones
review: Sound quality is great.  I have another pair of Sony headphones and needed another for my laptop.  My husband goes to bed early and I use the headphones almost every evening.

title: I'm impressed.
review:
I like the earbuds; they work like they're supposed to.
What impressed me was when I dropped them, in their case, from 50 feet up, onto cement.
The buds still work and the case still charges them! The USB port is a little wiggly and the light on the outside that shows it's charging stopped working, but the inner light still works.

title: very clear
review: This was plug and play easy to set up and has remarkable clarity. Don't know what else one could ask of headphones. They are also light and comfortable. Others on the call (Go to Meeting) remarked on how clear I sounded, as if I were in the room.

title: Works great, easy setup
review: I hooked the optical out from my Samsung TV to this splitter and to my sound bar and to a set of earphones.  My wife can now control the sound through the earphones whil I listen to the sound bar.

title: It holds my two sets of Bluetooth headphones easily.  A quality build.
review: It fit onto my desk edge just as I hoped it would and is very stable. Easily holds two headphones within my reach. I will buy again if any new needs come up.

title: Love
review: Keep earbud in place when I’m moving around. I don’t worry about the falling out now

title: Awesome value for product
review: Awesome headphones! Noise cancellation works a bit too well for office use lol. Definitely recommend.

title: not great
review: These headphones are too tight against my ears which is uncomfortable for me.  The sound isn't as good as my previous headphones.  It doesn't have any depth of sound.

title: They are ok
review: Like the fact I can use a diffrent color on each earphone to distinguish at a glance which one is the right or left ear. They are difficult to place in but obviously not impossible. They are cute too. Dislike that after a while on my ear they kinda tend to slide out.

title: Best bang for your buck!
review: I have read that these were the best headphones for the price…they were correct!! I have had some very expensive headphones that are very comparable to the quality of these. I bought these for my son and I ended up using them. VERY good noise canceling quality for the cost. I highly recommend, especially at this price point.

title: Five Stars
review: the head phones didn't last that long but i still use the bag to carry other headphones it!

title: He says that the headphones are mad comfortable and the fidelity is ridiculous
review: These were a gift to both my kid and myself. He says that the headphones are mad comfortable and the fidelity is ridiculous. And, most importantly, I don't hear the soulful sounds of Mine Craft and Terraria anymore when he is gaming next to me on the couch. 10/10. Would cover my kids ears with these headphones again.

title: This product is amazing the wireless is good I play basketball and when ...
review: This product is amazing the wireless is good I play basketball and when i play i hook up my headphones to my phone and play with my phone in my bag.  Connecting to your device is easy. It hooks into your ears and they wont come out of your ears. AWESOME PRODUCT!!

title: Great for a short time
review:
These earbuds worked great for a short time. Now the Bluetooth disconnects everytime I put my phone in my pocket. As soon as I take it out it magically reconnects. If I walk more than 10 feet away from my phone... disconnected.
Horrible!
Sometimes when I am walking my dog it does this thing where it connects and disconnects over and over again.
And the battery life is now only about an hour.
So these will be going to the recycle center. Waste of $20.

title: Great for noisy planes
review: Have had these for 6 months and they are the first pair of earbuds that have lasted this long without problem. Great for noisy planes!

title: Works better than expected
review:
I ordered the headset with some worries how this will work. My main fear was the range - I use this for exercise in gym and carry my phone in my pocket. I was pleasantly surprised that the range is more than good - I am able to leave my phone on the bench, go for weights close by or generally walk away without loosing connection. Obviously there is a limit, but so far, in regular use, I have not had any problems. The battery life is good for my needs (90 minutes), the fit is comfortable and stays in (though I did have to adjust it after a jump rope session), and the operation is easy.
Making phone call was fine - no problem with the microphone. The conversation was like with a wired set.
I use Galaxy S2 and pairing was fine.
Charger is standard though you will need a different cable if you want to charge it via your computer - which you should have anyway as it is now a standard.

title: Terribly Overpriced, Easy to Lose
review: These are the same quality as those cheapie $5 headsets that come with your phone, minus the wire.  They are hard plastic, creating zero seal, providing no comfort, no noise-cancellation whatsoever.  they are also prone to fall out easily, due to the poor fit.  Also, unless you hold the airpods into your ear, the sound quality is atrocious.  I only used these for podcasts, they are unusable for music.  That said, sure enough, eventually one fell out and disappeared.  I kept the other one in use and today that one fell out and disappeared.  A total rip-off and absolutely junk.  I have other wireless earbuds, I don't like them, but they are still superior to this rip off.

title: THEY ALMOST NEVER WORK
review: these headphones ....smh.  ...here we are, three years later, they are outdated and never got my moneys worth.  when they pair up, they are pretty slick, but that almost never happens.  its just such a headache.  stereo never comes in, there's lag (useless for audio work), the mono sounds like crap.  just unfortunate cause if they were reliable i would use them every day when i've only used them a few hours since its such a pain.  doesn't work with my imac, iphone 1, 2, 3.  works with iphone 4 (which i don't own) .  doesn't work with macbook.  so, pretty f'ing useless .  of course apple says its sony and sony says its apple.  done trouble shooting these

title: Did not last long
review:
UPDATE
The seller contacted me and said that they are going to issue me a full refund for the ear buds, I did not initiate the contact, so, excellent customer service, I will definitely give them another try again in the future based on their recent actions. Upgraded from two stars to three.

Have had these earbuds for a few weeks and already experiencing problems with the sound quality and the microphone. When using for phone calls, the person at the other end of the call has trouble hearing me, have to keep repeating myself, also there is a great deal of static during use. Very disappointed, looking for something better.

title: Not exactly what I was hoping for.
review: This headset does work, but I don't find it very comfortable to wear for long periods of time, also the microphone is very large, which I find burdensome to adjust and wear, and the sound quality is middle of the road. Overall, it is functional but not what I was hoping for.

title: For inexpesive headphones these have really good sound quality and I much prefer the cord only ...
review: For inexpesive headphones these have really good sound quality and I much prefer the cord only being on one side

title: Worth the purchase!
review:
Changed from a 4 star to a 5 star: the headband was initially given a 4 star because the product wasn’t the most comfortable to wear in the beginning. It fit awkwardly but after using it for a bit it has since stretched to the point that it is far more comfortable on my head! Just takes some getting used to :)

Upon receiving the product you could tell that the company worked hard on their presentation. The packaging was done beautifully and the product looked so neat. When trying it on for the first time it felt just a little too tight but you have to get used to having the headband on, and it kind of stretched and fits to you pretty well. I personally never forgot that I had the headband on but I could definitely see how that would be different for others. It was very easy to connect the device to my phone and the pieces fit in my ears quite well. The sound quality was actually pretty amazing! I could drown out the noise surrounding me entirely with this product and that was very nice. I haven’t had to charge the headphones yet and I’ve used them for quite a bit so I’m very impressed with the battery life. All in all I would definitely recommend this product. I’d even purchase it again as a gift!

title: Amazing noise cancellation
review: These sound amazing. The ANC is second to none as expected from Bose. Battery life is excellent. They are perfect for what I was looking for and I couldn't be happier. The beats studio wireless sound better as far as powered wireless headphones go but their ANC was virtually non existent. If you want great sounding headphones with amazing ANC then get these now

title: Terrible sound quality
review: Upon first listen the sound quality was surprisingly bad for both music and spoken word. I compared these to three other headphones, two cheap old Chinese Bluetooth earbuds and high-end Sennheiser wired headphones, all with an iPhone 8 as the source. These coioc headphones have noticeably poorer sound quality than all three. There is a static, tinny sound to them. The bass is muted. The “s” sounds hiss more, and the “p” sounds pop more. These are unlistenable if you have better headphones as an alternative and are destined for the trash can. These are generic unbranded Chinese headphones. The model number is BTW98. They are made by Kvance Technology Co.

title: Unsatisfactory sound quality. Too easy to accidentally record.
review:
Update: twice now I have accidentally entered recording mode, once when I meant to press the stop button, and the other when I fat-fingered the play button. This design is too dangerous, so I am lowering my rating.

This is a basic low-end cassette player and radio. The sound quality is tinny and hollow with no ability to adjust it, so you need headphones that add bass. Even with the added bass of certain headphones, the music still sounds too hollow for my liking. It seems to be more like a voice recorder in terms of playback quality and not optimized for playing music. The sound distorts if this is jostled while playing a tape, so you cannot use it while exercising. It lacks auto-reverse, noise reduction, sound enhancements, and Bluetooth support.

The record button seems dangerous. It seems easy to press accidentally and it looks a lot like a stop button. I would rather not have that button and I cannot imagine anyone buying a device like this for the record feature.

For the radio, it can be hard to dial in a specific FM number due to the imprecise small gauge.

Most people who buy this want to play music, and unfortunately, it is not great at that due to the poor music sound quality and the distortion in sound whenever it is jostled or bumped.

title: Works well and stays connected
review: This works well with an iPhone 8 to connect headphones. It stays in place and does not slip out, even when moving the phone vigorously. I tried another brand that worked so poorly that I threw it away. It kept disconnecting and stopping what was playing.

title: Decent. Not great for exercise.
review:
These work relatively well for the price and stay in my ears most of the time. These are not good for many activities since they block out outside noise rather completely, which is dangerous and anti-social in most instances. When exercising outside, working out in a gym, or going to the grocery store, I need to hear what is going on in my surroundings. These are good for doing work around the house when nobody else is around. These fall out of my ears when doing light jogging. One side is weighted down with the controller, which makes them unbalanced.

These are bad for running and jogging because they have this microphone sound effect where pressure is pushed into your ears with every step, which I suspect is related to the sound isolation. The other reason these are bad for jogging is the unnecessary risk of blocking out all environmental noise.

Sound quality is not great because they keep cutting out completely every few minutes, even when I am holding my phone in my hand. Other bluetooth headphones have this sound cutting off problem when my phone is in my pocket and I squat down. On these headphones, the problem happens all the time with my Android phone. I am not sure why this is and it is rather annoying.

The battery lasts a decent amount of time.

title: Headphones fall off
review: My headphones keep falling off this. There is no lip at the edge and no material increasing friction. Nothing that stops the headphones from crashing to the floor when accidentally brushed. The design is neat though, where you can change the orientation.

title: Nothing special. Easily lost
review:
This was disappointing after coming from a cheaper earpiece that I lost. This GoNovate G8 does not stay in my ear as well and often falls out. The outside sound in that ear is blocked completely, which makes it hard to have conversations with people unless this is removed. This seal likely increases the sound clarity, but I would rather hear my surroundings better in some situations. If I am by myself, then this attribute is not that bad. The magnetic charger is good and it is easy to turn off and on, compared to the cheaper earpiece I was using. The beige color makes it look like a hearing aid instead of a headphone, which is somewhat appropriate since hearing is greatly diminished while wearing this.

I would not recommend this and would look for a different one after I lose this.

I am lowering another star now that I have used it more because it falls out all the time and it is quite annoying. Cheaper ear pieces stay in.

Update: I lost this rather quickly, just like my last earpiece. So I am lowering my rating to one star.

title: Don't buy. Poor quality.
review: Poor quality. I have used many pairs of Yurbuds over the years and these are pretty bad. They don't fit well, the sound quality is not as good as the more expensive versions, they keep falling out and the rubber tips keep falling off. I lost the only size tip that worked well since it fell off somewhere when I put these in my pocket. The biggest downside to these is the remote is glitchy and it keeps causing my iPhone to randomly pause or go into voice control mode for no apparent reason. I think some sweat might have gotten into it. Whenever that control is brushed or jostled it seems to go off, making podcasts continually stop and start. This is not a good headset for running, which is the primary activity I bought them for.

title: A good basic headset
review:
I am using mine with a GE 26977GE6 phone, which came with a somewhat uncomfortable street-style headset. The Panasonic KX-TCA60 headset is much louder and clearer. I did not realize how poor the stock headset was until I tried these Panasonics. My only problem with these is that the volume is a bit too loud, even at the lowest phone volume. Otherwise, this headset is great.

Update May 2009:
After many years I'm still using these. A couple have broken on me with no easy way to fix them, but they are cheap enough to be considered a disposable product. These days I have a second pair on standby because I'm pretty sure I'll snap the headband on my current pair eventually.

title: My favorite headphones
review:
The Sony MDR-V6s were the first really good headphones I owned. After about 15 years of use, the foam padding was a bit run down. After doing the exhaustive search for the best headphones, I bought a pair of Sennheiser HD580s (I also own Etymotic ER-4Ps). Comparing the HD580 to my MDR-V6s, I would say that the MDR-V6s are better for two reasons. 1. The MDR-V6s are more comfortable to wear for long periods of time, and 2. The MDR-V6s have a telephone-like cord, which is easier to deal with than the straight HD580 cord. The sound quality was very good on both headphones, and about equal.
