I ended up buying new foam pads for my 15-year-old MDR-V6s, which made them feel like brand new headphones. I also bought a second pair of MDR-V6s, and shelved the HD580s for now.
Do not buy the MDR-600s by mistake. I have never used them, but I have read numerous reviews that state that the MDR-600s are inferior to the MDR-V6s. You can still buy the MDR-V6s, but they are harder to find. I bought mine at millionbuy because Amazon did not have them in stock. For some reason, the MDR-V6 product name at Amazon magically changed to MDR-600, even though it is an entirely different product. I am not sure why this happened.
The audioreview Web site has a great collection of headphone reviews.

title: Returned - Static When Playing
review: The headphones played a static sound whenever it was first turned on and then occasionally while playing songs.  Not at all the quality described by other reviewers.

title: What I Needed
review: Discovered the headphones purchased for grandson were too short to use with TV.  These were the best value extension cable I could find (highest rated + lowest priced). We've used this extension for about 10 hours of TV viewing now and it works perfectly.

title: The Reviews are Not for This Product
review: This looks like a great deal until you realize that most of the reviews are not for this product and the lower reviews show no comments. My grandson loved the way these headphones looked but I refused to order a product that needs deceit to generate sales.

title: Twins Like Them Better Than Other Models
review:
Update: The twins have used these daily for six weeks with no problems. The charge then every couple of days.

This is the third set of headphones I've bought for the 11 year twins and their favorite. They like the bluetooth connection with their MP#3 players, they fit more securely, the controls are easier to manipulate, and the sound quality is significantly better. They have speakers if they want to share their music but use the headphones when they want to dance to their own beat. There was no setup required for the headphones. The MP3 player found them and connected as soon as they turned on. Took them one day to run the battery completely out.

title: Big Jump in My Computer Savviness
review:
I ordered these to use when my husband is watching the news. Now that we are retired, we are having to adjust to each other's viewing habits and I prefer my news online.

I've used headphones for work but never used earbuds for pleasure. Connecting with Bluetooth on my iphone was a breeze but I had to read comments here to know to disconnect from phone to connect to MacBook. Sound is great and I totally can't hear endless political discourse and mindless advertisements.

title: A Bit Dissapointing
review: I was hoping this would work better than the San Disk MP# players I bought for the twins because of the size and screen.  However, it's not easy to navigate, won't play all of the songs that are on the San Disk players and is a pain to connect to Bluetooth.  Once you get it set up, it does play music and the quality is good. I bought LETSCOM headphones to use instead of the ones that came with it which provides more comfortable and higher quality audo.  The player and headphones fit fine in the hard, blue AGPTEK case I also bought.

title: Easy to Wear and Listen With
review:
I am prompted to write this review after a bad experience with the Ghostek Rapture Series Wireless Bluetooth Headphones Headset that beeps every 30 seconds to a minute and says it is connecting (while connected to my iPhone 8+) at least on every song.

Compared to the Ghostek, this Sennheiser Momentum On-Ear Headphone - Red has the same sound quality but is lighter, fit better on my ears, and are not as bulky. I find these relatively inconspicuous, comfortable to wear, and give me the sound quality I want.

title: Constant Beeping Makes Them Unusable
review:
The sound quality is good but it consistently disconnects. It beeps every 30 seconds to a minute and says it is connecting (while connected to my iPhone 8+) at least on every song. They are comfortable but the cushion tends to move around on my ear.

On the other hand, my [[ASIN:B00F3H20E4 Sennheiser Momentum On-Ear Headphone - Red]] has the same sound quality but are lighter, fit better on my ears, and are not as bulky.

I returned the headphones.

title: Great sound! Easy Set-up! But does cause interference.
review:
The sound is fantastic. It is very clear and the set-up was super-easy. It took only seconds. There is no difference in the sound quality from wireless to wired connection. (There is usb wired connection cable with mini-usb connector for headset for charging.) The headset itself is lighter and more comfortable than I thought it would be. The headset itself adjusts very easy and does not slip or slide.

The microphone is sensitive and very clear. It adjusts very easy both veritically and horizonally.

The only negative I can speak of does not relate to the actual headset. The wireless headset interfere with my wireless Panasonic surround sound in another room. It (wireless surround sound)crackles with static when the headset is being used in wireless mode.

title: Great little carrying case for Kindle Fire and such
review: Took Kindle Fire camping with us and this was great accessory. With the numerous pockets (of all sizes)- many smaller devices and accessories with able to be transported and kept together (like power cords and earbuds). It appears to be very well stitched and durable. Luckly, it did not get dropped or go for a swim so I cannot atest to how waterproof or rugged the jacket is, but it is extremely functional.

title: Great Sound
review: These are awesome. I got these for running and was blown away at their clarity. Music has never sounded so good. I will admit that it did take a few moments initially to fit them comfortably in my ears, but after a few tries I was ready to try them out. I had to lower the volume level to almost 1/2 of the level with my old earbuds. The clarity of the sounds was remarkable. I forgot how good my playlist sounded after years of using a lesser quality item. I would recommend these to anyone.

title: I Like These Earbuds A Lot
review: They fit well and play well.  I read the other reviews but apparently I lack the expertise to distinguish sound quality (don't ask about wine either).  I tried them with my kindle and my grandson uses them with his iPod and it worked flawlessly for both of us.  We also have cheaper earbuds that work equally well but I particularly like these.

title: Good Product But Needs to be More Adjustable
review:
I currently use this with Tmobile LG Optimus 3g network cellular phone. It was ideal receiving the amount of "accessories" with the headset, such as the extra eargels, belt clip, USB cable and charger.

Installation was seamless with respect to connectivity thanks to the enclosed "getting started" leaflet with simplified illustrations and to-the-point directions on basic usage. The charging station is very nice and protective, and gives you an immediate reading on your power level. I have yet to use it to see if 2 hour charge is accurate.

One thing that I am slightly dissatisfied with is the lack of customization for the fitting of the headset. The extra eargels are nice to offer however, the actual headset needs to be more adjustable to achive maximum comfort.

title: Love water resistant
review: I love the full featured water resistant use of my headphones. Nicely designed and it recharges in no time at all!

title: TOZO has outdone themselves - feature packed, great earbuds at a reasonable price.
review:
Bottom Line - These are great earbuds. I recommend them, as they sound great, are feature-packed, and are very portable. Please note that I'm a bigger guy and I think the fit works well for me. I see other reviews concerned about size, so maybe be more cautious if your ears are on the small side.

Detailed Review:
One of my daily use earbuds are TOZO brand already for my work computer, so I thought I'd give them a shot to try this one out with all the extra features (ANC and Transparency mode). I figured if it was good enough, I'd replace my slowly dying Galaxy Buds I use for being out and about (both ANC and Transparency mode are useful depending on the context when I'm out of the house).

I was impressed at both of these features. I've experienced better implementations of both in very-high-end products, but let's be realistic about the price point. They are equal or better than my Galaxy Buds in nearly every respect. Better battery life, better portability, ANC, and more useful Transparency/passthrough. I'm no audiophile, but the music I already enjoy sounds good through these, so no complaints.

title: Amazing value. Great sound quality, and great features.
review:
These are great earbuds - especially for the price. They're comfortable, and the silicone tips do a great job of noise isolation. The touch controls are easy and intuitive. I like the convenience of wireless and USB-C charging, and the stated battery life is 8 hours for music. Also, I found they held up a lot better at the edge of Bluetooth range than others I own.

The charging case is portable - easy to fit into a pocket or purse for sure. But most importantly, the earbuds seat easily and securely in the case, which I've found to be an issue in other similar products I've tried in the past. So no phantom connections or finding the earbuds didn't actually charge.

Overall, I'd definitely recommend these. I actually haven't found anything I dislike about them - which is rare for me.

title: Pretty good - especially for the price.
review:
Bottom Line Up Front: These are decent sounding wireless earbuds that have a pretty comfortable fit (in a style that is great for exercise), at a price point that is very attractive. If pocket-sized portability is *not* a concern, these should be a top contender for your needs.

Pros:
+Good audio quality, and loud volume limit with minimal distortion
+Charges easily in the case, and both charge quickly
+Good build quality - case feels sturdy, earbuds seat nicely for charging
+Pairing is and connecting is quick and easy
+Audio latency is surprisingly good for bluetooth. Games and videos are close to real time
+Great for PC / desk / home environment
+Price is great - $29.99 for this quality was an unexpected surprise.

Cons:
-Case is bigger than I thought - about the same volume as a tennis ball

title: Update: Support helped with some issues
review:
Rating: 4/5 (was lower, but their email customer support is actually helpful and responsive and made a difference)

Pros:
+Comfortable fit (though they may not fit well for smaller ears)
+Decent sound quality for earbuds in this price range
+Built-in volume control (a must-have for me, as I use it on PC)
+Reasonable battery life (see cons for the other side of this coin)
+Passthrough mode works pretty well at lower volume levels, ANC works great for white noise sounds

Cons:
-Advertised battery life is misleading. In my testing, they only last 3-4 hours when used together. Used only one at a time they seem to last a lot longer (probably because they don't have to communicate with each other).
-They aren't that easy to get out of the case for me, and they are slippery - easy to drop
-Typical latency of Bluetooth earbuds means a slight delay compared to video / games.
-Bluetooth range is okay, but it struggles to perform at maximum distance where other devices do well.
-Occasional ~1 second audio drops (not enough to bug me, but it does happen)

Like many things, there aren't a ton of perfect options - ear buds have been like that for me. Pick what matters to you, and maybe this one has what you want. Maybe not. With my newer issues, probably not.

title: Crackling sounds with your bass.
review: Feature-wise, it's what you'd expect - the tangle-free cord is great, it's a good fit in the ear, and the controls are a plus.  One of the earbuds crackled a lot during deep bass notes, but after searching online, apparently you can temporarily resolve this by sucking on the problematic earbud (with the cushion removed).  Oddly enough, that did the trick.  So while it's working properly, I can say they have a good sound and a comfortable fit.  I'm just concerned about having to suck on an earbud to get it working properly.

title: No durability - the wire inside the jack broke internally within 2 months.
review: These have no durability.  Less than two months into ownership - not even for exercising, just light usage at my cubicle and wrapping them up to store back in the carrying case provided at the end of the day, the wire inside has already broken.  Light movement of the wire causes it to disconnect from the phone (you can see the headphone icon flicker on and off, and it stops the music).  Other headphones I have work perfectly, so it's not my phone.  If you want a junk pair of headphones to last you a month, buy this.  Otherwise, stay away.

title: Love love love!!!!
review: Absolutely love these! Good quality, stylish and look more expensive!!! I was just looking for headphones with decent sound for work but didn’t expect the clear microphone quality. Calls are effortless! When people on the other end are having trouble with Bluetooth or sound quality the mic in this is effortless. Sure the cord can be a bit annoying at times but the sound quality make up for it. Not for little ones as they will last with gentle use.

title: The real deal
review: These are the real Apple earbuds.  Works great. Mic works well too. Great price! Arrived fast!

title: Fantastic buy
review:
I've been looking for in ear headphones to use while at the gym with my ipod. The ones that you get with the ipod constantly fall out. I also purchased expensive Bose in ear headphones but they also kept falling out.
I was minding my own business and doing some browsing on Amazon and lo & behold I came upon these beauties. What amazing value for such a versatile product. No matter how vigorous my workout they do not budge or get in the way.
I could get at least 15 of these babies for the price I paid for my Bose headphones.
If you purchase this product for your gym workouts, you will never be disappointed.

title: Great headphones for the price!
review:
These headphones have roughly a 50 ft range when there's no obstruction in the way of the signal. The battery life is exceptionally close to what's advertised. The sound quality is good, but nothing to be excited about. I've noticed better base with other headphones, but they were a fair amount more expensive too. However, I would say that the "noise canceling" that's advertised is ONLY because of the slight muffling effect of putting these in your ears and whatever sounds you play through these. This product does not have active noise canceling. I believe that the "noise canceling" claim should be erased from their product description.
Overall, this is a great product for the price, especially if you need something for studying. Would buy again.

title: It has it's good and bad qualities
review: The biggest peeve with these ear buds is it gets tangled all the time and the plastic ear piece keeps on falling off so I'm wearing it at the gym naked and it's not comfortable.  But what can you expect with some cheap earbuds.  At least it stays on my ear when I'm running.

title: Controls a little difficult to use, nice sound quality
review: Sometimes it's a little hard to feel the on controls, so I have to pull it off my head and look at it.  Then it is hard to see them.  There is also no easy way I've found to tell how much charge it has.  I like the sound quality and noise cancellation for the cost, pretty good like all Skull Candy headphones.

title: My New Favorite Skullcandy
review:
My ears feel happy! Great headphones, but just be aware you will probably have to take your earrings off. However, great for noise cancelling and also the SOUNDZ are so awesome. Comes with a little carrying bag that is very handy as although I intended these to be for work only, I love them so much I'm carrying them wherever I go. PLUS the MICROPHONE WORKS well on phone calls which was a PLEASANT surprise.

I thought I wouldn't be as happy with plain white as some wild design but I still get complements on the looks of these as well as enjoying the sound!

title: not noise cancelling earphones
review:
Nowhere on the package does it say that these are noise cancelling earphones. I tried the large sized plugs and they seem a bit small.
The cord makes noise when it rubs against clothing. It is annoying. The sound of the earphones is decent.

title: Perfect for the ears
review:
I didn't want in-ear headphones, since I keep getting ear infections. I didn't want bulky headphones for going on walks. I didn't want compact headphones that keep making my ears stick out from the band getting under them, which also ruled out bone conduction headphones. I wanted something that would keep my ears open for a polite company without necessarily taking them off, and not get in the way of a mask. This is basically everything I need. I wear them like a headband, and they work perfectly.

The sound does bleed in a bit - not always, not loudly, but a bit, depending on how they are sitting. And if you move your head around too much, they may slide off. Otherwise, can't complain.

title: Leaks
review:
I was recently informed by my co-workers that my headphones leak quite a bit of sound, so I searched for something that won't. After reading many reviews, this seemed to be cheap enough and quiet enough for the outside world. After they arrived, I tested them, and, well... they also leak. Pushing them as far as they can go into my ears doesn't make much difference. At low to medium volume they seem quiet enough, but as soon as settings are just a bit louder, they are quite audible to neighbors.

On a plus side, they do sound marginally better than my old pair.

title: High-quality, low-priced headphones.
review: This is the second pair of low-priced JVC 'phones our family has ordered, and these are even better than the others.  Unless your audio requirements are very high, you could not ask for a better headphone option than the JVC HAS700.

title: Good product!
review: Good product! Quality sound, lightweight and simple. I love having the clip and different size earbuds to choose from to wear. Good value for the money. Arrived on time and comes with 1-year warranty that is easy to setup.

title: Stereo  headbud earphones
review: Purchased these earphones and received them rather timely. I used them for my mp3 player and they sounded really good. However, they stopped working after a month. I would not buy them again!

title: Connected wire slips side to side
review: Do not use these for sports. Mainly to listen to music at office or phone calls in car. They work but connected wire slips side to side and pull on the earphone if you do not position the wire just right behind you neck. Maybe I just need a small clip to center wire on my shirt collar.

title: Good Headphone Hanger
review:
I change desks a few times a week and need something to hold my headphones so they don't sit on my desk taking up valuable real estate.

The BENKS headphone hanger does the job.

Goes onto desk very easy. Tightens quickly. Comes off just as easy. Made from sturdy metal instead of flimsy plastic.

Its not fancy, its functional.

Recommended.

title: Great replacement
review:
I have a pair of Skullcandy phones that are old, old, old. They are going on their 3rd set of replacement earpads.

My wife uses my headphones and her hair creams break down pads and turn them into dust.

These replacements went on with a little difficulty (typical for replacements). Once on they fit comfortably and provide decent isolation and fitment.

They seem ok in the cold and dry air of the Winter, but I have a feeling that they will be a bit sweaty once Spring/Summer kick in.

Recommended.

title: Yes
review:
If you're looking for a cable to use your VR headset with a gaming laptop like the Asus ROG ZEPHYRUS G14, this is the one you want.

DO NOT get one of those 30Hz cables...

title: Sturdy. Compact.  Decent sound for price.  A bit hot.
review:
Great headphone for the price. Sturdy. Decent sound. Folds up nicely.

Only weakness is they are really a sweaty set of phones to wear in any humidity or warm temperature. The fit is extremely tight and there is very little airflow. The plastic in contact with your head is also sturdy but nonporous.

If you have a large head you’ll need to avoid due to fit.

title: Arrrgh.  P.O.S.
review:
Ordered grey, got red. Sound is pretty bad (fuzzy and muted). They fit about as comfortably as they sound...

However, these were purchased as a very low-end solution for treadmill headphones (30 minutes max usage). Going to try to burn them in and see if that helps the sound a bit.

They shipped a bit slowly, but arrived in good packaging materials.

title: Not impressed
review: These were a Christmas gift and unfortunately for MEBUYZ earbud, someone else bought me a different brand for Christmas so I was able to compare the two.  The two wireless earbuds are in the same price range so my comparison of the two units was valid (was not comparing a $100 dollar unit against a $25 dollar unit).  The second unit was made by Soundcore.  The sound quality was much better on the Soundcore earbuds and the case used for charging and storage was better human factored.  Both units easily sync'd up to the bluetooth transmitter and have similar battery.  life. I did not evaluate the noise cancellation qualities.

title: Bluetooth Pairing Feature Works Well
review: First let me say I am not using this headset with a phone and many features of this headset are meant to control phone usage.  I only use them to pair with a Bluetooth transmitter (attached to a computer streaming music) for remote, hands-free listening. Not having owned a of Bluetooth headset before, I can see now that I probably purchased the wrong product.  Controls for the various functions are spread out along the neck harness and makes it difficult to remember which button/slider does what. You end up having to take the harness from around your neck to determine which control you are after. Also some functions don't seem to work or work poorly such as the Equalizer, Battery Status Alert.  The Bluetooth range is good.

title: Adapting Bluetooth system to Xbox One.
review: Currently using this unit to connect a Bluetooth transmitter to my Xbox One system so i can use my Turtle Beach wireless headphones. Works fine.

title: Hard to beat for inexpensive, good quality listening.
review: These headphones were used to replace a set of Titanium headphones bought at Radio Shack many years ago.  These headphones are inexpensive but deliver a very good quality of sound.

title: Good quality
review:
I had some issues with (some of) the Logitech products I have purchased in the past (who didn't?), but this Logitech Wireless Headset for my iPad delivered as promised. The quality is definitely good, the price is better than if I purchased it at a store, and the set-up is super easy. I thought it was taking so long to match (?) with my iPad2, not realizing it was done and over with! I wish I could use it for when I'm on the phone waiting for someone on the other end when I'm calling a business place, but that may be reaching..
I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 only because it was not offered in black so that it's less conspicuous.

title: For use in office.
review: When working at home used  noise canceling headphones that covers both ears. Had to talk loud to hear myself. Back in the office part time and needed a usb headset that only covered one ear so I was not so loud. This works perfectly

title: cord can be replaced rather than the whole headphone system!
review: My kids love these headphones.  It is also nice that you can replace just the cord if it becomes damaged.

title: Finally!!
review: These headphones are awesome.  I bought Skull Candy buds first but they were HORRIBLE.  I was looking for noise cancelling and these get the job done, I am outdoors a lot while on the phone.  These headphones with ANC reduce the noise of wind, cars, other people, etc.  they are exactly what I needed.  Super happy with my purchase.  Only issue now is trying not to lose these lil’ earbuds. 😉

title: Great
review: This is probably my fourth pair of headphones.  Hubby and daughter have too now.  I have purchased high end expensive ones that don’t work as good.  These do NOT last as long as they say tho.  I do 2 hour workouts and I have to fully charge after each workout.  Good investment

title: disappointed
review: Damn what a disappointment.  My beats are great.  Thought I would upgrade to wireless.  Had nothing but problems.  The sound kept cutting in and out nonstop like a cord was plugged in but loose....even though there is no cord.  The sound wasn't as good as the plug in beats. I ended up returning for the Beats Studio Wireless...and those were a disappointment too.  Returned those and ended up buying 50. cheap headphones that work great.  Sometimes just because you pay a lot of money doesn't mean you get a good value unfortunately.

title: Best product
review: There’s many headphones out there but this one is the very best for hearing and talking .. and I’ve bought many I always stick with this one I’ve bought five .. others tear up easy these don’t !! Great quality

title: Volume was too low!
review:
Unfortunately, this DVD player did not work for my family. I purchased one for each of my two kids (2 & 4) to use during a 3-hour flight. The DVD player worked fine, but the volume was so low that they could not hear any of their movie while on the plane, with or without their headphones. We could not adjust the volume to make it louder. We are returning this product and getting an Insignia from Best Buy. It's pricier but we have had one in the past and we know the volume is loud enough for my noisy boys.

UPDATE: The seller reached out and tried to correct the issue. I'm giving this a higher rating because customer service reached out for a solution. However, we had already returned the players and purchased new ones.

title: Sound decent for price, comfortable and good battery life.
review: They stay on really well and have great battery life. The quality of the sound is decent for the price range. The band that goes behind the head is comfortable, but you do hear the rubbing noise while moving around. I am not a fan of the type of squishy gel earbud tips that came with them and maybe that would greatly reduce the noise from the behind the head band. Otherwise, it was easy to pair, comfortable and easy to grab and go. Oh, it comes with a really cool tiny little zipper case to protect them while they are in your gym bag, carry on, book bag, ect.

title: Great but...
review: Great headphone but screen fell out within first 3 months. Still works great though.

title: Good quality!
review: I’m not an expert on sounds, but this item has great reception. They are fixed very well in my ears.  Also, you can manage the volume from each earbud, and turn it on or turn it off. I think those earbuds under $50 are great! Battery life is awesome, at least for me.

title: Great earbuds!
review:
Very impressed with this product. I like it a lot. I'm not so good with technology but it is easy to manage this item. Sound amazing! The earbuds come with other accessories for any changes to do. They stay in very well. My right ear is more reluctant to keep the earbud but it is not a problem for me.
Definitely, I recommend this product and the price is worth it.

title: My teenaged son loves it.
review:
My son bough these because other types did not work for him.
He does sport, and he needs to be able to listen to instruction and jump at the same time. So bulky over the head earphones do not work for him. The small earbuds keep falling out.
His coach recommended these. It is a bit too expensive, but it is bought for a good cause.
My son walks around in these all day long. Seems to fit him just fine.
I can always talk to him, he does not pull them out to listen.
The only downside is that the sound leaks a bit, and I can hear it when we are in the car. But this is a small thing that does not affect us much.
Overall, he absolutely loves them.

title: Comfortable
review:
I bought these earbuds for my boyfriend because he does not like wireless ones and these did not disappoint. It didn't say it was compatible with a Google pixel 6, but my common sense expected it to work since it's a C port. The case is really small and helpful. It even has a clip for the microphone to attach to a shirt.

The earbuds are smaller than ones I've had before, but this was actually a good thing because they fit very comfortably with the angle of my ear. The earbuds don't have a left or right marker on them but it's not really necessary. I put them on correctly the first time but if somebody's having issues remembering which is which the right side has the microphone.

The quality was good. As others have said, for the price of these it's good/better than what I expected.

I really love the magnet feature though. How many times have you been trying to listen to music and someone wants to ask you something really quick. Instead of having to hold on to the earbud or keeping one in, they can just connect behind your neck (or in front if you prefer to wear it backwards). The magnet also helps when you have them in the case so that they don't get tangled and knotted.

title: Confusing
review:
So I had the original Samsung Galaxy buds and they were great until eventually they just could not hold a charge anymore. I was hoping these would be a nice replacement and they are to a degree.
The sound quality is nice. I have no problems with that and the noise cancellation is also pretty well done. The issue I have is whenever I tap on the earbud when it's in my ear it can be confusing where to tap and what to tap.
Some of the options want you to tap at the top of the earbuds or at the middle and then some on the side to change the volume.
In the app there are a lot of options to help customize your taps, but sometimes it feels like it just doesn't read.

Overall they are very functioning earbuds

title: So the durability is pretty ok. Sound is beautiful
review:
Bought this headset in May 2013. Just had an earpiece break last month due to wear and tear I guess.
Never been thrown, always charged properly, always taken care of lovingly, and one day I went to take it off my head and as I pulled the earpiece it snapped.
Fortunatly the cord is still intact, and I was able to tape it and can still use it, it just doesn't sit tight naymore.

So the durability is pretty ok. Sound is beautiful, and the range of it is a solid 20 foot.

title: Great
review: Just got these new headphones and dang do they really cancel out all the other gym noise.  The volume of the music is awesome too and talking to people with them is great.  They can hear me just fine and I can hear them good.

title: Great stand, solid build
review: Works great for all sizes of headphones, I have several pair, a few for gaming and a few for work and they all fit on the stand without any issues.. A couple examples of headphones Creative Fatal1ty, Logitech G930 wireless and Plantronics Gamecon Pro1. Stand is sturdy and balanced enough that headphones don't cause it to fall over.

title: LOVE these earbuds
review: I always have trouble getting earbuds to stay on my ears, especially if I'm doing anything physical while wearing them. These fit perfectly and don't budge. The sound quality is excellent and they're very easy and quick to put on.

title: Blissfully paired with O2+ODAC
review: Paired together with a proper AMP/DAC, these headphones will truly sing. The instruments come to life, the vocals seem to just flow with ease. Nothing is too overpowering and overbearing.

title: Not as good as the reviews
review: This did not live up to the reviews.  I'm not sure if the people with positive reviews have actually heard good earphones or not.  This was only okay.  Bass was good but treble & midrange was weak.  Worth the price tag?  Yes, but there is at least one other brand (that i have personally tried) in this price range that is better.  This one supposedly has a better battery life (but I was not able to test that as I returned mine).  Bass can be improved with a better seal, but I am not sure how to improve the highs so this didn't work for me.

title: Great sound but a few shortcomings
review: Very impressed with sound.  Also very comfortable for in-ears.  A few observations now that I've been able to use them - wires are a little on the lighter side for $100.00 earbuds (not sure how well they will hold up over time but they are no thinner than the stock Apple earbuds and they hold up for me).  I now realize I prefer the angled plug but this isn't a deal breaker.  The biggest disappointment is that I noticed that in-ear headphones make terrible talkers.  Plug your ears with your fingers and talk - that's the effect you get when you talk on the phone with these.

title: needing something to extend the cord of my favorite headphones.
review: Exactly what I was looking for.  needing something to extend the cord of my favorite headphones.

title: Good value, pretty sturdy
review: Surprisingly sturdy for an inexpensive Bluetooth headset.  Runs for about four hours on a charge and the warning that the battery is low happens about 90 seconds before it shuts down.  All in all it's comfortable and I use it in my wood shop to suppress some medium level machine sounds.

title: Quality
review: For the price, these are quality. They have good bass and good overall sound quality. The cord is also thick and durable. I've had to throw away many pairs of expensive Bose headphones because they make their cords so cheap they fray and fall apart.

title: Bad cord
review: Sound is good but the cord is awful. The cord is extremely thin and cheap. It looks like a bad hair day when the cord is hanging. I like headphones with a cord that will just hang straight down when hanging from your ears.

title: For the price, just meh...
review: Always like to have a wired pair of buds for travel, and these were cheap.  Sound quality was not great, but ok for podcasts, etc.  I also have the Oneplus Bullets usb c and the old Pixel usb c earbuds and both of those are better and are not much more money (if you can find them)  Even the AKG cheap pair I have are better than these.  Once again, if you can get these for under $15, they are ok, but don't expect much.  I think some of the others from this brand are much better and worth a couple of extra dollars.

title: Android Users
review: For those of you who use Android and are thinking of buying. I have a Samsung Galaxy Note 4. I absolutely love these headphones. Totally worth what I paid for them. The sound quality is fantastic, and the BT range is great! I can walk around my entire apartment without losing the connection. I've had them a few weeks now and still have not had to charge them yet. Wonderful purchase!

title: Great battery life and very good sound quality
review: Decided to upgrade from my wired earphones to BT earbuds. After much online research into brands, quality, features, I decided on the Mifo O5 product. I couldn't be happier with the purchase. As other reviewers noted, the initial packaging and quality of battery case is outstanding...very heavy duty. The battery keeps the earbuds charged almost forever! It did take quite a bit of experimenting with the 6 included earbud covers to find the right size for my ear canal. The sound is fine for my less than audiophile requirements but plenty of bass and treble choices should work for most people. I highly recommend this product for sound, quality and battery life.

title: Best laptop headset
review: Bought to deliver web-based training and Skype friends. Although its only been a few weeks, the headset has been reliable, delivers great sound -- both ways -- and is the perfect size for mobile laptop use. I really like the "behind the head" configuration and find it comfortable. I bought the product from Amazon and received a great deal including a manufacturer rebate. Very satisfied.

title: Waste of money.
review:
I purchased these headphone from the Panasonic website. They came in the mail and when I opened the box it was like stepping into the car of a smoker. The terribly sour smell of years old carcinogens filled my kitchen. I put the battery in and put the headphones on. The right ear sounded amazing, the noise cancelling was working as it should. The left ear was terrible. It was just a loud hissing attempting to drown out the suburban noise, at the time between 20 and 30 decibels in my house, that was clearly too much for the unit to handle. I wouldn't pay $10 for this substandard set of headphones and they want $160.

Don't waste your money. After half an hour on hold with Panasonic, I hope I can get mine back.

title: Buy some and see
review: Great headphones for a great price. Great conversation starter as well --- real wood headphones, who would have thought!

title: Read this Review Before Purchasing These Headphones
review:
Not thrilled with this purchase! I find these headphones to be uncomfortable on my ears. The coiled design of the headphones makes them very springy and difficult to uncoil. They do not fit properly around my ears and slide out of place easily. I'm not too sure what all of the other positive reviews were pleased with! I purchased these based upon the favorable reviews and I'm glad I didn't waste a lot of money on these.
The bluetooth was easy to connect with my compatible electronics but the sound quality is average to poor. I will keep looking for a better wireless headphone in the meantime.

title: IPOD Shuffle
review: This product was shipped promptly. I was not thoroughly pleased with the product however. You can only control the shuffle from the headset. This is a problem if you ever want to plug the shuffle into any other speaker source. The sound is good. If your only use is for excercise or running I guess you would like the tiny size of this unit. It doesn't have a case and is really easy to lose due to the really small size. I wish I waited one more week to purchase this item. I didn't realise that NEW IMPROVED, LESS EXPENSIVE IPOD shuffles would be hitting the shelves.

title: Wont last even if you're careful
review: So after a lot of headset research, I decided to give this company a try. Everything was great at first. They're soft, don't get caught in your hair, dont hurt your head and the sound is great. We are extremely careful with the headsets. They have a special big hook close to the ground on the side of the entertainment unit where we place them immediately after use. We've never dropped them EVER. One day out of the blue the microphone and the sound stops working on one of the headsets. Just randomly. Then a few days later the same thing happens to the other headset. We bought them both at the same time. This is only after a few months of use. I reached out to the company and they were awesome about everything. They sent me 2 replacement headsets for free pf charge. I offered to send the broken ones so they could assess what could be wrong. It can't just be happening with only our 2 headsets. They said it was not necessary  so I was happy I didn't have to have the hassle of that. So here we are happy with our 2 replacements and what happens?!! A few months later THE SAME THING! THEY BOTH LITERALLY, ONE DAY, OUT OF THE BLUE, WITHIN A FEW DAYS APART, STOP WORKING. NO SOUND, NO MICROPHONE WORKING, NOTHING! So I. Just disappointed. Super disappointed I would skip this brand if I was you and try a different company.

title: The charging cable in with the headphones DOES NOT FIT the HeadPHONES!!!
review: Seriously bad quality control here.  The charging cable doesn’t even fit the headphones.  It’s far too short and the end is not the right end to fit into the jack on the headphones to charge.  SMDH

title: Used to Be Good, Can't Say Anything About Current Quality
review:
I am reviewing them as I received them about two years ago. They were great. I have read the quality has went downhill. Used to be my favorite for sound quality / fit for the price.

Now I am using the Betron BS10s, which far exceed what these earbuds were capable of and at the same price point.

title: Upgrade for earbuds
review: Great to convert regular Bose earbuds to more of a noise canceling pair. They sheid noise better and so it's a quick and cheap upgrade to making your earbuds better.

title: Great product for the price!
review: This is a great product if you want the wireless earbuds but don't want to spend a lot of money. They work great, stay charged for a long time, very easy pairing.

title: Not what I had expected!
review: This is my 3 or 4 San Disk Sport MP3 player.  The pros:  it came promptly, had internal storage around 32 GB, and works.  The cons:  The headset connects at the bottom of the player (under the clip) - this is awkward, there was supposed to be a slot for micro card - there is none, and finally it doesn't last anywhere near 20+ hours on a charge - like my old ones.  So, not really thrilled with this one, but I can live with it.  (Hence, a 3 star rating.)

title: Company will work with you if possible
review:
If you have very small ear openings (which I do), these are still too large for your ears. So, if an audiologist has ever mentioned that your ear openings are small, these will not work.

The company was very nice about the problem and apologized that their headphones didn't meet my needs. (For this I give them 4 stars.) Clearly it is not their fault. Probably 99.999% of the population could use these headphones. Alas, I am not one of them.

title: Great idea, cheap wires
review: Use these to sleep as I hate things going in my ear. The biggest issue is the wires are cheap and tangle, twist, and snap within a month or less. If they made these with better wires, this would be a great product for people who like to fall asleep with headphones but hate the soreness and pain from ear buds.

title: It's ok - bulky and zipper is wonky
review: This thing is "just ok". The zipper is finicky and sometimes comes off track. I do like that it is a hard case so I feel my headset is safe - but its also a little larger than I need it to be so it takes up a good bit of real estate in my handbag. I know some headsets are larger and would require more room - the ones with the mouthpiece and/or that wrap around your ear - but the little stick ones that most people have don't require this much space.

title: Good value for money
review: Bought these for my husband, who didn't want to spend $300 on Bose headphones. He said that they work great and really likes them. We didn't even realize that there was a Bluetooth microphone for taking phone calls, so that was an added bonus. Good value overall

title: Fair, not great
review:
As an audiophile, I took a chance on these as a gift because I once owned a part of really great audio technica headphones. These are not what I expected. The sound is fair, not great. I was expecting better not worse then I had some 25 years ago. Also, they are just uncomfortable. They are too stiff and are a little hard to handle with the folding ear pieces. Just disappointed and wish I'd purchased the lower model as I suspect they are just as good as these for $25 more. Gifting these to son and going back to my
Bose QCs.

title: Surprised
review: These are pretty good especially for the price. I had bought another brand from amazon and they kept disconnecting from my iPhone so I sent them back and bought these. They have not disconnected from my phone the sound quality is good but could be better. I sometimes hear some statistic but when that happens I just switch to the other ear bud n it’s fine. I’m assuming the charge was low on the static ear bud. Other than that these earbuds are great

title: Not quite the same as original
review:
Much thinner padthan original for my sennheiset 100 headphones.
But is more comfortable than no pad. No effect on music volume or fidelity.
Looks too small at first but easily stretches to secure fit.
Might try two on one ear for more comfort.
Very economical.

title: disappointing sound
review: I've had Koss headphones for years, including their electrostatic ones way back when. Disappointed in sound quality.Returned them/

title: comfortable and sound good enough
review: This is the only style earbuds that stay in my ears. Using for talk and old time radio broadcasts but occasionally music still sounds good. Comfortable enough for several hours of continuous listening. Only negative is the nonreplaceable tips but they hold last a while. I would easily replace them

title: Very nice headphones.
review: High quality wireless headphones. I really enjoy using these. The sound quality is much better than the pair I replaced.

title: If you're questioning if you should, the answer is yes
review: I really, really debated on whether or not I wanted to spend the money on these. I regret not buying them sooner. I tried the knockoffs and they sucked but these... These are perfect. They hold a charge. I mean, really hold a charge. I keep my charging cable at my desk and unplugged it one day and forgot to plug it back in. For a whole week I kept plugging the case into the unplugged charging cord. A whole week. I mean, I don't use them constantly but I definitely have them on for a couple hours most days. The sound is phenomenal. No complaints. If you're like me and you can't use most headphones because they insert into your ear and questioning the cost, just do it, you won't regret it.

title: Doesn’t work on Pacifica!
review: I read many of the reviews and the “Questions & Answer” section… there are some reviews that state these work on 2018 and newer Chrysler Pacificas, they will only work on the overhead DVD Players! Most other headphones state that in their description, if you have a behind the headrest system, these WILL NOT WORK! You can direct line into the system, but the seats in the very back of the van don’t have that option, so they still won’t be able to hear. Even though the seller states in the question and answer section that they will work on any IR system, this is not true. Otherwise, they are very comfortable and seem like very nice headphones.

title: Actually got mine from Best Buy.
review: Actually got mine from Best Buy... Sorry Amazon they beat you on the price. But just wanted to do a comparison of these vs. the Skullcandy crusher wireless. The Sony had more features, and the bass sounds more natural even when using the xtrabass feature. It's deep rich punchy however the mids and highs don't get downed out like on the old Sony xb950bt headphones. The mids could be a little more present but that's easily fixed with an equalizer app. Now... The Skullcandy crusher wireless headphones, have really good bass as well but at its highest seeing it over powers everything. Setting the bass at 15% is good enough. There are seperate bass driver's in the Skullcandy that deliver the bass... But it sounds more like after bass as if it's not nearly part of the song. Now if I'm watching movies I'm using the Skullcandy crushers. But for music I'm using the Sony 950n1"s or my v-moda Crossfade wireless which delivers excellent well balanced sound with a good amount to bass you can feel without sounding artificial it life an after thought. But the Sony 950n1's are fun headphones but honestly they are not 200.00 headphones for what they do. I use the Sony's when I just want to look silly and hear a lot of unrealistic bass in my music.... They are toys and not for serious music listening because the sound is anything but accurate, but they are a blast to listen to.

title: Amazing
review: Worked amazing went through the wash like 3 times and still worked as if I just pulled them out of the box. My dog ended up chewing them so I decided to get another pair, this time I got the ones with a mic and they were awful. The sound quality sucked and the right earbud didn’t work at all. So I got a third pair without the mic and I’m glad I did

title: Does not work!!
review: Kept getting error message that says accessory is not supported. This happened for both headphone options. So, totally worthless. Returning immediately.

title: Great combination of battery life, sound, and noise canceling technology
review: My partner snores and I wanted to have headphones to limit the noise when I can’t sleep.  These are wonderful. I put on some nature sounds and the noise canceling feature and have a much better nights sleep.  My previous headphones needed to be charged much more often and I was afraid they would die before morning. But this headset is great.

title: World-class noise canceling and okay sound
review: I’m an audiophile have lots of headphones and Amps and DACs for my headphones however out of all of them these AirPods are the only ones with noise canceling and it makes a massive difference. The sound itself lacks a lot mostly because Apple still lacks a HQ lossless Bluetooth coded like LDAC or APTX for the iPhone. Not even just the AirPods themselves, I have a BT receiver that I used on my old android phone but on my new iPhone 14 pro max the LDAC and APTX isn’t supported which was a huge let down. For simple terms there is no high quality Bluetooth it’s going to lose quality because of the lack of wires.

title: Great studio headphones at a good price
review:
Great studio headphones at a good price. THey just don’t fit as snug over my ears as I would like, I can’t get the right setting so that they both stay tight over my ears, one always has to lift off at the bottom of my ear. Does that make sense?
As far as sound quality, though, they’re good.

title: Fits great and no issues with sound impairment
review: Fit my Shoxx 808 earphones (which were peeling onto my skin, clothes, and floor) perfectly.  Very comfortable; sound quality of headphones not impacted.

title: Excellent fit and sound, great charging pod
review: When you choose the right size ear guard, they fit great and snug.  I have always had trouble finding earbuds that fit right in my ear canal.  Most of the time they would fall out after 5 minutes.  Haven't had that problem with these. They also have nice volume, not watered down like some.  But the best part is the portable charging pod - not only do the buds themselves have pretty long life, bring the very portable charging pod with you can give you days of charge. Works great on my conference calls as well. Very pleased after one month.

title: Battery does not keep charge.
review: Not a great product battery does not charge past 40% and I’ve only had the headphones for 4 months.

title: Useless: Imagine a phone that doesn't make calls
review:
If you like headphones that are so advanced that no one can hear you on a call, then these expensive pieces of crap are exactly what you are looking for. From a default "mute microphone by single press" setup that doesn't reflect as muted on your phone during the call to no one being able to hear you because the microphones are blocked by your ears, these are ONLY effective at producing sound and nothing else. And guess what? You always inadvertantly press one of the two headphones once simply by putting them in your ears so they are always muted. What an awesome design! You have to turn this feature off in the app which only works if the buds are out of the case. You cannot troubleshoot them in any other state, the app provides no interaction until the headsets are detected. Very backwards logic. Going through troubleshooting online, in the app, and with Jabra support, never once was it mentioned or thought of to check the mute feature, which, as I've stated, is completely stupid and will always mute your buds and never tell you.

I was so excited and so hopeful and now I'll never buy anything from this brand ever again. Terrible. Absolute garbage. Only good for listening, the worst at attempting to use for calls.

title: Great Value
review:
I am writing this review while working in a factory, and although as others have posted, the noise cancelling doesn't knock out loud banging sounds, they do a remarkable job eliminating the type of machine hum you get from idling machinery or air conditioners. Without these I wouldn't bother listening to music in my office during production hours.
For the price, these are a great buy. The only caveat would be if you have issues with earbuds. But even here, they are designed well, fitting nicely in my ear. Two thumbs up!

title: Great Earbuds!
review: It took a little bit of work but I got this to work perfectly with my BoboVR halo head strap! I was looking for an earbud setup that would emulate what my PSVR v2 headset has because it's so convenient. This works awesome and the audio so far is great for what earbuds can output.

title: nice headphones
review:
product loses 1 star for not having a charging cable for each headphone, package only comes with 1 charging cable for 2 headphones.
the other problem is you need to have a USB port on your tv to run these headphones, or buy a cable to plug into wall
other than that, the setup was easy as 1 2 3.
if you have problems getting it running do not forget the on off switch, like I did,
I thought since it is powered by the tv there would not be a on off switch but after finding switch on back of transmitter everything works great

title: Good head phones
review: I love everything about these headphones. The sound quality is good, they fit comfortably in my ears, and the pink color is very cute. I have nothing negative to say about them. I would buy these again in the future =)

title: Overall nice, very portable for travel.
review: Good looking headphones, and reasonable NC.  Sound quality is good, but not "wowing" as I was expecting from other reviews.  The earphones can get slightly uncomfortable (due to pressure) after a few hours, but the material of the cuffs is actually pretty nice/comfortable overall.  Very portable and come in a nice case with room for the included wires.  Of note, the audio cable is proprietary - you cant just use a normal 3.5mm audio cable.  However the necessary audio cable is included with the headphones.  If you have a large head or large ears, you'd probably be better off spending the extra money to get the Over/Around ears version instead of this on-ear version.  I paid $200 for this item (Ivory).

title: Best sound quality and comfortable
review: These replaced another very popular pair of earbuds. They are more comfortable and sound quality is excellent and the buds are very comfortable. This is important as these buds are worn 8+ hours a day.

title: WC ear pads for Sony MDR
review: I really like these ear pads and this purchase has allowed us to utilize our headphones. We had not used them for several years because the covers deteriorated and black pieces stuck in our hair and to the skin. I tried to sew some covers but those didn't fit as well. I do think these WC replacements are perfect but very pricey. They were a bit difficult to install.

title: If you have money to spend go for it
review: I do not recommend this product at all. The product kept coming off each time I took out my headphones and is completely an unnecessary purchase.

title: Worth it
review: If you care about stupid stuff like skinning your headphones this is a cool, cheap way of showing that stupidity. Easy to install with my 2.0 reading glasses. They fit and don’t seem to affect how they function.

title: These don’t work
review: I bought these to use on my iPhone and as soon as I start connecting these to my iPhone these start muting the sound. I have tried to adjust the issue through settings on the phone but no use. I have passed the return window but still could come on here and review the product. I do not recommend these headphones.

title: Decent Headset
review: I usually wear over-ears when exercising because in-ears will pop out (and I guess I have weird ears). Surprisingly though, this pair has survived a 5-mile run so that's auspicious. Downside though (as with all in-ear headphones) is that the tips can start to hurt a bit after a while.

title: Not bad....but longevity issue (updated review)
review:
UPDATE: headphones no longer turn on after a few months. Charged overnight so power is not the issue; the device itself just doesn’t activate.

These headphones are alright: comfortable to wear and they stick to you when you're running (they don't pop off or out like earbuds can).

Pros: 1) Cheap. There seems to be big price difference between these headphones and the next-up comparables. 2) Comfortable at least up to an hour or two.

Cons: 1) Cheap. I can hear something clicking or clacking when I run, which I suspect is like a button or something. 2) SKIPS randomly, which is unnerving. You're listening to whatever and suddenly your music or podcast jerks ahead 5-10 seconds. Mainly occurs during a run; maybe related to the clicking thing. 3) Some connectivity issues for the bluetooth.

Pro/Con: Sound level is capped it seems at a not-stupid decibel, which is good for your ears but can make it hard to hear if you're in a gym that likes to blast their music.

Overall: Mostly good, would recommend if you're not willing to consider higher quality and higher priced products.
Compared with the similar-priced Arctic brand headphones: ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ about the same. I had those for about 3 years so if these make it anywhere near that long it's probably worth the trade-offs.

title: Headset ease of usage
review:
Ordered the headset and it arrived in three days. My wife has many long conversations with relatives and this has been a God send for her.
She loves it!

title: WORKS
review: Was needing a bluetooth transmitter in my workout room. This was simple to set up, easy to understand the guide book that came with it. I used the optical audio cable that also came with it, i have ZERO latency in a room size of 20 feet by 20 feet. I am using skullcandy earbuds. Once i paired my earbuds to the transmitter all i have to do now it turn on my earbuds and the transmitter automatically  reconnects, no having to pair again or reset the transmitter.  Awesome product.

title: Good headset
review: Great sound for its size. It fits comfortably on my ears. Battery life seems to be good. I use it about an hour during my daily walk. It does not have active nose cancelling but it reduces outside noise very good. My previous Lenovo headset used to get disconnect a lot but this one has solid good connection with my iPhone 12 mini.

title: Graet for using with TV while others are sleeping
review: My TV does not have support for Bluetooth so I bought this and use it with my Avantree Bluetooth headphones. very easy to install. The volume control of the TV should not affect the audio output at the connector. I use mine with audio output from my cable box. The AptX is really great. You cannot visually detect the delay between the lips moving in the video and sound coming from the headphone. Sound quality overall is good. Great product.

title: Excellent audio quality
review:
I bought a Sennheiser PXC 300 collapsible headphones with active noise canceling a few years ago and used it mainly in air flights. It does not take very much space, has excellent sound quality, and easy to wear for extended period of time. I wanted a closed around the ear headphone and bought a refurbished HD428. Sound quality is excellent and is easy to wear for several hours at a time, but it is not as quiet as I wanted. It dampens most of the outside sound, but since I use it in bedroom with self help CD and DVDs, I still hear noise leaking in from the outside. Overall audio quality is excellent, low frequency (base) is good and is not too strong and balanced and high frequencies are crisp.
I bought a refurbished HD428 and my only complaint is about the cord length. The cord measures about 5 feet but was advertised as being 10 feet. I have to use an extension cable for my application.

title: Good sound, good price, good fit
review: I have tried several earbud/earphone solutions and always find that the fit is difficult for my small ear canals. These offer several sizes of tips, one of which did the trick for me. On a recent flight I found them very comfortable and the noice-isolation was enough that I could enjoy the sound. The case is a nice touch. As some reviewers noted, it is a bit cheap feeling but so far it is holding up well in my purse.

title: I've been using them since August of 2017 and they are still in perfect condition, no problems with sound delivery whatsoever
review: I'm known in the family as the one that always needs a cable replacement for my headphones, because I use them constantly as an avid music listener. I went through many cables before, but all of them eventually got damaged and no longer delivered quality sound. Then I came upon these cables. I've been using them since August of 2017 and they are still in perfect condition, no problems with sound delivery whatsoever. I'm very pleased with my purchase.

title: The buttons are sticky so you have to dial slowly ...
review: The buttons are sticky so you have to dial slowly enough to listen for each beep or keep starting over.  The headset is adequate but I have to hold the earpiece tight sometimes to hear.

title: A dream come true
review:
I always wanted to travel the world. When I bought these headphones, which I saw were designed for airplanes, I always imagined myself on a plane going to some exotic place. I never had the means to go anywhere, nor did I have anyone to go with. Once I had enough money, I still didn't go - I couldn't go with anyone, I had to work, and I was also afraid of flying. However, years after I bought the headphones, an opportunity arose for me to go with my sister to Spain. After wanting to go my entire life, I faced my fear of flying, and I got on the airplane. When it took off, I put on these headphones and I felt like those people in the advertisements who wore these headphones and relaxed on the plane. I was finally able to do what I always wanted to do, and I was able to wear these headphones as I did, like I always imagined I would.

+Sound quality is amazing
+Noise cancelling works perfectly and sometimes I don't hear when people are talking to me
-Requires a lot of battery chaning

title: ... Sony noise cancelling headphones and these by far are superior. On an airplane these can cancel almost 100% ...
review: I had a previous pare of Sony noise cancelling headphones and these by far are superior. On an airplane these can cancel almost 100% of the ambient noise. They are also comfortable enough to sleep in during the flight. Unlike my other Bluetooth headphones these never lose the signal, stays strong any distance in my house. I highly recommend these!

title: What a joke these are
review: I bought these to use a SD card with so that I didn't have to pair my phone or ipod. I put some music on my SD card and loaded it into the head set. It played for about 10 minutes then it made a screech sound and after that it would not work with a SD card. The radio however still worked. I didn't buy it for a FM radio as radios have garbage over the air waves. Back it goes, NO I do not recommend this worthless headset.

title: Five stars coming from a very frugal person
review:
I am very frugal when it comes to buying things like professional headphones. I usually am willing to pay about $10 for headphones. I have been doing a lot of overtime lately and thought what the heck, go for it. I paid $41.02 including tax and free shipping. I must say that I am very impressed with these headphones. I like the strain relief that should stop one speaker from going out, which is why I needed a new pair. I also like the way they fit over my ears and block noise. These also have the wire on the left ear only no they don't irritate my neck like the cheaper sets do.
Well for me it is a no brainer......BUY, BUY, BUY.

title: Great headphones, even better customer service
review: I bought an earlier version of these headphones from Amazon two years ago (in 2011). They worked great for those two years, but recently the sound began to short out and the connection needed to be wiggled or held in place to keep them working. I came on Amazon to buy a new pair, and noticed on the item page that Kidz Gear offers a lifetime warranty. I called the number and after a brief conversation and verification of my purchase through Amazon, I was told that a new pair (in my choice of colors!) would be on its way. Three days later, my son is listening to his new blue headphones. We are both thrilled. Thanks, Kidz Gear!

title: ZIUTY Wireless Earbuds Quality Sound
review: ZIUTY Wireless Earbuds is ordered. Ziuty offers quality sound, adequate noise cancellation and precise battery life. Everything about Ziuty is practical, effective, convenient, and worth the price of purchase and more! It does the job! Thank you!👍

title: Good sound quality and volume control
review: These headphones are comfortable and have good sound. I use them to watch tv at night.

title: So useful
review: This is really useful. I really don’t want to trash any of my wired headphones yet. I use them on airplanes and other places. This makes it so I can actually keep them a bit longer

title: Very nice
review: Really amazing sound and nice headphones. Use these at work when I’m editing and couldn’t be happier to be in my own little bubble when I use them.

title: Pretty good.
review: I can compare this to AirPods, Bose soundsport and a pair of wireless Motorola earbuds...  these are good, don’t get me wrong, but they aren’t Bose.  They are comparable to the Motorola but they can’t be paired individually like the Motorola was.. also, they don’t stop playing when you remove one bud... otherwise pretty good for the price.. wish they had more than green colors though...  oh, they were very easy to pair...

title: Very nice headphones.
review: Great headphones but I really don’t believe these light up. Otherwise I’m content

title: Great streaming device
review: This is a really nice streaming device. I also really like the remote and how you can plug headphones in. That’s my favorite part of this device.

title: So nice.
review: First of all let me express the recycled box makes me happy.  Secondly the case this comes with is perfect and hard protection.  Perfect for travel and perfect to fling around as a toy. The contents : aka the headphones will lot get damaged in this case.  Third;  finally - the headphones. Their sound is pretty darn amazing and close to perfect. These are some awesome and may I add attractive headphones.  They look elegant. Not obnoxious.

title: Good stuff
review: These fit well and sound good. They are pretty good headphones for the 20$ mark. They are also noise cancelling which is a huge plus.

title: Wonderful but don't fit.
review: This actually sounds amazing but for some reason all three ear pieces hurt my ear after a bit. A bit disappointing, these sounded amazing. BUT most people don't have the problems I do. Even the apple iPhone/ iPod  earbuds hurt me and don't hurt most others.

title: Compared to Studio edition and Beats
review:
[[VIDEOID:35856f83a4b64686090c8cd40e30a2ec]] These are comparable to the beats solo headphones. Their ear pads are a bit larger and cover a bit more area and they are a bit more flexible when you bend the plastic head band and move it around.

The sound quality is very comparable to the beats, except maybe the beats have a bit more of a clarity and bass but really not by much, i only notice it because I own about 8 pairs of headphones maybe more.

All in all everyone has their own preference. I will attach a comparison video and a unboxing to this written review.

title: I love it!
review: I have one of these,  everyone in the sprint store was using them and suggested it to me,  and it's the best headset I've found to date.  It cancels noise out just fine, and I hear very well.  On occasion if I'm on speakerphone and someone else on this headset model or vice versatile then there's some slight choppiness but,  for the most part it's the best headset imve encountered so far.  I'd suggest this headset to anyone.  Just be careful with the. Earpiece. It's delicate.  I know a few people who have broken theirs,

title: Best earbuds for small ears!
review: Skull candy knows exactly how to make earbuds for small ears! They are perfect! I keep buying them for me and my employees since they fit us ladies so well. Love the colors and I’ve had two sets for 4+ years that are still working flawlessly.

title: Excellent image, brilliant colors
review: Very happy with this purchase. After a great deal of research, I chose to go back to Sony for my next LED TV and they didn't disappoint.  As a matter of fact, up to now, this purchase has exceeded my expectations. I also have a new Samsung LED and consider this Sony to be a higher quality, better engineered item, and I perceive their user interface to be more user friendly. Only things missing are 1.- a Bluetooth OUT signal so I can listen to audio with my Bluetooth headset, and 2.- a built-in camera for Skype.  I am waiting for the third part Bluetooth transceiver to arrive, as well as a Sony USB camera.  I imagine they will include these two features in future models.  Other than that, no complaints.

title: Great purchase!
review: I got these for my daughter's 8th birthday. They are good quality and arrived on time. She is very happy with her headphones and so am I.

title: Poor Quality Headphones
review: I received these headphones on 04/26/22 and used them a few times. On 05/16/22 the button to skip tracks stopped working. I had to keep taking my phone out of my pocket while I was on a hike to skip to another track. I would not recommend these headphones.

title: Definitely worth the money!
review: First impressions are great - delivers all it promises. Very light, well done, great sound quality and good ANC. You can probably get a little more in sound quality and ANC with other higher priced headphones, but you'll have to spend 3 times or more - if money is not an issue and you have professionally trained ears, those may be worth for you, otherwise, this headphone is probably the best deal you can get!

title: Decent sound for the money
review: Good bang for the buck.  Easily paired with my iphone, with decent sound quality for both music and pod casts.  The only drawback for me is the fit (which I guess is a pretty big issue) - although I've tried several sizes of the ear pads, the "business end" of the headphones tend to pull out of my ear.  Could be the way the over the ear piece rests, or could be the angle that the earbuds are set at, but the earbuds just want to pop out of my ear.  For shorter listening periods, this is manageable, since they don't fall off my head, just a slip a bit out of my ear.  But for listening on longer projects that I do around the house, these can be a bit distracting.

title: Another installment of "you get what you pay for"
review: I have no complaints about the sound quality. But the construction is just a hair above the free headphones that airlines give out. The switches to loosen the grip on the skull seem pretty gimmicky to me. I do enjoy that they clasp together to stay pretty small. But they feel cheap, and look cheap, and I'm a little embarrassed to be seen wearing them in public.

title: These have been the best so far
review: These are currently my fav headphones.  Im addicted to skullcandy and have had a few diff ones. These have been the best so far.

title: Best for the price
review: I’ve ordered TONs of earbuds for my son we were going through a back almost every month these have last about 6 months which is really good.

title: Broke in 3 months
review: The battery life is excellent on these, I could go many days without having to charge them and that was sleeping in them every night. The earbud was a bit uncomfortable, my ear was sometimes sore in the morning.  I was happy with the sound quality and had high hopes for these but the earbuds popped apart at the seam and will not stay together. Very, very disappointed.

title: Great earbuds
review: I received these promptly and packaged well. I've only used two of them, so far, they work very well and are the most comfortable earbuds I've used. The case is perfect for keeping a pair in my purse or bag and big enough to hold all 3 pairs so other small items can fit with the earbuds if not using it for the additional pairs. I'm very pleased with my purchase and would definitely recommend this product to my friends!

title: Get what you pay for
review: Makes a lot of noise for the person on the receiving end of the phone call. They are no Samsung Level U headphones, but I guess I knew that from the price. Ohh, and the zipper on case has already spoiled.

title: Made in China.  No microphone.  Nice assortment of colors.
review:
This is a set of 20 headphones, in ten assorted colors. These headphones do not have microphones. So if you're going to use them for things like Zoom . . . these will not work. But as long as you don't need a microphone, then these will work. They have nice padding against the ear. The sound quality is quite nice for this type of inexpensive headphone.

These headphones are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. There are lower-priced options if you're looking for headphones which are more-or-less "disposable". There are nicer options with better sound and comfort if you're looking for something of higher quality and better sound. But if you're looking for something "in the middle", then these certainly work.

title: Made in China.  No Blu-ray.  Nice size.
review:

I like that the screen will turn-around and fold flat to the bottom of the unit. The speaker isn’t great, but you can use headphones or a separate speaker.

title: Made in China.  Bluetooth  AC Charger not included
review:
These headphones have smaller pads, so are best for younger kids. They fit comfortably next to the ears.

For some reason, they don’t use the word “Bluetooth” in the listing, but these are indeed Bluetooth headphones. You can also use them with a cord. Cord included. Charging with USB-C connection. Very short cord include. AC charger not included.

These headphones are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon.

title: Made in China. Pricey, but nice overall.
review:
These are wired headphones, and not wireless. The ear portions are soft and fit comfortably next to the ear. The portion that goes over the head is lightly padded. The ear portions fold in so they are a little more flat. It’s nice that these have limited volume. The sound quality is fine for this type of device. I have the blue and red design. I like the bright colors.

These headphones are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. At the current price of 16 bucks, they are at least 10 bucks overpriced, but overall they are fine.

title: Made in China.  Comfortable.  Attractive.
review:

These headphones are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon.

title: Made in Singapore.  Comfortable.  Good sound.  Nice active noise cancelling.
review:
These Bluetooth headphones come packed with a nice carrying case (bag), a 30-inch USB – C charging cord, a 46- inch 3.5 mm audio cord with straight on one end and 90 degree on the other. This is the “hybrid” part of the unit. The information indicates that this cord is good for when you are low on power, you can connect directly to a device. I like the voice that comes over the headphones that indicate when the device is on, off, pairing, etc. I also like the adjustable headpiece that extends on the two sides with graduation markers so you can make sure each side is equally extended for comfort fit. The noise cancelling function works very well as does the ambient, which is basically a low “white noise” sound. There is volume adjustable on the right side along with the other function buttons. The earpieces actually turn 90 degrees so that the headphones can lay flat. They also fold up so that they minimize space when stored. The headphones are very comfortable to wear, and should be able to be worn for extended periods with comfort. I wouldn’t call the sound exceptional, but it’s good. Overall, I really like this headset. I’ll use it for a lot of different things such as concerts and auto races, as my ears are particularly sensitive to loud noises.

Made in Singapore

review: I’m giving these earbuds five stars because they exceed my expectations when they only cost seventy cents each. I find it hard to complain about these, especially considering the cost. title: Made in China.  Really nice sound and great fit.
review:
These are nice earbuds with a nice fit. I really like that you can connect to more than one device. No issues with pairing. Very clear sound with very good bass. You can easily make adjustments through the app.

Made in China.

title: Great for fitness, but also for all-around use.
review: These earbuds are some of the most comfortable that I’ve tried. These are the “active fit” type of earbuds which stay in your ears better for workouts and such. I really like the active noise canceling. Great small charging case. I like using them not only for workouts, but for all around general use as well.

title: Made in China. Nice overall for the price.
review:
These earbuds are on the lower end of the pricing scale… Well as features scale… For Jabra earbuds. Nonetheless, they are quite nice.

Nonetheless, the sound is actually quite nice and there is reasonable base. Overall I like them.

title: Really nice sound.  Fit well.
review: These earbuds fit well and are comfortable.  They have really nice sound with nice bass.  Connected to my phone without a problem.  Compact case.  These are probably not the ones you want for sports, but for everyday, they are quite nice.

review:
This wearable gaming speaker is for those who do not wish to wear headphones for whatever reason. With this speaker you get great sound but you can also hear everything that is going on around you. Different sound modes allow you to make adjustments depending upon what you are listening to.

review:
These are cute headphones for kids. Flashing lights add a little extra “zip” to them. I really like that they have a micro-SD card input (micro card sold separately). This way you can listen to music anywhere without having to be connected to anything (phone / streaming service).

These headphones are Made in China and being sold by a Chinese company on Amazon. There are lots of these same or similar headphones being sold by Chinese companies on Amazon right now. . . so. . . .Make sure you look around for the best price.

title: Made in China.  Meeting neckband for quiet spaces.
review:
Though Sony likes to tell you that this neckband is for all sorts of different things. . . It’s really more for online meetings, than anything else. Even then. . . It’s best used in a quiet environment and not with other noise around you, as it doesn’t isolate your voice that well.
