These do have excellent sound and hold a charge for a long time.  They are easy enough to charge up and pairing with my Chromebook was fast and easy.  I have not had them drop out unless I leave the room.  Overall I'm pleased, but I just can't get them adjusted so they fit with my glasses on so I can watch videos (I end up putting the glasses on over the headband, and it just is not the same as actually wearing the glasses, and I can't get the bifocal (no line) to set right for my eyes.

title: No directions
review: This works pretty good as a preamp.  There were no directions so figuring it out took me a bit.  I really don't use headphones a lot anymore but this little preamp worked liked it should.  No idea if cut back on distortion as every thing is digital now anyways.  It did boost the signal but when I use headphones it is usually very quietly as I have sensitive hearing anyway.  If you have a need for this type of devise (I got it for using headphones with my guitar amps)this one works well.

title: What died in this?
review:
So I just received this to test out. Yes it is big (standard iPad sized) It has some very good potential storage straps and pockets and areas to keep chargers, battery packs, cables, cards , earbud, and small headphones. Well you know all the garbage we find necessary to take with us when we venture more than 10 miles from our homes (I mean seriously I have 4 chargers in my car and 4 battery pack charges and yet I still insisted on taking 4 cables and 2 wall worts wherever I go). Any way when I open this case up I almost vomited. I honestly smells like a rat died in this thing. I tossed it out on our porch and I'm airing it out as I type (after 2 hours it still smells like dead rat) Seems like it would be a somewhat handy (if not oversized) organizer if I can get the smell out, but as for now no way this is going anywhere with me and NO way I'm putting anything in this.
24 hour update: The smell is gone so I moved this up one star. Closed it up and reopened it up after a couple hours and no dead rat smell. If you get one that smells try airing it out (outside as no way you want that smell in your house). for 24 hours.

title: Charge issues
review: These earbuds have decent sound and actually link very easy.  They don't cut out like some other wireless ones I have tried.  THey come with a couple extra ear plugs to get a perfect fit.  My only issue with them is that the right side will not hold a charge.  I have tried to recharge 2 times and the left side holds a charge for about an hour of constant use.  the right side goes 15 mins then gives the low battery warning.  I'm going to try to run them both down to shut off and see if that helps but so far these are not up to the task.

title: Too cheap
review:
My headset came with the mic on the right side, not the left.
The left speaker is louder than the right one. It's not my hearing nor the computer, just poor quality.

title: Good
review: they are comfortable, good sound and bluetooth.  the only thing is that you can't use the left earphone independently, if the right one is charging

title: This Bluetooth are very good. I owned many brands of Bluetooth from cheap ...
review: WOW. This Bluetooth are very good. I owned many brands of Bluetooth from cheap to very expensive ones and I have to say that this ones are up there with very high prices one. I been using them since yesterday, I use them with my iPhone 6plus at the Gym, with my Macbook pro and they are very good. sound quality battery looks to last long, only charge it once and no problem so far. I been using them all day today on the same charge I will recommend this headset to anyone.

title: Get what you pay for.
review: With the price tag, a better job cannot be done. This is a good little pair of earbuds. Definitely worth it.

title: Very good product for the price tag.
review:
The sound quality is comparable to big names in the industry.
In love with this headphone. Totally covers my ears and it doesn't make me sweat too much on the sides. I like the product.

title: Very good headphone for the money.
review:
Incredibly good for the money. Sound quality is good for what you pay. I
It is definitely loud enough to not hear anything else outside in full volume.
And the touch feature is good in the earphone itself.

title: Amazing but old technology for these days.
review:
This product on a glance is amazing. But, it still has the old charging port, not type C so it takes a while to charge.

Apart from that, the sound quality is amazing for a 60$ headphone. I cannot comment about it’s durability since I’ve had it for 2 weeks now but until this point the headphone seems to work great.

Its definitely not the top of tiers but in the price range its one of the best. And skull candy is very popular. I shouldve chosen hesh 3 but I opted out for hesh 2 because of the review. It lives to the hype but it was a while this headphone was made. Now, with technology getting so good, this may be termed as a normal headphone.

The outlook is amazing. It looks great and the skull logo is definitely a plus. You can pretty much jam good music all by yourself if your music choice is good.

4/5 anyday.

title: Sound Quality is good, and good design.
review:
The overall product as a whole is very good. The battery stays for a while and the sound quality is good.
It doesnt seem like it but there are buttons in the little earbuds on there face side, for you to answer, put down your phone calls.
The only problem with this device is that, and this most certainly is a glitch; in iphones, once you put down a phone call, and you get it back again, the speaker doesn't automatically connect. You have to turn off your bluetooth and turn it back again to again make it accessible the next time. The newer models might have a fix for this, but as of now this is a glitch.

title: Want to say love them but can’t
review: I was so excited when I get my earbuds. Now they slide out my ear and the cap fell off the left ear. If I can keep them in my ear I would love them

title: Useless
review:
Despite some personal contacts by the company I was never able to get these puppies to sound "right", at least to me.
What was worse was the Bluetooth connectivity or lack of it. I measured its effective range for me at 24 inches from my iPod. At 25 inches the sound was choppy. At 34 inch distance I was getting messages like "Out of Range". I walk long distances and I found I couldn't put the iPod in my pocket because it was too far away. If I held my iPod in my hand and swung my arms as I walked it was okay when my arm swung up but would get choppy every time my arm came down, or the furthest point in the arc of my range of motion. Unless you are sitting perfectly still with your source within 24 inches of your headphones these buds are useless. The company didn't see fit to respond so Thank You Amazon.

title: The best
review: This is the third case I've tried. While the most expensive it is clearly the best. It comes in 2 pieces so you can remove the player itself and put it in a shirt pocket for instance and the outer part hold that case and has a clip. And what a clip! It is real strong and such that I wasn't able to shake it off my gym shirt.The other holders were so weak that they fell off with the slightest movement. Everything about is well designed and well made, even the tab to hold the inner case within the outer case. One teensy weensy quibble. The cutout for the head phone works fine with most plugs but sometimes I like to listen with my big headphones(Audia Technica M50) and the bigger plug prevents it from making contact. I may just wind up shaving that hole for the headphone on the case to accommodate the bigger plug. No big deal. Otherwise this just about the perfect case.

title: I Like it.
review: Not an audiophile but I know cheap earbuds. I've tried many - Sony, Phillips,MEE,Etymotic, Sennheiser, Panasonic, Klipsch and a host of others. For just sit-down listening it was clearly the Klipsch s4. But they are not built to stay and not that great at sound block. For my more active phases the MEE(or something) had the best earpiece that was flexible to mold around your ear and the bud itself was not bad. It stayed there, blocked the ambient sound but didn't sound great. Hey, 2 out of 3 ain't bad. But then came pre-Black Friday (once known as Thanksgiving) and Amazon drops the price of these puppies and  Wallah! I snap them up. These sound a little better to me than the Klipsch, have the same ear bending wire to mold it around the ear as the MEE and the unique way it fits and the cushion just fill the entire ear canal comfortably with the best earbud sound. That;s 3 out of 3 if you don't count the price. Get these if you're limited to $100 or less or wait until next Black Friday

title: Best 'phones under $6.
review: While I am no expert when it comes to earbuds under $6 I can truthfully say, "These ain't half-bad". I have certainly used earbuds that were more expensive than these that didn't sound as good. If your budget won't allow you more than $6. for buds then these puppies are the way to go. If you want to listen to music as it was recorded or instruments that sound real I would humbly suggest that you may have to spring for a little bit more. How much more? Whatever the Klipsch S4 costs.

title: Stays in place at least
review: I was sold by the reviews. Frankly, I don't feel that they are good music headphones. I'm no audiophile but to me the musical instruments just don't sound right. That being said once you learn how to put these puppies in they do stay in through all the situps and other gym stuff I do. I'll keep them for that but they are no Klipsch.

title: OK but not great.
review: I'm no audiophile but I think I can tell great speakers from ordinary ones. As everyone has said here they are a good value if you're looking to spend less than $40. Has nice features in the hockey puck control but the sound, to me, is just not real. Pianos and guitars just do not sound as "true" as compared to listening on my very good Klipsch earbuds. Step up from what I had but still a ways to go.

title: Tried it. Didn't love it.
review: Tried these as I have had good experience with other Sennheisers (P 200) but these just didn't impress. Maybe they need to be "broken in" with some burning in. I'm not a techie audiophile but the musical instruments just don't sound "real" to me. My best 'phones? my Klipsch S4s earbuds. I'll keep them and hope they get better.

title: They're OK
review: I bought these hoping they would be the perfect earbuds forever. I got them promptly and tested them and they sounded OK. Isolation was good with the foam tips. But when I compared them to my Klipsch S4 I could tell the difference. Not an audio expert but the Klipsch let the instruments sound like what I thought instruments sounded like. I also got a set of Comply foam tips and that seems to do the job better than the the original tips. Admittedly very subjective.

title: Great Purchase
review: Sound quality is great. Noise cancellation is great. Just received them and the battery life seems to be good also. I’m case you haven’t noticed these earbuds are - great. I would recommend.

title: I really love it. Very cute air-pods case with fluffy keychain
review: I truly love the quality, look and feel of this case cover. I bought two: one for me and an other one for my daughter. Fluffy ball looks and feels so soft and nice. Metal parts are durable and gold-looking. All the silicone parts also durable and feel nice in my hand. Size is absolutely perfect. I love that set came with earphone covers which have all openings accurately crafted. Also silicone earphone holder (not sure how to call that part) is great addition. I am using it in the gym. Now I don’t have to worry about earpiece falling on a treadmill. Overall I am very happy.

title: These are great. My son loves these earbuds and case.
review: Bought them for my son because he tends to loose or rip his earbuds, which always get tangled on something. These are different. The cord is not so easy to rip. Plus they come with nice hard shell-kind protection case which is very convenient. And sound is very good. Amazing deal. I just ordered an other pair for my daughter. Thank you for a good product.

title: My daughter loves it! Awesome gift and perfectly on time for cold weather
review:
Bought it for my daughter since she loves to wear beanies and at the same time she is totally into listening her music. It’s so hard to find earphones, that will feel good. But with this set problem is resolved! Now she can listen to music and wear her beanie at the same time without worrying about loosing earphones.
This set also feels soooo gooood! Very soft and pleasant to touch. So cozy and warm, perfect for cold winter time.
Also I love that included with the set is a nice tote.
This is perfect for teens and adults.

title: Great, durable, loud - what else we need?
review: It’s a great quality item! We like these earphones as they are loud, durable, good looking ones and very comfortable to wear. I bought them for my daughter and she uses them every day now!

title: Five Stars
review: Worked really well for my reading station at school with numerous types of headphones!

title: The sound cancellation is way better than Bose...
review: Got these and the Bose QuietComfort 35 II Wireless Bluetooth Headphones at the same time to compare. The Sony pair is way better, more comfortable, and better looking. The matte grey is a tad beige and looks very classy.  Goes with everything I wear and feels ore neutral than the black. I use these everyday for noise sensitivity issues I experience. I love that I can still hear voices well enough, but it neutralizes background sounds exceptionally. They help a lot with anxiety. As for the sound quality, I am not an audiophile by any means, but to me they sound great when I am listening to music and podcasts. The battery life is also impressive. For me they've been worth every penny. No issues 2 months in with heavy, but gentle usage.

title: These are what I was looking for
review: I was looking for something lightweight and simple. Most of earphones in this category are design to go inside the ear, which I don't like. I was glad to find these on Amazon.

title: Amazing
review: These are the best headphones.  Great sound.  Has noise canceling and ambient mode.  Very comfortable and battery lasts forever.  Highly recommend.  Color is awesome too.

title: Comfort
review: The bluetooth headphone is comfortable and in good quality. The adjustable metal slider make the headphone fits my head perfectly. It can be folded to a smaller size and is light weight so it is easy to carry in a travel bag.

title: Works well
review: My five year old wears these in kindergarten and says that they are comforatae and stay on. Good headphones for computer time at school

title: Finally - comfortable earbuds!
review:
I've been on the hunt for earbuds for a while and was very hesitant to spend a lot of money on the popular brands that you see everyone have. I've always had a problem with the wired buds apple give you with the phone. They make my ears so sore after 30 minutes. I've tried my husband's earbuds from a small brand on Amazon and they kept falling out of my ears. I was hesitant to get the airpod pros because I've heard they are also uncomfortable and jump out of your ears too.

I decided to take the chance and order the echo buds because Amazon is very easy to work with on returns and considerably more affordable than other brands. I did the fit test in the Alexa app and found the size small is the perfect fit. I already use the app for my echo devices so I wasn't worried about connecting the buds to an app like others have mentioned. I wore them for an hour and they were very comfortable. I tried to eat something while wearing them to see if the movement would make them jump out of my ears but I only felt a small amount of movement and no reduction in sound.

As another review pointed out, it's probably not the best ANC system out there, but for my needs, it's perfectly fine. The passthrough feature is very cool and the touch controls work well. Although, when my long hair got warm enough and moved over the earbuds, it did pause my music for me which was odd.

Overall, I'm very happy with these.

title: Fantastic buy
review: Absolutely incredible headphones. Long battery life with great sound. Will definitely purchased again in the future for my kids.

title: Worth the money
review: These were not cheap, but after trying out a number of noise canceling headphones, I decided these were the best. Just wore them on a flight and loved them. They are ultra-comfy and don't pinch your head, either.

title: Favorite headphones I have ever owned!
review: LOVE these so much. They have lasted much longer than any other headphones I have used, and they give out an amazing amount of bass for the size.

title: Very satisfied customer!
review: We love these headphones, bought for my daughter's 3rd birthday to hook up to her nabi Jr. She is hard on them and they stand the test. Great sound quality, Bluetooth range is far complained to other brands we had tried. Had them for 4 months and still going strong. Only down fall is they can get pretty loud, I have to keep checking to make sure she doesn't touch the volume button up.

title: Great quality & packaging for the price!
review: Great quality headphones, great sound, comfortable, and they come with three sets of changeable rubber covers for the headphones, plus this great tiny rubber bag, which I use every day so I never lose my buds! Very satisfied!

title: Great headphones!
review: Great headphones for my 8 year old daughter! They are really cute and fit her great and the sound is very good!

title: Clear audio.  Blocks distractions.
review:
Very impressed. I’ve been using the same cushioned plugin Sony headphones for over 10 years. I haven’t tried any other noise canceling headphones until now. They do a great job of passively block most of the sounds of my small children watching tv / playing. While still letting me hear if they get into trouble. The active noise canceling does a great job with consistent sounds like fans. People talking are some what muted. The second important aspect for me is the sound quality. Clear vocals, clear bass awesome sound.

My son wanted a set of headphones around the same time. I bought him a different similar brand so we wouldn’t confuse them. I’m super happy with mine. His has muddy bass. If I need to buy headphones again for my other kids I’ll buy these.

title: GREAT
review: We own a 2004 Mazda MPV and the headphones work perfectly! Just add batteries and turn on the dvd player. Everyone is happy!

title: So simple, so effective
review:
I bought this small Bobino cord wrap for my earbuds. It's a cheap and simple solution that keeps my earbuds together and untangled. It's so simple but so effective.

I got the small size for my earbuds but they have larger sizes for larger or longer cords. $5 may seem a bit cheap for a piece of rubber and plastic, but the design seals it. There is a small notch to start wrapping, and then, you just wrap. Then you unwrap to your desired length when using the cord. Bam, easy.

A full review including video can be seen at[...]

title: Beats who?
review:
These headphones blow me away. Music sounds like it's never sounded before. Unlike my Beats headphones, they sound good regardless of what I'm listening to. Crystal clear people. Crystal clear.

Update Sep 2016:

Honestly just listened to "Sea of Noise" in these and I'm STILL amazed at how gooooooood they are. Like its live. Seriously. WORTH IT.

title: not what I expected
review: The carrying/charging case is awesome - it gives you that extra talk time while also preventing you from losing the headset.  However, I find the method of keeping it in ear mildly uncomfortable, so I keep it in my bag until my phone rings.  Unfortunately I wanted to use this during long drives but it's not worth the discomfort.

title: Great for little ones!
review: My toddler LOVES these super cute headphones! And I love that they don’t allow the volume to get too high, so it keeps her hearing safe!! Light weight, yet sturdy enough for kids.

title: The best earbuds!!
review: Not sure why some reviews claim this is fake or counterfeit. What i received is indeed an Apple product. By far, very superior to the cheapie earbuds I’ve purchased before. Well worth paying a little extra! Even comes with an Apple 1 year warranty.

title: A good buy for the price
review: A good buy for the price, it gets the job done. I just would prefer the headphone part to be a bit bigger so its more comfortable while sitting on your ears.

title: Very Good Noise Cancellation!
review:
These earbuds are great. First time connection is very easy, as they go into paring mode seamlessly and connected to my iPhone right away. I downloaded the app (Headphones Connect) which allows me to see the charge level on the earbuds themselves as well as the charge on the base. The app allows me to change settings for the noise cancellation, meaning you can turn the feature on and off, as well as an auto setting that it can learn what environments you prefer to have noise cancellation. I'm very happy with the noise cancellation feature, as it really does take about 80% (my estimation) of the background noise away from what I’m hearing from the outside world going on around me.

The sound quality is excellent for the price-point. The fit is perfect as well, and the variety of ear bud sizes helps ensure I got the best fit for me—they are comfortable to wear. The Alexa capability is an interesting feature, but I haven’t tinkered with it yet. I’ll be sure to update when I give that feature a try. Overall, I think these are worth the price and worth 5 stars!

title: Great For The Price!
review: These earphones synced right up to my Apple device, so from a set-up standpoint, these are effortless. The sound quality is above average, and considering the price-point they have very good sound. If you are looking for a premium sound, these may not meet your expectations, but they are perfect for what I use them for (podcasts, a little bit of music, etc).  Comfort level is very good as well, and there are multiple ear piece options to find the best fit. The case is easy to charge and has a magnetic pull that secures the earphones in place for safe keeping and for charging. These are great headphones for the price!

title: Work Great For Me!
review:
I’m pretty basic with earphones, and a lot of times they do not fit my ears well or are uncomfortable to wear. These are my first set of wireless ear buds, and here’s my thoughts from a first-timer:

Aesthetically, they look great, and I love the soft green, neutral color. Charging was simple. The buds connect with a magnet inside the charging case. The little lights on the front let you know how far it’s charged and the lights turn off when it’s fully charged. Simple!

Four sizes of ear attachments come with the set so you can find the best fit. I found the pre-installed “medium” size to be very comfortable for me and I did not need to open the other options. When the buds are in operation mode (happens automatically when they're out of the case) there is a blue light that flashes on a cycle.

Connecting to my Apple device was effortless. I think the sound quality is great. I don’t often listen to music, so for my podcasts and other conversation-type of content, they were excellent. I could still hear outside noises when these were on (not completely noise cancelling) which I actually prefer so I can be aware of my family in the background when I’m listening to content as I do chores.

I couldn’t ask for anything better from these earbuds for the way I use them…I think the price is fair and the quality is great!

title: Didn't even last one year!
review: I bought in spring of 2019 - About two months (fall 2019) ago I realized that they wouldn't always charge when I plugged them in. Last week I realized that the earpiece near the charging hole was coming apart. Tried to charge a few days ago and the whole mechanism that inside of the earphones to grasp the charger when inserted came lose and is now rattling around inside the headphones. There's absolutely no way to charge now.

title: Did not fit headphones or charge properly
review: I wouldn’t recommend. One one actually fit on my phone and the other did not. It did not connect well with my headphones and often stopped charging.

title: VERY IMPORTANT - MUST PLUG HEADPHONES INTO CABLE FIRST AND ...
review:
VERY IMPORTANT - MUST PLUG HEADPHONES INTO CABLE FIRST AND THEN PLUG CABLE INTO COMPUTER OR PHONE.

otherwise it doesn't work.

title: awesome, simple headphones.
review:
unlike the many other headphones i have tried, these are simple, effective, and analog. i use them with a turtle beach usb sound card and they are awesome.

sound is good.

design is top notch, they have a great hidden mic feature and are very comfortable due to the unique headband along the top.

highly recommend if you don't want an overly designed beast that has too much to break.

these just do the job.

title: Ipod speaker case
review: A fellow beach sunbather had one of these on a cruise we went on - was nice to have the ability to listen to music without blasting all the other folks out of the area or having to wear headphones.  The clip comes in handy to hang on a beach chair, clip on a fence while working in the yard, etc.  Sound quality is good and we have had no issues at all with it.

title: Decent - not wonderful for me
review: These are the first wireless headphones I’ve ever gotten. I was very excited for them but they are taking some getting use to because the sound quality isn’t great compared to my old YURbuds. I got the minis and I feel like they still feel heavy and move around a lot on my head when I run. It can make the sound very annoying and distorted.

title: Great headphones / Poor call quality
review:
I have had these for a little less than a month and have used almost everyday during my runs. These headphones are great ergonomic quality as they come with various size choices that can be swapped out to fit your ear. They do a great job in blocking out most ambient noise. I don't believe these are true noise cancelling in terms of technology; seems to be just a tight fit of the ear canal that blocks out the noise.

My major fault with these headphones are phone quality, particularly when there is wind. They seem to pick up even moderate wind (i.e. when running or cycling) and transmits that to the person on the other end of the call. While I could not hear the wind, they experience loud noise and could not hear me talking.

For me at lease this issue is a major downside as I often have phone calls while running or commuting home from work.

title: Highly recommend!
review: We had several Kidz Gear headphones (between two kids) but something always stopped working or broke. Gave these a try on a recommendation and these are our new favorites! My daughters says they're super comfortable and work better than her old ones, plus I like that there's only a cord on one side and it's protected to prevent splitting. Added bonus of being able use the other jack as a splitter and to top it all off, they're very affordable.

title: Very Good Quality - Excellent Value
review: I needed a lightweight and inexpensive pair of stereo headphones, with volume control, and that's exactly what I got.  These can be adjusted to fit my bigger-than-average noggin quite comfortably, the sound quality is very good, the volume slider works even better than expected, and the build quality is excellent for the price.  I'm very pleased with these headphones!

title: Gave As A Gift - Very Well Received
review: I got this as a gift, and I'm told they are excellent quality headphones from my audiophile fiancée.

title: Works Great, Solid Consitruction, Good Connectors
review: I've used this for several different devices, two smartphones, charging a bluetooth headset, and a dock for a camera.  The plugs are good, make a tight connection to everything, and the entire cable feels like good quality.  I'll be sure to order more, as I need them.

title: Comfort lacking, range great
review: These have better range than other Bluetooth headphones I've used.  The sound quality is very good.  My only knock on them is they are not the most comfortable headphones I've had but for the price they are very nice.

title: Good Stuff
review: This is the most unique headphone cable that I Have ever seen. It looks  like a round shoestring. That makes it very flexible without kinking or tangling. It works great. Time will tell concerning durability. So far its great.

title: GOOD STUFF
review:
These are decent headphones for the buck. Compared to my KLH sound system they are light on the bass end of things. They are forward on the high mids. And the highs are natural sounding. I will keep these and continue searching for my ideal set.

Update: It is now 1/05/17. I have become quite happy with these headphones. Perhaps they just needed to burn in. The bass has become solid but refined. The highs and mids sound natural as well. I needed open air headphones and these are great. I recommend them without reservation.

title: Great Cans For The Price
review: It would be difficult to find a better buy in headphones than these in this price range. The bass is exaggerated a bit to overcome the open design. Due to this the midrange suffers a bit, but you can hardly fault these headphones for this at this price. These are made for on the go listening and that they do superbly. You can easily hear your music as well as the environment around you. It would be difficult to fault these at four times the price. Buy and enjoy.

title: Nice Radio
review:
I have had this radio for about a week. The FM is good out to about 30 miles. The AM is good due to skip. I listened to the Giants game in the playoff from Lancaster, Ohio via skip. Way cool.

That is the good. Now the not so good. The sound is tinny whether using the speaker or good headphones. The tuning dial is very tight and is like detentes rather than smooth. I am comparing my old Optimus packet radio through headphones. My Optimus has nowhere near the receiving capabilities of my KA321, though.

The SW is intersting too. Listening to other countries is way cool.

This is a nice radio at this price.

title: Amazingly simple w/surprisingly good sound
review: For the price, this is quite a bargain. They pair to each other and to Bluetooth very quick and I never lost contact, even after going about twice as far as the stated limit. The extra earbuds in different sizes are a nice touch. Overall? An A+ for sure.

title: Simple and effective
review:
This is absolutely what I needed. I was hanging my headphones on the drawer knob on my nightstand. Late at night or early in the morning, when I’m a bit tired and sleepy, sometimes I’d miss hanging it on the knob and the headphones would either hit the floor or land in the small trashcan at my bedside. Well, with this stand I have a relatively larger area to hang ‘em without worrying about them falling on the floor or in the trashcan.
Painfully easy to put together. There’s no way you can do it incorrectly as there are only three pieces that all connect in a snap. No tools needed. If it takes you more than 10 seconds to put it together then you’re somehow doing it wrong.
I did receive this product at a discount for my honest review.
Recommended? Sure, if you want to treat your headphones with care, then this is what you need.

title: Nice for the price
review:
Sounds much better than expected for $10. I know there are a billion lower priced earphones out there, so spend a tiny bit more and get these.

Recommended? yes

title: Buy for Mid-range sound only.
review: I sent these headphones back.. The comfort level was good for short periods but hurt your ears after a extended period of time.  The bluetooth function worked perfectly and had a good distance.  The overall look of these is nice and fashionable.  What brings these headphones down is the sound quality.. the one thing that matters most.  These are almost entirely mid-range.. little to no highs and you can forget about nice bass.. doesn't exist here.  If you like drums/bass of any sort these are not the headphones for you, you should stay away.  if you like mid-range music and don't care about a full spectrum of sound then they are a good buy..  they are also a little too big to fit a toddlers head properly.

title: What a POS !!!
review: Dropped calls frequently, then died completely after 32 days of moderate use. The noise cancelling is great, but totally useless if the headset doesn't work!!

title: great product.
review: fits well, affordable and easy. the only thing, was I just wrapped the headphone wires around it. That was annoying

title: Worked great with a helmet
review:
A Christmas gift for my wife and I. When we riding our bikes it is hard to hear with a helmet so each of us takes one earbud each so we can share music, Waze directions, or phone calls.

Worked great on it weekend ride and held a charge all day. Very comfortable with the adjustable ear pieces. Noise cancelation works be better with both buds in instead of the one.

title: Mono or Stereo connector.
review: Its labeled "Stereo" on both ends, which had me worried until I tried connecting standard mono 1/4" amp cables to see that they worked fine. The "Stereo" must be for connecting earphones, so there must be a method used for either mono or stereo plugs. Fine unit (its even gold-plated!) and I expected it would cost much more.

title: Headphone switch
review:
I use this to select audio for a wireless headphone system I use with the entertainment center. My only caveat is it is pretty light
weight and thus slides around easily.

title: Decent headphones
review:
Could not ask for a better pair of decent over-ear headphones at anything close to the price I paid for these. I have an assortment
of earbuds and phones but generally prefer these for use with my laptop at home, saving the earbuds for portable use.

title: Wireless headphones
review:
Being a creature of the night (night-shift worker) as well as a bit hard of hearing, I found these to be very useful for listening
to the TV without disturbing everyone else. So much so I bought myself a second unit and one as a gift for a friend. They
have some quirks in that they are prone to picking up AC hum if near power supplies or cords but for sitting and listening,
if properly placed, they work well. Range? Up to 20-30 feet in my experience and about as comfortable for wearing as any
other relatively inexpensive headphone I've ever used.

title: 2 yrs electronics plan for valued item of $100-150.
review: I purchased this protection plan for an item I bought my grandson for his birthday.  It's for some reversible headphones speakers that appear to be delicate.  I have not used the plan but received it's validation in eMail.  Great price for product protection.

title: Very satisfied customer here!!
review: Awesome sound from a headphone in this price range I recommend these headphones for the sound qualiy and you won't be sorry

title: First off i love the sound that this product outputs what bose could ...
review: Hey, First off i love the sound that this product outputs what bose could have done better was with the appearance of this product the bulkiness of the product and with long periods of time in my ears it started to feel a bit uncomfortable they could have also reduced the weight a little bit but we can only hope for those improvements with the second generation. But other wise the headphones does well with many generes of music crisp sound with very nice bass not to overpowering out of respect the product is also great on battery life sometimes it has a hard time of staying in my ears dont know if its the weight of the product or the shape of my ears but i tend to have to fix them too many times while taking a jog or while taking a simple but for everyday i had to put these down because of it being uncomfortable but if i were you i would still give the product a chance it may work for you and not for me not every product is for everyone and i wish everyone the best ✔️

title: He loves em
review: Bought this for my bf who wanted a small durable headset he can use when working out. He is satisfied with these, I am a fan of the Jlab brand

title: Great
review: This does not have volume control which I was aware of. I bought the same headset about 4 years ago and had to buy it again. it's such a good value for money

title: Not the Best Choice for Noise Cancelling Headphones
review: Maybe I'm over looking a setting in my TV, but so far this product only works when I don't use the noise cancelling feature on my headset. Otherwise the sound quality is okay. With the noise cancelling, there is a constant noise/vibration with the audio - too much to listen to.

title: One of the best Headphones i have ever listened to
review:
No jarring, No overly crazy treble sounds, and yet deep and rich.

I have been using this headphones for about 2 1/2 years and i have found Its pretty good in sound reproduction and does not break/damage easily.

Its also very soft on ears and does not pain the ear lobes like Sony or others do.

The headband is supple, yet strong, meaning it will be firm over your ears, but not paining.

Comes closest to noise-canceling feature because it covers your ears completely.

title: Well worth the purchase
review: Great item works as described. Was perfect for my sons headphones and it keeps it off the floor.  If your thinking about it get it.

title: so they do not make it easy to call them up
review: It is a very flimsy product.  I got it. I openned the  box.  Put the headphones over my ears and plugged it in. Nothing.  Money thrown away. There was no one to talk to. Amazon doesn't want customers bothering them, so they do not make it easy to call them up. My other alternative is to call the Federal Trade Commission.  In short, I am telling you this, I would not waste my money getting this.  Get something that works.

title: Horrific battery life
review: Battery life if extremely short. I lost my last set that I had for over a year that I paid $15 for.  They lasted 8+ hours. This headset hear can not make 3 hours on a full charge.  Completely disappointed and now they are going right back.  Back to the drawing board!

title: A good buy for $7
review:
I'm pleasantly surprised at how these earphones turned out.
I've been using them for a week and they don't make my ears nearly as sore as my old pairs (hard plastic).
They block a little background noise too which means I don't need to have the volume to high.
The base seems fine once you've got a good fit.

title: Good Sound, Comfortable, Decent Battery Life, Questionable Lifespan
review: I've purchased this and two similar products from LG over the years. The sound, battery, and comfort are always very good. The earbuds tend to degrade and start to cut out after about 6 months of daily use. I've moved on to a different product.

title: Great Sound, Questionable Quality, Minimal Instructions
review:
I use these for listening to music while working. They charge quickly and have better sound quality than the LG wrap around earbuds I had previously used. One of the earbuds stopped working in the first week after receiving the unit and required a replacement via Amazon.
The included handbook has minimal details on how to use them. I had to figure out many of the features by trial and error. They're probably not worthy of the price-point.

title: Great Sound
review:
Overall I really like these headphones. I primarily use them with my computer for conference calls and to listen to music. I can make it through an entire 8 hour work day on one battery charge. Sound quality is very good both for calls and music. I really appreciate the physical power switch instead of having to hold a power button.
The only drawback I have noticed is the range. I previously had LG Tone Active (HBS-A80) headphones and could stand in the adjacent room without any loss of quality. With these I can only step about 10 feet from the PC before things start breaking up.

title: Very comfortable
review: I have been very happy with these earbuds.  They are very comfortable to wear, even for extended time periods.  The sound quality has been excellent, and so far the batter life has been very good.  Excellent value.

title: Fantastic!
review: Fantastic pair of headphones! Looks amazing. Doesn't feel cheap at all. Average weight. The ear muffs are super comfortable. I can wear them all day and all night. Even though they are not noise cancelling, they do engulf my ears and drone out quite a bit of noise. At least now when my wife speaks, I have a real reason for not hearing her. Lol. As far as sound goes, I'm not an audiophile so I can't get into the nitty gritty. A nice warm sound. Good blend of bass, mids and highs. If you can get it for under $30, definitely get it! In my opinion, it's way better looking and performing than $100 headphones. Hope it lasts.

title: Fantastic sounding headphones, but very fragile
review:
Great pair of headphones. Love the unique look. Fits snug on my head, better than any pair I've had. Has a quality feel to it. Only had it for a few days. Only time will tell if it'll last. Bass booms. Highs is a bit lacking but you can fix it with EQ. I prefer bass more than treble so it suits me just fine.

Update: After a few months of usage, the ear cups snapped out on both sides. There is a tab that inserts the ear cup into the band and it's very weak. The band coating also started to peel off. Why isn't it just plain plastic?

title: These are just plain junk.
review: This is my third pair of JBL earbuds. I've always liked them. I had the 120 the 125 and now figured I'd like the 130 even more. Was very excited. My first pair were defective. The right bud was dead despite charging them overnight. It simply wouldn't power on so I sent them back for a new pair. Second pair I belive is also defective as anytime I want to conect them to a device I have to do so manaually. With my previous JBL buds they would automatically connect after the first time I set them up. With these new ones, if my phone disconnects for ANY reason I have to put the earbuds into pair mode manually to reconnect every time. And it doesn't always work. Additionally these buds fit poorly compared to the older versions, there is absolutely no noise cancellation at all in fact they're worse about background noise than most earbuds that have no "noise cancelling technology". All in all a huge disappointment. Looks like I'll have to try to buy the older versions or find a new brand.

title: Battery failed completely after 3 months of use
review: This was a cool little set of headphones. There was one major flaw (battery failure) and one more minor flaw which was that it's micro USB charging rather than USBC. Everything is going to USBC now except for this cheap Chinese stuff. I'll be looking for a higher quality unit with USBC charging for our next pair.

title: Two year review
review:
I purchased these in 2018 and I can report they are still running strong. Overall they are very good earbuds and I would recommend them to anyone.

Pros
excellent sound
good battery life
very comfortable
price

Cons
the left bud can't work independently
occasionally issues with left bud pairing

title: A great gift
review: I bought this for my Dad who is very hard of hearing.  He has a tendency to keep the TV volume up very high driving my mother crazy.  The results are fantastic.  He loves the headphones, he can now hear the TV clearly at all times and my mother can listen at her volume.  Happiness has been restored.

title: It works
review: I'm not an expert. I just needed extra cable to my headphones. For that purpose it works very well. The price was reasonable and I actually like the braided wrap on the outside.

title: Stronger bluetooth connection = less interference
review: I bought this bluetooth/wireless headset with optically connectable transmitter to replace a set (less expensive and less sophisticated) that is about three years old.  The old headphone set is no longer keeping a full charge so the time of use decreased from about six hours to one.  Thus, the new set.  This set offers extended run time and standby time as well as a greater range of signal.  My wife uses them to listen to the t v with the t.v.'s volume at zero (sparing me a lot of political chatter and movies from the 1940s and 1950s) while she can adjust the headphone volume to please herself.  She has remarked that when I use the microwave it no longer degrades the sound with electronic interference.  She is enamored with this set.  She praises the sound quality, the comfort of the fit over her ears and the fact that it can take several days of use and standby before the set needs recharge.

title: Hear the great sound comfortably
review: Love them!  I have hearing aids that I paid thousands of dollars for that do not sound as good as the Shure earphones.  This is my second set of them.  I lost my first set at the gym.

title: Good headphones for the price
review: I have to buy earbuds on the cheaper side bc my kiddos and lost/broke several pairs. These are great earbuds for the price. The sound quality is crystal clear. Only issue, is they’re not very loud. I like loud music while I’m cleaning

title: Typing made easy
review:
I am using this headset now along with Dragon NaturallySpeaking and it works great. It's a little tight if you wear too long which I rarely do.

Well made product and would recommend it if you need such a thing.

title: Comfortable headphones
review: Wife is pleasantly surprised by the comfort on the ears as she is a night owl. Her old earphones(different brand)were ear killers. The charging stand is a clean design and works regardless of not turning off the headphones.

title: Audio Unlimited Headphones
review: This item allows for an easy and fast conversion of A/V connections between the A/V source and the Audio Unlimited Wireless headphones.

title: Audio Unlimited SPK-9110 Wireless Headphones
review: Works great even at 50 to 70 feet from A/V source through walls and doors. We have a bedroom TV hooked to a COX cable box that when turned off will not activate the base to charge the headphones. Our primary TV is running through a COX cable box but is also controlled by a SONOS bridge and a DENON receiver that keeps an ongoing A/V signal that enables the base unit on this system to charge the headphones 24/7. Hence the reason for buying the second Audio Unlimited SPK-9110 to prevent running the other TV  for the sole reason of charging the headphones.

title: Only worked for a month - then quit charging.
review: Headphones quit charging within 30 days of receiving them. They are only guaranteed for 1 month, so I guess they'll function as stylish ear muffs when the weather turns cold.

title: Four Stars
review: Great headphones for the money. You can find better, but you'll spend four times as much.

title: Very Satisfied!
review: I have used 2 pairs of Letscom Bluetooth Headphones for several years now and have been very satisfied with them. I was looking for a 3rd pair and all my searches brought me to these Otium ones. They looked very similar so I bought them. I am just as satisfied with these as I’ve been with the others. They are little work horses!

title: These are good, but....
review: I have found these superior to others I have tried, in quality and other things. But they are bigger, or clumsily fatter than all the others and I have a difficult time with them in the gym, moving around, being in different positions. They are more for the sedentary times as far as I am concerned. I will continue to favor my [[ASIN:B07DXSYJ5N LETSCOM Bluetooth Headphones IPX7 Waterproof, Wireless Sport Earphones]] in the meantime.

title: Works Easily and Well
review: This is basically a cassette tape player, like a Walkman. It seems to be well made. It works easily and well. It cycles through the entire cassette tape, auto-reversing along the way. Auto-reverse can be turned on/off as desired. Instead of using the Audacity software that came with the unit, which seemed cryptic, I chose to use Audio Recorder Pro software from EZ SoftMagic, Inc., which I have been using for years. It is very easy to use. Audio Recorder Pro works with any Microphone input like [[ASIN:B00F9KTALQ BlueRigger 3.5mm Male to Male Stereo Audio Cable]] running from the earphone plug to the Microphone input port. Audio Recorder Pro allows you to monitor (preview) and adjust the stereo (L/R) input recording level as you go. It also allows you to choose from Mp3, WAV, and OGG formats, as well as the recording quality, i.e. the Sample Rates (Hz) and Bitrates (kbps). I gave this only 4-Stars because it claims that the unit can work off of USB power, which it can. But, for some reason, the monitoring feature of the Audio Recorder Pro software will not work as long as the USB is plugged into the unit.

title: Absolutely Amazing!
review: These wireless earbuds are everything! Great sound and base clarity with noise cancellation. Made durable and will not fall out your ears. Aslo great distance! A must have for sure!

title: Poor Replacement
review: These headphone cushions are not like the originals. The originals have a band of foam that fits down into the perimeter of the headphone and helps keep the cushions in place. That band of foam is absent in these replacement headphone cushions.  And, as others have said, the glue does not hold the cushions in place. I filled the rim of the headphones with construction glue to keep the headphone cushions in place.  If I had known what a hassle these headphone cushions would be, I would have thrown the headphones away and bought a new headphone.

title: Headset was terrible quality. Lots of static and people couldn't hear ...
review: Headset was terrible quality.  Lots of static and people couldn't hear me.  The seller was very nice to work with and provided a return without trouble.

title: These are definitely a good buy
review: Great reception, even out on the property.  Headphones a bit uncomfortable, but not bad.  These headphones have better sound than my older set of Sennheiser (15 yrs old and still working great, by the way) and are half the price of my older ones.  Could be technology upgrades thru the last decade or so.  Bottom line, great set of headphones that compare with higher priced sets.

title: Big Sound for Little Bucks.........
review: Having owned 3 other wireless headphones, I'd have to say I liked these the best.  If you treat them with the care that any electronic product deserves, they will provide you with reliable service.  If you drop them they will probably break, so will my portable DVD player.  The sound quality is excellent.  No they won't compete with $200-plus phones.  But for under $75. these phones are as good as you can expect. I highly recommend them.

title: Favorite earphones for my iphone
review: I have used these earphones for years. They are comfortable and have excellent sound. When they wear out, usually a little under a year, I replace them. I have some recent concerns however. I find the sound of the recent ones not as wonderful as the originals, although still excellent. What concerns me most is the quality of the manufacturing. I had to return the recent ones I bought less than a month ago because the end which goes into the iPhone broke off. They were replaced, but I worry that this piece is not as strong as it once was and that I will have the same problem in the future. I never worried about their construction before and I hope my concern is unnecessary.

title: Works well with IPad Pro3
review: I was looking for headphones for my IPad Pro3.  For the price these things work well and have held up well.  It comes in a metal case with a cloth mesh storage bag.  These earbuds are reasonably comfortable and provide good sound quality for the price point.

title: Olive
review: I've used my headphones almost everyday since I got them and it has made it easier to move around in the office. Great sound, which I helped with doing my own custom settings on my phone. Also pretty comfortable wear for long periods of time. Still no complaints so far!

title: My favorite headphones ever.
review: Noting that I’ve only had these a couple of days, these are my favorites listening devices ever.  They are comfortable, they have clear good sound, good battery life and are easy to use.  You can use them independently (one or the other for calls) and the buttons are easy to operate.  Overall not only the best earbuds I’ve used but the best Bluetooth device.

title: You'd need really strong input to split the signal
review: You'd need really strong input to split the signal more to more than two sets of ear buds. I'm not using it that way (I can somewhat get buy splitting my audio into two streams if I want to). The thing I love is it comes with several connector cables that I use for other purposes. And the star splitter makes the audio output on a monitor easier to access, even though I'm only plugging in a single headphone.

title: It Works
review: The title says it all.  I use this headset everyday. Good sound, comfortable and reliable.  I would definitely recommend them.

title: Unable to pair with 2 different bluetooth transmitters
review: Bought these to connect to my TV.  Tried pairing these headphones with two different 5.0 bluetooth transmitters (Avantree & Anker) but couldn't get it to work.  Was able to connect to my Samsung phone and sound was good.  Returned for a refund.

title: Couldn't get it to work
review: Tried pairing with my new bluetooth 5.0 headphones to no avail.  Even called customer support and they said it should work but offered no further assistance.  Returned for a refund.

title: Certainly lives up to hype
review: So after my last earphone broke, I decided to the Raycon earbuds I’ve seen a lot of YouTubers we follow pitching them. I was skeptical, because I’ve tried equivalently priced wireless earbuds before, and they then to just boost the bass to copious levels to try and cover up the fact that they actually suck. With one such pair, I actually had to pull the bass down to its minimum level, while pushing the treble to it’s max, to make the music even remotely enjoyable. Now I’m no audiophile, but I do know that balance between bass and treble is necessary experience the full speed trim of music, and I’m happy to report that the Raycon Everyday Earbuds do indeed achieve a good, balanced sound. So yes, I approve.

title: Blown Away!
review: I have tried a few lower priced earbuds and they were all lacking and more hassle than they were worth. NOT THESE! They connected right up and sound great. The ONLY slight minus, and not in any way a deal breaker, is when they are in the case...they are in the case! If you have fat fingers ( me ) they can be challenging to remove sometimes. I can walk all around my house and they have not lost connection once. I am impressed.

title: First one was Junk. Replacement works great.
review:
Sounds exactly like $18 wireless ( deal ) would be expected to sound like. Slave ( R ) earbud drops out on avg about every 30 seconds which no amount of resetting/reconnecting will correct . Does the same for laptop, or phone.
Trying to use while watching a movie or any video ( news etc ) on laptop or phone is frustrating because the sound latency ( delay ) is about half a second = Video + sound not synced.
Gave 1 last try today and decided to return for replacement.

Replacement arrived yesterday. Connects right up and stays connected. Sound not spectacular but good enough for casual phone calls or listening to music while out shopping. Still has sound sync errors with video but it's only slight. Not a deal breaker. To be expected with wireless under a hundred or more dollars.

title: Bluetooth full stereo headphones with full Bluetooth capabilities.
review: I love these headphones awesome Bluetooth sound for music, phone calls. And the battery charges fast and last up to 15+ hours. also comes with a direct audio patch cable when Bluetooth wireless is not available from the sending unit. Saving you battery power.

title: Good Sound
review: I’m a BIG music lover and enjoy listening from a good headphone sound quality is very important. I was not expecting these to be this good because it wasn’t a brand name I know boy was I wrong. Don’t knock it until you try

title: Tried, True and Trusted. Reliable and Still Going
review: Believe it or not, I still use the Bluetooth headset, the first Voyager Pro style. They have upgraded this and now call it the  Legend, which has a very straight boom. My use is daily, and it only needs charging after a few days. I never drop calls or lose Bluetooth connection with my HTC Thunderbolt Android phone either, and it is the older style. My husband has a vintage Raz-R he is still using and he purchased the Plantronics VP HD and it continues to drop the connection between the phone and headset. If he moves the headset, it detects every little change and all of suddenly he isn't hearing the person on the other line anymore. It is so irritating with the HD whenever he calls me because one minute we're talking and the next, nothing. This Bluetooth has been tried and true and I am glad it does not have all the techy junk built in like the HD. Sometimes too much is....well, just too much! I hope I can find this headset if mine ever fails. It has been so reliable.

title: Great little unit, tunes in well and it's still walking!
review: This is a pretty nice little unit and my husband uses it when he takes walks. We live outside of city, at least another 15 minutes away, and under tons of trees. He is able to tune in to most stations in without any problems. The city does not have that many stations, even though its' metropolitan area is over 380,000 population! With that said, finding local stations are no problem, but he does complain of the digital technology used with this Sony. The quality of sound is fine until there are spaces of what should be silence in between audio, but he describes an "echo-like" sound that fills those spaces which are a little annoying.  Also, he ditched the headset and uses his preferred earbuds. Not sure why Sony hasn't recognized that preference for many customers of its products. Overall, we really like Sony, and this unit won out after lengthy research and we are glad to have it. They almost have a perfect unit, the belt clip is fantastic and we would probably purchase this unit again. (We use rechargeable batteries these days and they work fine in the unit which we purchased in July, 2014)

title: Nice ear earbuds
review: Nice pair of Bluetooth earbuds. Love the magnets for keeping them around my neck when not in use. Battery life is a full day of on and off use for me. They sound great. And at just $20. I don't have to worry about breaking or losing them.

title: Sounds just as good as any $10-15 headphones that you would pick up ...
review: 5 stars for the price. Sounds just as good as any $10-15 headphones that you would pick up at a brick and mortar store.

title: Great Bluetooth Cans for the Money
review: I've tried a few of sets of Bluetooth headphones in this price range. Usually the sound is muddy, no clear highs, and marginal lows. These have good clear sound, easy controls, and most comfortable fit for the money. Don't get me wrong...these are not a $200+ set of headphones, but for the price, I've yet to find better.

title: Great Deal, good quality!
review: These work really well and the price was right! My family goes through headphones like crazy and these have withstood the abuse way longer than any of the others so I bought another pack to have as a backup.

title: Good deal
review: There is no button on the headphones for volume control. It has a button to pause though from what I can tell. The sound quality is nice and the noise cancellation works well. These headphones do have a braided cord which is a must have for pesky cats that like to chew on cords so that right there is a major plus!

title: These work very well!
review: Bought these for my son. He goes through headphones like crazy. So far these have held up very well they have a nice sound quality.

title: no media center HTPC
review: I installed in boot camp Windows 7 and ran infintv a by ceton through network from my desktop pc, But get no sound from hdmi or headphone outlet. Until Apple provides drivers the only soun comes from Mac Mini speakers. By the way sound works great from lion Mac side from HDMI, How about some help Apple!!!!!!

title: Well built rugged cables for your Apple device!
review: I bought these cables because our OEM white cables were being pulled apart by our teenage kids.  Literally - after they charges their devices, they yanked on the cord to remove the lightning connector and the OEM strain relief eventually pulls apart.  So far, these braided cables are fairing much better than the OEM cables, but time will tell if it was a worthwhile investment.  No problems with charging any devices (phones, iPads and earphones) so far.  The cables feel tough and I hope that translates into long life.

title: Nice budget headphones
review:
Surprisingly good sound from a budget device. I purchased a small Bluetooth speaker from Bose for $100 that doesn't sound as good as these headphones.

Also, they're quite comfortable for an on-the-ear headphone. You can't do any better at this price point.

title: Waste of money does not connect
review: The earbud die after 3 months, only used less than 10 times. The battery doesn’t charge anymore, it doesn’t connect to Bluetooth. The power isn’t really a button, but a sensor that you use your finger to block the hole. It’s a total waste of money. Wish I can return it.

title: Connecting Headphone Extensions to a Receiver
review:
This adaptor is just what is needed at a great price to connect
my two sound systems together using a 1/4" stereo headphone
extension cord. With this adaptor Dolby 10.2 sound is now
available at home.

title: Panasonic DVD-LS86 8.5-Inch Portable DVD Player
review: a great portable player, easy to operate, sound quality excellent via bose noise quieting headphones in noisy campgrounds, huge 13.5 hour battery life. a must when car camping away from 110 vac.

title: Very fine Nano Ipod
review:
OEM item including all the stuff one would need; battery, charging cable, case, earbuds, usb cable, screen protector, nice little pouch,and a little screen cleaning cloth.

Vendor puts it all together and pleased with the purchase.

It was the second bought. Granddaughter lost first and this was replacement. So, I knew it was a good buy

title: A Good Fit
review: I have many sets of earbuds and I use Comply tips on all of them. They have many advantages - they help keep the buds in your ears, they insulate you from outside sounds, they improve the comfort of the fit, and they improve the sound by focusing the sound in your ears. They really work well and I enjoy my buds more with them compared to silicone and other tips. I have one ear canal that is difficult to insert a bud into or even an ear plug. I put a little cortisone cream on the bud when I squeeze it down and it slides right in. Overall, I am very happy with the performance of the Comply tips and recommend them if you want to obtain maximum enjoyment from your buds.

title: Sweet sound
review: I listen to music almost constantly and have several sets of headphones and earbuds. These became my favorites when I heard the first song through them. I use Comply foam tips with them and they are almost as good as noise cancelling buds. When I have them in I can just barely hear the TV my wife is watching or hear her voice when she speaks to me. Definitely good noise blocking qualities. With the Comply tips they are comfortable to wear for hours and I really forget that I have earbuds in. The audio quality is excellent and full bodied. They have a good sound stage and project sounds beyond your ears. I never have had them in long enough to see if they will go for 6+ hours but they easily hit 5 1/2 hours and are still comfortable when I take them out. I really like the touch sensors for volume control and track/pause/etc. The Bluetooth range is average - nothing special but good enough. When I first used them I would have occasional drop outs from one or both ears but that has vanished. I highly recommend these for their good audio quality, comfort, and battery life. Definitely happy with them.

title: Sweet sound and long battery life
review: This review is for the ActivBuds S-250. I like these earbuds very much. They have a long playing time and have a pleasing sound quality. I use them with Comply foam tips which greatly improve the comfort and sound. Comply tips come in a variety of sizes, shapes, and sound isolation and are a positive addition to any buds. One improvement I would  like to see would be cloth braided connecting cable between the two buds. The rubber cable sticks to the back of my neck sometimes and it will dislodge the buds from one or both ears. I usually wear them with the cable in front of my neck and flip it to the back if I am going to take them out. I like these earbuds because the controls are easy to use and are ergonomically designed. The charge plug is easy to put in and the buds hold a charge for a long time. The playing time is quite good and is at least equal to the time claimed by the vendor. All in all a comfortable set of buds with sweet sound. (I also have a set of the S-255 buds and am not happy with the flimsy ear hooks. Fortunately, the Comply foam tips keep them in my ears as the hooks are quite useless.) I have several pair of these buds because I have a number of Bluetooth sources and the buds, like most Bluetooth devices will only pair to two at a time. Bluetooth 5, which will be released any day now, is claimed to allow several devices to pair.

title: Can You Hear Me Now?
review: These replacement pads for Sony headphones are great.  The original pads have been flaking for a few years leaving black dandruff on me every time I use them.  I finally thought to check on Amazon and found these.  I was pleasantly surprised to see how easy they were to install.  I expected a fight but they went on quickly and easily.  The first thing I noticed when I put them on is that the ear cup area is larger than the originals.  There is plenty of room inside for your ear without it being cramped or squished.  The second thing I noticed is how comfortable they are.  I wore them several hours without any discomfort or overheating of my ears.  Overall, I highly recommend them as a replacement for the original pads.  BTW, if the rechargeable batteries go bad you do not have to buy Sony replacements.  The plastic holder the batteries are in is easy to open with an exacto knife or similar.  I put Amazon rechargeable AAA batteries in it and the phones work fine.  Plus, they last much longer than the original batteries.  Like twice as long.

title: As good as the original pads
review:
These pads were a lifesaver. While the headphones I was using them for was on the "cheaper" end (still $90 to replace), they were my favorite for what they were being used for. The old fabric pads had "collapsed" allowing the earpieces to rest on my ears - not comfortable. I was just about to give up and pitch the headphones when I FINALLY found replacement pads. Couldn't even get any from the manufacturer.

These pads use a thin leather-like (probably some kind of vinyl) instead of the same cloth material as the originals. That is not a problem whatsoever. They pads are the same size and were relatively easy to replace. Comfort once again. The onl complaint wad shipping time. I live in the states and these had to ship overseas from Asia - took about 3 weeks. Worth the wait though.

title: Incredible sound and fit from such a low-cost headset.
review:
I'm a big IEM (In Ear Monitor) user and have been for a decade. My current IEM inventory consists of a Klipsch X10 and a Yamaha EPH-1000SL. Both are excellent earphones with their own distinct qualities...and each cost over $130! I purchased the Panasic HJE120 to replace some cheaper earbuds that my dog chewed up. I bought the Panasonic's from a discount store for a whopping $4 figuring that for what they are replacing, it was a steal.

Holy crap! I was completely shocked at both the fit and the sound quality of these earphones. They may look cheap in the package and feel cheap when you handle them. THEY ARE CHEAP. But the sound...the sound is not cheap whatsoever. Without any tools to measure audio quality and just using my own subjective opinion, the Panasonic earphones are easily within 90%, maybe 95% of sonic qualities I prefer in a higher-end IEM. And for as simple as the shape is, it works. I have no problems keeping these in my ears for hours. I've even fallen asleep with my ear to a pillow and the Panasonic earphone in my ear! They are that comfortable.

I'll be trying these out under my motorcycle helmet this coming week and will update this review to include their usability in that environment.

title: Yuck! Klipsch is usually better than this!
review:
My 3rd set of Klipsch in-ear monitors and the most disappointing pair I've ever had! I'm an experienced in-ear user (5+ years) and for the price I paid, these have problems. First, the high-end of the audio is just plain missing. I can hear a solid base response and the mids are certainly there but the high end is just gone! I bought these headphones primarily for use with my Galaxy S3. I tested the headphones against several other sources and had the same problem with the high end missing. Now there is always a chance that I have a bad pair of headphones, but the quality is identical in both ears so likely not. Frankly, the $10 earbuds that came with the phone sound better despite the fact that they don't seal in the ear correctly.

The second problem is that the Android control app works for everything but the volume. Trying to trigger a volume change instead triggers the voice command interface and there doesn't seem to be any way to change that behaviour.

Returning these to try something else.

title: They are nice, seemingly sturdy
review: We just received these headphones today, and tried them out tonight. They are nice, seemingly sturdy, and fold up most of the way when not in use. One thing I noticed it had said on the packaging was that they do not go above a certain decibel to help protect children's ears. It does seem to do that, as it was not blaringly loud on the highest setting. It came with a few different sticker options to out in the headphones, and help personalize it. In full disclosure, I received this product at a discount in exchange for an unbiased review.

title: Good Quality for Business Calls
review: This headset is perfect except for one very important issue. I can't hear myself speaking through these headphones. Why design headphones where you can't hear the ENTIRE conversation??

title: Too bad there's no option to alter treble and bass on ...
review: The fit is a tad bit uncomfortable, perhaps because they're new and have a stiff feeling.  The phones fit over each ear.  The sound is clear and  leans toward a more treble sound.  Too bad there's no option to alter treble and bass on the headset.  I suggest trying out a few different brands to see what fits your comfort level before making a purchase.  Pairing with my laptop was very easy.

title: HEADPHONES - short life
review: I bought these headphones about 1.5 yrs ago and thought the sound quality was good.  They're now dying on me - much crackling going in the phones, which I cannot understand.  The Sony quality is not what it used to be.

title: Great for the price
review: I started shopping for Bluetooth headphones about five years ago. Because I wanted them strictly for late night TV viewing I wasn’t interested in spending that kind of money in those days. But for this price they do an excellent job. Good long battery life and the Fidelity for voice on video I can’t imagine I could do any better.

title: Bad quality control
review:
Right side earphone doesn't produce the same volume of sound as left side. Bad buy as there are so many other headphones for a lot less price with better quality. Don't buy!!!!!!!
Beats have the name but no quality, junk

title: THEY FIT!!  THEY STAY IN!
review:
I tried several different brands that claimed to be comfortable, and adjustable, etc. Mostly they were the "IN EAR" style. Well it is a no go with that type, as they never stay in, and slowly loosen and fall out of my ears. So, I thought I would try these (my wired earbuds that I use are also the NOT IN THE EAR canal style also). This style is kind of hard to find. I needed Bluetooth wireless ones for the TV sound.
I wanted these for watching my new Sony Bravia OLED TV as I did not want to disturb anyone asleep in the house with sound coming from my TV. I also decided to try the little foam covers that I use on my wired earbuds (they come with them) and now they are even better. These are simple to use and instructions included. The foam covers are always a struggle to get on right, so I expected that with these but, got them on properly, and they are even more comfortable and secure. Great success with these earbuds after trying many in canal styles. I highly recommend these. You can buy the little foam covers separately, they are the 15mm diameter ones.

title: Works Great!
review:
I was a little confused by all the different styles and brands, even with all the convenient reviews on all of them, so I decided to go with a low end (price wise)set of wireless headphones to start for my bedroom HDTV (Plasma) I ended up ordering 2 more of them for the living room TV, (Plasma) they worked out so well. I would not recommend them for hours of movies, but the sound is great when you want to watch something late at night which I often do, without disturbing the rest of the household. These installed very quickly, although the instructions are minimal, and I would comment that you kind of have to be electronic savvy for a smooth install. Works great if you only want them because you can't hear the dialogue, which is a common occurance these days, and I am not hard of hearing. These do fit me (I have a small head) better than others that I have tried, but they will slide off if you bend over or move your head around so they do take a little fussing while you are watching. The sound is great, and I don't see a need for surround sound sets, I can hear every special effect with these. I was going to get a second headset for my husband, but the second headset cost almost as much as a whole unit, so I just got a second unit, so that I can use the charger. Only one headset hangs on the charger cradle.

MK

title: Great headphones, especially in a noisy factory environment
review: Great headphones, especially in a noisy factory environment. the bass on these is really deep, no sound issues at all.

title: These ARE the perfect running headphones
review: These absolutely are the best running headphones.  Man, the bass is just so great.  The whole acoustic profile is better reproduced by these over all others I have used.  The earbuds fall out, and I have tried those like 15-20 dollar sony wrap around the ear ones, which are okay, but not as great sounding as these.  I ran a 15k and they did not hurt my ears or anything like that, but I only ran for 1:16:33 so if I was slower, than maybe LOL.  JK.  Anyway, these are good RUNNING headphones, but don't think you are gonna wear them to the gym.  If you lay down on a bench or tilt your head up too high, they'll shift and/or get in the way.  They SUCK if you will be laying on a bench.

title: Great earbuds
review: I have used these now for several weeks. I would compare the sound quality to the Bose earbuds that I own.

title: Great headphones, excellent customer service from Bios Sound
review: My 11 year old really likes these and uses them, they are ones that finally fit.  However after 6 months after use one side stopped working. I contacted seller BIOS SOUND about it and they were very accommodating, offering to refund or replace the headphones.  Awesome.

title: Not what I expected
review:
Got these after several issues with accidentily getting my corded headphones caught up in whatever I was doing in the yard, ripping them out of my ears and often snapping the headphones. I thought these would solve the problem and give me a little more freedom.

First off, they are kinda big and I would be embarrassed to wear them in public, but fine around the yard. Seemed to function and connect well. Annoyed by the micro charger, a charge pad or something would be fantastic so I could throw them in a little box and wake up in the morning and they would be good to go. Ran in them and they felt like they would come out, could not get a good fit. Overall, good build quality. The box it comes in though is extremely overdesigned, I felt that 30% of the cost went into making the package look like space hardware. Would have been happy to see "environmentally sound" packaging option.

title: EASY TO USE & WORKS GREAT
review: I am getting ready to be on a long flight in a few days so I have been busy setting up this MP3 player so I have something to listen too. I have a tendency to get very bored on flights. It comes with its own headset and they are very comfortable in my ears and they sound really good.  The charge lasts a long time. They are bluetooth, which is good for me. It is very easy to use and download music. I really like how compact it is, will be very easy to put in my pocket for flight travel.

title: VERY NICE QUALITY & WELL MADE
review: This bone conduction headset works great. I have worn them walking my dogs and cycling. I like that I can still hear everything going on around me while I am enjoying music or chatting. They were so easy to set up and use. They paired fast with my cell. The sound is amazing. Calls are great.  They are lightweight and very comfortable to wear. They charge quite fast and last a long time. They are very well made and a very nice quality.

title: EASY TO USE & WORKS GREAT
review: These bone conduction headphones work great. They are lightweight. I don't have to take them in and out of my ears like normal earbuds, which is very nice. The sound quality is great. They are very easy to pair up. I can make calls and receive them. They are very comfortable on. They last a long time on a charge. These are very well made and a very nice quality.

title: EASY TO SET UP & USE
review: This projector is very easy to set up and use. It comes with a remote that is very easy to use. It is very easy to pair with my cell and laptop. I is lightweight and compact. The picture quality is amaing, the colors are very realistic. I will be using this outdoors with an outdoor movie screen. It is great that it will connect to speaker or headset.

title: CUTE & COMFORTABLE ON
