review: These toddler headphones are so cute. I like that there are different animal ear peces to change out. They work great. The headset is adjustable to get a good fit. There is a nice foam pad on the head area and ear area. They fold up small. They are well made.

title: GREAT SOUND & GREAT VALUE
review: [[VIDEOID:5c7cca2c582971f6997e569744a1f224]] I got these for my grandson, he said the sound quality is awesome with all different kinds of music. The battery life is long.. He likes the display on front of case for how much life is left to earbuds. They come with different size ear tips to get a perfect fit. They are small enough to carring in your pocket or purse easily. They were very easy to pair with his cell. The instructions are very easy to use. They are very easy to control.

title: AMAZING SOUND
review: [[VIDEOID:de1950ee221a8a72e8b0c3d8dc8a6016]] This headset is very easy to pair with my cell, but they also come with prerecorded music on them. They are lightweight and  super comfortable on for long periods of time. They sound amazing in all genres of music. They are very easy to use and control. He said these will be great for cycling and working out. They stay on great no matter what you are doing even running.

title: REALLY NICE SOUND
review: [[VIDEOID:279a451b30bb01e0073cc86026ecfddb]] The sound quality of these earbuds are amazing. The price point is fantastic for the quality of them. They fit perfectly in my ears. They are very light weight. They work perfectly with my samsung cell. I like to wear these in the mornings while doing all my outside chores and I can't be playing loud music while the kids are sleeping still. They are very well made.

title: GREAT FOR MY EARBUD CABLES WHILE CYCLING
review: These are so handy. I got them because it is getting nicer out and I plan to use them with my earbud cables when I am cycling so the cord doesn't hang down. Since these hold together with small magnets, it makes it very handy to hook the earbud cord to my waterpack.

title: GREAT SOUND & HARD CASE
review: My husband will only use wired earbuds. I have no clue why but he does not like Bluetooth ones. Well actually he said he hates it going in and out. He spends a lot of time flying for his job and is also a cyclist and spends a lot of time in the gym working out. The cord is tangle free and it comes with a clip so he can clip the cord to his camelback or shirt when cycling or working out. Everything is done on the cord, including answering the cell. It is very easy to use. I think he will really like the hard case that he can use for storage in his gym bag. I gave these a test and the sound is amazing and they are quite comfortable in the ears. They are very lightweight in the ears and they also come with foam pads to go over them.

title: GREAT QUALITY FOR THE PRICE POINT
review:
These are some great sounding head phones especially for the price point. I tested these on a windy day walking my dog. They passed the test of the wind interference and other outside sounds. To me 1 of my biggie test is...is it comfortable in my ears. For some reason alot of ear buds make my ears ache and hurt after 30 minutes, and that means if I am hiking I can not enjoy music the rest of my hike. I used these ear buds with my samsung galaxy S4 and they worked great.
These are in ear wired earbuds. They are mainly white with some pink and very stylish looking. They are very simple and easy to use. They have a mic that works great with calls, the volume up and down are on the same tab. They have very good and clear sound quality. I really like that they are plain, simple and easy to use. I definitely recommend them.
Thank you for giving me the chance to review these great in ear wired earbuds for a discounted price for my honest and unbiased review.

title: The Logitec C920x Pro HD Webcam is GREAT!
review: My first Web Cam and I'm very pleased with it.  Picture is clear with true colors.  I don't use the mic.  I haven't tried it yet, so I cannot comment on the audio.  I prefer to use my headphones and mic set.  It's SO nice to be able to see and talk with my family now - especially my Great Grandkids!  I highly recommend this Webcam!

title: Purchased 11-10-2010
review:
My monitor is a little more than 9 years old and still performing like a champ! The colors are bright, clear and very true. I use 1600x1200 resolution because my vision requires larger text and video sizes. I've made very few changes to any of its features in 9 years. I've never even heard it's speakers because I use headphones so that I don't disturb other members of my household. Plus, I find that headphones outperform any small speakers. I love this monitor and it has served me well all for 9 years. I've played Fortnite on this monitor with no problems at all.
Unfortunately, my vision is a little worse these days and I am searching for a 27" HP monitor. I'm not finding any that I think would match the quality of this monitor since it had some pretty sophisticated technology that was used in 2010. I would love to find one with the features this monitor has but in a larger 27" model and would purchase it without a second thought! I don't think HP even offers this model (2320m) any longer, but if they did I would HIGHLY recommend it.

title: A Little Disappointed
review: I purchased these headphones to replace another in-line volume switch set of headphones.  My previous pair was shorting out at the in-line volume control and I'd lose one side or the other unless I messed with the in-line contol.  These headphones are okay, but not as good as what I had.  I find them to be a little tinny - they could use a little more bass.  The volume is great; some things I can hear without even wearing the headphones.  The padding is comfortable, but they're not as tight as my previous pair and tend to fall off or slip out of place if I move around too much.  They're a decent set of headphones for the price but really wish I could find another pair of the Labtec headphones.  But, these will do for most of the purposes for which I use them.  However, if you demand great quality in construction and music listening, these headphones are not for you.

title: Good bang for your buck
review: These are a good budget friendly option. The charge like apple headphones. Sound is good and fit comfortably. The only thing that isn’t my favorite is they don’t have as big of a connectivity range as I thought they would but it’s not terrible either. Overall would definitely recommend

stay away from this company, No support and they don't stand behind their products.

save yourself a headache, buy something else!!!

title: Perfect headphones for my son who kills them
review: It is awesome. My son is always killing headphones. Lost count. These fit well. They are made of soft stretchy material. They fit well on all 4 of us despite different head sizes. The sound is strong and good. It has nice base.

title: Best deal for the excellent sound that comes out of ...
review:
Best deal for the excellent sound that comes out of these headphones. Don't know if the magnet technology has gotten better, but the lows and highs are better than any headphone I've purchased to date. I can honestly say these sound as good as the Sennheiser Momentum units I was forced to replace (thank you, thief) and wasn't looking forward to paying 4x the price of these for.
Great quality at an affordable price.

title: Excellent for hard of hearing people!
review: I am very hard of hearing and I'm able to use these without my hearing aids.  Most headsets or earbuds are unable to provide me the necessary volume to use but these are an exception.

title: Great quality for the price!
review: I'm hard of hearing and usually have to go to 100% on earbuds to hear but I can hear comfortably on these at 70%.

title: Works for the price
review: Smaller than what I was expecting. When I first opened the box I thought I bought kids headphones by mistake, but does have an adjustment, but for the price was good sounding over the ear headphones. Satisfied, only $14.95,works for what I need.

title: comfortable and good listening audio
review: The headset is lightweight and comfortable to wear.  I like the long cord and it was plug and play.  It is much easier to listen to audio on the headset verses the computer speakers.  The reason I got this headset was to provide better audio to the people listening to me.  When participating on zoom calls, I used the built in microphone on my webcamera and hoped this would provide better sound quality.  When i asked my participants to compare the sound quality from the headset and the webcam speaker, they told me there was very little difference.  So apparently either my webcam has a good speaker and the room doesn't echo, or the audio quality is equal.  But I like the headset for the better sound quality for my listening pleasure.  And I still think my audio would be better since I am talking directly into the mic and I am picking up less background noise.

title: The best choice
review: I have used Plantronics headsets for 25 years or more.  I don't believe there is a better headset out there.  If you need multiple headsets in one office, there are other models that can work, but for one headset, this is the best wireless one out there.  It has a model that attaches to your ear and I prefer that model.  This one has a band that goes over the head, which my wife prefers.  Once you use a headset you will never go back to using the handset.  No more pinching your neck while you write or type something.  At first you feel like a phone operator but quickly get past that.  Like I said... you will never go back to handsets.  Be sure to order the auto lifter as well for true hands free operation.

review: tried to use to go from 2.5 headset to 3.5 phone jack, didn't work, maybe due to not fitting all the way in since barrel on male end is fat

title: Great product
review: The best headphones, these replaced my originals that lasted almost 3 years. These will do the same, great product

title: Cute case
review: This is a cute little case and fits my ear buds easily. I like that I can find it in my purse and it offers protection for earbuds.

title: Beware!!!!!!!!!!!buyers. KNOW CLEARLY the coverage.
review: I purchased a warranty from Asurion and my headphones broke and I filed a claim, my money was credited to Amazon for another pair of the same product. I inquired to see if I needed to purchase another warranty, but was told by customer service that as long as I was purchasing the identical set of headphones that I would not need a new warranty. My new headphones broke not even 3 months after purchase, I again inquired about the warranty and was told that it only covers a one-time replacement which was opposite of what I had been told before. So, beware of their promises and in-between the lines warranty coverage. It seems they prefer loop holes and rely on confusion as to what is covered.

title: Quality sound
review: I owned a set identical to these except they were blue in color. The swivel on the bottom piece of the earphone broke. I had thought about not ordering the same set, but the quality of sound is excessive. I love them and use them almost daily. I bought an extended warranty on them this time. Hopefully, there are no issues.

title: Amazing sound
review: The sound these earbuds make are incredible.  They truly are noise canceling.  I received a different brand for my birthday earlier this year, but wanted a rose gold pair so I purchased these to try.  These are so much better than my other pair.

title: Exactly as advertised
review: There just cords...so not too much to say. They easily charged my phone head-set as well as my wireless Beats Headphones. The company website did an EXCELLENT job showing all the various USB cord types so there is no confusion and I bought from them with the confidence it was indeed the correct cord. Good job to the marketing team.

title: These are Perfect
review: I was sceptical because of the weight. But these are Damn good they go around the whole ear just what I wanted, they are light and for me I set the E.Q to Bass boost and then bass boost on my phone/lgv20 and D.j Tiesto came through like it did on my old H.K headset. So for $34 I say hands down YES!!! Now the test will be longevity.

title: they sound great. I keep them at work so I don't ...
review: For how cheap these are, they sound great. I keep them at work so I don't have to travel with (and forget) headphones. They fit in my ears great, too. Better than my more expensive buds. I rate these 800 out of 861.

title: Happy with my purchase
review: So far so good. These headphones go completely over my ears. The battery seems to last well. Easy to use. One thing I notice is you have to completely disconnect (I hit forget device) to connect to different devices. Otherwise it won’t connect to the new device. This is my experience of course.

title: Great quality earbuds
review: I have to say I normally do not like earbuds but these are super comfortable. The sound quality is amazing also. Definitely recommend buying these! Great product for a less expensive price.

title: Great headset, love the features
review: This is the first time I've purchased this particular headset. I usually get a much cheaper one and I go through them really quickly as they don't work for long. Because I had found one that works and fits my phone, I was concerned about trying this one. I'm so glad I did! I like the functionality better - the ability to mute - it feels nicer on my head since I'm often wearing it for long periods of time, I don't feel like I'm eating the microphone because I don't have to press it up against my lips for people to hear me. Since I work from home, all "meetings" are on the phone and I need to wear a headset for hours at a time. This is a great headset and I'm happy I gave it a try.

title: Great headset, just plug-and-use
review: This is a great headset, comfortable and just plug-and-use. It works well with my Panasonic Expandable Cordless Phone System 6.0 KX-TG6512B, if you are looking for a phone system that allows you to plug in a headset. It is really light weight, so even though I wear it almost all day I barely notice it is there. Others on the phone tell me they can hear me really well with this headset (vs. before when I was using my cell's bluetooth system). And it isn't expensive, so if I ever needed to replace it I wouldn't be concerned about it. Highly recommend it.

title: Won’t stay in my ears!
review: I was excited about these until i realized they won’t stay in my ears. I’ve tried every size ear piece that comes with the earbuds and I’m constantly having to shove them back in. No way i can workout in these.

title: Best available
review: The now unavailable Sony headphones are the gold standard for the behind the neck style. These are a close second. As mentioned by others, the sound quality could be improved but in every other respect, they're top notch. The cord is on the long side but I'd rather that than it being too short. I'll probably order a couple of extras in case they suddenly become unavailable like the Sonys did.

title: Meets my needs
review: Most feature work as intended but I can't paint my BT earbuds.  Battery life is as poor as stated in other reviews. Without power saver I get less than 24 hrs, with power saver maybe 32 tops.

title: Good sound for the price.
review: I do air shifts at a couple of radio stations and always keep an extra set of headphones at the studios and in the car. These are great for the price.

title: May have received a defective one
review: Prior headphones were wired Bose. Bought based on the positive reviews, but returned due to sound quality. Tried to improve via the iPhone sound adjustments (the Anker ap does not work with the Q20), but little improvement. Treble and mid range clarity/accuracy were poor. Noise cancellation better than expected. Comfort and build quality are very good.

title: Used and Dirty
review: My earbuds arrived already opened and they were dirty. They weren't in the box correctly so it wouldn't even shut all the way. I pulled them out and they had human hair on them. Gross, they were definitely used. Returning.

title: Average inexpensive earbuds
review:
I have a lot of inexpensive earbuds - ranging from $50 sets that were on sale for $25 or less, to cheaper ones that retailed at $25. I thought these might outperform them in sound quality, but they sound the same to me.
They have a quality look and feel to them.
Inexplicably, the right earbud goes on the left side in the case, and vice versa. Every time I try to put them away, I get it wrong first. They are labeled R and L, but it's habit to put the right one away on the right side. That's no big deal, but I don't understand why someone would design something that way.
Update: After using these a little longer, I have notices some ore things I like about them. They feel a little more solid than most of my cheap earbuds and they fit well. They always connect up well, and seem to hold a charge fairly long. Once you get used to their placement in the case, it makes them easy to grab - each with the correct hand.

title: Average earbuds
review:
I have several pairs of earbuds, all inexpensive. I don't typically pay more than $20, though they are usually on sale. These are average among them. To be honest, I expected a little better sound quality from these. They sound a little more "tinny" than my other ones.
They do fit well and feel nice and solid. They have a good case, and battery life has been good so far. They paired up easily with my iPhone. They are relatively small and comfortable.
Overall, I would say that these are an average pair of inexpensive earbuds.

title: Not durable enough to sleep in. - Updated
review:
Sound is fine and they are comfortable, but they only lasted a very short time for me. I sleep with them in. After a few weeks, one side lost sound, and then the other side. They are not durable enough to sleep in unless you sleep in one position all night.

Update: Atech saw my review and replaced the earbuds. Great service. I have been using the new pair successfully for two weeks with no issues. I will update again based on how durable they prove to be.

title: Quality, comfortable economy earbuds.
review: I have now had two pairs of these.  I sleep in them, and recommend them for a comfortable fit.  I mostly listen to talk shows and classic radio, and the audio quality of fine.  For music, you won't mistake the quality for $100 earbuds, but I find it good.  I bought my teenage daughter a pair, and she likes them as well.

title: Great durable headphones--now laundered and workin' fine!
review: Since March 2015 these little headphones have performed perfectly.  In October 2016 I forgot they were in my pocket and they went through the entire laundry process--108 minutes of wash, rinse and spin.  I put them out to dry and the next day they worked perfectly again.  So, yeah, they are definitely 'sweatproof'!

title: I am amazed with this product and the quality of it. Very nice 👍🏻 I definitely recommend it
review: I love this earbuds. I am amazed with this product and the quality of it. Very nice 👍🏻 I definitely recommend it.

title: A good, practical extension wire
review: I needed some extra length to reach from my bedside radio to where I sleep with earbuds. This cords gives just the xtra length that I need so that I don't accidentally rip the plug out of the radio jack, which usually happened at 3 a.m.!

title: Using with a smart phone
review: I spend a far amount of time on my cell phone for conference calls and I've found that having very clear audio helps a lot with picking out conversations when there is a lot of back ground noise or other discussions going on in the group.  I tried the Yamaha based on the brands reputation, and because of  it's over the ear fit, something I find more comfortable when I'm wearing a head set for long periods of time.  The audio is clear and sounds better than with ear buds.  I've also been told the sound coming out of the mike is also good for those on the other end of the conversation. However when using the head set with my cellphone alone the volume was to soft for good listening even when the phone was set for maximum volume. After adding a small match box sized cell phone headset amplifier from Plantronix the volume is great and can be adjusted either on the cell phone or on the amplifier itself.

title: Not Bad At All
review: I received these as an Amazon promotion and I'm very please they included me. These are really good in Ear Headphones. I can't compare them to  my Bose but for what they are....Not bad...Not bad at all.

title: Looks and functions like brand new!
review:
I purchased these from the seller 'Deal Zones' fulfilled by Amazon and I must say that everything looks brand new. There are no marks, scratches, blemishes, or any signs of usage on the earphones, charging case, etc.

The charging case is the original B&O one and the charging cable looks to be the original as well but I can't tell for sure. But it looks brand new. The only thing that was not original was the box. It came in a brown B&O 'Refurbished Factory Certified' box.

Included in the box were the earphones, charging case, charging cable, manual, and one pair of new Comply foam tips. The Comply foam tips fit my ears well but I wish a regular silicone tip was included as well.

It's only been a couple of days but everything works perfectly so far. The sound quality is amazing, no issues with connectivity, and the battery life is what is listed for these on B&O's website.

I will update if something changes but so far so good!

title: A bit bulky and heavy for me...
review: Excellent seller (Focus Camera LLC) and excellent price but unfortunately I am returning these.  I only opened and tried the headphones on to see how they fit and for me they were not comfortable.  They were a bit bulky (thick) and heavy and did not seem as though they would stay on my head.  And the ear pads were a bit uncomfortable for me, a bit too tight.

title: Excellent, high quality, earbuds at an excellent price...
review: Excellent, high quality, earbuds at an excellent price.  Bought these to use with my Apple Watch and iPhone 6 and so far so good.  They fit well, and securely, in my ear and have an excellent sound.  Clean highs and excellent bass.  And they look nice as well.  The only downside is that the integrated volume button on the earbud itself is too small/difficult to adjust without looking at it.  Maybe with use it'll become easier.  But all in all, excellent earbuds.  It even comes with a case for storage.  I will be ordering a second pair today!

title: Perfect.
review: Exactly what I needed when I needed them. My puppy munched the old set and these saved me from having to buy new headphones.

title: To small
review: OK I may sound a little picky but these earphones over ears are so small it makes you feel like a kid honestly I usually don’t give out ratings like this but this one definitely made me do it.

review: The built quality is good. Bass is alright. I use it with Samsung, so don't know if Siri would work or not. Overall good buy. review:
Extremely comfortable headset, good sound reception (hi fidelity playback suitable for listening to music) and transmission (microphone pickup is good for use with a cell phone. Bluetooth pairing is reliable and stable.
After using these earphones for several hours per day for weeks, I am upgrading my review to 5 stars, because they are incredibly comfortable to wear.

title: Good headset for voice calls on cellphone or computer, uses the new standard analog 4-connector audio input-output plug.
review: Good audio quality for phone calls, both input and output.  Very light weight, no discomfort.  Connects to cell phones, digital devices and computers with a single analog 4-conductor plug.  Cord length is adequate if seated at computer, and short enough if walking around while carrying the cell phone it is connected to.  Cord has an in-line volume control.  This headset is works well for VOIP telephone calls.

title: Adults will love this case too - every time it protects your Fire device......
review: Grown-ups will appreciate this highly protective case every time it prevents damage to their Fire unit, due to drops or being set down in a shallow puddle of water.  The blue plastic material is thick and a little spongy so that the impact protection is greater than those slim "adult" Fire cases.  Also, the cutout holes for the controls and for the headphone wire are large enough to use effectively, unlike the rugged black tire-tread adult kick-stand case I returned to Amazon before I discovered this case.  Shallow puddles on the table do not reach high enough to invade this thick case.  I want to encase my two 7-inch Fire units with similar cases now, if available.

title: One working splitter plus one dead on arrival splitter equals half of what I paid for.
review: This product consists of 2 identical headset jack splitters.  They convert a 4-conductor mini phono-plug to 2 x 3 conductor female phono-jacks.  One of the two worked when I tried it out.  The other splitter gave a dead open circuit on both the female jacks.  I tried it several times.  DOA.  Dead on arrival.  I asked for a replacement of the broken unit with a live one.  I want to keep the working unit.  Instead, Amazon issued me a full refund.  Now, I have to buy another pair of these, and hope that at least one of them works.

title: Great sound, comfortable fit, finally found comfortable ear buds
review: Extremely good sound reproduction - much better than Sony MDR-EX37B earbuds (which sound tinny), and the Sony product costs twice as much.  I plan to buy a few more pairs of these puppies, because they are dirt-cheap and it took me years to find earbuds that sound great, fit comfortably in my ears and are this low a price.

title: Comfortable, modular design and head-hugging stability, but sound quality inferior to Sony MDR-7506 headphones.
review:
Good qualities of the Sennheiser HD 380 headphones:
1) They are extremely comfortable to wear, even for long periods of time.
2) They are modular - you can easily replace the cord or the ear-pads yourself.
3) Sennheiser sells (on Amazon) a shorter replacement cable for folks who want to listen to mp3 players while walking around
4) Circumaural (around the ears & completely enclosing them) is the best design for headphones.

There is only one area where these headphones fail miserably when compared head-to-head with Sony MDR-7506 reference headphones:
1) The audio fidelity of these Sennheiser's is markedly inferior to the Sony's. The Sony's are less expensive and put much clearer and brighter music in your ears. I have now purchased 3 headphones by Sennheiser, and returned 2, in my failed quest to find headphones which combine the great sound reproduction of Sony headphones with the comfort, modularity and head-hugging stability of the Sennheisers.

title: 2.5 star audio quality, but priced to move
review: On an absolute scale, the audio quality rates maybe 2.5 stars at best.  I wanted to find out if these $10 headphones were really as good as the 4.1 stars averaged over all those reviews.  They are not anywhere near what I would rate as 4 stars or even 3 stars, except when the rating includes price value.  If you have only $10 for headphones, you could use these until you get a job, then celebrate with a pair of Sony MDR-7506 reference headphones.  A head to head comparison will reveal the deficiencies in these Behringers.

title: Okay for telephone use, but not for music.
review: Okay for telephone use, but not for music.  These cost me $7 on Amazon, and they sound tinny, meaning no bass response.  Spend an extra $8 to buy the Koss Titanium KTXPro1 (which I gave a 4 star review), which cost about $15 and are as cheap as music headphones can probably be.  I will use these ACM-70's for listening to AM talk radio and with my cell phone.  Maybe.

title: Best sound you can expect from $15 headphones
review: I wanted cheap headphones to wear while walking.  Must not block sounds I need to hear for safety & let me converse without removal.  Should be light-weight and have an in-line volume control.  Must have good sound.  These headphones fit the bill nicely.  I would give them 5 stars for their price range.  Of course, the sound does not compare with monitor headphones, line the Sony MDR-7506, but it's the closest approximation you can expect for $15.  Good bass response, does not sound tinny.  Head-band is comfortable and secure.  Does not hurt your ears.  No complaints.

title: Not nearly as comfortable as the Sennheiser HD 558 headphones I own.
review: Not nearly as comfortable as the Sennheiser HD 558 headphones I own, mainly because the earpads are plastic instead of velour like the 558's have.  Also, the open design of the 558 lets cool air in and moist warm air out, so the ears don't sweat as much.  Sound-wise, these headphones can't touch the Sony MDR-7506 despite the fact that the Sony's cost much less.  I sent these back for a refund.  I do not need another pair of uncomfortable headphones with second-rate sound reproduction.  My advice is get a pair of Sennheiser 558 headphones, for comfort, and Sony MDR-7506 when you want the best audio reproduction quality (but remember the Sony's also have plastic earpads and get  hot and uncomfortable.  So far, I have not found headphones which combine the comfort of the HD 558's with the sound quality of the MDR-7506 for less than $150.  Any suggestions, Amazonians?

title: Panasonic RP-HTF600-S headphones can't touch Sony MDR-7506
review:
I bought these Panasonic RP-HTF600-S headphones in the hope that their enormous 50 mm drivers would allow them to equal or surpass my Sony MDR-7506 headphones, which are the best I have ever owned. The Sony's have 40 mm drivers, which is considered very large. However, bigger is not always better. The Panasonic's did seem to improve a bit after a few days of burn-in, as suggested by other reviewers, but the Sony's were still easily recognized as providing superior accuracy in sound reproduction. Amazingly, the Sony's even had more accurate and detailed bass than the Panasonic's. On one jazz track, I could clearly hear the strings of the acoustic bass violin being plucked with the Sony's, while the Panasonic provided a much less clear and accurate reproduction of that sound.

Recommendation: Buy the Sony MDR-7506 which Amazon offers for less than $90; these are the best headphones I have ever used, and are far superior to higher-priced headphones, like the Sennheiser HD558 and the Sennheiser HD449

title: The most comfortable headphones I've ever worn, but murky audio quality
review: I am angry that these headphones have lost their sound quality after only 6 months.  When I first bought the Sennheiser HD 558 headphones, I rated them at 5 stars and said they were the best headphones I had ever owned, albeit the most expensive.  The were even better than my Sony MDR-7506 headphones, which had a brighter more detailed sound but were far less comfortable.  Well, the Sennheiser headphones have faded over the past 6 months of use.  My ears do sweat some, but I only wear the headphones about 1 hour per day.  Now, the sound is dull and faded and very flat, murky in comparison to the Sony's. Meanwhile, my Sony headphones have held up now for years with no change in quality.  I do not understand how headphones can lose their sound quality so dramatically.  I did not leave them in the sun or let them get wet.  I will contact Sennheiser, but right now I cannot recommend these headphones at all, even though they are very comfortable, they sound terrible.  I listen to jazz, classical and pop music from CD sources.  Direct comparison reveals excellent sound quality  from my Sony headphones, and awful, mushy, flat sound from the Sennheiser headphones.

title: Wired headset for that uniquely geeky look
review: You can't beat a wired headset for a rock-solid connection, without any of the noise or interference you can get with a wireless Bluetooth headset.  You will look like a geek, but at least you won't lose any calls.  The plug fits into the headset jack on all cell phones and wireless phones for land-line use.  This headset even plugged into my desk phone at work.  I had two of these units which worked great until the plastic head-band broke in exactly the same spot.  I bought the same model again (2 units) and will be more careful not to sit on the headsets this time.

title: Perfect stereo separation as a splitter; turn it around to merge 2 signals
review:
First of all, the reviewer who gave this product 1 star because he thought it failed to preserve the stereo signal was dead wrong. He must have received a different product (a stereo channel separator?) because I purchased two of these units and each female connector puts out the same perfect 2-channel stereo signal that goes into the male plug. The male and female connectors are all standard mini-stereo, ie: 3.5 mm or 1/8 inch in diameter. I leave this splitter plugged into my MP3 player at all times to prevent wear and tear on the MP3 player's built-in female mini connector, which would be difficult to replace.

One more use for this product: turn it around and this splitter becomes a signal merger. I have a Samsung Chromebook which has a single 3.5 mm input jack for audio headsets, combining the microphone input with the earphone output on a single jack. All of my headsets had separate 3.5 mm plugs for earphones and microphone. This splitter (when turned around into a merger) serves to merge the 2 headset lines into the single combined line with a 3.5 mm plug which is required for the Chromebook.

title: OK audio quality for a headset, makes my ears sweat
review: These headphones have OK audio quality for an inexpensive headset and they fit snugly over the ears to effectively reduce outside noise made by the loud-mouthed idiots with whom you might be unfortunate enough to work or live.  The only disadvantage is that the snug fit of the soft plastic cushions, while very comfortable, also seals in the moisture from the humidity in your ear canals.  My ears are quite sweaty when I wear this headset for more than 15 minutes.  On the other hand, open-air headphones would let in the noises made by you-know-who.

title: Fairly good quality Bluetooth audio
review: This headset works well and provides fairly good audio quality, but not nearly as good audio as a set of hard-wired headphones.  There are more expensive wireless headsets which do not use Bluetooth and require base stations but provide superior audio quality.  If you are looking for a lightweight headset with decent audio quality for music, at a low price and with the convenience of Bluetooth, then I recommend this product.  Remember, though, you will not get true audiophile sound quality with this unit.

title: Fits FreeTalk 5091 Wireless Stereo Headset
review: Recently, the foam rubber cushions on the ear pieces of my FreeTalk 5091 wireless stereo headset wore out.  I was very frustrated because the geniuses at FreeTalk do not offer replacement cushions for sale.  I guess they would rather sell you a whole new headset.  Their ear pieces are an odd size:  65 millimeters in diameter.  Fortunately, this product, nominally 60 mm, does stretch and fits quite well.  Plus, since this product includes 2 extra sets of ear pads, it will be quite some time before I need to go through this aggravation again.

title: Fit perfectly onto my Plantronics headset
review: These replacement earpads fit perfectly onto my Plantronics headset.  I wish I could tell you the model number but it is not on the headset, which has 2 inch diameter ear pieces.

title: Dangerous and frustrating packaging, great headset
review: This Plantronics headset's packaging is nearly impossible to open without slashing open an artery or destroying the headset.  I condemn this frustrating and dangerous packaging and urge Plantronics to improve it.  The plastic is way too thick to cut with a scissors, so I had to use a Bowie knife, which is where the slashed artery comes in.  Then, while trying to "deliver" the headset from its injection-molded plastic "womb", I destroyed the microphone boom.  Note to Plantronics: the packaging should safely and conveniently get the product to the consumer.  This headset is packaged as if were an Egyptian mummy meant to be sealed shut for five thousand years!  By the way, the headset itself is a great product & I would have given it 5 stars if not for the packaging.

title: looks 10, sound 3
review:
I'm using this TV for viewing plain old over-the-air HDTV only. No home theater, no gaming, etc. Found it easy to set up and the picture is great. Other reviewers have commented that there are actually 2 types of flat panels, one of which was much superior to the other, particularly in viewing angle. Well, I (think I) have the "bad" panel but the viewing angle is fine.

On the other hand, the sound is terrible. Tinny and flat. So bad that I didn't even want to listen to the evening news. In desperation I hooked up an old pair of powered speakers intended for a computer to the earphone output. Much better. Looking at reviews for 2.1 speaker systems I notice that many reviewers had made their purchases because of the poor sound quality of their flat panel TVs. Seems that the TV manufacturers must be figuring that everyone wants to have a "home theater" set up where they will use the digital sound output(s) to drive an X.1 audio system that costs as much as the TV so why bother with decent internal speakers!

Anyway, I bought a 2.1 system here on Amazon for ~$40 which is good enough for my viewing needs. If you're into the surround sound thing then the poor internal speakers will not matter to you.

title: Decent.
review: This is a very small bluetooth earbud.  It connected easily to my phone.  The sound volume is not loud, and it's not great for music, but fine for voice.  Not suitable for loud environments.  The fit is OK, and will depend upon your own personal preferences and ear shape.  It's a decent, low-cost option to more expensive options that (may) have better sound.  You can pair two, for stereo, but again, the music quality is not great.  The microphone picks up voice just OK, not great, but acceptable.

title: Very good...
review: I use this all day at work, and have been very happy.  The sound is great when speaking with other users of VoIP phones at work; sound is fine otherwise.  Nice headset.

title: Rare over-the-head bluetooth
review: These are the rare "over the head" bluetooth headphones.  They're reasonably comfortable, and I've used them exercising and just walking around.  Don't work extraordinarily well for phone calls, but OK in a pinch.  I actually lost the first pair, and bought a second...

title: Buy Them
review: I have never used super expensive headphones so I can't really compare. With that said, these are excellent for the price. They fit in my ears comfortably and the music is clear. The bass is surprisingly good for earbuds. I would absolutely buy these again.

title: Not noise-cancelling. Really thin sound.
review:
I didn’t buy these thinking they were noise-cancelling, funny that Amazon asked me to rate that (non-existent) feature.

Despite some of the negative reviews about the build quality, I went ahead and bought these. They sure use a lot of plastic in the packaging… I went ahead and paired them to my phone (quick and painless) and gave the a test. What I found was sound that was really thin in the mids and highs, and while there was adequate bass, it wasn’t really punchy. It’s kind of like listening to music immediately after swimming while your ears are still full of water. I tried with several different songs and genres, all of them with which I am thoroughly familiar, and was seriously underwhelmed. I’d expect this kind of sound out of a $30 headset, but not at this price point and not from JBL.

I haven’t decided yet on sending them back but I’m leaning strongly in that direction. I’m goi be to give them a try on an upcoming trip before my final decisions.

title: Excellent Radio
review: This radio is perfect. Works exactly as advertised. Even the belt clip is solid. I'm mainly a AM talk radio listener, with a little FM. I use the radio without the earbuds. Stations come in fine with decent sound. I use rechargeable AA's. I like the smallish size to easily carry in my pocket if I wish. I cut the cord portion off of the antenna cord that comes with the radio and only use the jack part, and FM comes in great that way, so no cord hassle. The only negative, and it's not a big deal, is that you can't delete a favorite "location". If you have 10 presets, you can't go to just 9 presets. Maybe if you remove the batteries and leave it that way overnight it will erase presets and then you can re-do them? Maybe I'll try that sometime. But again not a deal breaker. I'd buy this radio again.

title: Works really great for me and I wanted black instead of the ...
review: Works really great for me and I wanted black instead of the white you normally get with Samsung headphones.

title: The Greatest
review: I really enjoy these although they are pricey.  I use them in a communications environment.  The noise cancelling works very well.  I wish someone would come up with some headphones that could be powered via the audio cable.  I end up going through a lot of batteries.

title: Great lightweight headphones.
review: These are great lightweight headphones.  They sound good and the price is fantastic.  These are a good deal, with good sound too.

title: Good headphones.
review: Excellent headphones.  I bought the refurbs.  Good deal and they were refurb'd at the factory.  Good as new.  Closed-can so they don't leak out much sound - that was important to me for a special application.

title: Possible most defective prone computer cable ever
review: I have bought about 10 of these over the past two years.  Even though they are stationed secure boxes they fail at an alarming rate.  At least 2 of the 10 were non-functioning on arrival.  The cabling unravels and comes apart on it's own like those $1 earbuds from the dollar store.  50% failure rate.  Very badly manufactured.

title: Another Quality Tribit Product
review: I have been using this earbuds for the past few months. I had an issue with a pair of JBL's that would stop charging in the case and draining the battery (even after turning the earbuds off). For these, I wasn't expecting them to be quite the quality of sound given the price but I was pleasantly surprised. I have a Tribit BT speaker that use often and enjoy. It's a great value and directly comparable to a JBL Flip. These earbuds are also comparable to JBL. This brand offers great products and makes them very affordable. A bonus is USB-C charging on the case (unlike the JBL). These are also smaller and fit better in my ear. Battery life is decent, I can use them for at least a few hours and the case will charge them several times. USB-C makes for quicker case-charging. I highly recommend this product.

title: Won't Turn Off!
review: I purchased these earbuds about six months ago on a great deal (I think it was Black Friday). I was really excited for these since JBL is known to generally make great products. These sound pretty good and offer decent noise cancellation for what they are. However, I've been having a problem recently that when I place them back in the charging case they will not turn off. I even try to manually turn them off but once they hit the case they stay on until the battery is depleted. The last few times I went to use them (not super often), they have been very low on charge or not charged at all. It's frustrating to not have them at the ready when needed. At first I just thought it had been awhile between charges but I discovered the issue on a recent trip. I've read some helpful tips and tricks online to try and reset this flaw but I haven't been successful in preventing this issue. Even if I was able to, this is not what I would expect for a "$100" set of earbuds from a reputable company like JBL. I am probably going to just order some other off-brand that's about $25 because that should suit my needs. I typically use over the ear headphones anyway but the earbuds are obviously better for working out, mowing, on the go, etc. I would not recommend these earbuds unfortunately. I'll update if I find a fix because apparently this is a somewhat common issue.

title: Great Headphones by Sony
review: I bought these on Prime Day at a great discount. I had actually ordered another set of headphones about a week or so prior that were less than half of what I spent on these but I wasn't satisfied with that pair. These were exactly what I was looking for - a decent set of headphones for a reasonable price. The NC works really well and the sound depth is amazing. They have enough bass but not enough to be overwhelming. The sound quality is excellent. I returned the other pair after realizing my expectations were high and you get what you pay for. Although these come at a higher price tag, it's worth it. These are also very comfortable and offer 30+ battery life. It seems like they will also be very durable (the $40 set felt pretty cheap by comparison). Sony makes great headphones and I would highly recommend these!

title: Headphones For Those Who Are Active
review: These headphones sound great across different genres and have big sound. I have done some excercize with them and they have withstood a little sweat. The battery life is about 7+ hours depending on volume level. It comes with a nifty little case which is nice when I travel. I gave this a 5 star for the value aspect. I paid around $50 for this product. Otherwise, I would rate it as 4 stars. For the price I am extremely satisfied with this purchase. Everyone who is active should invest in a set of these headphones!

title: Excellent
review:
These Philips headphone are the best over-the-ear headphones I have ever owned.
They are very comfortable and the sound is excellent, including excellent separation.
No negatives. I highly recommend.

title: An Excellent Buy
review: This headphone set is an excellent buy at a reasonable cost  The headphones are well constructed and professional-looking.  The ear cushions are very comfortable and can be worn for several hours easily.  The sound is crisp and clear.  I have been using the headphones while watching TV movies.  They are great.

title: Better than I thought they might be
review:
Wanted to replace an old pair of wired ear-buds I have been using. I do a lot of walking outside and like to listen to audiobooks, podcasts, and music while doing that. I prefer using wired earbuds - as they tend to have control buttons that I can use without taking the headphones off.

Looked at several brands of these and picked these JBL ones because they looked to have earpieces that might actually fit in my ears and stay - plus, they were pretty inexpensive. I was really impressed at the packaging these came in - something I would more imagine for a more expensive product. The earbuds are pretty nice too. They fit my ears well, and you get some of the silicone pieces in different sizes. The ones that came one the earbuds fit me perfectly. The sound quality is good - course I'm mainly listening to audiobooks - but the few times I've listened to music I wasn't disappointed. The silicone earpieces do muffle outside sounds - but not totally. The control button works well.

If I were to have a complaint - it would be that you don't get a case/bag to store the earbuds in when not in use. Something simple as a small nylon bag would have been nice. Maybe cut back on spending so much money on the product packaging - which gets thrown out and instead include a bag/case. But other than that - I'm happy with the new earbuds and with my purchase.

title: A bit large
review:
Recently purchased a pair of the AfterShokz OpenMove headphones, and wanted a case for them when I'm carrying them in my backpack. This case wasn't listed for that model of headphones - but the OpenMove are somewhat similar in size & shape as the other AfterShokz headphones - so I took a chance. The headphone do fit nicely in the case - as does the case for the ear-plugs (which I never use). There is even space for the charging cable. I like the color too - I got the green one.

I purchase one of the repackaged cases sold by Amazon Warehouse and it was just like new. I'm more than happy with my purchase.

title: A tad smaller than the original ear pads
review:
I've been looking for a pair of replacement pads for my set of Pioneer Hi-Res Over-Ear Headphones - SE-MS5T as the original pair has pretty much disintegrated from years of use. These supposedly were a replacement. However - the pair I got is just slightly smaller than what came on the headphones. I've tried putting the new set on - but just can't seem to accomplish that. I'll keep trying I think if I can get these mounted they will work just fine. But right now, I just put the original pair back on.

ETA - gave the pads and the headphones to someone else to put on. They got them on. The new pads are a bit thicker than the originals - about 50% more padding by my estimation. Doesn't seem to effect the wearable of the headphones. I'm happy with my purchase.

title: Didn't fit - but not that surprising
review:
Purchased these replacement pads in hope that they might fit my headphones - which has pads that are disintegrating - leastwise the outer leather part. The headphones I have are a pair of Pioneer Hi-Res Over-Ear Headphones - SE-MS5T. I've been looking for a set of replacement pads - but haven't found any that are specifically for that set of headphones. So I took a chance and ordered a pair of these. Unfortunately they are too small to fit. About 15% smaller in size than what I need.

The replacement pads seem to be of good quality - and I think they would have been a more than adequate replacement if they had fit. I'm going to keep these in case I need them later as I have other headphones that they might fit. At least now I know I need to be looking at larger size pads.

title: Adequate quality for the price
review: Purchased a pair of these locally when I discovered that I had left without my usual pair. Just wanted something cheap that I could use for the day, and these were more than adequate. Not the best sounding pair of earbud I've used - but not the worst either. I'll probably keep these in my car's glove box just in case I need them later. Three stars = It's OK

title: Comfortable to wear
review:
For the price range these headphones sell for they are pretty good. They seem to be well constructed, and comfortable to wear for extended periods of time (for me that is more than an hour). The headphones come with a 1/4" phono jack adaptor in case you need that (I don't), and the cord on these things is a ridiculously long (IMO) 15 foot length. I'm using these headphones at work - at my desk, so I really didn't need that long a cord. But I guess too long is better than too short. I'm using one of these to keep the slack from interfering with the stuff on my desk - Mini Cord Wrap for Cord and Cable Management.

I'm noticing some issues with the sound quality - it's a bit flat in some ranges which makes it sound a little tinney (might just be the pair I got). I'm using these headphones with my Fire HD 10 (streaming Prime music) and my iPod touch. Tweaking the settings on the music players greatly improved the sound of the headphones. They do have a decent amount of bass.

Over-all, these headphones would be more than adequate for most people.

title: I can hear clearly now
review: I recently got a new computer at work, and needed a new set of speakers (the IT guy took the pair I had when he hauled off my old computer). My boss purchased a pair of these Inspire's for me. I'm really impress at the sound of them - even without a sub-woofer you get some decent sounding bass (well, good enough for a work space). I like that I  can plug my headphones into the front of the one speaker (for those times I need to really rock out and ignore my coworkers). I'm happy with the speakers (and I'll be hiding them the next time I get I new computer).

title: Big disappointment
review:
I like the features of these headphones, but they simply don't fit. The way the stem of the earbuds is molded, keeps them from actually sticking in my ears - and there is no way of twisting or bending the stems to do so. So whether it's a bad design on the earbuds or my ears (or a combination of both) - bottom-line they don't fit. I've tried the different ear-pieces, but it's not a case of the shape of my ears, but rather the angle that earbuds need to fit so as to be able to hear the music.

Probably should send these back, but I've had them for a couple months now and I don't think I kept the box. Guessing I'll try and find someone with ears these might fit and give it to them.

title: quality
review: I bought a portable stereo for use when the power goes out, and it did. The cheap headphones broke and I bought these. So far they are great and for the money, you can't beat them.

title: Sound quality in cd player is lacking bass
review: I like white accessories like these earbuds but sound quality lacks bass,i would return them but i like the case they came in.i am going to try them with my phone,hopefully the earbuds will be good for it

title: He loved it. Headphones are big but comfy
review: Speedy delivery. Purchased for my husband. He loved it. Headphones are big but comfy. Only used once so far but the sound and clarity was great. These are his 1st pair so I cannot compare it to any other brand. So far so good.

title: Could not get left earbud to work
review: This experience started downhill upon opening the box. The left earbud is on the right side of the case and the right earbud is on the left side of the case. I got the right earbud to work OK, but never got anything out of the left one. It is almost impossible to remove an earbud from the case without clicking the button on top. This may have led to some of my problems, but I went through the instruction booklet and tried to understand what the status lights meant. The booklet was not clear on what lights should be on for each step. There is a blue and red LED that flash in multiple ways to indicate the status, but I could not determine their meaning.

title: "REMARKABLE SOUND".... for the price
review: Absolutely Love them...Now my wife and I can listen to our TV up to 150ft simultaneously  together with our dual wireless headsets. Remarkable sound so realistic sometimes it scares and startles me. I also purchased separately the speaking Avantree Oasis transmitter from Amazon. No guess work if your un sure of proper connection... Loud audible vocal commands from Oasis transmitter... Very easy set up for bother or call cus service for aNY tech help... No more neighbors beating on my walls in the late night hours complaining of a loud TV ect.. Headset clarity is sharp and loud if you'd like to place yourself in the movie or the sport of the event...The compatible Osis always tells you automatically when your connected very audibly..Avantree headsets are rechargeable and last for up to 40 hours on one charge... Love'eem both !!!

title: Good mic, mediocre earphones
review: Mic seems to operate fairly effectively.  The earphones are too large for my ear canals, but that may just be a fitting issue.  With other units, I'm just on the small side of medium.

title: It’s a miracle
review: So I have this sound at work from like a ups generator or something. Did a sound test and it is 10000 hz. It kills me. I can’t function in it. No headphones have blocked it out from noise canceling and so on. These do! I can function again. So trying to block a high pitched sound, you need these.

title: Beware - This is NOT New
review: As soon as I unpacked my Jawbone I knew I had been duped.  One of the ear buds was cut and modified apparently by the previous owner to fit his ear better.  Then I noticed the talk time went from 4 hours to 1 hour very quickly.  Maybe I missed it but I didn't see any thing in the description of this that states it is used or refurbished.  I will be returning this headset and spending a little more for a new one.  I will also not be buying anything sold by Park Deals in the future.

title: Comfortably Sound!
review: [[VIDEOID:74f135d51ad82b06b113100e6803f935]] I LOVE these! They are comfortable. The material is soft and fits snuggly and not too loose.  The sound quality is surprisingly good. Customer service was great and they tried to coach me through fitting it to my head but it didn't help. I tried the headset 3 more times and could never get those loud startling noises to stop and had to return it. The noises were slightly more common when I turned my head, which my type of environment requires. It wasn't about the seal of the cups, these sounds just suddenly came and it made me wince every time. Also lightspeed MUST figure a way to reduce the size of their "computer" and decrease power consumption, this thing devours batteries so fast! And that adds up to a lot of money replacing 4 AA batteries. Maybe in another 3 years they'll come out with a better one.

review: These are good wired headphones that are adjustable.  The cord plugs into one side and is long for ease of movement.  They are comfortable to wear and the sound quality is good.

The headphones fit a kid nicely but are tight on my teenager even though they are adjustable.  The design of the headphones is nice with a port to connect instead of thin wires to each earpiece. review: These are good headphones.  They came in a small box folded up nicely and compact.  This is great for carrying the headphones along in a purse or backpack.  The headphones fold out and are adjustable.  The ear pads are nice and comfortable.  They work well and have a clear sound.

review: These are good wired headphones.  The earpieces have little cut outs on the inside to make them more comfortable to wear without putting pressure on the ear.  The only negative is the swivel part because it's more difficult to put them on even though the swivel helps with storage.

title: Great basic earbuds.
review:
These earbuds are perfect for what we needed.
The box is very sleek and small.
Easy and fast to pair with iPhone.
The sound quality is fair. I have some more expensive ones and the sound is not as good as those, but as basic, daily, send to school kind of earbuds are perfect.
The battery last very long before re charge.
The fit is comfortable, and the same size works on my husband and my 12 yo son.
We did not tried the water resistance, but it does resist sweat. (Not “shower” sweat, but normal running sweat)
For a basic, fair sound, easy to use earbuds, these are great.

title: So cute!!!
review:

review:

When I first saw them I was like... mmmm... they are going to fall as soon as I put a foot on the machine.... but to my surprise not only they stayed in, but the sound is very good and they are very comfortables!!! I have small ears and this is always challenging! They are small and they don’t look weird on my ears.

Easy and fast to pair with my iPhone.
The charging box is small. The battery last a long time!
Definitely a surprise and I really like them!!

review:

First, these ones are not as sturdy, the material feels and looks thin.

They are light weight so comfortables to use, the ear is very padded and soft. It is easy to adjust the head size.
The battery life is good.
Overall, I think (and I’m not a headphone expert!) that it is a good basic headphone, nothing incredible, but works fine. I will give these to my son for his classes.

review: I've always had problems with the wireless earbud staying in my ear without having to tape it in place on a walk or hike. The sound is very good about 80% of the time, on occasion they has cut out briefly, but, not to an annoying degree. Great product overall.

review: So far I've used these earbuds with my iPhone 6plus as well as my Macbook with good results.  The sound is excellent - superior to my wired buds while listening to music while walking - they stay in place well. However, on a treadmill at faster speeds they did NOT stay in place as well as found myself trying to adjust a bit too often.  On the Macbook - watching a movie, the sound again was fabulous. Overall I'm pleased with this product.

review:

Can't recommend this item. I think they tried to design it to sit too many different products besides the iPad??

review:

He tells me that the microphone is a good quality; the sound is better than average; the cables are plenty long; the set blocks out outside noise nicely; and that the headset was very comfortable to wear. A fair price for the product's quality as well.

RECOMMENDED

title: Fantastic product!
review: This is a great pair a earbuds.  The sound quality is nice, however, I wouldn't say they are noise cancelling.  They do come with a sheet of multiple sized pads so you can customize the fit.  I have smaller ear canal openings and I do have trouble keeping these snug in place.  Definitely read the instructions on how to properly use the controls.  The issue I have is that I have to work some magic, and even then it's rare, in order to get both buds working at the same time.  Usually, I can only get one, and it's only if the other earbud is in the case.  The battery life is great on these.

title: A GREAT Gadget Gift! Stocking Stuffer!
review:
Surprsingly stable, I'm pleasantly surprised at how long this has lasted. I've had it plugged into the USB port on the back of my office monitor for a couple of months now and use it almost daily. This little guy puts out just the right amount of air for me at my desk and It's quiet enough to have a phone conversation on a bluetooth headset without any disruption. Even after hours of running the body of the unit stays cool.
Also, the clock isn't a distraction like you would think and it's honestly really cool to look down at every once in a while. The gooseneck stays put and only needs a minor tweak every now and then to adjust for gravity. I wish it was that easy to adjust my body for gravity that easily :-)
Seriously, this is a very reasonable price for a really cool and useful gadget and I would recommend it.

title: Durable and Comfortable with Rich Bass - Just Try To Stay Still
review:
THE SOUND: There is indeed much more bass than your average earbud set and, with that, they are rather fun to listen to. I must admit that the amount of bass surprised me at this size. The highs are a little bit squashed (you can hear drum high-hats but not the super crisp top end). At this price point I'd give the overall sound quality an 8/10.

THE FIT: These are not designed to stay in with a lot of activity and moving around - there are other earbud sets made for that. However, they are quite comfortable. They are small enough to sleep with with your head on the pillow. They come with two additional sizes of earbud covers to adjust to your fit. They are lightweight and the cabling is flat, a little thicker than average (a good thing), and the strain reliefs seem to be quite durable.

title: If it looks cheap, and feels cheap, and sounds cheap...
review:
I was looking for a lightweight headset for conference calls at work.
Amazon Basics is a brand that almost always has the best value of any general merchandise products on Amazon. I'm a big fan.
Here, not so much.
This headset felt really flimsy out of the box and felt like a pair of old, cheap Walkman headphones. They kind of sit on your ear but don't really feel like they're making a great connection.
The sound quality is very squashed so that voices are not clear and crisp and the mic sound a bit muffled to the person on the other end. Also there's not much gain on the microphone.
There are much better headsets in this price range. Keep shopping.

title: Comfortable but Mediocre Sound Quality.
review:
I really wanted to like these headphones when I tried them on. Super comfortable earcups and headband. The mic fit mostly where you put it (just not too close). They look sleek and the LED is a really cool luminescent blue. The construction for this price range was sturdy. Standard options for a headset in this price range as well. (Inline Mute / Volume Control)
(The lounge pants in my photos should bear witness that I was indeed gaming since those is a part essential gaming apparel.)
When I checked the sound quality it was very compressed. Highs weren't very crisp and the lows weren't really there. If they can improve the dynamic range on the next model then I would definitely consider hanging on to a set.
ILive typically has good documentation, customer support, and good value for the money.
Ilive, pump up this sound and make me a believer.

You can use it wired or through Bluetooth. The instructions and controls are pretty much self explanatory. The sturdiness is ok, but for the cost it's a great value and nice for events.

review: For the longest time, it was a pain to not using specific bluetooth earbuds for my nintendo switch. Microphone was coming in clear as well.

title: Nice headphones and sound quality. A bit heavy while jogging though.
review: The sound quality of the headphones has good bass. It pairs with my Pixel 3 quite well. Wearing this stationary is something that works from my day to day use. However, when I tried wearing these my jogging or running, it can be fairly uncomfortable. With how your wear these, both sides can feel the weight, where you have the volume adjuster on one side and the other has the charging port.

title: Comfortable..Does its job to block out sound...Your PC may require an audio and mic splitter
review: The headset is comfortable, however it won't be for those who wear glasses as it will still press against your rear frames. If you're looking to use this for the PC and your PC does not have 1 dedicated slot of both audio and microphone, then you'll need to buy the splitter separately. I like the feature that you are able to toggle off the mic by flipping the mic to the upright position. As volume increases, the volume can be heard by other people around you. It does do its job to block out sound though.

title: You get what you pay for...Doesn't work correctly for my Pixel Device.
review:
I was hoping not to spend too much money on a pair of wireless headphones for my Pixel device, but I should have done more research to what works.

Pairing them both, only one of them works at a time. Tapping the headphone will pause the song, and double tapping, depending whether it is the left or right headphone will skip forward or backwards a track. Calls coming in do work with the headphones.

In my experience, the headphones each last roughly 2 hours. If you're not using them, it's best to put them back in the case as they tend to run out of juice fast. ** EDITED 01/27/19 - The charging case does have enough juice to support a lot of recharges. Having said this, make sure to keep the charging case with you for long trips.

Use the cable provided in the box to charge the case and headphones. As for the quality of the sound, it does the job. However, if you are ordering something from a store, and you are listening to music in one ear, it's best to just take them out. Leaving them in, it will be difficult to hear the other person.

review:

I tried them on and they fit my ears but are not very comfortable. The sound is ok, about what you would expect. The battery only last for a few hours at a moderate volume and it take a couple of hours for them to charge. Overall it's not a great pair of ear buds.

title: Really great sound, tight fit.
review:
Turtle Beach Stealth 700 Gen 2 Premium Wireless Gaming Headset for PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4

First the fit, they are a little tight but not painful. I wear glasses and these squeeze a little too much. The earcups are removable, and you can make space for glasses by adjusting a notched band but it's still tight. That's why I put them at 4 stars, everything else is top notch. USB-c charging is fantastic and I'm glad companies are finally starting to do this. The battery last about 20 hours and I went for a few gaming sessions between charges. The sound quality is excellent with a rich range. Overall these are a pretty solid choice for PS5.

title: Best fitting, best sounding in-ear earphones
review:
Bang & Olufsen Beoplay E8 Sport True Wireless In-Ear Bluetooth Earphones with Customizable Comfort Fit, Microphones and Touch Control, Wireless Charging Case, 28H Playtime, IP57 Dustproof & Waterproof

Wow! My Airpods always fall out, no matter what. I've been searching for something better. These are them. Not only do these sound amazing, seriously check out videos online about them, but they fit great. They come with the usual small medium large ear pieces and a foam one. The foam one is perfect. you squish it do and pop it in your ear. It expands and holds snug. They also come with different size wings to help stabilize them in your ear. They are super comfortable and light weight. The battery last all day and the charging case was able to charge them 3 times before I had to charge it. The Beoplay E8 Sport case can be wirelessly charged using any Qi wireless charging base. The mic works great and my voice sounds clear and crisp even in semi noisy environments. As for the sound from these earphones, there fantastic. Not earth shattering bass you get from huge over the ear headphones, great immersive sound. They sound rich and vibrant with deep bass creating a wonderful soundstage. I'm so incredibly happy with these earphones.

title: JBL has hit the sweet spot
review:
JBL Quantum 600 - Wireless Over-Ear Performance Gaming Headset - Black

I wasn't sure what to expect with this headset. I didn't even know JBL made gaming headsets. I mostly play Destiny 2 and I also use Discord. The fact that this headset is certified by Discord is a huge plus. Being able to adjust the in game volume and chat volume outside of the menus is a great feature.

Sound- These sound great! The soundstage is completely immersive with quantum 7.1 surround. The bass is punchy and deep with the highs and mids being clear and crisp.

Features- I really like the flip to mute feature on the mic way better than fiddling for a button somewhere else. The RGB effects are cool but only other people can see it so I'm not sure how much value it adds.

Software- The quantum engine software looks and performs great. It has a ton of customization like a host of EQ, RGB settings and battery modes.

Battery and charging- The battery is pretty good, lasting through quite a few play sessions. The only drawback it that you can't use the headset while charging.

Overall, I really love this headset and I think JBL has hit the sweet spot on price, performance, looks, quality, and features.

title: Great features and Energetic sound
review:
Sony Noise Cancelling Headphones WHCH710N: Wireless Bluetooth Over The Ear Headset with Mic for Phone-Call, Blue (Amazon Exclusive) (WHCH710N/L)

Decent noise cancelation at an affordable price. Weighing 223g, they don’t put a ton of pressure on your head when wearing them. The drawback is that they're mostly plastic with very little padding. At this price they are very competitive in terms of sound quality. The WHCH710N has clear midrange and crisp highs with ok bass. The battery is the clear stand out here. I went three days without charging them and not even a low battery warning. The charge time is a bit long reaching in a around 7 hours but I just plugged them in over night so it wasn't a big deal. I do wish these came with a travel case and the didn't feel so cheap.

title: Love Love Love the classic look!
review:
Marshall Monitor II Active Noise Canceling Over-Ear Bluetooth Headphone

The biggest point for me with any pair of headphone is that the are comfortable. These headphones have medium-sized cups, the pads are comfortable and the headband doesn't put too much pressure on my head. The joystick Marshall uses is really intuitive and on of my favorite parts of these. I'm always fumbling around for the controls on other headphones, but this solution is great. I'm getting a few 8 hour days worth of music between charges with the noise cancelling on, it probably could go longer. As for the sound, These sound best with punchy music. Maybe it's just me but some hard rock sound amazing with these. Other music sounds great too, the highs are crisp and clean and the low are warm and deep. I'm not an audiophile but I think my wife's Bose sound a little cleaner than these. But barely. I just love everything about these headphones.

title: Minimalistic and Modern
review:
UPPERCASE Zero Premium Aluminum Headphone Stand, Headset Holder, Black

I really love this headset stand. The Uppercase Zero is all metal and really well constructed. The curvature of the holder is nice because it wont put creases in the headset padding.

title: very good for the money
review:
Oneme Headphone Amp and Preamp Small Desktop Preamplifier Designed to Have Low Distortion

I got this Headphone preamp to drive some decent Dj headphones and man this thing makes a huge difference in the sound quality. I didn't realize how much a dedicated preamp could make. I am by no means an audiophile and this is my first experience with a headphone preamp. The control is nice and the low, mid and highs are very clear. I have no complaints and can only imagine what a high setup could sound. I think for the price this is a good starting point in bumping up the sound quality in you headphones.

title: Love these headphones
review:
Bose Noise Cancelling Wireless Bluetooth Headphones 700, with Alexa Voice Control, Soapstone

I've been using these headphones for about a month now. The sound quality is outstanding. The highs and mids are clean and crisp. The bass is great, not amazing but it is rich and smooth. The ear cups are a bit on the smaller side for over the ear headphones. The head strap is a little tight. My head is pretty normal and they do feel snug. They are comfortable though so I can't complain about that too much. The app is pretty simple but you don't need it to connect the headphones. If you don't use the app you miss out on some of the functionality but they sound great with out it too.

title: Battery last a long time / Bulky
review:
Altec Lansing MZX658 True Evo Waterproof Bluetooth Sport Earphones with Qi Wireless Charging Case

First off the sound quality is good for this type of earphones and the battery last a long time. I can go all day and just throw them in the charger case at night. They are a little tinny sounding but that is to be expected with this style of earphones. For me they are really uncomfortable and put pressure on the outside of my ear. I don't think I have that abnormally shaped ears, I think the size is just a bit too bulky. They do stay put and don't fall out when actively moving around. These a decent for the price but I would give up some battery for something more light weight and slimmer design.

title: The sound is so good, the plastic feels so cheap!
review:
Panasonic Premium Hi-Res Wireless Bluetooth Over The Ear Headphones with 3D Ear Pads and 3 Sound Modes

This is very difficult because I like these headphones. The sound quality is really good for the price. Only thing is they feel so cheap and flimsy. They are comfortable and The Bluetooth works really good. When you plug them in with the supplied cable, they really sound great. The battery has a very long life, I used them for a few days before recharging and I don't even think they needed it. They don't have any active noise cancelling but the ear cup padding does block a lot of the unwanted environment sounds.

title: Really great bluetooth headphones for under $100
review:
JBL T600BTNC Noise Cancelling, On-Ear, Wireless Bluetooth Headphones.
I'm not an audiophile. I'm just an average person who listens to music and podcasts at work. These headphones sound fantastic. The bass is deep and punchy, the treble is crisp and clear, and the mids are clean and smooth. The noise cancelling works really well. I only heard a slight hissing from the noise cancelling when they first turned on. When music is playing, even at a low volume the hissing is gone. The headphones feel sturdy and have a nice finish. The ear padding is soft and comfortable. I really like that they are snug enough so they don’t fall of when doing anything physical, but don't feel too tight on your head. I used the headphones for about 10 Hours at a generous volume, with noise cancelling on and they were still going strong. The battery seems to last a long time. They are my new favorite headphones.

title: Over ear Bluetooth headphones
review: The bass is great, battery life after fully charged about three hours. Comes with a hard case to store headphones. That’s  C  charger included. You can control the bass. The only issue is I have a small head so they are really big on me.

title: Earbuds with charging case
review: These ear buds has great bass a and they are loud came with a charge box and already charged. They fit perfectly in my ears and no problem with pairing them. These are most certainly the best earbuds I have

title: Uncomfortable to wear for a long period of time
review: The color I got was purple came with three ear pieces for sizing. The earbuds was uncomfortable to have in ears for a long period of time. Sound was not very loud. I had my phone volume on high and it didn't seem loud.

title: Not bad
review: We go through lots of headphones in this household, so I am constantly buying them. I do not like to spend an arm and a leg on them because they are always getting broken or lost (kids). That said, these are great for that. These are decent for the price. And I won't be upset when these get lost or broken.

title: They work for me
review: These are great little earbuds. They absolutely work for my needs 100%. plug and play! Couldn't be more simple to use. Sound quality is on par with the price. Great for running or when I'm at the gym!

title: Really cool
review: So first, I am not someone who wants to spend an arm and a leg on ear buds, so for me, these are perfect. That being said, I do own Bose headphones, and also the new Jabras. For my needs these work perfectly. The connected super easily, easy to control. They look great, and once I put the smallest little ear molds in the fit fine. I am a smaller sized person, so I'm sure the others are probably standard, but it comes with three sizes, so everyone should be good. My music sounded good, was clear, no skips. They charged very quickly. Not sure how long the battery lasts, but with the time it takes to charge it shouldn't be an issue. At least not for me. All in all, these are a great pair of earbuds!

title: 5 stars
review: Just got to use the on the plane. The noise canceling feature works very nicely. The music sounds crystal clear. It was super easy to connect to my phone and my Alexa. Alexa also works well. I love the take it off and the music pauses feature. The case is really ncie. They were very comfortable on the plane. They are very sleek and nicely made. I also have the Bose equivalent and these are just as good but with some better features.
