I want to like the T1. But having to spend a couple of minutes fiddling with the ear pads practically every time I want to use it and having it constantly fall out of my ear makes it not particularly useful. I can't recommend it unless you are satisfied with the over-the-ear option.

title: Lightweight,foldable and great sound
review: Needed headphones for a plane ride over the holidays. These worked great for our little guy. They are light weight and folded up easily for transporting. My son has a larger head and wears glasses so they did tend to not stay up as well, but not really the headphones 🎧 fault just something to note for others. Great sound quality especially for the price .

title: Nice Sound, Comfortable and My Daughter Likes Them!
review:
According to my daughter, age 10, the headphones are comfortable and sound great. I tried them and thought they sounded good.

My kids are always listing to their headphones full blast regardless of the occasion so I am excited to see that she likes them so much.

title: Like New!
review: I had a competing brand of noise cancelling headphones with deteriorating ear pads. Replacement pads were hard to find and cost five times the price of these. When I bought the Bose I researched replacement pads first. So glad I did because these seem to be as good as the OEM and at a reasonable price. Easy to install. Good directions. I didn't even need the included tool.

title: Good Quality
review: Bought this for an iPod and Audio Technica noise cancelling headphones. I have a Monster cable. Monster is too expensive. Problem is the jack in the headphone is small, not the jack, the hole the jack is through. The Monster cable has a very small diameter plug and fits. This cable is a little too big. Since the headphones are long out of warranty, I took a metal drill and enlarged the hole by a fraction. Now this cable fits fine. Quality seems on par with Monster for a fraction of the cost.

title: Pretty good solution for ps3
review: I've been looking for a good wireless headset solution for the ps3 for a few years, and didn't like any of the ones that used a base station (some were nice, just really expensive).  When sonly came out with an officially supported headset that actually did in game sound and chat instead of the crappy bt earpiece i had been using, i jumped on it.  The sound quality and range are good, battery life is ok, wish it was a little longer.  Not bad for the money for a factory type solution.

title: Great earbuds
review: I'm pretty picky about headphones, and really liked the first version of the cx300's until i cut the cord by accident.  I had heard some mixed reviews on the mkIIs but gave them a shot.  Excellent bass response and very natural sounding, would definitely buy again.  The cables are a little thin but fairly tough.

title: these are by far the best to date
review: I have owned the X1, X2 and now the Freedom F5's, these are by far the best to date! The new sound app is heaven sent!! I have been looking for a work around for the crappy EQ built into mobile devices and this is it!! I can also wear these under my motorcycle helmet!! I have never heard a better set of wireless headphones and I have tried many.

title: I have had these for more than a month now and they just keep getting better!! I use them with a portable and ...
review: Sensational headphones !!! I have had these for more than a month now and they just keep getting better!! I use them with a portable and desktop Fiio amp but you can run these on their own. You may want the amp if you like high punchy sound though. The level of detail these cans bring out in music and film is unreal. I have a pair of Audio Technica M50X and Etymotic ER4s and these are on the same level of detail I get from the 4s and a health dose of the bass found in the 50s. What these offer that the 50s and 4s dont is sound stage. These provide a very wide and at times captivating sound stage. The retro look is very appealing to me although some may not like it and I found that adding a set of colored ear cups from Ear Zonks really sets them off (I got red). I do not experience any of the wear fatigue from either the ear pads or head band that you read about from time to time. I did give them a little stretch when I used the for the first time. I have used these through 2 hour film and music sessions. Grado I will be a customer for life and will tell and give your headphones to family and friends!! I cant even imagine what a pair of your upper end headphones sound like !! [[ASIN:B00L1LXOWS Grado Prestige Series SR80e Headphones]]

title: It opens up the sound and brings out the fine detail while adding a good deal of power to ...
review: This DAC is a steal for this price. It opens up the sound and brings out the fine detail while adding a good deal of power to the audio. Drives my Audio Technica 50x and Grado sr80e's just fine with plenty of volume to spare. It is smaller than I expected which makes it easy to pack and take with you on the go. It offers so many options for so many different types of connections and setup. I am really pushing my tech friends to get one while they are still around. Love this DAC Fiio, love it so much that I have another one of your products on the way, the Montblanc amp!!! can't [[ASIN:B00LP3AMC2 FiiO E10K USB DAC and Headphone Amplifier (Black)]]wait!! Oh and just as a forewarning, this does not transform badly recorded music into great sounding music, if you start with crap then you hear loud crap, just a warning for those new to this sort of device.

title: These cushions fit perfectly and look fantastic. They really add nice character to my new ...
review:
[[ASIN:B00BW5U3HM Ear Zonk - Replacement Grado Headphone S Cushion - Fits Grado 60i, 60e, 80i, 80e, 125i, 125e & More - Pair in Red]]
These cushions fit perfectly and look fantastic. They really add nice character to my new favorite headphones Grado sr80e. I have been using them for over a month now and I do not find them scratchy or uncomfortable. I suppose some with sensitive skin may feel them irritating but I have gone more than an hour without any discomfort. I am just surprised out how much better these headphones look with a little color. I get compliments and questions about them often. I am thinking about getting an extra couple of pairs in case these ever stop selling. Thanks Ear Zonk!!

title: Great at isolating noise and comfortable, seem to break down quickly
review: I tend to carry these in my pocket (attached to my headphones of course) and they seem to break down after a couple of weeks. They start to come a part, so watch out for that. They are very comfortable and do a good job of knocking out background noise.

title: If you have to wear headphones for work, try these.
review:
I moved from the Plantronics to the Sennheiser and so far, it's been a win for me. The primary difference between the Plantronics and the Sennheiser is the lack of the weak link on the cord. Where the cord plugs into the dongle went intermittent on two Plantronics headsets.

The Sennheiser avoids this by eliminating the cord. The headset can connect via BT to the phone and via a USB dongle in my laptop to the computer. This eliminates the weak point but means the headset is not charging while in use. That problem is basically eliminated by the super super super fast charging on the stand. I can plug the headset into the stand for 15 or 20 minutes and get a full day's use out of it.

I'm pretty much not finding anything concerning about the Sennheiser. You do have to pop off a piece of the earphone on the mic side to perform updates but that's not really a problem. Also, I'm a bit clumsy and getting the headset over the stand can be challenging to people like me that refuse to use two hands. Neither of these are concerning.

title: Am I Doing It Wrong?
review:
Generally it seems like a good mount. It is holding my ASUS Predator. The problem I'm having is with the tilt. Too loose and it tilts down by itself. Too tight and I can't adjust it any longer. I can't find the sweetspot.

I like how it brings mic/headphones/USB to the base. That's convenient.It seems to be built very sturdy. Just wish I could get the tilt fixed.

title: Perfect for these Classic Headphones
review: I've had my headphones for ages and was amazed stock replacement earpads were available. Easy to install and restored the comfort and looks of the headphones.

title: Am I Doing Something Wrong? I Want to Like It.
review: Maybe I'm not getting it. I thought if I took off the headset it would disconnect from the phone (Nexus 6P) but it just hangs up. If I try to make a call on the phone without the headphones on the phone audio goes to the headset. When I receive a call, the phone rings and I hit answer. Nobody there. They are talking in my headset.

title: I'm always pretty impressed by AmazonBasics stuff
review: I'm always pretty impressed by AmazonBasics stuff. Besides these cables which don't feel cheap I've bought earphones, USB cables and a few other things. Always packed well, quality feeling and trouble free. AmazonBasics is becoming my go-to brand.

title: Good Earphones w/Mic - Good for Android
review: Cheap, functional and seemingly well made. They sound as good as some of the $30-$50 earphones I've listened to. I use it with my Android phone  (Galaxy S5) for calls. The mic seems to work well as I don't get any complaints from people I talk to. I also use them to listen to audible.com audio books on the phone and the voices come through clear even in noisier environments. They are inexpensive but don't feel or sound cheap.

title: Works For Me... and on, and on, and ...
review:
Update: 3/2018
These headphones are still going strong as hell and they've been through hell. I bought them in 2012, probably replaced the rubber ear pieces a few times but that's it. Never any cord problems, no music that over tasks them, still exciting to listen to. The only problem is, after 6 years, I'm not sure what's out there that I might be missing. I have a feeling these headphones will last and sound good as long as I'm still kicking.

I mentioned in my original comments I had a set of Shure and UE headphones. They're gone. No idea where. I think the Shures were lost and the UEs got eaten be the dog? Still got the Sonys.

Original comments:
I'm not sure how to review earphones. I buy nice headphones because I've convinced myself that I can hear music better - crisper maybe - than cheapies I'd buy in department stores. I own these along with Shure 535 (older versions) and and UE Triple-Fi. All three seem to be in the same sound class as far as my ears can tell. My favorites are the Shure for their fit but for sound I couldn't say one was better than the other. Sound-wise, I'd be happy with any of the three earbuds.

title: Best
review: I have both the UltimateEars and the Shure earphones. Both sound pretty close to the same but the sleeves for the Shure are far superior (as far as comfort) than anything made for UE. I wear these for hours on end, even falling asleep with them, and never feel any discomfort.

title: Perfect for me
review: I have a set of SE-530's and UE TripleFI 10's. Sound-wise, I can't tell the difference. I love them both. But the stock foam tips for the 530 are much more comfortable than the "Comply" tips I use with the UE earphones. For a stock tip, I couldn't ask for more.

title: OK - But Not Great
review: I use these with UE TripleFI 10. They are working fine but I'm a bit disappointed with how quickly they split open and become unusable. For comparison, I also have a set of Shure SE-530's and the stock foam tips are much more comfortable and longer lasting. Sound-wise, I can't tell the difference between the Shure and UE earphones. They both sound fantastic regardless of the tips used.

title: Very Pleased
review:
I wanted to treat myself to a great set of earphones. I use them at work, home and on the motorcycle (I know, don't say it). At any rate after a couple of weeks I think these earphones are wonderful. I was using the Etymotics before but they were getting old and worn out. These 530s seem to be better-built than the Etymotics. I really can't tell a major difference in sound quality - other than the typical "fooling myself." But they are beautifully clear.

If you really want to treat yourself and spend your income tax refund, give these a try and you will enjoy it.

Update: I am still very pleased with the sound of these earphones on the motorcycle. It is a real pleasure listening to Nickleback clearly with a Harley 88ci engine rumbling and all the wind (no windshield). However, I ran into a small problem that I see others have reported. The rubber pieces at the earphone end of the cable that appear to keep strain off the cable have separated and there seems to be no way to reattach them. I'm now worried that the wires will eventually pull away and that will be the end of the 530s. I wish they had lasted a little longer before starting to show wear. Based on the quality of the sound in harsh conditions and how well they fit under a helmet, I think I'll probably buy another pair when these are gone.

title: Noise Cancellation is worse than the original pads
review:
These are obviously made from lower quality materials than the Bose earpads, which I can live with as long as they function the same. The vinyl's not as soft, the foam is stiffer yet somehow more porous, and the stripes on the lining are printed on with some kind of coating rather than a silk screen. I can forgive all of that.

The deal-breaker for me is that the ANC is definitely worse with these on. At first I thought it was because they were new, so maybe the foam needed some time to compress and form a better seal. After about 5 weeks of using them 8+ hours / day I didn't notice any improvement, so I put the stock pads back on. The stock pads were noticeably better despite being old and worn out. I work around loud servers all day, so I don't really have time for subpar noise cancellation, especially for a device where that is the primary selling point.

If you care about getting the best ANC out of your expensive ANC headphones then don't waste your money on these.

title: Perfect solution to using a PS4 Slim with a computer monitor
review:
Since the PS4 Slim only has HDMI with no dedicated audio outputs, hooking it up to a computer monitor with no built-in speakers meant that the only way I was able to listen to audio was through headphones plugged into the controller. With this device, I can still use my computer monitor and also route audio from the PS4's HDMI output to my amp and speakers.

The only drawbacks I see so far are the way-too-bright red LED on the input side, which I've blocked off with electrical tape, and the way the inputs and outputs are oriented so that there's no "clean"-looking side where you don't see every wire. Doesn't bother me too much, but if you're serious about cable management you'll probably want to mount this device somewhere out of sight.

Output seems a little quiet, but I have no way to verify that that's not just the PS4 itself. All in all, very happy with this device as long as it lasts.

title: the price was so good I could't say no
review:
Purchased these as part of a flash sale, the price was so good I could't say no.
First impressions (I've only had these for two days) are a mixed bag.

The positives: inexpensive, they look like quality in ear monitors, the case might is nice but wish it were smaller. Perfect length cable, earbuds in phone in pocket. Mic seems to the highlight as far as audio quality goes, I've only made a few call since receiving these yesterday but nobody has complained about not being able to hear me. Three sizes of silicone cups, the small and large don't fit the monitor poles very well.

The negatives: They are HEAVY, I cant imagine wearing these on a run. The rubberized cable sheathing is sticky so rather than slide along your clothing they want to grab, and my phone reacts to the cable touching the display. The music sound quality is lacking in every category, bass, mids, treble, sound-stage, dynamics. They sound veiled, tinny and distant. Do they sound worse than the average plastic phillips, sony or panasonics I use for working out till I either lose or destroy them, yes they sound worse. I wasn't expecting them to compete with either my gaming cans or my Grado musical as all get out headphones.

Good for phone calls sitting at my desk, not so good for music on the run.

title: Very glad I purchased these!
review:
I am so happy that I had these headphones on a recent international trip. I was completely stunned at how well they work. After shoving them in my carry-on and now my laptop bag (back and forth to the office) I can report they are in perfect shape. I think you would have to work hard to break them - if you are relatively kind to your electronics, don't be scared off by other reviews that say they break easily...

With the downturn in the economy - Bose wasn't an option. For a tenth of the price - I am glad I bought these!

title: Five Stars
review: Great headphones, High quality sound, but cheap enough to replace if you lose them. Which I did.

title: Comfortable and Secure with Great Sound
review:
The SHS8000 headphones are by far the most comfortable I've worn. The flexible earpieces fit perfectly and do a decent job of blocking out ambient noise. They aren't noise-cancelling but they reduced the airplane noise to a point that I didn't notice it with the volume at a low level.

The flexible hook keeps these headphones very securely in your ear and the sound is excellent. After wearing these through a five hour flight I was completely blown away by how comfortable they really are. With stock iPod headphones my ears hurt after a couple hours... five hours into wearing these they still felt perfectly comfortable.

title: They look nice and paired easy.
review: I got the Aventree Audition Pro aptX LOW LATENCY headphones today. They paired easy peasy with both the iPod and Macbook. No issues. One of the selling points for me had to do with the materials. These have metal incorporated into the part that connects to speakers into the headband. I've noticed most of the headbands on other headphones are all plastic which after  a while break. That's what happened to a pair of LG headphones I had for six months and noticed since then very few still available. I've also seen several other reviewers complaining of the same problem with other brands.The pair of JBL headphones I bought to replace the LG headphones would not pair and went back to the store. I've reviewed both of those products on this webpage. Hopefully I don't have to revisit this review later to remove any of the four stars.

title: They won't pair.
review: Well here we go again. I had a pair of over ear bluetooth headphones by LG that lasted maybe six months before the plastic head band snapped in half. I repaired it twice before it broke a third time and threw them away. Other than that they worked quite well. So I started to look around for another pair. I found these at the Big Box store three days ago on sale. Turns out they weren't really on sale. The asking price here is the same as I payed. Hmmm. Anyway I got them to pair with my iPod just fine. I spent another 30 minutes trying to pair them with my Macbook to no avail. It just says pairing rejected. I should have read the reviews here first.

title: Bad Bluetooth
review:
I have 2 stars because they feel nice in my ears and the sound is good for the price. They lost 3 because it is constantly disconnecting and reconnecting to my Bluetooth, especially while eating or doing something active. My other Bluetooth headphones have never done this, so I know it isn’t my phone.

The microphone is also garbage and my Dad couldn’t make out what I was saying. Switched to my other Bluetooth and he was said “oh good, I can hear you again.”

Not sure if I have a defective pair, but will be sending them back.

title: Two stars because I don't like it.
review: These headphones are fantastic when they work, but unfortunately the right earbud has fried out a little. It is playing a noticeable lower volume than the left one and I have had them not even two months ago. Unfortunate because they sound great. I am going to contact the company and see if they will replace them. I'll update if they do or not, currently it is pending.

title: Yep, looks like the genuine article
review: I've had the same HD 600 set for over a decade and I'm on my fifth or sixth cable to date. If you want the "forget I'm wearing headphones" comfort the HD 580/600/650 are famous for, you need a relatively soft jacket. By no means is this cable flimsy. If you sit in a chair and listen to music, this cable would probably last forever. But if you dance around like an idiot and snag the cable on things, you're only going to get a couple or three years out of the cable. In the grand scheme of things, that's pretty excellent for the price. If you want studio grade ruggedness you're better off building your own cable out of Canare Starquad. But be warned, the microphonics of Starquad are not minimal.

title: You get what you pay for
review:
If you're on the fence as to whether you should spend $70 replacing the old cushions on your Sennheiser headphones, do it. Comfort aside, your ears are not in the proper position in relation to the drivers if your cushions are all worn out.

This is official replacement cushion for the most comfortable headphones I've ever owned (HD 600). Very soft velour fabric, firm but not too firm.

There are aftermarket replacement ear cushions for half the price but by all reports the velour is not as soft as the original and they don't snap in as firmly. The aftermarket headband cushions are okay as you'll never feel the cheaper fabric if you have hair. But I wouldn't cheap out on the ear cushions.

It does not come in the full retail packaging with the cardboard card as pictured, just a plastic bag with the Sennheiser sticker on it. The part number and UPC conform with the official Sennheiser part. Less waste to dispose of is a plus.

title: Disappointing Sound & Volume
review: These JLab Epic Air Sport earbuds fit well and would stay secured on/in my ears whereas clipless earbuds simply don't for me. I was excited to try these since they had many positive reviews, but the instant I tried them on I was really disappointed. The sound was "tinny" with almost no bass. I downloaded the app and tried using the equalizer settings as one of them is "bass boost" but this barely helped. Maybe my expectations were too high, but these really did not sound good at all. The noise reduction seemed to work quite well considering this was just an earbud and not an over the ear set of headphones. My other issue is even at the highest volume, they were not loud at all. I'm not looking for ear splitting volume, but if I'm going to wear these on an indoor stationary bike or running I'll want more volume than they can give.

title: Probably the best bargin in headphones.
review: These headphones are great for exercising with as they stay put and they sound great. I've found the ear clips start to break off after around 6 months of regular use, but at this price who cares, I just buy a couple more pairs. Considering they'll get sweaty if you use them during workouts it's not a bad idea to change them out anyway. The sound though is amazing for the money.

title: I was expecting the installation to be more difficult
review: My OEM ear pads had deteriorated to the point where my ears were full of black specks after wearing 'em.  I read a couple guides on how to install replacement ear pads and ordered these with some trepidation that it'd take a frustrating hour to cajole them onto the headphones.  However, after prying the old ones off, these simply snapped into place without much hassle at all.  The only thing I'm disappointed about is that I didn't order them months before!

title: They fit, and I can keep using my headphones.
review: Took a while to arrive, but they fit on the headphones and breathe new life into an older set of cans.

title: Decent headphones for IEM systems
review: They're cheap, they sound decent, and they don't make me stand out when I'm on stage!  I use them with a Rolls headphone amp on our worship team, and they've been pretty good for me.  Lots cheaper than the lowest-tier custom IEMs by a far cry.  I use the three dome inserts and it blocks practically all the stage noise.  It's kinda easy to overdrive them, so keep the volume low enough to not distort.  This is actually a pretty good idea anyway, to preserve your hearing!

title: SUPER comfy & cool pad for my Sennheiser headphones - I'm NO pilot.
review: I absolutely LOVE this sheepskin headpad. It is SUPER comfy and cool at the same time. I have a pair of Sennheiser headphones that I needed propped up just ONE INCH above my head so they would engage with a pair of Oticon aids (mic unit sits behind my ear). Without this extra cushion, the headphones would actually cover the aids, blocking all sound. I realize that this headpad is mainly for pilots who wear headsets, but I can vouch that pair of headphones ALSO hurt the head if worn for a period of time. My headphones have a 1.75" wide band and to my delight, this David Clark Sheepskin Headpad stretches perfect to fit over that width - no excess fabric tension or worry that the straps will tear off. The pad is only about 6" long by 3" wide to give you a better idea of its coverage. It's so soft and comfy that I bet I could sleep with these on my headphones. Probably a good thing I'm NO pilot if I wear these.

title: Writing a review in hopes that the company will stop pestering me about it.
review: I bought this item, and now the company is spamming me until I write a review, so here's my review. The headphones are just OK. They feel flimsy, but they do pair with my phone. They drain my phone's batteries quite a bit.

title: 5 STARS
review:
Left earbud stopped working after a month and completely ruins the music listening experience.

UPDATED

Anker contacted me after this review and sent me a new one free of charge, this the kind of customer service that keeps me coming back and purchasing their products.

title: Love it!
review: I'm a huge pc gamer and for the longest time I've used "Gaming Headsets" which all have broken. So when I buddy of mine told me to get these I wasn't really sure. So far I've owned them for about a year and they're still working great and have outlasted any other headset I've owned. The sound quality and pretty great, especially when watching a movie or playing games.

title: Very Poor Quality and Fit
review: I tried these headphones out after doing a decent amount of research. I was concerned that the fit wouldn't be great because there weren't any ear loops. Well, the fit ended up being the least of the problems. The fit was OK (not great by any means) but the quality was poor. I used them for about two weeks and the malfunctions started in the first week of use. I use them for running so they get a lot of sweat exposure. The malfunctions included powering down and dialing the phone on its own, losing connection with my iphone, and not powering up. The sound was fine. I might have just got a bad set but I returned them and opted for the JLab Epic2. I've worn those for two weeks of running and completed a half marathon in them without any hitches. I wouldn't recommend the Jaybird X2 but would encourage anyone looking for wireless sport earbuds to try the Epic2.

title: ... these for a couple of weeks now and absolutely love them. I've been using them mainly for running ...
review: I've had these for a couple of weeks now and absolutely love them. I've been using them mainly for running and just used them in a half marathon, stayed secure the entire time. I haven't had any connectivity issues and they have taken all the sweat and weather abuse I could throw at them. This would be enough to earn a 5 star rating. I have to add that the sound is great as well. I think the balance is good through the entire spectrum. The one downside I can think of is the phone part isn't that great, but I don't really care about that. When I'm slogging a 10 mile training run at 5:30 AM I really don't get that many calls or really want to talk to anyone. If you want durable bluetooth earbuds that fit and sound great, I would recommend you give these a try. (As a side note, I tried the Jaybird X2 first and they started malfunctioning within the first week. I think they might have been possessed).

title: Great Headset
review: I absolutely love this headset. The sound is great and the fit is comfortable. I like the switching feature that allows me to  go between my land line and cell phone with just the press of a button. I don't use it with my computer so I can't comment on that function. The setup is very easy. I have always had good luck with Plantronics and this headset is no exception. I would highly recommend this headset.

title: Great Headphones
review: I bought these as a replacement for my old Sennheiser headphones, the orange ones with the wrap around ear loop. I've had the old ones so long, about four or five years, I don't remember the model. I use my headphones mainly for running, four to five times a week, so I want a secure fit and the CX685 fits the bill. The are very easy to adjust and come with a variety of rubber buds so you can customize the fit to your ear.  For me, the sound performance is secondary but these blew me away, a very balanced, rich sound profile which is what I like. I've also used them on airplanes to listen to my music iPod or watch a movie on my iPad and they sound great. Granted, they don't have the sound of the B&W P5 or the PSB M4U 1, but those are $300 full over-the-ear headphones. These are great sport headphones that I'm sure won't disappoint. I highly recommend them.

title: Doesn't stay plugged in
review: The male end does not seat with a firm click. I'm not sure if the post isn't long enough or what, but it always feels like it's going to fall out. Similarly with the female end, when I attach my iPhone headphones, they don't make firm contact and fall out easily.

title: Almost great
review: Great idea, but the magnets are too weak to tightly bind cables. They'll work to loosely hold say, earbud cables. Plus, they're pretty fiddley to attach.

title: Hurt My Ears
review: The color is more dark purple than the picture represents. My main problem is that they hurt my ears while wearing them. The pro is that the cord is longer than most earphones.

title: Great rich sound! Excellent bass response
review:
I had* the Shure E3C headphones for many years and loved them. I have lost them in my own house and couldn't justify spending anywhere near $200+ for a replacement. I took a gamble and bought these headphones; they just arrived moments ago!

They came with a variety replaceable ear-tips. I installed the dual-stage pair for comfort and noise isolation and they fit great. Then, I hooked them up to my phone and started up the music. Immediately, I was satisfied with the sound. The bass is very "rich" and there is no distortion whatsoever! They are SLIGHTLY (and I really mean 'slightly') lacking on the high frequency end. It's nothing that a simple adjustment of the equalizer couldn't fix (if you're device has one).

For the price, this is a perfect alternative to the expensive Shure earbuds.

*Hopefully I find them!!

title: Not for Apple's Air Pro
review: Connect reasonably well to my Bose headphones, but to Apple's Air Pro is almost mission impossible. Beware.

title: Very Good Product
review: I have had these headphones  for a week and i have to agree with all the other positive reviews!  They have a good range of distance reception on my Razr Maxx and they sound very good.  Seems to be an outstanding product!!

title: Excellent value
review:
I bought these to replace the headphones that come with the iPod, after the iPod headphones started crackling in one ear. I chose these for two reasons: First, [...] gave them a good review--in fact, the best review of any in-ear headphones under $80. Second, because the Amazon user reviews were more positive than for headphones in the same price range recommended by [...].

These headphones are comfortable. The sound is excellent--I'm hearing things I'd never heard before in songs I've been familiar with since the 1970s. And the cord is just the right length: I have a long torso, but I can still comfortably keep my iPod in my front pants pocket while walking and using these headphones.

title: not for running with a Droid
review:
I give three stars because I think the product would probably work well for some applications, but for my application (running while streaming music through a Droid phone) it gets one star.

The receiver is behind the head, which seems like a nice way to keep it out of the way. But if the Bluetooth device is in front of me, as it would be if I'm running and holding it, or if it is clipped to my waistband or in a pocket, the connection is choppy. A choppy connection is essentially useless for music streaming. I'm returning the product. I may get something else later, but for now I'll continue using my iPod headphones.

title: ... every day for about a year and they are good. The sound is superior to standard headphones but ...
review: I have been using these headphones almost every day for about a year and they are good. The sound is superior to standard headphones but that comes with a price.

title: High hope, shattered expectations
review: Does not cancel ambient noise to a degree that is useful or noticable. Spend the extra money and get something better, the noise cancelation button just acts as power for the speakers in the headphones.....very disappointed. I will be returning this product.

title: Excellent quality, but you pay for it
review: Typical high quality Bose performance. I bought these for my daughter; I've had similar Bose headphones for 4 years with high performance and durability. Love them. Expensive, but in my opinion, worth it.

title: I can finally run with my AirPods
review: Let's be honest, it's hard to find headphones that are nicer than the AirPods. They do just about everything perfectly. The only thing I didn't like about them was they kept falling out of my ears when I went to work out. These fixed that problem! I took them out for a few miles and even though I was dripping sweat, they never even came loose. They stay in my ear even better than when I'm sitting at my desk and not moving. I'd highly recommend these!

title: Glad I bought them
review: These have good sound for such little things. I bought them because I was tired of having crappy headphones that broke all the time. These ones are still going strong. I love the color too.

title: Good product
review: Sound quality is good.  It fell out occasionally, but I guess it is not the earphones' fault.

title: Poorly thought out.
review: These are the most annoying things ever. They sound fine (a little quiet), they are great to wear, and their charging case is good... But every time you need to take one earphone out because someone is talking to you, it just stops playing music, and there doesn't seem to be a way to disable this on the app. It's really frustrating to have to use them in public, which is of course the only time I actually need to use earphones. Given all the positive reviews I'm really baffled as to why this doesn't seem to annoy everyone else, maybe I'm just difficult 🤷‍♂️

title: This works, it was easy for me to connect to devices, and the price is fair
review:
I read instructions, ordered the recommended charging base for the included charging cord to the headset... it was easy testing on my iPhone and iPad
And after I was satisfied with the testing results, I gave this set to my grandson to use on his new fire 8, the kids version. Headphones are Easy to connect

Side note
The headphones do try to connect first to the last device it was connected to. (As they should).
Side note
Perfect ear size to completely cover the grandson’s ear, not so much mine.

title: Never could pair this
review: I tried many things, and could never get this to successfully pair with any of my cell phones. I should have returned it when I had the chance. Maybe it's defective. I have another Motorola headset and know how to pair that one; this one does not respond to the same steps. Useless waste of money.

title: Absolutely fantastic
review: It's hard to say enough good things about the E10. Audio quality is fantastic for the price and compares favorably to DAC/amp units that cost twice as much. I pulled my Auzentech Prelude out of my pc and disposed of the large desktop headphone amp I'd been using as soon as I heard the output from the E10.

title: Great sound for the price $
review:
1. Very light and very comfortable 👍
2. Sound quality is just great 👍
3. Working BT wireless and wire as well 👍
4. Not recommend for noise canceling, but
5. Recommend for sound enthusiasts 👍 (wire it)
6. Looks nice but the materials are not high top and it will not reliable for a long time, but
7. This is one of the best headphones around $30! 💰

As headphone enthusiastist, I've owned very expensive high class headphones & earphones, this headphone has way over valued good sound quality for the price for sure! Good choice 👌

title: Like the originals
review: Perfect replacement for Klipsch earbuds. Feels just like the original. Just wish there were different color options.

title: and they stay on my ears well without making them super sore, but my main issues are that they ...
review: I've used these for several months now, so I'm prepared to provide an honest review. I bought them for exercise (running), and they stay on my ears well without making them super sore, but my main issues are that they are pretty quiet (I have to turn my volume nearly all the way up to get a good level), and the over-ear thing just isn't for me. It means that you can't swap left and right if you're in a hurry, and they get tangled really easily. I won't be buying over-ear headphones like these again.

title: Great headphones for the price
review: Great headphones for the price. No technical issues encountered with these at all, the only reason we replace them is because my husband and I are a pair of klutz and run them over occasionally with our chairs.

title: All around awesome!
review: I received these for free from a Samsung promotion for buying a Galaxy S6 phone. Pretty sure they were supposed to send me the wired ones instead, but they sent the wireless ones! We all get a little lucky sometimes :) Anyways, I wasn't really excited about receiving them at first, but these things are AWESOME!! I was skeptical.. I've owned a few pairs of studio quality headphones (Sennheiser's) but obviously don't want to be lugging those things everywhere I go. The noise cancelling feature is very good and the sound quality is amazing for the price. They are very comfortable, and the touch functions on the right earphone are very convenient. Also, selecting the SoundAlive+ option truly adds a great surround sound feel. I haven't even downloaded the app yet.. looking forward to playing around with it.

title: I just really like this unit
review: Can't really improve on the other reviews. I just really like this unit, it sounds great. I'm not impressed with it's  headphone amp though.

title: Works great and affordable!
review: I’ve only used this once but so far, so good. It charged up quickly and functions like you’d expect. I’ll probably buy another one for my other set of headphones.

title: good sound but earpieces break rapidly
review: The sound of mc5 is solid, especially for the price point. They work quite well for noise isolation. Unfortunately, I have only had these five months and already two of the earbud tips have broken (the two most effective for noise isolation). These come with 4 different types of tips so I can still use the headphones, but if I want to use my preferred tips I have to order new ones  for $12 since they're not covered by warranty. I have not used these for exercise or other high impact activities, I simply use them at work. I would not purchase these again. This gets three stars for the sound quality

title: AMAZING headphones (see what I did there?)
review: Okay, I know you're probably skeptical because the price is almost too good to be true, right? Try these on and I promise you, any doubts you may have will disappear. They dampen a fair amount of background noise (like traffic, fans, sounds of boyfriend's netflix from the other room) but they're not noise cancelling. As soon as you start playing music or watching a movie or listening to a book on tape, they might as well be noise cancelling. The bass is excellent. The treble is good. There's no tinniness to them that you can sometimes hear in other headphones. They're seriously freaking excellent headphones for ridiculously cheap. Buy them. You will get much more than your money's worth. Also -- I've had these for awhile now. More than a few months. I don't remember my exact purchase date but they get A LOT of use and I've had 0 problems. Last note -- if you wear glasses, these do put a bit of pressure on the stem just behind the ear. They're comfortable enough where I don't notice I'm wearing headphones for the first half-hour or so of use but if I wear them for much longer than that (even when I take 10-15 minute breaks throughout the hour or two that I have them on), this pressure does start to hurt. This may depend on the glasses you have (and your ability to tune annoyances out) but I felt it worth mentioning.

title: I received a USED backback
review: I did not receive a new LOVEVOOK like I was supposed to. 🤥 I know that it is used because someone had left their chapstick and wired earbuds in one of the pockets. 😡 I am not happy. Not to mention it is DIRTY, FILTHY!! I WANT A NEW NEW ONE. NOT A USED ONE!

title: Good for the price
review: For the price they are good! The only thing is when working out they fall off easier than I would like. But for $20 these headphones are good

title: Great sounding earbuds but not very comfortable to wear
review: The only thing I do like about these buds is the sound quality. Without getting into all the worn-out adjectives that try to describe the listening experience I will only say that these sound as good as the best premium earbuds I have used. Unfortunately, I don't like how these fit in the ear. After a half hour these hurt. This is just me, so you may not have that problem.  I further don't like that the case is not wirelessly chargeable. If your hands are not supremely steady you will often have more taps on the bud than you intended which often send your music to the next track or back and is very annoying. I don't understand the use of a fabric covering of the case. This make the case difficult to slip into a pocket and harder to keep clean. I can see where fabric would be an advantage if you carry the case in a purse.  In my opinion, Jabra and Bose make better alternatives to these earbuds.

title: I'm happy with mine
review: This works fine with my headphones to give some volume control. I like it a lot but the control wheel is so very tiny and hard to find at times. Not a major thing, but annoying. Also the legends printed on the case are nearly invisible. Seems well made and has a litte clip on the back which can be useful. I recommend this if you want a nice simple volume control that works.

title: It works as advertised.
review: This works just as it is claimed to do. I can now connect my headphones to an optical Dolby/DTS source without having to set the source to PCM. There is a low backgound hum during quiet passages that is the only annoyance.

title: Wonderful sound quality UPGRADES.
review: This is my second purchase of these headphones . The first ones lasted 2 years.  The quality has improved.

title: Pretty Good Wireless Headphones.
review: These are really good replacement headphones to my skull candy wireless headphones. The sound quality is good, the battery life is excellent and the noise cancellation is acceptable.

title: Good for casual use
review: Been using it for a week, they feel like regular ear buds. No real noise isolation, but if you're focused on the music, you're blocking out the background noise anyway. The earpieces fit well for the most part. I gave an indifferent rating for build because I intend on updating this review after prolonged use, since I use earbuds every day on the train rides, etc.

title: Sennheiser has yet to disappoint!
review: Like the majority of the reviews here, I am in favor of these earphones. Amazon's price is a bargain, even for the older models. The company makes quality earphones, and it is definitely doing it's job. Noise-cancellation works, the cord is perfect length, everything is quite durable, and comfortable as well. I am an everyman and I will keep this review short - the earbuds work great and it's recommended to those who want to try sennheisers before getting the newer brands, but I am saying not many will be disappointed for everyday use that is well above average.

title: It is worth it's price.
review:
I specifically got the bluetooth headset for multiple functions - such as pairing it with my phone and with my ps3. Based on my experience with it so far, it works fine and has not lost connection with my phone. It is fuzzy at times, so I don't know how effective the wind protection is. However, Battery life seems to be potent - it charges fairly fast and it's standby time is fairly accurate. I accidentally left it on for a couple of days and it's still running when I use it to answer my phone call. And it has not asked me to input the security code when pairing.

As long as it works as effectively with my ps3, it is definitely worth the Amazon price, not to mention that it comes with it's original packaging for a fraction of the "OEM package" price! Amazon is a great site to hit up.

title: great while it worked
review:
maybe it was just me, but i see myself as a guy who takes care of his belongings. while i used the skullcandys, they were great. noise cancelling was very efficient. but after a few months the cord was getting worn and my left earbud was flickering. about a month later, both were inefficient and near obselete since i'm not going to spend my time playing with the cord.

so, i guess take great care of the earbuds and cord; they aren't the most durable.

title: Waste of money; does not last.
review: I will NEVER EVER buy a Bose product again. Their earphones are overpriced and not durable. I take good care of my stuff. Yet, the first set got frayed just out of warranty. Bose did replace it for free. However, within a few months, that set got frayed in three places. This time, Bose insisted that I pay about $50 and did not include a case. This third set developed splits (in the left cord) in ELEVEN places AND where the cord joins the right side. Total waste of money, even though the sound is good.

title: Excellent
review: Love the headphones. Love the color (I got the purple) Sound quality is great. <3 <3 <3

title: Loved the first gen so much, i bought the 2nd gen as a gift to replace them
review: These just work.  They charge easily (moreso than the first gen), they play forever, and they stay tight and don't die no matter how much you sweat, get rained on, etc.  And they're lighter and easier than carrying your phone, especially in the summer when you don't have a jacket pocket to put them in (naturally I'm talking about running, since when you're cycling, it's no big deal to put your phone in a jersey pocket).  I've had these for several years now, and they play like they're brand new.  Definitely worth the purchase.  Take it from someone who killed numerous pairs of standard headphones

title: Awesome!
review:
The headphones work exceptionally well, sound quality is great, and they stay put. Haven't had any battery issues. I've mainly been using them for running and working on roofs, so I haven't the foggiest idea how they work underwater.

I'm adding more. It's been 2 months, and the right headphone has decreased significantly in volume. Everything works, but you can see how this would be disappointing and annoying. I will be contacting Sony about their warranty and hopefully replacing them.

title: Works great. Fits in my purse or the console of ...
review: Works great.  Fits in my purse or the console of my car.  I broke my last headset, so this has been a lifesaver!

title: Terrible pairing function..
review: Average sound quality, the pairing function is terrible, if you have more that one device pairing with the headphones ...You have many problems to pair each time that you want to change beetwin them...

title: Super cute and stylish backpack
review: Super cute and stylish backpack! I'm in high school, don't have a locker, and have to carry around all of my books all day and this works great! I love that it has the laptop pocket so I don't need a case for my computer, and it has the velcro pocket on the inside that I hold my gum and headphones in. The pocket in the front is great for shoving a jacket inside, and it's super deep and spacious. I love this backpack, and I can't wait to use it throughout the rest of high school!

title: Great sound that won't break the bank.
review: I was looking for an inexpensive pair of earphones but didn't want to sacrifice sound quality.  I could not be more pleased with this pair.  I didn't break the bank and the quality is as good as some of the much higher priced pairs.  You can't go wrong.  The cord on this pair seems of higher quality also.

title: Very nice.
review: I have hearing issues and was having a hard time finding a headset that worked for me. These work great. The sound comes through loud and clear. Happy I found them.

title: Great headphones for the money.
review: Comfortable, good sound.  Limited in range, seems alot of mid range sound is a little cloudy.  BUT, as stated in the title, great headphones for the money.

title: NOT Impressed.
review: a $99 Netflix box is what it boils down to.  Good for streaming some movies from your USB device or card as well, but thats about as far as it goes.  The headphone feature on the remote cuts out ALOT, with all apps.  Does NOT have HBO Go for xfinity customers.  Buy an XBOX for the same price.  You get more streaming options and the apps are better.  Many "channels" did not have any content, cost money, or were just plain garbage.  Does not have Youtube either, which is ironic b/c most of those garbage channels reminded me of youtube videos.  Bottom line:  Don't waste your money unless you REALLY want a Netflix/Hulu/Amazon streaming option, but thats about all you're going to get.

title: Maturely styled, amazing sound!
review: Enjoying these very much. Excellent sound quality for the price and as an adult, it is nice to wear headphones with style too!!  The boring black that so many others seem to call style make these all the more pleasant a purchase.

title: Was a good, basic cord though
review: We ordered this thinking my son needed it for a pair of headphones for the PS4.  He didn't and we ended up re selling.  Was a good, basic cord though.

title: Perfect for my daughter
review: My wife and I really like the volume control so our daughters hearing won’t get damaged. Also our daughter really liked the little cat ears that came with the headphones.

title: Great quality
review: These earphones were selected by my granddaughter. She had to have them. They turned out to be a great gift. She loves them! She tells me they have a good listening quality. She uses them for her online studies. They have become part of her backpack must haves. They were a good price. If she likes them, I like them.

title: Good price
review: I bought these earbuds for my iPad. They work well. Didn’t need anything very expensive. They do what I need them to do. I like the different size adjusters for a more comfortable fit. Not bad at all. Good price.

title: Good Headphones Great Price.
review:
“I received this product in exchange for an unbiased review. All of my opinions are my own and 100% the truth. “

For the price of these headphones I was really impressed. The head phones sound great. The Mids are a little weak but over all they are great. They do not over power you with too much bass like a lot of head phones try to do. I think the balance of the treble and bass is great.

These head phones are lightweight and fit great. Some head phones I have used in the past hurt my ears over time but these are light and do not press so hard on my ears.

I did not test the microphone any so I can not tell you about that. But my friend did and said the microphone was weak but not bad considering the price of the head set. But he did love how long the microphone is, that is the first headset that the microphone was actually in the middle of his mouth where people could hear him.

Bottom line for head phones they are great, they sound good and will not hurt your ears after using them for an hour or longer. The cord is long enough it will reach wherever you need it to reach. According to my friend the microphone is not the best but I do not care about that. I would recommend these to anyone. I gave 4 stars because I would rather have this set without the microphone or at least a detachable mic.

title: the headband looks like it has a lot of padding but it was ...
review: My son always had to adjust to these... the headband looks like it has a lot of padding but it was uncomfortable on his head so he had to adjust by adding extra padding. The earcups were not the most comfortable but he adjusted and got used to them. The wireless function was great and the charge lasts a long time but half of the time I would see him with them plugged in just because he was too lazing to charge them so having them be wireless wasn't really worth the investment. He liked the sound thingy that changes his voice. The USB plug came apart from its shell when he tried to remove it from his computer once. He was able to tape it to stay together but for the price of these, that shouldn't be something anyone should need to do. The one ear came out of it's socket and dangled but he adjusted by ducktaping it. But after 2 years, sound only came out of one ear, the other earcup dangles, it looked a hot mess. I couldn't take looking at them anymore and got him another headset recently, which he loves. These are not worth the price I paid.

title: New level crap
review: I bought for my sons school headphones. They are the worst quality sound out there 😊 like super bad

title: Great product.
review:
Good looking
Holds headphones securely.
Nice addition to the home system.

title: Great phones for the price point.
review:
For the price these are great headphones,a little heavy on the bass,but for inexpensive head phones they work really well
and are reasonably comfortable,the packaging was excellent,plenty of useable phone cords and 2 adjustable phone tips.
Worthy of consideration.,

title: Works well and sounds good.
review: This was a gift. Although I don't have direct knowledge of the product, the recipient (who had two different sets of Bluetooth earphones) was happy with all features/quality. They have small ear canals and this still fit for them.

title: Poor quality
review:
The headphones stopped working after a month, conveniently right outside of Amazon's return window. The headphones are now stuck on low volume and the volume keys no longer work, and there are also connectivity issues. I was happy with the headphones while they worked - the sound quality was good and they stayed in place while running.

UPDATE (8/7/2016): The company graciously send me a replacement pair of headphones and repeatedly asked me to update my review. Well, after a little over a month, the second pair of headphones is now suffering the exact same issues. It seems like there's a design defect. Also, given after how many times the company asked me to update my review after giving me a free replacement set, I assume that they've done the same to others as well. I would trust the reviews of this product at your own risk.

title: Overrated
review:
Sound Quality: I'm going to keep my review of this aspect fairly broad, since I am admittedly not an expert in this subject. However, I will say that the sound did not "blow me away."

Noise Reduction: Again, nothing special.

Bluetooth: Bluetooth may be useful for things like music; however, whenever I tried to use Bluetooth for a video file, the latency was significantly notable. For example, when playing FPS games I would hear a gunshot noticeably after the screen showed the gun being fired. I'm not sure whether this is a problem with the headphones themselves, or with Bluetooth technology in general (I think that current Bluetooth implementations have a latency of around 100ms. Bluetooth 4.0, which is being released 1st quarter 2012 apparently, is going to have a latency of around 6 ms but with the tradeoff of a significantly lower data-rate. I don't know whether 4.0 will be used in headphones, but it's just something to keep in mind.)

Design: I liked the design. The headphones felt durable.

Additional note: I ended up returning the headphones. I purchased these for $330, and I will probably purchase a pair from another manufacturer in the near future.

title: Unfortunate design flaw
review: This is my umpteenth pair of Sony headphones. I rely on Sony for sound quality, durability, reliability and value in my business and personal connections.  This pair was an exception, perhaps a design or production  flaw? In less than a month, main wire frazzled and headphones no longer work at all. Major disappointment.  Warranty expired, so total loss. Sony/ Manufacturer, will you replace at no cost?

title: Compact size, big sound
review: I'm using this Bluetooth receiver with a traditional set of wired earbuds for napping and sleeping. Unlike most people who want big volume, I'm interested in low volume so whatever I'm listening to doesn't prevent me from falling asleep. I've tested the volume at both ends -- very low and very high -- and the receiver delivers great sound and good bass. The on/off/start/stop button is easily accessible; the volume control is a little trickier but I figured it out. This device delivers great value for the price.

title: Love the earloops, very good sound
review: I’ve probably purchased eight pairs of these earphones over the last 10 years. I like falling asleep to music but I don’t like having Bluetooth in my head for hours. These earbuds stay in my ears, and lie flat against my head so I can sleep. The soft plastic of the ear loop keeps them comfortable. I use them when I’m awake too, which is how I know the sound is terrific.

title: Disappointing sound quality, wouldn't stay put
review: I really wanted to like these earbuds. I have a Jabra Speak 710 conference device that I absolutely love (rock-solid), and I hoped for the same with these earbuds. I am aware that not all earbuds fit all ears, no matter what you do; these just wouldn't stay in my head. My husband has gone through dozens of earbuds trying to find the right fit, so I don't fault Jabra on that point. But I was disappointed with the sound quality overall -- it seemed tinny to my ears. I'm a classically trained musician, but I wasn't expecting to listen to music with these earbuds, just hoping they'd work well for my daily-dozen videoconference calls. People couldn't hear me and the sound just wasn't that great. Like most things, it's better to pay more and stop wasting time on lower-cost versions. I returned these for a refund.

title: Great for being able to listen to 2 audio sources with one headset
review: I work in a cubicle environment, and wanted to be able to hear my computer audio along with the music from my iPhone with just one set of headphones. So I bought this cable, plugged one end into each device, and plugged my headphones into the jack. It's perfect! I would agree that this would not be suitable for attempting to combine audio sources for recording, but for this everyday purpose, this odd little Y-cable was *exactly* what I needed.

title: Great Volume Control Product
review: High quality earbuds with built in volume and stereo control  Excellent product. Quality sound.

title: Great.
review: I'm a working musician and I see why these headphones have been so highly touted and unchanged for decades. Big thanks to the manufacturer for not price gouging. Are they the absolute best? Probably not. Are they much better than the majority of people would ever notice or even need? Very likely, yes.

title: Great value!
review: I'm no audiophile...But, these headphones are amazing for the price.  Great sound quality-great price.  Comfortable( and I have a pretty big head).  They are not noise cancelling.  Would definitely buy again.

title: Equinox 600/800 compatible
review: I bought these to use with Minelab Equinox 600. They are low latency headphones. They pair easily with the detector. I like the cordless aspect as I was almost cutting the cord on my headphones every trip. The tones are crisp and clear.....as good as headphones that came with the detector. They are light and comfortable. I could use a little more pressure as when digging a target they fall out of place occasionally.

title: There is no better headset in this price range
review: There is no better headset in this price range. The sound is  good...ie excellent clarity. The mic picks up well. Most impressive to me is the fact that Sigtronics will stand behind this product for years to come  supplying great service and parts.  I have one pair that I have had for nearly 20 years and now have a second set for guests.

title: work great!
review: These headphones have excellent sound quality and last quite a long time on a single charge. The only problem is that the provided instructions are incomplete in English and the diagrams are difficult to decipher.  Ended up going online to find instructions so then was able to set it all up correctly and working. got them synced up to the iPhone just fine. The bottom line is that these are really nice headphones and work great!

title: at last - earbuds that hubby does not hate!
review:
Finally some earbuds that hubby likes! He is pretty picky so when I gave him these I was worried he'd immediately say "thanks, but no." Instead he has now used them during his workouts for the past several weeks and they are working well for him! he likes the various options for fitting them into his ears. I think this is his biggest issue with earbuds. The sound is really good - he uses these with an ipod shuffle. He's used to using the buttons no his shuffle so the buttons on the cord is not really used much.

I'm impressed that it has held up to his sweating during workouts (another issue that he has had with other earbuds). Also the little cloth pouch to store all the extra parts is handy.

title: Easy to connect, versatile ear piece attachments, quality sound
review:
This is my third set of Jabra headphones. This seems very similar to the other one, but with the added one-touch button to activate Siri and the inclusion of the earhook accessory.

The set itself connected right away to my iphone - no problem whatsoever with that. And the many options for size and shape of the ear piece attachments allowed me to find the perfect fit. I use these when running or using cardio machines so being water resistant is a huge plus. My first pair died from the sweat that got into them - clearly not a water resistant, but it definitely taught me that any headphones I use will need to be water resistant for sure!

The buttons are pretty much same as the previous version I have, so controls are handy and easy to work with.

The sound quality is also really good, though I'm not a perfectionist when it comes to audio sound - I just want it to sound good enough so I can keep my rhythm during my workouts.

Overall, while I've only used these for a few workouts now, I'm impressed and these have quickly become my go to headset for workouts.

title: Good for calls, music not so much
review:
I am comparing these to Tozo T6.
Pros:
-Call quality is so much better than T6. Probably because of the location of the mic.
-The controls are pretty much the same as T6 & easy to access.
-Fit Is decent...right earbud kind of hurt my ear. Could be my ear could be the bud. I can't get T6 to stay in my ears for any significant length of time.

Cons:
-No beep or sound when you hang up a call so I always have to look and see if the call ended.
-Music quality in my opinion is poor. Between T6 and T9, T6 has noticeably superior sound.

It's not bad for a pair of inexpensive earbuds. They go on sale often for under $30. I am debating whether to return them or not since the call quality is so good. But the music quality just isn't doing it for me. That's the trade off.

title: Amazing sound-fit not so great
review:
I wanted something wireless after losing my wired headphones and not wanting to pay for OEM products. I've stayed away from Bluetooth because the sound is usually trash, however the sound of these little buds are impressive. The fit is not.

Pros:
-Great sound
-Inexpensive
-small/lightweight
-decent battery life
-alot of ear pieces to choose from
-good Bluetooth connection range

Cons
-can't get them to stay in my ears
-high touch sensitivity, any brush against them can pause music
-can't increase /decrease volume on a call - it ends the call

My biggest issue is that they won't stay in my ear. I've tried all the included ear pieces. The sound is good though so I will keep them.

title: Stopped working today.
review: These headphones have a decent sound, but the microphone is not great. Every time I was using it, the person on the other line heard everything else going on around me but not my voice. Bought these on April 22 and they just stopped working today, July 22. So I got exactly 3 months of use out of them. Not very durable.

title: Ok while they last
review: As the name suggests, these headphones give alot of bass. That may not be for everyone, but I personally like to emphasize the bass in my music and these sound decent. However, these headphones really don't last that long. It only took about a month or so before there was a noticeable volume difference in each earbud, and then no sound in one at all. This happened with two pairs I have had in the past. I don't even know why anyone would pay so much for them, I only bought them because they were on sale for about $15 a while back. That's all they're worth, if that. What good is the sound if you can only enjoy it for a month?

title: Great sound but...
review: These have surprisingly good sound and clarity, but they don't fit in my ears. The foam earbuds feel nice, but they don't stay in my ears easily because they're too big.

title: Perfect for capturing your chat audio in your Twitch stream.
review:
You would be surprised how hard it is to find these kind of splitters.

When you have an iPad/iPhone and want to do a shared call but don't want to use speaker phone it could be an option.... but that's not why I got this.

I use the Astro A40s for gaming and I needed a way to pull the chat audio out of the Mixamp and add it to my Twitch livestream.

There are a few problems here that need to be addressed when trying this.

1. When you split out of the Mixamp you need to be sure all pins on the plug are being used. (That means you need to be sure that you plug a splitter to separate the headphone and mic on the one that you plug into your line on on the streaming computer)
2. You may find yourself turning up the volume a bit to compensate for the loss in power from splitting. (not much though)
3. The splitter I got is pretty tight and you need to press the cable *FIRMLY* into the splitter.

title: like the southwest of the US
review: I am in Chicago, which can be hot and humid.  Every summer, the glue in these things would melt and the pair would break.  I gave it two shots, but it happens every year.  Do not buy if you are in anywhere but a dry part, like the southwest of the US.  Very disappointed, headphones should last maybe more than just 6 months.

title: Just a bad product. Left earbud stopped working after less than ...
review: Just a bad product.  Left earbud stopped working after less than a week.  Quick, hassle free return, though.

title: Volume issues
review: Although I have a compatible Samsung phone, the volume on both headphones hardly even work.

title: Great At What They Do --But Not What I Expected
review:
Nothing on the Amazon Vine listing indicated that these headphones were specifically designed for use with a phone. My assumption (oops!) was that since it came with a cord that it could also be used on my laptop and desktop with equally good sound quality. Unfortunately this is not the case -- and that should have been mentioned in the description. Using it on my desktop provided a muddy and distorted sound, easily surpassed by any of the other 10 pairs of headphones I have. Even my desktop speakers provide a superior listening experience.

Looking at the Amazon product page now it is still difficult to find any information stating that it is not for use with those two devices. I will say though that they are VERY comfortable, easily adjustable for fit, and I like the 'desert' color which differentiates it from the typical black headphone. The fit itself is conducive to noise cancelling even without the electronic gizmos. More comfortable than my Bose unit and just as good as providing clear sound quality. Good product for the price point.

title: Surprisingly Good Product For Such A Reasonable Price
review:
Being genetically predisposed to hearing loss has required me to start using hearing aids, amplified telephones, and TV headphones. Since the telephones and headphones both require rechargeable AAA batteries, I had to look for a reasonably priced charger and batteries that I could rely on.

This EBL unit and batteries are just what I needed. An interesting bonus is that the charger also powers up AA batteries. Simple design, versatile, well-built, and easy to use.

title: Look And Sound Nice -- Probably Worth Twice The Price
review:
I ordered earbuds from three different manufacturers to compare them for quality, style, ease of use, and of course sound quality. These came in at $19.99 while the most expensive pair were $49.00 and the other one tested came in at $25.99. All three of them were offered to me in exchange for an honest and unbiased review.

These were by far the best -- and just happened to be offered at the best price. They look well-made, have great sound and excellent fit, and match the colors of my Giant road bike. No cords to tangle and get in your way, light weight, and they stay firmly in my ears. Extra buds and ear hooks are provided to customize your fit. A surprisingly good product for a very reasonable price.

title: Plug and Play
review: great product if your older PC doesnt have bluetooth connectivity, i just plugged this in and automatically started working, now i can use my bose wireless headphones to listen to music and movies.

title: Great Device
review: We liked these headphones so much that we bought two more this Christmas for our other girls. The only disappointment we have is that they no longer come with a nice black drawstring case. That was a nice plus.

title: a steal, decent sound
review: I needed inexpensive earphones - these fit the bill but didn't disappoint in sound quality.  Deep bass and crisp highs at a great price - worth a try, and great for a second set for traveling.  thanx

title: Awesome Sound & Pretty Good Fit
review:
I bought these on sale and took a chance after reading some reviews on them. They really sound great for their size. My main headphones are a set of Grado SR-60 which sound amazing but these sound very close.

The headband is adjustable. The fit is good if you use the band over your head. The behind the head use seems to not fit too comfortably for me and when I put it on that way the bad ripped a hair out of my head.

I use these with my 40GB Fourth Generation iPod. They have a lifetime warranty and I use my headphones for working out and go through a new pair every 6 months. Save your receipt!

They can sound a little bassy but I like that in a work out headphone especially since iPods really lack good bass. Excellent for almost any kind of music except classical.

title: great buy quality headphones
review:
best headphones I've ever bought, would buy again
update:
After using the headphones on and off for a few months I noticed the sound would quit on the left or right ear phone depending on which way I turn my head, there seems to be a loose wire on the head phone side attachment. I have contacted the seller but as of yet have not recieved any replies, down grading to 3 stars

title: Great headphones -  do NOT buy from Amazon Warehouse
review:
The headphone are great. The battery is best in its class, beating its competitors by a large margin. they are quite comfortable and it comes with a few end pieces and "wing" tips. The noise reduction, while not "active" is decent and does something. A great feature is the allowance and controls to allow you to hear outside noises without taking them off using the ambient control settings (using microphones on the outside of the headphone to feed in outside sounds to ear, when desired).
THE ISSUE however, is with Amazon Warehouse "like new", i have had to repeatedly reorder and return as there have been major issues, and clearly was NOT tested prior to it being shipped (contrary to a sticker on each box claiming otherwise). e.g. one set of headphone would not pair at all, another set, the right bud did not hold a charge.

title: IMPECCABLE SOUND!!
review:
Usually you have to break them in playing music 5 hrs each day until they reach their optimum level. (yes you can do this without listening for 5 hrs lol) But it's not even that long yet. I just received them today and they sound fantastic! You rather turn them upside down to avoid them from falling out then tuck the wire behind your ears. It is also good to do so for that great noise isolating sound. Just you and your music! AHHHHHHHHHHHHH....

PROS: 3 extra ear buds provided! Register your product for a 1 year warranty online!

CON: earbuds not as silicony and thick as Skull Candy buds.They are rather thin.

Not bad for the price!

title: Possibly a defect
review:
The headphones fit well, as advertised.
However using a bass test (youtube) i determined there is ZERO BASS coming out. Even my cheaper headphones have some degree of bass output.
I suspect there MAYYYY be a defeçt in my individual product.
I will rewrite the review if the problem is resolved.

title: nice headphone
review: Bought this for myself at christmas.  They have become my new favorites.  I have many pair of headphones because I am into music.  These are soft and comfortable - built to last with no exposed wires or parts that will break or short out.  I sleep with them on and when the family gets to noisy I turn on the noise cancelling which does a ok job tuning them out.  Most days I listen with noise canceling on because it does not improve sound of headphones in my opinion.  The buttons that make the Soul logo light up is the biggest treat of them all.

title: Great for those who need to switch between headphones/speakers at ...
review: Great for those who need to switch between headphones/speakers at the desk! Be sure to not have the volume knob at max, as it will produce some noise.

title: Five Stars
review: incredibly comfortable earbuds. battery life is great too. Nice compliment to my QC35's.

title: Perfectly fine
review:
I left my Galaxy Buds home during a 10 day trip so bought these via Prime as a fallback. They work perfectly fine and for the money are excellent. Sound is very good. (Not sure how I sound to other people.).

The worst thing (trivial) about them is that there are magnets holding the earbuds into the case and nothing good to grip when removing them, which can make you work a bit to get them out of the case. A trivial issue, but mildly irritating.

Very happy that I bought these.

title: These are good earphones. I compared them to my best Sony
review: These are good earphones. I compared them to my best Sony, the ones I had found to be the best for several years, and these sounded just as good. Some users say they don't fit, but I think they fit just fine. Also, I like the longer cord.

title: Best value on earth, but I miss the wingtip things
review: These are awesome. How could anyone complain for this price? This is the best earbuds value on earth. I do miss the wingtip things that I had in my old BeatsX though. They stayed in my ears better.

title: Great for the price.
review: Great sounding however my only complaint is the wires are a little sticky. They seem to cling to everything. Also I dropped one earbud into coffee (don't ask) and that side doesn't work. Not coffee proof

title: Great Headphones
review: These headphones are great. The bass is much more prominent then I expected. Sound quality is Great. I typically listen to Rap/R&B/Reggaeton and the occasional rock song. The sound is very crisp and the headphones are very loud. Taking the train bus everyday usually gets in the way of listening to music. However, the earbud do a great job of isolating the outside noise. The only problem I have with these headphones is the price. I bought my girl friend the V-moda Bass Freq headphones and those are just as great featuring a big punch for a small price. The Vibe headphones dont sound too much different from the bass freq model but audiophiles can tell the difference. Overall, Great buy if your willing to spend the money.

title: Worth more than you pay: an audiophile review
review:
I am not easily impressed by headphones. I have used everything from Beats to Bose, Shure, to custom molded headphones. Some of my headphones easily cost 20 times if not more than what I paid for these sound buds. I wasn't really expecting much from these. Truth be told, I only bought them because I wanted headphones I can make phone calls with. They have a mic, check, buy.

PROS:
I gave them a listen and wow. These sound good, very good, too good for their price. Bass is present, but not overpowering and the highs and mids are clean with minimal distortion.

They're also easy to pair (I've been switching these from my iPhone to Macbook pro with ease). Calls are clear and no one I've talked to has reported any issues with hearing me.

The magnets are a nice touch allowing me to keep them around my neck without worrying about them falling off.

CONS:
Cons are pretty minor: The eartips that come with them are thin and flimsy. They seal, but I wished they sealed better. They do distort some at max volume, but again, for what you pay for these, you'll be asking yourself why you didn't buy these earlier

title: Great range, great for voice, not so good for VOIP
review:
I'm a fan of plantronics and have been using their products for some time, but I'm not a big fan of the Savi 740.

My office has about 20 of these and everyone reports the same issue: VOIP is iffy.
