title: SanDisk Sansa c250 - Digital player / radio - flash 2 GB - WMA, MP3 - pink
review: Great price on a 2GB MP3.(under $25) Easy to use, sort and play songs by artist, album or title and there's always the random feature. I mostly just transfer music from my cd's off my microsoft media player. Second one purchased. First one was a present for my daughter, I loved it as much as, or more than her. Was told to get my own. Has FM radio, nice lil perk. Battery life is very good. I hooked it up to some old pc speakers and put them in my kitchen, works well as a stereo without taking up counter space. Also have used it in my car on long trips where the radio becomes a nuisance trying to find stations. Honestly it is even great as a personal device, might want to get new headphones, the buds are a bit large and somewhat uncomfortable but great sound. You won't be disappointed.

title: Just what I needed
review: The first time I tried it out of water, and it sounded great, then I tried one of the earbuds but when I was swimming my laps the sound kept going on and off on either side. I got worried that I'd have to return it right away. Then I went back home totally frustrated and tried all the earbuds in the different sizes. I finally found ones that seemed to fit the best and ever since then it's been perfect and no more sound going on and off. I also like how the ear buds stay on the posts tightly and don't come off in my ear canals.

title: Snug fit for small ears
review: These earbuds have a remarkably long battery life compared to others that I have owned. The feature that’s most important to me is the way they fit. These are the first earbuds that fit snugly in my tiny ears. They are secure and comfortable.

title: So nice I'm buying it twice
review: I have had this particular headset for nearly a year and love it. I find that having only one ear-bud allows me to hear the environment around me, and it works best for me. The plug fits well into the phone and the ear bud is comfortable and doesn't make me itch or need to constantly adjust.  Buying this because I lost my original on my recent business trip. Well worth the cost.

title: Shuts off when you sweat!
review: These headphones work great if you don’t workout, but as soon as you start sweating, they just stop working and go into a “safe mode”. Basically, they shut off for a certain amount of time and then will come back to life about 10-15 minutes later. I bought these for the Chicago Marathon, and I was so depressed when they stopped working around mile 6. So I was without headphones for the 20 miles I had left. They came back to life about 10 times during my run, only to turn back off within minutes. Frustrating!!! Save your money and get some that are truly sweat resistant.

title: AUSDOM Over the ear headphones with noise cancellation and built-in mike (lime green).
review:
It came early & quickly, as a Christmas gift for grandson who is in Gifted Program at school. He loved it! And we loved the quiet. All went well (noise cancelling too) until one of the earpieces came off, while the other's still intact. The problem is ... once detached, it becomes difficult to find. It has an earphone capability, which was a plus for him to keep in touch with friends while playing games together. I ordered another one for his younger brother, separately, and thought both were insured. The younger brother's was insured, but this one got inadvertently overlooked! Yet he's the one using it more and it should have been the one insured! I usually do both together and insure together! Now it is impossible to use with only 1 earpiece. Can one earpiece be ordered? If another is replaced, PLEASE INSURE. I will pay for insurance and change rating. Thank you.
UPDATED REVIEW:
Since reviewing the above, I found the item was insured. Thus, wanted to update on my end. Amazon has been great in getting it resolved! Another one is being shipped today. Thanks also to Square Trade for their help. (It's always a good idea to insure with them, for a small fee.)

title: Great Buy for the Money!
review: Used for second pair of headphones to listen together on movies. Length is perfect. Would have given 5 stars, but haven't used yet. Thanks, Amazon!

title: I love it.
review: For the price, it works better than the previous Plantronics 220. I like knowing that I can turn up the headset volume alone, and it tells me when it's on and connected. Advises that battery is highly charged, and let's me know when I've gotten out of range that it's "disconnected." It's like a reminder to me if I've left my cell phone anywhere.

title: Music
review: For the price, these are great earbuds! It paired with my Apple Watch with no problem. I really like the case too! Great for carrying the buds in my bag.

title: Great for a week
review: I really like them at first it would’ve given them a five. But they broke in one week the wire snapped right off one of the earplugs. I am in the construction business so I’m hard on them but I would think they should be made a little bit more durable for that situation. I’ve used many other earbuds that have lasted a lot longer. Actually I don’t think of ever had any of them rip through the wire like that

title: OH I LOVE THIS!!!!!
review: Those earbuds stuck in my ears have driven me crazy for years!  Heard about bone conduction headsets and thought, well, here's the ticket!  Ordered a set -- different manufacturer -- was better than buds in my ears, but the sound quality left a lot to be desired.  While being visited by my daughter during one of my many hospital stays, I noticed she had a set of bone conduction headphones on, and I asked how she like them..  She loved them.  "May I try them", I asked.  "Of course, Mama!"  Try them I did, oh was she lucky to get them back!  These were the AfterShokz!  Once home, I rushed to my laptop and ordered a set for myself, now I'm rarely without them, and I have to say, they are so comfortable, great sound quality, allow for background so you're not completely isolated from those trying to get your attention!  (Okay, some may prefer the totally soundproof stick in your ear style, but no one can sneak up on you with these and scare the bejesus out of you!)  Only five stars?  Hey, double that, please!

title: Decent product
review: Works fine for my husband but we had to get a different set of wireless headphones in order for it to function. Fast shipping.

title: Don't expect these to last long. Use The 1 Year Warranty!
review:
These were great and cute, but I expect at least a year of use out of even cheap headphones. They lasted 4 months before one ear stopped working.

Edit: Customer service replied to my review via email and provided a no-cost warranty replacement. Excellent service!

title: Bad connection and horrible range.
review: Started out working fine, I sit pretty close to the TV so never noticed the range till a month or two after I bought it. About five feet away from the PS4 it will not connect and even when I stay close to the PS4 it will randomly drop connection and refuses to reconnect unless you unplug the USB and turn off the headset. The mic will not work 60% of the time. I've had issues with Turtle Beach in the past but usually earphone issues, sound quality is great but that doesn't help when it disconnects me.

title: Nice headphones!
review: Very good set of headphones! I'm very pleased with my purchase. Was able to get some beats headphones discounted and the headphones look practically new! The pick color is cute! Everything was packed it originally packed. Nice sound too. Even though these are the older version of the Studio headphones, it was still a good purchase for the price; the headphones are very sturdy. Some of the guys I know want to take these headphones lol! The shipping was fast as well! These were an early Christmas present for myself and I'm happy about my purchase!

title: Clear Sound, eliminates distraction noises around you.
review: I am well pleased with the entire experience with this Headset. One thing I am not happy about. There is no mute button on the mic and I use it frequently. I'd like to be able to shut the mic off when I'm just listening on my phone, but the buttons apply only when connected via USB port..

title: Crazy battery life!!!
review:
I use earbuds all day and into the evening. These are on from 6am to 9 or 10pm. I listen to audiobooks for hours, take work calls, and watch videos.
I have yet to drain the battery. I haven't charged them for 12 days and I'm still at 40 percent battery life.
Sound is great for audiobooks and videos, but if you're looking for amazing sound with music you'll be a bit disappointed.
If battery life is your priority then these will exceed all expectations!!!

title: Not good.
review: I am disappointed. The ear discs move around so very much, I am constantly adjusting. I find it annoying. The speaker quality/audio sound is not good either. All in all for 22 dollars, honestly the really inexpensive ones work better than these. I wouldn't recommend, only if you were desperate for sleep headphones like me. In the meantime I am using but still searching for a flat head wrap with flat speakers.

title: Works very well
review: Works very well with both phones my husband has to carry. One personal and one for work. This headset means he only has to commit one ear instead of both. Works great!!

title: Great Product
review: Lightweight and easy to adjust headphones to fit exactly where my ears are. Very comfortable; barely able to feel the speakers when lying on my side. Good sound quality. Husband says he cannot hear anything -- I was worried about sound bleeding through, but this is not the case.  My only complaint is that the fabric makes my head warm, but that is only a very minor issue. I heartily recommend these headphones.

title: Perfect Fit
review: These fit my jam headphones perfectly. They were easy to put on and feel very comfortable.

title: Great Bluetooth Headset!
review:
I've had this headset for several months and it has performed very well. It's comfortable to wear and it works as advertised. I would recommend this to family and friends.
'

title: Easy to use
review: These earbuds are great at cancelling outside noise and last a long time. The tips were too large at first, but a variety of tip sizes are provided with these earbuds making it easy to find a comfortable tip.

title: Worked as well as stuffing cotton in my ears.
review: I tried everything told by customer service but never got any sound out of the earbuds sent to me. They paired but no sound and the toch controls didn't work. Bluetooth and media apps showed them connected, volume was on high, but couldn't get any sound.

title: My favorite
review: I have really sensitive ears and spent a long time trying to find good, comfortable tips that don't cost a fortune. The tips that came with my Jaybird headphones were nice, but the replacements were pretty expensive. These are a great substitute. They're super comfortable and conform to my ears really well, and also do a great job reducing noise.

title: Work fine, connect fine, uncomfortable and too loud for me
review: The sound quality was fine, and the actual ear parts are comfortable for side sleeping. But the control panel hurt my forehead and I found them too loud at the lowest volume. I also really didn’t like the very loud voice that says “power on” or “power off” in the earphones. I wanted them for sleep, so much too loud for me. But maybe great for exercising.

title: Too much static
review:
I kept getting a lot of static in my ear.
For some reason when I had these plugged in my phone and watching something, it would freeze what I was watching and I had to exit and go back in. Tried a different earbud did not have that problem

title: Works as advertised.
review: Tried similar Y cables to replace crimped originals for XBox One headphones. They failed to work. Bought these. They worked. Case closed.

title: Game over, man.
review: I'll keep this brief. Tried two of these cables on two separate XBox One headphones. Neither worked. But they sure do look neat. End of review.

title: perfect for the mp3 player it was made for
review: A nice hard protective case for the player it was made for.  Room for headphones also.

title: I love that I can hook it onto my purse to ...
review: This holds my earbuds perfectly.  I love that I can hook it onto my purse to find them quickly.

title: Sturdy case, does what it should.
review: I lost the bag that came with my PortaPro headphones at a busy convention and replaced it with another, similar bag.  However, I felt that a bag was probably not the best storage solution for me. This little box/pod/thing keeps them safe and protected without taking up any more space than the bag did.  They fit in perfectly and the cord stays coiled neatly under them, a big improvement from the bag. I keep my headphones in a large tote bag/purse with many other things I haul around with me and they always find their way to the bottom. I don't have to worry about them at all as this case is firm enough to keep its shape under the stress of all my junk jostling it around. It's been beating around in there for two months and it looks brand new.

title: I verified I have stereo without it fine.
review: I only get sound in one ear on each of the headphones I attach to this splitter.  I verified I have stereo without it fine.

title: I really like my gear fit
review:
I really like my gear fit. I love that I can get notifications so if my phone is in another room I can read the notification and decide if I really need to get my phone to reply. I really like being able to control my music with the gear fit especially when I am working out. I have blue tooth earbuds and with the fit I don't have carry my phone all around the gym. Could the fit part be better - yes. That said most of the fitness trackers have some kind of issue.

Other reviewers have stated they lost their fit because it came undone and they didn't realize it. Samsung could have made the clasp much better especially for the price. My solution to that concern was to go to Walmart and buy the tiny rubber bands that are in the hair care isle and wrap it around the band twice. I move it up when I take the fit off and then back down past the clasp when I put it on. Easy fix for .98 cents. And it works today mine came partially undone and the rubber band kept it on my wrist.

title: Extremely good value (sound and color choices) for the money
review: These headphones are great!  The sound quality is excellent, the microphone works well,  love the "fabric" wired cord and I'm happy that I can indulge my sense of whimsy with the color choices.  The only flaw for these headphones are the ear cushions aren't very comfortable. I wish they had just a tad more foam padding. Hence the four star rating rather than 5. Definitely recommend.

title: A happy surprise!
review: Given the price point, I wasn't expecting much from these earbuds.  They are a replacement for a more expensive pair that shorted out.  What a wonderful surprise the LUDOS turn out to be!  Great sound, wonderful balance, good noise cancellation and great price.  I will definitely buy another pair as a spare!

title: I think i finally found my perfect earbuds
review: I have tried any number of earbuds and been dissatisfied. Either uncomfortable, muddy sound or too flimsy. This set has checked all the boxes for me!  Really good sound, comfortable to wear and durable.  My only complaint and this is entirely my fault, I thought I had ordered a different color. Guess not! SMH. Nevertheless, I really like this product!

title: Not bad....
review: Pros: Quality sound and they look good.  Cons: uncomfortable and they don't feel properly "seated" even with the smaller earbud.

title: Happy purchase!
review:
Very happy with these earbuds. I really like the fact that they remain over my ears. Great sound. I also want to commend them on their prompt customer service. I had a problem with one of the replacement tips. Very quick to respond and resolve the issue.

Pleased with both the product and customer service.

title: Glad I invested in these earbuds/phones.
review: Love, love this in-ear headphones!  great sound, good balance and bass. Even more importantly for me -- they remain in my ears!!!! YES!!!!

title: Worth Every Penny!
review:
I have tried about 15 different types of headphones and wasted so much money on cheaper ones ($50 pairs). I am known to game for 12 hours at a time and was desperate to find some comfortable and convenient headphones. I wish I'd just spent the money on these in the first place because they are everything I wanted and more.

I'm not super knowledgeable or picky when it comes to sound, but these do sound amazing, like true surround sound. Most importantly they are SUPER comfortable even when worn for hours. They don't hurt my ears and the cord isn't easily tangled because it's covered in material/braided cord. I LOVE that the mic mutes when I lift the mic and I love that the volume control is on the ear piece instead of the cord (which is part of why it doesn't tangle). The mic is perfect for my uses (online/coop gaming and Youtube gaming videos).

Thus far I have no cons, not even the price. These were worth every penny I spent!

title: Looked like it would be good. Had good reviews but...
review:
I am a deeply critical listener and I can find something wrong with almost everything that makes a noise. Aside from a lack of soundstage and imagery, my favorite headphones to date are the Sennheiser HD600. My favorite home speakers are the Definitive Technology BP8060. My favorite BT speaker which is far from being all that great is the Doss Soundbox XL. I don't recommend the G-"Boom" nor the Anker BT speakers, they are abysmal.

Ironically and laughably monikered as the "G-BOOM", I found the system to have nearly zero BOOM, unless they meant BOOMY. The low end bass is not even present. The upper bass is boomy and sounds terrible - like most Bose but worse, even. The music is full of annoying frequency peaks and dips, making most songs have a signature sound, which is cheesy and cheap. I found myself hating this speaker quicker than most speakers. It lasted about 3 songs and then I had to return it before I could get any rest.

Terrible sound, decently built. Overall score: worthless.

title: Great headphones
review:
Headphones sound great with every type of music. The bass is ample but not as strong as the Audio Technica M50X, but the treble is mostly clean with a slight shimmer, the only complaint I have. What I mean is the treble is not completely as smooth as it should be, there seems to be a shimmer or break in the instruments. For $55-$65, these come close to perfection IMO and rival the AT M50X. These are for pure music lovers and not for people who like added bass. These are the most comfortable headphones I own.

I didn't like the Status CB-1.

title: Not a bad earbud
review:
I bought these in a 5 pack on eBay for $10. Sound quality is pretty good but not a whole lot of bass but it is a decent full-range sound. The midrange is a bit thin as to be expected for the price. The highs a little clangy and ringy. The mic seems to work well. The accessories that come with it was a nice touch. The colors are bold. The overall quality appears standard, probably around a 16 guage wire, thicker than some out there. The fitment is outstanding: I like the piece that fits the earbuds snuggly into the ear. These don't drop out of the ear at all.

Only problem why I rate only 4 is the sound isn't breathtaking but definitely listenable and not fatiguing. After 2 hours my ears were starting to feel a little sore. Value is 5 stars if they last any time at all.

title: Great sound clarity
review: Zvox makes a wonderful product!  This is my second pair (this time, in red) of their headphones, and they are as super as my rose gold pair.  The language is very clean, and the noise cancellation is exactly right.  The ear cups are very comfortable and the color is really cheery!  As usual with Zvox, they work right out of the box, as did my other pair and my TV speaker.  I love Zvox!

title: Good, comfortable headphone
review: This HP on ear headset is my second set, as it provides perfectly clear sound and folds up small for travel.  I bought my first set last summer in Spain and liked it so much that this second set is for home use.  The volume control on the cord is another plus.  A good, inexpensive headphone!

title: Love this head phone
review: Love this head phone. Even though it does not say in the product description, it has better noise control than the so-called noise cancelling bluetooth headphones that cost twice as much or even more. I have bought several pairs now. Still the best head phones I have owned.

title: Love these/ 2nd purchase
review: I am not much of a fan of earbuds. Too much EMF straight into the brain and small ears make me uncomfortable. If you have good over ear headphones, these make it easier to use them attached to a device. This helps to avoid EMS.

title: Not secured
review: I expected the headphones to be held together with the magnet securely. However, they do not stay connected, the magnet is extremely weak. My AirPods almost fell in the dish water, oh I would’ve been pissed 😡.

title: Great Headphones
review: Love these headphones. I've got some hearing problems and I can hear really well with theses! I use them primarily for phone but they're great for music as well!

title: Claims to have the top range
review: LOve everything about the headphones, the articles I read is that these headphones have the largest blue tooth range.  Honestly, seems the same as most all blue tooth...50-75 feet is the range

title: A+ Directional Cables
review:
I couldn't stand all those poor people RCA cables that let electrons flow in both directions. Like, what? Output goes to input, and cables should be built with that intent in mind. Extra rad is that these cables seemingly convert all electrons into positrons so that they're optimally shielded before reaching my headphone amp.

Has my music been perceptibly changed? Not in the least. But at least I know in which direction everything is moving.

Very crucial purchase. Very. Money well-spent.

title: Great $100 Buds
review:
I was surprised at how good these sounded. While the high end is definitely a bit too pronounced, the middle range is beautiful, and the bass is pleasantly a bit exaggerated. I wish the treble wasn't quite so prominent, as it's annoying on some tracks ... even though it's not too noticeable on others. Definitely the nicest pair of earbuds I've yet experienced in the ~$100 range.

Some have said the impedance might cause a volume issue on smartphones. But on an iPhone 7, I had no trouble getting it plenty loud, without needing to get the volume anywhere near all the way up.

title: Bose is Ultimately the best
review: I love Bose products for year unfortunately I had to return because I purchased for my laptop vs smartphone.  My loss. But I never use EARBUDS with my smartphone

title: Now its worth the cost
review: After a deep testing with different amps and dacs , comparing with Grado's PS , T1's , and ABYSS, this headphone rocks..

title: Amazing dvd player, improve a lot the image and sound of your dvd and bluray
review:
No any doubt, this is hthe best dvd, bluray, dvd-audio player. Improve amZing the image of the movies and the sound, iam use them with a onkyo 5508 under pure power set, and they work like a partners, very nice and the sound with my headphones grado ps1000 aunder analog playing cannot be better.
Dont doubts go ahead with the oppo95 if yut have the budget!,

title: One on the best headphone
review:
One on the best headphone. I have bought 4 of them so far. Extremely durable. Sound quality is amazing.
I liked them better than beats

title: Perfect for what I use it for.
review:
Love these headphones. My main use is to drown out the sound of the outside world. It does that perfectly when combined with some soft music. Battery lasts long, build is durable, and sound quality is great. Pairs easily with iOS (Apple) devices, and pairs even more easily with Android devices with NFC.

I took it on a plane recently, and it drowned out about 90% of the noise. The sound quality is tuned more for bass-heavy tracks. It reminds me of sitting in a chamber when I use it. I use it for personal use and in my therapy practice. It helps the kids drown out outside noise.

I just wish it wasn't so expensive.

title: These are what I've been needing for so long!
review: These are a blessing for sure. I've been listening to thunderstorms to fall asleep for years now. However, I always have issues with the earbuds falling out or hurting my ear after awhile. These solve those problems. The earbuds fit perfectly and don't fall generally fall out. The best thing is that I can lay on my side in comfort. They don't hurt! The sound is great and the battery life is awesome. They last all night and into the morning when I get up and drink coffee. I absolutely love this headset!

title: Beware it may suddenly stop working
review: Initially, I gave this product a 5 star rating. However I had to change it to 1 star. I received these headphones on October 5th. They worked great...good quality sound and long battery life. However, on October 12th, they suddenly stopped working. It seems that they will no longer turn on. I know it's not the battery because I charged it again. The on/off switch stopped functioning. It's really disappointing because they were an excellent set until they stopped working.

title: stops any complaint from my husband
review: I love all kinds of movies, especially Star Wars & most other Sci-Fi, but dialogue, music, & sound effects sometimes cause me to play with the audio so I can hear what the actors are saying & it drives my husband nuts. With these headphones I set the volume control where I want it & I don't disturb him while he's on the computer or reading & he doesn't bug me about the racket - Win Win!!!!

title: Easy to love wearable speaker system.
review: I was a little skeptical about the sound that I would get from these wearable speakers. I’ve shopped much more expensive versions and decided to give these a try. I’m very pleased with the sound quality of the small speakers. The unit is very durable. It fits my neck well, it is very rigid and inflexible. It will not fall off of my neck by accident or because of strenuous activity. I went kayaking on a river this weekend and they were a great way to listen to music or an audio book. I usually use a Bluetooth speaker that I have to fumble around with to use while kayaking, this headset was far superior. The battery life has not been an issue it lasts several hours.

title: After 2 years of heavy use.
review: I've had these headphones for over 2 years and I haven't had a single issue whatsoever. When I first bought them they sounded incredible. I try other headphones at the store to this day and the only pair of headphones that compare are the most expensive pair of Beats and the higher end Bose. After all these years I've only noticed a tiny drop in sound quality. They are great for Gaming. Amazing clarity and stereo quality. After slamming them on my desk out of anger dozens of times they've slightly lost some of their glossy shine from scratches. You can bend the arm that connects the two ear prices flat on a table and they will be fine (I'm not saying you should do it). Almost daily use with my volume all the way up or almost all the way up (it depends on the song) for two years and they still sound amazing and clear. This is the greatest purchase I've made on amazon and Im thinking of upgrading to the Bluetooth Hesh 2's.

title: My kids love this.
review: My kids love these headphones.  They were so excited to open them and the bag to carry them in was a nice bonus.  There was a problem with one,  but their customer service was great and I received a replacement.  Very happy with the product and would recommend to others.

title: The sound is great but
review: it is a little disappointing that is does not hold a charge for as long as my last one. Also there is some static after you answer or make a call, it lasts for about 10 seconds - it is annoying and sometimes the person I am calling hangs up because of the static. All in all it is a great headset - you can wear it in traffic, in the wind, while you are listening to the radio and driving down the road, it cancels out all surrounding noise. Next time I am buying the stereo one.

title: Love Love Love
review: Love this mask, I had trouble falling asleep and love listening to meditations at night. However, the headphones get wrapped up or they hurt my ears, with this I can avoid that. The volume was actually better than I expected and it is super comfy on your face.

title: Portable Rechargeable AM/FM Radio
review: Love this little radio. Easy too use with the presets. Sound quality only ok. I use when walking because I don’t like to use headphones when I out walking and my ears get sore. Fits in my pocket well. Plus, it’s rechargeable so I don’t need to buy batteries and it lasts for hours.

title: Monoprice SonicSolace Active Noise Cancelling Rechargable Headphones
review: Bought these based on the great reviews. These are very comfortable to wear  but a little weighty. They are heavier than I thought they would be but not uncomfortably so. I really enjoy the sound on these and the active noise cancelling. These are probably the best headphones I've ever purchased. I plan on using them on my flight next week. Very easy to use. I like that it's rechargeable.

title: 😑😑😑  You're just not going to believe me.
review:
Confidence in 20s.

I'm writing this with a blow dryer hooked to a cap and the noise cancelling blocks the air and I hear nothing but Purple Rain. Almost in full quality. If that doesn't say it.

Number 2. Shake test is for amateurs. I did the smack the head test. Headsets stayed in my head and they stayed in my shower.

Number 3. I forgot they were in my head because I started looking for them.

Thanks just doesn't quite say how much I appreciate a good product and I am a tight wad. I buy clothes on .99 cent sales from GoodWill to save cash. These headphones are like purchasing 4 headsets because customer service is top notch in the business and they TRULY stand positively behind every sale, every customer.

The build quality geez, it's ....past 20 s. I would say try them and give them back, but if you are a tight wad like I am, you KNOW that's not happening. You'll hear a good deal when you put these babies in.

title: I thought I wanted buisness type sound!
review:
I suppose the headphones did what they were supposed to do. They aren't for gaming or chatting or even enjoying music. They are for content creators period in my opinion.

Now if you want some fun, grab the OneOdio's. My son lowered his chair on my m40 AT's and one day I will have to thank that kid, but for now, his dad is very mad...but inside (yeah)

These headphones are not for fun. They are for insecure people like my self who saw somebody with a large following where them, but I've had better from less money spent and I'm being honest, but don't take my word for it. And if you are here because of MKBHD, you made my point. 😂

title: What Do You Need to Know!
review:
Plug n Play and your bluetooth options are suddenly recognized by Win10 just like that. I do music and I noticed I do not have to switch to my headphones. I can not advertise this will happen for everyone, but I am getting zero to low latency so how can I be upset. The syncing technlogy is fantastic.

Good buy! Never drops my signal.

title: Customer Service w/TOZO is 6/5. Product needs TLC though.
review:
No Rant. No negativity. They worked like a freaking dream. Headsets excellent condition, then the charging case died. Just that suddenly.

Love comes and love goes right. Oh well, the search continues. I wish I was fortunate enough to get the successful headsets.

UPDATE***

I rated it a one but I changed it. If this was 1 year ago, I would have got stuck with bad earbuds. They mailed me two additional pairs. I feel bad that many were necessary.

That's just love. That's not even customer service. That's something my father would do. So, I'm sticking with this company. Zero hassel.

I wish I knew how to change my bluetooth device address back. It changed itself somehow. But the newest ones I have work flawlessly and sound the best out of all the pairs.

I really want to recommend. Standby for update

**UPDATE

title: Feels military grade.
review: It is super snug on the for so it has a premium fit to it. Has a nice fingerprint Resistant design. Strangely and it may happen to no one else, my Bluetooth signal is stronger. It was awful just in my pocket. Headphones don't connect easily do Bluetooth is the way to go. Great product and fast shipping.

title: Sound just as great (maybe even better) as they look. Very comfortable and can be worn for hours without headache.
review:
Finally, a good pair of noise-isolating headphones that don't give me a headache because they're so tight! :) I love the fact that I can wear these for hours and don't need to stop or pop a pain pill due to the massive headphone. Both the earphones and headband are well padded and provide hours of comfort. Plus, I truly can't hear any background noise once I have these on.

The headband doesn't extend too much but it's enough for me (and I have a big head, lol). Along with being easy on the eyes, this headset is lightweight and folds for easy portability. The sound is superb, as well. There's a perfect mix of bass - not too much to again, give me a headache - and treble.

I actually didn't expect these to sound as well as they do. I've been disappointed' by a lot of headphones but these are not one of them. For now, they're my new everyday go-to pair and stay right on my computer desk.

A free item was provided for evaluation and unbiased review.

title: Works very well and feels nice; great design and color scheme. Does have some thickness to it.
review:
My husband and I both like this skin. It feels nice in the hands, is soft, comfortable to hold, makes the controller easier to grip. The silicone material stops the controller from sliding around in your hands, which is great. The fit isn't really tight and is a little loose in some areas, but with some tweaking, you can make it more uniform.

My husband has been using it more than me and he does have one complaint: it makes the buttons harder to press due to its thickness. So, he doesn't use it when playing COD because it slows him down being that he can't press the buttons as quickly.

The color scheme is great too - very stylish. Red is my husband's favorite color and who doesn't like red with black? It helps to protect the controller for spills and such, plus we can still plug in the headset (jack is in the clear).

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. All opinions are 100% mine.

title: Great bluetooth headsets
review: Great bluetooth headsets. The sound is better than all I have ever tried including bose. My only complaint is that the adjustment pieces that the headset comes with can fall of the the earbud. Without those pieces, the earbuds will not stay in the ear.

title: Headset Works Like New
review: Once the old headset started to die out quickly after charging, it was time to get a new battery. If you're going to invest in an expensive headset, you may as well buy a replacement battery for it, so you can keep on enjoying it to get the most out of what you purchased. The new battery was quick, and easy to install, and it holds a charge just as good as when the headset was new, and out of the box.

title: the top is a little to wide
review: Worked well for my headphones g935, The headband pad is wider then the Original, so I expect it will fall of at some point.  a little scratchy but Not bad hours of gamming I cannot complain.

title: It's FINALLY Quiet....
review:
My daughter and I are both extremely sensitive to sound, and have tried most "noise blocking" ear plugs/headphones/ear phones on the market... we needed something that shut out background sounds but allows life to continue. These magical little things do it !! No more hearing every conversation around me, every flickering light, and running computer... no more hearing a bug fart at 20 feet either. If you're like me and exhausted by all the input a day can bring- DO YOURSELF A FAVOR, BUY THESE.
And for when you don't want to wear these, check out Loop ; ) you can live in them !

title: Ear buds will not charge
review: In the beginning I loved the way they sounded. I have never been able to get a charge on the earbuds less than a month after I got them.

title: Ear Bud cuts out
review: Decent headset if you get a good one, right earbud cuts out when you turn your head love LG products but this one was a bust when you spend 40 dollars you expect a product thats going to work

title: Best headphones
review: I really needed Bluetooth headphones and these are amazing. I didn’t want apple since their designs look weird and needed the loop so it doesn’t fall.

title: Love them
review: [[VIDEOID:dd20dc0a37e3f2d07da01d9b9b3fef85]] Love these I can use them for a while  only need to charge. Once a week I use my headphone for 2to 8 hrs a day

title: Great Bluetooth headphones!
review: Needed a set of headphones to work out with.  The highs and mids are perfect on these.  Do not expect the lows/bass to be extraordinary, because they aren't.  For in-ear headphones this was exactly what I was looking for--great battery life, great sound with minimal bass, and very comfortable on the ear canals!

title: Great Bluetooth 4.0 USB!
review: Needed this for gaming headphones and also headphones I use to work out, plug and play, no need to install any drivers!  Was able to connect my bluetooth headphones immediately with no issue!!!

title: Excellent headphone
review: I am pleased with the product. Excellent sound and very comfortable. I bought them to wear at the gym. I was replacing another pair of headphones from a well known maker that fell apart. The ear pads just ripped with the cushioning falling out. I hope these are way more durable.

title: Five Stars
review: These are great sounding headphones. This was a better deal than buying another pair of Bose headphones.

title: Fits like a glove in your ear
review: They are comfortable and will not fall out of your ear! They are a little flimsy, the first one tore when I tried to pull it off the earbud so I could clean it. It still fits, but now it sticks in my ear when I pull the earbud out. It's good there are a few left to use if and when I lose or finish ripping it. I've run with them in and they stay put, and can wear them for an entire workday with no discomfort. Worth buying, it's good they are a multipack.

title: Makes for better talking experience handsfree
review: The battery life is decent, pretty close to what the stats quote. Talking to someone for an hour or so is good, I can hear them pretty clearly and they didn't complain about any background noise. I was a bit let down from the distance it could handle, I walked less than 10' to the next room with my phone on my desk and it started to break up. It doesn't do well with anything as a barrier in between the phone and the set. I had a Jabra BT before this one for my previous phone, it seemed to have better sound quality when it came to listening to music. I was able to go at least 30' outside the house and it got a little static but didn't lose the signal with the Jabra. Maybe it was the phone maybe the headset, they dont make a Jabra for my current phone or else I would have got one. If you want simple, with a slender design. This is for you.

title: Pampering for my ears
review: I have never had headphones that played such high quality sound. If you buy these Sennheisers, you will not be disappointed.

title: Good lightweight headphones
review:
I like Sennheiser headphones and was looking for some that are lightweight and relatively cheap. As I looked higher and higher in price, it seems that low-end Sennheisers are pretty divisive. Significant negative votes, even if you spent a lot more than these. So all in all, these fit the bill. I just got them, so who knows about durability. But one problem was immediate. What's right? What's left? It turns out they are most clearly marked R and L on the inside of headband at the base, so you have to slide the earpieces up to see the markings. Then use a light to read the black on black writing. Jeez. It turns out there's an easier way: the right side is labelled Sennheiser on the outside of headband. You're welcome.

Shipping? Hmm, with the holiday crunch it took a week to get these through the mail. Well, that's OK. But they shipped from my own town! Pretty poor shipping. And as I tracked the order, they kept asking if I wanted faster shipping. Yeah, from my own town. I could have picked them up in an hour round trip with traffic. Oh, well.

title: Immensely appealing planar in ear monitors
review:
Years ago, I had Stax headphones. They were excellent, but the headphone amp requirement bothered me. Stupid complaint really.

These are closely related to the Stax technology in a tiny format that runs without added amplification. I found the immediacy and richness to be terrific. In fact, I couldn't believe how lifelike these sounded.

Simply highly recommended. I was going to give this four stars, because I don't have a tons of in-ear-monitor experience to judge if it really deserves that fifth star.

title: Awesome!
review: Awesome headphones. I picked these up on the deal of the day. Well worth the price. They fit well for an average sized person.

title: Great!
review: They work well, I picked these up on the deal of the day. Great headphones for the price!

title: Solid--  UPDATE
review:
These are open back, so of course the noise cancellation is non-existent- but, these are better than most open backs in my opinion because they are more warm and have a bit more bass than other open back headphones. The memory foam is a little firm at first, so you have to keep them on for a while and then eventually they'll soften up and you'll forget you're wearing them. Solid headphones for sure.

UPDATE: I got these heaphones in December of 2019. It is now April 16, 2020 and one of the earcups is hanging out of it's designated spot. One of the cheap little screws used to hold the earcups in place broke somehow (I'm very gentle with my headphones.) Now, the headphones are basically non-wearable. It's a shame, because I love the headphones. I tried to contact Philips customer support, but I couldn't find anything anywhere on their page that allowed me to contact them. So. Yeah. I guess I'm out $100+

title: Absolutely Superb Headphones
review: These headphones are stellar. They sound great and fit perfectly on my head and my head is pretty big. They do sound better when the volume is louder for some reason but that's never a bad thing. And, of course, these are Sol Republic headphones so durability shouldn't be an issue. The blue color is sexy by the way :D

title: The Best You're Going to Find
review: These are the best headphones you can buy on the market for the price in my opinion. The sound is great and the bass is nice and punchy but not overpowering. I can honestly say I've had Beats Solo HDs and Monster DNAs and these are the best. Durable, nice sound, and sexy. Probably the most comfortable headphones I've ever worn as well. The ear cushions are SUPER soft and the headband is nice. They are very stylish and flashy in the white color. Love these headphones and would recommend to anyone.

title: Protective, but NOT precisely cut for the earphones, etc.
review: Well, it's pretty and protective, but I cannot insert the earphone plug so that it will transmit sound, and the other two outlets are absolutely covered, making the outlets useless. Also found the shaping of the lower front section covering the three lower directional "signs" very difficult to access unless one repeatedly pushes up the Kindle very vigorously and repeatedly into the case. Kept thinking it would loosen up a bit after repeated efforts, but no luck. Am going to try the floral case with the white background, to see if I can get a better fit. First time I've had such a failure of a Kindle case. I absolutely bought the correct case for the latest edition of the 10 inch Kindle Fire.

title: Great Headphones and Super Customer Service.
review: I purchased two of these sets of headphones.  They are great and we love them.  I had an issue with one and it was past my return window.  I emailed the company through Amazon and they made everything right, super fast!  I am really impressed overall.

title: Fantastic product. No regrets. It does slip off though. Use a clip
review: This is just about the best pair of Bluetooth headphones for the price. The part of people mentioned about the headphone slipping off from around your neck is true. I saw this issue by using a clip that I had from another pair of headphones. For the price though, the sound quality is pretty good. The bass seems pretty punchy but not overdone. Treble in the audio is clear without sounding tinny. I love these and as long as they continue to be produced at this quality I will keep buying them if I need to.

title: Great sound. Waaaay above price point
review: Great sound. Waaaay above price point. Headphones are fine but wiring is shoddy and thin. Could rip internally if yanked (which does happen since the wires are on the shorter end. Sound bleeds but not too much.

title: low sound
review: it is way too small. but i think power of earbud not good enough, espacially if you are at the outside you can not hear anything!!

title: I was really excited for these
review: I work in an open office and was excited for noise canceling headphones to drown out the unpleasant noises from my co-workers (there are a lot). These were comfortable to wear and did a great job of drowning everyone out. There were times that I'd have them on and the sound would fade in and out a few times (each day, not like every song or show I was listening to) or there would be a beeping, usually immediately after I turned them on. It would go away quickly, so no big deal. Unfortunately, here I am 9 months later and they just broke. I had read all the previous reviews and have often been very careful not to stretch them when putting them on. I am very disappointed that even being very careful they still broke and its too late to return...

title: Great sound
review: Love the sound of these earphones. I just wish that the button on the wire worked better

title: Best Headphones I've bought
review: Under non pandemic circumstances, I travel overseas frequently.  These are the best headphones I've used.  Very good noise cancellation and sound quality.  Battery life is excellent.  Bought this Amazon Renewed version and came with a case but no retail packaging.  Was well worth the savings.  Will admit I still have not used all the available features on the app, etc but like knowing it's all there.

title: Excellent, sounding as good as earbuds costing 10x the ...
review: I am giving these a conditional 5 star rating.  Oh heck.....forget the conditional.  At this price, I will probably lose them in my travels before they break.  I was so surprised at the sound from these earbuds.  Excellent, sounding as good as earbuds costing 10x the price I paid.  At the current Amazon price of $7.99 you cannot go wrong.

title: Trying to decide if I should return these
review: I just received these headphones today from Amazon.  I had tried these headphones at a shop in the airport a few months ago and really liked the noise cancelling and the sound quality.  What I did not realize was the annoying sound leakage from these headphones.  I'm not sure if people will be able to hear the leakage on a flight but at home everyone can.  I bought these primarily to use on airplanes but I need to decide if the leakage is bearable.  I'll try them some more over the next few days before I make the decision.  I got these on Black Friday week for a tremendous price and don't want to spend 300.00 for other quality noise cancelling units.

title: Good while it lasted
review: Worked for a little bit. Was great with it did. Now the left one won't connect. Tried charging it. Nothing. Very sad. I expected more life out of these headphones. But honestly, even when they did work the botton was too sensitive anyway when putting in your ear or moving it around. I had high hopes.

title: Fantastic
review: For an in ear headphone these have excellent sound quality and the bass is out of this world. Highly recommend.

title: Wireless earbuds
review: Wireless earbuds my nephew had these and they are absolutely great you can hear so well and other people can hear you so well it also has a bar that will hook up to your ear pieces so that way when you speak it will be picked up I do Recommend these for anybody that needs something while you’re driving or just want to listen to your music

title: Rizizi Wireless Earbuds
review: Absolutely perfect wireless headphones for my busy life. My hands are free. I am able to multi task. And the longevity is remarkable. Great purchase!

title: So lightweight!
review:
Originally I bought one of this brands headsets to use with my Xbox and I really loved it. I also work from home so I decided to give one of their USB models a try for work. Honestly I don’t see myself ever using another brand for my headset. Just like the one I use for my Xbox this USB model I use for work is very lightweight, has a mute button with a red light indicator, the mic turns all the way around so it can be worn on either ear and the volume control is really great 👍 The one I use with my Xbox I’ve had over a year and I’ve never had any issues with it.

Thank you for making/selling a great product.

title: Frayed wire and one bud died after 2 months
review: My teen daughter used these earbuds everyday.  She pointed out it quit working and wires were fraying.

title: Mediocre at best
review:
The sound, listening to audio books is acceptable. Phone calls is a joke. The quality coming is is choppy at times and the other side says my voice sounds robotic, but understandable. The noise cancellation abilities are ok, but no where near top of its class, even at this price point (MSRP $199). When wearing the headset, it feels tight along my jaw, and after an hour or two it will give me a headache. They don't fold up well for portability. I haven't tested the Alexa or Google interface yet. The ear pads are thin and overall the unit looks rather cheap in person. They seem to be fairly durable though.

The music and volume controls are easy to use and I do like that the pause/play button is easy to work. Pairing with my phone was simple. I have not had any issues while wearing my glasses.

title: Certainly not the final word in high Fidelity, but an absolute killer of a good deal.
review: Sound Quality, comfort, battery life, are all of a class of earbud typically of 3x or 4x the price.

title: The quality surprise me!
review: I am a radio producer try to purchase a microphone for my trip and I choose the low price for this time then after connect with my Sony headphone sounds really great!! I love it

title: MS Zune 8GB
review: Everything about this MS Zune looks good except one thing: Sound System. It has no EQ. It sounds dull n plain. My Klipsch S4 earbuds sound awesome even with a cheap $20 MP3 player, but could not help to improve it with this Zune. Don't waste money on this Zune. I think they did put back EQ on newer model. NOT RECOMMENDED!....

title: Plagued by audio drops [edited!]
review:
Edited 12/5: I returned the original pair I had when they launched only to be doomed by constant audio drops from my Xbox One X. When they did a flash sale on their site I went ahead and repurchased them as I had read their new firmware fixed the issues I was having. Low and behold -- they work like a dream now! Love these headphones top to bottom. Only thing keeping it from a 5/5 is having a more inventive charging solution such as a dock of some sort!

This product is amazing! Great look, functionality, sound quality, comfort... but unfortunately connectivity issues render the item useless. I played many hours suffering through audio drops of about two seconds in length at about an average of every 10-15 seconds. Sometimes go several minutes with no drop, but it always returned. For a $200 pair of headphones, that simply will not do. I’m sad to say I will be returning these after waiting over a year for their release. :(

title: Lasted less than a year - but received replacement!
review:
I loved the headphones, kept outside noise out, big rich and beautiful sound, decent microphone... And crapped out on one side in less than a year. Sigh.

EDIT: I'm pleased say that I was able to replace these headphones free of charge via Platronics Repair Center. Well done.

title: Outstanding
review: Wow, I’m shocked how good these headphones are. Amazing! They easily compete with my Westone W40’s which cost $499.

title: Doesn't come with a protective case... otherwise outstanding.
review:
Got these on sale at a great price, best sounding headphones I have ever had. 4 stars due to the fact that they only come with a bag for travel and storage, I bought a hard case on amazon and am well pleased.

In the end, they are true to sound and absolutely the most comfortable headphones I have ever owned. Others I have had pinch somewhere or cause some discomfort after a hour or so of use.

title: Offers better protection than the bag that Bose sends with their ...
review: Offers better protection than the bag that Bose sends with their headphones. A case like this one should come with the headphones for what you pay for them.

title: The Best Gets Better
review: I’ve owned the 2nd and 3rd gen versions of these headphones and the 4th gen is the best yet. I don’t like that the 3D audio feature is only supported by Tidal and a couple other apps. Other than that nit-picky feedback, I highly recommend.

title: great for my headphones
review: I don't want wireless headphones/earbuds so I got this and it works great. several of my friends shave had me order one for them.

title: Great headphones for the money!
review: For the money this was a great purchase. I don't care for earbuds, except for short periods of time, and I use these at work and they work really well off the computer listening to music on Jango. Headphones have evolved so much over the last few decades (yes, I am old!) and these are comparable to ones that I paid a lot of money for in the early 90's. I like these so much I am ordering another pair.

title: Five Stars
review: Love these wireless earphones! You can answer phone calls and they have different size ear molds.

title: Five Stars
review: Great sound and quality! Price is reasonable as well!! Love the retractable earbuds! I had the older model and these are much better.... The call feature is very clear and easy to use. They are comfortable wearing too! You get extra earbuds so you can change them depending on your preference. They charge up quickly as well. Highly recommend if your in the market for them....

title: Pretty, but not practical.
review: Nice looking, but not well laid out for storing all the "stuff" that I need for my MacBook Air...cords, adaptors, earphones, pencils, pens, paper, etc. I have to carry my Passport somewhere else, as well as the portable charger. Went back to my old case. Not as "spiffy' but more practical. PS it has very good padding.

title: SO handy!
review: I have this clipped on my gym-bag zipper, so I never have to hunt for my headphones. I use the "figure-8" technique to wind them up (look on YouTube) and they never tangle. It's hard-shelled, so they're protected, too.

title: Very handy
review: These are just the thing if you are sick and tired of untangling headphones. You can keep regular 'phones from tangling, but only if you wind them around something or if you use one of the "figure-8" winding techniques you see on YouTube. I'm too lazy to spend that time, so these are great. No tangles. They do take up a bit more room to store than regular 'phones wound up do, but that's OK with me.

title: Great product for the price.
review: I am really happy with these earbuds.  The voice response is a nice feature.  It tells you: Connected, On, Off.  I use them to watch TV on my iPad when riding an exercise bike.  They stay secure in my ears.

title: Great Headphones-They just don't last that long
review:
With any lower priced headphones, I suppose it shouldn't be too shocking when the audio starts giving out after around 3 months. While they initially did work as intended, the sound, noise cancellation and overall functionality was great!
However, I'm not enthused to buy new headphones every 3 months, so overall, great temporary headphones, not so much for durability and life span.

title: This product is great
review: The product had great sound quality. the noise cancellation is not really a feature on the headphones but is do to the fact that they are so loud and thats why I say they are not the best for working out because you cannot hear anything else.

title: Great product for the price
review: My son uses this for his ps4. So far so good. I have an 11 & 8 ur old boys, they both have a few head sets & expensive ones. My 8 yr olds headset he used all the time broke, so got him this 1 & he likes it. He can never hear me yell to him so guessing the quality is pretty good.

title: Surprisingly very good headphones.
review:
I just got these yesterday so this isn't an extensive review.

Pros
- The bass is rich and, just like the box description says, "thumpy".
- Nice and light on your head. It gets warm on the ears after a while, but still pretty comfortable.
- Paired easily with my iPod and Lenovo T500.

Cons
- The rocker switch to control rewind/fast forward + volume is okay. The bad part is that it's mounted on the round edge of the headphone and forward (between 4/5 o'clock position on a watch). It could have easily been mounted on the flat edge of the headphone or better yet, raised buttons. Maybe it could have been swapped with where the on/off switch is located (7/8 o'clock) so you can control with your thumb.
- The pause/play and mic buttons should have embossing on it to differentiate between the two.
- Not really an issue, but should have come with a small charger. Charging from computer USB is too slow.

title: Good compact bedside radio.
review: Easy to read the dial. Decent sound for its size. Earphone jack for privacy. Excellent value.

title: Not for me
review: I just purchased this Bluetooth headset device and while it took me about 40 minutes to pair it with my iPhone 4S the issue I have is it doesn't fit my head, yes I am a big guy, while I was able to get the fit to a point where I could deal with it, the earphones keep cutting out during play and is very irritating. I spent more time messing around with these earphones than working out. The fit is minor compared to the function. I do not recommend this to anyone.  I will continue searching for a better pair. I will also be getting a refund. The one star is too high of a rating for this but I had to put it in order to submit this review.

title: well worth the money
review: surprised at the really great performance.a really good buy for the money it just plugs into the USB port as though it was a pair of headphone & mic jacks

title: Bluetooth Headphones, Running Wireless Earbuds
review:
Bluetooth Headphones, Running Wireless Earbuds with 15 Hours Playtime, HD Deep Bass Stereo IPX7 Waterproof.
They hookup to my computer nicely. Sound is very good, easy volume control and on/off. They are comfortable too. The fit is just right, snug but not too tight. Light and easy to wear for long periods.

title: good value
review: Well I have had the computer for a week. So far no issues at all. I am slowly adjusting to windows 10 from Vista. I must say this I5 8400 is quite a bit faster than my AMD 1050T. System boot up is VERY fast compared to my older system. The only thing I have done is add 8 GB ram to make it 16GB total. One thing I find Very inconvenient is that there is no CD/DVD RW drive nor is there any place to install one in the case (got an external with a 15" USB cable). This unit is nice and quiet also. No cables hanging around inside the case either,  the internal layout is nice and organized. I haven't played with the LED lighting at all as I;m not interested in it I'm sure it's quite splashy. The headphone, microphone and 2 USB jacks are handy at the top front of the case, all else is located on the rear. I gave the system a 4 simply because I feel a CD/DVD RW drive is a necessity not a "maybe" component. Overall I'm quite pleased with this system both operationally and value wise. (I just didn't feel like building another system this time. lol)

title: Volume control won't work with old IPODS
review: Actually, I bought this to use with my old IPOD that is still going strong, but unfortunately the volume control doesn't work with the IPOD.  I still use them however.  The magnetic feature is great and I love, love, love the little earpieces that go within the ear and make them so comfortable and not constantly falling out of my ears like other earbuds.  I have never tried using them with my Samsung phone because I use bluetooth earbuds with that.

title: Beware tho, some won't pair with phone!
review:
These are fabulous! They fit in your ears and because of the design, they stay there, unlike some others that are always falling out, plus they are super comfortable! I tried another bluetooth headphone, and it cut in and out every 5 secs or so. Had to return those. This bluetooth connection is great! I just used them in my house and I was 20 feet away from the phone in another room and I still had terrific quality. Plus the volume is wonderful! Not too low like in so many others. I am using them with a Samsung Note 5. I think these are a great buy, and am considering a second pair before they are all gone!
Update: I used just in one session at the gym and found going wireless was miraculously wonderful, so I had to buy the second pair! Even bending over for dead lifts and stretching, using treadmill and elliptical, not once did they come out of my ears.

title: Call volume too low, L-shape would have been nice
review: The headphones work with my Samsung Note 5 pretty well.  Volume control is a little sensitive, but I can live with it.  Using Amazon Music, as long as I bypass Samsung's "safe" listening level, I can hear the music well while working out in a noisy gym.  However, even with the volume at full, and my Samsung volume at full, the volume on a voice call is low and hard to hear.  I am only slightly hard of hearing, but that may be affecting it.  The wires are flat, which is different than any headset I've ever owned, but not a problem.  A big drawback for me is that the plug is straight, rather than L-shaped.  This adds at least another inch and a half to your phone size, which if you are trying to fit it in a pocket or Flip-Belt, or similar, makes it VERY difficult.  In addition, the earbuds keep falling out of my ears, even using the smallest size!

title: Seems like good quality
review: Seems like good quality. I ended up returning mine because they were too big, I should’ve measured first and this was my fault. But the product was nice and sturdy and had they fit my Bluetooth headset I would’ve kept them.

title: Headphones
review: I have had the headphones about a month. I use them with my IPhone and IPad . The quality is excellent and I have had great sound. I am very pleased with them.

title: Impressed
review: I purchased these for a long flight as earbuds always hurt my ears.  I was seriously impressed (especially for the price) by how much noise cancellation there was and how good the sound was.  I actually wasn't expecting much but didn't want to spend a whole lot for a plane ride, and I did not want to travel with my expensive ones, so I rolled the dice, and it ended up being a good choice.

title: These Rock
review: I didn't know what to expect when I ordered these and honestly thought $40 bucks for a head set was excessive but I play a lot of on line games and we sky or team speak and my old pair hurt my head and I disliked the mic so I decided to take the plunge.  These arrived yesterday, simple to hook up, worked right out of the box with NO problem.  The headset is extremely comfortable, the mic easy to maneuver and the sound was crystal clear with no interference on either end.  I skyped and played a game for over 2 hours and was pleased at how well these worked.  The volume and mute on the device worked perfectly and were a great little added bonus.  The people on the other end said I sounded great.  I definitely recommend these.

title: Very Happy
review: These headphones are great. Very comfortable, sound wonderful, noise cancellation is good. The battery time (12-15hrs) is more than adequate for me. If you're already use to using Cortana then no problems, if not OK Google works fine as well.

title: Stacks up to IPOD
review: The only thing you don't get with this is the software that the other guys give you that does everything in it's power to make you pay for new music.  So you have to know how to rip your cd's and load them into this, but for someone with a cd collection dating back to the late 80's, and that was a member of the BMG music club over those years, this is a great way to pick and choose your favorite songs from your entire collection for those boring flights across the county.  The ear buds are okay, but you can afford noise cancelling headphones with the savings here.

title: Nice sounds not so nice noise canceling
review: The headphones are very comfortable and the sound of the blue tooth pleasant.  It muffled sound but doesn’t cancel.

title: Way better than the original
review: Way better than the standard Sony one that come on the 3. No idea why Sony can’t offer some this food for a $350 set of headphones.

title: hissing sound when active in a silent room
review: i have a few pair of active noise canceling headphones. this set has an issue, hissing when on. i did not take them on a jet, so i can not fully comment on normal condition use but i use my other ones in the office to block out noise sometimes and none of them hiss background noise like these do. i did not wear them long enough to comment on other topics like extended wear comfort, ear cup comfort etc. first and foremost they must block noise, these created noise where there was none. i will also point out my pair was rectified, not new.

title: only fits over classic earbuds
review: these fit over the classic large circular pard earbuds. they won't work on new Apple earbuds due to the new shape those have. they don't fit on tiny posts or replace soft earbuds. they only work over old-school round reads, so as long as you know that they work well. i use them on a basic 2-way Skype headset. would work over other cheap earbuds, but for the price you may just want to get a decent earbud headset with a silicone earbud set that may come with 3 sizes of cup/cones.

title: works great, be sure to get the right size
review: medium or large is for most guys over 5'10" (hard to say the cutoff for sure). the point is you have 3 sets of silicone cups/cones to block noise. i don't like the feel of them fitting so deep in my ears so i (carefully) cut off the smallest tip and use the remaining 2 cups/cones. good fit and good passive noise suppression. use in conjunction with active noise canceling earbuds and you have a small active noise-canceling headset for travel. saves 95% of the space of big headphones and does almost as well at reducing background noise and it will be 1/3 of the cost of big earphones, maybe less.

title: it does what it was designed for
review: Coiled cables are so convenient for traveling but also for at the office. I had a PC headset for Skype and webinars but it was uncomfortable. This sounds good, works well and is unobtrusive/compact.  It works well and feels ok in the ear. people on the receiving end say the mic is very clear. Not premium, but good and a good value. The only thing to remember is that it does not have a volume control.

title: Great price, great quality!
review:
Awesome price and quick shipping.

If you have expensive headphones, the first thing that will surely give out is your cord or jack. A great way of mitigating this problem is to shorten your headphone cord and use a plug-in coiled cord like this.

I used a soldering iron to remove my original cord from the speaker of my headphones, cut the cord to about six inches and reinstalled it. Then I plugged that smaller cord into this nice long coiled cord. Now, if there is ever a break in the cord or the jack fails I can just unplug the coiled cord and plug in a few one for a few bucks. No more throwing away expensive headphones because of a faulty cord or connector!

title: Excellent sound.  Works every time.
review: The sound is excellent!  Better than any headset I've ever had.  However, they make my ears hurt  after an hour or so.  It's well constructed of rigid plastic, but  it forces me to sit chin up, head back or it pokes me in the chest.

title: Earbuds for Everyone
review: These earbuds are great for everyone since they have 3 different size covers to insert into the ear canal.  They remain in place at all times and provide excellent music reception.  Highly recommend.

title: Good customer service
review:
Update, the company had reached out to me to either give me newer model or refund 40 dollars. Got to say I'm impressed. We shall see how new model works.

The earbuds are always on. So you have to constantly recharged them. That's probably my bad. if I had read more about them I would have realized that issue. The other problem is they keep disconnecting from one another while they're in my ears. Also they will not connect to my library app called Libby. So I'm sorry I purchased them. They're awful

title: Game-changer for me!
review:
Reviewing on my wife's profile...
I got so sick of wires getting in the way of lifting free weights and flapping around while running. I've had these for maybe 6 months now and they are holding up well. Sound is good, fit is good, battery life is good after plenty of cycles, they let in just enough exterior sound so as not to be dangerous, and controls are easy even with the multifunction buttons. This model is a lot sleeker than some of the other Bluetooth sport headset I've seen for not much more money. Most people don't even know I'm wearing it until they try to talk to me and they see me touch my ear through my long hair to pause. While charging, the LED ring pulsates red which is cool, and glows solid blue when charged. I have had the pause/play button glitch out on me once but it hasn't happened since. Definitely worth the investment. The only reason it isn't five stars is the button glitching that one time, the charger cord is tiny (maybe 6 inches) and the fact that it doesn't come with a wall plug-in so, unless you have a spare lying around which in this day and age most of us do, then you have to plug it into some other USB port, say, on a computer or car charger.

title: These sound amazing!
review:
UPDATE: They stopped playing out of one ear as usual. Won't spend money on these again as you can get earbuds that sounds just as good, last as long, but cost a lot less.

I absolutely love these headphones. I was very impressed with the sound quality. They feel pretty sturdy so hopefully they last a long while. I've had pretty bad luck with wired earbuds in the past, so hopefully these are built better.

They came in a nice little box, with extra ear bud sizes, and a carrying pouch.

The only issue was with my wife's pair. The earbuds are a little on the "heavy" side due to them being metal, and she has pretty small ears so she had a hard time finding a good bud size to fit her. She found one that works decently but they still fall out sometimes due to their weight, if she's moving around a lot. They aren't painful on the ears at all, but they might fall a little if they don't fit snuggly. Also you could loop them up around the back of your ear for extra support if need be.

title: Excellent headset for a great price!
review: The sound quality is awesome for the headphones. The mic quality isn't quite as good but it serves it's purpose well for talking and chatting. It's very comfortable and can be adjusted to fit a pretty large head if need be. I didn't adjust mine at all and it fits perfectly.  It has pretty good noise cancellation, and it's easy and practical to use! It's wonderful for the low price!

title: Wonderful headphones! Great sound and cheap price!
review: Wonderful headphones!  Great sound and cheap price! I am still always very impressed with the sound quality of these for how cheap they are. I've had a couple pairs, and they are overall pretty durable. I had one pair that broke pretty fast ( I think within a few months) but the first pair lasted me a while. I also used them a LOT at the time, so for the price it is a good deal. If they do break, they're cheap and easy to replace. But again, the sound quality makes them SO worth it!

title: Five Stars
review: LOVE these headphones!  They have great sound for such a cheap price!  Will definitely buy them again!

title: I did not know what I have missed before
review: I do listen to music using my Samsung S8 plus and the Philips X2Fidelio Premium Headphones and they sound very good together – at least I thought so. Decided to give the Oppo headphone amplifier HA-2SE a try since the Samsung S8 supports USB-OTG which is a must if you want to have a proper use of the Oppo HA-2SE. I needed to drop my Poweramp app and replace it with USB Audio Player Pro Media player – this media player recognizes and supports the HA-2SE instantly. Now after two days of listening to my high resolution music collection I have to say I did not know what I have missed before. The sound-stage is much better, the clarity, I can point out every single instrument and the voices are much better than before. Not that it was bad without the headphone amplifier but I think my Philips X2Fidelio now lives up to its full potential, I did not know those cans can sound so well.

title: Love the sound it produces
review: Great little tube amplifier, makes a difference with the iPad listening thru my Philips X2/27 Fidelio cans. It is very nice to look at, too! Love the sound it produces, best $50 I ever spent. My only wish would be a time delay to the amplifier when powering on so I can leave the headphones connected.

title: Xbox works great, the controller not so great!
review: The Xbox works great, however the controller has drift issues making it impossible to use (purchased a wired until next mont). So if you're going with refurbished, I believe the controller is a used item also but was never looked at. The creases between the pieces, I used a toothpick to clean it out all the way around. Very dirty! Be prepared to spend extra on new controllers! No one has replied to my message after asking for a possible controller replacement as we'd just opened the package 3 days after delivery. So I'm having to wait another month to buy a wireless controller. However you still might want to invest in a wired one, the headset plugs into the controller making for great sound features you don't hear through the TV.

title: Good but not the best
review: Good headphones but not the best. The sound quality is very good but I have trouble with the ear piece popping out of my ear. Maybe I just have a weird ear, but the loops that go over the top of my ears don't feel snug either. The headphones serve their purpose and they're not flopping all over the place on my runs but they could be a little more secure. It does come with different ear piece sizes but it's possible my ears just fall in to a weird category. I'm pretty happy with my purchase overall.

title: Bose product are great, i had other noise cancelling headphone but these ...
review: Bose product are great, i had other noise cancelling headphone but these are the most comfortable to wear on a long trip.

title: Wif is good, bluetooth is dead.
review: Wifi is strong and fast, but bluetooth could not find any device while my laptop, smartphone, headset found each other. Bought GIGABYTE GC-WBAX210 instead, cheaper price and newer chipset. (Asus:  Intel AX200, Gigabyte:  Intel AX210)

title: So comfortable with great sound
review: Talk about a great value for great quality. I was so surprised as to the comfort of these headphones, I use them all day and my ears do not hurt at all. The sound is crisp and clear. Best headphones in my book!

review: Not impressed with durability as these headphone which I take very good care, don’t twist them or mishandle are cracking sounds when in use. Left side sounds just awful as it seems wiring already came apart. Will not buy these again. Disappointing to say the least!

title: Definitely a keeper
review: I love everything about this headset. I work from my home on the phone and it fits my needs in every way. Their customer service is quite impressive too. You’d never know this has been refurbished.

title: Awesome Laptop Bag
review:

title: Dont buy
review: One of the earphones goes out after maybe 2 hours wanted to return but was too late

title: Love the fit
review:
I purchased these portable headphones based on information in a review by an Amazon customer. They are great. I replaced the earphones I received with my Zen Nano and I am so pleased. title: Great for music lovers.
review: Love these headphones.  They are substantial size and feel good on your head.  No where do they pull or pinch when I am chair dancing to my music.  The look and feel of them make them seem as if they will last a long time.  The ear padding is soft and cushy and cancel almost all outside sound. They deliver clear crisp high notes and robust bass notes without any static or buzz. For the price you can not get better headphones anywhere.

review: I forgot to take a picture before unfortunately but these headphones cushion are really nice
