review: I bought these headphones before a recent cross country plane trip. My husband has an older pair of Bose, but I didn't want to spend that much for an infrequently used item. These headphones are lighter and more comfortable than the Bose, the sound quality is good and are very good for dulling the volume of airplane noise. I'm very happy with this purchase and would recommend them to others.

title: Disappointed with design and functionality.
review:
I wanted to love this. I don't. I kept it because I may get some use from it, but I don't consider it very well designed.

1. Says it is "over ears." No so. My ears are normal and I have other headphones for other purposes (audio-technica) that are actually "over sears." These headphone are definitely "on ear" for everyone except those who have tiny ears, IMO.

2. The controls are maddening. It seems impossible that a modern company can release a design like this. I use a mini-card with Podcast episodes on it, and it is nearly impossible to adjust the volume without skipping away from the podcast I want to hear to others in the sequence. Same with music. Poor design and placement of controls. Sound was okay.

This is a cheap product. My advice is to pay more for a better designed product with less frustrating functionality.

title: Best for the price, IMO
review: I've had many different headphone brands and the price/quality factor with the Audio-Technica ATH-M20x is astoundingly good. Highly recommended.

title: Love but not durable for 3 year old
review:
To begin, we love these headphones. I have a pair for each child (6yrs and 3 yrs).
They are cute with their bright colors, fit well on kiddos head, have a great colorful case (bought separately) and they love them. We've had for about a year.

title: Technical flaw in my  Soundcore Life Q20 pair (NC noise).
review: I bought these for $39.99. It is a cheap price for the quality of sound these earphones provide. BUT.... I am still debating whether I should return these. My pair of the  Soundcore Life Q20  earphones has a technical defect. You will hear unbearable screeching noise (your ears will burst) each time you try to go for a run wearing these earphones with NC on. The same thing happens if you ride in the car or a bus and the vehicle hits the rough surface. when you have  NC on... I took a long ride and was not able to use these earphones in the NC mode as I was getting so much static noise that made the whole user experience super annoying. These earphones work great if you want to use those to listen to the music sitting on the couch or in the office chair. Do not move or run or you will get static screeching noises. So disappointing.  If you do not move, the sound is excellent though. Alternatively, you need to turn the NC off, if you expect a lot of movement / vibration -- so the NC feature is very limited in these earphones even though Anker advertises this pair as having NC... Again this review is about the  Soundcore Life Q20 pair that I purchased. You might or might not experience the same.

title: Great fit!
review: Love that we just replaced the covers in the ear phones instead of the entire headphones!

title: Good quality sound and fit
review:
Like these. Expensive, but they come with three differently sized earpieces that seem to mold into your ear canals. The left earpiece/canal creates a vacuum, which is why I bought them...to travel on an airplane. The right earpiece, even with different sizes, doesn't quite create the vacuum of the left ear, but I've decided that must be a slight variation in the shape of my right ear canal. In any case, they will get a try out this weekend, when I get on a plane. I'll try to remember to write an update.

Update: Well...there is nothing that will help too much if you sit next to the propellers. But if I hold my hands against my ears and push in the earphones, then, not bad. But I have to admit, the earphones that came with my $19.95 neoprene sleeve for the Kindle Fire here on Amazon work just as well. So...don't waste you money if you need a protective sleeve as well.

title: Excellent soft case with good earphones
review: I'm glad I bought this.  The case is just perfect for a Kindle Fire, and the zippered compartment in the back holds the earphones, which are really quite good. They have three different soft earphone sized covers, which is not clear from the description. I wish I had known that, because I bought a separate pair of earphones in case these were cheap. They're not.  I think I'll keep both pairs, but save yourself some money and just get the ones that come with this case.  They're just as good as the expensive ones out there.

title: Great for limited uses
review: I listen mostly to podcasts when I listen to headphones on my phone so sound quality is not all that important to me. However when I have listened to music the sound quality is blah. These seem more durable than the average corded earbud and they are very comfortable. Have also been good for speaking on the phone. I would buy these again.

title: Meh?
review:
I got these on a flash sale for a little under $20. There are about 5 other brands of BT earbuds like these (identical form) on amazon in that price range. Sound quality on those is similar. This brand appears to have more color options.

Good quality within several feet, good construction, durable. Comes with several earbud sizes for your comfort and a nice zipper closure travel case. Used for two hours straight no issues, while in the gym. No stability issues, they don't fall off easy.

Can only pair to one device at a time. Pairing button is the same as power, so instead of pairing sometimes it will turn on/off, which is a pain.

Sticker price is over $20. Do not buy for anything far over $20. Your money is better spent elsewhere if these are closer to $30 after tax and shipping.

title: Cut Out Issue
review:
Best wireless headset I could find. OVER ear not ON ear so it doesn't make you want to kill yourself for wearing it for hours on end. It does this weird thing where it cuts out, easily solved. Just switch your router from the default channel to an alternate and it will reduce cut-out by 90%. Probably this thing's signal getting crossed with the router's. If you don't understand what I mean by switch from default channel, google it and you should be able to find a good answer.

For windows peeps, just go into your command prompt and find your IP (ipconfig). Punch that into your browser engine and hit enter. Default user is admin and default password is usually admin or password. Browse through that garbage till you find your channel and switch it to a different one. Problem solved.

title: Great for gaming
review: I’ve been in search for a good headset for gaming. I bought a couple but i really like this one. It works great, good quality sound and the mic works good too.

title: Works great on my ps4
review: I bought this to hook up my wireless headphones with the ps4 and this works great. Now I don’t have to buy those ridiculous $120 ps4 only headsets. I can game with my comfy wireless earbuds.

title: high quality build!
review: fits great! sounds great! barely mediocre mic though, don't recommend as headset; otherwise great!

title: I like these headphones very much
review: I like these headphones very much. But I think that the higher bass claims are outrageously exaggerated. Good headphones. Might buy another as spares.

title: Wonderful headset
review: Great sound, noise cancelation, easy mute/talk function. Good range. Only thing I wish was different...little heavy on the head. I wish the headset was lighter in weight. Otherwise-love using them for work and the freedom to move about during work from home.

title: Sennheiser Set830 TV Wireless Infrared Stereo Assistive Listening System (Brown/Black)
review:
This a good set overall. Sennheiser has made electronices for years and the quality is definitely better than the cheaper sets. My only complaint is the foam and rubber earpieces come off. Now they don't wear out easy but they separate from the headset and if you lose them in the furniture or you have pets that can be a problem. The other issue is although you can buy replacement batteries at Amazon I don't see anyone selling the earpieces. I still like the set and Sennheiser backs it. I had a problem with the first set and they immediately sent me another. I just hope they start selling the earpieces here.

CA Luster

title: WoW Headset
review:
My wife got me these for Christmas but I opened them early. Now I can't give you the long term rating on this yet, but my initial reaction is great. They are far more comfortable than I expected and the sound is absolutely phenomenal. The new WoW Cataclysm music is best enjoyed with a high end heasdset like this one. My lightweights didn't let me appreciate how beautiful the music was, nor the realism of the ambient background sounds. I typically go for lightweight headsets and not the bulky over the head kind. After charging these up 8 hours for the initial charge I have worn them serveral hours and don't find them uncomfortable. I have yet to test the mic and will further elaborate once I do. I have alway liked Creative Labs products and this looks to be another winner. A little pricey, but decent sound cards and other accessories are never cheap if you want good quality.

Be sure to do "Rite of the Winds" quest at Evergaze Mesa if Horde and visit Mulgore if Alliance.

CA Luster

review: The case is perfect and the headphone are cradled in the case just right.  Very happy with my case.

title: Earbuds are quite comfortable.
review: The earbuds charge quickly, sound quality is good.I can’t judge the battery life as I haven’t used them that much.

review: Our factory headphones for our Sienna have finally given out after 5 years, so I ordered these to replace them. I wish we would have bought these years ago. review: Great! My 3 year old is in a “doesn’t like loud noises” phase, and these are wonderful! Loud public potties, airplanes, Vacuuming...these have helped with all our tough times! review: works really well, no complaints! there's virtually no product insert/manual, so it took me a while to figure out the ear configuration, especially when this is the first set of earphone i've purchased of this kind...

review: Seems inconsistent sometimes they work and sometimes they don’t. Returning it for a pair of Kant’s headset

review: Like I said in the title the sound quality is great. That is all I can say that is good about them. The item says it will last 8 hours after a charge. Nope not a chance. review:

review: Great little set. Comes with earbuds, 3 sizes to choose from ear inserts, firm case with a little pocket inside to hold extra size ear inserts and earbud splitter so someone else with earbuds can listen to music at same time on same device.

title: My new friend
review: I have never, in the past been able to wear ear buds...they were just uncomfortable for me. Headphones were too hot. I love the echo buds. they are comfortable with fantastic sound. The noise canceling allows me to cut the grass on a loud tractor and still enjoy the music. long life on the batteries and all you do is put them back in the case and the will recharge. Great purchase.

title: Bose fan
review: I just got it today and tried it on and love it! The sound quality is pretty good. review:

title: Great to have hands free calling!
review: Panasonic KX-TCA60 Hands-Free Headset with Comfort Fit Headband  These headphones are the best! The comfort and hearing capabilities are superior to others I have tried.  They have a secure connection and work with any wireless home telephone system.  And, you can't beat the PRICE! Any where! I have checked! I've purchased a dozen or more.  Have one for each phone in the house and have given them to friends and family.  I never write reviews but, this item is great and the price can't be beat!

title: Very good fit.
review: These earphones are convenient. They play clear music. Not exceedingly great but they could be if there was not intermittent static.

title: Great for Running, Good for Sound,
review:
I think these headphones do a great job if your doing something very active like running or sprinting. It can take a second to figure out how to get it in your ear properly but when you do, these things don't budge much if at all which I have had problems with in other headphones. Fits very comfortable in the ear especially with the foam inserts. Usually after long periods my ears will get irratated with something being in them but these last longer before I feel any irratation. (No product will fix that for me) The sound is good, I have heard slightly better in some other brands but I would still classify the sound as very good especially for Blutooth though I am no audiophile.

As far as them cutting out while outside, the receiver would sit behind your right ear so occasionally if I was holding my phone in my left hand while running and I let my hand drop suddenly down my left side it would cut out a few seconds when I would come to a walk from sprinting during interval training. I switched from my phone (Galaxy S7 Edge) to an Ipod Nano (so its lighter while running) that I keep in a pocket in my water bottle on my right hand and it hasn't cut out once. When you are outside you need more line of sight for good blutooth connection since there are no walls for the signal to bounce off of.

Battery life is excellent in my opinion.

title: Don't throw out those headphones just because the ear cushions are ripped
review: Don't throw out those headphones just because the ear cushions are ripped.  Why spend a lot of money to replace perfectly good set of working Bose headphones just because the padded ear cushions are ripped or deteriorated.  These replacement cushions are a snap to install.  The old ones literally snap out from the plastic lip on each ear cup.  The new ones pop right in.  The kit also gives you replacement R and L "scrims" if you need them (I didn't, but nice to have a spare), as well as a little plastic tool to help work the new cushions into place under the tab.  The whole process took less than 5 minutes and I basically had a "new" set of Bose headphones.

title: Great product for the price!
review: This headset is great if you don't want to keep a cordless up to your ear using your shoulder!  It is very clear when you are speaking to someone.  I wish it was a tad louder, but I guess I can turn up the volume on the phone.  Great product at a great price!

title: Amazing earbuds, poor QA
review:
I am currently on my third pair of SE846's - have needed repairs / replacements twice.

These are the best headphones I've over owned (worthwhile upgrade from SE535's) but the QA has been awful. Right earbud had issues cutting out a few years ago, and the replacement right earbud was noticeably lower volume than the left with occasional drops. The latest pair seems to be OK, so hopefully these give me a couple of years while I'm still covered under warranty protection.

Unacceptable for $1000 headphones.

title: Doesn't fit small heads/ears
review: Ah, man, I really don't want to return these but I must, they are really too big for my tiny head. I wear headphones while walking/travelling alot, the back gets in the way of my jacket/sweater, etc. The sound/technology is amazing on these. They fall off my ears also, like they come off my earlobes when I turn my head. I'm upset I'll have to return these. The bluetooth was super easy to set up with my phone and my TV, I am able to hear outside street noise (good for safety reasons) UGG, I wonder if they make a model that is smaller perhaps? I also love the USB-C connection, I love the color and the stickers that come with it to change out color with your outfit. So many good things about this product except for the size.

title: These are GREAT for the price... with very little cons
review:
These feel and look more premium! Honestly the case alone is something that looks and feels like better than earbuds that .... no joke... cost $200 or more! and even THOSE don't have all of these features. The fact that you can use the case to even charge your phone in a pinch... that's awesome! How the earbuds kinda "lock" into place magnetically in the case, is great! And how they have the hook over the ear, also awesome.

They connect easily, and when you take them out the box, they auto connect and when you put them back in the case, they auto shutoff!

They sound clear and the distance is good. My only issue really and this is something that is true of ALL earbuds, because of the size, is the bass! Mainly there isn't much. Don't expect deep thumping like you would with big over the ear headphones, where that can be done.

But for watching videos, listening to podcasts, talking on the phone and listening to music (if you don't mind the lack of bass) , then these are amazing for the price! Seriously, you can't go wrong.

title: Decent Earbuds for the price
review: The quality of the sound is pretty good considering the price.  I am concerned that the cables are thin and will not last, bit only time will tell.  Again, I wanted earbuds without a mike and these serve the bill.

title: Headset fits nicely, zipper closure works fine
review: Snug as a bug in a rug.  Headset fits nicely, zipper closure works fine, when not using the headset the case keeps it enclosed from dust and any other pesky things.  As you know, a good headset can be a financial investment - this is great protection.  I would anticipate it providing great protection even if you treat it a bit rough by just throwing it in the seat of the car.  Good choice, good price.

title: You don't have to miss the joy of music with low tones - these make it happen !!!
review: I read a lot of reviews before making the purchase.  I don't have near the "knowledge" of others in regards to decimals of sounds and the like.  I decided to buy when I kept reading how pleased others were with the "deep" sounds.  They were right - it's terrific. There are many options to consider - this one was a good fit on my ears, light on my head, sounds are just lovely.  A great choice for me.  I also bought the hard carrying case - just left a review for it.... the headset is safe and secure, fits nicely, snug as a bug in a rug.

title: Bose QuietComfort 35 II - I did not purchase this product
review: Bose QuietComfort 35 II Wireless Bluetooth Headphones, Noise-Cancelling, with Alexa Voice Control - Product was out of stock, so I purchased a different headphone.

title: THE # 1 NOISE CANCALATION HEADPHONES
review:
IT IS MY SECONED BOSE HEADSET.
IT IS THE BEST!!!
This is the BEST TRAVELING NOISE CANCELATION HEADPHONES I have bought so far.
I AM a WORLD TRAVELER and this serves me PERFACTLY.

title: Five Stars
review:
Great headphones, sound is fantastic.
Very comfortable to use.
Light and very nice looking.

title: Another hit from Skullcandy
review: I’ve always been a fan of Skullcandy and have been holding out on getting true wireless earbuds until a decent affordable alternative to AirPods came out. Well these are it! So glad I got these, they sounds great, as usual.

title: Best workout headphones I've found
review: Hands down best headphones I've found for working out. Ive never before had a pair of headphones that I can work out with and not pause every minute to adjust them from falling out of my ears, they even hold in place while running. I was concerned with comfort when I bought these because they had great reviews for staying in place but they look like they could be uncomfortable with the wrap around ear design. I was wrong, they are so light weight that I don't even notice they are on. Sound quality is decent and appropriate for the price, if you're an audiophile looking for pure sound you'll be disappointed.....but these are for working out, I'm not looking for sound quality as much as functionality. Can't go wrong with these.

title: You Get What you Pay For
review: The Good is they are VERY light, and easy to connect. Too bad the design and quality is poor.  The shape is way too circular and the headphones extend far from your head so watch out if you are on a Zoom call. Plus, due to the design the lower part of the ear pads rub your ears noticeably to the point that I had red marks on my ears the first week. I bent the metal head piece and was able to fix this a little.  Now there is ZERO sound cancellation going on with these headphones... that is simply false advertising, IMO.  Please note my last headphones cost over $75 and did have real noise cancellation, so what did I expect?  What I got was a decent cheap headphone.

title: Pretty cool but sound is horrible
review: This is a super cool idea, but the sound quality is terrible similar to the Nintendo gameboy headphones.  There is no bass, so when a song with bass is on you hear muffled garbage of noise.  My 5 year old loves it but everyone else can hear the music, its not private, and sound quality terrible - but pretty cool the first time someone sees it

title: Decent, but could be better
review: Good audio, and good noise blocking if you ensure that your ears are properly sealed in the cuff. I have my phones resting on my head at an angle; which is fine. The two things I don't like are the price and where the speakers are. Price is obvious, I generally don't spend more than $60 for head phones. Other thing I don't like is that, and I assume the bass speakers are what are sticking out in the headphones, so if your ear manages to press against one, you'll get a nice squeal from the speaker; which is great when you are interested in losing your hearing.

title: Wireless ear buds
review:
I made a mistake on my review.
These wireless ear buds are Supurb.too good to be that cheap.
My son has Bose headphones and says these pair are a
Perfection in the sound as well. I just LOVE THEM.
Unfortunately the right charger is no longer charging.

title: Very nice headset
review: Order was quick and easy. Headset arrived very quick and ready to use. It was easy to pair with my phone. The head set was a described. Very happy with my order.

title: Old faithful.
review: These are my go-to headphones for working out, moving and the battery life is amazing. The last pair I bought lasted three years after daily use, with my phone for calls, in the dry sauna many many times, at the gym, at work, and I've fallen asleep with them on. They were still working but one of the cords inside the plastic finally shorted out. My ONLY issue with these is I wish they could make the speakers a bit thinner on the ears. Some days when I am wearing them with my hair pulled back I look like some android from Star Wars.

title: When on a WebEx other attendees complain of echo
review: This is my second set of these. The first set worked great and the only reason I replaced them is because I broke one of the earbuds. I ordered a new set but every time I'm on a WebEx call, or any conference call for that matter, the other attendees complain they hear an echo if I'm not on mute.

title: Great Sound and Battery life !
review:
Updated review:

I was contacted by the company regarding my 3 star review and they sent me the LinkLike Fly 9. Although it is the same length as the Fly 8, it does seem to stay on my neck a lot better.
I have upgraded my review to a five because of the proactive customer service. I will purchase from this company again in the future.
The sound and battery life on both units is superb. I use the headset 9 hours a day for work and have had no battery issues.

Old review below:
Had this been just a couple inches longer it would have been much nicer. Keeps falling off my neck.

If you have a small neck, then this would be great.

title: Great accessory for around the neck Bluetooth headphones.
review: Keeps the plastic piece from the headphones from irritating my neck and getting sweaty during a workout. I like that it can be removed and washed. Also keeps them from slipping around on my neck while I'm running or working out. Comes in a nice variety of colors.

title: Don't buy these for a tech idiot.
review: I needed headphones for my wife and I. After watching reviews for several, I decided to buy 2 of these. They are built well for the price, with good enough sound quality that an undiscerning ear can enjoy. Sadly though, my wife has no ability to care for headphones, or adapt to their use in reasonable fashion. She has gone through several sets of headphones in the last year. Though her pair still works, she somehow succeeded in dislodging the size adjusting mechanism on one side. At less than two months old, I am disappointed. Mine are still working normally. I won't be replacing hers. At $25, only a little love lost.

title: I would get this again!
review:
I ordered this pair to replace a pair of Sony headphones that my daughter borrowed & I just let her keep. First let me say that this pair is just as good; it shuts out the noise, the music comes in clearly & as much as I loved my Sonys, this is a perfect replacement.
I would highly recommend this brand, this pair in particular.

title: As Good As I Thought They Would Be...
review:
These headphones are exactly what I was expecting they would be when I ordered them...my daughter has the same pair for her iPod and when I mentioned that I needed a better pair than the ones that came with mine, she suggested these to me.
I have used them nonstop since they arrived ~ love the blue earpiece, lol ~ and they are perfect!
I would recommend them to anybody who is looking for a good pair; the interchangeable earpieces are an added perk! just for fun...

title: Better Quality than all the less expensive ones
review: Decent quality for a tiny price. Of course they are no  way compared to Apple pro or Bose earbuds bit for the price, the quality is surprisingly decent. Good charging time, secure charger case. Would definitely buy again if I lost one of them

title: Good sound quality and comfortable to wear
review: I can't believe these cheap headphones can achieve such excellent sound quality and wear it for a long time without feeling uncomfortable, I love it.

title: Price and good
review: It has decent sound quality for headphones at this price. It certainly doesn't compare to apple headphones. I've already lost some headphones, so I don't want to buy expensive ones anymore. I won't be sad if I lose the cheap ones.

title: The receiver is a little too small
review: This earphone has good sound quality and noise reduction, but it is a little too small to cover the ear completely

title: STOPPED WORKING After 4 Months!
review: Both earbuds seemed to have trouble charging from the start, but usually if I unplugged them and tried again the red indicator light would appear. Now, after 4 months, the Left earbud will no longer charge whatsoever. I tend to be cautious with my devices' ports which makes this even more frustrating. I thought I had finally found a brand of affordable, reliable, wireless earbuds but I guess the search continues.

title: A nice headset for a reasonable price
review: I like this headset very much.  I had one in the kitchen,  but while my husband was working from home it got stretched out by his wide head. SO I bought a new one just for me. My 2 dislikes of this unit is: 1. I wish the head band was a tighter and 2. I am not crazy about both ears covered

title: Don't expect to use these as a "jumper" from 3.5mm to 2.5mm doesn't work
review: This jack moving from 3.5 mm standard earbuds with a mic to 2.5 millimeters for a cordless phone created such a terrible noise that they were unusable.

title: Absolute trash
review:
Garbage product at its finest. Sound quality was bad. I was hearing scratching sounds in some of the songs I was playing, that I would not hear in wired ear buds.

Battery life is trash as well. I had the pro version of these buds, and they lasted longer.

Overall not impressed at all with Samsung's wireless earbud line. Save yourselves the trouble & money, and steer clear of this product! Trust me!

title: Logitech
review: These have always been my goto headset for skype and other online chats. There only real downfall is the ear pads rot and replacements are not offered

title: Excellent purchase!!
review: This is a great child headphone! I bought this for a 6-year-old and she has no problem using it. The cord is very long so it's easy to move around. The ear covers are cushiony and prevent any sound from leaking out. Great purchase!!

title: Great buy!!!
review: Excellent graphics and ease of use. App store kids selection could be better. Do not like how the icons are automatically placed on the home page. Alexa is great! Wish you could listen to a movie while using other apps. Headphones work. A little too much glare. Amazon's help pages  good.

title: Highly recommend.
review: I really love these! Great sound for $10 headphones.  I asked if they could ship fast as I needed them for an event and they got them to me in 2.5 days.  Thank you!

title: Headphones now work on optical out!
review:
This is great! It has allowed me to finally be able to hook up my sound bar and AV headphones to my new LG TV. The LG TV only has the one optical out plug so you cannot use AV out equipment with it. Also, with the optical out if you hook headphones to that it cuts out the TV volume so you cannot have one person using headphones while the rest of the family listen to the TV.
With this Converter you are able to use the sound bar and the headphones at the same time. The tv volume can be adjusted to whatever volume you prefer and the headphones can be adjusted to whatever volume the wearer desires. You can also mute the tv and just use the headphones for listening without disturbing others!
On my tv I had to select LG sound sync optical on the sound menu to have everything work as I described. I am so happy with this since I had about given up on the headphone use after contacting LG several times only to be told that there was no way to do this but it appears they are wrong since it is working great!

title: Really good Earphones for the price, not Sony or Bose, but the for the Buck, Good product
review: I will tell you for being a low cost set of headphones these are pretty decent. Good sound, I use them a lot with my computer to listen to music so I don't disturb my animals or can crank it up if I love the song. Not perfect for traveling as a little bulky but they fold up nicely. I got a pair for my blind friend who listens to books on tape and she loves them.

title: A qreat quality buy at a LOW price
review:
2020...I just bought two more pair as this model is now discontinued. $10 each with free delivery is amazing. Love the bass.
2017...This is my backup for my existing pair that is the same. I have had $200 earbuds and these are underrated and low priced for the quality.
Yes, for earbuds, the bass is LOW.

title: Love the quality
review:
I heart these. Most earbuds aren't that great at the noise isolating, so even with my earbuds on while I work, I'm still aware of traffic noises from outside (the "joys" of living in a large city, right). I picked these up on a whim when the opportunity to get them for a discount came up, because who doesn't need a spare pair of earbuds. I was pleasantly surprised at the quality. Now, to be fair, I'm not an audiophile by any means. I have mild hearing loss so there's some ranges I can barely hear. Hence, I won't try and wax eloquent about the bass this or boom that, or all those things audiophiles say.

What I can attest to is that my music and podcasts come across clearly and cleanly on these earbuds. They're a comfortable fit. And the in-line controls work perfectly with both my iphone and my macbook. I usually stick with a $3 pair of earbuds, but now that I have these, they have become my new favorite every day pair.

This product was provided at a discounted price in exchange for my honest review.

title: Perfect fit
review:
This little case is so much better than I expected it to be. It fit my Samsung Galaxybuds 2 earbuds case perfectly even before I peeled off the adhesive backing off to secure the 2 halves. There is room so the case doesn't interfere with the hinge.
It also fit my replacement charge case that I got for my other Samsung Galaxybuds. I wanted to get something that matched my lavender buds, but couldn't find a matching replacement charging case. This cover comes in the same lavender. So, by using it with the black replacement charge case, lavender buds and lavender cover, it all looks intentional & very nice.
Super easy to apply.
Love the clip-ring. Easy to open, but not so much that I feel like I'll lose the case.
Overall, very good purchase.

title: Great case for Cowin E7 headphones
review: Good quality case, perfect size for the headphones it was designed for. Strong, hard sides to protect what’s inside. I put this in my backpack when I travel, and even if it ends up at the bottom I know my headphones won’t get smashed.

title: True Wireless Earbuds Cordless
review: These earbuds are awesome. Fit nice in the ear and are comfortable.  Great sound quality.  Would highly recommend these.  I'm going to buy a second pair for my office.

title: Great price. I need these to hook my earbuds to my iPhone
review: I use these to hook my ear buds to my iPhone my son states I’m really behind the times but I like the fact I can put my phone in my pocket and if it falls out I know immediately !!  Because it pulls my earbuds out

title: I liked the fact that the headset is as advertised
review: I liked the fact that the headset is as advertised.  It is comfortable to wear, works well and connects to my corded telephone without a problem.  The hands-free call center noise cancelling device is just that, simple to use and works!  I recommend everyone who works from home, is in a call center or need it for work should purchase this one.

title: works for older model office phones
review: My office has very old ATT phones that are not blue tooth enabled. This headset plugs in to the office phone and works great! Adjustable and comfortable on my head. Works really well.

title: Returned
review: Very nice headset but I had to return it. Purchased at the same time as my new phones, not realizing they didn’t have a headset jack.

title: Convinced the husband that HE needed these and he actually took them! lol
review:
i showed these to my husband as they were a "today's deal" and a great price. he was all for getting them. i didn't really think he'd be the one using them, since i'm the metal freak who uses headphones to listen to music.

boy, was i wrong. he has taken them over and keeps talking about the great quality and how they have actually marked the head phones left and right. i guess that's a big deal. they are pretty professional and fit his big ole head which was a concern i had after reading another person's review. :)

now he's taking them to work to block out all the noise in the land of cubes, in corporate america. so it's back to my old cheap ones that i've always used. sigh.

glad he likes them and is so happy to have them. he said the sound is wonderful and although they didn't say noise cancelling, they are. win/win.

title: Works, but I have to manually connect each time I use these headphones
review: The sound quality is average at best - somewhat muffled. These headphones pinch at my ears but hold on tight. The thing I have the biggest issue with is having to disconnect and reconnect each time I use these headphones.

title: Worked well with headphones, not so well with microphone
review: worked really well with my wife's headphones. Did not work with her condenser microphone.

title: Nice protective covering
review: I am writer and the proud owner of a iMac Pro 13” laptop, who was concerned about its safety. Lol I searched (with the help of my son) and it was suggested to purchase this sleeve. I chose the navy 14” for the extra room. The size I chose gave me the extra room for my writer “stuff”, (headphone, and note pad). It is very light weight,  and the fabric is very durable, (it is a canvas type of fabric). I am very proud of this case and will suggest  others to buy. There is a bonus…it has a nice carrying handle that can lie flat if you desire not to use it. I love it.

title: ...Just Love My Headphones
review: What can I say, I just love my headphones!!  I purchased these to listen to my CD's and movies via my laptop and I am enjoying it.  The sound is very nice the bass has a nice rich tone.  I treasure my headphones and because I don't want to share (not really) but I purchased a less expensive set for my grandchildren to listen to their Leap Frogs games and movies.  It does make a difference with them having their own headphones.  What a difference it makes (I didn't pay an arm or a leg for these, but the quality of sound is really nice).  I would recommend this set to anyone who doesn't want to spend a lot of money for headphones.  The price was right and I am so glad I purchase this set.  As I am writing I am listening to my 101 Strings CD via of my laptop using my headphones.  Beautiful!!

title: Great replacement headphones for my iPhone
review: I used my old iPhone headphones for years until they quite literally fell apart, so it was time to replace them. I ordered these from Amazon, and they are the same Apple quality headphones I love. They work great, are as good as the originals, and plug right into my phone using the lightning port. The only difference is that these headphones did not come in a plastic box like the last pair. These were in a cardboard one. But I rarely kept the headphones in the plastic box anyway, so it's not a big deal, it is just the only difference I can tell between these and my previous pair.

title: Echo Flex puts Alexa in small spaces
review: I moved my office into a part of the house where there was no Alexa nearby. I needed to be able to instruct Alexa to do things like turn on the lights, add items to my shopping list, check the weather, play my notifications, etc. This wasn't going to be a space where I would need to listen to music or make phone calls or check the news. So the Echo Flex is the perfect fit for this small space. The sound quality isn't stellar, but it wasn't advertised to be. It does exactly what I need it to do. Plus, I like that there's a USB port on the bottom of it so I can use it to charge my headphones. If you're looking for an extension of Alexa but don't need a great speaker, this little guy will do the trick.

title: An affordable alternate to Apple's pricy Airbuds
review: Everyone who has an Apple device wants a pair of Airpods. But who can afford the price point? Even on sale, they are on the expensive side. This pair of Bluetooth wireless earbuds is a nice alternative. You still get the practicality of no wires dangling between your phone and your ears when you exercise. You also get a pretty good sound too, as well as the touch commands that come with the more expensive alternate. This pair, however, doesn't maintain its charge quite as long as the original. Not a big deal, since I don't typically exercise for four hour stretches. My only hesitation is that I had a hard time keeping these in my ears. No matter which fitted tips I put on them, they stayed in my ears only as long as I didn't move my mouth. But if I talked at all, or chewed gum, or anything else that moved my jaw, I found that they fell out. So I had to be careful about that so I didn't lose them. Aside from that, however, these are a great, affordable alternative to Apple's buds.

title: Good Blue Tooth Device
review: This blue tooth device allows me to use my ear buds/headphones without cables running from the computer to my ears.  It frees up room and there are less cord tangles.  Also, I can plug it in (and listen to it) to a power source when the battery gets low to use/charge it.  I can also plug it into a speaker.

title: Nice and well made but I wouldn’t buy again
review: They really protect my earbuds but you don’t really need it because you can’t charge your buds so it’s just a case to hold my already nice case that at least I can charge buds.

title: GREAT bass, they last forever
review: These are the most incredible headphones of this style ever. GREAT bass, they last forever, and are lightweight on your ears. BUY THEM!

title: Sound was ok but they broke 3 months later
review: I've bought these before when Fred Meyers carried them and I loved them. The only problem I used to have with them is that the ear hook's rubber pieces would fall off. Well, buying these online I noticed that the ear hooks design was different and better so I was happy about that. Well 3 months later I'm fishing them out of my purse and one of the ear hooks snapped off. It's most likely my fault but I'm not happy about it. I still rate it 3 stars because the headphones themselves are great. Just be careful with them!

title: Awesome headphones
review: Wow. These are my first pair of nice headphones and I am blown away. After listening to them for a few weeks they just keep getting better. The bass was a bit muffled at first but after some playing time it sounds great. Not overpowering but just the right amount. Amazing trebles and mids. Every song I listen to is like listening to it again for the first time. I have played most genres through these and they rock every one of them. For the price I got them for I couldn't be happier. One problem though, I can't take these off! Don't waste your money on Beats and other overpriced, mediocre cans; these are where it's at.

title: Great earbuds, while they lasted... (Updated!)
review:
I really like the sound quality, the features, and the color. The only problem is that I have barely had them a month, and the first one is already going out. The sounds cuts out in one ear, and it keeps triggering Siri when I have them plugged into my Iphone. Great product, but just know that they don't last long.

They send me replacement headphones. So extra star for great customer service!

title: Dont buy!
review: Only one half of the headset actually works amd it is horrible quality, don't buy. I bought based on good reviews but it's not good at all

title: Awesome
review: Awesome headphones..they stay in my ears well. Good Sound qaulity.Great customer service also

title: Adorable and great fit.
review: I was very happy when I opened the package to reveal these headphones. I always have to search for ear bus that have a very small ear bud for my small ears. These look so adorable. I adore the small case that you can use to protect your head phones when your not using them. They have a very cute feel to them. I also love that they fit so well in my ears they are definetly noise canceling for me. Which is great for me at night.

title: didn't know what equipment was needed to use wireless
review: I'm sure I would have loved the earphones.  My tv did not have blue tooth.  Live in a VA nursing home, must have headset to listen to tv.  Wires are a pain in the butt.  Looking for another resident that might enjoy the wireless earphones.

title: Really comfortable
review: The only bothersome issue I have is occasionally only one earbud will sync to my phone. I have to start all over and it will work just fine afterwards. I do love them so far.

title: Affordable and great quality
review: Was reluctant about getting  wireless headphones Buy these had such a great price I didn’t see the harm, they have exceeded my expectations, most ppl can’t tell I have them in, my kids talk away and don’t even notice lol

title: If it was just a bad battery, I would have had it replaced.
review: There are two reasons for the one star rating. The primary reason is that I could never get it connected to Amazon's Fire TV (which I love). That is probably the result of a battery problem. The second and more important reason is that the strength of the plastic pushing on your ears may give you a serious headache. I have spent many hours, as a radio ham, talking to the world, and never have I had such an uncomfortable headset. I hasten to add that I don't believe my ears are any further apart than a normal person's. The grip is very tight.

title: Eh
review: They look cool but the sound quality is lacking. They are also, apparently, not meant for people with large heads. I only got these since I can no longer wear earbuds but they're tight enough to give me a headache.

title: So far, so good.. AND STILL GOOD!
review: So far so good. Opened today for Christmas. My 3 year old seemed to like the earphones at first: He's taken them off and now just listening aloud. So far he likes it. We'll see. The the thing is pretty though. Headphones are perfect for the little head and ears.Update: This has been a good buy. It's withstood my five year old for about a year now👌 It's been dropped countless to es and luges to and from the car and around the house.. literally. It's been outside on the patio..left there a few days..it will take a beating and keep on ticking! The charger still works perfectly and I also bought one for the car with a long cord so there aren't any problems there. I don't mount mine in my car.. obviously.. My son uses it for his night movies. Headphones not so durable. Broke those straightaway. Thee flimsy cord broke and therefore esndere then useless😑. Still, this is a great buy for t he moneny.

title: Unbelievable quality for the $
review: Great sound quality, comfort and noise isolation. They’re better than most $200 plus earbuds I’ve tried . I’m truly in shock about the overall quality and performance .

title: Great Bluetooth headphones that work great with voice to text
review: So far these are great headphones work great with voice to text and answering calls and speaking clearly I am very happy with the purchase

title: Don't waste your money
review: These are extremely cheaply made and feel like they would fall apart at any time. The ear cushions are hard and the headset is very tight. Uncomfortable to wear and the sound quality is poor to average. Noise cancelling is a joke.

title: Highly recommend
review: If youre looking to get a nice, more affordable pair of headphones these are it. I've went through A LOT of cheap and more expensive pairs from Amazon and these are by far the best.  If you're budget is in the $30-$60 range definitely get these. They're well made, comfortable and have good sound quality. And the noise cancelation is pretty good. I can't hear most ambient noises like people talking to me, cars driving by, dogs barking, thunderstorms, etc.

title: Don't waste your money
review: These are very cheaply made with very poor sound quality. I recommend investing a little more and getting some Falwedi headphones of your looking for some good cheap headphones.

title: Nice for the price
review: These are pretty good. They're serviceable. Decent sound quality and comfortable for in ear. I'd say these are best for those of us who dont like wireless but go through headphones quickly. My 5 year old son is constantly getting hold of mine and chewing them up lol so I need cheap but usable. And these are it.

title: Don't waste your money
review: These headphones are uncomfortable and the sound quality is awful. For one even if you have both the device and the headphones turned up to max it still isnt very loud. Also the sound isnt very clear theres a slight crackle. These are cheap so I guess you get what you paid for but I still wouldnt waste the money.

title: Also the headset is not really comfortable at all
review: This is not noise cancelling. People can still hear background noise so I'm surprised it's being marketing as "noise canceling". Also the headset is not really comfortable at all. I can only wear it for an hour before I get a headache from my head being squeezed.

title: Headphones
review: I have Bose headphones that I absolutely love, however, they aren't always what I want when I go for a walk or travel - just too cumbersome.  I have ear buds that were made from a mold taken of my ear.  These MEElectronics are more comfortable!!!  They come with different size covers for the ear buds.  I tried each one to find what felt best.  I wouldn't say they totally eliminate noise, but they do a decent job.  I wear them at the gym to walk.  The over-the-ear piece doesn't really mold to the ear - just loops over the ear and bends a bit.  But even so, it's enough to keep the ear buds in place without feeling like they are going to fall off my ear or out of my ear.  The cord is long enough that I can put my iPod in my pocket.  Comes with a clip on the cord, so I can clip the cord to my shirt and not have it flopping around.  They come with a nice case.  So far so good.

title: Only for in house use and good for 4 months.
review: There is 0 noise cancelation and neither the case nor the headphones hold a charge for as long as advertised. Also the right always dies way before the left. I’d be very upset if these were my primary headphones but since I only use them for phone calls in the house and to watch movies while my baby is either asleep or taking over the tv (we share a room) they’re useable. They’re cute but need improvements. One side stopped working after 4 months.

title: Great Value for the Price
review: I was surprised at how well this product fit in my ear. The mouldable portion did an amazing job at blocking outside sound. They include a mouldable piece for both ears. I didn't try using both with the radio headset, as I needed to hear other sounds. You can also buy a lanyard with plug inserts to create custom moulded ear plugs.

title: So far, so good
review: These did the trick, my son's SOL earphones stopped working and I thought I should change the cables and it worked, they sound like the original.

title: better than the one from beats
review: i love these!!! they are so much better than the one that come with beats. they dont attract dust as badly. i am throwing the ones with the b away and using these and buying more for all my earbuds.

title: crackling sound when i watch videos on youtube
review: i purchased this exclusively to watch videos while at work to replace another set of heavy headphones i had. these jlabs are crackly right out of the container. i love the look and the color but i can't stand the sound at all.

title: Possibly good if you have plain earbuds and do not mind lint
review: I bought this to house my Samsung S4 earbuds that came with the phone. Because the earbuds have a remote control attached, they do not wrap well in this very soft and flexible case, which becomes an odd shape as a result. I was planning to keep it anyway, however it is a lint magnet. Any piece of dust that adheres to it is very difficult to remove. Returning item.

title: Cheap and..... Cheap
review:
There are a perfect example of cheap bluetooth wireless headset.

No rotation for adjusting it in your ear.
The longest/largest don't come close to sealing off outside noises.
They are not comfortable in the least.
The sound quality is terrible when compared to another pair I have (those cost 35.00).

But, they make noise and are cheap.

If you've got the money buy up, if you need something to get by with, these are them.

title: A great set of headphones
review:
I absolutely love the 730s

I work in a automotive shop and am moving constantly. Ive tried corded headphones and the large around the neck kind, both either would get pulled out by normal movements or were just uncomfortable after a while.

These fit well and let in enough ambient noise so that they're not dangerous in my environment. I haven't had any issues with the ends popping off easily.

I listen to music and/or Audible every day for the last two months with these in.

I start at about 8:30 charge them at lunch (11:30-12:30ish) and listen all day again until 5:30.They don't give a low battery warning until right around then (5:30ish).
I have noticed that I get longer battery life with books vs. music fyi...

title: ... few other things that she absolutely loves it too bad there's not a spot where you can plug in ...
review: But for my granddaughter's birthday along with a few other things that she absolutely loves it too bad there's not a spot where you can plug in a microphone so she can sing-along we're going to try the earphone one and see if maybe we can get a pair of earphones that offended that plug-in but otherwise it was a big hit

title: Unbelievable
review: I just can't believe how good these cheap headphones are. Much better than more expensive ones I've had.

title: Excellent buds! Great value for price!
review: It is amazing how comfortable these earbuds are! So light and so minimal I hardly know I have them on. The sound is excellent, the phone button starts and pauses music and podcasts on my Android phone. I would give 5-Stars if they had a little carry bag or small hardshell case to carry them when I travel. Also, volume keys on the phone mic button would be nice so I could skip/ff/rewind. Otherwise excellent buds!

title: Some nice points, but cheap is cheap
review:
If you are looking for a cheap set of earbuds some nice features, you should consider the TOZO T-10. The charger/case, the assortment of various sized ear bud covers, and the amazing battery life are a pleasant surprise in such low-priced earbuds.

Two aspects of this product make it a disappointing value at best. First of all, the sound quality is only slightly above the economy-class earbuds on an airline.

The bigger reason not to buy this product is its poor reliability. Following several months of deteriorating sound quality, the Bluetooth capability simply failed completely after a total of 16 months of light use.

If you are value-conscious, it might be better to invest a little more money in a better-quality unit.

title: Not much better than the free earbuds on the airlines
review: Don't be tempted by the low price. The sound quality of these  earbuds is marginal at best. There is no noticeable noise cancellation. The charging unit failed after less than nine months of only light use, making them useless..

title: Incessant beeping on Earbuds
review:
These earbuds are generally satisfactory except for one huge, fatal flaw. These earbuds incessintly beep when you use the earbuds with a mobile phone and have another app (like Instagram, Snapchat, etc) open. The earbuds think that a video is being played, and will beep whenever the "video" pauses and plays. This function renders the earbuds nearly useless if you say scroll through your instagram feed while using the earbuds to listen to music.

The earbuds battery life is fine. About 8 hours. Needs to be charged every other day with regular use. Comfortable enough. But the beeping is such an awful flaw with the product that I can't in good faith recommend the earbuds to anyone. I would never buy these earbuds again because of this feature. I haven't been able to find any solution to remedy this problem. Would not recommend if you intend to multitask on your phone while using the earbuds.

Edit on 3/26: Anker Customer Service reached out and was very helpful in helping remedy my disappointment with the product.

title: Sound Quality Good but some annoying features
review:
The sound quality on these Yamaha earbuds are quite good and in line with similar priced earbuds from V-Moda and Sennheiser. I have no complaints with the sound quality and the sound sounds fine for all types of music. There are two major flaws with the earbuds however. The quality of the wires are just horrible, they are thin and rubbery and similar in quality to burner earbuds that one receives on a plane. Another fault of the earbuds is that the wire lenghts are unequal; the left earbud wire is shorter than the right earbud wire (I guess this is meant for exercising but it is frustrating for every other use of the earbuds). I have only had the earbuds for a few weeks now so I cannot speak for the durability but for the price (about $30) its a decent value.

UPDATE (01/31/2011): Earbuds lost hearing in left ear after about 50 days of use. I contacted Yamaha and shipped the earbuds to be repaired (I had to pay postage to Yamaha). About ten days later they sent me a new pair of earbuds.

title: Sound good but do not last
review:
The v-moda earbuds sound above average but do not last; one earbud died within 6 weeks of purchase and the customer service
is sub-par (+ they require me to pay shipping for their faulty product)

title: NOT good as a headset for computer. Crackle static when used with a professional docking station
review: Don't get these if you're planning to use them as a replacement for traditional headsets for video conferencing. I have a dual monitor setup, a high-speed docking station and all I hear is static and crackling over everyone's voice. Nice toy for your phone, but not for your home office set up. 200 dollars I could have spent on something useful like bose headphones. Which I now have and work great. Very disappointed.

title: AMAZING & COMFORTABLE
review: I purchased these so I could wear them for an interview. A 7 hour zoom interview with a presentation involved. I had my AC running in the background and the noise canceling worked great!. Unlike some other reviews, I could wear these all day and found them to be very comfortable and light. The low profile makes for a good look and the technology is superb. Sound incoming and outgoing. Highly recommend. Just for comparison, I have Bose noise cancelling over the head large headphones as well. These offer the same quality with a simple USB port so I don't have to worry about charging it. The clip and hand held controls work nicely.

title: Value for the price
review:
Pros:
Good price
Good sound. Delivers good lows, mids, and highs.
Comfortable even after an hour of so of use.
Durable

Cons:
Cord is really long and gets in the way sometimes.

Note: Do not compare a $20 pair of headphones to Beats or BOSE. I'm not going to say these sound as good as other have because the reality is they DO NOT. If you want that quality then buy those or a higher quality headphone set from Sony. I own a pair of BOSE and these are not comparable.

title: Ear buds with ear fin
review: I've been using the earbuds to listen to music during my daily runs (10 min/mile) without any issues.  They stay in my ear canal unlike other earbuds probably due to the 'ear fins'.  It really works well during the first week.

title: The headphones work quite well over Bluetooth. However, ...
review: The headphones work quite well over Bluetooth.  However, a key problem is that the SoundBot is NOT securely fastened to your ears.  The unit would slip off whenever I moved.  I would not purchase again.

title: Good value, May not be durable.
review:
Sounds was good, microphone worked fine.

One earbud no longer seems to charge and work for reasons unknown after just a couple of months.

title: Always a great buy
review: I bought these as a replacement for my last pair of Tozo earbuds after my kid got ahold of them. I didn't even bother to look around at other headphones, just headed right to the Tozo store to find good sound at a great value. I treated myself to some noise cancelation this time and have enjoyed just putting them in and enjoying silence.

title: Does not work to split 2 sources into one Powered Speaker output.
review: This is very well built, good materials and fit.  It may work fine on of splitting one source (iPhone, etc.) into 2 speakers (headphones, etc.), but it does not work to split 2 sources, e.g., Alexa and Sirius player, into  powered speakers.  I rated it a 3 due to quality of construction.  Suggest the item description clearly includes that it does not work as I mentioned above.

title: Not what I had hoped
review: This looks exactly like the earbud case that comes with westone IEMs. Unfortunately, that's the only way it is alike. The latch is very loose, and the hinge feels cheap. I am not a fan.

title: Not Kid Friendly
review: The volume is reduced too much on these, and they are not durable. Within less than a week, they had stopped working. The padding on the earphone had come off as well.

title: Great tv set
review: Best tv for the price. Only drawback is that headset can't work independently of tv speakers. Solved the problem with a headset/speaker splitter and a pair of small outside speakers. Other than that, the tv is great. Highly recommended

title: Work great with TV
review: I bought a new TV that doesn't have an audio out jack, only headset jack. With a splitter I was able to connect these speakers and headset to make them work independently. I love the volume and on/off control.  These are great speakers.  Highly recommended

title: Lives on to the promises of its predecessor Sony MDRXB50AP and oh more…
review:
Bought the predecessor last year which my kid yanked to play his Fortnite so the Daddy needed another one. And this is after me having a pair of AirPods Pro already. I feel a great wired portable headset with mic will always win against any wireless ones. These are perfect for my work calls, morning walk Spotify and workouts. Noise cancellation — I never care about. I will never be using a headset in a music concert or in a Super Bowl stadium!! Those who whine, go have a wine!! ;)

I am happy with a bass-heavy headset from a reputed brand that has an exceptional microphone.

title: Badass at under $30!!
review: Bass quality on this headset is mean and badass!! I don’t know how they fit all those drivers in this under $30 package. Super!!

title: really happy with the product
review: So, really happy with the product. Pros: No more sweat damaged headphones (or at least a warranty to cover it). No wire dangling in front. Forget they're there after a while. Bluetooth signal is great. Cons: expected richer, Bose-like sound at this price. Not so much. Also had a little difficulty getting everything fit in the ear properly. All in all, I'd definitely buy another pair but hope Jaybird continues to refine the quality of the sound.

title: Pleased
review: Fits my Audio Technica Bluetooth headphones well. Seems well constructed and sturdy.

title: Great Headphones for Running
review: First, I also own Apple AirPod Pro headphones, and really like them. I am a runner, and while the Pro's stay in my ears and are good for running, they aren't waterproof and besides, I use them at home and office and don't really want them gunked up with sweat. The Jaybirds are made for running, waterproof and with simple press-button controls. They stay firmly in my ears and satisfactorily block out surrounding noise. The phone app allows me to set my own equalizer settings (I prefer heavy bass), and the settings are transferred on to the headphones. That way I get the same type of sound even when I listen from my Apple watch while running and I leave my phone at home. These are my new running buddies, leaving my AirPod Pro's for lighter duty. I highly recommend these for running and gym!

title: Great, Comfortable Bluetooth Earbuds
review: These Beats are in-the-ear earbuds. I prefer this design to my previous Beats that hooked over the ear and never really went in-the-ear. Those had weak volume and let in surrounding noise. These isolate my music and provide great volume. I wore them on a four hour flight this weekend and they were completely comfortable. Battery lasts at least 8 hours as advertised. Highly recommend!

title: Very Good Headphones
review:
These in ear headphones are just as advertised.

To be clear, I use them with an iPod Shuffle, no controls for bass or treble.

They fit comfortably in the ear canal with a very low profile, very little of each earbud extends out. Combined with the black cord they have low visibility, a plus in my opinion.

The sound is excellent. At first I used the buds with the medium plugs, and I thought the sound was tinny with no bass. I was ready to return them. Then I put on the large plugs and amazingly the sound became rich and deep. The difference was so astounding I couldn't believe it. The sound is realistic, no overdone bass or treble, very clear and very pleasant.

The only downside is the cords. They are thin and tangle easily. They should last well, however, with a little care.

I am very pleased and can recommend these headphones.

title: Excellent and Convenient Ear Buds
review:
These are in-canal ear bud headphones. The sound quality is very good. Treble is excellent, bass is very clear, could be heavier bass for my taste, but still sound quality is very good compared to my best expensive headphones.
The in-line volume control is easy to access, easy to adjust and extremely convenient. I could reach down and adjust the volume on my ipod shuffle for each song but this is so much easier. The buds do an excellent job of blocking outside noise, and they come with an amazing variety of easily interchangeable earpieces, small medium and large in black, and a variety of colors.
I am very satisfied with the quality and value. They are easily the equivilent of much more expensive headphones.

title: Work really well, just as advritised
review: I purchased these with minimal expectations and am quite impressed. I have been using these with my cell phone and the sound quality is superb. Also, using these for phone calls is quite convenient. The microphone is great and sound quality is top-notch. Even when music is playing and you get a call it automatically pauses the music for the phone call and then resumes it when the call is finished. Battery life is way longer than I had expected; I have owned these for a couple of months now and have only had to charge them twice. Buttons on the headset are quite convenient as well.  I would say the only downside to these is that they are a tad bulky somewhat resembling earmuffs. Also, depending on your head size these may or may not fit on you; I can fortunately say that they fit me with no discomfort and stay on my head even when at the gym. Great product!

title: Five Stars
review: Awesome earphones! Great for gym workouts ! Use them all the time! Light weight and feels comfortable

title: Seem to be made well...would make a nice little gift for someone 15 and younger.
review: I purchased these for a 21 year old colleague.  They seem well made and I thought they were adorable but I think my colleague thought they were just okay.  I think I would recommend them for someone younger (perhaps under the age of 15).  Nothing against the headphones themselves...they just didn’t end up being as “cool” as I’d hoped they would be.

title: What You'd Expect For Kids
review: For $14.99 currently on Amazon with free Prime shipping, this is not a bad deal. The plastic headphones are easily adjusted to fit your child's head and ears quite well. The only complaint I heard regarding comfort was it slipped a little with glasses on and the soft padded ear phones tended to make their ears sweat a little. I double checked the package and website description and it says noise canceling, but I could clearly be heard talking by the child and I could hear every song well enough to know the title. However, there is a built in volume control that prevents kids from blaring their music in their ears - which is wonderful - so while you can hear what they are listening to, it isn't causing harm to their hearing. The only issue with sound quality was just a little bit of static that could be heard.

title: Awesome!!
review: I have used many bluetooth headsets in the past. I have never found one to be as wonderful as this headset. Set up is voice activated and extremely simple. It doesn't pick up a lot of background noise as I've used this in some pretty noisy areas without any complaints from the person I was speaking with. The top of the headset has the call/hang up button so no more accidentally hanging up on someone. I also love that I can answer the phone by voice command or say "Ignore" to allow the call to go to voicemail if I'm not able to talk. The battery lasts a good long time. Every time you turn the headset on, it will let you know the battery level - high, medium or low. It takes 20 minutes to fully charge, which is perfect for my busy life. I only need to charge it every three or four days it seems, but I don't generally talk long on the phone. I like that it came with different ear pieces. I like the over-ear style, but the inserts were very comfortable, too. My ear doesn't get as sore as it has in the past with other bluetooth headsets. Price-wise - I found the cost to be a much better deal after using this headset. This was a very smart purchase that I would make again.

title: Poor Quality
review: Sometimes I think I need to consider the name of a product when considering a purchase. The sound quality from these EarBombz really bombed. The earbuds did well to silence outside noises, but could not produce good sound themselves. Actually it sounded more canned than anything. We ended up having to return these thinking there might be a wiring issue but have since seen other reviews that complain of the same problems. The downside to purchasing them was we paid shipping twice - once to ship to us via media mail (but we paid more) and once to ship it back. If you have an issue and return them (and it's not purchased through Amazon) you will end up eating shipping costs, so carefully consider if it's really a purchase you want to make.

title: Got more than I hoped for.
review: I purchased this headset for home use to free up my hands while I cleaned, cooked, etc. It's absolutely perfect for me. I liked how light and comfortable it was to wear around my ear. The earpiece is actually very flexible, too, making the right fit easy to attain. The mouth piece doesn't smash up against your face as some other head sets I've owned. Callers can hear me loud and clear without any static on the line whatsoever. Granted, you do pick up background noises (although not to loud) so this wouldn't be a good purchase for a business where you'd like to have noise canceling features on your headset. You do have volume control through your handset, so no fiddling with your earpiece trying to find and adjust the volume. For as little as I paid, this was definitely a good buy. I would recommend it for home use.

title: They don’t fall off- highly comfortable and battery life
review: [[VIDEOID:53187eaf9258a34d9426b81a60f380c7]] Let’s get to the point - The quality of sound, the technology, long battery life, and comfort of the air buds are one of a kind. Compared to the other earbuds that are out there today. There is no comparison. We live in a society where technology is everything. These are the earbuds to beat as of now. I don’t know about you but I enjoy listening with my buds on and 16 hours you can’t beat it! You can shake your head in any direction and it won’t fall off. Don’t just listen to all the comments… Just get up, order them, and place them on your ears and enjoy the moment. Oh did I mention getting them on Amazon is $30 less than getting them through the company themselves and you can’t beat that.

title: Works great, and fantastic buy for the price.
review: Both my iPhone and my laptop use 3 ring 3.5mm plugs for headphones.  Since my work provided me with a Jabra Bluetooth headset (that I don't care for) and a wireless phone headset for my Cisco phone, I figured I wouldn't really need this, but thought it would be good to have a wired back up.  For $8, I expected something cheap, and while this doesn't feel high end, it sounds and works great.  Reading the comments, I suppose I got lucky, as the QC probably lets some buggier models through, but for the price I paid, I'm very happy with this headset.

title: Great
review: Loved them, only got about a 3 week use out of them as our dog decided to chew them. Up to that point the headphones were all I was looking for

title: You’re buying disappointment!
review:
I have extreme buyers remorse. As a loyal customer of Bose, I am disappointed. I prefer using quietcomfort and wished i had never gotten rid of my old wired Soundsports. I have had so many issues with these headphones.
1 - when you use the phone for calls, sound only comes through one ear. It’s extremely annoying.
2 - The volume does not adjust with my phone. The volume has to get adjusted through the app; The app is extremely slow.
3 - the ear buds are heavy and stick out of my ears, as if i have antennas popping out of my head. There’s a reason why there aren’t models advertised wearing these ear buds.
4 - the only way to “turn off” the ear buds are to put it back in the container or to let it turn off itself after like 20 minutes. It’s an inefficient way to try and preserve battery life.
5 - for the price, i would go with another brand.

The sole purpose of my headphones was to easily connect to my phone and to easily listen to music, and to easily have phone calls. It fails to do literally the only thing it’s supposed to do: project sounds.

title: Loved at first, but not anymore
review: I bought these because they were purple and they worked. Now, after a couple of months, only one ear bud works. I have no clue what happened, but only one earbud looks to be charging and only one works. This was a waste of money. And I really liked them too.

title: should have bought this nicer one a long time ago!
review: Plugs into device snuggly and sound clear allowing you and another to add headphones and listen to San program or music.

title: Highly Recommend!!!
review: These headphones are AMAZING. I cannot say enough good things about them. I have never, EVER found a pair of headphones or earbuds that stay in my ears during workouts. I constantly would have to push them back into my ears which was incredibly annoying. These headphones though, I have never ONCE needed to adjust them during workouts once they are in my ears. The battery lasts a long time and it is easy to charge. The headphones even tell you when the battery is low and when you should recharge. Easy to start/stop music, adjust volume, skip tracks, and although I have not used it to answer phone calls, it does that, too!

title: Love this!
review: This headset works great. Comfortable ear piece options and the sound is excellent.

title: Worked like a charm!
review: I needed to hook up my headset with a USB plug since I have an all-in-one computer and it has an audio in/out plug. I plugged this in, selected a USB mic and I was able to record and hear the playback in about 1 minute :)

title: Awesome Stocking Stopper
review:
My family each received one of these headphones as a Christmas stocking stuffer and they were a huge hit. The sound is amazing for such an inexpensive headphone. Best of all I no longer hear my daughter's music as no sound leaks out of these headphones. Comfortable fit and excellent value.

12/21/15 follow-up. I bought these headphones a few years ago and they still work extremely well. I've had more expensive headphones that stopped working shortly after purchase but these still produce great sound and are in great condition. Buying a few more for stocking stuffers. These are well worth the purchase.

title: Excellent sound but they stop working very quickly
review:
I purchased two of the J3 Earphones at the same time. One lost volume in one ear within hours of being used (running on the treadmill). The other lost volume in one ear within 5 months (used for walking). While Jlabs customer service is truly excellent and it was a super easy process to get replacements shipped for free I feel like it's just a matter of time before the replacements stop working properly. I would not purchase this brand again because I don't trust that it will continue to work well. Jlabs does appear to be aware of this issue.

PROS: Excellent sound quality and good price
CONS: Volume in one ear stops working suddenly

title: People can hear me very well, but the volume is a little quiet sometimes
review:
I purchased this headset after receiving several complaints about how I was impossible to hear on my old headset. The old one was a Plantronics Voyager headset from about 4 years ago... and after years of being tucked away in my computer bag or stuffed in my pocket, I guess it had given up.

With the new headset, people hear me extremely well... even when in the car, outside, or in a restaurant.

The only downside is that on some of my calls, the speakers are a little quiet and I would have liked a feature to boost the volume beyond what the phone will allow.

Rating this device at 4 stars because there is no option to "turn it up to 11."

title: Pretty awesome!
review: I love this sleep mask! I like to listen to audio books and music at night but it was a  nuisance to my family. I sleep on my side so regular headphones or ear buds, etc weren't comfortable. This is perfect for side sleepers! Its is so soft and lightweight, adjusts simply, doesn't completely block all noise, which is great since I need to hear the kids/dogs/etc. I have recommended it to several people who ordered them and love them as much as I do!

title: Works perfectly!
review: Just took these headphones out of the box, got in my 2010 Chevy Traverse and with out doing anything but turning them on they worked perfectly! Very happy with this reasonably priced purchase. Replacing a broken pair of headphones that came from the manufacturer for less than half the price is amazing! And, let me just say, the case that is included is the best! I just ordered a second pair!

title: Great product and gift!
review: My dog got into my first pair and chewed on them so I re-purchased these. They are still as great as the first day! I love being able to workout with no cords! Definitely recommend if you're looking for good wireless earbuds!

title: Powerbeats3
review: These were a replacement for my husband's other pair of Powerbeat Wireless Headphones.  His other pair he left in the car one day after coming back from his morning workout at the gym. When he went to work later that day he went to move the headphones on the seat he found that they had melted.  These headphones have great sound and are lightweight.

title: Powerbeats2
review: Husband got these for his gym workouts.  So far so good since we had heard that some of these ear headphones would quit working not long after they were purchased.  He absolutely loves the bass sounds that are heard from his music.

title: Gym/Workout Headphones
review: My husband needed a new set of headphones for his daily gym workouts.  He lifts weights and needed something that would not be in the way on his head or with long cords hanging around.  He is loving this set of headphones and says that they are the best he has used so far over the years.  The sound quality is very good and they stay put  and out of the way why he is doing his workout routine.

title: Sound is very Good
review: I purchased these for my son to use at work.  He put them on his computer and I listened to his music.  The sound was very good for a cheaper priced pair of headphones.  I was impressed and he is really is enjoying using them.

title: Pleseantly Surprised
review:
I was looking for a headset to go with my new HP laptop that did not have an echo effect; and the foldable set really surprised me, great sound, the cord-microphone worked better than I thought it would, and it does well at cancelling out sounds around me.
My only down is there the wires above the "ear covers" that are exposed that could easily become caught and pulled out.
But are worth the money.

RFT Nybro

title: Unusable worthless very bad mic, ok sound, good battery
