review: The sound quality is okay, I mostly listen to podcasts so it is perfect in that respect. The mic it really awful and unusable, however. It sounds muffled/quiet. Really disappointed. The battery life is great, 4-6hrs of constant use (I use one earbud at a time) and they recharge pretty quickly. I wouldn't buy these again tho bc I can't use them for calls.

title: UPDATED...Pretty go so far.... very short charging cord though.
review:
Super easy to pair, even for a technological dunce. Good fit, snug but not uncomfortable, even with glasses. Only downside so far is the charging cord is maybe 12 inches long.
Even after charging all night they still will not hold a charge for more than one hour. Also, if you wear glasses, the blinking light from the headphones will be a distraction.

title: Pretty Nice
review: I just bought mine at the local thrift store for ninety cents, was in mint condition.  Got it home thinking wouldn't work, threw some Pink in and it works mint.  Is kind of plasticky but I can deal with that it's still a Sony.  Has bass two levels and off.  Has anti skip and I tested it didn't skip once, right there it's worth a ten dollar Wal Mart cd player price.  But to move it further the radio tunes in very nicely and locks and doesn't come in and out like some radio tuners.  So that brings it up another five to ten dollars.  Has volume limiter just hold AVLS button to turn it on and off, I turned it off and now it's a thumpin little player with a set of JVC Flats.  It's worth 15.00 bucks or so.  If you don't like stuff that looks like it could double as a kids toy then don't buy, if you can get past that and hear the music then this might work for you.  It was worth the buck I spent, very, very pleased, this was a I want one item but couldn't justify spending fifty bucks on a new one when I just got a brand new Ariaaz mp3 player, but had nothing but a home system for my Pink and Kid Rock CDS and that broke, so I give this 5 stars for quality and sound.  Four stars on this review because of the appearance of cheap plastic. Wont crack though :) and mine had no headphones so can't say nothin about them.

title: Never had to use it bud feel secure for two more years left that if I need it it's there.
review: Never used it yet, but feels good knowing it's there if I need it for my mp3 player, which I take care of but what if it rains real bad, well then I'm protected wish it covered my headphones.  They worked with me to get it all set up with registration of my new product.  So know it's just a phone call if my Ariaz takes a dump.

title: 5 stars for what they are
review: These headphones sound amazing for the price, fit well, and look cool as heck.  Just worried I'm going to break them lying in bed with them on, bass is excellent, like I said for the price and better if not as good as the senheiser 202 that I had, I would recommend them is what is comes down to.  They are tiny though and move a bit on my ears is probably only drawback, thought they'd be bigger which is fine with me since doesn't seem to affect sound quality, and my ears don't sweat at all with them which my seneisers caused.  I using them with my new Ariaz player with full sound setting, and crystal clear with nice bass, not sure what else I can say light, sound great, good price, cool colors, just remember they are tiny so if you expect a full size set of headphones these are not them.

title: its big
review: Just got this today and it is exactly as decribed.  Good quality and works fine.  I of course found the new headphones I bought came first and have like a ten foot cord so this isn't really needed now, but I tested it anyway you lose some signal strength but not much.

title: call me kid
review: got these to replace my old set of deep bass ones, these are great with free ship & no tax can't go wrong with these and they came in like two days.(note I live in MN)  Buy these for cheap disposables, this is my fifth set of headphones with my cats chewing habits.

title: kid
review: Product came with one side messed up so they sent me another, then it was both right sided earbuds.  They refunded my money and let me keep both sets, so customer service was great, but they couldn't send a product without defects.

title: Craptacular Fit, Quality Sound
review:
I bought these headphones at Best Buy. When I got them home and was sitting around listening to them, I thought they were going to work for me; they sounded good and were comfortable. However, the next morning while riding the Metro to work, just the movement of the train made these fall out of my ears. I was using the smaller of the two sets of rubber ear pieces provided, but they still didn't fit well enough to stay in place. The weight of the cord alone made the left earbud fall out. All in all, I was pleased with the sound quality, but completely unhappy with the fit of these headphones. No matter how good they sound, if they won't fit, they're worthless.

I wouldn't recommend these unless you get a chance to try a pair on and make sure they stay put.

Also, no matter how many different ways I've tried to put the earbuds into the provided case, it never closes properly. The case also collects lint like nobody's business.

title: Super Bass
review: If you like deep throbbing bass that shakes your bones, these are the headphones for you.  I bought them as a gift for my husband because he has hearing issues (from playing drums with no ear protection).  I thought that the customized sound would be good but I’m not really sure if there is a difference.  He is happy with them though.  I took the hearing test and tried them with and without the customized sound and didn’t notice much of a difference.  However, I do not have hearing issues and my left and right hearing was pretty even so I may not be the best judge for that.  The sound is nice, clear and crisp top notes and the bass is easily adjustable from mellow to bone rattling.  I still prefer my Bose quietcomfort but these are definitely just as good and maybe better if you enjoy super heavy bass.  One complaint I have about them is you can only connect them to one device.  To sync to another device you have to manually disconnect from the first device and then connect to the second device.  I have Skullcandy earbuds and they do the same.  My Bose and my Beats Flex do this automatically so I know it’s possible.

title: Great Sound with Comfort
review:
Very easy to set up once I realized I was not supposed to hold the power button, just tap it, so it could pair with my phone.

I admit I'm not a sophisticated, technological music listener, but I do appreciate good quality, clear tone, and lack of interference. These Panasonic wireless headphones meet those requirements.

Classical music is interference and white noise free in the moments of orchestral silence. The guitar shredding of classic rock is note by note clear. And the twang of country singers is easily discernable.

Best of all, these headphones are easy to adjust, extremely comfortable, and lightweight so I don't feel like I'm wearing a 5lb. weight on my head. The cushioned ear pads seem to conform perfectly to my ears which helps to block out most, but not all, external noise.

title: Easy Setup and Very Good Sound
review:
I was expecting the ATH-DSR7BT headphones to be troublesome when wirelessly pairing with Bluetooth on my Samsung Galaxy phone but it paired before I finished reading the pairing paragraph. Woohoo!

I am using these when listening to Sirius on my cell during my daily 2+ mile walk. The sound is sharp and clear. The headphones are very comfortable though they fit snuggly enough that I can jog with them and not worry about them falling off.

These are not to be confused with noise cancelling headphones. I have Bose when I'm on a plane or somewhere else where I don't want external noise interference. But for walking I want to subtly hear what's going on around me for the safety of myself, my Lab, and others.

As with any headphone or earphone, the quality if the sound is largely dependent upon the device through which the music is played. A cell phone may not be the best use of these headphones so I can only imagine how blown away I'd be if I were using them with my computer or another device.

I highly recommend the Audio-Technica ATH-DSR7BT Wireless Over-Ear Headphones with Pure Digital Drive.

title: Deserves 10 Stars
review:
Wow!  I am astounded at the clarity of the sound; treble, mid range, and bass balance.  I was amazed at the earphone's noise cancellation capability - then I realized I hadn't yet activated the noise cancellation option!

These Huawei ANC earphones are phenominal and so much more comfortable to wear than any other earphones I have tried, both ANC and regular earphones.  This is the first pair of earphones that inserted easily and stayed in my ears without any discomfort at all.  The cable runs through the earpieces enabling customized support for each ear - genius!  This truly helped hold the earphones in my ears while exercising and rockin' to the music.

A dongle is provided for charging if your device is not capable of directly charging the earphones.  The in line volume control is intuitive as is the ANC activation switch.

Also, they are beautiful.  The box they come in rivals Apple's iPad box.  Very classy.  Upon opening the box you see stunning gold (almost rose gold) earphones.  Even the cable is nice looking.

Yes, these are quite expensive.  For someone who wants ANC and appreciates quality sound they are worth the price.  To me, they are near perfection.

title: Comfortable Though Sound is Not as Rich as Expected
review:
A couple of years ago I bought [[ASIN:B003S3RFIQ Etymotic Research MC5 Noise Isolating In-Ear Earphones (Black)]]. This is a mini comparison to the GOgroove in-ear noise canceling headphones.

GOgroove:
far more comfortable in the ear. I can wear them for 8 hours without realizing I have them in my ears.
stay in my ears - even if I'm in full rockin' mode. ;-)
fairly good noise cancellation.
the price is right if you're not an audiophile - the bass is somewhat lacking.

Etymonic:
better noise cancellation, blocks out noisy kids on the plane, the neighbor's yappy terrier, and unwanted conversation at the office.
somewhat richer sound; better bass and mid range.
difficult to get them to seat correctly in my ears and once properly inserted they don't stay in if I move too much.
hurts like a sonnofa_______ after about 10 minutes. I've tried all sizes of ear tips included, all of them hurt my ears.

As with all in-ear headphones, it's really dependent upon the shape of a person's ear canal.

GOgroove gets 5 stars for comfort and 3 for sound and noise cancellation...therefore a 4 since comfort is very important to me.

title: Didn’t fit
review: These did not fit my headphones I was kind of disappointed they seem to be made out of a plastic foam

title: Great little earbuds !
review: I like these earbuds they fit my ears I have very small at your holes in because up from a little bigger than a small adult to almost a kids size sounds great and bass like I’ve never had

title: Great product and great price!
review: I live near a train track and wanted to be able to hear my calls without the blasts of horns. These headphones definitely make a difference. I can hear clearly what someone is saying on the call. The headset is also very comfortable while wearing for 8 hours.

title: They work
review: Easy to install. Good storage idea for headphones- frees up desk space for other stuff

title: Great headphones, expect clip to break
review: I love these headphones. They are well priced, sound good and last. I have had very good luck in the JBL department. I have their speakers also. I'm more than happy with their items. One thing about these headphones that may be useful to know is that the clip on them has either been broken on arrival or breaks within a week. I already know this happens and have come to expect it. If that's important to you don't buy them. The price and sound are too good in my opinion to let that bother me.

title: works well but not on everything
review: Not all devices like having the dongle plugged in, my headphones come to mind, but on the devices it does work on (my ipad for example) it becomes hard to live withoit

title: My hubby is jealous
review:
When my hubby saw what headphones I got, he was jealous because he has a slightly older version and they’re his fave headphones. I can see why. Excellent noise canceling. Great sound quality. Nice hard carrying case. They’re pretty comfy.

Only complaint is that the mic wasn’t as popular on phone calls as the mic on my Sennheiser headphones. The person I call most regularly said it’s harder to hear me. But I mostly use them for headphones, not a mic so I am okay with that. Headphones are 5 overall while the mic is 4.

title: Cooling feature works
review:
I like USB headsets like this one because I can actually plug the headphones into the USB-Hub instead of the 3.5mm jack. Anybody who undocks their laptop a lot will LOVE that. The audio quality is good and they are attractive headphones.

I did want to bring up the ear-cooling feature: My wife got me this headset and I used it for several days, completely unaware that the ear-cups have a cooling feature. I want to be clear, it's a GOOD thing I didn't know about it. I might have avoided buying these headphones if I had known about this feature because, frankly, I've experienced mid-west winters and I *hate* having cold ears. That would have been a mistake because these headphones DONT chill your ears, they just keep the temperature from rising. In other words, the headphones don't feel cold, but if you stick your finger in you can find the cooling element, and it's definitely working! It's just not next to your ear and making it uncomfy. In other words, I have NOT be sweating in these headphones and that's exactly what that feature is there for.

In short, I *like* the cooling feature because they made it nice and innocuous. Very nice!

title: Nicely done
review:
I'm not an audiophile, so sadly I'd recommend looking at another review for details on the audio quality of these headphones. I personally think it's great, but I have aged ears and just want to be up front about that.

I think what has really made me warm up to these headphones is that I can tell a lot of effort went into some of the more subtle features of the headset. For example, you turn them off by twisting the headphones so you can lay them down flat. Turn them back to the 'over-the-ear' position and the headphones come on. Not only that, but when you put them on a voice tells you how much battery you have left. To put it another way, unlike my other wireless headphones, I don't have to find the nearly-invisible button to activate them. I think the noise-cancelling is good, too.

If I had one criticism it's that when you use the smart-phone App to configure the headphones they throw a term or two at you about how to configure them that is a little odd, to me anyway. They describe the configuration of your headphones as 'moments'. As I understand it, a moment is just a snapshot of an area you're in so the app/headphones can determine optimal settings. The settings would be different in your home vs. in a bus vs. walking in the park. Why 'places' or 'environments' wasn't chosen... search me. But that's just a teeny tiny criticism about their choice of words, not a flaw or anything like that. Overall it works fine.

Nicely done!

title: Good noise cancellation bad sound
review: These headphones do decent noise cancelling, but at the cost of the quality of the sound!  They're still useful, but the damage it does to the music I listen to makes me treat the noise cancelling feature as a compromise.  If you are big into music quality, give these a pass.

title: Exceeded my expectations
review:
Normally I give a product 4 stars for 'meets expectations', and this product easily does that. It comes in a small box, is easy to assemble, and works exactly as advertised! The reason I gave it an extra star is because I bought this not being entirely sure why I want or need it. Well, now that I have it, I feel stupid for not buying one (or more) of these sooner.

This last Christmas I received a pair of very nice bluetooth headphones. They'd normally lay on my desk when I'm done for the day. Now that I have a stand for this set up, the headphones now have a permanent home, I've even brought a cable near them so I can charge it. Now that's nice for convenience, but here's the bit I did not take into consideration when I bought the stand: The base of the stand is a MUCH smaller footprint than a pair of headphones laying flat on the desk.

That's right, I got some of my desktop space back with this stand. I have no idea why, but it had just never occurred to me that the headphones standing upright would make my desk neater.

It's very likely I'll be purchasing at least one more of these in the near future just for the desk-space-savings.

title: Block sound well and comfy
review: The audio quality of these headphones is really good.  Normally I give 4 stars for a 'meets expectations' product, but I went the full five because the material they used to make these headphones does a really good job of muting sound, especially in an office environment.  (Note: I am NOT saying these have noise cancelling, I'm just saying if you put these headphones on they block a good deal of sound.) They're also light-weight and compact fairly well for travel.  They're a weird mix of high quality and compact.  Very nice!

title: Occasionally glitchy coming off speaker, but mostly good.
review: Good sound.  Decent battery life (at about 3 hours  of use I knocked them down to 45%) I like the concept of just lifting the headphones from the speaker to go back and forth but find it kind of gimmicky.  I find my using at as a speaker or a pair of headphones but not going back and forth between the two.

title: Great sound for a small speaker.
review: Great sound for the size and price.  I usually use headphones when I want music, but I recently starting using a hula hoop and find headphones a pain to deal with while hooping.  This seemed like a good solution, and it was.  On the lower volume settings it is perfect for the small room I'm using it in.  Easy to use (assuming you know how to pair a device).  If you do not have such knowledge, I'dl look it up online as the manual is in tiny tiny print / pictures which will be hard enough to see, let alone understand.  The cloth and bamboo styling are gorgeous.  If I have a complaint, besides the manual being worthless, it's that it makes a pretty obnoxious ding when you power them on and off.

title: Not so great
review: They are lightweight, the audio quality is decent, but they don't fold up very compactly and the iPhone button on it only controls playback and not volume. .  Unfortunately they do almost nothing to block sound so I'd question their usefulness in noisy places.  That said, they're no worse than similar headphones, but I wanted to raise the issue in case pictures of the product lead you to believe that they are thicker than they really are.  Personally I'd prefer to use the standard iPhone earbuds.  I'd give it an extra star if it were under $10.

title: Skip them.
review:
We own several pairs of headphones. Wired and wireless. With mic and without. Thus far these are by far our least favorites.

They're less than comfortable. More importantly they simply do not work for us. We're in a city. Sometimes we talk on the phone outside where you're competing with traffic, voices, etc. They headphones simply could not hold up to that, which is daily everyday usage here. They neither blocked out any outside noises nor did they have a good enough sound quality to compete with what was around us. Another common use of the headphones in our house is to help keep us entertained while in the gym. They were used for that once before being thrown in a drawer.

I simply cannot find any reason to recommend this pair.

title: Great headphones
review: This is a great set of headphones.  I have a small head and they are snug enough to walk around in, but not jog, like I was hoping.  Overall, they have great sound.  I use them a lot to watch shows at night as to not wake anyone.  I have tried all kinds of ear buds and they don't stay in, so I did some research on affordable headphones.  These are a a great set for the price.

title: Not Recommended.
review: I have to say, this is the most painful headset I've ever had the displeasure of using. I would have returned it, but I convinced myself that perhaps it would get better with use. But no, here it is three months later, and the thing still gives me a horrible headache within about fifteen minutes of putting it on. I have a fairly small head, so it's not as though the thing had to try and stretch across a wide space. No, it's just made so that it crushes the ears against the head.

title: Great Little Headphones
review: Can't find better headphones for the price. They are nice and lightweight and the sound quality is better than you'd expect, given how inexpensive they are.

review: If you own the ~$80 apple headphones where there are the silicones that get replaced, you know that anywhere you go to buy replacement silicones only has them with the hole to go over the speaker where the hole is too big -- the standard ones only fit, for instance, the headphones that come with Samsung phones. THIS ITEM IS THE CORRECT SIZE FOR THE APPLE HEADPHONES. This is NOT false advertising.

review:
Works amazing. Worth the price.

Has a mute feature on the headset. Which I had a hard time finding a headset in this price range that included mute feature on the headset itself. Very slim, stays in my ear.

Excellent.

review: These worked great for my 16 month old. Were a tiny bit small but tthey still fit good enough to stay on her head. Perfect safety headphones so they never hear it too loud.

review: I had another pair of these that I ordered from Apple that were stolen and I was devastated because I love them so much that I ordered another pair. They are sound cancelling and comfortable sitting over the ear. I was never into bulky headphones like this before but after owning these I probably won't get anything else. I even use them when I shoot my gun because the noise cancelling is that good. I recommend them if you are considering buying them!

title: AMAZING!!
review: Wow, these headphones are fantastic! I noticed a difference right away in sound quality! I heard things in music (and games) i never noticed before! AWESOME!

title: plug in headphones, good length, can use for phone, or computer
review: easy to use and very comfortable. Nice length for the earphones headset. Good sound too. I would buy them again if I need another set.

title: Love them!
review: I am very happy with these earbuds!  The sound is good.  They are easy to use.  It did take me a couple of tries to get them synced together but I am tech challenged.  Synced with my phone with no problems. Slightly bulky in my ear but not uncomfortable.  Fit better than others. Would buy again.

title: Sick n tired of cheap Amazon crap that never lasts
review: 2nd of 2 types of headphones bought in the last six months. Neither lasted more than 4 months. I'm ready to pay more for quality items at a local retail store I can return defective items to in person. This sucks

title: Fits my work head set.
review: Love that this was easy to change. For well. Glad to have my wireless headset back since I like the 'mobility' better than my wires headset.

title: Great upgrade from the clip +
review:
This zip is great! I have installed Rockbox firmware on it since the included sansa firmware does leave room for improvement. I use it for listening to audiobooks everyday. It is great that it has the option for a micro SD card. Since I just click and drop my audiobooks onto the SD card, I still have plenty of room on the unit itself for music.

I got this to replace my sansa clip+ that I lost when running through the airport to catch a flight. I like that this uses the same charger as my cell phone.

I did not like the cheap earbuds that came with it, but that is no big deal because my son likes them.

Regarding those who have had issues with it not turning on, hold in the power button for almost a minute, not just the 20 seconds that Sansa states and it should power back on. The only times that I have had to do this is when it got a static "hit" from a fleece throw blanket and holding the power button for almost a minute has gotten it going again.

To those that do not like the sansa firmware, I highly recommend checking out the rockbox FREE open source firmware download for this unit. It allows more options such as being able to auto set it to rewind a user specified # of seconds after pausing or stopping the unit, which is fantastic for audiobooks. Also it has games that allow you to take advantage of the larger screen on this unit, a bit small for my liking, but it keeps the kids from getting too bored whilst waiting somewhere.

title: gave them away because they weren't the best ever, but ok
review: They were ok, gave them away because they weren't the best ever, but ok. Needed real headphones for sound.

title: Good headset. I use for traveling
review: Good headset.  I use for traveling.  Not much for noise reduction on an airplane, but great for short trips.  Folds up nicely for carry on, but I do bring my AT's over-the-ear phones for long flights.

title: Excellent Headset
review: This is my fourth 510.  I have a headset on for at least 6 hours a day.  This one is comfortable and the best value I've found.  My only complaint is that the microphone quality degrades over time (about 6 months), probably because it just fills up with dust & dirt.  At that point everyone tells me they can barely hear me, even when talking loudly.  So, its time to replace it.  Haven't found, or heard anyone recommend anything better.

review: Very nice headphones. They are comfortable to wear for long periods of time and have great sound quality.

title: Disappointing
review:
I purchased this because I lost my original Apple connector. I started using the first one in the package Dec 19th.
(Today is Jan 12) I use headphones to walk and workout while listening to audible books. The first week everything was great. Then the narration of books would stop, or I would have to jiggle the cord to get to connect, then I had to take it in and out of the plug to play or then you could hear the story out loud even with the plug in. Tonight the book simply refused to play while it was plugged in because it was cutting out so much. . I tried my head phones on the gyms plug to watch tv. Everything worked great. Attached the new iphone connector and the story played out loud without going through the head set and connector. Totally frustrating. I finally determined it was the connector. I found my old connector that is a genuine Apple and guess what...everything worked the way it was suppose to even while running on the treadmill. I haven't tried the second connector that came with the faulty one. When the first connector worked, the sound was great. But either the one I used was a faulty one or its just a disappointing failure. Sorry I just can not recommend this product. I guess for the price, I should not have been disappointed. You get what you pay for.

review: They claim to fit my Sony headphones, but they really don't fit. They technically fit on my earbuds, but they come off and stay in my ear every time....which means they don't really fit the earbuds. They are much smaller than the original ones. Very disapointed

title: Great Quality For Kids(and adults) and for Price!
review: Love these headphones! She is not easy on anything and these have already lasted longer than the 2-3 weeks than the $20 pair that we bought at Walmart! I'm thinking of getting a pair for myself! Just a warning though they are pretty good at canceling out sound. So don't get mad at your kid of they don't answer when you call for them.

title: Birthday gift gone bad.
review: My daughter got these for her birthday and they are already not working. I mean these didn't even make it a week and the left side quit working. I wish they would make good headphones that last.

title: But love it when she wears them they are so freaking ...
review: Adorbs. First pair broke, my youngest is hard on earphones, to be fair. But love it when she wears them they are so freaking cute.

title: GOOD
review: I LIKE THESE HEADPHONES.  THE SOUND IS GREAT, HOWEVER; I WISH THE BUTTONS WERE HIGHER UP LIKE THE HEADPHONES THAT COME WITH THE IPHONES

title: Good sound low battery life earphones
review:
Overall these earphones are a solid grade B:
sound quality (bass) are good, look and ergonomics are all nice while battery life is a big minus: you get 2.5-3 hours of continuous listening after which it starts annoying you with the sound that a battery is running low until it automatically shuts itself in about 10-20 minutes. If the battery life issue is solved - I’d totally settle for these over Apple equivalent but ... not yet..
Update(11/2022) They went to garbage!! One of the pods would not charge anymore. Yes, I accidentally dropped them a few times, yes, one pod had a crack in it but kept working for a while until it stopped charging. Would I buy another set - probably not. I switched to Beats and loving them much more actually. I don’t get annoyed by the short life of a battery which was a huge turn off!

title: Decent quality for the price but earmuffs are not durable
review:
Nice headphones with velvety earmuffs. Great quality of sound and decent sound proofing. Work great for my office use!
Update (05.10.2021). Earmuffs begun disintegrating - see picture - three months ago, the ring that holds earmuff in place completely ripped off and the other one is holding on a thread.. Unfortunately I ceasing successful to find replacement to the earmuffs as of yet, but I’ll continue the search. Quality of the sound is great but earmuffs is a big con!

title: nice quality for the money paid
review: These lasted for a bit more than two years, but for the cheaper made quality headset - the sound was loud and clear .. until the day when it (sound) begun dissapearing : first - in one of the ear cups, then both. Moving my head around helped for awhile but I quickly got tired of the need to constantly move my head around trying to get the sound back in.. Overall Ok quality for the money, but I'd look for better headphones next time.

title: lasted two years and went to garbage
review: they lasted two years exactly, I was overall satified with the quality of sound, but today I noticed the sound was 90% down from what it usually is and even though my computer sound volume setting was 100% I could barely hear anything.. anyway, I pulled the jack hoping to fix the sound and after a few jerking moves it came off completely.. and there went my earphones.. straight to the garbage.  Ohh well..

title: Nice looking and very light laptop backpack
review: I ordered this backpack as a gift so I can't comment on how it will wear, but I can comment on how nicely it looks and how well it is made. The confusing part is that label says for up to 15" laptops, but my 17" Dell laptop fits just right in and it seems to feel nicely while on the back. The padding adds a lot of comfort too. Very NICE looking, has lots of features that add on value. For example, the pocket for IPod or phone or whatever you prefer to listen to has a convenient slide-through pocket which allows you to nicely organize your earphone cables. Overall I'm pleased with the quality and look of this backpack and definitelly recommend it to anyone looking.

title: Nice headphones that fit very comfortably
review: My favorite headphones.  The earbud is slightly off from the wire part, a little hard to describe, but in my opinion it helps fit better in my ears.  I have smaller ears so I usually have a problem finding headphones that fit right, don't hurt after a few hours or that don't fall out.  These haven't had any of those problems for me.  I also love they are pink...makes them so easy to find!  I prefer these to the iPhone 6s plugs that were included. I've used it on my iPad, iPhone 6s and iPhone 4.  The sound is very clear.

title: Buy these ! They are wonderful !
review: I am so thrilled with these headphones !  The main thing that makes me smile is that they are gorgeous. I love the deep redwood look. When I initially saw these and read about the wood construction I wasn't sure what to make of it. However now that I've used them I think whoever designed them completely achieved a great set of headphones that are also a work of art. The chrome / silver next to the natural redwood looks just amazing. I also found the sound produced to be fantastic. I actually had a coworker try them on and they thought they were Noise Cancelling because they work so well. I noted some questions about this since they are stated as being Noise Canceling. They do not produce white noise for noise cancelling yet they work as well as my noise canceling headphones that generate white noise. I feel this is a plus because I'm not having to use a battery or external power for the noise canceling yet they do an amazing job at blocking out noise. The cords are cloth, which means they have less memory than rubber cords in my opinion. I personally think they are better quality and love them.  I have nothing negative to say about these. title: 3d Sound audio controller a good sound, but….
review:
Testing this item took a bit of time because of an audio popping sound ONLY when starting, restarting, and shutting down the computer. I am testing this device on a Mini PC running windows 10 and the Mini PC output jack has gone looney and will only play one channel, so I needed a good USB audio controller to connect to the computer USB port.

At first I thought the problem was possible because my speaker monitor cable was not working properly, but replacing with a new one didn't solve the problem. Then I thought maybe it’s the Mini PC so I connected the 3D sound audio controller to a different full desktop PC running a newer Intel 10th generation motherboard with USB 2.0 and 3.0 ports. The test results were the same when turning on and off the computer. It’s not an annoying pop sound but I could certainly hear it. It didn’t matter if I turned the volume on the computer up or down as the pop sound was still there. I also did a final test connecting a pair of headphones to the 3D Sound audio controller and got the same pop sound results when turning on and off the computer.

Final thoughts: This device does sound good through my monitor speakers after the pop sound stops. Another thought is because my monitor audio turns on automatically as the computer begins start up. The sound quality is clean and clear while listening to videos and audio, and if I had separate audio amplifier and kept it off until after the computer start up, all would be fine.

title: WavLink is top of the Line!
review:
Setting up this Wavlink was easy. I have used other models of this product line and they are sensational!!

After I downloaded the display Link software and installed it on the PC, then with Computer off I connected the Wavlink USB-C data cable, power supply, data cable to PC USB-C, and monitor cables. A straight USB-C to USB 3.0 cable is included if you don’t have USB-C on your PC. Turned on the Wavlink power button first, then the computer, and the monitors lit up instantly. The picture shows the quality in HDMI on 27-inch monitors. I tested the audio port and it worked using headphones.

These are excellent docking stations with plenty of other connections if needed. The display link software is a small patch that resides on your hard drive and in the control panel programs folder. It does have a tray ICON but you can turn it off in your Taskbar settings.

This product is perfect for connecting 2 more monitors to your computer. I think Wavlink is one of those exceptional companies that makes dependable products, and this one is certainly worthy of 5 stars!!

title: Small and powerful
review:
While trying this unit out, we noticed a little noise in the headphone input at high volume without any music playing through high quality headphones and only listening for noise. I also moved the power supply further from the device and it made no difference. The slight noise is not a hum but rather a low white noise, and all connections fit tight and of good quality. When music is playing you can’t hear the noise. I will say that the headphone amp otherwise is powerful and lows and highs are very good. The send and receive connections work rather well and are a nice addition if you wanted to add an effects device to enhance your sound a bit.

I also tested this amp while playing music from a good quality cell phone and it is pretty clean. If you have a set of small bookshelf speakers that are 8 or 4 ohm this amp can be loud enough for a home workshop and separating the speakers at least 8 feet apart for better stereo. It sounds good listening to podcast too.

Overall: The Just Amp 5 is a good sounding mini amp addition for music lovers. I let it run for a few hours and no excessive heat. Actually it runs rather cool. All the knobs work smoothly and click when in the center position. The mixer slider works smooth with no interference. With the exception of that bit of noise as described above, this is a nice little amp.

title: Lightweight and great sound!
review:
These earbuds were simple to set up and pair with my cell phone. They come with 3 sets of silicone ear tips. The size you choose may change how these earphones sound. These earphones are touch sensitive which means you can turn them on and off, change the volume up or down, and connect to your cell phone for texting and making calls if your phone supports it. There are many other touch sensitive features using all the multifunctions listed in the manual. I tested by making phone calls and texting and both features worked flawlessly.

The audio sound quality is nothing less than wonderful once I adjusted my cell phone's audio player equalizer function. I also liked how truly comfortable the earphones are. I will point out that these earphones may take a little time to get used to using the touch sensitive feature but a little practice is all it takes.

Charging your earphones is simple and done by placing them in the slots on the charger. It has a green digital readout when the cover is closed showing the percent of remaining power while plugged in with the USB cable. I uploaded a picture showing this. The charger case is also a very strong protective design. I own several earphones and so far these are my favorite go-to ones. I totally admire the folks who designed these earbuds, and I am giving them 5 big stars!!

title: Headphones and mic work great, clear audio and comfortable to wear
review: What a great little headset!  The headphones are lightweight, comfortable, adjustable for different head sizes, and the ear pieces are well padded.  The mic cord is bendable to adjust to the shape of your face.  Overall these are very easy to use, run via USB so plugs right into your computer,  and the volume adjustment, mute and mic on/off button right on the cord. We tested on a computer with Windows 10 OS. The computer audio automatically detected and defaulted to the headphones as soon as they were plugged into the USB, and sound clarity while watching / listening to videos was wonderful.  The audio was very clear, not muffled, and there was no static.  I am very happy with this headset and will get a lot of use out of it.

title: Five Stars
review: My daughter loved these headphones. Would definitely recommend it. Great product.

title: Exactly as described
review: Product received was exactly as described. My tween daughter loved it. However, that earbuds only lasted about six months before they no longer worked. Not sure to attribute that to the product itself or the wear and tear caused by tween.

title: Exceptional Quality headphones... I can’t workout without these headphones...
review: I usually don’t write reviews but this headphone Worked extremely well almost close to a year... sound effects were good and excellent noise cancellation ... When it stopped working I still had the warranty when I contacted the customer service they provided exceptional service.... Will order again in the future...Highly recommended... 5 stars for the quality and to the Service...

title: Bought this headphone a second time and the quality of this product is degraded and got worst.
review: I bought this headphone for a second time since I have lost my first one recently.  The quality of this product is degraded comparing to the first one.  The very short charging cable came with the box has a wrong connector type but luckily I still have to first charging cable so it not an issue but it would be for you if you did not have the correct charging cable.  The blue LED light on the headphone to indicate the full charged battery is not working.  The LED turn from Red (charging) to no light indicator.  Luckily I have sync the headphone to my phone so I can see the headphone battery full on my phone.  I will try a different product the next time.

title: Randomly reconnects to phone when in charging case.
review: These earbuds sound great, have full functionality (pause, volume, skip forward and back, etc.). I had to return them because, they were constantly reconnecting to my phone when locked inside the charging case. This would happen when the case was in my pocket, on a nearby table, whenever. This is a deal breaker. Hate when you answer a call on your phone and don't hear the caller...then find out that the earbuds in the case in your pocket have at some point reconnected.

title: Disconnects constantly, sound quality is good.
review: I’ve had these for years but like many others they randomly disconnect and beeps. You have to turn off the earphone and turn off Bluetooth on your phone. Then you have to then on blue tooth, ear phones and pair again to get it to work. It’s really annoying. Other than that, the sound quality is good and it stays in the ear.

title: I LOVE these!
review: I LOVE these headphones. I was wearing them when my granddaughter saw them. Boom, gave them to her and ordered again. I wear them all the time and lost order #2, hopefully they’ll turn up somewhere in the house!  I am now on order #3 and truly can’t say enough about them. You don’t order 3 times unless you LOVE them. Great sound, long lasting, perfect fit.

title: Poor customer service, avoid buying this brand.
review: These headphones died during their warranty period.  Manufacturer will not stand behind their product.  Don't waste your money.

title: conectivity
review:
I was really exited about these..I'm an audiophile..love my music
I listen to music in the shower but live in an apartment complex so I worry bout bothering my neighbors...
if you want these for listening in the shower you better have your blue tooth source about 3 feet away
as soon as it gets wet...PPPPPPPPPPPP

title: GREATTTTTTTTTTT!!!!!!!!
review:
these tips will make a lower priced set of earbuds sound 1000% better
I bought a 17$ set of earbuds just for talk radio

WOW!!!!

bottom line.........
LUV EM
Thank You

title: Decent sound.  Good battery life.  Annoying rattle while running/jogging.
review:
This is my 4th set of these earbuds. The sound and battery life are good as expected.

Each time the content and quality seems to be slipping. Gone are the foam inserts and the extra magnetic phone holder pieces. I can accept this - I understand that companies need to be profitable and optimize the product content for things the customer is willing to pay but I do expect basic things like minimal build quality and some form of customer service when things don't go well. .

I really wanted to like these earbuds but unfortunately, there is an annoying rattle coming from the right side earbud. The rattle drowns out the music while running/jogging. I have attempted to contact the company via their website but no response as of 2 weeks. I'm a bit concerned they will not stand behind their product. Just disappointing. Buyer beware...

title: Good value wireless sports earphones
review: These are our “go to” wireless earphones for sports.  They work well, sound good, and are a good buy.

title: Nice sport earphones.
review: The earphones fit perfectly and stay in place during your workout. Nice design. One of switches triggered voice control on my iPhone, which became annoying, but I fiddled with it and it seems to be OK now.

title: Better than expected
review: I saw the reviews on this headphones and I just had to try them. For the price I couldn't go wrong. I was so happy with the packaging and the little container it came with. The sound quality is really good. I forget to charge them and they last pretty much the whole day while I am at work. A great feature is that I can connect both my phone and computer at the same time. Also when you take a phone call you can hear on both ears. I would definitely purchase these again.

title: Works well for workout
review: I use these earbuds when I exercise. Appreciate the water resistance. Stays in my ear.

title: Great sound
review: I like the sound. Use when exercising. Like that I can adjust the earpiece around my ear. But, as usual, I have difficulty keeping an earbud in my ear. However, Senso fits better than any other brand.

title: The instructions were faulty, however....
review: I was going to return them because the instructions on how to charge headphones was inaccurate. The red light did not come on indicating they were charging. I called tech support and after numerous attempts they agreed they would not charge. They were sending me a replacement set and a return postage sticker. I decided to try them a day later and they worked excellent. I listened to music for over 7 hours. I am guessing somebody charged them then returned them. The red light now comes on when charging but the blue light never luminates. I love these headphones and decided to keep the replacement set to give as a gift. Great product for the money.

title: Meh
review: These were great for the first few months of use. After that I began having connection issues. The headphones would sync up and play for a little while then it would drop the signal reconnect, then drop signal again until I turn off head phones and re-pair again... lame.

title: Malfunction after a Few Months.
review: After a few months of regular use, the left earbud on the Senso headphones stopped working. When I sought support, the company told me to factory reset them. When that did not work, they stopped communication and did not fulfill their warranty.

title: Good product, great customer service
review: These headphones are comfortable and reliable. When I had an issue, the customer service was very quick and helpful.

title: Poor sound quality, bulky construction.
review:
I ordered these headphones because they had lots of good reviews on Amazon. However once I received them I was disappointed with there overall product.

What I liked:
- they where only 20 bucks
- they came with a nice storage case

What I disliked:
- cheep bulky construction
- poor noise canceling (if any)
- horrible sound quality
- no fine tunning volume adjustment

The headphones where bulky and did not fit snuggly in my ear (even with the difference earpieces) they definitely we're not noise canceling.

The sound was vary bass-y okay for pop or like Daddy Yanky but you didn't get a nice crisp sound. Also at higher volume it was very distorted.

I was unable to make fine adjustment to the volume at lower volume. It was either way too loud or not loud enough.

I will be returning them I'd trying something else.

title: great
review: once you pick the right size of bud covers then you will have great hearing of music or phone calls. I've only used for walking  so I can't say how it will hold up during heavy work outs. I would recommend to everyone who needs a good headset for a lower price. Works just like more expensive ones.

title: Good sound quality and quite comfortable
review: These little bluetooth over the ear headphones are great. They have an impressive range, and still work with clear reception when my phone is downstairs and I am upstairs. They're quite comfortable in ear, and the grip around the ear is soft and very flexible to keep the earphones in place. The sound quality is great, very clear, but not fully noise cancelling. For me, as every day headphones, this is totally fine. For an airplane or a loud situation, I'd probably still opt for higher end headphones (bose, etc), but these are very good for day to day stuff. They stay in place, don't shift around, and all of the controls are easily on the headphones, so you can turn them on/off, adjust the volume, etc. without having to touch your phone. For the price, these are great, comfortable headphones for blue tooth enabled devices.

title: Decent but wont last
review: For an inexpensive pair of headphones they are decent. I used mine at the gym and mowing the yard only. Best thing I can say about these is they stay in place. There is no bass or noise canceling at all. After 6 months of use, I could only Bluetooth pair with one device, tried with different devices and would get a connected notification but no music playback. Now, a year out they do not work at all, can not turn on. If you do not mind replacing every year go for it, just do not expect quality.

title: SENSO what a great pair of Headphones
review: Awesome Headphones, sound quality is fantastic.  These are awesome for walking and running and being able to have a telephone conversation on the fly.  I would recommend these to anyone and everyone.  Thank you SENSO for such a great product at a great price.

title: These headphones are PHENOMINAL
review: I am 55 and am very tight with my money, I was already planning on trying these out and sending them back because I knew there is no way the hype can be that great, well guess what, the hype is legit!  You will have to pry these from my dead hands!  Seriously, if you can swing the price, they will be the last headphones you will ever buy, they are very very good in every way, well worth the price!  Mike Glendale, Arizona

title: Great quality product
review: Great product! Exactly what the dialog states what the product can do and how good the quality of the product is. I woild know because I am an fan of sound and comfort xoiple with durability and these headphones have it all, great product, thank you for putting something of this quality and price out there!

title: Nice headphones for a great price
review: Great headphones!  My husband was given the expensive wireless headphones from his boys for Christmas.  They broke within 3 months.  We replaced with these and they work great

title: It should be highly rated....10/10 worth buying
review: Purchased lots of bluetooth headphones  but this one is completely different...I mean is awesome and I really love it. Guess I'm gonna buy two more. I use it for running

title: Good while they lasted
review: This are good headphones. The only, but major, downside is that they stopped working after 2 years. And its not that I used them every day during this time. I use them mostly during the weekends. Meaning they lasted around 200 days which is the equivalent of 6 months if you use them daily. Sound quality was good.

title: Didn't work at all
review: I rate this product a zero because it neither charged my phone or sent audio to my headphones. I am returning it. It was for my car. Substituting another similar unit worked fine.

title: These headphones are phenomenal BUT only for a couple of months; then they break
review: These headphones are great and fit fine, but after a couple of months, the connection between your phone and the headphones gradually gets weak

title: Awesome bassssss
review: So far this has been an awesome, cheap, better quality than any products I have purchased on any type of headphones. I’ve only had this for a day and the sound is amazing. I didn’t star the battery life yet since I only had it for 4hrs. But I will come back for another review once I start using this more.

title: Good for the price
review: Cheap wireless inear headphones. However they broke inside my backpack while not in the case....might have been my fault.

title: Broke within a month
review:
I ordered these headphones a month ago and the connector to recharge them has broken off inside the headphones. I've had several pairs of headphones with this type of connector and have never had any issues with them. So these are now useless as they can't be recharged.

Additionally, if there is any slight breeze outside, all you can hear in the wind whipping in the headphones. You have to turn up the volume to hear your music, then you are blasting your ears off. Also, after working out for about 20 minutes (I sweat a lot), the right earphone won't stay in my ear.

Terrible headphones. I would not recommend this brand.

title: Poor quality compared to what they used to be
review:
Every time I buy a new pair, the quality of these get worse and worse.

These used to be the best headphones, but now they're crap

title: Head phones were OK up until the first song with Bass played...
review:
Big disappointment... I bought these headphones b/c the apple buds are really uncomfortable and I needed something that would tend to stay in my ears while being active. While bulky the earbuds were comfortable and for the most part stayed put while riding my bike which was a nice surprise. Things went downhill from there really quick as I noticed the sound quality was far from great.. the bass is absolutely dreadful. The speakers crack and distort with the slightest bit of bass and that's a real disappointment. These headphones are just about useless if it can't play music with reasonable sound quality. Will be requesting refund.

I'm surprised by the 5 star reviews honestly... I read through a lot of them before buying but I'm starting to think that maybe these were fake reviews now.

Don't buy this product if sound quality means anything to you.

title: Outstanding product for the price.
review: I use these headphones 8 hours a day, 5 days a week, sometimes more and they are perfect for me. Yes the speaker pieces are hard plastic so they can be uncomfortable if you don't position them correctly, but they're really easy on your head and ears and have pretty decent sound for cheap headphones. Some of my neighboring cube dwellers can hear my music if I turn it up loud because of the open style of the speaker setup but they all wear headphones too so oh well. Overall, great purchase if you're looking to save some money and just need a pair of speakers strapped to your head. Not sure how they would work as "sports headphones" since they never leave my desk. I'll leave that to someone else to review.

title: Run From Logitech - Run Now - Run Fast
review:
One Absolutely horrible company. The headset broke, and though covered by warranty, everything they do is to stall and not replace their own defective merchandise - you know it is defective when it has been discontinued, and they offer a lesser model as replacement.

Will never buy Logitech again, bought the Rocketfish and am very happy with it. When you think Logitech, think horrible products, horrible customer service, and horrible people on the phone, in chat, etc.

title: Great headphones, excellent value
review:
Fantastic bluetooth headphones! Great battery life!
I listen to music all day with them and they stay charged the whole time.
I have weird ear canals and many eardbuds/headphones occasionally fall out; with the over the ear they don't get far.

The only downside is the strap the connects the two sides was tightly bound with a rubber band during shipping and it's permanently kinked, that means the strap snags on clothing when I turn my head. (Pencil is pointing at the kink in the photo)

title: Great headphones for the money
review: I was looking for wireless headphones to use on the bus and while mowing my lawn.  These have excellent sound quality and battery life.  They are well worth the money.

title: Meh. Seemed OK, but was a bit disappointed.
review:
This was my first bluetooth headphone purchase. I was not especially thrilled. Sound was fine for the price, but they never seemed to stay in place. And the foam ear pieces came off far too easily. They did not re-connect to my phone as readily as another brand I bought last week.

And - the sound on one side partially went out after a bit more than a year. Disappointed.

title: Giving a bad Review to an almost great product.
review:
Do I enjoy suddenly hearing a unrelated voice out of know where at full volume scaring the sh!t out of you?
No
Do I like picking up your headphones and finding I can't comfortable put them in my ears because for the millionth time the rubber part fell out?
No. (Although they do throw in extras, its still very annoying and the extras aren't always conveniently near by.)
Otherwise its a solid product.
I hope have a firmware update to fix the jump scare robot voice to say "battery low" at the volume the user is currently using. If they did I would increase the rating.

title: Excellent headphones for the price
review: I use these all the time to listen to podcasts, hockey games, and even music. On the bus, at work, at the gym, and at home- connection is solid and strong, charge life is decent, and sound quality is great for the price. I did have to tweak some of the equalization on my phone as there isn’t a ton of low end, but adjusting the EQ helped with that a little. You can hear things around them at lower volumes, but it’s not a huge issue and could probably be solved by swapping ear pieces in the kit or turning them up. Carrying case is sturdy but will occasionally turn the power on if it gets pressed in my backpack.  Overall, great headphones that I use all the time and don’t feel bad about them getting a little dirty, shoved in my backpack, or beat up.

title: Paper-thin junk
review: Did not fit the headphones for which they were purchased. Even if they did, they're paper-thin and wouldn't be comfortable.

title: Decent sound, but....
review:
These Senso wireless earbuds had surprisingly good sound for such an inexpensive item. They were so loud, in fact, that I actually kept the volume on my iPod turned down to the minimum while I used these for working out. That said, I always found the flat cable between them a little awkward, as it would never lay flat and always seemed to want to move to one side or another. It also, because of the nature of it being flat, would hold the shape from having been in the (nice) hard case, which also prevented it laying flat.

The most disappointing thing was that, after less than a year of use, it suddenly started just skipping songs randomly. A song would start, and just a few seconds in, my iPod would jump to the next song, as if I had pressed the button on the right earbud. It would sometimes do this multiple times in a row and then stop on its own. As well, the volume up button on the earbud now seemed stuck (and I don't abuse these - just normal use during workouts) so that it doesn't press in or click like the volume down button does. Unfortunately, customer support was even more disappointing. I contacted them in November and they promptly replied apologizing for the trouble and asking for pictures to be passed on to the warranty department. I sent the pictures the same day and have not been able to get a response from anyone there since. Needless to say, I will not be recommending nor buying any Senso products in the future.

title: My son is very happy with these earphones!
review: I bought it for my soon (11 years old) and he has been enjoying the freedom of this wireless Bluetooth earphones and has told me and I confirmed the sound is very nice and stay in place.Thanks to a friend who has a pair of this who recommended it!

title: Not loud or noise canceling
review: The sound quality on these headphones suck. I purchased this brand years ago and after breaking them I thought I stick with it since I didn't haven't issues with the previous pair. I don't know what changes they made or if I just got a bad pair but the volume is SO low and the sound quality isn't good at all. The songs sound flat and I can still hear my TV on level 11 or people talking near me with no problem. Why fix what wasn't broken!?

title: Senso senses a sound friend
review: I love these headphones. Charge them once a day n they will be best companions where ever you go!! 😁. Sound quality is pretty good. The packing was amazing. The headphones are great value for money. I recommend it!

title: great alternative to iphone headsets
review: a lot of my prior headsets became useless (not useless, but harder to connect due to the need of an adaptor), so finding an alternative solution to get headphones connected FAST became a priority. i use this at work to make calls/listen to music and it's been working out great!

title: Frustrating to Use, Cheaply Made and Poor Quality/ High, Shrill Sound
review: Ordered them in December, 2018. I finally had the opportunity to try the headphones. It was my first and extremely frustrating experience using a Bluetooth Device. They are muffled when applying pressure to them (to fit them in the ear properly). They are very high tone, when no pressure is applied. (Pushing them in, assists in a truer, but, poor tone.) I would prefer to return them for a better quality sounding headset, or, receive a refund. It took me over an hour to figure out how to get them to work. After doing so, it was nothing more than a disappointment. All the ear cushions are the same size (exception of one pair) None of them fit in the ear canal properly and they are all very difficult to switch on and off the headset. The power button easily turns off/ on while adjusting the ear piece. All 3 of my dollar store wired ear buds have a much nicer fit and sound quality. Would be nice to find a nice pair of wireless headphones with a healthy quality sound. I am not satisfied with these at all.

title: Failed in about  3 weeks
review:
Save yourself the aggravation, and pay a bit more for Bluetooth Earbuds.
These are cheap, and they lose charge quickly, then fail entirely in a short period of time.

title: These are complete trash
review:
These things are awful for doing anything more than sitting at a desk listening to audio, and even at that they fail pretty miserably since they're so uncomfortable. Save your $20.

Pros: Bluetooth seems to work fine, but so have all devices I've used in the last 5+ years. Comes with a case to protect them (good, so I can protect the next pair I buy).

Comes with a wallet holder for your phone (which is subsequently trash). Comes with a magnetic car mount for your phone (why do I need that with bluetooth headphones?)

They are uncomfortable, ugly (stick out ~1" from your ear...), the ear hook is made from foam that will be permanently disfigured after the first time it bends, but it doesn't actually do a good job of holding anything to your ear (and then go back that they stick out really far, the weight is all pulling out of your ear). They do a bad job at blocking out other noise, regardless of which size ear piece is being used.

Forget trying to move with these things in, they'll fall out of your ears almost immediately.

Not even worth returning this item.

title: Good for office desk headphones
review: It works. It sits on my office desk so my headphones reach longer. No change in audio quality, but I'm not an audiophile.

title: Comfortable and great sounding
review: The headphones sound great and were super easy to pair with my phone.  Have used them primarily to work out in the yard, but plan on using them to work out as well.  Very comfortable.

title: Great Headphones
review: The headphones are crystal clear and plenty loud. Great quality for the price point.

title: Great for the price
review: These headphones are great. They have great sound, and do not slip off me during a workout.

title: I've been using these nearly every day for almost 2 years and they're still working great.
review:
Sound quality:
Not amazing bass for but clear and much better quality for music and conversation than other Bluetooth headphones I own.
Comfort:
I use them all the time instead of other pairs because of how long I can wear them in the gym, running, wherever without discomfort or them falling out.
Durability:
No wear or loss of sound quality in nearly 2 years. The only thing that wore out was the zipper on the case.
Functionality:
Occasionally minor problems connecting automatically with phone. Resetting it in iPhone settings is an easy fix.

Would definitely recommend and will purchase again if they ever finally die.

title: Very good sound quality
review: Excellent headset for watching TV and not waking up my wife. Real easy to hook up to the TV.

title: Sound Quality and Sound Consistency Horrible
review: I usually use these headphones at the gym and while running, like majority of my headphones, and these headphones work horribly in both of those environments. I've had mine now for over a year and it is just not consistent in performance. Majority of the time whenever I bend, squat, or just sit while my phone is in my pocket the music drops out. And I can't walk more than 5ft away from my phone without the bluetooth losing reception. I would not buy this product again, and I would recommend you not to. The only good thing I can say about this product is that it came with extra ear buds.

title: Far superior to higher priced, bigger name earbuds
review: I bought these over two years ago and they have held up with no issues yet.  The sounds quality for me is fine.  If you're expecting audiophile SQ, these aren't for you but if you want to enjoy your music while on a run and still be cognizant of your surroundings these are great.  I am a heavy sweater when I exercise and have never had an issue with these crapping out due to moisture.  As a comparison in the past I had two pairs of Sport? Power? (can't recall exact name) Beats that broke from sweat/moisture.  The earbuds still charge quickly and hold a charge for a long time.  I had a pair of Jaybirds that suddenly would not charge or even turn on after less than a year.  One thing that I did notice with these, the Bluetooth sensor must be on the right side and you will want to run or carry your phone on your right arm or side.  Otherwise you do get some cutting out of the music.  It took me a couple of runs to figure this out.  And the more stationary (use an arm band vs keep in pocket) the better.  But overall these earbuds work like champs at a fraction of the price of the other big names out there.

title: International calling: not so good
review: The charging case is sensitive to the actually placement of the ear buds. So, be patient when you're placing them in there. Otherwise, they are great! Sound great and very comfortable to wear. Now.... The Battery: if you're an audiophile like myself, these will let you down. At any "normal" and enjoyable sound level, these headphones burn through the battery in about 5 hours. No Bullcrap!

title: Good/great headphones.
review: Very good headphones overall. Whatever you do, try to avoid "maxing out the volume" as much as you can. Audiophiles such as myself really can't help myself

title: Don't get sucked in by "the features" like I did. Do your Due diligence and get your money's worth.
review: Like: the price. Nothing else Really impressed me. The sound is good but, the "noise canceling" is a joke. Also, the volume isn't that great either. So, honestly.... Getting yourself A pair of betron headphones will save you the frustration, and deliver what you want and need in headphones.

title: Be Careful With The Volume. You don't want your ears blown out.
review: Really liked the fact that they could and would blow my ears out and, fit like like a glove. Overall, a GREAT PAIR OF HEADPHONES!

title: Very disappointed
review: Years ago, I shopped online on this exact site for headphones that I could use with my phone then, I bought this exact set. At that time they worked great and recommended them to as many as I could. The most recent set I purchased doesn't live up to my expectations. They look great, work good but the overall volume limit/level falls into what I personally think and believe is good ONLY FOR children! Adults, stay away. Especially if you are a music fanatic like I am.

title: Not as advertised
review: Purchased waterproof headphones with 8 hour battery life and 30 feet radius.  Unfortunately, they did not work underwater, less than 10 foot radius and battery lasted less than 40 minutes.  Do not buy.

title: Good Value but connectivity issues
review: I really enjoy this product and would recommend it. My issue is shortly after buying, the sound would cut out. Almost like the wire shorts when you move it a certain direction. I probably should have exchanged it but it wasn't a big deal. Now that I've had it for so long, it's getting worse. The sound quality has been good and better than other wireless headsets I've tried. Plus, I really like having audio controls on the headset. This way you can easily adjust the volume, answer a call, and switch songs all while you're phone can remain in your pocket or wherever you keep it while running.

title: great value
review: I bought these headphones a few months ago when I gave my mother my airpods.  I wanted something cheap that I could use for several months while I decided what I wanted to do on replacing my airpods.  But when I started using them, they worked great.  The sound quality is exceptional especially for the price paid.  I haven't tested the 8 hour battery life yet but I have used them for 4 hours straight.  The fit was so good that I had no problems having them in my ears for that long.  I've also used them on video conference calls and the other parties could hear me clearly.  I like them so much that I will not be buying any other headphones.  The only thing I didn't like about them initially were the hooks until I figured out they bend to fit behind your ears.  Not one of my best moments.  So I highly recommend this product.

title: been trying several brands and while this is the best wireless, My senso's hold a charge longer
review: These fit my ears well but don't hold a charge well. I have a Senso wireless headphones/buds that work better but don't fit nearly as well in my ears.

title: These are GREAT!!
review: I LOVE these headphones! Loud volume and great bass. The battery lasts a long time also. These pair, unfortunately, now has a short in one ear. I will contact support  to inquire about a replacement. But my 1st pair - I've had 6+ yrs are still going strong 😊 Noise cancelation is pretty good. I can make and take calls, no problem. The other person can hear me pretty good, which is great in my book, considering I work near an airport and take calls mostly outside.

title: Little Disappointed
review:
I read the reviews, some good, some bad, you know how that goes. Mostly good, so I bought them and I'm a little disappointed. Though the sound is clear, they are not very loud. I made adjustments through the app and various mobiles devices and the best quality and loudness came from my laptop. Different genres of music.

And the Bluetooth connectivity is iffy. Itbcould be already paired, but then I have to re-pair the earbuds most times, just to connect. Pushing/holding buttons. It's definitely not instant connectivity andI can have the earbuds right next to the device.

I have a pair of Senso-Activ Buds. Though not ANC or true wireless, they sound better than these across all my devices. No adjustments needed. I'm going to give these another whirl. I may return them though. I've got my eye on some Tozo's :)

title: 1 year and still going
review: I've been using these headphones for more than a year and I was pleasantly surprised that they still work well. Battery life is more than enough for a run and they are pretty comfortable.

title: Amazing
review: I love these headphones but so much ! They truly are noise cancelling and the battery lasts 8 hours with a full charge. Best purchase I made so far in 2019!

title: Excellent as workout headphones
review: I use these headphones to work out. I have zero issues connecting (unlike some I've had in the past). The sound is actually quite good -- once you get them on correctly (and that wasn't super easy to figure out for me -- I suppose some people it would be no problem.). It's not noise cancelling, but I am amazed at how much it does cancel, and still keep me aware of what's going on around me during workouts. They are not the ones  want for really getting into my music, but they are perfect for working out.

title: Uncomfortable earbuds
review: Bought these for work because the are water resistant. The earbuds are heavy and uncomfortable if you wear glasses like myself. When you turn your head the cords stick to your neck pulling them off. The cover for the charging port does not seal after two days of use and the battery life is not impressive.

title: Gave them a second chance...MISTAKE
review: After having this headset for just under two months, I couldn’t stand and take the quality of it. I had read reviews and actually believed what I read. When I ordered I realized I had ordered 7 years ago and believed they improved in quality. Boy I was wrong!!! Never again. I decided to be Beats headset that are known for the quality. I guess you get what you pay for. Really disappointed. I was truly hoping they were going to be good.

title: Doesn't charge anymore...
review: After few months of usage maybe only once or twice a week. This headphone will not charge anymore..

title: Random loud beeping, even when fully charged.
review:
They beep ALL OF THE TIME. And it’s super loud in my ears. Since I’ve gotten them this has been happening, I wrote in and never heard back. Even when they are fully charged they will beep. I did read in the reviews that some people said this happened and I was naive enough to think I would get a pair that didn’t. Don’t buy these, I’m sure there’s better blue tooth headphones out there.
If you don’t mind random beeping the entire time you use them, yes the sound quality is good.

title: Great so far
review: So far, I love these headphones. Great sound and they actually stay in my ears. I have not yet used them while working out, but i have walked around work quite a bit with them and they stay in place.

title: Ear hooks are not that helpful.
review: Ear hook doesn’t provide much support; nonetheless, when both earphones are tightly in place then the sound quality is great.

title: Wasted Money
review: I bought these to listen to audiobooks on my Kindle so audiophile sound quality was not my goal.  Good thing too since music production was mediocre at best.  I chose these because they were the "recommended" earbuds by Amazon for the Kindle.  Bad on you, Amazon.  When rating the stars I was unable to evaluate the noise cancellation, if any, because they were so ill-fitting and uncomfortable I could not wear them for any length of time ...ditto for moisture-wicking.  They were not worn long enough for moisture to accumulate.  I too am suspicious of the 5 star reviews.  I am currently in possession of MANY different brands and styles of headphones and earbuds.  While these are not the worst I have encountered, they are definitely in the bottom 3.  Look elsewhere.

title: Cheap but more than appropriate sound
review: Very decent sound from a budget pair of headphones. Connectivity can be intermittent, especially when I use my runner's belt. Overall, pleased with the purchase.

title: Eh-
review: Updated- These were my favorite headphones. Others that I've purchased over the last few years don't match these in comfort. I like how they don't push so hard into my ear canals like many others do. These hang off your ears but stay in well. The BIG downside in connectivity. The sound drops in and out when I'm outside even when fully charged and the connected device is in my front pocket. Fine for indoors while exercising though. Not sure what the problem is.

title: Poor Quality - Returned to Give a Lower Rating
review:
These headphones are not quality connecting at all. It is taking me 5 or 6 tries before they will connect to my phone, even after they've been paired. The overall quality of the headphones feels like cheap plastic that will soon fall apart; which is confusing because the actual quality of sound and noise cancelling is decent especially for the price. It doesn't help if I can't enjoy the music though.
Seriously considering returning them after only a day.

I gave these my best shot, kept them beyond the time to be able to return them (honestly die to covid) but I am decreasing my raing to only star. When they connect and actually hold, decent sound quality. That's all I will give these. Not recommended at all.

title: cant go to gym without
review: It has been a year since I bought these headphones. they are now part of my gym routine. Bluetooth connection is very good so I can just leave my phone on a corner and walk around 50ft radius inside the gym. I usually use spongy heads for my ears. However they don't cancel windy noise while running outdoor. it is a little annoying

title: Excellent bluetooth headphones for the price
review: I bought these headphones for my wife and she loves them.  She likes the Bluetooth feature to listen to her music when going to sleep without all the cords.  They are comfortable and had good sound quality.  Battery life I cannot measure yet as she just starting using these headphones.

title: Five Stars
review: good solid earphones I use travelling -- decent sound and no problem if broken or lost on the plane.

title: Affordable durable head phones that rock
review: These headphones was recommended by a coworker and I couldn’t have ordered better ones. The Bluetooth is so efficient that I was in a meeting about 150yards away from my cellular device in a separate room and was still able to answer my call.

title: Best buy for your buck, hands down!
review: I can’t be any happier with my purchase. No where on Gods green earth can you find headphones like these for under $20!

title: for $5 more I was able to purchase a prefabricated plastic headset that was much more comfortable and fits my
review: Needs foam padding for the nose, didn't fit the Nexus 6, for $5 more I was able to purchase a prefabricated plastic headset that was much more comfortable and fits my phone

title: Great buds for the price
review: The Senso Bluetooth Headphones came a day after I ordered them.  The directions provided were easy to follow and I was able to quickly sync the headphones to my Android phone.  They were easy to adjust, and I liked that three pairs of tips were provided so I could customize my listening experience.  A compact case is provided and it's protective enough that I can throw it in my purse or backpack without worrying about damage to my headphones.  Finally, they were inexpensive and the best wireless headphones I've owned.

title: Great Value
