review: I don't think the value you get on this earbud bulk can be beaten, so if that is what you are going for then this is the option for you. However, be aware that what it has in value it lacks in quality. The sound quality is lacking quite a bit. Also, earbuds of this quality usually stop working fairly quickly, at least when compared to higher-quality earbuds. With that said, I am also impressed by how many did come in working order. I have tested many of them and only one was faulty. So, if you go through earbuds quickly, like if you are a teacher who gives them to students then this will be a good pick.

title: Great sound quality, great comfort, and great length.
review: I really enjoyed the fact that this product has such a long cord. I don't like wearing headphones, but I couldn't find any earphones that would sound good and reach far enough from my pc. I'm really glad I found these.

title: All around a fair quality for the price.
review: I've bought several of these over the last year. It seems that each one lasts at least a few months before issues arise, but that's nothing new for earphones, at least in my experience. The sound quality is great, and it fits comfortably in my ear. The package comes with different-sized earbuds, so anyone concerned by that should rest assured; it is possible to change them out for comfort. The battery life is about 10-12  hours on average which is nice. The range is around 8 feet if the right earbud(where the signal is received) is pointing to whatever the Bluetooth is connected to such as your pc, phone, etc. If not, the signal will cut out fairly quickly which can get annoying. Another thing that may not annoy you, but it certainly did me, is the part that loops around your ears. It gets old fast, and the earbuds stay in your ears regardless of the loops being there or not so I always decide to cut them off. As far as I'm aware it does not damage them in any way, and I certainly have never seen a reduction in listening quality because of it.

title: Very nice little unit
review: Exactly what I need to charge all of my batteries, headphones, Bluetooth speaker and more.  I like being able to turn on or off each port.

title: Nice headphones
review: I like that you can control volume from the headphones instead of using phone controls. Hooks up instantly using Bluetooth.

title: Love these
review: Love these. They are comfortable and setup was a breeze. I wanted to make sure I wrote my review after I used them. Sound quality is clear and noise cancellation works well depending on the song. Best of all I don’t have a bulking headset around my neck

title: Great for the price!
review: I have to say for the price these are great. I run short distances 1-2 miles on a treadmill, and lift weights, these earphones don’t budge. Battery lasts a while too, and charges back up quickly.

title: Bluetooth earbud headphones are a great value and good quality
review: I am really impressed with the inexpensive Senso Bluetooth Headphones. The sound quality is good, the ear fit is better than any other earbuds I have owned and the length of charge is longer than I expected. It takes only couple hours to charge which is also a plus. For the price I Definitely recommend Senso

title: Happy with my purchase
review: These earbuds are of a very good quality for the price, and pairing them with my phone was painless.  I would recommend them.

title: Good headphones for the price
review: I bought these headphones because of the price and the reviews. The sound quality lives up to the hype and the button functions are easy enough to learn (although I wish the large logo was not the hang up button). Unfortunately for me the bluetooth connection was choppy at times. I am fairly sure that it is not my phone because my bluetooth speakers work fine and have a decent range (both are Bose). The range is also not great but that has not been an issue for me as I work out with my phone in my pocket or nearby.

title: Snug fit, very good.
review: If it had independent volume buttons I would give it 5 stars. Great set of headphones and they fit snug to the ears even when running, which is what I was looking for. They have playback control for pause, play, skip, replay. The volume control is three taps of the button. Overall very good, I haven't had an issue with the battery, the case charges them.

title: Not as good as older version, cheap plastic.
review:
Feels cheaper than previous versions of this product.
I have had these headphones for years and the quality of the product for the price is great. I feel let down this time around, my old ones had the cord between the headphones crushed, my fault. This version is made of very light plastic, the outside sound echos more when you are wearing them, and the behind the ear part doesn't feel as natural to put on as before. Might look elsewhere when these go bad.

title: I love the Senso earbuds!!
review: I love my Senso earbuds!! I lost my original pair so this is my 2nd pair.  I highly recommend them.

title: Nearly 2 years and still going.
review: I purchased these headphones almost two years ago and they still work just fine. Sometimes they'll disconnect for no reason but it's very infrequent for me. I've used these nearly everyday for work (I work in a loud shop). These headphones have been washed at least twice and chewed on by my 1 year old and have stood up to rigorous use.

title: Good for the price
review: These headphones are perfect. They work well. They connect easily with my devices, and they have a great ability to cancel the noise around me. And best of all they have a great price.

title: Not Water / Sweat Proof
review: For the money the product was adequate, but do not rely on the water proof rating. My first pair lasted a couple weeks and appears to have died from sweat while working out at the gym. The replacement was hassle free and I enjoyed the 2nd pair for about 6 months until I got caught in the rain one day while running. lasted maybe 15 minutes. Once finished with the run, I was unable to power off the earphones, pause the music, change the volume or skip forward or back. In other words, the buttons quit working. Service was great and sent me a replacement pair - which I'll keep as a backup if needed.

title: Been a Senso users for years, quality has gone down
review: Been a senso headphone users for years, old one finally broke down and the new one I just purchased had a worse sound quality and noise cancellation compared to last one, Disappointed with overall quality will continue testing.

title: Great For Hands Free
review: I purchased the 590E headset specifically for hands free driving.  My phone came with a set of stereo ear plugs which had fantastic sound but the mike was constantly getting hooked on my shirt or jacket.  The 590E does not have the quality sound as the stero ear plugs but it works fine for phone use.  I would prefer something less bulky and a little more volume but overall satisfied with the purchase.  Got a great deal through Amazon.com.

title: Ok headset but could be better. Good for its price.
review: Holders wore out and got softer really shortly after the purchase and headphones started to fall off during the run.

title: 2021 Purchase Update
review:
I bought these headphones in April, 2017. They worked fine. I'm not picky when it comes to sound quality. But I noticed recently that the thin wire that goes into the right ear plug is fraying; the black plastic covering is ripped and you can see the small metallic wires. After 4+ years of minimal use, I guess I can't complain. I'll duct tape the wire and hope that will solve the problem.

Sept. 2022: Since my 2021 purchase update, I've rarely used these headphones. In the last week or so, I've tried to use them and they're basically dead. I've charged them all day via the USB port and they barely hold a charge. Got what I paid for, I guess. Can't recommend these for the long term.

title: Microphone doesn't work
review:
I purchased two of these. Both arrived with non-functioning microphones. I returned one of them for a refund and requested an exchange for the other one. The replacement arrived and it, too, had a non-functioning microphone. I returned it to Amazon for a refund.

I then purchased the Sennheiser PX 100-II i Light Weight Supra-Aural Headset with 3 Button Control for i-Pod,i-Phone and i-Pad from Amazon for $58. The Cellet 3.5mm Headset with Microphone Boom was only $6.05 ... and I got what I paid for. The Sennheiser headset works beautifully and is worth the extra expense.

title: For customers who want loud, clear sound.
review: You will be find it difficult to find a better Bluetooth headphones. Very loud. Very clear sound. At a price that everyone can afford. I'm on my third set(only cause they keep getting stolen). I won't but anyother.

title: Good quality sound.
review: I'm really enjoying my Senso bluetooth headphones.  The sound quality is actually very good.  It only takes about an hour to fully charge them and they last a good 8 hours on a charge.  Included with the headphones were different size ear buds, a carrying case, and a magnetic car holder for your phone.  The different size ear buds were a nice bonus.  I was able to change the size and they fit perfectly in my ear with no slippage at all.  These are great headphones for the a good price.

title: Good value but lasted 6 months
review:
This price vs sound quality seems unmatched. The lower end of volume control could use more resolution.
I used the headphones 4 to 6 times a week during various workout types like outdoor running, indoor treadmill, and weight training. Unfortunately after 6 months of use, the charging connector on the headphones physically broke and now the headphones are no longer usable.

title: Very comfy
review: Finally i found a good ond this Headphones Extremely comfortable and very easy to carry.

title: Battery does not last
review: I was very happy with my purchase. They are very lightweight and have excellent audio quality. The case is a big plus in helping keep my earbuds in good condition. They are a bit bulky but everything else overall is great.

title: Sansa Fuze 8GB
review: this little mp3 was very inexpensive and looks real nice. I bought mine refurbished. The case fit it snuggly, but only thing, it didn't come with headphones or charger. I guess that was my fault, I automatically thought it came with at least the charging cable. Overall this was a very good buy.

title: I like it!
review: I have used the Bose noise-canceling headphones for years. My last pair disintegrated after a few years -- the soft plastic covering the cushions came off in flakes. Appalled by this quality issue - especially in light of the amount of money those headphones cost - I felt it was time to look for an alternative. So far I have been very happy with the Audio-Technica product. It is a bit bulkier than the Bose. But it sits equally comfortably on the head and ears, even on long transcontinental flight. As far as noise-canceling is concerned, I actually like them even better than the Bose. And you can listen to music without the noise canceling turned on. With the Bose I occasionally noticed some interference with radio signals in the area that resulted in a vibrating high-pitched tone, none of that with the Audio-Technica. Too soon to tell how they will hold up, but they seem to be sturdy. Initial verdict: two thumbs up.

title: Shocking my ears!!
review: These earbuds do work pretty well. However they randomly shock my ears and short out my computer. Would recommend to look elsewhere

title: Good while they last
review: Receive these as a gift and These were great earbuds for the price but unfortunately only lasted about 2 months before the right earbud stopped working.

title: SENSO Bluetooth Headphones
review: These headphones are awesome! I didn't even realize they would pick up my phone calls or alert me of a text message. These are better than I expected and really hold a charge for a while. Thank you for a great product!

title: These are great headphones. I take them on my run
review:
These are great headphones. I take them on my run. They're loud, have a battery life that I can use for at least a week, and have flawless connectivity.

The only issues is that sometimes the volume spikes. I suspect that it is with my phone, but I'm not 100% sure.

title: Inexpensive and work great!
review: I can't say enough good things about these headphones. I wore my first pair on long runs for several months and never had an issue. I even wore them when I was working from home. I left them at the gym and immediately got another pair. You cannot beat the quality of these for the price!

title: Sounds great!
review:
I wasn't sure what to expect for $40 for earbuds. Normally when I think of $40 earbuds 'they aren't going to sound good' "not as good quality". I was impressed with these! I charged these for a while before using them which didn't take too long. These paired to my laptop right away. They sound really good! The only I was eh on was they don't have a cover on the case. I'm pretty sure one day I'll knock them over and won't be able to find the other earbud. I just keep them in a drawer when I'm not using them so I prevent that. Otherwise, I really like these!

UPDATE: I wear these when I have my phone with me. I had these on and went outside without my phone and it totally cut out and disconnected from my phone so these don't have impressive range.

title: nice quality audio out, and a nice looking gadget
review:
I'm very happy with this. It connected easily to my components, and now I can stream from my phone to my stereo. Most pleasing.
the sound quality is impressive, with sharp treble, solid bass, and well-defined mid-range.
A great way to listen to the music on my phone without having to wear headphones!

title: Super fun functions!
review: I love all the stuff these watches have on them! AND, the headphones are amazing for parents since the sounds are a little loud. The games and educational material on these is fantastic. This is such an excellent value for an amazing little device.

title: Great audio and video quality
review: This is an amazing system for crystal clarity on zoom or other conferencing systems. The quality is amazing and the setup was a breeze. It was pretty much plug & play, and ready to go! The volume control on the headset is easy to use. Everyone says the voice quality is great, too, so the sound is good both directions. THe headset is comfortable for long working days, too.

title: Ultra comfortable & light, excellent sound quality
review: I have to admit these are the BEST headphones I've tried...and I've tried some VERY good headphones. I've got sensory processing issues, so often, noises can really be irritating to me. I put these on and the noise canceling is so good I can relax! Also, they're so soft and comfortable that I can wear them all day without feeling overwhelmed or uncomfortable. Now, the sound quality is so amazing! Smooth, rich tones that improve whatever I play on them over other headphones. I'm thrilled with these!!

title: Sounds amazing!
review: These little earbuds have mighty sound! I haven't had any experiences with Skullcandy before but these are great! They sound very clear and I didn't hear distortions. I haven't really experienced loose earbuds before, I'm only used to the ones with a cord so I know I won't lose them. They charged fast and instantly paired with my phone. The instructions were clear with big pictures so I can see which directions are for turning on, off, or pairing mode when setting up. These would make a great gift to someone else or a gift for yourself!

title: very comfy, sound is amazing!
review:
These are so comfortable. I have reviewed a lot of headphones, and these are by far the comfiest inner-ear ones that I have ever tried on.
Not just comfy, but they stay in place as you walk, run, bend, lift, they just stay where they should. I can only wonder why all the other headphone companies are so far behind.
But comfort is only part of the experience. The sound quality is jaw-dropping. I listen a lot to my Bose and my Anker ear-covering headphones, my every-day listening devices. These in-ear ones match the over-ear ones for clarity, definition, treble, mid-range and bass. Absolutely outstanding.

title: Sounds great!
review: These are great earbuds! This easily paired with my Andriod phone and I was playing music right away. They charged pretty fast and I really like that it shows how charged these are on the outside. I was impressed with how awesome these sounded. The battery life is really good and they last longer a few days on 1 charge. I like to keep these in the box when I'm not using these because I lose things super easily. I really recommend these! This would make a great gift for yourself or for someone else.

title: Great sound and noise cancelation
review: These are really good noise-canceling headphones! I don't have music on very loud so I can hear if someone is trying to talking to me and I can very slightly hear them. If I turn it up a little more then I really won't be able to hear them. I really like these because I have sound sensitivity to certain sounds so if someone is lawn mowing (one of my triggers) I put these on and I can't hear it. These are comfortable and I love that they are wireless so I can walk to the kitchen while I'm still connected to my computer. The sound quality sounds as good as my other wireless headset from V-Moda that sounds amazing! I recommend these to get for yourself or a gift!

title: Different, but great
review:
When these arrived, they reminded me of my dog treat pouch for training pup. But it works so well for protecting headphones and a cable or two.
It is very well made and will last a long time. A great way to protect your headphones or whatever.

title: They dont sound good, they are uncomfy.
review:
Disappointing. I like the battery meter being a percentage, that is pretty cool. But after that it is useless. The sound quality is poor - very flat, no bass, tinny treble. Noise cancellation? Well, if you force it down your ear canal, you will get some noise cancellation.
But you will not want to push it down your ear canal, or even just into the outside of your ear. The pads are hard and uncomfortable.
The best thing that you can do with these headphones is not buy them

title: Worse headphones I have ever used
review: And I review a LOT of headphones. These are uncomfy, the audio quality is poor, battery life is dreadful. Annoyingly tricky to pair, and the quality from the microphone is embarrassingly bad.

title: Super comfortable, excellent sound
review: I've actually paid way more money for headphones that didn't sound this good. I really like the fit and feel for long-term play, too. The sound quality is spectacular, and background noise fades during a conversation. Really happy with these.

title: the ear buds are very comfortable
review:
But the sound as only fair. Battery life is not very good. Bass is almost nonexistent, treble is scratchy.
Not a good pair of headphones.

title: Very good headphone stand.
review:
I am very pleased with this. I have it attached to my desk, holding two pairs of headphones.
It folds away when not in use. It can mount on a vertical post (such as the side of a bookcase)as well as a horizontal one.

It's strong, and will easily carry any headphones that you may have.

title: Excellent sound and noise cancellation
review: These are amazing headphones! They are so comfortable and lightweight, and the sound is amazing. I also love the noise canceling so I can work without distraction.

title: Amazing sound and value
review: We have a lot of high-end headphones around the house, so I'm used to some pretty amazing quality. These are a very competitive quality with the high-end headphones, but an excellent value! I really like the noise-canceling ability, and the deep bass. These are super comfortable, too, and look amazing in white. I love them for work so I can just get focused on my work with music in the background and no distracting noises from coworkers.

title: Surprisingly good value
review: I have a few pairs of very high-end headphones.  These are really close in quality and noise cancellation but at such an amazing value! The sound quality is excellent and they fit very comfortably. I don't feel comfortable using my expensive ones in public for fear of theft, but these are great to take along wherever I need to use them, especially for the noise cancellation.

title: Simple, stylish, effective.
review:
I really like this. The foot print is small, so it does not hog up valuable desk space. It keeps my headphones off the desk, and away from danger/trouble/spilled drinks/overly curious dogs. It looks great, and is impressively strong - way more than is needed!

I am very happy to have this on my desk..

title: Very useful, if you need to extract the
review:
This does a great job of pulling the audio out. Great for adding permanently connected headphones or a different amplifier.
The audio was not out of sync when this was used. Audio and picture quality were not impacted.
Easy to set up, great to use.

title: Awesome sound, great integratiuon with fitness apps.
review:
These are very good headphones. They are light and comfortable. the battery has a long life, the microphone works really well (for calls and for voice controls).
Water-resistant, easy to use. Perfect for any ears!

title: A great removable wire tie
review:
Very simple, some rubber with a strong magnet at each end. You wrap it around a wire/wires and let the magnets meet.
There is a cut out in the rubber so that you can thread the cable through, keeping the cable and the tie together at all times.
It works well, it has a pretty good grip. Excellent for wired headphones, managing charging cables on the road, and any other time you need to gather wires then release them repeatedly.

title: light, very copmfortable, amazing sound quality
review:
These are very impressive.
The noise-canceling has three levels. and it is the best noise-canceling I have used. I can see my dog barking, and with no music playing, I do hear him quietly. Put some music on, and it looks like he is trying to lip-sync.
The speakers are connected to the headband with ball and socket connections. This gives great freedom over the positioning, making them ever-so comfortable. abbyabbyabbyabbyabbyabbyabbyTabbyabbyabbyabbyhe ball/socket joint is not too loose - the headphones retain the position that you set.

The sound quality is excep[tional, deep bass and sharp treble.
Easy to wear these for hours without getting uncomfy. A truly good pair of headphones.

title: Incredible headphones
review:
Thirty hours of life on a single charge! Wow. And that is the weakest part of these headphones!
The sound is magnificent. You hear subtleties and delicate parts to songs that you never heard before. What you won't hear are your surroundings. These are the best headphones that I have ever used! You are immersed in the music, hearing it defined perfectly.

These are amazingly comfortable, from the cushion around the speakers to the fit of the headband.

I do not have the vocabulary to express how impressive these are. The audio quality is simply outstanding.

You will never regret buying these.

title: Exceptionally good in-ear head phones
review:
I truly love these!
They are well made and feel strong. They are the comfiest in-ear headphones I have ever worn. The noise-canceling is very impressive. I wear them mowing the lawn (with a gas-powered mower) and I can hardly hear the engine at all!
For the sound quality: Amazing. The bass is deep and rich, with no distortion. Treble is sharp, midrange impressively clear.
You put them in the case, and they charge up! Even though the case may not be connected to a power supply. The charger in the case does charge quickly.

Comfortable, clear sound with no background noise to interfere. I learned a little about how my hearing works with these, I was listening to music while I mowed the lawn and I pushed my hip against the mowers handle. Suddenly I could hear the engine, despite the noise canceling! The sound was reverberating through my skeleton! the biology may not be totally correct there, but that is how it felt, and that showed me that for certain noises I do hear with more than my easr!

title: needs careful treatment
review:
The battery life is okay, the sound is all right, the noise cancellation is poor but there.
However, the charging case broke very easily, and then it refused to work. Rendering the headphones useless.
I cannot recommend this product.

title: Audio quality not as good as I would like. Especially from Sony!
review:
I have had many Sony devices in my life. A Walkman, a Diskman, a stereo system (or 2) and many headphones. All of them have been better than I expected for the price.
Not this time. These were pretty poor quality. The battery life is great, they feel nice, they are very comfortable. But the bass is weak, and the treble is a littl hissy.
The mid range is flat with no clear definition. Very dissapointing.

title: Comfortable and secure
review:
Unlike most new headphones these do not feature any noise canceling. This is ideal, as you need to know what is happening around you whilst you are running.
These are very comfortable, the way the ear hook helps support the earphones is very well done. The weight is distributed evenly which works for both comfort and stability.

The sound quality is exceptional, music detail is clear. I found that I had to speak loudly for the microphone to work with my voice, but other than that, this was perfect.

title: ever-so comfortable and they don't fall out!
review:
The memory foam around the earpieces was a genius idea! These are so comfortable, and they don't start to work loose as you run, walk, or whatever. That alone makes this one of the best pairs of headphones that I have ever used.

But that is not all! The sound quality is very impressive, from rumbling base to the highest of trebles they are clear and well defined.

The battery life is a good eight hours (I have timed a 9 1/2 hour run from them). To top it off, they are easy to clean!

title: awesome headphones - great sound and easy to wear
review:
I prefer in-ear ear-buds. but the problem I have is that if I do anything more strenuous than walking the dog they fall out. These have an ear clip built-in. They do not fall out. That is wonderful!
Another benefit is the controls on the remote attached to the wire. For my in-ear headphones, I have to remember which button on which ear does what. Here I can look at the remote if IU need a quick reminder without having to take the phones off.
The sound quality is impressive, especially for speakers so small! Excellent treble, resonating bass, and a sharp, clear mid-range come together to give an excellent audio experience.
The battery lasts a long time (I am sorry, I have not timed it, I am just aware that I hardly ever have to charge it). these are sturdy. They feel very strong. And they come with lots of "spare parts" so you can easily customize them to fit your ears.

title: nifty bluetooth reciever
review:
This is a great gizmo. If you already have wired headpohones that you love, using this will convert them to bluetooth heasdphones.
The qquality of the device is very high, chances are high that the weakest link in your audio quality will be the headphones or the source, this has very impressive quality coming through it.

title: Bang and Olufsen delivering the best quality. Like they always do!
review:
These are very impressive headphones! They look outstanding. They are very comfortable. The sound is outstanding. Battery life? 19 hours! Bass delivery is firm and clear, the treble is tight with no hiss and the mid-range supports them both with beautiful clarity.

Between the aesthetics and the phenomenal audio quality, this may well be the last pair of headphones that you purchase.

title: tiny, but powerful!
review:
These blew me away. They are so small, but they fit snugly. the noise cancellation is amazing. I wore these and listened to some music at a moderate volume (my volume goes from 0 to 10, I had it on 4) whilst I mowed the lawn with my old gas mower. I could barely hear the mower! Just amazing!

They charge very quickly, and the battery lasts a long time. Using them for phone calls is nice, I can hear the caller, and they can hear me. Only, with this small device hidden in your ear, people may think you are talking to yourself if they see you using this!

Music quality? Exceptional! Rich, deep bass which was unexpected out of something so small. Impressive treble, and clear mid-range all added up to these being the most impressive headphones I have ever used.

title: Long battery life, which is a shame, because it won't get used when you throw these away
review:
Awful headphones. The sound like something from a dollar store. cheaply made, the part that goes around your ear is brittle and very uncomfortable. The part that goes into your ear is too firm and very uncomfortable.
Sound quality is missing. The sound is almost muffled. Bass is dire, treble is tinny, the midrange is lacking.

title: Great fit & sound!
review: These are now one of my favorite pairs of headphones! The Pansonic ones I have are really uncomfortable when trying to put over my ear, these are so easy and very comfortable to put on. I love the sound on these, they sound great even at a lower volume. I really like the material they are made from like a silicone. The neck ban was perfect for me. The Bluetooth range is great, our house is about 1,200 square foot and if I leave my phone in the living room I can go to our office and it sounds great still, leaving my phone in the house and taking out the trash it starts cutting out through the front door so have your phone with you if you go outside. If I were to get a headset, I would get these!

title: Very impressive noise cancelling
review:
I always thought Bose speakers were trendy, but would not sound too good. As an audiophile, the hype just seemed too much. And a fixed location single speaker? Has! What good could that be?

So I received these, read the manual, started the charging and waited to be able to laugh at them and publically mock them.

It came as a bit of a shock when I put them on. The sound quality was simply amazing. Breathtaking. Deep, rich base with clear, defined treble and the midrange was keeping up with both.
Okay, so I may have to eat a little humble pie on the sound quality, but the noise reduction. Surely not that good?
Phenomenal. I had the headphones on and powered up, but with no audio streaming. I adjusted the level of noise control to maximum and suddenly I was in a silent room. you could just hear the background noises, but it took a lot of effort, and some were completely gone. Add in some quiet music, and you are surrounded by silence and beautiful sounding audio.

I thought my wife would not want me to use them as much as I do, but I have not heard a word of complaint!

title: Great sound!
review: Panasonic make great headphones and earbuds. The are great for when I want to listen to music on my laptop. I was impressed how great they sound! I’m a little worried of how thin this cord is, by folding it up and unrolling it might start to crack.

title: Love the sound & noise cancelling
review: This is a great headset for working. I share a home office with my (adult) daughter and husband, and sometimes the three of us can easily distract each other from tasks that require focus on the computer screen (programming, writing, etc.) by just random talking, joking and general merriment. Wearing these is my way of saying, I can't hear your lunacy right now because I MUST finish this project within the next 30 minutes. Boy, do they work great for that! They fill my head with bass and the noise cancelling works beautifully to block out the craziness outside my little sound bubble. I can easily get my task done and THEN watch that funny dog video. At least one of us is productive! (Ordering two more of these right away!!)

title: Very nice, well balanced headset.
review:
This is very comfortable, can be worn for hours - useful when working on videos. The sound quality is very good, both the playback and the microphone. I am truly impressed.

The controls are easy, connecting it is easy, it plugs directly into my laptop. On my desktop I use the included USB adaptor.

Well built, it is supplied with a couple of different sized ear thingies. No, I do not know what they are called :) The bit you stick in your ear - it comes fitted with medium, and supplied with small and large!

It is all well made, quality construction A very good recording headset.

title: Truly amazing headphones!! Confortable, great sound quality
review:
I have many pairs of headphones, these are by far the best. The sound quality is amazing., They are ever so comfortable. Also, they don't block out all other sounds. So I can hear if the dog needs to go out a phone is ringing or someone is at the door.
The bass response in these headphones is phenomenal. Treble and midrange match it, giving a lovely balanced sound. More warm than clinical, which I prefer.

Battery life is also very good. I got just shy of ten hours of listening time when I measured it.

The only thing I don't love about these is the wire from one piece to the other. An inch longer would have made a HUGE difference.

title: Not great
review: I had gotten the same headset but in a black color and not white, I had the same following issues with this headset also, the sound could be heard from the outside of the headset and didn’t control the sound to stay in just the headset. Also the microphone does give out fairly good output sound quality.

title: Not great
review: Lets a lot of sound out of the headset and my friend that I was talking to said he could hear my sound and himself talking! Although it is a pretty comfortable headset it does have a few issues which include the fact that microphone has not that good of output sound quality, and a lot of sound comes out so I always have to turn the sound down really low.

title: Super comfortable, good sound cancellation
review: These are really nice headphones for work. I enjoy blocking out surrounding distractions while I work, and the noise cancellation on these work great. I also love that they're comfortable without being too weighty. They're well padded and comfortable and don't get too warm. The sound quality is excellent, and the battery life is great!

title: Amazing sound, excellent noise cancelling, weak casing
review:
I love these headphones. They are ever so comfortable, they sound amazing. Great bass, not overbearing, sharp treble, comfortable midrange, great stuff!
They do not weigh much, excellent battery life, and it recharges in just a couple of hours.

These are one of the best pairs of headphones I have ever listened to!

title: Great decor
review: Great stand for my gaming headset and good decor in the background. It comes in pieces so all you have to do is put the pole on the bottom and the holder on top. I use Xbox a lot and use a variety of headphones it’s great to just put a headset that I am not using right by my Xbox, looking professional.

title: poor audio in and out, combined with many other issues
review:
What I loved about this headset:
It is so uncomfortable, you cannot wear it for long. Which means you dont have to put up with the poor audio for long.

What I hated about this headset:
Sound quality was dire
Volume control did little but add line noise
Cable was cheap, and very weak where it met the plug, volume control, and headset.

A cheap and useless headset

title: Great headphones
review: I really like these headphones! They're comfortable and have vinyl-like material for the ear muffs. These sound great on level three for almost noise-canceling, level two is mid-tone for me and it's hard to hear it. I like that these are wireless so I can do my housework and not get the cord caught on things. They are easy to charge with just a USB cable.  These are really good quality and I recommend them!

title: The comfiest in-ear headset I have ever worn. And one of the best sounding ones also
review:
These are amazingly comfortable. They don't fall out, but they do not feel too big, or tight. They don't rub. And then you listen. The sound quality is better than impressive. How about the weight of them? They are amazingly lightweight. Of course, something has to give. I would like to have a longer battery life. But it will cover a fairly decent run or dog walk!

Excellent headphones!

title: Amazing sound, fit comfortably
review:
I usually prefer over-ear headphones for an immersive, noise canceling experience and a way to ‘get away from it all’.The earpiece is actually pretty comfortable, just sitting in your ear instead of having to push them in. That's the main reason I usually don’t like earbuds. So that’s a big win for me!. I like that I can still hear what’s going on around me, so I can listen to music while I’m working, but still hear to react to the other people in the room.

These are great, too, for the freedom to roam around the house while I work and don’t need to keep my phone in my pocket. I also love that these babies stay charged for a VERY long time! I’ve used them for a few hours every day all week and they’re still going strong!

So a feature I didn’t think would matter to me is pretty awesome! The music will pause if you stick the magnetic earbuds together! If I have to do something fast, like answer the door, I usually get flustered with the controls to pause anything, tv, music, etc. This is dead easy to pause!

Now the best part - the sound quality! These sound amazing! My hubby is the sound nerd and will talk to you about the drivers, the bass, hertz & dB until your ears bleed, but I just know that these sound excellent!

title: Awesome for Vlogging and Skyping
review:
I am so happy with this device. It has solved all of my problems with recording audio for my videos. It also has added to the sound quality for the people I call through Skype and Facebook.
I like how it has a switch on it, so I don't have to unplug it if I am using a headset or want to ensure my privacy.
I like the builtin tripod. The sound quality is exceptional.

title: The sound is choppy
review: Great if you want to clean your room and want some music, bad if you want to walk with your phone. I was listening to music as I had my phone in my pocket, it kept cutting in and out of the sound! I don’t recommend walking with your phone, set it down on a table or something but don’t bring it with you. Otherthan it cutting in and out when you walk with your phone it’s sound quality is great! I have a Samsung Brightside Phone which is a really old phone the Bluetooth worked with the Headphones! Great product and Truly Invisible.

title: Excellent voice recording
review:
This microphone is so easy to use. I plugged it in to a USB socket, and I was away! I now have great voice recordings/transmissions!
For Skype calls, it is simply wonderful - I am freed from my headset!
For recording on videos it is excellent! the sound quality is amazing - from something so small!

And, although it is small, it is good quality, the base is heavy enough to prevent vibrations and noisy wobbles. The gooseneck is also very strong and will hold the mic exactly as you want it. The USB cable is long enough for most needs.

I have been looking at much more expensive microphones. To my ears, this is as good as ones ten times this price

title: Great microphone quality
review: Great for xbox one gaming with great microphone quality, audio quality is amazing! I like that the microphone can come out instead of being out all the time. I asked my friend how my mic audio sounded because my last headset’s mic audio was horrible, he said this headset’s mic audio was like talking directly to me in real life. The headset has great LEDs that can be powered by a power bank by usb cable, next to the 3.5mm audio cable.

title: Very good student/work computer
review:
This is a very good PC. at 3.6 Ghz, its not the fastest on the market, but it is fast! The memory (16 GB Optane and 8 GB DDR4) is going to have everything flying. You could easily have all your work applications open, and this is not going to slow down!
Windows 10 Home was an odd choice. This isn't really a gaming rig, the core is good, but the graphics are not good enough for game animations. And the 300 Watt Power Supply limits expansion.

Bluetooth 5.0 is excellent! Easily dock your smart-phone and even your headset with this!

And having wifi built in means no more ugly cards, or ugly cables!

For college/university/work this is a perfect computer. For gaming, it will leave you wanting.

title: Comffortable, easy to use, over-rides computers audio in and out
review:
Skype, or VOIP from your PC?
Play games/listen to music/watch tv or movies on your computer?

Then you need this.
I plug it
in, my phone is routed to a very clear and comfortable headset. I finish my shift, want to watch something or play a game, I unplug the USB lead, and all my sounds come out of my computer's speakers again.

That alone makes this item a necessity.
On top of that, I like that:
The wire is plenty long enough
The sound quality is very exceptional
It weighs next to nothing!
It is ever so comfortable to wear
The microphone picks up my voice really easily,

The only thing I dislike is that I didn't have it sooner!

title: very good sweat proof headphones!
review:
I liked most of these, with a couple of issues - nothing bad enough to cost it its five-star review!

I like how one size fits all, but confess to having doubts about that. Evey headphone I have had in the past has come with three or four different size sleeves for the ear piece. However, I have to confess that it fit me very well - so would a different size benefit anyone else?

The sound is exceptional. The three little buttons on one ear-piece are tricky to use. They are very light-weight and ever-so comfortable.

title: Exceptionally good case, especialy for the price.
review:
Very good case. Excellent cable management throughout, two powerful and silent large fans, and a clear panel to see whats happening inside.
The clear panel on the side is good for the younger users who want to show off all the lights. For us more established users, here is why you want this case:
For the price, it's amazing!
The cable management, whilst keeping the wires out of the way to make it look good, also makes air flow easier - better to keep your system running at cooler speeds
Good cable management also makes later upgrades easier - no wires to work around as you add that memory, install that video car upgrade.
The front of the case is very nice - on top, there is a row of easy-to-get-at power switch, USB 3, USB, headphone and microphone

The quality of the case is excellent - it's not lacking anywhere.

For gaming or power computing, this is a great case.

title: Great gift and they sound great!
review:
These headphones are a lot of fun! At first I thought, they looked very cheap and I thought they wouldn't sound good, I was proved wrong! These sound really nice and not tinny sounding.

These would make a great gift for anyone!

title: Stop taking flat photos and build a library of 3d landscapes!
review:
This is an exceptional product - and at this price, its amazing!
Take photos/videos that you can change the angle of when viewing (by clicking and dragging) or that you can use with a VR headset.
Make your own virtual landscapes!

This is impressively easy to use, although frustrating hat you connect to it over wifi - with it behaving as the wifi access point. Irritating, but not that bad. And for all the good well worth it!
Easily share anything in the VR world, Fantastic.

The case that comes with it is poor, and offers little protection. You will want to invest in better protection, but beyond that, I canont fault this.
I am using it almost daily now!

Easy to set up, easy to use, and amazing to use!

title: Great quality and wonderful sound
review: These in-ear headphone buds are great! The sound is amazing! It's like a personal concert in your ears! I found both the bass and the tremble sounds really good. It's extremely lightweight sometimes I forget I'm wearing them. With the right size earbuds, they're really comfortable! The Bluetooth range is really good to whatever device I pair them with. After thoroughly reading the instructions, I learned everything I need to use it for everyday use. I'm not a sporty person so I don't use sport fins that come with it.

title: Great splitter, works very well.
review:
This is great for my lap top, when I use it on my desktop and have a separate mic and headphones.
no loss in audio quality, no interference - a great splitter.
I like how well made it is, doesnt feel like the connections will come loose, from how the headphones and microphone plug into the sockets to how securely the wires go into the molded plug and sockets.

title: Good little USB to audio device - protect your laptops audio connectors!
review:
I like this, I can hook up my docking station, and plug this into one of the USB's, and now I have my mic and headphones connected without having to connect them - and without having to wear out the ports on my laptop.
Which helps life of my laptop, which makes this very cheap insurance!
Audio quality is excellent both in and out, on Windows 10 it could not have been easier to install and configure.
Its small and strong, the cable affording some flexibility between the USB plug and the audio sockets.
